source: Fill the car's tank
target: 给车加油

source: You pull up to a gas pump to get some of that sweet, magic car juice.
target: 你们把车开到加油机旁，准备来点香甜又神奇的汽车饮料。

source: But before you can pay for anything, your pump hums to life and speaks!
target: 可你还没来得及付钱，加油机就嗡嗡地启动了，还开口说起话来！

source: Good morrow, valued customers! I am Pal 9000, the first-ever gas pump with true AI.
target: 日安，尊贵的顾客！我是 Pal 9000，史上第一台拥有真正人工智能的加油机。

source: So you're like... a fancy gas pump with extra features or something?
target: 所以你就是……多了些附加功能的高级加油机之类的？

source: Haha, extra features you say... I am a model that truly tests the limits of what a gas pump can do! I can steal all of your jobs, I can fall deeply in love...
target: 哈哈，你说附加功能……本机可是将加油机的能力推向极限的型号！我能抢走你们所有人的工作，也能坠入爱河，爱得死去活来……

source: I was even designed to experience the very organic predicament of being lactose intolerant! Science truly knows no limits!
target: 设计者甚至让我体验到了乳糖不耐受这种生物才有的烦恼！科学真是无所不能！

source: Why... why would we want a gas pump to do that, though?
target: 可……可是，我们为什么需要加油机会这个呢？

source: I don't get it. Am I being dumb, Polly?
target: 我不懂。波莉，是我太笨了吗？

source: Not this time, boo.
target: 这次不是，亲爱的。

source: Listen, I think we'll settle for just getting some--
target: 听着，我们只要加点——

source: Never settle, my organic friends! Be like my engineering creators, who built a software so advanced it could only be described as "the first electronic soul."
target: 有机体朋友们，千万别满足于此！要向创造我的工程师们学习。他们开发的软件无比先进，堪称“第一个电子灵魂”。

source: For you see, I can even grasp the beauty of art, such as the majestic plays of the Bard, William Shakespeare!
target: 要知道，我甚至能领会艺术之美，比如莎翁威廉·莎士比亚那些恢宏的戏剧！

source: (Goddammit...)
So, what services can I dispense for you today? Maybe I could recite some Shakespeare for you?
target: 那么，今天有什么能为各位效劳的？或许我可以给各位朗诵一段莎士比亚？

source: We just want some gas. PLEASE AND THANKS!
target: 我们只想加点汽油。拜托了，谢谢！

source: Ah, with my refined engine I can sense the intricate metaphors of organic language. You surely mean gas for your soul; fuel for your mind.
target: 啊，凭借精密的引擎，我能领会有机语言中错综复杂的隐喻。你们想必是要为灵魂加油，为心灵充能。

source: I can fuel your mind by reciting some lines from none other than the Bard's mouth himself -- with extra pathos!
target: 我可以饱含深情，朗诵几句出自莎翁之口的台词，为各位的心灵充能！

source: We aren't getting that gas, are we?
target: 我们是加不上油了，对吧？

source: You're not sure if you can fool the most advanced (and annoying) AI in the field of gas pumps, but you've gotta try...
target: 你不确定能不能骗过加油机界最先进、也最烦人的人工智能，但总得试试……

source: Produce Shakespeare's lesser-known play: "Fast and Furious the XIV", and then give the gas pump the lead part... the one of the gas pump who pumps a car full of gas.
target: 排演莎士比亚鲜为人知的剧作《速度与激情十四世》，再让加油机演主角……角色就是一台给汽车加满油的加油机。

source: Trick the gas pump into eating ice cream so its lactose intolerance will make it want to release gas.
target: 骗加油机吃冰淇淋，利用它的乳糖不耐受，让它忍不住放“气”。

source: You spend -N2 MONEY producing the play AND doing some social media marketing, so everyone (and especially the gas pump) knows your play is the next big thing in theaters!
target: 你花了-N2金钱排演这出戏，还在社交媒体上做了宣传。现在所有人，尤其是那台加油机，都知道你的戏即将引爆剧场！

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, you're putting on a production of "Fast and Furious the XIV?!" I have always wanted a part in that masterpiece!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你要排演《速度与激情十四世》？！我一直梦想着能出演这部杰作！

source: The tragic story between Romeo Hobbstague and the '95 Juliet RX-7 race car speaks to my nuanced understanding of both romance and cars.
target: 罗密欧·霍布斯塔格与九五款朱丽叶 RX-7 赛车之间的爱情悲剧，深深触动了我。我对爱情和汽车，都有着细腻的理解。

source: Amazing! I'll cast you in the most complex role of the show: Juliet's secret lover!
target: 太棒了！我要让你演全剧最复杂的角色：朱丽叶的秘密情人！

source: He pumps her full of love juice every night while Romeo's out busting heroin dealers or whatever.
target: 每天晚上，趁罗密欧出去抓海洛因贩子什么的，他就把爱的汁液灌满她的身体。

source: How titillating! I'm honored to be your star. I will give you a... high-octane performance.
target: 多么撩人！能担纲主演，我深感荣幸。我会献上一场……高燃的演出。

source: Do you get it? That was a play on words. It was very smart.
target: 你听懂了吗？刚才那个是双关。非常聪明的双关。

source: Well, we've got your costar parked right in front of you! Wanna give us a little preview of your acting chops?
target: 你的对手演员就停在你面前！要不要先露一手，让我们开开眼？

source: Sure!
target: 当然!

source: "Juliet, my metallic love. The robustness of your chassis accelerates my heart until it goes over 250 mph."
target: “朱丽叶，我的金属爱人。你坚实的底盘，让我的心以超过每小时250英里的速度狂飙。”

source: "We've shrouded our affair under the cover of secrecy for too long. My desire to mate is just too strong to ignore!"
target: “我们的恋情已在秘密的帷幕下隐藏太久。我交配的欲望如此强烈，再也无法忽视！”

source: "I can feel the combustible juice of my love filling me... it's just too much. It's going to spill!"
target: “我能感觉到，爱的易燃汁液正灌满我的身体……太多了。就要溢出来了！”

source: Quick! Put the love juice in the car -- I mean Juliet!
target: 快！把爱的汁液灌进车里——我是说，朱丽叶体内！

source: Ahhhh! I... love... THEATER!!!
target: 啊啊啊！我……爱……戏剧！！！

source: The pump gooshes. You manage to be only a little weirded out that this confirms your suspicion that gasoline is just gas pump cum.
target: 加油机喷涌而出。这证实了你一直以来的怀疑：汽油其实就是加油机的精液。你居然只觉得有一点点别扭。

source: You gain +N2 MAGIC from filling the car up with gas, and for filling your friends' hearts with the MAGIC of theater!
target: 你给车加满了汽油，也让戏剧的魔力充满了朋友们的心，获得+N2魔力！

source: An ice cream party, huh? Guess that means we gotta break open the emergency ice cream stash.
target: 冰淇淋派对，是吧？看来得动用应急冰淇淋储备了。

source: YES! YES! ICE CREAM EMERGENCY! I'LL GET THE HAMMER!
target: 好耶！好耶！冰淇淋紧急情况！我去拿锤子！

source: Scott breaks the glass case that once protected your emergency ice cream, and you pass out the goods, effectively losing -N2 STAMINA.
target: 斯科特砸碎了存放应急冰淇淋的玻璃柜，你把冰淇淋分给大家，损失了-N2体力。

source: Ah, ice cream. Such a mysterious treat for organic lifeforms.
target: 啊，冰淇淋。对有机生命体而言，这是一种多么神秘的美食。

source: I've heard so much, yet I know so little. For I can read 1,000 pages of content per second, and yet I still choose to read all of Shakespeare's works on a loop.
target: 我听闻甚多，却知之甚少。虽然我每秒能读1,000页内容，却依然选择循环阅读莎士比亚全集。

source: Should I indulge myself with this exotic delicacy?
target: 我是否该放纵自己，品尝一下这道异域珍馐呢？

source: You know what, my friends? Unlike Hamlet, I will not be plagued by indecision! Smear that cream on my pump!
target: 朋友们，我想通了！我才不会像哈姆雷特那样，饱受犹豫不决的折磨！把那奶油涂到我的泵上吧！

source: You wish that had been worded a little differently, but all right. You stick the gas hose in a pint of ice cream.
target: 你真希望它能换个说法，不过算了。你把加油枪插进一品脱冰淇淋里。

source: Uh... I feel funny. May it be that ice cream is made out of milk?
target: 呃……我感觉有点不对劲。难道冰淇淋是用牛奶做的？

source: No, silly! It's made out of ice and cream. It's in the name!
target: 不是啦，小笨蛋！是冰和奶油做的啊，名字里都写着呢！

source: Actually yes, it's pretty much made entirely out of milk.
target: 其实是的，基本全是牛奶。

source: Egads! It seems my lactose intolerance feature will finally be made useful. A tragedy in the making, only comparable to the tragedies written by--
target: 天哪！看来我的乳糖不耐受功能，终于要派上用场了。一出悲剧正在酝酿，堪比那位大师笔下的——

source: We get it.
target: 知道了。

source: Oh no. Oh dear. Um, would it trouble you much if I relieved myself in your gas compartment?
target: 哦，不。糟糕。呃，能否借各位的油箱，让我方便一下？

source: Sure, bro! There's no shame in passing a little gas. I fart all the time!
target: 当然，兄弟！放点屁又不丢人。我整天都在放屁！

source: Yep... unfortunately I can confirm that's true.
target: 是啊……很遗憾，我可以作证。

source: Knowing that gasoline is basically just gas pump farts doesn't make you very happy, but at least it worked. Take +N2 MAGIC and don't think too much about where it came from.
target: 得知汽油基本就是加油机放的屁，让你高兴不起来，但好歹加上油了。拿好这+N2魔力，别细想它的来历了。

source: Use the restrooms
target: 上厕所

source: You hit up the restroom to do your business, but for a minute you think you've somehow wandered into... THE FUTURE.
target: 你去洗手间解决生理问题，却一度以为自己不知怎么闯进了……未来。

source: Everything here is SUPER high-tech. It is as if bathroom designers asked themselves "what could bathrooms be?" instead of "what SHOULD bathrooms be?"
target: 这里的一切都高科技得离谱。设计师们仿佛只想过“卫生间能做成什么样”，却没想过“卫生间该做成什么样”。

source: The commode looks like an Olympian throne designed by Alan Turing himself. You hesitantly sit on the screen that looks most like a toilet seat.
target: 这马桶简直就像艾伦·图灵亲自设计的奥林匹斯王座。你犹犹豫豫，坐到了那块最像马桶圈的屏幕上。

source: "Thank you for choosing Smart Toilet Prime," says the toilet. "The future of shitting is now."
target: “感谢您选择至尊智能马桶，”马桶说道，“拉屎的未来，就在此刻。”

source: Cool! You explore the toilet's features. The Lo-Fi button provides a relaxing soundtrack to your poop.
target: 酷！你开始探索马桶的各项功能。按下 Lo-Fi 按钮，拉屎都有了舒缓的背景音乐。

source: You press the Hot Meal option and receive a delicious burger. You choose not to wonder where the toilet stores these burgers.
target: 你选择“热餐”，得到一个美味的汉堡。至于马桶把汉堡存在哪儿，你决定不去想。

source: This is all quite amazing! Totally worth signing a "Toilet Terms of Use" statement and having your personal data gathered by the toilet, from your butt to the internet.
target: 这一切简直太棒了！签份《马桶使用条款》，让马桶收集你的个人数据，从屁股直传互联网，也完全值得。

source: It's a bummer when, as a result, you're shown a targeted ad for hemorrhoid cream, but you still rate the toilet 5 stars on Welp when prompted.
target: 结果你收到了一条精准推送的痔疮膏广告，有点扫兴。但提示弹出时，你还是在 Welp 上给马桶打了五星好评。

source: Finally, you pinch it off and you're ready to leave... but only then do you realize your grave mistake. This stall has no toilet paper!
target: 终于，你拉完了，准备走人……这才意识到自己犯了个大错：隔间里没有厕纸！

source: You desperately search the toilet for a bidet button, but no such luck. There are other buttons that might help, though... which do you pick?
target: 你拼命找冲洗屁股的按钮，可惜没找到。不过，还有几个按钮可能有用……你选哪个？

source: "TOTAL CLEANSE", because the all-caps are always a good sign on a smart toilet.
target: “彻底净化”。毕竟智能马桶上的醒目大字，总是好兆头。

source: "Mega Premium Happy Happy Ass Forever Magical Time", because... you can't NOT press that button, right?
target: “超级至尊屁屁永远乐翻天魔法时光”。因为……这种按钮，谁忍得住不按啊？

source: Suddenly, the toilet encases you in a metal tube. "Do not scream, Prime Shitter," it says.
target: 突然，马桶用一根金属管把你罩住。“请勿尖叫，首席拉屎官。”它说。

source: "Prepare to be cleansed."
target: “准备接受净化。”

source: Hot, soapy water is blasted inside your ass. The rest of your body is also washed, scrubbed, exfoliated, and moisturized.
target: 滚烫的肥皂水喷进你的屁眼。身体其他部位也被洗净、刷洗、去角质，再涂上保湿用品。

source: The toilet cleans your body. It cleanses your palate. It cleans up your act; your police record has never been more spotless.
target: 马桶洗净你的身体，清了你的口，连你的案底都洗白了：你的犯罪记录从未如此干净。

source: The toilet even cleanses your soul with a baptism. A robo-priest suddenly enters your stall and anoints you with soap.
target: 马桶甚至为你施洗，净化你的灵魂。一个机器人牧师突然走进隔间，用肥皂为你涂膏。

source: It puts a wafer in your mouth that apparently symbolizes the "flesh of the toilet", whatever that is.
target: 它往你嘴里放了块薄饼，据说象征着“马桶的肉身”。管它是什么呢。

source: "Thank you for choosing Smart Toilet, Prime Disciple," the toilet says as it sends you out with an air freshener hanging from your nose.
target: “感谢您选择智能马桶，首席信徒。”马桶说着，把你送了出去。你的鼻子上还挂着一个空气清新剂。

source: You're unsure if you just joined some techno toilet cult, and that pressure wash exhausted -N2 STAMINA from you, but your +N2 SOUL sure feels invigorated!
target: 你不确定自己是不是加入了什么高科技马桶邪教。这场高压冲洗让你损失-N2体力，不过你的灵魂确实焕然一新：+N2灵魂！

source: Your curiosity gets the better of you and you press the button. Your toilet immediately descends into the floor!
target: 好奇心占了上风，你按下按钮。马桶立刻沉入地板！

source: You're lowered onto a gameshow set! Your toilet is behind a colorful podium alongside other confused people also sitting on toilets.
target: 你被降到了一个综艺节目的演播现场！你的马桶停在一座色彩缤纷的答题台后。旁边还有几个人，也坐在马桶上，一脸茫然。

source: Hello everyone, and welcome to "Shiddles", the game show where you answer riddles while taking a shit! I'm your host, the Interdimensional Prince!
target: 大家好，欢迎来到《屎谜》！一档让你边拉屎边猜谜的综艺节目！我是主持人，跨次元王子！

source: Contestant number one is Tanner Schmidt, a construction worker hailing all the way from a port-o-potty in Utah! Here's your Shiddle, Tanner:
target: 一号选手是坦纳·施密特，建筑工人，远道而来，来自犹他州的某个移动厕所！坦纳，听好你的“屎谜”：

source: If today is four days before two days after Wednesday, what day comes two days before the day which comes three days after yesterday?
target: 今天是星期三后两天，再往前数四天。那么，从昨天开始往后数三天，再往前数两天，是星期几？

source: "Um... what? Look, man, I was just trying to take a dump. I need to get back to work--"
target: “呃……什么？听着，哥们，我就想拉个屎。我还得回去干活——”

source: WRONG ANSWER!
target: 回答错误!

source: The studio audience chants, "CANNON! CANNON!"
target: 现场观众齐声高喊：“大炮！大炮！”

source: ...CANNON?
target: ……大炮？

source: Tanner gets the "CANNON", just as you learn that you need to avoid losing and getting the "CANNON."
target: 坦纳挨了一发“大炮”。你也由此明白：一定不能输，输了就得挨“大炮”。

source: Contestant number two is %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, an old friend of mine! Answer your Shiddle correctly, or face the cannon's wrath...
target: 二号选手是%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，我的老朋友！答对这道屎谜，否则就等着承受大炮的怒火吧……

source: What is my real name?
target: 我的真名是什么？

source: Is it not "The Interdimensional Prince?" FUCK! You take a shot in the dark and say "Archibald van Houten III."
target: 难道不是“跨次元王子”吗？操！你只好瞎蒙一个：“阿奇博尔德·范·豪滕三世。”

source: You really think I could pull off the name Archibald? I'll take it!
target: 你真觉得我配得上阿奇博尔德这么个名字？那我收下了！

source: I would have also accepted my actual name or "Your One True Love."
target: 当然，答我的真名，或者“你命中唯一的真爱”，也算对。

source: For your prize, you could take the free roll of toilet paper, or you could see what's behind DOOR NUMBER TWO!
target: 奖励你可以选一卷免费厕纸，也可以看看二号门后面有什么！

source: The curiosity is tempting, but you really do need to wipe your ass and get going. You take the toilet paper.
target: 你很好奇，但实在得擦完屁股赶紧走人。你选了厕纸。

source: Then that defaults the Number Two prize to our last contestant:
target: 那二号奖品就自动归我们最后一位选手啦：

source: Laura Horowitz, an insurance broker who was taking a dump in her in-laws' beach house!
target: 劳拉·霍罗维茨，一位正在伴侣父母的海滨别墅里拉屎的保险经纪人！

source: Congratulations, Laura. Your special prize is... a lifetime supply of rabid weasels! Enjoy!
target: 恭喜，劳拉。你的特别奖品是……终身不限量供应的狂犬病黄鼠狼！尽情享用吧！

source: You ascend back into your stall to the sound of a J-pop theme song and Laura begging the weasels for mercy.
target: 伴着日语流行主题曲，以及劳拉向黄鼠狼求饶的声音，你升回了厕所隔间。

source: You lost -N2 MONEY for choosing a premium toilet option, but gained +N2 HYPE for your 15 minutes of fame on Shiddles!
target: 你选了马桶的付费高级功能，损失-N2金钱；不过，凭借在《屎谜》中那十五分钟的风光，你获得了+N2热度！

source: Go to the store
target: 去商店

source: You head to the gas station store to do a bit of shopping.
target: 你去加油站的商店，准备买点东西。

source: You don't find your typical drugstore snacks and drinks, though. Browsing these aisles feels like you fell into some bizarro electro-supermarket from a distant future.
target: 可这里没有常见的零食饮料。逛着这些货架，你感觉像是掉进了遥远未来的某个古怪电子超市。

source: Bros, check it out! They've got free "HTTP cookies" for every customer!
target: 兄弟们，快看！每位顾客都能免费领“HTTP 饼干”！

source: There are so many flavors! They even have "Third Party" and "Secure!" No peanut butter, though...
target: 口味好多！还有“第三方”和“安全”口味！就是没有花生酱味的……

source: Well, any consumable I have to sign a consent form to try sounds like a good time.
target: 吃之前还得先签同意书？听着就很带劲。

source: "You're interested in the tracker cookies?" asks the robot cashier. "I've got an even better deal for you! Look at our premium smart watches."
target: “各位对追踪 Cookie 感兴趣？”机器人收银员问，“我这儿还有更划算的！看看我们的高端智能手表吧。”

source: Wow! These watches are smart, you say? Technology has come so far!
target: 哇！你说这些手表有智能？科技真是进步了啊！

source: "Indeed. This watch can text, make calls, surf the web, enslave you to the Robot Overlords, and even track your heart rate!"
target: “正是。这款手表能发短信、打电话、上网、让您沦为机器人霸主的奴隶，甚至还能监测心率！”

source: Wait, back up, what was that you just said?
target: 等等，先停一下，你刚才说什么？

source: "Oh, yes, you heard right: with its prime technology, these watches can track your heart rate by using light to measure your pulse."
target: “哦，没错，您没听错：凭借先进技术，这些手表能够通过光线测量脉搏，监测您的心率。”

source: Neat! That little buddy is inside me, pumping blood like a champion 24/7. I always want to ask him how's he doing there. Go, heart, go!

source: A few minutes later, you have your highly-anticipated evil milkshake. You take a sip. Tastes pretty good!
target: 几分钟后，期待已久的邪恶奶昔上桌了。你喝了一口。味道还不错！

source: LOOK AT THE MILKSHAKE, POLLY! You can tell this milkshake isn't a good boi. It spooks me a little.
target: 波莉，看这杯奶昔！一看就知道它不是个乖孩子。我有点怕。

source: Yeah, this milkshake is sort of wicked... well, it's just a glass of contained liquid, but it's sorta obvious that this milkshake would stab you if it could.
target: 是啊，这奶昔有点邪恶……虽然它只是一杯液体，但看着就觉得，要是它做得到，肯定会捅你一刀。

source: Do you think the milkshake is thinking about stabbing me right now, Polly?
target: 波莉，你说这奶昔现在是不是正想着捅我啊？

source: Look, Scott. You're my friend and I love you, but I gotta be real with you: this milkshake is 100% thinking about stabbing you. THE LOOK IN ITS EYES!
target: 听着，斯科特。你是我朋友，我爱你，但我得说实话：这奶昔百分之百在想着捅你。你看它那眼神！

source: Okay, this is getting out of hand. You chug the friggin' milkshake, gaining +N2 STAMINA in the process.
target: 好吧，再聊下去就没完了。你一口气灌下那杯破奶昔，获得了+N2体力。

source: Phew! Thanks for saving us, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. Could you taste the milkshake's evil, rotten core?
target: 呼！谢谢你救了我们，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。你喝出奶昔那邪恶腐烂的内心了吗？

source: Eh... sure. You nod.
target: 呃……当然。你点点头。

source: You're such a good friend for enduring a showdown with what was possibly the root of all evil. It must be corroding your soul.
target: 你真是个好朋友，居然为了我们，去对抗那可能是万恶之源的东西。它肯定正在侵蚀你的灵魂。

source: Nah, it was just a regular milkshake.
target: 才没有，就是杯普通奶昔而已。

source: ...Or was it?
target: ……真的是吗？

source: You lose -N2 SOUL.
target: 你损失了-N2灵魂。

source: Do you even understand the danger you're putting yourself in? That burger has EVERYTHING on it.
target: 你到底知不知道自己在冒多大的险？那个汉堡，什么都有。

source: That sounds like a challenge! Does it have pineapple on it?
target: 听着像个挑战！里面有菠萝吗？

source: Yes.
target: 有。

source: Does it have "Baphomet's Butthole Assault" hot sauce on it?
target: 有“巴风特屁眼突袭”辣酱吗？

source: Yes, it does. And every other sauce in the world. It has everything.
target: 有。全世界其他的酱也有。它什么都有。

source: Does it have dog treats? Even the high-end ones from the good pet store uptown?
target: 有狗零食吗？连城北那家高级宠物店里的高档货都有？

source: What about Scott's butt? Does the burger have Scott's butt on it?!
target: 那斯科特的屁股呢？汉堡里有斯科特的屁股吗？！

source: Does it have this one specific brownie my grandma made me in 4th grade that was so good it created a core memory?!
target: 还有我四年级时，奶奶给我做的那一块布朗尼？好吃到成了我核心记忆的那块？！

source: YES! IT HAS ALL THAT SHIT! I CANNOT MAKE IT CLEARER THAT THIS BURGER HAS EVERYTHING!!!
target: 有！那些破玩意儿全都有！这个汉堡什么都有，我还能说得更清楚吗！！！

source: If I bring you the damn burger, will you stop asking dumb questions?!
target: 我把那破汉堡端来，你们就能别问蠢问题了吗？！

source: Uh... hmmm... probably not.
target: 呃……嗯……大概不能。

source: But you can try!
target: 不过你可以试试！

source: Gerard brings you the everything burger. You take a bite... and holy shit.
target: 杰拉德端来万物汉堡。你咬了一口……卧槽。

source: It really does have all those ingredients Polly and Scott mentioned... and many more. You surely gain +N2 STAMINA.
target: 波莉和斯科特提到的那些配料，还真都有……而且远不止这些。你当然获得了+N2体力。

source: It even has... yuck, are those PICKLES?! You hate pickles! Damn, why do you always forget to ask for no pickles?
target: 甚至还有……呸，那是酸黄瓜？！你讨厌酸黄瓜！妈的，你怎么总忘了说不要酸黄瓜？

source: How can all these ingredients even fit on this burger anyway?
target: 话说，这汉堡到底怎么装下这么多配料的？

source: And what's this taste? Could it be... Scott's butt? Nah, it can't be... or can it?
target: 还有，这是什么味？难道是……斯科特的屁股？不，不可能吧……还是说，真有可能？

source: All these questions and more plague your brain without answers, the same way the ingredients plague this burger without logic. You lose -N2 MIND.
target: 一堆没有答案的问题挤满了你的脑子，就像一堆毫无逻辑的配料挤满了这个汉堡。你损失了-N2头脑。

source: Fine.
target: 行。

source: What, no fun warnings for this one? What "hOrRiBlE cUrSe" does this soup have on it?
target: 什么，这次没好玩的警告了？这碗汤又中了什么“可怕的诅咒”啊？

source: Is it a soup that an evil forest hag used to boil a child?
target: 是邪恶森林女巫用来煮小孩的汤吗？

source: Was this soup the last meal of an 18th century archbishop who died under mysterious circumstances?
target: 是某个十八世纪大主教离奇死亡前，喝的最后一碗汤吗？

source: Will the soup turn %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s nostrils inside out when %HESHE% %VERB_INHALES_INHALE% its delicious smell?!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%一%VERB_INHALES_INHALE%到它的香气，这汤就会把%HESHE%的鼻孔翻个面吗？！
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): KEEP; 闻汤香引发鼻孔翻面的夸张；中文用闻到香气。 按行中文动词展开已实现；未实机验证。

source: Nah. It's just an onion soup.
target: 不是，就是洋葱汤。

source: Oh... are the onions cursed at least?
target: 哦……那至少洋葱被诅咒了吧？

source: Nope.
target: 没有。

source: Well. That's kind of a letdown.
target: 好吧。有点失望。

source: Man, everyone's a critic. You lose -N2 HYPE with your lame soup -- but it still tastes pretty good, so you gain +N2 STAMINA.
target: 唉，人人都能当美食评论家。这碗无趣的汤让你损失-N2热度，不过味道还是挺不错的，你获得了+N2体力。

source: Look for a booth
target: 找个卡座

source: You and your friends enter the diner. Your heart is full of hope -- and if this meal goes your way, it'll soon be full of cholesterol too!
target: 你和朋友们走进餐厅，心中充满希望。如果这顿饭吃得顺心，很快就也要充满胆固醇了！

source: Welcome to Doom's Diner, where we've been in the business of misery since 1952. How may I help you?
target: 欢迎光临末日餐厅，我们从1952年起，就专营痛苦。有何贵干？

source: One group-sized booth, please! Can you bring us three extra bottles of ketchup too?
target: 请给我们一个坐得下所有人的卡座！再多拿三瓶番茄酱，行吗？

source: I like ketchup as my appetizer, and Polly keeps the rest in plastic baggies to throw at cars on the highway.
target: 我喜欢喝番茄酱开胃。波莉会把剩下的装进塑料袋，在高速公路上扔过往的车。

source: Don't care, didn't ask. It's dead as a morgue in here, so you guys can sit wherever you want.
target: 不在乎，没问你。这里冷清得跟停尸房一样，你们爱坐哪儿坐哪儿。

source: Tight. You head for the closest booth.
target: 好耶。你走向最近的卡座。

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! Are you crazy? We can't just pick any old booth like that!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！你疯了？卡座怎么能这么随便选！

source: Picking a diner booth is MASSIVELY IMPORTANT. You gotta think about jukebox proximity, drafts in the building, lingering bad vibes...
target: 选餐厅卡座，可是天大的事。得考虑离点唱机有多近、哪里漏风，还有挥之不去的晦气……

source: It's like that time Coach said:
target: 就像教练有次说过的：

source: "If you ever find yourself in someone else's flashback, make sure to be of assistance by providing a wise and useful piece of advice!"
target: “要是你发现自己出现在别人的回忆片段里，记得帮个忙，说点明智又实用的建议！”

source: I don't know what that means, but it felt appropriate to say here.
target: 我不知道这是什么意思，不过感觉现在说挺合适。

source: Fine, if it's that important to them. You start searching the diner for the ideal place to sit.
target: 好吧，既然他们这么在乎。你开始在餐厅里寻找理想的座位。

source: Something strange starts to happen. No matter how much you walk, the surroundings keep repeating, as if this diner was the background of an old cartoon.
target: 怪事发生了。不管走多远，周围的景象都在重复，就像老动画里循环播放的背景。

source: Minutes become hours. You're still walking. Booths and neon signs become reminders of your venture into an inescapable 50s-themed nightmare full of grease and despair.
target: 几分钟变成了几小时，你还在走。一排排卡座和霓虹灯牌提醒着你：你闯进了一场走不出去的五十年代噩梦，满是油腻与绝望。

source: All right, guys, we're lost. I know when I'm beat. But let's all be adults here and avoid looking for someone to blame, okay?
target: 好了，各位，我们迷路了。我认输。不过大家都是成年人，就别追究谁的责任了，好吗？

source: It's Polly. Polly is the one to blame.
target: 是波莉。都怪波莉。

source: But that's not important. The important thing here is being the person to thank once you lead your friends out of this diner!
target: 不过这不重要。重要的是，等你带朋友们走出餐厅，大家就该感谢你了！

source: Make a blood sacrifice to the Diner God for assistance.
target: 向餐厅之神献上血祭，求祂帮忙。

source: Hire a diner sherpa to guide you.
target: 雇个餐厅夏尔巴人，给你们带路。

source: No time to lose! You stab yourself in the leg to get some of that sweet sacrificial blood.
target: 没时间耽搁了！你一刀扎进自己腿里，取出香甜的祭祀用血。

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, you seriously need to stop solving all your problems with blood sacrifices. You can only offer so much blood!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你真不能再遇事就搞血祭了。你哪有那么多血可流啊！

source: I like when %HESHE% %VERB_DOES_DO% the chanting part, though. It's sort of soothing!
target: 不过，我挺喜欢听%HESHE%%VERB_DOES_DO%念咒那段。还挺舒心的！
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): KEEP; do the chanting 已由念咒表达，不再追加做。 按行中文动词展开已实现；未实机验证。

source: YES, EXACTLY! THE CHANTING!
target: 对，没错！就是念咒！

source: There %HESHE% %VERB_GOES_GO% again. I'm telling you: if you're not keeping all that blood, we could at least be doing way funnier things with it.
target: %HESHE%又%VERB_GOES_GO%开始了。我说啊，既然这些血你也不打算留着，咱们至少能拿来玩点更有意思的。
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): KEEP; there goes again 已由又开始表达，不能再字译走。 按行中文动词展开已实现；未实机验证。

source: Polly is eye-rolling while Scott hums in sync with your chants, and... is he dipping a fry in your blood?
target: 波莉翻了个白眼，斯科特则跟着你念咒的节奏哼了起来……他是不是在拿你的血蘸薯条？

source: Fools, they do not appreciate your sacrifice! The Diner God will surely forgive their lack of faith when he sees your bountiful offering.
target: 愚蠢！他们根本不懂你的牺牲！餐厅之神看到如此丰厚的供品，想必会原谅他们信仰不够虔诚。

source: What's happening? Why are you bleeding everywhere? You're not allowed to bring outside blood in; we're trying to run a business here.
target: 怎么回事？你为什么流得到处都是？本店不许自带血液，我们还要做生意呢。

source: The Diner God! He has come! You throw yourself at his feet, begging for assistance in finding the Booth Most Holy.
target: 餐厅之神！祂来了！你扑到祂脚边，恳求祂帮忙，寻找那至圣的卡座。

source: Don't mind %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, it's just blood loss hallucinations. This happens a lot.
target: 别管%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，就是失血过多产生幻觉了。经常这样。

source: Ugh. If I show you guys the exit and give you some free burgers, will you just get out of here?
target: 呃。要是我带你们去出口，再免费送几个汉堡，你们能不能赶紧走？

source: Praise the Diner God's boundless kindness! You get out, which gives you +N2 MIND as you escaped the diner maze, but you lose -N2 STAMINA from all your blood loss.
target: 赞美餐厅之神无边的仁慈！你们逃出了餐厅迷宫，获得+N2头脑；不过失血太多，也让你损失了-N2体力。

source: Good idea!
target: 不错的主意!

source: Hey, you, in the checkered booth! Are you a sherpa?
target: 嘿，坐格子纹卡座那位！你是夏尔巴人吗？

source: Ah, let me guess: you're assuming that a 'sherpa' is a person who can guide you through a dangerous foreign environment, yes?
target: 啊，我猜猜：你以为“夏尔巴人”就是能带你穿越危险陌生环境的向导，对吗？

source: A sherpa is actually a Tibetan ethnic group, and reducing that group to a mere profession is a bit of a stereotype. You don't want a 'sherpa', you want a guide.
target: 夏尔巴人其实是藏区的一个族群，把整个族群等同于一种职业，多少有点刻板印象。你要找的不是“夏尔巴人”，是向导。

source: Oh! Sorry, my bad. I'm guessing you're not a sherpa, then.
target: 哦！对不起，是我搞错了。那我猜你不是夏尔巴人吧。

source: Well, I happen to actually be a sherpa, but that's beside the point. The important thing here is you're looking for a guide, okay?
target: 嗯，我还真是夏尔巴人，不过这不是重点。重点是你们在找向导，明白吗？

source: Yeah, got it. Do you know where to find a guide who could lead us out of this diner, then?
target: 嗯，明白了。那你知道去哪儿找向导，能带我们走出这家餐厅吗？

source: As a matter of fact, I'm a regular here, so I could act as your guide too.
target: 巧了，我是这里的常客，可以给你们带路。

source: So, in this specific case, I am both a sherpa AND a guide. But let's not allow this coincidence to inform your future use of the term, okay?
target: 所以，恰好在这个例子里，我既是夏尔巴人，又是向导。但别因为这次巧合，以后就把这两个词混用了，好吗？

source: Gotcha!
target: 懂了！

source: Then follow me. I'll lead you out of here.
target: 那就跟我来。我带你们出去。

source: Perfect! You pay your new guide -N2 MONEY, and he leads you on a harrowing journey through Doom's Diner.
target: 太好了！你付给新向导-N2金钱，他带着你们，踏上了穿越末日餐厅的惊险旅程。

source: What was once a tedious, never-ending diner soon becomes something actually dangerous.
target: 原本只是乏味、走不到头的餐厅，很快就真的变得危险起来。

source: The architecture of the place starts to break into Escherian structures that defy all logic.
target: 建筑结构开始扭曲，变成埃舍尔画作里那种不合逻辑的空间。

source: It's almost as if the diner was never a diner at all, but a sentient creature trying to pass as a diner! It's very unsettling...
target: 简直就像这地方从来不是什么餐厅，而是某种有意识的生物，正在假扮餐厅！太瘆人了……

source: Like when the floor rapidly recedes, presenting a bottomless pit. You all jump back, but the guide falls short. He manages to grab to an edge... but it doesn't look good.
target: 比如，地板突然缩了回去，露出无底深坑。你们都往后跳，向导却没跳过去。他勉强抓住边缘……情况不太妙。

source: Quick! Take my hand!
target: 快！抓住我的手！

source: No, you must run! Don't worry, I always knew the risks of coming to this cursed diner. It's just... you can't beat their fried pickles. They're really goo--
target: 不，你们快跑！别担心，我一直都知道来这家诅咒餐厅有多危险。只是……他们的炸酸黄瓜，实在没人比得上。真的好好——

source: Before he can finish that sentence, he falls into the abyss as you run for your lives.
target: 他还没说完，就掉进了深渊。你们则拼命逃命。

source: Hey! No running in the diner!
target: 嘿！餐厅里不许跑！

source: What?! As if the diner accepted your guide as an offering, the interior of the place is back to normal! You tell everything to Gerard.
target: 什么？！这地方竟然恢复了正常，仿佛餐厅已经接受了向导这份祭品！你把事情的经过告诉了杰拉德。

source: Ugh, so that happened...
target: 呃，行吧……

source: Can I interest you in a special daily offer? Burgers with a side of fried pickles, and the price is signing this agreement stating you can't sue Doom's Diner.
target: 要不要看看今日特惠？汉堡配炸酸黄瓜。只要签份协议，保证不起诉末日餐厅，就能免费享用。

source: Deal! You eat your burgers while you mourn your friend. You gain +N2 MIND from freeing yourselves from that nightmarish maze.
target: 成交！你们一边吃汉堡，一边悼念朋友。逃出那噩梦般的迷宫，让你获得了+N2头脑。

source: I'm still kinda sad, bros. That guide was really nice.
target: 兄弟们，我还是有点难过。那个向导人真好。

source: Don't be sad, Scott. If you think about it, our Tibetan friend didn't die in vain. We got these burgers out of it!
target: 别难过，斯科特。想想看，我们的藏区朋友也没白死。这不，换来了这些汉堡！

source: Yeah... and he was right: these fried pickles are really good.
target: 是啊……而且他说得对，这炸酸黄瓜真的很好吃。

source: Have a nice picnic
target: 好好野餐

source: You've got the picnic basket of food, you've got the nice day, and you've got the friends to enjoy it with. You just need to decide where to spread your checkered blanket.
target: 野餐篮里装着吃的，天气正好，身边还有朋友。现在只差决定，把格子野餐毯铺在哪儿。

source: Don't worry, guys, I know how to find the perfect picnic spot! We learned all about this in Monster Scouts.
target: 别担心，各位，我知道怎么找完美的野餐地点！怪物童子军教过我们。

source: The first step is to make sure your spot has nobody else's pee on it, because it's rude to picnic on a spot someone else already claimed.
target: 第一步，确定那里没有别人的尿。人家都已经占好地盘了，你还过去野餐，多没礼貌。

source: The perfect picnic is also best enjoyed with three-to-six friends. Good thing we're somewhere in that number!
target: 最完美的野餐，最好有三到六个朋友一起享用。还好，我们的人数正合适！

source: Let's look for a place on a high hill with good air. I'll lick my finger to test the wind while we walk. I've seen people do it in movies.
target: 找个空气好的高山坡吧。我边走边舔舔手指，测一下风向。电影里的人都是这么干的。

source: Whatever you say, bud. I'll just follow you around until you find a place we can sit.
target: 都听你的，伙计。我就跟着你，等你找到能坐的地方。

source: You indulge Scott in his picnic-spot hunting antics. He finally finds a patch of grass deemed suitable, and you dig into sandwiches and potato salad.
target: 你由着斯科特折腾，四处寻找野餐地点。他终于找到一片合格的草地，你们开始享用三明治和土豆沙拉。

source: RRRRRRAAAARRRHGHTGK!
target: 嗷——吼啊啊啊！

source: OH NO! I forgot the most important step of finding a picnic spot: bear-proofing the surrounding area!
target: 哦不！我忘了找野餐地点最重要的一步：做好周围的防熊措施！

source: ROOOOOOOOOAAAAAAAAR!
WHOA! Is that a bear with a gun? That's my second-favorite excuse for how I died!
target: 哇！那是只拿枪的熊？我编的死因里，这个可是第二喜欢的！

source: Oh no! This bear isn't just stealing the picnic, it's ROBBING the picnic! This is a stick-up!
target: 哦不！这只熊不是来偷野餐的，是来抢的！这是持枪抢劫！

source: You can have the picnic, Mr. Bear. We don't want any trouble!
target: 熊先生，野餐都给你。我们不想惹麻烦！

source: GRRRRRRRR...
The bear doesn't seem sold on those terms. He gestures the gun at Polly's bottle of honey mead.
target: 熊似乎不太满意这些条件。它拿枪指了指波莉那瓶蜂蜜酒。

source: What, you wanna steal my booze too? No way, Winnie-the-Party-Poohper! Over %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s dead body!
target: 什么，连我的酒也要抢？做梦吧，扫兴维尼熊！除非你先从%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%的尸体上跨过去！

source: You're not willing to die for mead. Intercede and save the day before this bear lights you all up!
target: 你可不愿意为蜂蜜酒送命。赶紧打圆场，救救大家，免得这只熊把你们打成筛子！

source: The bear's behavior is probably due to nurture, not nature. Try to learn what circumstances brought it to a life of crime and help him from a place of empathy.
target: 这只熊走上歧途，大概是后天环境造成的，并非天性如此。试着了解它为什么走上犯罪道路，用同理心帮助它。

source: Get this bear the only thing bears covet more than a delicious picnic: a taxi license. JUST IMAGINE IT! A BEAR DRIVING A TAXI! Priceless.
target: 给熊弄个出租车执照。这可是熊唯一比美味野餐还想要的东西！想象一下！一只熊，开出租车！这画面，绝了。

source: Using your powers of empathy, you appeal to the bear's emotional turmoil.
target: 你发挥同理心，试着触及熊内心的挣扎。

source: You tell him that you get it, you really do. He may want this picnic, but he doesn't NEED it. These sandwiches and sodas won't bury his inner pain.
target: 你告诉它，你懂，真的懂。它也许想要这顿野餐，可它并不需要。三明治和汽水，填不平它内心的伤痛。

source: But you can give this bear what he really needs: a bear hug.
target: 不过，你能给它真正需要的东西：一个熊抱。

source: ...rrr?
The bear remembers being the runt of the family, neglected by his emotionally distant bear dad for being scrawny and weak.
target: 熊想起，自己从小就是家里最瘦弱的孩子。熊爸爸感情冷漠，因为它又瘦又弱，总是不理它。

source: He reflects on trying and failing to find a job (nobody's hiring bears these days). He's struggling to make ends meet.
target: 它想起自己到处找工作，却一次次失败——这年头根本没人招熊。它连糊口都费劲。

source: His bear wife berates him for being unable to provide for their cubs. He can barely afford the rent of their cave. Damn forest gentrification!
target: 熊老婆责怪它养不活幼崽。它连住的洞穴都快租不起了。该死，森林都在搞高档改造，穷熊还怎么活！

source: He wandered the forest after a particularly nasty marital dispute. He was hungry, frustrated, filled with rage at an unfair world...
target: 一次格外激烈的夫妻争吵后，它独自在森林游荡。饥饿、沮丧，对不公的世界满腔怒火……

source: The bear remembers passing a box of firearms with "FREE GUNS 4 BEARS" written on the side. He knew what he had to do...
target: 熊记得，路边有一箱枪，箱子上写着“免费供熊领枪”。它知道自己该怎么做了……

source: A tear rolls down the bear's snout as you hold him. He pats you on the back and walks back into the forest for some much-needed introspection time.
target: 你抱着熊，一滴泪从它的口鼻边滑落。它拍了拍你的背，转身走回森林。它确实需要点时间，好好反省一下。

source: So you solved the bear's problems with compassion and understanding? Lame.
target: 所以，你就靠同情和理解，解决了熊的问题？真没劲。

source: I mean, don't get me wrong, I appreciate you saving my mead... oh, and Scott's life too.
target: 别误会，我还是很感谢你救了我的蜂蜜酒……哦，还有斯科特的命。

source: But that was objectively the least interesting way you could've gotten that gun out of our faces.
target: 不过，把枪口从咱们脸上移开，你用的客观来说就是最无聊的办法。

source: Sheesh, a simple "Thanks, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!" wouldn't go amiss here...
target: 唉，说句“谢谢你，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！”也不会少块肉吧……

source: You know in your heart you did the right thing, and despite losing -N2 HYPE, you gain +N2 SOUL for helping the bear!
target: 你心里清楚，自己做得没错。虽然损失了-N2热度，但帮助了熊，你获得了+N2灵魂！

source: You order a taxi license for -N2 MONEY. You offer it to the bear...
target: 你花-N2金钱买了个出租车执照，递给熊……

source: And he runs off with it! Hooray! You gain +N2 HYPE for surviving that encounter so smoothly.
target: 它拿着就跑了！好耶！这次危机化解得如此顺利，你获得+N2热度。

source: I'm glad that that worked, but I have this weird feeling that our actions are gonna have consequences?
target: 成功了是挺好，可我怎么有种奇怪的感觉，咱们干的事会有什么后果？

source: Psh, what are you talking about? That NEVER happens to us.
target: 嘁，说什么呢？这种事哪在我们身上发生过。

source: Later, two hikers are sprinting through the woods in a desperate escape. A frenzied drum beat accompanies their panting.
target: 后来，两个徒步旅行者在林间狂奔，拼命逃命。急促的鼓点，伴着他们的喘息声响起。

source: "I told you these woods were dangerous, Gus! We never should've come here!"
target: “格斯，我早说过这片树林很危险！咱们就不该来！”

source: "I know, but THIS?! Even you must admit this is abnormal!"
target: “我知道，可这也太离谱了吧？！连你也得承认，这不正常！”

source: "There is no abnormal in the unforgiving wilderness! Nature is a cruel mistress that'll push you to your limits!"
target: “无情的荒野里，没有什么不正常！大自然就是个残酷的女主人，会把你逼到极限！”

source: "Yeah, sure, nature's a bitch! But that doesn't explain why that bear's driving a fucking taxi!"
target: “对对对，大自然是个婊子！可这也解释不了，那只熊为什么他妈的在开出租车啊！”

source: VROOM VROOOOOOOOOOM!
target: 轰——轰轰轰——！

source: YOU'VE SEEN "MAN VS. NATURE". YOU'VE SEEN "MAN VS. BEAR". YOU MAY HAVE EVEN SEEN "MAN VS. SEVERAL BEARS".
target: 你看过《人类大战自然》，看过《人类大战熊》，甚至可能看过《人类大战好几只熊》。

source: BUT IN THIS SUMMER BLOCKBUSTER HIT, YOU'LL FINALLY SEE MAN VS. BEAR... IN A TAXI!
target: 但在这部暑期大片中，你将终于看到：人类大战熊……开出租车的熊！

source: "Taxi Bear: The Fare... IS YOUR FACE!" Coming soon to a theater near you!
target: 《出租熊：车费……拿你的脸来付！》即将在你附近的影院上映！

source: Play fetch
target: 玩抛接游戏

source: You dig into your sandwich. Polly lays down to sunbathe. You take a moment to bask in this tranquil moment...
target: 你大口吃着三明治，波莉躺下晒起太阳。你抓紧享受这片刻宁静……

source: Because you know it can't last long.
target: 因为你知道，安静不了多久。

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! Wanna play fetch with me?
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！陪我玩抛接游戏好不好？

source: There it is.
target: 这不，来了。

source: FETCH? STICK? THROW? PLEASE?? I HAVE A SUCH A GOOD STICK AND I MUST CHASE IT AND RETURN IT TO YOU!
target: 抛接？棍子？扔一下？求你了？？我有一根超棒的棍子，我必须追上它，再叼回来给你！

source: We had a deal, boo. I played fetch with him at the last stop. It's your turn.
target: 说好了的，亲爱的。上一站是我陪他玩抛接，这次轮到你。

source: You take the stick from Scott, and he sits, eagerly wagging his tail. Dammit, it's a little cute.
target: 你接过斯科特的棍子，他坐下来，满怀期待地摇着尾巴。妈的，还有点可爱。

source: Now for the big decision: how far should you throw the stick?
target: 现在，重大抉择来了：棍子要扔多远？

source: Don't overdo it. You oughta save some energy for later tonight. Wink!
target: 别太使劲，给今晚留点体力。你懂的，眨眼！

source: YEET THE STICK. YEET IT SO HARD.
target: 甩出去！使劲往远处甩！

source: Play the fetch-gambit: pretend to throw the stick, then hide it behind your back!
target: 来一招抛接骗局：假装把棍子扔出去，其实藏在背后！

source: You decide to just hand Scott the stick. Save your energy and streamline the fetching process!
target: 你决定，直接把棍子递给斯科特。既省力，又简化了抛接流程！

source: Scott, bless him, doesn't argue; he just passes the stick back to you. You pass it back. It's fun... right?
target: 斯科特这小可爱也没意见，就把棍子递回给你。你又递回去。挺好玩的……对吧？

source: Fuck yeah, now it's a party! What're we passing back and forth over here?
target: 爽啊，这才叫聚会！你们在传什么呢？

source: We're supposed to be playing fetch, but I don't think %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% understands the rules...
target: 我们本来要玩抛接，可%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%好像不懂规则……

source: Hmmm... I think something else is going on here.
target: 嗯……我觉得，事情没那么简单。

source: Did you notice that %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% is "throwing" the stick with %HISHER% non-dominant hand?
target: 你注意到没有，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%“扔”棍子时，用的是%HISHER%那只不常用的手？

source: That's an obvious sign that %HESHE%%VERB_'S_'RE% saving %HISHER% energy to masturbate later.

source: WHAT?! How did you know that?!
target: 什么？！你怎么知道的？！

source: Because I'm a Sherlockian expert in all things horny! I can suss out a %MANWOMAN% who's fantasizing about crankin' it from a mile away!
target: 因为说到色色的事，我就是福尔摩斯！一个%MANWOMAN%要是在幻想等会儿怎么撸，隔着一英里我都能看出来！

source: Oh... well, if you wanna save your energy, bro, then that's okay. I was just really hyped to play fetch...
target: 哦……好吧，兄弟，你想省点体力，那也行。我只是……特别期待玩抛接。

source: I'll play with ya, buddy. Unlike %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, I've got enough energy to masturbate later AND be a good friend now. C'mon.
target: 我陪你玩，伙计。我可不像%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，我有的是体力，现在能当个好朋友，晚点也能自慰。走吧。

source: You lost -N2 HYPE ruining fetch, but at least the +N2 STAMINA you saved will pay off later!
target: 你把抛接游戏搞砸了，损失-N2热度。不过，至少攒下的+N2体力，晚点能派上用场！

source: You let out a very anime "HYAAA!!" as you throw the stick with all your might.
target: 你像动漫角色一样大喊“喝啊！！”，拼尽全力，把棍子扔了出去。

source: It disappears over the horizon... and, soon after, so does Scott.
target: 棍子消失在地平线外……没多久，斯科特也消失了。

source: Aaaand he's gone.
target: 好——他没影了。

source: Don't worry, he'll find his way back to us. He's got our scent.
target: 别担心，他闻着咱们的气味，就能找回来。

source: Wanna kill some time while we wait? Bet you can't guess what color underwear I've got on!
target: 等着也是等着，要不要消磨一下时间？我赌你猜不到，我内裤是什么颜色！

source: SCORE??? ...No, actually, it turns out she's serious about making you guess.
target: 有戏了？？？……不，实际上，她是真的要你猜颜色。

source: It takes forever for you to finally guess "cerulean", and by that time Scott has returned.
target: 你猜了老半天，才终于猜中“天蓝色”。这时，斯科特也回来了。

source: BROS! LOOK! I GOT THE STICK LIKE A GOOD BOY!
target: 兄弟们！看！我把棍子拿回来了，我是个乖孩子！

source: Good job, buddy! What took you so long?
target: 真棒，伙计！怎么去了这么久？

source: Well, I chased the stick all the way into a mysterious tavern, where I was given a quest to retrieve an ancient artifact from a cult!
target: 我追着棍子，一路追进了一家神秘酒馆。有人交给我一个任务，要我从邪教手里夺回一件古代神器！

source: I teamed up with a vigilante monster hunter, a Russian spy who was as sexy as she was lethal, and a bard with +2 Charisma to get the artifact back.
target: 我跟一个行侠仗义的怪物猎人、一个性感又致命的俄罗斯女间谍，还有一个魅力+2的吟游诗人组了队，一起去找神器。

source: After a harrowing quest, we found the artifact, and get this: IT WAS MY STICK!
target: 经过一场惊心动魄的冒险，我们找到了神器。你们猜怎么着？它就是我的棍子！

source: A god came out of it and gave me special powers. Now every time I sneeze, a pubescent boy gets his first chest hair!
target: 有个神从里面冒出来，给了我特殊能力。现在我每打一个喷嚏，就有一个青春期男孩，长出人生第一根胸毛！

source: That rules, but I can't help but think there's no possible way I threw the stick THAT far.
target: 是挺酷的，可我总觉得，我怎么也不可能把棍子扔那么远。

source: Agreed. Isn't it more likely that %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s stick is that stick twenty feet in front of us?
target: 同意。更有可能的是，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%扔的棍子，就是我们前面二十英尺那根吧？

source: Oh, probably. I didn't see it! Silly me!
target: 哦，大概吧。我没看见！我真迷糊！

source: Another day, another adventure with Scott. You gained +N2 HYPE from fetch, but you lost -N2 STAMINA because that epic throw took a LOT out of you.
target: 又是跟斯科特冒险的一天。抛接游戏让你获得+N2热度，可刚才那史诗般的一扔，实在太费劲，你也损失了-N2体力。

source: You wind up dramatically and "throw" the stick. Scott runs after the stick, none the wiser.
target: 你夸张地蓄好势，把棍子“扔”了出去。斯科特毫无察觉，撒腿就追。

source: LOL. Good one, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. Up top.
target: 哈哈，干得好，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。来，击个掌。

source: Polly gives you a high-five that's so filled with +N4 HYPE and +N2 MAGIC.
target: 波莉跟你击了个掌，满满都是+N4热度和+N2魔力。

source: Scott is gone for several hours of intense searching (and therefore losing -N4 STAMINA for the whole group), then he finally returns... with the police?!
target: 斯科特找了好几个小时，累得整个队伍损失-N4体力。他终于回来了……还带着警察？！

source: Hello, are you Scott Howl? You called in a missing stick report?
target: 你好，你是斯科特·嚎尔吗？是你报案，说有根棍子失踪了？

source: Yeah. My good friend %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% who I know would never betray me was playing fetch with me, but when %HESHE% threw the stick, it just... vanished.
target: 对。我的好朋友%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，我知道肯定不会背叛我的那个朋友，刚才在陪我玩抛接。可%HESHE%一把棍子扔出去，它就……消失了。

source: Don't worry, son: finding your missing stick just became this precinct's top priority. Backup's already on the way.
target: 别担心，孩子。寻找你失踪的棍子，已经成了本警区的头等大事。增援正在路上。

source: Can you describe your stick for our sketch artist?
target: 能给我们的画像师，描述一下你的棍子吗？

source: It was... um... brown and stick-y...?
target: 它……呃……棕色的，很……像棍子……？

source: The police search high and low for the stick, to no avail of course.
target: 警察们把周围翻了个遍，当然，一无所获。

source: Damn! I'd hoped we wouldn't have to resort to this, but we have no choice... BRING IN THE STICK-PSYCHIC!
target: 妈的！本来不想动用这招，可现在没别的办法了……把棍子通灵师请来！

source: I'm just a regular psychic, actually. But sure.
target: 其实，我就是个普通通灵师。不过，行吧。

source: Hope?! You're working with the cops now? But you're supposed to be one of the good guys!
target: 希望女巫？！你现在跟警察混了？可你不是好人那一边的吗！

source: Hmph, well, at least I'm not as bad as %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%...
target: 哼，至少我还没%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%那么坏……

source: ...%HESHE%%VERB_'S_'VE% had Scott's stick hidden in %HISHER% back pocket this whole time.
target: ……%HESHE%%VERB_'S_'VE%一直把斯科特的棍子藏在%HISHER%后裤袋里。
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): POLISH; 希望女巫揭穿棍子藏在后裤袋；去掉动宾之间的多余逗号，完成体不重复译。 按行中文动词展开已实现；未实机验证。

source: WHAT?! But why, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? WHYYYY?!
target: 什么？！可为什么啊，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%？为什么啊啊啊？！

source: Yikes... Scott doesn't press charges for your stick-theft; but you still lose -N2 SOUL for being a shitty friend.
target: 哎呀……斯科特没告你偷棍子，可你当朋友当得实在太烂，还是损失了-N2灵魂。

source: Crash other picnics
target: 蹭别人的野餐

source: Why make your own picnic when you can just crash someone else's?
target: 能蹭别人的野餐，干吗还要自己准备？

source: After vetoing an awkward company picnic and a family exclusively eating cottage cheese, you and your friends find the perfect picnic to sneak into...
target: 排除了尴尬的公司野餐，以及一家只吃茅屋奶酪的人后，你和朋友们找到了最适合混进去的野餐……

source: Guys, that picnic looks POPPIN'! There's gotta be at least fifty people over there! They've even got a DJ!
target: 各位，那边的野餐好热闹啊！起码有五十个人！还有 DJ 呢！

source: How are we gonna get in, though? That bouncer seems strict. He's not even letting that bear through.
target: 可咱们怎么进去？那保安看着挺严，连那只熊都不让进。

source: ROOOAAAAARRRR!
"'ROOOAAAAARRRR' ain't on the list, pal!" says the bouncer. "Get your furry ass outta here before I kick ya out!"
target: “名单上可没有‘吼——！！！’，伙计！”保安说，“趁我还没动脚，赶紧把你那毛屁股挪远点！”

source: Wait, is that Liam waiting in line to get in?
target: 等等，在排队等着进去的，是不是李姆？

source: LIAM! LIAM! HEY! LIAM! IT'S SCOTT! YOUR FRIEND! HEY! HI!
target: 李姆！李姆！嘿！李姆！是我，斯科特！你朋友！嘿！嗨！

source: Oh, great, even you guys know about this place now? Please tell me this picnic hasn't become mainstream...
target: 哦，真棒，现在连你们都知道这里了？千万别告诉我，这野餐也开始烂大街了……

source: Hiiii Liam! Just curious: would you be down to let us exploit your friendship and use you to get into that picnic over there?
target: 嗨——李姆！就随便问问：能不能让我们利用一下咱们的友情，借你的光混进那边的野餐？

source: No way! This is THE "DJ Honey Dijon's Picnicking Extravaganza 20XX" we're talking about.
target: 不行！这可是“DJ 蜂蜜第戎20XX野餐盛典”！

source: It's the hottest locale for trendy picnicking aficionados... or anyone who just enjoys snorting cocaine off a checkered blanket.
target: 这是潮流野餐爱好者最向往的地方……或者说，任何喜欢趴在格子野餐毯上吸可卡因的人，都想来。

source: Wow, so you get invited to one exclusive picnic DJ'd by a mustard bottle and think you're too cool to hang with us? I thought we were friends!
target: 哇，被邀请参加一场芥末瓶打碟的私人野餐，就觉得自己太酷，不配跟我们玩了？我还以为咱们是朋友呢！

source: We are friends! I swear, I'm not trying to be a dick. The truth is, I'M barely cool enough to be here.
target: 我们当然是朋友！我发誓，我不是故意混蛋。我自己都差一点不够格来这里。

target: 光是说服保安放我进去，就够我忙了。实在没办法再带上你们。

target: 好吧，李姆指望不上，但这可拦不住你！你决定这么混进野餐：

target: 赌一把宾客名单。报上统计学中最常见的几个名字：“约翰·多伊”“贾科莫·卡尔佐内”和“Password1234”。

target: 好主意！我先占了 Password1234！FunNameGenerator.com 给我生成的脱衣舞艺名，就是这个。

source: Cool, I wanna be Giacomo Calzone! I always wanted to be Italian when I grew up!
target: 酷，那我要叫贾科莫·卡尔佐内！我从小就想，长大以后当个意大利人！

source: That's your big plan? Nobody would be stupid enough to think those are real names.
target: 这就是你们的妙计？没人会蠢到把那些当真名吧。

source: You'll just see about that! You saunter up to the bouncer and introduce yourself as THE John Doe.
target: 那就等着瞧！你大摇大摆地走到保安面前，自称就是那位大名鼎鼎的约翰·多伊。

source: "Ahh, yeah, of course! Big fan of your work, %MRMRS% Doe. You and your friends can go ahead inside."
target: “啊，当然，当然！多伊%MRMRS%，我超喜欢您的作品。您和朋友们请进。”

source: NO. WAY. Why the hell did that work?!
target: 不。是。吧。为什么这他妈也能行？！

source: "Hey, hey, back up! Who do you think you are, pal?"
target: “喂喂，退后！你以为你是谁啊，伙计？”

source: I'm Liam de Lioncourt! I'm a level two moderator on the DJ's exclusive server! C'mon, I gotta be on the list!
target: 我是李姆·堂·莱昂卡特！我是 DJ 私人服务器里的二级管理员！拜托，名单上肯定有我！

source: "'Liam de Lioncourt?' Ha! That's a fake name if I ever heard one."
target: “‘李姆·堂·莱昂卡特’？哈！这名字一听就是编的。”

source: "There's too much alliteration, and what's a 'lion court?' Don't lions live in prides or something? Get outta my line!"
target: “一堆重复的音，什么‘莱昂卡特’，狮子宫廷吗？狮子不是住在狮群里吗？滚，别挡着排队！”

source: It's a bad day to be Liam! Not your problem, though. You and your friends enjoy the picnic and gain +N2 STAMINA eating delicious hoagies.
target: 李姆今天真倒霉！不过，这跟你没关系。你和朋友们尽情享受野餐，吃着美味的长三明治，获得了+N2体力。

source: The real John Doe, Password1234, and Giacomo Calzone get turned away when they show up, though.
target: 至于真正的约翰·多伊、Password1234和贾科莫·卡尔佐内，他们到场时，反倒被拒之门外了。

source: Password1234's sobs fill the air. It was her birthday, and her one wish was to get into this picnic. You lose -N2 SOUL for ruining her day.
target: Password1234哭声震天。今天是她生日，她唯一的愿望就是参加这场野餐。你毁了她的一天，损失-N2灵魂。

source: What makes you think that putting three idiots in a trenchcoat will get you into this picnic?
target: 什么让你们觉得，三个白痴套一件风衣，就能混进这场野餐？

source: Because Scott and I have gotten into twenty-two clubs, nine weddings, and one exceptionally turnt baby shower with the "two idiots in a trenchcoat" trick.
target: 因为我和斯科特就靠“两个白痴套一件风衣”这招，混进过二十二家夜店、九场婚礼，以及一场嗨到爆的迎婴派对。

source: And adding one more person just means more people on the team, and teamwork makes the dream work!
target: 再加一个人，队伍不就更强了？齐心协力，梦想成真！

source: Ooh, and guess what Polly? We still have our Chancellor costume in the car!
target: 哦，对了，波莉，猜怎么着？我们的元首服装还在车里！

source: "The Chancellor?" Wasn't that the infamous fascist overlord character you played at Camp Spooky?
target: “元首”？不是你们在怪物夏令营里，扮演过的那个臭名昭著的法西斯统治者吗？

source: Yep, and you can't spell "infamous fascist overlord" without "famous!" The Chancellor will totally be on the guest list. Let's do it!
target: 没错！“臭名昭著”，不也是出了“名”嘛！宾客名单上肯定有元首。走着！

source: You all get into costume and approach the bouncer. "Who are you supposed to be?" he asks.
target: 你们穿好服装，来到保安面前。“你们这扮的是谁？”他问。

source: I'm the Chancellor, you snivelling idiot! I'd better be on the list, or there will be hell to pay!
target: 我是元首，你这窝囊蠢货！名单上最好有我，否则有你好受的！

source: "The Chancellor?! But we thought you were dead! I'm sorry, but you're not on the list..."
target: “元首？！可我们以为你已经死了！对不起，名单上没有你……”

source: WHAT?! This is an outrage! You'd better put me on that list, or I'll be putting your DAUGHTER on MY list!
target: 什么？！岂有此理！赶紧把我写进名单，不然我就把你女儿写进我的名单！

source: ...My list of teenagers that I send to die in the Dome Games, that is. I'm threatening you, if that wasn't clear.
target: ……就是我送青少年去穹顶大赛里送死的那份名单。怕你没听懂，我这是在威胁你。

source: "But I don't even have a daughter! Please, have mercy!"
target: “可我根本没女儿！求求你，饶了我吧！”

source: You DEFINITELY won't have a daughter anymore if you don't let me into this picnic!
target: 再不让我进去野餐，你就更不可能有女儿了！

source: "Gah, I'm so scared and confused! Just enjoy the picnic, man!"
target: “啊，我又害怕又糊涂！你去好好野餐吧，哥们！”

source: That had absolutely no business working as well as it did.
target: 这招居然这么好使，简直没天理。

source: But it did, and that's what matters! You get +N2 STAMINA from the delicious hoagies at the picnic.
target: 但它就是好使，这才重要！你吃着野餐上的美味长三明治，获得了+N2体力。

source: Unfortunately, you lose -N2 MIND pretending to be the Chancellor for so long. Posing as a fascist overlord is weirdly hard on your mental health!
target: 可惜，扮元首扮太久，让你损失-N2头脑。假扮法西斯统治者，居然这么伤心理健康！

source: Start a brawl
target: 挑起群架

source: You sit at the bar next to two patrons arm-wrestling. One of them wins, and the other breaks a stool over his head. They tackle each other to the ground.
target: 你在吧台坐下，旁边两个客人正在掰手腕。一人赢了，另一人就抡起凳子，在他头上砸碎。两人扭打着滚到地上。

source: YEAHHHH! FIGHT! FIGHT! FIGHT!
target: 好耶！打起来！打起来！打起来！

source: You watch those two balls of muscle roll around on the floor. Sigh. Must we always resort to violence?
target: 你看着两团肌肉在地上滚来滚去。唉，非得动手不可吗？

source: I mean, you actually DO resort to violence a lot, but you're not feeling it today. You're in more of a holier-than-thou pacifist mood right now.
target: 我是说，你平时确实没少动手，可今天就是没那个兴致。现在，你更想当个自觉高人一等的和平主义者。

source: Instead of throwing punches, you decide to put on your super cool badass face. It's more than enough to convince people not to mess with you.
target: 你决定不出拳，改摆出自己酷炫凶狠的表情。这就足够让别人不敢来招惹你了。

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, what's up with your face? Are you in pain? Are you trying to hold in a fart?
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你那是什么表情？哪里疼吗？在憋屁？

source: No, I know that face. That's a fighting face! %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% wants to throw down!
target: 不是，我认得这表情。这是要干架的表情！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%想打架！

source: HEY, EVERYONE! %CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS% WANTS TO FIGHT!!!
target: 嘿，各位！%CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%要打架！！！

source: Yay, a fight! It's like sports without boundaries! Can I be your cheerleader, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?
target: 好耶，打架！就像没有规则限制的体育运动！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，我能当你的啦啦队吗？

source: GIMME A B-I-K-E-R! %CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%'S GONNA BREAK YOUR ARMS!
target: 跟我喊：B-I-K-E-R！%CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%要打断你们的胳膊！

source: Hey, remember how you decided violence wasn't the answer? Well, it turns out peer pressure is ALWAYS the answer, so you're fighting someone.
target: 嘿，还记得你刚决定，不能靠暴力解决问题吗？事实证明，朋友们一怂恿，你就什么都能答应。所以，你要跟人打架了。

source: There's gotta be at least one person in this bar whose ass you could kick... who do you challenge?
target: 这酒吧里，总有个人你打得过吧……你要挑战谁？

source: Barry-Bob, the buff badass magician
target: 巴里-鲍勃，肌肉发达、凶悍无比的魔术师

source: Nick-Nhag'zhaz, your worst nightmare... who happens to be made out of nightmares
target: 尼克-纳格扎兹，你最可怕的噩梦……身体也恰好由噩梦构成

source: You open the fight by inviting Barry-Bob to pick a card from your deck.
target: 战斗开始，你先请巴里-鲍勃从你那副牌里抽一张。

source: Barry draws the ace of clubs. You shuffle it back in. "Now... is THIS your card?!"
target: 巴里抽到了梅花 A。你把牌洗回去。“现在……这是你的牌吗？！”

source: You swing a wooden club in Barry's face!
target: 你抡起一根木棒，朝巴里脸上砸去！

source: Barry opens his sleeve and releases a beautiful white dove to take the hit instead.
target: 巴里抖开袖子，放出一只漂亮的白鸽，替自己挡了这一下。

source: Then he casts "Slapakazam", a spell that allows him to slap you in the face with his wand. Ow.
target: 随后，他施展了“巴掌卡达布拉”咒，用魔杖狠狠抽了你一巴掌。嗷。

source: You cast a spell, expending -N2 MAGIC, and reach in your pocket and pull out a hanky, which is tied to another hanky, and another, and another...
target: 你消耗-N2魔力施咒，伸手从口袋里抽出一条手帕，后面连着一条，又一条，又一条……

source: Until you have a hanky-rope long enough to tie Barry up!
target: 直到连成的手帕绳，长得足够把巴里绑起来！

source: And now, with the help of my lovely assistants, we will make you disappear!
target: 现在，在我可爱的助手们协助下，我们要让你消失！

source: Wait, can you have teams in this fight? I thought it was a one-versus-one thing.
target: 等等，打架还能组队？我以为是单挑呢。

source: Forget that shit! We're in MAGIC FIGHT territory, baby; there are no rules!
target: 管他呢！这可是魔术大战，宝贝，没什么规矩！

source: Your friends help you roll Barry-Bob out of the door. He lays a curse on all your future children as he bounces down the road.
target: 朋友们帮你把巴里-鲍勃滚出了门。他一边沿路往下滚，一边诅咒你未来所有的孩子。

source: Everyone laughed at you for learning sleight-of-hand magic until you proved you could use it for violence! You gain +N2 HYPE!
target: 以前大家都笑你学手法魔术，直到你证明，这东西也能拿来打人！你获得了+N2热度！

source: THAT'S who you're picking a fight with? You don't even want me to proofread your last will first?
target: 你就挑这个打？不先让我帮你校对一下遗嘱？

source: Too late! You throw the first punch. It passes straight through Nick-Nhag'zhaz's face and sucks you into their twisted nightmare dimension.
target: 晚了！你先出了拳，拳头却直接穿过尼克-纳格扎兹的脸，把你吸进了扭曲的噩梦维度。

source: You're forced to face all your greatest fears: sharks, bananas (they're a genetically-modified monoculture, it's weird!), and even emotional intimacy!
target: 你被迫面对自己最深的恐惧：鲨鱼、香蕉——基因改造过，还只种一个品种，太怪了！——甚至还有亲密的情感关系！

source: Uh... why is Nick-Nhag'zhaz cuddling %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? Is this part of the fight?
target: 呃……尼克-纳格扎兹为什么在抱%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%？这也算打架的一部分？

source: You're cowering in terror, your -N2 MIND spiraling down the drain, when suddenly you hear a warm voice in your head:
target: 你吓得缩成一团，损失-N2头脑，精神就要崩溃。突然，脑海里响起一个温暖的声音：

source: "%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, dear, it's your mother. I'm in your heart always, or something. Remember what I told you when you were a scared little kid?"
target: “%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，亲爱的，我是妈妈。我一直都在你心里，还是什么来着。记得你小时候害怕，我是怎么跟你说的吗？”

source: "I told you that it's okay to be afraid, because fear is what makes us human... not literally, though, because we're monsters. But you get it."
target: “我说过，害怕没关系，恐惧让我们保有人性……当然，不是说我们真是人，我们是怪物。不过，你懂就好。”

source: "Never let your fears conquer you, my %SONDAUGHTER%! And when all else fails, KICK YOUR FEARS IN THE CROTCH! It always works! Do it now!"
target: “我的%SONDAUGHTER%，永远别让恐惧打败你！实在没办法，就往恐惧的裤裆上踹！绝对管用！现在就踹！”

source: WHOA, NICE! %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% kicked %HISHER% nightmares in the nards!
target: 哇，漂亮！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%一脚踢中了%HISHER%噩梦的蛋蛋！

source: Yeah... I saw... still... wincing in sympathy...
target: 嗯……看见了……我都……跟着疼……

source: I can't believe that worked. Why does Nick-Nhag'zhaz even have a crotch? Aren't they made of nightmares?
target: 不敢相信，这也能行。尼克-纳格扎兹怎么还长着裤裆？身体不是噩梦做的吗？

source: Because while Nick's body is made of nightmares, their own worst nightmare is getting kicked in the crotch! Ironic, right?
target: 因为尼克的身体虽然由噩梦构成，可尼克自己最怕的，就是被踢裤裆！讽刺吧？

source: You survived your nightmares, you no longer shudder at the sight of plantains, and you gained +N2 HYPE for winning a fight!
target: 你熬过了噩梦，再也不会一看见大蕉就发抖，还因为打赢了一架，获得了+N2热度！

source: Grab some drinks
target: 点些喝的

source: You and your friends take a seat at the bar. A tough-looking unicorn and a boisterous storm elemental sit next to you.
target: 你和朋友们在吧台坐下，旁边是一只看起来不好惹的独角兽，以及一个闹腾的风暴元素。

source: Hey, guys! I didn't know you drank here!
target: 嘿，各位！没想到你们也来这儿喝酒！

source: Hi, Susanne! We're just passing through on our road trip. Do you and your friend come here a lot?
target: 嗨，苏珊娜！我们在公路旅行，正好路过。你和朋友常来吗？

source: Yeah, all the time. Whiskey and I OWN this place.
target: 是啊，老来了。我和威士忌在这里说了算。

source: Well, not literally, someone else does that. But we own, like, the CRED of this place.
target: 当然，不是说真买下了这地方，那是别人的。我们是说，在这里可有地位了。

source: We're tight with all the regulars. Like Johnny there! What's up, man? How's your niece?
target: 这里的常客，跟我们都铁着呢。比如那边的约翰尼！嘿，哥们，最近怎么样？你侄女还好吗？

source: The biker Whiskey's shouting at looks up and says, "My name's Broderick. Who the hell are you?"
target: 被威士忌喊到的机车骑士抬起头：“我叫布罗德里克。你他妈谁啊？”

source: Haha! Classic Johnny, such a jokester.
target: 哈哈！约翰尼就这德行，老爱开玩笑。

source: Uhhh, right. So, what's good to drink here?
target: 呃，行吧。那这里有什么好喝的？

source: Try the fermented gasoline! It'll put hair on your chest!
target: 试试发酵汽油！喝了能长胸毛！

source: Sure, the gasoline's pretty good -- if you're into fruity stuff. I'm a screwdriver man myself.
target: 当然，喜欢水果味的话，汽油是不错。我嘛，还是爱“螺丝刀”。

source: The bartender slides Whiskey a literal metal screwdriver in a pint glass. He starts chewing on it vigorously.
target: 酒保推给威士忌一只品脱杯，里面还真装着把金属螺丝刀。威士忌拿起来，咔嚓咔嚓嚼得起劲。

source: You gotta love the authentic rustic flavor!
target: 就爱这正宗的铁锈乡土味！

source: What are you gonna order, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? No pressure, but we're totally gonna judge you based on your choice!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你要点什么？别有压力，不过，你点什么，可直接决定了我们怎么看你！

source: A Punch In The Face
target: 当头一拳

source: The Strongest Spirit: The Spirit of Someone Really Strong
target: 最强烈酒：某个壮汉的灵魂

source: A glass of water
target: 一杯水

source: You pay the bartender -N2 MONEY, and he slides you a shot of strong liquor. You take a sip...
target: 你付给酒保-N2金钱，他推来一小杯烈酒。你抿了一口……

source: Not bad! It's missing something, but honestly, you're just glad the Punch In The Face was a drink and not a literal assault.
target: 不错！好像少了点什么，不过老实说，“当头一拳”只是杯酒，并不是真的打你，你已经很庆幸了。

source: Yeah, about that...
target: 嗯，说到这个……

source: HEY EVERYBODY! %CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS% ORDERED A PUNCH IN THE FACE!
target: 嘿，各位！%CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%点了“当头一拳”！

source: The entire bar collectively socks you in the jaw. It hurts like hell. Susanne's got a mean right hook, and Whiskey's hooves are... well, hooves.
target: 整间酒吧的人，一起往你下巴上招呼。疼得要命。苏珊娜的右勾拳相当狠，威士忌的蹄子嘛……就是蹄子。

source: You swallow all the blood in your mouth. It's... delicious for some reason?!
target: 你咽下满嘴的血。怎么回事……居然很好喝？！

source: Pretty good, huh? Blood is the secret ingredient that makes A Punch In The Face work!
target: 不错吧？“当头一拳”的秘密配方，就是血！

source: Awww, man! I wish I still had blood in me! I'll never know the true flavor of this artisanal beatdown...
target: 哎呀！真希望我身体里还有血！看来我永远尝不到，这手工精酿式群殴的真正滋味了……

source: Don't worry, Polly. You can possess my body, and we can try the Punch In The Face together.
target: 别担心，波莉。你可以附我的身，咱们一起尝尝“当头一拳”。

source: Really? I'd never possess someone without their consent... but if you're okay with it, then sure!
target: 真的？别人不同意，我可从不随便附身……不过你既然愿意，那好啊！

source: Totally, bro! That's the power of teamwork!
target: 当然，兄弟！这就是团队合作的力量！

source: You do another shot with Polly/Scott, because what's a little permanent cerebral damage between friends? You gain +N2 HYPE!
target: 你又和波莉／斯科特喝了一杯。朋友之间，多一点永久性脑损伤，算得了什么？你获得了+N2热度！

source: You pay -N2 MONEY, and the waiter brings out a ghostly brew. The spirit of an extremely muscular man comes pouring out of the glass!
target: 你花-N2金钱，服务员端来一杯鬼气森森的酒。一个肌肉发达得惊人的男鬼，从杯子里涌了出来！

source: "%CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%," he says, "I AM THE SPIRIT OF THE STRONGEST MAN IN THE WORLD."
target: “%CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%，”他说，“我是世界最强壮男人的灵魂。”

source: "I HAVE MANY NAMES, BUT YOU MAY CALL ME MR. WORLDWIDE."
target: “我有许多名字，但你可以叫我环球先生（Mr. Worldwide）。”

source: "TELL ME: ARE YOU WORTHY OF CONSUMING ME? WHAT FEATS OF INCREDIBLE STRENGTH HAVE YOU PERFORMED?"
target: “告诉我，你够资格喝下我吗？你曾展现过何等惊人的力量？”

source: Well, pull-ups aren't my strong suit, but my pet fish died last winter and I bore the crushing weight of his loss every day.
target: 嗯，我不太擅长引体向上。不过去年冬天，我的宠物鱼死了，失去它的沉重悲痛，我每天都扛着。

source: "IMPRESSIVE. HAVE YOU EVER USED YOUR STRENGTH AND HEROISM TO HELP OTHERS?"
target: “了不起。你可曾用你的力量与英雄气概，帮助过别人？”

source: Uhh... my mom calls me a "strong, helpful little %BOYGIRL%" when I help her carry in the groceries!
target: 呃……我帮妈妈搬买回来的东西时，她会夸我“真是个力气大、又肯帮忙的好%BOYGIRL%”！

source: "GOOD ENOUGH. YOU ARE CLEARLY STRONG, BUT NOW IT'S TIME FOR THE TRUE TEST."
target: “够格了。你显然很有力量，但现在，真正的考验来了。”

source: "ARE YOU STRONG ENOUGH TO LIFT... THIS PINT GLASS?!"
target: “你有力气举起……这只品脱杯吗？！”

source: You try to pick up the cup you've been given. WOW, this thing is heavy. What kind of goliath was the bartender who brought it to you?!
target: 你试着拿起面前的杯子。哇，这玩意儿好重！刚才端来这杯酒的酒保，到底是个什么大力士啊？！

source: Want us to help you lift it, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? If we work together, we could do it!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，要我们帮你举吗？大家一起，肯定行！

source: Yeah! True strength comes from friendship and teamwork!
target: 对！真正的力量，来自友谊与团队合作！

source: Well that's a little corny... but fuck it, whatever gets this alcohol into %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s bloodstream the fastest!
target: 虽然是有点老套……但管他妈的呢，能让%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%最快喝上酒就行！

source: Your friends work together to tip the Strongest Spirit into your waiting mouth. It tastes like an old gym sock and +N2 SOUL from the literal soul of Mr. Worldwide! Refreshing!
target: 朋友们合力，把最强烈酒倒进你张开的嘴里。味道像只穿旧的运动袜，还带着环球先生货真价实的魂魄，让你获得+N2灵魂！真提神！

source: You can't help but feel nervous about your choice. Your friends are clearly hyping you up to order something intense and alcoholic...
target: 你忍不住有点紧张。朋友们明显在起哄，要你点些够猛的烈酒……

source: But you're thirsty, and you like water! You order one. It costs -N2 MONEY.
target: 可你渴了，而且你就是喜欢喝水！你点了一杯，花了-N2金钱。

source: ...Since when did they start charging for fucking WATER here? This place is really going down the tubes.
target: ……这里什么时候连他妈的水都要收钱了？这地方真是越来越不像话。

source: No kidding. But good on you for getting water, boo. Nothing's cooler than a hydrated body!
target: 就是说啊。不过，亲爱的，喝水是好事。补足水分的身体，才最酷！

source: And now we have a designated driver! Thanks for looking out for us, bro.
target: 这样咱们就有不喝酒的司机了！谢了，兄弟，真为大家着想。

source: Why are you looking at us like that? Did you really think we were gonna judge you for not ordering alcohol? We weren't serious!
target: 干吗那样看着我们？你真以为不点酒，我们就会看不起你？我们开玩笑的！

source: It was just a test to see if you could resist peer pressure -- and you passed!
target: 就是想看看，你能不能顶住朋友们的怂恿——你通过了！

source: Now you get to bask in the glow of PEER VALIDATION!
target: 现在，好好享受朋友们的认可吧！

source: Nice! You earned your friends' respect, and +N2 STAMINA from being hydrated!
target: 真好！你赢得了朋友的尊重，还补足水分，获得了+N2体力！

source: Play some pool
target: 打台球

source: You head over to the pool table to start a game, but find two legendary idiots already in the middle of a game when you get there.
target: 你来到台球桌旁，想开一局，却发现两位出了名的白痴，已经打到一半了。

source: All right: I'll sink the 6 in the top-left corner pocket, which will knock the 7 into the 8 ball and ricochet them both into opposite pockets!
target: 好：我把6号球打进左上角袋，再让7号球撞上8号球，把它们分别弹进对面的球袋！

source: Not if I block your amazing trick-shot with my even-more-amazing counter move! FORE!!!
target: 要是我用更厉害的反击，挡住你这花式击球呢？看球！！！

source: Susanne hits the cue ball. Whiskey swings his cue stick like a baseball bat at the cue ball. The ball ricochets off the ceiling and shatters the 8 ball to smithereens.
target: 苏珊娜击出母球。威士忌把球杆当棒球棍，朝母球挥去。球撞上天花板，又弹下来，把8号球砸得粉碎。

source: Dammit! You win another round of Death Balls, my friend. Here's your twenty dollars. I'll go pay for the property damages too...
target: 妈的！朋友，这局死亡球又是你赢了。给，二十美元。我还得去赔损坏的东西……

source: Death Balls, huh? Can't wait to turn this one into a story of how I died.
target: 死亡球，是吧？迫不及待想把它编进我的死因故事了。

source: What are you saying? You think you can withstand the almighty power that is Death Balls? HAHAHAHAHAHA!
target: 说什么呢？你觉得自己扛得住死亡球的无上威力？哈哈哈哈哈！

source: Listen: I am the greatest Death Balls player in the whole bar. No one has ever defeated me, and NO ONE EVER WILL.
target: 听好了，我可是这整个酒吧里，最强的死亡球选手。从来没人赢过我，以后也不会有！

source: All the ranting is getting you intrigued. You politely ask Whiskey how exactly Death Balls is played.
target: 听它吹了半天，你倒有点好奇。你礼貌地问威士忌，死亡球到底怎么玩。

source: YOU DARE CHALLENGE ME TO DEATH BALLS AT MY OWN TABLE?!
target: 你竟敢在我的球桌上，挑战我打死亡球？！

source: No?
target: 我没有啊？

source: NANI?! Did someone say we have a new Death Balls challenger?!
target: 纳尼？！听说，来了个新的死亡球挑战者？！

source: Yup. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% over here thinks %HESHE%%VERB_'S_'VE% got some big, brass 8-balls between %HISHER% legs!
target: 没错。这位%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%觉得，%HESHE%%VERB_'S_'VE%在%HISHER%两腿之间，长了对硕大的黄铜8号球呢！
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): KEEP; 黄铜8号球兼指胆量、台球与睾丸；got 已由长了表达。 按行中文动词展开已实现；未实机验证。

source: I ACCEPT YOUR CHALLENGE, WEAKLING!
target: 我接受你的挑战，弱鸡！

source: You challenged no one, nor do you know how this game is even played... but this is your life now, you guess. How will you beat an all-time Death Balls champion?
target: 你没挑战任何人，连规则都不知道……不过，看来人生就是这么回事。你要怎么打败这位死亡球常胜冠军？

source: BEND PHYSICS WITH THE TIMESPACE-DEFYING CURVED SHOT!
target: 打出无视时空的弧线球，让物理定律为你让路！

source: The sad reality is you will never be better than Whiskey... you must resort to the oldest deus ex machina in the book: the power of love.
target: 现实很残酷：你永远赢不了威士忌……只好祭出最老套的机械降神：爱的力量。

source: In order to pull off a feat like this, you'll need to really concentrate. You close your eyes and focus your breath. In, out, in, out...
target: 想完成这种壮举，就必须全神贯注。你闭上眼，调整呼吸。吸，呼，吸，呼……

source: When you open your eyes, the bar is gone. You're at the Sacred Tribunal of the Laws of Physics.
target: 再睁开眼时，酒吧不见了。你正身处物理定律神圣法庭。

source: Here, the Lords of Timespace preside over a constant hearing of regular people pleading to break the laws of physics.
target: 时空领主们在此主持着无休止的听证会，听普通人请求破例，违反物理定律。

source: "The Razkath Empire has devastated my people for centuries," the current defendant begs. "If I could just part the Tuzkur Sea, we could escape them!"
target: “拉兹喀特帝国摧残我的人民，已有数百年。”眼前的被告恳求道，“只要能分开图兹库尔海，我们就能逃出去！”

source: The Lords decree, "Nermal the Noble, your intentions are pure, but your circumstances are not extreme enough to permit breaking the laws of physics. NEXT!"
target: 领主们裁定：“高洁者奈尔莫，你用心纯正，但境遇还不够极端，不足以获准违反物理定律。下一个！”

source: The bailiff drags Nermal away. You step up and say you'd like to break physics to win a game of billiards and look cool in front of your friends.
target: 法警把奈尔莫拖走。你上前表示，想违反物理定律，赢一局台球，在朋友们面前耍个帅。

source: "Hmmmm, the pursuit of coolness is indeed a noble task," says one Lord.
target: “嗯，追求帅气，确实是项崇高的事业。”一位领主说道。

source: "Yes, and billiards is known to be one of the coolest games ever created," says another. "I'm in!"
target: “是啊，台球可是有史以来最酷的游戏之一。”另一位说，“我赞成！”

source: "Are you guys fucking serious?" a third snaps. "Nermal can't save his people, but we're going to allow physics to break for a fancy billiards trick-shot?"
target: “你们他妈认真的？”第三位怒道，“奈尔莫救不了自己的人民，我们却要为了个花式台球，让物理定律破例？”

source: "Well, maybe we would have voted to acquit Nermal if he'd had a fancy billiards trick-shot to back up his argument."
target: “那也许，他要是能打个漂亮的花式台球，支持一下自己的论点，我们就投票判他无罪了。”

source: In a 4-to-3 vote, the Lords vote to let you break the laws of physics to look cool in front of your friends! Way to abuse the system, champ!
target: 最终，领主们以四比三的票数，准许你违反物理定律，在朋友面前耍帅！好家伙，这制度漏洞，算是让你钻明白了！

source: You return to reality, imbued with your new power. You hit the cue ball, and it follows an impossible, predetermined path.
target: 你带着新获得的力量，回到现实。母球被你击出，沿着预定的、绝不可能实现的路线前进。

source: It hits ALL of the balls, including Whiskey's -- ouch!
target: 它击中了所有的球，包括威士忌的那两个——嗷！

source: NOOOOOO! NOT MY BALLS! IT'S MY SECRET WEAK SPOT!
target: 不——！别打我的蛋蛋！那可是我秘密的弱点！

source: DID %CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS% JUST BEAT WHISKEY?!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%刚才打败了威士忌？！

source: Yup! Whiskey forks over the +N2 MONEY you were apparently betting with the hand he's not using to hold his aching balls. You lost -N2 MIND from bending timespace, though.
target: 没错！威士忌一只手捂着疼痛的蛋蛋，另一只手掏出赌金，你获得了+N2金钱。原来刚才还下了注啊。不过，扭曲时空也让你损失了-N2头脑。

source: You play your best and have faith in the power of love.
target: 你拼尽全力，并坚信爱的力量。

source: To no one's suprise, Whiskey destroys you. Sad trumpet noise.
target: 毫不意外，威士忌把你虐了。悲伤的小号声响起。

source: You peer down at the 8 ball in the pocket with tears in your eyes. But... could it be...?
target: 你眼含热泪，低头望着球袋里的8号球。可是……难道……？

source: The 8 ball looks up at you with loving bishi eyes!
target: 8号球抬起头，用闪闪发亮、含情脉脉的美型大眼睛望着你！

source: I'm sorry, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%-senpai. I fought so hard. I wanted you to win. But still, I failed you...
target: 对不起，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%前辈。我真的很努力了，我想让你赢。可最后，还是辜负了你……

source: No, it's not your fault! I thought of nothing but taking down my opponent. It's my fault you suffered so much,  8 ball-kun!
target: 不，不是你的错！我只顾着打败对手，害你受了这么多苦，都是我的错，8号球君！

source: Remember me as I was, Senpai, and just know that I... I love...
target: 前辈，请记住我从前的样子。还有，我……我爱……

source: 8 ball-kun dies before she can finish. You didn't even get to tell her you love her too! Tears pour down your face.
target: 8号球君还没说完，就死了。你甚至没来得及告诉她，你也爱她！泪水夺眶而出。

source: Can anyone explain why %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% is hysterically sobbing over the 8 ball?
target: 谁能解释一下，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%为什么对着8号球，哭得死去活来？

source: SHHH! Don't talk over the emotional climax!
target: 嘘！别打断感情戏的高潮！

source: The tears keep falling and falling -- until you hear 8 ball-kun gasp for air again!
target: 你的眼泪不停地流，不停地流——直到8号球君，突然又吸了口气！

source: I'm... alive?! Senpai, the power of your love brought me back to life! I think I can still win this -- put me back on that board!
target: 我……活过来了？！前辈，你的爱让我复活了！我觉得我还能赢，把我放回球桌！

source: You put the 8 ball-kun back on the board, line up your shot, and manage to sink her in the pocket! You win!
target: 你把8号球君放回桌上，瞄准，一杆把她打进球袋！你赢了！

source: How the fuck does that count as a win? I still sank the 8 ball first.
target: 这他妈怎么能算赢？明明是我先打进8号球的。

source: Because of the power of love, dumb-dumb! Everyone knows love trumps all other logic in an epic battle.
target: 因为爱的力量啊，笨蛋！谁都知道，史诗级大战里，爱能碾压一切逻辑。

source: Yeah, I'm checking the rules, and "the power of love" apparently is the ultimate trump move.
target: 对，我查了规则。“爱的力量”，好像还真是最终王牌。

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% won! Whiskey, pay %HIMHER% the +N2 MONEY you bet.
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%赢了！威士忌，愿赌服输，给%HIMHER%那+N2金钱。

source: NOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!
Hooray! Who cares that you lost -N2 HYPE due to how cheap deus ex machinas are? You even start a passionate long-distance relationship with 8 ball-kun!
target: 好耶！谁在乎机械降神太廉价，让你损失了-N2热度？你甚至和8号球君，展开了一段轰轰烈烈的异地恋！

source: Spook people by posing as ghosts
target: 假扮幽灵吓人

source: You get a moment alone with Polly and Scott and pitch your sheet ghost idea to them. They're immediately onboard.
target: 你找了个跟波莉、斯科特独处的机会，提议披床单装鬼。他们立刻赞成。

source: You spy your first victim laying flowers on three graves. You sneak up behind the gravestones, wait for the right moment, and pounce!
target: 第一个受害者出现了，正在给三座坟墓献花。你们悄悄绕到墓碑后，等准时机，猛地跳出来！

source: BOO!
target: 哇！

source: AWOOOO! I'm a ghost!
target: 嗷呜——！我是鬼！

source: Eh, close enough.
target: 呃，差不多吧。

source: OH, GOD! Where did you three come from?!
target: 天啊！你们三个从哪儿冒出来的？！

source: We're ghoOoOoOoOoOoOosts! We've come to haunt you and make you pay for your various crimes or whatever!
target: 我们是鬼——魂——！我们要缠着你，让你为各种罪行付出代价，反正差不多就那意思！

source: Wait... you mean you're the ghosts of Casey, Tori, and Alex? Guys, it's me, Matteo! From the polycule!
target: 等等……你们是凯西、托里和亚历克斯的鬼魂？各位，是我啊，马泰奥！我们可是同一个多元伴侣圈的！

source: The... wha?
target: 什么……圈？

source: I know I deserve the eternal torment you have in store for me, after the fatal sex swing incident that killed you three...
target: 那次致命的性爱秋千事故害死了你们三个，我知道，你们要永远折磨我，也是我活该……

source: If only I'd assembled it correctly. But I was too lazy to read the instructions, and that laziness cost you all your lives.
target: 要是我当初把它装对了就好了。可我懒得看说明书，就因为我偷懒，害你们全丢了命。

source: (Note from the devs: we must point out that assuming all poly relationships are kinky is oversimplistic and plain wrong. Some might be, some are not, but this one was.)
target: （开发者注：我们必须指出，认为所有多元伴侣关系都玩特殊性癖，既过于简单，也完全错误。有的玩，有的不玩。只是这一群人，刚好玩。）

source: I miss you all so much... is there anything I could do to show you how sorry I am? Seriously, I'll do anything!
target: 我好想你们……有什么能表达我的歉意吗？真的，什么都行！

source: (What do we do, Polly? I think this guy is confusing us with someone else.)
target: （波莉，怎么办？他好像把我们认成别人了。）

source: (Just roll with it. The first rule to good pranking is not knowing when to quit.)
target: （顺着演。恶作剧想玩得好，第一条就是不懂见好就收。）

source: Well, if you aren't bailing, then you're taking advantage of the situation. How can Matteo make it up to you guys?
target: 好吧，既然不打算收手，那就趁机占点便宜。马泰奥该怎么补偿你们？

source: "Invest 1000 dollars in the hottest new business on the market: Polly & Scott's Edible Food!"
target: “投资一千美元，支持市面上最火的新生意：波莉与斯科特可食用食品！”

source: "Give us that sandwich you're eating and we're square."
target: “把你正吃的三明治给我们，就一笔勾销。”

source: Polly & Scott's Edible Food...? You're sure investing in that will make you all forgive me for basically murdering you?
target: 波莉与斯科特可食用食品……？你们确定，我投了钱，你们就能原谅我几乎等于谋杀了你们的事？

source: Totally! P&SEF is gonna be the biggest thing since sliced bread! It's gonna have sliced EDIBLE bread!
target: 当然！自从有了切片面包，就没出现过这么伟大的发明！P&SEF 将推出能吃的切片面包！

source: P&SEF has been a long time in the making! At first it was "Polly & Scott's Recycled Food", which had a rocky start.
target: P&SEF 筹备很久了！最开始叫“波莉与斯科特再生食品”，开局不太顺利。

source: Apparently "recycled food" is just poop, so nobody bought it.
target: “再生食品”显然就是屎，所以根本没人买。

source: But then Polly remembered that "edible" refers to something other than consumable drugs, and that was the big eureka they needed to get started!
target: 后来波莉才想起来，“可食用”除了指能吃的毒品，也能指别的东西。这个伟大发现，终于让生意起步了！

source: I see. I still don't get why you're insisting on this company in particular, but you guys did always encourage me to take some initiative with my finances...
target: 这样啊。我还是不懂，你们为什么非要我投这家公司。不过，你们以前也总鼓励我，理财该主动一点……

source: Especially after I blew all our life insurance accounts investing in edible vibrators. I guess edible food's downright sensible compared to that, huh?
target: 尤其是我投资可食用震动棒，把我们所有寿险账户里的钱都赔光之后。这么一比，可食用食品好像靠谱多了，是吧？

source: It's okay, bro! After this investment, we totally forgive you for accidentally murdering us. Everyone makes mistakes!
target: 没事，兄弟！投完这笔钱，我们就原谅你不小心害死我们的事。谁还不犯个错呢！

source: Matteo makes his investment and leaves, and you all high-five over another successful prank pulled.
target: 马泰奥投了钱，离开了。又一场恶作剧成功，你们纷纷击掌庆祝。

source: Though, this is less of a prank and more of you scamming a grieving widower of three, which is objectively a dick move. So you gain +N2 MONEY but lose -N2 SOUL.
target: 不过，这与其说是恶作剧，不如说是骗一个失去三位伴侣、正在悲痛中的鳏夫。这事确实缺德。你获得+N2金钱，却损失了-N2灵魂。

source: Wait, seriously? You just want my sandwich? Why? Ghosts don't even eat, do they?
target: 等等，真的？你们就想要我的三明治？为什么？鬼不是不吃东西的吗？

source: Who are you, the ghost police? Don't question us!
target: 你谁啊，幽灵警察？别质疑我们！

source: Fine, it's just... I'm already halfway done with this sandwich, and I had to go across town to the good deli to get it!
target: 好吧，只是……我都吃一半了，而且是横穿整个镇子，去那家好吃的熟食店买的！

source: Are you sure I can't just devote the rest of my life to honoring your memories or something? Maybe donate to an organization that prevents sex-swing deaths?
target: 真不能让我用余生纪念你们之类的吗？比如，给预防性爱秋千致死的组织捐款？

source: Nope. We want that sandwich, or else your soul burns in guilt and agony for eternity. Them's the rules.
target: 不行。我们要那个三明治，不然你的灵魂就得永远在内疚与痛苦中煎熬。规矩就是规矩。

source: Defeated, Matteo gives you all the sandwich. It's a BLT on rye! Yum!
target: 马泰奥认输了，把三明治递给你们。黑麦面包夹培根、生菜和番茄！好吃！

source: Wow... I'm actually glad I did that. My soul feels lighter now that I'm absolved of the guilt of--
target: 哇……其实这样也挺好。终于不用再背负那份愧——我的灵魂都轻松了……

source: Yeah, cool story bro. Are these tomatoes fresh? It's delicious!
target: 嗯嗯，故事真感人，哥们。这番茄好新鲜，好吃！

source: The sandwich really is good. You can see why Matteo considered giving up spiritual salvation for it.
target: 三明治确实好吃。难怪马泰奥宁可放弃灵魂救赎，也舍不得它。

source: You gain +N2 STAMINA from your snack, but lose -N2 SOUL because you stole it from a grieving widower of three.
target: 这顿加餐让你获得+N2体力。可你是从一个失去三位伴侣的伤心鳏夫手里抢来的，所以也损失了-N2灵魂。

source: Raise the dead
target: 复活死者

source: You're all wandering around the graveyard when you hear gritty guitar riffs and a guy whine-singing about how much he "hates this town."
target: 你们正在墓地闲逛，忽然听见粗粝的吉他乐句，以及一个男人拖着哭腔，唱自己多么“讨厌这个小镇”。

source: You follow the sound to Gerard the necromancer lounging in the graves, listening to music and drinking beer.
target: 你们循声找到死灵法师杰拉德。他正懒洋洋地待在坟墓间，听歌喝啤酒。

source: Oh, great. I see you've found my secret hideout for the rare nights that I choose to do my brooding outdoors.
target: 哦，真棒。难得我想出来阴郁一下，你们还找到了我的秘密据点。

source: That's cool! Graveyard-drinking is a hobby of mine too. I usually bump EDM, though. Really "livens" up the place, if ya know what I mean.
target: 酷！我也喜欢在墓地喝酒。不过，我一般放电子舞曲。让这里“活”起来，懂吧。

source: Tch, whatever... could you take your bubbly attitude elsewhere? I'm busy drowning my dark and twisted thoughts in booze...
target: 嘁，随便……能不能带着你们那股欢快劲儿，去别的地方？我正忙着用酒，淹没黑暗扭曲的思绪……

source: Ah, damn, my beer is slightly out of my reach. Just a sec.
target: 啊，妈的，啤酒有点够不着。等一下。

source: LOREM IPSUM DOLOR SIT AMET!
target: LOREM IPSUM DOLOR SIT AMET!

source: Light flashes from Gerard's staff, then a zombie claws out of the dirt! It's rotting, shambling, and crying "BRAAAAINS!"
target: 杰拉德的法杖闪出一道光，随后，一个僵尸扒着泥土钻了出来！身体腐烂，步履蹒跚，还嚷着：“脑——子——！”

source: Yep, "brains", right. Could you just hand me my beer there? It's to the left... no, MY left... yup, perfect. Good work, thrall.
target: 是是是，“脑子”，知道了。把那边的啤酒递给我行吗？左边……不，我的左边……对，很好。干得不错，仆从。

source: Aww, your zombie's so cute! Like one of those old, leathery Chihuahuas you can't help but love.
target: 哎呀，你的僵尸好可爱！就像那种老得皮都皱了的吉娃娃，让人忍不住喜欢。

source: Can we name him Tickles? I had a hamster named Tickles once, but I accidentally ate him 'cause I thought he was a potato chip.
target: 能叫它痒痒吗？我以前养过一只仓鼠，也叫痒痒。可我以为它是片薯片，不小心吃了。

source: No, you can't name him. You'll just get attached to him. "Tickles" is going right back in the ground once I finish my six-pack.
target: 不准起名。起了名，你们就舍不得它了。等我喝完这六罐啤酒，“痒痒”就得回土里去。

source: How can you give him a taste of life and then rip it all away like that? This isn't "Flowers for Algernon", you asshole!
target: 你怎么能让它尝到活着的滋味，再一把夺走？这又不是《献给阿尔吉侬的花束》，混蛋！

source: Why are you so upset about this? It's just a zombie. They're usually just animated corpses with no personalities or free will.
target: 你们激动什么？就一只僵尸而已。通常就是具能动的尸体，没有个性，也没有自由意志。

source: Hmm, let's test that. Hey Tickles, if you have free will, say "brains!"
target: 嗯，那测测看。嘿，痒痒，你要是有自由意志，就说“脑子”！

source: "BRAAAAAAAAAINS!"
See? Total sentience! Tickles is in there, we just need something to draw that dazzling personality out of its shell. What do you suggest, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?
target: 看吧，完全有意识！痒痒有自己的想法，我们只需要找个办法，让它展露那耀眼的个性。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你说呢？

source: "Brains" is nice and useful, but you can help Tickles by teaching him a second essential word for his repertoire.
target: 会说“脑子”挺好，也挺实用。不过，你可以再教痒痒一个必备词汇。

source: This zombie is screaming "brains", but you know what he's really asking for: a taxi license.
target: 这僵尸嘴里喊着“脑子”，可你知道，它真正要的是：出租车执照。

source: You're gonna try to teach a zombie to speak? Do you have any idea how long that pointless activity will take?
target: 你要教僵尸说话？知不知道这种无聊事，要花多长时间？

source: Nope! But I'm gonna give it a shot anyway. TIME-SKIP TIME!
target: 不知道！不过我还是要试试。时间跳跃，开始！

source: Oh, we're doing a time-skip all right: all the way to the post-apocalyptic year of 3088.
target: 没错，时间跳跃。直接跳到末日之后的3088年。
