source: Mitch Badassberg, America's most muscular super soldier, and his elite strikeforce are gunning down zombies in Times Square.
target: 米奇·硬汉伯格，美国肌肉最发达的超级战士，正和精英突击队一起，在时代广场上扫射僵尸。

source: A zombie tackles Mitch to the ground, opens its mouth, and lets out its haunting wail...
target: 一只僵尸把米奇扑倒在地，张开嘴，发出毛骨悚然的嚎叫……

source: "COWABUNGAAAAAAAA!"
"What the--?" says Mitch. "General! Did you hear that?"
target: “什么鬼——？”米奇说，“将军！听见了吗？”

source: "Hear what, Sgt. Badassberg?! All I can hear are zombies dying and machine guns firing!"
target: “听见什么，硬汉伯格中士？！我只听见僵尸惨叫，还有机枪开火！”

source: "COWABUNGAAAAAAAA!"
"C'mon, General, you HAD to have heard it that time! This zombie is saying 'cowabunga!'"
target: “拜托，将军，这次你肯定听见了！这僵尸在说‘卡哇邦嘎’！”

source: "Who cares what it's saying?! Shoot it in the fucking head, Mitch!"
target: “谁他妈在乎它说什么？！朝它脑袋开枪，米奇！”

source: "Heehee... but it's kinda funny!"
target: “嘿嘿……可真的有点好笑！”

source: Mitch is so busy laughing at the zombie that he doesn't notice it's tearing his chest open until it's too late.
target: 米奇光顾着笑僵尸，没注意它正在撕开自己的胸膛。等发现时，已经晚了。

source: "General...," Mitch gasps while dying, "please... tell my wife... about the cowabunga zombie... funniest shit... I've ever seen...."
target: “将军……”米奇临死前喘着气，“拜托……告诉我老婆……那只卡哇邦嘎僵尸……我这辈子……没见过……这么好笑的……”

source: Wow. You really taught a zombie to say "cowabunga." Your commitment to idiotic tasks is almost impressive.
target: 哇。你还真教会僵尸说“卡哇邦嘎”了。能为蠢事这么执着，差点让我刮目相看。

source: Yeah! Just imagine a zombie saying "cowabunga" to you while it's eating your brains, bro. It's a great prank!
target: 是啊！兄弟，想象一下，僵尸一边吃你的脑子，一边说“卡哇邦嘎”。多棒的恶作剧！

source: You gain +N2 SOUL for expanding Tickles' vocabulary, but you lose -N2 MAGIC because you had to go to some dark, arcane places to teach a zombie a new word.
target: 你让痒痒的词汇量增长了，获得+N2灵魂。不过，教僵尸一个新词，让你涉足了黑暗深奥的领域，损失-N2魔力。

source: Zombies don't want taxi licenses. They can't even drive. The only thing this shambling creature "wants" is to embrace the cold quiet of his coffin.
target: 僵尸才不要出租车执照。它们连车都不会开。这具走路都晃悠的尸体，唯一“想要”的，就是回到冰冷安静的棺材里。

source: Gerard. Gerard. Buddy. Bro. Dude. Gerard. Think about it.
target: 杰拉德。杰拉德。哥们。兄弟。老弟。杰拉德。想想看。

source: If movies have taught us anything, it's that zombies have two major weaknesses: they're slow as fuck, and they don't have a day job that provides them daily sustenance.
target: 电影告诉我们，僵尸有两大弱点：慢得要死，以及没有一份能养活自己的正经工作。

source: This solves both problems! What could go wrong?
target: 这下两个问题都解决了！能出什么事？

source: You buy Tickles a taxi license for -N2 MONEY, and gain +N2 SOUL for giving his afterlife a new purpose!
target: 你花-N2金钱，给痒痒买了个出租车执照。让它死后的生活有了新目标，你获得+N2灵魂！

source: In the post-apocalyptic future, two citizens are sprinting away from the zombies that now ravage New York City. They can barely outrun the undead mob.
target: 末日之后的未来，两个市民正在拼命逃离蹂躏纽约的僵尸，眼看就要被身后的尸群追上。

source: "Look, honey, that taxi is coming toward us! It must be a fellow survivor!"
target: “快看，亲爱的，那辆出租车朝咱们来了！一定也是个幸存者！”

source: The couple jumps in the open doors, and the taxi speeds off.
target: 这对伴侣跳进敞开的车门，出租车飞驰而去。

source: "Phew, thanks for picking us up! We're headed to Northern Boulevard in Queens."
target: “呼，多谢你停下来载我们！我们要去皇后区的北方大道。”

source: The taxi driver responds by turning his head around 180 degrees and crying, "BRAAAAAAINS!"
target: 司机把头转了一百八十度，张嘴嚷道：“脑——子——！”

source: "OH GOD! HE'S EATING ME! I KNEW WE SHOULD'VE CALLED AN OOBER!"
target: “天啊！他在吃我！早知道就该叫 Oober！”

source: "PULL OVER! I'M NOT PAYING FOR THIS SHIT! TURN OFF THE METER! TURN OFF THE FUCKING METEEEER!"
target: “靠边停！这他妈我可不付钱！把计价器关了！把他妈的计价器关——了——！”

source: YOU'VE SEEN SLOW ZOMBIES. YOU MIGHT'VE EVEN SEEN WEIRD, SORTA-FAST ZOMBIES...
target: 你看过慢吞吞的僵尸，可能还看过有点快、怪怪的僵尸……

source: BUT IN THIS SUMMER'S BLOCKBUSTER HIT, GET READY TO SEE... A TAXI-DRIVING ZOMBIE!
target: 但今年暑期大片，将让你见识……开出租车的僵尸！

source: "Taxi Zombie: Lunch Rush" is coming soon to a theater near you!
target: 《出租僵尸：午餐高峰》即将在你附近的影院上映！

source: Crash a funeral
target: 去葬礼捣乱

source: You find your friends and tell them you plan to crash a funeral. They're immediately onboard!
target: 你找到朋友们，提议去葬礼捣乱。他们立刻响应！

source: Ahh, funeral-crashing, one of my favorite pastimes. It's like wedding crashing, but for ghosts, geriatrics, and thrice-widowed girlbosses.
target: 啊，蹭葬礼，我最喜欢的消遣之一。就跟蹭婚礼一样，只不过来的是幽灵、老头老太太，以及丧偶三次的女强人。

source: You all crash various funerals, wreaking all sorts of mourning havoc.
target: 你们接连闯进几场葬礼，把哀悼现场搅得一团乱。

source: Then you walk in on someone's eulogies... which, of course, Scott and Polly want to crash too. Nothing is sacred.
target: 随后，你们撞见有人正在致悼词……当然，斯科特和波莉也要掺一脚。真是一点敬畏之心都没有。

source: Oh, yeah, the deceased and I go wayyyy back. We made out in a bathroom stall at a club in Amsterdam.
target: 哦，我跟死者可是老相好了。我们在阿姆斯特丹一家夜店的厕所隔间里亲热过。

source: It was the second-best hookup I've ever had that started with accidentally walking into the men's restroom!
target: 因为误闯男厕所而勾搭上的人里，那次绝对能排第二！

source: Me and the deceased were best friends! We met at the zoo and had a really great conversation, and we met up there again every day for months.
target: 我跟死者是最好的朋友！我们在动物园认识的，聊得特别开心。后面几个月，我们每天都在那里见面。

source: To be honest... I don't know what I'm gonna do without Mr. Flippers in my life anymore...
target: 说真的……以后生活里没有鳍鳍先生，我真不知道该怎么办……

source: Scott, honey, we're not at Mr. Flippers' funeral. It's been a year since he broke out of his exhibit and got eaten by polar bears. You have to let him go.
target: 斯科特，亲爱的，这不是鳍鳍先生的葬礼。他跑出展区，被北极熊吃掉，都已经一年了。你该放下了。

source: "Uh... okay then," says the pastor. "Who's next on the eulogy list? %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?"
target: “呃……好吧，”牧师说，“悼词名单上的下一位是谁？%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%？”

source: "No offense, %SIRMAAM%, but given the... 'eccentric' eulogies that we've heard today, we want to make sure you actually know the deceased before we let you speak."
target: “%SIRMAAM%，无意冒犯，不过，今天听了这么多……‘别具一格’的悼词，我们得先确认，您真的认识死者，才能让您发言。”

source: Damn! You were just gonna say "they will be missed" and get back to eating cream puffs! Now you gotta come up with a lie on the spot.
target: 妈的！你本来只想说句“我们会想念的”，就回去吃奶油泡芙！现在只好现场编个谎了。

source: "I admit I was a stranger to the deceased... but aren't we all strangers to everyone at the end of the day?"
target: “我承认，我和死者素不相识……可说到底，我们不都是彼此的陌生人吗？”

source: "I was the deceased's SECRET LOVER!"
target: “我是死者的秘密情人！”

source: "I know the deceased... because I AM THE DECEASED! It's me!"
target: “我认识死者……因为我就是死者本人！就是我！”

source: You say your piece: sure, you didn't know the deceased, but honestly, did ANYONE here truly know them?
target: 你开始发言：没错，你不认识死者。可说真的，在座各位，又有谁真正了解过死者呢？

source: "Uh... yeah?" says one woman. "I wasn't a stranger to Gary. He was my father! Take your pseudo-philosophical bullshit somewhere else!"
target: “呃……我啊？”一个女人说，“我跟加里可不陌生，他是我爸！收起你那些伪哲学屁话，滚远点！”

source: The crowd boos, and you hang your head and start to leave, but then someone runs up and cries, "Stop! We need to listen to %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s wisdom!"
target: 人群一片嘘声。你低头准备离开，却有人冲上来大喊：“等等！我们该听听%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%的智慧之言！”

source: "Oh, great," Gary's daughter sighs. "Now Drunkle Phillip is gonna preach to us."
target: “哦，真棒，”加里的女儿叹道，“酒鬼叔叔菲利普，又要给我们讲大道理了。”

source: "Hey, I may be a drunk, but I know one thing: we were all strangers to Gary! Think about it!"
target: “嘿，我是个酒鬼，但有件事我懂：对加里来说，我们全是陌生人！想想看！”

source: "We knew Gary on the surface: his favorite sports, his terrible Chuck Norris jokes..."
target: “我们对加里的了解，都只是表面：他喜欢什么运动，他那些烂透了的查克·诺里斯笑话……”

source: "But did any of us truly understand Gary's soul? Who in your life can you truly say that you KNOW?"
target: “可我们谁真正理解过加里的灵魂？你这辈子，有谁是你敢说自己真正了解的？”

source: "Your loved ones are like onions: normal on the surface, but once you peel away the layers you're crying and in pain and you wish you'd just ordered takeout instead."
target: “你爱的人就像洋葱。表面看着没什么，可你一层层剥下去，就开始流泪，痛得不行，后悔自己还不如直接点个外卖。”

source: "Man, now I'm really craving takeout. What was I saying?"
target: “唉，说得我都想吃外卖了。我刚说到哪儿了？”

source: "Oh, yeah: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s right, you're all wrong, kiss my ass."
target: “哦，对：%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%是对的，你们全错了，吃屁去吧。”

source: Drunkle Phillip throws up two middle fingers, then falls on his face getting off the podium. At least his embarrassing moment gives you a chance to slip away.
target: 酒鬼叔叔菲利普竖起两根中指，随后下台时摔了个脸着地。至少，趁他出丑，你得以溜走了。

source: Wow, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. That must've been really profound, because I didn't understand a word of it!
target: 哇，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。一定讲得特别深刻，我一句也没听懂！

source: It wasn't. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s eulogy totally sucked. You should've known that telling the truth is the WORST way to start a prank, boo.
target: 才没有。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%的悼词烂透了。亲爱的，恶作剧开头就说实话，最要不得了，这你该知道吧。

source: Well, they say honesty is the best policy. What they often don't tell you is it's also the lamest policy. You gain +N2 SOUL but lose -N2 HYPE.
target: 俗话说，做人还是诚实好。可他们往往不说，诚实也是最没劲的做法。你获得+N2灵魂，却损失了-N2热度。

source: OMG! %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% was fucking Gary too?!
target: 天哪！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%也跟加里睡过？！

source: Whoa, same! I knew Polly and I both had a close relationship with someone named Gary, but I figured it was different Garys. Small world!
target: 哇，巧了！我知道，我和波莉都跟一个叫加里的人关系亲密，可我还以为不是同一个加里。世界真小！

source: "I have a confession to make too," says the pastor sheepishly. "I... was also Gary's secret lover."
target: “我也有件事要坦白。”牧师难为情地说，“我……也是加里的秘密情人。”

source: "So was I!" says Gary's former boss. "Hey, me too!" says Uncle Ernest.
target: “我也是！”加里的前老板说。“嘿，还有我！”欧内斯特叔叔说。

source: "Same here!" says the creepy, mysterious old lady who lives on the hill that everyone avoids.
target: “我也是！”住在山上、神秘阴森、人见人躲的老太太说。

source: "We were his lovers too!" say the members of Gary's men's choir.
target: “我们也是他的情人！”加里所在的男子合唱团成员们说。

source: "We lied about being a choir. We were actually Gary's orgy buddies, but we didn't want to offend anyone."
target: “说是合唱团，其实是骗人的。我们是陪加里群交的，只是不想冒犯大家。”

source: The eulogies are forgotten as everyone begins bonding over having sex with the deceased (in the past tense, importantly).
target: 悼词被抛到了脑后，大家聊起跟死者上床的经历，一下亲近了起来——强调一下，是过去的经历。

source: Man, I'm really gonna miss Gary. His legendary cock will live on in our hearts forever.
target: 唉，我真会想加里的。他那传说级的老二，将永远活在我们心中。

source: Me too. But Gary's smiling down on us knowing that we're discussing his genitals at his funeral. It's what he would've wanted.
target: 我也是。不过，知道我们在他的葬礼上讨论他的生殖器，加里在天上一定会笑着看我们。这正是他想要的。

source: True. Great job turning this around, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. If I ever die again, I hope my funeral will be such a vibrant, festive celebration of my ladyparts!
target: 也是。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，这场子救得真好。要是哪天我再死一次，希望我的葬礼，也能这么热热闹闹地歌颂我的私处！

source: Oh, you'll make sure of it. You lose -N2 SOUL for your crass eulogy, but gain +N2 HYPE!
target: 哦，你一定会确保如此。粗俗的悼词让你损失-N2灵魂，不过你获得了+N2热度！

source: Wait, what?! But... but how?!
target: 等等，什么？！可是……怎么可能？！

source: The crowd explodes as everyone freaks out over your admission. This gives you time to do some sleight-of-hand tricks to really bring your prank home.
target: 你的坦白让全场炸了锅。这正好给了你时间，玩些手法魔术，把恶作剧做足。

source: "Someone check the coffin!" one person cries. "Oh my God... it's full of confetti!"
target: “快去看看棺材！”有人喊道。“我的天……里面全是彩纸！”

source: But if %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% is really the deceased, why %VERB_DOES_DO% %HESHE% look like %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?
target: 可如果%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%真是死者，为什么%HESHE%%VERB_DOES_DO%还长得像%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%？
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): KEEP; 斯科特把玩家与死者的身份绕混；疑问助动词无需另译。 按行中文动词展开已实现；未实机验证。

source: Not for long! You use your sleight-of-hand magic to rip off your face and reveal the deceased's face underneath!
target: 马上就不像了！你施展手法魔术，撕下自己的脸，露出下面死者的面孔！

source: You declare that you're here to say your last goodbyes... AND TO INCRIMINATE YOUR MURDERER!
target: 你宣布，这次回来，是为了最后道别……还有，指认杀害自己的凶手！

source: The murderer is here? Oh shit! Whodunnit, Gary?!
target: 凶手就在这儿？卧槽！加里，是谁干的？！

source: "It was me!" cries the pastor, brandishing a gun.
target: “是我！”牧师掏出枪，大喊道。

source: "I'd so looked forward to officiating your funeral, Gary -- so much that I killed you. And I'll do it again if I must!"
target: “加里，我太想主持你的葬礼了，想到干脆把你杀了。必要的话，我还会再杀一次！”

source: The pastor's gun fires. Everyone screams. You fall, clutching the bullet wound in your chest.
target: 牧师开了枪。众人尖叫，你捂着胸口的弹孔，倒了下去。

source: You feel your life fading... but with a final sleight-of-hand, you remove your face one more time. "You may shoot me, Pastor. But would you shoot... YOURSELF?!"
target: 你感觉生命正在流逝……却拼出最后一次手法魔术，又揭下一层脸皮。“牧师，你敢开枪打我，可你敢开枪打……你自己吗？！”

source: HOLY SHIT! PLOT TWISTS UPON PLOT TWISTS!
target: 卧槽！反转之上，还有反转！

source: Wait, but if %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% was actually Gary who was actually the pastor all along, then... where's %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?!
target: 等等，如果%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%其实是加里，加里又一直都是牧师，那……%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%去哪儿了？！

source: Sitting in your chair, of course, the same place you were all along! You smile and eat a cream puff as Scott's mind gets completely blown.
target: 当然还坐在你的椅子上，你从头到尾就没动过！你微笑着吃了个奶油泡芙，而斯科特的脑子已经彻底转不过来了。

source: The pastor dies of his technically-self-inflicted bullet wounds. You gain +N4 HYPE and +N2 MAGIC, but lose -N3 SOUL and -N3 MIND for your mind-bending prank.
target: 牧师死于那处严格来说是自己开枪造成的枪伤。这个绕晕所有人的恶作剧，让你获得+N4热度和+N2魔力，却损失-N3灵魂和-N3头脑。

source: Get ready for bed
target: 准备睡觉

source: You claim your mattress and start preparing to go to bed.
target: 你占好床垫，开始准备睡觉。

source: As you're deciding which of your onesies make you look the most fuckable, you hear Scott and Polly giggling in the bathroom. You go investigate.
target: 你正纠结穿哪件连体睡衣，才最让人想跟你上床，忽然听见斯科特和波莉在浴室里咯咯笑。你过去看看。

source: Hey there, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! Scott and I are doing our nightly skincare routine. Care to join us?
target: 嘿，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！我和斯科特正在做晚间护肤，要不要一起？

source: Oh, surely!
target: 好啊！

source: But before you can rejoice about these two doing a normal activity for once, you see them step aside to reveal a fleshy, undulating pile of skin sitting on the sink.
target: 你还没来得及庆幸，这俩终于肯做点正常事了，他们就往旁边一让，露出洗手池上那团肉乎乎、不断蠕动的皮肤。

source: What the FUCK is that.
target: 这他妈是什么。

source: It's our skin, silly! I heard that skincare is really important, but Polly doesn't have skin of her own anymore, so I got her this little guy to care for.
target: 我们的皮肤啊，小笨蛋！听说护肤很重要，可波莉已经没有自己的皮肤了，所以我给她弄了这个小家伙，让她照顾。

source: I named it Rodriguez.
target: 我给它起名叫罗德里格兹。

source: Okay, but where did Scott even get this eldritch skin abomination?
target: 好吧，可斯科特到底从哪儿弄来这么个不可名状的皮肤怪物？

source: Boo, you ask too many questions.
target: 亲爱的，你问题太多了。

source: And questions are not part of a good skincare routine. Wink!
target: 而一个好的护肤流程，不包括问问题。眨眼！

source: So, are you gonna help us rub lotion on Rodriguez or not?
target: 所以，你到底帮不帮我们给罗德里格兹抹润肤露？

source: Despite not having eyes, the skin is somehow staring at you. Maybe even THROUGH you.
target: 这团皮肤明明没眼睛，却不知怎么，一直在盯着你。甚至像是看穿了你。

source: Nope. Nope. I did not sign up for this.
target: 不。不。我可没答应过干这个。

source: Well, actually, you did sign up for this. Moisturizing Rodriguez is in your road trip contract.
target: 其实你答应过。给罗德里格兹保湿，就写在你的公路旅行合同里。

source: Ugh, damned be the day I signed that contract on a dare!
target: 呃，当初就不该为了个挑战，签那份破合同！

source: It looks like you're stuck rubbing lotion on this creature. How long can you stand to do it?
target: 看来，给这东西抹润肤露，你是躲不过去了。你能撑多久？

source: 5 minutes
target: 5分钟

source: 1 hour
target: 1小时

source: ALL NIGHT
target: 整晚

source: You pat some lotion on the skin, but stop after 5 minutes. It feels like slime and it's warm and wiggly and you just can't do it.
target: 你往皮肤上拍了点润肤露，五分钟后就停了。它摸着像黏液，又温热，又扭来扭去。你实在受不了。

source: Why'd you stop? Don't you see our skin needs more care? We had a deal!
target: 怎么停了？没看见我们的皮肤，还需要多照顾吗？说好了的！

source: The skin starts making keening sounds like a wounded animal. Fuuuuck this.
target: 皮肤开始哀号，像只受伤的动物。妈——的，饶了我吧。

source: But you gotta take care of it, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. Rodriguez needs proper skincare!
target: 可你得照顾它啊，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。罗德里格兹需要好好护肤！

source: And to go to the dermatologist once a year, even if the dermatologist keeps asking why we do this to him.
target: 还得一年看一次皮肤科，哪怕医生一直问，咱们为什么要这么折磨他。

source: Plus, Rodriguez might eat our toes tonight if it doesn't get proper moisturization.
target: 再说，保湿没做好，罗德里格兹今晚可能会吃掉咱们的脚趾。

source: Now we're all gonna have to sleep with our shoes on. This sucks!
target: 这下大家都得穿鞋睡觉了。烦死了！

source: Nice going, asshole. You retain +N2 MIND for the limited skin-on-skin-creature contact, but lose -N2 HYPE for being a bad friend.
target: 干得漂亮，混蛋。你没碰那皮肤怪物太久，保住了+N2头脑，却因为当了个烂朋友，损失-N2热度。

source: You pat some lotion on the skin. It feels like slime, but it's warm and wiggly and seems to be purring...?
target: 你往皮肤上拍了点润肤露。摸着像黏液，不过又温热，又扭来扭去，似乎还在打呼噜……？

source: Nice work! Rodriguez has been kinda stressed lately; do you think you could rub the lotion in shiatsu-style to relax the knots in its back?
target: 不错！罗德里格兹最近有点紧绷，能不能边抹润肤露，边给它做点指压，按开背上的肌肉结？

source: THIS THING HAS A SPINE?!?
target: 这玩意儿还有脊柱？！？

source: I... think so?
target: 我……觉得有？

source: Also try singing to it while you go. Its favorite songs are "99 Bottles of Lotion on the Wall" and Frank Sinatra's "Under My Skin".
target: 也试试边抹边唱歌。它最喜欢《墙上九十九瓶润肤露》，还有弗兰克·辛纳屈的《Under My Skin》。

source: Ooh, and Rodriguez LOVES it if you imagine vacationing in Denmark while you care for it.
target: 哦，还有，给罗德里格兹护肤时，你要是想着去丹麦度假，它会特别开心。

source: Uh. Okay. Should I... narrate the thought of visiting Denmark aloud as I go?
target: 呃。好吧。那我该不该……一边想，一边大声描述自己去丹麦玩？

source: Nah, you just have to think about it. The skin will know.
target: 不用，想就行了。皮肤会知道的。

source: You imagine being in Denmark. At least the fantasy helps you get through this ordeal. You lose -N2 MIND, but gain +N2 HYPE for being a skincare-conscious friend.
target: 你想象着自己身在丹麦。至少这点幻想，让你熬过了这场折磨。你损失-N2头脑，却因为是个重视护肤的朋友，获得+N2热度。

source: Fuck it; if you're doing this, you're DOING this. You start vigorously rubbing lotion into the warm, wiggly skin.
target: 妈的，要干就干到底。你开始用力，把润肤露揉进那团温热蠕动的皮肤。

source: Minutes become hours. You're up to your elbows in detached skin. You run out of lotion and begin moisturizing Rodriguez with your own blood.
target: 几分钟变成几小时，你的双臂一直到手肘，都埋进了脱离躯体的皮肤里。润肤露用完了，你开始用自己的血，给罗德里格兹保湿。

source: The skin appreciates the blood sacrifice. You begin seeing things, like choruses of angels singing in forbidden tongues surrounded by a cascade of unrecognizable colors.
target: 皮肤很欣赏这份血祭。你开始看见幻象：天使们用禁忌语言合唱，周围流淌着你从未见过的色彩。

source: Your mind expands. Skin is the biggest organ in the body. Skin is everywhere. The entire world is covered in a fine layer of skin.
target: 你的意识扩展开来。皮肤是身体最大的器官。皮肤无处不在。整个世界，都覆着一层薄薄的皮肤。

source: At one point, God appears to you and says, "Thank you, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, for caring so much for my creatures. Even the ugly, disturbing ones I made when I was drunk."
target: 某一刻，上帝现身，对你说：“谢谢你，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，如此悉心地照料我的造物。连那些我喝醉后捏出来，丑得让人不安的，你也没有嫌弃。”

source: The skin is love. The skin is life. You care for this skin, and this skin will care for you... forever.
target: 皮肤即是爱，皮肤即是生命。你照顾皮肤，皮肤也会照顾你……直到永远。

source: Good morning, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! Still taking care of Rodriguez? That's cool!
target: 早上好，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！还在照顾罗德里格兹？真棒！

source: Do you mind if I take my morning poop while you're at it?
target: 你接着忙，我在旁边拉个早屎，你不介意吧？

source: Go ahead, it matters not. There is no privacy. We are all connected by The Skin.
target: 请便，无妨。隐私并不存在。皮肤，将我们连为一体。

source: You lost -N6 MIND doing this all night, but you gain +N2 HYPE from your friends' approval and +N2 SOUL because you've done a good deed today (or so you think).
target: 忙了一整晚，让你损失-N6头脑。不过，朋友们很认可你，你获得+N2热度；今天你还做了件好事，至少你自己这么认为，所以又获得+N2灵魂。

source: You also gain +N2 MAGIC from meeting God during a skincare session... or at least from tripping so potently you believe you did.
target: 护肤时见到了上帝，还让你获得+N2魔力……或者说，你只是嗨到产生了足以让你信以为真的幻觉。

source: The skin always provides!
target: 皮肤自会赐予一切！

source: Watch some tv
target: 看电视

source: You're not quite ready for bed yet, so you decide to watch some TV.
target: 你还不想睡，决定先看看电视。

source: Sadly, your motel doesn't have any streaming services, so you're stuck watching cable like some 18th-century peasant.
target: 可惜，汽车旅馆没有流媒体服务。你只好像个十八世纪的农民一样，看有线电视。

source: One channel is playing a reality show where the contestants are tiny people literally trapped inside your TV.
target: 一个频道在播真人秀，选手全是小人，而且真的被困在你的电视里。

source: "Please don't change the channel!" they beg. "We're so hungry! We've been waiting for--"
target: “求你别换台！”他们哀求，“我们好饿！我们一直在等——”

source: Ugh, boooooring. What else is on?
target: 呃，无——聊。还有什么节目？

source: You change it to the "Snakes and Ladders" TV adaptation.
target: 你换到《蛇梯棋》的电视剧改编版。

source: One aloof man says to another, "Chaos is a ladder, my old friend. Perhaps the only ladder out there. Ah, and ladders... ladders are also a ladder."
target: 一个冷漠的男人对另一个说：“混乱是阶梯，老朋友。也许是世上唯一的阶梯。啊，还有梯子……梯子，也是阶梯。”

source: The other super-serious person responds, "Indeed... our dreams and hopes resting at the top, so close yet so far."
target: 另一个满脸严肃的人回应：“确实……我们的梦想与希望就在顶端，如此接近，却又遥不可及。”

source: "What a cruel world, plagued with snakes who will betray you and make you slide down their slippery bodies..."
target: “多么残酷的世界，到处是会背叛你的蛇，让你顺着它们滑溜的身躯，一路滑落……”

source: "For this is a world... of SNAKES AND LADDERS."
target: “因为这就是一个……蛇与梯子的世界。”

source: They said the thing!
target: 点题了！

source: This show seems complicated. Is there anything else to watch?
target: 这节目好像很复杂。还有别的吗？

source: The next channel is the Merkingdom Totally Objective News station.
target: 下一个频道，是人鱼王国完全客观新闻台。

source: "In today's news, all trespassers who breach the surface will be beheaded. Dolphins, orcas, and other mammals will need to apply for a temporary surface residence permit."
target: “今日新闻：凡擅自浮出水面的入侵者，一律斩首。海豚、虎鲸及其他哺乳动物，须申请水面临时居留许可。”

source: Fuckin' bureaucracy. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, can you find a channel that isn't totally lame?
target: 他妈的官僚主义。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，能找个没那么无聊的台吗？

source: "A Decomposing Possum Carcass." It's the most popular miniseries right now. Nonsensical but full of twists!
target: 《一具正在腐烂的负鼠尸体》。目前最火的迷你剧，莫名其妙，却反转不断！

source: A marathon of very weird Japanese "Scott Snacks" commercials. Surely it'll make you crave some!
target: 连播怪得离谱的日本“斯科特零食”广告。看完保准馋！

source: "Dark Arts and Crafts with Melchor the Ancient and the Kidz!"
target: 《和远古术士梅尔乔及小朋友们，一起做黑魔法手工！》

source: Oh, I've been hearing about this show. The critics say "it's the tits."
target: 哦，最近总听说这部剧。影评人都说“绝了”。

source: Whoa. It's really gross, but I can't look away.
target: 哇。真恶心，可我就是移不开眼。

source: Right? Like, is its arm gonna fall off? What type of insect will retrieve which part of the possum?
target: 对吧？它的胳膊会掉下来吗？什么虫子，会搬走负鼠的哪个部位？

source: And most importantly: can we imagine how it smells just by how it looks?
target: 最重要的是：光看这画面，咱们能想象出它有多臭吗？

source: You couldn't stop watching this beautiful, disgusting force of nature even if you wanted to.
target: 这大自然的奇观，又美又恶心，你想不看都不行。

source: Literally. You end up watching the show all night.
target: 真的。你们一看，就看了一整夜。

source: That was great! I liked the underlying message about the beauty of nature's cycle.
target: 太棒了！我喜欢它暗含的寓意，讲的是自然循环的美。

source: We live and feed from the Earth, and once we die we go back to it... as quality TV.
target: 我们活着时，从大地获取养分。死后，又回归大地……成了优质电视节目。

source: Bro... do you think the possum will survive?
target: 兄弟……你说，这负鼠能活下来吗？

source: Eh...
...Maybe, Scott.
target: ……也许吧，斯科特。

source: You lose -N2 MIND facing the meaninglessness of life and death.
target: 直面生与死的毫无意义，让你损失-N2头脑。

source: But you gain +N2 HYPE by following @DecomposingPossumPosse to meet other fans and discuss theories about the next episode!
target: 不过，你关注了 @DecomposingPossumPosse，结识其他粉丝，一起讨论下一集的剧情猜想，获得+N2热度！

source: The commercial opens with two kids eating a bland fiber cereal and crying.
target: 广告开场，两个小孩正在边哭边吃寡淡的高纤麦片。

source: Suddenly, a person in what only can be described as a Scott fursuit appears with bag of Scott Snacks!
target: 突然，一个人提着一袋斯科特零食出现了。那人穿的衣服，只能说是一套斯科特兽装！

source: He throws the snacks at the kids while yelling "GOOD BOIS!", and the kids transform into buff bodybuilders in revealing swimwear.
target: 他把零食扔给孩子们，大喊“乖孩子！”孩子们顿时变成了穿着清凉泳装的肌肉猛男。

source: He throws the snacks at a passing car while yelling "GOOD BOI!", and the car transforms into a buff robot in revealing swimwear.
target: 他朝一辆路过的汽车扔零食，大喊“乖孩子！”汽车变成了穿着清凉泳装的肌肉机器人。

source: The parents appear and start asking what happened to their children. Scott throws snacks at them, but he doesn't say "GOOD BOIS."
target: 父母出现，追问孩子们怎么了。斯科特朝他们扔零食，却没说“乖孩子”。

source: The parents transform into bowls of bland fiber cereal.
target: 父母变成了两碗寡淡的高纤麦片。

source: The family dog starts barking, because from a metaphysical standpoint, its owners have disappeared, possibly forever.
target: 家里的狗开始狂吠。毕竟，从形而上的角度讲，它的主人消失了，而且可能再也回不来了。

source: Scott throws snacks at the dog and yells "GOOD BOI!". It transforms into a buff werewolf in revealing swimwear.
target: 斯科特朝狗扔出零食，大喊“乖孩子！”狗变成了穿着清凉泳装的肌肉狼人。

source: Scott looks at the camera and yells: "ALWAYS BE GOOD BOIS! NEVER BE NOT GOOD BOIS! SCOTT SNACKS: THE TASTE OF GOOD BOIS!"
target: 斯科特看向镜头，大喊：“永远做乖孩子！绝对不能不乖！斯科特零食：乖孩子的滋味！”

source: What a good commercial! I don't remember recording it, though.
target: 真是个好广告！不过，我不记得自己拍过。

source: Wait... if the parents turned into bowls of fiber cereal, does that mean those boys were being forced to eat people who'd been transformed? Is that why they were crying?
target: 等等……要是父母变成了麦片，那两个男孩一开始被逼着吃的，岂不也是变过来的人？所以他们才哭？

source: The commercial was really weird, but it worked. You're craving Scott Snacks like crazy. You order some bags online, losing -N2 MONEY but gaining +N2 STAMINA.
target: 广告很怪，可确实有效。你馋斯科特零食馋得不行，网上下单买了几袋，损失-N2金钱，却获得+N2体力。

source: GOOD BOI!
target: 乖孩子！

source: "Hiya, Kidz," says the warlock onscreen. "Or, as we say in my realm, 'GLORY TO THE ARCHDEMONS, COMRADES.'"
target: “嗨，小朋友们，”屏幕上的术士说，“或者，按我们那边的说法：‘同志们，荣耀归于大恶魔！’”

source: "Who's ready for some dark arts and crafts with your buddy Melchor?"
target: “谁准备好了，跟你们的好朋友梅尔乔，一起做黑魔法手工？”

source: ME! ME! I'M READY! PICK ME!
target: 我！我！我准备好了！选我！

source: "We're ready!" say the Kidz in haunting unison. "What are we making today, Melchor?"
target: “我们准备好了！”孩子们整齐得让人发毛地齐声说，“梅尔乔，今天要做什么？”

source: WHAT ARE WE MAKING, MELCHOR?! I HAVE TO KNOW!!!
target: 梅尔乔，我们要做什么？！快告诉我！！！

source: "We're making voodoo paper dolls! For this craft, you'll need a bit of glue, some construction paper, and THE DNA OF SOMEONE YOU WISH TO DESTROY."
target: “我们要做巫毒纸娃娃！需要一点胶水、几张手工纸，还有——你想毁掉的那个人的 DNA。”

source: "But before we get to crafting, do you Kidz know what time it is?"
target: “不过，开始做手工之前，小朋友们知道，现在是什么时间吗？”

source: "Sacrifice time!" the Kidz cheer.
target: “献祭时间！”孩子们欢呼道。

source: "It sure is! Everyone draw a popsicle stick, and the person with the shortest stick gets to be today's sacrifice to the Archdemons of Crafteroth!"
target: “没错！大家各抽一根冰棍棒，抽到最短那根的，就是今天献给克拉夫特罗斯大恶魔们的祭品！”

source: Young Toby draws the short stick. The Kidz sing a song while drawing a pentagram with sidewalk chalk.
target: 小托比抽到了短签。孩子们一边唱歌，一边用粉笔在地上画五芒星。

source: Then they proceed to stab Toby repeatedly to release his sweet sacrificial blood. They all laugh and splash in the blood puddles. Joy!
target: 随后，他们开始一刀又一刀地刺托比，放出甜美的祭祀用血。大家在血泊里又笑又踩，溅起血花。真开心！

source: "Fantastic job, Kidz! The Archdemons are appeased, and our crafts can commence! You're going to grow up to be excellent warlocks one day."
target: “小朋友们，干得真棒！大恶魔们满意了，我们可以开始做手工了！长大后，你们一定都能成为优秀的术士。”

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, can we do the crafts here? Pretty please!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，我们能在这里做那些手工吗？求求你啦！

source: Um... you're pretty sure practicing these dark arts and crafts will take a toll on your soul, but you can't say no to those puppy eyes!
target: 呃……你很确定，搞这些黑魔法手工，有损灵魂。可你实在拒绝不了那双小狗般的眼睛！

source: You lose -N2 SOUL from the unspeakable things you do with scissors, glitter, and glue...
target: 你用剪刀、亮片和胶水，干了些不可言说的事，损失-N2灵魂……

source: But you gain +N2 MAGIC from the magic of friendship! (And also from all the black magic you practice.)
target: 不过，友谊的魔法，让你获得了+N2魔力！（还有你练的那些黑魔法。）

source: Order some pizza
target: 点披萨

source: No way you're going to bed on an empty stomach! You decide to order some pizza. Trouble is, none of you know any of the local restaurants around here.
target: 哪能饿着肚子睡觉！你决定点披萨。问题是，你们谁也不熟悉附近的餐馆。

source: The best way to get pizza is to call and order it. We could call a random number and see if there's pizza.
target: 想吃披萨，最好的办法就是打电话订。咱们可以随便拨个号码，问问有没有披萨。

source: Scott, the odds of calling a random phone number and actually getting a pizza restaurant are SUPER low.
target: 斯科特，随便拨个电话，刚好打到披萨店的概率，可低得要命。

source: So let's dial a bunch of random numbers to increase our chances!
target: 那就多随便拨几个，提高成功率！

source: Beep boop beep!
target: 哔嘟哔！

source: Hello, is this a pizza place? ...Okay, that sounds close enough!
target: 喂，是披萨店吗？……好吧，听起来差不多！

source: We'd like one large sausage and pepperoni with stuffed crust. Thanks!
target: 我们要一份大号香肠加意式辣香肠披萨，夹心饼边。谢谢！

source: Whoa, you actually got a pizza place on the first try? What do you think are the chances of getting ANOTHER pizza place on your SECOND try?
target: 哇，第一次就打到披萨店了？你说，第二次再打到另一家披萨店的概率，有多大？

source: I think we have good odds! Like, 5 out of 3 at least!
target: 我觉得挺高的！起码三分之五吧！

source: Let's find out.
target: 试试就知道了。

source: Hi, is this a pizza restaurant?
target: 喂，是披萨店吗？

source: ...You specialize in pizza to DIE for, huh? Perfect, we'll take one!
target: ……你们专做“好吃到死”的披萨？太好了，我们要一个！

source: ...Yeah, sure, I can destroy this phone after you hang up. Bye!
target: ……嗯，好，挂了就把这部电话销毁。拜拜！

source: Polly does so. Good thing it was just the motel landline.
target: 波莉照做了。还好，只是汽车旅馆的座机。

source: Thirty minutes later, there's not one, but TWO knocks at the door.
target: 三十分钟后，有人敲门，而且来了两拨。

source: "I'm here to deliver one hot, steaming sausage to Scott Howl," says the naked guy with a pizza box on his crotch. "Let's make that crust EXTRA stuffed, big boy."
target: “我来给斯科特·嚎尔送一根热腾腾的香肠。”一个裸男说着，用披萨盒遮住裆部，“大块头，咱们把这饼边塞得满满当当吧。”

source: "I've got the 'pizza' here for Polly Geist," says the shady guy in a trenchcoat. "Nice pseudonym, by the way. Let's make this quick."
target: “来给波莉·鬼斯特送‘披萨’。”一个穿风衣的可疑男人说，“顺便说一句，假名起得不错。咱们速战速决。”

source: Oh, boy, what a fun problem! We have two pizzas but can only afford one!
target: 哇，好有意思的问题！两份披萨，可咱们只付得起一份！

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, you're good at making decisions and shit. Which pizza should we take?
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，拿主意什么的，你最擅长了。咱们选哪份披萨？

source: The stripper's extra-large sausage. You suspect there's no pizza in that box, but at least you'll get a show!
target: 脱衣舞男的特大香肠。你怀疑盒子里压根没有披萨，不过，至少能看个表演！

source: The shady guy's "pizza." The air quotes seem sketchy, but you think the odds of actually getting a pizza from him might be better.
target: 可疑男人的“披萨”。手势引号确实可疑，但你觉得，真能从他那儿买到披萨的概率，好像更高点。

source: You let the naked guy inside. He immediately sits on Scott's lap.
target: 你让裸男进来，他立刻坐到了斯科特腿上。

source: Whoa! What are you doing, pizza-bro?
target: 哇！披萨兄弟，你在干吗？

source: "Delivering your pizza, of course. You want me to feed it to you, big boy?"
target: “当然是给你送披萨，大块头。要不要我喂你？”

source: Sure! Man, this is a really thorough delivery!
target: 好啊！哇，这送餐服务，还真够周到的！

source: Scott does not get pizza. What he gets is a stripper giving him a lapdance to a trap remix of the Italian national anthem.
target: 斯科特没吃到披萨。脱衣舞男伴着意大利国歌的 Trap 混音版，给他跳了一支膝上舞。

source: Um... nice dance, but you haven't given me any pizza yet. When is that gonna happen?
target: 呃……舞不错，可披萨还没给我呢。什么时候能吃到？

source: "Oh, you mean you want MORE? Maybe you want a side of delicious fries?"
target: “哦，你还想加量？要不要再来一份美味的薯条？”

source: Yeah, I guess I could go for some fries.
target: 嗯，来点薯条也不错。

source: The stripper opens the door, and another stripper walks in wearing French fry nipple tassels!
target: 脱衣舞男打开门，另一个舞者走了进来，胸前挂着薯条形状的乳贴流苏！

source: Oh, you know, I think I'm craving fries actually. You can bring that right over here, boo.
target: 哦，说起来，我还真有点馋薯条。亲爱的，往我这儿送吧。

source: You never eat, Polly. What's going on?
target: 波莉，你又不吃东西。这怎么回事？

source: Well Scott, I've expertly deduced that these people aren't pizza delivery people. They're strippers. They deliver lapdances.
target: 斯科特，经过我的专业推理，这些人不是送披萨的，是脱衣舞者。他们提供的是膝上舞服务。

source: Oh! That would explain why they're really good at stripping, but really bad at delivering food.
target: 哦！难怪脱衣服这么熟练，送吃的却不怎么在行。

source: The strippers give you all a FULL-contact delivery. You lose -N2 STAMINA because you're still hungry, but you gain +N2 HYPE!
target: 脱衣舞者给你们送上了全接触“外卖”。你们还是饿，损失-N2体力，不过获得了+N2热度！

source: You let the shady guy inside. He says, "All right, let's get this over with. You gimme the stuff, I'll give you the 'pizza.'"
target: 你让可疑男人进门。他说：“好了，赶紧完事。你给我东西，我给你‘披萨’。”

source: Why do you keep using air quotes like that?
target: 你为什么老用手指比引号？

source: Because "pizza" is probably code for something else, like drugs, or illegal ferrets.
target: 因为“披萨”大概是别的东西的暗号，比如毒品，或者非法雪貂。

source: The guy undoes his trenchcoat and holds it out for you to see. Each pocket contains...
target: 男人解开风衣，撑开给你们看。每个口袋里都装着……

source: Slices of pizza. Not in boxes or anything, either. Just loose pizza.
target: 披萨片。连盒子什么的都没装，就是散装披萨。

source: "You want it or not?"
target: “到底要不要？”

source: Sure!
target: 当然!

source: Scott tries a slice. Polly does too, because she's not entirely convinced this isn't drugs yet.
target: 斯科特尝了一片。波莉也尝了，因为她还是没完全排除这是毒品的可能。

source: It's the best pizza I've ever had! Is the secret ingredient ferrets? I never knew ferrets tasted so good!
target: 这是我吃过最好吃的披萨！秘密配方是雪貂吗？以前都不知道，雪貂能这么好吃！

source: Surprisingly, there AREN'T any illicit substances in this. Why were you calling it "pizza" if it's just regular pizza?
target: 真意外，这里面居然没有违禁品。既然就是普通披萨，你干吗还叫它“披萨”？

source: "Because it isn't pizza. It's 'pizza.' It's pizza that's so damn delicious I can't legally call it pizza."
target: “因为这不是披萨，是‘披萨’。好吃到这份上，法律都不允许我叫它披萨。”

source: "And it isn't expensive either! The only price is me taking some pics of you eating it that I may or may not use for future blackmail material."
target: “而且不贵！唯一的代价，就是让我拍几张你们吃披萨的照片。以后会不会拿来勒索，可不好说。”

source: Oh, okay! Take the photos from my left. People say it's my good side!
target: 哦，好啊！拍我左边，大家都说我这边好看！

source: If you upload these to the dark web, remember to tag me!
target: 传暗网时，记得标记我！

source: There is definitely something incredibly shady about all this; you can feel it in the -N2 SOUL you lose. But hey, you got your fill of "pizza", so you gain +N2 STAMINA.
target: 这件事肯定有大问题，你损失的-N2灵魂足以证明。不过，至少“披萨”吃饱了，你获得+N2体力。

source: Visit the saloon
target: 去酒馆

source: You visit the saloon. It's full of rugged cowboys, high-stakes poker, and a lot of unwashed horse ass.
target: 你走进酒馆。粗犷的牛仔、赌注惊人的牌局，还有一大堆没洗过的马屁股，挤满了这里。

source: You all sit down at a poker table. But before you can be dealt in, the saloon double-doors dramatically blow open!
target: 你们刚在牌桌旁坐下，牌还没发到，酒馆的双扇门就猛地打开了！

source: A breathless cowboy stands in the doorway. "The name's Otto 'Deadeye' McCray," he says.
target: 一个牛仔气喘吁吁地站在门口。“我叫奥托·‘神枪’·麦克雷。”他说。

source: "A gang of outlaws are terrorizing my momma's farm. I'm here to recruit a band of misfits who are good with a revolver to help save it. Who's with me?"
target: “一帮亡命之徒，正在我妈的农场闹事。我来招一队使左轮的怪咖，帮忙救下农场。谁愿意跟我干？”

source: That's great, Deadeye, but here's the deal: I'm Polly "Rough Rider" Geist, and I found these cowboys first. So you need to back the fuck up.
target: 说得好，神枪。可我是波莉·“狂野骑手”·鬼斯特，这些牛仔是我先找着的。你他妈得往后排。

source: Are you sure we shouldn't help Deadeye, Polly? His mom's in danger!
target: 波莉，咱们真不该帮帮神枪吗？他妈妈有危险！

source: But if my poker game gets cancelled, I'M in danger! I could die of boredom! It's happened to me before!
target: 可我的牌局要是泡汤，我也有危险！我会无聊死！以前就死过！

source: I'm sure there's a way to make both of you happy. Maybe some of the cowboys can go with Deadeye, and some can stay here and play poker.
target: 肯定有办法，让你们都满意。让一部分牛仔跟神枪走，另一部分留下打牌，不就行了？

source: We could even take turns picking teams! It'll be like gym class, but with lives on the line!
target: 还可以轮流挑队员！就像体育课分队，只不过这回赌上了人命！

source: Fine, but I call dibs on %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% then. Making difficult decisions like this is %HISHER% whole thing.
target: 行，那我要先占了%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。这种难做的决定，就是%HISHER%专长。

source: The team-choosing commences! Deadeye chooses Curly "Aimbot" Adams. Polly chooses Betty "The Thighs" Crackerbarrel.
target: 分队开始！神枪挑了柯利·“自瞄”·亚当斯，波莉挑了贝蒂·“美腿”·克拉克巴雷尔。

source: Deadeye chooses Scott. Polly trades him two Bettys and a rare holographic Hank "Loverboy" Deckard for Scott.
target: 神枪挑了斯科特。波莉用两个贝蒂，再加一张稀有镭射版汉克·“情圣”·戴卡德，换回斯科特。

source: Thank you, Polly. You saved me from being on the wrong side of history.
target: 谢谢你，波莉。你救了我，没让我站到历史错误的一边。

source: Okay, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, it's time to see if I wasted my choice picking you: who should be the last member of our poker table?
target: 好了，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，看看选你有没有白选：咱们牌桌最后一个位置，给谁？

source: Charlie "Cheese Fingers" Chesterton
target: 查理·“奶酪手指”·切斯特顿

source: Reginald "The Very Bad Gambler" Rossineau
target: 雷金纳德·“赌术烂透”·罗西诺

source: Are you sure? I've heard Charlie's a scary outlaw, known for marking cards with his always-cheesy fingers!
target: 你确定？听说查理是个可怕的亡命徒，专门用那总沾着奶酪的手指，给牌做记号！

source: Actually, "Cheese Fingers" is a very serious medical condition...
target: 其实，“奶酪手指”是一种很严重的病……

source: The greasy, sticky cheddar leaking from my pores is inconvenient and incurable. Nobody will play poker with me because of it...
target: 油腻黏稠的切达奶酪，不断从我毛孔里渗出来。又麻烦，还治不好。就因为这个，没人愿意跟我打牌……

source: Awww, don't worry about it, you can play with us! I respect %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% for vouching for you.
target: 哎呀，别担心，跟我们玩就好！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%肯替你担保，我很敬佩。

source: Thanks %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! I hope this doesn't sound too "cheesy", but it's very "gouda"-hearted of you to have so much faith in this old "munster"!
target: 谢谢你，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！这话可能有点“芝”腻，可你这么相信我这老怪物，真是个“芝”心好人！

source: Okay, just 'cause you have a debilitating medical condition doesn't mean you can get away with bad puns.
target: 好吧，病得难受，也不代表你就能随便讲烂梗。

source: All right... I'll do my best to "wheel" them in. Wink!
target: 行吧……我尽量少“酪”叨。眨眼！

source: You all get busy gambling. You win some money. You lose it all to Charlie.
target: 你们开始打牌。你赢了点钱，又全输给了查理。

source: Honestly, whether his "condition" is real or not, it's definitely helping his winning streak to tag the cards he needs with cheddar smears.
target: 说真的，不管他是不是真“有病”，用切达奶酪给需要的牌做记号，确实让他赢个不停。

source: But you don't mind, because he brought cheesy snacks to share! You gain +N2 STAMINA from the delicious nachos and unlimited fondue.
target: 不过你不在乎，因为他带了奶酪小吃来分享！美味的玉米片，加上吃不完的奶酪火锅，让你获得+N2体力。

source: Unfortunately, you lose -N2 SOUL because you played poker instead of helping Deadeye. I heard his mom had to take out a second mortgage after the farm burned down.
target: 可惜，你光顾着打牌，没去帮神枪，损失-N2灵魂。听说他妈妈的农场被烧了，只好又背上一笔抵押贷款。

source: Ha! You're in for it now. Everyone may call me Reginald "The Very Bad Gambler" Rossineau, but tonight I'm gonna prove them all wrong!
target: 哈！你们等着输吧。人人都叫我雷金纳德·“赌术烂透”·罗西诺，但今晚，我就要证明他们错了！

source: LOOK! My luck is already turning around! Behold: a straight with TWO fours-of-spades!
target: 看！我时来运转了！瞧，一手顺子，里面有两张黑桃四！

source: So... you cheated.
target: 所以……你出千了。

source: No I didn't! What are you talking about?! Cheating isn't even real! You're crazy!
target: 才没有！说什么呢？！世上根本就没有出千这回事！你疯了！

source: Drop the act. There aren't two fours-of-spades in a poker deck, wiseass.
target: 别装了。一副牌里不可能有两张黑桃四，机灵鬼。

source: And fours are useless anyway. You didn't even cheat right.
target: 再说，四有什么用？你连出千都不会。

source: Also, it doesn't matter, 'cause I've got a royal flush. Better start calling me Polly "Great at Poker" Geist!
target: 而且，无所谓，我这可是皇家同花顺。以后请叫我波莉·“牌技超群”·鬼斯特！

source: Ooh, do we get to pick our own nicknames now? I wanna be "Scott 'Scott Howl' Howl!"
target: 哦，现在可以自己取外号了吗？我要叫“斯科特·‘斯科特·嚎尔’·嚎尔”！

source: You play several rounds. Polly lives up to her name. (So does Scott, for what it's worth.)
target: 几局下来，波莉果然名副其实。顺带一提，斯科特也是。

source: Reginald, also true to his name, plays five 2s, an UNO wild card, a round of Blackjack, and for some reason rolls a 20-sided die over the course of the night.
target: 雷金纳德同样名副其实。一晚上，他出了五张二、一张 UNO 万能牌，玩了一把二十一点，还不知道为什么，掷了一颗二十面骰。

source: You also quickly learn his tell. He winks right after he bluffs.
target: 你也很快发现了他的破绽：每次诈唬，他都会眨眼。

source: It gets even easier to notice when you've gotten him drunk and he just starts saying "WINK!" aloud.
target: 你把他灌醉后，就更好认了。他会直接大声说：“眨眼！”

source: You take Reginald to the cleaner's and end up +N2 MONEY richer. Nice!
target: 你把雷金纳德赢了个精光，进账+N2金钱。漂亮！

source: Unfortunately, you lose -N2 SOUL because you played poker instead of helping Deadeye. I heard his mom had to take out a second mortgage after the farm burned down.
target: 可惜，你光顾着打牌，没去帮神枪，损失-N2灵魂。听说他妈妈的农场被烧了，只好又背上一笔抵押贷款。

source: Duel at high noon
target: 正午决斗

source: This village is filled with cowboys showing off the big irons on their hips like they're just begging for a high-noon shoot-off.
target: 小镇到处是牛仔，炫耀着腰间的大铁家伙，仿佛巴不得有人来场正午枪战。

source: But more importantly, it's filled with cute horses! You see brown horses, black horses, speckled horses, horses that Polly and Scott are siphoning magic from... wait.
target: 但更重要的是，这里有好多可爱的马！棕马、黑马、斑点马，还有正在被波莉和斯科特抽取魔力的马……等等。

source: I CAN EXPLAIN!
target: 我可以解释！

source: Oh, it's just you. Sorry, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, I thought you were a cowboy here to duel us for fucking with his horse.
target: 哦，是你啊。抱歉，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，我还以为是哪个牛仔，发现我们乱搞他的马，来找我们决斗了。

source: Which begs the question of WHY Polly and Scott are fucking with a cowboy's horse?
target: 这就得问了：波莉和斯科特，为什么要去乱搞牛仔的马？

source: Well, we're low on gas, but nobody could give us directions to the nearest gas station.
target: 车快没油了，可谁也不知道，最近的加油站在哪儿。

source: But I thought, cars have horsepower, right? So let's just get power for the car straight from the horses!
target: 可我一想，汽车不是有“马力”吗？那直接找马给车提供力量，不就行了！

source: Can you believe it worked? We just got some free +N2 MAGIC with no consequences!
target: 你敢信？还真管用！白得了+N2魔力，什么后果都没有！

source: "HEY!" you hear a cowboy shout. "What in tarnation are you doin' to Cheddar Biscuit?!"
target: “喂！”一个牛仔大喊，“你们对我的切达饼干干了什么？！”

source: Ope, spoke too soon.
target: 哎，话说早了。

source: That guy looks mad! What do we do, Polly?
target: 那家伙好像很生气！波莉，怎么办？

source: Same as always: blame someone else.
target: 老办法：甩锅。

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS% DID IT! I saw the whole thing!
target: 是%CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%干的！我亲眼看见的！

source: Then I reckon you and me got a problem, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. Draw your gun and duel me at high noon, if you ain't yellow-bellied!
target: 那咱俩可就有过节了，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。有种就拔枪，正午跟我决斗！

source: Great, looks like you're not getting out of this without a duel... so you'd better suggest a duel you have a chance at winning!
target: 真棒，看来不决斗，是走不了了……那就提个你有机会赢的决斗方式吧！

source: Turn your backs on each other, walk ten paces away... and just keep walking. Start new lives. Never look back.
target: 背对背，各走十步……然后继续走。各自开始新生活，永不回头。

source: A classic duel to the death, but replace the "duel to the death" part with "truth or dare match."
target: 经典的生死决斗，不过把“生死决斗”换成“真心话大冒险”。

source: What? How is that even a duel?
target: 什么？这算哪门子决斗？

source: Oh, buddy, if I have to explain to you what a duel is, we clearly have nothing to talk about here.
target: 哎，伙计，要是连什么叫决斗，都得我来教，那咱们也没什么好聊的。

source: No, that ain't what I meant! Fine, let's do it now!
target: 不是，我不是那个意思！行，现在就来！

source: You face him. He faces you. You turn your backs on each other, walk ten paces... and then you continue on.
target: 你看着他，他看着你。你们背对背，各走十步……随后，你继续往前走。

source: You walk for a while. It's hot and sweaty, and you regret choosing today to experiment with dress shoes and no socks.
target: 你走了一阵，又热又汗。偏偏今天想试试不穿袜子配皮鞋，真是后悔。

source: It takes -N2 STAMINA, but eventually you've walked far enough... and you get straight into the car where Polly and Scott are waiting.
target: 你损失了-N2体力，不过总算走得够远了……你直接钻进车里，波莉和斯科特正在等你。

source: Ha! I'm in awe of your pranking genius, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. You totally tricked that guy into WALKING!
target: 哈！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你这恶作剧天赋，真让人佩服。你居然骗那家伙去走路！

source: I wonder how long he'll keep walking for. Guess we'll never know...
target: 不知道他还会走多久。看来，咱们永远也不会知道了……

source: Nah, I'm gonna tell you. The cowboy continues to walk for miles and miles without stopping.
target: 不，我会告诉你的。牛仔继续走了好几英里，一刻不停。

source: A suburban mom passes him on her jog, and decides to jog alongside him and gossip about her neighbors.
target: 一个住在郊区的妈妈慢跑经过，决定跟在他旁边，边跑边聊邻居的八卦。

source: An escaped convict joins him next. After he outruns the police, he's so inspired by the cowboy's perseverance that he gives up crime to join him.
target: 接着，一个越狱犯也加入了。他先甩掉警察，又被牛仔的毅力打动，决定不再犯罪，跟他一起走。

source: The cowboy keeps walking, gathering more disciples. Spotters in major cities and small towns alike are on the lookout for the Lone Walking Ranger.
target: 牛仔一直走，追随者越来越多。大城小镇，都有人留意着这位独行步侠的踪迹。

source: "He's a metaphor for the lone walking ranger in all of our hearts," the magazines say. He inspires spiritualists everywhere. They even make a Walking Ranger Funko Pop.
target: “他象征着我们每个人心中的独行步侠。”杂志这样写道。他鼓舞了各地的灵修人士，甚至还有了独行步侠 Funko Pop 公仔。

source: The cowboy and his followers walk serenely into the sunset, never to be seen again...
target: 牛仔和追随者们安详地走进落日，再也没人见过他们……

source: SUCKERRRS!
target: 一群傻子——！

source: What?! But truth-or-dare's not near as excitin' as a regular duel to the death! It ain't even a duel at all!
target: 什么？！真心话大冒险，哪有生死决斗刺激！根本算不上决斗！

source: I agree that truth-or-dare doesn't quite pack the same -N2 HYPE as two cowboys quick-drawing in the desert...
target: 我也承认，真心话大冒险，没有两个牛仔在沙漠里比拔枪那么刺激。-N2热度……

source: But %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% kept the word "classic" in the name, so by law, they're technically the same.
target: 不过，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%保留了名字里的“经典”，所以从法律上说，这俩严格来讲是一回事。

source: Can't argue with that! LET THE TRUTH OR DARE DUEL BEGIN!
target: 有道理！真心话大冒险决斗，开始！

source: In round one, the cowboy gets you to admit that you wet the bed until you were thirteen. Rough start.
target: 第一轮，牛仔让你承认，你十三岁还在尿床。开局不利。

source: You retaliate by daring him to lick a mescaline cactus. He then dares you to bare-knuckle box the purple fairies flying around his head.
target: 你不甘示弱，让他舔一口含麦司卡林的仙人掌。他接着让你赤手空拳，跟在他头边飞舞的紫色仙子打一架。

source: You point out that you can't do that because he's hallucinating them, but you lose a point anyway.
target: 你指出，那是他的幻觉，你根本打不了。不过，你还是丢了一分。

source: It's looking bleak, but then inspiration hits you: you dare the cowboy to shoot himself in the leg!
target: 眼看要输，你突然灵机一动：让牛仔朝自己腿上开一枪！

source: Hmm, normally I'd think that shooting myself in the leg is a pretty dumb idea...
target: 嗯，平时我肯定觉得，朝自己腿上开枪挺蠢的……

source: But I don't wanna lose, and I didn't get to shoot anything earlier, so... why not?
target: 可我不想输，刚才也一直没捞着开枪，所以……有什么不行？

source: The cowboy shoots himself in the leg and quickly remembers why not: fatal blood loss.
target: 牛仔朝自己腿上开了枪，随即想起为什么不行：会失血过多而死。

source: Good work, bro! You live another day!
target: 干得好，兄弟！又活过一天！

source: Or at least until Scott or I somehow endanger your life with our antics again.
target: 至少活到我或者斯科特，下次再折腾出什么事，把你的小命搭进去。

source: Yeah... or, just a thought: you and Scott could do your best to NOT do that?
target: 是啊……或者，我就随便提一句：你和斯科特，能不能尽量别再干这种事？

source: Unlikely! Now let's go, we've got a road trip to survive!
target: 没戏！走吧，这趟公路旅行，咱们还得活着走完呢！

source: Visit the horsies
target: 去看马儿

source: You decide to visit the horse stables. You're always down to see some cute animals and indulge your inner horse girl.
target: 你决定去马厩看看。可爱动物，你一向来者不拒，也正好满足一下自己内心那个爱马女孩。

source: Look, Polly, this one likes me! You can see in his eyes that he really loves my head pats.
target: 波莉，快看，这匹喜欢我！看它的眼睛就知道，它超喜欢我摸它的头。

source: Totally! You can always tell what a horse is thinking when you look into its eyes. They're the big, derpy windows into its soul.
target: 没错！看着马的眼睛，就总能知道它在想什么。那可是它灵魂的大窗户，呆呆傻傻的那种。

source: Like I can tell this one really wants a bite of my pocket. Do you smell the ketamine cookies in there, big guy?
target: 比如，我就知道这匹想咬我的口袋。大家伙，闻到里面的氯胺酮饼干了？

source: What is your horse thinking, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你这匹马在想什么？

source: You look into the eyes of the horse you're petting. At first you don't see anything, so you REALLY squint. And then...
target: 你看着正抚摸的那匹马的眼睛。一开始什么都看不出来，于是使劲眯起眼。然后……

source: You can envision the horse's wants. Its desires. The things it craves most in the world.
target: 你看见了马的愿望，它的欲望，它在这世上最渴求的东西。

source: And it craves... violence. Arson. Bloodshed. So much bloodshed.
target: 它渴求的是……暴力。纵火。流血。无穷无尽的流血。

source: "Doooo itttt, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!" the horse says with its eyes. "Burn down the world! Commit tax fraud! It is our DESTINY!"
target: “动——手——啊，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！”马用眼睛对你说，“烧掉整个世界！搞税务欺诈！这就是我们的命运！”

source: Well? What's your horse saying, bro?
target: 怎么样，兄弟？你的马说什么了？

source: "Why are you still standing there?" the horse's eyes demand. "Why haven't you committed tax fraud yet?! As your horse overlord, I COMMAND YOU!"
target: “还站着干什么？”马的眼睛质问道，“为什么还没去搞税务欺诈？！以马之霸主的身份，我命令你！”

source: What's wrong, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? You won't deny this adorable horsie its sweet, innocent desires by staying silent, will you?
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，怎么了？难道你要一直不吭声，辜负这匹可爱小马，甜蜜又天真的愿望？

source: Crap! You don't want to let your friends down, but does that mean you need to do the horse's bidding? You decide to...
target: 糟了！你不想让朋友失望，可这就得听马的命令吗？你决定……

source: Chalk up the horse's disturbing demands to your own weird, intrusive thoughts and just pat its dumb head.
target: 把马那些不安分的要求，当成自己脑子里冒出的怪念头，摸摸它的傻脑袋就好。

source: Do the horse's bidding.
target: 听从马的命令。

source: Pledge yourself to your new horse overlord and do whatever he demands until the end of your days.
target: 向你的新马之霸主宣誓效忠，余生都照它的命令行事。

source: You play dumb (or maybe you just are dumb, who knows?) and give the horse a friendly head pat.
target: 你装起傻来——也可能真傻，谁知道呢——友善地摸了摸马头。

source: "Noooo! What about the tax fraud?!" screams the horse with its eyes. "I was very explicit about you committing tax fraud!"
target: “不——！税务欺诈呢？！”马用眼睛尖叫，“我不是说得很清楚，让你去搞税务欺诈吗？！”

source: But does it HAVE to be tax fraud? If these intrusive thoughts are gonna be in your head, can't you at least have a say in things?
target: 可非得搞税务欺诈吗？既然这些乱七八糟的念头，在你脑子里冒个不停，至少也该让你有点发言权吧？

source: "Fine, no tax fraud. We'll burn down an orphanage then! Ashes to ashes! Dust to dust!"
target: “行，不搞税务欺诈。那就去烧孤儿院！尘归尘，土归土！”

source: Hmm, yeah, still gonna need to tone it back a little.
target: 嗯，还是得收敛一点。

source: "Ugh. Fine. You could scratch my ears, maybe?"
target: “呃。行吧。那……给我挠挠耳朵？”

source: Sure! Finally, we're getting somewhere.
target: 好啊！这才像话嘛。

source: "Good... and now that I've gotten pets, we're close enough to burn down an orphanage together! OUR FRIENDSHIP WILL BE FORGED IN FLAMES!"
target: “好……既然你都摸过我，咱们已经亲近到，可以一起烧孤儿院了！让火焰铸就我们的友谊！”

source: Aaaand we're back to square one.
target: 好——又绕回来了。

source: You decide to just get the horse an apple. It's just a dumb horse, after all. All these homicidal requests are just your fucked-up psyche talking, right?
target: 你决定给马拿个苹果。说到底，就一匹傻马而已。那些杀人放火的要求，只是你自己脑子有毛病，想出来的，对吧？

source: Oh, boo, you really aren't good at this horse whispering thing. Can't you see in its eyes that it didn't want an apple?
target: 哎，亲爱的，你还真不擅长读懂马的心声。看它的眼睛，就知道它不想吃苹果啊？

source: Yeah, I was getting a clear "burn down an orphanage and commit tax fraud" message from your horse. Why didn't you respect its wishes?
target: 是啊，我明明读到了“烧孤儿院、搞税务欺诈”。你怎么不尊重它的愿望？

source: Whoops. Caring about the lives of little orphans gives you +N2 SOUL, but being so painfully lame and unwilling to commit crimes costs you -N2 HYPE.
target: 哎呀。关心小孤儿的性命，让你获得+N2灵魂；可你无聊得要命，还不肯犯罪，损失-N2热度。

source: Fuck it; you hated being in charge of your own life and decisions anyway. Might as well turn over your autonomy to a fuckin' horse.
target: 妈的，反正你也不想为自己的人生做主，不如把自主权交给一匹破马算了。

source: You start by committing tax fraud, netting the horse thousands of dollars. It's risky, but you hope it will be enough to appease your new friend.
target: 你先搞了税务欺诈，替马捞到几千美元。虽说冒险，但愿足够让新朋友满意。

source: No, this meager sum is not enough. The horse commands you to rob banks. Fine, ski mask robbery it is.
target: 不，这点钱远远不够。马命令你抢银行。行，那就戴上滑雪面罩去抢。

source: You stick up a bank. The teller is taking too long to fill the bag. You can feel the horse growing impatient...
target: 你持枪抢劫银行。柜员往袋子里装钱，装得太慢。你能感觉到，马渐渐不耐烦了……

source: But... you don't want to hurt the teller! She's filling the bag as fast as she can! This isn't necessary!!
target: 可……你不想伤害柜员！她已经在尽快装钱了！没必要这样！！

source: Sigh... how can you say no to those eyes?
target: 唉……那双眼睛，让你怎么拒绝？

source: You shoot the teller in the head and make off with the money. Not without shitting yourself a little, though.
target: 你朝柜员头上开了一枪，卷钱逃走。不过，你也吓得拉了一点出来。

source: When they're covering the robbery on the news later, they call your crime outfit "Whinny and the Poo."
target: 后来，新闻报道这场抢劫，把你们这个犯罪组合称为“小马维尼与便便”。
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): FIX; 前句明确马指挥抢劫、玩家吓出便便；小马维尼与便便保留马、排泄及 Winnie the Pooh 的戏仿。

source: You gain +N2 HYPE for being so devoted to the horse, but you still lose -N2 SOUL for committing murder. Bummer.
target: 你对马如此忠心，获得+N2热度，可谋杀仍让你损失-N2灵魂。真扫兴。

source: Fuck it; you hated being in charge of your own life and decisions anyway. Might as well turn over your autonomy to a fuckin' horse.
target: 妈的，反正你也不想为自己的人生做主，不如把自主权交给一匹破马算了。

source: No words are spoken, but the covenant is complete. You stare into its eyes and sign your mind, body, and soul over to this horse.
target: 无需言语，契约已成。你凝视它的眼睛，将自己的思想、身体与灵魂，统统交给这匹马。

source: Uhh, Polly? Does %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% seem... like a husk of %HISHER% former self to you?
target: 呃，波莉？你觉不觉得，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%好像……只剩下%HISHER%从前的空壳了？

source: Nah, %HESHE%%VERB_'S_'RE% always making that face.
target: 没有啊，%HESHE%%VERB_'S_'RE%一直就是这表情。
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): KEEP; 波莉把被马控制后的空洞表情当成常态；系词已由就是表达。 按行中文动词展开已实现；未实机验证。

source: %HESHE% probably just did something HUGE to make that horse happy. Good job, boo!
target: %HESHE%肯定是为了让那匹马高兴，干了件了不得的大事。干得好，亲爱的！

source: You go about your life pretty much as normal after that.
target: 之后，你的生活基本照旧。

source: But every once in a while you pass a stranger in the street, and their eyes are as empty and soulless as your own.
target: 可偶尔，你在街上跟陌生人擦肩而过，会看见那双眼睛，和你一样空洞，没有灵魂。

source: This is comforting, in a way. It's good to know who your allies are in the Hivemind of Horse.
target: 某种意义上，这倒让人安心。能认出马之集群意识里的盟友，挺好的。

source: The horse rewards you for your loyalty, of course; being in its fold grants you +N2 HYPE, +N2 MONEY, and +N2 MAGIC via its lucrative, arcane powers.
target: 马当然会奖励你的忠诚。加入它的麾下，凭着那神秘又生财有道的力量，你获得+N2热度、+N2金钱和+N2魔力。

source: But you also have to commit several atrocities on the horse's behalf: theft, arson, tax fraud, stabbing yourself in the leg for the laughs...
target: 不过，你也得替马犯下种种暴行：偷盗、纵火、税务欺诈，还有，为了逗乐，往自己腿上捅刀子……

source: Your new life of horse-crime takes a toll on you, and you lose -N3 MIND and -N3 SOUL.
target: 这场替马犯罪的新生活，代价不小，你损失了-N3头脑和-N3灵魂。

source: Display your own art
target: 展出自己的艺术作品

source: You tell your friends that you intend to display some of your own artwork at this exhibition.
target: 你告诉朋友们，打算在这场展览里，展出几件自己的作品。

source: Sounds fun! And look: they even hung up a blank canvas for people to draw on!
target: 好玩！快看，他们还挂了块空白画布，让大家随便画！

source: Hello friends. Are you also admiring Vincenzo Spinelli's piece, "Bianco e Nient'altro"? This all-white portrait was his last great work before he died.
target: 朋友们好。你们也在欣赏文森佐·斯宾内利的《纯白，别无他物》吗？这幅通体雪白的肖像，是他去世前最后的杰作。

source: What'd he die of, boredom?
target: 他怎么死的，无聊死的？

source: Looks like ol' Polly and friends are gonna have to put the "TWERK!" in artwork!
target: 看来得由波莉和朋友们，给这艺术品“画龙点臀”了！

source: Yeah! Let's draw something fun on that boring canvas!
target: 好耶！给这块无聊的画布，加点有意思的东西！

source: What?! You can't draw on Spinelli's masterpiece! It'd be a crime against art! And also against the actual law!
target: 什么？！你们不能在斯宾内利的杰作上乱画！这可是对艺术的犯罪！而且真的犯法！

source: Don't worry, Liam, our art will be hella legit. We'll even do our drawings on paper first and pick the best one.
target: 放心，李姆，我们的艺术绝对拿得出手。先在纸上画，再挑最好的一张就是了。

source: Well, I'm not just going to stand by and let you deface an art piece... not without my input, anyway. Give me a marker!
target: 我可不能站着看你们糟蹋艺术品……至少不能没我的份。给我支马克笔！

source: You all take a moment to create your drawings and take turns showing them off.
target: 大家各自画好，轮流展示作品。

source: Feast your eyes, plebeians: a blank page! Inspired by "Bianco e Nient'altro", it's an expression of ennui in an increasingly consumerist--
target: 睁大眼睛吧，凡人们：一张白纸！灵感来自《纯白，别无他物》，表达的是消费主义日益膨胀之下的倦——

source: Ugh, Liam's disqualified for being boring. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, what'd you draw?
target: 呃，李姆太无聊，出局。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你画了什么？

source: You drew Keith Bloodclaw, your Warrior Cats OC... which quickly gets disqualified for "having excessive abs".
target: 你画了基思·血爪，你的《猫武士》原创角色……很快就因“腹肌过多”，被取消了资格。

source: It's okay, boo! You can still make a mark on the art world... by choosing which piece should be exhibited: mine or Scott's?
target: 没事，亲爱的！你还是能在艺术界留下印记……选一幅来展出吧，我的，还是斯科特的？

source: Scott's piece
target: 斯科特的作品

source: Polly's piece
target: 波莉的作品

source: Scott translates his drawing to the museum wall. Immediately, art snobs are falling all over it to discuss its "imaginative brushstrokes" and "clear call-to-action."
target: 斯科特把自己的画搬上展馆的墙。艺术势利眼们立刻蜂拥而至，热烈讨论那“富有想象力的笔触”和“明确的行动号召”。

source: "Monsieur Howl!" says one art critic. "Can you explain what inspired you to choose an uncooked macaroni frame for your masterpiece?"
target: “嚎尔先生！”一位艺评家说，“请问，是什么让您选择，用没煮过的通心粉给杰作做画框？”

source: Oh, that's easy. I really like macaroni, but I'm not allowed to boil water by myself anymore, so I just eat the noodles raw.
target: 哦，很简单。我特别喜欢通心粉，可现在不准我自己烧水了，所以我就吃生的。

source: I spilled some on the picture while I was working, so I just rolled with it!
target: 画画时不小心撒了几根上去，我就将错就错啦！

source: Ugh, this is such an insult to Vincenzo Spinelli! You destroyed his masterpiece with your shitty macaroni art!
target: 这简直是在侮辱文森佐·斯宾内利！你用破通心粉画，毁了他的杰作！

source: "Oh, I wouldn't say he destroyed it. In fact, Monsieur Howl understood my art better than anyone!"
target: “哦，我可不觉得他毁了什么。事实上，嚎尔先生比谁都更懂我的艺术！”

source: The art critic removes his fake mustache and giant beret to reveal...
target: 艺评家摘掉假胡子和巨大的贝雷帽，露出真容……

source: VINCENZO SPINELLI?! But you're supposed to be dead!
target: 文森佐·斯宾内利？！可你不是死了吗！

source: "Nay, I merely faked my own death so I could watch 'Bianco e Nient'altro' in secret, waiting for the day a true artist would correctly interpret it... as a blank canvas!"
target: “不，我只是诈死，暗中守着《纯白，别无他物》，等待一位真正的艺术家，正确理解它……就是块空白画布！”

source: "Buff, gentle artist of luscious fur -- thank you for realizing my dream. You are a true artist at heart."
target: “这位身强体壮、性情温柔、毛发柔美的艺术家，谢谢你实现了我的梦想。你骨子里，就是个真正的艺术家。”

source: "You, and not the purple vampire who obviously didn't get my art."
target: “是你，可不是那个显然没看懂我作品的紫色吸血鬼。”

source: Sheesh, okay...
target: 唉，行吧……

source: Hooray! You gain +N2 SOUL for choosing the piece with the wholesome message! But you lose -N2 STAMINA because that macaroni came out of your road trip food supplies.
target: 好耶！你选了寓意温暖的作品，获得+N2灵魂！不过，那些通心粉来自你们的旅行口粮，你也损失了-N2体力。

source: Polly translates her drawing to the museum wall. Immediately, art snobs are falling all over it to discuss its "melancholy color palette" and "abundance of absolute dumptruck ass."

source: Interpret the art

target: 才不用。看艺术很简单，玩“睡、结婚、杀”就行！

target: “抱歉打扰，可我急需建议。我是个古怪的亿万富翁，来这里买画，却拿不定主意！”

source: "You all seem like experts in art interpretation. I was hoping you could help me decide?"
target: “你们看起来都很懂艺术，能不能帮我选选？”

target: 先生，找对吸血鬼了！请让我效劳。我可以好心写篇三十页的论文，论证您该买哪一幅！

target: “哦，抱歉，可能您误会了。我只是想请你们看看这幅画，告诉我，你们想睡它、跟它结婚，还是杀了它？”

target: 波莉说得对：三个选项，偏要挑最没劲的，就这下场。好好享受你的-N2热度吧。

target: 哇！我开始觉得，亿万富翁好像不是什么好人了！

target: “爽！毁掉这幅画，让我这富豪的大老二都硬得一跳一跳了！”

target: 馆长心都碎了。原来这场艺术展，是为了筹钱，把昂贵的画送给无家可归的孤儿。

target: 真棒。就因为%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%让有钱人毁了画，几十个挨饿的孩子，再也没机会拥有这件无价之宝了。

target: 不知道这问题是不是有点傻，不过，既然孩子们饿着，为什么不送吃的，非得送画？

source: Because ART IS PRICELESS AND ENRICHING, Scott! Who needs food when you can feed YOUR SOUL?!
target: 因为艺术无价，还能充实内心，斯科特！灵魂都能吃饱了，谁还需要食物？！

target: 你倒也该补补灵魂：毁了可怜孩子欣赏昂贵画作的唯一机会，让你损失-N2灵魂。真不害臊！

target: 等等……什么？这不是我的画！你们干了什么？！

source: Uh... does anyone have a question that's actually relevant to my artwork, like my disruptive use of color or my unique brushstroke technique?
target: 呃……有人想问点跟作品相关的吗？比如我颠覆性的用色，或独特的笔触？

source: Why are you dodging the question? You said you'd answer anything.
target: 为什么回避问题？你说了，什么都回答。

source: Guess you're not a true artist, huh?
target: 看来，不算真正的艺术家嘛？

source: "She's got a point," says an audience member. "I met Mark Rothko once, and he could correctly guess ANY number someone was thinking."
target: “她说得有道理。”一位观众说，“我见过一次马克·罗斯科，别人想什么数字，他全能猜对。”

source: "Yes, good artists can always guess what number you're thinking," another agrees. "There's clearly a direct correlation."
target: “对，好艺术家总能猜中你心里的数字。”另一人附和，“显然，这两者有直接关系。”

source: FINE! If it's that important to you all, I'll guess the stupid number!
target: 行！既然你们这么在意，我就猜那个破数字！

source: Liam stares deeply into your eyes. Is he using... magic vampire eyes?! You can feel the +N2 MAGIC running through you!
target: 李姆深深凝视你的眼睛。他在用……吸血鬼的魔眼？！你感觉到+N2魔力流遍全身！

source: Liam assesses you, inside and out... and pinches the bridge of his nose with a sigh.
target: 李姆从里到外，把你看了个透……随后，捏着鼻梁，叹了口气。

source: I cannot fucking believe this. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% is thinking of the number 69.
target: 我他妈真不敢信。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%心里想的是69。

source: Haha, nice!
target: 哈哈,不错!

source: Polly high-fives you.
target: 波莉跟你击了个掌。

source: The art critics LOSE IT. "He really guessed it! He's a real artist after all!"
target: 艺评家们激动得不行。“他真猜中了！果然是真正的艺术家！”

source: I could've proven that WITH MY REAL ART! %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% didn't have to turn my esteemed Q&A into a dirty joke!
target: 我用真正的作品，就能证明这一点！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%根本不用把我这场受人尊重的问答会，变成黄段子！

source: 69 isn't just a joke! It's a timeless hieroglyphic, artistically rendering 2 consenting adults giving mutual fellatio in a carnal testament to human sexuality.
target: 69才不只是个笑话！它是永不过时的象形文字，以艺术手法描绘两个自愿的成年人，相互口交，用肉欲印证人类的性欲。

source: "That woman is right!" says another art critic. "I never realized it before, but the number 69 DOES look like two people practicing oral sex. What an amusing discovery!"
target: “这位女士说得对！”又一位艺评家说，“以前没注意，69这个数字，还真像两个人在口交。多有趣的发现！”

source: Ugh, you guys are the worst. At least I still have my beautiful artwork to comfort me...
target: 呃，你们真是烂透了。至少，我还有美丽的画作可以安慰自己……

source: Wait... WHAT? This isn't my painting! What did you guys do?!
target: 等等……什么？这不是我的画！你们干了什么？！

source: Go swimming
target: 去游泳

source: You're about to get in the water when a loud whistle stops you in your tracks. It's the lifeguards!
target: 你正要下水，一声响亮的哨声，叫住了你。是救生员！

source: Heyyy, long time no see! What brings you guys to the lake?
target: 嘿——好久不见！什么风把你们吹到湖边来了？

source: We wanted to go swimming! You can do that at a lake, right?
target: 我们想游泳！湖里能游泳，对吧？

source: You sure can, brah, but only if you know how to swim safely.
target: 当然能，兄弟，不过，得知道怎么安全游泳才行。

source: Okay, how do we do that?
target: 好，那该怎么做？

source: Uhhh...
...Damn, dude, we totally forgot. Anyone got any ideas?
target: ……妈的，兄弟，我们全忘了。谁有主意？

source: Hmm... I know you shouldn't eat beforehand... move your arms and legs around... avoid wearing heavy stuff that'll drag you down, like metal or stone...
target: 嗯……我知道，之前不能吃东西……手脚要动起来……别穿金属、石头之类的重东西，会把你拖下去……

source: Oh, balls, I'm totally made of stone! Do you think that's why I lost my last job as a lifeguard?
target: 哎，糟了，我全身都是石头！难道这就是我上份救生员工作被炒的原因？

source: That makes sense. It must be why I got fired, too; I'm usually pretty stoned.
target: 有道理，难怪我也被炒了。我也总是嗨成一块“石头”。

source: But you guys aren't made of stone or metal, so you're safe, I think. Have fun out there!
target: 不过，你们又不是石头或金属做的，应该没事。去玩吧！

source: Are you sure that's all it takes? You haven't told us any actual tips on swimming safely yet...
target: 你确定这样就行？你们还没教过我们，任何真正能安全游泳的诀窍……

source: Eh, fair enough. If you're nervous, I'm sure I've got something in my lifeguard bag that'll help you swim.
target: 呃，也是。别紧张，我的救生包里，肯定有能帮你们游泳的东西。

source: But then again, I also have a lot of random shit in here. Does any of this crap seem helpful for swimming, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?
target: 不过，里面也有不少乱七八糟的玩意儿。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你看，哪个像是游泳能用的？

source: The very smol and intense swimming instructor that's as harsh as he is kawaii.
target: 又小只、又凶猛的游泳教练，严厉程度和可爱程度，不相上下。

source: Life insurance. Just in case.
target: 人寿保险。有备无患。

source: The pair of bright, arcane armbands that allow their user to cast a forbidden floating spell.
target: 一对鲜艳的秘法臂环，戴上就能施展禁忌漂浮术。

source: Awww, he's so cute! How harsh can one little otter be?
target: 哎呀，好可爱！这么小一只水獭，能严厉到哪儿去？

source: "YOU THINK I CAN'T BE HARSH AND CUTE AT THE SAME TIME?!" the instructor barks. "I CONTAIN MULTITUDES, ROOKIE! I'LL SHOW YOU HOW TOUGH I CAN BE!"
target: “你以为我不能又严厉又可爱？！”教练吼道，“老子可不只一面，菜鸟！这就让你见识我的厉害！”

source: The swimming lessons are INTENSE. You practice kicking, paddling, diving, washing the sensei's car, peeling potatoes...
target: 游泳课强度惊人。你们练习打腿、划水、跳水、给师父洗车、削土豆……

source: Okay, not to be THAT girl, but I don't see how preparing lunch is gonna help with swimming.
target: 好吧，不是故意抬杠，不过，做午饭到底怎么帮助游泳？

source: "DON'T QUESTION ME, ROOKIE! POTATO-PEELING IS THE BEST WAY TO TRAIN YOUR BODY FOR THE WATER!"
target: “别质疑我，菜鸟！削土豆，是训练身体下水的最佳方式！”

source: "THE REPETITIVE PEELING MOTIONS STRENGTHEN YOUR PALMS AND PHALANGES SO YOU CAN CARVE A PATH THROUGH EVEN THE TOUGHEST RIPTIDES!"
target: “反复削皮的动作，能强化手掌和指骨！再汹涌的激流，你们也能劈开一条路！”

source: Fair enough, but what about the car-washing thing? How will that help us swim?
target: 行吧，那洗车呢？怎么帮我们游泳？

source: "Um... okay, I admit, that was just me taking advantage of you."
target: “呃……好吧，我承认，那个就是占你们便宜。”

source: "BUT DO YOU KNOW HOW HARD IT IS TO WASH YOUR DIRTY CAR WHEN YOU'RE TWO FEET TALL?!"
target: “可你们知不知道，身高才两英尺，洗车有多难？！”

source: You lose -N2 STAMINA training, but when you finally start swimming, it's super easy!
target: 训练让你损失-N2体力。不过，终于下水时，游泳简直轻而易举！

source: Who knew swimming had so much in common with peeling potatoes? Nobody probably, because it makes no sense, but here you are!
target: 谁能想到，游泳跟削土豆这么像？大概没人，毕竟根本不合逻辑。不过，反正就是这么回事！

source: "EXCELLENT WORK, PUPILS!" the instructor says. "I CAN FINALLY RETIRE KNOWING THAT I'VE MOLDED YOU SAD SACKS INTO SPECTACULAR SWIMMERS!"
target: “干得好，学员们！”教练说，“把你们这群废柴，培养成出色的泳者，我总算能安心退休了！”

source: Thanks a million, little dude. You want a snack before I put you back in your travel cage for nappies?
target: 多谢，小家伙。把你放回便携笼睡午觉之前，要不要来点零食？

source: "YES! I REQUEST A CUP OF WARM MILK AND POSSIBLY A BEDTIME STORY BEFORE I RETURN TO MY SLUMBER."
target: “要！我要求一杯温牛奶，最好睡前再讲个故事，然后，我就要重返梦乡！”

source: Can do. You put your instructor to bed, and gain +N2 HYPE swimming in the lake!
target: 没问题。你哄教练睡下，随后在湖里尽情游泳，获得+N2热度！

source: Ahh, true. Swimming can be pretty dangerous; it'd be smart to have your life insurance worked out before you jump in the water.
target: 啊，也是。游泳确实挺危险，下水前把人寿保险办好，比较稳妥。

source: You look over the lifeguards' life insurance policy. It claims to cover "every danger you might encounter while swimming"...
target: 你看看救生员的寿险保单，上面号称承保“游泳时可能遇到的一切危险”……

source: ...yet it doesn't cover drowning?
target: ……可是不保溺水？

source: Well, yeah, you can't have it all. But this policy covers lots of other potentially deadly swimming scenarios.
target: 对啊，总不能什么都要吧。不过，很多别的游泳致死情形，这份保险都保。

source: Like dying from a work-related swimming accident!
target: 比如，因工游泳时发生意外，死掉！

source: Or death by water bears. That'd be a hella bad time.
target: 或者，被水熊杀死。那可就惨了。

source: Aren't water bears microscopic anyway?
target: 水熊不是小得得用显微镜看吗？

source: But there's still, like, millions of them living in the lake. We're totally outnumbered!
target: 可湖里有几百万只呢。敌众我寡啊！

source: Yeah. A million water bears vs. one %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? I don't fancy your chances.
target: 对啊，一百万只水熊，对付一个%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%？我看你胜算不大。

source: Okay, but why is "death by fire" covered by this policy?
target: 可为什么，这份保单还保“火灾身亡”？

source: Dude, if you don't understand the dangers of burning alive, maybe it'd be irresponsible of us to let you swim...
target: 兄弟，要是连活活烧死的危险都不懂，我们还放你去游泳，也太不负责任了……

source: C'mon, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, you're thinking too hard about it. Polly and I will feel a lot better if you took the extra safety precaution before we go swimming.
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，别想那么多了。下水前，你多一层保障，我和波莉才能放心。

source: Word. I've already picked the stripper I'm gonna hire for your funeral, so we'll need that life insurance check if this goes sideways.
target: 就是。你葬礼上要请的脱衣舞者，我都挑好了。万一出事，可得靠那笔寿险赔款。

source: Fine, if it means that much to them. You lose -N2 MONEY buying this nonsensical life insurance.
target: 行吧，既然他们这么在乎。你花-N2金钱，买下这份莫名其妙的人寿保险。

source: The good news is, you go on to have a great day in the lake! Much fun is had, no one dies from water bears or a lake fire, and you gain +N2 HYPE.
target: 好消息是，你们在湖里玩得很开心！没人被水熊杀死，也没人死于湖中火灾，你获得了+N2热度。

source: Whoa, mad respect. The Arcane Armbands of Buoyancy are suuuper powerful magic items.
target: 哇，佩服。这浮力秘法臂环，可是超级强大的魔法道具。

source: Really? They just look like regular floaties to me.
target: 真的？我看，就是普通充气浮袖啊。

source: That's 'cause you don't have the "magic touch", dude. Wanda and I got ours from the wizard who lives at Fill It.
target: 那是因为你没有“魔法天赋”，兄弟。我和万达这对，是住在加满它加油站的巫师给的。

source: Fill It... the gas station?
target: 加满它……那家加油站？

source: That's just what they WANT you to think. The wizard who lives in the Fill It parking lot told us it's actually a magical pocket dimension!
target: 他们就是想让你这么以为。住在加满它停车场的巫师说，那儿其实是个魔法口袋空间！

source: We were skeptical at first too, but then the wizard gave us some magic cosmic brownies that totally opened our eyes!
target: 一开始，我们也不信。可巫师给了我们几块魔法宇宙布朗尼，一下就让我们大开眼界！

source: Then, when Wanda and I were tripping magical balls, the wizard gave us the Armbands of Buoyancy to aid us on "whatever you do next, I don't fucking care."
target: 后来，我和万达嗨得灵魂出窍，巫师就给了我们浮力臂环，祝我们“接下来爱干吗干吗，老子他妈不在乎”。

source: But there was a catch: we had to dump magic onto the armbands to make them work.
target: 不过有个条件：得往臂环上灌魔力，它才管用。

source: We used the magic metal elephant trunks at Fill It to get the magic at the time, but I dunno where you'll find any magic all the way out here...
target: 当时我们用加满它那些魔法金属象鼻，弄到了魔力。不过，现在跑这么远，你们去哪儿找魔力呢……

source: Hey, we've been filling our car with magic! Let's use some of that!
target: 嘿，我们一直在给车灌魔力！用点那个不就行了！

source: I'm pretty sure dumping our hard-earned fuel on these floaties would be a terrible idea.
target: 辛辛苦苦弄来的燃油，往浮袖上倒，我很确定，这主意不怎么样。

source: Pfft. Spoken by someone who totally lacks the "magic touch".
target: 嘁，一听就知道，是没有“魔法天赋”的人说的。

source: C'mon, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, we gotta do it! The flotation spell won't work otherwise!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，得这么干！不然漂浮术就没用了！

source: Ugh, fine. You lose -N2 MAGIC dunking the floaties in gasoline.
target: 呃，行吧。你把浮袖浸进汽油，损失-N2魔力。

source: At least you still have fun playing in the lake, and gain +N2 HYPE splashing around with your friends!
target: 至少，你们在湖里玩得很开心。跟朋友们打水仗，让你获得+N2热度！

source: Build sand castles
target: 堆沙堡

source: You're having fun building castles when you notice that your sandy abodes have acquired some new tenants.
target: 你们正开心地堆着沙堡，忽然发现，沙子搭的房子，来了新住户。

source: Bros, look! Those hermit crabs are moving into our sand castle.
target: 兄弟们，看！寄居蟹搬进我们的沙堡了。

source: That's dope. We have king and queen crabs now. You guys are, like, the kingmakers of the lake.
target: 酷。这下有国王蟹和王后蟹了。你们简直就是这湖里的造王者。

source: Yup! And check out the king's brother sharpening that shell shard into a spear. I smell a regicide coming on!
target: 对！看国王的弟弟，正把贝壳碎片磨成长矛。我闻到弑君的味道了！

source: Hi Wanda! Hi Stu! What're you doing at the lake?
target: 嗨，万达！嗨，斯图！你们来湖边干吗？

source: Uh... fuck... what ARE we doing here?
target: 呃……妈的……我们来干吗的？

source: Aren't you lifeguards?
target: 你们不是救生员吗？

source: Oh yeah! Good catch. That explains these rescue floaties and this whistle and why my swimsuit says "Lifeguard."
target: 哦，对！提醒得好。难怪有救生浮标、哨子，泳衣上还写着“救生员”。

source: And that reminds me: as the lifeguards, we gotta check to make sure your sand castles don't have any OSHA violations.
target: 这倒提醒我了：作为救生员，我们得检查你们的沙堡，有没有违反 OSHA 职业安全规定。

source: Yup, them's the rules for some reason. And I can tell you already that these castles aren't up to code at all.
target: 对，不知为什么，规矩就是这样。而且我现在就看得出，这些城堡，根本不合规。

source: Bummer, dudes. We'll be back with the paperwork to condemn them. It should take five minutes to an hour depending on if we forget what we're doing on the way.
target: 真遗憾，伙计们。我们回去拿文件，等会儿来查封。大概五分钟到一小时，取决于路上，会不会忘了自己要干吗。

source: We have to do something, bros. If they condemn our sand castles, King and Queen Snippy won't have a place to call home!
target: 兄弟们，得想想办法。沙堡一被查封，钳钳国王和王后，就没家了！

source: There's gotta be some way to get the castles up to code before the lifeguards return. Time to save your crabs from total OSHAnnihilation!
target: 得赶在救生员回来前，让沙堡符合规范。是时候拯救你们的螃蟹，躲过 OSHA 的“安全歼灭”了！

source: You may have to replace the sand with another material. Sand isn't well-known for its integrity as a material.
target: 也许该换个材料，别用沙了。沙子这东西，可不以结实牢靠见长。

source: You probably have to ditch the Murder Plaza. Chances are the Murder Plaza is the least-safe part of this sand castle.
target: 大概得拆掉谋杀广场。整座沙堡里，最不安全的，八成就是谋杀广场。

source: You and your friends spend -N2 MONEY on concrete, metal scaffolding, and other construction materials to reinforce your sand castle.
target: 你和朋友们花-N2金钱，买了混凝土、金属脚手架等建材，加固沙堡。

source: We're back, dudes. Ready for us to hand down our verdict?
target: 我们回来啦，伙计们。准备好听判决了吗？

source: Wait a sec, Stu. Something's different about their sand castle...
target: 等等，斯图。他们的沙堡，好像不太一样了……

source: Are you admiring the marble balconies with which King Snippy can address his devoted subjects?
target: 在欣赏大理石阳台吗？钳钳国王可以站在上面，对忠诚的臣民发表讲话。

source: Or are you more into the Romanesque support columns in the throne room, which stabilize the castle and look super kickass?
target: 还是更喜欢王座厅里的罗曼式支柱？既能加固城堡，看着又超帅。

source: Do you like where I wrote "Scott thinks ur super cool" in this wall before the cement dried?
target: 我趁水泥没干，在这墙上写了“斯科特觉得你超酷”，你们喜欢吗？

source: Waaait, I figured it out! Your sand castle's not made of sand anymore!
target: 等——等，我知道了！你们这沙堡，已经不是沙子做的了！

source: But... if it's not made of sand anymore... can you even call it a sand castle?
target: 可……既然不用沙子，还能叫沙堡吗？

source: That's a good question. But let's not be so technical. Architecture is much more about art, and less about "chitecture".
target: 好问题。不过，别抠技术细节。建筑，重在“造艺”，不在“造房”。

source: We've still made a sand castle, but we've broken the artistic boundary of using sand and totally redefined your preconceptions of what a sand castle can be!
target: 我们造的，还是沙堡。只不过突破了必须用沙的艺术边界，彻底重新定义了你们心中，沙堡该有的样子！

source: A sand castle can be concrete! It can be metal! It can even be... OSHA COMPLIANT!
target: 沙堡可以是混凝土的！可以是金属的！甚至可以……符合 OSHA 规范！

source: Oh, sure, it's compliant. This sounds more like an art piece than a building now anyway, so it's not under our jurisdiction to judge it.
target: 哦，那当然合规。反正听着也更像艺术品，不是建筑了，不归我们管。

source: Sweet! You gain +N2 MIND from the artistic insights of building a sand-less sand castle.
target: 好耶！堆出一座没有沙的沙堡，让你对艺术有了新的领悟，获得+N2头脑。

source: Awww, are you sure? The Murder Plaza was, like, the best part of the castle!
target: 哎呀，确定吗？谋杀广场可是城堡最棒的部分！

source: And I spent so long sculpting little bloodthirsty sand golems!
target: 我还花了那么久，雕那些嗜血的小沙魔像！

source: How are King and Queen Snippy gonna have Sexy Knifeplay Thursdays now?
target: 没了它，钳钳国王和王后，周四还怎么性感玩刀？

source: Actually, it's King Scuttle now. King Snippy was mysteriously found dead with a seashell spear in his thorax.
target: 其实，现在是横横国王了。钳钳国王被发现离奇死亡，胸部插着一根贝壳长矛。

source: Oh... where was his body found?
target: 哦……尸体在哪儿发现的？

source: The Murder Plaza, obviously. It's thematic!
target: 当然是谋杀广场。很符合主题嘛！

source: Goddammit...
target: 妈的……

source: You lose -N2 HYPE getting rid of the awesome Murder Plaza and all its amazing sand-torture devices, but it's for the best.
target: 拆掉超棒的谋杀广场，以及各种绝妙的沙制刑具，让你损失-N2热度。不过，这也是为大家好。

source: Sah, dudes! Ready for us to hand down our verdict?
target: 哟，伙计们！准备好听判决了吗？

source: Stu, check it out! They got rid of the Murder Plaza! That puts you right in OSHA compliancy, my dudes.
target: 斯图，快看！谋杀广场拆了！这下，完全符合 OSHA 规范了，兄弟们。

source: Wow, that was pretty easy. We didn't even have to clean out the mold in the guest house!
target: 哇，好简单。连客房里的霉菌，都不用清！

source: Yeah, OSHA certifications are stupid easy to get. As long as you don't have asbestos, Murder Plazas, or less than three windows, you're good to go.
target: 是啊，OSHA 认证，简单得要命。没有石棉，没有谋杀广场，窗户不少于三扇，就没问题。

source: Great! You gain +N2 MIND from the relaxing joy of building a sand castle, sans Murder Plaza.
target: 真好！不用谋杀广场，也能享受堆沙堡的轻松快乐。你获得+N2头脑。

source: Collect seashells
target: 收集贝壳

source: You, Scott, and Polly set about collecting seashells, as a little memento of your trip together.
target: 你、斯科特和波莉，开始捡贝壳，留作这趟旅行的小纪念。

source: Check this shell out! Scott, hold it up to your ear!
target: 快看这贝壳！斯科特，放到耳边听听！

source: Ooh, does it sound like ocean waves?
target: 哦，能听见海浪声吗？

source: No, better! It sounds like vaporwave music!
target: 不，更好！是蒸汽波音乐！

source: Polly's shell is covered in gridlines and inexplicably fills you with 90s nostalgia, so that makes sense.
target: 波莉的贝壳布满网格线，还莫名勾起了你对九十年代的怀念。这就说得通了。

source: That's cool. I found this shell, but I'm not sure if it's a seashell. It looks more like a lake-shell to me.
target: 酷。我也找到了一个，不过，不确定是不是海贝壳。我觉得，更像湖贝壳。

source: ...Stellar deduction, buddy.
target: ……好厉害的推理，伙计。

source: You show your friends the shell you found. It's beautiful and small and swirly -- and it suddenly starts crawling around your palm!
target: 你给朋友们看自己捡到的贝壳。小巧漂亮，还带着螺旋纹——忽然，它在你掌心爬了起来！

source: Cool! %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s shell is haunted!
target: 酷！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%的贝壳闹鬼了！

source: Nah, it's not haunted. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% just found a hermit crab.
target: 不是闹鬼，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%只是捡到了一只寄居蟹。

source: Yeah... and sorry to be a buzzkill, but we can't let you take that shell. As the lifeguards of this lake, we can't let you mess with the local wildlife.
target: 是啊……抱歉扫兴，不过，这个贝壳，你不能带走。我们是这湖的救生员，不能让你们打扰本地的野生动物。

source: Yeah. It could be bad for, like, the environment or something?
target: 对。可能……对环境什么的，不太好？

source: Plus, having a bunch of sad, homeless hermit crabs around would really harsh the vibe around here.
target: 再说，一群无家可归、伤心的寄居蟹，留在湖边，多破坏气氛。

source: Oh no, you're right! We don't wanna be hermit crab homewreckers!
target: 哦不，你说得对！我们可不想拆散寄居蟹的家！

source: Hmm, what if %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% traded the hermit crab something for its shell instead of just taking it?
target: 嗯，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%用点东西，跟寄居蟹换贝壳，不直接拿，行不行？

source: Sure. As long as this is a fair-and-square exchange of goods and not a theft situation, we're cool.
target: 行。只要是公平交易，不是偷窃，就没问题。

source: Fair nuff. What do you give the hermit crab in exchange for its shell?
target: 也好。你拿什么，跟寄居蟹换贝壳？

source: This seashell is the crab's house, so the only fair thing to do is give the deed to your own house to the crab.
target: 贝壳是蟹的房子，唯一公平的办法，就是把你自己家的房契给它。

source: Make a pact to give the crab your first child.
target: 订个契约，把你的第一个孩子给寄居蟹。

source: Cool, that makes perfect sense! I appreciate you guys rehoming this hermit crab so we didn't have to.
target: 酷，很合理！多谢你们给寄居蟹安了家，省得我们操心。

source: But wait, Wanda... what if %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s actions will... like... have consequences?
target: 不过，等等，万达……%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%干的事，会不会……有什么后果？

source: What do you mean?
target: 什么意思？

source: Well, what if this hermit crab becoming a homeowner makes all the other hermit crabs jealous?
target: 就是，这只寄居蟹有房了，其他寄居蟹会不会嫉妒？

source: So then the hermit crabs start trading their shells to other gullible young adults with property to spare...
target: 然后，它们开始拿贝壳，去跟其他好骗、又有多余房产的年轻人换……

source: And then we crash the housing market 'cause all the best properties are being bought and sold for hermit crab shells!
target: 接着，最好的房子，全拿寄居蟹壳买卖，房产市场就被我们搞崩了！

source: Then all the houses have been bought by crabs, so monsters start having to live in hermit crab shells, then even THAT housing market inflates...
target: 房子都被蟹买走，怪物们只能住进寄居蟹壳。然后，连这个房产市场也开始涨价……
