source: Before you know it, it won't be weird to see poor families with eight people sleeping in one undersized shell on the beach!
target: 到最后，贫困的一家八口，挤在海滩上一只小小的壳里睡觉，都不稀奇了！

source: Damn, that's a good point... and if the hermit crabs take our houses, what's next? Our jobs?!
target: 妈的，说得有道理……寄居蟹抢走咱们的房子，下一步呢？工作？！

source: Nooooo! A hermit crab would be such a better lifeguard than me! I can't compete!
target: 不——！寄居蟹当救生员，肯定比我强！我怎么竞争啊！

source: I feel like all that happening is pretty unlikely...
target: 我觉得，这一整套发生的可能性，不太大……

source: Oh yeah? Smoke this and see if you still feel that way in a few minutes.
target: 是吗？抽口这个，过几分钟，看你还这么想不。

source: Twenty minutes later...
target: 二十分钟后……

source: Holy shit. We're gonna crash the housing market!
target: 卧槽。房产市场要被我们搞崩了！

source: Told ya.
target: 早跟你说了。

source: You're still skeptical, but you for sure lost -N2 MONEY trading an entire house to a hermit crab. At least you gained +N2 MAGIC from the gorgeous shell!
target: 你仍有点怀疑。不过，一整套房子换给寄居蟹，确实让你损失了-N2金钱。至少，漂亮的贝壳让你获得了+N2魔力！

source: Whoa, you get the shell AND you don't have to pay for birth control? Sweet deal!
target: 哇，既能拿贝壳，又不用花钱避孕？赚了！

source: Sweet indeed. You get your shell, your crab gets an "IOU 1 Baby" coupon, and everyone is happy.
target: 确实赚了。你拿到了贝壳，寄居蟹拿到一张“欠一个宝宝”的兑换券，皆大欢喜。

source: You continue on your merry way, quickly forgetting about the whole incident...
target: 你开心地上路，很快就把这事，忘了个一干二净……

source: ...for about 8 years. By this time, you've married the love of your life and gotten a home together. You two now have a healthy, bouncing baby.
target: ……大概忘了八年。这时候，你已和一生挚爱结婚，一起安了家，还有了个健康活泼的宝宝。

source: You and your spouse are cuddling your little bundle of joy when you hear a quiet -- yet insistent -- knock at the door. It's the hermit crab!
target: 你和伴侣正抱着小宝贝，忽然听到轻轻的、却不依不饶的敲门声。是那只寄居蟹！

source: "What's happening, honey?" your spouse cries. "Why is a hermit crab trying to take our baby out of my arms?!"
target: “亲爱的，怎么回事？”伴侣叫道，“为什么有只寄居蟹，要从我怀里抢走我们的孩子？！”

source: You explain that you promised this crab your first child in exchange for its shell. It seemed like a good idea at the time.
target: 你解释，曾答应把第一个孩子给寄居蟹，换它的贝壳。当时觉得，是个好主意。

source: You're sure you could convince your spouse it was worth it if you showed them the shell...
target: 你很确定，只要把贝壳拿出来，伴侣就会相信，这交易绝对值……

source: But you traded it to a raccoon 3 years ago for a plate of spaghetti. Oops!
target: 可三年前，你已经拿贝壳，跟一只浣熊换了盘意大利面。哎呀！

source: "Dammit, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! This is why we're getting a divorce, you know -- you're TERRIBLE at bartering!"
target: “妈的，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！知道为什么要跟你离婚吗？就是因为你太不会以物易物了！”

source: That must also be why your spouse is getting the house and everything else you own in the settlement. When will you learn?
target: 想必也正因如此，离婚财产分割时，房子和你所有其他财产，全归了伴侣。你什么时候，才能长点记性？

source: But that's years from now. All you know right now is that you lose -N2 SOUL from your heartless decision, but gain +N2 MAGIC from your shell! Ooh, pretty!
target: 不过，那都是好多年后的事了。现在你只知道，冷血的决定让你损失-N2灵魂，可贝壳让你获得+N2魔力！哇，真漂亮！

source: Pancake eating contest!
target: 大胃王煎饼赛！

source: You enter the diner and are greeted by the hostess.
target: 你走进餐厅，迎宾员上前招呼。

source: Welcome to Pancake Paradise. Are any of you entering our pancake-eating championship today?
target: 欢迎光临煎饼乐园。各位，今天有人要参加大胃王煎饼锦标赛吗？

source: Championship? Nah, I didn't do any warmup drills or anything. I think I'll just cheerlead from the sidelines.
target: 锦标赛？不了，我连热身都没做。还是在旁边当啦啦队吧。

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% and I might give it a shot. Maybe there's a cool prize!
target: 我和%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%可以试试。说不定有很酷的奖品！

source: (Psst, want me to mix some laxatives into the pancake batter to ensure our victory, boo?)
target: （嘘，亲爱的，要不要我往煎饼面糊里掺点泻药，保咱们稳赢？）

source: (Tempting, but no thanks. If I'm gonna eat a disgusting amount of carbs to win a competition, I'd rather do it on my own merit.)
target: （挺诱人，不过算了。既然要靠吃下离谱数量的碳水赢比赛，我宁愿凭真本事。）

source: First you guys need to complete this readiness questionnaire to see if your body can handle the amount of pancake you're about to consume.
target: 先填这份参赛准备问卷，看看你们的身体，能不能扛住即将吃下的煎饼量。

source: 1. Are you legally allowed to consume pancakes in this country?
target: 1. 你们在本国，是否获准合法食用煎饼？

source: This one, yes! Let's hope she doesn't ask about Croatia.
target: 这个国家，没问题！希望她别问克罗地亚的事。

source: 2. Do you have any syrup allergies?
target: 2. 对糖浆过敏吗？

source: Nope! The only thing I'm allergic to is not having a good time!
target: 没有！我唯一过敏的，就是玩得不开心！

source: 3. Have you taken any appetite-enhancing drugs? Entering the competition with the munchies is strictly forbidden.
target: 3. 是否服用了增强食欲的药物？严禁嗑嗨之后，饿着肚子来参赛。

source: Nah, I'm clean (today).
target: 没，我没嗑——今天没嗑。

source: FUCK! Guess I'm disqualified.
target: 操！看来我被取消资格了。

source: All right, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, you're good to enter. Which weight class did you wanna compete in?
target: 好了，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你可以参赛。要选哪个量级？

source: Pancake Boy Jolly Race: Born to Pancake!
target: 煎饼男孩欢乐赛：生来就爱煎饼！

source: The Epic Pancake Tournament Arc: Pancake to the Death!
target: 史诗煎饼大赛篇：吃到死！

source: Pancake Beyond: Consume the Concept of Pancake!
target: 煎饼之彼岸：吃掉煎饼的概念！

source: Uh... that category's only for babies and toddlers...?
target: 呃……那个组别只限婴幼儿……？

source: The poster says "for ages 1 AND UP". %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% is up, and therefore still allowed in.
target: 海报上写的是“一岁及以上”。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%就是“以上”，当然能参加。

source: Hooray! Nice loophole-ing, bro!
target: 好耶！兄弟，这漏洞钻得漂亮！

source: Fine, whatever. Come with me, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 行吧，随便了。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，跟我来。

source: The hostess hands you a bib and shows you to your high chair.
target: 迎宾员递给你一条围嘴，带你坐上婴儿餐椅。

source: You're surrounded by drooling, babbling babies with no clear sense of competitive spirit. Such amateurs!
target: 周围的宝宝们，流着口水，咿咿呀呀，毫无竞争意识。一群业余选手！

source: "Wow, that %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% is such a good eater!" says one mom in the audience as you compete. "I wish I could get my Carson to clean his plate like that."
target: 比赛时，观众席上一位妈妈说：“哇，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%吃饭真棒！我家卡森，要是也能把盘子吃这么干净就好了。”

source: "That's true...," says another mom, "but don't you find it disturbing how much body hair %HESHE% %VERB_HAS_HAVE% at %HISHER% age?"
target: “是啊……”另一位妈妈说，“可%HESHE%在%HISHER%这个年纪，就%VERB_HAS_HAVE%那么多体毛，不觉得吓人吗？”
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): KEEP; 婴幼儿比赛里的妈妈谈体毛；has 为长着，非完成时。 按行中文动词展开已实现；未实机验证。

source: You win the eating competition easily, owing to such advantages as "you have teeth" and "you can use a fork properly."
target: 靠着“有牙齿”“会正确使用叉子”等优势，你轻松赢下了大胃王比赛。

source: Congratulations, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. You're this year's Pancake Boy Jolly Race winner. You are such a strong, capable young %BOYGIRL%.
target: 恭喜，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。你是今年煎饼男孩欢乐赛的冠军，真是个强壮又能干的好%BOYGIRL%。

source: NOICE! How much money %VERB_DOES_DO% %HESHE% win?
target: 漂亮！%HESHE%%VERB_DOES_DO%能赢多少奖金？
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): POLISH; 追问奖金；助动词不译，移回主语后的语法位置。 按行中文动词展开已实现；未实机验证。

source: Oh, there's no cash prize for this one. Babies don't have much use for cash, y'know.
target: 哦，这项没现金奖。毕竟宝宝们，也不怎么用得上钱。

source: You do win a year's supply of Pancake Paradise brand diapers, though. If they give you a rash, cry to my manager, not me.
target: 不过，你赢得了够用一年的煎饼乐园牌尿布。要是用了起疹子，找我经理哭，别找我。

source: Well, at least you got +N2 STAMINA from eating pancakes, but you lose -N2 HYPE for your embarrassing impersonation of a baby.
target: 好吧，吃煎饼，至少让你获得+N2体力。可你扮宝宝扮得太丢人，损失-N2热度。

source: You go to a long table where the other competitors are waiting. Many of them have colored hair and weird outfits and general protagonist vibes.
target: 你来到长桌旁，其他选手正在等待。不少人染着彩色头发，衣着古怪，浑身主角气场。

source: "I've mastered the art of ancient pancake jutsu," one of them is saying. "I trained for nine years inside an active syrup volcano for this contest!"
target: “我已掌握远古煎饼忍术。”其中一人说，“为了这场比赛，我在一座活糖浆火山里，修炼了九年！”

source: "That's nothing!" says another. "My mother was THE Pam Cake, winner of every pancake eating championship since 1964. I'm taking home the gold in her honor!"
target: “那算什么！”另一人说，“我妈可是帕姆·凯克！自1964年起，所有大胃王煎饼赛的冠军，都是她！我要为她赢下金牌！”

source: That's nice, sir. Would you like to supersize your drink for a dollar more before the competition starts?
target: 真好，先生。比赛前，要不要加一美元，升级大杯饮料？

source: "I would like it MEGA-SUPER SIZED! It's the only drink size worthy of my power!"
target: “我要超级无敌大杯！唯有这种容量，才配得上我的力量！”

source: ...I'll just bring you the soda hose. Knock yourself out.
target: ……那我直接给你拿根汽水管。喝个够吧。

source: Shit, these competitors are really serious. Maybe you're in over your head...
target: 妈的，这些选手来真的啊。你是不是有点不自量力……

source: Don't worry, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, you got this! I'm your sensei now, and I'm gonna coach you to victory!
target: 别怕，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你行的！从现在起，我就是你的师父，包你赢！

source: You gotta open your chakras to win this thing. But most of all, you gotta open your BUTT CHAKRA!
target: 要赢，就得打开脉轮。不过，最重要的是，打开你的屁股脉轮！

source: "Butt chakra"... do you mean my anus?
target: “屁股脉轮”……你是说肛门？

source: Yeah, but I'm gonna keep calling it a "butt chakra." Sounds more powerful and less icky.
target: 对，不过我还是叫它“屁股脉轮”。听着更有力量，也没那么恶心。

source: And remember, bro: the best athlete is only as good as %HISHER% sporting equipment. For you, that's gonna be this toilet I took from the bathroom.
target: 记住，兄弟，再好的运动员，也得靠%HISHER%装备。给你准备的，就是这个我从厕所搬来的马桶。

source: Perfect! The eating contest begins, and with your butt chakra wide open, you smoke the competition on your porcelain throne.
target: 完美！大胃王比赛开始了。屁股脉轮大开，你端坐瓷器王座，把所有对手杀了个片甲不留。

source: Wow... that was... the worst thing I've ever seen. But you won. Congrats, I guess.
target: 哇……那真是……我见过最糟糕的画面。不过，你赢了。恭喜，算是吧。

source: Hooray! You gain +N2 HYPE for winning, but you lose -N2 STAMINA from the, ah, "butt chakra" strain.
target: 好耶！胜利让你获得+N2热度，不过，呃，“屁股脉轮”负担太大，你也损失了-N2体力。

source: Great, another "theoretical pancologist"... you'll be eating in the conference room.
target: 真棒，又来个“理论煎饼学家”……去会议室吃吧。

source: This greasy diner has a conference room? ...Yes, apparently, and it's full of uber-serious philosophers contemplating a stack of pancakes on the table.
target: 这油腻小餐厅，还有会议室？……还真有。里面全是严肃得不得了的哲学家，正凝视桌上那叠煎饼，陷入沉思。

source: The discussion leader says, "Thank you all for gathering for our yearly conference on the Consumption of the Pancake Beyond."
target: 主持人说：“感谢各位参加一年一度的‘煎饼彼岸之吞食’研讨会。”

source: They have beyond-flavored pancakes now? Cool!
target: 现在都有彼岸味煎饼了？酷！

source: "Oh, no, we aren't going to eat the pancakes on that table with our mouths. Theoretical pancology is the study of consuming pancakes with our MINDS."
target: “哦，不，我们不用嘴，吃桌上那些煎饼。理论煎饼学，研究的是用思想吃煎饼。”

source: "You see, we believe the term 'pan cake' was actually an Ancient Greek philosophical concept..."
target: “我们相信，‘pan cake’其实是个古希腊哲学概念……”

source: "...referring to the nutritional, intellectual, and even spiritual sustenance cosmically sealed within EVERYTHING!"
target: “……意指万物之中，由宇宙封存的营养、智慧，乃至精神的滋养！”

source: Damn, that's wild. What evidence do you have to support this theory?
target: 我去，真玄乎。你们有什么证据，支持这个理论？

source: "I'm glad you asked. The word 'pancake' begins with the Greek prefix 'pan', which means everything. Therefore, it translates to 'everything-cake'!"
target: “问得好。‘pancake’开头的希腊语前缀‘pan’，意为‘一切’。所以，这个词应当译作‘万物之饼’！”

source: Okay... and is that all you've got, or...?
target: 好吧……证据就这些了，还是……？

source: It's good enough for me! How do I eat the pancake in everything?
target: 对我来说，够了！那我怎么吃万物里的煎饼？

source: "Well... we're still trying to figure that out. For now, we've just been trying thinking about pancakes really hard and seeing where that gets us."
target: “嗯……我们还在研究。目前就是努力想煎饼，看看能不能有点进展。”

source: ...Are you sure I can't just eat the pancakes on the table?
target: ……真不能直接吃桌上那些煎饼吗？

source: You're not exactly popular for choosing the philosophical conference where nobody eats pancakes. You lose -N3 HYPE and -N3 STAMINA.
target: 你挑了个没人吃煎饼的哲学研讨会，自然不怎么讨人喜欢。你损失了-N3热度和-N3体力。

source: But after pondering with the theoretical pancologists for a while, you can sorta buy into their point of view. You gained +N3 MAGIC and +N3 MIND, anyway!
target: 不过，跟理论煎饼学家们一起琢磨了会儿，你好像还真有点信了。反正，你获得了+N3魔力和+N3头脑！

source: Eat the biggest meal
target: 挑战最大份套餐

source: You all enter the restaurant and are greeted by the hostess.
target: 你们走进餐厅，迎宾员上前招呼。

source: Welcome to Pancake Paradise. Today's special is the Captain Carbs' Butterball Pancake Stack Challenge.
target: 欢迎光临煎饼乐园。今日特推：碳水船长黄油球煎饼塔挑战。

source: If you eat the entire meal in one sitting, you get your food for free.
target: 一口气吃完整份套餐，就能免单。

source: Aww, man, too bad I'm on a keto diet right now. No carbs for me! Just get me six sides of bacon and a cup of melted butter, please.
target: 哎，真可惜，我最近在生酮，不能吃碳水！给我六份培根配菜，再来杯融化的黄油，谢谢。

source: None for me either. I don't really do food. Well, I "do" food occasionally, but I don't eat it.
target: 我也不吃。我不怎么碰食物。偶尔倒会跟食物“搞一搞”，不过不吃。

source: But I'm sure %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% will do it! %HESHE%%VERB_'S_'RE% always doing weird challenges for our entertainment.
target: 不过，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%肯定会参加！%HESHE%%VERB_'S_'RE%老爱做些怪挑战，逗我们开心。
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): KEEP; 大餐挑战开场，老爱做怪挑战已完整传达原意。 按行中文动词展开已实现；未实机验证。

source: Fuck yeah, you'll do it! A plate of pancakes roughly the same weight as a toddler would really hit the spot right now anyway.
target: 当然干啊！反正，你现在正想吃一叠，跟小宝宝差不多重的煎饼。

source: It's your funeral.
target: 死了可别怪我。

source: Er, I mean, "Captain Carbs commends your unparalleled bravery. You're a true breakfast hero. He offers you his captain's badge as prize."
target: 呃，我是说，“碳水船长赞赏您无与伦比的勇气。您是真正的早餐英雄，他将以船长徽章，奖励您的壮举。”

source: Don't let children or pets chew on it. It's covered in lead paint.
target: 别让小孩或宠物啃，上面全是含铅涂料。

source: You're hyped for your stack of cholesterol and your sick badge, but just as the waitress takes your order, there's sudden cheering and air horns from across the diner.
target: 你正期待着那叠胆固醇，以及酷炫的徽章，服务员刚记下订单，餐厅另一头就响起欢呼，还有气喇叭声。

source: Ope. Looks like someone else just completed Captain Carbs' Butterball Challenge.
target: 哎，看来又有人完成了碳水船长黄油球挑战。

source: You won't be able to win the badge now, sorry. We only had one.
target: 不好意思，现在赢不到徽章了。我们就一枚。

source: Oh, well. At least %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% came in second place! It's like my grandma always says: "Second place is just 'Best Loser!'"
target: 哎，至少%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%拿了第二名！我奶奶常说：“亚军，就是输家里最强的！”

source: No way! You're not gonna take defeat lying down. There's gotta be some way to one-up the fucker and claim the highly-toxic badge you're rightfully owed...
target: 才不！你可不会就这么认输。总得想个办法，压过那混蛋，把本该属于你的剧毒徽章抢回来……

source: Use your foolproof solution for whenever you're denied what you want: cry.
target: 祭出你想要东西没得逞时，百试百灵的绝招：哭。

source: EAT THE CHAMPION.
target: 吃掉冠军。

source: As you learned when you were five years old (which is also when you stopped maturing), tears and tantrums are always the key to getting your way.
target: 五岁那年，你就学会了：眼泪加撒泼，想要什么都能到手。那年之后，你也没再成熟过。

source: You sob and stomp your feet and scream "I WANT MY PANCAKES!!" Everyone's staring. Some people even have their phones out.
target: 你又哭又跺脚，大喊“我要我的煎饼！！”所有人都在看，有些人连手机都掏出来了。

source: Oh my God, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. Are you seriously throwing a fit because you couldn't do the stupid challenge?
target: 天啊，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。就因为没做成那个破挑战，你还真撒起泼了？

source: Could you please relax, %SIRMAAM%? You're harshing the vibe for the other diners.
target: %SIRMAAM%，能冷静一下吗？您这样，影响其他客人吃饭了。

source: The Captain Carbs' Butterball Challenge winner approaches your table. "Hey, are you crying about the challenge?" he asks.
target: 碳水船长黄油球挑战的赢家，来到你桌前。“喂，你是在为挑战哭吗？”他问。

source: "If I just give you the badge, will you stop? It was fun at first, but you're making it weird."
target: “徽章给你，能不闹了吗？本来挺好玩，现在让你搞得好尴尬。”

source: Here, my manager told me to bring you these since you couldn't have the meal you wanted. Enjoy your "Pity Pancakes."
target: 给。经理说，您没吃上想吃的，让我把这个端来。请享用您的“同情煎饼”。

source: "It's okay. You're a big %BOYGIRL%. Pat on head." Oh, shit, shouldn't have read that part aloud.
target: “没事了。你是个大%BOYGIRL%了。摸摸头。”哦，妈的，这部分不该念出来。

source: Well, you got your badge and your food, but you definitely killed the mood. You lose -N2 HYPE, but those Pity Pancakes give you +N2 STAMINA!
target: 好吧，徽章和吃的，你都拿到了，可气氛也毁了。你损失-N2热度，不过，同情煎饼让你获得+N2体力！

source: Can you please not eat the other diners, %SIRMAAM%? I think that violates a lot of OSHA regulations.
target: %SIRMAAM%，能不能别吃其他客人？这应该违反不少 OSHA 规定。

source: Meh, let %HIMHER% do what %HESHE% %VERB_WANTS_WANT%. I'm in no place to judge anyone for ingesting questionable stuff.
target: 随便啦，让%HIMHER%做%HESHE%%VERB_WANTS_WANT%做的。我可没资格批评别人乱吃东西。
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): POLISH; 想做什么就做什么，保留波莉不评判乱吃东西的态度，删掉主谓之间的逗号。 按行中文动词展开已实现；未实机验证。

source: I'm on the fence about it, but I'm pretty sure Wolf Scott has eaten at least a few people, so I don't wanna be a hypocrite.
target: 我也说不好。不过，我变成狼的时候，应该也吃过几个人，不想当伪君子。

source: Fuck yeah, judgement-free zone! You approach the champion and announce your intent to eat him.
target: 爽，没有人指指点点！你走向冠军，宣布准备吃掉他。

source: "I knew this day would come," he sighs. "My father was also a pancake eating champion, and his greatest rival consumed him. It was a risk I took when I followed his legacy."
target: “早知道会有这天。”他叹道，“我爸也是大胃王煎饼冠军，被最强的对手吃掉了。继承他的衣钵，就得冒这个险。”

source: "Could you at least give this letter to my wife when you're finished? It's a poem I wrote for her. It's also our WiFi passwords -- she always forgets them."
target: “吃完后，至少把这封信给我太太，好吗？是我写给她的诗，也是我们家的 Wi-Fi 密码。她总忘。”

source: You unhinge your jaw and swallow the champion whole. You dab your lips with his letter, then eat that too.
target: 你张开脱臼般的大嘴，一口吞下冠军。再拿他的信擦擦嘴，连信也吃了。

source: Nice, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! You're the Captain Carbs champion now!
target: 漂亮，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！现在，你就是碳水船长挑战的冠军了！

source: Yeah, my manager just checked the rule book, and apparently this counts.
target: 嗯，经理刚查过规则，这样居然也算。

source: That, and we really want you to leave. Take the badge and please get out.
target: 而且，我们实在想让你走。拿好徽章，请出门吧。

source: You get +N2 STAMINA from your big breakfast, but lose -N2 SOUL from the whole "cannibalism" thing. LOL.
target: 这顿丰盛早餐，让你获得+N2体力。不过，整个“吃人”环节，也让你损失了-N2灵魂。哈哈。

source: Just... eat food... like a regular person?
target: 就……像正常人一样……吃个饭？

source: You take a seat at the least-sticky booth you can find and get ready to order.
target: 你找了个没那么黏糊的卡座，坐下准备点餐。

source: Welcome to Pancake Paradise. My manager told me to say that we love seeing new faces, but I don't actually feel that way. What can I get you?
target: 欢迎光临煎饼乐园。经理让我说，我们喜欢新面孔，不过，我本人并不这么觉得。您要点什么？

source: I want my pancakes medium rare with steak sauce, please! And can you get the chef to crush up this pill in the batter?
target: 我的煎饼要三分熟，配牛排酱，谢谢！能让厨师，把这粒药碾碎了，拌进面糊里吗？

source: It's my heartworm medication, but it's yucky, so I gotta take it in food. Also, don't tell me you're gonna put it in there or I won't eat it.
target: 治心丝虫的，可难吃了，得混在饭里吃。还有，别告诉我你放了，不然我就不吃了。

source: I'll have an iced tea. Can you sprinkle this pill in it? It's for, uh, butt worms. Yeah, let's go with that.
target: 我要冰茶。能把这粒药撒进去吗？治，呃，屁股里的虫子的。嗯，就这么说吧。

source: Would you like to upgrade your drink to a pancake batter smoothie for an extra dollar? It comes in a collectible mug.
target: 加一美元，把饮料升级成煎饼面糊奶昔吗？还送收藏杯。

source: We also have a lovely collection of high-end syrup-scented perfumes. They're buy-one-get-one free if you order a meal.
target: 我们还有一系列精美的高端糖浆味香水。点套餐，即可买一送一。

source: Also, my manager said I can't clock out until I get at least 5 people to check out his Cloudsound page. Please, free me from my pain.
target: 还有，经理说，至少得让五个人去看他的 Cloudsound 主页，我才能下班。求求你们，救我脱离苦海。

source: Uhh, are you gonna stop trying to upsell us at some point and just take our order? How long is your script?
target: 呃，你能不能别再推销，先给我们点餐？这话术，到底还有多长？

source: We're not even halfway through it. But if you're as sick of listening as I am of talking, you can just pick something from the list.
target: 还没到一半呢。你们要是跟我一样，听得、说得都烦了，就从清单上选样东西吧。

source: If that's what it takes to get your food faster, so be it. You check out Pancake Paradise's merchandise catalogue and decide on...
target: 行吧，能早点吃上饭就行。你翻开煎饼乐园的周边目录，决定买……

source: Sexy breakfast lingerie
target: 性感早餐内衣

source: A fake ID with a brand new identity as one of our Pancake Lords
target: 假证，给你一个全新的煎饼领主身份

source: "THE PANCAKE SONG!" on cassette
target: 磁带版《煎饼之歌！》

source: Ha! Sometimes I love that one-track dirty mind of yours, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 哈！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，有时候，真爱你这满脑子只有色情的劲儿。

source: This looks so cool! I love cute clothes, and I REALLY love breakfast, so seeing them brought together is a dream come true!
target: 好酷！我喜欢可爱衣服，又特别喜欢早餐。这俩能凑一起，简直美梦成真！

source: You wanna wear the lingerie, Scott? You may just find someone who wants to eat YOU for breakfast, if you know what I mean.
target: 斯科特，你想穿这套情趣内衣？说不定，真有人想把你当早餐吃掉，懂吧。

source: I don't know what you mean, but if someone will want to have breakfast with me if I wear this outfit, I'm IN!
target: 不懂。不过，穿了这套，就有人愿意陪我吃早餐？那我穿！

source: You pay -N2 MONEY for the lingerie. The waitress leaves to put in your order and give Scott his new "breakfast uniform."
target: 你花-N2金钱买下内衣。服务员离开，去下单，再把斯科特的新“早餐制服”拿来。

source: Ta daaa!
target: 当当——！

source: WOW. I mean, I love it, but are you sure you wanna wear it now? You know that's underwear, right?
target: 哇。我是说，我很喜欢，不过，你确定现在就穿？知道那是内衣吧？

source: That's okay, I like being in my underwear. Sometimes it's nice to feel the breeze on my balls.
target: 没事，我喜欢只穿内衣。有时候，微风吹过蛋蛋，挺舒服的。

source: Well, fair enough, but wearing lingerie in particular is usually reserved for... "special moments."
target: 好吧，也对。不过，情趣内衣一般是留给……“特殊时刻”穿的。

source: What moment could be more special than eating a delicious breakfast on a road trip with my friends?
target: 跟朋友们一起，在公路旅行途中吃美味早餐，还能有什么时刻，比这更特别？

source: Uh... okay! If you're feeling it, then be my guest!
target: 呃……好吧！你喜欢就穿！

source: Seeing Scott in sexy pancakes and cream is bound to give anyone +N2 HYPE. Enjoy your breakfast with a view! ;)
target: 斯科特穿着性感的煎饼奶油装，任谁看了，都得+N2热度。好好享受美食与美景吧！;)

source: You're not a cop, right?
target: 你不是警察,对吧?

source: Nope! One of my cousins trained to be a K-9 once, but he got fired after he bit an officer's leg 'cause he thought it was a salami.
target: 没有！我一个表亲，以前训练当过警犬。可他把警察的腿认成萨拉米香肠，咬了一口，就被开除了。

source: LOVE IT. DIRECT ACTION.
target: 爱了，直接行动派。

source: Okay, as long as you're not a cop, I can sell you the lordship. Come with me into the kitchen, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% -- alone.
target: 行，只要不是警察，这领主身份就能卖。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，跟我进厨房，只能你一个人。

source: Hmmm, this seems like a sketchy situation. Better forge blindly ahead and hope for the best!
target: 嗯，怎么看都可疑。那就一头扎进去，听天由命吧！

source: The pizza girl brings you to her manager in the kitchen. He's wearing a pimp coat and a fedora with a pancake brim.
target: 披萨女孩带你去厨房，见到了她的经理。他穿着皮条客大衣，头戴一顶用煎饼做帽檐的礼帽。
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): KEEP; 整个事件服务员槽位均为 pizzagirl；wigshop 又明说她打二十多份工，煎饼餐厅不构成改掉披萨女孩称呼的依据。

source: "This is the new kid?" he asks the waitress. "You sure %HESHE%%VERB_'S_'VE% got what it takes to be a Pancake Lord?"
target: “就是这新人？”他问服务员，“你确定%HESHE%%VERB_'S_'VE%有当煎饼领主的本事？”
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): KEEP; 经理问是否有本事，got 已由有表达。 按行中文动词展开已实现；未实机验证。

source: Don't worry, %HESHE% already paid me -N2 MONEY.
target: 放心，%HESHE%已经付过我-N2金钱了。

source: "Oh, swell, you DO have what it takes! Welcome to the Pancake Lords reward program, kid."
target: “哦，那太好了，你确实有这个本事！孩子，欢迎加入煎饼领主会员奖励计划。”

source: "Here's your new ID. Show it each time you visit Pancake Paradise, and we'll give you a sticker."
target: “你的新证件。每次来煎饼乐园，亮出来，就送你张贴纸。”

source: "When you get ten stickers, you can either get a free pancake or a single-use hitman on the house."
target: “集满十张，就能换一份免费煎饼，或者一次免费杀手服务。”

source: "And if any of those damned Waffle Earls give you hell, you tell 'em you're under OUR protection, got it?"
target: “要是那帮该死的华夫伯爵，敢找你麻烦，就告诉他们，你是我们罩的，懂了吗？”

source: Well, you now have an ID stating your name is "Pancake McPancake", and you might've just joined the mob? Oh well, you still gained +N2 HYPE!
target: 好吧，你现在有张证件，上面写着你叫“煎饼·麦煎饼”。好像还顺便入了黑帮？反正，你获得了+N2热度！

source: Wow, these are super cheap... actually, does the price tag say "150% OFF"? How is that even possible?
target: 哇，好便宜……等等，标价上写的是“降价150%”？这怎么算的？

source: You don't understand. The Pancake Song was... a mistake. Nobody wants a cassette that only plays the same terrible song on repeat.
target: 你不懂。《煎饼之歌》……是个错误。没人想要一盘，只会循环播放同一首烂歌的磁带。

source: People bought them, but then they returned them. In fact, they PAID us to return them. It was more lucrative than actually selling them.
target: 有人买了，后来又退回来。甚至付钱求我们收回去，比直接卖出去还赚钱。

source: We tried burying them in the desert, but they reappeared in the supply closet the next day. We tried smashing them, but they just shattered our hammers.
target: 我们试过埋到沙漠里，结果第二天，又出现在储物柜。试过砸，可锤子反倒碎了。

source: We tried putting them on the menu as a "Cassette Slider Special", but the grill wouldn't char them, and they taste terrible with every condiment.
target: 也试过加进菜单，做“磁带迷你汉堡特餐”。可烤盘烤不焦，配什么酱都难吃。

source: We're convinced that the only way we can get rid of them is if someone willingly accepts them. The curse can only be lifted if it latches onto another host.
target: 我们相信，想摆脱它们，只能等有人自愿接手。诅咒得黏上下一个宿主，才能从我们这儿解除。

source: Sounds lit! We'll take 'em!
target: 听起来超带劲！我们要了！

source: I see no problem with this!
target: 我看不出有什么问题!

source: Guess this is your life now. You gain +N3 MONEY from your "purchase", but lose -N3 HYPE listening to the accursed melody of the perpetual Pancake Song.
target: 看来，这就是你的人生了。你这场“购物”进账+N3金钱，不过，循环不休的诅咒煎饼歌，让你损失了-N3热度。

source: The table who clearly doesn't want to be bothered
target: 那桌明显不想被打扰的人

source: Owing to your famous lack of common sense, you and your friends sit with the scariest-looking motherfuckers in the diner.
target: 你那出了名的没常识，又发作了。你和朋友们，坐到了餐厅里最吓人的几个混蛋旁边。

source: Hi! I'm Scott, and these are my friends! I like your big trench coats and the fact that you're wearing sunglasses indoors.
target: 嗨！我是斯科特，这是我的朋友们！你们的大风衣好酷，我也喜欢你们室内戴墨镜的样子。

source: What's up with the crying guy sitting between you two? He looks like he's about to shit himself... and smells like he already might've.
target: 夹在你们中间哭的家伙，怎么了？看着快吓出屎了……闻起来，可能已经吓出来了。

source: Well, well, well. Looks like help has finally arrived for yous, Johnny. This must be your lucky day.
target: 哟哟哟，约翰尼，救兵终于来了。今天算你走运。

source: Let me go, I'm begging you! I'll pay you back somehow! Just--!
target: 求求你们，放了我！我会想办法还钱的！只要——！

source: One of the men slaps some duct tape on Johnny's mouth.
target: 一个男人拿胶带，封住了约翰尼的嘴。

source: Ooh, kinky! Momma like it.
target: 哦，有点野哦！姐姐喜欢。

source: Now, here's the skinny: youses better have some serious dough for us. We need one million smackaroos.
target: 听好了：你们最好带够了钱。我们要一百万大洋。

source: Sorry, I don't have any "smackeroos." I spent my last five bucks on this pack of Pokemans cards.
target: 抱歉，我没有“大洋”。最后五块钱，都拿去买这包宝可猛卡牌了。

source: Wanna trade?
target: 要换卡吗？

source: I don't want no stinkin' cards, I want my fuckin' money! Nix the funny business, or I swear to God, Johnny gets it!
target: 谁要你的破卡，我要他妈的钱！少耍花样，不然，信不信老子宰了约翰尼！

source: Wait, what counts as funny business? Only "ha ha" funny business? What about "exhale-through-your-nose" funny business? Are funny faces allowed?
target: 等等，什么算耍花样？笑到“哈哈”的才算？从鼻子哼口气的，也算吗？做鬼脸行不行？

source: Like this one?
target: 像这样？

source: What about this one?
target: 这样呢？

source: I've also got this one!
target: 我还会这个！

source: Not bad, Scotty! But can you beat...
target: 不错嘛，小斯科特！不过，你能比得过……

source: THIS ONE?! BLEHHHHHH!
As usual, Scott and Polly are useless at de-escalating a bad situation. Looks like it's up to you to save Johnny from these mobsters...
target: 一如既往，斯科特和波莉，完全不会缓和局面。看来，救约翰尼脱离黑帮魔爪，还得靠你……

source: Look into the stream of potential futures to show the criminals that Johnny is instrumental in saving monsterkind from doom.
target: 窥探各种可能的未来，让罪犯们看见：约翰尼可是拯救怪物世界、阻止末日的关键人物。

source: Give the mobsters the only thing more valuable than a life or a million dollars: your Alf-themed sock collection.
target: 送上唯一比人命和一百万美元更值钱的东西：你收藏的整套阿尔夫主题袜子。

source: You use -N2 MAGIC to cast a spell that opens the timestream for everyone to see and hone in on Johnny's life.
target: 你消耗-N2魔力施法，打开时间之流，让大家聚焦约翰尼的人生。

source: You look a year ahead. Johnny's being held for ransom by a gang in a supermarket. Next year, he's been kidnapped for ransom by a drug cartel.
target: 往后看一年，约翰尼在超市里，被一群歹徒绑架勒索。再下一年，他又被贩毒集团绑去要赎金了。

source: Wow, you get held for ransom a LOT. Is this, like, a thing with you?
target: 哇，你怎么老被绑票。这算你的什么特色吗？

source: It's his face, I think. He has a very kidnappable face.
target: 我看是因为脸。他长了张特别适合被绑架的脸。

source: You fast-forward through the years. You see Johnny eating cereal, Johnny going to the bank, Johnny being held at gunpoint at the bank...
target: 你把岁月快进。约翰尼吃麦片，约翰尼去银行，约翰尼在银行里，被人拿枪指着……

source: Fifteen years into his future, you see that Johnny's an executive producer for a reality show in which contestants compete to marry a potato.
target: 十五年后，约翰尼成了一档真人秀的执行制片人。节目里，选手们竞相争取，跟一颗土豆结婚。

source: Whoa, whoa, whoa, stop there! Now here's somethin' interesting. Look at that potato's rugged cheekbones!
target: 哇，等等，停这儿！这可有意思了。看那土豆，颧骨多有型！

source: I gotta know how this ends. Will the potato pick the graceful, delicate Cindy, or Brad the billionaire bachelor?!
target: 我得知道结局！土豆会选优雅娇柔的辛迪，还是亿万富翁单身汉布拉德？！

source: Well, far be it from you to argue with the guy pointing a gun at your knee.
target: 好吧，枪口正对着你的膝盖，你可不敢反对。

source: You end up watching the show for three hours until your spell finally wears off.
target: 你们看了整整三小时，直到法术终于失效。

source: NOOOO, it ended on such a cliffhanger! Chuck is objectively the best suitor, but Kimberly has the best chemistry with the potato. And their kids would look super cute!
target: 不——，竟然停在这么吊胃口的地方！客观来说，查克才是最佳人选，可金伯莉跟土豆最来电。他们的孩子，肯定超可爱！

source: You guys can't kidnap Johnny. You gotta let him live long enough for this incredible show to get produced!
target: 你们不能绑约翰尼。得让他活到那时候，把这么棒的节目拍出来！

source: Damn, youses right. We'll let Johnny go until Potato Bachelor gets produced, THEN we'll hold him hostage for money.
target: 妈的，说得对。先放约翰尼走，等《土豆单身汉》拍完，再绑他要钱。

source: In fifteen years Johnny won't be your problem anymore, so whatever. For now, you gain +N2 SOUL for saving his life!
target: 十五年后，约翰尼也不归你管了，随便吧。至少现在，你救了他一命，获得+N2灵魂！

source: You're giving up your Alf sock collection, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? Is saving an innocent life really worth losing that?
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你真要放弃整套阿尔夫袜子？一条无辜的命，值得赔上这个吗？

source: Maybe you could give them one or two pairs, but your WHOLE COLLECTION? We could get two Johnnys for that price!
target: 给一两双还行，可整套？这价钱，都能换俩约翰尼了！

source: We'll take 'em all! We actually got into a life of crime to acquire a collection of Alf socks this vast.
target: 全要了！我们走上犯罪道路，就是为了集齐这么大一套阿尔夫袜子。

source: We were gonna go all the way through a barter chain for 'em. We started with a paperclip. We traded that to a guy for a lawnmower, which we traded for a jet ski...
target: 本来打算一路以物易物，换到它们。最开始是个回形针，换成割草机，再换水上摩托……

source: ...which we traded for TWO paperclips, which we traded to Johnny's wife for Johnny, and we were gonna trade Johnny for a million bucks to buy the socks.
target: ……再换成两个回形针，拿去跟约翰尼老婆换了约翰尼。本来再拿约翰尼换一百万，就能买袜子了。

source: But if you're just givin' the socks up for Johnny, youses can have him! See ya, suckers!
target: 不过，你们既然愿意拿袜子换约翰尼，那人归你们了！拜拜，冤大头！

source: Thank you so much! I can never repay you for--
target: 太感谢了！我永远报答不了你们的——

source: You're damn right you can't repay us. Those were some PREMIUM Alf socks.
target: 没错，你他妈当然报答不了。那可是高档阿尔夫袜子。

source: We'll never get to have Wacky Alf Socks Wednesdays again... what are we gonna do with all these dad sandals now?
target: 以后再也过不了“周三搞怪阿尔夫袜子日”了……这么多老爹凉鞋，怎么办啊？

source: You gain +N2 SOUL for rescuing Johnny, but lose -N2 HYPE for sacrificing the coolest thing you will ever own.
target: 救下约翰尼，让你获得+N2灵魂。不过，你牺牲了这辈子能拥有的最酷的东西，损失-N2热度。

source: The poor soul waiting for their blind date
target: 等着相亲对象的可怜人

source: You all sit down with a nervous lich.
target: 你们在一个紧张的巫妖旁边坐下。

source: Hey, bro! I'm Scott. Is this seat taken?
target: 嘿，兄弟！我是斯科特。这座位有人吗？

source: Huh? Um, hi, Scott. I'm Ernis the Avaricious, and that seat actually is being taken by my date...
target: 啊？呃，嗨，斯科特。我是贪婪者厄尼斯。其实，这座位是留给我的约会对象的……

source: Oh, okay! When's your date getting here?
target: 哦，好！她什么时候到？

source: Any second now, I'm sure. Her name is Mindy. We were set up by mutual friends to go on our first date today.
target: 我想，马上就来。她叫明蒂，共同的朋友安排我们，今天第一次见面。

source: Aww, congrats boo!
target: 哎呀，恭喜，亲爱的！

source: How long have you been waiting for her to show up?
target: 你等她多久了？

source: About three hours. But surely there's a good explanation and she's on her way... right?
target: 大概三小时。不过，她肯定有正当理由，正在路上……对吧？

source: Uhhhh... would you just give me a second to talk to my friends privately?
target: 呃……能给我点时间，跟朋友们私下聊聊吗？

source: Oh... um, sure. Definitely not rude of you to sit at my table uninvited then exclude me from the conversation.
target: 哦……嗯，当然。没邀请，就坐到我桌旁，然后聊起天，把我排除在外，真是一点都不失礼。

source: (Guys, Ernis' date obviously isn't coming and it's really bumming me out. We gotta help him.)
target: （各位，厄尼斯的约会对象，显然不会来了。我好难过，得帮帮他。）

source: (Okay, we need a plan. Let's do a huddle about it!)
target: （好，得想个计划。咱们围在一起，商量商量！）

source: (Wait, we're already doing a huddle. I'm out of ideas.)
target: （等等，我们已经围着商量了。我没招了。）

source: (Don't worry, I've already got a plan: it's wholesome prank time! We're gonna lie, but for nice reasons!)
target: （别担心，我有计划了：温暖人心的恶作剧时间！我们要说谎，不过，出发点是好的！）

source: Heyyy, Ernie, guess what? We're actually your date! All of us! Completely forgot to mention that until now.
target: 嘿——厄尼，猜怎么着？其实，我们就是你的约会对象！全都是！刚才完全忘了说。

source: You're ALL Mindy? But I thought...
target: 你们全是明蒂？可我还以为……

source: Actually, you know what? This must just be modern dating culture. I'm okay with this. This is fine.
target: 不过，算了。这大概就是现代约会文化吧。没问题，我接受。挺好。

source: So, Mindy, tell me more about you! Why does your dating profile describe you as a 36-year-old woman and not... multiple young adults? I'm sure you get asked that a lot!
target: 那，明蒂，多聊聊你吧！交友资料上，怎么写你是三十六岁女性，而不是……好几个年轻人？这问题，肯定经常有人问吧！

source: Oh! It's 'cause... uh, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, why is that again?
target: 哦！因为……呃，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，为什么来着？

source: "BECAUSE THIS IS A GAME SHOW! IF YOU CAN GUESS WHICH OF US IS MINDY, YOU WIN A CASH PRIZE (and a date I guess)!"
target: “因为这是一档综艺！猜对我们谁是明蒂，就能赢现金大奖——还有约会，算是吧！”

source: "Because we're actually all one being. Mindy is short for Hive Mind."
target: “因为我们其实是同一个存在。明蒂，就是集群意识（Hive Mind）的简称。”

source: DID SOMEBODY SAY GAME SHOW?!
target: 谁说综艺节目了？！

source: Have you been lurking in that corner waiting for somebody to say "game show" all this time?
target: 你一直躲在那角落，就等着有人说“综艺节目”？

source: Don't judge me. Everyone needs a hobby.
target: 别管我。总得有个爱好吧。

source: Ladies and gentlemen, thank you for tuning in to our debut episode of MINDY OR NOT MINDY!
target: 女士们、先生们，感谢收看《明蒂还是非明蒂》的首期节目！

source: I'm your celebrity host and excruciatingly-eligible bachelor, the Interdimensional Prince!
target: 我是明星主持人，也是条件好得让人心痛的单身汉，跨次元王子！

source: Let's start with contestant number one: the hairy fellow with the baby-blue eyes. What's your name, doll?
target: 先看一号选手：这位毛茸茸、长着浅蓝色眼睛的先生。宝贝，你叫什么？

source: Scott Howl!
target: 斯科特·嚎尔！

source: Incorrect! The answer we were looking for was "Mindy." You're disqualified!
target: 回答错误！正确答案是“明蒂”。你出局了！

source: Aw...
Contestant number two, the sultry spirit! Here's your question: "What was the first message you sent to Ernis the Avaricious?"
target: 二号选手，性感的幽灵！请听题：“你发给贪婪者厄尼斯的第一条消息，是什么？”

source: I'm gonna go with a dick pic. This is online dating; there's, like, a 75% chance any given DM is a dick pic.
target: 我猜是老二照。网上约会嘛，随便一条私信，是老二照的概率，大概有75%。

source: Nope! The correct answer was, "Hi, Ernis. Do you watch 'The Office'? I love it, personally!"
target: 错！正确答案：“嗨，厄尼斯。你看《办公室》吗？我可喜欢了！”

source: That just leaves contestant number 3, who I suppose is now Mindy by default. Congratulations!
target: 只剩三号选手，所以，默认你就是明蒂了。恭喜！

source: But since my lawyer says my dating gameshows need to "value consent", I'll give Ernis the option to choose a date with you... OR WHATEVER'S BEHIND THIS MYSTERIOUS DOOR!
target: 不过，律师说，我这约会综艺，得“重视双方意愿”。所以厄尼斯，你可以选跟这位约会……或者，选这扇神秘门后的东西！

source: Hmmm... I'll choose... THE MYSTERIOUS DOOR!
target: 嗯……我选……神秘门！

source: Congratulations, Ernis! You've won... %CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%'S WALLET, and the -N2 MONEY inside it!
target: 恭喜，厄尼斯！你赢得了……%CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%的钱包，还有里面的-N2金钱！

source: How your wallet got behind that mysterious door truly is mysterious... but oh well, at least you got +N2 SOUL for cheering up Ernis with cash!
target: 你的钱包，怎么跑到神秘门后的，确实很神秘……不过，算了。用钱让厄尼斯开心起来，至少让你获得+N2灵魂！

source: Oh... well, I guess that makes sense. You did say some strange things when we were chatting online.
target: 哦……好吧，倒也说得通。网上聊天时，你确实说过一些怪话。

source: Like, 'I can't wait for you to meet the real me. ALL of me.'
target: 比如，“迫不及待想让你见见真正的我。全部的我。”

source: Or, 'one of my kinks is suppressing your free will and thoughts and bringing you into my Collective.'
target: 还有，“我的性癖之一，是压制你的自由意志和思想，把你纳入我的集体。”

source: I mean... I kinda get it.
target: 我是说……我倒也能理解。

source: So, Mindy, what if our relationship gets... more serious? Will I be expected to join the hive mind?
target: 所以，明蒂，如果我们的关系……更进一步，我是不是就得加入集群意识？

source: You do you, boo! Just because we gave up any semblance of our identity and personal sparkle doesn't mean you have to.
target: 做你自己就好，亲爱的！我们放弃了自我与个性光彩，可不代表你也得这样。

source: No, no, I want to. I'm tired of being in charge of my own decisions.
target: 不不，我想加入。自己做决定，我已经受够了。

source: I spent 59 gold bars on Oober Eats last night. I'm a wreck. Please, recruit me!
target: 昨晚点 Oober Eats，我花了五十九根金条。我太废了，求你们收了我吧！

source: If you insist. We all just gotta stare deeply into each other's eyes for three hours without blinking. GO!
target: 既然你坚持。大家只要深情对视三小时，不能眨眼。开始！

source: You do it. You start to lose yourself in Polly, Scott, and Ernis' eyes. It's mesmerizing.
target: 你照做了。你开始迷失在波莉、斯科特和厄尼斯的眼睛里，神魂颠倒。

source: So mesmerizing, in fact, that you forget to wonder how you're maintaining eye contact with three different people at once.
target: 迷得你连一件事都忘了想：自己怎么能同时跟三个人，保持眼神接触？

source: Your sense of self is slipping away. You were once four separate beings, but slowly, you become one... you are all Mindy... WE ARE MINDY.
target: 你的自我意识，正在消退。原本独立的四个个体，慢慢融为一体……你们全是明蒂……我们是明蒂。

source: "Thanks for the fun date!" you all say in unison as you leave. You lost -N2 MIND and -75 PERCENT OF YOUR INDIVIDUALITY, but at least you got +N2 SOUL for cheering up Ernis.
target: “谢谢，约会很愉快！”离开时，你们齐声说。你损失-N2头脑，个性还少了75%。不过，至少哄好了厄尼斯，获得+N2灵魂。

source: The couple who looks like they need couple's therapy... from you, maybe?
target: 那对看起来需要伴侣咨询的人……也许，你来当咨询师？

source: You take a seat next to a highly unusual couple, though the way they're shouting, you could've sat anywhere and still overheard their conversation.
target: 你在一对相当不寻常的夫妻旁坐下。不过，就他们这嗓门，你坐哪儿，都能听见他们吵。

source: I'm just saying you've changed! You used to be such a sweet, thoughtful man. But that damned cult has made you insufferable!
target: 我只是说，你变了！以前多温柔、多体贴，可那该死的邪教，把你变得烦透了！

source: Ugh, you're just jealous of the Brotherhood of Mh'athra. You NEVER have anything nice to say about my new friends or hobbies.
target: 呃，你就是嫉妒 Mh'athra 兄弟会。我的新朋友、新爱好，你从来没句好话。

source: I invite you to cult meetings. I encourage you to let the Eternal Darkness consume our bodies so that we may live in the shadows together. But you refuse to take interest!
target: 我邀你参加教团聚会，鼓励你让永恒黑暗吞噬我们的躯体，一起在阴影中生活。可你就是不肯感兴趣！

source: Because it's all you care about now! It's like there's no room in your life for both me and your cult! You aren't the same man I married...
target: 因为你现在只在乎它！你的生活里，就像根本容不下我和你的邪教！你已经不是我嫁的那个人了……

source: I don't appreciate you playing the victim in all this, Willow. My cult isn't the only thing that's "changed" around the web, you know.
target: 薇洛，别把自己说得像个受害者。家里的蛛网之下，发生“变化”的，可不止我的邪教。

source: Is this about how I ate the kids and the dog? I'M A BLACK WIDOW. You should just be grateful I haven't eaten YOU yet!
target: 就因为我吃了孩子和狗？我可是黑寡妇蜘蛛。还没吃你，你就该谢天谢地了！

source: Sheesh. Marriage is a lot more complicated than I thought.
target: 唉，婚姻比我想的，复杂多了。

source: It's a classic "he said/she said/deity said/dog's dead" situation. You see it all the time on Maury.
target: 典型的“他说她说，神也说，狗没了”局面。看《Maury》，天天都有。

source: I have an idea: let's meddle! %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, weigh in on their argument!
target: 我有个主意：咱们管管闲事！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，评评理！

source: At the risk of sounding blasphemous... who gently spoons you on cold winter nights? Mh'athra, or your wife?
target: 容我冒昧，亵渎一下神明……寒冷冬夜里，从背后温柔抱着你睡的，是 Mh'athra，还是你太太？

source: Eating the kids doesn't sound like relationship goals, honestly.
target: 说真的，吃掉孩子，听着不太像理想伴侣会干的事。

source: I guess that's fair. Willow's a world-class big spoon. You don't know comfort until you've had 8 limbs lovingly imprisoning you in spider silk.
target: 倒也是。薇洛从背后抱人，可是世界一流。没被八条腿温柔地包进蛛丝里，你都不知道什么叫舒服。

source: Sounds like it could also be kinky in the right setting.
target: 听着，气氛对了，也能玩点刺激的。

source: Also true. It's not as if the cult members and I make freaky, passionate, arachnoid love together.
target: 确实。我跟教团成员，也没在一起，搞什么古怪又激情的蜘蛛式性爱。

source: Well, neither have WE, as of late. You never even look at me while you're fertilizing my egg sack anymore! Not since you became so obsessed with your cult...
target: 可我们最近，也没搞过。你给我的卵囊受精时，都不肯看我一眼了！就是从你迷上邪教开始……

source: I suppose Mh'athra HAS consumed my thoughts lately... literally. It also consumed most of my memories.
target: 最近，Mh'athra 确实占据了我的心思……字面意义上的。连我的大部分记忆，也被吞了。

source: Meanwhile, all I've wanted is to make memories with you.
target: 可我一直想的，只是跟你一起，创造新的回忆。

source: I guess I have been a little jealous of the Brotherhood...
target: 我大概，确实有点嫉妒兄弟会……

source: Because I miss you, Nate. I miss US.
target: 因为我想你了，内特。我想念从前的我们。

source: Just then, the diner doors blow open. A group of cultists fill the restaurant!
target: 就在这时，餐厅门猛地打开，一群邪教徒，涌进了餐厅！

source: Brother Nathan! You're cavorting with mortal women when you should be sacrificing goats to Mh'athra?!
target: 内森兄弟！你该向 Mh'athra 献祭山羊，怎么却在跟凡间女子厮混？！

source: We thought what we had was special!
target: 我们还以为，这份感情非同一般！

source: Well you thought wrong! It's decided -- I'm leaving the cult!
target: 那你们想错了！我决定了，退出教团！

source: I've realized I don't need an eldritch abomination to give my life meaning. I already have that with my wife!
target: 我想明白了，人生的意义，不需要什么不可名状的怪物来给。我太太，已经给了我！

source: Oh, Nate!
target: 哦，内特！

source: Nate and Willow embrace... then they start straight-up fucking on the table. It's... something. The cultists leave in disgust.
target: 内特和薇洛相拥……随后，直接在桌上干了起来。真是……一言难尽。邪教徒们嫌弃地走了。

source: By weakening the power of Mh'athra, you manage to regain +N2 MIND for all monsterkind! (But you still keep it. #JustProtagonistThings)
target: 削弱 Mh'athra 的力量，让你为所有怪物，夺回了+N2头脑！不过，还是你自己收着。#主角日常

source: But by forfeiting Mh'athra's blessing, Nate loses access to its magic, and you lose -N2 MAGIC that was apparently tied to it too. Meh.
target: 不过，失去 Mh'athra 的赐福，内特也就没法用它的魔法了。你的-N2魔力，显然也跟这有关，一起没了。啧。

source: Ugh, THIS again. I don't shame you humanoids for eating pork or flax seed or whatever.
target: 呃，又来。我可没因为你们这些人形生物，吃猪肉、亚麻籽之类的，就指责你们。

source: Eating my children and sexual partners is just part of a black widow's nature!
target: 吃孩子、吃性伴侣，本来就是黑寡妇的天性！

source: I know that! Eating the kids wasn't what upset me. I was a little relieved to be rid of them, in fact.
target: 我知道！吃了孩子，不是让我难过的原因。说实话，没了他们，我还松了口气。

source: But you didn't even ask me first! You should ALWAYS consult your partner before making a major life decision, like buying a new car or devouring all of our offspring.
target: 可你都不先问问我！买新车也好，吃掉咱们所有孩子也好，做这种重大决定，总该先跟伴侣商量！

source: I didn't ask you because I didn't want you to judge me. Most of my exes ran screaming when I showed them my true fangs...
target: 没问你，是因为不想被你指责。以前大多数对象，一见我露出真正的毒牙，就尖叫着跑了……

source: Willow, I love you, thorax and all! You're my Mommy Long Legs! I knew what I signed up for when I married you.
target: 薇洛，我爱你的全部，连胸部也爱！你是我的长腿妈咪！娶你那天，我就知道，要面对什么。

source: The issue is that you just don't TALK to me. I want to be consulted on major choices you make. We're supposed to be a team.
target: 问题是，你根本不跟我沟通。重大选择，我也想参与。我们应该是一队的。

source: Honestly, that was what originally drew me to the cult... I craved companionship and validation, even if I had to get it from an eldritch horror.
target: 说实话，最初我会加入邪教，就是因为这个。我渴望陪伴与认可，哪怕得从不可名状的恐怖存在那里找。

source: Nate... I'm so sorry. I shouldn't have been so selfish. The next time I have a problem or a craving for our young, I promise I'll consult you first.
target: 内特……对不起。我不该这么自私。下次遇到问题，或者馋咱们孩子时，我保证先问你。

source: Thank you, sweet legs. Don't worry, life is long; we'll have more kids for you to eat. I'm sure we'll have a chance to get this right next time.
target: 谢谢，亲爱的长腿。别担心，日子还长，咱们会再生孩子给你吃。下次，肯定有机会好好商量。

source: Wow. That was... something.
target: 哇。真是……一言难尽。

source: Does this mean eating kids is okay as long as you're honest about it? 'Cause if so, Wolf Scott has some things to get off his chest.
target: 所以，只要说实话，吃孩子也行？那我变成狼的时候，可有些事，得坦白一下。

source: You gain +N2 SOUL for not condoning children-eating, but lose -N2 STAMINA from all that offspring you'll never get to have for lunch.
target: 你不赞成吃孩子，获得+N2灵魂。可那些永远没机会当午饭吃的后代，让你损失-N2体力。

source: Fill the car's tank
target: 给车加油

source: You park under the ancient, fantasy-land bridge overtop this gas station and go inside to pay.
target: 加油站上方，架着一座仿佛来自奇幻世界的古桥。你把车停在桥下，进店付钱。

source: Hi... er, wait, I mean, "Welcome, ye weary travelers, to the mystical PeTroll Gas Passage. How may I aid your quest today?"
target: 你好……呃，等等，我是说：“疲惫的旅人，欢迎来到神秘的巨油通道（PeTroll）。今日，有何使命，需要我相助？”

source: One gasoline, please!
target: 请来一份汽油！

source: Uh... sure, whatever. How're you gonna pay for it?
target: 呃……行，随便。怎么付？

source: With money, of course. I heard it makes the world go around, and I definitely don't want the world to stop going around, so let's keep spending!
target: 当然付钱！听说钱能让世界转起来，我可不想让世界停转，所以，继续花钱吧！

source: Sorry, but PeTroll doesn't accept money as a form of payment.
target: 抱歉，巨油通道不接受用钱付款。

source: What? But you need money! Look, at first I didn't get it either, but let me tell you: these little papers don't look like much, but they can be used to get ANYTHING YOU WANT!
target: 什么？可你需要钱啊！我一开始也不懂。不过告诉你，这些小纸片，看着不起眼，什么想要的，都能换到！

source: Like right now, I want gas, so I give you the papers, you give me gas, then you can give the papers to someone else to get something you want!
target: 比如现在，我想要汽油，就给你小纸片，你给我油。你再拿纸片去找别人，换你想要的东西！

source: It's a magical system called "econology"!
target: 这套神奇的系统，叫“经钱”！

source: ...Or is it "econimation"?
target: ……还是“钱济”来着？

source: I think it's "economy", sir. And trust me when I say that economy is meaningless to trolls.
target: 应该叫“经济”，先生。而且相信我，经济对巨怪，毫无意义。

source: PeTroll only accepts "magical forms of payment." Like dragon scales, or cursed lockets, or first-born children...
target: 巨油通道只收“魔法付款”。比如龙鳞、诅咒吊坠盒，或者第一个孩子……

source: Damn, too bad none of you are having a baby anytime soon or this'd be a lot easier. How else can you "magically pay" for this gas?
target: 啧，可惜你们最近都不打算生孩子，不然就简单了。那还怎么用“魔法”，付这笔油费呢？

source: Forfeit your fondest memory to the gas pump.
target: 把最美好的回忆，交给加油机。

source: Hunt down a boar to feed the gas pump, as was done for centuries before coin ever existed.
target: 按照硬币尚未出现前，传承数百年的办法：猎头野猪，喂给加油机。

source: My fondest memory, huh? I've already "forfeited" a lot of those to no-holds-barred partying, but let's see...
target: 最美好的回忆，是吧？放开了玩派对时，我已经“交出去”不少了。不过，想想啊……

source: I've got a nice memory of the first time I beat my mom at chess. That was a great day!
target: 我记得，第一次下国际象棋，赢过妈妈那天。那天真好！

source: Mine's when I found a chocolate cookie in the bushes at the dog park!
target: 我的是，在狗公园的灌木丛里，找到巧克力饼干那次！

source: That's also when I found out I'm deathly allergic to chocolate, but it was worth it.
target: 那次还发现，我对巧克力严重过敏，能要命的那种。不过，值了。

source: You choose a fondest memory to forfeit, which I can't even recount to you now, because it's been lost to the mystical gas pump.
target: 你选了一段最美好的回忆，交了出去。具体是什么，我现在也没法告诉你，因为它已经归神秘的加油机了。

source: Rest assured, though, it involved a lot of epic story beats and sexual thrill that were foundational to your character -- and now it's gone!
target: 不过，放心，那段回忆里，有壮阔的情节，有让人心跳加速的色情体验，都是塑造你这个角色的关键——现在，没了！

source: Kay, your tank should be full now. I'll "pray to the Great Trolls" that you "choose PeTroll to aid you on your next great adventure."
target: 好，油箱应该满了。我会“向伟大巨怪祈祷”，愿你们“下次踏上伟大冒险，仍选择巨油通道相助”。

source: (Corporate makes me say that, but honestly, you should go to Fill It next time; gas is cheaper there, and costs a real currency. Bye.)
target: （公司非让我这么说。不过，说真的，下次去加满它吧。油便宜，还收正经货币。拜拜。）

source: I'm glad we got the gas, bros, but I feel weird now... like there's a hole in my head that used to be full of joy.
target: 兄弟们，加上油是挺好，可我怎么感觉怪怪的……像脑子里空了一块，原来装满快乐的地方，没了。

source: I know, buddy, but it's okay. We'll fill that hole with lots of new fond memories during the road trip!
target: 我懂，伙计，不过没事。这趟旅行里，咱们会创造好多新的美好回忆，把那个洞填满！

source: That's true! Can we start by getting some chocolate ice cream? I have no reason to believe I shouldn't eat that!
target: 对啊！先来点巧克力冰淇淋，好不好？反正我完全想不到，为什么不能吃！

source: Sounds yummy! You lose -N2 HYPE from your memory loss, but gain +N2 MAGIC for the car.
target: 听着真好吃！失去回忆，让你损失-N2热度，不过，车获得了+N2魔力。

source: Yeah, that'd work. Do you have a wild boar?
target: 嗯，这也行。你们有野猪吗？

source: Not on hand, but luckily, this highway's full of them! It's actually a huge safety hazard!
target: 身边没有，不过，幸好高速路上到处都是！其实，这可是个巨大的安全隐患！

source: Woohoo! Let's hunt!
target: 好耶！打猎去！

source: Thank God you packed your medieval flails and crossbows or this would never work. -N2 STAMINA later, you've tracked and killed a wild boar.
target: 还好，你带了中世纪链枷和弩，不然还真没法干。损失-N2体力后，你追踪并猎杀了一头野猪。

source: Okay, great. Now you just need to smear the boar's blood on your hands, faces, and the gas pump.
target: 好，接下来，把野猪血抹到手上、脸上，还有加油机上。

source: Cool! I'm gonna do a boar's blood smokey eye!
target: 酷！我要画个野猪血烟熏妆！

source: I'll recite the sacrificial incantation. Just gotta find the page in my Employee Ritual Manual...
target: 我来念祭祀咒语。先找找《员工仪式手册》里，是哪一页……

source: "O ancient trolls, accept this blood spilled for your great hoard / and allow these travelers passage they can barely afford..."
target: “古老巨怪，鲜血已为宝库洒 / 旅人勉强凑路费，还请通融放一马……”

source: "...and enjoy this sacrifice, old as Man, old as Time / old as the tedious practice of chanting in rhyme."
target: “……请享此祭，与人同岁，与时同老 / 正如押韵念咒这破规矩，一样无聊。”

source: The ground shakes, and there's a sound like the Earth just let out a fart of Biblical proportions.
target: 大地震动，那声音，仿佛地球刚放了个惊天动地的屁。

source: I guess that means your transaction's been accepted. Here's your +N2 MAGIC.
target: 看来，交易获准了。给，你们的+N2魔力。

source: Have a "troll-tastic" day or whatever. Try not to hit any other wild boars on your way out.
target: 祝你们“巨怪巨开心”，反正就那些话。走的时候，尽量别撞上其他野猪。

source: Use the restroom
target: 上厕所

source: You head to the bathroom to drain the ol' pipes, but the door is locked. That's odd, but you guess you can hold it...
target: 你去洗手间，想清清库存，可门锁着。奇怪，不过，应该还能憋一会儿……

source: Then the clerk materializes in front of you and nearly makes you piss your pants anyway.
target: 店员突然出现在面前，差点直接把你吓尿了。

source: Hello, %SIRMAAM%. Welcome to the mystical PeTroll Gas Passage, "where fun and fantasy stop briefly on their way to paradise."
target: %SIRMAAM%，您好。欢迎来到神秘的巨油通道，“快乐与幻想，在奔向天堂的途中，于此稍作停留”。

source: I can't let you enter the restroom until you solve my riddles three... hundred.
target: 先解开我的三个谜……三百个，才能进洗手间。

source: She gives you a thick storybook. The title page reads, "Wandering Adventurer Lavatory Satisfaction Riddles by C.E.O. Gibblebock."
target: 她递给你一本厚厚的故事书。扉页写着：“《漫游勇者如厕满意之谜》，作者：首席执行官吉布博克。”

source: Seriously? Why is she making you fill out a customer satisfaction survey BEFORE you even use the bathroom?
target: 不是吧？厕所都还没用，怎么就让你先填顾客满意度调查？

source: First of all, this isn't a customer satisfaction survey. It's "a whimsical gimmick to enrapture the magical minds of our guests."
target: 首先，这不是顾客满意度调查，而是“用奇幻妙招，令客人充满魔法的心灵沉醉”。

source: Second, if you're not gonna buy anything, company policy says you gotta pay in something more valuable than coin: personal information.
target: 其次，要是不买东西，公司规定，就得付出比钱更值钱的东西：个人信息。

source: Ugh, fine. This book of "riddles" is BIG, though, and it's only the first of twelve high-fantasy volumes! What are you gonna do?
target: 呃，行吧。可这本“谜语书”，未免太厚，而且还是十二卷高等奇幻巨著的第一卷！怎么办？

source: Suck it up and fill out the book: 120 pages on your feelings about using the bathroom.
target: 忍了，把书填完：一百二十页，畅谈你的如厕感受。

source: Invoke your right to Survey By Combat, in which you fight the author of these riddles to the death instead.
target: 行使“比武调查权”，改跟这些谜语的作者，来场生死决斗。

source: You sigh, sharpen your number 2 pencil, and fill out the entire. Fucking. Book.
target: 你叹口气，削好二号铅笔，把整本。破。书。全部填完。

source: "Riddle 13.C: How did you first hear about the concept of using the bathroom?"
target: “谜题13.C：您最初，是如何得知‘上厕所’这一概念的？”

source: "a. Social media."
target: “a. 社交媒体。”

source: "b. I got a referral code."
target: “b. 别人给了我推荐码。”

source: "c. From my family, when they begged me to stop going in the kitchen."
target: “c. 家人告诉我的，当时，他们求我别再拉在厨房里。”

source: "Riddle 23.F: Would you recommend using the bathroom to a friend?"
target: “谜题23.F：您会向朋友，推荐‘上厕所’吗？”

source: "a. Yes"
"b. No"
target: “b. 不会。”

source: "c. It would depend on if they have a digestive system"
target: “c. 得看朋友有没有消化系统。”

source: "Riddle 48.Q: How often do you wash your hands after using the bathroom?"
target: “谜题48.Q：上完厕所，您多久洗一次手？”

source: "a. Every time"
target: “a. 每次都洗。”

source: "b. Depends whether it's #1 or #2"
target: “b. 看是小便（#1）还是大便（#2）。”

source: "c. Never. I'm a disgusting menace to society."
target: “c. 从不。我是个恶心的社会公害。”

source: By the time you're done with the survey, I mean riddles, you've been holding it in for so long that you've probably permanently damaged your kidneys.
target: 等问卷——我是说，谜语——终于答完，你憋得太久，肾可能都受了永久损伤。

source: You gain +N2 MIND when you finally have your moment on the toilet, but that exhaustive experience still cost you -N2 HYPE.
target: 总算坐到马桶上，享受片刻安宁，你获得+N2头脑。不过，折腾这么一通，也让你损失了-N2热度。

source: Right... let me get my standard-issue Survey Horn.
target: 行……我去拿统一配发的调查号角。

source: The clerk pulls an ancient bull horn off her belt. She blows into it, and an enormous troll in a business suit appears.
target: 店员从腰间解下一只古老的牛角，吹响后，一个穿西装的巨大巨怪，现身了。

source: "Hello, Employee #58359!" he says. "Have I been summoned to defeat a plucky adventuring party? Or perhaps a feral soccer mom with expired coupons?"
target: “你好，58359号员工！”他说，“召我来，是要打败一队勇敢的冒险者？还是个拿着过期优惠券、失去理智的接娃妈妈？”

source: Nah, you're fighting %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%; %HESHE% invoked Survey By Combat. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, meet C.E.O. Gibblebock.
target: 不是，你的对手是%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，%HESHE%行使了比武调查权。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，这位是首席执行官吉布博克。

source: "Great!" says Gibblebock as he swings a briefcase-warhammer at your face. "Thank you for choosing the Gas Passage as your preferred method of death!"
target: “太好了！”吉布博克抡起公文包战锤，朝你脸上砸去，“感谢选择巨油通道，作为您首选的死亡方式！”

source: You fight. It's intense, bloody, and made worse by Gibblebock asking you survey-related questions while you beat each other up.
target: 你们打了起来，激烈又血腥。更烦的是，吉布博克边跟你互殴，还边问调查问题。

source: "How did you first hear about the Survey By Combat?" "Would you recommend this ass-kicking to a friend?"
target: “您最初，是如何得知比武调查的？”“您会向朋友，推荐这顿毒打吗？”

source: "On a scale of 'frowny face, neutral face, or smiley face', how satisfied are you with my roundhouse kick?"
target: “请从‘哭脸、平脸、笑脸’中选择：您对我的回旋踢，有多满意？”

source: You lose -N2 STAMINA in the fight, but finally, you've brought Gibblebock to his knees.
target: 战斗让你损失-N2体力，不过，最后，你终于把吉布博克，打得跪倒在地。

source: "I guess it's true... the customer... is always right. But please... before you kill me, I have one last request..."
target: “看来……顾客……确实永远是对的。不过，杀我之前……求你，满足我最后一个愿望……”

source: "Will you rate this duel to the death 5 stars on Welp?"
target: “能在 Welp 上，给这场生死决斗打五星吗？”

source: "I rate it ZERO STARS!" you scream as you valiantly behead Gibblebock.
target: “我打零星！”你大吼着，英勇地砍下吉布博克的脑袋。

source: Wow... okay, you can go to the bathroom now. In fact, you can do whatever the hell you want.
target: 哇……行，你可以去厕所了。其实，你他妈想干什么都行。

source: That guy signed my paychecks, so if he's dead, I'm going home.
target: 我工资单是他签的。既然他死了，我回家了。

source: Good show, hero! You gained +N2 MIND in the bathroom and slayed C.E.O. Gibblebock, scourge of Ye Olde Siliconne Valley!
target: 干得好，英雄！你在厕所获得了+N2头脑，还斩杀了古老硅谷的祸害，首席执行官吉布博克！

source: Go to the shop
target: 去商店

source: Yay, shopping! The shelves are filled with all manner of junk: colorful crystals, rusty keys, newt eyes, pickled tongues, orc porno magazines...
target: 好耶，购物！货架上塞满各式杂物：彩色水晶、生锈的钥匙、蝾螈眼睛、腌舌头，还有兽人色情杂志……

source: Meh, you can find all this at your standard flea market. I've seen better troll hordes.
target: 啧，普通跳蚤市场就能买到。我见过比这强多了的巨怪宝藏。

source: Excuse me, %SIRMAAM%, have you dared to besmirch the good name of my boss, Gibblebock the Greedy? 'Cause that's, like, against store policy.
target: %SIRMAAM%，不好意思，您敢诋毁我老板“贪婪者吉布博克”的名声？这可是违反店规的。

source: Sorry, we didn't mean to. Do you guys sell any snacks or anything here?
target: 抱歉，不是故意的。这里有卖零食什么的吗？

source: All I found to eat was a taxidermied fairy. Too bony.
target: 我只找到一个仙子标本，能吃。骨头太多了。

source: Depends. What are your feelings on unicorn jerky?
target: 那得看，你们喜不喜欢独角兽肉干？

source: ...Does it come in BBQ flavor?
target: ……有烧烤味的吗？

source: I was wondering what you had in the "cursed items" department. I'm a notorious collector of cool shit I probably shouldn't mess with.
target: “诅咒物品”区有什么？那些很酷、又明显不该乱碰的东西，我可是出了名地爱收藏。

source: Well, the supply truck doesn't get in from the dungeons until tomorrow, but I can show you our items on the "Every Curse Must Go!" rack.
target: 补货卡车明天，才从地牢过来。不过，可以看看“诅咒统统清仓”货架。

source: Hey, you're not one to turn down a bargain. You decide to buy...
target: 有便宜，你当然不会放过。你决定买……

source: A cassette of ritual troll lo-fi chants
target: 巨怪 Lo-Fi 祭祀吟唱磁带

source: The legendary keychain of Jaryaya, the infamous troll warlock
target: 臭名昭著的巨怪术士贾里亚亚，留下的传奇钥匙扣

source: Children's blood-flavored soda
target: 儿童血口味汽水

source: What is "troll lo-fi", exactly? I thought trolls were just people who said mean things online. I didn't know mean people could be musicians.
target: “巨怪 Lo-Fi”到底是什么？巨怪不是在网上说坏话的人吗？没听过，坏人也能当音乐家。

source: Oh, they have lo-fi for everything now. Chillhop lo-fi, Japanese lo-fi, Naruto lo-fi, "two trucks having sex" lo-fi...
target: 哦，现在什么都有 Lo-Fi 版。Chillhop、日本风、火影忍者，还有“两辆卡车做爱”Lo-Fi……

source: It's inevitable trolls would jump on the bandwagon too.
target: 巨怪也来跟风，是迟早的事。

source: Troll lo-fi chanting has actually existed for centuries. It's a mystical tradition from the ancient troll pantheon, now available for the low price of -N2 MONEY.
target: 巨怪 Lo-Fi 吟唱，其实流传数百年了，是远古巨怪诸神传下的神秘传统。如今，只需-N2金钱，就能拥有。

source: I mean, you can call it what you want, but lo-fi is a modern music genre. Trolls didn't invent it.
target: 名字你们随便起，可 Lo-Fi 是现代音乐流派，又不是巨怪发明的。

source: Per company policy, I'm supposed to dispute that...
target: 按公司规定，我应该反驳你……

source: But... yeah, it's true. Trolls have always made money stealing shit from other people.
target: 不过……确实没错。巨怪一直靠抢别人的东西赚钱。

source: It used to be cattle and jewels and little children. Now it's popular music genres.
target: 以前抢牲口、珠宝、小孩，现在抢流行音乐流派。

source: Well, stolen or not, troll lo-fi sounds like the perfect thing to fall asleep to in the car later. You buy the tape and gain +N2 MIND!
target: 管它是不是偷的，巨怪 Lo-Fi 听着，正好适合待会儿在车里睡觉。你买下磁带，获得+N2头脑！

source: Ummm, am I supposed to know who Jaryaya is?
target: 呃，我应该知道，贾里亚亚是谁吗？

source: The whole gas station suddenly goes silent. A gnome with a lute and novelty Jaryaya sunglasses jumps up on the checkout counter.
target: 整个加油站，突然安静下来。一个戴着贾里亚亚搞怪墨镜、抱着鲁特琴的侏儒，跳上收银台。

source: "YOU DON'T KNOW THE TALE OF JARYAYA THE FORGETFUL?!" he cries.
target: “你不知道，健忘的贾里亚亚的故事？！”他大喊。

source: Nope! But I don't know lots of things, like how trigonometry works or what "amalgamate" means or what we're talking about right now.
target: 不知道！我不懂的东西，多着呢。比如三角函数怎么算，“糅合”什么意思，还有咱们现在，在聊什么。

source: "Well, it's your lucky day. I'll recount the tale of Jaryaya -- IN SONG!"
target: “那你今天走运了。贾里亚亚的故事，我要唱给你听！”

source: Oh, that really isn't necessary--
target: 哦，真没必要——

source: It is, actually. "Rapturously listening to the tale of Jaryaya the Forgetful" is store policy.
target: 很有必要。“如痴如醉地聆听健忘的贾里亚亚的故事”，是店规。

source: "There once was a warlock named Jaryaya / who stood at a mighty 4'4"!"
target: “从前术士贾里亚亚 / 身高四英尺四英寸，气势可不差！”

source: "He was clever and cute and courageous to boot / and he was forgetful to his very core!"
target: “聪明可爱胆子大 / 可惜健忘到了家！”

source: "Jaryaya'd be wed to the Troll Queen, they said / if he slayed the green dragon with ease."
target: “众人说，绿龙若能轻松杀 / 巨怪女王就嫁他！”

source: "So he prepped his spells and bid us farewell / but forgot his carriage's keys!"
target: “备好咒语告别啦 / 马车钥匙却落下！”

source: "The dragon got away and destroyed the whole town! / Jaryaya and Troll Queen were no more!"
target: “巨龙逃走毁全镇 / 女王术士都没啦！”

source: "But for -N2 MONEY, you'll never lose your keys / like Jaryaya the Forgetful boor!"
target: “只花-N2金钱，钥匙再也不会丢啦 / 别学那健忘蠢汉贾里亚亚！”

source: Wait, did the gnome just force you to purchase the keychain while he was singing that song? That's some powerful advertisement magic!
target: 等等，侏儒是不是边唱，边强行让你买了钥匙扣？这广告魔法，也太强了！

source: And now that +N2 MAGIC is yours, contained within this mystical (if tacky) keychain.
target: 现在，这+N2魔力归你了，就藏在那神奇、虽然俗气的钥匙扣里。

source: Kay. Do you want a sixteen ounce, a twenty-four ounce, or a "Diabetic Dragon Supersize?"
target: 好。要十六盎司、二十四盎司，还是“糖尿病龙超大杯”？

source: What IS "children's blood flavor" anyway? Is it like blue raspberry where they make it sound like it's a real thing but it's all a lie?
target: “儿童血口味”到底是什么？跟蓝树莓味一样，听着煞有其事，其实全是编的？

source: Sorry, but I'm not legally permitted to reveal the secret ingredient.
target: 抱歉，法律不许我透露秘密配方。

source: Dammit, the soft serve machine's down again. I gotta fill up your soda in the back. One sec.
target: 妈的，软冰淇淋机又坏了。我得去后面给你接汽水，等一下。

source: She leaves. Faintly, you hear a small voice begging for mercy cut off by a sudden scream. Then silence. Then a sound like a thick liquid being funneled through a tube.
target: 她离开了。隐约间，你听见细小的求饶声，被突然的惨叫打断。随后，寂静。再然后，像有什么黏稠液体，正从管子里灌出来。

source: Sorry about that. Here's your soda, %SIRMAAM%. That'll be -N2 MONEY.
target: 不好意思，您的汽水，%SIRMAAM%。一共-N2金钱。

source: What's that all over your shirt?
target: 你衣服上，沾的都是什么？

source: ...Magical cranberry juice?
target: ……魔法蔓越莓汁？

source: Works for you! Your soda is delicious (a little metallic, but you dig it) and it gives you +N2 STAMINA.
target: 你信了！汽水很好喝，稍微有点金属味，不过你喜欢，还获得了+N2体力。

source: Fill the car's tank
target: 给车加油

source: You park the car at a pump, then walk inside the store to pay.
target: 你把车停在加油机旁，走进店里付钱。

source: Welcome to Fill It, where all your dreams come true in the very specific case that your dream is filling your car's tank.
target: 欢迎光临加满它，我们让您梦想成真——仅限梦想是给车加满油的情况。

source: That's exactly our dream. We need some gas for our car... or magic... dunno, the monster realm is weird about cars.
target: 那正是我们的梦想。车需要加汽油……还是魔力来着……不知道，怪物世界的汽车，就这么怪。

source: Yeah, gas is made of magic. What would it be made of otherwise? Dinosaurs?
target: 是啊，汽油就是魔力做的。不然能是什么？恐龙吗？

source: Anyway, how much magic does your car's tank hold?
target: 总之，你们车的油箱，能装多少魔力？

source: Uh... I don't know. Ten?
target: 呃……不知道。十？

source: Four... Scotts...?
target: 四个……斯科特……？

source: "Scotts" is the only measurement I know how to use. If you help me get in the tank, we can see how many Scotts will fit!
target: “斯科特”是我唯一会用的计量单位。你们帮我钻进油箱，就能知道，能装几个斯科特了！

source: Sorry, but "Scotts" isn't an accurate unit of magical measurement.
target: 抱歉，“斯科特”不是准确的魔力计量单位。

source: Oh, okay. What would be an accurate unit of magical measurement then? Pollys?
target: 哦，好吧。那什么才是准确单位？波莉？

source: Magic is an arcane energy that we as a society don't fully grasp yet, making impossible to properly measure it.
target: 魔力是一种神秘能量，整个社会，都还没完全理解它，所以根本无法准确测量。

source: How do you normally solve this problem with other customers?
target: 那平时，别的顾客遇到这问题，你怎么解决？

source: I normally just don't. You don't understand how little I get paid to do this. They're lucky I even show up.
target: 通常，不解决。你们根本不知道，我干这个才拿几个钱。我肯来上班，公司就该偷笑了。

source: Well, maybe that's what society gets for using a volatile, unquantifiable substance like magic to power cars. Oh well!
target: 好吧，拿魔力这种不稳定、又没法量化的东西给汽车供能，社会也就得担着这后果。算了！

source: Still, there must be SOME way to describe how much magic you need...
target: 不过，总得有个办法，形容你们要多少魔力……

source: Whatever can pull a rabbit out of a hat
target: 够从帽子里，变出一只兔子就行

source: Two-and-a-half fireballs
target: 两颗半火球

source: The dark magical strength from sacrificing all the children from a village
target: 献祭一整个村子的孩子，产生的黑魔法力量

source: Works for me.
target: 行。

source: The clerk snaps her fingers, and a secret compartment is revealed on the gas pump!
target: 店员打了个响指，加油机上，露出一个隐藏的隔间！

source: She reaches inside and pulls out a gas hose with an end shaped like a top hat.
target: 她伸手进去，抽出一根油管，末端做成了高礼帽的样子。

source: You're pretty sure you see two pointy ears poke out right before she hooks it up to your car.
target: 她往车上接之前，你好像看见，两只尖尖的耳朵，从里面冒了出来。

source: What exactly are you filling the tank with?
target: 你到底在给油箱里，加什么？

source: I cannot reveal a magician's secrets. Corporate rules.
target: 魔术师的秘密，不能泄露。公司规定。

source: It's a rabbit, isn't it? You just pumped one or several live rabbits into our car.
target: 兔子，对吧？你刚往我们的车里，泵了一只，或者好几只活兔子。

source: Who knows! If I told you, where would the magic be?
target: 谁知道呢！说出来，哪还有魔法的惊喜？

source: ...Also it may or may not make us liable for animal cruelty.
target: ……再说，承认了，没准还得承担虐待动物的责任。

source: Riiiiiiiight.
target: 哦——这样啊。

source: Well, you know what they say about ethical consumption under capitalism: try not to think about it!
target: 资本主义之下，如何进行道德消费？老话说得好：尽量别想！

source: You pay -N2 MONEY and gain +N2 MAGIC for the car.
target: 你付出-N2金钱，给车加上了+N2魔力。

source: Once upon a time, there was a small village filled with magic and promise. Two children, Jimoir and Kegan, were exploring its outskirts and found a dark, foreboding cave.
target: 从前，有个充满魔法与希望的小村庄。两个孩子，吉莫尔和凯根，在村外探险，发现了一处黑暗阴森的洞穴。

source: "Let's go back. I heard an evil wizard lives in there," said Jimoir. "He incinerates bad kids who don't go to bed on time."
target: “回去吧，听说里面住着个邪恶巫师。”吉莫尔说，“不按时睡觉的坏孩子，都会被他烧成灰。”

source: "Your mom made that up, stupid," said Kegan. "Are you really scared of a dumb cave?"
target: “那是你妈编的，傻瓜。”凯根说，“不就个破洞穴，你真怕？”

source: Jimoir was, in fact, scared shitless.
target: 吉莫尔确实怕，怕得屁滚尿流。

source: But he went anyway, exploring the darkness filled with creepy crawlies and cave gnomes, until he found a glowing purple light.
target: 可他还是进去了，穿过满是爬虫和洞穴侏儒的黑暗，直到眼前，浮现一团紫光。

source: In the light was the wizard, evil and foreboding. Kegan dropped dead of fright, like a total pussy.
target: 巫师就在光中，邪恶而不祥。凯根当场吓死了，真是个怂包。

source: "Do not fear me, child," said the wizard. "I've spared you because I sense great potential in you... potential to master the powerful ways of ARSON MAGIC."
target: “孩子，别怕。”巫师说，“我饶你一命，是因为看出了你的巨大潜力……掌握强大纵火魔法的潜力！”

source: "From this day, I dub thee Jimoir the Arsonmancer. You will become my pupil, and I will teach you the life-changing wonders of magic!"
target: “从今天起，赐你名号，纵火术士吉莫尔。你将成为我的学徒，我会教你足以改变命运的奇妙魔法！”

source: And so, Jimoir's life changed forever as he poured himself into Arson Magic, knowing it would lead him into a life of epic proportions... A LIFE OF LEGEND!
target: 从此，吉莫尔的命运彻底改变。他全身心投入纵火魔法，深信它会引领自己，走向史诗般的人生……成为传奇！

source: Fine, that works. HEY, JIMMY! TWO-AND-A-HALF FIREBALLS ON PUMP TWO!
target: 行，没问题。喂，吉米！二号加油机，两颗半火球！

source: A young man blasts your car with magic flames. He looks empty and broken inside...
target: 一个年轻人，用魔法火焰轰向你的车。他眼神空洞，内心仿佛已被碾碎……

source: ...but you suppose most minimum wage workers look like this provided the current economy, so you don't think much of it.
target: ……不过，眼下这经济状况，拿最低工资的，大概都这样。你也没多想。

source: You pay -N2 MONEY and gain +N2 MAGIC for the car.
target: 你付出-N2金钱，给车加上了+N2魔力。

source: Once upon a time, there was a small village filled with magic, but also with poverty. The last two harvests yielded nothing. The village elders met to discuss solutions.
target: 从前，有个小村庄，充满魔法，也充满贫困。连续两次收成都颗粒无收，村中长老们，开会商量对策。

source: "Everyone, this food shortage is causing a big problem: people are dying too quick for us to make any taxpayer money! We gotta do something!"
target: “各位，粮食短缺，出了大问题：人死得太快，税钱都来不及收！得想办法！”

source: "Hmmm, we could try... working?"
target: “嗯……要不试试……干活？”

source: "No way! What about selling essential oils? I'm actually part of a program already, and if I get three more sign-ups by next Friday we'll all get a bonus check for--"
target: “不行！卖精油怎么样？我已经加入一个项目了，下周五前，再拉三个人，咱们就都有奖金——”

source: "Elder Enoch, if you suggest a pyramid scheme one more time, I will curbstomp you."
target: “以诺长老，你再提一次传销，我就把你脑袋按路边，踩个稀烂。”

source: Suddenly, the doors to the meeting room opened to reveal a grinning man in a slick suit.
target: 突然，会议室的门打开，一个西装笔挺、满脸堆笑的男人，走了进来。

source: "I hear you're having money troubles," he said in a suave, nasally salesman voice. "I know how to fix that, if ya can handle it."
target: “听说，各位缺钱。”他说，带着推销员式的油滑腔调和鼻音，“办法，我有，就看各位敢不敢。”

source: "I'll pay you one million dollars for all of the village's children!"
target: “村里所有孩子，我出一百万美元，全买！”

source: "ALL the children? The peasants are kind of attached to them... but oh well, what're you gonna do?"
target: “所有孩子？村民还挺舍不得他们的……不过，算了，还能怎么办？”

source: After not nearly enough debate, the village elders agree to sell the stranger all the village children.
target: 讨论远远谈不上充分，长老们就同意，把村里所有孩子，卖给这个陌生人。

source: "Come along, kiddies!" the salesman says to the children following him out of town. "This trip is gonna be a GAS!"
target: “来吧，小朋友们！”推销员带着孩子们离开村庄，说道，“这趟旅程，肯定超‘燃’！”

source: "YAAAAAAY!" all the kids scream joyfully.
target: “好——耶！”孩子们开心地大喊。

source: The villagers watch as the children are led away, never to be seen again...
target: 村民们望着孩子被带走。从此，再也没见过他们……

source: Okay, that works for me. HEY, JIMMY! TWENTY-SIX CHILD SACRIFICES ON PUMP TWO!
target: 好，这也行。喂，吉米！二号加油机，二十六个儿童祭品！

source: You pay -N4 MONEY and gain +N6 MAGIC for the car. You also lose -N2 SOUL for some reason. Meh.
target: 你付出-N4金钱，给车加上+N6魔力。不知为什么，还损失了-N2灵魂。啧。

source: Use the restroom
target: 上厕所

source: You're sitting in your stall, getting all your farts out, when there's a knock coming from the stall to your left.
target: 你正坐在隔间里，一口气把屁放干净，左边隔间，突然传来敲击声。

source: Hey! I hate to bother you, but I need some toilet paper. I wouldn't normally do this, but it's a funny story...
target: 嘿！不好意思打扰，不过，能借点厕纸吗？平时我不会这样，可说来好笑……

source: Is the funny story that you ran out of toilet paper?
target: 好笑的故事，就是你厕纸用完了？

source: Hey, good guess! So, can I have some?
target: 哎，猜对了！能给点吗？

source: You give %HIMHER% a wad of toilet paper, and %HESHE% %VERB_LEAVES_LEAVE% you alone... for about thirty seconds.
target: 你递给%HIMHER%一团厕纸。%HESHE%%VERB_LEAVES_LEAVE%总算不再烦你……大概三十秒。
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): KEEP; leave alone 已由不再烦你表达；三十秒后继续索取的包袱保留。 按行中文动词展开已实现；未实机验证。

source: Hey, buddy! So, funny story: I went to light a cigarette and dropped my lighter in the toilet. Could I bum a light?
target: 嘿，伙计！说来好笑，我刚想点烟，打火机掉马桶里了。能借个火吗？

source: You pass %HIMHER% a lighter and hope that'll be the end of it. It isn't.
target: 你把打火机递给%HIMHER%，但愿这下能消停了。并没有。

source: Hey there, ol' buddy, ol' pal! Still there, huh? Must be a big shit!
target: 嘿，老兄，老伙计！还在啊？这泡屎，够大的！

source: So, can I borrow an umbrella? It's a funny story: I think it's gonna rain later today, but I left my umbrella at home.
target: 那个，能借把伞吗？说来好笑，今天晚些时候，好像要下雨，可我把伞落家里了。

source: Oh, and hey, do you think you could help me solve my crossword puzzle?
target: 哦，能再帮我解解填字游戏吗？

source: Funny story: I've been a crossword champ since I was twelve. It's kinda my thing.
target: 说来好笑，我从十二岁起，就是填字冠军。这可是我的拿手好戏。

source: My strategy is doing them in public restrooms and asking whoever's in the stall next to me for help with the solutions. Genius, right?
target: 秘诀就是，在公厕做题，请旁边隔间的人帮着想答案。天才吧？

source: Anyway, I need an eleven-letter word for 'navel.' Any ideas, buddy?
target: 总之，要个十一个字母的英文单词，意思是“肚脐”。老兄，有主意吗？

source: You suggest "bellybutton." You also ask if %HESHE%%VERB_'S_'VE% got any other favors or "funny stories" for you before you get back to doing your business.
target: 你给出“bellybutton”这个答案。接着问，你还没拉完，%HESHE%%VERB_'S_'VE%还有多少忙要帮，或者“好笑的故事”要讲？
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): KEEP; 上句是十一字母的 navel 填字题，bellybutton 必须保留英文；have got 已由还有表达。 按行中文动词展开已实现；未实机验证。

source: Ooh, I'm glad you asked! See, it's a funny story: I've been keeping a list on the back of my crossword just in case I needed anything else.
target: 哦，问得好！说来好笑，我早在填字题背后，列好了清单，就怕还有需要。

source: A hand passes you a crossword over the stall with a list of things on its back. Which of these can you give the stranger?
target: 一只手从隔板上方，递来填字题，背后写着清单。陌生人要的东西，你能给哪样？

source: A very fancy hat
target: 一顶特别华丽的帽子

source: Feedback on %HISHER% 300-page toilet-themed screenplay
target: 对%HISHER%那三百页的厕所主题电影剧本，提些意见

source: A free piggyback ride
target: 免费背一程

source: "Whaaat? How'd you know I've always wanted a very fancy hat?!"
target: “什么——？你怎么知道，我一直想要一顶特别华丽的帽子？！”

source: Because the list says, verbatim: "1. A very fancy hat !! PLS do this (will be super grateful :D)"
target: 因为清单上，原话写着：“1. 一顶特别华丽的帽子！！求你了，会超级感激 :D”

source: This is so great. I've got my high school reunion coming this Saturday. I can't wait to roll up in my new fancy hat!
target: 太棒了，这周六，我高中同学聚会。迫不及待，要戴着新帽子登场！

source: I bet Kimberly's gonna be there. She was my prom date, but she dumped me for the Quarterback! And now they're married!
target: 金伯莉肯定会去。当年她陪我参加舞会，后来却甩了我，跟四分卫跑了！现在都结婚了！

source: The Quarterback was so cool, nobody even knew his real name. We all just called him 'the Quarterback.'
target: 四分卫酷得，没人知道他的真名，大家就管他叫“四分卫”。

source: These days he's 'Dr. Quarterback' according to $urgeon Monthly, the premier magazine showcasing millionaire surgeons who moonlight as male models...
target: 现在，按《外科富医月刊》的说法，他已经是“四分卫医生”了。那杂志，专门介绍百万富翁外科医生，还兼职当男模的那种……

source: But hey, Dr. Quarterback doesn't have a fancy hat, I bet, so I win! Kimberly will be so fucking jealous!
target: 不过，我赌四分卫医生，没有华丽帽子，所以，我赢了！金伯莉肯定嫉妒死了！

source: Sure. You lose -N2 MONEY buying this bizarre stranger a hat, but at least you gain +N2 SOUL for helping out!
target: 行吧。给这古怪的陌生人买帽子，让你损失-N2金钱，不过，帮助别人，也让你获得+N2灵魂。

source: "Ooh, yes, thank you! Please, give me your honest opinion. I really think I've got something good here."
target: “哦，太好了，谢谢！请说实话，我真觉得，这剧本有戏。”

source: The screenplay is titled, "Detective Chatty: Toilet Inspector."
target: 剧本名叫《查蒂警探：厕所督察》。

source: Detective Chatty's whole thing is having long, noir-esque narrations of stakeouts in public bathrooms.
target: 查蒂警探的特色，就是在公共厕所蹲点，配上黑色电影风格、没完没了的旁白。
