target: ……还是不懂，这怎么比看电视强了。

source: Yeah, introspection is fuckin' boring. Just watching %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% do all that character development made me lose -N2 HYPE.
target: 是啊，反省他妈的好无聊。光看%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%完成这么一大段角色成长，都让我-N2热度了。

source: Whatever; if they don't want to achieve enlightenment by finding their inner soul birbs, so be it. You gain +N2 MIND all the same!
target: 随便吧。他们不愿找到灵魂里的小鸟，悟透人生，就算了。你照样获得了+N2头脑！

source: The haunted room where someone was totally murdered
target: 绝对死过人的闹鬼客房

source: You get to your room. It's haunted. Say what you want about this motel, but you can't accuse them of false advertisement.
target: 你进了房间。确实闹鬼。这旅馆，别的随你怎么骂，虚假宣传是真算不上。

source: Welcome to your room. Hope you don't mind if my fellow curses and I unravel your sanity tonight! MWAHAHAHA!!
target: 欢迎入住。今晚，我和其他诅咒，要把你们逼疯，希望别介意！哇哈哈哈！！

source: Yeah, go ham. I'm already dead, so most curses don't fuck me up too much.
target: 行，随便来。我已经死了，大部分诅咒，对我没什么用。

source: You're not even afraid of Spaghetti Sergei, the Italian chef who drowned in the bathtub? He cursed all the faucets to only dispense cold, creepy pasta!
target: 连意面谢尔盖都不怕？那个意大利厨师，在浴缸里淹死了。他诅咒了所有水龙头，打开就只能流出冰凉诡异的意面！

source: Wait, we get a room with unlimited pasta faucets?! This RULES! Do any of the other appliances dispense garlic bread?
target: 等等，我们这房间，能无限放意面？！太棒了！别的电器，能放蒜香面包吗？

source: NO!
target: 没有!

source: But we have Mirror Mary, the spirit trapped in the mirror who wails funeral dirges through the night!
target: 还有镜中玛丽！困在镜子里的幽灵，整晚唱挽歌，哭个不停！

source: Aww, sick! I was JUST SAYING I wanted to do 4 a.m. karaoke, but %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% said we couldn't if we didn't have backup vocalists! This is great!
target: 哇，酷！我刚还说，想凌晨四点唱卡拉 OK，可%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%说，没伴唱就不行。这下好了！

source: Yeah, it's just fucking super.
target: 是啊，真他妈太棒了。

source: We've got two backup singers, actually. Check out that guy staring at us in the corner! I bet he's got a great singing voice and a bubbly personality.
target: 其实，咱们有两个伴唱。看，角落里那家伙，一直盯着我们！我赌他歌声好听，个性也很开朗。

source: Oh, uh... that's actually super unsettling. Who the hell are you?
target: 哦，呃……这倒真的有点瘆人。你到底谁啊？

source: "I'm Tanner," says the creep. "I was killed in this corner by a guest I was watching sleep. She stabbed me, can you believe it?"
target: “我叫坦纳。”怪人说，“我就在这角落，被一个客人杀了。当时我在看她睡觉，她居然捅我，你敢信？”

source: Your death was a total injustice, Tan. It's your given right to haunt this room in revenge and stare at guests all night long.
target: 小坦，你死得真冤。在这房间闹鬼报仇，整晚盯着客人，是你的天赋权利。

source: Um, no. Spooky spaghetti I can handle, but creepy men staring at me while I sleep is NOT allowed. Do something, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!
target: 呃，不行。鬼意面，我受得了，可睡觉时，有个怪男人盯着我，绝对不行。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，想想办法！

source: Break the curse by helping Tanner complete his unfinished business: listing EVERY BIRD known to man aloud.
target: 帮坦纳完成未了的心愿，解除诅咒：大声念出人类所知的每一种鸟。

source: Upgrade your curse! See if the ghost of the guy who drowned in champagne and now vomits free champagne is available.
target: 升级诅咒！看看那个淹死在香槟里、现在能吐免费香槟的鬼，有没有空。

source: "You want me to list ALL of the birds?" asks Tanner. "Okay, if you really think that'll work..."
target: “要我把所有鸟，都念出来？”坦纳问，“好吧，你要真觉得有用……”

source: "Albatross, auklet, bittern, blackbird, bluebird, bunting, bushtit, canvasback, cardinal, chickadee..."
target: “信天翁、海雀、麻鳽、乌鸫、蓝鸲、鹀、丛山雀、帆背潜鸭、红雀、山雀……”

source: Is he really gonna list every bird in alphabetical order? Isn't this gonna take, like, forever?
target: 他真要按英文字母顺序，把所有鸟都念一遍？不得念到天荒地老？

source: Yeah, we'll probably be here a while. Don't worry, though, it'll be worth it to get rid of him.
target: 嗯，大概得等一阵。不过别担心，只要能送走他，就值得。

source: "Dipper, dotterel, dove, dowitcher, duck, American black duck, falcated duck, fulvous whistling-duck..."
target: “河乌、鸻、鸽子、半蹼鹬、鸭子、北美黑鸭、罗纹鸭、草黄树鸭……”

source: Oh my God. He's gonna list SUBTYPES of each bird too?!
target: 我的天，连每种鸟的细分类别，也要念？！

source: It's okay, Polly, just cover your ears and it'll be over soon!
target: 没事，波莉，捂住耳朵，很快就过去了！

source: "Eagle, falcon, finch, flycatcher, godwit, goldeneye, goldfinch, goose, Canadian goose, gull, hawk, grey hawk, red hawk, white hawk, blue hawk--"
target: “鹰、隼、雀、鹟、塍鹬、鹊鸭、金翅雀、雁、加拿大雁、鸥、鹰、灰鹰、红鹰、白鹰、蓝鹰——”

source: THERE IS NO SUCH THING AS A BLUE HAWK!
target: 根本没有蓝鹰这种东西！

source: "Oops, I think you're right... dammit, now I lost my place! I gotta start over. Albatross--"
target: “哦，好像是……妈的，念到哪儿来着？得重来了。信天翁——”

source: AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!
target: 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！

source: Scott hugs Polly while she goes insane. The list of birds seems to spiral on forever, and then suddenly it's over. Tanner ascends into the sky.
target: 波莉快疯了，斯科特抱着她。鸟名仿佛永远念不完，却又突然结束。坦纳升上了天空。

source: Ugh... that seriously worked? Do you think if I listed all the birds, I'd leave the physical realm too?
target: 呃……还真管用？要是我也把所有鸟念一遍，是不是也能离开物质世界？

source: Hopefully you never find out, 'cause you never want to go through that bushtit -- I mean bullshit again.
target: 最好永远别知道。毕竟，这通鸟话——我是说，屁话，你可不想再听一遍了。

source: You gain +N2 SOUL for helping the weird spirit move on, but you lost -N2 HYPE listening to that exhaustive list.
target: 帮这个怪幽灵往生，让你获得+N2灵魂。不过，听完那份巨长无比的鸟名清单，也让你损失-N2热度。

source: "You're trading me for that champagne guy? Why?!"
target: “你们要拿我，换那个香槟男？为什么？！”

source: "All he does is create endless free booze! I can offer you endless uncomfortable staring contests!"
target: “他只会变出喝不完的免费酒！我可是能无休无止地，跟你们尴尬对视！”

source: ...Make the call, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: ……打电话，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。

source: Room service... yeah, you can upgrade. The champagne-vomiting ghost is available, but he's one of our premium options.
target: 客房服务……嗯，可以升级。吐香槟的鬼，现在有空，不过，属于高级付费项目。

source: Anything to get rid of Creepy McNeverblinks. You pay -N2 MONEY and have the ghost of Sir Chandon Büble visit your room.
target: 能送走这个死盯着人不眨眼的怪胎，怎样都行。你付出-N2金钱，请尚东·布布尔爵士的幽灵，到房间里来。

source: Sup, Bubbles? So do you, like, vomit the champagne into a glass on command, or should we keep a bucket with some crazy straws under you at all times?
target: 嗨，泡泡。你是听指令，就能往杯子里吐香槟？还是说，我们得一直在你下面，放个桶，插好弯弯吸管？

source: "It comes at random... it's a horrible reminder of my untimely -- BLAAAARGH! -- death."
target: “随机的……每次都让我痛苦地想起，我那过早——呕——！的死亡。”

source: "It happened on my golden yacht in 1974. I was -- HURK! -- cruising my wealthy father's champagne lake with -- BLAAARGH! -- Count Murr D. Erer on the moonlit waves--"
target: “1974年，在我的黄金游艇上。我正——呕！——跟沙·仁·犯伯爵，泛舟在我那有钱老爸的香槟湖上——呕哇！——月光照着波浪——”
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): FIX; 香槟幽灵讲离奇死亡，Count Murr D. Erer 暗示 murderer；用沙·仁·犯保留一眼可识别的凶手谐音，补回父亲富有的信息。

source: LOL, sorry dude but I can't take you seriously when you're comically vomiting like that. But hey, cheers to unlimited booze!
target: 哈哈，抱歉，哥们，你这么吐，实在太滑稽，没法让人严肃起来。不过，敬无限供应的美酒！

source: Cheers indeed. You and your friends have a great time and you gain +N2 STAMINA!
target: 确实该干杯。你和朋友们玩得很开心，获得+N2体力！

source: Cheers indeed. You and your friends have a great time getting wasted on the byproduct of this ghost's misery, and you gain +N2 STAMINA!
target: 确实该干杯。你和朋友们喝着这个幽灵痛苦的副产物，醉得不亦乐乎，获得+N2体力！

source: The room with only one bed
target: 只有一张床的房间

source: You horny fuck.
target: 你这满脑子色情的混蛋。

source: Nice! I'd love to share a bed with you guys! It'll be nice to have the bros keeping me warm at night.
target: 好耶！超想跟大家挤一张床。晚上有兄弟们暖着，肯定很舒服。

source: I wish everyone had good bros to share their beds with. If I could, I'd share our bed with the whole world so everyone can experience this joy!
target: 真希望，人人都有好兄弟陪着睡。可以的话，我想把我们的床，分享给全世界，让大家都感受这份快乐！

source: Eh, fuck it, wish granted. Let's share our bed with the world, Scotty!
target: 嗨，管他呢，这就帮你实现愿望。小斯科特，咱们把床，分享给全世界！

source: Polly posts a Gregslist ad saying, "BED-SHARING PARTY! ALL ARE WELCOME!" Soon, you've got a line of potential bed-sharers outside your door!
target: 波莉在 Gregslist 发广告：“拼床派对！所有人都欢迎！”很快，门外就排满了想来拼床的人！

source: Is this the free bed? I'm in. I was hotboxing in the parking lot, and a nap sounds real nice right now.
target: 这里是免费睡觉的床？我来。刚在停车场的车里闷着抽了一阵，正想睡一觉。

source: Free nap, huh? ...Fuck it, I was planning to come back from my break late anyway.
target: 免费午觉，是吧？……妈的，反正我休息完，也没打算准时回去。

source: Ghosts of Parties Past in da house! Let's slumber the HELL out of this party!
target: 昔日派对幽灵，闪亮登场！来把这场派对，睡个痛快！

source: This is the police! We heard about the free bed. We're, uh... here to confirm you haven't torn off the tag on your mattress.
target: 警察！我们听说，有免费床。呃……来查查，你们有没有撕掉床垫标签。

source: We are? I thought we were here to take a nap on duty.
target: 是吗？我以为，我们是来上班摸鱼，睡午觉的。

source: Dammit, partner! I told you not to blow our cover!
target: 妈的，搭档！不是说了，别露馅吗！

source: Polly, I think we were a little overconfident trying to fit the whole world in our bed. We pretty much only have room for one more person.
target: 波莉，想把全世界塞进这张床，好像是有点自信过头了。差不多，只能再挤一个人。

source: Then we have a big decision to make! %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, who should be the last person we let in our bed?
target: 那得好好选了！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，最后让谁上床？

source: Warm Walter, big spoon for hire
target: 暖暖沃尔特，收费提供背后抱睡服务

source: Commander Night-Night, survivor of the Pillow Wars
target: 晚安指挥官，枕头战争的幸存者

source: Great choice, honey. You won't regret hiring me; I've got LOTS of experience sharing a bed.
target: 选得好，亲爱的。雇我，绝不后悔。跟人同床，我经验多得很。

source: Momma likes what she hears. What credentials are you bringing to the bedroom, Walter?
target: 听着就喜欢。沃尔特，你给卧室，带来了什么专业资历？

source: My body has the perfect size, shape, and soft-to-firmness ratio to provide the optimal cuddling experience.
target: 我的身材大小、体形，还有软硬比例，都恰到好处，能提供最佳的抱睡体验。

source: I'm also an expert in pillow-talk therapy if you need to sort out any thoughts or feelings before you drift off into blissful slumber.
target: 我还擅长枕边谈心疗法。你要有什么想法和情绪，需要理清，我可以帮你，然后，让你安安稳稳入睡。

source: And if you get hungry or thirsty before bed, my PJ pockets are filled with snacks and hot cocoa to share!
target: 睡前饿了、渴了，也没事。我的睡衣口袋里，全是能分享的零食和热可可！

source: Cuddling AND snacks? Is there anything you can't do?!
target: 能抱，还带零食？你还有什么不会的？！

source: Yes... the one thing I can't do is leave you unsatisfied!
target: 有……唯一不会的，就是让你不满意！

source: And it seems I've arrived just in time... %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, it's been a while since I've seen eye-bags as big and stress-induced as yours.
target: 而且，我来得正是时候。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，很久没见过，有人压力大到眼袋像你这么重了。

source: Are you, by chance, on a wacky road trip with volatile, unpredictable friends?
target: 你该不会，正跟几个脾气反复、难以捉摸的朋友，来场古怪的公路旅行吧？

source: Damn, is it that obvious?
target: 妈的，有这么明显？

source: Yes, but don't worry, honey. My deep-tissue snuggle therapy will fix you right up!
target: 有，不过别担心，亲爱的。我的深层拥抱疗法，包你满血复活！

source: Holy shit. Warm Walter gives you the spooning of a lifetime. Never have you felt so rested, so relaxed, so... LOVED.
target: 卧槽。暖暖沃尔特从背后把你搂着，给了你这辈子最棒的抱睡。你从没这么安心、这么放松，这么……被爱着。

source: He charges you -N2 MONEY for his services, but it's worth every penny for the +N2 MIND you gained.
target: 服务费-N2金钱，不过，获得的+N2头脑，让你觉得每分钱都值。

source: I appreciate that. It'll be nice to be with others tonight, rather than alone with my memories of the dreaded Pillow Wars.
target: 谢谢。今晚有人陪着真好，不用独自面对，那场可怕枕头战争的回忆。

source: I've never heard of the Pillow Wars. Were they scary?
target: 没听过枕头战争。很吓人吗？

source: They were absolute hell. I was just a girl then, starry-eyed and ready to protect the Mattress Kingdom with my life.
target: 简直是地狱。当年，我还只是个满眼憧憬的女孩，随时准备，为床垫王国献出生命。

source: But war changes you. We lost so many good soldiers. My pillowcase was soaked in the blood of friends and foes alike.
target: 可战争会改变人。我们失去了太多优秀的战士，我的枕套，被战友和敌人的鲜血浸透。

source: Wait, did you literally fight the war with... pillows?
target: 等等，你们还真拿……枕头打仗？

source: Yes. It's an old tradition in my kingdom, steeped in blood and feather stuffing.
target: 对，那是我国古老的传统，浸透了鲜血，还有羽毛填充物。

source: It was terrible. I can barely even look at a pillow now without hearing my comrades' screams...
target: 太惨了。现在，我几乎一看见枕头，耳边就响起战友的惨叫……

source: But pillow fights are fun! When we go on away games, me and the other sportsball players have pillow fights in our underwear! It's a bonding experience.
target: 可枕头仗很好玩！打客场时，我跟其他打球的队员，都只穿内衣，互相拿枕头打。可增进感情了。

source: Sounds sexy. Wanna show me how it's done? TAKE THIS!
target: 听起来很性感。教教我？接招！

source: Polly swings a pillow in Scott's face. Feathers explode everywhere. Oh, it is ON.
target: 波莉抡起枕头，朝斯科特脸上砸去，羽毛四处飞散。哦，开战了。

source: Foolish kids. You play-fight now, because you don't understand the horrors of war. But if you were there...
target: 愚蠢的孩子。现在拿打仗玩，是因为你们不懂战争的恐怖。要是当年，你们也在……

source: Night-Night stares broodingly into the distance. Meanwhile, you and your new bed buddies have an epic pillow fight! You lose -N2 STAMINA and gain +N2 HYPE.
target: 晚安凝望远方，满眼阴郁。与此同时，你和新床友们，来了一场史诗般的枕头大战！你损失-N2体力，获得+N2热度。

source: Prank call the front desk
target: 打恶作剧电话给前台

source: When in doubt, prank it out! You tell your friends your plan to prank call the front desk.
target: 拿不定主意，就玩恶作剧！你告诉朋友们，准备打个电话，整整前台。

source: NOICE! What's the prank here, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? We could call in a fake bomb threat! Fake bomb threats are fun!
target: 好耶！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，怎么整？谎报炸弹怎么样？这个好玩！

source: Bomb threat! Woohoo!
target: 炸弹威胁！好耶！

source: You spend the next twenty minutes explaining to your friends why a fake bomb threat is not a fun idea.
target: 接下来二十分钟，你都在给朋友们解释，为什么谎报炸弹，并不好玩。

source: Now that you put it like that, I can see why calling in a fake bomb threat may NOT be fun!
target: 这么一说，我懂了。谎报炸弹，可能确实不好玩！

source: It really makes me reconsider the last four fake bomb threats we called in last month...
target: 那上个月谎报的四次炸弹，我还真得重新想想……

source: I'VE GOT IT! Let's call the front desk pretending to be the town mayor! Tell them all motels must now provide complimentary rare steaks to all guests!
target: 有了！假装镇长，给前台打电话，宣布所有旅馆，必须免费给客人送一分熟牛排！

source: Okay... you guess it's still a better prank idea than a fake bomb threat, so... to the prank phone!
target: 行吧……总比谎报炸弹好点。拿电话来，开整！

source: Front desk speaking... you're the mayor, you say?
target: 这里是前台……您说，您是镇长？

source: Well, that's weird, because I'm actually speaking face-to-face with the mayor right now.
target: 可真奇怪，镇长现在，就在我面前说话呢。

source: Oops.
target: 糟了。

source: Did you tell them about the rare steaks yet?
target: 跟他们说一分熟牛排的事了吗？

source: "Wait, you say you have the mayor on the phone?" asks the real mayor. "That's fascinating! Put me on the line!"
target: “等等，电话里说，他是镇长？”真正的镇长问，“有意思！让我接！”

source: Oh, this should be good.
target: 哦，有好戏看了。

source: Greetings, Me! Using my big politician brain, I've deduced that you're a version of myself calling from the future!
target: 你好，我自己！凭我这颗政治家的聪明脑袋，我推断出：你是未来的我！

source: Uh... sure?
target: 呃……算是吧？

source: Wonderful! You must be calling to advise me on if I should take the hefty bribe Fancy Motels offered me to demolish the public park to build a golf course.
target: 太好了！肯定是为了华丽汽车旅馆给的大笔贿赂，来指点我该不该收。他们想拆公共公园，建高尔夫球场。

source: They offered me a LOT of money, and I do like money. But I suspect their plan is a bit unethical.
target: 钱给得很多，我也喜欢钱。可我怀疑，这计划有点不道德。

source: So, Future Me, based on your inside future knowledge: should I take the deal?
target: 那么，未来的我，凭你的未来内幕消息，这买卖，该不该答应？

source: "Take the deal. In the future you will get very obsessed with launching your own shampoo brand. I'm sorry to say this, but shampoo trumps ethics."
target: “答应。未来，你会疯狂迷恋，创立自己的洗发水品牌。很抱歉，可洗发水，比道德重要。”

source: "Don't do it. In the future scientists have discovered karma is very real and we need sweet karma points if we want to fulfill our dream of reincarnating into a robo-dinosaur."
target: “别干。未来，科学家发现，因果报应是真的。想实现转世成机器恐龙的梦想，咱就得多攒功德！”

source: A week later, the mayor sends a letter to your car.
target: 一周后，镇长寄来一封信，收件地址，是你的车。

target: 嗯，肯定没事，不过，一小时后，又有人报警，说你挖了个坑，把“人形包裹”滚了进去？

source: Oh! I was just... gardening! Yeah. I always do my best planting at two a.m.
target: 哦！那个……在搞园艺！对。凌晨两点，我种东西最有一手。

source: Gardening does require digging holes!
target: 搞园艺，确实得挖坑！

source: I think we can safely say this all checks out.
target: 看来，可以放心说，完全说得通。

source: Yup, this all seems to be in order.
target: 嗯，没什么问题。

source: Sorry to take up so much of your time, Jerry. My partner and I will be goi--
target: 耽误你这么久，不好意思，贾利。我们就先——

source: "AHHHHH!!!" scream the cops as they suddenly plummet into the ground.
target: “啊啊啊！！！”两个警察突然脚下一空，掉了下去。

source: Owww... silly us, falling into this sudden six-foot hole! Thank goodness our fall was broken by this soft corpse.
target: 嗷……真笨，竟掉进这个突然出现的六英尺深坑！还好，这具软尸体，给我们垫了底。

source: Wait a second...
target: 等一下……

source: Jerry, buddy, care to explain why you have a corpse in a hole in your backyard?
target: 贾利，兄弟，解释一下？你家后院坑里，为什么有尸体？

source: Oh! Well. That's because... uhm...
target: 哦！嗯。因为……呃……

source: Actually, I need a second to talk to my lawyers. Wait just a second!
target: 其实，我得先跟律师谈谈。等一下！

source: Psst! Hey, you! Trespassers! Congrats, you guys are my lawyers now. I'll pay you if you can get me out of being arrested.
target: 嘘！喂，你们这些擅闯的！恭喜，现在，你们是我的律师了。能让我不被抓，就给钱。

source: Wow, I'm a lawyer! My grandma's gonna be so proud!
target: 哇，我是律师了！奶奶肯定骄傲死了！

source: Don't worry, Jer, I've got a plan: we'll ask %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% to come up with a plan!
target: 别担心，小贾，我有计划：让%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%想个计划！

source: Pose as doctors to certify that the corpse isn't actually dead.
target: 假扮医生，证明尸体，其实没死。

source: For your next trick, make the corpse DISAPPEAR!
target: 下一项魔术，让尸体……消失！

source: You don't have much time to discuss your roles, but your friends are always happy to improvise!
target: 没多少时间分配角色，不过，你朋友们，随时乐意即兴发挥！

source: Phew! Finally out of the hole. Jeez, I can't believe my wings have gotten so flabby...
target: 呼！总算爬出坑了。天哪，我翅膀居然，松垮成这样了……

source: Okay, Jerry, lawyer-time is up. What can you tell us about the dead woman in your yard?
target: 好了，贾利，跟律师谈的时间到了。院子里的女尸，怎么解释？

source: Just a sec, bros! Can you really be sure this woman is dead?
target: 等等，兄弟们！真能确定，这女人死了吗？

source: Who are you?
target: 你是谁?

source: I'm Doctor Bigbrain, and I can tell you this woman is 100% alive!
target: 我是大聪明医生。我能告诉你，她百分之百活着！

source: No, wait... more like 120%!!! Yeah, we could say this woman might be, in fact, TOO ALIVE!
target: 不，等等……百分之一百二十才对！！！没错，这女人简直活得，太过头了！

source: Scott laughs and slaps the corpse's back. Her head pops off.
target: 斯科特笑着，拍拍尸体的背。她脑袋掉了下来。

source: Look, I admit I'm no doctor, but I'm like 95% sure this woman is dead.
target: 好吧，我不是医生，可我有95%的把握，这女人死了。

source: THAT'S WHERE YOU'RE WRONG!
target: 这你可就错了！

source: What is truly the condition of "death"? Can we even say someone is dead if, in life, they never truly felt ALIVE?!
target: “死亡”究竟是什么状态？要是生前，从没真正感觉“活过”，还能说这个人，死了吗？！

source: Who are YOU?!
target: 你又是谁？！

source: Well, I'm a doctor too...
target: 嗯，我也是医生……

source: ...a doctor of philosophy!
target: ……哲学博士！

source: And as such, I declare that life and death are concepts we cannot completely fathom... therefore, it is impossible to determine if this woman here is dead.
target: 因此，我宣布，生与死，都是人无法完全理解的概念。所以，无法判定这位女士，是否死亡。

source: I never saw it that way! Dang, we could really use a forensic philosopher in the force.
target: 从没从这个角度想过！哇，警队可真需要，来个哲学法医。

source: I think our job here is done, partner. Let's go get a coffee and a donut. I need to ponder all this philosophy.
target: 搭档，活儿干完了。喝咖啡，吃甜甜圈去。我得琢磨琢磨，这一堆哲学。

source: They... leave? Really? Well, Jerry pays your +N2 MONEY retainer, and you definitely lose -N2 SOUL for fooling the law.
target: 他们……就走了？真的？行吧。贾利付给你+N2金钱的律师聘用费，你骗过执法者，也确实损失了-N2灵魂。

source: Great idea, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! You be the magician. I'll back you up.
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，好主意！你当魔术师，我打配合。

source: Come one, come all to the debut performance of %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% the Illusionist! Cops get in free!
target: 走过路过，快来看，幻术大师%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%的首演！警察免票！

source: Really? Military veterans and teachers get all the fun discounts! Finally, a win for cops!
target: 真的？好折扣，全让退伍军人和老师占了。终于，警察也捞着一次！

source: You dazzle the cops with some warmup tricks: quarter behind the ear, card tricks, mildly-invasive hypnosis...
target: 你先玩几手暖场：耳后变硬币、纸牌戏法，还有略微侵犯个人意志的催眠，晃得警察眼花缭乱。

source: Now, I need a volunteer from the audience! Does anyone here have a corpse I can use?
target: 现在，需要一位观众志愿者！谁有具尸体，能借我用用？

source: Hey, what luck! We've got a corpse right here!
target: 嘿，真巧！这里正好有一具！

source: You put the corpse in your magic box, do a little jig, and say the magic words! -N2 MAGIC later, you open the box to show that the corpse has disapeared.
target: 你把尸体放进魔术箱，跳两步，念出咒语。消耗-N2魔力后，打开箱子，尸体已经消失。

source: Woohoo! That was amazing! Bravo, bravo!
target: 好耶！精彩！真棒，真棒！

source: Yeah, nice trick... but, uh, where's the corpse? We kinda need it to convict a serial killer.
target: 嗯，好魔术……可，呃，尸体呢？给连环杀手定罪，还得用它。

source: Shame on you! You should never ask a magician to reveal %HISHER% secrets!
target: 真不懂规矩！怎么能让魔术师，泄露%HISHER%秘密！

source: Seriously, partner, that's magician rules 101! Where are your manners?
target: 就是，搭档。这可是魔术师的基本规矩，礼貌呢？

source: Dammit! This is the third time this week we've lost crucial evidence this way. The sheriff's gonna strip my wings for sure!
target: 妈的，这周第三次，这么弄丢关键证据了。警长肯定要扒了我的翅膀！

source: Relax, it'll be fine. Why don't we find a nice, quiet city block and give random people parking tickets?
target: 别急，没事。找个安静的街区，随机给人开停车罚单，怎么样？

source: Y'know... that does sound nice. Thanks, partner; you always know how to cheer me up.
target: 这么说……倒也不错。谢了，搭档，你总知道，怎么让我开心。

source: Nice work, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. Here's your +N2 MONEY. When the time comes, I promise to kill you last.
target: 干得好，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。你的+N2金钱。等到那天，我保证，最后再杀你。

source: Just knock on the door, goddammit
target: 敲门就行，他妈的

source: You knock on the front door. No answer.
target: 你敲了敲前门，没人应。

source: Maybe no one's home?
target: 可能没人在家？

source: Unlikely; there are too many loud chainsaw noises for the house to be empty.
target: 不可能，电锯响成那样，怎么会没人。

source: Scott turns the doorknob. Turns out the door wasn't locked. As soon as it's open, a bloody man with duct-tape over his mouth runs into the night.
target: 斯科特一拧门把，原来没锁。门刚打开，一个浑身是血、嘴上封着胶带的男人，就冲出去，消失在夜色里。

source: NO! WAIT! Goddammit! That's the third one this week! I leave for five seconds to find my lucky butcher knife...
target: 不！等等！妈的，本周第三个了！就离开五秒，找我的幸运砍肉刀……

source: Butcher knife? Was he your dinner guest?
target: 砍肉刀？他是你请来吃晚饭的？

source: If by "dinner" you mean "murder" and by "guest" you mean "victim", then sure.
target: 如果“晚饭”，指的是“谋杀”，“请来的人”，指的是“受害者”，那确实是。

source: That's too much word replacing for me, but listen: if you want your guests to stay for dinner, you gotta up your game, bro!
target: 换词太多，我跟不上。不过，想让客人留下吃饭，兄弟，你得用点心！

source: You're damn right, Scott! It seems our friend here needs a crash course in host etiquette.
target: 太对了，斯科特！看来，这位朋友，需要速成待客礼仪课。

source: Yeah! Like, maybe put some extra lighting in your front room here and clean up the ketchup stains all over the floor. That'll make your guests feel welcome and safe!
target: 比如，把前厅弄亮点，再擦擦满地的番茄酱渍。客人才能感觉，受欢迎，还安全！

source: Hmmm. So you're saying that by being a better host, I can get my "guests" to stay for "dinner"?
target: 嗯。所以，当个好主人，就能让“客人”留下“吃饭”？

source: Yup, perfect plan! What's the best way to transform Jerry the grisly serial killer into Jerry the hostess with the mostest?
target: 对，完美！怎么把恐怖连环杀手贾利，变成最会待客的贾利？

source: A good host always treats their guests. Teach Jerry how to cook a dessert to DIE for.
target: 好主人，总得款待客人。教贾利，做一道好吃“到死”的甜点。

source: Gift Jerry your best jigsaw puzzle so he can keep his guests hooked forever.
target: 把你最爱的拼图，送给贾利，让客人迷得，永远舍不得走。

source: A cooking lesson? Sounds great! All I have handy is "almost ketchup", "maybe pork", and cumin, though. Can we make anything with that?
target: 烹饪课？不错！不过，手头只有“差不多是番茄酱”“也许是猪肉”，还有孜然。能做点什么？

source: Pass. You give Jerry some of your road trip food, which costs you -N2 STAMINA, but it's all in the name of passing on the magic of cooking!
target: 算了。你分点旅行口粮给贾利，损失-N2体力。不过，一切为了传授，烹饪的魔法！

source: A few nights later, screams are once again emanating from Jerry's house. A terrified couple runs from room to room, covered in blood, trying to escape.
target: 几夜后，贾利家，再次传来尖叫。一对满身是血的夫妻，惊恐地从一间屋，逃到另一间，想找出口。

source: "Good, I think we lost him!" cries the woman. "How did I let you talk me into going to a dinner party hosted by a serial killer?"
target: “好，应该甩掉他了！”女人说，“你怎么说服我，来参加连环杀手办的晚宴的？！”

source: "ALLEGED serial killer! And we need to socialize more with the neighbors, honey! You said so yourself!"
target: “是涉嫌连环杀人！而且，得跟邻居多来往，亲爱的，不是你自己说的？”

source: "Shh, he could find us at any moment! We need to get back to the car! My head wound is really starting to sting."
target: “嘘，随时会被找到！得回车里去！我头上的伤口，越来越疼了。”

source: Come out, come out, wherever you are... you don't wanna miss "dessert", haha!
target: 出来吧，出来吧，都藏哪儿了……别错过“甜点”，哈哈！

source: "Wait, that's right," the man says. "Back before he murdered Carl, Jerry mentioned making some sort of berry vanilla cheesecake parfait for dessert... I want to try it!"
target: “等等，对了，”男人说，“杀卡尔之前，贾利说，做了莓果香草芝士蛋糕芭菲……我想尝尝！”

source: "Dessert was code for murdering us, Eddie! I could practically hear him air-quoting the word!"
target: “艾迪，‘甜点’是杀我们的暗号！那词上打了引号，我都听出来了！”

source: "But today's my cheat day, and I already had to watch my whole fantasy football league get murdered!"
target: “可今天是我的放纵餐日，我梦幻橄榄球联盟的人，又刚被杀光！”

source: "C'mon, honey, I NEED this berry vanilla cheesecake parfait! Didn't your therapist tell you to stop playing safe and start taking more chances?"
target: “亲爱的，那份莓果香草芝士蛋糕芭菲，我非吃不可！你的心理咨询师，不是让你别老求稳，多冒点险吗？”

source: "Ugh. Fine. But we are absolutely NOT staying for coffee afterwards, got it?"
target: “呃，行。但绝对不留下喝饭后咖啡，听懂了？”

source: Found you! Ready for "dessert"?
target: 找到你们了！准备好吃“甜点”了吗？

source: "Ohhh, you were right, he's totally airquoting. I can see it now."
target: “哦，你说得对，他真的在比引号。这下看见了。”

source: You gain +N2 SOUL for teaching Jerry how to be a great host, AND Jerry gets to eat all the parfait? Tonight, everyone won! (Except for the couple, of course.)
target: 教会贾利待客之道，你获得+N2灵魂；贾利还能独享所有芭菲？今晚，人人都是赢家！当然，那对夫妻除外。

source: You give Jerry your favorite puzzle. You lose -N2 HYPE for not being able to complete it, but anything to help out a neighbor in need!
target: 你送出最爱的拼图，没法再拼完它，损失-N2热度。不过，邻居有困难，总得帮！

source: A few nights later, screams are once again emanating from Jerry's house. A terrified couple runs from room to room, covered in blood, trying to escape.
target: 几夜后，贾利家，再次传来尖叫。一对满身是血的夫妻，惊恐地从一间屋，逃到另一间，想找出口。

source: "I think he's gone. God, this is a nightmare!" cries the woman. "How did I let you talk me into going to a dinner party at JERRY'S?"
target: “应该走了。天啊，噩梦！”女人喊道，“你怎么说服我，到贾利家赴晚宴的？！”

source: "I can't believe he killed everyone," the man weeps. "Even Carl! His wife has a baby on the way..."
target: “他居然把所有人，都杀了。”男人哭道，“连卡尔也不放过！他老婆，还有宝宝没出生呢……”

source: "Shh, he could find us at any moment! Help me break open a window so we can get out of here! My gushing head wound is really starting to sting."
target: “嘘，他随时会找到我们！帮忙砸开窗，好逃出去！我头上还在流血，伤口越来越疼了。”

source: "I'm not finding any blunt objects in here, just old newspapers and moldy socks and... wait, is that a half-finished jigsaw puzzle on the ground?"
target: “没找着钝器，就旧报纸、发霉袜子，还有……等等，地上是不是，有幅没拼完的拼图？”

source: "Who cares? We don't have time to study a puzzle of a stupid pack of wolves! We need to get to the car!"
target: “谁管它？没空看这幅蠢狼群拼图，得回车上！”

source: "Wait, did you say wolves? This puzzle is obviously depicting a pack of jaguars."
target: “等等，你说狼？这明明是一群美洲虎。”

source: "No, jaguars don't hunt in packs. It's wolves, you idiot."
target: “不，美洲虎不成群狩猎。这是狼，白痴。”

source: "It's jaguars!"
target: “美洲虎！”

source: "WOLVES!"
"JAGUAAAAAAAARS!"
Sup, guys? I could hear you shouting all the way across the house!
target: 哟，各位？隔着整栋房子，都听见你们喊了！

source: You like my puzzle? My friend %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% gave it to me; %HESHE%%VERB_'S_'RE% a kind +N2 SOUL.
target: 喜欢拼图？朋友%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%送的，%HESHE%%VERB_'S_'RE%真是个善良的+N2灵魂。
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): KEEP; 善良灵魂兼作 +N2 SOUL 结算，真是已表达系词。 按行中文动词展开已实现；未实机验证。

source: Now, let's find out how many pieces I can turn YOU guys into! HAHAHAHAHA!
target: 现在，看看你们，我能拆成多少块！哈哈哈哈哈！

source: For those at home who were curious, the completed puzzle was actually a bowl of fruit.
target: 在家看戏的观众，要是还好奇：拼完的图，其实是一碗水果。

source: Dress up as astronauts
target: 扮成宇航员

source: You're checking out all the weird control rooms and laboratories when you and your friends find a closet full of colorful astronaut costumes.
target: 你们逛着各种古怪的控制室和实验室，发现一个柜子，塞满五颜六色的宇航服。

source: OMG, these are adorable! Here, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, you wear the orange one. Do you think this banana peel accentuates my booty?
target: 天哪，好可爱！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你穿橙色这件。我这个香蕉皮，显屁股翘吗？

source: You're observing Polly's booty (respectfully) when an emergency siren goes off. "CREWMATES, REPORT TO THE CONFERENCE ROOM!"
target: 你正礼貌地欣赏波莉的翘臀，警报忽然响起：“各位船员，到会议室报到！”

source: You all go to the conference room. You're surrounded by other astronauts.
target: 你们来到会议室，周围全是其他宇航员。

source: Let's remember why we're here, everyone: we're simulating living together in a REAL space station!
target: 各位，别忘了，我们在干什么：模拟在真正的空间站里，共同生活！

source: That means we all have to do our tasks and work together... right, Yellow?
target: 所以，要完成任务，互相配合……对吧，小黄？

source: Why are you singling me out?! I know, I slacked on cleaning out the oxygen tank. But I fixed it before we all fully suffocated!
target: 干吗专门点我？！我知道，清氧气罐时，是偷懒了。可大家彻底窒息前，我不就修好了吗！

source: If anything, it's Cyan and Red who haven't been pulling their weight. I've never seen them do ANYTHING around here.
target: 真要说，倒是小青和小红，没尽责任。我就没见他们，在这儿干过什么。

source: Well I was, uh... unclogging the toilets? That's reasonable, right? Do you still poop in space?
target: 呃，我在……通马桶？合理吧？太空里，也拉屎的吧？

source: And I was doing... astronaut things. So many of them.
target: 我在做……宇航员的事。可多了。

source: Wait. I just did a head count, and there are definitely more people here than we had earlier. I think we have an impostor...
target: 等等，数了数人头，这里的人，肯定比刚才多。我觉得，有冒牌货……

source: ...AMONG US.
target: ……在我们之中。

source: (Yaaasss he said the thing!!!)
target: （好耶！他说出那个词了！！！）

source: Ugh, does that mean we have to do the "vote people out" thing again? I hate when HQ sends us these drills.
target: 呃，又要“投票踢人”了？最烦总部，派这种演习了。

source: I suspect... Orange. Yellow and Cyan both have alibis, and Red was obviously doing astronaut things. But Orange has been completely silent since %HESHE% got here.
target: 我怀疑……小橙。小黄、小青，都有不在场证明，小红明显在干宇航员的事。可从%HESHE%来了，小橙就一句话不说。

source: Yeah, fuck that Orange guy... wait, YOU'RE Orange!
target: 对啊，小橙算什么东西……等等，你就是小橙！

source: Convince everyone you're not the impostor!
target: 快让大家相信，你不是冒牌货！

source: Convince them all by doing something so "astronaut-like" you couldn't possibly be the impostor.
target: 做件特别像“宇航员”的事，让所有人相信，你绝不可能是冒牌货。

source: Astronauts only listen to the stars. Convince them to check everyone's horoscope for clues to find the true impostor.
target: 宇航员，只听星星的。说服他们，查查每个人的星座运势，找出真正的冒牌货。

source: Yeah! Do something astronaut-like! Like... uh... shit. You actually don't know that much about the day-to-day lives of astronauts.
target: 对！做点宇航员会做的事！比如……呃……操。其实，宇航员平时干吗，你也不怎么懂。

source: Astronauts... love space? Nah, too obvious.
target: 宇航员……喜欢太空？不，太明显。

source: Astronauts... probably have strong opinions on which type of curry is the best? Closer, but not quite.
target: 宇航员……大概对哪种咖喱最好吃，很有主见？有点靠近，还不够。

source: Astronauts... are fiercely competitive and ambitious, and therefore insecure about "not making the cut?" Yes, that could work!
target: 宇航员……好胜、上进，所以很怕自己“不够格”？对，这招行！

source: If I was an impostor, how would I know the Super-Secret Astronaut Handshake?
target: 要是冒牌货，怎么会“超级秘密宇航员握手式”？

source: The Super Secret... what? That's not real.
target: 超级秘密……什么？根本没这回事。

source: Of course it's real, dumb-dumb. Every astronaut's heard of the Super-Secret Astronaut Handshake!
target: 当然有，小笨蛋。哪个宇航员，不知道超级秘密宇航员握手式！

source: Uh, yeah, right! The Super-Secret Astronaut Handshake. Obviously.
target: 呃，对，对！超级秘密宇航员握手式，当然了。

source: I learned it at Yale, a place where I definitely went and got my degree in astronauting.
target: 在耶鲁学的。我绝对在那儿上过学，还拿了个宇航学位。

source: What are you all talking about?! There is no such handshake!
target: 你们在说什么？！根本没这套握手！

source: Bro, if you don't know the Super-Secret Astronaut Handshake, just be honest. I'll show you!
target: 兄弟，不会就直说，我教你！

source: Scott grabs your hands, and you two perform the convoluted handshake you've been perfecting for years. You pull it off so perfectly, you gain +N2 HYPE!
target: 斯科特抓起你的手，跟你演示那套，多年不断完善、复杂得要命的握手。配合得完美无缺，你获得+N2热度！

source: Oh... well, I can obviously do that! You just clap, then shake hands, then do a twirl... or was it a fistbump... and now the splits -- OWWW! CRAMP! CRAMP!
target: 哦……我当然也会！先拍手，再握手，再转一圈……还是碰拳来着……然后劈叉——嗷！抽筋！抽筋！

source: HE CAN'T DO THE HANDSHAKE! EJECT THE IMPOSTOR!
target: 他不会握手！把冒牌货扔出去！

source: You all throw Green out of the airlock. Sowing doubt and insecurity won the day! You lose -N2 SOUL for lying, though.
target: 你们把小绿扔出了气闸。挑起猜忌和自我怀疑，大获全胜！不过，说谎让你损失了-N2灵魂。

source: Horoscopes? Seriously? You expect us, followers of science all, to listen to the "+N2 MAGIC prophecies of the stars?" That's such hippie crap.
target: 星座运势？认真的？我们都信科学，你还想让我们，听什么“星辰的+N2魔力预言”？嬉皮士鬼话。

source: Yellow's right. We'd much rather consult a rational method of determining the impostor, like magic crystals!
target: 小黄说得对。找冒牌货，我们更愿意，用点理性的方法，比如魔法水晶！

source: How is that any better than astrology?!
target: 那跟占星，有什么区别？！

source: Whatever, guess you'll play along. The astronauts spread out their crystals on the floor.
target: 算了，陪他们演吧。宇航员们把水晶，铺在了地上。

source: HEY, SHINY ROCKS! WHO IS THE IMPOSTOR?!
target: 喂，亮晶晶的石头！冒牌货是谁？！

source: The crystals don't respond. Shocker.
target: 水晶没有回应。真意外。

source: Hmm... maybe these crystals are defective. Should we try the Ouija board to ask the local aliens for help?
target: 嗯……水晶是不是坏了？要不用通灵板，请本地外星人帮帮忙？

source: But Ouija boards are for ghosts, not aliens!
target: 可通灵板，不是找外星人的，是找鬼的！

source: True, but it's possible that there will be ghosts OF ALIENS that we can contact! We gotta use all our options here.
target: 对，不过，也许有外星人的鬼魂，可以联系啊！能用的办法，全得试！

source: All right, everyone put your hands on the planchette. *Ahem...*
target: 好，大家把手，放在指示板上。*咳……*

source: O Spirits of the Moon People! Is there an impostor among us?
target: 月球人的英灵啊！我们之中，有冒牌货吗？

source: The planchette's moving! It says... "NO LOL." That's odd.
target: 指示板动了！说的是……“没有，哈哈。”奇怪。

source: Well, guess we'd better believe it. A ghost would never lie! Not even if it would be really funny for them to do so!
target: 那只能信了。鬼可从不撒谎！就算撒个谎，能把自己乐坏了，也不会！

source: But I was so sure... dang it. Sorry, everyone. I guess I was just excited to throw someone out of the airlock again and I saw what I wanted to see.
target: 可我明明那么确定……可恶。抱歉，各位。大概太想再把人扔出气闸，就看见自己想看见的东西了。

source: It's okay, bro. Sometimes when I get too excited, I pee on the carpet. It's nothing to be ashamed of!
target: 没事，兄弟！我有时太兴奋，还往地毯上尿呢，没什么好丢人的！

source: Hooray, you live to deceive people another day! You lose -N2 SOUL for it, though.
target: 好耶，活下来了，还能继续骗人！不过，你为此，损失了-N2灵魂。

source: Watch a rocket launch
target: 看火箭发射

source: You sneak past security, open a bag of astronaut food, and settle in to watch the show.
target: 你们绕过安保，打开一袋太空食品，坐好等着看戏。

source: This is so cool! I can't believe we're gonna watch a real rocket launch!
target: 好酷！真没想到，能亲眼看火箭发射！

source: We sure are, Scotty! And you know what every rocket launch needs, right?
target: 当然，小斯科特！知道每次火箭发射，都缺什么吧？

source: A rocket?
target: 火箭吗?

source: No! A prank!
target: 不是！缺个恶作剧！

source: A rocket launch is probably the worst time to play a prank, actually.
target: 其实，火箭发射，可能是最不适合恶作剧的时候。

source: And that, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, is why you're still just a Prank Masterz intern.
target: 所以，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你才一直只是恶作剧大师的实习生。

source: In order to be a true Master-with-a-Z, you gotta see the potential pranks in every scenario, even a rocket launch!
target: 想当真正的“大师z”，就得在任何场面，找出恶作剧的机会，连火箭发射也不例外！

source: Right! And the perfect prank for a rocket launch is... is...
target: 对！最适合火箭发射的恶作剧，就是……就是……

source: ...something involving a whoopie cushion, maybe?
target: ……放屁坐垫之类的？

source: Nah. The perfect prank would be to set up a cardboard cutout of the moon and launch the rocket there instead! The ol' switcheroo!
target: 不。搭个纸板月亮，让火箭改飞那里，才完美！经典掉包计！

source: Okay! Do we have enough cardboard to do that?
target: 好！纸板够吗？

source: No, sadly we used all of it to make that cardboard skyline of Detroit for our "Liam thinks he's going to Detroit" prank.
target: 可惜，不够。“李姆以为自己要去底特律”那个恶作剧，做纸板城市天际线，全用光了。

source: Totally worth it, though.
target: 不过，完全值得。

source: Then what do we do?
target: 那我们怎么办?

source: Make our intern think of a prank, obviously. What should we do, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?
target: 当然，让实习生想。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，咱们干吗？

source: Replace the rocket's fuel with sugar! What a SWEET idea!
target: 拿糖，换掉火箭燃料！这主意，真甜！

source: Replace the oxygen with helium! Helium? More like HELL YEAH!
target: 拿氦气，换掉氧气！“氦”呀，好主意！

source: Replace the astronauts with corgis! It's a cor-GENIUS plan!
target: 拿柯基，换掉宇航员！真是个“柯”学天才！

source: You siphon the rocket fuel while Scott empties your road trip sugar supply into the tank.
target: 你抽出火箭燃料，斯科特把旅行备的糖，一股脑倒进燃料箱。

source: Sweet! Not only is putting sugar in their gas tank a hilarious slapstick prank, but we also got +N2 MAGIC for the car!
target: 甜！往别人油箱倒糖，多么经典的闹剧恶作剧，还顺便给车，弄到+N2魔力！

source: Woohoo! This calls for some celebratory PB&J sandwiches!
target: 好耶！来点花生酱果酱三明治，庆祝一下！

source: Oh... we don't have any sugar for the jelly.
target: 哦……做果酱，没糖了。

source: Oh, bummer.
target: 哦，真遗憾。

source: Oh well, we can at least celebrate with a cup of coffee!
target: 算了，至少能喝杯咖啡庆祝！

source: Right! I'll make some. How many spoonfuls of sugar do you like in your coffee, Polly?
target: 对！我来泡。波莉，你加几勺糖？

source: Two, please!
target: 两勺，谢谢！

source: Oh, bad news. It looks like we have... no spoons of sugar left.
target: 哦，坏消息。好像……一勺糖都不剩了。

source: Wait, seriously? How much sugar did we put in the dumb rocket?
target: 等等，真没了？那破火箭，到底倒了多少糖？

source: Well, we had to fill the whole rocket tank, which took about... (two... four... carry the eleven...)
target: 要灌满整个燃料箱，大概用了……（二……四……进十一……）

source: ...a LOT of bags of sugar.
target: ……特别多袋糖。

source: UGH! That sucks!
target: 呃！太烦了！

source: You can't help but wonder why Polly even cares. She almost never eats food.
target: 你不禁纳闷，波莉为什么在乎。她几乎不吃东西啊。

source: No, but I eat drugs! Which sugar and caffeine both are! Now I'm gonna crash hardcore and be tired and cranky all day!
target: 不吃东西，可我嗑药！糖、咖啡因，都算！现在药劲过去，我得又累、又暴躁，一整天！

source: Dang. This has been a great reminder to consume sugar responsibly... and maybe not put it in rocket engines. Just a thought. You lose -N2 STAMINA.
target: 唉，这事提醒你，糖，要吃得有分寸……也许，也别塞火箭引擎里。就这么个想法。你损失-N2体力。

source: That sounds hilarious! Everyone'll laugh so hard, they won't be able to breathe!
target: 好好笑！大家肯定笑得，上气不接下气！

source: They're not gonna be able to breathe for lots of reasons -- but that's the astronauts' problem, not yours!
target: 喘不上气的原因，可多了，不过，那是宇航员的事，不是你的。

source: Besides, they probably trained for this, right? Astronaut training preps you for lots of emergencies; having all the oxygen replaced with helium is probably one of them.
target: 再说，他们肯定练过吧？宇航训练，各种突发情况都教，氧气全换成氦气，大概也教过。

source: You, Polly, and Scott hook up the helium tank they packed (for "prankmergencies") to the rocket, then sneak into Mission Control to watch the show...
target: 你、波莉和斯科特，把随身带的氦气罐，接到火箭上。这可是为“恶作剧紧急情况”准备的。接着，你们溜进任务控制室看戏……

source: "Mission Control, this is Test Rocket 9. Do you copy?"
target: “控制中心，这里是九号测试火箭。收到吗？”

source: "Test Rocket 9, this is Mission Control. Is there a problem with your communications equipment? Your voice sounds strange."
target: “九号测试火箭，这里是控制中心。通讯设备出问题了吗？你声音，好奇怪。”

source: "It seems like our equipment is fine. What's the problem?"
target: “设备好像没事，怎么了？”

source: "Haha... sorry, your voice just sounds so funny and squeaky!"
target: “哈哈……抱歉，你声音好好笑，又尖又细！”

source: "It sounds...? Oh, God, my voice DOES sound different. Is anyone else in here having trouble getting a breath?"
target: “声音怎么……？天啊，还真变了。还有谁，感觉喘不上气吗？”

source: "Heehee... hahaha...!"
target: “嘿嘿……哈哈哈……！”

source: "MISSION CONTROL, STOP LAUGHING! THIS ISN'T FUNNY! WE'RE RUNNING OUT OF AIR!"
target: “控制中心，别笑了！不好笑！空气快没了！”

source: "HAHAHAHA! Test Rocket 9, we can't take you seriously when you sound like an angry baby!"
target: “哈哈哈哈！九号测试火箭，你这声音，像个生气的小宝宝，真没法当真！”

source: Classic!
target: 经典！

source: You, Polly, and Scott high-five over your pranking genius. You lose -N2 SOUL for suffocating the astronauts, but gain +N2 HYPE!
target: 你、波莉和斯科特，为天才恶作剧，击掌庆祝。把宇航员憋死，让你损失-N2灵魂，不过，你获得了+N2热度！

source: Days later, the rocket touches down on an alien planet far away. The aliens watch as 200 corgis exit the rocket wearing four-legged astronaut suits!
target: 几天后，火箭降落在遥远的外星球。外星人看着，两百只柯基，穿着四条腿的宇航服，走了出来！

source: "How do we address the alien situation?" the planet's emperor asks at the next advisor meeting. "Have the invaders explained why they're here?"
target: 下一次顾问会议上，星球的皇帝问：“外星人的事，怎么处理？入侵者说明来意了吗？”

source: "They're here to declare WAR!" says one advisor. "We must slaughter the furry bastards!"
target: “宣战来的！”一位顾问说，“得杀光，那群毛茸茸的混蛋！”

source: "They keep chewing up furniture, digging up our buried dead, and urinating everywhere to claim all our territory! Act soon, Emperor, or we'll become their slaves!"
target: “他们咬家具，挖我们的死者，到处撒尿，霸占领土！陛下，再不动手，我们就成奴隶了！”

source: "That's not a war declaration!" says another advisor. "Those are just cultural norms on the aliens' home planet!"
target: “不是宣战！”另一位顾问说，“那只是，他们母星的文化习俗！”

source: "These invaders know only love, friendship, and head pats. They're here to usher us into an era of peace!"
target: “这些入侵者，只懂爱、友谊，还有摸头。他们要带我们，进入和平时代！”

source: "Well, give them whatever they want!" says the emperor. "I've fallen in love with their cute faces and little legs. If only we knew their demands!"
target: “那就要什么，给什么！”皇帝说，“那可爱的小脸、小短腿，太让我着迷了。要是能知道，他们想要什么就好了！”

source: Just then, the meeting doors open. It's Fluffbutt, the invaders' ambassador! Cue a chorus of "awws" from the aliens.
target: 门开了。是入侵者的大使，绒屁屁！外星人们，齐刷刷“哎呀”一声。

source: Fluffbutt jumps in the emperor's lap and lets him pet his belly. The emperor notices the note tied around his neck and reads it.
target: 绒屁屁跳上皇帝腿上，让他摸肚子。皇帝发现，它脖子上绑着张纸条，读了起来。

source: It says, "Dear aliens, You're welcome for the dogs! Please wire a million alien dollars to our shared prank fund in thanks."
target: “亲爱的外星人，送你们狗，不用谢！请汇一百万外星元，到我们的共享恶作剧基金，聊表谢意。”

source: "We also accept tips in super juicy alien secrets. We won't tell anyone, promise! XOXO, the Prank Masterz (with a Z!)"
target: “小费，也收超劲爆外星机密。保证不告诉别人！亲亲抱抱，恶作剧大师——带 Z 的那种！”

source: Polly, listen! I just got a call from the bank saying someone deposited "one million Glorpals" into our prank account, which is worth +N2 MONEY!
target: 波莉，听！银行刚来电话，说有人给恶作剧账户，存了一百万格洛帕尔币，值+N2金钱！

source: NOICE! I just got a highly-classified alien telegram! It says, "Vacate this planet before the year ends if you want to live."
target: 漂亮！我刚收到外星绝密电报，写着：“想活命，年底之前，离开这颗星球。”

source: Haha, wacky! You lose -N6 SOUL, but gain +N2 HYPE from your successful prank. And that alien tip will prove useful sooner than you think, so you gain +N2 MIND!
target: 哈哈，真怪！你损失-N6灵魂，不过，恶作剧成功，让你获得+N2热度。那条外星小费，还会比想象中更快派上用场，所以你又获得+N2头脑！

source: Go into the communications room
target: 进入通讯室

source: You guys sneak into the communications room -- and immediately bump into an important-looking woman with a big frown.
target: 你们溜进通讯室，迎面撞上一个，满脸不悦、看着级别很高的女人。

source: "AHEM! Are you supposed to be here?!"
target: “咳！谁准你们来这儿的？！”

source: Uh... yes?
target: 呃……准了吧？

source: "Well... fine. The Feds slashed our security budget, so I guess I have to believe you. I'm General Kerran."
target: “行吧。联邦砍了安保预算，看来，只能信你们了。我是凯兰将军。”

source: Hi! We're interns of... whatever is happening in this room. It's our first day, so we need you to explain everything that's going on in here like we're five.
target: 嗨！我们是实习生，负责……这屋里，正在干的那些事。第一天来，请当我们五岁，把一切从头讲讲。

source: "Ugh, seriously? It's my lunch break. Just watch this training video and don't break anything while I'm away."
target: “认真的？我午休呢。看这培训录像，别在我不在时，弄坏东西。”

source: She leaves you all with a VHS tape explaining how to respond to distress calls from astronauts. It's boring as fuck, and you all soon nod off, until...
target: 她留下一盘 VHS 录像带，教你们怎么处理，宇航员的求救来电。无聊得要命，你们很快打起盹，直到……

source: Guys, wake up! The emergency phone is ringing! Good thing we watched twenty minutes of a two-hour long training video about this!
target: 各位，醒醒！紧急电话响了！还好，两小时培训片，我们看了二十分钟！

source: You've reached Mission Control -- you fly the rockets, we line our pockets! How may I assist you?
target: 这里是控制中心，你们开火箭，我们装满钱袋！有什么能效劳？

source: "Help! Something's wrong with the oxygen tanks! If we don't find a way to fix the air pressure, we're gonna suffocate!"
target: “救命！氧气罐出问题了！不修好气压，我们会窒息！”

source: Sheesh, sounds important! I should probably patch you through to the General for that.
target: 哇，听着挺要紧。这得给你转接将军。

source: Wait, don't patch them through! This must be a test to make sure we watched that video. We should solve this problem ourselves!
target: 别转！肯定是测试，看看我们有没有看录像。自己解决！

source: But... are you sure we're smart enough to fix a rocket?
target: 可……咱们真有那脑子，修火箭吗？

source: Half of intelligence is just winging it, Scott -- and now's the perfect time to try!
target: 斯科特，聪明有一半，靠临场瞎编。正好试试！

source: Okay, guess that means you need to help this suffocating astronaut. What do you suggest?
target: 好吧，看来这位快窒息的宇航员，得你来帮。你有什么建议？

source: Call center rules dictate that trying to sell services the client isn't interested in trumps actually solving the very problem they called about!
target: 客服规矩：客户不想要的服务，硬推销，也比解决他打电话求助的问题，更重要！

source: Keep your cool; fixing a spaceship probably isn't much different than fixing a toaster.
target: 别慌，修飞船，大概跟修烤面包机，没什么区别。

source: THAT'S PERFECT!
target: 完美！

source: We're sorry to hear about your problem, Mr. Astronaut. Maybe you should upgrade your oxygen tanks?
target: 宇航员先生，听说出了这事，真遗憾。要不，升级一下氧气罐？

source: "We can't very well do that while we're in space!"
target: “人在太空，怎么升级？！”

source: Sure you can! With NASA's all-new partnership with Amazong, we now offer SPACE-RACE FAST SHIPPING!
target: 当然可以！NASA 全新联名亚马宗（Amazong），现在推出：太空竞速快递！

source: You could have your new oxygen tanks in just two business lightyears!
target: 只要两个工作光年，新氧气罐，就能送到！

source: "THAT DOESN'T HELP ME NOW!"
target: “现在根本帮不上忙！”

source: While you're at it, you should buy some Scott Snacks Astronaut Food!
target: 顺便，再买点斯科特零食太空餐吧！

source: It comes in four flavors: "Boisenberry", "Hot Habanero", "Wet Dog", and "Untitled Flavor #11".
target: 四种口味：“乖崽莓”“火辣哈瓦那辣椒”“湿狗”，还有“未命名11号口味”。

source: "OH GOD. THE OXYGEN'S DEPLETED. WE'RE ALL DOOMED."
target: “天啊。氧气耗尽了。我们全完了。”

source: Well, before you go, you should know that Scott Snacks Astronaut Food qualifies for space-race fast shipping! Can I put you down for a couple bags?
target: 您走之前，还得告诉您，斯科特零食太空餐，也支持太空竞速快递！来几袋，给您记上？

source: Silence.
target: 沉默。

source: If you listen closely, you can hear faint choking sounds in the background.
target: 仔细听，背景里，还有微弱的窒息声。

source: Hello? I didn't quite catch your credit card number, sir.
target: 喂？先生，信用卡号码，没听清。

source: The line goes dead.
target: 通话断了。

source: Aww, he didn't buy anything... was our pitch bad? Did I do a bad job, Polly?
target: 哎，什么也没买……推销词不好？波莉，我做得不好吗？

source: Nah, sometimes you just gotta find the right customer -- and the person calling us now might be that person! Let's try again!
target: 没有，有时，只是得找对顾客。现在来电话的，也许就是！再试试！

source: You spend the day being very unhelpful to desperate astronauts and losing -N2 SOUL. But amazingly, some of them DO buy Scott Snacks Astronaut Food, and you earn +N2 MONEY!
target: 一整天，你们对求救的宇航员，毫无帮助，损失-N2灵魂。可神奇的是，真有几个买了斯科特零食太空餐，让你赚到+N2金钱！

source: Okay, let's see here... have you tried turning the rocket off and back on again, sir?
