source: Become extras
target: 当群众演员

source: You all go to audition to be extras. Scott is SUPER hyped to audition in his tree costume. Whatever makes him happy, you suppose.
target: 你们一起去试镜群众演员。斯科特穿着树装，兴奋得不得了。行吧，他开心就好。

source: You're called into a room with the casting agent and... a lizard man in a cardboard mask?
target: 你被叫进一间屋子，里面是选角经纪，还有……一个戴纸板面具的蜥蜴人？

source: How do you do, fellow kids? I'm the junior director of hiding in plain sight! It's important that all extras be able to camouflage with the crowd!
target: 各位年轻人，最近怎么样？我是负责大隐隐于市的初级导演！群众演员最重要的，就是混进人群里不被发现！

source: Hey, Counselor Flodge! You brought your costume from home too? Awesome!
target: 嘿，弗洛奇辅导员！你也从家里带了戏服来？太酷了！

source: How'd you know it was me?!
target: 你怎么知道是我？！

source: I mean, good job, kids! You passed the test! The most important role of the extra is to blend in, and if you can do that, you're already an expert!
target: 我是说，干得好，孩子们！测试通过！群众演员最重要的职责就是融入人群，能做到这点，你就是专家了！

source: "Ignore him," sighs the casting agent. "Security's tried to throw him out six times, but he's got too many disguises and keeps pretending to be set pieces."
target: “别理他。”选角经纪叹了口气，“保安都赶了他六次，可他伪装太多，还老假装自己是布景。”

source: "Anyway... why are you auditioning as a tree? You know this movie is set on Saturn, right? There are no trees. And even if there were, we could just CGI them in."
target: “总之……你为什么来试镜一棵树？知道这电影设定在土星吧？没有树。就算有，我们也能用电脑特效加进去。”

source: Yeah, but I play a really good tree! Watch me act like I'm turning sunlight into food!
target: 可我演树真的很棒！看，我现在要把阳光变成食物！

source: (Guys, I think I'm killing it!)
target: （伙计们，我好像演得棒极了！）

source: "Not happening. I'll even quote the script: 'Man, I miss Earth and trees. Or I would if trees hadn't gone extinct 100 years ago, ushering in an era of no trees. ZERO trees.' Okay?"
target: “没门。我直接念剧本给你听：‘唉，好怀念地球和树木啊。要是树没在一百年前灭绝，我就会这么想。那之后就是个没有树的时代，一棵都没有。’懂了吗？”

source: Just then, the director walks in and gasps! "Who is this beautiful tree-man?! You are my new muse. We'll rewrite the entire script around this new pro-tree-gonist!"
target: 就在这时，导演走进来，惊呼道：“这位美丽的树人是谁？！你就是我的新缪斯！我要围绕这位新‘树角’，重写整个剧本！”

source: The casting director's forehead hits the table. This is going well!
target: 选角导演一脑门磕在桌上。进展顺利！

source: Now it's time for you to audition. What part are you going for?
target: 现在轮到你试镜了。你要争取哪个角色？

source: You're not auditioning to be an extra. You're auditioning TO BE EXTRA... ALL DAY!
target: 试镜可不是为了当“背景板”，而是为了抢尽风头……从早抢到晚！

source: This is Scott's time, and you're okay being in his shadow. Be the shrub to his tree.
target: 这是斯科特大放异彩的时刻，你甘愿待在他的树荫下。他当树，你就当灌木。

source: Everyone's the protagonist of their own story; therefore, isn't everyone also the extra in someone else's story? Audition to be the juiciest extra of all: the lead role.
target: 每个人都是自己故事里的主角，那不也都是别人故事里的群众演员？试镜最肥的群众演员角色：主角。

source: NOICE! I'm doing that too now! I'm already extra as hell; I might as well make a career out of it.
target: 漂亮！那我也这么干！我本来就天天抢尽风头，干脆当个事业做。

source: "But 'being extra' isn't a job," the casting agent says. "No one is going to pay you to be extra on set."
target: “可‘抢风头’不算职业。”选角经纪说，“没人会付钱请你在片场抢戏。”

source: Who cares about getting paid? We're extra all day, every day, 365 days a year, because it's our passion, baby! LET THERE BE CONFETTI!
target: 谁在乎钱啊？我们一天到晚、一年三百六十五天都爱抢风头，因为这就是热爱，宝贝！礼花给我放起来！

source: You and Polly fire a confetti cannon, and that settles it! You all head to set to film the big romance scene between the leading astronaut and his alien lover.
target: 你和波莉开了一炮礼花，就这么定了！你们一起去了片场，准备拍主角宇航员和外星恋人的浪漫重头戏。

source: "Okay everyone, let's get this in one take," the director says. "Lights, camera, action!"
target: “各位，争取一条过。”导演说，“灯光、摄影，开拍！”

source: No, boo, you gotta say it like this! "CUE SPOTLIGHTS! ROLL THE CAMERA! PUT YOUR HANDS TOGETHER LADIES, GENTLEMEN, AND ET CETERA... AAAAND, ACTION!"
target: 不对，亲爱的，得这么说！“聚光灯就位！摄影机开转！女士们、先生们，以及其他各位，掌声响起来——开拍！”

source: Hi, everybody! I'm Scott, and I'm a tree! You can call me Tree Scott for short.
target: 大家好！我叫斯科特，是一棵树！简称树斯科特就行。

source: "CUT! The tree doesn't have any lines! And even if it did, it wouldn't introduce itself like that!"
target: “卡！树没有台词！就算有，也不会这么自我介绍！”

source: Really? I think movies would be a lot easier to follow if all the characters introduced themselves at the beginning of every scene.
target: 真的？我觉得每场戏开头，所有角色都先自我介绍，电影会好懂很多。

source: Tree Scott should be introduced by riding a jet ski through the set wall! Then your scene would be EXTRA memorable.
target: 树斯科特应该骑着水上摩托撞穿布景墙登场！这样这场戏才格外让人难忘。

source: "Wow. You are really bad actors... but I'm so captivated by Tree Scott that I want to try that jet ski thing out. PRODUCER! BRING ME MORE BUDGET!"
target: “哇，你们演得真烂……可我实在太迷恋树斯科特了，真想试试水上摩托那个点子。制片人！再给我加预算！”

source: Thanks to your extra suggestions, this movie ends up featuring 100% more exploding hyenas, and Tree Scott rap-battles the antagonist's corpse in the finale!
target: 多亏你们那些浮夸的建议，电影里的爆炸鬣狗多了一倍，结尾树斯科特还跟反派的尸体来了一场说唱对决！

source: You don't get paid since you were never hired in the first place, and you lose -N2 STAMINA because Scott insists on doing his own stunts, but you do gain +N2 HYPE!
target: 你们本来就没被雇用，所以一分钱也没拿到。斯科特还坚持亲自演特技，让你失去 -N2 体力，不过你倒是获得了 +N2 热度！

source: You'd do that for me? Thanks, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! That's really nice of you!
target: 你愿意为我这么做？谢谢，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！你真好！

source: Yeah, it's nice. Kinda boring, though. I was hoping we could at least be backup dancers.
target: 是挺好的。就是有点无聊。我本来还盼着至少能当个伴舞。

source: "You guys have no idea what this movie's even about, do you?" sighs the casting agent.
target: “你们根本不知道这电影在讲什么，对吧？”选角经纪叹气。

source: "Well, to be fair, neither do we," says the director. "It's settled, I'll cast you as the shrubby sidekick to my shining tree star. Let's get filming!"
target: “说句公道话，我们也不知道。”导演说，“就这么定了，你演灌木跟班，配我那位闪耀的树明星。开拍！”

source: Today you're filming the climactic battle scene where the protagonist and the antagonist are holding each other at gunpoint.
target: 今天拍的是高潮决战：主角和反派拿枪指着彼此。

source: "This planet ain't big enough for the two of us," says the antagonist. "Well, technically it is. Saturn is huge. But I'm gonna shoot your ass anyway."
target: “这颗星球容不下我们两个。”反派说，“好吧，严格来说容得下，土星可大了。不过我还是要毙了你。”

source: HOLD IT RIGHT THERE, MR. BAD GUY! If you wanna shoot the nice man, then you'll have to go through me, Tree Scott, and my friend Shrub %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!
target: 坏蛋先生，给我站住！想朝这位好人开枪，就得先过我树斯科特，还有我的朋友灌木%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%这一关！

source: "CUT!" shouts the director. "What are you doing? That wasn't in the script! The tree has no lines!"
target: “卡！”导演喊道，“你在干什么？剧本里没这段！树没有台词！”

source: Well, I did a character study, and I think Tree Scott would team up with the good guy to save the day. He's a good guy, and it's good to care about trees.
target: 我研究过角色了，觉得树斯科特会跟好人联手，拯救大家。他是好人，而且爱护树木也是好事。

source: And Tree Scott would know that because trees have mind-reading powers, which they have to use since trees can't talk... until now!
target: 树斯科特之所以知道，是因为树会读心。树不会说话，只好靠这个本领……不过现在会说了！

target: “唉！你们演得真烂……可这一树一灌木的组合又实在太棒了。重来一条吧……”

source: Scott ruins more takes with such antics as "releasing magic tree spores" to turn bad guys into good boys and asking the bad guy "pretty please" not to be evil anymore.
target: 斯科特继续花样毁镜头，比如“释放魔法树孢子”，把坏人变成乖孩子，还求坏人“拜托拜托”，别再作恶了。

source: You end the day without getting any shots and lose -N2 HYPE. But you gain +N2 SOUL for supporting Scott!
target: 一天过去，一个能用的镜头也没拍到，你失去了 -N2 热度。不过支持斯科特，让你获得了 +N2 灵魂！

source: "No. We have a lead actor already," says the casting agent. "A weird proverb isn't going to make me want to recast that. You can still be an extra, though."
target: “不行，主角已经有人演了。”选角经纪说，“几句歪理不会让我想换人。不过你还是能当群众演员。”

source: You'll just see about that! You get to set and start filming the Saturn saloon shootout scene.
target: 那可不一定！你去了片场，开始拍土星酒馆枪战那场戏。

source: "This planet ain't big enough for the two of us," says the antagonist. "Well, technically it is. Saturn is huge. But I'm gonna shoot your ass anyway."
target: “这颗星球容不下我们两个。”反派说，“好吧，严格来说容得下，土星可大了。不过我还是要毙了你。”

source: Oh, no! They're gonna kill each other! Just like my father was mysteriously killed eighteen years ago!
target: 不好！他们要互相残杀了！就像我父亲十八年前被人神秘杀害那样！

source: Next, you film the lovemaking scene where the protagonist bangs the femme fatale in an alien egg sac. You're there too, because reasons.
target: 接下来拍床戏，主角要在一个外星卵囊里跟蛇蝎美人上床。不知为什么，你也在场。

source: Love is beautiful, isn't it? It reminds me of the love my father had for me before his untimely disappearance...
target: 爱情真美好，不是吗？让我想起我父亲离奇失踪前，是多么爱我……

source: I'M IN THE SEX PART TOO! Fun fact: trees can have sex with themselves via pollination! I'll show you!
target: 我也在床戏里！有个小知识：树可以靠授粉跟自己做爱！我演给你们看！

target: “卡！”导演尖叫，“不许给自己授粉！我们又不是在拍色情片！……是在拍吗？不，不，肯定不是。”

source: Don't cut, it was just getting good!
target: 别喊卡啊，刚演到好看的！

source: Here's a thought: what if the protagonist IS %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s father, and %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% went back in time and watched %HISHER% own inception?!
target: 有个想法：万一主角就是%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%的爸爸，而%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%穿越回了过去，亲眼看见%HISHER%生命是怎么被“造”出来的呢？！

source: "Say, that's the kind of twist that'll put me above that asshole M. Night Salamander! Okay, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, you win. You can play the lead."
target: “诶，这反转能让我压过 M. 奈特·火蜥蜴那个混蛋！好吧，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你赢了。主角归你演。”

source: Woohoo! With %HISHER% trusty sidekick and best bro Tree Scott by %HISHER% side, right?
target: 呜呼！还有%HISHER%可靠跟班兼好兄弟树斯科特，陪在%HISHER%身边，对吧？

source: "Nope. The producer said I'm only allowed to rewrite the script one more time before he slashes my tires. We're just adding %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%."
target: “没有。制片人说了，只能再重写一次剧本，再多就扎我的轮胎。这次只加%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。”

source: Oh... okay. I'll just wait in the car, then. And I'm definitely not -- *sniff* -- gonna cry or anything!
target: 哦……好吧。那我去车里等。而且我绝对不会——吸鼻子——哭什么的！

source: Oof... poor Scott. You lose -N6 SOUL for shattering his dreams... but being the lead pays better than being an extra, so you gain +N6 MONEY!
target: 唉……可怜的斯科特。你打碎他的梦想，失去了 -N6 灵魂……不过主角片酬比群众演员高，所以你赚了 +N6 金钱！

source: Get an autograph
target: 讨个签名

source: You heard that Cool Josh -- the famous actor, singer-songwriter, e-sports champion, skateboarding prodigy, and top-ten chess grandmaster -- is filming on this set!
target: 你听说酷乔希正在这个片场拍戏！就是那位著名演员、创作歌手、电竞冠军、滑板神童，还是世界前十的国际象棋特级大师！

source: You and your friends obviously need to get his autograph. You sneak on the set and find his trailer next to some bushes.
target: 你和朋友们当然得弄到他的签名。你们偷偷溜进片场，在灌木丛旁找到了他的休息房车。

source: Psst! Over here!
target: 嘘！这边！

source: Uhhh, can anyone else hear that bush talking?
target: 呃，还有谁听见那丛灌木在说话了？

source: I'm no bush! You've just fallen prey to my clever disguise! As the youths say, "Get rekt!"
target: 我可不是什么灌木！你们又被我高明的伪装骗了！用年轻人的话说，“菜就多练”！

source: Oh, hey Counselor Flodge! I didn't know you worked here.
target: 哦，嘿，弗洛奇辅导员！不知道你在这儿工作呢。

source: I don't. There's actually a warrant out for my arrest for breaking and entering onto this set. But those cops are no match for my costume kit!
target: 我不在这儿工作。其实，因为非法闯入片场，我正被通缉呢。不过那些警察可斗不过我的变装套装！

source: Niiiice. We snuck on set 'cause we heard Cool Josh was filming here. I'm gonna get him to sign my bra.
target: 厉——害。我们是听说酷乔希在这里拍戏，才溜进来的。我要让他在我胸罩上签名。

source: Well, good luck with that, kiddo. I've been trying to show Cool Josh my screenplay all week.
target: 那祝你好运，孩子。我这整整一周，都在想办法把自己的剧本给酷乔希看。

source: It's an autobiographical documentary called "Hidden In Plain Sight", and Cool Josh is the only actor who can capture me onscreen!
target: 是部自传式纪录片，叫《大隐隐于市》。能在镜头前捕捉到我的神韵的演员，只有酷乔希！

source: Maybe if you kids can get Cool Josh out of his trailer, we'll get this project off the ground!
target: 要是你们能把酷乔希从休息房车里请出来，这项目也许就能启动了！

source: Well, you do have a vested interest in meeting Cool Josh. Find a way to get him out of his trailer!
target: 反正你自己也想见酷乔希。想办法把他请出房车吧！

source: Maybe it's not about getting the actor outside the RV, but about getting yourself inside the actor! ...Inside of his head, you perv. Talk to him. INTENSELY.
target: 也许重点不是让演员走出房车，而是让你走进演员体内！……说的是脑子里，你个色鬼。跟他聊，使劲聊。

source: Lure him out with an Academy Award.
target: 拿奥斯卡奖把他引出来。

source: You knock on the door of Cool Josh's trailer. He yells from inside:
target: 你敲了敲酷乔希的房车门。他在里面喊道：

source: Is that you again, Cameron? Go away!
target: 卡梅伦，又是你吗？走开！

source: Actually, it's Polly Geist. From one fan-favorite to another, I think we should hang out. What do you say, wanna come out and meet us?
target: 其实，我是波莉·鬼斯特。咱俩都是人气角色，应该一起玩玩。怎么样，出来见个面？

source: No! I'm staying right here inside my trailer.
target: 不！我就待在房车里。

source: You SAY you're inside your trailer, but have you ever thought that maybe you're actually ALREADY OUTSIDE, and we're the ones INSIDE?
target: 你说自己在房车里面，可有没有想过，也许你其实已经在外面了，反而是我们在里面？
……没有？

source: Okay, but like... would that be fucked up or what?
target: 好吧，可要真是这样……是不是够离谱的？

source: Ugh, you're persistent... look, I really can't come out, okay? I don't wanna explain why. It's embarrassing.
target: 唉，你们真不死心……听着，我真的出不来，好吗？原因不想说，太丢人了。

source: C'mon, bro, you can talk to us. We're just like you, only not rich and famous. What's holding you back?
target: 说嘛，兄弟，跟我们聊聊。我们跟你一样，只是没钱也不出名。到底什么事困住你了？

source: Fine... I can't go because... I don't know how to open this trailer door! There, I said it!
target: 行吧……我出不去，因为……我不知道这房车门怎么开！好了，我说了！

source: Now that you know the truth, can you let me out please? I've had to shit for like an hour now.
target: 既然真相大白，能放我出去了吗？我已经憋屎憋了快一个小时了。

source: Polly opens the door, and you bask in the glorious presence of Cool Josh himself.
target: 波莉打开车门，你总算得以亲自沐浴在酷乔希的光辉之下。

source: Phew, thank you! Now, what's this about a signed bra?
target: 呼，谢了！刚才说签名胸罩，怎么回事？

source: You, your friends, and Cool Josh all get croissants together. You lost -N2 MIND talking in circles, but you got your autographs, which is pure +N2 HYPE!
target: 你和朋友们跟酷乔希一起吃了可颂。绕圈子聊天让你失去 -N2 头脑，不过签名到手，绝对值 +N2 热度！

source: You knock on the door of Cool Josh's trailer.

target: 天哪，禁忌之恋，还有舔屁股？斯科特，咱俩怎么就不能去那个故事里，当讨人喜欢的配角呢？感觉好玩多了！

source: You gain +N2 HYPE for talking a runaway bride into forbidden ass-eating; but that means no wedding, which means no wedding buffet, so you lose -N2 STAMINA.
target: 你说服逃婚新娘去体验禁忌的舔屁股，获得了 +N2 热度。但没了婚礼，也就没了婚宴自助餐，你失去了 -N2 体力。

source: Catch the bridal bouquet
target: 接新娘捧花

source: IT'S TIME FOR THE BOUQUET TOSS! You've been training your entire life for this moment!
target: 抛捧花的时间到了！你一辈子的训练，就为了这一刻！

source: Damn, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, you REALLY want that bouquet. Let me guess: you're anxious to find that special someone and do the do.
target: 哇，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你还真想抢到那束花啊。让我猜猜：等不及找个命中注定的人，干点该干的事了？

source: And here I thought you left your horny ways behind after the Monster Prom.
target: 我还以为怪物舞会之后，你已经不再这么饥渴了呢。

source: Nope! You're %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, horny for life, if only because I said so. Which means you need to catch that friggin' bouquet!
target: 想得美！你可是%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，这辈子都这么色，光凭我说了算也得是！所以那束该死的花，你非抢不可！

source: I don't get it. What does catching a bouquet of flowers have to do with finding love?
target: 我不懂，接一束花跟找到真爱有什么关系？

source: Catching the bride's bouquet is a tradition. Whoever catches it will supposedly get married next. It's nonsense, but it's fun nonsense.
target: 接新娘捧花是个传统。据说谁接到了，谁就是下一个结婚的。纯属胡说，不过挺好玩。

source: It sounds cool! I've always wanted to have a hobby that combined romance and full-contact sports!
target: 听起来好酷！我一直想找个爱好，能把浪漫和全接触运动结合起来！

source: I just like how chaotic the whole thing is. Everybody's throwing down to catch some flowers 'cause they really wanna bone. It's awesome.
target: 我就喜欢这乱成一团的场面。人人都想上床，抢几朵花抢得大打出手。太棒了。

source: I'm rooting for ya, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. Don't be afraid to tear a bitch's hair out to get that bouquet!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，我支持你！为了抢到花，薅掉哪个婊子的头发也别手软！

source: Shit, the pressure's really on now -- not only to catch the bouquet, but to impress your friends too!
target: 操，压力来了——不光得接到花，还得在朋友面前露一手！

source: You need a FOOLPROOF plan to snatch those flowers. Think of something!
target: 得想个万无一失的办法，把花抢到手。快动脑子！

source: Plant a tracker on the bouquet so you never lose sight of it. Those flowers aren't going ANYWHERE.
target: 往捧花里装个追踪器，时时锁定位置。那束花，跑不了。

source: Don't leave anything to chance! It's time to spend wish number %NEXTPAWWISHNUMBER% from the monkey's paw: ask to catch that goddamn bouquet!
target: 不能听天由命！是时候用掉猴爪的第 %NEXTPAWWISHNUMBER% 个愿望了：许愿接到那束该死的花！

source: You pay -N2 MONEY for a fancy tracker and sneak it onto the bouquet without the bride noticing, then get in position to catch it.
target: 你花 -N2 金钱买了个高级追踪器，趁新娘不注意，偷偷装进捧花里，然后站好位置准备接花。

source: The bride tosses the bouquet, and in slow motion, you watch it somersault through the air...
target: 新娘抛出捧花。时间仿佛放慢，你看着它在空中翻转……

source: Only to be snatched by some punks in leather jackets! Noooo!
target: 结果被几个穿皮夹克的混混一把抢走！不——！

source: Hey! What's the big idea? Were you even invited here, bub?!
target: 喂！干什么呢？小子，你受邀了吗？！

source: (Um, Polly, were WE even invited here...?)
target: （呃，波莉，我们自己受邀了吗……？）

source: "We don't need an invitation," says one of the punks. "We're the Anti-Wedding Biker Gang, notorious scourge of the wedding industry!"
target: “用不着邀请。”一个混混说，“我们是反婚礼飞车党，婚庆行业臭名昭著的克星！”

source: "Modern wedding culture is dumb. People spend so much money on useless shit like tuxedos and bad DJs. That money should be spent on your rad Harley!"
target: “现在的婚礼文化蠢透了。大家把钱浪费在礼服、烂 DJ 这些没用的破事上。这钱该拿去给你那辆酷炫的哈雷！”

source: "That's why we crash weddings and steal bouquets, to prevent the spread of wedding-fever. Without this bouquet, NONE OF YOU can get married!"
target: “所以我们才来砸婚礼、抢捧花，阻止结婚热蔓延。没了捧花，你们谁都结不成婚！”

source: Before anyone can stop them, the bikers hop on their motorcycle and ride off. All hope is lost...
target: 还没等人拦住，飞车党就跨上摩托跑了。希望全没了……

source: NOT! That's right, you have that tracker! You and your friends jump in your car and follow the flowers' location to the bikers!
target: 才怪！没错，你还有追踪器！你和朋友们跳上车，跟着捧花的位置，追上那帮飞车党！

source: While Scott drives and Polly cheers you on, you jump onto the leader's bike. You knock him out, grab the bouquet, and jump back in your car as the bike explodes.
target: 斯科特开车，波莉给你加油。你跳上头目的摩托，把他打昏，抢回捧花，在摩托爆炸的那一刻跳回车里。

source: Hooray! We all worked together and got the bouquet back as a team!
target: 耶！大家齐心协力，把捧花抢回来啦！

source: ...Sure. You return the bouquet, and gain +N2 HYPE for your daring car chase!
target: ……行吧。你把捧花送了回去，还靠这场大胆的飙车追逐获得 +N2 热度！

source: Ahh, yes, remember that time you got a monkey's paw from a creepy old man in a dark magic shop? No? Well, that's what flashbacks are for!
target: 啊，对了，你还记得在黑魔法商店里，从一个阴森老头手上得到猴爪的事吧？不记得？那不正好用回忆镜头！

source: You happened upon the shop while you were walking to the supermarket to satisfy your late-night Cheese Doodles craving.
target: 那晚你馋芝士条馋得不行，正往超市走，偶然路过了那家店。

source: I've got something BETTER than snack foods! I've got highly-dangerous magical artifacts, like this monkey's paw! Interested?
target: 我这儿有比零食更好的东西！危险至极的魔法宝物，比如这只猴爪！有兴趣吗？

source: Totally! With something like that, you could wish for UNLIMITED Cheese Doodles!
target: 当然！有了这玩意，就能许愿要无限的芝士条！

source: NO! Don't wish for Cheese Doodles! This paw is only for BIG EMERGENCIES! Don't you know the consequences of using cursed magic?!
target: 不！不许要芝士条！这只猴爪只能在重大危机时使用！你不知道用诅咒魔法会有什么后果吗？！

source: Sheesh, you'd half a mind to wish for the paw to shut the old man up. But you promised to use it wisely and left, watching that shop turn into smoke...
target: 啧，你都想许个愿让猴爪把老头的嘴堵上了。不过最后还是答应会明智使用，然后离开，看着那家店化成烟雾……

source: ...and now, you're keeping your promise by wishing to catch a bouquet of flowers, a symbolic love gesture with little-to-no real meaning! Nice!
target: ……而现在，你为了接到一束花许愿，完美履行了承诺！象征一下爱情，基本没半点实际意义！干得好！

source: Uh, wouldn't it make more sense for %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% to just wish on the paw to get married, if that's what %HESHE% %VERB_WANTS_WANT% anyway?
target: 呃，既然%HESHE%%VERB_WANTS_WANT%结婚，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%直接对着猴爪许愿结婚，不是更合理吗？
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): POLISH; 猴爪许愿抢花束与直接求婚的逻辑对比；wants 为想。 按行中文动词展开已实现；未实机验证。

source: Let it go, Scotty. It's a waste of time trying to get %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% to do things the logical way.
target: 算了吧，小斯。想让%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%按逻辑办事，纯属浪费时间。

source: You spend -N2 MAGIC and catch the bouquet. You gain +N2 HYPE. Just be thankful SMARTS is not a stat you need in this game...
target: 你花了 -N2 魔力，接到捧花，获得 +N2 热度。真该庆幸，这游戏不用看你的“聪明（SMARTS）”值……

source: Speak now... or forever hold your peace
target: 现在反对……或永远保持沉默

source: You each have your own approach to sneaking into the wedding. Polly phases through the wall. You use your trusty plot armor to get into whatever wacky situation you want.
target: 你们各有各的办法混进婚礼。波莉直接穿墙，你则靠着可靠的主角光环，想闯进多离谱的场面都行。

source: Scott wears a lampshade and pretends to be furniture in the back of the room. You're pretty sure security just doesn't have the heart to throw him out.
target: 斯科特戴着灯罩，站在房间后面假装家具。你很确定，保安只是狠不下心把他赶走。

source: You watch the ceremony. It's normal and boring until the preacher says, "If anyone objects to this union, speak now or forever hold your peace."
target: 你们看着婚礼仪式，正常得无聊。直到主婚人说：“如有人反对这桩婚事，请现在提出，否则便永远保持沉默。”

source: Ooh, them's prankin' words! I OBJECT!
target: 哦，这不就是在邀请我们恶作剧嘛！我反对！

source: "What? Why? Who even are you?"
target: “什么？为什么？你到底是谁？”

source: I'm Pippin Pussinpoppindippindopulos, professional wedding objector! I'm a pro at spotting a doomed couple, and these newlyweds REALLY take the cake.
target: 我是皮平·普辛波平迪平多普洛斯，专业婚礼反对人！我最擅长看出哪对情侣没好下场，这对新人真是没救到家了。

source: I OBJECT TOO! I'm a lamp, and I don't think it's fair that furniture can't legally marry!
target: 我也反对！我是一盏灯，我觉得家具不能合法结婚，太不公平了！

source: I'm gonna keep objecting until this injustice is fixed! OBJECT! OBJECT! OBJECT!
target: 这不公一天不改，我就一直反对！反对！反对！反对！

source: (Scott, this is a wedding, not a courtroom. It's not the same kind of objection.)
target: （斯科特，这是婚礼，不是法庭。不是那种“反对”。）

source: Who's Scott? I'm not gonna stop objecting until a household object's love is recognized in a court of law! OBJECT! OBJECT!
target: 谁是斯科特？只要家居用品的爱情还没得到法律承认，我就不会停止反对！反对！反对！

source: (Oh no, he's too into character! %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, can you distract everyone with an objection while I snap him out of it?)
target: （完了，他入戏太深！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你能不能也反对一下，分散大家的注意力？我来让他清醒清醒。）

source: The pressure's on now! Why do you object to this union? How far will you go with this prank?
target: 压力来了！你凭什么反对这桩婚事？这场恶作剧，你要玩到哪一步？

source: "Marriage is a scam! You know what ISN'T a scam? Investing in your 401k at an early age."
target: “婚姻是骗局！知道什么不是骗局吗？早点开始投你的 401k 退休金。”

source: "The open bar has been out of limes for like an hour. We can continue the ceremony when this pressing problem is resolved!"
target: “免费酒吧的青柠都断供一个小时了！这个紧迫问题解决之前，仪式不许继续！”

source: "BEWARE! That is not your fiancé; it's his evil twin! His sudden goatee isn't a bold fashion statement, but an undeniable proof of evil!"
target: “小心！这不是你未婚夫，是他的邪恶双胞胎！突然冒出来的山羊胡可不是什么大胆的新造型，而是邪恶的铁证！”

source: "Good idea, let's do it!" says the groom. "With our 401ks in order, we'll be starting our marriage off by putting our best financial foot forward, and we'll be much happier!"
target: “好主意，就这么办！”新郎说，“把咱俩的 401k 安排好，婚后的财务就有个好开端，日子也会更幸福！”

source: "You seriously want to postpone our wedding to set up a retirement fund?" says the other groom. "Are you out of your mind?"
target: “你真要为了建个退休基金，把婚礼推迟？”另一个新郎说，“疯了吗？”

source: "Of course not! And you know who else isn't? My accountant Claude, who says if I set up my 401k now, I can afford to retire by the time I'm 81!"
target: “当然没有！知道还有谁没疯吗？我的会计克劳德。他说现在就开始投 401k，等我八十一岁就有钱退休了！”

source: "Maybe you could if you would GET A JOB. Are you sure you even want to commit to me? You couldn't even commit to showing up to your shift at Shake Shack!"
target: “那你倒是先找份工作啊。你真想跟我共度一生？连 Shake Shack 的班，你都没法保证去上！”

source: Oof, maybe Pippin Pussinpoppindippindopulos was right about these two. But who cares, your 401k looks immaculate now!
target: 唉，皮平·普辛波平迪平多普洛斯对这两人的判断，没准还真对。不过谁管呢，你的 401k 已经安排得明明白白！

source: Good job, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! How much money have you made so far? Enough to retire?
target: 干得好，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！到现在赚多少了？够退休了吗？

source: So far, I've only made +N2 MONEY. But a 401k is a long-term investment, you'll see!
target: 目前只赚了 +N2 金钱。不过 401k 是长期投资，等着瞧吧！

source: Yeah, whatever. You still made the wedding all dumb and boring by bringing up adult obligations.
target: 是是是，随你。反正你一提成年人那些责任，婚礼就又蠢又无聊了。

source: True. Fiscal responsibility is no joke, and therefore it's no prank, either. You lose -N2 HYPE.
target: 没错，对财务负责可不是开玩笑，那自然也算不上恶作剧。你失去了 -N2 热度。

source: "Are you serious?" the groom scoffs. "The limes aren't important! We can fix it after the ceremony!"
target: “认真的？”新郎嗤之以鼻，“青柠又不重要！等仪式结束再补不行吗？”

source: "It's very important!" shouts Drunk Aunt Doris. "How do you expect us to get through this long, boring ceremony without a quality Moscow mule?"
target: “很重要！”醉鬼姨妈多丽丝喊道，“没有一杯像样的莫斯科骡子鸡尾酒，谁熬得过这么又臭又长的仪式？”

source: "I only go to weddings for the free limes anyway," says Lime-Loving Lenny. "Refill them now, or else I'm writing a VERY strongly-worded social media post."
target: “反正我来婚礼就图免费青柠。”青柠狂热者莱尼说，“马上补货，不然我可要发篇措辞极其严厉的社交媒体帖子了。”

source: "YOU'D BETTER REFILL THOSE GODDAMN LIMES, OR I'LL SKIN YOUR GROOM AND WEAR HIS SCALP LIKE A WIG!" screams Grandma.
target: “赶紧把那该死的青柠补上，不然我就把你新郎的皮剥了，拿他的头皮当假发戴！”奶奶尖叫道。

source: "Okay, okay, jeez!" says the other groom. "We'll pause the ceremony until we have more limes, I guess. I'll call the caterer."
target: “好好好，天哪！”另一个新郎说，“那就先暂停仪式，等青柠补上再说。我给餐饮供应商打电话。”

source: Everyone waits around silently while the other groom orders more limes. It's suffocatingly awkward, honestly.
target: 另一个新郎打电话订青柠，所有人都在一旁默默等着。说实话，尴尬得令人窒息。

source: But when the limes are finally delivered, everyone cheers so loudly the end of the vows get drowned out! Yay!
target: 可等青柠终于送到，大家的欢呼声又大得把誓词结尾都盖过去了！耶！

source: Good prank, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. Holding the wedding hostage was a little weird, but bonus points for saving the bar!
target: 不错的恶作剧，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。拿婚礼当人质是怪了点，不过救下酒吧，加分！

source: Fuck yeah, you're a hero! You lose -N2 SOUL for interrupting, but gain +N2 STAMINA from the fresh limes!
target: 操，你就是英雄！打断婚礼让你失去 -N2 灵魂，不过新鲜青柠又让你获得 +N2 体力！

source: "You really think I'm evil just 'cause I grew a goatee?" the groom says. "I just thought it looked nice. Goatees are due for a comeback, you know!"
target: “就因为我留了山羊胡，你就觉得我是坏人？”新郎说，“我只是觉得好看。告诉你，山羊胡早该重新流行了！”

source: Fair enough, but what about your sinister eyepatch? Does that mean you're evil?
target: 也有道理，可你那阴森的眼罩呢？那能证明你是坏人吗？

source: "WOW. So now everyone who wears an eyepatch has to be evil? Do you realize how fucked up you sound?"
target: “哇，现在戴眼罩的就一定是坏人了？知道你这话有多混账吗？”

source: "It's true that the evidence is circumstantial," says the best man, "but it's worth noting that the groom's parents DID have twin boys: Richard and Evil Richard."
target: “确实，证据都是间接的。”伴郎说，“不过新郎父母还真有一对双胞胎儿子，一个叫理查德，一个叫邪恶理查德，这点值得注意。”

source: Wow, really? That's pretty indicting, then. Are you actually Evil Richard?
target: 哇，真的？那就很可疑了。你真是邪恶理查德？

source: "FINE! YOU CAUGHT ME!" the groom says. "But maybe if my parents hadn't named me 'Evil Richard', I wouldn't have felt the need to be evil! Nature vs. nurture, people!"
target: “行！被你们抓到了！”新郎说，“可要不是爸妈给我取名叫‘邪恶理查德’，也许我就不会觉得自己非得做坏事！这是先天还是后天的问题啊，各位！”

source: "Wait, so you're really an evil twin?" the other groom asks. "That's so crazy! I'M an evil twin too!"
target: “等等，你真是邪恶双胞胎？”另一个新郎问，“太巧了！我也是邪恶双胞胎！”

source: "I stabbed my twin brother and came here planning to disrupt the whole ceremony, but I guess I don't have to do that anymore!"
target: “我捅了我孪生兄弟一刀，跑来是为了搅黄婚礼，不过现在看来没这个必要了！”

source: "Really? Small world!" Evil Richard laughs. "I smothered Richard with a pillow to be here! I guess great, evil minds think alike, my dear."
target: “真的？世界真小！”邪恶理查德大笑，“我为了来这里，用枕头把理查德闷死了！亲爱的，真是恶人所见略同啊。”

source: Awww! Love wins!
target: 啊，真好！爱情万岁！

source: The best man frowns. "Uh, should someone maybe go call the police or--?"
target: 伴郎皱起眉：“呃，是不是该有人去报警，或者——？”

source: SHHH! DON'T SPOIL THE TENDER MOMENT!
target: 嘘！别破坏这温馨时刻！

source: Your dumb prank ended up uniting an evil power couple in unholy matrimony! You lose -N6 SOUL, but gain +N5 HYPE and even +N1 MIND for cracking the case of the secret evil twin(s).
target: 你这场蠢恶作剧，居然促成了一对邪恶强强组合，结下一桩不神圣的婚姻！你失去 -N6 灵魂，却获得 +N5 热度，还因为破了隐秘邪恶双胞胎案——可能是两起——获得 +N1 头脑。

source: Hot springs
target: 温泉

source: On your way to the springs, you run into the most regrammable reaper you've ever seen.
target: 去温泉的路上，你遇见一位死神。上镜又值得转发的程度，你前所未见。

source: ...and if you're just tuning into the livestream now, you'll see that I'm about to have an adorable meet-cute with my friends! Say hi, chat!
target: ……刚进直播间的各位，马上就能看到我跟朋友们来场可爱的偶遇！弹幕，打个招呼！

source: I'm signing off now to enjoy an organic, 'Gram-free moment with them. Don't forget to follow me on Tweeter for my livetweet of the experience! Byeee!
target: 现在下播，享受一会儿自然、不上 'Gram 的相聚时光。记得关注我的 Tweeter，我会实时发文记录全过程！拜——！

source: Hello, darlings. What brings you to the spa?
target: 亲爱的们，你们怎么来水疗馆了？

source: Hi Milo! We're on a road trip vacation. It turns out vacationing can be really stressful when you almost die a lot, so we're taking a mini spa vacation on the way.
target: 嗨，迈洛！我们在公路旅行度假。老是差点死掉，度假原来也会压力很大，所以我们打算顺路再来个水疗小假期。

source: How fun! I'm on my way to the hot springs for some de-stressing myself.
target: 真有趣！我也正准备去泡温泉，减减压呢。

source: Care to join me? Assuming you don't feel weird about being naked together.
