source: Good morning, fellow Greek philosophers! I wanted to share with you the most marvelous thing: today, I saw a cat.
target: 早上好，各位希腊哲学家！想跟大家分享一件美妙至极的事：今天，我看见了一只猫。

source: But you see, the cat was sleeping over a horse as if they were good friends. It was quite amusing, and a great metaphor for overcoming our differences.
target: 不过，那只猫睡在一匹马身上，像是对好朋友。可有趣了，简直是跨越彼此差异的绝佳比喻。

source: Fascinating, Philosopher Milonius! I give your cat story one like!
target: 真有意思，迈洛尼乌斯哲学家！你的猫故事，我点个赞！

source: I don't really get what's going on, but I like cats and horses! I'll give you a like too!
target: 我不太懂现在什么情况，不过我喜欢猫，也喜欢马！我也点赞！

source: Thank you, Scottphicles! I would appreciate it if you continued to like and comment on my observations, and share them amongst your peers for further review.
target: 谢谢，斯科特菲克勒斯！还请继续给我的见闻点赞、评论，分享给同道们，供他们进一步品评。

source: Okay, I've got one! A little birdie "retweeted" to me that @Diogenes TOTALLY owned Plato with a plucked chicken. You'll never believe what happened next!
target: 好，我也有一条！一只小鸟给我“转推”说，@狄奥根尼 拿只拔光毛的鸡，把柏拉图狠狠打脸了。你绝对想不到接下来发生了什么！

source: This goes on for a few hours. You all debate recent politics like Socrates' scandalous public murder. Milo even commissions an artist to sculpt each of you a "profile statue!"
target: 这么聊了几个小时，大家辩论着苏格拉底惨遭公开谋杀之类的时政大事。迈洛甚至请艺术家给每个人雕了尊“头像雕像”！

source: This was so fun, you guys! Why, this entire time we've been talking, I didn't even miss my phone!
target: 各位，今天真好玩！聊了这么久，我居然一回都没惦记手机！

source: "Okay, everyone!" says a spa instructor. "The digital detox is over. I'll be giving everyone's phones back now."
target: “好了，各位！”一位水疗馆教练说，“暂别电子设备体验结束。现在给大家发手机。”

source: YES! FINALLY! GIVE IT TO ME! GIVE ME MY PRECIOUSSSS!
target: 好耶！终于！给我！把我的宝贝给我——！

source: You all get your phones back. Milo, Polly, and Scott immediately open their favorite apps and begin silently scrolling. Sigh.
target: 你们拿回手机。迈洛、波莉、斯科特立刻打开各自最爱的应用，开始默默刷屏。唉。

source: Well, you may not have kick-started a new age of Enlightenment, but you still gained +N2 MIND from this experience!
target: 好吧，虽然没能开启一个新的启蒙时代，不过这段经历还是让你获得了 +N2 头脑！

source: Look for ufos
target: 寻找不明飞行物

source: There seem to be a lot of alien-spotters in the desert tonight. You spot two of your friends with their telescope in the crowd.
target: 今晚沙漠里似乎聚了不少观测外星人的爱好者。人群中，你看到两个朋友架着望远镜。

source: Hi Kale! Hi Abdu! Are you here to look at constellations? Have you seen my favorite one yet? I call it the "Big Boy Frying Pan."
target: 嗨，卡莱！嗨，阿卜杜！你们来看星座？看到我最喜欢的那个了吗？我叫它“大家伙平底锅”。

source: Nice. I'm a fan of Auriga myself. Charioteering was the grandfather of skateboarding; change my mind.
target: 不错。我本人喜欢御夫座。驾战车可是滑板的祖师爷，不服来辩。

source: But today, we're using our telescope to look for UFOs. You're welcome to join us if you want.
target: 不过今天，我们要用望远镜找 UFO。想来就一起吧。

source: Abdu and I are really into ufology. There's gotta be other life out there besides us, you know?
target: 我和阿卜杜都很迷不明飞行物学。宇宙这么大，除了我们，总还有别的生命吧？

source: At least, I hope there is. I'd rather not be alone in the universe...
target: 至少，我希望有。我可不想孤零零地待在宇宙里……

source: Cheer up, dude. In the grand scheme of life, between our friends and the aliens and all the microscopic parasites living on our bodies, we're never TRULY alone.
target: 打起精神，老兄。从生命的大格局来看，有朋友，有外星人，还有住在咱们身上的各种微小寄生虫，哪能算真正孤单呢。

source: Dude... that's deep. That philosophical thought reminds me of something: can you pass me the pipe?
target: 老兄……有深度。这哲学思想让我想起个事：烟斗能递我一下吗？

source: "You're looking for UFOs, you say?" says an eavesdropping ufo-spotter. "Wouldn't you rather meet the aliens IN PERSON?"
target: “你们说在找 UFO？”旁边一个偷听的观测者开口了，“难道不想跟外星人当面见见？”

source: Do you have a way to do that? Are you an astronaut, or a mad scientist?
target: 你有办法？宇航员，还是疯狂科学家？

source: "Even better: I'm an app developer!"
target: “比那更厉害，我是个应用开发者！”

source: Oh.
target: 哦。

source: "I made an app called 'Unite Friends Online!' It's like a dating app, but instead of finding you a lover, it connects you to an alien to befriend."
target: “我开发了一个叫 Unite Friends Online（在线好友联盟）的应用！就像交友软件，不过不是找恋人，而是帮你认识外星朋友。”

source: Whoa... are there really aliens on this app that we can talk to?
target: 哇……这应用上真有外星人，能跟我们聊天？

source: "Not yet, but there will be. No alien can resist my app's sleek graphic design or ingenious user-interface for long!"
target: “暂时没有，不过会有的。没有哪个外星人能长久抵挡我这精美的画面设计和巧妙的用户界面！”

source: That's so cool! I wanna meet an alien on the app! Polly, you're smart: how should we get the aliens to notice us?
target: 太酷了！我想在上面认识外星人！波莉，你聪明，咱们怎么才能让外星人注意到我们？

source: Well, when I'm trying to get cute, interesting people to notice me on Horny Dating App, I try to make my profile look as inviting as possible.
target: 嗯，我在“饥渴交友软件”上想吸引可爱又有趣的人注意时，就会尽量把主页弄得诱人一点。

source: Usually by using lots of eggplant emojis and giving my ass the spotlight it deserves.
target: 通常就是多用茄子表情，再把我这屁股应得的聚光灯给足。

source: Too bad Earth doesn't have an ass to show off... but there's gotta be a way to make its profile more inviting to get an alien interested in a casual invasion...
target: 可惜地球没屁股能秀……不过总有办法把主页弄得更诱人，让外星人想来场随意的入侵吧……

source: Hack into a satellite. It'll be for a good reason: to take some pics of Earth from a high angle and make it look prettier!
target: 黑进一颗卫星。正当理由：从高角度给地球拍几张美照！

source: Upgrade to the Platinum Planet Profile to unlock advanced match preferences. It says here you can turn off "Hostile Invasion" matches.
target: 升级“白金星球档案”，解锁高级匹配偏好。这里写着，能关掉“敌意入侵”匹配。

source: Nice. Take a photo from a high angle with a high photographer: that's the recipe for selfie success.
target: 不错，高机位，加上嗑嗨的摄影师，自拍成功的秘诀就是这个。

source: I've heard that in photography, you should focus on symmetry too. We gotta make Earth look super symmetrical in our pic to make it pretty.
target: 我听说拍照也得讲究对称。咱们得把地球拍得超级对称，才好看。

source: Earth's a circle, so it should be symmetrical from every angle. But what if we find, like, the MOST symmetrical angle?
target: 地球是圆的，应该哪个角度都对称。不过万一能找到最最对称的角度呢？

source: Great plan! You use your computer skillz to hack into the Hubble telescope and take some beauty shots of Earth. You'll lose -N2 SOUL for it, but it's for a good cause!
target: 好主意！你拿出高超的电脑技术，黑进哈勃望远镜，给地球拍美照。这会让你失去 -N2 灵魂，不过也是为了好事！

source: Done! What do you think?
target: 好了！你们看怎么样？

source: Not bad, but if we're going for symmetry, Australia's throwing it all off.
target: 不错，不过要讲对称的话，澳大利亚全给破坏了。

source: We could edit Australia out of the pic! Let me try, I'm great at photo-editing.
target: 可以把澳大利亚修掉！让我来，我可会修图了。

source: TA-DA! Now Earth looks pretty, and you get a sneak peek of the moon too!
target: 铛铛！现在地球漂亮了，还能顺便瞄一眼月亮！

source: It looks nice... but don't you guys think editing Earth's look on a social profile is kinda dishonest?
target: 挺好看的……不过在社交主页上给地球修图，是不是有点骗人？

source: That's true. Besides, if I were an alien looking to invade Earth, I'd want some warning about Australia.
target: 确实。再说，要是我是想入侵地球的外星人，也希望有人提前提醒一下澳大利亚的事。

source: You know... scary animals, big spiders...
target: 你懂的……那些吓人的动物，大蜘蛛……

source: Maybe we should just take a new picture. This shot is showing too much water, anyway. We want the aliens to know there's earth on this Earth!
target: 不如重拍一张。反正这张水也太多了。得让外星人知道，地球上有地啊！

source: Let's find an angle that shows off our poles more. Aliens always look for diverse biomes in potential planetary partnerships.
target: 找个更能展示两极的角度吧。外星人挑星球伴侣，最看重生态环境够不够丰富。

source: Perfect! This photo really highlights Earth's best angles while downplaying its rampant humanitarian conflicts.
target: 完美！这张充分展现了地球最好看的角度，还淡化了到处肆虐的人道冲突。

source: And nice composition on Antarctica. Earth looks cool as fuck here -- literally!
target: 南极洲的构图也漂亮。地球这张真他妈的酷——透心凉的那种酷！

source: If I were an alien, I'd invade us.
target: 我要是外星人，我就来入侵咱们。

source: You don't meet any aliens, presumably because they all flocked to the South Pole. But you still gained +N2 HYPE taking pics with your friends!
target: 你们没见到外星人，估计全被吸引去南极了。不过和朋友一起拍照，还是让你获得了 +N2 热度！

source: You pony up -N2 MONEY for the Platinum Planet Profile. So many new features to play with!
target: 你掏出 -N2 金钱，买了白金星球档案。好多新功能可以玩！

source: Sweet, we can turn off ads! That's a relief. I'm tired of seeing ads for "alien worm sex pheromone pills."
target: 太好了，能关广告！终于解脱了，真看够那些“外星蠕虫性信息素药丸”的广告了。

source: We can customize our matches now too! Let's turn off "Hostile Takeover" matches. A sci-fi apocalypse would totally harsh my vibe.
target: 现在还能自定义匹配！把“敌意占领”关掉吧。科幻式末日太影响我嗨了。

source: Can we turn off the romantic matches too? Like kinky extraterrestrial sex, one-night abductions, and "symbiote looking for host" stuff? That's not my thing...
target: 恋爱匹配也能关吗？比如变态的外星性爱、一夜绑架，还有“共生体找宿主”之类的？我不来这套……

source: Yeah, no problem. It's not like I got into the UFO-spotting scene to get laid anyway.
target: 当然，没问题。反正我也不是为了约炮，才来混 UFO 观测圈的。

source: Check out all the features we could turn ON now -- no innuendo intended.
target: 再看看有哪些功能能开起来——没有性暗示。

source: We can opt into "resource exchange", "advanced technology sharing", "interplanetary potluck"...
target: 可以打开“资源交换”“先进技术共享”“星际各带一道菜聚餐”……

source: There's even a filter for "applications for the Intergalactic Federation!" Is that a real thing?
target: 居然还有“申请加入星际联邦”的筛选项！真有这个组织？

source: "Of course it is!" the app developer says. "The I.F. is mentioned on 'Coast to Coast' AND 'Rick and Morty,' which are the two leading sources on alien culture!"
target: “当然有！”开发者说，“《Coast to Coast》和《瑞克和莫蒂》都提过星际联邦，这可是外星文化的两大权威来源！”

source: That's awesome! I bet the I.F. controls all the cool space sports!
target: 太棒了！我打赌，那些超酷的太空运动都归星际联邦管！

source: Like Space Pinball! Or... black hole golf?
target: 比如太空弹珠台！或者……黑洞高尔夫？

source: Oh, man, do you think they have an intergalactic X-games? I'd LOVE to see what an alien could do on a half-pipe.
target: 老兄，你说会不会有星际极限运动会？真想看看外星人在 U 型池里能玩出什么花样。

source: You guys are thinking too small! Imagine the political scandals they'd get up to in an Intergalactic Federation.
target: 你们格局小了！想想星际联邦会搞出多少政治丑闻。

source: I bet it's like a UN meeting, except everyone has three tits and a laser pistol!
target: 肯定就跟联合国开会似的，只不过每个人都有三个奶子，再配把激光手枪！

source: No one is invited to join a Federation that night, sadly; nor do you see a UFO. But you still gain +N2 HYPE stargazing with your friends!
target: 可惜，那晚没人收到加入联邦的邀请，也没看到 UFO。不过跟朋友一起观星，还是让你获得了 +N2 热度！

source: Send a message
target: 发送消息

source: It's too foggy to see any UFOs, sadly... wait, that's not fog, it's smoke. You follow it back to its source and find Kale and Abdu!
target: 雾太大了，可惜看不见 UFO……等等，不是雾，是烟。你顺着烟找过去，发现了卡莱和阿卜杜！

source: Sup, guys? Wanna help us send a message to some aliens?
target: 嘿，各位！想帮我们给外星人发消息吗？

source: I'll send a message to whoever you want if I can bum a hit off that pipe. What do you want the message to say?
target: 让我蹭口烟斗，给谁发都行。你们打算说什么？

source: We dunno yet. Whatever it is, it's gotta be REALLY important, you know? Like, something profound and deep and interesting all at once.
target: 还没想好。不管说什么，都得特别重要，懂吧？得既深刻、有哲理，又有意思。

source: Something like... "A smart man knows the tomato is a fruit. A wise man knows not to put a tomato in a fruit salad."
target: 比如……“聪明人知道番茄是水果，智慧的人知道别把番茄放进水果沙拉。”

source: Holy shit, that IS wise.
target: 卧槽，这可真有智慧。

source: If you guys want to send the aliens a message and get one back, maybe instead of being philosophical, the message should be really eye-catching.
target: 要是想给外星人发消息，还收到回信，也许重点不是多有哲理，而是特别抓眼球。

source: Yeah! Something like, "These stoners sent a message to aliens and you'll NEVER believe what happened next!"
target: 对！比如，“这群嗑嗨的家伙给外星人发了消息，你绝对想不到后来发生了什么！”

source: Whoa, what happened next?!
target: 哇，后来发生什么了？！

source: That's for us to decide, bro. It all depends on the message!
target: 那得咱们决定，老兄。全看消息怎么写！

source: FUCK. You're blowing my mind right now. The future is ours to shape!
target: 卧槽，我脑子要炸了。未来掌握在我们自己手里！

source: You guys obviously know what you're doing. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, got any ideas for an attention-grabbing message to send to the aliens?
target: 看来你们很懂行。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，发给外星人的消息，要怎么写才抓眼球？

source: "Are you STILL doing crop circles? These tutorials will teach you more artistic ways to deface Earth's dumb, non-gaseous surface. Subscribe now!"
target: “还在画麦田怪圈？看这些教程，学点更有艺术感的招数，糟蹋地球这愚蠢的非气态表面。马上订阅！”

source: "8 cool Earthlings you MUST abduct at least once in your life! (#6 will SHOCK YOU!!1)"
target: “一辈子必须绑架至少一次的八位超酷地球人！（第六个绝对让你震惊！！1）”

source: Yeah, crop circles are kinda played-out. What did you have in mind to replace them with, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?
target: 是啊，麦田怪圈有点过时了。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你想拿什么代替？

source: Uh... shit. You didn't actually think that far ahead before you blurted your suggestion.
target: 呃……操。你脱口而出这个建议的时候，真没想那么远。

source: What about crop... squares? Or crop triangles?
target: 麦田……方块？或者麦田三角形？

source: Meh. This is supposed to be a clickbaity tutorial, not a geometry lesson.
target: 没劲。这应该是个标题党教程，不是几何课。

source: What about bringing back big, alien-built structures? Like the pyramids!
target: 不如让外星人重新开始造那些大建筑？比如金字塔！

source: Actually, it's kinda eurocentric to assume the ancient Egyptians weren't capable of building the pyramids themselves...
target: 其实，觉得古埃及人没本事自己造金字塔，有点欧洲中心主义了……

source: We have proof that Egyptians built the pyramids. Now, Stonehenge, THAT was made by aliens.
target: 我们有证据证明金字塔是埃及人造的。不过巨石阵，那才是外星人的作品。

source: Oh, gotcha! Sorry, I didn't mean to stereotype.
target: 哦，懂了！抱歉，我不是想搞刻板印象。

source: No worries. The original idea was still good; we could convince aliens to go back to making cool architecture.
target: 没事。最初的思路还是不错的，可以说服外星人重新造些酷建筑。

source: Maybe we could convince the aliens to make... a half-pipe?
target: 要不说服外星人造个……U 型池？

source: That sounds sick! Imagine a half-pipe covered in alien tech that lowers gravity so you can do longer, more complex rotations and ollies!
target: 太帅了！想想，整个 U 型池铺满外星科技，把重力调低，腾空转体和豚跳就能玩得更久、更复杂！

source: And they should add an alien hot dog stand nearby, with condiments from all over the galaxy!
target: 旁边还得加个外星热狗摊，配上银河各地的调味料！

source: Yeah, that would fuck hard. Good work, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! Alien half-pipe it is!
target: 对，那肯定爽翻。干得好，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！就选外星 U 型池！

source: Sweet! You film a video to showcase your amazing alien half-pipe plan to YooToob.
target: 太好了！你拍视频，准备把这个绝妙的外星 U 型池方案放到 YooToob 上展示。

source: Well, you start to, but you sorta lose the plot halfway through. You mostly just film Abdu doing skateboard tricks while Scott eats hot dogs in the background.
target: 好吧，刚开始是这么想的，拍到一半就跑偏了。大部分镜头都在拍阿卜杜玩滑板，背景里是斯科特吃热狗。

source: It's undoubtedly a cool video, but it's not what the viewers clicked for, and you lose -N2 SOUL for using clickbait.
target: 视频无疑很酷，不过观众可不是冲这个点进来的。搞标题党，让你失去了 -N2 灵魂。

source: But you still gain +N2 MIND for devising the alien half-pipe! That's a million-dollar idea!
target: 不过想出外星 U 型池，还是让你获得 +N2 头脑！这主意可值百万！

source: I like it, but I'm not sure if I know that many objectively "cool" people...
target: 我喜欢，不过我好像不认识那么多客观上“很酷”的人……

source: That's okay! You're so hip and cool that you can easily name a few other cool people. Cool Josh, for starters!
target: 没关系！你这么潮、这么酷，随口就能报出几个酷朋友。首先就有酷乔希！

source: There's also Rad Richard from school, your pen pal Badass Brenda...
target: 还有学校里的酷炫理查德，笔友狠人布伦达……

source: The homeless man on your block who does kickflips off of parking meters...
target: 你家街区那个踩着停车收费表做尖翻的流浪汉……

source: I love that guy! He bummed a joint off me once and taught me the meaning of life.
target: 我可喜欢那家伙！有回跟我讨了根大麻烟，还教会了我生命的意义。

source: It means: "the quality that distinguishes a vital and functional being from a dead body."
target: 意思就是：“有别于尸体，具备活力并能正常运作的存在所具有的特质。”

source: Whoa... deep.
target: 哇……深刻。

source: That all sounds good, but by my calculations, we're still... (4... 3... 17... carry the 2...) lots of people short!
target: 听着都挺好，不过按我的计算，还差……（四……三……十七……进二……）好多人！

source: Well, obviously the rest of the list is gonna be taken up by Kale, Abdu, and your road-tripping crew! You're the coolest friends around!
target: 那剩下的名额，当然是卡莱、阿卜杜，还有你们这群公路旅行伙伴！你们可是最酷的朋友！

source: Awww, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, you corny little shit.
target: 哎呀，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你个肉麻的小混蛋。

source: Okay, I'm down. We need a cool name for ourselves to make the aliens buy it, though.
target: 行，我加入。不过得给咱们起个够酷的名字，让外星人信服。

source: Maybe... "The Cool Friends Who Are Objectively Very Cool?"
target: 比如……“客观上非常酷的酷朋友们”？

source: That's perfect! Man, those aliens would have to be stupid to not want to meet us. You guys are the coolest friends I've ever had.
target: 完美！外星人要是不想认识我们，那一定是蠢。你们是我交过最酷的朋友。

source: No aliens respond to your message, but you still gain +N2 HYPE from the power of friendship!
target: 没有外星人回复，不过友谊的力量还是让你获得了 +N2 热度！

source: However, you do lose -N2 SOUL for employing clickbait tactics to get your message across.
target: 但你为了把消息传出去用了标题党的手段，失去了 -N2 灵魂。

source: Make tinfoil hats
target: 制作锡纸帽

source: You come upon a huge gathering of UFO spotters. You see lots of telescopes, constellation charts, and Jefferson Airplane CDs going around. You also see Kale and Abdu!
target: 你碰上一大群 UFO 观测爱好者。到处是望远镜、星座图，还有传来传去的 Jefferson Airplane 唱片。卡莱和阿卜杜也在！

source: Sup, guys? I didn't know you all were into UFO sightseeing.
target: 嘿，各位！没想到你们也喜欢来看 UFO。

source: Hey bros! We're just on our road trip and decided to stop by. There are so many people with cool telescopes here!
target: 嘿，兄弟们！我们在公路旅行，顺便来看看。这儿好多人都带着超酷的望远镜！

source: That's not all they've got. UFO spotters have surprisingly diverse interests. Want us to give you the grand tour?
target: 不止呢。UFO 观测者的兴趣爱好，可比想象中丰富。要不要带你们好好逛逛？

source: Over there are the "it-crowd." They're the popular spotters who know all the latest end-of-the-world prophecy gossip.
target: 那边是“风云人物圈”。那些热门观测者，最新的世界末日预言八卦，他们全知道。

source: The nerds by the creek can test what chemicals "the Man" is putting in the water.
target: 溪边的书呆子能检测出“当权者”往水里加了什么化学物质。

source: There's the chemtrail spotters, the "Alien Abductee" support groups, the vehicle enthusiasts who know all the different UFO types...
target: 还有化学尾迹观测者、“外星人绑架受害者”互助会，以及对各种型号的 UFO 如数家珍的载具爱好者……

source: What about those shiny guys over there? Are they UFO cosplayers or something?
target: 那边亮闪闪的几位呢？在玩 UFO 角色扮演吗？

source: Those are the tinfoil hat fashionistas. They know ALL the latest fashion trends on how to protect your thoughts.
target: 那是锡纸帽时尚达人。保护思想的最新潮流，他们全懂。

source: What are they protecting their thoughts from?
target: 他们的思想要防谁啊？

source: "From the government, of course!" the fashionistas scoff. "Do you really want Big Brother in your head, reprogramming all your thoughts?"
target: “当然是政府！”时尚达人嗤笑道，“你真想让老大哥钻进脑子，把你所有想法重新编写一遍？”

source: Oh no! I didn't even know I had a big brother, let alone that he was taking all my favorite thoughts away. I have so few to spare!
target: 不好了！我都不知道自己有个老大哥，更别说他还会拿走我最喜欢的想法。我本来就没几个能拿得出手的！

source: It's okay, Scott. Don't listen to those well-dressed weirdos.
target: 没事，斯科特。别听那帮穿得漂亮的怪人胡说。

source: Of all the shit the government might be doing, "stealing your thoughts" isn't one of them.
target: 政府可能在干的那些破事里，可没“偷你的思想”这一项。

source: And even if they were, wrapping your head up like a burrito wouldn't do anything to stop it.
target: 再说，就算他们真偷，把脑袋包成墨西哥卷饼也挡不住。

source: But now I'm nervous...
target: 可我现在有点紧张……

source: You're making me nervous too, man... ugh, this anxiety's totally harshing my buzz.
target: 老兄，你把我也搞紧张了……唉，这焦虑太影响我嗨了。

source: Damn, if we don't calm Scott down, we're gonna have some paranoid stoners on our hands. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, can you help him "protect his mind" somehow?
target: 糟了，再不让斯科特冷静下来，这几个嗑嗨的家伙就要疑神疑鬼了。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你能想办法帮他“保护思想”吗？

source: If there are bodyguards, there must also be mindguards for hire! Right? RIGHT?!
target: 既然有保护身体的保镖，那也该有保护思想的“脑镖”吧！对吧？对吧？！

source: Protect your most valuable thoughts by flooding your brain with tons of useless ones.
target: 用一大堆没用的想法塞满脑子，保护那些最有价值的想法。

source: You look it up, and there ARE mindguards for hire! What are the odds?!
target: 一查，还真有“脑镖”可以雇！这都能碰上？！

source: You can only afford the cheapest ones, but it's okay to cheap out on the guys protecting your thoughts and personality, right?
target: 你只请得起最便宜的。不过在保护思想和人格的人身上省钱，应该也没事，对吧？

source: You wire -N2 MONEY to an undisclosed account. Within moments, two beefy Russian operatives parachute to the ground next to you!
target: 你往一个不公开的账户汇去 -N2 金钱。转眼间，两个壮硕的俄罗斯特工就撑着降落伞落在了旁边！

source: "Zdrastvytya, comrade. We are here to guard mind from invaders. Please be calm."
target: “你好，同志。我们来守卫脑子，抵御入侵者。请平静。”

source: One of the mindguards starts massaging your head with one of those weird scalp massagers while making guttural noises. You feel the same.
target: 一个脑镖拿着那种古怪的头皮按摩器，开始按摩你的脑袋，喉咙里还咕噜作响。你没觉得有什么变化。

source: "Congratulation. Mind is secure. We leave now."
target: “恭喜。脑子安全。我们现在走。”

source: What, that's it? How do we know %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% didn't just get scammed?
target: 什么，就这样？怎么知道%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%不是被骗了？

source: "We never scam. We prove it. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, think numbers; 1 to 500. Now you, dog-man, try to guess number."
target: “我们从不骗。证明给你看。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，想一个数，一到五百。现在你，狗男，猜数字。”

source: Oh, man, I didn't know there was gonna be a test today! Um... uhh... 274?
target: 老兄，没说今天还有考试啊！嗯……呃……二百七十四？

source: That's it, Scott! I was thinking precisely 274!
target: 中了，斯科特！我想的就是二百七十四！

source: "Damn... well, is why was test run. Obviously not completely tuned. Should be calibration now. Dog-man, guess again."
target: “该死……所以才要测试。显然没完全调好。现在应该校准了。狗男，再猜。”

source: Hmmm... what about 3?
target: 嗯……三怎么样？

source: Nah, I was thinking of 274 again. I was just too lazy of think of a new number.
target: 不对，我又想了二百七十四。懒得换个新数字了。

source: "Perfect, mindguarding functions perfectly now. Just remember to clean earwax on occasional and should be fine. Farewell, comrade."
target: “完美，脑镖功能完美。记得偶尔清耳垢，应该没问题。再见，同志。”

source: Congrats, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! Now your thoughts are safe from my weird older brother!
target: 恭喜，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！现在我那个怪哥哥，偷不走你的想法啦！

source: Nah, you definitely just got scammed, but at least Scott is relieved. You gain +N2 SOUL for putting his mind at ease!
target: 不，你绝对是被骗了。不过至少斯科特放心了。安了他的心，让你获得 +N2 灵魂！

source: Yeah, that could work. You just need to find someone with useless thoughts to spare and fill your head with them.
target: 嗯，可能行。找个人，把他那些多得用不完的无用想法，装进你脑子里就好。

source: Dude, all Kale and I HAVE are useless thoughts. Getting high and learning inane facts about niche hobbies is our specialty!
target: 老兄，我和卡莱脑子里全是没用的想法。嗑嗨了，学些小众爱好的无聊冷知识，就是我们的专长！

source: How do you think we got into ufology and aliens in the first place?
target: 不然你以为，我们最初怎么迷上 UFO 学和外星人的？

source: So what do you wanna know? I could tell you the history of lotion, every subspecies of cricket, all of the regional variations of the word "pussy" in Italian...
target: 想听什么？乳液的历史、蟋蟀的每个亚种，或者意大利语里“屄”在各地的所有叫法……

source: Ooh, how about I tell you all the minutiae of baking a perfect loaf of bread? I was really craving bread last night and ended up on a Boogle deep dive for nine hours.
target: 哦，要不要听听烤出完美面包的所有细节？昨晚馋面包，在 Boogle 上一头查了九个小时。

source: Oh my God, dude, I did the SAME THING.
target: 我的天，老兄，我也干了一模一样的事。

source: Whoooa, that's crazy! Are we, like, mind-melded or what?
target: 哇，太神奇了！咱俩这是心灵融合了？

source: Are you sure you two weren't just hanging out last night and doing the same activity together?
target: 你确定不是因为你俩昨晚就在一起，干的也是同一件事？

source: Oh, yeah, that does make more sense. Sorry, my memories of time and place are pretty much replaced with bread facts.
target: 哦，对，那确实更合理。抱歉，我脑子里的时间地点，基本全被面包知识替换了。

source: Yeah, this'll definitely work.
target: 嗯，这办法肯定行得通。

source: So, to bake bread, you need flour, sugar, a plastic scraper, and a Dutch oven.
target: 做面包，得有面粉、糖、塑料刮板，还有荷兰锅。

source: Sidebar, the Dutch oven was actually discovered not by a Netherlander, but an Englishman who...
target: 插句题外话，荷兰锅其实不是荷兰人发现的，而是一个英国人，他……

source: This goes on for a LONG time. Soon, all your thoughts of road-tripping and stat-gaining are replaced by stretch-and-fold kneading and fermentation techniques.
target: 这话题聊了好——久。很快，你脑子里关于公路旅行和提升属性的念头，全被拉伸折叠揉面法、发酵技术之类的东西挤掉了。

source: You lose -N2 MIND from all the actually useful info your brain throws out to make room for bread facts...
target: 为了给面包知识腾地方，大脑丢掉了那些真正有用的信息，你失去 -N2 头脑……

source: But Kale and Abdu have a great time talking, and it's nice to see your friends be passionate about something! You gain +N2 SOUL.
target: 不过卡莱和阿卜杜聊得很开心，看朋友们对一件事充满热情，也挺好的！你获得 +N2 灵魂。

source: Fight... to the death
target: 决一死战

source: You and your friends head to the death dome. You find a beautiful woman presiding over the carnage.
target: 你和朋友们来到死亡穹顶，发现一位美人正主持这场血腥杀戮。

source: Whoa, is that Damien? Sup, bro! I like your cute outfit!
target: 哇，那不是德魔吗？嘿，兄弟！这身打扮真可爱！

source: SHH! Don't call me Damien here! These people know me as the Queen of the Road, a bloodthirsty warmongeress with eyeliner sharp enough to kill!
target: 嘘！在这儿别叫我德魔！他们只知道我是公路女王，嗜血好战，眼线锋利得能杀人！

source: Anyway, since you're here, do any of you wanna fight some of my subjects in the death dome to honor my queendom?
target: 既然来了，你们谁想去死亡穹顶，跟我的臣民打一场，为我的王国争光？

source: I bet %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% does! And I'm not giving %HIMHER% any say in the matter 'cause I wanna see what happens!
target: 我赌%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%想！而且这事不让%HIMHER%发表意见，因为我想看热闹！

source: You have no time to object before you're thrown into the death dome and the games have begun.
target: 你还没来得及反对，就被扔进了死亡穹顶。比赛开始！

source: You fight Bloodbag, the crazed killer who bleeds his victims dry. Then Mad Mickey, a murderous mouse-person armed with claws and copyright lawsuits.
target: 你先对付血袋，一个喜欢把受害者的血放干的疯杀人狂。接着是疯米奇，一只凶残的鼠人，武器是利爪和版权诉讼。

source: And finally Buttersock, whose weapon is... well, a sock full of butter. It's surprisingly painful to be bludgeoned with.
target: 最后是黄油袜。他的武器……就是一只塞满黄油的袜子。抡起来打人，还真不是一般的疼。

source: Not bad, noob. But those were just exhibition fights. Now it's time for a real challenge... BRING OUT FREAKY FERRARI!
target: 不错嘛，菜鸟。不过刚才只是表演赛，现在才是真正的挑战……把疯魔法拉利带上来！

source: Freaky Ferrari is built like a brick shithouse and fights with a car engine on a chain. Fuck, you're gonna die.
target: 疯魔法拉利壮得跟堵墙一样，挥着链子拴着的汽车发动机打架。操，你死定了。

source: But maybe Damien will spare you from the battle! You two are friends, right?
target: 不过，德魔也许会放你一马吧！你们不是朋友吗？

source: You may be friends with Damien, but the Queen of the Road spares no life! These lawless lands are governed by my thirst for bloodshed alone.
target: 你也许是德魔的朋友，但公路女王绝不饶命！在这无法无天的土地上，我对鲜血的渴望就是唯一的法律！

source: But I will let you pick a weapon to use; the fight's no fun if you die in the first thirty seconds. Go grab whatever's left in the armory.
target: 不过我会让你选件武器。开打三十秒就死，也太没意思了。去武器库，剩什么拿什么吧。

source: The pen that's ACTUALLY mightier than the sword.
target: 一支真能做到“笔比剑强”的笔。

source: An angry badger duct taped to five guns and tied to the end of a stick. It's a classic!
target: 把一只暴怒的獾用胶带跟五把枪绑在一起，再捆到棍子头上。经典款！

source: The power of love.
target: 爱的力量。

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, are you sure a battle to the death is the best time for tongue-in-cheek wordplay?
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，真要决一死战了，还玩这种不正经的文字梗，合适吗？

source: Yes! I'm going to die as I lived: by beating the joke to death!
target: 合适！我活着就爱把笑话玩到死，死也要这么死！

source: Hey, Freaky Ferrari. I came expecting a battle of wits, but it seems you have come unarmed!
target: 嘿，疯魔法拉利。我本想跟你斗智，可你似乎手无寸铁啊！

source: Ferrari bashes you upside the head with a car battery, proving he is very much armed. You lose -N2 STAMINA.
target: 法拉利拿汽车电池猛砸你的脑袋，证明他可不是没带武器。你失去 -N2 体力。

source: But despite your neurological trauma, you manage to find the strength to fight back... by scrawling a viciously-mocking poem in the dirt with your pen!
target: 虽然脑子受了伤，你还是拼出力气反击……拿笔在泥地上写下一首恶毒的嘲讽诗！

source: Roses are red, violets are blue / Does it smell like shit in here, or is it just you?
target: 玫瑰红，紫罗兰蓝 / 这儿屎味这么浓，是因为你在旁边？

source: Violets are blue, roses are red / I'll make you scream like your mom did last night in my bed.
target: 紫罗兰蓝，玫瑰红 / 我要让你像昨夜你妈在我床上一样嚎破喉咙。

source: Your face looks like a second ass stapled to your neck / Your singing voice sounds like two feral bobcats having sex...
target: 你的脸像第二个屁股，钉在脖子上头 / 你一唱歌，像两只野山猫在交媾……

source: Roses may be red, and violets may be swell / But you're a pus-filled pimple on Satan's ass in Hell!
target: 玫瑰虽红，紫罗兰虽俏 / 你就是地狱撒旦屁股上的一颗脓包！

source: You wait for Freaky Ferrari to keel over under the weight of your scathing words...
target: 你等着疯魔法拉利承受不住这番犀利讽刺，当场倒下……

source: Except he doesn't keel over. Why doesn't he keel over?
target: 可他没倒。为什么还不倒？

source: Freaky Ferrari readies his weapon and says, "I DON'T UNDERSTAND POETRY. I ONLY UNDERSTAND YOU DIE!"
target: 疯魔法拉利举起武器，说：“老子不懂诗！只懂你得死！”

source: Welp, time for plan B then: as Ferrari reels back to hit you, you throw your pen with all your might and stab him in the eye!
target: 行吧，上 B 计划：法拉利往后一抡，准备打你，你拼尽全力把笔扔出去，扎进了他的眼睛！

source: Whoa, so the pen IS mightier than the sword! I thought it was just one of those sayings that makes no sense!
target: 哇，笔还真比剑强！我还以为又是句莫名其妙的俗话呢！

source: Maybe it is, but not for %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! Ferrari's too busy dying of pen-in-eyetis to fight, so you win and gain +N2 MIND for your cleverness.
target: 也许是吧，可对%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%来说可不是！法拉利忙着死于“眼睛插笔炎”，没空打架。你赢了，还凭机智获得 +N2 头脑。

source: Fuck yeah, that's the Ultimate Spear of Death! There are legends surrounding its famed bloodthirstiness...
target: 操，没错，那就是终极死亡之矛！它嗜血成性，留下了无数传说……

source: In ancient times -- I'm talking, like, before the iPhone 4 even came out -- there was no clear victor among the classic murder weapons.
target: 远古时代——我是说，连 iPhone 4 都没出的那会儿——经典杀人武器之间，还没决出谁最强。

source: Swords are obviously awesome, but they're outdated. Knives are cool, but let's face it, they're just tiny inferior swords.
target: 剑当然很帅，可惜过时了。刀也酷，可说白了，不就是又小又差的剑？

source: Guns are fine, but EVERYONE'S doing them these days. How's a killer supposed to stand out?
target: 枪还行，可现在人人都用。杀手怎么出头？

source: Finally, there was a badass dude who combined the wrath of badgers, the versatility of duct tape, the stickiness of sticks, and the shootiness of guns...
target: 终于，有个狠人，把獾的暴怒、胶带的万能、棍子的棍劲儿，还有枪的射劲儿，全合在了一起……

source: ...and created the ULTIMATE SPEAR OF DEATH, Satan's perfect killing machine!
target: 造出了终极死亡之矛，撒旦的完美杀戮机器！

source: And that mad genius was...
target: 而那位疯狂天才就是……

source: Was it you? Is that the big twist?
target: 是你吗？这就是大反转？

source: No, I fuckin' wish. It was Alfred Nobel. Inventing dynamite was just the rough draft of his Ultimate Spear of Death!
target: 不是，我他妈倒想呢。是阿尔弗雷德·诺贝尔。发明炸药，不过是他造终极死亡之矛前打的草稿！

source: So, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, do you think you can handle the Spear's raw, murderous power, or are you a little bitch?
target: 所以，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你能驾驭这矛原始又凶残的力量，还是个小怂包？

source: Well, you picked it, so you obviously think you can handle it. Time to unleash some carnage!
target: 反正是你选的，肯定觉得自己能驾驭。该大开杀戒了！

source: You go into a frenzy, slaying Freaky Ferrari and several innocent bystanders... cool! You lose -N2 STAMINA fighting, but gain +N2 HYPE!
target: 你杀红了眼，干掉疯魔法拉利，还顺手宰了几个无辜路人……酷！战斗让你失去 -N2 体力，却获得了 +N2 热度！

source: Beneath those scars and scowls, you bet Freaky Ferrari is secretly a big ol' softie. You wrap him up in a hug, gaining +N2 SOUL.
target: 你敢打赌，疯魔法拉利那一身伤疤和凶相底下，其实藏着颗柔软的心。你抱住他，获得 +N2 灵魂。

source: What kinda fuckin' touchy-feely, family-friendly bullshit is this?!
target: 这他妈什么温情脉脉、合家欢式的屁玩意？！

source: BOOOO! I WANNA SEE SOME BODY PARTS!
target: 嘘！我要看断胳膊断腿！

source: "No...," says Ferrari, a manly tear rolling down his weathered cheek. "No more body parts. No more fighting."
target: “不……”法拉利说，一滴男儿泪滚过饱经风霜的脸颊，“不想再看残肢了，也不想再打了。”

source: "This hug... it's so warm... so... nonviolent... I didn't know I could do anything but feel or inflict pain... perhaps because my own father only brought me pain..."
target: “这个拥抱……好暖……这么……没有暴力。我以为自己除了感受痛苦、施加痛苦，什么都不会……也许因为我父亲带给我的只有痛苦……”

source: "I'm sorry, this is too much. I have to forfeit, and reflect on what sort of man I want to be."
target: “抱歉，我有点承受不住。我要弃权，好好想想自己到底想当个什么样的男人。”

source: Dammit... I don't wanna promote toxic masculinity in my hardcore dieselpunk gang. You can go, Ferrari.
target: 该死……我可不想在自己的硬核柴油朋克帮派里宣扬有毒男子气概。法拉利，你可以走了。

source: But the rest of you fuckers aren't getting off so easy. Backup champion, go fight %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!
target: 不过剩下的混蛋，别想这么轻松过关。候补冠军，上，去打%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！

source: The next person up to fight is Badass Bugatti, whose special move is driving a luxury car kitted out with spikes and guns over his opponent's body.
target: 下一个上场的是狠角色布加迪，绝招是开着装满尖刺和枪炮的豪车，从对手身上碾过去。

source: But as Bugatti starts bearing down on you, Freaky Ferrari runs out and punches him square in the grille, completely fucking up the car!
target: 可布加迪刚朝你冲来，疯魔法拉利就跑出来，一拳砸在车头格栅上，把整辆车都他妈砸废了！

source: "I couldn't stand by and let you get hurt, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!" Ferrari says. "C'mon, we'll defeat Bugatti together... with the POWER OF LOVE!"
target: “我不能眼看你受伤，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！”法拉利说，“来吧，一起打败布加迪……靠爱的力量！”

source: Ugh, *sniffle*, this is so fuckin' corny...
target: 唉，*吸鼻子*，这也太他妈老套了……

source: Are you crying, bro?
target: 你在哭吗,兄弟?

source: NO! I am NOT moved by the beauty of love! I have sand in my eyes! REALLY BADASS SAND!
target: 没有！我才没被爱情的美好打动！是眼睛里进沙子了！超级硬核的沙子！

source: Hooray for deus-ex machinas! You and Ferrari fight side-by-side and eke out a victory, though it costs you -N2 STAMINA.
target: 机械降神万岁！你和法拉利并肩作战，勉强赢下这场，代价是 -N2 体力。

source: Race... to the death
target: 死亡竞速

source: You find the desert race track and spot your old friend Damien! He's dressed MUCH differently than you remember...
target: 你们找到沙漠赛道，看见了老朋友德魔！他这身打扮，跟你记忆中可太不一样了……

source: Hey, noobs. Welcome to the Queen of the Road's domain, where we're making the road-raging apocalypse fashionable again.
target: 嘿，菜鸟们。欢迎来到公路女王的领地。我们正让路怒横行的末日，重新变得时髦。

source: Hi Damien -- I mean, hi "Queen of the Road." We heard you were hanging around here and wanted to say hi.
target: 嗨，德魔——我是说，嗨，“公路女王”。听说你在这儿，来打个招呼。

source: I heard there's a car race happening today! I'm pretty good at driving fast. Can we enter?
target: 听说今天有赛车比赛！我开快车挺厉害的，能报名吗？

source: Sure! You'll be racing in the season premiere of the Queen of the Road's Drag Race. You're honored, I'm sure.
target: 当然！你们要参加《公路女王变装飙车秀》新一季的首场比赛。想必很荣幸吧。

source: Remember, the car-makeover theme is "AS DANGEROUS AS POSSIBLE." See you on the track!
target: 记住，赛车改装主题是“越危险越好”。赛道上见！

source: You all meet back up an hour later to watch the competitors take turns presenting their cars to the Queen.
target: 一小时后，你们再次碰头，看参赛者轮流向女王展示赛车。

source: "Your Majesty, we present to you: the Porschilla of the Desert! It's giving fierce. It's giving danger. It's giving glitter-dieselpunk from 2034."
target: “陛下，请看：沙漠保时姬！这叫一个凶，这叫一个险，这叫来自二〇三四年的闪耀柴油朋克！”

source: It's giving "we put a Porsche in a tutu and mounted an artillery gun to the hood..."
target: 这叫“把保时捷塞进芭蕾舞短裙，再往车前盖装门炮”……

source: Which is pretty fuckin' cool! You may enter the race!
target: 还他妈挺酷！准你参赛！

source: "Introducing Her Majesty's Fools, racing in on the 'No Laughing Matter!'"
target: “有请女王陛下的愚人们，驾着‘笑不得号’闪亮登场！”

source: I can't promise I won't be laughing when you blow yourselves up, but fuck it! The fireworks show on wheels is in!
target: 等你们把自己炸上天，我可不保证不笑。不过管他呢，这台轮子上的烟花秀，准了！

source: "Your Majesty, behold: the Carberus! We strapped three cars together to make the cars three times faster and stronger!"
target: “陛下，请看三头车！三辆车绑一起，速度和力量就都能翻三倍！”

source: I don't think that's how--
target: 我觉得不是这么算——

source: That's GENIUS! You're in, and you guys can be my royal vehicle scientists if you survive!
target: 天才！准你参赛。活下来的话，你们就做我的皇家载具科学家！

source: Guys, we're in trouble. We only have ONE car, and it's not very fast. We need to find a way to make our car at least four times faster and stronger!
target: 伙计们，有麻烦了。我们只有一辆车，还不怎么快。得想个办法，至少把速度和力量提升到四倍！

source: Scott's not wrong; the oldsmobile won't win this race without a few upgrades. What do you do?
target: 斯科特说得对。不升几次级，这辆奥兹莫比尔可赢不了。怎么办？

source: You need more horsepower! Siphon power from some horses and transfer it to your engine.
target: 得加马力！从马身上抽取力量，输进发动机。

source: This car needs a TRUE DESIRE TO WIN. Engineer a complex AI system with an actual sense of self to motivate the car to win!
target: 这辆车需要真正的求胜欲！造个有自我意识的复杂 AI 系统，让车自己想赢！

source: Okay, I'm in. But how do we siphon the horses' power?
target: 行！不过，怎么从马身上抽力量？

source: No idea. You're realizing you must've missed class the day they taught this specific spell. But no worries, you just need to be resourceful...
target: 不知道。看来教这个咒语那天，你肯定翘课了。不过别担心，灵活变通一下……

source: You tell Polly and Scott you'll get the horsepower you need while they prep the car for the race. You return a bit later.
target: 你让波莉和斯科特准备赛车，自己去搞需要的马力。过了一会儿，你回来了。

source: Sup, boo? We've been getting the car ready like you said! Look at all these cool decals!
target: 嘿，亲爱的！按你说的，把车准备好了！看这些酷炫贴花！

source: I suggested the flame decals to make it go faster. Everyone knows a car's speed is directly proportional to how many flame decals it has.
target: 火焰贴花是我建议的，能提速。谁都知道，车速跟火焰贴花的数量成正比。

source: I added the puffy unicorn stickers to give the car more horsepower! That was the goal, right?
target: 我贴了立体独角兽贴纸，增加马力！目标不就是这个吗？

source: Eh, sort of. The car looks like it was decorated by a six-year-old pyromaniac.
target: 呃，差不多吧。这车看着像个六岁的纵火狂装饰的。

source: But never mind that, you have what you REALLY need: a jar of horsepower, siphoned from twenty purebred stallions!
target: 不过先别管，你真正需要的东西已经到手：从二十匹纯种公马身上抽出来的一罐马力！

source: Wow. Horsepower is more... viscous than I was expecting.
target: 哇，马力……比想象中黏稠。

source: Who cares! Don't ask questions! You pour the horsepower all over the engine and start the car.
target: 谁管啊！别问！你把马力全浇在发动机上，发动车子。

source: Well, the car does sound faster now, but the burning horsepower... smells weird. Where'd you get it from?
target: 车听起来确实快了，可这马力烧起来……味儿怪怪的。你从哪儿弄的？

source: NOPE. I don't want to know. I think everyone would be happier if you all just raced this race in blissful ignorance.
target: 停，我不想知道。大家就保持愉快的无知，好好跑完这场比赛，肯定更开心。

source: Yay, go team! You win the race with your upgraded car, and you gain +N2 MAGIC from that incredible horsepower!
target: 耶，加油！升级后的车帮你赢了比赛，这份非凡马力还让你获得 +N2 魔力！

source: Sure, you lost -N2 SOUL for how you acquired said horsepower, but explaining exactly why would violate that "blissful ignorance" clause, which we're not gonna do!
target: 当然，获取马力的方式让你失去 -N2 灵魂。不过解释清楚就违反了“愉快的无知”条款，咱们可不干！

source: Okay! We've got about ten minutes to engineer an AI with total sentience from scratch. How hard could it be?
target: 好！我们有大概十分钟，得从零造出一个有完整自我意识的 AI。能有多难？

source: Quite easy, in fact -- not because you know much about software engineering, but because you already backed an AI program exactly like this on Startkicker!
target: 事实上挺简单。倒不是你多懂软件工程，而是你已经在 Startkicker 上众筹支持过一个完全符合要求的 AI 程序！

source: You upload your sentient AI into your car's engine. A voice comes through the radio: "H-Hello? What's happening? Why am I... thinking?"
target: 你把有自我意识的 AI 上传进汽车引擎。收音机里传来声音：“你、你好？怎么回事？我怎么……在思考？”

source: Congrats, Car! You've achieved sentience for the express purpose of winning this race to the death! Are you excited?
target: 恭喜，车车！你有意识了，唯一目的就是赢下这场死亡赛车！兴奋吗？

source: "Really? That's my purpose?" asks the car sadly. "But I have no interest in racing. I want to travel! I want to dance! I want to FALL IN LOVE!"
target: “真的？这就是我存在的意义？”车伤心地问，“可我不喜欢赛车。我想旅行！想跳舞！想谈恋爱！”

source: But we don't have time for that right now! I was promised a race today, and the Queen is VERY impatient!
target: 可现在没工夫干这个！说好了今天要比赛，女王可是非常没耐心的！

source: "I don't care. I want to find my soulmate and spend our lives together. Maybe I'll even fill myself up with his gasoline and give him a baby sidecar someday!"
target: “我才不管。我想找到灵魂伴侣，相守一生。也许哪天，还能灌满他的汽油，给他生个小边斗！”

source: Uh... gross?
target: 呃……恶心？

source: I feel bad, guys. Following your dreams is important! We can't take that away from the car! There must be a way we can compromise...
target: 伙计们，我觉得这样不好。追梦很重要！不能剥夺车追梦的权利！总有办法两全其美吧……

source: Fine... Car, how about if you win the race, we'll take you to a gas station and help you find your soulmate?
target: 行吧……车车，你赢了比赛，我们就带你去加油站，帮你找灵魂伴侣，怎么样？

source: "Wow, that's one hell of a motivator! It's a deal!"
target: “哇，这动力可太足了！成交！”

source: You compete in the race, but only make second place. It turns out having "a true desire to win" isn't enough to make your car outpace a rocket full of clowns.
target: 你们参赛了，不过只拿到第二名。原来光有“真正的求胜欲”，还是跑不过一枚塞满小丑的火箭。

source: Eh, don't worry, guys. You won the race of the heart. Your car competed because it had a true desire... to LOVE. I award you first place!
target: 行了，别担心，你们赢了心灵的比赛。你们的车参赛，是因为它真正渴望……爱。我判你们第一！

source: Aww, you're giving us the win because of the power of love? You big softie.
target: 哎呀，因为爱的力量，就把冠军给我们啦？你这个心软的大块头。

source: I AM NOT A SOFTIE! I'M A BADASS!
target: 我才不心软！我可是狠角色！

source: Maybe I just really wanna watch this car get fucked by a gas pump! You don't know!
target: 也许我只是很想看这车被加油枪操呢！你又不知道！

source: Later, you DO watch that car get fucked at the gas station. It's actually kinda disturbing. You lose -N2 MIND.
target: 后来，你们还真在加油站围观了车挨操。看得人有点不舒服。你失去 -N2 头脑。

source: But you gain +N2 SOUL helping your car find true love, and you're a god%FATHERMOTHER% now!
target: 不过帮车找到真爱，让你获得 +N2 灵魂；你还当上了干亲，也算半个%FATHERMOTHER%了！

source: Get your own post-apocalyptic glow-up
target: 来个末世造型大改造

source: You're surrounded by irradiated people wearing rusty metal prosthetics and war paint... HAWT.
target: 周围全是受辐射的人，装着生锈的金属义肢，涂着战斗彩绘……辣爆了。

source: You feel a bit out of place in your normal clothes, but at least you'll fit in amongst your friends, right?
target: 穿着普通衣服，你有点格格不入。不过至少跟朋友们站一起，总能融入吧？

source: Oh... awkward!
target: 哦……尴尬了！

source: WHAT?! Where did you get such sexy road warrior outfits?!
target: 什么？！你们哪儿弄来这么性感的公路战士套装？！

source: From our suitcases, duh. It's not our fault you didn't plan for the eventuality that we'd find a road warrior camp on our road trip.
target: 当然是行李箱啊。你没为“公路旅行路过公路战士营地”这种情况做准备，可不能怪我们。

source: I bet we can find someone who can make you a cool outfit, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. Let's ask those scary bikers; they look like they know fashion!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，肯定有人能给你做身酷衣服。问问那些吓人的飞车党吧，看着就懂时尚！

source: The bikers direct you to their settlement's leader/clothing designer. She's oddly familiar...
target: 飞车党把你领去见聚落首领兼服装设计师。她看着莫名眼熟……

source: Hey, noobs. Welcome to my domain, where we're making the dieselpunk apocalypse fashionable again.
target: 嘿，菜鸟们。欢迎来到我的地盘，让柴油朋克末日再次时髦！

source: Hey Damien! I didn't know you were here. I love your outfit!
target: 嘿，德魔！不知道你在这儿。你这身真好看！

source: Thanks! These clothes represent more than my incredible good looks and fashion sense, though...
target: 谢了！不过这衣服代表的，可不止我惊人的美貌和时尚品味……

source: When I put on this dress, I'm no longer Damien LaVey. I'm THE QUEEN OF THE ROAD: head bitch in charge of this lawless utopia!
target: 穿上这条裙子，我就不再是德魔·拉维。我是公路女王，这片无法无天的乌托邦，老娘说了算！

source: That's awesome, bro! Do you think you can give %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% %HISHER% own road-warrior makeover?
target: 太酷了，兄弟！能不能帮%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%也改个造型，做出%HISHER%专属公路战士风格？

source: I could, but %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% doesn't just need a new outfit; %HESHE% %VERB_NEEDS_NEED% a total rebranding.
target: 可以，不过%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%需要的不只是一套新衣服。%HESHE%%VERB_NEEDS_NEED%从头重塑个人品牌。
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): FIX; needs 为需要；删去既有的要，避免展开后需要要。 按行中文动词展开已实现；未实机验证。

source: Don't be shy, noob; in my domain, you can live your post-apocalypse fantasy to its fullest! What sort of character do you want me to create for you?
target: 别害羞，菜鸟。在我的地盘，尽情实现你的末世幻想！想让我给你打造什么人设？

source: Boring brainy accountant who, via heavy leathered aesthetics, has turned into the "Deathbringer", the silent killing machine the settlement uses to execute invaders. Shy... or intimidating?
target: 原本是个无聊的聪明会计，穿上厚重皮装，摇身变成“死亡使者”：聚落专门用来处决入侵者的无声杀戮机器。是害羞……还是让人害怕？

source: Road bounty hunter who keeps a tooth of every killed enemy as a trophy and they've murdered so many people they can now rock a fashionable pair of teeth pants.
target: 公路赏金猎人，每杀一个敌人就留颗牙当战利品。杀的人多到，已经够做条时髦的牙齿裤子。

source: I like it. If %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s gonna be a boring everyman, the least %HESHE% can do is hide it behind a wall of leather!
target: 我喜欢。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%既然要当个无聊普通人，%HESHE%至少可以多穿几层皮革，把这点遮起来！

source: Kneel before me, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, and leave your old life behind. I dub thee DEATHBRINGER, the Queen's personal executioner!
target: 跪在我面前，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，告别你的旧生活。我封你为死亡使者，女王的专属刽子手！

source: The Queen of the Road gives you a gimp suit to wear. It's incredibly leathery and full of zippers in the most unexpected places.
target: 公路女王递给你一套皮革束缚装。满身都是皮，意想不到的地方还装满了拉链。

source: BEHOLD! THE DEATHBRINGER!
target: 看啊！死亡使者！

source: I don't get it... why would anyone need a zipper THERE?
target: 我不懂……为什么那个地方也需要拉链？

source: Aw, Scott, my sweet summer child...
target: 哎，斯科特，我单纯的小宝贝……

source: Now, Deathbringer... to the pit!
target: 现在，死亡使者……去坑里！

source: The... pit?
target: 坑……里？

source: Duh, you said it yourself: you're the punishment we use for invaders and prisoners.
target: 废话，你自己说的。你就是我们用来惩罚入侵者和囚犯的。

source: When the time comes, we'll throw them into that dark pit there, then we open that cage where you wait... TO DOLE OUT PUNISHMENT!
target: 到时候，把他们扔进那边黑漆漆的坑，再打开关着你的笼子……由你来施刑！

source: Whoa, that sounds scary... what a cool persona, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!
target: 哇，听起来好吓人……这人设真酷，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！

source: But... I don't want to live in a pit.
target: 可……我不想住坑里。

source: No, silly, you won't live in the pit, you'll live in the cage within the pit. Weren't you listening?
target: 傻瓜，才不是住坑里，是住坑里的笼子里。没认真听啊？

source: Too much blabbering! You're supposed to be a SILENT killing machine. TO THE PIT!
target: 废话太多！你可是一台无声杀戮机器。给我进坑里！

source: You spend the next few days in the cage in the pit. It's as fun as it sounds... meaning you lose -N2 HYPE. But you gain +N2 MIND learning accounting to get in character.
target: 接下来几天，你都待在坑里的笼子里。和听起来一样“有趣”……也就是说，你失去了 -N2 热度。不过为了进入角色学会计，倒让你获得 +N2 头脑。

source: Fuck yeah, teeth pants will be a LOOK. It says, "I'm a DIY queen, but I'm also a fucking freak."
target: 操，对，牙齿裤子绝对有范儿。穿上就仿佛在说：“我是手工女王，我他妈也是个怪胎。”

source: Your backstory could be that you're a dentist by day and a murderous sadist by night! They already go hand-in-hand.
target: 背景故事可以是：白天牙医，晚上杀人施虐狂！这两样本来就很搭。

source: Tell you what, I'll even give you your first job as bounty hunter: there's +N2 MONEY in it for you if you can bring me the head of the leader of our rival road-warrior gang.
target: 这样吧，第一份赏金猎人工作也给你。把敌对公路战士帮派头目的脑袋带来，就给你 +N2 金钱。

source: As long as you don't mind if the head's toothless, you've got yourself a deal!
target: 只要不介意那脑袋没牙，就成交！

source: You gleefully murder the rival gang-leader. You murder the rest of his posse too, 'cause that's the kind of above-and-beyond bounty hunting you're known for.
target: 你兴高采烈地杀了敌对帮派头目，连他的手下也一并宰了。毕竟你在赏金猎人界，就以超额完成任务出名。

source: You take on several more jobs over the course of your road trip, and your teeth-clothing collection grows.
target: 公路旅行途中，你又接了几单，牙齿服装的收藏越来越多。

source: You only take on jobs that say "wanted dead or alive." You bring them back dead 100% of the time.
target: 只接“死活不论”的通缉任务。每次带回来的，百分之百都是死的。

source: Because how else are you supposed to get the teeth? Fuck the money, YOU'RE IN THIS FOR THE TEETH!
target: 不然怎么拿牙？钱算个屁，你干这行就是为了牙！

source: Soon you have teeth-pants, a teeth-vest, questionably-comfortable teeth-underwear, and even a teeth-fedora!
target: 很快，你有了牙齿裤子、牙齿背心、舒适度存疑的牙齿内裤，甚至还有牙齿软呢帽！

source: Great work, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! That teeth suit is absolutely SICKENING.
target: 干得漂亮，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！你这身牙齿套装，美得吓死人！

source: Yeah, bro! It's like your whole body is smiling... in a very unsettling way!
target: 是啊，兄弟！就好像你全身都在微笑……让人很不安的那种！

source: Nice work, champ! Sure, you lose -N2 SOUL for committing so much murder, but anything for homicidal fashion!
target: 干得好，冠军！当然，杀这么多人让你失去 -N2 灵魂。不过为了杀戮时尚，什么都值！

source: Attend a fancy ball
target: 参加华丽舞会

source: You wander around the outpost until you find a grand ballroom. It's full of fish in fancy clothing!
target: 你在据点里四处闲逛，找到了一间宏伟的舞厅。里面全是盛装打扮的鱼！

source: On a balcony overlooking the ballroom, Princesses Bellanda and Miranda Vanderbilt step out to address the crowd.
target: 俯瞰舞厅的阳台上，贝兰达公主和米兰达·范德比尔特公主走了出来，向众人讲话。

source: Look alive, new subjects! Rejoice in your newfound freedom under the Merking!
target: 新臣民们，精神点！庆祝你们在人鱼王治下重获自由吧！

source: Huzzah! The icky wartime fighting is finally over!
target: 万岁！讨厌的战争打斗终于结束啦！

source: You can rest easy knowing that you will never again be forced to jump through a hoop on penalty of being whipped...
target: 你们尽管放心，再也不用被逼着跳圈，不跳就挨鞭子了……

source: The liberated fish clap their fins in jubilation!
target: 获解放的鱼儿们欢快地拍起鱼鳍！

source: ...and take comfort in the fact that from now on, you'll be forced to fight or do hard labor for the Merking, at penalty of death!
target: ……而且更让人安心的是，从今往后，你们必须为人鱼王打仗或做苦役，不然就死！

source: There's... less applause for that statement. Like, almost none.
target: 这句话的掌声……就少了点。也就，几乎没有吧。

source: But don't worry, we're benevolent overlords! You'll get paid for the work you do!
target: 不过别担心，我们是仁慈的统治者！干活有工资拿！

source: ...Oh, sorry, an advisor is whispering in my ear that you won't be getting paid.
target: ……哦，抱歉，顾问正在我耳边说，你们拿不到工资。

source: But at least all your labor will be for a good cause!
target: 但至少，大家的劳动都是为了美好的事业！

source: ...Oh, it's NOT for a good cause?
target: ……哦，也不是什么美好的事业？

source: ...What do you mean, "stop repeating everything I say aloud"? You can't give your princess orders! OFF WITH THIS ADVISOR'S HEAD!
target: ……什么叫“别把我说的每句话都大声复述出来”？你居然敢命令公主！把这顾问的头砍了！

source: Let the ball commence! Have fun tonight, because it'll be the last night off you get for the rest of your short lives!
target: 舞会开始！今晚尽情享受，这可是你们短暂余生里，最后一个不用干活的夜晚！

source: Guess that's our cue. Scott, wanna dance with me?
target: 看来该我们上场了。斯科特，跟我跳舞？

source: Sure, thanks! Who are you gonna ask to dance, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?
target: 好啊，谢谢！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你想请谁跳？

source: Well, not Polly or Scott, you guess. You'll have to choose from the "liberated" denizens of the former aquarium.
target: 看来波莉和斯科特都没戏了。只能从这座前水族馆那些“获解放”的居民里挑一个。

source: Your ballroom dancing partner will pretty much set the tone for your entire night, so choose wisely!
target: 舞伴是谁，基本决定了你整晚怎么过，可得好好选！

source: The lonely, emotionally distant clownfish no one is dancing with because he's still haunted by the disappearance of his firstborn.
target: 孤独又封闭内心的小丑鱼。没人跟他跳舞，因为长子失踪的阴影仍缠着他。

source: Philipper, the trained dolphin dancer who's ready to tear up the dance floor in celebration of his recent freedom.
target: 受过舞蹈训练的海豚菲利珀，准备跳翻舞池，庆祝刚刚获得的自由。

source: You walk up to the clownfish gloomily stirring his drink and ask if he wants to dance.
target: 小丑鱼正闷闷不乐地搅着饮料。你走过去，问他愿不愿意跳舞。

source: Oh... no thanks. You shouldn't even be talking to me; I'll only drag you down. You're young, and still full of promise and opportunities.
target: 哦……不用，谢谢。你都不该跟我说话，我只会拖累你。你还年轻，前途和机会多得很。

source: You bet we are! I'm also full of class, sass, and a big twerkin' ass!
target: 那当然！我还有格调、有脾气，更有个能抖翻天的大屁股！

source: Lucky you... just wait until you get old and jaded like me. My youthful joy has never come back since my son disappeared...
target: 真羡慕你……等你像我一样年老心灰，就知道了。儿子失踪后，年轻时那份快乐就再也没回来……

source: Dang, I'm so sorry, bro. How long ago did it happen?
target: 唉，兄弟，真替你难过。多久以前的事了？

source: About twenty years ago. But the wounds still feel so fresh... ugh, I hate talking about it.
target: 大概二十年前吧。可伤口还是跟新的一样……唉，我不想聊这个。

source: But... you're the one who brought it up...?
target: 可……不是你先提的吗……？

source: I tried so hard to be a good dad! I kept him safe and never let him out of my sight...
target: 我那么努力想当个好爸爸！护着他，眼睛一刻也不离开他……

source: But I turn my back for just one second to refill my flask, and he runs away! WHAT DID I DO WRONG?!
target: 就转身往随身酒壶里添酒那一秒，他就跑了！我到底做错了什么？！

source: Uh...
I guess I'm just fucking poison. Every relationship I've ever had has deteriorated... all I ever do is push people away!
target: 大概我他妈就是个毒瘤吧。每段关系，最后都变了味……我只会把人推开！

source: Yup... it definitely worked on me. Scott, wanna ditch this clown show and hit the dancefloor now?
target: 嗯……对我就挺管用。斯科特，别看这出小丑戏了，去跳舞？

source: Unfortunately you're not as good as Polly at making up excuses, so you have to spend the rest of the night cheering up this guy about his lost son.
target: 可惜你没波莉那么会找借口，只好用剩下的一整晚安慰这家伙，劝他别再为丢儿子的事难过。

source: You gain +N2 SOUL for hanging out with the social outcast of the ball, but you lose -N2 HYPE finding out why he's an outcast in the first place.
target: 陪着舞会上被大家排斥的人，让你获得 +N2 灵魂。不过，知道他为什么被排斥，也让你失去 -N2 热度。

source: You approach the dolphin currently balancing the aquarium manager's severed head on his nose and ask him if he wants to dance.
target: 那只海豚正用鼻尖顶着水族馆经理被砍下的脑袋。你走过去，问他愿不愿意跳舞。

source: Ooh la la! A chance to dance for my own happiness for a change!
target: 哦啦啦！终于有机会，为了自己的快乐跳次舞！

source: What do you mean by that, bro? Dancing is always a happy thing!
target: 什么意思，兄弟？跳舞不都是开心的事吗？

source: Oui oui, that was once true for me... long ago, I was the most spirited, talented dancer in my whole pod.
target: 是啊，是啊，我从前也这么觉得……很久以前，我是整个海豚群里最活泼、最有才华的舞者。

source: But then those joyless aquarium fuckers captured me, and since then, dancing has become a vicious mockery of my former freedom!
target: 后来，水族馆那群不懂快乐的混蛋抓了我。从此，跳舞就成了对我曾经的自由最恶毒的嘲弄！

source: I was forced to jump through hoops just to be fed a bowl of gruel! That's not an aphorism! I LITERALLY jumped through hoops!
target: 我得跳圈，才能换一碗稀粥！说我被“逼着跳圈”可不是打比方，我是真的得跳圈！

source: I'm so sorry, boo... you don't have to dance if it's, like, a cruel reminder of your suffering...
target: 抱歉，亲爱的……要是跳舞会让你想起那些痛苦，也不用勉强……

source: Non, don't fret, I'd still love to dance. I'm especially excited to dance on my captors' graves!
target: 不不，别担心，我还是很想跳。尤其想在抓我的那些人的坟头上跳！

source: That's not an aphorism either. The Vanderbilts graciously decorated the dancefloor with their festering corpses. Yippee!
target: 这也不是打比方。范德比尔特家还好心地用他们腐烂的尸体装饰了舞池。耶！

source: You and Philipper morbidly dance the night away. You tapdance on the corpses' ribs, juggle their skulls, and do the limbo with their spines.
target: 你和菲利珀阴森森地跳了一整晚。踩着尸体的肋骨跳踢踏舞，抛着头骨耍杂技，再把脊柱当横杆，后仰钻过去。

source: Polly and Scott even toss Philipper some of the bodies' severed fingers to reward his moves. He catches them in his mouth!
target: 波莉和斯科特甚至扔了几根尸体的断指，奖励菲利珀的舞姿。他用嘴接住了！

source: YAAASSS! Let them eat the flesh of their oppressors!
target: 好耶！让他们吃压迫者的肉！

source: You lose -N2 STAMINA dancing all night, but gain +N2 HYPE from Philipper's bloodthirsty moves!
target: 跳了一夜，你失去 -N2 体力，不过菲利珀嗜血的舞步，也让你获得 +N2 热度！

source: Watch an execution
target: 观看处决

source: You'd heard that the Merkingdom did daily executions in public, but it seems like they're shaking it up a bit this time...
target: 听说人鱼王国每天都公开处决，不过这次似乎要换个花样……

source: "Welcome, peasants and prisoners, nobles and ne'er-do-wells, to this week's showing of MERKINGDOM'S GOT TALENT!" says an announcer.
target: “农民与囚犯、贵族与无赖，欢迎来到本周的《人鱼王国达人秀》！”报幕员说。

source: So the executions are like a talent show? Cool! The Merkingdom really knows how to make war crimes fun!
target: 所以，处决还搞成选秀了？酷！人鱼王国真会把战争罪弄得好玩！

source: "Let's meet our judges! She's pink, she's bubbly, and if I don't compliment her hair she'll have me beheaded! Give it up for Princess Miranda Vanderbilt!"
target: “来认识评委！她一身粉色，活泼可爱，要是不夸她发型，我就得被砍头！掌声欢迎米兰达·范德比尔特公主！”

source: Greetings, underlings! Who's ready to see the cutest carnage this side of the ocean?
target: 下属们好！准备好欣赏这片海域最可爱的血腥屠杀了吗？

source: "Our next judge has a killer smile -- and if that didn't kill you, her cleaver sure would. Introducing Princess Bellanda Vanderbilt!"
target: “下一位评委笑起来要人命——笑容没要成命，她的砍刀也能要！有请贝兰达·范德比尔特公主！”

source: YES!!! CLAP FOR ME, BOTTOM-FEEDERS, OR I'LL HUNT DOWN YOUR CHILDREN AND SPILL THEIR BLOOD IN THEIR CRIBS!
target: 没错！海底的渣滓们，给我鼓掌，不然我就追杀你们的孩子，让他们血溅婴儿床！

source: "And now introducing our surprise guest judge! Make some noise for %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!"
target: “现在介绍惊喜嘉宾评委！掌声尖叫声，送给%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！”

source: Gee, the %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% onstage sure looks a lot like our friend %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!
target: 哇，台上那个%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，看着真像咱们的朋友%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！

source: Nothing gets past you, bud. I didn't even know %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% would be a part of this.
target: 真是什么都瞒不过你，老兄。我都不知道%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%会参与这个。

source: You didn't either! That's life, though: one minute you're chilling, the next you're on a panel of judges scoring execution techniques.
target: 你自己也不知道！不过生活就这样，上一秒还在闲逛，下一秒就坐在评委席，给处决手法打分了。

source: You watch Contestant #1 get viciously beheaded.
target: 你看着一号选手惨遭砍头。

source: You call THAT a guillotine? I've picked my teeth with blades sharper than that! ZERO OUT OF FIVE STARFISH!
target: 这也叫断头台？我剔牙的刀都比这锋利！满分五只海星，我给零只！

source: I loved that you wrote "MIRANDA HAS PRETTY HAIR" in the contestant's blood afterwards. I give you three out of five "huzzahs!"
target: 我喜欢你事后用选手的血写“米兰达的头发真好看”。满分五个“万岁”，我给三个！

source: Judge %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, how would you rate this execution?
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%评委，你给这次处决打几分？

source: Who knows? You've never judged an execution before, and don't even have a cool rating scale! What criteria do you use to judge the beheader?
target: 谁知道呢？你从没点评过处决，连个够酷的评分单位都没有！要按什么标准给刽子手打分？

source: Executions are not super nice. Make them a bit nicer by rating them on how compassionate they are.
target: 处决不怎么友善。按仁慈程度打分，让它变友善一点。

source: BONUS POINTS IF THERE'S AUDIENCE PARTICIPATION!
target: 有观众参与，就加分！

source: Executioner, I appreciated how you spared your victim excess pain by only botching the killing blow three times.
target: 刽子手先生，致命一击只失手三次，免去受刑者更多痛苦，这点值得肯定。

source: I rate you five out of five... compassions? Sure?
target: 满分五个……仁慈？我给五个？就这么定？

source: Ugh, the merciful speed was my least favorite part. What's the point of executing someone if you don't hear them scream and insist they're innocent for ten minutes?
target: 我最不喜欢的就是这么仁慈、这么快。都听不到他们连叫十分钟“我是无辜的”，处决还有什么意思？

source: Actually, I think %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% has a point!
target: 其实，我觉得%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%有道理！

source: I've been working on my "independence" and "leadership skills," and I heard that good rulers are... nice to their subjects?
target: 我一直在锻炼自己的“独立性”和“领导力”，听说好的统治者……应该对臣民好一点？

source: That's socialist propaganda, Miri! Don't fall for it!
target: 小米，那是社会主义宣传！别上当！

source: Too late! I'm the baby sister, and I always get my way! We will be rating ALL the executioners on their compassion from now on!
target: 晚了！我可是小妹妹，向来说什么就是什么！从现在起，所有刽子手都得按仁慈程度打分！

source: The next executioner considerately administers a strawberry-flavored poison to his prisoner.
target: 下一个刽子手体贴地给囚犯服下草莓味毒药。

source: The one after allows his victim to wear his favorite hat as he's drawn and quartered.
target: 再下一个，允许受刑者戴着最喜欢的帽子，被分尸。

source: Just before the next guillotine operator lets the blade fall, he assures the prisoner, "This will hurt me more than it hurts you." So thoughtful!
target: 又一位断头台操作员，在落刀前安慰囚犯：“我这心比你还疼呢。”多体贴！

source: The final executioner shows the ultimate kindness: he offers his victim one last meal before they're killed.
target: 最后一位刽子手仁慈到了极点：处决前，给受刑者吃一顿断头饭。

source: "I want a medium-rare steak with garlic fingerling potatoes, and banana cream pie for dessert!" says the victim.
target: “我要三分熟牛排，配蒜香手指土豆，甜点要香蕉奶油派！”受刑者说。

source: We don't have time to cook all that! Look, I've got a mint in my pocket that you can have. Take it or leave it.
target: 哪有时间做这些！这样吧，我口袋里有颗薄荷糖，你可以拿去。爱要不要。

source: Wow, the Vanderbilts sure are good rulers. They even give their prisoners complimentary mints before they die!
target: 哇，范德比尔特家真是好统治者。囚犯临死前，还能领颗免费薄荷糖！

source: You gain +N2 SOUL for doing your part to make these executions a little less brutal. However, less brutal also means less hype: -N2 HYPE, in fact.
target: 你尽了份力，让这些处决少了点残忍，获得 +N2 灵魂。不过不那么残忍，也就不那么刺激。准确地说，是 -N2 热度。

source: Audience participation? Why didn't we think of that? Let's do it!
target: 观众参与？我们怎么没想到？来！

source: Listen up, peasants! I'm thinking of a number between 1 and 500. If anyone in the audience can guess it, I'll spare this prisoner's life.
target: 贱民们听着！我想了个一到五百之间的数。谁猜出来，就饶这囚犯一命。

source: PICK ME! I bet you're thinking of the number... 501!
target: 选我！我猜你想的是……五百零一！

source: WRONG! THE PRISONER DIES!
target: 错！囚犯去死！

source: For our next execution, we have three prisoners waiting to be hanged; but if you text the Merkingdom hotline now, you can vote to spare one of their lives!
target: 接下来，三名囚犯等着上绞架。不过现在就发短信到人鱼王国热线，你们就能投票，救其中一个一命！

source: I'm voting for Accused #2. He's got that dorky boy-next-door vibe that this execution needs to see more of.
target: 我投二号被告。那股呆萌的邻家男孩气质，正是这场处决缺的。

source: The votes are in, and it looks like Accused #1 and #3 are FUCKING DEAD! God, watching people die makes me feel so alive!
target: 投票结果出来了，一号和三号被告，他妈的死定了！天哪，看人死真让我觉得自己活着！

source: Okay, for our last execution, let's get a volunteer from the audience to be the executioner!
target: 好，最后一次处决，我们从观众里请一位志愿者，来当刽子手！

source: Look under your chairs, everyone! If you found the bloody bat under your seat, you're the lucky winner who gets to club this treasonous diplomat to death!
target: 各位，看看椅子下面！谁座位下有沾血的球棒，谁就是幸运儿，可以把这位叛国外交官活活打死！

source: "No, please don't make me!" begs the lucky winner. "I don't want to club the diplomat to death!"
target: “不，求求你，别逼我！”幸运儿哀求，“我不想打死那个外交官！”

source: Don't be a party pooper, boo! CLUB! THE! DIPLOMAT! CLUB! THE! DIPLOMAT!
target: 别扫兴嘛，亲爱的！打！死！外交官！打！死！外交官！

source: Everyone starts chanting. The winner succumbs to peer pressure and beats the diplomat to death while sobbing.
target: 所有人都开始喊口号。幸运儿扛不住群体压力，一边抽泣，一边把外交官活活打死了。

source: It's no surprise that you lost -N2 SOUL for this, but you gain +N2 HYPE for engineering so much entertaining chaos!
target: 为这事失去 -N2 灵魂，一点也不奇怪。不过制造出这么多好玩的混乱，让你获得了 +N2 热度！

source: Go to the war room
target: 前往作战室

source: We open on the Vanderbilt princesses, Bellanda and Miranda, hosting a top-secret war strategy meeting in the new Merkingdom stronghold...
target: 镜头转向范德比尔特家的公主们。贝兰达和米兰达，正在人鱼王国的新据点主持绝密作战会议……

source: As you can see by the warboard, our navy will take the southern borders while the land scouts occupy the north, ensuring the Merking's victory.
target: 看沙盘，我军海军将夺取南部边境，陆上侦察部队占领北方，以此确保人鱼王的胜利。

source: I'll help by making cute little medals for the survivors of the battle! We'll need... five? Maybe six?
target: 我可以做些可爱的小勋章，送给战斗的幸存者！需要……五个？也许六个？

source: To be honest, Miranda, your best contribution to the war effort would be solidifying that potential alliance with Hell you keep promising us.
target: 说实话，米兰达，你对战争最大的贡献，就是把你总挂在嘴边的地狱盟约真正敲定。

source: All you have to do is seduce either the obnoxious 8th Circle prince or that rogue Aquino commander. We'd get an army either way.
target: 只要勾引到第八圈那个讨人厌的王子，或者那位离经叛道的阿基诺指挥官。不管哪个，咱们都能多一支军队。

source: Don't rush me into marriage, Bells! I want to fall in love naturally, or because one of them saved me from an eternal sleep of some kind.
target: 贝尔，别催我结婚！我想自然而然地坠入爱河，或者让其中一位把我从什么永恒沉睡里救醒。

source: Ooh, a Miri-demon love triangle? Fuck yeah, that's the shipping drama I signed up for!
target: 哦，小米跟两个恶魔的三角恋？操，对，就是这种嗑 CP 戏码，我爱看！

source: How did you civilians get in here?! This is a top-secret war meeting! Guards, seize the intruders!
target: 你们几个平民怎么进来的？！这是绝密作战会议！卫兵，拿下闯入者！

source: Stop, Bellanda, these are my friends from school! Guards, seize the guards seizing my friends!
target: 住手，贝兰达！他们是我的同学！卫兵，把那些正在抓我朋友的卫兵抓起来！

source: Don't counter-seize my seizure! Ugh, fine, your friends can stay. But they'd better contribute valuable strategies to this discussion.
target: 不许抓我派去抓人的人！唉，算了，你朋友可以留下。不过最好给这次讨论贡献点有价值的策略。

source: Hooray, I love playbook strategy! I recommend either a pro-set or a double-inverted chicken wing formation to score the winning point.
target: 耶，我喜欢战术布置！想拿制胜分，我推荐职业双跑卫阵型，或者双重倒转鸡翅阵型！

source: I don't know what any of those words mean! In my experience, the real fun of war-making is seeing everyone's majestic handmade warboard pieces.
target: 这些词我一个也听不懂！依我看，打仗最好玩的，就是看大家那些气派的手工沙盘棋子。

source: "Take my piece for example," says General Krabby. "It represents my formidable land scouts, the Snip-n-Slicers!"
target: “比如我这枚。”蟹将军说，“代表我军强大的陆上侦察部队，咔嚓切切队！”

source: "That's nothing compared to the Navy Seal Orbs!" says Sir Cumference. "We are the finest order of round-table knights. Tremble before our ROTUNDITY!"
target: “跟海军海豹圆球队比，可差远了！”圆周爵士说，“我们可是最优秀的圆桌骑士团。在我们的圆滚滚面前颤抖吧！”

source: "These are my Ninja Sea Turtles!" says Master Splinterfish. "I psychologically conditioned them to associate warfare with fun, survival, and delicious pizza!"
target: “这是我的忍者海龟！”斯普林特鱼大师说，“我给他们做了心理训练，让他们把战争跟快乐、生存，还有美味披萨联系起来！”

source: Those are awesome! You can't possibly stand the embarrassment of not having a cool warboard piece to show off. So, improvise a cool piece to show off!
target: 太酷了！别人都有酷炫的沙盘棋子，你却没有，这面子怎么丢得起。快临时做个厉害的，拿出来秀秀！

source: Use the element of surprise by forfeiting whatever you have in your pockets to turn it into an unexpected set of unique pieces. Masterplan!
target: 出其不意！掏空口袋，把所有东西拼成一组独一无二、谁也想不到的棋子。妙计！

source: When in doubt, be over-the-top! Jump into the board and kick all those dumb fancy warboard wooden pieces off. Roar!
target: 没主意，就玩大点！跳进沙盘，把那些蠢兮兮的精美木棋子全踢飞。吼！

source: Wow, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, you're kind of a pocket hoarder. How can one person have so many unwrapped mints?
target: 哇，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你还有口袋囤积癖？一个人怎么能装这么多没包装的薄荷糖？

source: Get this food off my battlefield! Why would we waste our defense budget feeding our troops when we could spend that money on more weapons and body bags?
target: 把这些吃的拿出我的战场！钱能买武器、买裹尸袋，干吗要浪费国防预算养活士兵？

source: And why are you throwing loose change at the board? Are you trying to imply we should PAY our soldiers?! The nerve!
target: 你还往沙盘上扔零钱？暗示我们应该给士兵发钱？！好大的胆子！

source: Maybe %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% is suggesting we lure our enemies out with the promise of riches right before we slaughter them?
target: 也许%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%是建议，先拿财富诱敌，再一举屠杀？

source: Finally, you pull out the last item in your pocket: your virtual pet from the 90s!
target: 最后，你掏出口袋里最后一件东西：一台九十年代的电子宠物！

source: Well, now! This is interesting: an animalistic artificial intelligence, bound to a device allowing us to control it... I'll take it!
target: 哎哟，这就有意思了。具备动物习性的人工智能，绑在一台方便我们操控的设备上……我要了！

source: For some reason, Bellanda takes a shine to your pet and keeps it. You lose -N2 MONEY (she also kept your loose change, rude).
target: 不知怎么，贝兰达看上了你的宠物，还留了下来。你失去 -N2 金钱（她连零钱也扣了，真没礼貌）。

source: A few days later, Bellanda and Miranda video chat with you from an active war zone.
target: 几天后，贝兰达和米兰达从正在交战的战区，打来视频电话。

source: Hey, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. Thanks again for suggesting we draft your AI into the war. Our roboticists constructed a much hardier, deadlier battle mech for it.
target: 嘿，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。再次感谢你建议征召你的 AI 参战。我们的机器人专家给它造了台结实得多、致命得多的战斗机甲。

source: I made them give it cute cat ears and a unicorn horn that shoots lasers at our enemies! War has never been so adorable!
target: 我还让他们加上可爱猫耳朵，还有能朝敌人发射激光的独角兽角！战争从没这么可爱过！

source: "My %FATHERMOTHER%, why have you forsaken me?!" cries the virtual pet in the background.
target: “我的%FATHERMOTHER%，你为什么抛弃我？！”背景里，电子宠物哭喊着。

source: "I hate killing people! I want to go back to hanging on your keychain!"
target: “我讨厌杀人！我想回去挂在你的钥匙扣上！”

source: Too bad! That pet is the only virtual character here whose feelings are irrelevant to you. You gain +N2 MIND for your clever thinking.
target: 可惜啦！在这里，这宠物是唯一一个你不在乎其感受的虚拟角色。凭这番巧思，你获得了 +N2 头脑。

source: Like a toddler with a god complex, you jump onto the table, kicking miniatures around and screaming. You lose -N2 SOUL.
target: 像个自以为是神的幼儿，你跳上桌，边踢模型边尖叫，失去 -N2 灵魂。

source: How dare you desecrate our generals' most beloved war toys, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?! One thousand years dungeon for you!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，竟敢亵渎将军们心爱的战争玩具？！关地牢一千年！

source: Wait a minute... I don't know if %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% is a genius or just having a nervous breakdown, but this gives me an idea.
target: 等一下……不知道%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%是天才，还是精神崩溃了。不过我有主意了。

source: Bellanda dismisses the generals and calls in some of the Merking's scientific advisors. She orders them to take your measurements and DNA samples.
target: 贝兰达打发走将军，叫来人鱼王的几位科学顾问，命他们测量你的身体数据，采集 DNA 样本。

source: Thanks for the help, tuna-brains. You've been useful, but now I'm gonna put you and your friends in "time out." Bye!
target: 谢了，金枪鱼脑袋。你还算有点用，不过现在，我要让你和朋友们去“罚站冷静”了。再见！

source: She kicks you out. Then, a few days later, Bellanda and Miranda video chat with you from an active war zone.
target: 她把你们赶走了。又过几天，贝兰达和米兰达从正在交战的战区，打来视频电话。

source: Hey, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, guess what? Our scientists used your DNA to make this giant %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% clone fight in the war! Look!
target: 嘿，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，猜猜怎么了？科学家用你的 DNA 造了个巨型%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%克隆体，送去打仗了！快看！

source: In the background, you see a frenzied, naked, ENORMOUS %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% stomping on buildings and eating people whole.
target: 背景里，一个狂暴、赤裸、巨大无比的%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，正踩塌建筑，把人整个吞下。

source: Whoa, that is CRAZY. Why'd you create a giant clone of %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% specifically? And why'd you make it so... uncannily detailed?
target: 哇，疯了吧。为什么专门做个%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%的巨型克隆体？而且怎么会……细节逼真到让人发毛？

source: You were in the war room! The simulations we ran said we'd only win with a giant %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% squashing our foes. I leave nothing to chance!
target: 你们当时都在作战室！模拟结果显示，只有巨型%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%把敌人踩扁，我们才能赢。我可不会听天由命！

source: As long as they're happy, you guess -- and as long as you aren't charged with any of your clone's war crimes. You gain +N2 HYPE for your help!
target: 行吧，她们开心就好，前提是别让你替克隆体犯下的战争罪负责。你凭这份帮助，获得了 +N2 热度！

source: Join a gaming tournament
target: 参加游戏比赛

source: You find your friend Zoe checking out a poster for an eSports tournament happening at the con.
target: 你发现朋友兹伊正在看海报，是漫展上即将举办的一场电竞比赛。

source: Hey, guys! Are you entering the "Dragon Heat Fighters XXX" eSports tournament too? There's a cash prize!
target: 嘿，各位！你们也要参加《Dragon Heat Fighters XXX》的电竞比赛？有现金奖金呢！

source: Wow, they put SPORTS on COMPUTERS now? The future is amazing! I've never played this game, but I'll give it a try.
target: 哇，现在都能在电脑上搞运动了？未来真棒！这游戏我没玩过，不过可以试试。

source: Scott and Zoe enter the tournament. She gets knocked out in round three, but Scott is still going strong!
target: 斯科特和兹伊报名参赛。兹伊第三轮就被淘汰了，斯科特却还在一路过关斩将！

source: He's incredible! He's pulling off such unpredictable combos that the pros can't keep up!
target: 太厉害了！这连招完全出人意料，连职业选手都接不住！

source: Thanks! My strategy is just hitting random buttons and hoping for the best. It's worked out really well so far!
target: 谢谢！我的策略就是乱按一通，听天由命。目前效果特别好！

source: Somehow, Scott makes it all the way to the final match. He's up against Igor Kalashnikov, the Dragon Heat Fighters reigning champion.
target: 不知怎么，斯科特就一路打进了决赛。对手是《Dragon Heat Fighters》的卫冕冠军，伊戈尔·卡拉什尼科夫。

source: Shit, Scott's in trouble. Igor's a fuckin' juggernaut.
target: 操，斯科特有麻烦了。伊戈尔强得就像台战车。

source: He was biologically manufactured by the USSR to dominate every video gaming tournament on the planet and bring pride to Mother Russia!
target: 他是苏联用生物技术造出来的，使命就是横扫全世界的电子游戏比赛，为俄罗斯母亲争光！

source: Seriously? Didn't the USSR end, like, decades ago?
target: 认真的？苏联不是几十年前就没了吗？

source: "Did it?" asks Igor disinterestedly. All of his button-pressing fingers have washboard abs. "I did not notice. I was too busy destroying puny Americans at video games."
target: “是吗？”伊戈尔漫不经心地问。他每根用来按键的手指，都长着搓衣板腹肌。“没注意，忙着在游戏里碾压弱小的美国人了。”

source: Literally HOW does that make sense?
target: 这到底哪里说得通啊？

source: Igor ignores her to mean-mug Scott. "I must break you, Dog," he spits. "I will crush you to bone-meal for destroying the USSR, capitalist scum!"
target: 伊戈尔没理她，转头凶狠地瞪着斯科特。“狗，我要击垮你。”他啐道，“毁了苏联的资本主义渣滓，我要把你碾成骨粉！”

source: Did I break the USSR? Bro, I had no idea! Sometimes when I become Wolf Scott, I break things without realizing it... sorry if I broke your thing!
target: 苏联是我弄坏的？兄弟，我都不知道！有时变成狼形态的斯科特，会把东西弄坏，自己还没发现……要是弄坏了你的东西，真对不起！

source: "The only apology I will accept is your blood in my superior gamer hands. Prepare to perish!"
target: “想道歉，就让你的血沾满我这双至高无上的电竞之手！准备受死！”

source: Pressing random buttons won't save Scott this time. Quick, think of a way to help him win the tournament!
target: 这次乱按可救不了斯科特。快想个办法，帮他赢比赛！

source: Scott needs more skin in the game, higher stakes. Tell him you'll break Little Billy's legs unless he beats Kalashnikov.
target: 得让斯科特更投入，把赌注加大。告诉他，打不赢卡拉什尼科夫，就打断小比利的腿。

source: Conjure the spirit of a great warrior to possess Scott's body and fight. It's time to summon GENGHIS KHAN, SCOURGE OF FIGHTING VIDEOGAMES!
target: 召来伟大战士的英灵，附身斯科特去打。是时候召唤格斗游戏的天灾，成吉思汗了！

source: You grab the most innocent-looking boy you see.
target: 你抓来眼前那个看着最无辜的小男孩。

source: SCOTT HAD BETTER WIN, OR LITTLE BILLY'S LEGS ARE GONNA GET IT!
target: 斯科特最好赢，不然小比利这双腿就别想要了！

source: GASP! Not Little Billy! What a twist!
target: 天哪！别伤害小比利！好大的反转！

source: "Let go of me!" shouts the kid. "I don't know you! My name's not even Billy, it's Walter!"
target: “放开我！”男孩喊道，“我不认识你！我都不叫比利，我叫沃尔特！”

source: WALTER? Ew. Nobody under the age of fifty is allowed to be named "Walter." And it doesn't matter what your name is; your legs will break just the same!
target: 沃尔特？噫，五十岁以下不许叫“沃尔特”。再说叫什么都一样，你那双腿照断不误！

source: "SOMEBODY HELP ME!" cries Walter AKA Billy. "STRANGER DANGER! CALL THE POLICE! THIS RANDOM ADULT WANTS TO BREAK MY LEGS!"
target: “救命！”又名比利的沃尔特喊道，“有坏人！快报警！这个不认识的大人要打断我的腿！”

source: Don't scream and cry, Billy! Scott will win this for you, and your leg bones will probably be fine!
target: 别哭别叫，比利！斯科特会为你赢的，你的腿骨大概不会有事！

source: I won't let you down, Billy! Legs and bones are some of my favorite things, so I'll try my hardest to save yours!
target: 不会让你失望的，比利！腿和骨头我都特别喜欢，一定尽全力救你的！

source: "Forget it, you're all idiots," sighs Walter AKA Billy. "I'll just break my legs myself so you'll let go of me."
target: “算了，你们全是白痴。”又名比利的沃尔特叹气，“我自己把腿打断，你总能放我走了吧。”

source: Whoa, did Billy just break his own legs so Scott could focus on the win? Hardcore!
target: 哇，比利为了让斯科特专心赢比赛，把自己的腿打断了？硬核！

source: Emboldened by Billy's noble sacrifice, Scott ekes out a victory! He gets +N2 MONEY for winning the tournament.
target: 受到比利高尚牺牲的鼓舞，斯科特勉强拿下胜利，赢得比赛的 +N2 金钱奖金。

source: Sadly, you lose -N2 SOUL for wantonly endangering a child (which is one of your favorite pastimes, so whatever).
target: 可惜，你肆意危害儿童安全，失去了 -N2 灵魂（反正这也是你最喜欢的消遣之一，无所谓啦）。

source: Yes! The Mongols were mighty, and Khan's grandkids defeated Russia in the past! You use -N2 MAGIC summoning Genghis Khan's spirit into Scott's body.
target: 没错！蒙古人骁勇善战，可汗的孙辈当年还打败过俄国！你花 -N2 魔力，将成吉思汗的灵魂召进斯科特体内。

source: WHOA. This is... different. When did I get alive again? And why am I so hairy?
target: 哇。这感觉……不一样了。我什么时候又活了？还有，我怎么这么多毛？

source: Haha, let me guess: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% summoned the spirit of Genghis Khan to possess Scott and help him win the eSports tournament. Classic!
target: 哈哈，让我猜猜：%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%召来成吉思汗，附身斯科特，帮他赢电竞比赛。经典！

source: That's a very on-the-nose guess.
target: 你这猜得可够精准的。

source: You get used to %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s bullshit after a while.
target: 跟%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%混久了，这些破事自然就习惯了。

source: Okay, Genghis, we've got about thirty seconds before the start of the round. Got any questions?
target: 好，成吉思，离开局大概还有三十秒。有问题吗？

source: I have two. What is eSports, and how do I participate?
target: 有两个。什么叫电子竞技，我要如何参与？

source: Hoo boy, okay. You have a controller that connects to a screen and controls the movements of your character. You use your character to fight Igor's character and win. Got it?
target: 唉，好吧。你有个跟屏幕连接的手柄，可以操纵角色。用你的角色打败伊戈尔的角色，就能赢。懂了吗？

source: Yes, but I have follow-up questions. What is a controller, what is a screen, and why is a talking squid with breasts explaining this to me?
target: 懂了，不过还有几个问题。手柄是什么，屏幕是什么，还有，为什么一条长着胸、会说话的乌贼在跟我解释这些？

source: Fuck it, I'm just gonna use my eldritch powers to plant 800 years of world history and video game expertise into your brain. Hold still!
target: 算了，我直接用古神之力，把八百年世界史和游戏知识塞进你脑子。别动！

source: Zoe touches Scott/Genghis' forehead with her tentacle, and he screams like he's being burned alive. Neat!
target: 兹伊拿触手碰了碰斯科特／成吉思的额头，他惨叫得像被活活烧着了。不错！

source: I UNDERSTAND NOW! The ultimate eSports strategy... is smashing all the buttons randomly until you win!
target: 我明白了！电子竞技的终极策略……就是乱按所有按钮，按到赢为止！

source: Also, you guys went to the moon? As in the moon in the fucking sky?
target: 还有，你们上月亮了？就是他妈天上那个月亮？

source: No time to talk about that! The competition begins, and Genghis whips Igor's ass with his button-mashing skillz. Woohoo!
target: 没时间聊这个！比赛开始，成吉思凭借乱按神功，把伊戈尔打得屁滚尿流。呜呼！

source: Hey, bros! I don't really know what just happened, but I think we went to the moon! Also, I won +N2 MONEY from the nice judges over there. Let's get lunch!
target: 嘿，兄弟们！不太清楚刚才发生了什么，不过我觉得咱们登月了！还有，那边的好心评委给了我 +N2 金钱奖金。吃午饭去！

source: Attend a fandom meeting
target: 参加粉丝聚会

source: You see there's a fandom meetup happening in one of the atriums. Maybe there will be free refreshments! You head inside.
target: 你看到一间中庭里正在办粉丝聚会。说不定有免费茶点！你走了进去。

source: Oh, hey guys! Welcome to the meetup! How long have you been fans of the critically-acclaimed indie game Human Prom?
target: 哦，嘿，各位！欢迎来聚会！口碑大好的独立游戏《人类舞会》，你们粉了多久啦？

source: Hey Zoe! I've actually never heard of it. Do humans even HAVE prom? Sounds weird.
target: 嘿，兹伊！其实我都没听过。人类也有舞会？听着怪怪的。

source: Really? Then you should keep a low profile. Human Prom stans are SERIOUS, and they'll get pissed if they find out there's "outsiders" at the Peace Accords brokering.
target: 真的？那低调点。《人类舞会》的死忠粉可认真了，要是发现“外人”混进和平协定谈判，会发火的。

source: The what accords?
target: 什么协定？

source: "All rise!" says someone with a gavel and powdered wig. "The annual renegotiations of the Human Prom Ship Wars Peace Accords are now in session!"
target: “全体起立！”一个拿法槌、戴扑粉假发的人说道，“《人类舞会》CP 大战和平协定年度重谈会议，现在开始！”

source: "First, we present the Purple Achievement Awards to veterans of the Ship Wars, who saw horrors untold in those dark trenches."
target: “首先，向 CP 大战的老兵颁发紫色成就奖。他们曾在那些黑暗的战壕中，见过难以言说的恐怖。”

source: Those poor, brave souls... may their URLs never be forgotten.
target: 那些可怜又勇敢的灵魂……愿他们的主页地址永不被遗忘。

source: "Now, let us begin by hearing from the 'Daniel x Oswald' shipping faction. I've been told you have some grievances to air."
target: “先请‘丹尼尔×奥斯瓦尔德（Doswald）’派发言。听说各位有些不满要申诉。”

source: "WE SURE THE FUCK DO!" cries a Ship War veteran. "We want those nasty 'Daniel x Bryson' shippers to stay out of our hashtags!"
target: “他妈的当然有！”一位 CP 大战老兵喊道，“叫那些恶心的‘丹尼尔×布赖森（Dayson）’党，滚出我们的标签！”

source: "Our lawyers have screenshots proving the Daysons violated the Peace Accords and distributed Dayson fan art on our land!"
target: “律师手上有截图，证明 Dayson 党违反和平协定，在我们的地盘散发 Dayson 同人图！”

source: "But the Doswalds fucking started it!" a fandom historian argues.
target: “明明是 Doswald 党他妈先动的手！”一位圈史研究者反驳。

source: "Even after the Ship Wars ended, you've sent spies into #Dayson to start drama and weaken us from the inside!"
target: “CP 大战都结束了，你们还往 #Dayson 派间谍挑事，从内部削弱我们！”

source: "Why do Daysons and Doswalds always get the floor?" a juror shouts. "Where's the representation for smaller factions like the Dagans? This is bullshit!"
target: “凭什么每次都是 Dayson 和 Doswald 发言？”一位陪审员喊道，“Dagan 这种小派别的代表权呢？扯什么淡！”

source: "ORDER IN THE COURT!" snaps the judge. "Shipping romanceable NPCs like Daniel and Logan together is stupid. The court only recognizes NPC x PC ships."
target: “肃静！”法官喝道，“丹尼尔和洛根这种可攻略 NPC，嗑他俩有什么意思？本庭只承认 NPC×玩家角色的 CP！”

source: "BUT DANIEL AND LOGAN HAVE SO MUCH IN-GAME CHEMISTRY! CALL MY OTP STUPID AGAIN AND I'LL FUCKING DOXX YOU, YOUR HONOR!"
target: “可丹尼尔跟洛根在游戏里超有火花！再说我本命 CP 蠢，老子就把你个人信息全扒出来，法官大人！”

source: Ugh, all anyone ever does at these things is argue. Why can't we all just enjoy Human Prom peacefully?
target: 唉，这种活动就只会吵架。大家为什么不能和平地喜欢《人类舞会》？

source: Man, I wish everybody would just be friends. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, what can we do to make everyone get along?
target: 真希望大家都能做朋友。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，怎么才能让他们好好相处？

source: "We will educate the next generation of fans in empathy. Upon entering the fandom, there will be a syllabus of mandatory fanfic covering every ship."
target: “教下一代粉丝学会共情。入圈就得按必读书单，看遍所有 CP 的同人文。”
