target: “雪花，”一头牛问，“新政权下，干草真的能随便吃吗？”

source: "Of course!" says Snowflake. "That's the best part about my regime! We won't have to pull ploughs or do any work, and we'll have food aplenty."
target: “当然！”雪花说，“我的政权最棒的就是这点！不用拉犁，不用干任何活，还能吃个饱。”

source: "How is that possible?" asks a concerned horse. "We do need a more equal labor distribution, but everyone will need to do SOME work in order for society to function."
target: “这怎么可能？”一匹忧心的马问，“劳动分配是该更平等，可社会要运转，总得人人都做点活吧。”

source: Snowflake's response is drowned out by someone suddenly WAILING on a grungy electric guitar.
target: 雪花正要回答，突然一阵狂飙的电吉他噪响，把他的声音淹没了。

source: Ugh, you guys are SO BORING. Who needs society when you can say "fuck that noise" and MAKE some noise? Wake up, sheeple!
target: 你们也太无聊了！谁还需要什么社会，喊句“扯什么淡”，直接自己制造噪音不就行了？醒醒吧，绵羊们！

source: "We like what he's saying!" say the sheep, headbanging in unison. "EMBRACE ANARCHY!"
target: “这话我们爱听！”羊群一起甩头，“拥抱无政府！”

source: YEAH! ANARCHYYY!
target: 对！无政府——！

source: "Um, wait, let's not be too hasty," Snowflake says desperately. "I promise a lifetime of free hay AND an enslaved monster to any animal who supports my leadership!"
target: “呃，等等，别急着决定。”雪花急得不行，“谁支持我，就给谁一辈子免费干草，再配一个怪物奴隶！”

source: No one cares. The skunk is drowning out Snowflake's propaganda with loud guitar solos.
target: 没人在乎。臭鼬正用响亮的吉他独奏，盖住雪花的宣传。

source: The skunk puts on the best punk concert you've ever seen... well, maybe not the best, but it's definitely the loudest.
target: 臭鼬办了场你见过最棒的朋克演出……好吧，也许不是最棒，但绝对最响。

source: You gain +N2 SOUL for thwarting an Orwellian plot, but the mosh pit at the concert did a LOT of damage to Jacqueline's barn, and you have to pay -N2 MONEY to fix it.
target: 挫败奥威尔式阴谋，让你获得 +N2 灵魂。不过演出的冲撞区把杰奎琳的谷仓毁得够呛，你得掏 -N2 金钱修理。

source: Oh! That guy is... a choice. Where did you even meet this rabbit, Jacqueline?
target: 哦，这家伙……倒也是种选择。杰奎琳，你到底在哪儿认识这只兔子的？

source: Well, FurCon came through the valley one time, and... yeah, the rest speaks for itself.
target: 嗯，有一次兽迷展来过山谷，然后……是吧，剩下的也就不用说了。

source: It's nice to meet you all. My name's Lester, but in this outfit, I prefer to go by "Rabbix CrimsonSoul".
target: 很高兴认识各位。我叫莱斯特，不过穿这身时，更喜欢叫“拉比克·克林森·苏尔”。

source: I'll do everything in my power to take the pig down. We just need to put our -N2 MIND to it and devise Rabbix's amazing backstory...
target: 我会尽全力扳倒那头猪。只需要大家动动 -N2 头脑，给拉比克编一段绝妙的背景故事……

source: Let's tell the animals I'm a lost prince from the toppled CrimsonSoul Kingdom, here to warn them of the dangers of following corrupt leaders, like my OWN FATHER was!
target: 就说我是已经覆灭的克林森·苏尔王国的落难王子，专程来警告大家，别追随像我亲生父亲那样腐败的领袖！

source: Sounds a little convoluted, but I think the animals will believe it. Go for it!
target: 听着有点绕，不过动物们应该会信。去吧！

source: Great! Also, Rabbix can shoot crimson flames from his palms that turn anything they touch into voluptuous bunnies with breasts. Can I tell them that too?
target: 太好了！还有，拉比克能从手心射出赤红火焰，把碰到的一切变成胸大身材好的兔子。这个也能说吗？

source: Don't push it.
target: 别得寸进尺。

source: For some reason, you send Rabbix in. It's going well for the first two minutes until he tries to do a cartwheel and his head falls off.
target: 不知为何，你们还是派拉比克上场了。头两分钟很顺利，直到他想来个侧手翻，头套掉了。

source: "He's not a real rabbit!" cries Snowflake. "He's an imposter sent here to overthrow me! BESSIE, TRAMPLE THE OUTSIDER!"
target: “他不是真兔子！”雪花喊，“是派来推翻我的冒牌货！贝西，踩死这个外来者！”

source: "But why?" asks Bessie the cow. "He's harmless, and obviously a big fan of animal culture. I'm intrigued by this idea of having a 'fursona.'"
target: “为什么？”奶牛贝西问，“他又没害人，还明显喜欢动物文化。我倒对‘兽设’这个点子挺感兴趣。”

source: "I confess, I've always had... a skinsona. I like to pretend I'm a banshee who's a lawyer by day and a secret ninja at night."
target: “说来惭愧，我一直都有个……皮设。喜欢假装自己是报丧女妖，白天当律师，晚上当秘密忍者。”

source: Oh, Bessie! If you want, I can sew you a banshee costume to wear while I'm milking you in the mornings.
target: 哦，贝西！你想要的话，我可以给你缝件报丧女妖服，早上挤奶时穿。

source: "Um... can we all be a part of this?" Snowflake asks. "Like, can my skinsona be a fallen angel called 'Emperor Snowflake', who everyone fears yet secretly wants to be?"
target: “呃……我们都能参加吗？”雪花问，“比如，我的皮设能不能是个堕天使，叫‘雪花大帝’，大家怕他，却又偷偷想当他？”

source: Fine, as long as these fantasies are strictly hypothetical.
target: 可以，只要这些幻想都停留在幻想里。

source: Hooray, the power of roleplay solved everything! The animals get to live their skinsona dreams, and you gain +N2 SOUL for thwarting an Orwellian plot.
target: 耶，角色扮演的力量解决了一切！动物们能实现皮设梦想，你也因挫败奥威尔式阴谋，获得了 +N2 灵魂。

source: Crows
target: 乌鸦

source: You and your friends wander the farm for a little bit when you run into its owner.
target: 你和朋友们在农场逛了一会儿，遇上了农场主人。

source: Oh, hello there! My name is Jacqueline. What brings you to my farm?
target: 哦，你们好！我叫杰奎琳。怎么来我的农场了？

source: Hi Jacqueline! I'm Scott, and these are my friends Polly and %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. We're on a road trip and we saw the farm and thought, "Let's check it out!"
target: 嗨，杰奎琳！我是斯科特，这是朋友波莉和%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。我们在公路旅行，看到农场，就想：“看看去！”

source: How fun! So do you frequently trespass on strangers' property while you're road-tripping?
target: 真有趣！所以你们公路旅行时，经常擅闯陌生人的地方吗？

source: We don't just trespass, we also meddle! We saw your crops being totally ravaged by crows and thought we could scare them off or something.
target: 我们不光擅闯，还爱管闲事！看到乌鸦把你的庄稼糟蹋成那样，就想帮你赶一赶。

source: Could you? That would be SO nice. I built a scarecrow to protect my crops a few weeks ago, but the crows weren't scared one bit.
target: 真的？那太好了。前几周我做了个稻草人保护作物，可乌鸦一点也不怕。

source: They're immune to all my pesticides, they bribed the sniper I hired to guard the crops, they disarmed my anti-crow force fields... these birds are ruthless!
target: 杀虫剂对它们全没用，雇来守庄稼的狙击手被它们收买，防鸦力场也被它们拆了……这些鸟太狠了！

source: I don't have time to be thwarting crow plots all the time. Running a farm is a LOT of work. I still have so much fishing and mining to get done...
target: 我可没工夫成天挫败乌鸦阴谋。经营农场忙得要命，还有好多鱼要钓、矿要挖……

source: Speaking of which, is it already two o'clock?! I need to sell my artisanal jellies before the farmer's market closes! I'll be right back!
target: 说起来，已经两点了？！得赶在农贸市场关门前，卖掉手工果冻！马上回来！

source: Sounds like Jacqueline has a lot on her plate. Let's surprise her by getting rid of all the crows before she gets back!
target: 杰奎琳事情够多了。趁她回来前，赶走所有乌鸦，给她个惊喜吧！

source: Okay, how are we gonna do that?
target: 好啊，怎么赶？

source: LOL, beats me. But I'm sure %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s got an idea, don't you, boo?
target: 哈哈，我哪知道。不过%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%肯定有主意，对不对，亲爱的？

source: Fear isn't crows' biggest issue nowadays; it's social awkwardness. Corner the farming market by building the first embarrasscrow.
target: 如今乌鸦最大的问题不是害怕，而是社交尴尬。造出首个“社死稻草人”，垄断农业市场！

source: Get some props to disguise the scarecrow as one of the crows' exes, so the whole gang will avoid the vicinity in fear of a touchy situation.
target: 弄点道具，把稻草人扮成某只乌鸦的前任。整群乌鸦为了避免尴尬碰面，都会绕着走。

source: Get inside the crows' minds! Arrange a series of focus groups with some crows in order to "crowsource" the scariest scarecrow ever made.
target: 深入乌鸦内心！办几轮乌鸦调研座谈会，靠“鸦众智慧”，设计史上最吓人的稻草人。

source: You build your prototype with gusto. It's like a normal scarecrow, but it inexplicably reminds you of the time you called your teacher "Mom" in seventh grade. GAG.
target: 你兴冲冲地做出原型。看着跟普通稻草人差不多，却莫名让你想起七年级那次，把老师叫成“妈妈”。呕。

source: I'm back! I've got an hour left to talk to you guys before I need to go fishing; eels only come out during the evening rains. How's the de-crowing going?
target: 回来了！还能陪你们聊一小时，就得去钓鱼，鳗鱼只有晚上下雨才出来。赶鸦赶得怎么样？

source: Check it out, we made an embarrasscrow to ward off the crows with unbearable awkward tension! What do you think?
target: 快看！我们做了个社死稻草人，用让人受不了的尴尬气氛赶乌鸦。你觉得怎么样？

source: I think that that embarrasscrow makes me want to bury myself in a shallow grave and never face my peers again...
target: 我觉得，看着这个社死稻草人，我想把自己埋进浅坑，再也不见人了……

source: So, it looks great!
target: 所以，棒极了！

source: You set up the embarrasscrow. A few crows land on it. Somehow, you can tell they're uncomfortable and can hardly look at each other.
target: 你把社死稻草人立好。几只乌鸦落在上面，不知怎么，看得出它们浑身不自在，连彼此都不敢看。

source: Wow, they actually flew off! I really can't thank you guys enough--
target: 哇，真的飞走了！太谢谢你们——

source: Wait, now they're coming back?
target: 等等，怎么又回来了？

source: They brought coins and shiny rocks to the embarrasscrow! Aww, I think they love him!
target: 它们给社死稻草人带了硬币和亮石头！哎呀，我觉得它们爱上他了！

source: That's bad, Scott. The whole point of the embarrasscrow was to keep the crows AWAY from the crops.
target: 这可不好，斯科特。社死稻草人是为了让乌鸦远离庄稼的。

source: I think I know what's going on. The crows are using the embarrasscrow as a primitive kind of therapy, to help them cope with social awkwardness in a safe setting!
target: 我大概懂了。乌鸦把社死稻草人当成一种原始疗法，在安全的环境里，练习应对社交尴尬！

source: Wow, how can you tell?
target: 哇，你怎么知道？

source: I've been dealing with these crows long enough to know their behavior. It looks like I'll be dealing with them for a while yet... oh, well.
target: 跟这群乌鸦打交道够久，习性也摸清了。看来，还得再跟它们耗一阵……唉，算了。

source: You lose -N2 SOUL for failing to help Jaqueline. At least you can add "crow therapist" to your resume, and all the coins the embarrasscrow earned gives you +N2 MONEY!
target: 没帮到杰奎琳，你失去 -N2 灵魂。至少简历能加上“乌鸦治疗师”，社死稻草人赚来的硬币，也给了你 +N2 金钱！

source: You have to spend -N2 MONEY on a wig, Groucho glasses, and go-go boots for the scarecrow, but it pays off the moment the crows touch down in the field...
target: 你花 -N2 金钱，给稻草人买了假发、格劳乔假鼻子眼镜和戈戈舞长靴。不过乌鸦一落地，这笔钱就值了……

source: "I tell ya what, Creed, I LOVE this restaurant. They have the best salad this side of the valley!"
target: “跟你说，克里德，我爱这餐厅。山谷这一带，沙拉属这儿最好！”

source: "Meh, it's all right. The service is ass. I wish they didn't leave the food all over the ground."
target: “还行吧，服务烂透了。真希望他们别把吃的都扔地上。”

source: "It's probably just some hipster trend thing. I don't care if it's on the ground as long as it's free!"
target: “大概是什么潮人新风尚。反正免费，放地上也无所谓！”

source: The crows start to dig into Jacqueline's cabbages and tomatoes, but then one of them sees your scarecrow.
target: 乌鸦开始大吃杰奎琳的卷心菜和番茄，忽然有一只看见了你的稻草人。

source: "Hey, Craig, look at that freakshow. Back off, buddy! This is OUR brunch spot!"
target: “嘿，克雷格，看那个怪胎。闪边去，老兄！这儿是我们的早午餐地盘！”

source: "SHIT! Don't talk to that guy! That's my ex, Groucho Go-Go!"
target: “操！别跟那家伙说话！那是我前任，格劳乔·戈戈！”

source: "What?! You dated a scarecrow? That's so taboo! What was it like?"
target: “什么？！你跟稻草人谈过？太禁忌了吧！什么感觉？”

source: "It was terrifying and exhilirating all at once. But things didn't end well between me and Groucho, and I do NOT want to run into him today. Can we leave?"
target: “又吓人，又刺激。不过我跟格劳乔闹得不愉快，今天一点都不想碰到他。走吧？”

source: "Eh, fine. Wanna hit up the farm east of the river? I heard they just put up a sexy scarecrow, and you know what they say: one nail drives out another!"
target: “行吧。要不要去河东那家农场？听说刚立了个性感稻草人。不是有句话，忘掉旧爱的最好办法，就是找个新欢嘛！”

source: Wow, you guys actually got rid of them! Thank you SO much.
target: 哇，你们真把它们赶走了！太谢谢了。

source: It was your pleasure! For helping Jacqueline get rid of those crows, you gain +N2 SOUL.
target: 乐意效劳！帮杰奎琳赶走乌鸦，让你获得 +N2 灵魂。

source: Ugh, putting together a focus group sounds like a chore... but if it'll help Jacqueline, I guess it's worth it.
target: 唉，办调研座谈会，听着就累……不过能帮到杰奎琳，应该值得。

source: You lose -N2 HYPE and -N4 MONEY advertising your focus group and offering incentives to participants to join, like free shiny rocks for everyone. Ten crows join your group.
target: 为招募调研参与者打广告，提供免费亮石头之类的奖励，让你失去 -N2 热度，还花掉 -N4 金钱。十只乌鸦加入了小组。

source: Good morning, participants! I'm Dr. Corvimeister, marketing executive of "Crow Masterz Products."
target: 各位参与者，早上好！我是科维迈斯特博士，“乌鸦大师用品”的营销主管。

source: And I'm Crow Scott! CAW, CAW! (That means "hey, bro" in crow!)
target: 我是乌鸦斯科特！嘎，嘎！（乌鸦语的“嘿，兄弟”！）

source: So, tell us: how do you, as crows and consumers of our brand, feel about scarecrows?
target: 说说吧，作为乌鸦，同时也是本品牌的消费者，各位对稻草人怎么看？

source: "SCARECROWS BORING!" caws one participant. "SCARECROWS STUPID!" says another.
target: “稻草人无聊！”一只参与的乌鸦叫道。“稻草人蠢！”另一只说。

source: "Crow has evolved sufficient intelligence to understand scarecrow not a legitimate threat, CAW!" says a third crow, who's using a metal tool to flip you off.
target: “乌鸦进化出足够智慧，知道稻草人没有真正威胁，嘎！”第三只乌鸦说着，拿金属工具给你比了个中指。

source: So -- CAW -- what would you see -- CAW CAW -- as a "legitimate threat?"
target: 那——嘎——什么才算——嘎嘎——“真正的威胁”？

source: "BIG CATS SCARY!" "NO LIKE FLYING INTO GLASS DOORS!"
target: “大猫吓人！”“不喜欢撞玻璃门！”

source: "Am scared of ocean! So vast, so unexplored! What horrible aberrations forgotten by God hide in those murky depths?!"
target: “怕海！这么大，这么多没探索！那些浑浊深处，到底藏着什么被神遗忘的可怕怪物？！”

source: Cool, thanks for the input! We'll definitely NOT put any of the scary stuff you just mentioned into our next product.
target: 好，感谢意见！刚才各位说的那些吓人的东西，绝对不会出现在我们的下一款产品里。

source: WINK! -- I mean, CAW!
target: 眨眼！——我是说，嘎！

source: With the +N2 MIND you gained from your market research, you build the world's perfect scarecrow. When Jacqueline returns, you unveil your creation...
target: 市场调研让你获得 +N2 头脑，也让你造出了世上最完美的稻草人。杰奎琳回来时，你揭开了杰作……

source: A scarecrow with a cat's head and a Kraken's body holding eight panes of glass in its tentacles that spin really fast?
target: 猫脑袋、克拉肯身体，触手各拿一块玻璃，八块玻璃转得飞快的稻草人？

source: ...I LOVE IT!!!
target: ……我爱死它了！！！

source: When the crows see your scarecrow, they fly off looking terrified... and a bit betrayed. But fuck their feelings! Helping Jacqueline granted you +N4 SOUL!
target: 乌鸦一见稻草人，全都吓得飞走……还有点被背叛的感觉。不过谁他妈管它们的感受！帮上杰奎琳，你获得了 +N4 灵魂！

source: Crops
target: 作物

source: You and your friends wander the farm for a little bit when you run into its owner.
target: 你和朋友们在农场逛了一会儿，遇上了农场主人。

source: Hello, strangers! My name's Jacqueline. I just moved into the valley, so I'm still getting to know everyone. What are your names?
target: 陌生人们，你们好！我叫杰奎琳，刚搬来山谷，还在认识大家。你们叫什么？

source: I'm Polly, this good boi here is Scott, and that's %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 我叫波莉，这位好狗狗是斯科特，那是%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。

source: Nice to meet you! You have a really nice farm!
target: 很高兴认识你！农场真不错！

source: Thanks! This farm belonged to my dear grandfather until he passed away.
target: 谢谢！这里原本是亲爱的爷爷的农场，直到他去世。

source: I've always been interested in the rural, cottagecore lifestyle, so I thought I'd try restoring it!
target: 我一直很喜欢田园小屋那种乡村生活，就想试着让农场恢复生机！

source: Sweet! Are you raising cute cows and knitting comfy sweaters and drinking all the homemade apple cider you always dreamed of?
target: 真好！是不是养着可爱奶牛，织着舒服的毛衣，喝着梦寐以求的自酿苹果酒？

source: Well... not exactly. Money's been tight ever since I moved here. My crops haven't really been selling...
target: 嗯……倒也不是。搬来之后，手头一直挺紧的。我种的东西卖不太出去……

source: Why, what's wrong with them?
target: 为什么？作物怎么了？

source: Jacqueline leads you to her crop rows, which are filled with plump, ripe... severed heads.
target: 杰奎琳领你们来到一排排田垄前，种的东西饱满又成熟……全是砍下来的脑袋。

source: Ohhhhh, I get it. I'm having a nightmare! When's the part where all my clothes disappear right before the big game?
target: 哦——懂了，我在做噩梦！接下来是不是该轮到大赛开场前，我衣服突然全没了？

source: Ugh, my home-grown heads are NOT a nightmare! I don't understand why everyone's so freaked out by them!
target: 唉，我自己种的脑袋才不是噩梦！真不懂，大家为什么这么害怕！

source: Monsters and humans are always growing MY people's heads, carving them up for holidays and turning them into pies, and you don't see me complaining... much.
target: 怪物和人类天天种我们族人的脑袋，过节刻着玩，再做成派，也没见我抱怨……多少句啊。

source: I just wanted to bring some of my culture into the valley, but nobody's buying my heads, and now I'm banned from the farmer's market for "traumatizing" the baker's son.
target: 我就想给山谷带点自己的文化，可谁都不买我的脑袋。现在农贸市场还禁止我进去，说我让面包师的儿子“留下了心理阴影”。

source: Chin up, Jacqueline! Or... "stem up," I guess?
target: 抬起头，杰奎琳！或者该说……“抬起瓜蒂”？

source: We'll think of a way to make a profit off these severed heads. What do you suggest, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?

target: 这时，陌生号码打来电话。一定是命运！操，+N2 热度来了！派对搞起来！

source: "Hello? %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?" says the caller. Shit, it's not Fate, it's your mom! She probably wants to lecture you. Incoming -N2 HYPE...
target: “喂？%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%？”来电者说。操，不是命运，是你妈！八成又要说教。预备，-N2 热度……

source: "Sorry to bug you on your road trip, honey, but there's a party coming up that I need you to attend."
target: “亲爱的，抱歉打扰你公路旅行，有个派对，你得来参加。”

source: (YESSSSS! PARTY!!! BREAK OUT THE UP-DRUGS AND THE +N2 HYPE!)
target: （好耶，派对！！！拿出兴奋剂，还有 +N2 热度！）

source: "It's your little cousin's fifth birthday party! It'll be at Chuckle's Cheeseria next Friday. Can you go?"
target: “是你那个小表亲的五岁生日会！下周五，在查克尔芝士屋。能来吗？”

source: (Oh, that's... less yay. Time for the down-drugs and -N2 HYPE.)
target: （哦，这就……没那么耶了。该拿镇静剂和 -N2 热度了。）

source: "Don't worry, it'll be fun. Your aunt's hiring a clown to make balloon animals!"
target: “放心，会好玩的。你阿姨还找了个小丑来做气球动物！”

source: (SUPER YAY! I love balloon animals! They don't die when you forget to feed them! That's +N2 HYPE from me!)
target: （超级耶！我喜欢气球动物！忘了喂，也不会死！我给 +N2 热度！）

source: Well, looks like Hope's prophecy came true, at the very least.
target: 好吧，至少希望女巫的预言成真了。

source: It did! And now your future is filled with joy and balloon animals.
target: 没错！你的未来，现在充满快乐和气球动物。

source: You still lose -N2 SOUL for rigging Hope's reading. It doesn't help that you don't have your mom's phone number saved, either.
target: 不过，给希望女巫的占卜做手脚，还是让你失去 -N2 灵魂。连你妈的号码都没存，也没好到哪儿去。

source: For your future, we have... GASP! The Legendary Blue-Eyes White Dragon Card in mint condition?!
target: 你的未来牌是……天哪！传说中的青眼白龙卡，还是全新品相？！

source: These cards are quite rare. They were used by ancient kings and their court magicians to bring wealth and prosperity into their kingdoms for centuries!
target: 这牌相当罕见。几个世纪以来，古代国王和宫廷法师都用它，为自己的王国带来财富与繁荣！

source: I think the kings also used these cards to battle each other in The Shadow Games or something? I dunno, that's treading too far into nerd territory for me.
target: 国王们好像还用这些牌打什么黑暗游戏？不知道，再往下就超出我的宅知识范围了。

source: Anyway, there's money in your future, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% -- +N2 MONEY, to be precise. I'd like to buy that card from you.
target: 总之，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你的未来有钱赚，准确地说，+N2 金钱。这卡我想买。

source: Uhhh, what are you talking about? This is your card, Hope! Why would you--?
target: 呃，什么？这不是你的牌吗，希望女巫？干吗要——？

source: Cut the bull. I know %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% planted the card to rig the reading. Which was rude, by the way.
target: 少装。我知道%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%偷塞了牌，想操纵占卜。顺便说句，很没礼貌。

source: But you can make it up to me by selling me the dumb card.
target: 不过把这破卡卖给我，就算赔罪了。

source: Fine, that's fair. Hope takes the card reverently in her hands... and rips it in half!
target: 行吧，也算公平。希望女巫虔诚地双手接过卡……撕成两半！

source: NO WAY!
target: 不会吧！

source: HOLY SHIT!
target: 卧槽！

source: NOT THE LEGENDARY BLUE-EYES WHITE DRAGON!
target: 别啊，那可是传说中的青眼白龙！

source: Yeah, I destroyed it. It was too dangerous to even exist. Entire empires have fallen due to the incredible nerdy power this wicked card wields.
target: 没错，我毁了它。光是存在就太危险了。这张邪恶的卡，蕴含惊人的死宅力量，曾让整个帝国崩塌。

source: Wait... who the fuck are you?
target: 等等……你他妈谁啊？

source: Who, me? I just like to join in when people scream dramatically. It's fun.
target: 我？就喜欢别人戏剧性地大喊时，跟着凑个热闹。好玩。

source: Ah, okay.
target: 啊，行吧。

source: Still, not cool, Hope!
target: 不过，希望女巫，这还是太不厚道了！

source: Well, that power was fun while it lasted, you suppose. You still lose -N2 SOUL for rigging the reading.
target: 行吧，那股力量还在的时候，至少挺好玩。你仍然因为操纵占卜，失去 -N2 灵魂。

source: Now, for your future, we have... whoa, the +4 Tarot Card! Okay, that means you get an additional four-card spread.
target: 你的未来牌是……哇，塔罗加四牌！好，你可以再来一组四张牌阵。

source: First up, we have... the Death Card.
target: 第一张是……死神。

source: SCORE! More ghosts for the group!
target: 赚了！队里又能多几个鬼！

source: Don't be so literal. The Death Card doesn't mean you're going to die. It represents change: things coming to an end, and new things beginning.
target: 别光按字面理解。死神牌不是说你会死，而是代表改变：旧事终结，新事开始。

source: Next up, the Five of Cups reversed. This represents a paradox of interest. What at first seems like a bad choice or situation will work out well for you in the end.
target: 接着是圣杯五逆位，代表一种有趣的悖论。乍看是坏选择、坏处境，最终却会对你有利。

source: Like dying, for example!
target: 比如死掉！

source: For Goddess' sake, Polly, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% is NOT gonna die!
target: 看在女神的份上，波莉，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%不会死！

source: Your next card is... The Tower.
target: 下一张牌是……高塔。

source: It represents... uh... actually, let's just skip that one.
target: 代表……呃……其实，跳过这张吧。

source: Your last card is the Twin Outfits card. It means in the near future, someone is gonna wear the same outfit as you to a party and it'll be awkward.
target: 最后一张是撞衫牌。意思是近期你去派对，有人会跟你穿同一套衣服，特别尴尬。

source: Poor %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. That's so embarrassing. You know what I bet you'd rather do than that? DIE.
target: 可怜的%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，太丢人了。碰上这种事，知道你可能更想干什么吗？去死。

source: Not so fast! You reach into your pocket and present Hope with your surprise trump card... THE TAROT REVERSE CARD!
target: 别急！你往口袋一摸，掏出秘密王牌，亮给希望女巫看……塔罗反转牌！

source: NANI?!
target: 纳尼？！

source: WHOA!
target: 哇！

source: HOLY SHIT!
target: 卧槽！

source: What have you done?! The Tarot-Reverse means that this whole reading applies to ME now!
target: 你干了什么？！塔罗反转，代表刚才整套占卜，现在都算到我头上了！

source: Oh no, poor Hope! She's gonna be so upset when she goes to a party and someone is wearing the same dress as her!
target: 不好，可怜的希望女巫！去派对跟人撞裙子，肯定会伤心的！

source: THAT ISN'T THE CARD I'M WORRIED ABOUT! Just get out of my tent, all of you!
target: 我担心的不是那张牌！全都给我滚出帐篷！

source: Welp, you lost -N2 SOUL for rigging Hope's reading. But you gained +N2 MAGIC for messing with the threads of destiny.
target: 行吧，操纵希望女巫的占卜，让你失去 -N2 灵魂；不过拨弄命运之线，也让你获得了 +N2 魔力。

source: Séance
target: 降灵会

source: Given that one of your own road-trippers is a ghost herself, you're curious what a séance might entail...
target: 毕竟旅伴里就有个女鬼，你挺好奇降灵会到底是怎么回事……

source: Welcome to Hope Halko's Tent of the Great Beyond! I can foresee your future; I can plunder your past; I can even--!
target: 欢迎来到希望女巫·哈尔科的彼岸帐篷！我能预见未来，挖掘往昔，甚至还能——！

source: Wait, Polly? Scott? %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? Ugh, you're not dumb tourists; you're just dumb. What are you doing at my side hustle?
target: 等等，波莉？斯科特？%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%？唉，原来不是傻游客，就是傻。跑我做副业的地方来干吗？

source: Checkin' shit out! Your sign outside says you can do a séance. Is that true?
target: 随便看看呗！外面的牌子说能办降灵会，真的？

source: Yeah, it's true. My otherworldly powers can bridge the gaps between the realms.
target: 真的。我的超凡之力，可以沟通不同界域。

source: What realms, exactly?
target: 具体是哪些界域？

source: What's a realm?
target: 什么叫界域？

source: I dunno. THE realms. I can connect to, like, the spirit realm I guess?
target: 不知道，反正就是那些界。应该能接通灵界之类的吧？

source: Why would you need a séance for that? Wouldn't a phone work?
target: 那为什么非得降灵？打电话不行？

source: Not if it's the spirits.
target: 对灵魂就不行。

source: I bet they have a weird country code or something.
target: 肯定是有什么奇怪的国家区号。

source: That's not it. Look, I don't have time to do a whole worldbuilding explanation right now, but just trust me when I say this séance is a cool and fun thing to pay me to do.
target: 不是这回事。听着，我现在没时间给你们讲整套世界观。相信我，付钱请我办降灵会，又酷又好玩就对了。

source: Well, I like spirits, and I AM a spirit, and I am indeed very cool and fun. So contacting other spirits would probably be cool too. Let's do it.
target: 我喜欢鬼，我自己就是鬼，确实又酷又好玩。那联系其他鬼，应该也挺酷的。来吧。

source: I'm sold! I love following the crowd and being cool!
target: 我信了！我喜欢随大流，也喜欢酷酷的！

source: Glad you're convinced. Just give me -N2 MONEY and the name of the spirit you wanna call, and I'll do my best to connect you.
target: 很高兴说服了你们。给我 -N2 金钱，说个想联系的灵魂，我尽量接通。

source: Instead of annoying random ghosts with unsolicited calls, call the spirit who REALLY wants to hear from you: Polly's mom.
target: 别给陌生鬼打骚扰电话。联系一个真正想听见你声音的灵魂：波莉的妈妈。

source: Contact the part of you that died the day Burger Queen discontinued its delicious Salsa Sauce.
target: 联系你灵魂中死去的那一部分：汉堡女王停产美味莎莎酱那天，就死掉的那部分。

source: Oh, sure. We can call my mom. I haven't seen her since we left for the road trip, so it'll be nice to catch up.
target: 哦，好啊，可以找我妈。上路后就没见过她了，正好聊聊天。

source: Hope connects you all to Polly's mom, Nadja Geist. Nadja's voice comes from Hope's mouth:
target: 希望女巫接通了波莉的妈妈，娜佳·鬼斯特。娜佳的声音从希望女巫嘴里传来：

source: Hi, sweetie! Hi, Scott! Wow, I've never been contacted via séance before; you usually just call me. This is so exotic!
target: 嗨，宝贝！嗨，斯科特！哇，第一次有人用降灵会联系我。平常你都直接打电话，真新鲜！

source: Hi, Mrs. Geist! Thanks for packing me some graveyard cookies for the road trip. I loved the chocolate-and-bone-chip ones!
target: 鬼斯特太太，你好！谢谢你给我装了墓地饼干，带着路上吃。我最喜欢巧克力骨头碎那款！

source: I'm so glad! How's the trip going? Are you kids staying out of trouble?
target: 真高兴你喜欢！旅行怎么样？孩子们，没惹麻烦吧？

source: Nope! But when do I ever?
target: 惹了！我哪次不惹呀？

source: Yes, you've always had that wild streak in you. Just try not to do TOO many drugs, please? At least, not all at once?
target: 是啊，你从小就野。就是别嗑太多药，好吗？至少……别全混着一起嗑？

source: I know you're a young adult now -- and, technically, you will be forever -- but I still worry because I love you, and you'll always be my little girl.
target: 我知道你长大了，已经是年轻大人——严格来说，也会永远这么年轻——可我爱你，总会担心。你永远是我的小女孩。

source: I know, Mom. I love you too. I appreciate how much you care about me while still letting me be myself. I promise, I won't die twice.
target: 我知道，妈妈。我也爱你。谢谢你这么关心我，又愿意让我做自己。我保证，不会再死一回。

source: Oh, by the way, I texted you my move earlier. "Rook to E5."
target: 哦，对了，我刚发短信告诉你，我走哪步了。“车到 E5。”

source: Oh, I do love our chess-by-SMS matches! I'll send you my move as soon as we hang up the witch. Goodbye, sweetie! Goodbye, Scott!
target: 哦，最喜欢咱们用短信下棋了！把女巫挂断后，我就把下一步发过去。宝贝再见，斯科特再见！

source: Byyyyyye Mrs. Geist!
target: 鬼斯特太太，再——见！

source: Well, that was sweeter than one of Nadja's delicious graveyard cookies! You gained +N2 SOUL checking in on Polly's mom.
target: 这比娜佳那些美味墓地饼干还甜！跟波莉妈妈聊聊家常，让你获得 +N2 灵魂。

source: I remember Salsa Sauce! Burger Queen released it for a two-week period in 2015 to promote the then-new animated movie "Salsa Baby." It was delicious!
target: 莎莎酱我记得！二〇一五年，汉堡女王为宣传刚上映的动画片《莎莎宝贝》，限时卖了两周。可好吃了！

source: How can you remember details like that, but you can't even pass a test on werewolf anatomy?
target: 这些细节记得那么清楚，狼人解剖学考试却过不了？

source: I can pass that test! The anatomy of a werewolf is "fur, snoot, chompers, heart of gold, bottomless stomach, tail!"
target: 我过得了！狼人构造就是“毛毛、鼻头、大牙、金子般的心、无底胃，还有尾巴”！

source: ...Sure, whatever you say.
target: ……好，你说什么就是什么。

source: SPIRIT OF %CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%'S SALSA-SAUCE-BOUND SOUL, COME FORTH!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%那与莎莎酱相连的魂灵，现身吧！

source: "Whoa," says the spirit Hope summoned. "Am I looking at... myself? In the flesh? And so... empty inside? You must be what remains alive of %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!"
target: “哇。”希望女巫召来的灵魂说，“这是……我本人？活生生的？心里还这么……空虚？你就是%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%还活着的那部分吧！”

source: Wuddup, Ghost of Sauces Past? I see you brought some ephemeral chicken nuggets and Salsa Sauce packets to the séance.
target: 嗨，往日酱灵！看到你带了灵体鸡块和莎莎酱包，来参加降灵会。

source: "Yup. When Salsa Sauce got discontinued, it got sent to the spirit realm. Discontinuation is basically the 'death' of material goods, so..."
target: “对。莎莎酱停产，就被送进了灵界。停产基本就是物品的‘死亡’，所以……”

source: DOES THAT MEAN YOU HAVE SALSA SAUCE WITH YOU THAT WE CAN EAT?!
target: 就是说，你真带了能给我们吃的莎莎酱？！

source: "If Hope's clairvoyance is strong enough to manifest them in the material realm, then yes, I can share some!"
target: “只要希望女巫的通灵能力够强，能让它们在物质世界显形，当然可以分点！”

source: HOPE! This is the most important play of your psychic career! You HAVE to be the perfect vessel for this sauce!
target: 希望女巫！这可是你通灵生涯最重要的一战！一定要当好这酱的完美容器！

source: Ugh, what a waste of my talents...
target: 唉，真是大材小用……

source: Hope brings the Salsa Sauce into the physical realm, and it truly is delicious enough to die for! You gain +N2 STAMINA.
target: 希望女巫把莎莎酱带进现实，真是好吃到死！你获得 +N2 体力。

source: Bucking bulls
target: 骑公牛

source: You approach the rodeo announcers and say you want to try riding a bull.
target: 你走到牛仔竞技赛主持人面前，说想试试骑牛。

source: "Okay," they say, "do you want a mechanical bull or an ACTUAL bull?"
target: “行，”他们说，“机械牛，还是真公牛？”

source: Real bull! Do whatever's the most dangerous and the least sensible!
target: 真牛！怎么危险、怎么没道理，就怎么来！

source: "Unsensibly dangerous, coming right up! %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, come to the stage! Your friends can watch from the stands."
target: “危险又没道理，马上安排！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，上场！朋友们在看台上等着就行。”

source: "WELCOME TO THE RODEO, EVERYBODY! Today we've got only the roughest, toughest, sweatiest bulls and bull-riders, starting with %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!"
target: “各位，欢迎来到牛仔竞技赛！今天，公牛和骑手，都是最野、最硬、最汗流浃背的！先从%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%开始！”

source: Go %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! Go for the win! Say, how DO you win at this sport?
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，加油！拿下冠军！话说，这运动到底怎么才算赢？

source: Usually a winner is declared when the bull is exhausted or when the rider needs emergency spinal surgery. Whichever comes first.
target: 一般等牛累趴了，或者骑手得赶紧送去做脊椎手术了，就宣布胜者。哪个先来算哪个。

source: "Now, y'all know our rodeo's a bit different. We don't like exhausting poor animals just for our enjoyment. We like a bull-man who can consent to entertain you fine folks!"
target: “各位都知道，我们的比赛不太一样。可不喜欢为了取乐，把可怜动物累坏。我们喜欢自愿为各位献艺的牛头人！”

source: "So give it up for the king of shattering the dreams and pelvises of bull-riders everywhere: MOOOOOOOORTY THE MINOTAUUUUUR!"
target: “掌声欢迎，粉碎天下骑牛者梦想与骨盆的王者——牛头人，莫——蒂——！”

source: What's up, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? Ready to ride this bare back into oblivion?
target: 嘿，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。准备骑上这赤裸的背，一路骑到忘乎所以了吗？

source: I see that look in your eyes. You don't know if you should be terrified or aroused. I call it "going horny with fear."
target: 看你那眼神，都不知道该害怕还是该兴奋了。我管这叫“吓到发情”。

source: You should be horny-afraid! It'll be a real challenge to ride ME. It's hard, it's rough, and it takes more fortitude than a Spartan in battle. And that's just the foreplay.
target: 就该又怕又想要！骑我可是大挑战，又硬又粗暴，比斯巴达战士上阵还考验毅力。这还只是前戏。

source: YOU GOT THIS, %CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%! Just establish a safeword, like "AHHHHH GET ME OFF THIS FUCKING BULL!"
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%，你可以的！先约好安全词，比如“啊啊啊，快让我从这他妈的牛身上下去”！

source: You absolutely do not got this, but you can't back down now! You just need the right strategy to come out on top (heehee). How do you ride Morty?
target: 你完全不可以。不过也没法退缩了！得想对策略，才能稳占上位，嘻嘻。怎么骑莫蒂？

source: Whoa, maybe it's too soon to ride Morty? You barely know each other! Maybe you can just get lunch and take it slow?
target: 哇，这么快就骑莫蒂，太着急了吧？还不怎么认识呢。先吃顿午饭，慢慢来？

source: Set the right mood with suggestive music and lighting, while also wearing appropriate rodeo leather. Then you'll be ready for a wild ride!
target: 用暧昧音乐和灯光营造气氛，再穿上合适的牛仔皮装。这样就能来场狂野骑行！

source: Brew a performance-enhancing tantric potion so you and Morty can transcend flesh and ride for hours into a deeper journey you'll never forget.
target: 调一剂提升表现的密宗魔药，和莫蒂一起超越肉体，骑上几个小时，深入一场毕生难忘的旅程。

source: I'm fine with that! I love riding and being ridden, and doing it at any pace is enjoyable. Let's take this niiiice and slooooow.
target: 我没意见！我喜欢骑，也喜欢被骑，快慢都好玩。咱们就好——好——慢——慢——来。

source: You and Morty sit down for a refreshing midday meal. He orders a slab of ribs and a pre-workout shake.
target: 你和莫蒂坐下，吃顿提神的午餐。他点了大块排骨和一杯训练前奶昔。

source: I know, big lunch. But I gotta keep my protein up! You don't get gains like these with weight training and HIIT pelvic workouts alone.
target: 我知道，午饭吃得多。不过蛋白质得跟上！光靠举铁和高强度间歇骨盆训练，可长不出这身肌肉。

source: So, what got you interested in bull-riding? Money? Fame? The adrenaline of straddling a bucking animal with nothing but the power of your thighs to save you?
target: 怎么会对骑牛感兴趣？钱？名气？还是跨在狂蹦的动物身上，只能靠大腿保命的刺激感？

source: Polly volunteering me for it, mostly.

source: WOOOOO! Okay, I'm ready to investigate! I'm, like, so ready I can hear my fucking PULSE! Wait I don't even have one HAHAHA THAT'S SO FUNNY!
target: 呜呼！准备好查案了！准备得连他妈自己的脉搏都听见了！等等，我根本没脉搏，哈哈哈，好好笑！

source: Polly, look, there's a phone on the ground! Let's check the photos on it. Maybe your superpowered Sherlock brain will see a clue!
target: 波莉，看，地上有手机！看看照片。没准你那超级福尔摩斯脑袋，能看出线索！

source: The last photos on the phone are of the cloudy sky above the village. You see a weird electrical storm brewing in one of the pics.
target: 手机最后几张照片，拍的是村庄上空的阴云。其中一张里，奇怪的雷暴正在酝酿。

source: Fuck yeah. Fuckyeahfuckyeahfuckyeah this is so promising oh my God are my teeth VIBRATING? Weeeeeird.
target: 操好耶，好耶好耶好耶，太有戏了，我的天，我牙齿在震？好——怪。

source: WAIT, FORGET THE DUMB PHOTOS! Look at this phone! Something's off about it!
target: 等等，别管蠢照片了！看手机！有问题！

source: You're right! The case is cracked. Maybe that means there was foul play?
target: 对啊，手机壳破了。会不会是有人下过黑手？

source: No, forget the crack. Look at the ugly color scheme on this case! Mauve with olive-green stripes? Gross! I could do SO MUCH BETTER.
target: 不，别管裂缝。看这破手机壳的配色！藕紫色配橄榄绿条纹？恶心！我设计肯定好多了。

source: Polly grabs some markers and starts drawing a better phone case. The vibrant colors! The amazing design! The breakdancing stick-figure! Polly's a natural!
target: 波莉抓起彩笔，开始给手机壳画新设计。色彩真鲜艳！设计真绝妙！还有跳霹雳舞的火柴人！天生就是吃这碗饭的！

source: You're right, I sooo am! I should design phone cases professionally! I'll make us millions in no time, and then we can use those millions to buy MORE NOSE CANDY!
target: 没错，我就是！应该专职设计手机壳！分分钟赚几百万，再拿那几百万，买更多鼻糖！

source: You're right, I sooo am! I should design phone cases professionally! I'll make us millions in no time, and then we can use those millions to buy MORE COCAINE!
target: 没错，我就是！应该专职设计手机壳！分分钟赚几百万，再拿那几百万，买更多可卡因！

source: OF COURSE! It's all so obvious now. You've been wasting time on prom or summer camp or road trips when the answer all along was building a phone case empire!
target: 当然！全想明白了。舞会、夏令营、公路旅行，全是浪费时间！答案一直都是，建立手机壳帝国！

source: Fuck yeah, let's DO THIS! %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, do you know anything about designing a website or running an online marketplace?
target: 操，就这么干！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，会设计网站、开网店吗？

source: IT CAN'T BE THAT HARD! You excitedly Boogle "howw to dsegin websit", ready to build your fortunes.
target: 能有多难！你兴奋地打开 Boogle，搜索“怎摸设技网战”，准备发家致富。

source: What's going on over here? I thought you guys left already.
target: 干什么呢？还以为你们已经走了。

source: HAHAHAHAHAHA! You underestimated us, Joy, but we proved you wrong! We were TOTALLY capable of being millionaire phone-case designers!
target: 哈哈哈哈！乔伊，你小看我们，可我们证明了自己！我们完全有能力，成为身家百万的手机壳设计师！

source: ...What?
target: ……什么？

source: Woohoo! You definitely cracked the case -- the PHONE case! You lose -N2 STAMINA being coked-up and hyper, but you gain +N2 MIND.
target: 好耶！案子没破，手机壳倒是破了！嗑药嗑得过度亢奋，让你失去 -N2 体力，不过也获得了 +N2 头脑。

source: Go wild
target: 放肆撒欢

source: Who cares where the population went? It's an empty village! You can go hog wild!
target: 谁在乎村民去哪儿了？整个村子都空了！你们可以尽情撒欢！

source: Please don't go hog wild. I'm trying to investigate what happened to the missing villagers, and I really don't need you guys tampering with any crime scenes.
target: 拜托，别撒欢了。我在调查村民失踪的事，真不需要你们去破坏犯罪现场。

source: Oh, Joy. Poor, poor Joy. Will there ever come a day that you're not such a wet blanket?
target: 哎呀，乔伊。可怜的乔伊。你就不能有一天，别这么扫兴吗？

source: I am NOT a wet blanket. I can have fun! I'm just busy right now!
target: 我才不扫兴！我也会玩！只是现在很忙！

source: So busy that you can't ride bikes around the industrial plant with us?
target: 忙到连跟我们在工厂里骑自行车都不行？

source: Or sneak into an R-rated movie without buying a ticket?
target: 或者不买票，偷偷溜进去看R级电影？

source: Or raid an abandoned ice cream truck and eat so many blue raspberry popsicles your pee is blue for a week?
target: 或者洗劫一辆废弃的冰淇淋车，把蓝树莓冰棒吃个够，吃到尿都蓝一整个星期？

source: That's your idea of fun? Are you eight years old?
target: 这就是你们觉得好玩的事？你们才八岁吗？

source: Whatever. More fun for us!
target: 随便。正好我们自己玩得更开心！

source: HEY! Stop egging cop cars, you guys! I understand the sentiment, but I need to concentrate on my investigation!
target: 喂！你们别拿鸡蛋砸警车了！我理解你们的心情，可我得集中精力调查！

source: Seriously, Polly? You're gonna write "JOY SUX" in the egg yolk? Real mature.
target: 不是吧，波莉？还要用蛋黄写“乔伊逊毙了”？可真成熟。

source: You know, if there's an evil villain here making populations vanish, I might be the only witch powerful enough to stop it! You're being really rude preventing me from--!
target: 要是真有邪恶反派在这里让村民消失，我可能是唯一有能力阻止他的女巫！你们这么妨碍我，实在太——！

source: Oh no, I knocked out Joy with my egg! She was supposed to catch it with her hands, not her forehead!
target: 糟了，我的鸡蛋把乔伊打晕了！她该用手接，不是用额头接啊！

source: Oh well, she was being lame anyway. But I'm bored now. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, got any suggestions for what we can do with this empty town?
target: 算了，反正她也挺扫兴。不过我现在无聊了。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，这空荡荡的小镇，你有什么玩法建议？

source: You're in a "village alone," which is quite close to "Home Alone." Fill the village with wacky booby traps so hijinks will ensue when the villagers get back.
target: 既然现在是“小村当家”，那离《小鬼当家》也不远了。在村里装满稀奇古怪的机关，等村民回来，就有好戏看了！

source: Run for mayor. You actually have a chance of winning now!
target: 竞选市长。现在，你真有机会赢了！

source: YAAASSSSS! A Prank Masterz takeover of the whole town! It'll be legendary!
target: 好耶——！恶作剧大师接管整座小镇！这下要名垂青史了！

source: Let's put confetti cannons along the streets! When everyone's driving home, it'll feel like a parade!
target: 在街道两边装上彩纸礼炮吧！大家开车回家时，简直像在参加游行！

source: Great idea! And we can release a herd of alpacas in the mall. I've had an alpaca herd on backorder for ages, just for an occasion like this!
target: 好主意！还可以往商场里放一群羊驼。我早就下单订了一群，只是一直没货，等的就是这种机会！

source: Yeah! And... and... let's replace all the butter with margarine! They won't be able to believe it's not butter!
target: 对！还有……还有……把黄油全换成人造黄油！他们绝对不敢相信，那居然不是黄油！

source: STELLAR prank. Ooh, and let's dig a pit behind the front door of every house and fill that pit with snakes!
target: 这恶作剧绝了。哦，还可以在每家正门后头挖个坑，里面装满蛇！

source: When people come home, they'll be all, "Hum de dum, I'm walking inside now, nothing suspicious -- AHHHH! A PIT FULL OF SNAKES!" Classic!
target: 大家回家时，就会这样：“哼哼哼，我进屋啦，没什么可疑的——啊啊啊！一坑的蛇！”经典！

source: Three weeks later, when you turn on the news...
target: 三周后，你打开新闻……

source: "In breaking news, the residents of Hopsville are finally returning after they were unexpectedly evacuated during a severe weather event."
target: “突发消息：霍普斯维尔的居民在一场恶劣天气中被紧急疏散，如今终于开始返家。”

source: "We're going live to Linus Roosevelt, a resident who lost everything in the storm, returning home for the first time."
target: “下面连线莱纳斯·罗斯福。他在风暴中失去了一切，如今正第一次重返家园。”

source: "Thanks, Susanna. After everything my family and I endured, it's a relief to walk through my front door and--"
target: “谢谢，苏珊娜。我和家人吃了这么多苦，终于能走进自家大门，真是松了口气——”

source: "AHHHH! A PIT FULL OF SNAKES! O CRUEL FATE, HAVEN'T I SUFFERED ENOUGH?!"
target: “啊啊啊！一坑的蛇！残酷的命运啊，我受的苦还不够吗？！”

source: LOL, so classic. You gain +N2 HYPE for your shenanigans, but you lose -N2 SOUL (the side effect of every great prank).
target: 哈哈，太经典了。你靠胡闹获得了+N2 HYPE，却失去了-N2 SOUL（每场伟大恶作剧的副作用）。

source: Hey, great idea! It'll be fun to be mayor. It's like being the sports captain of a whole city!
target: 嘿，好主意！当市长肯定很好玩，就像当一整座城市的运动队长！

source: Umm, I'm pretty sure %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% wants ME to be the mayor, silly. I'd legalize every drug! And most forms of vandalism!
target: 呃，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%想让我当市长才对吧，傻瓜。我会让所有毒品合法化！还有大部分破坏公物的行为！

source: Does that mean you're gonna run against me? I don't mind some friendly competition!
target: 那你要跟我竞选？我不介意来场友好的比赛！

source: Oh, it is ON. I'm sure I can get %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% to vote for me! A vote for Polly is a vote for this BOOTY!
target: 哦，那就来吧。我肯定能让%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%投我！投波莉一票，就是投这翘臀一票！

source: Well, a vote for Scott is a vote for Scott! And a vote for Scott would make me really happy!
target: 那投斯科特一票，就是投斯科特一票！而且，投斯科特一票，斯科特会特别开心！

source: Polly and Scott spend -N2 MONEY putting together their campaigns -- slogans, advertisements, rallies, the works.
target: 波莉和斯科特花了-N2 MONEY，张罗起各自的竞选活动——口号、广告、集会，一应俱全。

source: It's a little much since you're the only impartial voter, but whatever floats their election parade floats.
target: 你是唯一中立的选民，他们却搞这么大阵仗，实在有点过头。不过，他们的竞选，他们开心就好。

source: When election time comes about two hours later, you have Joy count the ballots to make sure it's fair.
target: 大约两个小时后，选举开始了。为了确保公平，你让乔伊负责计票。

source: I can't believe you guys are making me count ballots with a concussion.
target: 真不敢相信，我都脑震荡了，你们还让我数选票。

source: Anyway, Scott got one vote, and Polly got two. Congrats, Polly.
target: 总之，斯科特一票，波莉两票。恭喜，波莉。

source: YAAASSS! I knew %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% would vote for me! You're a peach, babe.
target: 好耶！我就知道%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%会投我！宝贝，你真好。

source: Actually, I voted for Scott. I've always wanted to see a dog mayor in person!
target: 其实，我投的是斯科特。我一直想亲眼见见狗狗市长！

source: Wait, but that means... Scott, did you vote for me? Why didn't you vote for yourself?
target: 等等，那就是说……斯科特，你投我了？为什么不投你自己？

source: Because you wanted to be mayor, and I thought it'd make you happy! I'm just glad to be included.
target: 因为你想当市长啊，我觉得这样能让你开心！能让我参与，我就已经很高兴了。

source: Awwww, that's so sweet! You know what, buddy? You can be mayor. You deserve it.
target: 嗷，太暖心了！伙计，你知道吗？你来当市长吧，你值得。

source: Hooray! My first act as mayor is declaring EVERYONE mayor! Let's share the love!
target: 万岁！我当市长后的第一件事，就是宣布人人都是市长！一起分享这份爱吧！

source: Does that include me? If so, my first decree as co-mayor is to make it illegal for you guys to interfere with my investigation. So, skedaddle.
target: 也包括我吗？那我作为联合市长，颁布的第一条法令，就是禁止你们妨碍我的调查。所以，赶紧走人。

source: Can't argue with that, sadly. But you still gain +N2 HYPE for winning the election, and now you can add "mayor" to the "Previous Careers" section of your resume!
target: 可惜，这还真没法反驳。不过，赢得选举还是让你获得了+N2 HYPE，现在还能在简历的“过往职业”一栏填上“市长”！

source: Attend the kids' tour
target: 参加儿童导览

source: O...kay? You and your friends attend the kids' tour instead of checking out any of the more age-appropriate options at this museum.
target: 呃……好吧？你们放着博物馆里那些更适合自己年龄的项目不选，偏偏参加了儿童导览。

source: "Hiya, kids!" says the tour guide. "Today we're learning about the wonderful world of wigs. If you answer my questions right during the tour, you get a gold star!"
target: 导览员说：“小朋友们好呀！今天我们要一起探索奇妙的假发世界。参观时，谁答对了我的问题，谁就能拿到一颗金星！”

source: WOOHOO! Gold stars! I love positive reinforcement that makes me feel smart!
target: 呜呼！金星！我就喜欢这种能让我觉得自己很聪明的表扬！

source: "Look at this wig. It's an Egyptian pharaoh's wig from thousands of years ago! Does anyone know why the Egyptians wore wigs?"
target: “看看这顶假发。这可是几千年前埃及法老戴过的！有谁知道埃及人为什么戴假发吗？”

source: To avoid sunburn, insect bites, and male-pattern baldness!
target: 为了防晒、防虫咬，还有遮住男性谢顶的脑袋！

source: Says it right there on the sign, dumb-dumb! Man, this competition is easy!
target: 旁边的牌子上不都写着嘛，笨蛋！这比赛也太简单了！

source: "It isn't a competition... but fine, here's your gold star."
target: “这不是比赛……算了，给你一颗金星。”

source: "Now, look at this wig, kids. It was worn by a judge in the UK! Can anyone tell me the fastest way to become a judge in the UK?"
target: “小朋友们，再看看这顶。这是英国法官戴的假发！谁能告诉我，怎样才能最快成为英国法官？”

source: ME ME ME!!! The fastest way to be a judge is to steal another man's powdered wig! We're gonna win this, Polly!
target: 我我我！！！最快的办法就是偷走别人的扑粉假发！波莉，咱们赢定了！

source: The tour continues. Polly and Scott rack up stars. But by the end, they're tied with another participant...
target: 参观继续，波莉和斯科特拿了一颗又一颗金星。可到了最后，两人的分数却跟另一名参与者持平……

source: Little Bobby. Little fuckin' Bobby. Scott, we gotta take that whiz kid down if we want the grand prize!
target: 小鲍比。小他妈的鲍比。斯科特，想拿大奖，咱们就得干掉这个小神童！

source: "And that's the end of the tour!" says the guide. "Aren't wigs fascinating, kids? Who knows what wigs will be like in the future?"
target: “今天的参观到此结束！”导览员说，“小朋友们，假发是不是很有意思呀？谁知道未来的假发会是什么样呢？”

source: PICK ME! PICK ME! I think wigs will, uh... give people the ability to understand poetry!
target: 叫我！叫我！我觉得假发会，呃……让人看懂诗！

source: "Shut up, you two!" the guide snaps. "The tour is OVER! It was just a rhetorical question, anyway!"
target: 导览员忍无可忍：“你们两个给我闭嘴！参观已经结束了！刚才那句只是设问，没让你们答！”

source: A rhetoriwhat question?
target: 设什么问？

source: Rhetorical, which means this question is worth DOUBLE POINTS!
target: 设问，就是这题分数翻倍的意思！

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, help us answer the question right and kick Bobby's diapered ass!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，快帮我们答对这题，把鲍比那裹着尿布的小屁股踢出局！

source: You don't know the answer because there is no answer. But there are other ways to eliminate Bobby from the competition...
target: 你不知道答案，因为这题根本就没答案。不过，想让鲍比出局，还有别的办法……

source: Plant some drugs in Bobby's pockets and frame him for doping for this competition.
target: 往鲍比口袋里塞点毒品，诬陷他靠嗑药参赛。

source: Bribe Bobby with the one thing his parents (and the law) have denied him all these years: a taxi license.
target: 拿一件他爸妈和法律多年来都不肯给他的东西贿赂鲍比：出租车驾驶执照。

source: You want to plant drugs on a toddler? Isn't that kinda--
target: 你要往一个小宝宝身上栽毒品？这是不是有点——

source: GENIUS! IT'S GENIUS! WE MUST ELIMINATE THE LITTLE FUCKER BY ANY MEANS NECESSARY!
target: 天才！简直是天才！必须不择手段，把这个小混蛋淘汰掉！

source: "Hey, what are you doing in my son's pockets?!" screams Bobby's mother.
target: 鲍比的妈妈尖叫起来：“喂！你在我儿子口袋里翻什么？！”

source: I'm fighting on the front lines of the war on drugs, bitch! Look what I found!
target: 老娘正在禁毒战争的第一线奋战呢，贱人！瞧瞧我找到了什么！

source: I knew there was no way Little Bobby was winning this competition without a little "help".
target: 我就知道，小鲍比要是没靠点“小手段”，怎么可能赢得了这场比赛。

source: "You put that in there!" the mom accuses. "How would a toddler even get his hands on acid?!"
target: 他妈妈指责道：“明明就是你塞进去的！一个小宝宝上哪儿弄迷幻药去？！”

source: "Ma'am, why would anyone even dope with acid?" the tour guide asks exasperatedly. "Hallucinogens don't enhance performance."
target: 导览员气恼地说：“女士，谁会拿迷幻药来作弊啊？致幻剂又不能提高比赛成绩。”

source: Well DUH, but Bobby's a little kid, he doesn't know better! It's the intent that counts! Throw Bobby out of the competition!
target: 这还用你说！可鲍比还是个小孩，他哪懂这些！关键是他有这个心！把鲍比赶出比赛！

source: "There is no competition! These drugs are obviously yours, ma'am. I'm calling security."
target: “根本就没有比赛！女士，这些毒品明显是你的。我叫保安了。”

source: THIS IS BULLSHIT! I HOPE YOU'RE FUCKING HAPPY, BOBBY!
target: 扯他妈的淡！鲍比，你这下他妈的满意了吧！

source: Do you feel all smart with your gold stars?! I'LL KILL YOU IN YOUR FUCKING CRIB! We'll see how much your wig knowledge matters then!
target: 拿了几颗金星，就觉得自己聪明了？！老娘要让你死在婴儿床里！到时候看看你那点假发知识还能顶什么用！

source: You're all dragged out of the wig museum.
target: 你们全被拖出了假发博物馆。

source: Sorry we didn't win, Polly. I know it was really important to you.
target: 对不起啊，波莉，我们没赢。我知道你很想赢的。

source: Don't worry, boo; that meltdown was all a distraction! Look what I swiped on the way out!
target: 别担心，宝贝。刚才发飙就是为了转移注意力！看看我出来时顺了什么！

source: Polly pulls a WHOLE SHEET of gold star stickers out of her pocket! Woohoo! You lose -N2 SOUL for the ruse, but gain +N2 HYPE.
target: 波莉从口袋里掏出了一整张金星贴纸！呜呼！这番骗术让你失去-N2灵魂，不过你获得了+N2热度。

source: Hey, great idea! It's a good thing we found that website that lets you buy unregulated taxi licenses at a ridiculously cheap price.
target: 嘿，好主意！幸好我们找到了那个网站，花点小钱就能买到不受监管的出租车执照，便宜得离谱。

source: You spend -N2 MONEY and bribe Bobby with a taxi license. He asks his parents to quit the tour, as his only desire now is to pursue this new career!
target: 你花了-N2金钱，用一张出租车执照贿赂鲍比。他让爸妈别参观了，现在满脑子都是开启这份新事业！

source: Later, on the mean streets of New York City...
target: 后来，在纽约市险恶的街头……

source: "OWWWW! Honey, please hurry and call a cab! The baby is almost here!"
target: “啊啊啊！亲爱的，快叫出租车！孩子就要生了！”

source: "Look, here's one now! Cabbie, hurry to the closest hospital, my wife is in labor!"
target: “看，这儿就有一辆！师傅，快去最近的医院！我老婆要生了！”

source: "Wowie! What's a 'osspidul?'"
target: “哇哦！‘医愿’是什么呀？”

source: "Wait, is the taxi driver a fucking toddler? How does he even reach the pedals?!"

target: 你和朋友们下了车，走进……也不知道这到底算什么地方。

source: Howdy, customers! Welcome to Noodles' "Gift Shop."
target: 客人们好呀！欢迎来到面条的“礼品店”。

source: Why'd you put gift shop in air quotes?
target: 你说“礼品店”的时候，干嘛用手比引号？

source: Legal reasons.
target: 法律原因。

source: You've got a lot of stuff for sale, Noodles. Can you tell us more about it?
target: 面条，你这儿卖的东西好多啊。能给我们介绍介绍吗？

source: Nope!
target: 不能！

source: But... why not?
target: 可……为什么呀？

source: Why all the questions? What are you, cops?
target: 问这么多干嘛？你们是警察啊？

source: I don't think I'm a cop, last time I checked. Polly, do I smell like a cop?
target: 应该不是吧，反正上次确认的时候还不是。波莉，我闻着像警察吗？

source: I dunno. What do cops smell like?
target: 不知道。警察闻着什么味儿？

source: The blood of the gods that we killed with our hubris! Also glue.
target: 有股神明的血腥味——那些被我们的傲慢杀死的神！还有胶水味。

source: But... that's what YOU smell like.
target: 可……你身上就是这个味儿啊。

source: Teehee!
target: 嘻嘻！

source: Okay, this is weird as hell, but you really want to buy a... whatever it is Noodles is selling. So hurry up and buy one!
target: 行吧，怪得要命。但你真的很想买一个……面条卖的那个什么玩意儿。那就赶紧挑一个吧！

source: Happy Happy Fun Time!
target: 开心开心好时光！

source: Cute Little Embodiment of All My Fears of no one ever really caring about me
target: 我害怕永远没人真正在乎我的所有恐惧的可爱小化身

source: Shiny Shteven
target: 闪亮史提文

source: Yay, good choice! "Happy Happy Fun Time is the bestest dude! / Never add him into your food!"
target: 耶，选得好！“开心开心好时光，真是个好伙伴！千万别把他，往你饭里拌！”

source: Well, that's a cool jingle, I guess. But what does Happy Happy Fun Time do, exactly?
target: 好吧，这广告歌还挺带劲。可开心开心好时光到底是干什么的？

source: "He's the cutest lil rock with the happy grin! / Lock the doors and don't let your parents in!"
target: “小小石头笑开颜，可爱无敌惹人怜！锁好门，别让爹妈进房间！”

source: "Lock the doors?" Is Happy Happy Fun Time a sex toy or something? Or a murder weapon, maybe?
target: “锁好门”？开心开心好时光是什么情趣玩具吗？还是说……凶器？

source: "Happy Happy Fun Time is so great! / You'll love the sacred memories you create! / If you found him today, it must be fate!"
target: “开心开心好时光，好得没话讲！共创神圣的回忆，让你永难忘！今天遇见他，缘分来身旁！”

source: "Now it's time to go home and masturbate!" Haha! I found the jingle lyrics on the internet.
target: “现在就该回家去，手淫爽一场！”哈哈！我在网上搜到歌词啦。

source: Great, that's gonna be stuck in your head for hours. You pay -N2 MONEY for whatever Happy Happy Fun Time is, but you gain +N2 HYPE!
target: 完了，这歌得在你脑子里循环好几个小时。你花了-N2金钱，买下这个不知有什么用的开心开心好时光，不过也获得了+N2热度！

source: Aww, that's so sweet, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. It's like you went into the animal shelter and adopted the ugliest stray of them all.
target: 哎呀，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你可真有爱心。感觉就像去动物收容所，领养了里面最丑的那只流浪动物。

source: It's so nice and selfless of you to show love to the least appealing rock on Noodles' shelves. You're, like, a gift shop saint!
target: 面条货架上最没人喜欢的石头，你都愿意疼爱，真是又善良又无私。你简直就是礼品店里的圣人！

source: NO SAINTS! No religion allowed in my "Gift Shop!" This is a place God forgot!
target: 不准有圣人！我的“礼品店”禁止宗教！这里是被上帝遗忘的地方！

source: You pay -N2 MONEY for the "Cute Little Embodiment of All My Fears of no one ever really caring about me." You can't help but shed a tear over the little guy's plight.
target: 你花了-N2金钱，买下“我害怕永远没人真正在乎我的所有恐惧的可爱小化身”。想到小家伙的处境，你忍不住为它掉了一滴泪。

source: How'd you get the idea to create this sad little cutie, Noodles? Is it a manifestation of your own fears and insecurities?
target: 面条，你怎么会想到做这么个可怜又可爱的小东西？它体现的是你自己的恐惧和不安吗？

source: Nope.
target: 不是。

source: Oh. Then where DID you get the name from?
target: 哦，那这名字是怎么来的？

source: I dunno. It sounded funny!
target: 不知道啊。听着好玩嘛！

source: Well, I guess it was still nice of %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% to help Noodles move his least popular merchandise then.
target: 好吧，那%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%帮面条卖掉了最滞销的货，也算做了件好事。

source: It was! Do you want to join our loyalty program, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?
target: 可不是嘛！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，要加入我们的会员计划吗？

source: No emails or phone calls ever; just carve my name into your arm with this obsidian knife!
target: 绝不发邮件，也不打电话。只要拿这把黑曜石刀，把我的名字刻在你胳膊上就行！

source: NOPE. You already hit a home run by earning +N2 SOUL with your new pet rock. Why ruin that with whatever cursed energy Noodles is brewing?
target: 想都别想。新买的宠物石已经让你获得了+N2灵魂，成绩够漂亮了。干嘛还要沾上面条捣鼓的那些诅咒能量，毁掉好事？

source: Whoa. Am I high, or is that rock glowing?
target: 哇。我是嗨了，还是那石头真的在发光？

source: Yes!
target: 没错!

source: Okay, that fucks. I'll give you -N2 MONEY for Shiny Shteven. Where'd you find this weird rock, anyway?
target: 行，这玩意儿真牛逼。给你-N2金钱，闪亮史提文我要了。话说，这怪石头你哪儿找来的？

source: Who knows? These things are everywhere.
target: 谁知道呢？到处都是这东西。

source: Before Noodles can refuse to elaborate further, an interdimensional portal opens, and a team of superheroes rushes in!
target: 面条还没来得及拒绝继续解释，一道跨次元传送门就打开了，一队超级英雄冲了进来！

source: "DROP THAT ROCK!" says the leader superhero, his cape flapping heroically in the still air. "That's the last Eternal Stone!"
target: “放下那块石头！”领头的超级英雄说道。他的披风在无风的空气里英勇地飘扬着。“那是最后一块永恒之石！”

source: "We need its power to save our world from all evil!" says the only woman in the group, whose outfit is oversexualized, but in, like, a feminist way, we swear.
target: 队伍里唯一的女英雄说：“我们需要它的力量，才能拯救世界，消灭一切邪恶！”她的衣服性感得过了头，不过我们发誓，那可是女权主义式的性感。

source: Sorry, can't help ya. I just sold it.
target: 抱歉，帮不上忙。刚卖掉了。

source: "You SOLD IT?! To who?!"
target: “你卖了？！卖给谁了？！”

source: Not you, motherfucker! Bye!
target: 反正不是你，傻逼！拜拜！

source: Noodles pushes the superheroes back into the portal, and it closes.
target: 面条把超级英雄们推回传送门，随后传送门关闭了。

source: Wow, Noodles... you're really good about honoring your sales!
target: 哇，面条……你做生意可真守信用！

source: He sure is. You gain +N2 MAGIC from your powerful new pal, Shiny Shteven.
target: 可不是嘛。强大的新伙伴闪亮史提文让你获得了+N2魔力。

source: Invest in this clearly booming business
target: 投资这门显然蒸蒸日上的生意

source: You and your friends get out of the car and enter... whatever this place is.
target: 你和朋友们下了车，走进……也不知道这到底算什么地方。

source: Greetings, fellow flesh-bags! Welcome to Noodles' "Gift Shop!" See anything you like?
target: 各位肉袋子同胞，你们好！欢迎来到面条的“礼品店”！有看上的吗？

source: Wow, this stuff is so cool!
target: 哇,这东西太酷了!

source: ...What is this stuff, anyway?
target: ……话说，这些到底是什么东西？

source: Rocks, of course! They're the cold, silent onlookers that never love you back!
target: 当然是石头！它们冷冰冰地看着你，一声不吭，而且永远不会回应你的爱！

source: Noodles, these rocks are THE SHIT. How long have you been running this stand?
target: 面条，这些石头可太牛逼了。你这摊子开多久了？

source: Long enough to know better than to answer personal questions.
target: 久到足以明白，私事不能随便告诉别人。

source: Nice. You're a really good business owner. You've got the makings of entrepreneurial greatness in you.
target: 不错，是个做生意的料。你可有成为伟大企业家的潜质。

source: ...Does he, though?
target: ……真的有吗？

source: Of course he does, dumb-dumb! Check out all that natural business smarts and charisma oozing out of Noodles' pores!
target: 当然有啦，笨蛋！你瞧瞧，面条那天生的商业头脑和魅力，都顺着毛孔往外冒了！

source: DON'T TALK ABOUT MY OOZES!
target: 不许讨论我往外冒的东西！

source: We gotta invest in this booming business, y'all. These rocks are about to go BIG. Let's go all in on it now and get ahead of the curve!
target: 伙计们，这么红火的生意，咱们必须投！这些石头马上就要火了，趁现在全押上，抢占先机！

source: Polly, no. Don't you remember the last time you invested in a "booming business" while you were drunk?
target: 波莉，别。你忘了上次喝醉了投资“红火生意”的事了吗？

source: Hey, I don't regret investing in Dick Shirts: Shirts For Your Dick. Scott loves them!
target: 嘿，我可不后悔投资“屌衬衫：给你家老二穿的衬衫”。斯科特可喜欢了！

source: I'm wearing a dick crop top right now!
target: 我家老二现在就穿着露脐装呢！

source: All we gotta do is decide how to use our investment to expand Noodles' business. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, what do you suggest?
target: 现在就看这笔投资该怎么花，才能帮面条扩大生意了。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你有什么建议？

source: Advertise in printed newspapers. They're so desperate for relevance that they may feature this stand for free.
target: 在纸质报纸上打广告。它们都快没人看了，说不定愿意免费报道这个摊子。

source: Officially sponsor a team of competitive "Rock, Paper, Scissors" players.
target: 正式赞助一支“石头剪刀布”职业战队。

source: In times like these, you go big or you go home. START A CINEMATIC UNIVERSE!
target: 这种时候，要么做大，要么回家。打造一个电影宇宙！

source: You, Scott, and Polly head to the local newspaper office. It's staffed by two bored elderly men who look half-dead on their feet.
target: 你、斯科特和波莉去了当地报社。里面只有两个百无聊赖的老头，站着都像丢了半条命。

source: They barely look up as you walk in. "The dentist's office is on the second floor," one sighs.
target: 你们走进去时，他们连头都懒得抬。其中一人叹了口气：“牙科诊所在二楼。”

source: No way, I hate the dentist! We're looking for the newspaper people.
target: 才不去呢，我讨厌牙医！我们是来找办报纸的人的。

source: "Wait, you want the newspaper? As in, the paper with the news printed on it? That one?"
target: “等等，你们找报社？就是把新闻印在纸上，做出来的那个报纸？找的是那个？”

source: I think so?
target: 应该是吧？

source: "That's great! I'm the CEO. My partner here was our janitor, but after our whole staff quit, he's been promoted to head journalist."
target: “太好了！我是首席执行官。这位搭档原本是我们的保洁，不过全体员工辞职以后，他就升任首席记者了。”

source: Nice to meet'cha! We were wondering if we could run a feature story in your newspaper?
target: 幸会幸会！我们想在你们报纸上做篇专题报道，可以吗？

source: "Sure! We're desperate for anything that'll click with young people and sell these papers. If you have an idea, we're all ears."
target: “当然！只要能吸引年轻人、把报纸卖出去，什么我们都愿意试。有什么点子，尽管说！”

source: Oh, we've got THE idea. We want you to run a story on Noodles' "Gift Shop", the one-stop shop where you can buy... these things!
target: 哦，我们有个绝妙的点子！报道一下面条的“礼品店”吧！一站式购物，想买这些……这些东西，就去他那儿！

source: "A rock...? What is it used for? Is it a pet rock? A paperweight?"
target: “一块石头……？它是干什么的？宠物石？镇纸？”

source: No clue. Noodles has systematically avoided giving us a proper explanation.
target: 不知道。面条一直在有条不紊地回避给我们一个正经解释。

source: "Well, we could still make that our story angle. We'll be happy to feature Noodles' 'Gift Shop' in the paper!"
target: “嗯，这也可以当报道角度。我们很乐意在报上介绍面条的‘礼品店’！”

source: "We'll just cut that feature on the rampant corruption in the Brazilian government. No one's reading about that stuff these days anyway."
target: “把那篇巴西政府腐败猖獗的专题撤掉就行。反正如今也没人看那些东西了。”

source: You're sent a copy of the feature a few days later. It's boring as fuck. No wonder this medium is dead. You lose -N2 HYPE.
target: 几天后，你收到一份登着专题的报纸。真他妈无聊。难怪这种媒体已经死了。你失去了-N2热度。

source: But at least you gain +N2 MIND reading the front-page story about the emerging markets from SEA. That's something!
target: 不过，头版关于东南亚新兴市场的报道让你获得了+N2头脑。也算有点收获！

source: Excuse me? No way there's a competitive "Rock, Paper, Scissors" scene, much less anyone who actually watches it.
target: 什么？“石头剪刀布”怎么可能有职业比赛，更别说真有人看了。

source: Of course there is! We live in a world crippled by the unstoppable tide of ennui, silly. People will do anything to stave off the inescapable boredom of being alive!
target: 当然有啦，傻瓜！无可阻挡的倦怠浪潮，早就把这世界压垮了。为了逃避活着就躲不掉的无聊，人们什么都干得出来！

source: That settles it, apparently. You spend -N2 MONEY sponsoring a team and go to watch their first big match.
target: 看来就这么定了。你花了-N2金钱赞助一支战队，还去看了他们的首场大赛。

source: Scott is appointed team cheerleader, Noodles is the unsettling mascot, and Polly is... drunk.
target: 斯科特被任命为啦啦队长，面条成了令人不安的吉祥物，波莉则……喝醉了。

source: GIMME AN R-O-C-K! WIN THAT GAME OF CHANCE TODAY!
target: 跟我喊：石——头！今天猜拳，拿下冠军！

source: ...I dunno why we're losing, bros. I'm cheering as hard as I can!
target: ……兄弟们，咱们怎么还在输啊？我都拼命加油了！

source: We're losing 'cause this ref fuckin' SUCKS! That other team totally fouled!
target: 还不是这裁判他妈的太烂了！对面明明犯规了！

source: Actually, I'm pretty sure our team's losing because Noodles ordered them to play rock to promote his business.
target: 其实我敢肯定，是因为面条非让他们只出石头，好给自己的生意打广告，咱们队才一直输。

source: It seems one of your athletes figured that out too, because in the next round, he plays scissors -- and wins!
target: 看来有位选手也想明白了。下一轮，他出了剪刀——赢了！

source: You're out.
target: 你被开除了。

source: "But I had to play scissors, Mr. Noodles!" the competitor begs. "It's the only way to--"
target: 选手苦苦哀求：“可我只能出剪刀啊，面条先生！只有这样才——”

source: I SAID YOU'RE OUT!
target: 我说，你被开除了！

source: Wow... Noodles' little tentacles can really choke a motherfucker out.
target: 哇……面条那几根小触手，掐起人来可真狠。

source: Should we get help?
target: 我们要不要找人帮忙？

source: No, are you kidding? This is the most interesting thing that's happened all match.
target: 不要，开玩笑呢？这可是整场比赛最精彩的一幕。

source: This was certainly a memorable way to spend your day. You gain +N2 HYPE from competitive rock, paper, scissors.
target: 这一天过得确实让人难忘。竞技石头剪刀布让你获得了+N2热度。

source: Good idea! We'll begin with four stages of movies to solidify our Rock Cinematic Universe. Then we'll launch some spinoff TV shows and cartoons...
target: 好主意！先分四个阶段拍电影，给我们的石头电影宇宙打牢基础。接着推出衍生剧和动画片……

source: ...then we'll make some sequels and prequels, novels based on the movies, video games based on the novels, maybe an official brand of cereal...
target: ……再拍续集、前传，推出电影改编小说、小说改编游戏，也许还能做个官方联名麦片……

source: ...and when we're done with all that, we'll be just in time to re-release remastered versions of the original movies and get that nostalgia money! We'll be rich!
target: ……等这些全搞完，正好把最早那几部电影修复重映，再赚一波情怀钱！咱们要发财啦！

source: Okay... what are the movies gonna be about?
target: 好吧……那电影要讲什么？

source: Who cares? SHOW ME THE MONEY!
target: 谁管啊？钱拿来！

source: You spend -N2 MONEY creating this -N2 SOUL-less mockery of cinema. Predictably, these movies are about nothing and nobody likes them.
target: 你花了-N2金钱，打造了这场亵渎电影艺术、毫无灵魂的闹剧，还损失了-N2灵魂。不出所料，电影空洞无物，根本没人喜欢。

source: I REFUSE TO KNOW FAILURE! THROW MONEY AT IT UNTIL IT WORKS!
target: 老娘的字典里没有失败！砸钱！砸到它成功为止！

source: So you do, spending -N2 MONEY again. Over time, you attract more investors who see some sort of late-capitalist potential in the RCU.
target: 于是你又砸了-N2金钱。慢慢地，更多投资人加入了进来，在石头电影宇宙里看到了某种晚期资本主义潜力。

source: You get invited to some Hollywood producer parties. You gain +N2 STAMINA from the open bars and +N2 MAGIC from the "creativity-enhancing powder" they let you snort.
target: 你受邀参加了一些好莱坞制片人的派对。免费畅饮的酒水让你获得了+N2体力，他们让你吸的“创意增强粉”则让你获得了+N2魔力。

source: HOLY SHITBALLS, I JUST HAD A GREAT IDEA. WE NEED TO MAKE AN RCU THEME PARK!
target: 我操，我刚想到个绝妙的点子。咱们得建个石头电影宇宙主题乐园！

source: AND CAN WE MAKE A MOTORCYCLE THAT'S ALSO A COFFEE MACHINE? THAT WOULD FUCK! PUT THAT IN THE MOVIE TOO!
target: 还能不能造一辆兼当咖啡机的摩托车？那他妈得多酷啊！也给我拍进电影里！

source: AND DRUGS! DRUGS ARE COOL! ADD DRUGS TO THE RCU!
target: 还有毒品！毒品多酷啊！把毒品也加进石头电影宇宙！

source: You have to bail out of this money-pit eventually, but at least you gained +N2 HYPE while it lasted.
target: 最后你还是得退出这个无底洞，不过至少在这期间获得了+N2热度。

source: And over the years, from time to time, you hear about some new development in the "extended RCU" that the current showrunners are doing.
target: 此后的几年里，你时不时还会听说，接手的主创又给“石头扩展电影宇宙”加了些什么新东西。

source: Good work contributing to the slow death of art, champ. Now, back to the road trip!
target: 干得漂亮，朋友，你也为艺术的慢性死亡添了把力。好了，继续公路旅行吧！

source: Bring the shop to the next level
target: 把这家店的生意做大

source: You and your friends get out of the car and enter... whatever this place is.
target: 你和朋友们下了车，走进……也不知道这到底算什么地方。

source: Welcome to my "Gift Shop," gullible consumers! Feast your eyes on my shelves of products!
target: 好骗的消费者们，欢迎来到我的“礼品店”！尽情欣赏满架子的商品吧！

source: Yeah, you've got a lot of cool rocks and stuff for sale here! What does all this stuff do?
target: 对啊，你这儿有好多酷酷的石头什么的！这些东西都有什么用啊？

source: Haha, why ask questions when you can just enjoy things in ignorant bliss?
target: 哈哈，什么都不懂，开开心心地享受不就好了，干嘛非要问呢？

source: Hey, good point!
target: 嘿,说得好!

source: Noodles, you've got a really great business idea here. Have you ever considered bringing this little "Gift Shop" stand to the next level?
target: 面条，你这生意点子真不错。想没想过把这个“礼品店”小摊做大？

source: Of course! Soon, my shop and I will ascend to the next evolutionary level, and then I will fight God!
target: 当然！很快，我和我的店就会升上更高的进化层次，然后我就要跟上帝干一架！

source: Cool, cool, but how are you gonna profit from that?
target: 酷，挺酷。可这怎么赚钱啊？

source: Hmm, I guess I never considered that. Do you have any ideas?
target: 嗯，这我还真没想过。你有什么主意吗？

source: Oh, yeah. My friends and I are TOTAL Business Masterz. Tell him, Scott!
target: 那当然。我跟我的朋友们，可都是货真价实的生意大师！斯科特，告诉他！

source: Can't talk now. I was smelling Noodles' mystery rocks and got one stuck up my nose.
target: 现在说不了。我刚才闻面条的神秘石头，有一块卡鼻子里了。

source: INHALE HARDER! EMBED MY CREATIONS INTO YOUR BRAIN!
target: 再使劲吸！让我的作品嵌进你的脑子里！

source: Okay, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, it's up to you. Tell Noodles all about how we're gonna turn this little roadside stand into the hottest shop in the middle of nowhere!
target: 好吧，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，靠你了。告诉面条，咱们要怎么把这个路边摊，变成荒郊野外最火的店！

source: Guerrilla marketing: throw the products at unexpecting pedestrians. They will surely notice it when it hits their faces. And you can sell them more rocks to fight back!
target: 搞游击营销：把商品扔向毫无防备的路人。砸到脸上，他们肯定就注意到了。还能卖他们更多石头，让他们扔回来！

source: Plan a big, complex media strategy to redefine rock beauty canons so you can legally name these "precious stones" and sell them at a higher price point.
target: 制定一套庞大复杂的媒体策略，重新定义石头的审美标准，好名正言顺地把这些东西叫作“宝石”，卖得更贵。

source: Our whole strategy is just throwing rocks at people? Won't that make everyone mad at us?
target: 咱们的策略就只是拿石头砸人？大家不会生我们的气吗？

source: Well, it's like they say: "Fuck around and find out!"
target: 俗话说得好：“作一作，就知道了！”

source: Noodles, with no hesitation or remorse, throws a rock at a passing pedestrian's forehead.
target: 面条毫不犹豫，也毫无悔意，抄起石头就往一名路人的脑门上砸。

source: "OW!" says the pedestrian. "Why would you do that? You could've killed me!"
target: 路人叫道：“嗷！你干嘛啊？差点就砸死我了！”

source: Trust me, dear customer: were it not for the laws of this land, I would have joyfully slaughtered you.
target: 相信我，亲爱的顾客，要不是本地法律不允许，我早就开开心心把你宰了。

source: You, Polly, and Noodles throw more rocks at passers-by. If they didn't want rocks thrown at them, why did they come to the desert in the first place, right?
target: 你、波莉和面条又朝路人扔起了石头。不想挨石头砸，干嘛还来沙漠，对吧？

source: Soon, an angry mob with a collective headache confronts Noodles' stand. "Why are you throwing rocks at us?!" they demand.
target: 很快，一群被砸得头痛、怒气冲冲的人围住了面条的摊位，质问道：“你为什么拿石头砸我们？！”

source: Because I'm sick and twisted! But for a small fee, you can buy a rock of your own to throw back at me!
target: 因为我又变态又扭曲呀！不过只要花一小笔钱，你就能买块自己的石头，扔回来砸我！

source: "Fine, we will! Hope you like the taste of granite, motherfucker!"
target: “好啊，买就买！等着尝尝花岗岩的滋味吧，混蛋！”

source: They buy rocks to throw at Noodles. Noodles ducks, and the rocks phase right through Polly's forehead and hit MORE innocent bystanders.
target: 他们买了石头砸向面条。面条一闪，石头穿过波莉的额头，又砸中了更多无辜路人。

source: Check it out! Word-of-mouth marketing! We did it, guys!
target: 快看！口碑营销！伙计们，咱们成功了！

source: What you did was start an all-out rock-throwing war in the middle of the desert as people buy more rocks to throw at each other. Success, you guess?
target: 你们的成果，是在沙漠中央掀起了一场全面石战。人们不断买更多石头互砸。这就算成功了吧？

source: After lots of market research, I think we can say for sure that throwing rocks at strangers isn't nice.
target: 做了这么多市场调研，我想可以确定：朝陌生人扔石头，是不好的。

source: Yeah, fine, we lost -N2 SOUL. But Noodles paid us +N2 MONEY in consultancy fees. With that kinda cash, we can buy good karma!
target: 是啦，我们失去了-N2灵魂。可面条付了我们+N2金钱的咨询费。有这么多钱，还怕买不到好报应？

source: You, Polly, and Scott put your heads together and lose -N2 MIND drafting up your marketing strategy to turn this granite into green.
target: 你、波莉和斯科特凑在一起，绞尽脑汁，损失了-N2头脑，终于拟出一套把花岗岩变成钞票的营销方案。

source: How sweetly cynical! You're twisting the "everyone is beautiful" movement to convince others that my worthless stones are precious gems!
target: 好一手甜美的犬儒主义！你们歪曲“每个人都很美”的理念，说服别人相信，我这些一文不值的石头也是珍贵宝石！

source: Hey, c'mon, your definition is a really narrow way of looking at what we're trying to do here.
target: 哎，别这么说嘛。你这么理解我们想做的事，就有点狭隘了。

source: Sure, our marketing strategy seems like a mockery of redefining beauty standards, and it kinda plays on the idea that external beauty is equivalent to one's value...
target: 没错，我们的营销策略看着像在拿“重新定义审美标准”开涮，也有点利用了“外貌等于价值”的想法……

source: But what we're REALLY doing is giving a big ol' middle finger to the precious gems industry. They've been committing crimes against monstrosity for YEARS.
target: 可我们真正要做的，是狠狠给珠宝行业竖个中指。他们犯下反怪物罪都多少年了。

source: Gem companies create forced scarcity of their products and inflate the prices to convince you that diamonds are worth millions. But it's all a lie!
target: 珠宝公司人为制造稀缺，抬高价格，让你相信钻石价值几百万。其实全是骗局！

source: So if they're gonna use slave labor and market manipulation to sell their shiny rocks, why don't we fight the corrupt gem market with these regular rocks?
target: 既然他们能靠奴工和操纵市场来卖亮晶晶的石头，我们为什么不能用普通石头对抗这腐败的珠宝市场？

source: AND WE'LL MAKE LOTS OF MONEY AT THE SAME TIME! EVERYONE (who matters) WINS!
target: 顺便还能大赚一笔！所有人——所有重要的人——都赢了！

source: Wow! You gain +1 VALUABLE INSIGHT from this conversation (which isn't a stat in this game, but maybe it'll come in handy someday).
target: 哇！这番对话让你获得了+1宝贵见解（虽然这不是本游戏的属性，不过没准哪天能派上用场）。

source: More to the point, your marketing campaign works, and Noodles is soon rolling in that sweet "precious stones" money. He pays you +N2 MONEY for your help.
target: 更实际的是，营销活动成功了，面条很快就靠这些“宝石”赚得盆满钵满。他付了你+N2金钱作为酬谢。

source: Look for cryptids
target: 寻找神秘生物

source: Sometimes you go looking for the cryptid; sometimes the cryptid finds you.
target: 有时，是你去找神秘生物；有时，是神秘生物找上你。

source: At least, that's what happens when you, Polly, and Scott enter the woods and run into Moss Mann, your favorite moth-person from summer camp!
target: 至少你、波莉和斯科特进了树林之后就是这样：你们遇到了莫斯·曼，夏令营里最讨你们喜欢的那位蛾人！

source: Hello, friends! Are you enjoying the national park?
target: 朋友们好！国家公园逛得开心吗？

source: I was just chatting with some of the park rangers. You wouldn't BELIEVE who Officer Riley's wife is sleeping with this week!
target: 我刚在跟几个护林员聊天。你们绝对猜不到，莱利警官的老婆这周又跟谁睡了！

source: Hey, Moss! You're still a messy, gossippy bitch I see.
target: 嘿，莫斯！你还是那么爱搅浑水、聊八卦啊，贱货。

source: Always! But lately I've been pursuing other hobbies, such as enjoying the beauty of nature and training to fly into the sun.
target: 那当然！不过我最近也在培养别的爱好，比如欣赏自然美景，还有练习飞进太阳。

source: I definitely don't recommend you do that last thing, unless you wanna die.
target: 最后那个我可真不建议你试，除非你想死。

source: I AM MORE THAN WILLING TO PERISH FOR MY PASSIONS!
target: 为热爱而死，我求之不得！

source: Sounds cool, bro! We were just on the hunt for some cryptids. Do you know where we could find any?
target: 听着真酷，兄弟！我们正找神秘生物呢。你知道哪儿有吗？

source: Besides my glorious self? Yes, this park is full of my fellow cryptids!
target: 除了光芒万丈的我本人？当然，这公园里到处都是我的神秘生物同胞！

source: I could introduce you to one. I need to catch up with them anyway. We cryptids make great friends, but BOY are we hard to keep in touch with!
target: 我可以带你们认识一个。反正我也该去找他们叙叙旧了。我们神秘生物当朋友可好了，但想保持联系，哎哟，那叫一个难！

source: But I've got a hot date with a hot campfire this evening, so we only have time to visit one person. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, who would you prefer to meet?
target: 不过今晚，我还得跟一团火辣的篝火来场火热约会，所以只来得及拜访一位。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你想见谁？

source: Visit the Fresno Nightcrawler. He's always happy to teach friends the beautiful game of soccer!
target: 拜访弗雷斯诺夜行者。他一向很乐意教朋友踢足球，领略这项运动的美妙！

source: Have some tea and pastries at Sasquatch's secluded cabin where he hides from the paparazzi.
target: 去大脚怪躲狗仔的林间隐居小屋，喝茶吃点心。

source: We're gonna meet a cryptid AND play a sport? Is today my birthday or something?!
target: 既能见到神秘生物，又能搞体育？今天难道是我生日？！

source: Moss leads you to an improvised soccer field in the woods. The Fresno Nightcrawler is playing on both teams, kicking a soccer ball between two tree-trunk goals.
target: 莫斯带你们来到林间的一块简易球场。弗雷斯诺夜行者一人分饰两队，在两座树干搭成的球门之间来回踢球。

source: Isn't he a cutie? HEY, NIGHTCRAWLER! Long time no see!
target: 是不是很可爱？嘿，夜行者！好久不见！

source: ¡Che, Moss! ¡Qué bueno que viniste! You brought friends, I see.
target: 嘿，莫斯！你能来真好！还带了朋友啊。

source: I'm Moss' friend Scott! You're a really great soccer player, bro. Do you wanna play a game together?
target: 我是莫斯的朋友斯科特！兄弟，你球踢得真棒，想不想一起踢一场？

source: That sounds great! Soccer is my passion. It's actually where I got the name "Fresno Nightcrawler."
target: 好啊！足球就是我的热爱。其实，我“弗雷斯诺夜行者”这名字就是这么来的。

source: Most people think it's because I'm from California, but I'm actually Argentinian. "Fresno" comes from my stint on the Fresno soccer team.
target: 大家都以为是因为我来自加州，其实我是阿根廷人。“弗雷斯诺”是我以前效力过的球队。

source: That's so cool, bro! Do you have any good soccer tips for an amateur like me?
target: 太酷了，兄弟！我这种业余球员，有什么踢球诀窍可以学学吗？

source: Sure, let's have a cup of yerba mate and talk strategy. Now, the most important part of being a good soccer player is having a good heart, and GREAT calves.
target: 当然，咱们喝杯马黛茶，聊聊战术。想踢好球，最重要的就是有一颗善良的心，还有特别结实的小腿。

source: You enjoy some good bitter mate while Scott and the Fresno Nightcrawler play a game of soccer. The Nightcrawler is a good sport, and coaches Scott on his techniques.
target: 你品着清苦的马黛茶，斯科特则跟弗雷斯诺夜行者踢起了足球。夜行者球品很好，还指导斯科特改进技术。

source: ¡Alta gambeta, Scott! Remember, it's not about kicking the ball hard. It's about kicking it with your heart!
target: 过人漂亮啊，斯科特！记住，踢球不是靠蛮力，是要用心去踢！

source: Sounds anatomically impossible, but I'll try! ¡Mucho gracias!
target: 按身体构造来说好像办不到，不过我试试！谢啦！

source: Wow, the Fresno Nightcrawler playing soccer with an opponent for the first time in decades! My gossip forum is going to FREAK.
target: 哇，弗雷斯诺夜行者几十年来第一次跟别人踢球！我的八卦论坛要炸了！

source: This has been the kickoff to a wonderful friendship. (See what I did there? See?!)
target: 一场美妙的友谊，就此开球！（懂我的梗了吧？懂了吧？！）

source: You lose -N2 MIND staring into Nightcrawler's burning, soulless eyes, but gain +N2 HYPE!
target: 盯着夜行者那双燃烧着、没有灵魂的眼睛，你失去了-N2头脑，不过也获得了+N2热度！

source: ¡Aguante Argentina, la concha su madre!
target: 阿根廷加油，他妈的！

source: Sounds fun! Sasquatch lives in a secluded cabin DEEP in the woods. We'll have to fly there to save time.
target: 好啊！大脚怪的小屋藏在树林深处，特别隐蔽。咱们得飞过去，才能省点时间。

source: Moss scoops you all up and flies into the sky! After a very intense debate convincing him not to fly you into the sun together, you touch down at Sasquatch's cabin.
target: 莫斯把你们一把捞起，飞上天空！经过一番激烈争论，总算说服他别带着你们一起飞进太阳之后，你们降落在大脚怪的小屋前。

source: The legend himself is sitting on a rocking chair on the front porch, knitting the biggest pair of socks you've ever seen.
target: 这位传说中的本尊正坐在门廊的摇椅上，织着一双你见过最大的袜子。

source: Hey, 'Squatch! Long time no see! I brought some friends to visit you, I hope that was okay.
target: 嘿，大脚！好久不见！我带了几个朋友来看你，希望没打扰到你。

source: Hey, Moss! I don't mind, I'm just sorry I didn't clean up more. Forgive all these hair clumps, it's shedding season.
target: 嘿，莫斯！不打扰，就是屋里没好好收拾，怪不好意思的。别介意这些毛团啊，换毛季嘛。

source: RELATABLE, bro. It's so cool to meet you in person! Do you know how many internet forums there are for people just hoping to see you once?
target: 我懂，兄弟！能见到你本人真酷！你知不知道网上有多少论坛，里面的人都盼着能见你一面？

source: Ugh, yes, I'm well aware of my stalkers. They're the reason I retreated into the woods in the first place.
target: 唉，知道，我很清楚那些跟踪狂的存在。就是为了躲他们，我才退隐到树林里。

source: Being constantly hunted is irritating -- especially by paparazzis. Those insidious parasites follow me everywhere!
target: 老被追着跑真的很烦，尤其是那些狗仔。阴险的寄生虫，我走到哪儿就跟到哪儿！

source: They have bright, flashing, soulless lights for eyes, and they make the most horrible shutter-clicking cry!
target: 他们的眼睛会发出刺眼的闪光，没有半点灵魂，叫声就是那种可怕的快门咔嚓声！

source: Squatch, I told you, there's no such thing as paparazzis. That's just a myth.
target: 大脚，我说过了，世上没有狗仔这种东西。那只是个传说。

source: They're real, and I've seen them! They stalk in the night, crawling out of their strange dimension to hunt me down!
target: 真的有，我亲眼见过！他们在夜里潜行，从奇怪的次元里爬出来，就为了追踪我！

source: That sounds terrible! How do you deal with it?
target: 太可怕了吧！你怎么应付啊？

source: I remain in seclusion. It's not bad; being unplugged from society has given me time to perfect my possum cookie recipe! Want to try some?
target: 我就隐居着呗。也挺好，跟社会断了联系，正好有时间把负鼠饼干的配方琢磨到完美！要尝尝吗？

source: Sure! You lose -N2 MIND listening to Sasquatch's paranoid paparazzi rants, but you gain +N2 STAMINA eating delicious possum pastries!
target: 好啊！听大脚怪满怀被害妄想地痛斥狗仔，让你失去了-N2头脑，不过美味的负鼠糕点也让你获得了+N2体力！

source: Go hiking
target: 去徒步

source: You and your friends are checking out the trail map at the information kiosk when a huge, moth-shaped shadow blots out the sun.
target: 你和朋友们正在咨询亭看步道地图，突然，一片巨大的蛾形阴影遮住了太阳。

source: It's Moss Mann, your fire-loving friend from summer camp!
target: 是莫斯·曼，你们夏令营里那位爱火的朋友！

source: Hey, guys! Do you want to take a hike with me? We could enjoy the tranquility of nature and swap juicy gossip along the way!
target: 嘿，伙计们！要不要一起徒步？一路欣赏宁静的大自然，交换劲爆八卦！

source: Sure! We were just deciding what trail to take.
target: 好啊！我们正商量走哪条路呢。

source: Oh, forget these "official" trails. My buddy Sasquatch told me all about a scenic off-the-map trail with beautiful views. Let me show you some REAL hiking!
target: 嗨，别走这些“官方”步道了。我朋友大脚怪告诉过我一条地图上没有的小路，风景特别美。带你们见识见识什么才叫真正的徒步！

source: Two hours and -N2 STAMINA later...
target: 两个小时和-N2体力之后……

source: Fine, so I couldn't find the trail. You can't always rely on trail gossip to be true, okay? That's the beauty of it!
target: 好吧，我是没找到那条路。可小道消息哪能保证条条都真啊，对吧？这正是它的魅力！

source: I'm sure we'll find the path back to the car when we pass Bare Ass Boulder. I heard it's a boulder shaped like such a beautiful butt, it'll make you insecure about your own butt.
target: 只要经过光屁股巨石，我肯定就能找到回停车处的路。听说那石头长得像个特别美的屁股，美得能让你对自己的屁股自卑。

source: Ugh, we're never getting out of here! You guys are gonna starve and die, and then we'll be a group of lost ghosts forever, and I will be SO MAD at you.
target: 烦死了，咱们永远出不去了！你们几个会饿死，然后咱们就要永远当一群迷路的鬼！我会气死的！

source: No, we'll survive this. We may just need to "rough it" for a while and get my tie muddy.
target: 不，咱们能活着出去。可能就是得先“吃点苦”，把领带弄脏了也得认。

source: Let's start by making a roaring campfire!
target: 先升起一堆熊熊篝火吧！

source: Okay! Do you wanna start by burning this map?
target: 好啊！要先把这张地图烧了吗？

source: Scott, have you had a trail map with you this whole time?!
target: 斯科特，你一直带着步道地图？！

source: Yeah, I figured I'd keep one from the kiosk as a souvenir. Why, did you wanna use it for kindling earlier?
target: 对啊，我从咨询亭拿了一张，留作纪念嘛。怎么，你刚才就想拿它引火？

source: For fuck's sake... you make a mental note to strangle Scott later. For now, check his map and figure out how to get the hell out of here!
target: 真他妈服了……你默默记下一笔，回头一定要掐死斯科特。不过眼下，先看看他的地图，想办法离开这鬼地方！

source: The Mystical Journey to the Heart of the Park, where the lucky may find the Mythical Park Spirits, and the luckiest may even get a selfie with them!
target: 踏上通往公园之心的神秘旅程。幸运儿能见到传说中的公园精灵，特别幸运的还能跟它们自拍合影！

source: The path to Enlightenment.
target: 觉悟之路。

source: What? I've never met any Park Spirits here.
target: 什么？我在这儿可从来没见过什么公园精灵。

source: "You've never met them," says a voice like rustling leaves from behind you, "because YOU ARE THEM."
target: 身后响起一道像树叶沙沙作响的声音：“你没见过他们，是因为你们就是公园精灵。”

source: AHHH! Who are you?!
target: 啊啊啊！你是谁？！

source: "I'm Princess Wildheart, sacred protector of this park. I need your help to save these lands from the crushing tide of deforestation!"
target: “我是野性之心公主，这座公园的神圣守护者。请帮帮我，拯救这片土地，抵挡毁林的浪潮！”

source: Whoa, uh... this is all moving really fast...
target: 哇，呃……这进展也太快了吧……

source: Why do you even want our help? We aren't Park Spirits. We're basically invasive tourists trespassing on your land.
target: 你为什么找我们帮忙？我们又不是公园精灵，顶多算一群闯进你地盘的外来游客。

source: "No, think about it: you're park spirit-adjacent. That guy's a wolf, you're half-moth, and she's a spirit. It's close enough!"
target: “不，想想看，你们跟公园精灵差不多啊。他是狼，你是半个蛾子，她是鬼。够接近了！”

source: I guess... but how are we supposed to stop all of industrialization and deforestation? Isn't that gonna take awhile?
target: 也许吧……可要怎么阻止工业化、阻止砍伐森林啊？那不得花很长时间？

source: Apparently not! Princess Wildheart takes you on an action-packed, forest-demon-fighting adventure, and you save the national park in a tight 133 minutes!
target: 显然用不着！野性之心公主带你们展开了一场紧张刺激、对抗森林恶魔的大冒险。短短133分钟，你们就拯救了国家公园！

source: Hooray, we saved the forest and Mother Nature! I don't get why politicians made that sound so hard.
target: 万岁，森林和大自然母亲都得救了！真不懂那些政客为什么说得那么难。

source: "Thank you so much for your help, true heroes! I hope you had a good time. Please exit to the left."
target: “谢谢你们的帮助，真正的英雄们！希望各位玩得开心，请从左侧出口离开。”

source: Exit... what? The forest?
target: 出口……什么出口？森林的？

source: "Yup. You've reached the end of the Save the National Park Interactive Exhibit. The exit is to your left."
target: “对，你们的‘拯救国家公园’互动体验到此结束。出口在左边。”

source: "Stop by the information kiosk to buy a framed photograph of you slaying the demonic representations of industrialization!"
target: “欢迎到咨询亭购买带相框的纪念照，留下各位斩杀工业化恶魔化身的英姿！”

source: You mean this was all a ride?! We can't even have authentic life-changing brushes with Mother Nature anymore? What's the world coming to?
target: 所以这一切都是游乐项目？！现在连一次真正亲近大自然、改变人生的经历都没有了吗？这世界怎么了？

source: Oh, well. At least you got +N2 MAGIC from "saving" those "authentic" Park Spirits.
target: 唉，算了。至少“拯救”那些“真正的”公园精灵，让你获得了+N2魔力。

source: After carefully reviewing the map, you set off on the path to Enlightenment with hope in your hearts... well, SOME of you do.
target: 仔细看过地图后，你们怀着希望，踏上了觉悟之路……好吧，是你们当中的一部分人。

source: This fuckin' sucks. All this walking's gonna wear out my cute new running shoes!
target: 真他妈烦。走这么多路，我可爱的新跑鞋都要磨坏了！

source: You need to take this seriously. If you want to reach Enlightenment, you need to let go of your attachments to worldly luxuries.
target: 你得认真点。想达到觉悟，就得放下对世俗奢侈品的执念。
