target: 行，我试试……我不在乎我的鞋，我不在乎我的鞋，我不——

target: 好耶！骗你的，宇宙，我其实特别在乎我的鞋！

source: You run to the trail exit... and you're greeted with a metal turnstile operated by an old man?
target: 你们跑到步道出口……迎接你们的，居然是个老头把守的金属旋转闸门？

target: 他说：“恭喜走完‘觉悟之路’体验项目！靠近一点，我把觉悟的秘密悄悄告诉你。”

source: Okay... you lean in, and the man whispers, "Remember: all your fears, insecurities, and pressures will one day be gone."
target: 好吧……你凑过去，老人低声说：“记住，你所有的恐惧、不安和压力，终有一天都会消失。”

source: "You're just a speck on history's vast page. Let this revelation relieve all those meager burdens from your shoulders and set you free."
target: “在历史浩瀚的书页上，你不过是一粒尘埃。明白这一点，就能卸下肩上那些微不足道的负担，获得自由。”

source: Wow, that's actually really profound! You ask your friends what they were told.
target: 哇，还真挺深刻！你问朋友们，他们听到了什么。

source: The old man told me Brandon is fucking Astor behind Chelsea's back. I KNEW IT!
target: 老头告诉我，布兰登背着切尔西跟阿斯特乱搞。我就知道！

source: I got the true meaning of "Neon Genesis Evangelion." It was... a lot.
target: 我听到了《新世纪福音战士》的真正含义。实在是……信息量太大了。

source: He told me I need to clean my ears.
target: 他让我掏掏耳朵。

source: Cool! The path to Enlightenment was exhausting, confusing, and at times irritating, but it was all worth it to gain +N2 MIND.
target: 不错！觉悟之路让人疲惫、迷茫，有时还挺烦躁，不过能换来+N2头脑，也值了。

source: Pick mushrooms
target: 摘蘑菇

source: You're about thirty minutes into your hike when Scott apparently can't take it anymore.
target: 徒步走了大约三十分钟，斯科特显然已经撑不住了。

source: Man, I'm starving! Isn't there anything to eat in this lush, beautiful forest?
target: 老天，饿死我了！这么茂密、这么漂亮的一片森林，就没有点能吃的吗？

source: Ah, hello friends! It's good to see you, but you should be wary; I can hear the growling of some great beast somewhere on the trail...
target: 啊，朋友们，你们好！见到你们很开心，不过得小心。我听到这条路上有头巨兽在咆哮……

source: Hey, Moss Mann! Don't worry, that's just my stomach. I haven't seen a burger restaurant on this trail yet, and I'm getting pretty hungry.
target: 嘿，莫斯·曼！别担心，那只是我的肚子。这条路上连家汉堡店都没见着，我可饿坏了。

target: 哦。汉堡我是不知道，不过想吃点东西的话，我倒知道附近有个很棒的天然食物来源。

source: Moss leads you to a fallen tree covered with mushrooms.
target: 莫斯带你们来到一棵长满蘑菇的倒树前。

source: Behold, my friends: FUNGUS VIVI! They're succulent, they're savory...
target: 朋友们，看好了：活生菌！饱满多汁，滋味鲜美……

source: They're ALIVE?!
target: 它们是活的？！

source: "Of course we're alive!" giggle the sentient mushrooms. "We're the sweetest parasitic fungi in the whole forest!"
target: 有意识的蘑菇们咯咯笑道：“我们当然是活的！我们可是全森林最甜美的寄生真菌！”

target: “你们看着就很好骗——我是说，很友善。吸点我们的孢子吧，我们就能住进你们的脑袋，永远做最好的朋友！”

target: 不用了，谢谢。不过这些孢子配上炒洋葱和细香葱，味道肯定很不错……

source: But isn't eating something that's sentient and still alive kinda... wrong?
target: 可是，吃掉有意识、还活着的东西，是不是……不太对啊？

source: "It definitely is!" say the shrooms. "It'd be much more humane to let us germinate in your brains!"
target: 蘑菇们说：“绝对不对！让我们在你们脑子里发芽，才更人道嘛！”

source: I dunno... what do you think, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? Should we inhale the spores or eat the mushrooms?
target: 我也不知道了……%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你觉得呢？是吸孢子，还是吃蘑菇？

source: Uh... how about neither?
target: 呃……能不能两个都不选？

source: Nope! You should know the rules by now, boo: pick a wacky outcome and suffer the consequences. Are we eating or inhaling?
target: 不行！宝贝，你该懂规矩了吧：挑一个离谱的结果，再承受后果。所以是吃，还是吸？

source: You know what they say: "When you live with a mushroom parasitizing your brain, you're never truly alone!"
target: 俗话说得好：“脑子里有蘑菇寄生，你就永远不会真正孤单！”

source: Hey, the shrooms want to live rent free in your brain, but you want them to live rent free in the risotto you're having for dinner tonight. Fuck 'em.
target: 蘑菇想在你脑子里白住，你却想让它们在今晚的意式烩饭里白住。管它们呢。

source: Fuck yeah, let's snort 'em up! Dope mushroom powers, here we come!
target: 爽啊，吸起来！超酷蘑菇之力，我们来了！

source: Are you sure that was wise? What "dope mushroom powers" do you even have now?
target: 你们确定这很明智？所以现在，你们到底有什么“超酷蘑菇之力”？

source: "We've enhanced the strength of your skulls!" the mushrooms explain. "Now you can smash bricks with your foreheads!"
target: 蘑菇们解释道：“我们强化了你们的头骨！现在你们可以用脑门碎砖了！”

target: 他们为什么要拿脑门碎砖？

target: “呃……砖头里说不定有宝藏！不砸开怎么知道？”

target: 你从徒步背包里掏出早就装好的砖头，用头撞开。可惜，你从砖头里找到的，只有更多的头部创伤。

source: Well, that was a giant waste of time.

target: 蘑菇们说：“要是能让你们好受点，我们也算浪费了时间。我们刚用心灵感应商量过了，觉得还是搬出你们的脑子比较好。”

target: “本以为这会是一次很棒的寄生合作，可你们有的脑子里几乎没有一点营养……”

source: You look at Scott.
target: 你看向斯科特。

source: "...some are so flooded with toxic substances that they're killing us just to be here..."
target: “……有的灌满了有毒物质，光待在里面，我们就快死了……”

source: You look at Polly.
target: 你看向波莉。

source: "...or they're so full of weird shit that living here is a psychologically-traumatizing nightmare."
target: “……还有的塞满了奇怪玩意儿，住在这里简直是会留下心理创伤的噩梦。”

source: You look at... oh, wait, that's gotta be you.
target: 你看向……哦，等等，这肯定是在说你。

source: Wow, I can't believe you guys got dumped by a group of parasitic mushrooms. Wait until my gossip chain hears about this!
target: 哇，你们竟然被一群寄生蘑菇甩了。等我的八卦圈知道这事，还不得炸了！

source: The mushrooms evacuate your noggins, which is probably for the best, 'cause you already lost -N2 MIND. At least those mushroom powers left you with +N2 MAGIC!
target: 蘑菇们撤出了你们的脑袋。这大概也是好事，毕竟你已经失去了-N2头脑。至少蘑菇之力还留给你+N2魔力！

source: Excellent choice! Fungus vivi's natural smokey flavor pairs wonderfully with a good risotto.
target: 选得好！活生菌自带的烟熏风味，配上好的意式烩饭，简直绝了。

source: "NO, PLEASE DON'T EAT US! WE CAN'T STAND THE AGONY OF BEING EATEN!"
target: “不，求求你们，别吃我们！被吃掉太痛苦了，我们受不了！”

source: Well, you should've thought about that before you decided to be so delicious!
target: 那你们决定长得这么好吃之前，怎么不先想清楚呢！

source: You all pick some mushrooms to cook later. You go ahead and snack on some of them now, gaining +N2 STAMINA and listening to their screams.
target: 你们采了些蘑菇，留着之后做饭。眼下先吃几个垫垫肚子，听着它们的尖叫，获得了+N2体力。

source: "AGH! OH, GOD, THE ENDLESS PAIN!"

target: “不——！胃酸烧得好痛！为什么，残酷的世界，这是为什么？！”

source: "WOOHOO! FUCK YEAH! EAT ME!"
target: “呜呼！爽死了！吃了我！”

source: Uh... shouldn't this mushroom be screaming "DON'T eat me?"
target: 呃……这蘑菇不该喊“别吃我”吗？

source: "Oh, I can do that... 'Oh, no, don't eat me! Don't put me in your big, moist mouth and devour me whole, you beautiful pile of flesh!'"
target: “哦，这我也会……‘哦，不，别吃我！别把我塞进你那又大又湿的嘴里，一口吞下，亲爱的漂亮肉堆！’”

source: This is weird... %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, what's that on the ground next to where I picked this weird mushroom?
target: 真怪……%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，我采这只怪蘑菇的地方，旁边地上是什么？

target: 你凑近一看……是本迷你色情同人志，里面画满了吞食癖插图。

target: 果然，早该猜到这是性癖了……不过管它呢，我算是同意了。下肚吧！

target: 吃饱了我很开心，可我还是觉得，吃掉那些蘑菇有点坏……

target: 别担心，斯科特。咱们实现了那只怪蘑菇的性幻想，所以其实是做了件好事！

source: Oh, okay! That's a relief!
target: 哦，好吧！那我就放心了！

target: 你乐得让斯科特开心，不过自己心里有数。生吞有意识的蘑菇让你失去了-N2灵魂，你这变态混蛋。

source: Watch the show
target: 看节目

target: 你们落座看比赛。斯科特正准备吃辣肉酱热狗，就被一团夹着橄榄球头盔的毛茸茸扑倒了。

source: BROOOO! You made it!
target: 兄弟——！你来啦！

source: Whoa, hey bros! Polly, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, you know my cousins, right?
target: 哇，嘿，兄弟们！波莉，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你们认识我这些表兄弟吧？

source: Yes, I am painfully aware of the Wolfpack.
target: 认识，狼队嘛。想不认识都难，烦死了。

target: 兄弟，幸好找到你了，不然你就只能跟一帮无聊书呆子，看这超带劲的巨轮卡车厮杀了！

target: 怎么，你们觉得我跟%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%受不了死亡赛的血腥混乱？小子们，混乱就是我们发明的。

target: 行吧，死人可能不是什么好办法，可你也实在受不了这么无聊了。一定有办法让死亡赛更有意思……

source: Everyone seems to have fun by aggressively insulting the referee. But what about aggressively complimenting the referee and tipping him for doing a great job under such duress?
target: 大家骂裁判都骂得挺开心。不如改成拼命夸他，再给点小费，感谢他顶着这么大压力还尽职尽责？

target: 观众好像什么都赌。那就下个稳赢的注：这些卡车不会遵守交通法规。

source: FUCK YOU, REF! DON'T GIVE A PENALTY JUST 'CAUSE YOUR FOOT GOT RUN OVER! YOU'RE A COWARD IF YOU DIDN'T COME HERE TO GET HURT!
target: 去你的，裁判！不就是脚被碾了吗，罚什么罚！来这儿还不敢受伤，你就是个孬种！

target: 你没有跟着起哄，而是花-N2金钱给裁判打赏，还夸他身手矫健，能躲开那些想撞他的卡车。

target: 裁判说：“哇，谢谢！这小费真帮大忙了，多少能减轻点医药费的压力。”

target: 什么……？你夸了裁判？这也行？

target: 嘿，裁判！我喜欢你这身衣服！竖条纹可太时髦了！

target: 裁判先生，我觉得你的眼睛很漂亮！至少应该挺漂亮的吧，这儿太远，看不见。

target: 你们这些混蛋，觉得自己比我们会夸人？！我们能夸得比你们猛多了！

target: 嘿，裁判！你那张丑得像猪的蠢脸，远看可比近看漂亮多了！

target: 好吧，呃……嘿，裁判！红酒配牛排，美酒配佳肴！改天试试！

source: Wrong type of compliment. Do you guys know what a compliment even is?
target: 让你说美言，没让你说美酒。你们到底知不知道什么叫夸人？

target: 知道啊，就是你想跟漂亮妞打炮时，对她说的那些话嘛。

source: Wait, that's it! HEY, REF! YOU'VE GOT A MAGNIFICENT PUSSY!
target: 等等，有了！嘿，裁判！你的逼真他妈漂亮！

target: 好吧，虽然还没学会，但他们已经尽力了。你夸得比这强多了，至少获得了+N2灵魂！

target: 我赌2金钱，这些卡车不会遵守交通法规！

source: (%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, c'mon. I respect the attempted hustle, but not even the Wolfpack will fall for--)
target: （%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，别闹。你想捞一笔，这我敬你，可这连狼队都不会上——）

source: YOU'RE ON, NERD!!!

source: (Oh, never mind. I can't believe I almost gave them credit.)
target: （哦，当我没说。差点就高看他们了。）

source: In the first round alone, you point out fourteen traffic violations:
target: 光是第一轮，你就指出了十四起交通违章：

target: 不打转向灯、高速急转弯、无视交通锥……

source: Neither truck exchanges insurance information after crashing into each other...
target: 撞车之后，双方还不交换保险信息……

source: And one truck apparently has spikes on its wheels that can cut through a steel exoskeleton, which is definitely not street legal!
target: 还有一辆卡车，车轮上的尖刺能切穿钢铁外骨骼。这绝对不能合法上路！

source: You're just making shit up to confuse us! None of those things are against the driving rules!
target: 你就是瞎编来唬我们的！这些哪条违反驾驶规则了！

source: Are you serious? Do you guys not know how to drive?
target: 认真的？你们到底会不会开车？

source: No, we know how to drive. The rules are you gotta go faster than everyone else, and the more pedestrians you hit, the more points you get!
target: 当然会。规则就是得比所有人都快，撞的行人越多，分数越高！

source: At least, that's what every driving simulator we've ever played has taught us.
target: 至少我们玩过的驾驶模拟器，都是这么教的。

source: ...Are you referring to Grand Theft Auto?
target: ……你们说的是《侠盗猎车手》吧？

source: Well, whether the Wolfpack believes it or not, they owe you +N2 MONEY. You lose -N2 HYPE for wagering such an easy-to-win bet, though.
target: 不管狼队信不信，他们都欠你+N2金钱。不过，这注赢得实在太轻松，让你失去了-N2热度。

source: Take a joyride
target: 开车兜兜风

source: Your plan to drive a truck in the Monster Truck DeathMatch is going well until security says you can't drive a truck in the Monster Truck DeathMatch.
target: 你们本想开辆卡车参加巨轮卡车死亡赛。一切进展顺利，直到保安告诉你们：你们不能开卡车参加巨轮卡车死亡赛。

source: What do you mean, "we don't have security clearance?" Don't you know who I am?!
target: 什么叫“我们没有通行许可”？你不知道我是谁吗？！

source: "Uh... no, I don't. That's why I'm not letting you inside."
target: “呃……不知道。所以才不让你进去啊。”

source: But I'm THE Turkbekistan Worldwide Monster Truck DeathMatch Champion three years in the running!"
target: 我可是连续三届土尔别克斯坦世界巨轮卡车死亡赛冠军！

source: "Oh shit, are you serious? We're so sorry. We didn't know you were coming today."
target: “我去，真的假的？太抱歉了，我们不知道您今天会来。”

source: I'll let it slide for now, gentlemen, but the Turkbekistani Emperor will hear about this!
target: 先生们，这次我就不计较了。不过这件事，土尔别克斯坦皇帝会知道的！

source: "Wow, Turkbekistan has an emperor now? Times sure change!"
target: “哇，土尔别克斯坦现在都有皇帝了？时代真是变了啊！”

source: The security guards let "the Turkbekistani champion" (Polly) and "her hype squad" (you and Scott) into the arena.
target: 保安让“土尔别克斯坦冠军”（波莉）和“她的应援团”（你和斯科特）进了赛场。

source: I can't believe that worked! Let's ride, gang!
target: 居然真成了！伙计们，开起来吧！

source: Uh... we still have a problem, bros. These trucks are way too tall to climb into.
target: 呃……还有个问题，兄弟们。这些卡车太高，爬不上去啊。

source: Fuck, you're right! Stupid monster-truck engineers only cared about how high they COULD make their trucks, and not how high they SHOULD have.
target: 操，你说得对！那些蠢货工程师，光顾着想卡车能造多高，根本没想过该不该造这么高！

source: Polly, if we're getting in, we need to do it quick. The crowd's getting restless!
target: 波莉，要上车就得快点，观众等得不耐烦了！

source: What's happening?! Someone better figure out how to drive that car quick, or I'm gonna get really PISSY and RESTLESS!
target: 怎么回事？！赶紧来个人把车开起来，不然我要开始暴躁、开始不耐烦了！

source: Shit, it's true. You need to think of a way to get in that car!
target: 妈的，还真是。得赶紧想个办法上车！

source: This is why God invented giraffes, probably. Dunno, conjure a giraffe?
target: 上帝创造长颈鹿，大概就是为了这种时候吧。不知道，变一只出来？

source: Transcend the sense of self until space makes no sense anymore. You are everything and you are everywhere; therefore, you're already inside the monster truck.
target: 超越自我，直到空间再无意义。你是万物，你无处不在，所以你已经在巨轮卡车里面了。

source: Ugh, why are Scott and his friends drawing pictures in the mud on the monster truck instead of just driving the monster truck! THIS IS DUMB!
target: 烦死了，斯科特跟他朋友干嘛不直接开车，非要在巨轮卡车的泥巴上画画？！蠢死了！

source: Holy shitballs... I think they're attempting the Forbidden Giraffe Transmutation!
target: 我操……他们好像在尝试禁忌的长颈鹿炼成术！

source: The... what? Is that a new sports strategy or something?
target: 什么……术？是什么新的体育战术吗？

source: No, bro, it's alchemy! Scott and his friends are drawing the alchemical symbols to summon a giraffe!
target: 不是，兄弟，是炼金术！斯科特和他朋友在画炼金符号，想召唤一只长颈鹿！

source: But it's so risky... with the Law of Equivalent Exchange, they'll have to sacrifice something to create such a complex creature.
target: 可风险太大了……按照等价交换原则，要创造这么复杂的生物，就必须付出牺牲。

source: Damn, bro, how do you know all that?
target: 我去，兄弟，你怎么懂这么多？

source: I'm into alchemy. You know I do other stuff besides stand behind you wearing a football helmet, right?
target: 我喜欢炼金术啊。你不会以为，我除了戴着橄榄球头盔站你后面，就没别的爱好了吧？

source: While the Wolfpack bickers, you guys have finally completed your summoning circle. From the fabric of the universe, you slowly begin assembling the giraffe.
target: 狼队还在斗嘴，你们终于画好了召唤阵，开始从宇宙的构造中，一点点拼出长颈鹿。

source: The giraffe's giant skeleton spawns from nothingness. The bones are then slowly coated with bloody, sinuous, throbbing muscle and flesh.
target: 巨大的长颈鹿骨架凭空出现。血淋淋的肌肉和皮肉缓缓缠绕、覆盖上去，蜿蜒着，一下下搏动。

source: A horribly anguished bleating cry fills the arena as the giraffe is conjured from its dark realm into your reality.
target: 长颈鹿从黑暗的领域被召进你们的现实，痛苦至极的惨叫响彻整个赛场。

source: You begin to understand why nobody knows what a giraffe sounds like. It's too painful to witness.
target: 你开始理解，为什么没人知道长颈鹿怎么叫了。实在是听不下去。

source: Oof, is it finally summoned? That was a HUGE bummer.
target: 唉，终于召出来了？也太让人难受了。

source: Sorry we subjected you to so much pain and misery, giraffe bro. Would taking a joyride in a monster truck make up for it?
target: 抱歉，长颈鹿兄弟，让你受了这么多苦。带你开巨轮卡车兜兜风，能不能补偿一下？

source: The giraffe lets out a horrible bleat that you take to mean "yes please!" He ferries you up to the truck bed and then climbs in himself.
target: 长颈鹿发出一声可怕的叫声，你们就当是“好啊，拜托了！”它把你们送上卡车后斗，自己也爬了进去。

source: You gain +N2 HYPE competing in the Monster Truck DeathMatch, your giraffe bleating joyously the whole time.
target: 参加巨轮卡车死亡赛，让你获得了+N2热度。长颈鹿一路都在欢快地叫着。

source: Unfortunately, you lost -N2 MAGIC due to that whole Law of Equivalent Exchange bullshit. Oof.
target: 可惜，那套等价交换的破规矩让你失去了-N2魔力。唉。

source: Ooh, okay! As a semi-corporeal ghost, I'm GREAT at ignoring the laws of physics.
target: 哦，可以啊！身为半实体的鬼，违反物理定律我可拿手了。

source: Here's how ya do it: first, imagine nothingness. Now, imagine something-ness. Now, ask yourself... how different are they really?
target: 来，先想象“无”。然后想象“有”。再问问自己……这俩到底差多少？

source: Uh... pretty different, I think. Like, total opposites actually.
target: 呃……我觉得差挺多的吧。根本就是完全相反啊。

source: Don't be so sure, boo. The lines of physics in this world are not so cleanly drawn.
target: 别那么肯定，宝贝。这个世界的物理界限，可没划得那么清楚。

source: The existence of the multiverse and interdimensional travel prove that fixed existence in one space is a total myth.
target: 多元宇宙和跨次元旅行的存在，足以证明“只能固定存在于某处”根本就是扯淡。

source: The Human Realm and Monster Realm overlap; they just exist on a different quantum level or something. Who's to say how many other realms sit on top of ours?
target: 人类世界和怪物世界彼此重叠，只不过在不同量子层面之类的地方。谁知道还有多少世界叠在咱们的世界上？

source: What does it even mean to be "here" and not "there"? Aren't we all just atoms and stardust being yanked around by gravity and magic?
target: 在“这里”，不在“那里”，到底是什么意思？我们不都只是被引力和魔法扯来扯去的原子和星尘吗？

source: How is wishy-washy-ass reality gonna stop us from being in the monster truck RIGHT NOW?!
target: 这破现实自己都含糊不清，凭什么不让我们现在就在巨轮卡车里？！

source: Isn't meditation supposed to relax you? 'Cause this is just making my head hurt.
target: 冥想不是应该让人放松吗？我怎么越听越头疼。

source: Yours is too. You've lost -N2 MIND trying to understand Polly's experimental, borderline-nonsensical train of thought.
target: 你也头疼。为了理解波莉那套极具实验性、近乎胡说八道的思路，你失去了-N2头脑。

source: Well don't worry, it still worked! We're inside the monster truck!
target: 不过别担心，还是成功啦！我们已经在巨轮卡车里了！

source: HOLY SHIT! How'd they do that?!
target: 我操！他们怎么做到的？！

source: Who knows; who cares? Fuck physics, fuck space, fuck time, fuck logic, and most of all: FUCK THESE OTHER MONSTER TRUCKS! LET'S SMASH 'EM!
target: 谁知道呢，谁管啊！去他妈的物理、空间、时间、逻辑！最重要的是：去他妈的其他巨轮卡车！撞烂它们！

source: Polly gets her wish; you drive your monster truck in the DeathMatch and gain +N2 HYPE!
target: 波莉如愿以偿。你们开着巨轮卡车参加死亡赛，获得了+N2热度！

source: Pose as food vendors
target: 假扮食品小贩

source: You just checked your bank account and had a minor heart attack. It's time to make some extra cash...
target: 你刚查了银行余额，差点心梗。是时候赚点外快了……

source: Don't worry, I know the perfect way for us to get money. Let's pretend to be food vendors!
target: 别担心，怎么赚钱，我有个绝妙的办法。咱们假扮卖吃的！

source: But won't people notice we don't have uniforms or food or stuff?
target: 可咱们没制服，也没吃的，人家不会发现吗？

source: Psh, we don't need all that fancy shit to get people to give us money.
target: 切，想让人掏钱，哪用得着那些花里胡哨的东西。

source: We're at a monster truck rally. Everyone's too focused on the monster trucks to actually stop and realize we're phonies.
target: 这可是巨轮卡车大赛。大家光顾着看车，根本没空反应过来，发现咱们是假冒的。

source: Trust me, half the "food vendors" here are scammers themselves. Look around.
target: 相信我，这里的“食品小贩”，一半自己就是骗子。往四周看看。

source: "FOOD"! GET YOUR "FOOD" HERE!
target: 卖“吃的”咯！来这儿买“吃的”！

source: Great, I'm starving! But... did you put "food" in air quotes?
target: 太好了，饿死我了！不过……你说“吃的”的时候，干嘛用手比引号？

source: Who knows? You're too focused on the monster trucks to even notice that I'm a phony.
target: 谁知道呢？你光顾着看巨轮卡车，根本没发现我是个骗子。

source: Yeah, good point. One "food" please!
target: 对啊，有道理。给我来份“吃的”！

source: Excellent! I just put it into your mouth. No refunds!
target: 好嘞！已经放你嘴里了。概不退钱！

source: Mmm... this tastes... weird... what am I eating, bros?
target: 唔……这味道……怪怪的……兄弟们，我吃的是什么啊？

source: Can't look now! Too busy staring at trucks!
target: 现在没空看！看卡车还忙不过来呢！

source: Holy shit, this really will be easy. The only thing left to decide is what "food" product you're going to sell to these suckers...
target: 我操，还真是好骗。只剩一件事要决定了：该卖什么“食物”给这帮冤大头……

source: Sell hard metaphysical questions. It will be... food for thought.
target: 卖深奥的形而上学问题。这就是……精神食粮。

source: You're with Scott. And with Scott there's never a shortage of... SCOTT SNACKS!
target: 有斯科特在，还能缺什么？当然是……斯科特零食！

source: These people really love cars. Milk your car to get some sweet CAR JUICE!
target: 这些人那么爱车，就给咱们的车挤挤奶，来点香甜的汽车汁！

source: Great idea! People at monster truck rallies always expect hot dogs and beer, but what they're really craving are unanswerable philosophical questions!
target: 好主意！来巨轮卡车大赛的人总以为自己想要热狗和啤酒，其实他们渴望的是无解的哲学问题！

source: Scott, is that you? Why are you and your nerd friends talking about philosophy when you could be talking about sick-ass monster trucks?
target: 斯科特，是你吗？不聊那么牛逼的巨轮卡车，你跟你的书呆子朋友聊什么哲学啊？

source: We're selling food for thought, bros! Do any of you have hungry brains?
target: 我们在卖精神食粮啊，兄弟们！你们谁的脑子饿了？

source: Here, try a free sample: why do we bake cookies, but cook bacon?
target: 来，免费尝一口：为什么饼干叫 cookies，却用 bake 来做；培根叫 bacon，却用 cook 来做？
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): KEEP; 食粮式哲学问答；原梗依赖 bake/bacon 与 cook/cookies 的字音，现译明示对应词且保留食物，不改成无关中文脑筋急转弯。

source: ...Whoa.
Or this one: if you enjoyed yourself while you were "wasting time", was that time really even wasted?
target: 再来个：如果你“浪费时间”的时候很开心，那这时间真的算浪费了吗？

source: WHOOOOOA!
Or the ULTIMATE unanswerable question: if you hate all the haters, aren't you a hater yourself?!
target: 还有这道终极无解题：如果你讨厌所有爱喷人的人，那你自己不也在喷人吗？！

source: YOU ARE BLOWING MY MOTHERFUCKIN' MIND RIGHT NOW!
target: 我他妈的脑子要炸了！

source: I wanna try! If werewolves turn into wolves in the moonlight, but moonlight is just reflected sunlight, why aren't we wolves all the time?
target: 我也来！如果狼人遇上月光就会变成狼，可月光又只是反射的阳光，那我们为什么不是一直都变成狼呢？

source: Damn, that's a good one. You lose -N2 MIND pondering all these questions.
target: 我去，这个问题问得好。思考这些问题，让你失去了-N2头脑。

source: Whoa, I've been so busy thinking, I forgot all about being hungry! This food for thought thing is the shit! Take our +N2 MONEY!
target: 哇，光顾着动脑子，我都忘了饿了！精神食粮真他妈牛逼！拿着我们的+N2金钱！

source: Broooo, did you say you have Scott Snacks?!
target: 兄弟——你说你有斯科特零食？！

source: Of course I have Scott Snacks! My contract says I can never leave home without them!
target: 那当然！我的合同写着，出门绝对不能不带斯科特零食！

source: AWESOOOOME! We'll take some!
target: 太——棒——啦！给我们来点！

source: Hey, Scott, do you remember when you starred in that weird cartoon to promote these snacks? That was funny.
target: 嘿，斯科特，你还记得自己以前主演过一部推广这零食的怪动画吗？那可真逗。

source: Are you talking about "Scott Snaccs", the reverse-harem anime about the Scott Snacks Supermarket? Of course I remember! I played all the parts!
target: 你说的是《斯科特真可口》？那部以斯科特零食超市为背景的逆后宫动画？当然记得！所有角色都是我演的！

source: I was the strong, silent, handsome supermarket butcher...
target: 我演了超市里那个强壮、沉默又英俊的肉铺师傅……

source: And I was also the charming divorced dad who brought his kids to the store to get groceries every week...
target: 还演了那个迷人的离异爸爸，每周都带孩子来超市买菜……

source: And I was ALSO the annoying-yet-sexy supermarket manager everybody hated to love...
target: 还有那个让人又爱又恨、烦人却性感的超市经理……

source: I even played the cardboard-cutout of the Scott Snacks mascot who magically came to life with the power of sexy friendship!
target: 我甚至演了斯科特零食吉祥物的人形立牌，靠性感友谊的力量，神奇地活了过来！

source: Yeah, "Scott Snaccs" had a good run. I liked the episode where you had an appropriately-anime over-the-top sales battle with your rival grocery store.
target: 对，《斯科特真可口》当年挺火。我喜欢你跟竞争超市打销售大战的那集，夸张得很有动画片那味儿。

source: Holy shit, you're DEFINITELY binge-watching "Scott Snaccs" later. For now, though, you gotta make some sweet cash.
target: 我操，回头一定要把《斯科特真可口》一口气补完。不过现在，还是先赚钱吧。

source: You earn +N2 MONEY selling Scott Snacks to other spectators who are nostalgic about Scott's anime.
target: 你把斯科特零食卖给那些怀念这部动画的观众，赚了+N2金钱。

source: It takes some of the sting out of the -N2 STAMINA you lose giving all that food up.
target: 为了卖货把吃的都交出去，让你失去了-N2体力，不过赚到的钱多少算点安慰。

source: You siphon -N2 MAGIC from the car and start hawking your delicious "car juice" to anyone stupid enough to drink it.
target: 你从车里抽走-N2魔力，开始向那些蠢到肯喝的人，叫卖美味的“汽车汁”。

source: Scott, is that you? Why are you and your nerd friends carrying around a gas canister when you could be watching monster trucks ram the shit out of each other?
target: 斯科特，是你吗？你跟你这些书呆子朋友，不看巨轮卡车狠狠互撞，拎着个汽油桶干嘛？

source: Hey, bros! We're selling car juice to the spectators. You wanna try some?
target: 嘿，兄弟们！我们在卖汽车汁给观众呢，要尝尝吗？

source: Car juice? What's that? Some kinda new energy drink?
target: 汽车汁？那是什么？新出的能量饮料？

source: You said it, not us!
target: 你自己说的啊，我们可没说！

source: ALL the big muscle car aficionados drink car juice. I can't believe you haven't heard of it.
target: 肌肉车迷全都喝汽车汁。你们居然没听过？

source: Who said we hadn't heard of it?! We love cars! We know EVERYTHING about cars!
target: 谁说我们没听过？！我们爱车！车的事我们全知道！

source: We even know what makes them go: the power of testosterone!
target: 连车靠什么跑，我们都知道：靠睾酮的力量！

source: I love cars so much, I'd even fuck my car!
target: 我爱车爱到，跟我的车打炮都行！

source: Uh... okay. I didn't ask--
target: 呃……好吧。我也没问——

source: That's nothing! I love cars so much, I'd marry my car and open a joint bank account with it!
target: 这算什么！我爱车爱到，能跟自己的车结婚，再一起开个联名银行账户！

source: DON'T TRY TO ONE-UP ME, BRO! I love cars so much, sometimes I get naked, cover myself in car paint, and run around making engine noises!
target: 别想压我一头，兄弟！我可爱车了，有时我会脱光衣服，浑身涂上车漆，边跑边学发动机响！

source: ...Bro, what?
target: ……兄弟，你说啥？

source: ...I'm a little embarrassed now. If I give you +N2 MONEY, can we never speak of this again?
target: ……现在有点尴尬了。我给你+N2金钱，咱们就当没聊过这事，行吗？

source: Done! You sell your gasoline to the Wolfpack. They drink it, probably killing what few brain cells they have left, but whatever!
target: 成交！你把汽油卖给狼队。他们喝了下去，可能连仅剩的那点脑细胞都喝没了。不过，管它呢！

source: PVP
target: 玩家对战（PVP）

source: You're at the LARP working up the courage to order a whole leg of mutton when Scott runs up to you excitedly.
target: 你在真人角色扮演活动现场，正鼓起勇气想点一整条羊腿，斯科特就兴奋地跑了过来。

source: Polly, the LARP organizers said they're doing a scavenger hunt! Whoever finds "The One Bracelet to Rule Most Things" wins a prize!
target: 波莉，活动主办方说有寻宝游戏！谁找到“能统治大多数东西的至尊手镯”，就能拿奖！

source: We are GETTING that bracelet then. What's the first clue?
target: 那这手镯咱们要定了。第一条线索是什么？

source: "Intrepid travelers, search for the bracelet if you dare! Your first clue... is that your prize is OVER THERE!"
target: “勇敢的旅人，不怕就来寻手镯！第一条线索……你的奖品就在那边搁！”

source: You look where Scott's pointing and see The One Bracelet to Rule Most Things literally sitting on a pedestal. Sweet!
target: 顺着斯科特指的方向一看，那只至尊手镯还真就摆在底座上。爽啊！

source: You rush to grab it -- but some punk-ass human grabs it at the same time!
target: 你冲过去拿，结果一个臭屁的人类也同时伸手抓住了手镯！

source: It's too late, villains! We found the bracelet first. I invoke your honor to give us our prize fair and square.
target: 晚了，恶徒！是我们先找到手镯的。请拿出你们的荣誉感，把我们凭本事赢来的奖品交出来。

source: Okay, well I invoke "finders keepers losers weepers." We saw the bracelet first, so back the fuck up.
target: 行啊，那我就按“先到先得，后到哭去”的规矩来。我们先看见的，给老娘滚远点。

source: Fine. If you won't stand down, we'll settle this the old fashioned way... WITH VIOLENCE!
target: 好。你们不肯退让，那就用老办法解决……动手吧！

source: (Do we HAVE to use violence? Could I try making a seduction check instead?)
target: （非得动手吗？我能不能先过个魅惑检定？）

source: Sorry, but I don't want to fight a bunch of humans. I could hurt you; your skulls are so fragile!
target: 抱歉，可我不想跟一群人类打架。会弄伤你们的，你们的头骨太脆了！

source: Tch, who are you calling human? I'm obviously a vampire; I've got razor-sharp fangs and an aloof, antiheroic aura!
target: 嘁，你说谁是人类？我明明是吸血鬼，有利如刀锋的尖牙，还有高冷反英雄的气场！

source: Yeah, but when your "razor-sharp fangs" are obviously plastic replicas from Party Town, it kinda takes the oomph out of it.
target: 是啊，可你那“利如刀锋的尖牙”，明显是派对用品店买的塑料货，气场多少打了点折扣。

source: NO MORE TALKING! COMBAT HAS BEGUN! We've chosen our champion; who will be yours? The sassy alchemist, or the buff ent?
target: 别废话了！战斗开始！我们选好了出战代表，你们派谁？那个嘴辣的炼金术师，还是那个壮硕的树人？

source: Who knows? We don't make decisions. Ask %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!
target: 谁知道？我们不做决定。问%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%去！

source: Polly, the potion maker; the showstopper; the breathtaker; the HARBINGER OF CHAOS!
target: 波莉，魔药调制师、全场焦点、让人屏息的美人、混乱的先驱！

source: Scott, the good boy! He has good intentions and... apples, maybe?
target: 斯科特，乖狗狗！他有一片好心，还有……苹果，大概？

source: YAAASSS! It's Polly time, bitch!
target: 好耶！波莉时间到，贱人！

source: Ha! You might as well surrender now. Your alchemist build is totally weak against my vampire powers!
target: 哈！你现在投降还来得及。你那炼金术师配装，完全被我的吸血鬼能力克制！

source: Wait, which ones are the vampire powers again?
target: 等等，吸血鬼都有什么能力来着？

source: Y'know, the shit Liam does: being purple, turning into a hot dog stand, annoying people, etc.
target: 就李姆那些呗：浑身紫色，变热狗摊，烦人，之类的。

source: What? Have you even read the core rulebook? Vampires turn into bats, not hot dog stands!
target: 什么？你看过核心规则书吗？吸血鬼会变蝙蝠，不是热狗摊！

source: And their skin isn't purple; it's sexily pale, like moonlight glittering on the back of a dying swan.
target: 而且皮肤不是紫色，是性感的苍白，像月光在垂死天鹅背上流转。

source: Well, you've clearly got the "being annoying" part down.
target: 好吧，“烦人”这项，你倒是掌握得很到位。

source: UGH! ATTACK, MY CHILDREN!
target: 可恶！攻击，我的孩子们！

source: The vampire throws some rubber bats at Polly. She phases out of where she was standing and appears behind him.
target: 吸血鬼朝波莉扔出几只橡胶蝙蝠。她瞬间虚化，从原地消失，出现在他身后。

source: Nice try, Count Dorkula.
target: 想得美，蠢古拉伯爵。

source: How did you do that?! You were just over there!
target: 你怎么做到的？！你刚才明明还在那边！

source: I dunno. Ghost powers?
target: 不知道啊，幽灵能力？

source: But you can't have ghost powers, you're already an alchemist! Having two classes is against the LARP rules!
target: 可你不能有幽灵能力，你已经是炼金术师了！双职业违反活动规则！

source: I know, but I sorta drank all my "potions" while you were being annoying. So, ghost powers it is.
target: 我知道，可你刚才烦个不停的时候，我已经把“魔药”全喝光了。所以只好用幽灵能力咯。

source: YOU'RE SUCH A CHEATER! I'm telling the GM!
target: 你作弊！我要去告诉主持人！

source: Good job, bro! You made him retreat!
target: 干得好，兄弟！你把他逼退了！

source: Yup. Lucky for me, "being annoying" is a ghost power too.
target: 对啊，幸好“烦人”也是幽灵能力。

source: You gained +N2 HYPE witnessing Polly's chaos at work! But you lost the -N2 MAGIC she used to brew her "potions."
target: 亲眼见证波莉制造混乱，让你获得了+N2热度！不过她调制那些“魔药”，也花掉了-N2魔力。

source: WOOHOO! Tag me in, Coach! I'll win with the power of love and a well-balanced diet!
target: 呜呼！教练，换我上！我要靠爱的力量和均衡饮食赢下这一局！

source: Tremble, evildoer, before my SONG OF DESPAIR!
target: 邪徒，在我的绝望之歌前颤抖吧！

source: The bard plays a melody. The only despairing thing about it is how untuned her lute is.
target: 吟游诗人弹起一段旋律。唯一让人绝望的，是她的鲁特琴跑调跑得有多离谱。

source: Nice song! Can I sing one I like now? "How much is that doggie in the windooooow?"
target: 歌真好听！现在我能唱首喜欢的歌吗？“橱窗里的那只小狗，要多——少——钱——？”

source: Stop that! She's playing a song of despair! The rules say you're supposed to fall into a nightmarish sleep!
target: 停下！她弹的是绝望之歌！按规则，你应该陷入噩梦般的沉睡！

source: Oh, sorry! I didn't mean to break the rules. I'll be a good boy next time.
target: 哦，抱歉！我不是故意破坏规则的。下次一定乖。

source: But just out of curiosity, do you know any songs that aren't about despair?
target: 不过我有点好奇，你会不会唱点不绝望的歌？

source: Um... I do, actually! No one ever lets me play what I want to play...
target: 呃……其实会！只是从来没人让我弹自己想弹的……

source: ...Anyway, here's Wonderwall!
target: ……总之，接下来这首《Wonderwall》！

source: STOP! That song is completely wrong for this medieval-fantasy setting! And you're supposed to be kicking your foe's ass, not serenading him!
target: 停！这首歌根本不符合中世纪奇幻设定！你该把敌人揍趴，不是给他唱情歌！

source: But all we ever do is fight people! I'm tired of it!
target: 可我们除了打架还是打架，我受够了！

source: I became a bard to end suffering with art... and to get laid. You guys never let me get laid!
target: 我当吟游诗人，是为了用艺术终结痛苦……还有打炮。你们从来不让我打炮！

source: Yeah, let's not fight. Good bois don't fight! Maybe we can just share some apples and have a song-fight instead of a fight-fight?
target: 对啊，别打了。乖狗狗不打架！要不分点苹果吃，把打架换成斗歌？

source: YES! BATTLE OF THE BANDS!
target: 好啊！来场乐队争霸！

source: Scott and the bard play more music, and you gain +N2 SOUL solving things peacefully! But you lose -N2 STAMINA sharing Scott's apples.
target: 斯科特和吟游诗人继续演奏。和平解决冲突让你获得了+N2灵魂，不过分掉斯科特的苹果，也让你失去了-N2体力。

source: GM
target: 当主持人（GM）

source: You arrive at the LARP, but it looks like the event hasn't started yet. Some props are strewn about, and you see the GM writing in his worldbuilding notebook.
target: 你来到真人角色扮演活动现场，可活动似乎还没开始。道具散落各处，主持人正在世界观设定笔记上奋笔疾书。

source: You ask him where the bathrooms are. He takes one look at you, screams "AAAHH!!! REAL MONSTERS!", and falls over.
target: 你问他厕所在哪。他看了你一眼，大叫“啊啊啊！真怪物！”，然后倒了下去。

source: Yup... he's dead. Don't feel bad, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. I would NEVER die just by looking at your face.
target: 嗯……死了。别难过，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。我绝对不会光看你的脸就死掉的。

source: What do we do, bros? The LARP is starting soon, and there's no Game Master to direct the event!
target: 怎么办啊，兄弟们？活动快开始了，都没有主持人来带大家玩！

source: Maybe we can fill in for him! The show must go on! Let's check his worldbuilding notes...
target: 要不咱们顶上？活动不能停！先看看他的世界观笔记……

source: These notes say, "The LARP has been taken over by an evil sorceress, and it's up to the LARPers to find the Sword of Justice and slay the--"
target: 上面写着：“邪恶女术士控制了这片土地，冒险者们必须找到正义之剑，杀死——”

source: YAAAAAAWN. I'm already asleep. Not to bash nerdy shit, but this is SUPER played-out nerdy shit.
target: 哈——欠。我都睡着了。不是想喷宅圈的东西，可这宅味套路也太老掉牙了。

source: Maybe it's a good thing %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% killed that guy with %HISHER% face. Now we have a chance to improve his setting!
target: 没准%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%用%HISHER%脸把这人吓死，倒是件好事。现在咱们能改进他的设定了！

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, can you think of a twist we could add to the LARP to make things more unique?
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你能想个反转加进去，让这场活动更独特一点吗？

source: Design a complex economy that relies on microtransactions. It's so popular in mobile games nowadays that it must be the thing players like the most! Right?
target: 设计一套依靠内购的复杂经济系统。现在手游都流行这个，玩家肯定最喜欢它了！对吧？

source: Introduce these people to the REAL adventure: a world where they must brace for an upcoming prom while attending a school where they do everything but learning.
target: 带他们体验真正的冒险：上学期间什么都干，就是不学习，还得为即将到来的舞会做好准备。

source: After a few hours of setup and revisions, the LARPers arrive. For their sake, you hope they brought their wallets!
target: 布置、修改了几个小时后，玩家们来了。但愿他们带了钱包，毕竟这可是为他们好！

source: En garde, villains! My adventuring party and I are here to slay the evil sorceress! But first, do you have a quest for us to gather experience?
target: 接招吧，恶徒！我们冒险小队是来讨伐邪恶女术士的！不过在此之前，有没有任务给我们刷点经验？

source: Sure! Here's a direwolf. Slay that thang.
target: 有啊！这儿有只恐狼，干掉它。

source: You set up a cardboard direwolf. The fighter slashes it to pieces.
target: 你摆出一只纸板恐狼。战士几剑把它劈成碎片。

source: Oop, sorry boo. Your DMG output wasn't quiiiiite high enough to slay the direwolf. But for +N2 MONEY, you can increase your DMG by 80% for 48 hours!
target: 哎呀，抱歉，宝贝。你的伤害输出还差那么一点点，没能打死恐狼。不过只要给我们+N2金钱，就能让伤害提高80%，持续48小时！

source: Ooh, do you have any upgrades for me? I'll easily pay that amount for an increase in lute-playing! That sounds way easier than practicing my scales!
target: 哦，有适合我的强化吗？花这点钱就能提高鲁特琴演奏水平，我肯定买！听着比练音阶容易多了！

source: COMMERCIAL BREAK TIME! Have you guys ever tried Scott Snacks? They're the yummiest treat for the adventurer on the go!
target: 广告时间到！各位吃过斯科特零食吗？出门冒险，这是最美味的点心！

source: Pah! I'm an immortal vampire; a creature of the night! I have no use for your pedestrian junk food!
target: 哼！我是不朽的吸血鬼，暗夜的生物！哪用得着你们这些平庸的垃圾食品！

source: They come in Cherry Blood Flavor!
target: 还有樱桃鲜血口味哦！

source: SHUT UP AND TAKE MY MONEY!
target: 别说了，钱拿去！

source: Congratulations, adventurers! For watching the whole advertisement, you win a spin on our LOOT WHEEL for a 0.6% chance to win a fantastic prize!
target: 恭喜冒险者们！看完广告，就送一次战利品转盘抽奖机会！有0.6%的概率抽中豪华大奖哦！

source: Finally, rewards for my efforts! Let's spin!
target: 努力终于有回报了！转起来！

source: It's slowing down! Your prize is... horseshit! Literally! You can keep it -- no need to thank us!
target: 慢下来了！你的奖品是……一坨马粪！真马粪！拿走吧，不用谢！

source: Uh... no thanks. Can we just continue the quest now?
target: 呃……不必了，谢谢。现在能继续做任务了吗？

source: Sorry, boo. You guys are all out of questing energy for the day. It replenishes automatically in 6 hours -- or you can pay to refill it now!
target: 抱歉，宝贝。你们今天的任务体力已经用完啦。再过6小时自动回满，也可以现在付费补满哦！

source: Seriously? I took a day off work and spent hours making cosplay just for this to suck! I'm going home.
target: 真的假的？我专门请了天假，花了好几个小时做角色服装，就玩这么个破东西？！我回家了。

source: Who'd have thought making a LARP pay-to-win would be an unpopular decision?! You lose -N2 HYPE.
target: 谁能想到，把真人角色扮演活动改成氪金就能赢，居然不受欢迎？！你失去了-N2热度。

source: Over the next few hours, you build some sets and get into costume. Soon, the first LARPers arrive.
target: 接下来几个小时，你们搭好布景，换上服装。很快，第一批玩家来了。

source: En garde, villains! My adventuring party and I are here to slay the evil sorceress! Prepare to fight!
target: 接招吧，恶徒！我们冒险小队是来讨伐邪恶女术士的！准备战斗！

source: Nah, we're not doing that anymore. Now the LARP is all about being a student at Spooky Academy, where danger and horniness abound!
target: 不玩那个了。现在的设定是：你们是惊悚学院的学生，校园里到处都是危险和欲望！

source: In this scenario, you're skipping class in the bathroom when a wild griffin appears! What do you do?
target: 这个场景里，你正躲在厕所逃课，突然出现一只野生狮鹫！你会怎么做？

source: I use my greatsword to behead the beast!
target: 我用巨剑砍下这野兽的头！

source: Actually, you can't. Your only two options are to turn the griffin into a rapper or bake it into a pasta.
target: 其实不行。你只有两个选项：让狮鹫当说唱歌手，或者把它做成焗意面。

source: Wh... what?
target: 什……什么？

source: LET'S DO THE MUSIC ONE! Doot doot magic lute!
target: 选音乐那个！嘟嘟嘟，魔法鲁特琴！

source: Now for this event, you need to throw a bunch of parties to discover the secret ingredient that makes all parties great! What do you do?
target: 接下来这个事件，你们得连办好几场派对，找出让所有派对都好玩的秘密配方！你会怎么做？

source: Oh, um... I wouldn't even know where to start. I've never actually been invited to a party...
target: 哦，呃……我都不知道从哪儿开始。其实，从来没人邀请我参加过派对……

source: Goddamn, are you serious? That's so mean! Humans really ARE the real monsters, huh?
target: 我靠，真的假的？也太过分了！人类还真是怪物啊？

source: Why are you saying that like you're something other than human?
target: 你这话怎么说得好像自己不是人类一样？

source: ...Moving on!
target: ……看下一个！

source: Now you have to help your vampire friend become popular enough to be crowned Prom King!
target: 现在，你们要帮助吸血鬼朋友提高人气，让他当上舞会国王！

source: R-Really? That sounds... awesome!
target: 真、真的吗？听着……太棒了！

source: I was never popular enough to be prom king back in the day. This is the wildest fantasy ever!
target: 我以前从来没人气到能当上舞会国王。这才是最疯狂的幻想！

source: The LARPers have a great time cosplaying as people who were happy and popular in high school. You gain +N2 HYPE!
target: 玩家们扮演了一回高中时代快乐又受欢迎的人，玩得特别开心。你获得了+N2热度！

source: But this all reminds you that you learned nothing in school 'cause you were too busy being Chaotic Horny, and you lose -N2 MIND from all these nonsensical scenarios you present.
target: 可这也提醒了你，上学时你光顾着瞎搞和发情，根本没学到东西。你编出的这堆离谱场景，让你失去了-N2头脑。

source: NPC
target: 扮演非玩家角色（NPC）

source: You're ready to get your medieval costumes and mead on! You just need to buy tickets. They only cost...
target: 你准备好换上中世纪服装，喝起蜂蜜酒了！现在只差买票。票价只要……

source: SEVENTY-FIVE BUCKS?! Just to stand in the hot sun with a wooden sword all day?! God, nerds will pay for ANYTHING.
target: 七十五块？！就为了顶着大太阳，拿把木剑站一天？！老天，书呆子真是什么都肯花钱啊。

source: "If the tickets are too pricey for you, you could get in free if you fill in for some of our NPCs who didn't show up today," the ticket-seller offers.
target: 售票员提议：“嫌票贵的话，今天有些NPC演员没来，你们可以补他们的缺，免费入场。”

source: Polly, what's an NPC?
target: 波莉，NPC是什么？

source: A non-player character. They have no real autonomy and only exist to interact with the player characters and make the game interesting.
target: 非玩家角色。没有真正的自主权，存在的意义就是跟玩家角色互动，让游戏更有意思。

source: Oh... Polly, are we NPCs?
target: 哦……波莉，那我们也是NPC吗？

source: I try not to think about it.
target: 这个问题，我尽量不想。

source: Anyway, let's do this! Do you have any openings for a sexy barmaid NPC who occasionally drips liquor on her lavish bosoms?
target: 总之，干吧！有没有性感酒馆女招待的空缺，时不时往自己丰满的胸脯上滴点酒那种？

source: "Uh... no, we don't have anything like that."
target: “呃……没有，没这种角色。”

source: Can I be an Abraham Lincoln NPC? I heard he had a cool hat!
target: 我能演亚伯拉罕·林肯吗？听说他有顶很酷的帽子！

source: "What? No. Sorry, you gotta choose something off the available NPC list."
target: “什么？不行。抱歉，你们得从现有的NPC名单里选。”

source: Ugh, fine. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, what NPCs should we be?
target: 烦，好吧。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，咱们演什么NPC？

source: The random NPCs who sit in the same spot all day and repeat the same sentence again and again when interacted with. Sounds chill!
target: 那种整天坐在同一个地方，有人来搭话就反复说同一句台词的路人NPC。听着挺清闲！

source: Merchants who imprint arcane glyphs to imbue weapons with strange powers. It can give your sword an "edge" in battle, wink!
target: 当附魔商人，刻下奥术符文，给武器注入奇妙力量。让你的剑在战斗中“锋芒毕露”，懂吧！

source: Great idea! I won't have to think of new sentences to say all the time! Let's sit on these barrels and wait for some adventurers to show up.
target: 好主意！这样就不用老想着下一句该说什么了！咱们坐在这些桶上，等冒险者来吧。

source: Greetings, travelers! My party and I come in search of gold, loot, and adventuring fame. Do you have any quests for us?
target: 旅人们，幸会！我和队友们为黄金、战利品与冒险的名声而来。你们有什么任务要交给我们吗？

source: I hope you have a grrrrrrreat adventure!
target: 祝你们来场超——棒的冒险！

source: I like turtles.
target: 我喜欢乌龟。

source: Have you seen my daughter? She's been missing since the warlock came from the mountains.
target: 你们见过我女儿吗？自从那术士从山里来，她就失踪了。

source: Nice, a quest! Let's look around this area and see if there are any clues to finding %HISHER% daughter!
target: 不错，有任务了！咱们在附近找找，看有没有关于%HISHER%女儿的线索！

source: The LARPers smash your barrels to see if there are clues inside. They find nothing, and now you have to sit in the mud. Damn.
target: 玩家们砸烂你们坐的桶，想看看里面有没有线索。什么都没找到，你们却只能坐泥地里了。靠。

source: Hmm... maybe to find the daughter, we have to bring the plague doctor a turtle? Or maybe %HISHER% daughter IS a turtle? Are we getting warmer?
target: 嗯……想找到女儿，是不是得给瘟疫医生带只乌龟？还是说，%HISHER%女儿本来就是只乌龟？我们快猜对了吗？

source: I hope you have a grrrrrrreat adventure!
target: 祝你们来场超——棒的冒险！

source: I like turtles.
target: 我喜欢乌龟。

source: The LARPers spend hours overanalyzing your lines. Eventually, you've said your daughter is missing so many times, you wonder if you really DO have a missing daughter IRL.
target: 玩家们花了好几个小时过度解读你们的台词。“女儿失踪了”说了太多遍，你都开始怀疑现实里自己是不是也有个失踪的女儿。

source: Did a warlock really kidnap her, or did she leave of her own accord? Maybe because you failed as a parent and you blocked out the memory?!
target: 她真的被术士绑走了，还是自己离开的？难道是你没当好家长，所以把这段记忆封存了？！

source: Guys, they won't stop bringing me turtles. What do I even do with twenty-seven turtles? I don't like turtles THAT much...
target: 伙计们，他们不停地给我送乌龟。二十七只啊，叫我怎么办？我也没那么喜欢乌龟……

source: I hope you have a grrrrrrreat adventure!
target: 祝你们来场超——棒的冒险！

source: Scott? SCOTT?! You know you can say other sentences, right? SPEAK TO ME!
target: 斯科特？斯科特？！你知道自己可以说别的台词吧？跟我说话啊！

source: How do those NPC pros in Skyrim bear this torture?! You gained +N2 STAMINA sitting around all day, but lost -N2 MIND repeating yourself so many times.
target: 《上古卷轴5：天际》里那些专业NPC，都是怎么熬过这折磨的？！干坐一整天让你获得了+N2体力，可重复太多遍台词，也让你失去了-N2头脑。

source: You, Polly, and Scott set up your shop. It doesn't take long for players to arrive.
target: 你、波莉和斯科特支起了摊子。没多久，玩家们就来了。

source: Well met, merchants! What wares do you have for a gang of fearless adventurers?
target: 商人们，幸会！我们这群无畏的冒险者，在你们这儿能买到什么好货？

source: We've got that good shit: MAGIC! Scott, give 'em a glyph!
target: 我们有好东西：魔法！斯科特，给他们来个符文！

source: Ooh, I'll take a glyph that gives me a bonus to my performance skill. Or do you have one that lets me cast fire spells?!
target: 哦，我要个能加表演技能的符文。或者，有没有能让我施放火焰法术的？！

source: Nope! But I'll give you the best glyph I know. It's also the only one I know!
target: 没有！不过我可以给你我知道的最棒的符文。也是我唯一会的！

source: Scott draws an arcane glyph on the vampire's dagger in magic marker.
target: 斯科特用记号笔，在吸血鬼的匕首上画了个奥术符文。

source: With this glyph your dagger has gained the powerful skill of... Portuguese!
target: 有了这符文，你的匕首获得了强大的能力……葡萄牙语！

source: Wait, what? Why would we want a dagger that speaks Portuguese?
target: 等等，什么？我们要一把会说葡萄牙语的匕首干嘛？

source: It doesn't SPEAK Portuguese, silly; weapons can't talk! It just understands Portuguese now.
target: 它又不会说葡萄牙语，傻瓜。武器怎么会说话！它只是现在能听懂葡萄牙语了。

source: Uh... okay then. Do you have any upgrades for my sword?
target: 呃……行吧。那我的剑，有什么能升级的吗？

source: I've got just the weapon-enhancing potion for you, boo. Watch my alchemy at work!
target: 宝贝，我这儿正好有瓶强化武器的魔药。看我的炼金术！

source: Polly pulls out a jar of mayonnaise and slathers the sword in thick, white goo.
target: 波莉掏出一罐蛋黄酱，把浓稠的白色酱料抹满剑身。

source: VOILA! Your sword is now imbued with the Potion of Mayo! It gives your sword the power to taste like mayo.
target: 大功告成！你的剑现在注入了蛋黄酱魔药！获得的力量就是：尝起来像蛋黄酱。

source: What's the point of that?
target: 那有什么用？

source: Think of the joke potential next time you're in a duel. You'll be all, "Taste my sword, villain!", and they'll be all, "Why the fuck does it taste like mayo?" Classic!
target: 想想下次决斗能玩什么梗。你来一句“尝尝我的剑吧，恶徒！”，对面就会说“这他妈怎么一股蛋黄酱味？”经典！

source: ...What?
target: ……什么？

source: That'll be +N2 MONEY. No need to thank us!
target: 收你们+N2金钱。不用谢！

source: They do not thank you, which sucks, 'cause you spent -N2 MAGIC manifesting that glyph and producing that potion. Fuckin' ungrateful humans!
target: 他们还真没谢。可恶，你可是花了-N2魔力才弄出符文和魔药的。忘恩负义的人类！

source: Arcade
target: 去游戏厅

source: As you and your friends walk around the mall, you see your friend Valerie sitting on the center fountain and texting. She looks up and smiles at you.
target: 你和朋友们逛着商场，看见瓦莱丽坐在中央喷泉边发短信。她抬起头，冲你们笑了笑。

source: Wassup, guys?
target: 嗨，伙计们，怎么样？

source: Hey, Val! Long time no see! How's business?
target: 嘿，小瓦！好久不见！生意怎么样？

source: It's good, same as always: selling dangerous totems of ancient deities and used tampons to any fool who's willing to pay!
target: 挺好，老样子：给愿意掏钱的傻瓜卖危险的古神图腾，还有用过的卫生棉条！

source: Who... who would pay for a used tampon?
target: 谁……谁会花钱买用过的棉条啊？

source: I dunno. My policy is to never ask where that shit comes from or where that shit goes.
target: 不知道。我的原则是，不问那些破玩意儿从哪儿来，也不问卖到哪儿去。

source: Good policy! I also choose not to think about where my poop comes from or goes!
target: 好原则！我也选择不去想，我的便便从哪里来、到哪里去！

source: Eh... great minds think alike, Scott.
target: 呃……英雄所见略同啊，斯科特。

source: Anyway, I'm taking the day off and having fun the 90s way: celebrating peak non-critical capitalism at a shopping mall.
target: 总之，我今天休假，打算用九十年代的方式找乐子：在商场里，拥抱那种毫无反思、登峰造极的资本主义。

source: Wanna hit up the arcade with me?
target: 要不要一起去游戏厅？

source: Ooh, yes!
target: 哦，要！

source: Welcome to my mall, target demographic! Why don't you play the new arcade game we just installed? It is, as the kids say, very LMAO.
target: 目标消费群体们，欢迎来到我的商场！试试刚装上的新街机怎么样？用年轻人的话说，那可是非常“笑死”。

source: Sure! What's the game?
target: 好啊！什么游戏？

source: It's called Cashy Road! You just cross the road to win. Earn bonus points by entering your full name, social security number, and credit card info!
target: 叫《捞钱过马路》！过了马路就算赢。输入全名、社保号和信用卡信息，还能获得额外积分！

source: All that for an arcade game? What do you even win?
target: 玩个街机要填这么多？到底能赢什么？

source: Tickets, lots of tickets! ...To see the new show I just produced, ADS ON ICE! It's a 2.5 hour musical advertisement for ice!
target: 票，好多票！……我刚制作的新演出《冰上广告》的门票！那是一部长达2.5小时、宣传冰块的音乐广告！

source: Uh, I think I'd rather play... literally anything else. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, what game should we play first?
target: 呃，我宁愿玩……随便别的什么。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，先玩哪台？

source: The glitchy off-putting game that seems to be lifted straight from a creepypasta.
target: 那台故障频出、让人不舒服的机器，简直像从网络恐怖故事里搬出来的。

source: A claw machine where you try to grab porridge. Good luck.
target: 一台抓粥机，得用夹爪把粥抓上来。祝你好运。

source: "Dragon Heat VR: Thrust Your Senses", the game you don't want to play in front of your parents... or in front of anyone at all for that matter.
target: 《Dragon Heat VR：冲击你的感官》，一款不想当着父母玩……准确说，是不想当着任何人玩的游戏。

source: Oh, this one... I think it's called "UR ALREADY DED.exe"
target: 哦，这台……好像叫《你已经死了.exe》。

source: Ominous!
target: 听着不吉利啊！

source: Yeah, it's a bold choice. I heard it just showed up in the basement one day and the guy who found it died in a forklift accident. I wouldn't play it myself, but to each their own.
target: 嗯，选得挺大胆。听说这机器有天突然出现在地下室，发现它的人后来死于叉车事故。我反正不碰，不过你开心就好。

source: The game seems to be based on some beloved childhood title with a classic retro pixel aesthetic!
target: 这游戏看着像是改编自某款深受喜爱的童年游戏，画面是经典的复古像素风！

source: You and two friends must retrieve the magical book to save the pixelated fantasy world.
target: 你和两位朋友必须找回魔法书，拯救这个像素奇幻世界。

source: It's fun, but suddenly, the screen starts glitching as if the file was heavily corrupted, deafening all of you with white noise.
target: 玩着挺开心，可屏幕突然像文件严重损坏了一样开始故障，白噪音震得你们耳朵都快聋了。

source: The screen goes back to normal, but now the pixelated friends look strangely like Polly and Scott!
target: 画面恢复正常，可那两个像素小伙伴，怎么看着那么像波莉和斯科特？！

source: When you cast a spell from the magic book... it releases a world-ending deity?!
target: 你用魔法书施了个咒……结果放出了一位灭世神？！

source: The world is engulfed in despair; you see all your loved ones dying as a result of your actions...
target: 整个世界陷入绝望，你看着所爱的人一个接一个因你的所作所为死去……

source: An eerie noise comes from the machine. It sounds like distorted versions of Polly and Scott's voices...
target: 机器传来诡异的声音，听着像波莉和斯科特的声音被扭曲了……

source: "PrANk MasTerZ..."
"...WitH a Z!"
Whoa, Polly, I don't like this game. It looks like us doing bad things to our friends!
target: 哇，波莉，我不喜欢这游戏。看着就像咱们在伤害朋友！

source: It's okay, buddy. It's just this asshole arcade game messing with us. We'd never do something like this in real life.
target: 没事的，哥们。就是这破游戏在耍咱们。现实里，我们绝对不会干这种事。

source: Credits roll with superimposed images of your friends with no eyes, while some strange smoke comes from the machine.
target: 制作人员名单滚过屏幕，叠着朋友们没有眼睛的图像。机器里还冒出了奇怪的烟。

source: You are filled by the cursed energy of the arcade machine, gaining +N2 MAGIC but totally losing -N2 MIND.
target: 街机的诅咒能量灌满你的身体，给了你+N2魔力，却也让你狠狠损失了-N2头脑。

source: You see a post-credits scene. It's you -- not %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, but YOU, the person playing "Monster Roadtrip" -- in front of a door.
target: 片尾彩蛋出现了。画面里是你——不是%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，而是正在玩《Monster Roadtrip》的你本人——站在一扇门前。

source: The door opens... and some shadowy figures lunge towards you, then stab you repeatedly while screeching:
target: 门开了……几个黑影朝你扑来，一边不断捅你，一边尖叫：

source: "PraAAaAaAAaaaANk MasTeeEEEeeEEeeeeEeerZ... WITH A Z!"
THAT game? It's such a scam. If you wanna waste your money on a scam, at least invest in one of mine.
target: 这台？纯纯的骗局。真要花钱受骗，至少投我一个项目吧。

source: No, I want porridge! I'm really craving it now. Will you win me some, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?
target: 不要，我想吃粥！现在特别想吃。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，帮我赢点粥好不好？

source: Who can say no to those puppy-dog eyes? You all gather round the claw machine as you try to win.
target: 谁能拒绝这双小狗眼呢？你准备大展身手，大家都围到了抓粥机旁。

source: You waste a lot of quarters trying with no success. Because it's, y'know, loose porridge, and you're trying to grab it with a metal claw.
target: 你投进去一堆硬币，却一无所获。毕竟那是一摊稀粥，而你想用金属爪子把它夹起来。

source: Ready to admit this is a scam yet? I know a way to beat the system.
target: 这下肯承认是骗局了吗？我倒知道个钻空子的办法。

source: How do we win, Val? My stomach can't take much more suspense!
target: 小瓦，要怎么赢啊？我的肚子可受不了这么吊胃口！

source: Okay, I learned this hack a few months ago from those yummy mall rats that hang out in the food court. Watch and learn.
target: 几个月前，我跟那帮在美食广场混、秀色可餐的商场小老鼠学了这招。看好了。

source: With your and Polly's help, Valerie tilts the machine forward so the porridge flows into the prize slot.
target: 在你和波莉的帮助下，瓦莱丽把机器往前倾，让粥流进了出奖口。

source: Here it comes! Scott, put your mouth on the prize hole!
target: 来了！斯科特，嘴对准出奖口！

source: WOOHOO! Tastes like month-old oats and plastic!
target: 呜呼！一股放了一个月的燕麦和塑料味！

source: As long as he's happy...
target: 他开心就好……

source: And hey: your parents always said you'd never be able to earn your own food as an adult by playing video games, but you sure showed them today!
target: 而且你爸妈以前总说，长大了靠打游戏可养不活自己。今天你算是证明给他们看了！

source: All it took was 3 hours and -N2 MONEY to win... basically a bowl's worth of old porridge. But that's worth +N2 STAMINA nonetheless!
target: 只花了3小时和-N2金钱，就赢得了……差不多一碗陈粥。不过，好歹也换来了+N2体力！

source: The side of the machine says, "Welcome to Harold McDongHard's Mansion of Lewd. The Evil Queen Rosequeef has filled it with traps to drain all your sticky, vital energy."
target: 机器侧面写着：“欢迎来到哈罗德·麦硬屌的淫欲宅邸。邪恶王后萝丝·奎芙在这里布满陷阱，要榨干你所有黏糊糊的生命精华。”

source: "Prepare for a night of exhausting 'duels' where only the best will thrive."
target: “准备迎接一整夜精疲力竭的‘决斗’，唯有最强者才能大展雄风。”

source: Sounds like fun! You put on the VR visor and VR crotch guard and begin playing.
target: 听起来很好玩！你戴上VR头显和VR护裆，开始游戏。

source: Wow, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! It looks like you're churning a LOT of butter in that game. Nice grip technique!
target: 哇，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！你在游戏里搅了好多黄油啊。握得真不错！

source: Yeah, uh, be sure to work the shaft of the "butter churner" really good if you want a high score.
target: 对，呃，想拿高分，那根“搅乳棒”可得好好上下撸动。

source: Yes! And don't forget to tickle the butter churner's balls too!
target: 对！也别忘了挠挠搅乳棒的蛋蛋！

source: Ooh, now %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% is eating popsicles! That must be one BIG popsicle -- I'm so jealous!
target: 哦，现在%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%在吃冰棒！那冰棒一定特别大——好羡慕！

source: Now you're eating TWO popsicles? Don't get greedy, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! You don't wanna gag on all that icy goodness!
target: 现在又吃两根？别贪心啊，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！那么多冰凉的好东西，别给自己塞得直反胃！

source: Yeah! The trick is to suppress your gag reflex!
target: 对！诀窍就是忍住干呕反射！

source: Now %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s playing pinball! Nice technique! I also thrust my hips against the pinball machine to give more power to my balls.
target: 现在%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%在打弹球！技术不错！我也会用胯顶弹球机，让球更有劲儿。

source: Don't forget to tilt if you wanna win! Turn that bad boy over and pound from behind!
target: 想赢，可别忘了倾斜角度！把那小子翻过来，从后面猛干！

source: You lose -N2 STAMINA "playing pinball." You're a sweaty mess. Somehow, the "Dragon Heat VR: Thrust To Win" machine is sweating too?
target: “打弹球”让你失去了-N2体力，出了一身大汗。不知怎么，《Dragon Heat VR：挺进致胜》这台机器居然也出汗了？

source: Aww, it only gave you one ticket? That sucks. I thought you did really well.
target: 啊，才给你一张票？真扫兴，我还觉得你玩得特别好呢。

source: Wait, that's not a ticket, that's the machine's phone number! NICE!
target: 等等，那不是票，是机器的电话号码！可以啊！

source: Good work, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. I've seen lots of people, ah, "underperform" on this game before, but you fuckin' crushed it.
target: 干得漂亮，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。我见过好多人玩这游戏都，呃，“发挥不佳”，你可他妈太猛了。

source: Hell yeah. This has been more cardio than you usually do, but you gained +N2 HYPE, so you can't complain!
target: 爽！这回的有氧运动量比你平时大多了，不过换来了+N2热度，也没什么可抱怨的！

source: Pizza parlor
target: 披萨店

source: You're looking for the food court when you see your friend Valerie sitting on the center fountain and texting. She looks up and smiles at you.
target: 你正找美食广场，看到瓦莱丽坐在中央喷泉边发短信。她抬起头，冲你们笑了笑。

source: Hey, guys. Long time no see. What brings you to the mall?
target: 嘿，伙计们，好久不见。什么风把你们吹到商场来了？

source: Hi Val! We're on a road trip and stopped by to get some lunch. Where's the best place to eat around here?
target: 嗨，小瓦！我们在公路旅行，顺路来吃午饭。这儿哪家最好吃？

source: Bad question. All the food here is garbage. But I can take you to the LEAST garbage food they serve...
target: 这问题问得。这里的吃的全是垃圾，不过我可以带你们去吃最不垃圾的那家……

source: Welcome to Pozzo's Pizza, where every slice is sliced with love.
target: 欢迎光临波佐披萨，每一片披萨都用爱切开。

source: Except we're fresh out of love, so we've been slicing it with the pocketknife that the chef uses to cut cocaine.
target: 不过爱刚好用完了，现在切披萨的，是主厨分可卡因用的那把小折刀。

source: Is the coke on the menu?!
target: 可卡因也在菜单上吗？！

source: Hey, Sadie! I didn't know you still worked here. How have things been?
target: 嘿，赛迪！不知道你还在这儿干呢。最近怎么样？

source: Oh, you know. It's been a lot of... this.
target: 唉，你懂的，基本上就一直……这样。

source: When ARE you gonna quit, girl? You should ditch the greasy smock and start hustling with me.
target: 妹子，你到底什么时候辞职啊？脱了这身油腻腻的工作服，来跟我做生意吧。

source: I earn twice as much selling junk to my classmates as I did working at Pozzo's.
target: 我卖破烂给同学，赚的钱是在波佐打工时的两倍。

source: Thanks for the offer, but I don't mind it here. We both know the night manager would be useless without me.
target: 谢谢你的好意，不过我在这儿也还好。咱们都知道，没了我，夜班经理就什么都干不成。

source: Suit yourself. Anyway, I'll have a calzone, triple-fried, with extra anchovies and bell peppers UNDER the cheese, and a saucer of milk to drink.
target: 随你咯。老样子，我要一份意式披萨饺，炸三遍，多加凤尾鱼，甜椒放在芝士下面，再来一小碟牛奶。

source: "Valerie's Usual", coming right up. What about you guys?
target: “瓦莱丽老样子套餐”，马上来。你们要什么？

source: I want Scott's Usual! Whatever that is!
target: 我要“斯科特老样子套餐”！管它是什么！

source: IS. THE COKE. ON. THE MENU.
target: 菜、单、上、到、底、有、没、有、可、卡、因。

source: Dang, if you're buying coke, we definitely won't have enough money to get any food for me!
target: 我去，你要买可卡因的话，肯定就没钱给我买吃的了！

source: Don't worry, I know all about that minimum-wage life. We're running two price discounts today; wanna use one of them?
target: 别担心，拿最低工资过日子是什么滋味，我懂。今天有两种优惠，要不要选一个？

source: Get a free pizza if you attend the opening show of the manager's conceptual theater piece.
target: 看经理的概念戏剧首演，就送免费披萨。

source: BUY 1 PIZZA, PAY FOR 2!
target: 买1份披萨，付2份钱！

source: Wow, really? Dang... guess you'd do anything for free pizza. I'll let my manager know.
target: 哇，认真的？我去……为了免费披萨，你还真是什么都肯干。我跟经理说一声。

source: Well, you chose this. You're led to the alley behind the mall, where several pizza boxes have been stacked up to create a makeshift stage.
target: 行吧，自己选的。你们被带到商场后巷，几个披萨盒堆在那里，搭成了临时舞台。

source: Behold, I am the Face of Greed. I demand money, because I don't get paid enough for this shit.
target: 看啊，我是贪婪之面。我要求加钱，因为这点工资不够我陪你们搞这破事。

source: The Pozzo's manager comes out next. "BEHOLD!" he screeches. "I am the Face of Wrath! Tremble before my bloody visage!"
target: 接着，波佐的经理出场了。他尖叫道：“看啊！我是愤怒之面！在我血淋淋的面容前颤抖吧！”

source: Dude, all you did was smear pizza sauce all over your face. It's too watery to even look like blood.
target: 老兄，你不就是往脸上抹了点披萨酱吗？那么稀，看着连血都不像。

source: "BEHOLD!" the manager screams, holding a hand mirror up to Valerie. "HERE STANDS THE FACE OF CONSUMERISM!"
target: 经理把一面小镜子举到瓦莱丽面前，大喊：“看啊！这就是消费主义之面！”

source: Get that mirror OUT of my face. I'm not declawed, motherfucker, and I will prove it!
target: 把镜子从我面前拿开。老娘的爪子可没拔，信不信我当场给你见识一下！

source: The next three hours are filled with the manager screaming at a mannequin covered in melted mozzarella about the lie of the meritocracy.
target: 接下来三个小时，经理对着一个淋满融化马苏里拉芝士的假人，尖叫着控诉精英制度的谎言。

source: There are a few other patrons here, also bored to tears. "You here for the free pizza?" you whisper to an old man.
target: 旁边还有几个顾客，同样无聊得快哭了。你小声问一位老人：“你也为免费披萨来的？”

source: I think he was, at one point, but now he's asleep with a slice of pizza hanging out of his mouth. Or he's dead, I dunno.
target: 我想一开始是吧。不过他现在睡着了，嘴里还挂着片披萨。也可能死了，不知道。

source: If he's dead, do you think he'll miss that pizza slice?
target: 他要真死了，还会惦记那片披萨吗？

source: You gain +N2 STAMINA from the free pizza you were promised, but was it worth the -N2 HYPE loss? Who knows.
target: 说好的免费披萨，让你获得了+N2体力。不过为此损失-N2热度，到底值不值？谁知道呢。

source: Huh? I think that was just a typo. You don't have to--
target: 啊？我想那个只是打错字了。你不用——

source: No, no, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% chose "BUY 1 PIZZA, PAY FOR 2!" Now %HESHE% has to do it, to abide by the pizza promo laws.
target: 不不，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%选了“买1份披萨，付2份钱”！现在%HESHE%就得照做，遵守披萨促销法。

source: THE PIZZA PROMO LAWS!
target: 披萨促销法！

source: There's no such thing...
target: 没有这种东西……

source: It's okay, we know you're contractually obligated to deny the pizza promo laws' existence, but we know the truth... wink!
target: 没事，我们懂，合同规定你不能承认披萨促销法的存在。不过我们知道真相……眨眼！

source: ...What?
target: ……什么？

source: Yeah, remember the massive uptick in murders after the infamous pizza promotion of '97? The one that promised a "pizza to die for?"
target: 是啊，还记得1997年那次臭名昭著的披萨促销吗？说什么“好吃到死”，之后谋杀案就暴增了。

source: Life is precious! No pizza should be worth your life!
target: 生命很宝贵！再好吃的披萨，也不值得拿命去换！

source: Yeah, I learned that the hard way... since that's how I died.
target: 是啊，这教训我可是用命换来的……毕竟我就是这么死的。

source: I am pretty sure ALL of that is factually untrue.
target: 我很确定，你刚才那些话没一句是真的。

source: Why would we make up something that's a disservice to ourselves?
target: 对自己没好处的事，我们干嘛瞎编啊？

source: At this point, I never know with you two.
target: 事到如今，你俩干什么我都猜不透了。

source: Ah, but that's half our charm!
target: 啊，可我们的魅力有一半就在这儿！

source: C'mon, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, pay up: we must abide by the pizza promo laws. We're noble that way.
target: 来吧，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，付钱：必须遵守披萨促销法。我们就是这么高尚。

source: THE PIZZA PROMO LAWS!
target: 披萨促销法！

source: Dang, you just misread the special, but now you sort of can't backpedal, can you?
target: 我去，你就是看错了优惠，可现在好像也没法反悔了，是吧？

source: You lose the -N2 MONEY and get the +N2 STAMINA from the pizza. At least it tastes good!
target: 你失去了-N2金钱，吃披萨获得了+N2体力。至少味道不错！

source: And if you can one day achieve at least half the charm Polly and Scott have, that'd be a win in your book!
target: 要是哪天，你能有波莉和斯科特一半的魅力，对你来说就算赢了！

source: Shoplifting
target: 在商店顺手牵羊

source: As you're searching for the best store to steal from, you see your friend Valerie sitting on the center fountain and texting. She looks up and smiles at you.
target: 你正找哪家店最适合下手，看到瓦莱丽坐在中央喷泉边发短信。她抬起头，冲你们笑了笑。

source: Hey, strangers. What are you doing at the mall?
target: 嘿，好久不见。在商场干嘛呢？

source: WE AREN'T SHOPLIFTING!!!
target: 我们没在店里偷东西！！！

source: Smooth, Scott.
target: 真会掩饰啊，斯科特。

source: Eh, don't worry, I won't rat on you. I'm also a big fan of shoplifting.
target: 放心，我不会告密。我也很喜欢顺手牵羊。

source: It's cheap, it's thrilling, and you get to stick it to The Man!
target: 省钱、刺激，还能让那些大人物吃瘪！

source: The Man? What man? Why is he so sticky?
target: 大人物？哪个人？得多大个儿？

source: Eh... never mind. You guys are newbies at shoplifting, I'm guessing? Maybe I can help.
target: 呃……算了。你们是第一次在店里偷东西吧？我倒是能帮帮忙。

source: Half the work is not getting nervous. Just vibe and no one will suspect you. Try whistling a jaunty tune as you shove shit into your pockets.
target: 成功一半靠不紧张。放松点，没人会怀疑你。往口袋里塞东西时，试着吹段欢快的小调。

source: Also, don't look suspicious. Avoid using fake mustaches. They're great for white-collar crime, but they don't work for shoplifting.
target: 还有，别显得可疑。假胡子就别戴了。那玩意儿适合白领犯罪，不适合商店行窃。

source: If you get caught, just pretend to be a time traveler from medieval times who still doesn't understand the concept of paper money or malls. Works every time.
target: 被抓就假装自己是中世纪穿越来的，还不懂纸币和商场是怎么回事。百试百灵。

source: Valerie's got great tips! The only thing left to do is decide what you're going to steal. What'll it be?
target: 瓦莱丽的建议真不错！现在只差决定偷什么了。选哪个？

source: You stole hearts back in your Prom days; it's time to shoplift some hearts!
target: 以前参加舞会，你偷走过别人的心；这回就去商店里偷点心吧！

source: Steal the security cameras. It will pave the way for future shoplifting. Plus, the security cam is the only thing that the security cam itself cannot watch.
target: 偷监控摄像头，为以后行窃铺路。而且，摄像头唯一拍不到的，就是它自己。

source: Steal a store manager's identity. It's one simple theft that will automatically make everything in the store yours.
target: 偷店长的身份。只偷这一样，整家店的东西就自动全归你了。

source: All of you split up for a bit to do some shoplifting. You later meet up at the food court to show off your hauls.
target: 你们暂时分头行动，之后在美食广场碰头，展示各自的战利品。

source: All right, I got six keychains and some weird-ass DVDs! What about you guys?
target: 好了，我弄到六个钥匙扣，还有几张怪得要命的DVD！你们呢？

source: I got a kidney!
target: 我弄了颗肾！

source: I shoplifted some yummy mini sandwiches from the food court! They were super easy to steal; there's a lady out there handing them out!
target: 我从美食广场偷到了好吃的迷你三明治！特别好偷，外面就有个阿姨在发！

source: Taking free samples doesn't count as... eh, never mind. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, what about you?
target: 拿免费试吃不算……算了。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你呢？

source: I stole the greatest treasure of all: the hearts of dozens of shoppers!
target: 我偷到了最珍贵的宝藏：几十位顾客的心！

source: Oh, nice. Those go for a ton on the black market. How'd you steal a bunch of hearts without getting caught?
target: 哦，不错。那些在黑市可值钱了。偷那么多心脏还没被抓，你怎么做到的？

source: No, Valerie, you misunderstood. I stole their hearts METAPHORICALLY, with the power of kindness!
target: 不是，瓦莱丽，你误会了。偷心只是个比喻，我靠的是善意的力量！

source: I complimented some shoppers' outfits and made jokes with the overworked cashier. My pockets are full of their stolen hearts, and their days are a little bit brighter!
target: 我夸了几位顾客的穿搭，还逗忙得够呛的收银员笑了笑。现在我的口袋里装满了偷来的心，他们的一天也多了点亮色！

source: Awww, that's nice! %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% used thievery to make the world a better place!
target: 哎呀，真好！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%靠偷东西，让世界变得更美好了！

source: No! Don't acknowledge %HIMHER%, Scott! We had only one assignment: to shoplift stuff.
target: 不许夸%HIMHER%，斯科特！咱们就一个任务：在店里偷东西。

source: Some people here did their job. Not %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, though.
target: 有些人确实完成任务了。但不包括%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。

source: Even Scott got us some sandwiches, even if they're not technically stolen.
target: 连斯科特都给咱们弄来了三明治，虽然严格来说不算偷的。

source: But nooooo, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% wanted to go for a fun play on words. Those hearts aren't real!
target: 可%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%偏不，非要玩什么文字游戏。那些心又不是真的！

source: Look at this kidney, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. Does it look METAPHORICAL to you? Nah, it's a literal fuckin' kidney.
target: 看看这颗肾，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。你觉得这像个比喻吗？不，这他妈就是颗货真价实的肾。

source: I guarantee you, I did something more drastic than complimenting someone or cracking a joke to get this very literal kidney.
target: 我敢保证，为了弄到这颗实实在在的肾，我干的事可比夸人、讲笑话激烈多了。

source: I didn't go through that just for you to cheat on the assignment and do some lame-ass stuff and call it shoplifting. I call it bullshit!
target: 我可不是费了这么大劲，就为了看你偷懒耍滑，干点无聊的事，还管那叫行窃。要我说，那叫扯淡！

source: Polly forgets about this five minutes later when you get some milkshakes at the food court.
target: 五分钟后，你们在美食广场喝起奶昔，波莉就把这事忘了。

source: And you're at peace with your choice. Shoplifting metaphorical hearts might be -N2 HYPE less than shoplifting literal hearts, but it surely makes up for that in its +N2 SOUL!
target: 你也安心接受了自己的选择。偷走比喻里的心，虽然比偷真心脏少了点刺激，损失了-N2热度，却也足足换来了+N2灵魂！

source: Meanwhile, in the camera room, two security officers are sitting around drinking coffee and staring at dozens of security camera feeds.
target: 与此同时，监控室里的两名保安正喝着咖啡，盯着几十路监控画面。

source: "Hey, Tom," one says, "Camera 11 just went down! Should we go check on it?"
target: 其中一人说：“嘿，汤姆，11号摄像头断线了！要不要去看看？”

source: "Wait, never mind, looks like it's working again... but why's it showing footage of a desert?"
target: “等等，没事了，好像又能用了……可画面怎么是一片沙漠？”

source: "Beats me," Tom says. "Did the corner of that store always look like a desert? Probably climate change or something."
target: 汤姆说：“谁知道呢。那家店的角落以前就长得像沙漠吗？大概是气候变化什么的吧。”

source: "Camera 12 is down now! Wait, now it's back on... and it's showing footage of a bare butt?"
target: “12号也断了！等等，又好了……怎么拍着个光屁股？”

source: "Weird. I didn't check with the managers; maybe they added a butt section to the shop?"
target: “怪了。我没跟经理确认过，也许店里新开了个屁股专区？”

source: "Now Camera 13 is down! No, wait, it's back... and it's showing a crayon doodle of a blue girl and a purple cat saying, 'WE STOLE YOUR CAMERAS, LOSERS!! ;3'"
target: “13号现在也断了！不，等等，回来了……画面是张蜡笔画，一个蓝女孩和一只紫猫在说：‘摄像头我们偷走啦，笨蛋！！;3’”

source: "Shit, we've been had! Grab your gun, Tom -- we gotta track down those felons!"
target: “妈的，被耍了！汤姆，拿枪，我们得去追那几个罪犯！”

source: Good work guys. It'll be easy as hell to shoplift without any cameras to spy us now!
target: 干得好，伙计们。没摄像头盯着，接下来偷东西就太容易了！

source: "STOP!" some security officers shout at you. "We're looking for a blue girl and a purple cat that look a lot like you!"
target: 几名保安冲你们喊：“站住！我们在找一个蓝女孩和一只紫猫，看着跟你们特别像！”

source: "...The main difference is, they're made of crayon. Have you kids seen them?"
target: “……主要区别是，他们是蜡笔画的。你们见过他们吗？”

source: Uh... I think I saw them heading toward... the craft store?
target: 呃……好像看见他们往……手工用品店去了？

source: "Ah, makes perfect sense -- they're probably having a rendezvous with their thieving crayon posse. Thanks for the tip. As you were!"
target: “啊，那就对了，估计是去跟那帮蜡笔贼同伙碰头了！谢谢线索，你们继续！”

source: The security guards run off. It's concerning that your authority figures are so stupid, but it worked out great for you now! You lose -N2 SOUL and gain +N2 HYPE!
target: 保安跑了。管事的这么蠢，确实让人担心，不过眼下倒是便宜你们了！你失去了-N2灵魂，获得了+N2热度！

source: With worryingly little effort, you steal the manager's identity. You start taking all the stuff you want, but then the real manager and the cops show up.
target: 你几乎没费劲就偷到了店长的身份，容易得让人担心。你开始想拿什么拿什么，可真正的店长和警察出现了。

source: "What are you assholes doing?!" the manager demands. "You're going straight to jail for robbing my store!"
target: 店长质问道：“你们这帮混蛋在干嘛？！敢抢我的店，等着坐牢吧！”

source: Ooh, fun story, actually. This is OUR store. Check it out.
target: 哦，其实这事挺有意思。这是我们的店，你看。

source: Here's an ID and a deed to the store made out to "Mario McManager" -- which is my friend here!
target: 这有身份证，还有写着“马里奥·麦店长”名字的店铺产权证——就是我这位朋友！

source: "What are you saying?! I'M Mario McManager!" the manager yells.
target: 店长大喊：“你说什么？！我才是马里奥·麦店长！”

source: Are you, though? Do you have an ID to prove it?
target: 是吗？那你有身份证明吗？

source: "Yes! I... oh, no, I can't find it! But look at my face! That's obviously my face on your ID! You stole my identity!"
target: “有！我……糟了，找不到了！可你们看看我的脸！证件上明明就是我的脸，你们偷了我的身份！”

source: That can be explained. See, "Mario McManager" here isn't really a manager; that's just his cover story.
target: 这可以解释。你看，这位“马里奥·麦店长”其实不是店长，那只是他的掩护身份。

source: He's actually an undercover cop trying to catch %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, leader of the most notorious shoplifting clan in the world!
target: 他其实是个卧底警察，想抓住%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%——世界上最臭名昭著的行窃团伙头目！

source: After several failed arrest attempts, the FBI decided to surgically reconstruct McManager's face to look like %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s so he could dismantle the clan from inside...
target: 抓捕屡屡失败后，联邦调查局决定给麦店长整容，整成%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%的模样，好从内部瓦解这个团伙……

source: But %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% caught wind of the plan, so that scoundrel got %HISHER% OWN face reconstructed to look like McManager's to escape arrest!
target: 可%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%提前听说了计划，这家伙就把%HISHER%脸也整成了麦店长的样子，好躲避追捕！

source: We know you're %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% in disguise! Officers, arrest %HIMHER% before %HESHE% %VERB_ESCAPES_ESCAPE% and %VERB_KEEPS_KEEP% ripping off the plot of "Face Off!"
target: 我们知道，你就是乔装的%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！警官，快逮捕%HIMHER%，别让%HESHE%%VERB_ESCAPES_ESCAPE%，再%VERB_KEEPS_KEEP%照抄《变脸》的剧情！
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): POLISH; 追捕与继续照搬变脸情节为两个动作，分别展开为逃走和继续。 按行中文动词展开已实现；未实机验证。

source: "WOW," says one of the cops. "Do you think they're telling the truth, Chief?"
target: 一名警察说：“哇。长官，你觉得他们说的是真的吗？”

source: "They have to be," says the chief. "When people lie, it's never THIS elaborate. McManager -- I mean, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, you're going to jail!"
target: 警长说：“肯定是真的，撒谎的人哪编得出这么复杂的故事。麦店长——不，我是说%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你被捕了！”

source: The real manager is arrested, and you get to keep all his products. You make +N4 MONEY selling some of it, and +N2 HYPE throwing the rest in a bonfire for the lolz.
target: 真店长被捕了，他的商品全归你们。你卖掉一部分，赚了+N4金钱，剩下的扔进篝火烧着玩，又获得了+N2热度。

source: You lose -N4 SOUL for ruining a man's life, though. And Valerie's lie was so elaborate, you can't help but wonder if you really ARE Mario McManager... you lose -N2 MIND.
target: 不过，毁掉一个人的生活让你失去了-N4灵魂。瓦莱丽的谎编得太复杂，你都忍不住怀疑，自己难道真是马里奥·麦店长……你又失去了-N2头脑。

source: Ritual sacrifice
target: 参加献祭仪式

source: You and your friends enter the cult's sacrificial chamber with all the optimism of the first characters to die in a horror movie.
target: 你和朋友们走进教团的献祭室，乐观得就像恐怖片里最先死的那批角色。

source: Check out this holy pamphlet! "The ritual sacrifices are completed to please Mh'athra, the Deity of Sacred Secrecy and Darkness."
target: 看看这本圣典宣传册！“献祭仪式旨在取悦神圣秘密与黑暗之神Mh'athra。”

source: "Completing the sacrifice will give Mh'athra's worshippers a taste of its exclusive magical powers."
target: “完成献祭，Mh'athra的信徒即可领略它独有的魔法力量。”

source: Cool! We can siphon some of that magic into the car afterwards!
target: 酷！之后咱们还能抽点魔力，给车加上！

source: Hell yeah, I love a good ol' ritual sacrifice! Let's kill some goats and have a big, kinky orgy in the pool of their blood!
target: 爽啊，我就爱老派献祭仪式！杀几只山羊，然后在血池里来场盛大的变态群交吧！

source: Hold your horses, eager acolytes. You cannot simply wander into Mh'athra's sacred halls and throw yourselves into a goat blood orgy right away!
target: 别急，热心的信徒们。不能刚踏进Mh'athra的圣殿，就立刻扑进羊血群交大会啊！

source: Why not?
target: 为什么不呢?

source: Because that's not what being in a cult is about! So many new cultists only care about the orgies, without understanding their ceremonial implications!
target: 入教又不只是为了这个！太多新教徒只惦记群交，根本不懂其中的仪式意义！

source: (Wait, there are ceremonial implications to this? I thought we just all liked to fuck goats.)
target: （等等，这还有仪式意义？我还以为大家都只是喜欢操山羊呢。）

source: ONLY YOU do that, Brother "Goat Fucker" Ismael, and that's exactly why nobody wants to grind on you at the blood orgies anymore.
target: 只有你喜欢，“操羊人”伊斯梅尔兄弟。所以血池群交时，才没人愿意再贴着你磨蹭。

source: Anyway, we now have a proper sacrifice tier list that new cultists must complete in the correct order.
target: 总之，我们现在有一份正经的献祭等级表，新教徒必须按顺序完成。

source: It helps us weed out those who aren't truly committed, like those sacrilegious bastards that put their careers and loved ones above our dark cult.
target: 这样才能筛掉信仰不坚定的人，比如那些把事业和亲友看得比黑暗教团还重要的亵渎神明的混蛋。

source: Fine, we'll do it your way. This tier list says we first have to sacrifice "something of great personal value." %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, what do you suggest?
target: 行，听你们的。表上说，首先得献出“一件对自己极有价值的东西”。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你觉得献什么？

source: Sacrifice your account on "Dragon Heat: So You Like Role-Playing, Wink?", the MMORPG in which you've sunk over 1,000 hours of play.
target: 献出你在大型多人网游《Dragon Heat：原来你喜欢角色扮演，懂吧？》里的账号。你已经在里面玩了一千多个小时。

source: Sacrifice 8 of the 22 subscriptions to interesting newsletters you may or may not ever read anyway.
target: 你订了22份有意思、却未必真看过的邮件刊物，就退订其中8份当祭品吧。

source: EGAD! That truly is an enormous commitment you're giving up. More than 1,000 hours!
target: 天哪！你真是下了大决心，愿意舍弃这么多投入。一千多个小时啊！

source: Yup. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s spent almost a lifetime on Dragon Heat's "Massive Multiplayer Orgy-filled Racy Penetration Game".
target: 对，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%差不多把一辈子都花在《Dragon Heat》这款“大型多人群交风骚插入游戏”上了。

source: Mh'athra will be so pleased with this sacrifice. Our cult has actually lost several members to addictive MMORPGs.
target: Mh'athra一定会很满意这份祭品。我们教团已经有好几个成员，被这些让人上瘾的大型多人网游拐走了。

source: They're such an all-consuming time sink, one would think MMORPGs are a cult themselves!
target: 那种游戏吞掉了所有时间，简直像个邪教！

source: Yeah, you did get invited to do a LOT of dragon cock worship on DH:SYLRPW, so that checks out.
target: 确实，你在DH:SYLRPW里收到过大量崇拜龙屌的邀请，这么说倒也没毛病。

source: Let the sacrifice commence! Delete your account, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, and feel the power of the Sacred Secrecy coursing through your veins!
target: 开始献祭！删掉你的账号，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，感受神圣秘密的力量流遍全身吧！

source: You'll miss having lewd adventures as "JizzterOfTheKingdom_6669", but now you get to have a night of unspeakable cultish pleasure in the real world!
target: 你会想念那些顶着“王国弄精_6669”的名字四处色情冒险的日子，不过现在，你可以在现实里享受一整晚难以启齿的教团狂欢了！

source: You delete your account and participate in the ritual, gaining +N2 MAGIC.
target: 你删掉账号，参加仪式，获得了+N2魔力。

source: Meanwhile, at the DH:SYLRPW headquarters, executives are freaking out over the loss of your account!
target: 与此同时，DH:SYLRPW总部的高管们，正因流失了你的账号而惊慌失措！

source: "Damn, that's another long-time player lost!" the CEO cries. "Were the dragon cocks not enough?! What did %HESHE% list as %HISHER% reason for leaving?"
target: 首席执行官叫道：“该死，又流失了一个老玩家！龙屌还不够吗？！%HESHE%怎么说的，%HISHER%退游理由是什么？”

source: "Looks like %HESHE% listed 'joined a cult' as %HISHER% reasoning, sir."
target: “先生，看来%HESHE%把‘加入教团’填成了%HISHER%退游理由。”

source: "FUCK! Then another follower of Rr'lozma'ag is gone. Our recruitment numbers are getting dangerously low this month!"
target: “操！Rr'lozma'ag又少了一个信徒。这个月的招募人数已经低到危险水平了！”

source: "Yes, sir; we're aware that the God of Utter Abandonment, whom we all worship, is displeased that so many are leaving their digital lives for the despised 'physical realm.'"
target: “是的，先生。我们都知道，大家放弃数字生活，奔向可鄙的‘物质世界’，让我们共同崇拜的彻底遗弃之神很不高兴。”

source: "What do we do?" frets the CEO. "Should we sacrifice another goat and have a blood orgy?"
target: 首席执行官发愁道：“怎么办？再献一只山羊，来场血池群交？”

source: They do, but it's not enough for Rr'lozma'ag to forgive them for losing your account. It cosmically confiscates -N2 HYPE from you all as punishment.
target: 他们照做了，可Rr'lozma'ag还是不肯原谅他们流失了你的账号。它从宇宙层面没收了你们的-N2热度，以示惩罚。

source: That's a good idea! I'm tired of my laptop getting cluttered with all these informational newsletters and videos I WANT to consume, but never do.
target: 好主意！我的笔记本电脑都快被邮件刊物和视频塞满了，全是我想看、却一直没看的东西，烦死了。

source: Us too! Who here doesn't have a miles-long "Watch Later" playlist they'll never clean out?
target: 我们也一样！谁还没个长得要命、永远清不完的“稍后观看”列表啊？

source: Yeah, I keep meaning to watch "How to Predict the Lunar Cycle" but never get around to it.
target: 对啊，我一直想看《如何预测月相周期》，可总腾不出空。

source: But I dunno, lycanthropy's more fun when it's all a surprise.
target: 不过嘛，每次变狼都是个惊喜，也挺有意思的。

source: I'll lose this article I saved and never read on the ancient technique of making alcohol out of cashews in Goa.
target: 那我就献掉这篇收藏后一直没读的文章，讲的是果阿用腰果酿酒的古老技艺。

source: I mean, let's be real, I'm just gonna keep making toilet wine.
target: 说实话，我反正还是会继续酿马桶酒。

source: Indeed. Brother "Goat Fucker" has been subscribed to a newsletter on cheese-aging techniques for years, but has never once opened it.
target: 确实。“操羊人”兄弟订阅芝士熟成技术刊物好多年了，却连一次都没点开过。

source: (It seemed like a sophisticated and mature thing to be interested in. I like the person I'll become when I read those newsletters... someday!)
target: （喜欢这种东西，显得人很成熟、很有品位嘛。等我读完那些刊物，我一定会喜欢那时的自己……总有一天！）

source: Personally, I'll sacrifice this reminder to watch that TED talk on how to stop procrastinating and improve my life now.
target: 我呢，就把这个提醒献掉。它是提醒我去看一场TED演讲，讲怎样立即改掉拖延、改善生活。

source: Eh... or maybe I'll keep it. I'm sure I'll watch it tomorrow. Definitely tomorrow.
target: 呃……要不还是留着吧。我明天肯定看。明天一定。

source: For your part, you sacrifice your subscription to Weekly Book Reviews. You've had that "10 Must-Reads of 2007" article bookmarked for too long.
target: 轮到你，你献出了《每周书评》的订阅。那篇《2007年十本必读书》，在收藏夹里待得够久了。

source: You and the Mh'athra cultists bask in the communal relief of admitting you're never getting around to learning new things, and gain +N2 MAGIC from the sacrifice!
target: 你和Mh'athra教徒们一起承认：那些新知识，反正你们也永远不会去学。大家如释重负，你还从献祭中获得了+N2魔力！

source: But you do lose -N2 MIND for losing all of the knowledge that could have been.
target: 不过，那些原本可能学到的知识也随之失去，让你损失了-N2头脑。

source: Initiation rites
target: 参加入会仪式

source: You see signs outside advertising an "open recruitment event" for the cult. That sounds exactly like your brand of weird shit to check out!
target: 你看到外面挂着教团“公开招募”的广告牌。听起来，正是你喜欢去凑热闹的那种怪事！

source: Glory to Mh'athra! Welcome to the Brotherhood, new recruits, where we worship the Deity of Sacred Secrecy and Darkness.
target: 荣耀归于Mh'athra！欢迎加入兄弟会，新人们。我们崇拜的是神圣秘密与黑暗之神。

source: Joining our congregation has lots of perks. You'll get your own cloaks, you'll be invited to cult-sponsored dinners and networking events...
target: 加入我们，好处可不少。你们会领到自己的斗篷，还能参加教团出资举办的聚餐和人脉交流活动……

source: And best of all, Mh'athra's loyal followers are given a taste of the immense secret power it wields over our universe!
target: 最棒的是，忠实的Mh'athra信徒，还能领略它支配整个宇宙的强大秘密力量！

source: Fuck yeah, I'm in! GIMME DA POWAH!
target: 爽，老娘入了！力量给我拿来！

source: The cultists give you a soul-binding contract you have to sign in blood. So authentic!
target: 教徒们递给你一份绑定灵魂的契约，还得用血签名。真有那味儿！

source: Yay, new outfit! This'll be the perfect look for when I'm blasting motherfuckers with Mh'athra's secret magic!
target: 耶，新衣服！穿这身，用Mh'athra的秘密魔法轰飞那些混蛋，简直再合适不过了！

source: Oops, you must not have read the fine print. You can't access Mh'athra's power until you're promoted to acolytes. Right now, you're still "unpaid initiates."
target: 哎呀，你们肯定没看小字条款。晋升侍祭之前，不能动用Mh'athra的力量。你们现在还只是“无薪见习教徒”。

source: But don't worry. You just have to prove yourselves to the Dark Deity at your performance review in six months!
target: 不过别担心。六个月后的绩效考核上，向黑暗之神证明自己就好！

source: For now, here's a shovel. The goat pens need to be cleaned. Have fun; glory to Mh'athra!
target: 先拿好铲子，羊圈该清理了。干得开心，荣耀归于Mh'athra！

source: Over the next few days, you're tasked with cleaning goat pens, getting coffee, washing the cloaks...
target: 接下来几天，你们的任务是清理羊圈、买咖啡、洗斗篷……

source: Who knew being a dark-magic-worshipping cultist would involve so much drudgery?
target: 谁能想到，当个崇拜黑魔法的教徒，还得干这么多苦活？

source: Guys, I can't take it anymore. I'll be damned -- literally -- if I'm gonna clean up one more goat turd.
target: 伙计们，我受不了了。再让我铲一坨羊粪，我真得下地狱了——字面意思！

source: Forget the performance review; there's gotta be a way to get our power over all things secret and hidden right now!
target: 去他的绩效考核。肯定有办法，让咱们现在就拿到掌控一切秘密和隐匿之物的力量！

source: Sweeten the cultists' hearts by bringing them the best coffee ever, using your trademark secret blend (shhh).
target: 用你的独家秘密配方（嘘），煮出世上最棒的咖啡，讨教徒们的欢心。

source: Don't give into the temptation of cult gossipping. Show your co-worshippers you REALLY know how to keep a secret.
target: 不参与教团八卦，抵住诱惑。让其他信徒见识一下，你真的很会保守秘密。

source: For the next few days, you serve the Brothers your special blend. Then, with no warning, you switch back to the regular stuff.
target: 接下来几天，你都给兄弟们供应特调咖啡。然后，你突然换回了普通咖啡。

source: PTOOEY! What is this shit? Where's your special blend, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?
target: 呸！这什么破玩意儿？%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你的特调呢？

source: Hey man, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s secret ingredient ain't cheap. We'll need to start charging you if you want %HISHER% special blend.
target: 嘿，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%的秘密配料可不便宜。想喝%HISHER%特调，我们就得开始收费了。

source: That's ridiculous! Just tell us what the secret ingredient is and quit trying to rake us over the coals!
target: 太荒唐了！直接告诉我们秘密配料是什么，别想再宰我们！

source: But that'd disobey Mh'athra's rules of sacred secrecy! Not cool, bro!
