target: 可那样就违反Mh'athra神圣的保密规矩了！这样可不酷，兄弟！

source: Ugh... how dare you hold us to our own religious standards... fine, how much for a cup?
target: 可恶……居然敢拿我们自己的教义要求我们……好吧，一杯多少钱？

source: Cha-ching! Soon enough, your coffee is so popular that you decide to open a business!
target: 叮，钱到账！很快，你的咖啡大受欢迎，你决定干脆开门做生意！

source: Welcome to Brew Mh'asterz Coffee, the only coffeeshop endorsed by Mh'athra itself!
target: 欢迎光临秘酿大师咖啡，唯一一家获得Mh'athra本尊认可的咖啡店！

source: We'll take three "%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s Sacredly-Secret Brews", please.
target: 来三杯“%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%的神圣秘密特调”，谢谢。

source: Can do! That'll cost +N2 MAGIC of Mh'athra's sacred power. Have a darkly-blessed day!
target: 好嘞！收您+N2魔力，用Mh'athra的神圣力量结账。祝您度过受黑暗庇佑的一天！

source: Is that the last of them? Good, let's close. Who knew running a business took so much work?
target: 最后一波客人了？好，关门吧。谁知道开店这么累啊。

source: Did you ever think we'd be running our own coffee shop, Polly? It feels like just yesterday we were on that wacky road trip!
target: 波莉，你想过咱们会开自己的咖啡店吗？感觉昨天还在那场疯狂的公路旅行里呢！

source: I know! But it wasn't yesterday; it was three days ago!
target: 对啊！不过不是昨天，是三天前！

source: Dang... do you ever miss those days? Having adventures, chasing our dreams wherever they took us...
target: 唉……你会怀念那段日子吗？到处冒险，追着梦想，想去哪儿就去哪儿……

source: Yeah... you know what? Fuck it. Let's ditch this place. I miss being on the road.
target: 会啊……知道吗，管它呢。丢下这地方走吧，我想继续在路上了。

source: ...And I miss having our own coffee to drink. Seriously, we've lost like -N2 STAMINA worth of coffee selling it off.
target: ……而且我也想念能喝自己的咖啡。真的，全卖掉以后，咱们少喝的咖啡都值-N2体力了。

source: That's on you for not calculating production costs. Oh well! You'll still fondly remember these lo-fi coffee shop days... and all the magic you snubbed from those dumb cultists!
target: 谁让你们不算生产成本呢。算了！你们还是会怀念这段Lo-Fi咖啡馆时光……以及从那些傻教徒手里骗来的魔力！

source: The next time you go on a coffee run, you keep your mouth shut and your ears open. You run into Brother Kenny on your way.
target: 下次出门买咖啡时，你闭紧嘴，多听多看。路上，你遇到了肯尼兄弟。

source: Hey, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%; glory to Mh'athra and all that... listen, can you keep a secret?
target: 嘿，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，荣耀归于Mh'athra，诸如此类的……听着，你能保密吗？

source: You know Brother Lenny, right? Well... I'm having an affair with his wife. There, I said it!
target: 你认识莱尼兄弟吧？那个……我跟他老婆有一腿。好了，说出来了！

source: The secret was killing me, but I guess I can trust a total stranger that I just met. Anyway, see you around -- all hail Mh'athra!
target: 这秘密憋死我了，不过你虽然是刚认识的陌生人，应该也能信吧。回头见——赞美Mh'athra！

source: Later, while you're alphabetizing the holy texts, Brother Lenny approaches you.
target: 后来，你正按字母顺序整理圣典，莱尼兄弟凑了过来。

source: Hey, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, how's it going? If you promise not to spread it around, can I tell ya something juicy?
target: 嘿，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，怎么样？答应我别往外传，我跟你说个劲爆的，行不行？

source: I've never liked Brother Kenny; something about him rubs me the wrong way. So last night, I stole his kidney while he slept and fed it to his least-favorite goat!
target: 我一直不喜欢肯尼兄弟，总觉得他哪儿不对劲。所以昨晚趁他睡觉，我偷了他一颗肾，喂给了他最讨厌的那只山羊！

source: ...Hey, what're you looking at me like that for? Don't judge me! Even cultists have the right to have fun!
target: ……哎，你干嘛这么看我？别评判我！邪教徒也有找乐子的权利！

source: Even later, while you're scrubbing bloodstains off the sacrificial altar, Brothers Kenny and Lenny run into each other!
target: 再后来，你正擦洗祭坛上的血迹，肯尼兄弟和莱尼兄弟碰上了！

source: Hey, Lenny. How's your wife? (Heh...)
target: 嘿，莱尼，你老婆怎么样？（嘿嘿……）

source: She's fine. Say, Kenny, you look tired. Have you been having headaches, nausea, or severe abdominal pain? (Heehee...)
target: 挺好的。倒是肯尼，你看着挺累。最近有没有头疼、恶心，或者严重腹痛啊？（嘻嘻……）

source: Maybe you should spend the day relaxing with the goats... heehee... and not do too much physical activity.
target: 也许你今天该陪山羊放松放松……嘻嘻……别做太剧烈的运动。

source: Don't worry about me. I'm plenty healthy, and I recently did a LOT of physical activity (heeheehee) and it was really good (hahahaha)!
target: 别担心我。我健康着呢，最近还做了好多运动（嘻嘻嘻），感觉特别好（哈哈哈）！

source: What's going on? There are too many heehee's in here!
target: 怎么回事？这儿也太多“嘻嘻”了吧！

source: You guys are being suuuper cryptic. If someone here knows what's really going on, now would be a super amazing time to spill the beans!
target: 你们说话也太藏着掖着了。要是谁知道怎么回事，现在就说出来，那可就太好了！

source: Everyone looks at you... and you look right back, silently. You're a devotee of Mh'athra now, no matter how much -N2 HYPE you lose by keeping your lips sealed.
target: 所有人都看向你……你也默默看了回去。现在你可是Mh'athra的信徒，哪怕守口如瓶会让你失去-N2热度，也绝不松口。

source: Ugh, seriously? I didn't know being in a cult that worships secret-keeping would mean people would keep secrets from ME!
target: 烦死了，认真的吗？我哪知道加入崇拜保密的邪教，居然意味着别人也要瞒着我啊！

source: Brothers Lenny and Kenny both nod approvingly at you, and you can feel it as an extension of Mh'athra's own approval. You gain +N2 MAGIC!
target: 莱尼和肯尼兄弟都赞许地点点头，你觉得这也代表了Mh'athra的认可。你获得了+N2魔力！

source: Cult marketing meeting
target: 参加教团营销会议

source: What is a cult but a club that takes itself really, REALLY seriously? And clubs need to market themselves to find new members, right?
target: 所谓邪教，不就是个把自己当回事、特别当回事的俱乐部吗？俱乐部总得宣传自己，才能招到新人，对吧？

source: Following this logic, you assume the cultists must be having a marketing strategy meeting SOMEWHERE... and lo and behold, they are!
target: 顺着这个逻辑，你猜教徒们肯定正在哪儿开营销策略会……嘿，还真让你找着了！

source: Brothers of Mh'athra, Keepers of the Sacred Secrecy and Darkness, we are having a crisis. Our recruitment numbers are extremely low this month!
target: Mh'athra的兄弟们，神圣秘密与黑暗的守护者们，我们遇到了危机。这个月招到的新人少得可怜！

source: We tried flyers, we tried making obscure fortune cookies with our holy message inside, we tried leaving dead goats around town... why isn't it working?!
target: 传单发过了，写着神谕的晦涩幸运饼干做过了，镇上也到处扔过死山羊……怎么就不管用？！

source: (Even you must realize those outreach campaigns are awful, Brother Aleksy. We'd do well to hire a real marketing director.)
target: （阿列克谢兄弟，你总该看出来了吧，这些宣传活动实在太烂了。咱们最好雇个真正的营销总监。）

source: True. But it's impossible to know which career professionals are recruited to the cult beforehand.
target: 没错。可招人之前，谁知道他们以前干什么工作。

source: That's how we ended up with 8 former furniture designers, but no marketers.
target: 所以我们招了8个转行的家具设计师，却一个营销人才都没有。

source: (At least the sacrificial chamber is full of comfy sofas now!)
target: （至少献祭室现在摆满了舒服的沙发！）

source: It would also be nice if we had some security personnel. For example, I just noticed those outsiders snuck into the meeting and have been here this whole time.
target: 要是有点安保人员就好了。比如，我刚发现有几个外人溜进会议，一直待在这里。

source: Hi!
target: 嗨！

source: Sup, Brothers? Before you throw us in a cell or sacrifice us to your god for sneaking in, consider that we can help you recruit more followers!
target: 兄弟们好啊！先别急着把我们关起来，或者因为偷溜进来就把我们献给你们的神。想想看，我们能帮你们招更多信徒！

source: Let's try carving "JOIN A CULT" on 666 goats and scattering them around the city. People love goats!
target: 试试在666只山羊身上刻“加入教团”，再把它们放到城里各处。大家都爱山羊！

source: We already tried that. It didn't go over well.
target: 试过了，反响不太好。

source: Oh. Hmmm... what about 667 goats?
target: 哦，嗯……那667只呢？

source: You distract Scott with a squeaky ball and take the floor. Time to show off your brilliant cult-marketing strategy!
target: 你拿个吱吱响的球引开斯科特的注意，接过话头。该展示你绝妙的教团营销方案了！

source: Become a sponsor of the annual Competitive Secret Santa tournament. You don't get why anyone would watch it... but for some reason people do?
target: 赞助一年一度的秘密圣诞老人竞技赛。你不懂这种比赛有什么好看……但不知为什么，还真有人看？

source: Half the time people join cults and gangs because they have cool exclusive tattoos. It's time to use your knowledge in arcane glyphs: Mh'athra Tramp Stamps for everyone!
target: 很多人加入教团和帮派，就为了酷炫的专属纹身。是时候用上你的奥术符文知识了：给大家来个Mh'athra腰骚纹！

source: You whisk your friends and the cultists off to this year's Competitive Secret Santa tournament.
target: 你带着朋友和教徒们，赶赴今年的秘密圣诞老人竞技赛。

source: "WELCOME TO THE 255TH ANNUAL COMPETITIVE SECRET SANTA!" says the high-energy announcer. "HOW ARE WE FEELING TONIGHT: NAUGHTY OR NICE?"
target: 亢奋的解说喊道：“欢迎来到第255届年度秘密圣诞老人竞技赛！各位今晚是乖孩子，还是坏孩子？”

source: Nice! -- I mean naughty! -- I mean, uh, something in between that conveys the nuance of morality!
target: 乖孩子！——我是说坏孩子！——我是说，呃，介于两者之间，能体现道德复杂性的那种！

source: I'm feeling... underwhelmed.
target: 我感觉……没什么意思。

source: "IT'S STARTING, FOLKS! CAROL 'FA LA LA' FARLEY IS ALREADY GOING FOR THE GIFT BASKET! IT'S A BOLD MOVE, AS IT RISKS EXCEEDING THE AGREED-UPON BUDGET!"
target: “开始了，朋友们！卡萝尔‘发啦啦’法利，已经冲向礼品篮了！这一招很大胆，毕竟有超过约定预算的风险！”

source: "NOW WE SEE RUDY 'RED NOSE' NELSON GOING FOR A CLASSIC PLAY: GIFTING A VOUCHER FOR A FREE MASSAGE! IS IT LEGIT? ... THE REF SAYS YES!"
target: “接着是鲁迪‘红鼻子’尼尔森的经典打法：送出一张免费按摩券！这券有效吗？……裁判说有效！”

source: "VETERAN SPECTATORS WILL REMEMBER TWO YEARS AGO A PLAYER TRIED TO FIT THE BUDGET BY GIFTING A COUPON FOR A MASSAGE GIVEN BY THE GIFTER, AND IT WAS REALLY AWKWARD!"
target: “老观众一定记得，两年前有位选手，为了不超预算，送了张自己亲自提供按摩的券，当时可尴尬了！”

source: "WOW, WHAT A CURVEBALL! WINKLER IS GIFTING 'RED NOSE' A HANDMADE SCRAPBOOK! IT'S A GIFT FILLED WITH EMOTIONAL VALUE REPRESENTING THEIR FRIENDSHIP!"
target: “哇，出其不意！温克勒送给‘红鼻子’一本手工剪贴簿！满满的情感价值，象征着他们的友谊！”

source: Great play from Winkler, I guess!
target: 温克勒这招，应该挺漂亮的吧！

source: Ugh, none of this makes sense! How do you even earn points? Is this a team sport or an every-man-for-himself thing? How do you even win?!
target: 烦死了，完全搞不懂啊！这怎么得分？团队赛还是各自为战？到底怎么才算赢？！

source: "BEFORE THE TOURNAMENT ENDS, LET'S HEAR A WORD FROM OUR SPONSORS: THE BROTHERHOOD OF MH'ATHRA!"
target: “比赛结束前，先听听我们的赞助商——Mh'athra兄弟会——想说什么！”

source: If you're so bored that you'd consider watching Competitive Secret Santa, you may be bored enough to join a cult.
target: 你要是无聊到想看秘密圣诞老人竞技赛，估计也无聊到可以加入邪教了。

source: Wait no more: join the Cult of Mh'athra, deity of all that's secret, including Secret Santa!
target: 别再等了，加入Mh'athra教团吧！它掌管一切秘密，包括秘密圣诞老人！

source: "THE GIFTS ARE UNWRAPPED, WHICH MEANS SECRET SANTA HAS BEEN WRAPPED UP. THIS YEAR'S WINNER IS... EVERYBODY, THANKS TO THE SPIRIT OF GIVING!"
target: “礼物都拆封了，秘密圣诞老人也该封箱收工了！今年的赢家是……所有人！感谢无私奉献的精神！”

source: Hooray!
target: 万岁!

source: No, Scott. That's a seriously unexciting and stupid way to end this completely illogical event.
target: 不，斯科特。这个活动本来就完全不合逻辑，结尾还这么无聊、这么蠢。

source: Oh. What should I say, then? "Hoo...nay?"
target: 哦，那我该说什么？“万……不岁？”

source: Well, at least the cult's membership went up, and they pay you +N2 MONEY for helping.
target: 好吧，至少教团的人数涨了。他们付给你+N2金钱，感谢你的帮助。

source: But you lost -N2 HYPE watching this dumb "sporting event", and you didn't even get a gift!
target: 可看这场蠢“体育比赛”，让你失去了-N2热度，而且连件礼物都没捞着！

source: Great idea! We could even call them "Mh'athramp Stamps!"
target: 好主意！还可以起名叫“Mh'athra骚腰印”！
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): KEEP; 完整教团招募事件为下背部纹身；Mh’athra 神名与骚腰印保留混词两端及性暗示，避免与正文同名纹身脱节。

source: Hmm, that could work. What should the Mh'athramp Stamps look like, though?
target: 嗯，可行。不过“Mh'athra骚腰印”该长什么样呢？

source: (Maybe we could do a tattoo of my mom's name? It'd have a lot of emotional meaning.)
target: （要不纹上我妈的名字？特别有感情意义。）

source: But aren't we all getting the same tattoo? Why would anyone else want a tattoo of your mom's name?
target: 可咱们不是都要纹一样的吗？别人干嘛要纹你妈的名字？

source: (Well, her name is Martha. That sounds a lot like "Mh'athra." It kinda fits!)
target: （她叫玛莎，Martha。跟“Mh'athra”听着挺像，正合适嘛！）

source: (Wait, your mother's name is Martha? So is mine! Did you also join this cult 'cause the deity sounds a lot like your mom's name?)
target: （等等，你妈也叫玛莎？我妈也是！你也是因为这神的名字像你妈，才加入教团的吗？）

source: Stop! No Martha tattoo! We should make a tattoo that appeals to the masses. The whole point of this is to INCREASE membership, REMEMBER?
target: 停！不纹玛莎！得想个大众都喜欢的图案。别忘了，这是为了增加成员！

source: Hmmm... ooh, people like iguanas! Reptiles are cool! Get an iguana tattoo!
target: 嗯……哦，大家都喜欢鬣蜥！爬行动物多酷啊，纹只鬣蜥吧！

source: Oooh, and what if the iguana is playing the xylophone? Xylophones are like... super sexy.
target: 哦，要是那鬣蜥在敲木琴呢？木琴就……特别性感。

source: I hear your ideas... but what if we do some brainstorming to come up with an idea that's less... how do I put this... dumb?
target: 主意我都听到了……不过，要不要再集思广益，想个不那么……怎么说呢……蠢的点子？

source: After two hours of intense intellectual debate and drawing several iterations and prototypes on napkins, you come up with the ultimate tramp stamp design, which happens to be...
target: 激烈讨论了两个小时，又在餐巾纸上画了好几版草图，你们终于想出了终极腰骚纹图案，那就是……

source: ...this.
target: ……这个。

source: As long as the cultists like it. You use -N2 MAGIC giving them their arcane Mh'athramp Stamps. They pay you +N2 MONEY for your help!
target: 教徒们喜欢就好。你花了-N2魔力，给他们纹上奥术Mh'athra骚腰印。他们付给你+N2金钱，感谢你的帮助！

source: Ride the horsies
target: 骑小马

source: You and your friends enter the stables and see a familiar redheaded fuckubus brushing one of the horses' manes.
target: 你和朋友们走进马厩，看到一个熟悉的红发魅魔，正在给一匹马梳鬃毛。

source: Hey, I know you! You're Sawyer, right? From summer camp?
target: 嘿，我认识你！你是索伊尔吧？夏令营的那个？

source: Indeed I am. But today, I'm Sawyer from this ranch.
target: 没错。不过今天，我是这座牧场的索伊尔。

source: I can see that. Do you visit the ranch a lot?
target: 看出来了。你经常来牧场吗？

source: Yeah. I really like the horses here. They're easier to vibe with than people sometimes.
target: 嗯，我很喜欢这里的马。有时跟它们相处，比跟人相处更自在。

source: That's cool. We just stopped by hoping we could ride some horses. Do you have any suggestions on which ones are good to ride?
target: 挺好。我们路过，想骑骑马。有没有适合骑的，给推荐一下？

source: Totally! How experienced are you guys at horseback riding?
target: 当然！你们骑马经验怎么样？

source: Not at all. But you'll do anything to impress your friends, including lying about being a pro at an extremely dangerous activity! You say you're an expert equestrian.
target: 一点没有。可为了让朋友刮目相看，你什么都敢干，包括把自己吹成危险活动的专业选手！你说自己精通马术。

source: Nice. I don't personally have much experience horseback riding. But I am an expert at riding things cowgirl-style.
target: 不错。我骑马没什么经验，不过“女上位骑乘”可是我的专长。

source: Um, I hope you guys won't judge me for this, but... I've actually never ridden a horse before.
target: 呃，你们可别笑话我，其实……我以前从没骑过马。

source: Don't be embarrassed. We'd never judge your worth based on your ability to ride a horse, that'd be dumb.
target: 别不好意思。我们又不会按骑马水平来判断你的价值，那也太蠢了。

source: ...Fuck.
Polly, how about you ride Hazelnut? She's a good girl who loves apples and long trots on the beach. I think you'll get along.
target: 波莉，你骑榛子怎么样？它是个乖姑娘，喜欢吃苹果，还喜欢沿着海滩慢跑。你俩应该合得来。

source: Scott, since you're a first-timer, you can take Chonk. He's our buffest pony, but he's very gentle, and he can handle a surprisingly heavy rider.
target: 斯科特，你是第一次骑，就选壮壮吧。它是我们最壮实的矮种马，性子特别温顺，能驮得动重得出奇的骑手。

source: Woohoo! I love you, Chonk! We're gonna have a soulful connection and be best horse bros forever!
target: 呜呼！我爱你，壮壮！咱们要灵魂相通，永远当最好的马兄弟！

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, since you're so experienced, I'm putting you on Big Boss. He's a wild stallion that has yet to be tamed. But you've got this, right?
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，既然你经验丰富，就骑大老板吧。它是匹还没驯服的野公马。不过你肯定没问题，对吧？

source: You look into Big Boss' wild, murderous eyes and know you absolutely do not got this. But you can't admit you lied! How will you tame this stallion?
target: 望进大老板那双野性十足、杀气腾腾的眼睛，你就知道自己绝对不行。可又不能承认撒了谎！该怎么驯服它？

source: Placate the wildness of this stallion by numbing its spirit through the power of late capitalism and its many entertaining temptations.
target: 动用晚期资本主义和它那无数娱乐诱惑，麻痹这匹公马的灵魂，安抚它的野性。

source: Promise him you'll take turns: you'll be the horse next time!
target: 答应轮流来：下次换你当马！

source: This stallion is wild and indomitable. But any indomitable spirit can be numbed with the power of an endless stream of mindless media.
target: 这匹公马狂野、不肯低头。不过，再不屈的灵魂，也经不住源源不断的无脑娱乐来麻痹。

source: You spend -N2 MONEY subscribing to Neighflix, the premiere horse streaming platform.
target: 你花了-N2金钱，订阅首屈一指的马儿流媒体平台“嘶飞”。

source: The content on Neighflix is... not the best, since it's staffed and consumed entirely by horses, who don't have thumbs. But Big Boss seems to enjoy it!
target: 嘶飞的内容嘛……不算太好。毕竟员工和观众全是马，都没有拇指。不过大老板似乎很喜欢！

source: You end up binge-watching "The Amazing Horserace," where horses race around the world while also solving clues and interacting with locals.
target: 最后，你们一口气刷起了《极速马赛》。参赛的马儿要一边环球竞速，一边解谜，还得跟当地居民互动。

source: They must travel only by airplane, boat, taxi, and other public transportation options despite their limited budget and the fact that most of these options don't allow horses.
target: 预算有限，它们却只能搭飞机、船、出租车和其他公共交通，更别说其中大多数根本不让马乘坐。

source: Wow, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, I'm impressed. Not even I could break in Big Boss, but you got him to sink into a couch all afternoon.
target: 哇，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，真厉害。连我都驯不服大老板，你居然让它窝在沙发上待了一下午。

source: Good, good. You don't pay much attention to Sawyer; you're too distracted by "Masterchef (but with Horses)" now.
target: 好，好。你根本没怎么听索伊尔说话，现在正看《厨艺大师（马儿版）》看得入迷。

source: Is this a cooking show for horses? Can horses even use cooking utensils?
target: 这是给马看的烹饪节目？马还能用厨具？

source: Not really, but that hasn't stopped them from making "The Great British Bake-off (but with Horses)" and "Masterchef (but with Horses): Celebrity Edition", among many others.
target: 用不太来，可这不妨碍它们接着拍《英国烘焙大赛（马儿版）》《厨艺大师（马儿版）：名人季》等等。

source: You gain +N2 HYPE for finding some new weird shows to binge-watch, and because Big Boss looks funny lazing around on the sofa.
target: 找到新的怪节目追着看，让你获得了+N2热度。再说，大老板瘫在沙发上的样子也挺逗。

source: You whisper your bargain to Big Boss. The stallion doesn't respond.
target: 你凑到大老板耳边，小声提出交易。它没反应。

source: Silly you. He's a fucking horse. What made you think he'd understand speech?
target: 傻了吧，它他妈是匹马。你凭什么觉得它听得懂人话？

source: But then... Big Boss locks eyes with you and offers you a hoofshake. Sick, he agreed to your plan!
target: 可接着……大老板直视你的双眼，伸出蹄子要跟你握手。牛啊，它同意了！

source: You mount him and take off at a gallop. Big Boss acts wild and untameable, but he winks at you to let you know it's all an act. Your friends are impressed!
target: 你翻身上马，飞驰而出。大老板表现得狂野难驯，却冲你眨眨眼，让你知道这都是演的。朋友们看得佩服极了！

source: Wow, look at %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% go! And here I thought %HESHE% lied about being an experienced rider just to impress us.
target: 哇，快看%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！我还以为%HESHE%是在吹牛，想装成老练骑手给我们留个好印象呢。

source: Not even I could stay on Big Boss' back for longer than a minute, but %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s handling him like a pro. Impressive.
target: 连我在大老板背上都待不了一分钟，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%却骑得跟专业选手似的。厉害。

source: Go %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! Now that you're bros with your horse, do you wanna get matching braids with Chonk and me?
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，加油！既然你跟你的马也成兄弟了，要不要跟我和壮壮编个同款辫子？

source: Later that day when your friends are busy braiding their horses' manes, you return to the stable to fulfill your end of the bargain.
target: 晚些时候，朋友们忙着给马编鬃毛，你回到马厩，履行自己那一半约定。

source: Big Boss eagerly mounts you, and you trot him around the ranch. He seems so happy to be the rider for a change!
target: 大老板迫不及待地骑到你身上，你驮着它绕牧场小跑。难得当一回骑手，它高兴坏了！

source: The other horses watch rapturously, obviously jealous and impressed that Big Boss managed to tame a bossy monster into being rideable.
target: 其他马看得入迷，显然又嫉妒又佩服。大老板居然驯服了一只爱发号施令的怪物，还能骑！

source: You've gained a lot of empathy for this stallion. Firstly because being ridden is fucking hard.
target: 你对这匹公马多了许多体谅。首先，被人骑着跑，真他妈累。

source: But also because now you realize that, even though he seemed wild and crazy, you two aren't so different. You both just wanted to look cool in front of your peers!
target: 再说，你也意识到，它看着狂野又疯狂，其实你俩没那么不同。你们只是都想在同伴面前显得酷一点！

source: You lose -N2 STAMINA carrying around a 1,200 pound horse, but you gain +N2 SOUL!
target: 驮着一匹1200磅的马让你失去了-N2体力，却也获得了+N2灵魂！

source: Whisper to the horsies
target: 跟小马说悄悄话

source: You enter the stables only to find a redheaded fuckubus serenely braiding a horse's mane.
target: 你走进马厩，看到一个红发魅魔，正安安静静地给一匹马编鬃毛。

source: Oh, visitors! Wait, I know you guys, we went to summer camp together. What brings you to the ranch today?
target: 哦，有客人！等等，我认识你们，咱们一起去过夏令营。今天怎么想到来牧场？

source: Hey, Sawyer! We're on a road trip and just wanted to check the joint out. Nice Dutch braid on that horse!
target: 嘿，索伊尔！我们在公路旅行，顺路来逛逛。你给这匹马编的荷兰辫真不错！

source: Thank you. I've had a lot of practice. I, uh, spend a lot of time with these horses.
target: 谢谢，练得多嘛。我，呃，经常跟这些马待在一起。

source: They're so sweet and gentle, and sometimes it's just more relaxing to be among animals than people, you know?
target: 它们又温柔又乖，有时候跟动物待着，确实比跟人待着放松，你懂吧？

source: Sure, animals rock! Do people come here to hang out with the horses often?
target: 当然，动物超棒！经常有人来这儿陪马玩吗？

source: Yeah, some people come here to braid their manes or practice drawing horse anatomy. Some hardcore horse girls even like whispering in the horses' ears.
target: 有啊，有人来编鬃毛，有人练习画马的身体结构。一些资深爱马女孩，还喜欢趴在马耳边说悄悄话。

source: Wow, weird. What do they whisper to them? Is there, like, an established process to whispering to a horse?
target: 哇，挺怪。她们都说些什么？跟马说悄悄话，还有固定流程吗？

source: No idea. They never tell me what they say, and I figured it's not my business.
target: 不知道，她们从来不告诉我。我也觉得，那不关我的事。

source: Why, you wanna give it a shot?
target: 怎么，你想试试？

source: Oh, uh, I don't think so... what if I whisper the wrong thing and the horse thinks I'm dumb?
target: 哦，呃，还是算了……万一说错了，马会不会觉得我很蠢？

source: I know a lot of people mistake my bubbliness for dumbness, which I couldn't care less about... but I don't think I could take it if a horse thought I was dumb.
target: 我知道，很多人把我活泼开朗当成没脑子，这我根本不在乎……可要是一匹马觉得我蠢，我大概真受不了。

source: Fair enough. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, do you wanna whisper to a horse? Bull-rushing weird experiences with no forethought is sorta your thing, isn't it?
target: 也行。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你想跟马说悄悄话吗？遇上怪事不多想，先一头冲进去，算是你的风格吧？

source: Damn right! Time to show your friends what whispering to a horsie is all about! You just have to figure out what to say first.
target: 那当然！让朋友们见识一下，什么叫跟小马说悄悄话！不过，先得想好要说什么。

source: Whisper the cosmic words of Mh'athra that shall never be spoken. They may unleash a powerful truth beyond mortal comprehension... but keeping them to yourself is killing you!
target: 低声念出Mh'athra那不可言说的宇宙密语。它们也许会释放超越凡人理解的强大真理……可憋在心里，实在要憋死人了！

source: "I have a gun in my pocket. Hoof me all your money and nobody gets hurt, horsie."
target: “我口袋里有枪。小马，把钱都用蹄子递过来，谁都不会受伤。”

source: Ah, yes, the cosmic words of Mh'athra! You learned them from a mysterious fortune cookie you got at a hella sketchy restaurant.
target: 啊，没错，Mh'athra的宇宙密语！你是在一家超级可疑的餐馆里，从一块神秘幸运饼干上学到的。

source: The words have been nagging at you ever since. The cookie said never to share them, but fuck it, why would you obey a stupid cookie?
target: 从那以后，这些话就一直萦绕在你脑海。饼干说不能告诉任何人，可去他的，凭什么听块蠢饼干的话？

source: You whisper the words into the horse's ear. The horse's head turns around 180 degrees and stares at you with blood-red eyes!
target: 你凑到马耳边念出密语。它的脑袋转了180度，用血红的眼睛直勾勾盯着你！

source: "YOU STUPID MORTAL!" it says in your mind. "YOU DARE TREAT MH'ATHRA'S WORDS AS IF THEY WERE A GAME?!"
target: “愚蠢的凡人！”它的声音响在你脑中，“竟敢拿Mh'athra的密语当儿戏？！”

source: "YOU MEDDLE WITH WHAT BELONGS TO THE MASTER OF EVERYTHING THAT LURKS IN THE DARKNESS; EVERYTHING THAT MUST REMAIN OUT OF SIGHT AND OUT OF MIND!"
target: “你所触碰的，属于黑暗中一切潜伏之物的主人，属于那些必须藏于视线与意识之外的秘密！”

source: But -- but the cookie!
target: 可——可是那块饼干！

source: "THE COOKIE WAS A TEST THAT YOU'VE FAILED. ONCE AGAIN, MORTALS PROVE THAT THEY ARE UNWORTHY OF MH'ATHRA'S SACRED SECRECY!"
target: “那块饼干是考验，而你失败了。凡人再次证明，自己不配接触Mh'athra的神圣秘密！”

source: "YOU COMMIT BLASPHEMY BY BRINGING ITS WORDS TO THE MORTAL REALM. SUCH SACRILEGE IS PUNISHABLE BY COSMIC EGO-DEATH!"
target: “你将它的密语带入凡间，已是亵渎！如此大逆不道，当受宇宙自我消亡之罚！”

source: "AS THE WEIGHT OF THE WORLD SHALL BREAK THE MORTAL'S SHOULDERS, THE WEIGHT OF THE MYSTERIES SHALL BREAK THE MORTAL'S MIND!"
target: “正如世界的重量能压断凡人的肩膀，秘密的重量也将压垮凡人的心智！”

source: Suddenly, you're in a dark, confusing plane of existence! Mh'athra's Sacred Secrets hover around you, churning and swirling...
target: 突然，你置身于一个黑暗、混沌的存在位面！Mh'athra的神圣秘密在四周翻涌、盘旋……

source: Long-dead languages; the contents of private Tweeter accounts; horse girls' diaries; passwords hidden behind bullet points; the corruption behind so many governments...
target: 失传已久的语言、私人Tweeter账号里的内容、爱马女孩的日记、藏在圆点后的密码、无数政府背后的腐败……

source: You fall to your knees, overwhelmed by so much you should never have known, and feel your -N2 MIND begin to break!
target: 太多你永远不该知道的事压得你跪倒在地，你感觉心智开始崩溃，失去了-N2头脑！

source: "NOW YOU TRULY KNOW THE WEIGHT OF THAT WHICH SHALL NOT BE SHARED; OF THAT WHICH MUST REMAIN IN ETERNAL DARKNESS. DO YOU UNDERSTAND?"
target: “现在你终于懂得，那些不可分享、必须永远隐于黑暗的秘密，有多沉重。明白了吗？”

source: Yeah, fuck, you get it! You won't ever say the words again! Just please, stop this!
target: 懂了，操，懂了！再也不说了！求你停下吧！

source: "I WILL STOP... BUT ONLY IF YOU PINKY PROMISE TO EMBRACE MH'ATHRA'S SACRED SECRECY FROM NOW ON."
target: “我可以停下……但你必须拉钩，发誓从今往后尊奉Mh'athra的神圣秘密。”

source: Fine! You touch your pinky to the horse's hoof and are freed from your torment.
target: 好！你用小指碰了碰马蹄，终于摆脱了折磨。

source: Well? How was the horsie-whispering, bro?
target: 怎么样，兄弟？跟小马聊得如何？

source: It was... something. You gain +N2 MAGIC from your exposure to Mh'athra's Sacred Secrecy, but at what cost?
target: 真是……一言难尽。接触Mh'athra的神圣秘密让你获得了+N2魔力，可代价呢？

source: You stare down the horse, eye-to-eye. The horse is visibly sweating.
target: 你跟那匹马四目相对，死死盯着它。它明显开始冒汗。

source: You got this, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. We believe in you!
target: 你行的，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，我们相信你！

source: Shit, your friends are all giving you a thumbs-up. They don't even know! Oh well, back to the horse.
target: 妈的，朋友们还全在给你竖大拇指。他们根本不知道你在干嘛！算了，先管这匹马。

source: You can sense the horse is fearful for its life. You have to be intense; make it believe you really DO have a gun. You reach slowly into your pocket.
target: 你感觉得到，它已经怕得要命。得再凶一点，让它相信你真有枪。你慢慢把手伸进口袋。

source: Ooh, are you gonna give the horsie a treat, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? This is the start of a beautiful friendship!
target: 哦，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你要给小马吃零食吗？一段美好友谊就此开始！

source: Oh, poor Scott! He'd never approve of this... no, you can't think about that now! Gotta rob this horse!
target: 可怜的斯科特！他肯定不会赞成这种事……不，现在不能想这个，先把马抢了再说！

source: "You fucking equine," you whisper, "you'd better hand over the cash before this gets ugly."
target: 你低声说：“你这该死的马，最好趁事情还没难看起来，把钱交出来。”

source: Shaking and sweating, the horse starts rustling through a pile of its hay. It pulls out a wallet with its teeth. Great!
target: 马抖着、冒着汗，开始在干草堆里翻找，最后用牙叼出一个钱包。好极了！

source: But it doesn't pull money out of the wallet. Instead, it pulls out a picture of itself alongside two smaller horses.
target: 可它没掏钱，而是拿出一张照片：它旁边还有两匹小一点的马。

source: Fuck, does this horse have foals?! Oh, no, you're threatening a mother! You're a monster! Well, you literally are, but now also on the inside!
target: 操，它有孩子？！不，你居然在威胁一位母亲！你真是怪物！虽然本来就是，但现在心也成了怪物！

source: ...Wait, those aren't foals. Those are just adult ponies. This fucking horse is trying to emotionally manipulate you! That's YOUR thing!
target: ……等等，那不是幼驹，只是成年矮种马。这破马居然想打感情牌操控你！那可是你的专长！

source: You take the photo and rip it into tiny little pieces. That seems to send the message. Despairingly, the horse gives you +N2 MONEY from its wallet.
target: 你拿过照片，撕了个粉碎。它似乎懂你的意思了，绝望地从钱包里交出+N2金钱。

source: Aww, it seems like you and that horse had a great emotional connection, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. Look how sad it is to see you go!
target: 哎呀，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，看来你跟这匹马建立了很深的感情。看你要走，它多难过！

source: Your friends really have no idea what a fucking psychopath you are. You're not gonna come clean, obviously, but you do lose -N2 SOUL.
target: 朋友们根本不知道你是个多可怕的变态。你当然不打算坦白，不过还是失去了-N2灵魂。

source: Worship the horsies
target: 崇拜小马

source: You all approach the stables, but find they're already full of other people visiting the ranch.
target: 你们来到马厩，却发现里面早就挤满了其他游客。

source: You're surrounded by young girls in blue jeans and ponytails. They're bowing to the horses and filling diaries with horse doodles.
target: 周围全是穿蓝牛仔裤、扎马尾的年轻女孩。她们向马儿鞠躬，往日记本里画满小马。

source: You also see a familiar ginger fuckubus you met at summer camp.
target: 你还看到了夏令营里认识的那个熟悉的红发魅魔。

source: Oh, hey there!
target: 哦，嘿，你们好！

source: Hi Sawyer!
target: 嗨,索伊尔!

source: Whoa, what's the weird stuff happening back there?
target: 哇，后面那些人在搞什么奇怪的事？

source: Oh, that? It's the horse girls. They love worshipping the horsies.
target: 哦，她们啊？爱马女孩们，最喜欢崇拜小马了。

source: It's weird, but I sort of get it. Horses are beautiful and gentle, and easier to talk to than people sometimes.
target: 是挺怪，不过我有点能理解。马又漂亮又温顺，有时候比人更好聊。

source: I even consider myself a horse girl from time to time!
target: 有时候，我甚至觉得自己也是个爱马女孩！

source: Oh, really? But I thought... you know...
target: 哦，真的？可我以为……你懂的……

source: Ah, yes, for the most part I prefer using non-gendered terms for myself. It's sweet of you to remember!
target: 啊，对，我通常更喜欢别人用不带性别的称呼来叫我。你还记得，真贴心！

source: But I dunno, I like to think that "horse girl" sort of refers to a way of life... like something that goes beyond gender.
target: 不过怎么说呢，我觉得“爱马女孩”更像一种生活方式……某种超越性别的东西。

source: That's just me, though. It's not one size fits all. It's best to always ask first.
target: 当然，那只是我自己的想法，不能套用在所有人身上。最好还是先问问本人。

source: You know what, Sawyer? I may not be a girl, or a horse... but I think I might be a horse girl!
target: 索伊尔，你知道吗？我不是女孩，也不是马……可我觉得自己可能是个爱马女孩！

source: Nice!
target: 不错!

source: So are you not joining the horsie worship with the other girls?
target: 那你不跟那些女孩一起拜小马吗？

source: Nah. They can get... pretty intense. They say the worship grants them "secret horsie magic" or something.
target: 不了，她们有时……太狂热了。说这么拜，能获得什么“秘密小马魔法”。

source: I'll try it! Now that I'm a horse girl, I'll honor the horsies by playing the basketball game "HORSE" with them. I'm sure they'll love to be included!
target: 我试试！既然我是爱马女孩了，就跟小马一起玩“HORSE”投篮游戏，向它们致敬。能一起玩，它们肯定很高兴！

source: I mean, horses aren't really known for their basketball skills, but sure. Knock yourself out.
target: 虽说马不怎么以篮球技术出名，不过行吧，你开心就好。

source: I'll knit my new equine overlords a beautiful saddle blanket. Except I'll knit it with my butt, to honor them with my incredible booty!
target: 我要给新认的马儿霸主织条漂亮的鞍毯。不过得用屁股织，让它们见识我这绝世美臀，表达敬意！

source: Uh... okay then. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, are you getting in on this?
target: 呃……行吧。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你也来吗？

source: Obviously! Horses aren't even in the top 5 weirdest things you've ever worshipped. How do you worship them?
target: 那当然！在你拜过的怪东西里，马连前五都排不进。要怎么拜呢？

source: Scream "HORSE" until your throat gets... you know... hoarse.
target: 大喊“马”，一直喊到声嘶力竭……嗯，马嘶的“嘶”。

source: To show loyalty, kill the horses' natural enemy: Travis Packard. Fuckin' Travis Packard!
target: 杀掉马儿的天敌，以表忠心：特拉维斯·帕卡德。去他妈的特拉维斯·帕卡德！

source: Do the Horse Girl Pact: complete devotion by braiding your hair and filling a thousand notebooks with drawings of majestic horsies and essays on how much you love them.
target: 缔结爱马女孩契约：编好辫子，用小马的优美画像和满怀爱意的文章填满一千本笔记本，献上全部忠诚。

source: You start screaming "HORSE" at the top of your lungs. In any other context, someone would probably think a horse is about to trample you.
target: 你扯着嗓子大喊“马”。换个场合，别人可能会以为你马上就要被马踩了。

source: But the horse girls see you doing this and get excited! They start yelling "HORSE" too.
target: 爱马女孩们却兴奋起来，也跟着大喊“马”！

source: "Yes, great work!" says one girl with a body-length braid and a unicorn T-shirt. "You're summoning the horsie's cosmic energy!"
target: 一个穿独角兽T恤、辫子长及全身的女孩说：“对，就是这样！你在召唤小马的宇宙能量！”

source: "Can you feel its power welling up inside you? You're becoming a horsie!"
target: “感觉到力量在体内涌动了吗？你正在变成小马！”

source: Are you? You feel the same, besides your throat getting sore. But who knows? Your +N2 MAGIC has gone up a bit, anyway.
target: 有吗？除了喉咙疼，你没觉得有什么变化。不过谁知道呢，反正你获得了+N2魔力。

source: "Come on, girls!" says the horse girl. "Let's prance around and become majestic horsies together!"
target: 那个爱马女孩说：“来吧，姑娘们！一起蹦蹦跳跳，变成威风的小马！”

source: Eh, I'd just roll with it if I were you. Part of these horse-worshippers' devotion is "playing horsies."
target: 换作我，就顺着她们来。对这些拜马的人来说，“扮小马”也是表达虔诚的一部分。

source: I won't judge you if you get into it. It can be fun to release your inhibitions and run around neighing for a while.
target: 你要是真喜欢上了，我也不会笑你。放开拘束，边跑边学马叫，有时候还挺好玩。

source: Fuck it, why not? You run with the horse girls on all fours for a couple hours, neighing and galloping and braiding each other's "manes."
target: 管它呢，试试呗！你跟爱马女孩们四脚着地跑了几个小时，嘶鸣、飞奔，还互相编“鬃毛”。

source: It's a nice afternoon, though you do lose -N2 STAMINA from the loud whinnying and clip-clopping.
target: 下午过得挺愉快，不过大声嘶鸣、哒哒乱跑，也让你失去了-N2体力。

source: ...Who's Travis Packard?
target: ……特拉维斯·帕卡德是谁？

source: "BANISH HIS NAME FROM OUR STABLES!" the horse girls shriek. "Fuck Travis Packard! All horsies HATE Travis Packard!"
target: 爱马女孩们尖叫：“马厩里不许提他的名字！去他妈的特拉维斯·帕卡德！所有小马都恨他！”

source: But what did he do? Does he have an anti-horse agenda? Is he the CEO of a glue factory or something?
target: 可他干什么了？搞反马事业吗？还是说，是什么胶水厂的老板？

source: "You ask a lot of questions. Questions serve no purpose to horsies. You know what DOES serve purpose to horsies? KILLING. TRAVIS. PACKARD."
target: “你问题太多了。问问题对小马毫无用处。知道什么才有用吗？杀、了、特拉维斯·帕卡德。”

source: Well... you don't get it, but there's no mechanic that lets you backpedal on your choice, so it looks like Travis Packard's gonna die.
target: 好吧……你还是不懂，可游戏又没有让你反悔的机制。看来特拉维斯·帕卡德非死不可了。

source: Meanwhile, in the nearby town, a middle-aged, mustachioed man visits his favorite coffee shop.
target: 与此同时，附近小镇里，一名留着小胡子的中年男人走进了最喜欢的咖啡店。

source: "Good morning, Melodie!" he says to the barista. "One espresso and a chocolate donut, please."
target: 他跟咖啡师打招呼：“早上好，梅洛迪！一杯意式浓缩，一只巧克力甜甜圈，谢谢。”

source: "The same as usual, then," says the barista. "It always makes me happy to see you, Travis. I hope you have a good day!"
target: “还是老样子嘛。”咖啡师说，“见到你总是很开心，特拉维斯。祝你今天愉快！”

source: The man leaves the coffee shop. "Ahh, a delicious breakfast and a beautiful sunny day. It's a great day to be Travis Packard!"
target: 男人走出咖啡店。“啊，美味的早餐，阳光灿烂的好天气。当特拉维斯·帕卡德，今天真幸福！”

source: Travis Packard approaches the florist to buy his wife flowers. But before he can open the door, you jump out at him from behind a plant!
target: 特拉维斯·帕卡德正要进花店，给妻子买花。门还没推开，你就从一株植物后面蹿了出来！

source: "Oh, hello young %MANWOMAN%. How are -- AHHH, WHY ARE YOU STABBING ME?! WHAT DID I DO?!"
target: “哦，这位年轻的%MANWOMAN%，你好啊。过得怎——啊啊啊，你为什么捅我？！我做什么了？！”

source: You have no clue! Sheesh, Travis Packard seems like a nice guy! But you're in too deep now, you gotta finish the job!
target: 你也不知道！哎呀，特拉维斯·帕卡德看着人挺好啊！可已经走到这步，只能把事做完了！

source: You bring a pound of Travis Packard's flesh back to the ranch and present it to the horses and horse girls. They go nuts, cheering and neighing in excitement.
target: 你带着一磅特拉维斯·帕卡德的肉回到牧场，献给马儿和爱马女孩们。她们欢呼，马儿嘶鸣，全都兴奋疯了。

source: God, you feel awful... you definitely lost -N2 SOUL. You can feel the horses' gratitude made manifest in +N2 MAGIC coursing through you, but at what cost?
target: 天哪，你难受极了……毫无疑问，你失去了-N2灵魂。马儿的感激化为+N2魔力，在你体内流动，可代价呢？

source: You pour the magic into your car later, and you pour one out in memory of Travis Packard, the Good Man All Horses Inexplicably Hated.
target: 之后，你把魔力灌进车里，又洒了一杯酒，悼念特拉维斯·帕卡德——那个莫名其妙被所有马憎恨的好人。

source: You grab some notebooks and get to work. You fill thousands of pages with equine doodles, poems, and heartfelt essays about your horsie overlords.
target: 你拿来笔记本，开始写画。几千页纸上，全是马儿的涂鸦、诗歌，还有写给马儿霸主的真情文章。

source: "I love horsies," you write. "I really, really love horsies. I love them so so so so so so so so so so so so much!"
target: 你写道：“我爱小马。我真的、真的爱小马。我超级超级超级超级超级超级超级超级超级爱它们！”

source: "I've loved horsies ever since I stared into the soft, soulful eyes of a friendly horsie and knew that this majestic creature understood my very soul."
target: “自从望进一匹友善小马温柔又有灵性的双眼，明白这优美的生灵懂得我的灵魂，我就爱上了小马。”

source: "Horsies are so pretty. Their manes are so shiny. Their legs are so strong and supple. I love the way their flanks ripple and undulate as they gallop."
target: “小马好漂亮。鬃毛闪亮，四肢有力又柔韧。我喜欢它们飞奔时，两侧肌肉起伏流动的样子。”

source: "I wish I was a horsie. Then I would be free to gallop through the grasslands, one with the wind, and I wouldn't know about taxes or the high expectations my parents put on me."
target: “真希望我也是小马。那样就能自由驰骋草原，跟风融为一体，也不用知道税是什么，更不用背着爸妈那么高的期望。”

source: "I drew this picture of me as a horsie for you. Please, horsies, accept my worship, and let's be BFFs! XOXOXOXOXO, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%"
target: “这幅画送给你们，画的是变成小马的我。小马们，请接受我的崇拜，跟我做永远的好朋友！亲亲抱抱亲亲抱抱，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%”

source: You show the horse girls your work. They're pleased with your offerings, and they prepare you for the horsie altar.
target: 你把作品拿给爱马女孩们看。她们很满意你的献礼，开始帮你准备去小马祭坛朝拜。

source: Your hair is beautifully braided. You're outfitted in jeans, riding boots, and a sequin-covered jacket.
target: 你的头发被编成漂亮的辫子，换上牛仔裤、马靴和亮片外套。

source: You kneel before the horsies, spread out your diaries, and kiss their sacred hooves. They love it!
target: 你跪在小马面前，摊开日记，亲吻它们神圣的蹄子。它们喜欢极了！

source: ...Cool, are you done now? 'Cause we were supposed to get back on the road, like, hours ago.
target: ……行，现在完事了吗？咱们几小时前就该回公路上了。

source: Oh yeah. Only now do you realize you lost -N2 HYPE, -N3 MIND, and -N1 STAMINA because you spent all day fantasizing about being a horse instead of eating or being normal.
target: 哦，对。你这才意识到，自己一整天没好好吃饭，也没干正常事，光顾着幻想当马，失去了-N2热度、-N3头脑和-N1体力。

source: At least %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% got +N6 MAGIC from the horsies as thanks for being so obsessed with them. Now we have gas for the car!
target: 至少，小马们为了感谢%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%这么痴迷它们，给了+N6魔力。咱们的车有油了！

source: Yep, that's true... but you're reminded that you only need the car because you're not a horse and can't run fast. Your dreams will never come true... oh well.
target: 没错……可这也提醒了你：正因为你不是马，跑不快，才需要车。你的梦想永远不会实现……唉，算了。

source: Work a machine
target: 操作机器

source: You approach the foreman and ask if you and your friends could work at the factory for a day.
target: 你找到工头，问能不能让你和朋友们在工厂干一天。

source: "For... just one day?" he asks. "I mean, that's not really how employment contracts work."
target: 他问：“就……一天？不是，劳动合同不是这么回事啊。”

source: How do they work, then?
target: 那是怎么回事？

source: "They work... well... hm. I dunno. Now that I think about it, half our employees are in draconian contracts with nonsensical clauses, and half have no contract at all."
target: “合同嘛……呃……嗯。还真不好说。仔细想想，我们一半员工签着苛刻合同，条款莫名其妙，另一半压根没合同。”

source: "You know what? Fuck it. Some of my guys called in today anyway. You can fill in for them."
target: “算了，去他的。反正今天有人打电话请假，你们正好顶上。”

source: Cool! Is there any sort of training we need to do to operate the equipment properly?
target: 酷！要正确操作设备的话，需要先培训吗？

source: "Nah. You'll just be screwing Screw 3B into Panel A for eight-to-twelve hours. It isn't hard."
target: “不用。把3B螺丝拧进A面板，干上八到十二小时。没什么难的。”

source: Got it. So, what's your company's position on office romances? What's the policy on sharing company-related memes?
target: 懂了。那公司怎么看办公室恋情？跟公司有关的梗图，可以随便发吗？

source: Is there a group chat for all the employees? Are there any rules on using lewd emojis?
target: 有没有员工群？发黄黄的表情包有什么规定？

source: "What? We don't have policies for any of that stuff. Our employees almost never talk to each other. I could probably only name like three of the 300 guys on the floor."
target: “什么？那些都没规定。员工之间几乎不说话，车间三百来个人，我大概只叫得出三个的名字。”

source: Good to know! What's your brand philosophy?
target: 了解！你们的品牌理念是什么？

source: "Brand philosophy? Uh... does 'screw Screw 3B into Panel A for eight-to-twelve hours' count as a philosophy?"
target: “品牌理念？呃……‘把3B螺丝拧进A面板，干上八到十二小时’，这算理念吗？”

source: Works for you! You sidle up to start screwing Screw 3B into Panel A for eight-to-twelve hours. What could be more fun?
target: 你没意见！你走到工位前，准备把3B螺丝拧进A面板，干上八到十二小时。还能有什么比这更好玩？

source: ...After about fifteen minutes, you realize that anything, ANYTHING, would be more fun than doing this.
target: ……大约十五分钟后，你发现，随便干点什么，任何事，都比这好玩。

source: Luckily, since there's no contract at work here, it's up to you to decide how hard to work today. So, how much are you committing to this torture?
target: 幸好又没签合同，今天出几分力，全看你自己。所以，这份折磨你打算投入到什么程度？

source: Oof, what if you just bribe the dude next to you to assemble both Screws 3B and 4B into Panel A while you play Solitaire?
target: 要不贿赂旁边那人，让他把3B、4B螺丝都装进A面板，你自己玩纸牌接龙？

source: Just work, dammit. No jokes here. We, the writers, always work for you to have fun. Today, YOU work and WE play.
target: 老老实实工作，妈的。这里没笑话。我们编剧一直忙着给你找乐子，今天换你工作，我们玩。

source: WORK FOREVER! Work until life looks like a Panel A that ought to be solved by assembling a Screw 3B into it... where the Screw 3B is work. This is your life now.
target: 永远工作！干到人生在你眼里就是块A面板，只有装上3B螺丝才能解决……而3B螺丝就是工作。这就是你往后的人生。

source: Hey, it's not like you're not compromising here. Solitaire fucking sucks. But at the end of the day, it's what people play at work, right?
target: 嘿，你也不是没做牺牲。纸牌接龙他妈的无聊死了。可上班摸鱼，不都是玩这个吗？

source: The guy next to you agrees to the bribe. He does your work while you play some of the most exciting games of Solitaire of your life.
target: 旁边那人收了贿赂，替你干活，你则玩起了人生中最惊险刺激的几局纸牌接龙。

source: You thought you were gonna lose that first game when you couldn't find the ace of clubs, but you saved it when you finally moved the five of diamonds aside!
target: 第一局找不到梅花A，你还以为输定了，结果终于移开方块5，救了回来！

source: You later mixed things up by drawing THREE cards at a time instead of one. It really raised the difficulty level, but you mastered it soon enough!
target: 后来你又换了种玩法，每次翻三张牌，不再只翻一张。难度大增，可你很快就掌握了！

source: Then there was that time you shuffled the cards between games and somehow got THE EXACT SAME CARD ORDER.
target: 还有一回，两局之间你明明洗了牌，结果牌序居然一模一样。

source: The probablity of that happening is 0.00000000000000000000000000000000000000000000002%! It's only slightly more likely to happen than you getting a date this Friday!
When your shift ends, you've gained +N2 HYPE from playing Solitaire. Ha, working isn't so hard! People should stop complaining so much and start getting better at Solitaire.
target: 下班时，玩纸牌接龙让你获得了+N2热度。哈，上班也没那么难嘛！大家少抱怨，多练练接龙技术不就好了。

source: You meet back up with your friends to see how much money you made between the three of you.
target: 你和朋友们碰头，看看三个人一共赚了多少。

source: Wait, we were supposed to MAKE money? I spent my entire paycheck on these cute company coveralls. Whoops.
target: 等等，咱们是来赚钱的？我把工资全拿去买这些可爱的公司连体工装了。哎呀。

source: They didn't pay me 'cause I accidentally ate all the screws.
target: 他们没给我钱，因为我不小心把螺丝全吃了。

source: Well, you actually lost -N2 MONEY, because it turns out you bribed that guy more than a day's wages. No wonder he was so eager to accept.
target: 而你其实还亏了-N2金钱，因为贿赂那人的钱比一天工资还多。难怪他答应得那么痛快。

source: Oh well. At least you got to play Solitaire all day, the premiere card game for lonely losers!
target: 唉，算了。至少玩了一天纸牌接龙，孤独废柴的首选纸牌游戏！

source: Yeah, you know what? Fuck you. We're taking the day off.
target: 对啊，去你的。我们今天放假。

source: You screw Screw 3B into Panel A or whatever. I don't care.
target: 你把3B螺丝拧进A面板，还是什么的。谁管你。

source: Meanwhile, the writers are having a contest to see who can stuff the most cookies in their mouth!
target: 与此同时，编剧们在比赛，看谁嘴里塞得下最多饼干！

source: Another Screw 3B. You know what you're gonna do? That's right, screw it into Panel A.
target: 又一颗3B螺丝。你知道该怎么办吧？对，拧进A面板。

source: Ooh, it looks like the writers are learning how to play the xylophone now! Godspeed, you funky creatives!
target: 哦，编剧们好像开始学木琴了！加油啊，你们这帮有趣的创作人才！

source: Screw 3B; Panel A. Screw 3B; Panel A. Screw 3A; Panel B... wait, did I get that right? Eh.
target: 3B螺丝，A面板。3B螺丝，A面板。3A螺丝，B面板……等等，说对了吗？算了。

source: I'm too busy drawing wacky fan art to care! That's right, writers can make fan art too, even if we can't do it very well!
target: 我忙着画稀奇古怪的同人图，没空管！没错，编剧也能画同人，画不好也能画！

source: Shit, I think the creative director saw me goofing off. Uh, back to your regularly scheduled antics!
target: 妈的，创意总监好像看见我摸鱼了。呃，回到各位熟悉的胡闹时间！

source: You know what? I'm sick of this! Screw Screw 3B!
target: 知道吗？我受够了！去他的3B螺丝！

source: But not "screw it" as in "screw it into Panel A." "Screw it" as in "screw this shit, let's leave before we lose any more -N2 HYPE."
target: 不是说“去把它拧进A面板”，是说“去他妈的，咱们赶紧走，别再损失-N2热度了”。
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): KEEP; 上句是去他的3B螺丝；去把／去他妈的已连接拧螺丝和咒骂，不必另改前句。

source: You leave with a newfound appreciation for the people behind this whole thing, who in their own way screwed the Screws 3B into the Plaques A of this game.
target: 离开时，你对幕后创作者多了一份感激。他们也是用自己的方式，把3B螺丝一颗颗拧进了这游戏的A面板。

source: You also leave with +N2 MONEY for the work you did today. Woohoo!
target: 今天的工作也让你赚了+N2金钱。呜呼！

source: Yes. YES. This is your dream. When other kids wanted to be astronauts or rockstars, you knew your calling was to screw Screw 3B into Panel A.
target: 对。没错。这就是你的梦想。别的小孩想当宇航员、摇滚明星，你却早已知道，自己的使命是把3B螺丝拧进A面板。

source: You throw yourself mind, body, and soul into the work. You are one with your screws and panels.
target: 你把身心和灵魂全都投入工作，跟螺丝、面板融为一体。

source: They're your flesh and blood; they're your tether to this dreary world; they're life, love, and God incarnate!!!
target: 它们就是你的骨血，是你跟这灰暗世界的纽带，是生命、爱，还有上帝的化身！！！

source: Hey, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, that was the lunch bell! Wanna eat with us?
target: 嘿，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，午饭铃响了！一起吃饭吗？

source: Who needs lunch? I'll happily lose -N3 STAMINA. I'll sustain myself on the +N1 MAGIC of worshipping Screw 3B!
target: 谁要吃午饭？损失-N3体力，我乐意！崇拜3B螺丝得来的+N1魔力，就是我的精神食粮！

source: Oh no. Scott, I think %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s obsessive-addictive personality is making %HIMHER% lose %HISHER% -N2 MIND over this!
target: 糟了。斯科特，我觉得%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%那爱钻牛角尖又容易上瘾的性格，要让%HIMHER%着魔了。%HISHER%心智都损失了-N2头脑！

source: DON'T LISTEN TO HER, SCOTT. THIS ANTI-SCREW 3B RHETORIC IS BLASPHEMY OF THE HIGHEST ORDER!
target: 别听她的，斯科特。这种反3B螺丝的言论，是最严重的亵渎！

source: Yep, %HESHE%%VERB_'S_'VE% gone off the deep end.
target: 对，%HESHE%%VERB_'S_'VE%彻底走火入魔了。
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): KEEP; 拧螺丝成瘾导致走火入魔，完成体由了表达。 按行中文动词展开已实现；未实机验证。

source: I'll get the net.
target: 我去拿网。

source: Scott and Polly net you like a fish and carry you kicking and screaming back to the car.
target: 斯科特和波莉像捞鱼一样，把你罩进网里。你又踢又叫，还是被扛回了车上。

source: You lose -N1 HYPE from being separated from your precious screws, but at least you earned +N4 MONEY for working so hard.
target: 被迫跟心爱的螺丝分开，让你失去了-N1热度，不过这么卖力地干活，至少赚了+N4金钱。

source: And the company is so grateful that you worked so hard that they give you a bonus +N1 SOUL! Fuck yeah, who said capitalism was soulless?
target: 公司也很感激你的拼命工作，又奖励你+N1灵魂！爽啊，谁说资本主义没有灵魂？

source: Test a product
target: 测试产品

source: What's the best thing to do at a factory? Touch shit you aren't supposed to! You tell your friends you'd like to test out the final product they manufacture here.
target: 到了工厂，最该干什么？当然是乱碰那些不该碰的东西！你告诉朋友们，想试试这里生产的最终成品。

source: I'm in! Where is the final product, though? And WHAT is it? Do you know, ma'am?
target: 我来！不过成品在哪儿？到底是什么啊？这位女士，您知道吗？

source: "Are you talking to me?" asks one of the workers. "I dunno what the final product does. I don't think anyone does."
target: 一位工人问：“你在跟我说话？我不知道成品干什么用，估计没人知道。”

source: "I've spent 32 years screwing Screw 4B into Panel A. I'm not paid to know what the hell it's all for."
target: “我把4B螺丝往A面板上拧了32年。人家付钱，又不是让我知道这些到底有什么用。”

source: Well, do you at least know where we should go to find the final product?
target: 那你至少知道，要去哪儿找成品吧？

source: "Hmm... I've heard some of the retirees speak of a magical, faraway sector where the assembly line comes to an end."
target: “嗯……听退休的人说过，有个遥远又神奇的区域，流水线在那里结束。”

source: "I've never believed in such hogwash, but if you're looking for the final product, that's the only place I can think to check."
target: “我从来不信这些胡扯，不过想找成品的话，我也只能想到那里。”

source: Sweet! You hop in a forklift and start driving down the assembly line, taking in its processes along the way:
target: 好极了！你跳上叉车，沿着流水线开去，一路欣赏各道工序：

source: You pass an employee screwing Screw 5B onto Panel A.
target: 一名员工正把5B螺丝拧到A面板上，你从旁经过。

source: You pass an employee embossing the logo for "Everweasel Electronics" on Panel A.
target: 一名员工正往A面板上压印“恒鼬电子”的标志，你从旁经过。

source: You pass a priest blessing Panel A's pilgrimage down the assembly line.
target: 一名牧师正祝福A面板沿流水线展开的朝圣之旅，你从旁经过。

source: You pass an employee smashing the absolute shit out of Panel A with an electric hammer.
target: 一名员工正拿电锤把A面板往死里砸，你从旁经过。

source: You pass an employee sanding off the "Everweasel Electronics" logo from Panel A.
target: 一名员工正把“恒鼬电子”的标志从A面板上磨掉，你从旁经过。

source: You pass employees screwing Screw 6B onto Panel A.
target: 几名员工正把6B螺丝拧到A面板上，你从旁经过。

source: At the end of the line, behind a heavy curtain, you find Noodles! He picks up the completed Panel A and tosses it in the trash.
target: 到了流水线尽头，你在厚重的帘子后找到了面条！他拿起完工的A面板，直接扔进垃圾桶。

source: Why did you throw away Panel A, bro? People worked hard on that!
target: 兄弟，为什么把A面板扔了？大家可是辛辛苦苦做出来的！

source: Did they? I dunno. I always throw out Panel A. It's got bad vibes.
target: 是吗？不知道啊。我一直都把A面板扔掉，感觉它不太吉利。

source: Well, we wanted to test out the final product you guys are making. Do you have it?
target: 我们想试试你们生产的成品。你这儿有吗？

source: Final product? Which one? I make something different every time.
target: 成品？哪一个？我每次做的都不一样。

source: The designs come to me in dark prophetic visions!
target: 黑暗的预言幻象，会把设计送到我脑子里！

source: Okaaaay... well, there are two freshly-made final products here. Which one do you try out?
target: 好——吧……这儿有两件刚出炉的成品，你试哪件？

source: The Washing KarMachine
target: 洗业机

source: The huge, inefficient contraption that burns a lot of fuel to produce a tiny fortune
target: 烧掉大量燃料，却只产出一点小小“财运”的庞大低效装置

source: I don't get it. Does the machine, like, wash your karma?
target: 我不懂，这机器是能洗掉你的业力吗？

source: Yep!
target: 没错!

source: What does that even mean, though? Karma is lost and gained; it doesn't get washed. Karma doesn't get dirty... does it?
target: 可那是什么意思？业力有得有失，又不是拿来洗的。业力也不会变脏……会吗？

source: Of course it does! But this machine will wash those greasy, hateful impurities from your tarnished soul.
target: 当然会！这机器会洗掉污浊灵魂里那些油腻、可憎的杂质。

source: Okay, but soul and karma are different.
target: 可灵魂和业力不是一回事啊。

source: Yeah, but I liked the pun! It's all made-up concepts anyway, so who cares?
target: 对啊，可我喜欢这谐音梗！反正都是编出来的概念，谁管呢？

source: What do you mean? Are you saying souls and karma aren't real?
target: 什么意思？你是说灵魂和业力都不存在？

source: They can be real if you're willing to pay!
target: 只要你肯付钱，它们就能存在！

source: Put a coin in the Washing KarMachine, and I'll believe karma is the underwear of your soul or whatever you want. Who gives a shit?
target: 往洗业机里投个币，我就相信业力是灵魂的内裤，还是你想要的任何东西。谁他妈在乎？

source: But why would I pay for something that I know is a scam?
target: 可我明知道是骗局，为什么还要付钱？

source: For the same reason people devote themselves to priests and gurus and abstract deities: pure desperation for meaningful purpose in an uncaring universe!
target: 跟人们投身神父、导师和抽象神明怀抱的原因一样：宇宙对你漠不关心，你却拼了命，也想给自己找点意义！

source: ...Yeah, okay, can't argue with that. Here's -N2 MONEY.
target: ……行吧，这我没法反驳。给你-N2金钱。

source: Thanks! I'm going to remove your souls for the cleansing now. Noodley-doodley-doo!
target: 谢谢！现在，我要把你们的灵魂抽出来清洗了。面条嘟嘟嘟！

source: Noodles does some weird dance and makes some noises. He doesn't even turn on the KarMachine! What the fuck is going on?!
target: 面条跳了段怪舞，又发出些怪声。他连洗业机都没开！这他妈到底怎么回事？！

source: After a few minutes, he "gives back" your "cleansed souls." Hmm, you actually do feel like you gained +N2 SOUL! Real or placebo, who knows, who cares?
target: 几分钟后，他“归还”了你们“洗干净的灵魂”。嗯，你还真觉得获得了+N2灵魂！是真有用，还是心理作用？谁知道呢，谁管呢？

source: Okay! We just need magic to power the machine, and your fortunes will be manifested!
target: 好！只要用魔力驱动机器，你们的运势就会显现！

source: Are you sure it's a good idea to use magic on this? Like, isn't that an important thing we need to drive the car and--?
target: 把魔力用在这上面，真的好吗？那不是还要留着开车用，而且——？

source: TOO LATE TO CHANGE YOUR MIND! Away we go!
target: 现在反悔太迟啦！启动！

source: Noodles hits the machine with a giant hammer. It whirs to life, cranking gears and spewing smog and killing the ozone layer before your eyes.
target: 面条拿大锤砸向机器。齿轮轰然转动，浓烟喷涌而出，当着你的面破坏臭氧层。

source: At last, the gears stop, and from the machine's chassis, three fortunes are printed off.
target: 终于，齿轮停了，机器底座打印出三张运势签。

source: Mine says, "In the near-ish future, a thing with a degree of importance will happen and affect your day." Good to know!
target: 我的写着：“在不太遥远的将来，一件有一定重要性的事将会发生，影响你的一天。”了解了！

source: Mine says, "To achieve bliss, become soda." Wow, deep!
target: 我的写着：“想获得幸福，就变成汽水。”哇，好深刻！

source: Mine says, "An off-putting green jellyfish thing will scam you into losing -N2 MAGIC. You will gain +N2 MIND learning not to do it again."
target: 我的写着：“一只让人不舒服的绿色水母状生物，会骗走你-N2魔力。记住别再上当，你就能获得+N2头脑。”

source: Whoa, super accurate!
target: 哇，准得要命！

source: Seize the means of production
target: 夺取生产资料

source: You and your friends crash a union meeting. It seems all the factory workers have turned up to list some complaints to tell the factory boss.
target: 你和朋友们闯进了一场工会会议。全厂工人似乎都到了，正在列要跟老板提的意见。

source: "Let's tell the boss we won't work weekends anymore," says one worker. "I've missed so many good TV show premieres!"
target: 一名工人说：“告诉老板，我们再也不周末加班了！好剧开播，我都错过多少次了！”

source: "Let's demand better snacks in the vending machines!" says another. "I'm sick of off-brand potato chips and candy bars!"
target: 另一人说：“要求自动售货机换点好零食！杂牌薯片和糖果条，我都吃腻了！”

source: "Tell the boss man that we won't come back to work until my wife lets me get another cat!" says a third. "It's totally unfair that I can't have more cats!"
target: 第三个人说：“告诉老板，我老婆不答应再养只猫，我们就不回去上班！凭什么不让我多养猫，太不公平了！”

source: Ooh, I've got one! Tell that mean boss man you demand a raise of +2 milkbones an hour!
target: 哦，我也有！告诉那个坏老板，要求时薪加2块磨牙奶骨！

source: Tell the boss you're not working another minute until he gives you a six-month vacation, twice a year.
target: 告诉老板，不给你们每年两次、每次半年的假期，就一分钟也不干了。

source: With your demands decided, you all storm the boss' office. You break down the door... and find no one inside!
target: 列好诉求，你们一起冲向老板办公室，撞开门……里面没人！

source: "Whoa, where's the boss?" they ask. "Could it be that... we've never even HAD a boss?"
target: 他们问：“哇，老板呢？难道……我们从来就没有老板？”

source: "Does anyone remember even meeting him? Or did this factory just show up one day, and we assigned ourselves jobs and conditions because it seemed logical?"
target: “谁记得自己见过他吗？还是说，这工厂只是某天突然出现，我们觉得理应如此，就自己分配了岗位和工作条件？”

source: "If there's no boss, then I WANNA BE THE BOSS!" shouts a worker. "First rule is I make ALL the money, and anyone who bitches about it gets fired!"
target: 一个工人大喊：“没老板，那我要当老板！第一条，钱全归我，谁敢抱怨谁就滚蛋！”

source: Shit, now everyone's gonna wanna be the boss. And whoever becomes the boss will just be hated by everyone else and kicked out! It's a never-ending cycle!
target: 妈的，这下人人都想当老板了。可谁当上，都会被其他人讨厌，再赶出去！没完没了！

source: That sucks, but you don't work here, so maybe you should just let them handle it?
target: 是挺糟，不过你又不在这儿上班，要不让他们自己处理？

source: LOL JK CAN YOU IMAGINE. Of course you're gonna propose your own solution! Who should be the new boss?
target: 哈哈，逗你的，怎么可能。当然是你来提解决办法啦！谁该当新老板？

source: You need no bosses! Fuse the consciousnesses of all the factory workers into one being: Proletariat, the Working Class.
target: 不需要老板！把所有工人的意识融合成一个存在：无产者，工人阶级的化身。

source: This dog. What he lacks in business acumen, he makes up for in cuteness. Woof, woof!
target: 这只狗。商业头脑不够，可爱程度来凑。汪，汪！

source: Good idea! Karl Marx once said, "Workers of the world, unite!" This is obviously what he meant by that.
target: 好主意！卡尔·马克思说过：“全世界工人，联合起来！”他显然就是这个意思。

source: Yup, totally. You lose -N2 MAGIC performing a spell to connect all the workers' consciousnesses.
target: 没错，当然。你施法把所有工人的意识连在一起，失去了-N2魔力。

source: "Whoa," say all the workers in perfect unison. "What... what happened? Where are all my individual thoughts and feelings?"
target: 所有工人异口同声：“哇。发生……什么事了？我自己的想法和感受都去哪儿了？”

source: All gone! You won't miss them, will ya? They were probably already ground out of you by the mind-numbing assembly line work anyway.
target: 全没啦！你们也不会怀念吧？反正多半早被那麻木的流水线工作磨光了。

source: "Hey, good point," says Proletariat, the Working Class. "Wow, this is incredible! We were so divided, but now we are all one consciousness: the class consciousness!"
target: 工人阶级的化身——无产者——说：“嘿，有道理。哇，太不可思议了！以前我们四分五裂，现在却共享一个意识：阶级意识！”

source: "In this form, we can finally SEIZE THE MEANS OF PRODUCTION!"
target: “现在，我们终于可以夺取生产资料了！”

source: Cool!
target: 酷！

source: ...What are the means of production, exactly?
target: ……所以，生产资料到底是什么？

source: Whatever it is, Proletariat seizes it out of thin air, and uses their newfound powers to turn it into... a pair of kickass katanas!
target: 管它是什么，无产者凭空把它夺了过来，再用新力量将其变成……一对帅炸了的武士刀！

source: "Thank you for your help, friends! With our powerful unity and these dope swords, we can take down monopolies everywhere! Farewell!"
target: “朋友们，多谢帮助！有强大的团结，还有这些酷炫的刀，我们能打倒世上一切垄断势力！再会！”

source: Proletariat assembles themself into a huge communist mecha and leaves the factory.
target: 无产者把自身组装成一台巨大的共产主义机甲，离开工厂。

source: Wow... I wish them the best, but I also feel like class disparity is a bigger issue than can be solved with mecha battles between the Proletariat and monopolies, y'know?
target: 哇……祝好运吧。不过，阶级差距这么大的问题，真能靠无产者跟垄断集团打机甲大战解决吗？你懂我意思吧？

source: I don't know! At least the katanas were cool!
target: 我不懂！不过武士刀至少挺酷的！

source: The katanas were, indeed, so fucking cool. You gain +N2 SOUL for solving all the problems in the class system, no further questions!
target: 那对武士刀确实帅得他妈离谱。你解决了阶级制度的一切问题，获得了+N2灵魂，别问了！

source: Great idea, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! Dogs are monster's best friend, and they'd never betray us!
target: 好主意，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！狗是怪物最好的朋友，绝对不会背叛我们！

source: Yeah, I think dogs are the only non-corruptible creature left on Earth. A dog would make a great boss! I see no flaws in this plan whatsoever!
target: 对，狗大概是地球上仅存、无法被腐化的生物了。让狗当老板，肯定很棒！这计划我看不出半点毛病！

source: A few days later, your plan is in full effect! CUE THE THEME SONG!
target: 几天后，计划全面落实！主题曲起！

source: He calls the shots, he signs the checks! / He wags his tail and wants his pets! / Boss Dog! He's the boss who loves you!
target: 拍板是他，签支票也是他！摇摇尾巴，等你摸摸他！狗老板！他是爱你的老板！

source: Give him walks and give him praise! / You'll be sure to get a raise! / Boss Dog! He's the boss who loves you!
target: 遛遛他，夸夸他！升职加薪少不了啦！狗老板！他是爱你的老板！

source: If you want to be paid in treats / and lead your employer on a leash / call Boss Dog! He's the boss who loves yooooou!
target: 想领零食当工资，牵着老板散散步？快找狗老板！他是爱——你——的老板！

source: "WOOF, WOOF!"
On today's episode of "Boss Dog", the company accountant enters the boss' office. Boss Dog is scooting around the carpet on his butt. Canned laughter ensues.
target: 今天这集《狗老板》，公司会计走进办公室，狗老板正拿屁股蹭着地毯到处挪。罐头笑声随之响起。

source: "Hey, Boss Dog," says the accountant. "I was looking over this quarter's finances, and our profits are plummeting! We need to lay off at least a third of the staff."
target: 会计说：“嘿，狗老板，我看了本季度财报，利润暴跌！至少得裁掉三分之一的员工。”

source: The accountant hands Boss Dog the financial reports. Boss Dog chews them to bits! Oh, Boss Dog!
target: 会计递上财报，狗老板一口咬得粉碎！哎呀，狗老板！

source: "Well... okay, I guess we'll just ignore the problem for now," sighs the accountant. "Can't argue with the boss!"
target: 会计叹气：“好吧……那就暂时不管这个问题了。老板都发话了，还能说什么！”

source: Wow, this was a GREAT plan. Sure, the company loses -N2 MONEY, but look how cute Boss Dog is! He's got soft ears and +N2 SOUL!
target: 哇，真是个好计划。公司是亏了-N2金钱，可看看狗老板多可爱！耳朵软乎乎，还有+N2灵魂！

source: Find the best rave spot
target: 寻找最佳狂欢地点

source: You're all searching for the best spot to party when you're approached by three smiling spirits.
target: 你们正找哪里最适合狂欢，三个笑容满面的鬼魂迎了上来。

source: POLLY! You made it to the rave! I'm so glad you're here.
target: 波莉！你也来锐舞派对了！太高兴见到你了。

source: YASSS, it's great to see you!
target: 好耶，见到你们真开心！

source: Scott, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%: meet Summer, Macarena, and Cheese. They're the Ghosts of Parties Past, and oh boy, they know how to get down.
target: 斯科特，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，认识一下，Summer、Macarena和Cheese。他们是昔日派对之鬼，玩起来可带劲了。

source: You bet! It's our unfinished business to make sure you guys dance, drink plenty of water, and have a bitchin' time.
target: 那当然！让你们跳舞、多喝水、玩个痛快，就是我们未了的心愿。

source: That's awesome! We were just trying to find a good spot to party.
target: 太棒了！我们正找个好位置狂欢呢。

source: Finding the perfect spot is sooo important... you gotta find that middle ground in the party where it's not... like... overcrowded, but... you're also not dancing alone... y'know?
target: 找个完美位置……特别重要。得找个刚刚好的地方，不能……挤得要命，可也不能……只剩你自己跳……你懂吧？

source: You also want to be close to the bar to order drinks. But not SO close you're standing in beer and piss all night.
target: 还得离吧台近点，方便点酒。可也别太近，免得一整晚都踩在啤酒和尿里。

source: Also consider proximity to the DJ. Not so close you mingle with the lame DJ groupies, but close enough to get the coveted "DJ nod of acknowledgement."
target: 还有跟DJ的距离。太近会混进那群无聊的DJ迷妹迷弟里，但又得近到能收到那个梦寐以求的“DJ认可的点头”。

source: Ahhhh... the DJ nod of acknowledgement... it's like, "you really get the vibe, great job."
target: 啊……DJ认可的点头……就像在说：“你懂这氛围，干得好。”

source: It'll probably take 30-60 minutes to find the sweet spot. But don't worry, it'll be worth it when we're partying in that spot for the next 72 hours straight.
target: 找到黄金位置，估计得花30到60分钟。不过别担心，咱们要在那儿连嗨72小时，绝对值。

source: Okay, I'm ready to take this journey! What about this spot next to us? Is it a good place to start?
target: 好，我准备踏上这段旅程了！先看旁边这儿怎么样？适合作为起点吗？

source: The Ghosts of Parties Past examine the spot with some rulers, levels, and barometers, making calculations.
target: 昔日派对之鬼掏出尺子、水平仪和气压计，仔细勘测这块地方，开始计算。

source: Holy shit... this is it! IT'S THE PERFECT SPOT!
target: 我操……就是这儿！完美位置！

source: It's like... the perfectest of the perfect spots. Gimme a hug, puppy boy... you're the bestest.
target: 这简直是……完美位置里最完美的。抱一下，小狗狗……你最棒了。

source: Scott beams and wags his tail. Then, suddenly, he clutches his stomach.
target: 斯科特笑得灿烂，尾巴直摇。可他突然捂住了肚子。

source: Oof... I'm sorry guys, I got so excited about the spot that it made me have to pee!
target: 唉……抱歉，伙计们，这位置太好了，我一激动就想尿尿！

source: No worries, buddy! Want me to take you to the port-o-potties so you don't get lost?
target: 没事，哥们！要不要我带你去移动厕所，免得走丢？

source: Nah, I can do it alone. I've got a good sense of direction. You guys enjoy the perfect spot, I'll be right back!
target: 不用，我自己行，方向感好着呢。你们先享受完美位置，我马上回来！

source: Scott leaves, and you party hard. You party so hard, an hour has passed before you realize he still isn't back. Shit, should you try to go find him?
target: 斯科特走了，你们继续猛嗨。嗨得太投入，一个小时后，你才发现他还没回来。妈的，要不要去找找？

source: Rookie mistake, my dude. If you leave this spot, there's almost no chance you'll find it again.
target: 这就新手了，哥们。你离开这个位置，就基本别想再找回来。

source: We can't just leave him, though! Surely you can come up with a creative solution to find Scott, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?
target: 可也不能丢下他不管啊！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你肯定能想出个有创意的办法，找到斯科特吧？

source: Start a conga line in the Perfect Spot and dance your way into finding Scott. You can later trace your way back to the conga line's origin point.
target: 在完美位置发起康加接龙舞，一路跳着去找斯科特。之后还能顺着队伍，回到起点。

source: Hire Wyatt Solomon, hard-boiled party detective.
target: 雇怀亚特·所罗门，硬汉派对侦探。

source: That sounds insane... so insane it just might work! Go on, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! Shake what yo momma gave you!
target: 听着真疯……疯到没准能成！上吧，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，把你那天生的翘臀扭起来！

source: It's a big risk, being the leader of the conga line. What if you start to conga and no one joins in and you're a sad one-monster-conga line with no friends?
target: 领跳康加舞，风险可不小。万一你跳起来没人跟，就成了一条没朋友、孤零零、只有一只怪物的接龙舞队伍，得多惨？

source: But you throw yourself into it, bravely shaking your booty and dancing forward...
target: 可你还是全情投入，勇敢地扭着屁股，向前跳去……

source: AND A DRUNK STRANGER GRABS YOUR SHOULDERS AND JOINS IN! WOOHOO!
target: 一个醉醺醺的陌生人搭住你的肩膀，加入了进来！呜呼！

source: More people join your party centipede. The conga is impossible to resist, like a drunken partygoer black hole!
target: 越来越多人加入这条派对蜈蚣。康加舞根本无法抗拒，像个专吸醉汉的派对黑洞！

source: Don't worry, we'll make sure the end of the conga line is still in this spot when you come back. Godspeed, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!
target: 放心，你回来的时候，我们会保证队尾还在这儿。加油，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！

source: You shake your groove thang and conga across the rave.
target: 你扭着身体，领着康加舞队伍穿过整场派对。

source: As your line grows, so does your responsibility to lead it. This much conga takes -N2 STAMINA from your body.
target: 队伍越来越长，领队的责任也越来越重。跳了这么久，你失去了-N2体力。

source: Finally, you spot Scott at a food truck buying fries! You grab him!
target: 终于，你发现斯科特正在餐车前买薯条！你一把抓住他！

source: Hey, bro! Nice conga line! Should I join?
target: 嘿，哥们！这接龙舞不错啊，要我加入吗？

source: THERE'S NO TIME! You have to return to your spot; your conga pilgrimage is almost at its end!
target: 没时间了！得赶紧回去，你的康加朝圣就快走到终点了！

source: You turn to the dancer behind you and tell him you now bestow the great responsibility of being the conga leader unto him.
target: 你转向身后的舞者，告诉他，现在要把领跳康加舞的重任交给他。

source: With all the gravitas of a young prince taking up the mantle of king, he promises that the fate of the conga line will be safe in his funky feet.
target: 他郑重得如同年轻王子继承王位，保证会用自己灵活的舞步，守护好整条队伍的命运。

source: Yay, you're back! You were a masterful conga leader, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. It took everything in me not to join in!
target: 耶，回来了！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你领跳得太棒了，我拼命忍住才没加入！

source: The Ghosts of Parties Past bestow the title of "Party MVP" upon you. YAS! You also gain +N2 SOUL for finding Scott.
target: 昔日派对之鬼授予你“派对MVP”的称号。好耶！找到斯科特，还让你获得了+N2灵魂。

source: That's perfect! Wyatt Solomon could crack this case easy-peasy!
target: 太好了！这案子交给怀亚特·所罗门，肯定轻松拿下！

source: Whoa, I've never heard of this guy. What is this obscure party lore I've yet to hear about?
target: 哇，从没听过这人。派对圈还有什么冷门传说，是我不知道的？

source: Polly, my dude: Detective Solomon is the SHIT. He can reconstruct blurry nights at the club; he can track down your missing friends after a wild bachelor party...
target: 波莉，哥们，所罗门侦探可太牛逼了。他能还原你在夜店喝断片的那一晚，也能找回单身派对狂欢后失踪的朋友……

source: He even found my missing keys... after a week-long bender! They were... like... in my butt pocket all along... plot twist!
target: 他甚至帮我找回了丢掉的钥匙……那次我连着疯喝了一星期！结果……一直在屁股后面的口袋里……惊天反转！

source: Gosh... I hope someday I'm reincarnated into... one of his cigars... so I can... give that man a kiss on the lips...
target: 天哪……希望有一天，我能转世成……他的一支雪茄……这样就能……亲亲他的嘴唇……

source: You wire -N2 MONEY to Wyatt Solomon's undisclosed bank account and wait for him to find Scott. And by wait, I mean you dance your ass off.
target: 你往怀亚特·所罗门的秘密账户汇了-N2金钱，等他找回斯科特。这里说的“等”，就是跳舞跳到疯。

source: Detective Wyatt Solomon arrives at the scene with a pessimistic blues soundtrack and dramatic voice-over narration.
target: 怀亚特·所罗门侦探来到现场，自带悲观的布鲁斯配乐和戏剧感十足的独白旁白。

source: "I was smoking a Cuban and drinking a whiskey on the rocks (my usual vices, after I lost my wife) as I hunted down the elusive werewolf."
target: “我抽着古巴雪茄，喝着加冰威士忌——失去妻子后，留下的老毛病——追踪那个行踪难觅的狼人。”

source: "I started at the port-o-potties and followed a trail of shedded fur and discarded toilet paper to the food truck."
target: “我从移动厕所开始，沿着掉落的毛和丢弃的厕纸，一路追到餐车。”

source: "There stood my quarry, ordering chili fries. He was happy; young; naive. I couldn't help it; the kid warmed my heart."
target: “目标就站在那里，点着辣肉酱薯条。快乐，年轻，天真。我控制不住，这孩子让我心头一暖。”

source: "Just when I'm ready to quit this job, life gives me a reason to party on."
target: “每当我准备退出这行，生活总会给我一个继续狂欢的理由。”

source: Bros, I'm back! Your detective friend found me. I got hungry and went to buy food, and -- plot twist -- I ran into Liam!
target: 兄弟们，我回来啦！你们的侦探朋友找到我了。我饿了，就去买吃的，然后——惊天反转——我碰见李姆了！

source: LIAM?! As in, our friend from school Liam? Where is he?!
target: 李姆？！咱们学校那个朋友李姆？人在哪儿？！

source: Scott points to the confused stranger next to him.
target: 斯科特指了指身边一脸困惑的陌生人。

source: I keep telling you, I'm not Liam!. My name is Orrin!
target: 我都说了多少遍了，我不是李姆！我叫奥林！

source: Are you sure? You're wearing glasses like Liam, and you complain a lot like him too.
target: 你确定？你戴眼镜，跟李姆一样。抱怨起来也挺像他。

source: Today, my friend, your name will be Liam. Party with us!
target: 朋友，今天你就叫李姆吧。一起嗨！

source: You end up having a hell of a party with Polly, Scott, the ghosts, Wyatt Solomon, and even "Liam." You also gain +N2 SOUL for finding your friend!
target: 最后，你跟波莉、斯科特、鬼魂们、怀亚特·所罗门，甚至“李姆”，痛痛快快嗨了一场。找到朋友，还让你获得了+N2灵魂！

source: Try to get some drinks
target: 想办法点酒

source: As you and your friends approach the bar, three happy-go-lucky party spirits approach you!
target: 你们走近吧台，三个无忧无虑的派对鬼魂迎了上来！

source: Polly, you magnificent bitch! I didn't know you were coming to this rave!
target: 波莉，你这迷人的贱人！不知道你也要来这场锐舞派对！

source: OMGEEE! HI!
target: 天哪——！嗨！

source: Scott, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%: meet Summer, Macarena, and Cheese. They're the Ghosts of Parties Past!
target: 斯科特，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，认识一下Summer、Macarena和Cheese。他们是昔日派对之鬼！

source: Sup, my dudes? Any friend of Polly's is a friend of ours.
target: 嗨，伙计们！波莉的朋友，就是我们的朋友。

source: Whoa... your fur is so... furry. Can I... pet it?
target: 哇……你的毛……好毛茸茸啊。我能……摸摸吗？

source: Go ahead!
target: 摸吧！

source: Let's go to the bar! The first round is on us.
target: 走，去吧台！第一轮我们请。

source: You approach the bar. Macarena slides down her sunglasses, gives the bartender A Look, and does some weird hand gestures.
target: 你们来到吧台。Macarena往下拉了拉墨镜，给酒保递了个眼神，又比划了几个奇怪的手势。

source: "Ah!" the bartender says. "A tequila moonrise, three water bottles, a tall glass of vodka, and a sex on the beach in a pewter mug with a crazy straw, coming right up!"
target: 酒保说：“啊！龙舌兰月出，三瓶水，一高杯伏特加，还有一杯用锡杯装、配花式吸管的‘海滩性爱’，马上好！”

source: Wow! You try to order, but the bartender completely misses you and helps someone else. Too bad you don't know BSL (Bartender Sign Language).
target: 哇！你也想点酒，可酒保完全没注意到你，转头招呼别人去了。可惜你不懂BSL，也就是酒保手语。

source: Don't feel bad, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%; summoning the bartender takes a lot of practice. We'll wait for you and Scott to get your drinks.
target: 别难过，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。召唤酒保得多练练。我们等你和斯科特点好酒。

source: Listen... the DJ's playing my favorite song!
target: 听……DJ放我最喜欢的歌了！

source: Ahhh... if I get reincarnated one day... I hope I'm reborn as this song... such a bop.
target: 啊……要是有天能投胎……希望我能变成这首歌……太好听了。

source: You said it, my tiny dude. Vibing to this song is 100% my unfinished business!
target: 说得对，小伙伴。跟着这歌嗨，就是我百分之百放不下的执念！

source: Hey, if you guys really wanna go dance, we can find you after we get our drinks. It's okay.
target: 嘿，你们想跳舞就先去吧，我们拿了喝的再去找你们。没事的。

source: Really? Thanks, Scott! You're the best!
target: 真的？谢谢，斯科特！你最棒了！

source: Let's get some drinks, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! Mr. Bartender, can you please serve us? But, like, when you have the time? No pressure!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，咱们点酒吧！酒保先生，能麻烦您招呼一下我们吗？当然，您有空再来就好，不着急！

source: Ugh, your shyness and Scott's politeness isn't gonna get you drunk any faster. You need to go big if you wanna get the bartender's attention!
target: 唉，你的害羞加上斯科特的客气，可不会让你们更快喝上酒。想引起酒保的注意，得来点大的！

source: Desperate times call for desperate measures. Use your wish number %NEXTPAWWISHNUMBER% from the monkey's paw to ask for the most flamboyant hairdo ever so you are unignorable!
target: 特殊情况，特殊手段。用掉猴爪的第%NEXTPAWWISHNUMBER%个愿望，给自己整一个史上最张扬的发型，让人想忽略都难！

source: Disguise yourself as the waiter's long-lost sibling, then ask him for a reunion drink.
target: 假扮酒保失散多年的手足，让他请你喝杯重逢酒。

source: Ah, the monkey's paw. You remember buying it from the weird old man who only spoke in cryptic, vaguely-threatening sentences.
target: 啊，猴爪。你还记得，是从一个怪老头那儿买的。他说话总是神神秘秘，隐约带点威胁。

source: This paw comes with immense power. You can use it to wish for whatever you can imagine. But beware... your wishes may come true... hahaha!
target: 这只爪子拥有无穷力量。你想得到的，都能拿来许愿。不过小心……你的愿望，也许真会实现……哈哈哈！

source: Which is good, right? Wishes coming true is the endgame of any wish you could ask for.
target: 那不是好事吗？许愿不就是为了成真？

source: Enjoy your paw; but remember, the wishes are limited, and most importantly: there's no coming back from whatever you may wish for... hahaha!
target: 享受这猴爪吧。不过记住，愿望次数有限，更重要的是：不管许了什么，都没法反悔……哈哈哈！

source: The old man really had a low bar for "things that made him laugh," but okay. Limited wishes; only rule is not wishing your past wishes to be unwished; easy.
target: 老头觉得“好笑”的门槛也太低了，不过行吧。次数有限，唯一规矩是不能撤销之前的愿望。简单。

source: You tucked the paw in your pocket and promised yourself that you'd save it for a REAL emergency...
target: 你把猴爪揣进口袋，答应自己，一定要留到真正紧急的时候再用……

source: And that emergency is finally here! You use -N2 MAGIC on your wish, and...
target: 而紧急时刻终于到了！你花了-N2魔力许愿，然后……

source: Whoa! %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, did you do something new with your hair? It's so flamboyant and impossible to look away from!
target: 哇，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你换发型了？也太张扬了，眼睛根本挪不开！

source: Yup! Thanks to the monkey's paw, you have a new obnoxious 'do. The bartender can't possibly miss you now!
target: 没错！多亏猴爪，你有了个嚣张的新发型。这下酒保绝对不可能忽视你！

source: But you could've wished for ANYTHING, right? Why didn't you just wish for drinks for us? Or for infinite free drinks, for that matter?
target: 可你什么都能许，对吧？那为什么不直接许愿，给我们来点酒？或者干脆，永远免费、想喝多少喝多少？

source: You shush him. Silly Scott; he can't comprehend the nuances of wishing on a monkey's paw!
target: 你赶紧让他嘘声。傻斯科特，根本不懂猴爪许愿的精妙之处！

source: Let's be clear: your hair is SPECTACULAR. The colors, the volume, the overpowering odor; it's a full mood, the ultimate vibe, a memory to cherish!
target: 先说清楚，这发型简直绝了。颜色、发量，还有那扑面而来的气味，全是态度、全是氛围，值得一辈子铭记！

source: Forget about the likely severe cursed consequences of using the monkey's paw and just embrace the 'do!
target: 别想猴爪可能招来的严重诅咒后果了，享受新发型就好！

source: The bartender serves you your drinks, if only to get away from your sensory-overloading hair. You gain +N2 STAMINA and return to your friends.
target: 哪怕只是为了赶紧远离你那让感官过载的头发，酒保也给你们上了酒。你获得了+N2体力，回去找朋友们。

source: ...%HESHE% used the monkey's paw, didn't %HESHE%?
target: ……%HESHE%用了猴爪，是不是？%HESHE%肯定用了吧？

source: Nice, disguise time! The bartender is rocking a cool, natural white hairstyle. #50IsTheNew30!
target: 好，变装时间！酒保顶着一头天然白发，相当酷。#五十才是新三十！

source: You need to improvise with what you've got, so you put a mop on your head. It might work!
target: 手头有什么就用什么，你把拖把顶到了头上。说不定能成！

source: The bartender is super busy, but as soon as you reach the counter, he stops and stares at you. "Joebert?" he gasps. "Is... is it really you?!"
target: 酒保忙得团团转，可你刚到吧台，他就停下，盯着你，倒吸一口气：“乔伯特？真……真的是你吗？！”

source: Uh... sure?
target: 呃……算是？

source: "Un-fucking-believable!" he cries. "My long-lost twin, finally returned! I've missed you!"
target: 他喊道：“真他妈不敢相信！我失散多年的双胞胎，终于回来了！我好想你！”

source: I have no idea what's going on. Can you give me some exposition here, bartender?
target: 完全搞不懂。酒保，你能给我补补这段剧情吗？

source: "Sure! Thirty years ago, Joebert and I we were waiting for drinks at the bar, at a rave much like this one."
target: “当然！三十年前，我和乔伯特，也是在一场差不多这样的锐舞派对上，等吧台上酒。”

source: "Joebert hadn't been served yet, but the DJ started playing my favorite song, and I couldn't resist going to dance! Joebert promised to find me later."
target: “乔伯特还没拿到酒，DJ却放起我最喜欢的歌，我实在忍不住，就去跳舞了！乔伯特答应之后会来找我。”

target: “可他没来。我找遍了整个场地，也没找到。从那以后，再没见过他。”

source: Oh no! What a tragic-but-unavoidable twist!
target: 天哪！真是个悲惨却无法避免的转折！

source: "Indeed. I became a bartender just hoping to see him once again, and now that day has come! Joebert, old pal, let's have a drink on me!"
target: “是啊。我当酒保，就是盼着能再见他一面，今天终于等到了！乔伯特，老伙计，来喝一杯，我请！”

source: He starts pouring you a drink, but then someone with remarkably mop-like white hair walks up next to you.
target: 他开始给你倒酒，这时，一个白发像极了拖把的人走到你身边。

source: "Johnbert?!" he gasps. "It's me, Joebert! Your long-lost twin!"
target: 那人惊呼：“约翰伯特？！是我啊，乔伯特！你失散多年的双胞胎！”

source: "YOU'RE Joebert?!" Johnbert says. He looks at you. "But then... who are you?"
target: 约翰伯特说：“你才是乔伯特？！”他看向你，“那……你是谁？”

source: I'm... uh... your long-lost triplet... Jackbert?
target: 我……呃……是你们失散多年的三胞胎……杰克伯特？

source: "...OF COURSE!" cries Johnbert. "That totally checks!" says Joebert.
target: 约翰伯特大喊：“……当然！”乔伯特说：“完全说得通！”

source: "Wow, what an emotional day! Joebert, Jackbert, let's toast! To old reunions, and new family!"
target: “哇，今天太感人了！乔伯特、杰克伯特，干杯！敬重逢的故人，也敬新来的家人！”

source: You finally reunited with your "long-lost triplets." You lose -N2 SOUL for lying to them, but gain +N2 STAMINA!
target: 你终于跟“失散多年的三胞胎”团聚了。撒谎让你失去了-N2灵魂，不过你获得了+N2体力！

source: You do shots with your "long-lost triplets." You lose -N2 SOUL for lying to them, but gain +N2 STAMINA from good shots!
target: 你跟“失散多年的三胞胎”一起干了几杯烈酒。撒谎让你失去了-N2灵魂，不过好酒也让你获得了+N2体力！

source: Party 24/7
target: 全天候狂欢

target: 爽啊，派——对——时间到！你正琢磨在哪儿跳个痛快，三个笑容满面的鬼魂飘了过来。

source: Holy shit, is that Polly? Good to see you! Welcome to the rave!
target: 我操，这不是波莉吗？见到你真好！欢迎来锐舞派对！

source: OMG, hey!
target: 天哪，嗨！
