target: 斯科特，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，认识一下我的蹦迪搭子：Summer、Macarena和Cheese。他们是昔日派对之鬼！

source: Awww... Scott and %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%...? Polly talks about you all the time... it's so nice... she really loves you guys... gosh... Polly is the best...
target: 哎呀……斯科特和%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%……？波莉总提起你们……真好……她真的很爱你们……天哪……波莉最棒了……

source: She is! How is everything, gurl? Are you liking the party so far?
target: 没错！姐妹，最近怎么样？派对玩得开心吗？

source: Yeah, it's awesome! We were just deciding which DJ set to listen to first.
target: 开心，棒极了！我们正选先听哪个DJ的演出呢。

source: That's a big question! Macarena, Summer, and I got that shit down to a science.
target: 这可是个大问题！我、Macarena和Summer，早把这事研究成一门科学了。

source: We put together a DJ schedule. We'll rotate methodically throughout the sets so that we're always changing and curating our vibes.
target: 我们排了张DJ时间表，有计划地穿梭各场演出，随时更换、精心调整自己的氛围。

source: Vibing is... like... the best.
target: 沉浸在氛围里……就是……最棒的。

source: We even scheduled visits to the bar and the bathroom, even though we don't actually have to use the bathroom anymore. It's part of the vibes!
target: 连去吧台、上厕所都排好了，虽然我们早就不需要上厕所了。可这也是氛围的一部分嘛！

source: Of course, in like an hour we're gonna be too blitzed to actually follow our schedule, and we'll probably just wind up wherever feels right.
target: 当然，差不多再过一个小时，我们就会嗨到根本没法照着表走，最后多半是哪儿舒服就待哪儿。

source: RELATABLE.
target: 懂，太懂了。

source: Which DJ are you scheduled to listen to now?
target: 那按计划，你们现在该听哪个DJ？

source: Well, we just finished our scheduled "mingle with other ravers" time... so we're actually ahead of schedule!
target: 刚刚完成了“跟其他舞客交际”的安排……所以我们其实提前啦！

source: Cool! So we have an opening, don't we?
target: 酷！那就空出一段时间了，对吧？

source: We could... like... get high again...
target: 可以……再嗨一轮……

source: We could... like... do some more ecstasy...
target: 可以……再来点摇头丸……

source: We can do that AND hit another set! Do you guys have any preference for who we listen to next?
target: 一边嗨一边听下一场也行啊！你们想听谁？

source: HypnoD&J, the robo-warlock trance DJs who will put a spell on you. Surrender to the groove!
target: 催眠D&J，那对机器人术士DJ，放的迷幻电音真能让你中咒。向节奏投降吧！

source: "Dead/Mouse", a skillful French mouse that controls a funky corpse by pulling its hair to create the most frantic DJ set in town.
target: “尸/鼠”，一只技艺高超的法国老鼠，靠扯头发操控一具律动十足的尸体，打造全城最疯狂的DJ演出。

source: Awww... yes... I love the brain tickles...
target: 啊……好啊……我喜欢脑子痒痒的感觉……

source: Summer's right, this is a great choice! HypnoD&J can REALLY bring an audience together, if you know what I mean.
target: Summer说得对，选得好！催眠D&J真能让观众融为一体，懂我意思吧。

source: You don't, but you're sure you're about to find out. You join the rave crowd.
target: 你不懂，不过马上就会知道了。你挤进狂欢的人群。

source: Air horns blare over the speakers, and a droning voice that says, "ALL HAIL HYPNOD&J!" As soon as the beat drops, you start to feel ticklish.
target: 扬声器传出气喇叭的轰鸣，还有一个嗡嗡作响的声音：“赞美催眠D&J！”节拍一落，你就开始觉得痒痒的。

source: Whoa, this is... something. Am I the only one who feels like my brain's melting out of my ears?
target: 哇，这可真……只有我觉得脑子要化了，顺着耳朵流出来吗？

source: Nah, my dude. This is what HypnoD&J is all about: inducing a true trance that brings the audience together.
target: 不，哥们。催眠D&J玩的就是这个：让观众进入真正的出神状态，彼此融为一体。

source: Don't resist it; embrace the music!
target: 别抵抗，拥抱音乐！

source: Your brain merges with the rest of the crowd, all your thoughts commingling into one being. You can hear what everyone's thinking!
target: 你的脑子跟其他人融合，所有思绪混成一个存在。现在，每个人在想什么，你都能听见！

source: (God, I can't believe this is my afterlife! How fuckin' lucky am I?)
target: （天哪，不敢相信这就是我的死后生活！我他妈也太幸运了吧？）

source: (Brain tickles... heehee... wheeeeeee...)
target: （脑子痒痒……嘻嘻……呜——）

source: (This set is legit! And the best part is, I'm pretty sure once it finishes, we won't be behind on the DJ schedule. Perfect planning!)
target: （这场太棒了！最好的是，听完这场，我们应该也不会耽误DJ时间表。计划完美！）

source: (*TV STATIC SOUNDS*)
target: （*电视雪花噪音*）

source: You surrender to the rave-mind, but lose -N2 MIND. But you also gain +N2 MAGIC!
target: 你融入锐舞集体意识，失去了-N2头脑，不过也获得了+N2魔力！

source: Excellent choice! Dead/Mouse is the hottest DJ in Europe right now. They've got a great rags-to-riches story, too.
target: 选得好！尸/鼠是现在欧洲最火的DJ，还有个从一穷二白到功成名就的传奇故事。

source: The duo got started as a gourmet chef in Paris, with the mouse controlling the chef's movements by pulling on his hair.
target: 这对搭档最初在巴黎当大厨，老鼠拽着厨师的头发，控制他的动作。

source: Ooh, I think I've heard this story before!
target: 哦，这故事我好像听过！

source: But... there was like a twist... the chef died... so sad... how everything eventually dies...
target: 不过……有个转折……厨师死了……好难过……万物终究都会死……

source: But Mouse wasn't ready for his career to be over! He knew he couldn't keep the corpse employed as a chef, though -- too unsanitary.
target: 可老鼠不甘心事业就此结束！它也知道，尸体不能再当厨师，太不卫生了。

source: So they became a DJ duo... 'cause... you know... DJing is like... cooking with sound and vibes...
target: 所以他们成了DJ二人组……因为……你懂吧……打碟就像……拿声音和氛围做菜……

source: So nice... everything is eventually reborn...
target: 真好……万物终究都会重生……

source: Well, weird backstory aside, Dead/Mouse turns out to be an amazing DJ, playing remixed bops from the 00s.
target: 怪异的背景故事先不提，尸/鼠的表演确实惊艳，放的全是零零年代热歌的混音版。

source: This set is incredible!
target: 这场也太棒了！

source: Isn't it great? By pulling on a corpse's hair, Dead/Mouse pulls on the heartstrings of nostalgia.
target: 是不是？尸/鼠扯着尸体的头发，也牵动了大家怀旧的心弦。

source: Awww... remember having functional heartstrings... haha...
target: 啊……还记得心弦能正常运作的时候吗……哈哈……

source: I hope wherever my corpse is... it's being controlled by a rodent...
target: 希望不管我的尸体现在在哪儿……都有只啮齿动物在操控它……

source: Haha, I hope mine is too!
target: 哈哈，我也希望我的尸体这样！

source: You gain +N2 HYPE raving like you're a kid again. Except you're not a kid, and raving is hard on your aging joints. You lose -N2 STAMINA.
target: 你像重回童年般尽情狂欢，获得了+N2热度。不过你早不是孩子了，蹦迪让老化的关节吃不消，也失去了-N2体力。

source: The oasis of a 1,000 Scotts
target: 一千个斯科特的绿洲

source: You and your friends check out the mirage. It's full of gorgeous oases, flying pigs, unproblematic Tweeter feeds, and other things that will never exist.
target: 你和朋友们逛起了海市蜃楼。里面满是美丽的绿洲、会飞的猪、不惹争议的Tweeter动态，以及其他根本不可能存在的东西。

source: Polly, I'm thirsty. Can I get a drink out of that puddle over there?
target: 波莉，我渴了。能去那边的水洼喝点水吗？

source: I mean, you don't need MY permission. But I have to warn you that I don't think that puddle's actually real.
target: 你不用征求我同意。不过先提醒一句，我觉得那水洼不是真的。

source: If I can see it, that means it's real! Besides, I feel like I'm DRAWN to this puddle. It's almost as if it were made for Scott specifically!
target: 看得见，就说明是真的！再说，那水洼好像在吸引我，简直像专门为斯科特准备的！

source: Okay, whatever that means. You wander over to the puddle to indulge Scott... and come across something BUCK FUCKING WILD.
target: 行吧，虽然不知道这话什么意思。为了顺着斯科特，你们走向水洼……结果撞见了件离谱到家的事。

source: Holy shit. This place is CRAWLING with Scotts! How is this even happening?!
target: 我操，这地方到处都是斯科特！怎么回事？！

source: Welcome to the Dark Side, Scott! Let's say cuss words and pee on fire hydrants that aren't ours!
target: 欢迎来到黑暗面，斯科特！咱们说脏话，再去别人的消防栓上撒尿吧！

source: Oh, sure! I mean, I do both of those things every once in a while anyway.
target: 哦，好啊！反正这两件事，我偶尔也会干。

source: You do? Is it possible that... YOU were the Dark Side Scott all along?!
target: 你也干？难道……你才是一直藏在身边的黑暗面斯科特？！

source: It's nice to meet you, dudes! I'm Chaz!
target: 伙计们，很高兴认识你们！我叫查兹！

source: Hi Chaz! Dang, bro, you sure look distinct from me while somehow still being the same genre of good boy as me.
target: 嗨，查兹！兄弟，你长得明明跟我很不一样，却又跟我是同一款乖狗狗，真神奇。

target: 可不是嘛，哥们。我正给其他斯科特做华夫饼呢，来一块？

target: 好啊！不过先问个问题。那边那个斯科特，什么情况？

target: 啊，非走不可吗？在这儿我好受欢迎！终于找到同类了！

source: Me? Wise? That's a lot of pressure! %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, can you help me decide who to talk to?

target: 你真酷，兄弟！怎么把身体变成这样的？

source: ARE YOU ASKING HOW I ACHIEVED MY PERFECT METAPHYSICAL FORM OF LIGHT AND RATIONAL THOUGHT?
target: 你是在问，我如何达成这由光与理性思维构成的、完美的形而上之躯？

source: Uh... I think so?
target: 呃……应该是吧？

source: BY DOING ONE MILLION PUSH-UPS IN ONE REP.
target: 做一百万个俯卧撑。只用一次动作。

source: NICE!
target: 不错!

source: Wait, you say you constructed your body from rational thought? Does that mean you're, like... smart?
target: 等等，你说身体是理性思维构成的？那就是说……你很聪明？

source: I AM AS SMART AS THE UNIVERSAL "LAW OF SCOTTS" CAN ALLOW.
target: 我的智慧，已达到宇宙“斯科特定律”允许的极限。

source: I CAN PREDICT THE EXACT OUTCOME OF ALL PRANKS. I CAN PINPOINT THE PRECISE COORDINATES OF EVERY BONE I'VE EVER BURIED.
target: 我能预知一切恶作剧的准确结果，也能定位自己埋过的每根骨头的精确坐标。

source: HOWEVER, I DO OCCASIONALLY FORGET THAT I CANNOT CONSUME CHOCOLATE WITHOUT EXPERIENCING ADVERSE EFFECTS. SUCH IS MY BURDEN.
target: 不过，我偶尔还是会忘记，吃巧克力会对自己造成不良影响。这就是我的宿命。

source: If you're all-knowing, can you answer a question for me?
target: 既然你无所不知，能回答我一个问题吗？

source: INDUBITABLY, BRO.
target: 毫无疑问，兄弟。

source: How can I be a better good boy?
target: 我怎么才能当一只更乖的狗狗？

source: I POSSESS TOTAL TRUTH OF EVERYTHING, AND IN KNOWING EVERYTHING, I CAN ANSWER THIS QUESTION WITH CONFIDENCE:
target: 我掌握万物的全部真理。正因为知道一切，我可以自信地回答：

source: YOU ARE ALREADY THE BEST GOOD BOY.
target: 你已经是最乖的狗狗了。

source: Aww, shucks! We're BOTH the best good boys, bro. High five!
target: 哎呀，怪不好意思的！咱俩都是最乖的狗狗，兄弟。击掌！

source: Oh, wait, can you high-five without arms?
target: 哦，等等，没胳膊也能击掌吗？

source: I HAVE EVOLVED BEYOND THE NEED FOR ARMS. LET US HIGH-FIVE WITH OUR SOULS.
target: 我已进化到不再需要双臂。让我们用灵魂击掌。

source: You're surrounded by light as Scott and Omnipotent Cube of Pure Energy Scott high-five their souls on a higher evolutionary level. You gain +N2 MAGIC!
target: 斯科特和纯能量全能立方体斯科特，在更高的进化层次上用灵魂击了掌。光芒将你包围，你获得了+N2魔力！

source: Scott in a revealing maid outfit AND carrying a tray of snacks? How is this even a contest?!
target: 斯科特穿着暴露的女仆装，手里还端着零食？这还用选？！

source: AWOOOOUWU! Nya-t's up, bros? Do you want some dewicious ice cweam?
target: 嗷呜喵～兄弟们好呀！要不要来点好次的冰淇淋？

source: Thanks for the yummy snacks, bro! Where'd you learn the recipe?
target: 谢啦，兄弟，零食真好吃！配方在哪儿学的？

source: From my maid café, "Kawaii Wolf"! The salmon sorbet is our most bewoved wecipe ;3
target: 窝的女仆咖啡馆“卡哇伊狼”呀！三文鱼雪葩是窝们最受欢迎的配方 ;3

source: Whoa, you own a restaurant? Congrats, bro!
target: 哇，你开餐厅了？恭喜啊，兄弟！

source: Teehee, thanks! In my wealm, evwyone runs their own food joint, and evwyone competes to be DA BEST FOOD JOINT EVA!! >:3
target: 嘻嘻，谢谢！在窝的世界里，大家都有自己的餐馆，人人都想当史上最棒的餐馆！>:3

source: Catgirl Aawavi and Catboy Cawcuwester run a food truck; Catboy Liam and I have our café; Powwy opened her own toiwet winery...
target: 猫娘阿拉维和猫郎计算斯基开餐车；猫郎李姆跟窝开咖啡馆；波莉开了自己的马桶酒庄……

source: Wait, why am I not a catgirl in this alternate reality? What did I do to get left out of the gimmick?!
target: 等等，这个平行世界里，我为什么不是猫娘？我干什么了，连这个设定都不带我玩？！

source: Forget that! Is Catboy Scott saying he runs a café? Like, an ACTUAL café? He's not, just, like, a weirdly-detailed mirage?
target: 先别管那个！猫郎斯科特说他开咖啡馆？真正的咖啡馆？所以他不是什么细节异常丰富的海市蜃楼？

source: Of course nya-t! OwO, what's this? Are you saying you bros awen't miwages yoursewves?
target: 当然不是喵！OwO，怎么回事？乃们是说，自己不是海市蜃楼吗？

source: I don't think I'm a mirage... but maybe I could be? If I was a mirage, would I even know it?!
target: 我觉得我不是……可也可能是？如果我是海市蜃楼，我自己会知道吗？！

source: Seriously, is there some sort of "anti-catgirl" quality about me? I never thought I'd be offended by this until it happened...
target: 认真的，我身上到底有什么“反猫娘”特质？以前都没想过，这事居然能让我生气……

source: Okay, you should probably go before Catboy Scott makes you question your existences for any longer.
target: 行了，还是走吧，免得猫郎斯科特继续让你们怀疑自己的存在。

source: At least you gained +N2 STAMINA from that surprisingly-delicious salmon sorbet!
target: 至少，那三文鱼雪葩意外地好吃，让你获得了+N2体力！

source: The wise talking bush
target: 会说话的智慧灌木

source: You and your friends check out the mirage. It's full of gorgeous oases, flying pigs, unproblematic Tweeter feeds, and other things that will never exist.
target: 你和朋友们逛起了海市蜃楼。里面满是美丽的绿洲、会飞的猪、不惹争议的Tweeter动态，以及其他根本不可能存在的东西。

source: Check it out, Polly. There's a bush making noises near that iridescent camel with sixteen humps!
target: 波莉，快看！那头闪着彩虹光、长十六个驼峰的骆驼旁边，有丛灌木在出声！

source: Hi, kids! I'm Counselor Flod--I mean, Counselor Floral Talking Bush!
target: 孩子们好！我是弗洛——我是说，花语灌木辅导员！

source: Oh, neat! A wise, talking, magical bush! I was wondering when we'd run into one of these.
target: 哦，真不错！聪明、会说话，还会魔法的灌木！我还在想，什么时候才能遇上一丛呢。

source: Are you sure it's not just Counselor Flodge disguised as a bush?
target: 你确定不是弗洛奇辅导员假扮的？

source: Nah, I don't think this is Flodge. It wouldn't make sense for him to be out here anyway.
target: 不是吧，我觉得这不是弗洛奇。他没道理出现在这里啊。

source: Like, why would Flodge wear a bush disguise and sit in the middle of the desert for no reason? That'd be INCREDIBLY sad and lame.
target: 想想看，弗洛奇干嘛无缘无故，扮成灌木坐在沙漠中间？那也太凄凉、太逊了。

source: Hey! If I was Flodge -- which I'm not -- it wouldn't be sad or lame of me -- I mean, of him -- to dress up as a bush alone in the middle of the desert.
target: 喂！就算我是弗洛奇——当然我不是——我一个人扮成灌木待在沙漠里，也不凄凉、不逊——我是说，他不凄凉、不逊。

source: It would be an admirable commitment to the noble art of camouflage. Committing to the things you love isn't sad or lame, it's brave and cool!
target: 那是为崇高的伪装艺术献身，值得钦佩。全心投入自己热爱的东西，才不凄凉、不逊，是勇敢又酷！

source: Wow, that is wise! You're right, Polly, this IS an all-knowing talking bush!
target: 哇，好有智慧！波莉，你说得对，这真是丛无所不知的说话灌木！

source: Of course I am! If you want, I could use my wise magic bush powers to answer your questions about the secrets of the universe, heh heh.
target: 当然！你们想问宇宙的秘密，我可以用智慧魔法灌木之力，为你们解答。嘿嘿。

source: That sounds awesome! Guys, we have ONE CHANCE to ask a super-smart question. We gotta make it count!
target: 太棒了！伙计们，咱们只有一次机会，一定得问个特别聪明、特别值得的问题！

source: Uh, I never said anything about there being a limit on the questions--
target: 呃，我没说问题次数有限——

source: NOPE, WE ONLY GET ONE! Them's the fuckin' rules. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, what should we ask Counselor Floral Talking Bush?
target: 不，就一次！规矩就他妈这样。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，问花语灌木辅导员什么？

source: Use this opportunity to solve monsterkind's biggest unsolved mystery: how planes work.
target: 抓住机会，破解怪物有史以来最大的未解之谜：飞机为什么会飞。

source: Ask the bush for its bank account password.
target: 问灌木的银行账户密码。

source: YAAASSSS, good idea! I've always wanted to know the answer to this deeply-kept secret!
target: 好耶，好主意！这个深藏的秘密，我早就想知道答案了！

source: Well, that's not much of a secret, actually. It's just--
target: 其实也不算秘密。就是——

source: My theory has always been that they pull the plane back in a ginormous slingshot and let it fly that way.
target: 我一直觉得，是拿个巨大的弹弓，把飞机拉满再弹出去。

source: Oooh, good theory. It's not like we can see the plane taking off on the tarmac, so we wouldn't be able to see the slingshot!
target: 哦，好理论。反正咱们又看不到停机坪上怎么起飞，自然也看不见弹弓！

source: Actually, kids, planes fly with--
target: 其实啊，孩子们，飞机靠——

source: MY theory is that they have to make periodic sacrifices to the Plane Gods throughout the flight to stay airborne.
target: 我的理论是，得在飞行途中定期向飞机之神献祭，才能一直飞着。

source: Why do you think you never see the same flight attendant twice?
target: 不然，你为什么从来没见过同一个空乘两次？

source: Wow, good point! I always assumed they stuff the engines with birds that fly the plane for them.
target: 哇，有道理！我一直以为，他们把鸟塞进发动机，靠鸟带着飞机飞。

source: That's a good one. You know, I saw this documentary once where they got a whole bee colony to hold up the plane and--
target: 这个也不错。我看过一部纪录片，他们让一整群蜜蜂托住飞机，然后——

source: THAT WASN'T A DOCUMENTARY!
target: 那不是纪录片！

source: Now look what you've done. Your inability to pay attention was so vexing I couldn't disguise my frustration anymore!
target: 看你们干的好事。一个个不肯认真听，气得我连怒气都伪装不住了！

source: Listen up: planes actually fly based on lift, drag, gravity, and thrust. If you turn your physics textbooks to the diagram on page 105--
target: 听好了，飞机飞行靠的是升力、阻力、重力和推力。把物理课本翻到105页的示意图——

source: Wait, there's homework involved in this explanation? Ew. Can't we just say it's birds in the engines and call it a day?
target: 等等，听个解释还要写作业？咦。就当是发动机里的鸟带着飞，不行吗？

source: NO! YOU ASKED! If I can't dazzle you with the beautiful art of camouflage, I'm at least going to teach you aeroscience!
target: 不行！是你们问的！伪装艺术的美妙震撼不了你们，至少也得教会你们航空知识！

source: Great. At least you gain +N2 MIND from Flodge's lecture, but you definitely lose -N2 HYPE learning aeroscience in the boiling desert heat.
target: 好极了。听弗洛奇讲课，至少让你获得了+N2头脑；不过顶着沙漠酷暑学航空知识，也确实让你失去了-N2热度。

source: Um... I don't... know the answer to that question?
target: 呃……这个问题，我……不知道答案？

source: But I thought you knew all the secrets of the universe. Did you lie to us, bro? Not cool.
target: 可我以为你知道宇宙的所有秘密。兄弟，你骗了我们？这可不酷。

source: Wow. Typical magical flora: lying to gain our trust and being unable to deliver on its promises.
target: 哇，典型的魔法植物。靠撒谎博取信任，承诺却兑现不了。

source: This is just like the time I ate those mushrooms that promised to teach me the secrets of the universe, but all I learned is that tripping in a port-o-potty in Vermont is NOT fun.
target: 就像那次，我吃了些蘑菇，说能告诉我宇宙的秘密。最后只知道，在佛蒙特州的移动厕所里嗑嗨，一点都不好玩。

source: Okay, fine, I admit that I DO know my bank password, but I don't feel comfortable sharing it with strangers.
target: 好吧，我承认，我确实知道自己的银行密码。可告诉陌生人，我不太放心。

source: But is ANYONE truly a stranger to an all-knowing bush, who knows everyone and everything in all of space and time?
target: 可你是全知的灌木，知道整个时空里所有人和所有事，还会有“陌生人”吗？

source: I... I guess not, but...
target: 我……应该没有，可是……

source: Look, dude, if you're not actually an omnipotent bush in the middle of a mirage in the desert, just say so. We won't judge you... to your face.
target: 伙计，要是你根本不是沙漠幻境里一丛全能的灌木，直说就好。我们不会笑话你的……至少不当面笑。

source: But I AM an omnipotent bush! Fine, if you must know, my bank password is... "passwordy."
target: 可我就是全能灌木！行，非知道不可的话，我的银行密码是……“passwordy”。

source: Wow, that's the least-secure password you've ever heard. Also, it looks like this bank account only has twenty bucks in it. Womp womp.
target: 哇，这大概是你听过最不安全的密码。再看账户，里面居然只有二十块。白高兴了。

source: Well, an all-knowing magical talking bush happens to have the same salary as a summer camp counselor, which is... not high.
target: 唉，全知的魔法说话灌木，工资恰好跟夏令营辅导员一样……不高。

source: What use does a magic bush have for money anyway? We'll just take that money off your hands for you and be on our way.
target: 再说了，魔法灌木要钱有什么用？我们就替你收下这些钱，告辞啦。

source: Fine. But you really believe I'm a talking bush now, don't you? My clever disg-- I mean my clever deduction of my own bank account password proved it?
target: 行。不过现在，你们真相信我是会说话的灌木了吧？我高明的伪——我是说，我对自己银行密码的高明推理，证明了吧？

source: Absolutely, bro! You convinced me!
target: 当然，兄弟！你说服我了！

source: THEN I GOT YOU! It was me, Counselor Flodge, all along! You succumbed to the incredible power of my camouflage!
target: 上当了吧！一直都是我，弗洛奇辅导员！你们败给了我不可思议的伪装之力！

source: Yup... you sure fooled us, buddy. Good job.
target: 对……确实骗过我们了，哥们。干得好。

source: You leave, a little bit richer and a little more soulless. And by that, I mean you have +N2 MONEY more and -N2 SOUL less than you started with.
target: 你离开时，多了点钱，少了点良心。也就是说，获得了+N2金钱，失去了-N2灵魂。

source: Mirage town
target: 幻影镇

source: You and your friends check out the mirage. It's full of gorgeous oases, flying pigs, unproblematic Tweeter feeds, and other things that will never exist.
target: 你和朋友们逛起了海市蜃楼。里面满是美丽的绿洲、会飞的猪、不惹争议的Tweeter动态，以及其他根本不可能存在的东西。

source: Then, you stumble upon an odd gate. It's got a sign hanging over it that says...
target: 接着，你们撞见一扇奇怪的大门，上面挂着牌子，写着……

source: "Welcome to Mirage Town! DO NOT ENTER IF YOU ARE REAL."
target: “欢迎来到幻影镇！真实存在者，请勿入内。”

source: ...Polly, are we real?
target: ……波莉，我们是真实的吗？

source: Hmm, good question. Part of me wants to say yes, because I consider myself a logist...
target: 嗯，好问题。一方面我想说是，毕竟我自认是个讲逻辑的人……

source: But the other part wants to say no, 'cause I'm high as fuuuck right now, so nothing feels real at all.
target: 可另一方面又想说不是，因为我现在嗨得要命，感觉什么都不是真的。

source: Either way, we should definitely go into this town. It'll be fine -- and even if it won't be fine, it'll be funny!
target: 反正不管怎样，这镇咱们一定得进。会没事的，就算有事，也会很好笑！

source: Can't argue with that! Behind the gate is a beautiful, nonsensical metropolis that shimmers in the dry desert heat.
target: 有理！门后是一座美丽却毫无道理的大都市，在干燥炽热的沙漠中闪闪发光。

source: It's like your childhood imaginary friends and your sleep paralysis demons collaborated on a city block project.
target: 就像你小时候的幻想朋友，跟鬼压床时见到的恶魔，一起合作搞了个街区项目。

source: Oh, hello... do any of you have the time? I can't find a clock that isn't melting around here...
target: 哦，你们好……请问现在几点？我在这儿找不到一只没融化的钟……

source: Whoa, bro, who are you?
target: 哇，兄弟，你是谁？

source: I'm Mr. Scribblehead... um, pardon me, but are you all... real?
target: 我是涂鸦头先生……呃，冒昧问一句，你们……是真实的吗？

source: Yes, we are. Please don't get Scott started on this.
target: 是，我们是真的。拜托，别再勾起斯科特这个话题了。

source: I see... then I must recommend that you leave... Mirage Town wasn't built for flesh-folk; this place can be quite taxing on your minds...
target: 明白了……那我得建议各位离开。幻影镇不是为血肉生灵造的，这地方很伤脑子……

source: Nah, I can handle it. I'm Polly Geist, baby! Mirage Town may be chaos, but I am MADE OF CHAOS!
target: 没事，我应付得来。我可是波莉·鬼斯特，宝贝！幻影镇是混乱没错，可我本人就是混乱！

source: Yeah, this place is cool, and I barely use my mind anyway! We can stay a LITTLE longer, can't we %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?
target: 对啊，这地方很酷，反正我也不怎么用脑子！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，再待一小会儿，可以吧？

source: What about just visiting the tourist district, getting a coffee and silly T-shirt to prove you were here, and calling it a day?
target: 要不就逛逛游客区，喝杯咖啡，买件傻乎乎的T恤证明到此一游，然后收工？

source: Just visit Mirage Town's biggest landmarks: the Boulevard of Broken Dreams, the Garden of Forking Paths, and the Eiffel Tower.
target: 就逛幻影镇最大的几个地标吧：梦碎大道、小径分岔的花园，还有埃菲尔铁塔。

source: Go all in: stay here for a while, become a local, truly experience the place. Time works differently in Mirage Town anyway.
target: 玩就玩个彻底：住一阵子，当个本地人，好好体验。反正幻影镇的时间，跟外面流逝得不一样。

source: Well, if you insist upon staying... may I recommend checking out the World's Least Real Café?
target: 既然各位坚持要留下……不妨去“全世界最不真实的咖啡馆”看看？

source: Sure! You all visit the café, get some drinks, and enjoy a relaxing sit.
target: 好啊！你们来到咖啡馆，点些喝的，舒舒服服坐了下来。

source: This is nice! Doing shenanigans is fun, but I'm glad we took a break and got our +N2 STAMINA up with some coffee.
target: 真好！胡闹是好玩，不过能歇歇脚，喝点咖啡补上+N2体力，也挺开心。

source: Yeah, I guess it's nice to relax and not pull a prank or commit a war crime for once...
target: 是啊，难得不搞恶作剧、不犯战争罪，就这样放松一下，也不错……

source: But remember, guys: we're still the PRANK MASTERZ! We've got a reputation to uphold!
target: 不过记住，伙计们，咱们可是恶作剧大师！名声还得维护！

source: I'm supposed to be Polly "LIVE FOR THE CHAOS" Geist; I can't let people think I've started to go soft 'cause I relax at coffeeshops all the time!
target: 我可是波莉“为混乱而活”鬼斯特。不能老在咖啡馆休息，让别人以为我开始心软了！

source: Don't worry, bro, we can still save your reputation. Maybe with a funny souvenir?
target: 别担心，哥们，还能救回你的名声。买个有趣的纪念品怎么样？

source: How so?
target: 怎么救？

source: Look at this one! It says "I Went to Mirage Town and Did a Bunch of Crazy Bullshit and All I Got to Prove It Was This Dumb T-shirt"!
target: 看这件！上面写着“我到幻影镇干了一堆疯到家的破事，最后只有这件蠢T恤能证明”！

source: ...Okay, it's actually kinda cute. I guess this works.
target: ……行吧，还挺可爱。我觉得可以。

source: But if anyone asks, we did some wacky-ass shenanigans in Mirage Town and they were so fuckin' insane nobody ever spoke of them again. Agreed?
target: 不过谁要问起来，咱们就是在幻影镇干了些特别离谱的事，疯到根本没人敢再提。说定了？

source: Agreed!
target: 说定了！

source: Sure, I agree! I already kinda forgot what we're talking about right now!
target: 好啊，同意！虽然我都快忘了咱们在说什么了！

source: You pay -N2 MONEY for your stuff, hit the road, and get your stories straight... but you'll secretly always look back fondly on your chill day at the Mirage Town Café.

target: 逛镜子迷宫

source: You wander through the hall of mirrors until you stumble upon an unexpected visage.
target: 你在镜子迷宫里闲逛，突然撞见一张意料之外的脸。

source: Oh... hey.

target: 波莉和斯科特都很好……可社交这么久，我还是有点累了。

source: That's true.

source: I love challenging myself with all these shenanigans...
target: 我喜欢跟着他们胡闹，挑战自己……

source: ...but I also miss cozying up at home with a cup of tea.
target: ……可我也想念窝在家里，捧杯茶的日子。

source: Listening to some chill music while it rains outside...
target: 听着轻柔的音乐，窗外下着雨……

source: Getting lost in my own thoughts while time passes, so slowly...
target: 沉浸在自己的思绪里，看时间慢慢流过去……

source: I totally get you.

source: But it's good to get out of our comfort zone every now and then, no?
target: 不过，偶尔走出舒适区，也挺好的，不是吗？

source: Yes. Don't get me wrong: I like being social from time to time too.
target: 嗯。别误会，偶尔跟人来往，我也喜欢。

source: It's just... it can get so exhausting that sometimes it's a bit hard to push myself into social situations.
target: 只是……真的会很累，有时很难鼓起劲，主动去参加社交。

source: And once there you think, "dang, this isn't thaaaat bad, I should do it a bit more often".
target: 可真到了现场，又会想：“哎，好像也没那么糟，以后该多来点。”

source: Totally. But hey, here we are.
target: 没错。不过你看，至少咱们已经来了。

source: Look at us!
target: 看看我们!

source: ...still... it's a bit exhausting...
target: ……但还是……有点累……

source: It's okay. Summer is coming to an end... and you know what that means.
target: 没事。夏天就快结束了……你知道接下来是什么。

source: FALL TIME.

source: Yes. Almost all introverts are also Fall people. I have no proof, but no doubts of it either.
target: 对。差不多所有内向的人，也都喜欢秋天。我没证据，不过也毫不怀疑。

source: Preach.

source: Anyway, I have to leave now. The others must be looking for me.
target: 总之，我得走了，他们该找我了。

source: It's okay. See you soon. Remember to save me some quality time together.
target: 没事，很快再见。记得留点时间，好好跟我待一会儿。

source: You wander through the hall of mirrors until you stumble upon an unexpected visage.

source: Well howdy, stranger!
target: 哟，陌生人，你好啊！

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%... you must return...
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%……你得回去……

source: What?
target: 什么？

source: You must return to the farm!
target: 你得回农场去！

source: What's wrong with the farm?
target: 农场怎么了？

source: Everything's burned down!
target: 全烧光了！

source: WHAT?!
target: 什么？！

source: What happened to the animals?! Are the horses okay??
target: 动物怎么样了？！马儿还好吗？？

source: The horses are sick! They've developed super-flu because nobody's been cutting their carrots the way they like!
target: 马都病了！没人按它们喜欢的样子切胡萝卜，它们染上超级流感了！

source: Oh, no! They have to have their carrots cut into little cubes!
target: 糟了！它们的胡萝卜，得切成小方块才行！

source: Exactly! Also, the pigs have started a revolution! They're ruling the farm with an iron hoof!
target: 没错！还有，猪闹革命了，正用铁蹄统治农场！

source: What would your grandfather say if he knew you abandoned his precious farm to go off and... do what?

source: Noooooo...!
You defeat your inner workaholic and leave the house of mirrors. You're on a road trip, dammit, and you're determined to have more fun than a toked-up cow!

source: House of mirrors
target: 逛镜子迷宫

source: You wander through the hall of mirrors until you stumble upon an unexpected visage.
target: 你在镜子迷宫里闲逛，突然撞见一张意料之外的脸。

source: Oh, hey you!
target: 哦，嗨，是你！

source: Or... hey me?
target: 或者……是我？

source: How DO you say hi to yourself without sounding crazy?
target: 跟自己打招呼，到底怎么才不像个疯子？

source: Ugh, I'm no better at talking to my own reflection than I am at talking to strangers...
target: 唉，跟自己的倒影说话，也没比跟陌生人聊天轻松多少……

source: Though, it doesn't hurt to practice... and I'm basically alone right now...
target: 不过，练练也没坏处……反正现在就我自己……

source: Where's my list of small talk, icebreakers, and interesting anecdotes... ah, found it!
target: 我那份闲聊话题、破冰语和有趣轶事的清单呢……啊，找到了！

source: "List One: Greetings" -- there's gotta be some good stuff in here!
target: “清单一：打招呼”——这里肯定有好东西！

source: "AHOY, SCALLYWAG! HOW IS YER BOOTY?"
target: “啊哈，海盗小贼！你的宝贝还好吗？”

source: Hmmm, better save that for if I'm ever kidnapped by pirates.
target: 嗯，这句留着以后被海盗绑架时再用。

source: "Well met, traveler! Fear ye the dragon's mighty schlong?"
target: “旅人，幸会！巨龙那威猛的大屌，可曾令你胆寒？”

source: Eh, that one really only works in the Dragon Heat MMO... I don't want people to think I don't touch grass.
target: 呃，这句好像只适合《Dragon Heat》网游……可不想让人觉得我成天不出门。
