target: “史蒂夫，你个老不正经的！离婚办得怎么样了？”

source: That'd work if I meet someone named Steve who's going through a divorce... I'm getting somewhere!
target: 要是碰上叫史蒂夫、正在离婚的人，这句就能用……有进展了！

source: You stand there for several minutes, testing out increasingly bizarre and specific greetings, until you're found by one of the carnival security guards.
target: 你站了好几分钟，试着说出越来越古怪、适用范围越来越窄的开场白，直到一名嘉年华保安找到你。

source: "Hey, pal, you okay?" one asks. "You've been here a while. Are you lost?"
target: 他问：“嘿，朋友，没事吧？你在这儿待了挺久，迷路了吗？”

source: Oh, no, I was just...
target: 哦，没有，我只是……

source: You notice the security guard's nametag.
target: 你注意到保安的名牌。

source: Uh... Steve, you old sinner... how's the divorce going?
target: 呃……史蒂夫，你个老不正经的……离婚办得怎么样了？

source: "...It's honestly been really hard. She's talking about taking custody of the dog."
target: “……说真的，挺难熬的。她说想把狗的抚养权也拿走。”

source: Not the dog!!!
target: 狗可不行！！！

source: You spend several more minutes comforting Steve as he blubbers about broken hearts and alimony. You always knew that your small-talk practice would one day pay off!
target: 接下来几分钟，史蒂夫抽抽噎噎地说着心碎和赡养费，你一直安慰他。你就知道，闲聊练习，总有一天会派上用场！

source: Carnival games
target: 嘉年华游戏

source: Sure, carnival games are rigged and overpriced and the prizes aren't worth it... but their blinking lights and big plushies still call out to you. Time to game!
target: 嘉年华游戏是有猫腻，收费也高，奖品还不值钱……可闪烁的灯光和大毛绒玩具，还是在召唤你。开玩！

source: Check out this Zoltar machine! I wonder what the best strategy is to win a prize from it...
target: 看看这台Zoltar占卜机！不知道用什么策略，才能从它那儿赢到奖品……

source: Can you even win a Zoltar machine? Doesn't it just tell you your fortune with no actual reward?
target: 占卜机还有赢不赢的吗？它不是只给你算个命，根本没奖品？

source: Ooh, my fortune says, "You're the best boy, and you're sure to be a winner!" And it printed me a voucher for a prize! Hooray!
target: 哦，我的签上写：“你是最乖的狗狗，一定会赢！”还给我打印了张领奖券！万岁！

source: WHOA. That's amazing. You take Scott over to the prize table to claim his plushie.
target: 哇，厉害。你带着斯科特去兑奖台，领他的毛绒玩具。

source: Manning the prize table is a disinterested orc girl painting her nails.
target: 兑奖台前，一个兽人女孩正百无聊赖地涂指甲。

source: You can take anything on the bottom shelf.
target: 最下面那层，随便拿。

source: Actually, can I exchange my prize voucher for more game tokens? I wanna win all the things!
target: 其实，能把奖券换成更多游戏币吗？我想把所有东西都赢回来！

source: You think you can win THESE carnival games? I hate to break it to ya, big guy, but most of them are rigged as hell.
target: 大块头，你以为这些嘉年华游戏都能赢？不想扫你的兴，可大多都动了手脚，坑得很。

source: You can win any game with enough heart and a good attitude! Come with us, I'll show you!
target: 只要够用心、心态够好，什么游戏都能赢！跟我们来，给你看看！

source: Scott, I don't think she can leave her post while she's working.
target: 斯科特，人家还在上班，应该不能擅离岗位吧。

source: Nah, fuck this job. I wanna see this guy prove himself. Let's play some games.
target: 没事，去他的工作。我倒想看看，他能不能说到做到。玩游戏去。

source: You all watch Scott win all the carnival games with increasing awe. He's weirdly incredible at this!
target: 你们看着斯科特横扫所有嘉年华游戏，越看越佩服。他在这方面，强得莫名其妙！

source: Damn! You beat the high scores on the basketball freethrow, the dart toss, the water gun squirting race...
target: 我去！篮球罚球、飞镖、水枪竞速……最高分全让你破了！

source: That last one was kinda hard, though. I aimed the wrong way at first and got my T-shirt wet.
target: 不过最后那个挺难的。我一开始瞄反了，把T恤都弄湿了。

source: Yeah, so you did... on a completely unrelated note, are you doing anything later?
target: 是啊，确实湿了……顺便问个完全无关的，你待会儿有安排吗？

source: Playing more games, I hope! Are there any more to play?
target: 希望能再玩点游戏！还有没玩的没？

source: Only the SUPER hard ones. I've literally never seen anyone win them. You'd lose less money just letting my manager rob you.
target: 就剩超级难的了。我从没见人赢过。直接让我经理抢你钱，可能还亏得少点。

source: But you already smashed my expectations at the games you played before... how about this, big guy: I challenge you to win one of these super-hard games. You in?
target: 不过刚才那些游戏，你都让我刮目相看了……这样吧，大块头，我挑战你，再赢一个超级难的。敢不敢？

source: Sure! I love a challenge! Which game should I play?
target: 当然！我喜欢挑战！玩哪个？

source: "Whack-A-Mole-Person Trying To Get To The Surface" The prize is... guacamole?
target: “打鼹鼠人——他们只是想挖到地面上”。奖品是……牛油果酱？
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): KEEP; 后续鼹鼠人逃生与来源可疑的牛油果酱完整关联；不为 Whack-a-mole/guacamole 音梗新增提前揭底的打成肉酱情节。

source: The Kiss-Wrestling Machine where you measure your kissing skills in the most whimsical duel ever.
target: 亲吻摔跤机，用史上最奇妙的决斗，测测你的接吻本事。

source: The Rigged Game. Sure, they admit it's rigged, but the prizes are HUGE!
target: “黑幕游戏”。人家是承认做了手脚，可奖品超级大！

source: Meanwhile, hundreds of kilometers underground, the last remnants of the Mole People Resistance Fighters are digging desperately toward the surface.
target: 与此同时，地下几百公里深处，鼹鼠人抵抗军仅剩的战士们，正拼命往地表挖。

source: "Are you sure this is a good plan, Moe? What if the surface people don't help us?"
target: “莫，你确定这计划行？地表人要是不帮我们呢？”

source: "We gotta try, Mort. The only way we're going to defeat the Insectoid People empire is with the surface people's magic boomsticks!"
target: “得试试，莫特。想打败虫人帝国，只能靠地表人那些会轰响的魔法棍！”

source: "I think they're called 'guns', Moe."
target: “莫，我想那叫‘枪’。”

source: In the back of the group, a sickly mole person stumbles and falls, coughing up blood.
target: 队伍后方，一名病弱的鼹鼠人踉跄倒地，咳出了血。

source: "MOLLY!" cries Moe, helping her up. "Shit, that giant spider bite looks really bad. Are you sure you can make it?"
target: 莫扶起她，惊叫：“莫莉！妈的，被巨型蜘蛛咬的地方看着很严重。你真撑得住？”

source: "I'm fine! The survival of Molekind is more important than me. I can hold on until we reach the surface."
target: “我没事！鼹鼠一族的存亡，比我重要。我能撑到地面上。”

source: "Stay strong, Molly. The surface people will have medicines that can help you. Take my arm, I'll help you walk."
target: “莫莉，坚持住。地表人会有药救你的。抓住我的胳膊，我扶你走。”

source: "MOE, I SEE LIGHT AHEAD! We're almost there! I can taste freedom already!"
target: “莫，前面有光！就快到了！我已经尝到自由的滋味了！”

source: HERE COMES ANOTHER ONE! Bash its head in, Scotty!
target: 又冒出来一个！斯科蒂，砸烂它的脑袋！

source: I'm still not sure about this. These mole people's screams seem REALLY real... are you bros sure this is nice?
target: 我还是不太确定。这些鼹鼠人叫得也太真了……兄弟们，这真是好事吗？

source: Heyyyy, c'mon. Would you rather ask uncomfy questions, or win a bowl of yummy guacamole without questioning how we got the guacamole?
target: 哎呀，别这样嘛。你是想问些让人不舒服的问题，还是想赢碗美味牛油果酱，而且别问这酱哪儿来的？

source: Guacamole, hands down. Scott beats the high score and wins you all a bowl of delicious, dubious guac. You all share it and gain +N2 STAMINA.
target: 当然选牛油果酱，毫无疑问。斯科特破了最高分，给大家赢来一碗好吃却来路可疑的酱。你们分着吃掉，获得了+N2体力。

source: This was a lot of fun, but I'd better get back to my shift now. Call me sometime, will you, big guy?
target: 玩得很开心，不过我得回去上班了。大块头，有空给我打电话，好吗？

source: Wow, she was really nice! Do you guys think she liked me? I couldn't tell.
target: 哇，她人真好！你们觉得她喜欢我吗？看不出来。

source: Oh, Scott! At least his inability to read social cues is distracting him from the mole-people murder he just committed (and the -N2 SOUL you lost as a result).
target: 唉，斯科特！至少看不懂这些暗示，让他没心思想到自己刚刚杀了鼹鼠人——还有你因此失去的-N2灵魂。

source: What? But kissing and love are magical things! They shouldn't be turned into a silly carnival game!
target: 什么？可亲吻和爱都是很神奇的东西，不该拿来做蠢兮兮的嘉年华游戏！

source: So you're backing down from the challenge, huh? I knew you didn't have it in ya. You're just a big ol' chicken.
target: 哦，所以你临阵退缩了？就知道你不行，胆小鬼。

source: I'm not a chicken; I'm a werewolf, last time I checked. And I'm not scared of kissing. I'm good at it, even!
target: 我不是胆小鸡，是狼人，上次确认时还是。还有，我不怕接吻，甚至挺擅长的！

source: Kissing is all about using your tongue, and your tongue is one of the most important muscles in your body. I've got a stronk tongue, I'll show you!
target: 接吻靠舌头，舌头可是身体里最重要的肌肉之一。我舌头壮得很，给你看看！

source: Scott approaches the Kiss-Wrestling Machine and goes hog wild. (Or should I say... DOG wild?)
target: 斯科特来到亲吻摔跤机前，开始疯狂发挥。疯得跟野猪似的——还是说，跟疯狗似的？

source: Wow. That's... something. You're using a LOT of tongue.
target: 哇，这可真……你舌头用得挺猛啊。

source: You know that kissing someone is more than just licking their face like a happy puppy, right?
target: 你知道，接吻不只是像高兴的小狗一样，一直舔人家的脸吧？

source: G-Gosh...
target: 天、天哪……

source: Well, fine, I guess it's somebody's thing after all.
target: 好吧，看来还真有人吃这套。

source: Woo, that was a workout! It definitely took -N2 STAMINA to beat that high score. How'd I do?
target: 呼，真是场锻炼！破这个纪录，确实花了-N2体力。我表现怎么样？

source: Uh... you won. You definitely won. Take whatever plushies you want. Take... ANYTHING you want.
target: 呃……你赢了，绝对赢了。想要什么毛绒玩具，随便拿。想要……什么都行。

source: Yay, I won with the +N2 MAGIC of kissing! Thank you so much!
target: 耶，我靠亲吻的+N2魔力赢了！太谢谢你啦！

source: In his excitement, Scott licks the orc's cheek. She turns scarlet and runs off.
target: 斯科特一激动，舔了下兽人女孩的脸颊。她脸一下红透，跑掉了。

source: Aw, she left! Guess she didn't like my kissing after all...
target: 啊，她走了！看来还是不喜欢我的吻……

source: Oh, don't worry, bud. I think she liked it BIG TIME.
target: 别担心，哥们。我看她喜欢得很。

source: THAT'S the game you're choosing? It literally says it's rigged in the title.
target: 你就选这个？名字都直接写着有黑幕了。

source: That's okay! Rigged doesn't mean impossible!
target: 没事！有黑幕又不等于不可能！

source: Well, it's not impossible, but winning is highly unlikely. You'd have to calculate the perfect toss speed, trigonometrically deduce the best angle, calculate inertia vs. thrust--
target: 是不至于不可能，不过赢的概率极低。得算出完美的投掷速度，用三角函数推导最佳角度，再计算惯性和推力——

source: All I'm hearing is that it's not impossible, 'cause you said lots of really big words after that and I kinda tuned them out. Let's game!
target: 我只听见“不至于不可能”。后面那些词太深奥，我就没听进去了。开玩！

source: Scott pays -N2 MONEY for three rings. He misses every throw.
target: 斯科特花-N2金钱买了三个套圈，全没中。

source: Don't worry, it's like Coach says: if at first you don't succeed, try again!
target: 别担心，教练说过：一次不成功，就再试一次！

source: He pays for three more rings. He loses. He pays again. He loses again. This game, like life, is a vicious, expensive cycle.
target: 他又买三个圈，输了。再买，再输。这个游戏跟人生一样，循环往复，又恶劣又费钱。

source: Darn... well, it's like Coach says: if you don't succeed by the tenth try, go home and cry into your pillow. Let's go, guys.
target: 唉……教练也说过：试到第十次还没成，就回家抱着枕头哭吧。伙计们，走了。

source: Hey, uh, you know what? I forgot to give you your last ring. You get one more shot, big guy.
target: 嘿，呃，要不这样？我忘了给你最后一个圈。大块头，你还能再投一次。

source: But since this is your last try, let's try a new technique: you gotta throw it BLINDFOLDED.
target: 既然最后一次了，试个新技巧：蒙上眼睛扔。

source: Blindfolded? But if I couldn't even win while I was using my eyes. How could I win without them?
target: 蒙眼？可睁着眼都赢不了，闭着眼怎么赢？

source: Maybe you'll feel the heart of the rings while you're blind or something! It'll be exciting if nothing else!
target: 也许蒙着眼，就能感受到套圈的心什么的？起码很刺激嘛！

source: Scott puts on the blindfold and throws the ring. He misses, of course. But the orc girl grabs the ring and puts it on a bottle for him!
target: 斯科特戴上眼罩，抛出套圈。当然又没中，可兽人女孩拿起圈，帮他套在了瓶子上！

source: HOLY SHIT!
target: 我操！

source: What? What happened?
target: 怎么了？发生什么了？

source: You did it! You won the ring toss blindfolded! I underestimated you, but I know when I'm beat. You can have any prize you want.
target: 成了！你蒙着眼，套中了！是我小看你了，不过输了就得认。想要什么奖品，随便挑。

source: I won?! HOORAY! Thanks so much for believing in me!
target: 我赢了？！万岁！太谢谢你相信我了！

source: Scott picks out a plushie, wraps the orc girl up in a BIG body-lifting hug, and runs off to tell the world about his victory.
target: 斯科特挑了个毛绒玩具，一把抱起兽人女孩，给了她一个大大的拥抱，再跑出去，恨不得把自己的胜利告诉全世界。

source: I gotta say, gurl, you turned out to be legit. Thanks for making my friend's day.
target: 我得说，姐妹，你真不错。谢谢你让我朋友这么开心。

source: Y-Yeah... my pleasure.
target: 嗯、嗯……我也很开心。

source: Scott calls pretty much every phone number he remembers to tell them he won a ring toss blindfolded. His +N2 HYPE is infectious!
target: 斯科特把记得的电话号码几乎都打了一遍，告诉人家自己蒙眼赢了套圈。他的+N2热度，真能感染人！

source: Freak show
target: 看怪胎秀

source: You see a tent with a long line outside of it. "Come one, come all!" a carnie beckons. "Behold my finest freaks, if you dare!"
target: 一顶帐篷外排着长队，招徕游客的工作人员喊道：“来呀，都来呀！胆子够大，就来看看我最出色的怪胎！”

source: What do you think, Polly? Should we dare?
target: 波莉，你觉得呢？咱们敢不敢？

source: I NEVER chicken out of a dare. Let's do it!
target: 挑战我可从不认怂。走！

source: You pay -N2 MONEY for tickets and get in line to see the freaks. Inside, you witness some mind-boggling individuals...
target: 你花-N2金钱买票，排队入场，见到了几个不可思议的人物……

source: Mr. "Right To Bear Arms"?
target: “持熊臂权”先生？
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): KEEP; 完整怪胎秀紧接熊叫，持熊臂权已用持X权句式对应 right to bear arms 的词义错拆。

source: ROOOAAARRRRRR!
The Illustrated Man (Literally)?
target: 插画人（字面意思）？

source: PORTAMI FUORI DI QUI, CAZZO!
target: 他妈的，带我离开这里！

source: THE CHAOTIC CREATURE FROM BEYOND THE BELIEVABLE BOUNDARY?!
target: 超越可信边界的混沌生物？！

source: ...Wait, that's just Noodles.
target: ……等等，不就是面条吗？

source: Teehee!
target: 嘻嘻！

source: You finally reach the end of the freak show. The tent splits off in two directions -- and a choice of the final freak to see!
target: 终于到了怪胎秀的尾声，帐篷分出两条路，让你选择最后要看的怪胎！

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, it's your call. Which of these freaks do you think will be the freakiest freak to ever freak us out?
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你来定。你觉得哪个怪胎，能怪到把我们都吓一跳？

source: The Amazing Man Who's Always Nice on the Internet
target: 网上永远待人友善的神奇男人

source: The Dog That Thinks It Knows Programming
target: 以为自己会编程的狗

source: This anomalous wonder of the web is smiling and typing on his laptop.
target: 这位网络奇人，正面带微笑地在笔记本上打字。

source: You're trying to tell me this guy has NEVER been rude online? I call bullshit.
target: 你说这家伙从没在网上嘴臭过？我不信，扯淡。

source: Look, he's commenting on a YooToob video!
target: 看，他在评论YooToob视频！

source: "I can't believe you gave 'Adult Regular Samurai Frogs: The Movie' such a bad review. This film literally defined my childhood..."
target: “真不敢相信，你把《成年普通武士蛙：大电影》评得这么差。它可是塑造了我整个童年的电影……”

source: "...but I respect your differing opinion, and you made some points that made me see Master Ribbiter in a new way." Nice!
target: “……不过我尊重不同意见，而且有几个观点，确实让我对呱呱大师有了新的认识。”真好！

source: Oh God, now he's playing Federation of Fables Online. This is where the real toxicity comes out, guarantee it.
target: 老天，现在他开始玩《寓言联邦Online》了。保证这就能见识到真正的乌烟瘴气。

source: The man quietly plays a competitive match. His team is losing, but he's keeping his cool.
target: 男人安安静静打着排位。队伍劣势，他还是稳得住。

source: Wow, not a single swear or accusation that his teammates are twelve... he's good.
target: 哇，一句脏话都没有，也没骂队友都是十二岁小孩……有点东西。

source: He didn't even get mad when that other player told him to "get rekt cuntrag" and squatted lots of times over his dead body!
target: 另一个人骂他“菜就多练，废物逼”，还在他尸体上反复蹲起，他都没生气！

source: Nor did he respond when that guy gave VERY graphic details about exactly how he was gonna have sex with his mother.
target: 那人特别详细地描述了要怎么操他妈，他也没回嘴。

source: Yeah... I think I need a shower after that one.
target: 嗯……听完这个，我都想去洗个澡了。

source: BEST FREAK SHOW EVER!
target: 史上最棒的怪胎秀！

source: You give The Amazing Man Who's Always Nice on the Internet two thumbs up. You gain +N2 SOUL from his positivity!
target: 你朝网上永远待人友善的神奇男人，竖起了两根大拇指。他的正能量让你获得了+N2灵魂！

source: You all walk into a room where a normal-looking dog sits on a pedestal, wagging its tail.
target: 你们走进一间屋子，一只长相普通的狗正坐在高台上摇尾巴。

source: I don't get it. What's special about this dog? It's supposed to be a programmer?
target: 我不懂，这狗有什么特别？说它是程序员？

source: "Nope!" says the freakshow host. "This dog ISN'T a programmer. It's just a normal dog."
target: 主持人说：“不是！这狗不是程序员，就是条普通狗。”

source: "But, from the very bottom of its misguided heart, this dog THINKS it's a programmer. Look into its eyes and see its naive confidence!"
target: “可在它那想岔了的内心最深处，它坚信自己是程序员！看看它的眼睛，那天真的自信！”

source: You look deeper into the dog's eyes. You see... no thoughts. Head empty. Just doggo.
target: 你深深望进狗的眼睛，看到了……什么想法都没有。脑袋空空，只有狗狗。

source: "Look how sure he is! SNAP OUT OF IT, DOG! YOU'LL NEVER BE A PROGRAMMER! FACE REALITY ONCE AND FOR ALL!"
target: “看它多自信！狗，醒醒！你永远当不了程序员，认清现实吧！”

source: "WOOF!" says the dog.
target: 狗说：“汪！”

source: He's a stubborn pup! Almost as stubborn as an actual programmer!
target: 真是只倔狗！都快跟真正的程序员一样倔了！

source: "Haha, yes, this ridiculous pooch will never know the truth. But you have to admire his confidence against all odds. Here, dog, have a treat!"
target: “哈哈，这傻狗永远不会知道真相。不过，哪怕希望渺茫也这么自信，真让人佩服。来，狗狗，吃块零食！”

source: Your friends move on, but you hang back to pet the dog. You stare into its eyes one last time...
target: 朋友们继续往前，你留下来摸摸狗。你最后一次望进它的眼睛……

source: Whoa. WHOOOOOA! Deep in this pup's eyes, you're pretty sure you see the master codes of the universe!
target: 哇，哇——！在狗眼睛的深处，你几乎可以确定，自己看见了宇宙的底层代码！

source: Are you tripping, or is this dog actually a programmer?!
target: 是你嗑嗨了，还是这狗真是程序员？！

source: "WOOF WOOF!"
target: “汪汪！”

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, are you coming, or are you just gonna keep making excessive eye contact with a dog all day?
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，走不走啊？还是要跟一只狗深情对视一整天？

source: You leave, but seeing the binary in that dog's eyes made you feel like YOU know programming now too. Wild. You gain +N2 MIND!
target: 你离开了，可狗眼里的二进制，让你觉得自己现在也懂编程了。离谱。你获得了+N2头脑！

source: Grind experience
target: 刷经验

source: Time to get your RPG on! You suggest grinding this dungeon for experience points.
target: 开刷RPG啦！你提议刷这座地牢，攒点经验值。

source: I LOVE being on the grind! Let's do it!
target: 我最喜欢磨练自己了！上吧！

source: I love grinding too, so this should be fun!
target: 磨磨蹭蹭，我也最爱了，这下有得玩！

source: Not the right kind of grinding. But it's too late to explain; you're surrounded by slimes to kill. Time to grind for XP!
target: 这可不是那种“磨”。不过已经来不及解释，周围全是等着挨打的史莱姆。开始刷经验！

source: You get to work slaying slimes. You'd think this would be a difficult task, but these slimes are actually STUPID easy to kill.
target: 你开始杀史莱姆。本以为多少有点难度，结果它们好杀得离谱。

source: They practically explode at your touch. In fact, you kill a couple just by staring at them really hard. WTF?
target: 几乎一碰就炸，有几只甚至被你瞪死了。什么鬼？

source: This feels so mean. I don't like killing slimes! Why are we even doing this to them?
target: 这感觉好坏啊。我不喜欢杀史莱姆！为什么要这样对它们？

source: I think we're supposed to gain experience from this? Which is important for... something.
target: 应该是为了涨经验吧？这对……某些事挺重要。

source: If this is for experience, it's not a good experience! The slimes don't deserve to die!
target: 要是这叫长经验，那也不是什么好经历！史莱姆不该死！

source: Just look at the little guys. They're beautiful!
target: 看看这些小家伙，多漂亮！

source: Uh... sure.
target: 呃……行吧。

source: Ugh, you're right, Scott. This is cruel! These slimes were just chilling in this dark, homey dungeon before we started slaughtering them.
target: 唉，你说得对，斯科特，太残忍了！我们开杀之前，它们就在这黑乎乎、又像家一样的地牢里，好好待着。

source: As you stand around contemplating your heinous actions, the slime in front of you throws itself onto your sword!
target: 正当你反省自己的恶行时，面前的史莱姆，自己扑上了你的剑！

source: NO! Stay with me, little slime-bro! Let me heal you with the power of my hugs!
target: 不！撑住，小史莱姆兄弟！让我用拥抱的力量治好你！

source: Scott hugs the slime so hard it explodes. Oof... the price of never skipping arm day.
target: 斯科特用力一抱，史莱姆炸了。唉，手臂训练从不落下的代价。

source: I don't get it! Why don't they even try to protect themselves?
target: 不明白啊！它们怎么连保护自己都不试试？

source: I think these slimes have gotten so used to adventurers killing them for XP that they've evolved to think their ONLY purpose is to be killed for XP.
target: 我看，这些史莱姆太习惯被冒险者杀来刷经验，已经进化到觉得，自己活着就只有这么一个用途了。

source: That's terrible! Can we try to teach the slimes a new way of life so they won't exist to be slaughtered anymore?
target: 太可怕了！能不能教它们过别的生活，别再只是活着等被杀了？

source: That sounds more fun than tediously spilling slime blood all afternoon. How do you improve the slimes' lives?
target: 这可比整个下午机械地放史莱姆的血有意思。怎么改善它们的生活？

source: Teach them karate. They'll acquire confidence and self-esteem, value their existence over giving XP points, and they'll be able to kick adventurers' asses!
target: 教它们空手道。有了自信、自尊，它们就会珍惜生命，不再甘愿只当经验包，还能把冒险者揍趴下！

source: If their main purpose is giving adventurers experience, help them open a high-end restaurant. It won't sell a meal; it'll offer an experience!
target: 既然使命是给冒险者“经验”，不如帮它们开家高级餐厅。不卖饭，卖“体验”！

source: That's a great idea! I could totally teach karate to a bunch of slimes! HI-YA!
target: 好主意！教一群史莱姆空手道，我肯定行！嘿呀！

source: You think so? Do you know any karate, Polly?
target: 是吗？波莉，你会空手道？

source: I mean, not REALLY, but I've seen lots of ninja and martial-arts movies. You just do training montages and chop stuff and go HI-YA! How hard can it be?
target: 其实不太会，可忍者片、武打片，我看得多啊。搞个训练蒙太奇，劈劈东西，再喊声“嘿呀”！能有多难？

source: Scott, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, you go round up the slimes while I set up the dojo. Let's do this! HI-YA!
target: 斯科特，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你们去召集史莱姆，我来布置道场。开干！嘿呀！

source: You and Scott gather up some slimes to train. When you get back, Polly is HAMMERED.
target: 你和斯科特召集了些史莱姆来训练，回去一看，波莉已经喝得烂醉。

source: Whooooa, I'm seeing double... which just means more targets to hit, haha!
target: 哇——看东西都重影了……那不就是有更多目标可以打嘛，哈哈！

source: Okay, students! The first rule of karate is to ALWAYS BE ALERT! Like this! HI-YA!
target: 好，学生们！空手道第一条，随时保持警惕！就像这样！嘿呀！

source: Polly karate-chops a slime. It explodes.
target: 波莉一记手刀劈向史莱姆，它炸了。

source: ...Okay, uh, bad example.
target: ……好吧，呃，反面教材。

source: Let's do some chopping exercises! Scott, get us some wood to split in half! HI-YA!
target: 来，练练手刀！斯科特，找点木头，让大家劈成两半！嘿呀！

source: No one chops wood in half. Between Polly's drunkenness and the slimes' lack of arms or legs, no progress is made, and -N2 STAMINA is lost.
target: 没一根木头被劈开。波莉醉着，史莱姆又没胳膊没腿，毫无进展，还损失了-N2体力。

source: COME ON, YOU STUPID SLIMES! You're supposed to be karate masters by now! How else are we gonna get black belts and defeat the rival dojo?!
target: 加把劲啊，蠢史莱姆！照理说，你们早该成空手道大师了！不然怎么拿黑带，打败对家道场？！

source: Ugh, this is taking too long. Scott, hold my beer. I'll just do a training montage to speed this shit up.
target: 烦，太慢了。斯科特，拿着我的啤酒。来个训练蒙太奇，加快进度。

source: Polly starts doing some nonsensical martial-artsy moves while humming "Eye of the Tiger." This is NOT a training montage.
target: 波莉哼着《Eye of the Tiger》，做起了毫无章法的武术动作。这可不叫训练蒙太奇。

source: Oh, isn't it, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? ISN'T IT?!
target: 哦，不叫吗，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%？真不叫吗？！

source: Aaaaand she blacks out.
target: 然后——她醉倒了。

source: Whoa, the montage worked! Look at the slimes!
target: 哇，蒙太奇管用了！看史莱姆们！

source: HUH? All the slimes are suddenly wearing black-belts now! Was that actually a training montage somehow?!
target: 啊？所有史莱姆突然都系上了黑带！难道刚才还真莫名其妙成了训练蒙太奇？！

source: You gain +N2 SOUL for helping the slimes learn self-defense and purpose. Scott carries Polly out to the car while she mumbles "hi-ya..." in her sleep. Oh, Polly!
target: 帮史莱姆学会自卫、找到人生目标，让你获得了+N2灵魂。斯科特把波莉抱回车上，她睡着了还在嘟囔“嘿呀……”。唉，波莉啊！

source: Great idea! I've seen enough TV shows about high-end experimental restaurants to run one myself, easy-peasy.
target: 好主意！高级实验餐厅的节目，我看得够多了，自己开一家还不容易。

source: You gather up the slimes and work on opening your restaurant. Polly helps out by drinking lots of wine and yelling at people.
target: 你召集史莱姆，着手开餐厅。波莉则喝了大量的酒，再冲大家大吼，算是帮忙。

source: I said to cut these tomatoes to LOOK like strawberries! You're not supposed to ACTUALLY make them strawberries, you absolute fucking walnuts!
target: 我说的是把番茄切得像草莓，不是把它真的变成草莓，你们这群他妈的核桃脑袋！

source: And what's this?! I said to paint a surrealist rendition of the Mona Lisa out of pistachio paste on these crackers. THIS IS IMPRESSIONISM!
target: 这又是什么？！我说用开心果酱，在饼干上画超现实主义版《蒙娜丽莎》。你这分明是印象派！

source: What do you think we're doing here, making food?
target: 你以为我们在干嘛，做饭吗？

source: Um... yes, that's exactly what I thought we were doing.
target: 呃……对，我还真以为咱们在做这个。

source: NO! We're not making food, we're making an EXPERIENCE! That's what people are paying for!!!
target: 不是！做的不是饭，是体验！人家花钱买的就是这个！！！

source: After much preparation, it's finally the opening day of your restaurant! Adventurers line up to loot the dungeon, but instead they find...
target: 筹备许久后，餐厅终于开业！冒险者排着队来搜刮地牢，结果迎接他们的却是……

source: Welcome to "Le Donjon!" I'm your waiter, Scott.
target: 欢迎光临Le Donjon地牢餐厅！我是服务生斯科特。

source: May I recommend the Animated Skeleton Crisps for your first course? They're very yummy with our mulberry wine!
target: 第一道菜，要不要试试活化骷髅脆片？配我们的桑葚酒，可好吃了！

source: (Scott, 86 the mulberry wine! Someone -- not me -- drank it all, and if anyone says it WAS me, they're fired.)
target: （斯科特，桑葚酒下架！有人——不是我——把酒全喝了，谁敢说是我，谁就滚蛋。）

source: "What the hell's going on here?" the adventurers ask. "We came here to slay the Elderdragon boss, not have fine dining!"
target: 冒险者问：“这他妈什么情况？我们来是为了砍古龙首领，不是吃高级料理！”

source: Ooh, speaking of that, we're running a special on the Elderdragon Tar-tar entree. It comes with treasure-hoard-gold shavings on top!
target: 哦，说到这个，古龙肉塔塔今天特价，顶上还撒了从宝藏堆里刨下来的金箔！

source: You fail to make a profit -- in fact, you lose -N2 MONEY on ingredients -- but that's business. Le Donjon's opening day is still a great success!
target: 你们没赚到钱，食材反而花掉了-N2金钱，不过做生意嘛。Le Donjon地牢餐厅开业，仍算大获成功！

source: We made RPGuide's "Top 10 Dungeon Restaurants of the Year"! I'm so proud of you little slimes!
target: 我们上《RPGuide》“年度十佳地牢餐厅”了！小史莱姆们，我真为你们骄傲！

source: Now it's time for us to go, but we'll leave you in good hands. There's one slime who has proven themself worthy of wearing my "Head Chef" hat.
target: 咱们该走了，不过餐厅会交给可靠的人。有只史莱姆，已经证明自己配得上我这顶“主厨”帽子。

source: It's... uh... well, to be honest, you slimes all kinda look the same, so I dunno. I'll promote... this guy. Good luck!
target: 那就是……呃，老实说，你们长得都差不多，我也分不清。就提拔……这个吧。好运！

source: This has truly been an experience worth gaining. You earn +N2 SOUL!
target: 这回的经历，才算没白刷。你获得了+N2灵魂！

source: Fight the dungeon boss
target: 挑战地牢首领

source: Ninety-nine levels of exploring the dungeon, fighting slimes, and solving puzzles later, you find a heavy iron door labeled "FINAL BOSS".
target: 探索地牢、打史莱姆、解谜，闯过九十九层后，你终于找到一扇厚重的铁门，上面写着“最终首领”。

source: You open the door, readying yourself for a fight. Inside, you see...
target: 你推开门，准备战斗，却看见里面……

source: A single skeleton sitting in an armchair doing a book of sudokus?
target: 只有一副骷髅，坐在扶手椅里，拿着一本数独题在做？

source: Uh... where's the boss? Are YOU the boss?
target: 呃……首领呢？你就是首领？

source: The skeleton looks up at you over his spectacles and says, "Actually, I'm the landlord."
target: 骷髅从眼镜上方看了你一眼，说：“其实，我是房东。”

source: Oh, we get to fight a landlord? That's kinda cathartic!
target: 哦，能揍房东？那还挺解气的！

source: "I can't recommend fighting me. My special moves are 'call the cops' and 'sue for assault and battery.'"
target: “不建议跟我打。我的绝招是‘报警’和‘起诉故意伤害’。”

source: Seriously? But we didn't hack-and-slash our way through those ninety-nine other floors to NOT kick some dude's ass!
target: 真的假的？我们一路砍穿九十九层，可不是为了最后连个人都揍不着！

source: "Well, if it's a fight you want, you're in luck: there are actually TWO final bosses that you can choose from."
target: “要打架，那你们来得正好。这里其实有两位最终首领，可以选一位。”

source: "Due to the recession, lair-rental prices have gotten pretty steep, so this dungeon has been converted to a timeshare."
target: “经济不景气，巢穴租金涨得太高，这地牢就改成分时共用了。”

source: "I'd be happy to schedule a beatdown with either one of my tenants for you. Who do you want to fight?"
target: “我可以帮你们跟任意一位租客约架。想打谁？”

source: Dominaphel, the edgy fallen angel who draws power from their very complicated fashion choices and convoluted backstory.
target: 多米纳菲尔，中二堕天使。力量来自极其复杂的穿搭，以及绕到不行的身世。

source: Harry, Dungeon Middle Manager.
target: 哈利，地牢中层经理。

source: Dominaphel arrives with a swell of black-metal music and oiled-leather smell.
target: 黑金属音乐骤然响起，伴着上过油的皮革气味，多米纳菲尔登场了。

source: COWER, FILTHY SINNERS! Your damnation is sealed! I'm going to force you into submission, and there WON'T be a safeword.
target: 肮脏的罪人，颤抖吧！你们的毁灭已成定局！我要强迫你们臣服，而且没有安全词！

source: Okay, but... why? What's your motivation for being such an edgy antagonist?
target: 行，可是……为什么？你当这种中二反派，动机是什么？

source: Tch... I was once a servant of Heaven, as devout as the rest, until I became seduced by the power of the 666 Chaos Keys.
target: 嘁……我曾是天堂的仆从，跟其他人一样虔诚，直到被六百六十六把混沌之钥的力量诱惑。

source: My mother, the archdemon Plahthol, created the keys using drops of my fetal blood when I was raised in a holy laboratory to become the perfect weapon--
target: 我在神圣实验室里被培育成完美武器时，我的母亲，大恶魔普拉索尔，用我还是胎儿时的鲜血，造出了这些钥匙——

source: Wait, if your mom was a demon, shouldn't you be a demon too? Or at least half-demon? Actually, if you were raised in a lab, how do you have a mom at all?
target: 等等，你妈是恶魔，你不也该是恶魔？至少半个恶魔吧？而且都在实验室里长大了，怎么还会有妈？

source: DON'T INTERRUPT ME! Anyway, I became obsessed with using the Chaos Keys to unlock the Dimension Doors, which have been sealed for centuries.
target: 别打断！总之，我痴迷于用混沌之钥，开启那些封印了几个世纪的次元之门。

source: Once unlocked, they would free Plahthol and bring her power to its zenith, and she and I will rule this land of filthy sinners--
target: 一旦打开，就能释放普拉索尔，让她的力量达到巅峰。然后，她跟我就能统治这片罪人横行的土地——

source: No, wait, how can your mom be locked behind 666 separate doors? And how'd she access a lab to make you at all if she's imprisoned?
target: 不，等等，你妈怎么能被锁在六百六十六扇不同的门后？既然被囚禁，她又怎么进实验室造出你？

source: UGH, SHUT UP! You sound just like the angels in Heaven right before they threw me out for expositing on my confusing backstory 24/7!
target: 烦死了，闭嘴！你跟天堂那帮天使一模一样！就因为我一天到晚讲这复杂身世，他们就把我赶出来了！

source: I have a question: why do you wear so many belts, bro? They're not holding up pants or anything, so aren't they kinda pointless?
target: 我有个问题，兄弟，你为什么绑这么多皮带？又不拿来提裤子什么的，不是没用吗？

source: MY BEAUTIFUL LEATHER BELTS ARE THE ENTIRE POINT! THEIR EDGINESS GIVES ME POWER! YOU WOULDN'T UNDERSTAND!!!
target: 我漂亮的皮带，就是全部意义！它们的中二劲儿，就是我的力量！你们根本不懂！！！

source: Wait, you get your power FROM your belts? What happens if we cut them off?
target: 等等，力量来自皮带？那剪断会怎么样？

source: You grab a pair of scissors and find out it means that Dominaphel loses all their powers and dies. Sweet!
target: 你拿来剪刀，试出了答案：多米纳菲尔失去全部力量，死了。好耶！

source: You lost -N2 MIND trying to understand that clusterfuck of a backstory, but gained +N2 HYPE admiring Dominaphel's badass aesthetic!
target: 理解那团乱七八糟的身世，让你失去了-N2头脑，不过欣赏多米纳菲尔酷炫的造型，也让你获得了+N2热度！

source: An elevator appears in the center of the room. Harry steps out of it and takes a seat at a cubicle desk.
target: 房间中央出现一部电梯，哈利从里面走出，坐到一张格子间办公桌前。

source: Welcome to Dungeon Solutions Incorporated. Did you finish filling out those puzzle-efficacy spreadsheets? They were due this afternoon.
target: 欢迎来到地牢解决方案公司。谜题效能表填完了吗？今天下午就该交了。

source: Uh... we were never told to do that...?
target: 呃……可从来没人叫我们填啊……？

source: YES YOU WERE! I CC'd YOU IN THE EMAIL!
target: 叫过了！邮件抄送你们了！

source: You watch a health bar above your head lose 25 HP. FUCK!
target: 你看着头顶的血条，掉了25HP。操！

source: Well, did you send it after 5 p.m.? According to the Employee Grimoire, employees aren't responsible for checking or responding to emails during off-hours.
target: 那邮件是下午五点后发的吗？《员工魔典》规定，下班后没有查收、回复邮件的义务。

source: OOF!
target: 呃啊！

source: Thank God Polly has a plan -- and better yet, it's working! Harry's HP is going down!
target: 谢天谢地，波莉有办法，而且还真管用！哈利的血量往下掉了！

source: Fine, but I need those charts ASAP. You'll have to work through your lunch break to get them in on time.
target: 好吧，可那些图表我要尽快拿到。午休也得干，保证按时交。

source: You mean my UNION-MANDATED lunch break? You can't force me to do that!
target: 你是说，工会规定的午休？你可不能逼我放弃！

source: ARGH, FUCKIN' UNION!
target: 啊啊，该死的工会！

source: Harry's HP goes down even further!
target: 哈利的血量掉得更多了！

source: Harry, your reign of corporate terror has gone on long enough! Did you even approve Scott's PTO for this full moon?
target: 哈利，你这职场恐怖统治，该到头了！斯科特这次满月的带薪假，你批了吗？

source: He failed to submit a formal request! I don't have to honor that!
target: 他没提交正式申请，我没必要批准！

source: But it's for his lycanthropy! You legally have to accommodate for pre-existing conditions!
target: 可他有狼人症啊！既有病症，你依法就得提供便利！

source: AWOOOOO! I'M GOING TO HR!
target: 嗷呜——！我要找人事部！

source: NOOOOOOOO!
Harry's HP falls to zero, and a stack of employee-harassment reports the size of an anvil falls from the ceiling and squishes him. Hooray!
target: 哈利的血量归零，一摞铁砧那么大的员工骚扰投诉书从天而降，把他压扁了。万岁！

source: You lost -N2 HYPE entering the corporate hellscape, but earn +N2 MONEY from briefly working for Dungeon Solutions Incorporated.
target: 走进这片职场地狱，让你失去了-N2热度，不过短暂替地牢解决方案公司打工，也赚了+N2金钱。

source: Solve puzzles
target: 解开谜题

source: You and your friends enter the dungeon. Before you is a locked door, a big square hole in the floor, and a lever.
target: 你和朋友们走进地牢，面前有扇锁住的门，地上有个大方洞，旁边还有根拉杆。

source: Ah, this is one of those puzzle rooms. We gotta put our heads together and solve this conundrum!
target: 啊，这种解谜房间。得集思广益，把难题解开！

source: A big hole and a little pole... what could it mean?
target: 一个大洞，一根小杆……能是什么意思呢？

source: Uh, I'm pretty sure it's a lever. We're meant to flip it.
target: 呃，那明显是拉杆吧，就是让咱们扳的。

source: Nah, that's too obvious. It's a puzzle dungeon, boo; you gotta think outside the box!
target: 不，太明显了。宝贝，这可是解谜地牢，得跳出框框想！

source: Is it thinking outside the box if we dig the hole out more? Honestly, I'm kinda just psyched to dig a hole.
target: 那把洞再挖大点，算不算跳出框框？说实话，我就是有点想挖洞。

source: Hey, that's not a bad idea. Maybe the key's buried down there! Good thinking, Scott!
target: 嘿，好主意。没准钥匙就埋在下面！斯科特，想得好！

source: Fine. You help your friends dig out the big hole even more. It's hard work, and eventually Polly takes a minute to relax... by leaning on the lever.
target: 行吧。你帮朋友们把大洞又挖大了一圈。干活挺累，波莉终于想歇口气……就靠在了拉杆上。

source: Whoa, is there an earthquake?
target: 哇，地震了？

source: Nope. You look up to see some things that are similar to but legally distinct from Tetris pieces falling from the ceiling.
target: 没有。你抬起头，看见一些很像俄罗斯方块、但在法律上绝不相同的方块，从天花板掉了下来。

source: Ohhhh, I think we're supposed to arrange those pieces to fit in the hole.
target: 哦——应该是要把那些块拼起来，刚好填满洞吧。

source: It seems so obvious now... now that I hit the lever, anyway. Which was my plan from the get-go.
target: 现在看来好明显……至少在我碰了拉杆之后。反正我从一开始就是这么计划的。

source: Sure... you, Polly, and Scott arrange the pieces the way they should have been, but the amount dug out accidentally made the hole exactly one piece bigger.
target: 是是是……你、波莉和斯科特按原本的样子拼好方块，可刚才多挖的地方，恰好让洞多缺了一块。

source: So it's unsolvable now? Ugh, this can't get any worse!
target: 所以现在没解了？烦死了，不可能更糟了吧！

source: Oh yes it can! The door you came from slams shut, and the room is filled with the ticking of a timer counting down.
target: 当然还能！进来的门砰地关上，倒计时滴答声响彻房间。

source: Uh oh... what do you think happens when that reaches zero?
target: 糟了……你们说，数到零会怎么样？

source: God, who knows? Death? Death 2: SuperDeath? Something even worse than the sequel to death?!
target: 老天，谁知道？死亡？《死亡2：超级死亡》？还是比死亡续集更糟的东西？！

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, can you do that thing where you solve our problems in an unexpected way before we succumb to a horrible fate? The sooner the better!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，快像平时那样，用出人意料的办法解决问题，别让咱们死得太惨。越快越好！

source: It's time to put your yoga skills to use: do the "Missing Piece" asana.
target: 该用上瑜伽本事了：摆出“缺块式”。

source: Access the shop menu and see if this dungeon sells tips for puzzles or a "skip this level" option.
target: 打开商店菜单，看看能不能买谜题提示，或者“跳过本关”。

source: Ah, yes, those incredible yoga skills that you've definitely always had. You close your eyes and recall your training...
target: 啊，对，你那套一直都很厉害、绝不是突然冒出来的瑜伽本事。你闭上眼，回忆训练……

source: You attended the Wealthy White Women Monastery, where you achieved peace and enlightenment for four easy payments of $4,999.99.
target: 你曾在富有白人女性修道院求学，只需轻松分四期、每期付4999.99美元，就能获得平静与觉悟。

source: You spent your days on far-off, mystical lands of the West Coast, doing asanas and perfecting your technique at ordering a chai latte.
target: 那些日子，你在遥远、神秘的西海岸练瑜伽体式，精进点香料茶拿铁的技艺。

source: There, your yoga master (a man founded the WWWM after realizing that wealthy white women would spend any amount to glimpse enlightenment) gave you a pearl of wisdom:
target: 在那里，瑜伽大师赠你一句至理名言——他创办这修道院，是因为发现有钱白女为了窥见觉悟，花多少钱都肯。

source: "If you can't find the missing piece, consider that you ARE the missing piece. Namaste, or whatever."
target: “找不到缺的那一块时，想想看，或许你自己就是那一块。合十致敬什么的，随便啦。”

source: Back then, you thought it was just a vapid, vaguely-inspirational colloquialism... and honestly, it probably was.
target: 当时你觉得，这只是句空洞、勉强算励志的套话。说实话，大概也确实是。

source: But now your chakras have aligned, and all his teachings make sense! Or so you want to believe, for the amount of money you paid for them!
target: 可现在，你的脉轮对齐了，他教的一切都说得通了！至少花了那么多钱，你很想相信是这样！

source: You take a deep breath, stretch to your fullest height, and assume the Missing Piece asana.
target: 你深吸一口气，尽可能舒展开身体，摆出“缺块式”。

source: HOLY SHIT you are not nearly as flexible as you used to be. Your tendons feel like they're about to snap!
target: 我操，你已经远没有从前那么柔软了。筋都像快绷断了！

source: Whoa, check it out! %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% will perfectly fit in the slot now!
target: 哇，快看！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%现在正好能塞进空位！

source: Damn... let's go ahead and shove %HIMHER% in the empty slot so we can stop hearing %HISHER% screams of pain.
target: 我去……赶紧把%HIMHER%塞进空格，省得再听%HISHER%惨叫了。

source: Polly and Scott insert you in the empty slot before you get too many serious cramps, though you still lose -N2 STAMINA.
target: 波莉和斯科特赶在你严重抽筋之前，把你塞进了空格。不过，你还是失去了-N2体力。

source: But thankfully, the timer stops, and the puzzle is solved! You guys escape the level and gain +N2 MIND.
target: 幸好，倒计时停了，谜题解开！你们逃出关卡，获得了+N2头脑。

source: You cry out to any gods, demons, or GMs that might be listening: "PLEASE DON'T KILL US! WE'LL PAY TO ESCAPE! HEEELP!"
target: 你向一切可能听见的神、恶魔和游戏主持人呼救：“别杀我们！我们付钱买命！救——命——！”

source: Suddenly, the bits of bone scattered around that you thought were just scene dressing assemble into an animated skeleton!
target: 突然，周围那些被你当成布景的碎骨，拼成了一副活骷髅！

source: "Hello!" he says cheerfully. "I heard you wanted to buy a hint? Please, feel free to peruse this Ancient Tablet of Microtransactions."
target: 骷髅欢快地说：“您好！听说您想买提示？欢迎浏览这块古老的内购平板。”

source: "Ad-free dungeon experience, extra lives, exclusive limited edition skins, 'Get Out of Puzzle Free' cards..."
target: “无广告地牢体验、额外生命、独家限量皮肤、免费脱离谜题卡……”

source: Wait, you can pay to just skip the whole level? Why is that even for sale?
target: 等等，花钱就能直接跳过整关？这为什么也拿来卖？

source: "It makes the dungeon profitable! We used to be in the red, what with adventurers looting us all the time..."
target: “这样地牢才能赚钱啊！以前老被冒险者搜刮，我们一直亏损……”

source: "But with these premium options, we can profit and also provide a stimulating, +N2 MIND-enhancing puzzle experience, even for those who are... less intelligent."
target: “有了这些付费选项，我们既能赚钱，也能给那些……不太聪明的人，提供刺激又增长+N2头脑的解谜体验。”

source: Hey, what are you trying to say?! We aren't dumb! We're great at dungeons, right, Scott?
target: 喂，什么意思？！我们又不蠢！地牢可玩得好了，是吧，斯科特？

source: Huh? I wasn't paying attention. Look, I bought a top hat from the tablet! Do we win the puzzle now?
target: 啊？没注意听。看，我在平板上买了顶礼帽！现在算解开谜题了吗？

source: ...Fine, he's gotcha there. You pay -N2 MONEY to skip the level and get on with your lives.
target: ……好吧，这点他没说错。你付了-N2金钱，跳过关卡，继续过日子。

source: Family games
target: 家庭游戏

source: You and your friends knock on the front door of the manor and are received by a butler.
target: 你和朋友们敲响庄园正门，管家出来迎接。

source: "Greetings, guests," he says. "Are you here for game night?"
target: 他说：“客人们，欢迎。是来参加游戏之夜的吗？”

source: Sure! I love games! What are we playing?
target: 好啊！我喜欢游戏，玩什么？

source: "Let's find out," says the butler with an evil laugh.
target: 管家邪恶地笑着说：“来看看就知道了。”

source: This seems legit! You're led into a sitting room filled with rich people eating.
target: 听着挺靠谱！你们被领进一间客厅，里面坐满了正在吃饭的富人。

source: "Oh, Jeeves!" says the lady of the house. "You found fresh meat for the grinder. Sit, sit, you perfectly oblivious proletariats!"
target: 女主人说：“哦，吉夫斯！又找着能塞进绞肉机的鲜肉了。坐，坐啊，你们这些一无所知的无产者！”

source: "We were just finishing supper," say the creepy twin children in unison. "Do you like Second-Class Citizen Tar-tar?"
target: 瘆人的双胞胎异口同声：“我们正准备吃完晚餐呢。喜欢二等公民肉塔塔吗？”

source: Hmm, this tastes pretty familiar... like something Wolf Scott's eaten before. Except if I remember right, this flavor screamed when he bit into it.
target: 嗯，这味道很熟……好像狼形态的斯科特以前吃过。不过要是没记错，他咬下去时，这味道还会尖叫。

source: "Let's get to the game!" says the lady. "We've got a very special game planned tonight. Jeeves, fetch the box!"
target: 女主人说：“玩游戏吧！今晚特意安排了一款特别的游戏。吉夫斯，把盒子拿来！”

source: Jeeves returns with a tabletop game called "The Game of Life... AND DEATH!"
target: 吉夫斯拿来一款桌游，叫《人生游戏……还有死亡！》。

source: "Have you ever played?" ask the twins. "You move your piece across the path, and whatever directions are on the square you land on, you must complete."
target: 双胞胎问：“玩过吗？沿着路线移动棋子，停在哪格，就得完成那格的指示。”

source: "If you win, we can give you a monetary prize," says the lord of the house. "Money is the only thing we understand as a token of appreciation."
target: 男主人说：“赢了，我们会给奖金。要表达谢意，我们只懂得用钱。”

source: These are some weird-ass squares. Like, "The player to your left can cut off up to three of your fingers?" "You must spend 10 minutes in the Murder Room?"
target: 这些格子怪得要命。比如“左手边的玩家可以砍掉你最多三根手指”？“必须在谋杀室待十分钟”？

source: It's okay, there's some good squares too! This one says if you land on it, you get to eat a banana!
target: 没事，也有好格子！这格说，走到这里就能吃根香蕉！

source: Look closer. It says, "You must eat a POISONED banana."
target: 仔细看，写的是“必须吃一根有毒的香蕉”。

source: That's bad, Scott.
target: 那是坏事，斯科特。

source: Oh!
target: 哦！

source: "Well, if you don't like this game, we can play sports," the lord says. "But be advised, 'sports' for rich families is just hunting poor people with crossbows."
target: 男主人说：“不喜欢桌游，也能搞体育。不过先说明，富人家的‘体育’，就是拿弩猎杀穷人。”

source: Fine, board game it is. Looks like you're up first. You roll a 5 and come to a fork in the road. Which square do you decide to land on?
target: 好吧，那还是桌游。看来你先来。你掷出5点，走到岔路口。停在哪一格？

source: All your original business ideas are now the intellectual property of the player to your right.
target: 你的所有原创商业点子，其知识产权现在全归右手边的玩家所有。

source: Lose 1 moral principle of your choice.
target: 自选1条道德原则，丢掉它。

source: Noooo, not your business ideas, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! Those were your only chance of succeeding in life after high school!
target: 不——！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你的商业点子！那可是你高中毕业后，人生取得成功的唯一指望！

source: "Too bad! Now your ideas are mine!" cackles Uncle Wilbur. "Stealing other's ideas during the Game of Life... AND DEATH is how I made my fortune! Go on, spill!"
target: 威尔伯叔叔咯咯笑道：“真遗憾！现在点子归我了！玩《人生游戏……还有死亡！》偷别人的创意，可是我的发家之道！快，说来听听！”

source: You pitch your million-dollar idea: "A social media network for dogs."
target: 你提出那个能值百万的点子：“专供狗狗使用的社交平台。”

source: ...On second thought, maybe this isn't much of a loss for %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: ……仔细一想，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%也许没损失多少。

source: No, hear me out! Dogs are social creatures, right? But what if their owners are too busy or lazy to take them to the dog park and meet other dogs?
target: 不，听我说完！狗是群居动物，对吧？可主人要是太忙、太懒，没空带它们去狗公园交朋友呢？

source: A social network for dogs would let dogs mingle with their kind without ever leaving home.
target: 有了狗狗社交平台，它们不用出家门，就能跟同类交往。

source: It's the perfect solution to the problem dog owners don't even know they have!
target: 主人根本没意识到自己有这个问题，而我提供了完美的解决办法！

source: "I love it!" cries Wilbur. "Convincing people our products solve problems they don't know they have is an excellent business model."
target: 威尔伯叫道：“我喜欢！让人相信，我们能解决他们根本没发现的问题，多棒的商业模式！”

source: "There's a lot of potential here. Dogs are certainly popular. Why, they're even the face of some cryptocurrencies!"
target: “潜力巨大。狗确实受欢迎，有些加密货币，甚至拿狗当招牌！”

source: "Come to think of it, let's add a feature to the social network allowing dogs to buy stocks. If dogs start making money, that's a whole new demographic to market to!"
target: “想起来了，再给平台加个功能，让狗能买股票。狗要是开始赚钱，咱们就多了一整个新的消费群体！”

source: "Maybe we can even make this network worse for the environment! That's how you make the big bucks: killing the planet better and faster!"
target: “没准还能把这平台做得更不环保！想赚大钱，就得更好、更快地毁掉地球！”

source: "Add NFTs!" the twins suggest. "The uglier, the better! That's how they sell!"
target: 双胞胎提议：“加上NFT！越丑越好，那样才卖得动！”

source: "We could make a whole WEB of pet-centric social medias!" the lady says. "Like cats, gerbils, birds... and we could call it 'The Petaverse!'"
target: 女主人说：“可以建一整张以宠物为中心的社交网络！猫、沙鼠、鸟……就叫‘宠物元宇宙’！”

source: You and your friends slip out as the evil millionaires break into a musical number about the joys of controlling the internet and monetizing counterculture.
target: 邪恶的富豪们唱起歌舞曲，赞颂控制互联网、把反主流文化变现的乐趣。你和朋友们趁机溜走。

source: You lose -N2 MIND because your innocent dog social media idea has been forever tainted and lost. But you do get +N2 MONEY for selling the rights!
target: 你那个单纯的狗狗社交点子，就此被永远玷污、夺走，让你失去了-N2头脑。不过卖掉版权，也赚了+N2金钱！

source: "Ooh, excellent choice!" the lady of the house giggles. "We all try to land on that square at some point during the game. It's tradition."
target: 女主人咯咯笑道：“哦，选得好！我们玩的时候，都得找机会走到这格，传统嘛。”

source: "Just last week, I lost my moral principle against mistreating my employees," says the lord.
target: 男主人说：“就在上周，我放弃了‘不虐待员工’这条道德原则。”

source: "I remember that, sir," sighs Jeeves, who you've just noticed is wearing iron manacles around his ankles chaining him to several rabid dogs.
target: 吉夫斯叹气：“记得，先生。”你这才注意到，他脚踝上戴着铁镣，锁链另一端还拴着几条疯狗。

source: "I gave up my principle against stealing!" says Uncle Wilbur, who is now wearing your clothes.
target: 威尔伯叔叔说：“我放弃了‘不偷东西’。”他现在穿的，正是你的衣服。

source: "We gave up our principles against conducting horrific physical experiments on commoners," say the twins, smiling in unison.
target: 双胞胎一起笑着说：“我们放弃了‘不拿平民做可怕的人体实验’。”

source: "A few years ago, I gave up my moral obligation to let common folk experience the color 'blurple'!" titters the lady of the house.
target: 女主人轻笑：“几年前，我还放弃了‘应该让平民也能见识布噜紫’这项道德义务！”

source: So THAT'S why I can't identify what color scarf you're wearing!
target: 难怪我叫不出你那条围巾的颜色！

source: "So, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, what moral will you be giving up? 'Don't steal people's data?' 'Don't convince commoners that spaghetti isn't made of people?'"
target: “那么，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你要放弃什么原则？‘不偷个人资料’？还是‘不骗平民说意面不是用人做的’？”

source: I think I'll give up my moral stance against eating other people to assert your power.
target: 那我就放弃“不能靠吃别人来彰显权力”这个道德立场吧。

source: "That's a good one!" Uncle Wilbur says. "It'll make the fact that we fed you ground-up monster meat for dinner more bearable, I'm sure."
target: 威尔伯叔叔说：“选得好！刚才晚餐我们喂你吃的，全是怪物肉末，这下你一定更能接受了。”

source: You knew it! You gain +N2 MONEY for winning, and now you have no qualms saying that dinner was delicious... but still, condoning cannibalism costs you -N2 SOUL.
target: 你就知道！赢了游戏，你获得了+N2金钱，现在也能毫无负担地承认，晚饭确实好吃……不过认可食人，仍让你失去了-N2灵魂。

source: Grandpa's fun experiments
target: 爷爷的趣味实验

source: You and your friends ring the manor doorbell, and a wealthy woman dressed in furs answers.
target: 你和朋友们按响庄园门铃，一个披着皮草的富婆来开门。

source: "Oh, hello!" she says. "Are you here to look after Grandpa?"
target: 她说：“哦，你们好！是来照顾爷爷的吗？”

source: Oh, uh, we're not trained to care for old people really--
target: 哦，呃，我们可没受过照顾老人的训练——

source: "I don't care. He's driving me nuts; I'll give you +N2 MONEY to look after him. Follow me."
target: “我不在乎。他快把我烦死了，给你们+N2金钱，帮我看着他。跟我来。”

source: Uh... okay. You're taken into a dark, shadowy basement where you find an old man using a circular saw.
target: 呃……行吧。她把你们带到昏暗的地下室，里面有个老头，正摆弄着一把圆锯。

source: Oh, visitors! Come in, come in! So nice to meet you!
target: 哦，来客人了！进来，进来！见到你们真高兴！

source: Nice to meet you too, Gramps... you sure have a lot of old Splash Kaboom games lying around down here...
target: 我们也很高兴，爷爷……您这儿放了好多旧的《水花大爆炸》游戏啊……

source: Oh, I have much more than just the game! I'm the biggest Splash Kaboom fan in the world! Let me show you some of my work.
target: 何止游戏！我可是世界头号《水花大爆炸》粉丝！来，看看我的作品。

source: This is Crimson Darkheart, my original Splash Kaboom character. He's Splash's best friend and oozes class, sass, and radical charm.
target: 这是绯红·暗心，我原创的《水花大爆炸》角色。他是水花最好的朋友，浑身都是品位、俏皮劲儿和酷炫魅力。

source: I see. This design is certainly, uh... creative.
target: 明白了。这个设计，呃……确实很有创意。

source: Yes, isn't Crimson amazing? He's just the sort of guy you'd like to know in real life, don't you think? Maybe someday, heh heh...
target: 是吧，绯红很棒吧？现实中要是认识这么个人，多好啊，你们说呢？没准哪天就能，嘿嘿……

source: And this is Crimson's loyal steed, Excelsior the Ghostwolf! All the best OCs have minor OCs attached to them, to build lore.
target: 这是绯红的忠实坐骑，幽灵狼埃克塞尔西奥！优秀的原创角色，都得配些小原创角色，丰富世界观。

source: This is a really weird-looking horse...
target: 这马长得可真怪……

source: You know... you kids are remarkably similar to Excelsior, almost as if you're two halves of his whole body...
target: 你们知道吗……你俩跟埃克塞尔西奥特别像，简直像各占了它身体的一半……

source: As if God put you in my lab so that I may stitch you together and make my incredible steed a reality!
target: 就像上帝把你们送进我的实验室，让我把你俩缝起来，让这匹绝妙的坐骑变成现实！

source: Pump the brakes, Gramps! Loving your OCs is one thing, but doing amateur surgery to bring your OCs to life is a step too far!
target: 打住，爷爷！喜欢自己的原创角色是一回事，靠业余手术把他们变成活物，可就过头了！

source: Shh, don't worry, it'll all be over soon. Stay here, I'm going to get my forceps!
target: 嘘，别担心，很快就结束了。待在这儿，我去拿手术钳！

source: (Psst, Polly, is it just me, or this is starting to get weird?)
target: （嘘，波莉，是我的错觉，还是事情开始不太对劲了？）

source: (No SHIT it's getting weird. Grandpa wants to stitch us together into a cursed OC chimera!)
target: （废话，当然不对劲！爷爷想把咱俩缝成他那受诅咒的原创缝合怪！）

source: (I love you guys, but I'm not spending the rest of my unlife sewn to Scott's butt. We need to escape, but we'll need a distraction...)
target: （我爱你们，可不想死后余生都跟斯科特的屁股缝在一起。得跑，先想办法分散他注意力……）

source: Tell Grandpa to explain in great detail the good ol' days... of Splash's early seasons.
target: 请爷爷详细回忆美好的旧时光……也就是《水花大爆炸》早期的那几季。

source: Do your best to teach him how to use the internet. That's where Splash lives!
target: 尽力教会他上网，水花就住在网上！

source: Yeah, that'll probably work. HEY, GRANDPA! Can you tell me in five minutes or less why you like Splash so much?
target: 嗯，应该行。嘿，爷爷！能不能用五分钟以内的时间，说说您为什么这么喜欢水花？

source: Oh, I couldn't possibly fit my glorious evaluation of Splash Kaboom in those time constraints, but I'll try!
target: 哦，这点时间可装不下我对《水花大爆炸》的精彩评论，不过我试试！

source: I've loved Splash since I was a boy. Splash and his friends felt like MY friends, and making characters in their world was my ultimate fantasy escape.
target: 我从小就喜欢水花。水花和他的朋友，就像是我的朋友。在他们的世界里创造角色，是我逃进幻想的终极方式。

source: Sadly, the franchise took a nosedive in the 80s when the creator killed off Toots, the best character. Fans were so incensed, we trampled that fucker in the streets!
target: 可惜，八十年代，创作者把最棒的角色嘟嘟写死，整个系列就一落千丈。粉丝气疯了，在街上踩那混蛋！

source: Yes, I was there! I held the bastard's head down while a man in full Toots cosplay slit his throat! Ahh, memories...
target: 对，我也在场！我按着那混账的脑袋，另一个全套扮成嘟嘟的人割了他的喉！啊，美好的回忆……

source: But since then, they've been pushing a stupid agenda with Splash, like 'friendship is magic' and 'you shouldn't behead creators because you disagree with their ideas', ugh.
target: 可那以后，他们开始往水花里塞蠢理念，什么“友谊就是魔法”“不能因为不同意创作者的想法，就把他砍头”，呸。

source: Back in my day, Splash didn't shove any of that P.C. crap in your face! The comics were bloody, the characters were sexy, it was a dream!
target: 我们那时候，水花可不会把政治正确那套屁话怼你脸上！漫画血腥，角色性感，简直跟做梦一样！

source: The new writers aren't brave enough to do Splash right -- the way *I* would do it! I say, GIVE SPLASH KABOOM'S TITS BACK!
target: 新编剧没胆子把水花写好——照我的方式写！我说，把水花大爆炸的奶子还回来！

source: Okay, I've had enough of this explanation -- I'm losing -N2 HYPE by the second. SCOTT, NOW!
target: 够了，这解释我受不了了，热度都在一秒一秒掉，损失-N2热度。斯科特，动手！

source: Scott hits Grandpa across the head with a chair, knocking him unconscious. You all run for the exit!
target: 斯科特抡起椅子砸中爷爷的头，把他打晕。你们拔腿就往出口跑！

source: Wait, bros, this isn't the way out. This is a dungeon or something...
target: 等等，兄弟们，这不是出口，好像是什么地牢……

source: From the shadowy corner of the room, a bleeding, shambling, stitched-together creature trudges toward you...
target: 房间的阴暗角落里，一个浑身流血、拼缝而成的生物，拖着身子朝你们走来……

source: Help... me...
target: 救……救我……

source: AHHHHHHH! WHAT THE KENTUCKY FRIED FUCK IS THAT?!
target: 啊啊啊！这他妈的肯德基油炸怪物是什么东西？！

source: You guys gotta go... fast!
target: 你们得……快跑！

source: The exit's... up the stairs! Hurry... before... you end up like me!
target: 出口……在楼梯上面！快……别变得……跟我一样！

source: Never have you ever fled a room so fast. Time to repress this whole traumatic experience for your own sanity! Yay, road trip!
target: 你这辈子没跑这么快过。为了自己的理智，赶紧把这整段创伤记忆封存起来！耶，公路旅行！

source: That should work! HEY, GRANDPA! Do you wanna meet Splash for real?
target: 应该行！嘿，爷爷！想不想见到真正的水花？

source: Are you kidding?! That would be my dream! Do you know where he is?!
target: 开什么玩笑？！那可是我的梦想！你们知道他在哪儿？！

source: He lives in the magical, digital world we call... THE INTERNET. Have you heard of it?
target: 他住在一个神奇的数字世界，我们称之为……互联网。听过吗？

source: Oh, that place where young folks go to invent new genders? That's all a bit beyond me...
target: 哦，年轻人发明新性别的那个地方？我可搞不懂那些……

source: Not anymore! %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% here is terminally online; %HESHE%'ll show you the ropes. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, help Gramps set up an AO4 account.
target: 现在能懂了！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%是个重度网瘾患者，%HESHE%来带您入门。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，帮爷爷注册个AO4账号。

source: So pass the most frustrating 20 minutes of your life as you try to explain to Grandpa how to open his browser window.
target: 接下来，你试着向爷爷解释怎么打开浏览器窗口，熬过了人生中最抓狂的二十分钟。

source: You want me to open the window? Is it so Splash can enter through the window?
target: 你让我开窗？这样水花就能从窗户进来了？

source: No! I mean the window on his computer! You just need to click on the browser icon--
target: 不是！我说电脑上的窗口！点一下浏览器图标就——

source: Click? What is click? Splash doesn't make clicking sounds. His voice is radical and devil-may-care!
target: 点？什么叫点？水花可不会发出咔哒声，他的嗓音又酷又桀骜不驯！

source: Okay, that's enough distractions -- one more second of this and I'm gonna lose my -N2 MIND. SCOTT, NOW!
target: 行，分散得够久了。再多一秒，我都得损失-N2头脑。斯科特，动手！

source: Scott hits Grandpa across the head with a chair, knocking him unconscious. You all run for the exit!
target: 斯科特抡起椅子砸中爷爷的头，把他打晕。你们拔腿就往出口跑！

source: Wait, bros, this isn't the way out. This is a dungeon or something...
target: 等等，兄弟们，这不是出口，好像是什么地牢……

source: From the shadowy corner of the dungeon, a bleeding, shambling, stitched-together creature trudges toward you...
target: 地牢的阴暗角落里，一个浑身流血、拼缝而成的生物，拖着身子朝你们走来……

source: Help... me...
target: 救……救我……

source: AHHHHHHH! WHAT THE KENTUCKY FRIED FUCK IS THAT?!
target: 啊啊啊！这他妈的肯德基油炸怪物是什么东西？！

source: You guys gotta go... fast!
target: 你们得……快跑！

source: The exit's... up the stairs! Hurry... before... you end up like me!
target: 出口……在楼梯上面！快……别变得……跟我一样！

source: Never have you ever fled a room so fast. Time to repress this whole traumatic experience for your own sanity! Yay, road trip!
target: 你这辈子没跑这么快过。为了自己的理智，赶紧把这整段创伤记忆封存起来！耶，公路旅行！

source: Babysitting the children
target: 照看孩子

source: You and your friends ring the manor's doorbell. A wealthy middle-aged woman answers and says, "Oh, hello! Are you the babysitters?"
target: 你们按响庄园门铃，一个有钱的中年女人来开门：“哦，你们好！是保姆吗？”

source: Nope! We're just a couple friends on a wacky road trip that decided to stop by and--
target: 不是！我们就是几个朋友，在疯狂的公路旅行中，决定顺路来——

source: "Hush, hush. Answer this question: are you disgustingly rich?"
target: “嘘，嘘。先回答我：你们有钱到令人发指吗？”

source: Uh... no?
target: 呃……没有？

source: "Then let me stop you right there. If you're not rich, you'll be whatever I want you to be. You want your +N2 MONEY, don't you?"
target: “那就别说了。没钱，我要你们是什么，你们就是什么。还想要+N2金钱，对吧？”

source: Well, I'm not gonna say no to free money.
target: 好吧，白送的钱，我可不拒绝。

source: "Perfect, then you ARE the babysitters. You've arrived in the nick of time -- it's almost time for our second-class-citizen crossbow hunt!"

target: “不过这无关紧要。对预测干扰最大的，是毕古先生庞大的飞盘收藏。”

target: 对，他可是头号飞盘迷！眨眼！

source: "He's hoarded so many Frisbees, I'm predicting that it'll destabilize the inflation of Frisbee products and lead to economic collapse in 15 years."
target: “他囤了太多飞盘，预计会扰乱飞盘产品的通货膨胀，十五年后引发经济崩溃。”

source: "With that, could you please leave? I need to focus all my computational power on researching Ahab Hugh Baddocks' upcoming Frisbee crisis."
target: “所以，可以请你们离开吗？我得集中全部算力，研究沃尤·巨·毕古即将引发的飞盘危机。”
