target: 你们离开了。搞出这么棒的恶作剧，让你获得了+N6热度。不过整电脑显然也算缺德，让你失去了-N3灵魂。

source: True AI
target: 真正的人工智能

source: You walk into a room full of elegant people. There's a pianist, waiters serving sushi, and... some engineers taking notes?
target: 你走进一间满是体面宾客的房间。有人弹钢琴，侍者端着寿司穿梭，还有……几个工程师在记笔记？

source: "Ah, guests!" says one engineer. "Welcome to the showcase of our latest invention: an AI that can pass for a regular monster!"
target: 一个工程师说：“啊，客人！欢迎看我们的最新发明，能完美冒充普通怪物的AI！”

source: "We're actually doing a publicity stunt right now. There's one robot in the room with us. If you can correctly guess who it is, you'll win a cash prize."
target: “正在办宣传活动呢。房间里藏着一个机器人，猜对是谁，就有现金奖。”

source: Whoa, that's crazy! Polly, are you the robot?
target: 哇，真厉害！波莉，你是机器人吗？

source: I don't think so. I can dance a mean robot, but that doesn't mean I AM one.
target: 应该不是。我是会跳很厉害的机械舞，可也不等于我就是机器人啊。

source: What about you, Scott? Are you the robot?
target: 那你呢，斯科特？你是机器人？

source: I dunno... can a robot be a good boy?
target: 不知道……机器人能当乖狗狗吗？

source: If it was programmed that way, sure.
target: 程序这么写的话，当然能。

source: Really? Then maybe I AM the robot!
target: 真的？那我没准就是机器人！

source: I can't believe I have to say this, but no, Scott isn't the robot.
target: 真没想到这也得解释：不是，斯科特不是机器人。

source: How do you know that, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? Are YOU the robot?!
target: 你怎么知道，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%？难道你才是机器人？！

source: No! None of us are the robot, obviously!
target: 不是！咱们几个明显都不是！

source: Sounds like something a robot would say... I'll let it go for now, but you're on thin fuckin' ice.
target: 听着就像机器人会说的话……先放你一马，不过你他妈可小心点。

source: Well if none of us are the robot, how are we gonna figure out who here IS the robot?
target: 既然都不是，要怎么找出真正的机器人呢？

source: Pretend to be dismayed by every conversation you hold, as an excuse to throw your drink over your interlocutor as a sign of strong disapproval.
target: 不管聊什么，都假装大受冒犯，借机朝对方泼酒，表示强烈不满。

source: Start conversations on topics that would be hard for a cold logical mind to truly comprehend and see who cracks first.
target: 聊些冷冰冰的逻辑头脑难以理解的话题，看谁先崩溃。

source: That's an AMAZING plan. Nothing could possibly go wrong with this plan. Let's do it!
target: 这计划太棒了，绝对不会出半点问题。干！

source: Hello, ma'am! What are your thoughts on the 1974 "Double Choice" infrastructure bill?
target: 您好，女士！怎么看1974年的“双重选择”基础设施法案？

source: "What?" asks the surprised woman. "I don't know. I'm not even familiar with that bill."
target: 女人惊讶地问：“什么？不知道，我连这法案都没听过。”

source: You mean you've never taken an interest in civic planning?! Take a more active role in the community, dammit!
target: 所以你从不关心市政规划？！他妈的，多参与社区事务啊！

source: Polly throws her martini in the lady's face. She doesn't short-circuit or anything, so you get a refill and move onto the next person.
target: 波莉把马天尼泼到她脸上。她没短路，你们又续上酒，找下一个人。

source: Hi there, sir! Do you let your dogs sit on the sofa?
target: 您好，先生！你让狗狗上沙发吗？

source: "I don't have any dogs, actually. I'm more of a cat person--"
target: “其实我不养狗，我比较喜欢猫——”

source: YOU DON'T LIKE DOGS?! THE NERVE! GET MARTINI'D!
target: 你不喜欢狗？！好大的胆子！吃我一杯马天尼！

source: "Oh, God," says the next person you approach. "You're going to throw your drinks on me, aren't you?"
target: 下一位见你们靠近，说：“老天，你们也要朝我泼酒，对吧？”

source: Why would you even assume that? RUDE!
target: 凭什么这么猜？没礼貌！

source: Polly throws her drink in his face. And in several other people's faces. About forty minutes of doing this later...
target: 波莉把酒泼到他脸上，又泼了好几个人。如此这般，大约四十分钟后……

source: ...You think robotics should focus on building water-proof robots? Who are you to speak on what the whole field of robotics should do?! THE NERVE!
target: ……你觉得机器人领域该专注防水机器人？整个行业该干嘛，轮得到你指手画脚？！好大的胆子！

source: You throw your drinks on the man. He short-circuits, and his head explodes into a pile of wires and metal bits.
target: 你们泼过去，他短路了，脑袋炸开，电线和金属碎片散了一地。

source: ...Did we just kill someone?
target: ……咱们刚杀人了吗？

source: Don't think about that! WE FOUND THE ROBOT!
target: 别想那个！机器人找到了！

source: Hooray! You're awarded +N2 MONEY, but you lose -N2 STAMINA from throwing all your martinis on people instead of drinking them.
target: 万岁！你获得了+N2金钱，不过马天尼全泼别人，没喝进肚里，让你失去了-N2体力。

source: You three approach a group of socialites sitting on some sofas and talking.
target: 你们走向一群坐在沙发上聊天的社交名流。

source: "It's just so tragic," one woman is saying. "Mother's illness has progressed to the point of no return. The doctors say she only has a few weeks left..."
target: 一名女人说：“实在太难过了。妈妈的病已经无法挽回，医生说只剩几个星期……”

source: Fuck that noise. You should try healing crystals. Everyone knows illnesses are caused by a buildup of bad vibes.
target: 别听那些屁话。试试疗愈水晶。谁不知道，生病就是坏气场积出来的。

source: Just rub some clear quartz on her forehead and you'll suck those shitty vibes right out!
target: 拿点白水晶，在她额头揉一揉，坏气场不就吸出来了！

source: "That makes sense," say the socialites. "Healthcare is free in most of the world, but healing crystals aren't, and everyone knows expensive things are always better!"
target: 名流们说：“有道理。世上多数地方医疗免费，疗愈水晶却要花钱。谁不知道，贵的总是更好！”

source: You notice one rich man not taking part in the conversation. He's being strangely quiet...
target: 你注意到一个富人没参与聊天，安静得有点奇怪……

source: You could also try putting your mom on an all raw-meat diet! The muscular bros I watch on YooToob say fermented liver gets all the toxins out of their biceps.
target: 还可以让妈妈全吃生肉！我在YooToob看的肌肉兄弟说，发酵肝脏能排掉二头肌的毒素。

source: The man is being noticeably quiet now. You think you see smoke coming from his ears.
target: 那人现在明显沉默了。你觉得，好像有烟从他耳朵里冒出来。

source: "I'm all for trying anything to help Mother," says the woman, "but what if the crystals and the raw liver don't work?"
target: 女人说：“为了妈妈，什么都愿意试。可水晶和生肝都没用呢？”

source: Hmmm... well, it's like I always say: when in doubt, turn to the power of prayer.
target: 嗯……正如我常说的，有疑问，就靠祈祷的力量。

source: Why don't we join hands and pray right now? "Our Father, who art in Heaven, hallowed be thy--"
target: 来，手拉手，现在就祈祷。“我们在天上的父，愿你的名被尊为——”

source: BOOM! The quiet man's head explodes and showers everyone in twisted metal.
target: 轰！沉默男人的脑袋炸了，扭曲的金属溅了大家一身。

source: Oh no, our prayer made that guy die! Was he Satan?
target: 糟了，祈祷把他害死了！他是撒旦吗？

source: Only if the Devil is a robot! We did it, gang!
target: 除非魔鬼是机器人！伙计们，成了！

source: You win +N2 MONEY for finding the robot! But you lose -N2 MIND for resorting to illogical tactics to do it.
target: 找出机器人，你赢了+N2金钱。不过用了这么不讲逻辑的办法，也失去了-N2头脑。

source: The metaverse
target: 元宇宙

source: You find a lab labeled "Metaverse Testing Chamber." The scientists staffing it are VERY eager to have you test their new tech.
target: 你发现一间挂着“元宇宙测试室”牌子的实验室。科学家们热情得过头，非要你们试新技术。

source: Wow, you guys are offering us a lot of money to test this Metaverse thing... is it safe?
target: 哇，测试这元宇宙，你们给这么多钱……安全吗？

source: "Yes, it's safe!" they say. "You can't get stuck in the Metaverse unless you're very, very stupid. But that's not the case, right?"
target: 他们说：“安全！除非蠢到家了，否则不会困在里面。你们不会这么蠢吧？”

source: Um... no comment.
target: 呃……无可奉告。

source: This might be dangerous, but on the other hand, free money! You put on some goggles and have your consciousnesses uploaded to the digital Metaverse.
target: 可能危险，可钱是白送的啊！你戴上设备，把意识上传进数字元宇宙。

source: Wow, this Metaverse place looks... exactly like the real world.
target: 哇，这元宇宙看着……跟现实一模一样。

source: "Yes, but it's DIGITAL!" say the other Metaverse test subjects surrounding you. "We're playing a game of dominoes. Wanna join in?"
target: 旁边的测试者们说：“没错，但这是数字的！我们在玩多米诺骨牌，一起？”

source: Why? I've never had the urge to play dominoes in the first place.
target: 为什么？我本来就没想玩多米诺骨牌啊。

source: "But now you can play dominoes IN THE METAVERSE! It's very subversive and cool!"
target: “可现在能在元宇宙里玩！多颠覆，多酷！”

source: Pass. Why don't you tell me more about those floating otters you've got on strings?
target: 算了。说说你们拿绳牵着的那些漂浮水獭吧？

source: "We Metaverseans collect them!" the strangers explain. "For every five floating otters you collect in the Metaverse, you can trade them for 100 confettis."
target: 陌生人解释：“我们元宇宙人收集这个！五只漂浮水獭，就能换100片彩纸屑。”

source: But why do you want confettis?
target: 可为什么要彩纸屑？

source: "Because with 10,000 confettis you can buy a unique set of eyebrows. Unique eyebrows are greatly coveted in the Metaverse. They've become a speculative market."
target: “因为一万片彩纸屑，就能买一套独一无二的眉毛。独特眉毛在元宇宙可抢手了，已经成投机市场了。”

source: Ugh, leave it to the internet to make EVERYTHING a speculative market. This Metaverse meta-sucks.
target: 烦，互联网真能把什么都搞成投机市场。元宇宙简直是元级垃圾。

source: "Sheesh, SOMEONE'S a critic," the Metaverseans scoff. "If you don't like it around here, why don't you make your own Metaverse?"
target: 元宇宙人嗤笑：“哟，还挺会挑。不喜欢，干嘛不自己做个元宇宙？”

source: Well, I'm not tech-savvy enough to do that, but you just gave me a great idea!
target: 技术我倒是没那么懂，可你给了我个好主意！

source: Or it could be a horrible idea. We'll find out on the way!
target: 也可能是烂主意，走着看！

source: Polly leads you and Scott to the Metaverse version of the lab you were in, where you put on the digital headsets and enter the METAMETAVERSE!
target: 波莉带你和斯科特来到这实验室的元宇宙版本，戴上数字头显，进入元元宇宙！

source: It's so dark in here. Where are all the people? Are we in the Bad Place?
target: 这儿好黑，人都去哪了？咱们进坏地方了？

source: "Psst! Hey! You!" whispers a shady guy in a trenchcoat. "Wanna buy some illegal eyebrows?"
target: 一个穿风衣的可疑家伙小声招呼：“嘘！嘿，你！买非法眉毛吗？”

source: Sure!
target: 当然!

source: NO, SCOTT! Don't do it; we don't know where those eyebrows have been!
target: 不行，斯科特！别买，谁知道那些眉毛以前都在哪儿待过！

source: This place is too dark. We need to go deeper!
target: 这地方太阴暗了，得再深一层！

source: You upload yourselves to the Metametametaverse, and now I'm stopping the bit where I add another "meta" every time 'cause if I don't this is gonna get annoying.
target: 你们上传进元元元宇宙。好了，接下来我不每次都多加一个“元”了，再加就烦了。

source: Cool, new look! What do you think, Polly? Is it too much?
target: 酷，新造型！波莉，怎么样？会不会太夸张？

source: Nope! It's just the right amount of much!
target: 不会！夸张得刚刚好！

source: "WHOA!" gasps a nearby Metaversean, grabbing a rusty razor. "HEY, EVERYBODY! NEW EYEBROWS JUST DROPPED!"
target: 旁边一个元宇宙人抓起生锈的剃刀，惊呼：“哇！各位，新眉毛上线啦！”

source: SHIT! RUN TO THE NEXT METAVERSE!
target: 操！快跑，下一个元宇宙！

source: Whoa! Were-otter Scott!
target: 哇，水獭人斯科特！

source: I can't twerk in these physical conditions! Keep going deeper!
target: 这身体还怎么扭臀！继续往深处走！

source: Oof, I feel weird and squishy. Have I been slacking at the gym without knowing it?
target: 唉，感觉又怪又软乎乎。我是不是不知不觉偷懒，没好好健身？

source: THIS is the third dimension everyone keeps hyping up? I'm not a fan. Go deeper!
target: 这就是大家吹上天的第三维度？不喜欢。再往下！

source: So it goes for countless Metaverses. They get progressively weirder and weirder until you find yourself in a black void.
target: 就这样，穿过无数越来越怪的元宇宙，直到你置身漆黑虚空。

source: Hello? Is anybody there?
target: 有人吗？谁在那儿？

source: "Hey!" someone says, running up to you. "Thank goodness I found someone else! I thought I was all alone in here!"
target: 一个人跑来说：“嘿！谢天谢地，终于找到别人了，还以为就我一个人！”

source: Where is everything? Are we still in the Metaverse?
target: 东西都哪儿去了？还在元宇宙里吗？

source: "Yup. I've been stuck here for... well, I don't even know how long. Time flows differently in the Metametametametametametametametaverse."
target: “对，我困这儿……唉，都不知道多久了。元元元元元元元元宇宙里，时间流逝不一样。”

source: "So, since we're stuck in here together for all eternity, do you wanna play some dominoes?"
target: “既然得永远困在一起，玩点多米诺骨牌怎么样？”

source: NOOOOOOOO!
You gotta get out of here! But you're in too deep to find an easy exit... so how will you break free of the Metaverse?
target: 得出去！可深入这么多层，哪有现成出口……怎么逃离元宇宙？

source: Do something very unethical to get banned from ALL Metaverses. Something completely out of line, like... a raunchy dance. BUT LIKE A VERY RAUNCHY DANCE.
target: 干点大逆不道的事，让所有元宇宙把你封禁。比如……跳艳舞。特别、特别下流的那种。

source: Keep escaping forward! Dig deeper into Metaverses no matter what until you somehow solve this situation.
target: 继续往前逃！不管怎样，往更深的元宇宙钻，直到莫名其妙解决问题。

source: Fuck yeah! We'll solve this with the power of asses that won't quit! Follow my lead!
target: 爽！靠我们这让人看不够的好屁股，解决一切！跟我来！

source: Polly teaches you the raunchiest dance moves she knows, like "The Wet Koala" and "The Expired Burrito in my Tummy" and "Twerking 2: Revenge of the Twerk."
target: 波莉教你她最下流的舞步，比如“湿考拉”“过期卷饼在我肚子里”，还有“扭臀2：翘臀复仇”。

source: A moderator bot materializes in front of you. "Stop that!" he says disapprovingly. "Your dancing is too lewd. There are children here!"
target: 管理机器人凭空出现，严厉地说：“停下！太下流了，这里还有孩子！”

source: There literally isn't anyone here but us and that weird domino guy. Also: fuck you. I'll twerk if I want!
target: 明明就咱们和那个骨牌怪人。还有，去你的，老娘想扭就扭！

source: You all get banned from that Metaverse and appear in the next level up. It's working! Keep twerking!!
target: 你们被这层元宇宙封禁，出现在上一层。真有用，继续扭！

source: "Stop shaking your butts immediately!" an admin bot shouts at you. "Dancing that sexually isn't allowed in several of the countries we're depending on for investors."
target: 管理员机器人喊：“立刻停止摇屁股！几个我们指望投资的国家，禁止这么色情的舞蹈！”

source: Uh huh, I see, okay. But do they allow THIS?
target: 嗯嗯，懂了，好。那允许这样吗？

source: Polly flips the bot the middle finger. You're immediately banned! Nice!
target: 波莉朝它竖起中指，你们当场被封。好耶！

source: "Hey, cut that out!" cries a moderator in the next Metaverse.
target: 下一层的管理员叫道：“嘿，停下！”

source: What's wrong, prude bot? Are our wiggly butts too sexy for you?
target: 怎么了，假正经机器人？我们扭的屁股，性感得让你受不了？

source: "The sexiness is no big deal. But your butts are bouncing so fast that our framerate can't keep up. You can come back when the Metaverse is optimized for advanced butt physics."
target: “性感倒无所谓。可屁股弹得太快，帧率跟不上。等优化好高级臀部物理系统，你们再来。”

source: And so it goes, until your booties are officially banned from all Metaverses and you're back in the real world.
target: 如此反复，直到你们的屁股被所有元宇宙正式封禁，回到现实。

source: You're paid +N2 MONEY for being test subjects, but you lost -N2 SOUL for disobeying the rules of the Metaverse, which is kinda the same as sinning.
target: 测试费让你获得了+N2金钱，不过违反元宇宙规矩，跟犯罪差不多，让你失去了-N2灵魂。

source: Fair enough; looks like the only way out is through. Let's find the lab and keep going deeper!
target: 行吧，看来只能一路闯过去。找实验室，继续深入！

source: So you do. The next Metaverse is made entirely of dominoes. The next is a dystopic wasteland devastated by the Otter Wars. In the next, the eyebrows buy YOU.
target: 下一层全由多米诺骨牌构成，再下一层是水獭战争摧毁的反乌托邦废土，再下一层则轮到眉毛买你。

source: After hours of Metaverse-hopping, you take off your goggles and find yourself back in the lab you started in.
target: 穿梭几小时后，你摘下设备，发现回到了起初那间实验室。

source: "Welcome back, test subjects!" the scientists say. "Here's your +N2 MONEY. Glad you didn't die."
target: 科学家说：“欢迎回来，测试者！给你们+N2金钱。很高兴没死。”

source: Was dying a possibility?!
target: 还能死的吗？！

source: Eh, whatever. Let's just get out of here. I need a drink.
target: 唉，管它呢，先走吧。我得喝一杯。

source: ARE we back, though? What if this is just another super-realistic simulation? We saw tons of those on our way here.
target: 可真回来了吗？万一还是特别逼真的模拟？刚才见过不少啊。

source: Uh... I don't know. I guess it COULD be a realistic simulation and we'd have no way of knowing.
target: 呃……不知道。确实可能是逼真模拟，咱们也分辨不出来。

source: So our whole world could be a lie? What about our friends? We'll never know if they're our real pals or just advanced AI programmed to emulate something real!
target: 所以整个世界都可能是假的？朋友们呢？咱们永远不知道他们是真朋友，还是程序模仿出来的高级AI！

source: I don't think we should question it, bud. It's better this way. Let's go; we could ALL use a drink.
target: 别想了，哥们。这样比较好。走，都该喝一杯了。

source: Look at those silly video game characters losing their -N2 MIND wondering if their reality is all a simulation! Ha!
target: 看看这群傻游戏角色，怀疑现实是模拟，想得损失-N2头脑！哈！

source: Don't worry, we can laugh at them because we know ours is the true reality.
target: 放心，咱们能笑他们，毕竟咱们的现实才是真的。

source: ...Or IS it?
target: ……真是吗？

source: Pet the animals
target: 摸摸动物

source: You're checking the place out, booping snoots with all sorts of cute critters, when you run into a familiar witch.
target: 你在园里闲逛，跟各种小动物碰鼻尖时，遇见了熟悉的女巫。

source: Hello there. What brings you all to the petting zoo and animal sanctuary?
target: 你们好，怎么来亲子动物园和动物庇护所了？

source: We wanted to pet the cute animals! This place is so cool!
target: 想摸摸可爱动物！这里真酷！

source: I agree; I love volunteering here. It's a great place to meet some animals and maybe even adopt a critter in need.
target: 我也觉得，在这儿当志愿者很开心。能认识动物，没准还能领养需要家的小家伙。

source: Feel free to pet all the animals you like. We've got puppies, kitties, duckies, alpaca-ies...
target: 想摸谁就摸谁，有小狗、小猫、小鸭、小羊驼驼……

source: What about the geese? They look cute!
target: 那鹅呢？看着可爱！

source: No, I don't recommend that. NEVER trust a goose.
target: 不，不推荐。永远别信鹅。

source: Faith goes back to working her shift, and you get to work petting some animals.
target: 信念女巫回去忙，你们开始摸动物。

source: You go to the bunny pen to stroke a rabbit's soft ears. One rabbit puts his nose in your pocket. Aww!
target: 你走到兔栏，轻抚兔子的软耳朵。一只兔子把鼻子探进你口袋，好可爱！

source: Then it grabs your car keys in its mouth and runs off. Aw.
target: 接着，它叼起车钥匙跑了。哦。

source: You chase the rabbit around the pen. You can't catch it, but you are attracting attention; kids are pointing at you and crying, "Stop trying to steal the poor bunny's car keys!"
target: 你追着兔子绕栏跑，没抓着，倒吸引了目光。孩子们指着你喊：“别偷可怜兔兔的车钥匙！”

source: But those are our car keys! The rabbit stole them from us first!
target: 可那是我们的钥匙！兔子先偷的！

source: "That's exactly what somebody trying to steal a rabbit's keys would say!"
target: “偷兔子钥匙的人，肯定都这么说！”

source: Great. Even if we get the keys back, we'll be found guilty in the court of public opinion... %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, what do we do?
target: 真棒，钥匙拿回来，舆论法庭也得判咱们有罪……%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，怎么办？

source: Be nice! Offer the bunny your 90s comic about a very sexy rabbit who's a basketball player playing against evil aliens in exchange for the keys.
target: 友善点！用你那本九十年代漫画换钥匙：性感兔子篮球手，对战邪恶外星人的故事。

source: Regain your car keys by challenging the rabbit to a car race against a tortoise you'll train personally. The winner keeps the car.
target: 亲自训练一只乌龟，让它跟兔子赛车。赢家保留车，赢回钥匙。

source: Slowly, you drop down and hold your comic book out to the rabbit. It takes a few tentative hops forward and sniffs the comic.
target: 你慢慢蹲下，把漫画递给兔子。它试探着跳近几步，嗅嗅漫画。

source: You like my comic? It's a classic story of aliens wanting to turn the world into a theme park, but the rabbit protag defeats them in a game of high-stakes basketball.
target: 喜欢吗？经典故事：外星人想把世界改成主题公园，主角兔子靠一场豪赌篮球赛打败他们。

source: This is the 90s version, so the rabbits are way more sexualized. Back then, being a furry wasn't so widely ridiculed.
target: 九十年代的版本，兔子性感得多。当时兽迷还没这么被群嘲。

source: The surrounding kids are laughing and taking photos of you. "Doesn't mean we won't ridicule you now!" they cackle. Great.
target: 周围孩子笑着拍照：“不影响我们现在笑你啊！”真棒。

source: Why are you explaining all of this to a dumb rabbit, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? One, it can't understand you. Two, it can't read anyway.
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，跟笨兔子解释这么多干嘛？第一，听不懂。第二，它也不识字。

source: Polly's proven wrong when the rabbit takes your comic in its teeth and starts turning the pages.
target: 兔子叼走漫画，开始翻页，当场证明波莉错了。

source: It ends up on a sexy centerfold panel of the protagonist rabbit wearing her oddly-revealing basketball uniform.
target: 它翻到一页性感跨页图：主角兔女郎穿着暴露得离谱的篮球服。

source: The rabbit's eyes go WIDE. It drops your keys and drags your comic off to the bathrooms to do something you don't ever want to imagine a rabbit doing ever again.
target: 兔子瞪大眼睛，丢下钥匙，拖着漫画奔向厕所。它要干什么，你这辈子都不想再想。

source: Woohoo! You did it, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!
target: 呜呼！成了，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！

source: Well I'll be damned. There was a reason to oversexualize rabbits after all!
target: 还真没想到，过度性感化兔子，居然也有用！

source: You leave, losing -N2 HYPE for giving up your horny comic, but gaining +N2 SOUL for bartering nicely with the bunny!
target: 你离开了。交出色气漫画，失去了-N2热度，不过跟兔子友好交换，也获得了+N2灵魂！

source: You put out your hand, and the rabbit puts its little paw in it to shake. The contest is on!
target: 你伸手，兔子把小爪放上来握了握。比赛成立！

source: Good plan, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! The rabbit accepted 'cause it obviously assumes it's faster than a tortoise.
target: 好计划，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！兔子肯答应，肯定以为自己比乌龟快。

source: But we're evening the playing field by doing the race in cars, which neither a rabbit or a tortoise can drive!
target: 可比赛开车，这就公平了，反正兔子乌龟都不会开！

source: With both parties in equally-shitty circumstances, we might have a chance!
target: 双方处境一样烂，咱们就有希望！

source: Later that day, the local hospital is overwhelmed with people being brought in with terrible injuries!
target: 当天晚些时候，重伤者接连被送进当地医院，挤得医院应接不暇！

source: "Doctor!" cries an EMT with a man on a gurney. "We've got an emergency! Prepare the operating table!"
target: 急救员推着担架上的男人喊：“医生，急诊！准备手术台！”

source: "What happened to this one?" the doctor asks. "Another car accident? This is the eighth one today."
target: 医生问：“这个又怎么了？又是车祸？今天第八起了。”

source: "Yes. This one is still semi-conscious. He told me there's some kind of reckless car race going on between a tortoise and a rabbit."
target: “对，还有点意识。他说，外面有乌龟和兔子在乱开赛车。”

source: "... What?"
"Ridiculous, right? It'd explain all the injuries; those stupid animals don't understand traffic laws!"
target: “荒谬吧？难怪伤员这么多，那俩蠢动物不懂交通法规！”

source: "No, no, forget about that!" the doctor cries. "Which one's winning the race?"
target: 医生喊：“不不，那些先别管！比赛谁赢？”

source: "What? I have no idea. Look, just get this guy into surgery; I need to get back in the ambulance."
target: “什么？不知道。先把他送进手术室，我得回救护车上了。”

source: "Doctor... am I going to die?" the badly-injured patient wheezes.
target: 重伤的病人喘息着问：“医生……我要死了吗？”

source: "Dunno, maybe," says the doc. "But more importantly, I'm also dying... dying to know who's winning that race! Who's in the lead, the tortoise or the rabbit?"
target: 医生说：“不知道，也许吧。可更重要的是，我也要死了——急死了，想知道谁赢！乌龟还是兔子领先？”

source: "*Cough, cough!*... Can you... tell my daughter... I love her?"
target: “*咳，咳！*……能不能……告诉我女儿……我爱她？”

source: "Only if you tell me who won! Speak up, man!!"
target: “告诉我谁赢了，我就帮你！大声点！！”

source: "*Cough!*... I think it was... the tortoise..."
"REALLY? Wow! I never would've seen that coming. Thank you!"
target: “真的？哇，完全没想到。谢谢！”

source: The patient doesn't respond; he's too busy flatlining. Oh well.
target: 病人没回答，正忙着让心电图变成直线。算了。

source: You lost -N2 MAGIC in all the gas lost in the car race, but you win back your car keys and gain +N2 HYPE!
target: 赛车烧掉不少燃料，让你失去了-N2魔力，不过拿回钥匙，还获得了+N2热度！

source: Volunteer with the rescued animals
target: 当志愿者，陪伴获救动物

source: You're checking the place out, booping snoots with all sorts of cute critters, when you run into a familiar face.
target: 你在园里闲逛，跟各种小动物碰鼻尖，遇见了熟悉的面孔。

source: Oh, hey! Are you guys volunteering at the sanctuary too?
target: 哦，嗨！你们也来庇护所做志愿者？

source: Hi, Faith! We'd love to! Do you have animals who could use some volunteering/friendship?
target: 嗨，信念女巫！很乐意！有没有动物需要帮忙，或者交朋友？

source: Sure! Why don't you spend time with Old Major? He's getting up there in years and could use the exercise.
target: 有啊，陪陪老少校吧？它年纪大了，正需要多活动。

source: WOOHOO! I love you, Old Major! Let's play fetch; last one to the dog park has to throw the Frisbee!
target: 呜呼！老少校，我爱你！来玩接飞盘，谁最后跑到狗公园，谁负责扔！

source: Polly, you can brush Annie the alpaca if you want! She's a very sweet girl.
target: 波莉，想的话，可以帮羊驼安妮梳梳毛。它很乖。

source: I'd rather brush YOUR alpaca, if you know what I mean.
target: 我倒更想梳你的“羊驼”，懂吧？

source: No idea what you mean, honestly... but I'm gonna guess it's a sex thing. It usually is a sex thing with you.
target: 其实不懂……不过我猜是性暗示。跟你聊天，通常都是这个。

source: You betcha!
target: 当然了!

source: Well, I'm kind of working right now... but maybe we can "brush alpacas" when I go on break?
target: 可我现在在工作……休息时，再一起“梳羊驼”？

source: Fuck yeah, boo. Text me when you're free!
target: 爽，宝贝。有空发消息！

source: And you, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%: what if you hang out with Colonel Grumpo?
target: 还有你，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，陪陪格伦波上校怎么样？

source: Faith takes you to the ugliest, grumpiest cat you've ever seen. If cats had phalanges, this one would definitely be giving you the finger.
target: 信念女巫带你看一只丑得惊人、暴躁得惊人的猫。猫要是能像人一样动手指，它绝对在对你竖中指。

source: Colonel Grumpo was rescued from a really bad situation. He has trouble trusting monsters, but I promise, there's a sweet boy under all that radiating hate. Have fun!
target: 格伦波上校以前过得很糟，是被救出来的，不太能信任怪物。不过这浑身仇恨下面，肯定藏着乖孩子。玩得开心！

source: Great, Scott gets to play fetch and Polly's having car sex while you're stuck with the world's meanest cat. Oh well, maybe it will all be okay...
target: 真棒，斯科特玩接飞盘，波莉在车里做爱，你却得陪世界上最凶的猫。算了，没准没事……

source: Wait, did Colonel Grumpo just steal your wallet? How? You didn't even see him move!
target: 等等，它刚偷了你钱包？怎么做到的？都没看见它动！

source: You'd better get on this cat's good side before he does something worse...
target: 趁它还没干更坏的事，赶紧讨好一下……

source: This cat obviously lost faith in people due to monsterkind's inevitable descent into idiocy. Show him there's still hope by showing off your extensive classic literature knowledge.
target: 怪物无可救药地越来越蠢，让猫对大家失去信心了。展示你丰富的古典文学知识，让它重燃希望。

source: Show Colonel Grumpo you're the real deal by giving him what all cats want most: the chance to drive a Ferrari.
target: 给它所有猫最想要的东西：开法拉利的机会。让格伦波上校知道，你来真的。

source: Good thing you packed some books! You read Plato's "The Republic" to Colonel Grumpo.
target: 幸好带了书！你给格伦波上校读起柏拉图的《理想国》。

source: A few hours later, Colonel Grumpo doesn't look any happier, and now Polly and Faith have returned.
target: 几小时后，猫没见高兴，波莉和信念女巫倒回来了。

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, why are you reading to Colonel Grumpo? Cats don't like to read, nor CAN they read, and being reminded of that just annoys them.
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，为什么读书给它听？猫不爱读，也不会读。提醒它不会读书，只会让它烦。

source: Look at him, it's obvious he's angry about that.
target: 看看，明显为这事生气了。

source: Thanks to the magic of video games, we can now actually know what's going on inside Colonel Grumpo's head:
target: 托电子游戏的福，我们现在能知道上校脑子里究竟在想什么：

source: MEOW MEOW MEOW
target: 喵喵喵

source: No, Faith, you got it wrong. We just need to find the right book for Colonel Grumpo. His face conveys an interest in finding a literary genre that ignites his passion for books.
target: 不，信念女巫，你搞错了。得找到对的书。它脸上分明写着，想找到能点燃阅读热情的文学类型。

source: Look at him, I think it's obvious.
target: 看看它，这不挺明显嘛。

source: MEOW MEOW MEOW
target: 喵喵喵

source: What if... Colonel Grumpo is actually upset because we're assuming what he thinks without even asking?
target: 也许……它生气，是因为我们问也不问，就擅自猜它在想什么？

source: Yes, he's probably angry because of that... sorry, Colonel Grumpo.
target: 嗯，肯定为这个生气……对不起，格伦波上校。

source: MEOW MEOW MEOW
target: 喵喵喵

source: No, you must ignore them both. You can't stop; you are building a connection with Colonel Grumpo, you can feel it!
target: 不，别听她们。不能停，你感觉得到，正在跟上校建立联系！

source: Plato's ideas on an ideal government really make you think. I'm happy that someone finally read it to me, for I am a cat and I can't read.
target: 柏拉图关于理想政体的思考，真发人深省。终于有人读给我听了，我很开心，毕竟我是猫，自己不识字。

source: I guess we must accept we might never know what goes inside Colonel Grumpo's head, and that's okay.
target: 看来，得接受一个事实：咱们也许永远不知道上校在想什么。也没关系。

source: No, you know you got to Colonel Grumpo, even if it was at the cost of -N2 HYPE out of being a big nerd. You gain +N2 SOUL from this selfless act!
target: 不，你知道自己打动了它。书呆子行为是让你损失了-N2热度，可这份无私，也让你获得了+N2灵魂！

source: In the time it takes you to convince a rental company to give you a Ferrari despite your horrible driving record, your friends have returned.
target: 你费劲说服租车公司，无视糟糕的驾驶记录，租给你一辆法拉利。折腾完，朋友们也回来了。

source: Hey! Have you guys seen the car out front with the grumpy cat in the driver's seat? It's so cool they're letting underprivileged animals work for Oober now!
target: 嘿，门外那车，驾驶座上坐了只臭脸猫，看见没？现在Oober也给弱势动物工作机会了，真酷！

source: Wait, is Colonel Grumpo in that Ferrari? %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, are you letting a cat drive?! That's so dangerous!
target: 等等，法拉利里是格伦波上校？%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你让猫开车？！太危险了！

source: Meh, I'm not pressed. I'm dead anyway, so who cares? Let's go for a ride with Colonel Grumpo!
target: 嗨，无所谓。反正我死了，管它呢？跟上校兜风去！

source: But...
target: 不过...

source: I have no sense of danger, and a cat-chauffeur sounds cool, so I see no problem with this! Grumpy kitty, take us away!
target: 我毫无危险意识，猫司机听着又酷，所以完全没问题！臭脸猫猫，出发！

source: You all hop in the car with Colonel Grumpo and let him drive you into the sunset.
target: 你们上了上校的车，让它载着你们驶向夕阳。

source: So is this a regular thing with you, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? Every time you wanna cheer a cat up, you let it drive a Ferrari?
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你经常这么干？想哄猫开心，就让它开法拉利？

source: Pretty much!
target: 差不多！

source: Cool, cool.
target: 酷，挺酷。

source: AWOOOOOO! I love sticking my tongue out of the window! You're the best reckless driver ever, Colonel Grumpo!
target: 嗷呜——！我就爱把舌头伸出窗外！格伦波上校，你是最棒的危险司机！

source: Well, at least everyone's wearing their seatbelts. That makes me feel marginally better about this extremely unsafe situation.
target: 至少都系了安全带。虽然危险得要命，也算让我稍微放心一点。

source: You give Faith a few extra white hairs, but your joyride is a success. You even see a small smile on Colonel Grumpo's face as he snoozes on the steering wheel.
target: 信念女巫被你吓得多长了几根白发，不过兜风成功。上校趴在方向盘上打盹时，脸上甚至有点笑意。

source: You lose -N2 MONEY on the car rental, but gain +N2 SOUL spending time with Grumpo!
target: 租车花了-N2金钱，不过陪上校相处，也获得了+N2灵魂！

source: Cat café
target: 猫咖啡馆

source: What's better than coffee and cute cats? You step into the café and see your friend Faith manning the register.
target: 咖啡加猫猫，还有更棒的组合吗？你走进店里，发现信念女巫正守着收银台。

source: Welcome to the cat café, guys. What brings you in today?
target: 欢迎来猫咖啡馆。今天怎么想到来的？

source: I had to come see my favorite witch! Also we've been on the road for hours and if I don't get some caffeine in me I will LITERALLY die.
target: 当然来看我最喜欢的女巫！而且赶了几个小时路，再不来点咖啡因，我真的会死。

source: Polly, it's impossible for you to "literally" die if you're already dead. Liberal use of the word "literally" destroys its true meaning.
target: 波莉，你已经死了，不可能“真的会死”。随便乱用“真的”，就失去这个词原有的意思了。

source: Ahh, I love it when you talk nerdy to me, boo.
target: 啊，就喜欢你这样一本正经地跟我抠字眼，宝贝。

source: Heh, thanks... and thanks for coming in and supporting the café. The cats here really love the attention and playtime.
target: 嘿，谢谢……也谢谢来支持咖啡馆。猫们可喜欢有人陪、有人玩了。

source: That's good, 'cause I've got a pussy here that could use some playtime... BEHOLD!
target: 正好，我这小猫咪，也需要有人陪着玩……看！

source: Polly holds up a cat she befriended in the café.
target: 波莉举起刚在店里交上朋友的一只猫。

source: Haha! Okay, but for real, I was talking about my vagina, in case that wasn't clear.
target: 哈哈！不过说正经的，我刚指的是自己的阴道，怕你没听明白。

source: POLLY! I'm working now!
target: 波莉！我在工作！

source: ...my shift ends in a few hours, though. I can text you then.
target: ……不过再过几小时就下班了。到时发消息。

source: For now, can I get you guys anything to drink?
target: 现在，要喝点什么？

source: Yes, please; you didn't come here just so Polly could flirt. What do you order?
target: 要，谢谢。你们来可不只是为了让波莉调情。点什么？

source: Cat Coffee (made FOR cats)
target: 猫咖啡（给猫喝的）

source: Cat Coffee (made BY cats)
target: 猫咖啡（猫煮的）

source: Whoa, that's a weird-looking coffee. Why does it seem so... ominous?

target: 猫喜欢超黑的咖啡，配得上它们暴躁、易受惊又高冷的灵魂。

source: I mean, have you ever seen a cat get random zoomies at 3 a.m.? Where do you think all that energy comes from?
target: 见过猫凌晨三点突然满屋疯跑吧？你以为哪儿来这么多精力？

target: 行，猫的咖啡，现在变成%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%的咖啡了！来一杯。

target: 确定吗，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%？“给猫喝的”，可不是白写的……

target: 确定，去他的！选都选了，知道有危险，也拦不住你！

source: You drink the coffee for cats and gain +N2 STAMINA. Ha, that wasn't so strong! Faith worried you for nothing.

target: 一眨眼，你突然到了沙漠中央。衣服又破又湿，心跳飞快。什么鬼？

target: 找到你了，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！总算赶上，我们开车追了半小时！

target: 开车追你？你还比车快？！怎么做到的？

source: It's gotta be that coffee. You're more wired than an electronics store!
target: 肯定是咖啡，把你通上电了！整家电器店都没你这么带劲！

source: I tried to warn you, moron. A shot of Cat Coffee is worse for your blood pressure than a hit of cocaine.
target: 我警告过你，笨蛋。一份猫咖啡对血压的冲击，比吸一口可卡因还猛。

source: You can barely hear them over the sound of your pulse. Your soul is under siege by the caffeine. Your body wasn't made to handle this much hyper!
target: 心跳声震耳欲聋，几乎盖过他们的话。灵魂正在被咖啡因围攻，身体根本承受不了这股亢奋！

source: Are you gonna die? Hopefully not, but at the very least, you're losing -N2 MIND.
target: 会死吗？但愿不会，不过至少失去了-N2头脑。

source: Ooh, great choice! This is an exclusive, one-of-a-kind coffee we offer, made by the cats who live here at the café!
target: 哦，选得好！这可是独家限定咖啡，住在店里的猫亲手煮的！

source: Oh, cool! Are they specially-trained barista cats or something?
target: 酷！专门受训的猫咖啡师吗？

source: No, they're just regular cats. But that's part of the charm, no?
target: 不是，普通猫。不过这不也是魅力所在？

source: Uh... I'mma go with no.
target: 呃……我觉得不是。

source: Does the coffee they make taste good at least?
target: 那至少味道好吧？

source: That's sort of a matter of opinion. The cats really enjoy making the coffee, though!
target: 看个人口味吧。不过猫们确实很喜欢煮咖啡！

source: Is it even sanitary for the cats to be behind the counter?
target: 让猫待在柜台后，卫生吗？

source: Of course; cats are very clean animals. They bathe themselves multiple times a day.
target: 当然，猫很爱干净，一天要给自己洗好几次澡。

source: Your (many) remaining doubts are dispelled when you see one cat flop on the espresso machine's power button to pour the coffee.
target: 你看见一只猫扑到意式咖啡机的开关上，咖啡倒了出来。剩下那一大堆疑虑，也随之打消。

source: A second cat knocks a cup of sugar off a high shelf into the coffee. A third bats at a ball of yarn until it turns the lever that dispenses your coffee in its cup.
target: 第二只把高架上的一杯糖碰进咖啡，第三只拨着毛线球，直到碰动拉杆，把咖啡放进杯里。

source: A fourth cat licks said foam into delicate latte art. Uh...
target: 第四只用舌头舔奶泡，舔出精致拉花。呃……

source: Here's your coffee, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! Enjoy!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，咖啡好了，慢用！

source: The cats are all watching you rapturously to know your opinion... or maybe they're just like that. Cats do like to stare.
target: 猫们热切地望着你，等你评价……也可能只是天生这样。猫是爱盯人。

source: You sip your drink. Blegh. It's full of cat hair, and it mostly tastes like that last cat's tuna breath.
target: 你喝一口。呸，全是猫毛，主要味道还是最后那只猫嘴里的金枪鱼味。

source: You got what you paid -N2 MONEY for, you guess. At least even shitty, tuna-ish coffee boosts your +N2 STAMINA.
target: 算是对得起花的-N2金钱吧。至少再烂、再一股金枪鱼味，咖啡也给你加了+N2体力。

source: In horrified silence, Faith points at the menu description under the coffee you just ordered.
target: 信念女巫震惊得说不出话，默默指向你刚点的咖啡下面，那段菜单说明。

source: "Did this shock you? Of course we don't serve coffee made of cats. But is it really so different than eating burgers made of cows?"
target: “吓到了？我们当然不提供用猫做的咖啡。可这跟吃牛肉汉堡，真的差很多吗？”

source: "All animals deserve compassion, not just the cute ones. Consider reducing or even stopping your meat intake. It makes a small difference, but it's still a difference!"
target: “所有动物都值得关爱，不只是可爱的那些。考虑少吃点肉，甚至不吃。改变很小，也依旧是改变！”

source: I can't believe you. That menu item is only there as a clever PSA. The whole point is that NOBODY would be fucked-up enough to order it.
target: 真不敢相信。那道菜单只是个公益宣传的巧思。前提就是，没人会变态到真的点它。

source: Then that's kinda on you for underestimating %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s fucked-up-ness.
target: 那得怪你，低估了%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%有多变态。

source: Wait, so I CAN'T order the made-of-cats coffee?
target: 等等，所以不能点用猫做的咖啡？

source: ...Seriously?!
target: ……认真的？！

source: Okay, guess that's a no. Do you have any coffee made of raccoons, at least?
target: 行吧，看来不行。那至少有浣熊做的吗？

source: Goddess help me... I'm just gonna get you guys regular coffees and pretend this never happened.
target: 女神救救我……还是上普通咖啡吧，刚才就当没发生。

source: Eh, don't let Faith get you guys down. I think all of us have ingested weirder things than cats at this point, so no judgment from me.
target: 别被信念女巫弄得扫兴。反正吃过的怪东西，早就比猫离谱多了，我可不评判。

source: At least your friends aren't mad, but the same can't be said of the cats in the café, who are all looking at you like they'd beat you with a crowbar if they had thumbs.
target: 至少朋友没生气，可店里的猫就不一样了。它们看你的眼神，分明是有拇指就要拿撬棍揍你。

source: The regular coffee Faith brings you restores +N2 STAMINA to you, but there's no saving your -N2 SOUL.
target: 信念女巫拿来的普通咖啡，恢复了+N2体力，可你的-N2灵魂，谁也救不回来了。

source: Chance: roulette!
target: 碰碰运气：轮盘！

source: You enter the casino, ready to make some sweet money.
target: 你走进赌场，准备大赚一笔。

source: YAAASSS! I love casinos! The land of random chance, impulsive decisions, and drinking! Everything's coming up Polly!
target: 好耶——！我爱赌场！处处碰运气，做决定全凭冲动，还能喝酒！今天简直就是波莉的幸运日！

source: You're the expert here, bro! What game should we play?
target: 你才是行家，兄弟！咱们玩什么？

source: Hmmm, roulette probably. There's very little rules involved, and I'm like six Old Fashioneds deep, so I'm too drunk to coach you on a proper game anyway.
target: 嗯，就轮盘吧。规则不多，而且我已经灌了六杯古典鸡尾酒，醉成这样，也教不了你们什么正经玩法。

source: Fine by me -- roulette's the only casino sport with balls in it, so it's bound to be my favorite! How does it work?
target: 没问题！赌场里只有轮盘这项运动用得到球，肯定最合我胃口！怎么玩？

source: People place their bets, the croupier spins the wheel, the ball lands on a number, and you win or you don't. That's it!
target: 大家下注，荷官转轮盘，小球落在某个数字上，然后你要么赢，要么输。就这么简单！

source: The only thing you have to do is pick a number or color to bet on. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, what are you feeling?
target: 你只要挑个数字或者颜色下注。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你看好哪个？

source: I'm betting on 69, of course!
target: 当然押 69！

source: I respect that, but the highest number in roulette is 37.
target: 有品位，不过轮盘上最大的数字是 37。

source: What, so I can't pick 420 either? LAME! I'll just bet it all on red, then.
target: 什么，那也不能押 420 了？没劲！那就全押红色吧。

source: Okay, what are we gonna bet? It should be something good if we wanna win big!
target: 好，那咱们拿什么下注？想赢个大的，赌注就得够好吧！

source: Scott's right. What are you willing to lose? What are you willing to win?! It all comes down to this!
target: 斯科特说得对。你舍得输掉什么？又想赢些什么？！成败在此一举！

source: Bet this delicious hot dog!
target: 押上这根美味的热狗！

source: Bet some money, dang. That's the whole point of gambling, isn't it? Gettin' free moneys.
target: 押钱呗，还能押什么。赌博不就图这个吗？白捡钱。

source: Bet this priceless silver watch. The mysterious warlock who gave it to your long-dead ancestor probably wanted someone to gamble with it eventually!
target: 押上这块价值连城的银怀表。把它送给你那位早已过世的祖先时，那位神秘术士肯定就盼着有人拿它下注！

source: NOOO, not the hot dog! I was really looking forward to eating that!
target: 不要啊，别拿热狗赌！我还等着吃呢！

source: That's why we HAVE to bet it, Scotty. Gambling's no fun if you're not putting it all on the line!
target: 所以才必须押它，小斯！不豁出去，赌博还有什么乐趣！

source: You bet your hot dog, and the croupier spins the wheel. Scott is visibly sweating as he watches the ball bounce along the numbers.
target: 你押上热狗，荷官转动轮盘。小球在数字间跳来跳去，斯科特看得直冒汗。

source: Oh man, did we go too far this time guys?! This is a REALLY GOOD HOT DOG we might lose!
target: 天啊，伙计们，这次是不是玩过头了？！咱们可能要输掉一根超好吃的热狗啊！

source: You know I support a life of pranks and shenanigans, but risking this hot dog might've crossed a line!
target: 你们知道，我一向支持到处恶作剧、瞎胡闹，可拿这根热狗冒险，是不是有点过了！

source: Don't worry, Scott! Look, the ball landed on a red number. We won!
target: 别担心，斯科特！看，小球落在红色数字上了。咱们赢了！

source: WOOHOO! Thank goodness! What did we win? Another hot dog?!
target: 呜呼！谢天谢地！赢了什么？又一根热狗吗？！

source: The croupier hands you back your hot dog... along with a hamburger!
target: 荷官把热狗还给你……还附送一个汉堡！

source: Wait, why a hamburger? How is that logical? What weird food currency valuing system are we using here?
target: 等等，怎么是汉堡？这逻辑说得通吗？咱们这套食物货币到底怎么定价的？

source: Does this burger represent the same value as the hot dog? Is it implying we won more than what we bet, or is this like diminishing returns?
target: 这个汉堡和热狗等值吗？意思是赢来的比押上的还多，还是说收益在递减？

source: "It's not that deep, toots," the croupier sighs. "You're the morons who gambled with a hot dog. I didn't know what else to do besides give you my lunch."
target: “没那么复杂，亲爱的。”荷官叹了口气，“拿热狗下注的是你们这帮白痴。我实在不知道怎么办，只好把自己的午饭给你们了。”

source: Cool! Good job, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%; you really are a breadwinner!
target: 太棒了！干得好，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！你真能给大家挣口饭吃！

source: Or maybe... you're a bun-winner?
target: 或者说……挣口面包胚吃？

source: You're a winner either way! You and Scott split the hamburger and hot dog and gain +1 STAMINA.
target: 反正赢了就好！你和斯科特分了汉堡与热狗，获得 +1 体力。

source: NOOO, not the hot dog! I was really looking forward to eating that!
target: 不要啊，别拿热狗赌！我还等着吃呢！

source: That's why we HAVE to bet it, Scotty. Gambling's no fun if you're not putting it all on the line!
target: 所以才必须押它，小斯！不豁出去，赌博还有什么乐趣！

source: You bet your hot dog, and the croupier spins the wheel. Scott is visibly sweating as he watches the ball bounce along the numbers.
target: 你押上热狗，荷官转动轮盘。小球在数字间跳来跳去，斯科特看得直冒汗。

source: Oh man, did we go too far this time guys?! This is a REALLY GOOD HOT DOG we might lose!
target: 天啊，伙计们，这次是不是玩过头了？！咱们可能要输掉一根超好吃的热狗啊！

source: You know I support a life of pranks and shenanigans, but risking this hot dog might've crossed a line!
target: 你们知道，我一向支持到处恶作剧、瞎胡闹，可拿这根热狗冒险，是不是有点过了！

source: You watch with bated breath as the roulette wheel slows down... and the ball lands on a black number. Ouch.
target: 你屏住呼吸，看着轮盘渐渐慢下来……小球落在了黑色数字上。惨了。

source: NOOOOOOO!
I'm sorry, buddy. It's my fault for pushing you to bet your delicious hot dog. I'll never forgive myself.
target: 对不起，伙计。都怪我逼你押上那根美味的热狗。我这辈子都不会原谅自己。

source: Hey, kidz! It's me, Tubular Eddy, the Anti-Gambling Aardvark. I'm here to tell you that gambling is totally UN-RADICAL!
target: 嘿，孩子们！我是潮人艾迪，反赌博土豚！我来告诉大家，赌博一点都不酷！

source: The only thing you can bet on is that gambling is something cool cats NEVER do.
target: 只有一件事能打包票：真正的酷猫绝不赌博。

source: But I'm not a cat. I'm a werewolf.
target: 可我不是猫。我是狼人。

source: Oh. Those too, then!
target: 哦，那狼人也一样！

source: Aww, man!
target: 唉，不是吧！

source: I gotta go now, I have a line of coke to snort off my skateboard. Peace out!
target: 我得走了，还得吸一口铺在滑板上的可卡因呢。回见！

source: Well, you guess the casino was the most likely place for you to see an anti-gambling PSA... and also the most likely place to lose some stats. This time, it's -1 STAMINA.
target: 想来也是，最容易碰上反赌公益宣传的地方，就是赌场……当然，这里也最容易损失属性。这次你失去了 -1 体力。

source: You place your bet, and the croupier spins the wheel around. But then a public safety announcement shows up to ruin your fun.
target: 你下了注，荷官转动轮盘。偏偏这时，公益宣传跑来扫你的兴。

source: Hold it, kidz! Don't you know it's not cool to gamble?!
target: 慢着，孩子们！不知道赌博很不酷吗？！

source: Says who?
target: 谁说的?

source: Says me, Tubular Eddy, the Anti-Gambling Aardvark!
target: 我说的！我是反赌博土豚，潮人艾迪！

source: Okay, but if you're against gambling, why are you at a casino?
target: 好吧，可你既然反对赌博，来赌场干什么？

source: Cause I'm betting it all on black that gambling is the fastest way to face terrible consequences!
target: 因为我敢全押黑色，赌赌博就是最快让你尝到恶果的办法！

source: Nah, I can think of faster ways.
target: 才不是，我能想出更快的。

source: But gambling preys on your thirst of adrenaline and the mentality that "just one more hit" will give you the satisfaction that you crave!
target: 赌博就是利用你爱刺激的心理，让你觉得“再来一把”，就能得到梦寐以求的满足感！

source: That's not healthy! Cool kidz don't gamble; cool kidz play addictive mobile games and buy nose candy!
target: 这多不健康！酷孩子才不赌博，酷孩子都玩让人上瘾的手游，买鼻糖！

source: That's not healthy! Cool kidz don't gamble; cool kidz play addictive mobile games and do cocaine!
target: 这多不健康！酷孩子才不赌博，酷孩子都玩让人上瘾的手游，吸可卡因！

source: Huh?
target: 啊？

source: Don't worry, Eddy; I know all about the dangers of gambling and random chance.
target: 放心吧，艾迪。赌博和碰运气有多危险，我清楚得很。

source: That's why I rigged the roulette wheel beforehand to ensure our victory!
target: 所以我提前在轮盘上动了手脚，保证咱们稳赢！

source: Oh, so you aren't actually gambling at all. That's fine! Cheaters always win!
target: 哦，那你们压根没在赌嘛。没问题！作弊的人总能赢！

source: I'm starting to think you might not actually be a good influence, Tubular Eddy.
target: 潮人艾迪，我开始觉得你可能不是什么好榜样。

source: You bet! Don't stay in school!
target: 那可不！记得退学！

source: What a weirdo. At least you won at roulette! You gain +2 MONEY!
target: 什么怪人。不过轮盘总算赢了！你获得 +2 金钱！

source: You place your bet, and the croupier spins the wheel around. But then a public safety announcement shows up to ruin your fun.
target: 你下了注，荷官转动轮盘。偏偏这时，公益宣传跑来扫你的兴。

source: Hold it, kidz! Don't you know it's not cool to gamble?!
target: 慢着，孩子们！不知道赌博很不酷吗？！

source: Says who?
target: 谁说的?

source: Says me, Tubular Eddy, the Anti-Gambling Aardvark!
target: 我说的！我是反赌博土豚，潮人艾迪！

source: Okay, but if your whole thing is being against gambling, why are you at a casino?
target: 好吧，可你整天嚷嚷着反对赌博，来赌场干什么？

source: Cause I'm betting it all on black that gambling is the fastest way to face terrible consequences!
target: 因为我敢全押黑色，赌赌博就是最快让你尝到恶果的办法！

source: It preys on your thirst of adrenaline and the mentality that "just one more hit" will give you the satisfaction that you crave!
target: 它就是利用你爱刺激的心理，让你觉得“再来一把”，就能得到梦寐以求的满足感！

source: Just then, the roulette wheel stops its spin... and the ball landed on a red number! You win +2 MONEY!
target: 就在这时，轮盘停了……小球落在红色数字上！你赢得 +2 金钱！

source: YEAHHH! Fuck you, Eddy! You were wrong, just like every anti-fun PSA I've ever seen!
target: 好耶！去你妈的，艾迪！你错了，跟我看过的所有扫兴公益宣传一个德行！

source: Wait, Polly, I think we did it wrong. It says on the screen that betting on colors wins us double what we bet, but if we bet on a number and win, we get 36x our bet!
target: 等等，波莉，我觉得咱们玩法不对。屏幕上说，押颜色赢了能拿到赌注的两倍，可押数字赢了，能拿到三十六倍！

source: ...That is more, right?
target: ……那是更多的意思，对吧？

source: YOU'RE DAMN RIGHT IT'S MORE! Why doesn't everyone just bet on the numbers all the time?! Let's go again!
target: 他妈的当然更多！那大家怎么不干脆全押数字？！再来一把！

source: This time, you bet all your casino winnings on number 23... and the wheel doesn't land on 23. Ouch.
target: 这次，你把在赌场赢来的钱全押在 23 号上……轮盘却没停在 23 号。惨了。

source: ...Okay, maybe Tubular Eddy had a point.
target: ……好吧，潮人艾迪说的可能也有点道理。

source: I told you! I gotta go to a rager at the skatepark now -- only cool kidz who don't gamble are invited. Smell ya later!
target: 我早说了！我得去滑板场参加狂欢派对了，只邀请不赌博的酷孩子。回头见啦！

source: Jeez, Eddy, way to add insult to injury. You lose -4 MONEY.
target: 靠，艾迪，别往伤口上撒盐了。你失去了 -4 金钱。

source: Whoa, you're gambling your priceless watch? But it's so shiny! If it's shiny, that must mean it's really valuable!
target: 哇，你要押上那块无价的怀表？可它那么闪！闪成那样，一定特别值钱！

source: "I'm actually a watch expert," says a random bystander, "and I can tell you that that watch is EXTREMELY valuable."
target: 一位围观群众说：“其实我是钟表鉴定师，我可以告诉你，这块表极其值钱。”

source: "It has to have been in your friend's family for at least sixteen generations. Maybe even seventeen!"
target: “你朋友家起码传了十六代吧。没准都有十七代了！”

source: That just makes it an old watch, then. Not necessarily a valuable one.
target: 那也只能说明表很旧，不代表一定值钱。

source: "It's both, actually!" says another stranger. "I heard that that watch was given to %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s ancestor by a mysterious warlock!"
target: “它既古老，又值钱！”另一个陌生人说，“听说这块表是某个神秘术士送给 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 的祖先的！”

source: You heard that from... where? Do we even know you?
target: 你听……谁说的？我们认识你吗？

source: "Nope!"
target: “不认识！”

source: Okay, well, why does getting the watch from a warlock make it valuable?
target: 行吧，可术士送的表为什么就值钱？

source: A warlock gave Scott a sandwich the other day, and it wasn't worth millions. He just didn't want to finish it.
target: 前几天还有个术士给斯科特一个三明治呢，也没值几百万。他就是不想把剩下的吃完而已。

source: I liked that sandwich, though. It was magically delicious!
target: 不过我挺喜欢那个三明治的。简直好吃得像施了魔法！

source: "No, trust me, this watch is highly valuable," says the watch expert. "Based on its mystical, silvery nature, I can guarantee it's worth at least... some MONEY."
target: “不，相信我，这块表非常值钱。”鉴定师说，“它又神秘，又银光闪闪，我敢保证，起码值……一些金钱。”

source: "Have some respect for such a bold, reckless gambler like %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!"
target: “对 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 这样敢下狠注的赌徒，要有点敬意！”

source: Respect %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? Oh, honey, you must be new here.
target: 对 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 有敬意？哎哟，亲爱的，你刚来的吧。

source: You make Polly eat her words when the roulette wheel comes up red and win! You're given your watch back and some matching earrings!
target: 轮盘开出红色，你赢了，狠狠打了波莉的脸！对方还给你怀表，另附一对配套耳环！

source: "WOW!" cries a third bystander. "I'm an expert on earrings, and those are worth a fortune! At least +3 MONEY and +2 MAGIC!"
target: “哇！”第三位围观群众惊呼，“我专门鉴定耳环，这对可是价值连城啊！起码值 +3 金钱和 +2 魔力！”

source: Ugh, can we go find a roulette table that isn't surrounded by jewelry experts loudly expositing on everything %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% does?
target: 烦死了，能不能换张轮盘桌？别再有珠宝专家围着，扯着嗓子解说 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 的一举一动了。

source: "Those lucky bastards...," the strangers sigh. "One can only imagine all the zany adventures they must be having on the road trip they're on."
target: “这帮走狗屎运的家伙……”陌生人叹道，“真不敢想，他们这趟公路旅行还得碰上多少稀奇古怪的冒险。”

source: A PRICELESS SILVER WATCH WITH MYSTICAL PROPERTIES?! NO WAY!
target: 一块拥有神秘力量的无价银怀表？！真的假的！

source: The croupier stares wide-eyed at your watch. "Just a moment, %SIRMAAM%," they say. "I need to call the boss to make sure we can accept this."
target: 荷官瞪大眼睛，盯着你的怀表。“请稍等，%SIRMAAM%。”荷官说，“我得问问老板，这个能不能收。”

source: They make a call on their telephone. "Hi, Boss. I've got a roulette player who wants to bet a priceless silver watch. Can we take that?"
target: 荷官打起电话：“喂，老板。有个玩轮盘的客人想押一块价值连城的银怀表，咱们收吗？”

source: "Yes, exactly, a silver watch... yes, it does look like it has magical properties..."
target: “对，银怀表……是的，看着确实有魔法力量……”

source: "Okay, I'll ask, one sec." The croupier turns to you. "How many generations has that watch been in your family for?"
target: “好，我问问，稍等。”荷官转向你，“这块表在你家传了多少代？”

source: About seventeen?
target: 大概十七代？

source: "For seventeen generations, Boss. It was gifted to %HISHER% family by a warlock... understood, I'll ask, hold on."
target: “十七代，老板。是一位术士送给 %HISHER% 家族的……明白，我再问问，稍等。”

source: The croupier, to you again: "Are you sure the warlock was mysterious, %SIRMAAM%?"
target: 荷官又转过来问你：“%SIRMAAM%，你确定那个术士很神秘？”

source: Pretty sure!
target: 挺确定的！

source: "Yes, boss, the warlock was mysterious... okay, understood, perfect. Bye!" The croupier takes your watch.
target: “对，老板，那个术士很神秘……好，明白，太好了。再见！”荷官收下了你的表。

source: You got this, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! In every casino movie I've seen, when the good guy makes a big bet, he always wins!
target: 稳了，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！我看过的赌场电影里，只要好人下大注，就一定会赢！

source: Ouch! %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% lost. Guess %HESHE%%VERB_'S_'RE% not the good guy of this story.
target: 哎呀！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%输了。看来%HESHE%%VERB_'S_'RE%不是这个故事里的好人。
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): POLISH; 赌场失利后的电影好人梗；保留不是，删除变量外围多余空格。 按行中文动词展开已实现；未实机验证。

source: Meanwhile, in the deepest part of the casino, the boss hangs up the phone with your croupier and cackles maniacally.
target: 与此同时，赌场最深处的老板挂断荷官的电话，发出一阵疯狂的狞笑。

source: He takes a seat in his dark throne and faces a table of five evil wizards. "We've done it, boys," he says. "We've taken back Balthasar's watch!"
target: 他坐上漆黑的宝座，面对桌旁的五个邪恶巫师。“成了，伙计们！”他说，“巴尔塔萨的怀表终于回到我们手里了！”

source: "Balthasar really thought he could hide its power from us by giving it away to a random family seventeen generations ago. That fool!"
target: “巴尔塔萨以为十七代以前，把表送给随便哪家人，就能藏住它的力量。真是个蠢货！”

source: "It took a few centuries of planning, but building this casino and waiting for someone to gamble the watch finally paid off!"
target: “虽然策划了几百年，不过开这家赌场，等着有人拿表来赌，终于有回报了！”

source: The wizards keep cackling and planning world domination or whatever. The real tragedy here, though, is that you lost -2 MAGIC and -3 MONEY.
target: 巫师们继续狞笑，谋划着统治世界之类的事。可真正的悲剧是，你失去了 -2 魔力和 -3 金钱。

source: Skill: poker!
target: 比拼技术：扑克！

source: You enter the casino, ready to make some sweet money.
target: 你走进赌场，准备大赚一笔。

source: YAAASSS! I love casinos! The land of random chance, impulsive decisions, and drinking! Everything's coming up Polly!
target: 好耶——！我爱赌场！处处碰运气，做决定全凭冲动，还能喝酒！今天简直就是波莉的幸运日！

source: You're the expert here, bro! What game should we play?
target: 你才是行家，兄弟！咱们玩什么？

source: Poker, of course! It's got some degree of skill, even if a lot of it comes down to getting lucky with a good hand.
target: 当然是扑克！多少讲点技术，虽然很大程度上还是得靠运气，摸到一手好牌。

source: Only problem is that I'm six Old Fashioneds deep and wayyyy too drunk to read the card faces right now. So I'll just entertain myself by watching %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% play.
target: 唯一的问题是，我已经灌了六杯古典鸡尾酒，醉得连牌面都看不清。所以我就看看 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 打牌，找点乐子吧。

source: Okay, I'll watch %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% too! I'll be happy if you win, bro, and I'll be REALLY, REALLY SAD if you lose!
target: 好，那我也看 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 打！兄弟，你赢了我会很开心；可要是输了，我会特别、特别难过！

source: Cool, so now not only are you risking losing money, but your friends will be watching you play as well. Pressure's on!
target: 很好，这下你不光可能输钱，还得让朋友围观你输钱。压力来了！

source: You sit down in the last available seat at a nearby poker table. "Okay, table's closed," says the dealer. "Time to start a round of Poker 2."
target: 你在附近的牌桌旁，坐上最后一个空位。“好，人齐了。”荷官说，“开始一局‘扑克 2’。”

source: Wait, Poker 2? The fuck is that?
target: 等等，扑克 2？那他妈是什么？

source: You've never heard of Poker 2, boo? Do you live under a rock or what?
target: 亲爱的，你没听过扑克 2？你是山顶洞人吗？

source: It's like normal poker where the dealer puts five cards on the table and gives you two. Then, you just pick one card from your hand to play and place your bet then.
target: 跟普通扑克差不多，荷官往桌上摆五张牌，再给你发两张。你从手里选一张打出去，再下注就行。

source: So you just play the best card you have? Sounds easy enough!
target: 所以只要打出手里最好的牌？听着挺简单！

source: The dealer spreads five cards out on the table: the three of hearts, the five of spades, the ace of hearts, the jack of hearts, and the queen of hearts.
target: 荷官在桌上摊开五张牌：红桃 3、黑桃 5、红桃 A、红桃 J 和红桃 Q。

source: Okay, being dealt a heart could give you a flush. That's something! You're given your cards.
target: 好，要是发到一张红桃，就能凑个同花。有戏！你的牌发下来了。

source: These are... NOT normal poker cards.
target: 这些……可不是普通扑克牌。

source: What's the holdup, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? Pick your card!
target: 磨蹭什么呢，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%？选张牌吧！

source: The Forty-Four of Clubs
target: 梅花四十四

source: The Three of Swords
target: 宝剑三

source: "I fold," sighs the first player.
target: 第一个玩家叹了口气：“我弃牌。”

source: The second player flips over an ace of spades. "Ha! Two aces. Read 'em and weep."
target: 第二个玩家亮出黑桃 A。“哈！一对 A。看清楚了，哭去吧！”

source: "You fool, going for aces on a table full of hearts!" laughs the third player. "Behold my king of hearts! The highest flush available, sucker!"
target: 第三个玩家大笑：“一桌子红桃，你还指望一对 A？蠢货！看看我的红桃 K！最大的同花，傻眼了吧！”

source: Now it's your turn. You slowly turn over your forty-four of clubs.
target: 轮到你了。你缓缓翻开自己的梅花四十四。

source: WHOA!
target: 呜哇!

source: "You bastard!" the player with the ace screams at you.
target: 拿着 A 的玩家冲你大吼：“你这混蛋！”

source: "What's the problem?" the flush player asks, nonplussed. "There aren't any clubs on the table... or another forty-four, for that matter. That card doesn't even make sense."
target: 拿到同花的玩家一头雾水：“怎么了？桌上又没有梅花……也没有另一张四十四啊。这牌根本就不合理。”

source: Don't you know how Poker 2 works, dummy? %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% has a FORTY-FOUR OF CLUBS. That's, like, so many clubs!
target: 笨蛋，你不懂扑克 2 的规则吗？%CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 拿的是梅花四十四！那得有多少朵梅花啊！

source: It's a way higher amount of clubs than your pitiful hearts flush. Your five hearts cards are meaningless in the face of forty-four clubs!
target: 比你那可怜巴巴的红桃同花多太多了！四十四朵梅花面前，你那五张红桃算个屁！

source: "She's right," the dealer says. "Get the fuck out of here with your flush. Per the rules of Poker 2, you can't return to the table for three years."
target: 荷官说：“她说得对。带上你那同花滚蛋吧。根据扑克 2 的规定，三年之内不许再上桌。”

source: The flush player leaves with his tail between his legs, and you gain +1 MONEY as you advance to the next round!
target: 拿到同花的玩家夹着尾巴走了，你获得 +1 金钱，晋级下一轮！

source: "I fold," sighs the first player.
target: 第一个玩家叹了口气：“我弃牌。”

source: The second player flips over an ace of spades. "Ha! Two aces. Read 'em and weep."
target: 第二个玩家亮出黑桃 A。“哈！一对 A。看清楚了，哭去吧！”

source: Now it's your turn. You slowly turn over your forty-four of clubs.
target: 轮到你了。你缓缓翻开自己的梅花四十四。

source: WHOA!
target: 呜哇!

source: Is that card... good?
target: 那张牌……很好吗？

source: It's a GREAT card. Forty-four clubs is SO MANY CLUBS! Way to go, boo!
target: 好极了！四十四朵梅花，超多的啊！干得漂亮，亲爱的！

source: The last player to go merely chuckles darkly. "It WOULD be a good card," he says, "if I didn't have... this!"
target: 最后一个玩家阴沉地笑了笑：“这本来会是张好牌，可惜……我有这个！”

source: WHOOOOOOOA! THE FORTY-SIX OF CLUBS!
target: 哇——！梅花四十六！

source: That's more, Scott.
target: 斯科特，那个数字更大。

source: Oh! Wow!
target: 哦！哇！

source: "You lose," the dealer says to you. "Step away from the table. Poker 2 rules state you can't play again for another three years."
target: 荷官对你说：“你输了，离桌吧。根据扑克 2 的规则，三年内不许再玩。”

source: Dang, guess that's on you for gambling on a game you didn't know the rules of. Stupid Poker 2. You lose -1 MONEY.
target: 靠，连规则都不懂就来赌，怪谁呢。该死的扑克 2。你失去了 -1 金钱。

source: "I fold," sighs the first player.
target: 第一个玩家叹了口气：“我弃牌。”

source: The second player flips over an ace of spades. "Ha! Two aces. Read 'em and weep."
target: 第二个玩家亮出黑桃 A。“哈！一对 A。看清楚了，哭去吧！”

target: 第三个玩家大笑：“一桌子红桃，你还指望一对 A？蠢货！看看我的红桃 K！最大的同花，傻眼了吧！”

source: Now it's your turn. You slowly turn over your card.
target: 轮到你了。你缓缓翻开手里的牌。

source: A three of swords?! No way!
target: 宝剑三？！不会吧！

source: "Ah!" the dealer says. "You're in luck; I happen to be the casino's resident tarot reader and fortune-teller. Let me interpret that for you."
target: “啊！”荷官说，“你走运了，我正好也是赌场的驻场塔罗师兼算命先生。让我替你解牌。”

source: "The Three of Swords represents unhappiness, heartache, sorrow, and sadness. It is a Minor Arcana card of grief, loss, depression, and tears."
target: “宝剑三代表不快、心痛、哀伤与悲痛。这张小阿尔卡那牌象征悲伤、失落、抑郁和泪水。”

source: "When it appears in your tarot reading, it generally indicates a period of difficulty or hardship, usually on an emotional level."
target: “占卜时抽到这张牌，一般预示你将经历一段艰难困苦的时期，通常是在感情方面。”

source: That sounds bad...
target: 听着不太妙……

source: Not at all, bud. You know what they say...
target: 才不是呢，伙计。俗话说得好……

source: "Scott, don't eat that?"
target: “斯科特，别吃那个”？

source: No, silly! "Lucky at cards, unlucky in love!"
target: 不是啦，傻瓜！“情场失意，赌场得意”！

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s heart-related bad fortune means %HESHE%%VERB_'S_'RE% lucky at cards, so %HESHE% %VERB_WINS_WIN% the round!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%情场失意，说明%HESHE%%VERB_'S_'RE%赌场得意，所以这局%HESHE%%VERB_WINS_WIN%了！

source: "Yep, I must admit my defeat," the player with the flush sighs, getting up. "You lucky-unlucky bastard."
target: 拿到同花的玩家叹着气站起来：“行吧，我认输。你这倒霉又走运的混蛋。”

source: Well, it sucks about your future, but at least you advanced to the next round of Poker 2! You gain +1 MONEY!
target: 虽说你的未来惨了点，可至少晋级了下一轮扑克 2！你获得 +1 金钱！

target: 第三个玩家大笑：“一桌子红桃，你还指望一对 A？蠢货！看看我的红桃 K！最大的同花，傻眼了吧！”

source: Now it's your turn. You slowly turn over your card.
target: 轮到你了。你缓缓翻开手里的牌。

source: A three of swords?! Noooooo! That's bad news!
target: 宝剑三？！不要啊！这可不是什么好兆头！

source: It is?
target: 是吗?

source: "Indeed," says the dealer gravely, pulling out a pager. "I need to call down the resident casino fortune-teller."
target: 荷官神情凝重，掏出呼机：“没错，我得叫赌场的驻场算命先生过来。”

source: A man in flowing robes appears and assesses your card. He says, "In a general context, the Three of Swords represents unhappiness, heartache, sorrow and sadness."
target: 一个长袍飘飘的男人出现了，端详着你的牌，说：“一般而言，宝剑三代表不快、心痛、哀伤与悲痛。”

source: "When it appears in your tarot reading, it indicates a period of difficulty or hardship, usually on an emotional level."
target: “占卜时抽到这张牌，预示你将经历一段艰难困苦的时期，通常是在感情方面。”

source: Oh no!
target: 哦，不！

source: Well, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, you came here to make a fortune... and you got a bad fortune. That's gambling for ya.
target: 唉，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你是来发财的，结果倒发了一笔霉运财。赌博嘛，就这样。

source: Maaaan. You leave the table and lose -1 MONEY, overcome by unhappiness, sorrow, and sadness. Stupid Poker 2!
target: 唉。你满心不快、哀伤与悲痛，离开牌桌，失去了 -1 金钱。该死的扑克 2！

source: In the next round, the dealer reshuffles and lays out the next five-card table spread:
target: 下一轮，荷官重新洗牌，再往桌上摆出五张公共牌：

source: Seven of spades, two of diamonds, eight of diamonds, ace of hearts, seven of spades.
target: 黑桃 7、方块 2、方块 8、红桃 A、黑桃 7。

source: Wait, two sevens of spades? The fuck??
target: 等等，两张黑桃 7？什么鬼？？

source: Actually, after last round, that seems downright normal. Especially when you see the cards you were dealt... what do you lay down?
target: 不过，经历了上一轮，这也算挺正常的了。尤其是看过你手里发到的牌之后……你要打哪张？

source: The Rules Card
target: 规则说明牌

source: The Business Card of a Heart Surgeon
target: 心脏外科医生的名片

source: Just fold and leave
target: 直接弃牌走人

source: The player to your left has the eight of spades. "Double pair of sevens and eights!" he says proudly.
target: 你左边的玩家拿着黑桃 8，得意地说：“7 和 8，两对！”

source: The two players to your right grumble and fold. The last player shows ANOTHER seven of spades. "Three of a kind! Read 'em and weep, fuckers!"
target: 你右边的两个玩家嘟囔着弃了牌。最后一个玩家又亮出一张黑桃 7。“三条！看清楚了，哭去吧，你们这群混蛋！”

source: What do you have, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? Show us!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你拿的什么？亮出来！

source: You turn over your card.
target: 你翻开手里的牌。

source: "NO WAY!" the remaining players cry. "The Poker 2 rules card?!"
target: 剩下的玩家惊呼：“不会吧！扑克 2 的规则说明牌？！”

source: Even the dealer looks impressed. "There are rules to this game? Incredible!" he says. "I gotta confess that I have no earthly idea how to play this game."
target: 连荷官都肃然起敬。“这游戏居然还有规则？不可思议！”他说，“说实话，我压根就不知道这游戏怎么玩。”

source: "Neither do we!" say the other players.
target: 其他玩家说：“我们也不知道！”

source: Yeah, me either TBH. I've just been making shit up this whole time.
target: 对，我也不懂。说实话，我从头到尾都在瞎编。

source: Oh, cool! That's how I passed senior year!
target: 哦，酷！我高三也是这么混过去的！

source: "I'll cut you a deal," the dealer says to you. "If you let us read that rules card, you can win the round."
target: 荷官对你说：“跟你商量一下，让我们看看规则，这局就算你赢。”

source: You'll take it! You gain +1 MONEY and live to poker another day!
target: 成交！你获得 +1 金钱，还能继续上桌打扑克！

target: 你左边的玩家拿着黑桃 8，得意地说：“7 和 8，两对！”

target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你拿的什么？亮出来！

source: "Ha! The Rules Card?" the three-of-a-kind player chortles. "That card's worthless!"
target: 拿到三条的玩家嗤笑道：“哈！规则说明牌？这张牌一文不值！”

source: She's right, boo. Read the card.
target: 她说得对，亲爱的。看看牌上写了什么。

source: It says: "RULES CARD -- Rule 1: The Rules Card has no value in Poker 2 whatsoever."
target: 上面写着：“规则说明牌——第一条：规则说明牌在扑克 2 中毫无价值。”

source: I feel like this one's on you for not reading the card. I can't hold your hand the whole game, dumbass.
target: 这回得怪你自己，谁让你不看牌上的字。我总不能每一局都手把手带你吧，笨蛋。

source: She's not wrong. You leave the table in shame, losing -3 MONEY.

target: 可万一是烂牌呢？就像教练常说的：“要知道什么时候该冲刺达阵，什么时候该下场冲澡！”

source: Fine, y'all do you. What should we do now?
target: 行吧，你们随意。那现在干什么？

source: I dunno. Hit the showers?
target: 不知道。下场冲澡？

source: Mmmm... nah. Let's go to the bar!
target: 嗯……算了，去酒吧！

source: And so you do, leaving Poker 2 behind. Arrivederci, losers!
target: 于是你们抛下扑克 2，去了酒吧。再见啦，输家们！

source: ...THE FORBIDDEN GAMES
target: ……禁忌赌局

source: You enter the casino, ready to make some sweet money.
target: 你走进赌场，准备大赚一笔。

source: YAAASSS! I love casinos! The land of random chance, impulsive decisions, and drinking! Everything's coming up Polly!
target: 好耶——！我爱赌场！处处碰运气，做决定全凭冲动，还能喝酒！今天简直就是波莉的幸运日！

source: You're the expert here, bro! What game should we play?
target: 你才是行家，兄弟！咱们玩什么？

source: That's a hard question! There's roulette, slots, craps, poker, Poker 2...
target: 这可难选！有轮盘、老虎机、双骰、扑克、扑克 2……

source: ...horse racing, snail racing, which-drunk-guy-will-make-it-to-the-bathroom-first racing...
target: ……赛马、赛蜗牛，还有比赛哪个醉鬼先冲进厕所……

source: "Psst!" says a mysterious stranger in a dark coat. "If you're looking for a REAL gambling thrill, have you ever tried... THE FORBIDDEN GAMES?"
target: 一个身穿黑大衣的神秘陌生人压低声音：“嘘！想体验真正刺激的赌博？有没有试过……禁忌赌局？”

source: I've never heard of it. What are the forbidden games?
target: 没听说过。禁忌赌局是什么？

source: "NO! You're pronouncing it wrong! It's... THE FORBIDDEN GAMES! The pregnant pause is important!"
target: “不对！你念错了！是……禁忌赌局！前面那个意味深长的停顿很重要！”

source: We're in! I love doing shady shit that requires a specific pronunciation!
target: 算我们一个！我就爱这种连念法都有讲究的可疑玩意儿！

source: The stranger leads you to the back of the casino where a bouncer stands next to a curtain. He does a strange gesture, and the bouncer pulls the curtain aside.
target: 陌生人领着你们来到赌场后面，一个保镖守在帘子旁。他比了个奇怪的手势，保镖就把帘子拉开了。

source: You're led down a dark hallway. Then you pass the kitchen. Then you pass what appears to be an illegal boxing ring filled with brawny fighters.
target: 你们被带着穿过黑暗的走廊，路过厨房，然后经过一个疑似非法拳场的地方，里面全是肌肉壮汉。

source: Then you pass a room filled with people in cages. They're all sobbing, "NEVER MAKE A DEAL WITH THE SMALL GREEN CREATURE WITH TENTACLES!"
target: 接着，你们路过一间关满笼中人的屋子。他们都在哭喊：“千万别跟那个长触手的绿色小东西做交易！”

source: You pass another kitchen. Then another dark hallway. Then another illegal boxing ring, but it's in a kitchen and the boxers are wearing chef hats.
target: 你们又路过一间厨房、一条黑暗的走廊，还有另一个非法拳场。不过这次拳场就在厨房里，拳手全戴着厨师帽。

source: "Here we are," says the stranger at the final room. "Welcome to... THE FORBIDDEN GAMES!"
target: 终于到了最后一间屋子。陌生人说：“到了，欢迎来到……禁忌赌局！”

source: Wow, this place is really dim, dusty, and smells like bad decisions... AWESOME!
target: 哇，这里又暗又脏，空气里都透着要干蠢事的味儿……太棒了！

source: ...THE FORBIDDEN GAMES room is filled with tables around which sketchy, scarred-up people sit, playing inscrutable card games and flashing knives.
target: ……禁忌赌局的房间里摆满牌桌，桌旁坐着一群可疑的疤脸人，玩着看不懂的纸牌游戏，还不时亮出刀子。

source: This doesn't seem safe, but it was a long walk to get here and you need a breather before you go back, so you might as well pick something to play!
target: 看着不太安全，可走到这儿花了那么久，回去前总得歇口气。干脆挑个游戏玩吧！

source: The extremely strange table where they play a game that seems to be riddled with obscure rules and little sense
target: 那张特别古怪的牌桌：游戏规则晦涩难懂，还没什么道理

source: The "Lenny Gambling" table, where people gamble obscene amounts of money on all kinds of things around this random dude Lenny's life, without him even knowing
target: “赌莱尼”桌：大家拿巨款押注一个叫莱尼的普通人的生活琐事，而他本人毫不知情

source: The game is apparently called "Feral Hamster Blitzkrieg", and you have no idea what you're doing.
target: 这游戏好像叫“疯狂仓鼠闪电战”，你完全不知道自己在干什么。

source: The croupier deals everybody two cards, two dice, a whistle, and sixteen-and-a-half marbles.
target: 荷官给每个人发了两张牌、两颗骰子、一只哨子，还有十六颗半弹珠。

source: The guy to your left rolls his dice and gets two 1s. The girl next to him folds her card into an origami swan. She's given 2 mana points. Huh?
target: 左边那人掷出两个 1。旁边的女孩把牌折成纸天鹅，得到了 2 点法力。啊？

source: A player blows her whistle and yells "CHANGE PLACES!" Everyone runs to new seats.
target: 一位玩家吹响哨子，大喊：“换位子！”所有人都跑去换座。

source: "EATING CONTEST!" the croupier shouts, hitting a gong. "FINISH THAT MUFFIN!"
target: 荷官敲着锣大喊：“大胃王比赛！把那个麦芬吃完！”

source: Everyone gets a jellybean muffin to eat. The player to your right bites into his and realizes his muffin is a bomb! It explodes in his face.
target: 每个人都分到一个软糖豆麦芬。右边的玩家咬了一口，发现自己的麦芬是颗炸弹！炸弹当场糊了他一脸。

source: The next player throws a dart at the dartboard. It lands on a space that says "B." The letter B is added to the hangman game, spelling out "BOMB." The player explodes.
target: 下一个玩家朝镖盘掷出飞镖，命中标着“B”的格子。猜字游戏里添上字母 B，拼成了“BOMB（炸弹）”。那个玩家炸了。

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, I think I've figured it out! I know how to play!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，我好像搞懂了！我知道怎么玩了！

source: Do you, or are you just really drunk?
target: 你真懂了，还是只因为喝多了？

source: Those aren't mutually exclusive, boo! Invoke your Get Out of the Game Free Card and tag Scott in!
target: 这两件事又不冲突，亲爱的！用你的“免费退场卡”，换斯科特上！

source: What? Why me?
target: 什么？为什么是我？

source: Because you're the only one who can legally play the Lycanthropy Kamikaze Gambit. Just trust me on this!
target: 因为只有你能合法使用“狼人神风敢死战术”。信我就对了！

source: Sure, fine, anything to avoid getting hurt by a surprise bomb. You play your Get Out card and let Scott take your seat.
target: 行吧，只要别被突然冒出来的炸弹炸伤，怎么都行。你打出退场卡，让斯科特坐上你的位子。

source: Okay, Scotty: pick all the red jellybeans out of the muffin, then feed them to the feral hamster. If it doesn't eat your fingers off, you win!
target: 好，小斯：把麦芬里的红色软糖豆全挑出来，喂给那只疯狂仓鼠。只要它没咬掉你的手指，就赢了！

source: Okay... wait, which jellybeans are red? I can't remember the difference between red and other colors.
target: 好……等等，哪些软糖豆是红色的？我忘了红色跟其他颜色有什么区别。

source: Polly helps him, Scott feeds the hamster, and by keeping all his fingers intact, YOU WIN THE GAME (for some reason)! You gain +2 MONEY
target: 波莉帮他挑好，斯科特喂了仓鼠，所有手指都完好无损。于是你们就赢了，不知道为什么！你获得 +2 金钱。

target: 这游戏好像叫“疯狂仓鼠闪电战”，你完全不知道自己在干什么。

target: 一位玩家吹响哨子，大喊：“换位子！”所有人都跑去换座。你坐下时，所有弹珠都被换成了软糖豆麦芬。

source: The next player eats half of their muffin. Inside is a bomb! He tries to diffuse it, but he runs out of time and explodes.
target: 下一个玩家吃到一半，发现麦芬里藏着炸弹！他试图拆弹，却没来得及，整个人炸了。

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, I think I've figured it out! I know how to play!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，我好像搞懂了！我知道怎么玩了！

source: Do you, or are you just really drunk?
target: 你真懂了，还是只因为喝多了？

source: Those aren't mutually exclusive, boo! Throw a dart at the dartboard and say you're ready to solve the hangman puzzle. Guess the letter "B!"
target: 这两件事又不冲突，亲爱的！朝镖盘扔一镖，说你准备解开猜字谜。猜字母“B”！

source: You're unsure, but you don't have any better ideas. You follow Polly's instructions.
target: 你心里没底，可也没有更好的办法，只好照着波莉说的做。

source: Apparently, "B" was the last letter in the hangman phrase! Unfortunately, the resulting word was "BOMB." As soon as it's solved, your pants explode.
target: 原来“B”就是猜字谜里缺的最后一个字母！可惜拼出来的是“BOMB（炸弹）”。刚猜出来，你的裤子就炸了。

source: "DISQUALIFIED!" the croupier cries. "Now get out of here, or I'll call the cops on you for public nudity!"
target: 荷官大喊：“取消资格！赶紧滚，不然就告你公共场合裸露，叫警察来抓你！”

source: Oh, never mind, I have no idea how to play.
target: 哦，算了，我根本不知道怎么玩。

source: That's on you for listening to me, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. Don't you know I'm drunk?
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，谁让你听我的。你不知道我喝醉了吗？

source: Yup, great, cool. You're kicked out of the casino and lose -2 MONEY, and -1 FAVORITE PAIR OF PANTS.
target: 行，真行，棒极了。你被赶出赌场，失去了 -2 金钱，还有 -1 条最爱的裤子。

source: Surrounding the table are several screens, all broadcasting different locales where one guy, Lenny, seems to frequently visit.
target: 牌桌周围摆着几块屏幕，分别播放着一个叫莱尼的人常去的不同地点。

source: There are cameras at a park, in a metro station, in a diner, in an office cubicle, in a bedroom, in a bathroom...
target: 公园、地铁站、餐馆、办公隔间、卧室、浴室……到处都装了摄像头。

source: This seems really invasive... but hey, I came here to gamble, not question anybody's morals. FIVE BUCKS SAYS LENNY'S LATE FOR WORK!
target: 这也太侵犯隐私了……不过我来是赌博的，又不是来批判别人道德的。我押五块，赌莱尼上班迟到！

source: Lenny's alarm clock goes off, but he sleeps through it, and he's over an hour late! Point to Polly!
target: 莱尼的闹钟响了，他却睡得雷打不动，一迟到就是一个多小时！波莉得一分！

source: "Lenny's getting a sandwich for lunch now," says the croupier. "Do I hear any bets that he'll put ketchup on his sandwich?"
target: 荷官说：“莱尼现在要吃三明治当午饭了。有没有人押他往里面加番茄酱？”

source: Ooh! I bet he'll accidentally put the ketchup on his penis instead!
target: 哦！我押他手一滑，把番茄酱挤到鸡巴上！

source: Lenny puts mustard on his sandwich, to everyone's chagrin. But you get it now: the riskier/less likely the event you bet on is, the bigger the payout if it happens.
target: 莱尼加了芥末酱，众人大失所望。不过你明白了：赌得越险、押中的概率越低，真中了赚得就越多。

source: Someone wins 1500 bucks on a winning bet that Lenny will lose his job. Another gets $20k betting that he'll sell his gaming console to pay his rent.
target: 有人押中莱尼失业，赢了 1500 块。还有人赌他卖掉游戏机付房租，赢了两万。

source: "I'm sick of you, Lenny!" Lenny's husband says onscreen. "You have no drive; no ambition! I want a divorce!"
target: 屏幕里，莱尼的丈夫说：“我受够你了，莱尼！没干劲，没上进心！我要离婚！”

source: Damn, this just got INTERESTING! I'll put money down on Lenny's ex-husband getting custody of the dog!
target: 靠，这下有意思了！我押莱尼的前夫拿到狗的抚养权！

source: No! Not Captain Woof Woof! He doesn't deserve to grow up in a broken home!
target: 不！别这样对汪汪船长！它不该在破碎的家庭里长大！

source: If risky bets are what pays, then you've got one: you bet that Lenny will find love again and turn out okay.
target: 既然高风险的赌注才赚钱，你就押个高风险的：赌莱尼会再找到真爱，好好生活下去。

source: You watch Lenny lose his house, his money, and even Captain Woof Woof in the divorce. He goes to the park to eat a sad hot dog.
target: 你眼看莱尼在离婚中丢了房子、钱，连汪汪船长都没留下。他跑去公园，悲伤地吃起热狗。

source: So TODAY'S the day you try ketchup, you fucker?! UGH!
target: 偏偏今天才吃番茄酱，你这混蛋？！烦死了！

source: You watch Lenny drop his hot dog on himself, smearing ketchup over his last good suit, and burst into tears.
target: 莱尼手里的热狗掉在自己身上，番茄酱弄脏了他最后一套好西装。他顿时泪如雨下。

source: Then, a tall man with an elegant mustache offers Lenny a silk hanky! "I thought you might need this," he says, "...handsome."
target: 这时，一个留着优雅胡子的高个男人递给莱尼一条丝绸手帕！“我想你可能用得着……”他说，“……帅哥。”

source: "The %MANWOMAN% who bet on Lenny finding love again wins," says the croupier.
target: 荷官说：“押莱尼会再找到真爱的那位 %MANWOMAN% 赢了。”

source: Hooray! You won... THE FORBIDDEN GAMES with +2 SOUL, the least likely outcome of them all.
target: 万岁！你赢下了……禁忌赌局，获得 +2 灵魂。所有结果里，就数这最不可能。

target: 屏幕里，莱尼的丈夫说：“我受够你了，莱尼！没干劲，没上进心！我要离婚！”

source: This just got really interesting! You bet on Lenny losing his dog in the divorce.
target: 这下真有意思了！你押莱尼离婚时会失去他的狗。

source: You're bringing poor Captain Woof Woof into this?! Shame on you!
target: 你要把可怜的汪汪船长也扯进来？！太不像话了！

source: Yeah, betting on the misfortune of one dude without his knowledge or consent is one thing, but doing it to a poor defenseless dog? WOW.
target: 就是，瞒着一个人赌他倒霉是一回事，可连一只可怜无辜的狗都不放过？哇哦。

source: I know we're monsters, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, but we gotta draw the line somewhere. You make me sick.
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，我知道咱们是怪物，可总得有个底线吧。你真让我恶心。

source: So this is what it feels like to be the asshole among assholes. Ouch.
target: 原来这就是当混蛋堆里最混蛋的那个的感觉。扎心了。

source: Worse, Lenny manages to keep Captain Woof Woof in a move that benefits everyone but you as you lose -2 SOUL.
target: 更惨的是，莱尼竟然成功留下了汪汪船长。所有人都高兴，除了你：你失去了 -2 灵魂。

source: Identify constellations
target: 识别星座

source: You'd like to learn more about the constellations, but you don't know much about what you're looking at. If only you had an expert to tell you more about them...
target: 你想多了解些星座，可满天星斗，你实在看不出门道。要是有个专家来讲讲就好了……

source: Sorry to bother you, but I sense that my presence was narratively foreshadowed. Are you folks interested in learning more about the constellations?
target: 不好意思，打扰了，不过我感觉刚才的旁白已经给我的出场埋了伏笔。各位想了解星座吗？

source: We totally are! What great timing!
target: 太想了！你来得正好！

source: Then I can help! I'm Andy. I've got a PhD in astronomy, and I can teach you all about the science and history of the celestial bodies!
target: 那我能帮忙！我叫安迪，有天文学博士学位，可以给你们讲天体的科学知识和历史！

source: Sure, but can your fancy degree teach you how to properly attune to the ever-changing vibes of the universe? Didn't think so.
target: 行啊，可你那个高大上的学位，能教你如何跟宇宙变幻的能量同频吗？我看不能。

source: Whoa, who are you?
target: 哇，你又是谁？

source: I'm Lee, expert astrologist. I can teach you how the positions of the cosmos affect your moods, your behavior, and even your FUTURE. Cool, huh?
target: 我叫李，专业占星师。我能教你，天体的位置如何影响你的情绪、行为，甚至未来。酷吧？

source: Ugh, not this ridiculous star-magic again. You know astrology is all hogwash, don't you?
target: 唉，又来这套荒唐的星星魔法。你不知道占星术全是胡扯吗？

source: Psh, typical skeptic. Just 'cause you can't scientifically prove something's existence doesn't mean it isn't real.
target: 嘁，典型的怀疑论者。科学证明不了它存在，不代表它就不存在。

source: I can't use science to prove that you're a huge nerd, but everybody knows it's true.
target: 我也没法用科学证明你是个大书呆子，可大家都知道那是真的。

source: No they don't!
target: 才没人这么觉得！

source: Eh... Lee may have a point here.
target: 呃……这点李可能说对了。

source: As much as you'd love to watch these two experts bicker all day, you actually do want to learn about the constellations. But from whom will you learn?
target: 虽然你很想看这两位专家吵上一整天，可你确实也想了解星座。该听谁的呢？

source: Stars are beautiful celestial bodies by themselves; no need to pretend they're crabs, virgins, or sexy centaurs. Let's hear the astronomy take.
target: 星星本身就是美丽的天体，何必非把它们想成螃蟹、处女或性感的半人马。听听天文学怎么说吧。

source: There needs to be something else to the stars besides being tons of gas exploding miles from Earth. Let's hear the astrology take.
target: 星星除了是远离地球的一大堆爆燃气体，总该有点别的意义吧。听听占星术怎么说吧。

source: Right you are, my friend! Why embrace unknowable, undefinable magic when the real world is fascinating enough?
target: 说得对，朋友！现实世界已经够迷人了，何必去追求那些不可知、无法定义的魔法？

source: Cool! Dr. Andy, can you tell me anything about the Big Boy Frying Pan constellation?
target: 酷！安迪博士，你能给我讲讲大个子平底锅星座吗？

source: Oh... well, an interesting fact about that constellation is that it's actually called the Big Dipper.
target: 哦……关于那个星座，有个有趣的知识：它其实叫北斗七星。

source: Whoa, you know Big Boy Frying Pan's legal name? You two must be really close!
target: 哇，你连大个子平底锅的大名都知道？你俩肯定很熟！

source: What can you tell me about Fashionable Steve? Like, do you know where he got his starry belt? I want one just like it!
target: 那时髦史蒂夫呢？比如，你知道他那条星星腰带哪儿买的吗？我也想要一条！

source: Oh, you're referring to Orion... well, what if I told you that one of the three "stars" in Orion's Belt is actually a nebula?
target: 哦，你说的是猎户座……那我要是告诉你，猎户腰带上的三颗“星”里，其实有一颗是星云呢？

source: It's not a star? WOW! I had no idea my nighttime buddies were such a diverse group!
target: 不是星星？哇！我都不知道，我这些夜里的好朋友竟然这么多元！

source: Dr. Andy, can you tell me why the constellations go away? Sometimes they're in the sky and sometimes they're not... am I making them mad at me?
target: 安迪博士，星座为什么会消失啊？有时在天上，有时又不在……是不是我惹它们生气了？

source: Don't worry, the stars never really "go away". The visible constellations simply change as the Earth rotates around the sun.
target: 别担心，星星并没有真的“消失”。只是地球绕太阳公转，我们能看到的星座就会跟着变化。

source: What? The Earth doesn't rotate, silly. The sun rotates around us; you can see it moving in the sky.
target: 什么？傻瓜，地球不会转。是太阳绕着我们转，你看，它就在天上移动呢。

source: You think that the...? Okay, I'm gonna need to grab you a textbook. Stay here.
target: 你觉得……？好吧，我得去给你拿本教科书。待着别动。

source: This is the most you've ever seen Scott connect with academic material! You gain +N2 MIND learning astronomy, but lose -N2 MAGIC for snubbing astrology.
target: 你从没见斯科特跟学术知识这么投缘！学习天文学让你获得 +N2 头脑，不过你冷落了占星术，失去了 -N2 魔力。

source: Nice, high five! The stars' predictions are in, and they're telling me you're super cool.
target: 不错，击个掌！星星给出了预言：你超级酷。

source: Fuck yeah I am! So, if you can use the stars to predict the future, can you give me my next big-winning roulette number?
target: 他妈的可不嘛！既然你能看星星预测未来，那能告诉我下一把轮盘押哪个数字赚大钱吗？

source: Heh, not quite... but I can use astrological theory to predict what sort of person you are.
target: 哈，那倒不行……不过我能根据占星理论，推断你是什么样的人。

source: For instance, given your bubbly spirit and interest in learning, I'm willing to bet you're a Sagittarius.
target: 比如，你开朗活泼，又爱学习，我敢说你是射手座。

source: Sags are ruled by the fiery planet Jupiter. They're jacks-of-all-trades with a passion for life. They go with the flow and don't take things too seriously.
target: 射手座的守护星是火热的木星。他们样样拿手，热爱生活，随遇而安，不太把事情当回事。

source: Yup, spot on. You're either great at your job or great at secretly reading my Horny Dating App (TM) profile.
target: 没错，全中。你要么业务过硬，要么偷看我饥渴交友软件 (TM) 上的简介很有一套。

source: Me next, me next! My zodiac sign is Cancer. What does that mean?
target: 换我，换我！我是巨蟹座，代表什么？

source: Cancer is controlled by the Moon. The Moon is a maternal figure in mythology; as such, Cancers make great caregivers, or even just great friends.
target: 巨蟹座由月亮守护。神话里的月亮是母亲的象征，所以巨蟹很会照顾人，也特别适合当朋友。

source: That makes sense. I'm a good boi, and I'm totally controlled by the moon!
target: 说得通！我是乖狗狗，也确实完全受月亮控制！

source: This is ridiculous! These baseline personality traits prove nothing; you could apply "likes to learn" and "is sensitive and caring" to anyone!
target: 太荒唐了！这些泛泛的人格描述什么都证明不了。谁不能说自己“喜欢学习”“敏感体贴”？

source: Ugh, always criticizing and over-analyzing... you're a Virgo, I take it?
target: 唉，老爱挑毛病，什么都分析过头……你是处女座吧？

source: Hmph... lucky guess.
target: 哼……蒙对而已。

source: What a fascinating lecture! You gain +N2 MAGIC from learning the cosmic chaos of astrology, though you do lose -N2 MIND for snubbing astronomy.
target: 真是一堂精彩的课！占星术里混沌的宇宙奥秘让你获得 +N2 魔力，不过你冷落了天文学，失去了 -N2 头脑。

source: Watch the laser show
target: 看激光表演

source: You, Scott, and Polly are sitting in your seats waiting for the laser show to start, when suddenly a man appears before you in a cloud of magic and cheap rum smell.
target: 你和斯科特、波莉坐在座位上，等着激光秀开始。突然，一团魔法烟雾裹着廉价朗姆酒的味道，一个男人出现在你们面前。

source: Hey, bro! Who are you? I like the weird, unsettling stains all over your wizard robes.
target: 嘿，兄弟！你是谁？你巫师袍上那些怪怪的、看着很不妙的污渍，我挺喜欢的。

source: "Heyyy, kids!" the stranger says. "I'm Joe the Laser, the wizard who runs the laser show!"
target: 陌生人说：“嘿——孩子们！我是激光乔，负责激光秀的巫师！”

source: Oh, cool, I remember you!
target: 哦，酷，我记得你！

source: You guys have met before?
target: 你们以前见过？

source: Yup! I was leaving the club and ran into Joe the Laser. He taught me how to shuffle to "Party Rock Anthem" by the 2010s hit band LMFAO -- with lasers!
target: 对啊！我从夜店出来时碰到过激光乔。他教我用激光，跟着 2010 年代的当红组合 LMFAO 的《Party Rock Anthem》跳鬼步舞！
