source: It was an educational experience I'll never forget!
target: 那次学习经历，我这辈子都忘不了！

source: "Oh! That's good to hear, because I completely forgot that happened," Joe the Laser says. "But since we're old shuffle-buddies, you gotta help me!"
target: “哦！那太好了，因为我完全不记得这事。”激光乔说，“不过既然是一起跳过鬼步的老朋友，你可得帮帮我！”

source: "I'm worried my laser-show routine is getting old. Laser shows aren't really 'hip' anymore. Could one of you 'with-it' youths help me spice up the show?"
target: “我怕自己的激光秀套路太老了。现在激光秀也不怎么‘时髦’了。你们这些‘潮流’年轻人，能不能帮我加点料？”

source: I can try. Let's see... if I wanted to do the perfect laser show, I would...
target: 我试试。想想看……要办一场完美的激光秀，我会……

source: USE LASERS!
target: 用激光！

source: "Good call, good call. But I still need a big WOW factor... how about you just come up and run the lights with me?"
target: “有道理，有道理。不过我还缺点让人‘哇’出来的东西……要不你上台，陪我一起控灯？”

source: Sounds super fun! Polly, you wanna help us run the laser show?
target: 听着超好玩！波莉，你来不来帮忙办激光秀？

source: Eh, no thanks. Unlike Joe the Laser, I know better than to operate pyrotechnical equipment while I'm drunk.
target: 呃，不了，谢谢。我跟激光乔不一样，至少知道喝醉了别碰烟火设备。

source: But you can take %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% with you. I'm sure %HESHE%'d love the opportunity to butt in on someone else's problems.
target: 不过你可以带 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 去。能掺和别人的麻烦，%HESHE% 肯定乐意。

source: Yup, it's kinda your thing! You and Scott take the stage with Joe the Laser and punch up the laser show with your foolproof method:
target: 没错，你就好这口！你和斯科特跟激光乔一起上台，用万无一失的方法给激光秀加点料：

source: Do an educational rap on how lasers actually work. Educational raps are fun!
target: 唱一段科普说唱，讲讲激光的原理。科普说唱多好玩啊！

source: Add some surprise by hiding a coupon for a free laser hair removal session under a random seat.
target: 往随机一个座位底下藏张免费激光脱毛券，制造惊喜。

source: Increase the stakes by adding one death laser among the regular lasers. Ultimate thrill!
target: 在普通激光里混一道死亡激光，提高风险。追求极致刺激！

source: Are you sure, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? Aren't educational raps kinda... boring?
target: 你确定吗，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%？科普说唱不是有点……无聊吗？

source: NO! Educational raps are the best way to connect to modern youths on their own turf while simultaneously enriching their +N2 MIND!
target: 才不！用现代年轻人熟悉的方式接近他们，同时让他们获得 +N2 头脑，科普说唱可是最佳选择！

source: Okay, if you say so. Let's do this! Can you gimme a beat?
target: 好吧，你说是就是。开始吧！能给我打个节拍吗？

source: Sure! You start beatboxing: "Boots and cats and boots and cats and boots and cats and--"
target: 当然！你开始用嘴打节拍：“动次打次、动次打次、动次打次、动次——”

source: YO, WELCOME TO THE SHOW HERE IN LASER NATION / TALKIN' ABOUT ELECTROMAGNETIC RADIATION
target: 哟，欢迎来到激光国度的现场／今天我们来把电磁辐射讲！

source: LASERS ARE CREATED BY LIGHT AMPLIFICATION / AND NOT THE KINDA LIGHT THAT MAKES YOU LOOK LIKE A RAISIN
target: 激光靠的是把光来放大／可不是把你晒成葡萄干的那种光啊！

source: NO, LASERS ARE DISTINCT BECAUSE OF THEIR COHERENCE / YO, THEIR LIGHT'S DIFFRACTION-LIMITED, NO INTERFERENCE
target: 激光有啥不一样？相干性很强／达到衍射极限，不受干扰影响！

source: MY RHYMES FLOW LIKE LIGHT WAVELENGTHS IN A VACUUM / NOW MY BRO JOE THE LASER'S GONNA SPIT MORE FACTS AT YOU!
target: 我的押韵像真空里的光波一样流淌／接下来激光乔老兄，更多知识他来讲！

source: The spotlight swings around to Joe the Laser... who's currently asleep with his head in a bucket of rum. Nobody claps.
target: 聚光灯转向激光乔……他正把头埋在一桶朗姆酒里呼呼大睡。没人鼓掌。

source: Boo, I'm sorry, but I dunno how else to say it... that was boring. You somehow managed to take rap and lasers, two objectively very cool things, and make them boring.
target: 亲爱的，抱歉，我也不知道还能怎么说……实在太无聊了。说唱和激光，明明两样都很酷，你愣是把它们弄无聊了。

source: Yeah, you're right. I think this has pretty much decided that I won't pursue a career in educational rap.
target: 对，你说得对。看来我已经可以确定，以后不会从事科普说唱了。

source: Suddenly, a security guard runs in. "What are you doing?!" he shouts. "Why are you onstage?!"
target: 突然，一个保安冲了进来，大喊：“你们在干什么？！谁让你们上台的？！”

source: Joe the Laser let us up here! He's the wizard who runs the show and taught us life lessons about 2010s party music.
target: 激光乔让我们上来的！他是负责表演的巫师，还教过我们 2010 年代派对音乐里的人生道理。

source: "Oh, THAT guy," the guard sighs. "He doesn't actually work here. He just gets drunk and trespasses and insists he's in charge of the laser show."
target: 保安叹了口气：“哦，又是那家伙。他根本不在这儿工作，就是喝醉了乱闯，非说激光秀归他管。”

source: Oh, whoops. Joe the Laser gets thrown out, a lot of the audience leaves because you made the laser show lame with your rap, and you lose -N2 HYPE.
target: 哎，搞错了。激光乔被扔了出去，好些观众也走了，因为你的说唱让激光秀变得很无聊。你失去了 -N2 热度。

source: "Hey, great idea, kid!" Joe the Laser says. He grabs a mic. "EVERYONE! We've got a special laser show planned today!"
target: “嘿，好主意，小家伙！”激光乔拿起麦克风，“各位！今天有一场特别的激光秀！”

source: "Look under your chairs. Whoever finds the beer I lost will get a FREE laser hair removal from my assistant, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!"
target: “看看椅子底下！谁找到我丢的啤酒，就能享受一次由我的助手 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 提供的免费激光脱毛！”

source: Oh, awesome! If I still had hair and not just an ectoplasm ponytail, I'd totally be down to participate.
target: 哦，太棒了！要是我还有头发，而不是这条灵质马尾，我肯定参加。

source: "Hey, I found a beer!" an aging man in the back row shouts. "Do I win?!"
target: 后排一个上了年纪的男人喊道：“嘿，我找到一瓶啤酒！我中奖了吗？！”

source: Yup! Come onstage, bro! What's your name?
target: 没错！上台来，兄弟！你叫什么？

source: "Hello! My name's Pavel. I'm a 62-year-old train operator."
target: “你们好！我叫帕维尔，今年六十二岁，是个火车司机。”

source: Hi, Pavel! Do you wanna give anyone a shout-out before %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% lasers your hair off?
target: 嗨，帕维尔！在 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 给你激光脱毛之前，有没有想对谁喊句话？

source: "Yes, I'd like to shout-out my wife... who died recently. She always wanted to go to a laser show, but I was always too busy driving trains, so we never did go see one."
target: “有，我想对我的妻子说几句……她最近过世了。她一直想看激光秀，可我总忙着开火车，一次也没陪她看过。”

source: "I'm doing this for her. I miss you, Doris, wherever you are."
target: “今天我是为了她来的。不管你在哪里，多丽丝，我都很想你。”

source: Aww! MAKE SOME NOISE FOR PAVEL AND DORIS!!!
target: 呜！把欢呼声送给帕维尔和多丽丝！！！

source: "Could you do the laser hair removal on my butt?" Pavel asks, dropping trou. "Doris used to shave my butt for me, but now that she's gone, it's gotten... out of hand."
target: 帕维尔脱下裤子，问：“能给我屁股脱毛吗？以前都是多丽丝帮我刮屁股毛，可她走了以后，就……失控了。”

source: Sure! You gain +N2 HYPE lasering the hair off Pavel's left cheek. Unfortunately, security bursts in before you can address the other one.
target: 当然！你给帕维尔的左半边屁股脱了毛，获得 +N2 热度。可惜另一半还没处理，保安就冲了进来。

source: "DAMMIT! It's Joe the Laser again!" the guards swear. "You don't work here! Quit trespassing and drunkenly operating our lasers!"
target: 保安骂道：“妈的！又是激光乔！你根本不是这儿的员工！别再闯进来，醉醺醺地乱开我们的激光了！”

source: "Uh, time for me to go!" Joe the Laser says. "Assistant %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% will do my jail time for me! Joe the Laser is OUT!"
target: 激光乔说：“呃，我该走了！坐牢就让助手 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 替我去吧！激光乔撤了！”

source: Joe the Laser disappears in another puff of smoke. You don't go to jail, but you do have to pay a -N2 MAGIC fine for "impersonating a laser wizard."
target: 又一阵烟雾，激光乔消失了。你倒没坐牢，可因为“冒充激光巫师”，交了 -N2 魔力的罚款。

source: Hmmm, I dunno. Death sounds bad... but lasers are fun. So do they cancel each other out?
target: 嗯，不太确定。死听着不太好……可激光很好玩。那是不是就互相抵消了？

source: "They do now!" says Joe the Laser. "Life is only fun for those who take risks! (Except for whoever dies tonight because of that risk, but fuck 'em.)"
target: 激光乔说：“现在能抵消了！只有敢冒险，人生才有乐趣！（今晚因为冒险死掉的人除外，不过管他妈的。）”

source: Okay, sounds good to me! Let's fire the lasers!
target: 好，听起来不错！发射激光！

source: Ten minutes later...
target: 十分钟后...

source: "SOMEONE HELP!" a woman cries. "My husband is bleeding out!"
target: 一个女人哭喊：“救命啊！我丈夫快流血流死了！”

source: Whoa, Joe the Laser wasn't kidding. That is one EFFECTIVE death ray!
target: 哇，激光乔还真没开玩笑。这死亡射线真管用！

source: "WHY ARE YOU ALL JUST STANDING AROUND?!" the woman screams. "Somebody, call an ambulance now!"
target: 女人尖叫：“都傻站着干什么？！快来个人叫救护车啊！”

source: Lady, it's called a "death ray" for a reason. The whole point is that it kills you immediately.
target: 女士，都叫“死亡射线”了，肯定有原因。这玩意儿就是为了让人当场死掉。

source: "It's okay, Sharon," the husband coughs, tenderly stroking his wife's cheek. "Truthfully, it... *cough!*... it was a very cool laser show, wasn't it?"
target: 丈夫咳嗽着，轻轻抚摸妻子的脸：“没事的，莎伦。说真的，这……*咳！*……激光秀真的很酷，对吧？”

source: "Oh, Edward...," Sharon sighs. "It was. It really, truly was."
target: “哦，爱德华……”莎伦叹道，“是啊，真的、真的很酷。”

source: "Don't... *cough!*... call an ambulance. I don't want... *cough, cough!*... to interrupt the dope laser show."
target: “别……*咳！*……叫救护车。我不想……*咳，咳！*……打断这么酷的激光秀。”

source: "It'd... *cough!*... be super... uncool..."
"Edward? EDWARD?! NOOOOOO!"
target: “爱德华？爱德华？！不——！”

source: What's that noise? Is someone screaming in heartbroken horror out in the crowd?
target: 什么声音？是不是有人在人群里，绝望又伤心地尖叫？

source: Ignore it! IT'S LASER TIME, MOTHERFUCKERS!
target: 别管！激光时间到了，小婊子们！

source: So it is. You gain +N6 HYPE from your high-stakes laser show, but you lose -N3 MAGIC and -N3 SOUL for using Joe the Laser's magic to endanger lives. Oh well!
target: 可不嘛。这场玩命激光秀让你获得 +N6 热度，不过你用激光乔的魔法危及他人性命，失去了 -N3 魔力和 -N3 灵魂。管他呢！

source: Attend the comet shower
target: 观赏彗星雨

source: Lucky for you, there is a comet shower happening tonight! You and your friends settle in at the planetarium to enjoy a special viewing.
target: 你运气真好，今晚正有一场彗星雨！你和朋友们在天象馆坐好，欣赏这场特别观测。

source: This is so cool! I love comet showers! The shooting stars are all so pretty!
target: 太酷了！我爱彗星雨！流星都好漂亮！

source: This takes me back to Camp Spooky. Scott, remember that meteor shower at the end of summer camp?
target: 想起怪物夏令营了。斯科特，记得夏令营快结束时那场流星雨吗？

source: Oh, yeah! You and I decided to take a break from being super invested in finding a date and watched the shower as friends.
target: 哦，记得！咱俩决定暂时别一门心思找约会对象，以朋友的身份一起看流星雨。

source: Yup, it was great! I'm glad we weren't one of those desperate motherfuckers losing sleep over finding a summer honey.
target: 对，超棒！幸好我们没像某些饥渴的混蛋，找个夏日情人找得觉都不睡。

source: Damn, Polly didn't have to scalp you like that.
target: 靠，波莉，你也不用这么揭人伤疤吧。

source: What are you guys gonna wish for when the stars start shooting?
target: 等流星划过，你们想许什么愿？

source: That's a good question. Hmm, what do I want to wish for?
target: 问得好。嗯，我想许什么愿呢？

source: Wishing for a flask that never empties would be pretty sweet. Or maybe I could wish for a talking octopus that gives me massages?
target: 许愿要个永远喝不空的酒壶，应该挺爽。或者来只会说话、能帮我按摩的章鱼？

source: I was gonna wish for world peace, but a massage octopus sounds so much cooler! I can't decide now!
target: 我本来想许愿世界和平，可按摩章鱼听着酷多了！这下选不出来了！

source: HERE COMES THE FIRST SHOOTING STAR! We only have one chance for a good wish! %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, what should we wish for?
target: 第一颗流星来了！许个好愿望的机会只有一次！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，咱们许什么？

source: Dang, you never know what to wish for. That's why you still have wishes left in your monkey's paw. Maybe you can use your wish number %NEXTPAWWISHNUMBER% to wish for the clarity to know what to wish for.
target: 唉，你总不知道该许什么愿，难怪猴爪的许愿次数还没用完。要不用第 %NEXTPAWWISHNUMBER% 次机会，许愿让自己想清楚该许什么愿？

source: Forfeit the opportunity to sound cool and spend your wish on a selfless deed: wish Scott hadn't put his hand in that marmalade jar that was full of wasps.
target: 放弃耍酷，把愿望用在无私的事上：但愿斯科特没把手伸进那个装满黄蜂的橘子酱罐子。

source: Ah, yes, your monkey's paw. You have a helpful flashback to remind yourself how you acquired it.
target: 哦，对，你的猴爪。来段及时的闪回，回忆一下它是怎么来的。

source: You encountered its previous owner, a mysterious old man with seriously cursed vibes, in an abandoned subway station at 3 a.m.
target: 凌晨三点，你在一座废弃地铁站遇上了猴爪的前任主人：一位神秘老人，浑身透着一股诅咒的气息。

source: This paw is unimaginably powerful," he said as he gave it to you. "When you wish on the paw, you rewrite your whole reality.
target: 老人把它交给你时说：“这只猴爪的力量超乎想象。对着它许愿，就能改写整个现实。”

source: You basically create a splintering timeline in which your wish came true. It's all very complex and arcane.
target: 基本上，就是创造一条愿望成真的分支时间线。原理非常复杂，也很玄奥。

source: Be careful with this thing. Nobody's truly sure what the consequences of using magic like this could have!
target: 用这东西千万小心。谁也说不准，用这种魔法会有什么后果！

source: Ugh, yawn. However you came to visit this abandoned subway station, you definitely didn't come to learn about this boring fantasy riff on quantum physics.
target: 唉，听得想打哈欠。不管你怎么跑到这座废弃地铁站来的，肯定不是为了听这种奇幻版量子物理的无聊设定。

source: Now that you think about it, will wishing for wish-making clarity count as 1 compound wish or 2 wishes? Will that be, like... worse?
target: 现在想来，许愿让自己想清楚该许什么愿，算一个复合愿望，还是两个愿望？那会不会……更糟？

source: Well, only one way to find out! You wish for clarity on the monkey's paw, spending -N2 MAGIC.
target: 试试才知道！你对猴爪许愿，让思路清晰起来，花掉了 -N2 魔力。

source: For a minute, you feel like your mind is cleaving in two... but then, suddenly, you gain +N2 MIND and know EXACTLY what to wish for.
target: 有那么一会儿，你觉得脑子要裂成两半了……可随后，你突然获得 +N2 头脑，清楚地知道自己该许什么愿。

source: I wish to one day open an awesome waterpark. It'd be the perfect place for our next big adventure.
target: 我希望有一天能开一家超棒的水上乐园。那就是咱们下一场大冒险的绝佳地点。

source: A waterpark? That sounds awesome, boo! We'd finally get our own road trip bikini episode!
target: 水上乐园？好主意，亲爱的！咱们这趟公路旅行，终于能有比基尼特别篇了！

source: And it was really nice of you to include us in your wish! If only there were a way to ensure our wishes could come true.
target: 而且你许愿还想着我们，真好！要是有办法确保愿望成真就好了。

source: Yeah, that would be really nice. Oh well, we can't have everything!
target: 是啊，那可真好。不过，做人不能太贪心嘛！

source: Hey, that's a good wish! And it was really nice of you to use your wish to make my life nicer, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 嘿，这愿望好！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，谢谢你用自己的愿望，让我的日子更好过。

source: Scott, that reminds me, is your hand STILL stuck in that wasp-infested marmalade jar?
target: 斯科特，说起来，你的手还卡在那个全是黄蜂的橘子酱罐里吗？

source: It sure is! Man, I've probably had my hand in this thing for, like, four hours now.
target: 没错！天啊，我的手伸进去，大概有四个小时了吧。

source: Damn, that's right! I remember we were gonna try to get it off, but then we got distracted by that cool-looking cloud and totally forgot about it.
target: 靠，对哦！本来想帮你弄下来，结果看见一朵超酷的云，就走神忘光了。

source: That cloud was SO cool, though. It looked like a duck riding a skateboard upside-down!
target: 不过那朵云真的酷！像只鸭子倒骑着滑板！

source: But then if you squinted at it and stood on your head, it looked more like a walrus taking a sponge-bath.
target: 可要是眯着眼睛倒立着看，又更像只在擦澡的海象。

source: And then when the wasps stung my eyelids and made them swollen and puffy, the cloud looked like a keytar-playing snail!
target: 后来黄蜂蜇了我的眼皮，肿得老高，那云看着又像只弹肩背键盘的蜗牛！

source: The wasps...? OH, RIGHT! Scott, we almost forgot about the jar again!
target: 黄蜂……？哦，对！斯科特，差点又把罐子忘了！

source: Haha, you're right! That cloud's so cool, it's STILL distracting us!
target: 哈哈，没错！那朵云酷得咱们到现在还在走神！

source: Well, better act now before your short attention spans run out again. You smash the marmalade jar with a hammer, and the angry wasps fly away.
target: 趁你们的注意力还没再次跑掉，赶紧动手。你拿锤子砸碎橘子酱罐，愤怒的黄蜂飞走了。

source: I feel a lot better now. Thanks, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!
target: 现在好多了。谢谢你，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！

source: Whoa, do you guys grasp what just happened?! %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% wished on the shooting star for Scott to be freed, and %HISHER% wish came true!
target: 哇，你们明白刚才发生什么了吗？！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 对流星许愿，想让斯科特脱困，结果 %HISHER% 愿望成真了！

source: You're right! %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s like a star-wishing wizard!
target: 对哦！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 简直是个流星许愿巫师！

source: If %HISHER% wish was bound to come true, though, it's a shame %HESHE% didn't wish for something cooler, like three matching aquatic bikes or something.
target: 不过，既然 %HISHER% 愿望注定会成真，%HESHE% 怎么没许个更酷的呢？比如三辆配套的水上自行车什么的。

source: Whoa, you're right, that would've been a REALLY cool wish. Oh well, guess it's a missed opportunity.
target: 哇，说得对，那愿望可酷多了。唉，错过机会了。

source: That's a shame. You lose -N2 HYPE, but gain +N2 SOUL for being a good friend to Scott.
target: 真可惜。你失去了 -N2 热度，不过你对斯科特这么够朋友，获得了 +N2 灵魂。

source: Go berserk
target: 杀红眼

source: That's right, you didn't come here to play. You're here to make this bloodbath your bitch.
target: 没错，你可不是来过家家的。你要彻底征服这场血战。

source: Are you sure about this, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? Won't we lose lots of SOUL by killing innocent people?
target: 你确定吗，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%？杀无辜的人，不会掉很多灵魂吗？

source: Are they really innocent if they're trying to kill us first, though? Besides, we signed those waivers at the entrance protecting our SOUL from being lost in wanton murder.
target: 他们先想杀咱们，还能算无辜吗？再说，进门时签过免责书了，随便杀也不会掉灵魂。

source: Oh, okay! I'm fine with killing people as long as we can do it with a healthy conscience.
target: 哦，好！只要问心无愧，我就不介意杀人。

source: You enter a fugue state, slaughtering fools with guns and knives and bare hands and anything else your twisted heart desires.
target: 你杀得恍恍惚惚，枪、刀、赤手空拳，扭曲的内心想用什么就用什么，把一群蠢货屠了个遍。

source: But no matter how many people you kill, every time you look at the death toll leaderboard, there's a name consistently ahead of you...
target: 可不管你杀多少人，每次看击杀榜，都有个名字稳稳压在你前面……

source: Hey, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! Look at you, holding onto second place like it's your mother's skirt. I'm almost impressed.
target: 嘿，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！瞧你抱着第二名不撒手，跟抓着妈妈裙子似的。都快让我刮目相看了。

source: But if you came here thinking you could defeat Dahlia Aquino, buff blue warmongeress extraordinaire, you've got another thing coming!
target: 可要是你以为能赢过我，肌肉发达、蓝肤好战、举世无双的达丽雅·阿基诺，那就等着瞧吧！

source: You can beat her, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! Use your underdog-candidate powers to win at the last minute!
target: 你能打败她，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！发挥黑马的力量，最后关头逆袭吧！

source: No offense, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, but I'm putting my money on Dahlia here.
target: 无意冒犯，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，不过我押达丽雅赢。

source: I saw her smash a watermelon with a headbutt once. I don't think there's an ass she can't kick.
target: 我见过她一头撞爆一个西瓜。我看谁都不是她的对手。

source: What are you idiots doing?! Are you seriously turning this soulless murderfest into a game?
target: 你们这些白痴干什么呢？！居然把这场丧尽天良的屠杀当游戏？！

source: Can't you see this whole battle royale is a ploy by our corrupt government to turn violence into entertainment so we won't notice all the atrocities they commit?!
target: 还不明白吗？整个大逃杀就是腐败政府的阴谋！把暴力变成娱乐，咱们就顾不上他们干的那些暴行了！

source: If that's true, then it's working! I AM MASSIVELY ENTERTAINED.
target: 要是真的，那他们可太成功了！我玩得爽翻了！

source: Batniss probably has a point... but if you start catching morals now, you'll never out-murder Dahlia!
target: 巴特尼斯说的可能有道理……可这会儿突然长良心，你还怎么比达丽雅杀得多！

source: The thing is, Polly's right: you'll never defeat Dahlia in sheer body count. But if she's focusing on quantity, maybe you can defeat her by going for a QUALITY kill!
target: 问题是，波莉说得对：光比击杀数量，你永远赢不了达丽雅。可既然她追求数量，你或许能靠一场有质量的击杀取胜！

source: Do what cool kidz do these days: after murdering someone in cold blood, perform a silly internet dance. It's proven to be the perfect pairing!
target: 学学现在的酷孩子：冷血杀人以后，再跳段滑稽的网络舞蹈。事实证明，这俩绝配！

source: Kill them FOREVER. Before murdering them, harvest their souls and hoard them all together into a single raccoon. Vicious!
target: 让他们永世不得翻身。动手前先抽出灵魂，全塞进同一只浣熊。够狠！

source: Cut to two survivors of the battle royale. They're huddled together behind a large rock.
target: 镜头切到大逃杀中的两个幸存者，他们正缩在一块大石头后面。

source: "We have to think, Curtis!" the girl says. "We've made it this far, and for that I'm grateful. I can't imagine living without you."
target: 女孩说：“得想想办法，柯蒂斯！能撑到现在，我已经很感激了。我不敢想象没有你该怎么活。”

source: "I know. I love you, Carol, and I'm not leaving here without you," says Curtis. "We have a chance of escaping alive if we can make it to the river and--"
target: 柯蒂斯说：“我知道。我爱你，卡罗尔，没有你，我绝不离开。只要跑到河边，我们就有机会活着逃出去，然后——”

source: Curtis is cut off by a sniper bullet cleaving his skull in two. Carol screams and holds him in her arms, devastated.
target: 一颗狙击子弹把柯蒂斯的头骨劈成两半，打断了他的话。卡罗尔尖叫着抱住他，悲痛欲绝。

source: "Whyyy, cruel universe?!" she sobs. "What did he do to deserve this?!"
target: 她哭喊：“残酷的宇宙啊，为什么？！他到底做错了什么，要遭这种罪？！”

source: "All our plans, our dreams, the apartment we just signed the lease for... all gone! I curse the day I thought this battle royale would be a fun weekend activity!"
target: “我们的计划、梦想，还有刚签了租约的公寓……全没了！我真该死，当初怎么会觉得大逃杀适合周末来玩！”

source: Then, something bursts out of the bushes -- it's you, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, wielding a knife!
target: 突然，一个身影从灌木丛里冲出来——是你，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，手里还握着刀！

source: "JUST DO IT, YOU BASTARD!" Carol screams. "Stab my guts out, I don't care!"
target: 卡罗尔尖叫：“动手啊，混蛋！把我肚子捅穿吧，我不在乎了！”

source: You do stab her guts out. She lays bleeding out in the grass...
target: 你真的捅穿了她的肚子。她倒在草地上，鲜血不断涌出……

source: And you start tea-bagging her.
target: 而你开始对着她蹲尸嘲讽。

source: YAAASSS, BITCH! Shake yo booty over that woman dying in excruciating pain!
target: 对，就是这样，婊子！在那个痛得要死的女人身上扭屁股！

source: "What are you doing?" Carol sobs. "Stop tea-bagging me! This is the worst!"
target: 卡罗尔哭着说：“你在干什么？别蹲在我身上羞辱我了！太过分了！”

source: "I can't even focus on my life flashing before my eyes because I'm so enthralled by your butt jiggling in my face!"
target: “你那屁股在我脸前一晃一晃，我都看入迷了，连临死前的人生走马灯都没法专心看！”

source: Too bad! You dance like your life depends on it (and in this circumstance, it kinda does). You lose -N2 STAMINA from how hard you're shaking your hips.
target: 管她呢！你拼了命地跳，仿佛不跳就活不下去，而眼下确实也差不多。你扭胯太卖力，失去了 -N2 体力。

source: "I can see the light... the light reflecting off your bouncing cheeks," Carol sighs. "With this final image of your butt, I go into the great beyond..."
target: 卡罗尔叹息：“我看见光了……你那弹跳的屁股反出来的光。带着你屁股这最后的画面，我要奔赴另一个世界了……”

source: Hot damn, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. You made the end of that person's life way more painful and disrespectful than if you'd just killed her -- AND you killed her! Mad respect!
target: 我靠，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。比起直接杀了她，你让她死得更痛苦、更屈辱，而且也确实杀了她！服，真服！

source: I know when I'm beat. Here, take the spoils of our battle: +N2 HYPE for you!
target: 输了我认。拿上咱们这场战斗的战利品吧：给你 +N2 热度！

source: Cut to two survivors hiding behind a rock while the battle royale rages on.
target: 大逃杀激战正酣，镜头切到躲在石头后面的两个幸存者。

source: "We've somehow made it this far, Curtis. With our alliance and a bit of luck, we might be able to win this wretched thing."
target: “柯蒂斯，咱们居然撑到现在了。有这份同盟，再加点运气，没准真能赢下这破比赛。”

source: "We've got this, Ted. We just have to stay vigilant. If we just make it to the river, we can--"
target: “稳了，特德。只要保持警惕。跑到河边，我们就能——”

source: Curtis is cut off by a bullet cleaving his skull in two. So much for vigilance.
target: 一颗子弹把柯蒂斯的头骨劈成两半，打断了他的话。这警惕也没什么用。

source: Then, something bursts out of the bushes! It's you, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, wielding a knife!
target: 突然，一个身影冲出灌木丛！是你，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，手里还握着刀！

source: "FUCK IT!" Ted screams at you. "You already got my boyfriend! I don't care anymore! JUST KILL ME!"
target: 特德冲你吼：“去他妈的！你已经杀了我男朋友！我什么都不在乎了！杀了我吧！”

source: "Wait... what are you doing? Why are you... drawing glyphs on that cardboard box... with... my... blood..."
target: “等等……你在干什么？为什么……用我的……血……往那个纸箱上……画符……”

source: Ted dies before you can answer him -- and then, with -N2 MAGIC, he wakes up inside the cardboard box! But something doesn't feel right...
target: 你还没回答，特德就死了——然后你花掉 -N2 魔力，他在纸箱里醒了过来！可好像哪里不对……

source: "Whoa, a newcomer!" says a voice in his head. "Welcome to the Raccoon Collective!"
target: 脑海里响起一个声音：“哇，新来的！欢迎加入浣熊共同体！”

source: "The raccoon... what? What are you talking about?!" Ted cries.
target: 特德惊叫：“浣熊……什么？你在说什么？！”

source: "You were stabbed to death by that weirdo who drew glyphs in your blood, right? Yeah, that person was adding your soul to the body of a dead raccoon."
target: “你是被那个拿你的血画符的怪人捅死的，对吧？没错，那人在把你的灵魂装进死浣熊的身体。”

source: "It ain't paradise, but we gotta make do. We all control a different part of the raccoon and try to work together."
target: “这里算不上天堂，凑合过呗。我们一人控制浣熊的一部分，努力配合。”

source: "I control the front-left leg. Mohammed's on tail duty, Jason does the blinking, Pingzhi controls the back legs, and my wife's on the lungs."
target: “我管左前腿，穆罕默德管尾巴，杰森管眨眼，Pingzhi 管后腿，我老婆管肺。”

source: "So, what part do you wanna control? Don't say the penis. Natalie already called that one."
target: “你想管哪部分？别说鸡巴，娜塔莉已经抢先认领了。”

source: "I just want to die," Ted weeps.
target: 特德哭着说：“我只想死。”

source: "Well, since you're not choosing, I'm assigning you the anus. Nobody's taken it yet, and the raccoon REALLY needs to poop. Good luck!"
target: “好吧，既然不选，那就分你肛门。还没人管，浣熊又真的很想拉屎。祝你好运！”

source: Wow. Being from Hell, I thought I knew the depths of torture, but the raccoon-purgatory you're condemning your victims to is next-level.
target: 哇，我从地狱来的，还以为自己见识过各种酷刑。可你让受害者困在浣熊炼狱里，境界又高了一层。

source: I know when I'm beat. Here, take the spoils of our battle: +N2 HYPE for you!
target: 输了我认。拿上咱们这场战斗的战利品吧：给你 +N2 热度！

source: Make strong alliances
target: 结成强大的联盟

source: You and your friends are walking around the battle royale, doing your best not to get murdered, when you run into your friend Dahlia!
target: 你和朋友们在大逃杀场地里转悠，竭力避免被杀，结果碰上了朋友达丽雅！

source: Hey, you guys! I didn't know you were gonna be at the battle royale. Glad we got to say hi before I had to brutally murder you all!
target: 嘿，各位！都不知道你们也来参加大逃杀了。真好，还能赶在残忍杀光你们之前打个招呼！

source: But why would you murder us, bro? Aren't we friends? I'd rather team up with you than be killed by you!
target: 可为什么要杀我们，兄弟？咱们不是朋友吗？比起被你杀，我更想跟你组队！

source: Of course we're friends! But there's no "team" in battle royale! I'll stop at nothing to win!
target: 当然是朋友！可大逃杀哪有“组队”可言！为了赢，我什么都干得出来！

source: "Attention everyone!" someone announces over a loudspeaker. "We'll now be implementing a new rule: PARTNER BATTLES!"
target: 广播响起：“各位注意！现在开始执行新规则：双人战！”

source: "Everyone find a partner and kill as many people as you can together until you're the last group standing. Good luck!"
target: “每人找个搭档，一起尽可能多地杀人，直到只剩你们一组。祝好运！”

source: Oh, looks like we can do teams now! That's cool. But which of you would strategically be the best to pair up with?
target: 哦，看来现在能组队了！挺好。可从战术上讲，该找你们谁搭档最划算？

source: Scott's obviously got the brawn, but Polly's at a clear advantage for being un-re-killable... hmm, I think I'll go with--
target: 斯科特显然力气够大，波莉又有没法再死一次的优势……嗯，我想选——

source: DAHLIA AQUINO! It is I, Batniss, the obvious protagonist of this battle royale scenario, here to ally with you in my hour of need!
target: 达丽雅·阿基诺！是我，巴特尼斯，一看就是这场大逃杀的主角！如今急需援手，特来与你结盟！

source: We'll be unstoppable with your incredible killing physique, my plot armor, and our palpable romantic subplot energy.
target: 有你那一身杀人肌肉，加上我的主角光环，还有咱俩之间满得快溢出来的恋爱支线感，绝对无敌！

source: By combining our forces, we're sure to win the battle and take down the government in the meantime!
target: 联手之后，咱们肯定能赢下比赛，顺便推翻政府！

source: Oh, sick, I'm good with that. See you on the other side, losers!
target: 哦，牛啊，我看行。战场上见，输家们！

source: Okay, guess Dahlia's out of the equation... which means this is one of those situations where you choose between Polly or Scott!
target: 好吧，达丽雅没戏了……所以接下来就是波莉和斯科特二选一的老套路了吧！

source: Oh, bad news, boo. Scott and I already paired up with each other. Prank Masterz 4 lyfe!
target: 哦，坏消息，亲爱的。我跟斯科特已经组好队了。恶作剧大师一辈子！

source: Greeeeat. Time to get desperate. You see two lone people still searching for someone -- snag one of them quick!
target: 好极了。只能饥不择食了。你看见还有两个人落单，赶紧挑一个抢过来吧！

source: The jolly guy who seems to spend a fuckton on cosmetics. Someone who has invested so much into this bullshit probably knows a thing or two!
target: 那个笑呵呵、似乎在外观上氪了巨款的家伙。肯在这玩意儿上花这么多钱，总该有点本事吧！

source: That brooding, aloof bastard that looks like she's seen... TOO MUCH. She literally has a visible pulsating aura, so that must mean something!
target: 那个阴郁冷漠、看着像经历了太多的混蛋姑娘。身上都能看见气场在涌动，肯定有两把刷子！

source: Fantastic! You won't regret partnering with me. I have a plan to win this thing easy-peasy!
target: 太好了！跟我搭档，你不会后悔的。我有个办法，轻轻松松就能赢！

source: Step 1: we gotta buy these matching banana suits to survive.
target: 第一步：想活命，咱俩得买一套同款香蕉服。

source: Okay...? You don't really get it, but he seems confident, so you pull up the battle royale store menu and spend -N2 MONEY on two banana suits.
target: 好吧……？你没太懂，可他信心十足，于是你打开大逃杀商店菜单，花掉 -N2 金钱，买了两套香蕉服。

source: Great! Now check out that house to our left.
target: 很好！现在看看左边那所房子。

source: Your partner pulls out a rifle out of nowhere and guns down the five people hiding out in the house to your left.
target: 搭档不知从哪儿掏出一把步枪，射杀了左边房子里躲着的五个人。

source: Nice! We totally pwned their asses!
target: 爽！虐得他们满地找牙！

source: Sure... what were the banana suits for, though?
target: 行吧……不过香蕉服是干什么的？

source: So we can do the banana dance on their corpses, obviously. C'mon, dance with me!
target: 当然是在他们尸体上跳香蕉舞啊。来，一起跳！

source: Is that really necessary? Shouldn't you focus on killing more people?
target: 真的有必要吗？不该专心多杀点人吗？

source: Trust me, I know my shit. I've been in this battle royale long enough to become a level 568 Bananadancer.
target: 信我，我可是行家。打了这么久大逃杀，我已经是 568 级香蕉舞者了。

source: Uhhh...
Look, Dahlia, survivors! I'll aim an arrow for their throats and--
target: 看，达丽雅，还有幸存者！我一箭射穿他们的喉咙，然后——

source: NOOOO, THEY'RE DOING THE BANANA DANCE! It's the secret strategy to ensure immediate victory!
target: 不——他们在跳香蕉舞！那可是能立刻获胜的秘密战术！

source: Dammit, you're right! I hate this pay-to-win shit!
target: 妈的，你说得对！最烦这种氪金就能赢的破玩意儿！

source: Wow, okay, guess you'll never question the effectiveness of microtransactions again. You gain +N2 HYPE with your a-peel-ing moves!
target: 哇，行吧，这下你再也不会质疑内购的威力了。你“蕉”点十足的舞步带来 +N2 热度！

source: Your new partner accepts your presence with a dismissive eye-roll.
target: 新搭档不屑地翻了个白眼，算是接受了你的加入。

source: Fine... I guess if I have to partner with someone to win, it might as well be you.
target: 好吧……既然想赢就必须找搭档，那你就你吧。

source: But if we're going to win this, I need you to commit. I won't let you be a burden on my power.
target: 不过要赢，你就得全力以赴。我可不会让你拖我力量的后腿。

source: I'll teach you how I access my dark magic. But be warned: the path to power is a dark, twisted, lonely road -- the only road I've ever known...
target: 我会教你如何汲取我的黑暗魔法。但警告你：力量之路黑暗、扭曲而孤独——我此生只走过这一条路……

source: Magic this powerful and edgy doesn't come for free. You'll be a powerhouse, sure, able to bend the universe to your will... but at what cost?
target: 如此强大又阴暗的魔法，绝非唾手可得。你会拥有无穷力量，足以让宇宙屈从于你的意志……可代价是什么？

source: The cost of listening to this broody bullshit for an hour, maybe? Well, at least the training she gives you teaches you +N2 MAGIC.
target: 代价，也许就是听这套阴郁废话听一个小时？不过她的训练，确实让你获得 +N2 魔力。

source: Hey, there's %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! I'll just sever %HISHER% windpipe with a well-fired arrow. FOR THE RESISTANCE!
target: 嘿，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 在那儿！看我一箭射断 %HISHER% 气管。为了反抗军！

source: You stop Batniss' arrow in midair with your mind! "Your resistance is futile," you say, "as futile as the search for happiness in this wretched world!"
target: 你用意念让巴特尼斯的箭停在半空。“反抗毫无意义，”你说，“就像在这悲惨的世间寻找幸福，一样徒劳！”

source: Yes! You've learned well. You know the truth now: magic is power, and power is loneliness. Abandon your puny peers!
target: 对！你学得很好。现在你知道真相了：魔法就是力量，力量就是孤独。抛弃你那弱小的同伴吧！

source: Dreams, optimism, friendship, wearing bright colors -- it's all just a distraction from TRUE POWER.
target: 梦想、乐观、友谊、穿鲜艳的衣服——都只会让你偏离真正的力量。

source: Wow, jeez. Edgelord much? I just wanted to come here and murder people for fun, not get all sad and junk.
target: 哇，天啊，未免太中二了吧？我只是想来杀人取乐，又不是来伤春悲秋的。

source: Yeah, way to ruin the "all hope is lost" portion of my hero's journey, jerk. I'm not even in the mood to kill you anymore. C'mon, Dahlia, let's go.
target: 就是，你把我的英雄之旅里“希望尽失”的桥段都毁了，混蛋。我连杀你的心情都没了。走吧，达丽雅。

source: You use your dark, brooding powers to murder lots of people. But it doesn't bring you the joy that murdering people usually does...
target: 你用阴郁的黑暗力量杀了很多人，可这次却没像平常杀人那样，让你感到快乐……

source: Was learning magic really worth the cost of spending an afternoon with the physical embodiment of a 14-year-old's dark poetry book? You lose -N2 HYPE.
target: 为了学魔法，花一下午陪一个活生生的十四岁少年暗黑诗集，值得吗？你失去了 -N2 热度。

source: Fuckin' hide
target: 他妈的，躲起来

source: You and your friends are walking around the battle royale, doing your best not to get murdered, when you run into your friend Dahlia!
target: 你和朋友们在大逃杀场地里转悠，竭力避免被杀，结果碰上了朋友达丽雅！

source: Sup, fuckers? Welcome to the battle! I hope you brought shampoo, 'cause it's gonna be a BLOODBATH!
target: 怎么样啊，混蛋们？欢迎参战！洗发水带了吗？接下来可是一场血洗！

source: Dang, you seem like you know what you're doing, Dahlia. Do you wanna make an alliance with us?
target: 哇，达丽雅，你看着挺有经验的。要不要跟我们结盟？

source: Nah, sorry, no alliances. There can only be one winner, and Dahlia ALWAYS wins!
target: 不了，抱歉，不结盟。赢家只能有一个，而达丽雅永远会赢！

source: I'll give you guys a head start for old time's sake, but if I see you again after this, I'm totally whooping your ass. Good luck!
target: 看在老交情上，先让你们跑一会儿。不过下次再碰到，我可要把你们揍开花了。祝好运！

source: Nope nope nope. You're a lover (and now apparently a road-tripper), not a fighter. There's no way you'd survive facing Dahlia head-on.
target: 不行不行。你擅长谈情说爱，现在显然还擅长公路旅行，可打架不行。跟达丽雅正面硬碰，绝对活不了。

source: I mean, survival is a non-issue for me, but it'd be a big bummer if you or Scott died. So yeah, let's hide maybe.
target: 我是无所谓，反正死不了。但你或者斯科特死了，那就太扫兴了。嗯，还是躲起来吧。

source: You find a shallow cave to hide in. You slide in -- and collide with someone else hiding in here!
target: 你们找了个浅浅的山洞躲进去，刚挤进去，就撞上了另一个躲在里面的人！

source: "Oh! Visitors!" says a long-haired, long-bearded hermit with crazy eyes. "Welcome to my apocalypse bunker!"
target: 一个长发长须、眼神癫狂的隐士说：“哦！有客人！欢迎来到我的末日地堡！”

source: "Let me introduce you to my closest friends: Rocky the Rock, Planky the Plank, Rockie the Rabid Raccoon, and Tiberius the Magazine Cutout of Marilyn Monroe."
target: “介绍一下我的挚友：石头洛奇、木板普兰基、狂犬病浣熊洛琪，还有提比略，那张从杂志上剪下来的玛丽莲·梦露照片。”

source: Coooool... how long have you been in here, exactly?
target: 酷哦……你到底在这儿待多久了？

source: "About 513 days. We're waiting out the battle royale, which can obviously only end in apocalypse. When it ends, we'll emerge to start a New World Order."
target: “大概五百一十三天。我们在等大逃杀结束，这场比赛显然只能以世界末日收场。结束以后，我们就出去建立新世界秩序。”

source: "So, if I let you stay here, what role will you fulfill in our new society? We can't keep anybody who's dead weight!"
target: “我可以让你们留下，可你们能在新社会里干什么？这里不养闲人！”

source: "I'll be President, of course. Rocky and Rockie will be my security detail, Planky will be the treasurer, and Tiberius will be the mother of my children!"
target: “我当然当总统。洛奇和洛琪当贴身保镖，普兰基管国库，提比略给我生孩子！”

source: I'll be the representative of the Party Party! It's a political party that works to provide bitchin' parties that the post-apocalypse will clearly be lacking.
target: 那我当派对党的代表！末日之后肯定缺劲爆派对，我们党就是专门解决这个的。

source: And I'll be the astronaut! I've always wanted to go to space, and with society starting over, we'll have lots of time to invest in cool rockets!
target: 我当宇航员！我一直想上太空，等社会从头发展，我们就有好多时间造酷炫火箭了！

source: All eyes turn to you. Guess it's either buy into this hermit's insanity or get your spine ripped to bits by Dahlia. What role will you promise to fill?
target: 所有人都看向你。要么陪隐士一起发疯，要么被达丽雅扯碎脊椎。你打算承诺当什么？

source: A brand new world means a brand new economy system, and a brand new economy system will require brand new internet coaches that promise easy ways to make a profit. It's the circle of life.
target: 新世界要有新经济体系，新经济体系自然需要新一批网络导师，教你轻松赚钱。生命就是这样循环的。

source: The answer is always "BARD." Acquire a lute and save the century-defining culture of cheap action movies through oral tradition.
target: 答案永远是“吟游诗人”。搞把鲁特琴，用口述传承那些足以定义这个世纪的廉价动作片文化。

source: You pull out a briefcase, slick back your hair, put on a pair of aviators, and say:
target: 你掏出公文包，把头发抹得油光水滑，再戴上飞行员墨镜，开口说道：

source: Do you want to be a millionaire? Do you want to be your own boss? Do you want to live in paradise earning fat stacks with almost no effort?
target: 想成为百万富翁吗？想当自己的老板吗？想过着神仙日子，几乎不用努力就赚得盆满钵满吗？

source: Those all sound like my dream career! How do I do it, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?
target: 听着都像我的理想职业！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，该怎么做？

source: It's easy if follow my program: "The 3 Steps to Becoming a Millionaire OVERNIGHT! (fire emoji) (flex emoji) (sharp exhale emoji) (100 double-underline emoji)"
target: 跟着我的课程，很简单：“一夜暴富的三个步骤！（火焰表情）（秀肌肉表情）（鼻孔喷气表情）（双下划线一百分表情）”

source: Nice emojis, bro! I love it when presentations have pictures to help explain the long words!
target: 表情包不错，兄弟！我最喜欢讲解时配图了，看不懂的长词，靠图就能明白！

source: "Step 1: Have A Rich Mindset"
target: “第一步：拥有富人思维。”

source: What exactly is a "rich mindset"?
target: “富人思维”到底是什么？

source: I think it's when you think about money real hard, and eventually you make some! It's like karma, right?
target: 就是拼命想着钱，想着想着就有钱了吧！像因果报应，对不对？

source: It's EXACTLY like that, Scott. Good job!
target: 完全正确，斯科特。干得漂亮！

source: "Step 2: When Free Cash Flow Meets Debt Service, That's It"
target: “第二步：自由现金流一遇上偿债需求，就成了。”

source: That's... it? What's it?
target: 就……成了？什么成了？

source: That's IT! Free cash flow. Debt service. Meeting. Get rich. What's not clicking here?
target: 就是成了！自由现金流，偿债需求，碰一块儿，发财！这有什么听不懂的？

source: Okay, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, that's enough. This isn't real advice; you're just stringing together financial buzzwords to sound smarter than you are!
target: 行了，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。你这根本不是建议，只是把金融术语串起来，显得自己很聪明！

source: That actually brings us to "Step 3: Always String Together Financial Buzzwords to Sound Smarter Than You Are."
target: 这就说到“第三步：永远把金融术语串起来，显得自己很聪明。”

source: Okay, I'll try... hey, hermit-bro... do you wanna... financially... and with lots of smarts and finances... give me some finances... for smart finance reasons?
target: 好，我试试……嘿，隐士兄弟……你想不想……从金融角度……凭着满满的智慧和金融……给我一点金融……出于聪明的金融原因？

source: "Well, I was gonna use this money to fund the new nation...," says the hermit. "But hell, all that finance talk was so darn convincing! Take my +N2 MONEY!"
target: 隐士说：“这钱本来要拿去建设新国家的……可该死，你这套金融话术太有说服力了！拿走我的 +N2 金钱吧！”

source: Thanks! Man, I'm great at this! Being a finance bro must be my calling!
target: 谢了！天啊，我太会了！做金融男肯定就是我的天命！

source: ...Sure.
target: ……是啊。

source: You survive the battle royale a little bit richer! But also a little bit scummier; you lose -N2 SOUL for stooping to such low financial tomfoolery.
target: 你活过大逃杀，还小赚了一笔！不过也更人渣了：用这么下作的金融把戏，你失去了 -N2 灵魂。

source: To prove your point, you bid -N2 MONEY on a lute on eBuy, strum a Renaissance-y tune, and sing your song:
target: 为了证明自己，你在 eBuy 上花 -N2 金钱拍下一把鲁特琴，拨起文艺复兴风格的曲调，唱道：

source: "There once was a man, John Wick was his name / An assassin whose power was second-to-none"
target: “从前有个约翰·威克，杀手之中无人敌／本领天下第一等，威名响彻千万里。”

source: "He didst slay three fine warriors with a pencil, they claim / Should you wish not for war, just give John Wick a gun"
target: “传闻铅笔在他手，三名勇士命归西／若想免去刀兵苦，给他把枪就可以。”

source: "This beast forged in fire was set to retire / But, avast! Villains slew the man's dog!"
target: “烈火锻出的猛兽，原想退休避风波／谁料恶徒不知死，竟把他的爱犬杀！”

source: NOT THE DOG!
target: 别杀狗啊！

source: "The rage in his breast made Wick slaughter the rest / who dared query why he was called 'Baba Yag...a'"
target: “怒火在他胸口烧，余下敌人尽屠戮／谁还敢问他为何，人称‘巴巴雅……嘎’！”

source: Heh. "Breast."
target: 嘿嘿，“胸”。

source: "Rival gunmen, he killed! Car chases, he bested! / The gold on Wick's head mounted, but he could not be arrested!"
target: “来犯枪手都斩尽，飞车追逐夺头筹／头上赏金节节涨，谁能抓他入牢房！”

source: "And when the dawn finally came with his nemesis slain / Wick found peace, a new dog, and box office acclaaaaaim!"
target: “终于曙光天边照，宿敌倒地命难保／威克安享太平日，新犬票房双双到——！”

source: WOOOO! Encore! Do "The Fast and the Furious" next!
target: 呜——！再来一个！下一首唱《速度与激情》！

source: Wow, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, good shit. I was so distracted by your epic bardic tale that I completely forgot to strangle you!
target: 哇，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，真不错。你那史诗传唱太精彩了，我连要掐死你都给忘了！

source: I've got a new idea. Instead of killing you, you can follow me around the battlefield with your lute and sing songs of my exploits!
target: 我有个新主意。别杀你了，你带着鲁特琴，跟我在战场上跑，唱我的丰功伟绩吧！

source: DEAL! Dibs on being %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s bard-groupies!
target: 成交！我先占个 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 的吟游粉丝团名额！

source: You spend the rest of the battle singing sophisticated bardic tales about Dahlia ripping people's spines out of their chests, and gain +N2 MIND.
target: 接下来的战斗，你都在用高雅的诗歌传唱达丽雅如何从别人胸口扯出脊椎，获得 +N2 头脑。

source: 90s car chases
target: 九十年代式飞车追逐

source: You're exploring a bit, dodging bullets in random shootouts and trying not to get run over by hijacked police cars, when you find your friend Dahlia!
target: 你四处逛逛，躲过突然打响的枪战，还得小心别被遭劫持的警车碾到。这时，你碰上了朋友达丽雅！

source: Oh, hey guys! You must be my highly-specialized posse here to help me at the last minute, just as the action movie tropes foretold!
target: 哦，嘿，各位！你们肯定就是千钧一发时赶来帮我的精英小队，完全符合动作片的套路！

source: Sure, let's go with that. What's up, girl? You here to conquer something?
target: 行，你说是就是。怎么啦，姐妹？来征服什么地方吗？

source: Nope! I just stopped here to ask for directions, but then through a series of increasingly-unlikely action-packed events, I became the hero this city needs.
target: 没有！本来只是停下问个路，可经过一连串越来越离谱的火爆事件，我就成了这座城市需要的英雄。

source: Right now, I'm trying to deliver these disarm codes to city hall before the dastardly Dr. Mediocre releases a deadly neurotoxin in the atmosphere!
target: 现在得赶在卑鄙的平庸博士向空气里释放致命神经毒气之前，把解除代码送到市政厅！

source: Oh no, that sounds bad!
target: 哦，不，听着好糟糕！

source: ...It is bad, right?
target: ……确实很糟糕，对吧？

source: It's very bad. I'm the only one who can stop him, but there's one problem:
target: 特别糟。只有我能阻止他，可现在有个问题：

source: My car is parked across the street.
target: 我的车停在街对面。

source: So? You can cross the street and get your car. Just remember to look both ways and hold an adult's hand if you're less than ten years old, or under four feet tall.
target: 所以呢？过马路去开就行啦。记得左右看看；如果不到十岁，或者身高不到四英尺，就牵着大人的手。

source: No, you don't understand. In this city, crossing the street is one of the most dangerous things you can do. Watch.
target: 不，你不明白。在这座城市，过马路就是最危险的事情之一。看好了。

source: Dahlia throws a tomato in the street. It's immediately run over by seven cars in a high-speed chase. Then it spontaneously explodes.
target: 达丽雅往街上扔了个番茄，立刻被高速追逐的七辆车碾过，然后自己炸了。

source: Yeah, I see your point. Pedestrian safety does NOT seem paramount here.
target: 嗯，懂了。这里显然没把行人的安全当回事。

source: That's why I need your help! I can't save the city if I'm a muscular blue smear on the highway. What should I do, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?
target: 所以才需要你们帮忙！要是我在公路上成了一摊蓝色的肌肉泥，还怎么救这座城？%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，怎么办？

source: Hire an expert: call a professional chicken. You'll cross the road and maybe finally understand the chicken's elusive reasons to do so.
target: 请专家，打电话叫只专业的鸡来。既能过马路，没准还能终于弄明白鸡为什么要过马路。

source: Pray, and then trick God into thinking it is very necessary for you to acquire the power of parting this sea of traffic.
target: 祈祷，然后骗神相信：你确实急需能劈开这片车海的力量。

source: Great idea! We need a seasoned road-crosser's help. And that's exactly how I like my chickens: seasoned!
target: 好主意！咱们得找个过马路的老辣高手。巧了，我爱吃的鸡也得够辣！

source: Nice pun, Dahlia! Up top!
target: 双关不错，达丽雅！击个掌！

source: You spend -N2 MONEY hiring a professional road-crossing chicken on Eggslist. Within minutes, a grizzled werechicken parachutes down next to you.
target: 你花 -N2 金钱，在 Eggslist 上雇了只专业过马路的鸡。几分钟后，一位沧桑的鸡人撑着降落伞，落在你旁边。

source: How's it going, bro? Are you here to tell us how to cross the road?
target: 嘿，兄弟，你好啊！是来教我们过马路的吗？

source: The werechicken takes a long drag from her cigarette. "It's not about HOW to cross the road," she says heavily. "It's about knowing WHY you cross the road."
target: 鸡人深吸一口烟，沉沉地说：“关键不在于怎么过马路，而在于，你为何要过马路。”

source: Oh, okay. So why do you cross the road?
target: 哦，好吧。那你为什么过马路？

source: "My reasons are my own," she says, putting on a pair of dark sunglasses. "It's a secret I'll take to my grave. But each of us must cross the road to go on our own journeys."
target: 她戴上墨镜：“我的理由属于我自己，这秘密会被我带进坟墓。但我们每个人，都得跨过马路，踏上自己的旅程。”

source: She takes a deep breath, clenches her fists... and crosses the road. Somehow, traffic seems to weave around her as she walks!
target: 她深吸一口气，攥紧双拳……走过了马路。不知怎么的，车流居然在她身边自动绕开了！

source: Okay, I think I get it now. I know why I cross the road: to be with my friends!
target: 好，我好像懂了。我过马路，是为了和朋友在一起！

source: I cross the road to deliver this antidote to city hall, which is something I'm pretty sure I already made clear, but whatever.
target: 我过马路，是为了把解毒剂送到市政厅。我记得这事已经说得够清楚了，不过算了。

source: I cross the road 'cause I'm already dead, so getting hit by a car isn't a concern of mine.
target: 我过马路，是因为已经死了，不用担心被车撞。

source: And you cross the road because it's your objective in this event, which will bring you one step closer to beating this game... this game called life!
target: 而你过马路，是因为这是本次事件的目标，完成以后，离通关这场名为人生的游戏……又近一步！

source: (JK, this game is called "Monster Roadtrip." How quickly you forget!)
target: 开玩笑，这游戏叫《Monster Roadtrip》。这就忘了！

source: You all cross the road unscathed and get in Dahlia's car. She saves the city, and you gain +N2 MIND from your newfound road-crossing clarity!
target: 大家毫发无伤地过了马路，坐上达丽雅的车。她救下这座城市，你也因终于领悟过马路的真谛，获得 +N2 头脑！

source: Of course, religion! The de-facto solution to all of life's insurmountable problems! You start screaming to the heavens for a deity's help.
target: 当然，靠宗教！人生那些看似无解的问题，最终都能找它解决！你开始朝天大喊，求神帮忙。

source: Boo, stop. You shouldn't invoke the divine without at least giving them, like, a warning text.
target: 亲爱的，打住。召唤神明之前，好歹先发个消息打声招呼吧。

source: If you want divine intervention, why don't you just ask Zoe? Isn't she an eldritch goddess or something?
target: 想让神出手，怎么不问兹伊？她不就是个邪神什么的吗？

source: That's a great idea! You call Zoe.
target: 好主意！你给兹伊打了电话。

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? What's up? I'm halfway through a ten-hour Garfield creepypasta video compilation, so if we could keep this short...
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%？怎么了？我在看一个十小时的加菲猫都市怪谈视频合集，才看到一半，所以尽量长话短说……

source: Oh, you want eldritch powers? I mean, yeah, I could totally give them to you, but granting mortals infinite cosmic power can have pretty icky consequences.
target: 哦，想要邪神之力？是啊，给你当然没问题，可让凡人获得无穷的宇宙力量，后果可能有点恶心。

source: It's an emergency, you say? Okay, but is it a REAL emergency, or is it a %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% shenanigans emergency?
target: 你说是紧急情况？好吧，是真紧急，还是 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 式胡闹紧急？

source: Like, this isn't just to fuck someone, is it? I respect the noble pursuit of horniness, but that's not QUITE an eldritch-powers-scale emergency.
target: 比如，不是就为了跟谁上床吧？追求性福这件高尚的事，我是支持的，可还不至于紧急到要用邪神之力。

source: No, I'm not trying to fuck anyone this time! This isn't a dating sim, dang!
target: 不是，这次真没打算跟谁上床！这又不是恋爱模拟游戏，真是的！

source: Fine, if you promise this is important... can you remind me of your email?
target: 行，只要你保证是正事……再说一下你邮箱多少来着？

source: Yup! It's %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%stanktaint6669@geezmail.com.
target: 没错！是 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%stanktaint6669@geezmail.com。

source: I already regret this... okay, it's sent. I have to go now. If this all goes south, I wasn't involved, 'kay?
target: 我已经后悔了……好，发过去了。我得走了。万一搞砸，就当没我这回事，好吗？

source: It takes a few minutes for the email to arrive (eldritch powers are a BEEFY attachment), but soon a message titled "Power Forbidden Power LOL" hits your inbox. Sweet!
target: 邮件花了几分钟才送达，毕竟邪神之力这个附件可不小。很快，一封题为“力量 禁忌之力 笑死”的邮件进了收件箱。爽！

source: You use your new +N2 MAGIC powers to part the sea of cars. You lose -N2 SOUL for abusing Zoe's trust, but you saved the city, so the end justifies the means!
target: 你用新获得的 +N2 魔力劈开车海。虽然辜负兹伊的信任，让你失去了 -N2 灵魂，可城也救下了，结果好就行！

source: 90s sudden explosions
target: 九十年代式突如其来的爆炸

source: You're exploring a bit, dodging bullets in random shootouts and trying not to get run over by hijacked police cars, when you find your friend Dahlia!
target: 你四处逛逛，躲过突然打响的枪战，还得小心别被遭劫持的警车碾到。这时，你碰上了朋友达丽雅！

source: Whoa, what are you guys doing here? Haven't you seen all the bombs and car-chases going on? This city is really unsafe!
target: 哇，你们怎么在这儿？没看见到处都是炸弹和飞车追逐吗？这城市可不安全！

source: Hey Dahlia! This place doesn't look dangerous, it seems fun! What are you doing here?
target: 嘿，达丽雅！这儿看着不危险，挺好玩的！你来干什么？

source: Well, I stopped here to ask for directions, but then through a series of increasingly-unlikely action-packed events, I became the hero this city deserves.
target: 本来只是停下问个路，可经过一连串越来越离谱的火爆事件，我就成了这座城市应得的英雄。

source: Last week I dismantled a local terrorist organization and beat up a sniper who was gonna shoot the President while he took a bath...
target: 上周，我端了个本地恐怖组织，还揍趴了一个想趁总统洗澡时，开枪暗杀他的狙击手……

source: Yesterday I saved a little girl who was stuck inside a demolishing skyscraper...
target: 昨天，救了个被困在正在拆除的摩天楼里的小女孩……

source: Today, I'm scheduled to defeat a terrorist who's gonna detonate a bomb at the airport! But I'm kinda in a pickle right now...
target: 今天排好的任务，是打败一个要在机场引爆炸弹的恐怖分子！可现在遇上点麻烦……

source: I was gonna take a bus to the airport, but my bus got a bomb planted in its engine that'll detonate if the bus drops below 50 miles per hour, so they couldn't pick me up!
target: 本来想坐巴士去机场，可车子引擎里被装了炸弹，时速一低于五十英里就会炸，没法停车接我！

source: We can take you to the airport! We've got a car, and I wanna go on an action-adventure too!
target: 我们送你去机场！我们有车，我也想来场动作冒险！

source: Scott, I love you, but I just don't know if you guys are cut out for the "90s action movie protagonist" lifestyle.
target: 斯科特，我很喜欢你，可真不知道你们适不适合过“九十年代动作片主角”这种日子。

source: No way, I can totally be a grizzled thick-skinned action hero! There must be some way to prove it to you...
target: 怎么不行，我完全能当个身经百战、皮糙肉厚的动作英雄！总有办法证明给你看……

source: Hmmm... there is one way. There's one thing a true action movie star never does: look at an explosion.
target: 嗯……有个办法。真正的动作片明星，绝不会做一件事：回头看爆炸。

source: Looking at explosions is only for secondary characters who are there to look shocked or sad and make the protagonist seem more badass by comparison.
target: 只有配角才看爆炸，好露出震惊或伤心的表情，衬托主角有多牛。

source: So, here's the deal: if you can go an hour without looking at an explosion, and also refrain from dying in a shootout or a car chase, you can hang with me. Deal?
target: 这样，一小时之内，你们能忍住不看爆炸，而且不在枪战或飞车追逐里丢掉命，就能跟我混。成交？

source: Deal! But not looking at an explosion is gonna be hard... how will you keep your eyes off those fiery infernos so Dahlia will take you seriously?
target: 成交！可忍住不看爆炸还挺难……要怎么把目光从熊熊烈焰上挪开，让达丽雅刮目相看呢？

source: The problem is explosions are too eye-catching... but no moreso than a super fun magic eye book. Order one and spend the rest of the day looking ONLY for its hidden images!
target: 问题是，爆炸太吸睛……不过超好玩的立体画册也不差。买一本，接下来一整天都盯着它找隐藏图案！

source: Don't let an explosion catch your attention. Go for the kill: leave the explosion on read.
target: 别让爆炸吸引你的注意。来招狠的：对爆炸已读不回。

source: Good idea! You stop by the first bookstore that isn't on fire and pay -N2 MONEY for a book of magic eye puzzles.
target: 好主意！你找到第一家没着火的书店，花 -N2 金钱买了本立体视觉谜题画册。

source: You open to the first page and start crossing your eyes, moving the book further and closer, and trying all the other tricks to see these damn hidden pictures.
target: 你翻开第一页，斗鸡眼、把书拉远推近，什么办法都试，就想看出那些该死的隐藏图案。

source: I don't get it. What am I supposed to be seeing in these trippy shapes?
target: 看不懂。这些迷幻形状里，到底该看出什么？

source: Probably a dolphin. It's usually a dolphin.
target: 大概是海豚。一般都是海豚。

source: The first one is, in fact, a dolphin. The second one is a unicorn.
target: 第一张确实是海豚，第二张是独角兽。

source: The third hidden image is an absurdist art piece that serves as a meta-commentary on what a magic eye puzzle could be.
target: 第三张是荒诞派艺术作品，借立体视觉谜题本身，探讨它究竟能是什么。

source: The fourth is a Rorschach blob test that you interpret to be an image of your father being disappointed in you.
target: 第四张是罗夏墨迹测验，你看出了父亲对你失望的样子。

source: The fifth one is another fucking dolphin.
target: 第五张又他妈是海豚。

source: You flip the page to look at the sixth one, but suddenly, Polly slams your book shut!
target: 你翻页，准备看第六张，可波莉突然合上了你的书！

source: DON'T LOOK AT THAT ONE, %CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%! It's a picture of an explosion!
target: 别看那张，%CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%！那是爆炸的图！

source: Whoa, really? Let me see... just gotta cross one eye, squint, tilt my head to the left...
target: 哇，真的？我看看……一只眼斗鸡眼，眯起来，脑袋往左歪……

source: You're right, this IS an explosion! How'd you know that, Polly?
target: 还真是爆炸！波莉，你怎么知道的？

source: Because like you said, boo: cool action-movie heroes NEVER look at explosions.
target: 亲爱的，就像你说的：酷炫动作片英雄绝不看爆炸。

source: We just know they're there, and we put on sunglasses and walk away in slow-mo, while a sick guitar riff plays.
target: 我们就是知道它在那里，然后戴上墨镜，伴着超酷的吉他乐句，用慢动作走开。

source: Damn, I'm impressed! You guys have seriously proven yourselves. You can come to the airport with me.
target: 靠，佩服！你们可算证明自己了。跟我去机场吧。

source: HOORAY!
target: 万岁!

source: You all put on sunglasses and drive away from a raging explosion in badass slow-motion, gaining +N2 HYPE.
target: 大家戴上墨镜，开着车，以酷炫的慢动作远离猛烈的爆炸，获得 +N2 热度。

source: You follow Dahlia around the city while she busts up gunfights, parkours through laser security systems, and blows shit up.
target: 你跟着达丽雅在城里转，看她平息枪战、跑酷穿过激光安保系统，到处炸东西。

source: Explosions are happening, but you're totally unphased. To a worrying degree, might I add. People are dying, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 爆炸接连发生，你却丝毫不为所动。淡定得都有点让人担心了。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，有人在死啊。

source: But you don't care. You don't even check your phone as it vibrates constantly.
target: 可你不在乎。连手机一直震，你都不看。

source: Don't you hear your phone going off, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? Someone's texting you!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，没听见手机响吗？有人给你发消息！

source: So what? I'm too cool to take calls.
target: 那又怎样？我这么酷，才不接电话。

source: I respect your commitment to the bit, but I HAVE to know who's trying to get ahold of you. Gimme your phone!
target: 你这演到底的精神，我服。但我非得知道谁在找你。手机给我！

source: Whoa, it's the explosion hitting %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% up. This is one needy atom bomb!
target: 哇，是爆炸在撩 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。这颗原子弹可真黏人！

source: "hey cutie, u up?" "i think we'd be hot together" "you light a fuse in my pants bb"
target: “小可爱 睡了吗”“我俩在一起肯定热辣”“宝贝 你把我裤裆里的引线点着了”

source: "wow, ur just ignoring me huh?" "did u not like my puns?" "i can change"
target: “哇 真不理我啊”“不喜欢我的双关吗”“我能改”

source: "fine. ignore me then." "whore" "ur a whore"
target: “行 那就别理”“婊子”“你就是个婊子”

source: "ok i didnt mean it ur not a whore im just going thru some stuff rn"
target: “好吧 刚才不是认真的 你不是婊子 我最近有点不顺”

source: "im sorry. ur not a whore. ur a beautiful angel." "pls love me. im so alone."
target: “对不起 你不是婊子 你是美丽的天使”“求你爱我 我太孤独了”

source: You're not gonna text it back, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? Not even to reject it?
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你不回一下吗？连拒绝都不说？

source: You take your phone, unlock it, look at the texts... and then leave that explosion on read. That'll certainly send a message!
target: 你拿回手机，解锁，看看消息……然后对爆炸已读不回。这态度，可够明确的！

source: Wow, you ignored that explosion like it was nothing! You're one bad motherfucker.
target: 哇，你真把爆炸当空气啊！你他妈真是个狠人。

source: And an emotionally healthy motherfucker. That explosion would've burned you, psychologically and literally. I love your self respect.
target: 还是个心理健康的狠人。那场爆炸真会把你烧伤，心里和身上都会。就喜欢你这份自尊自爱。

source: You slide on a pair of sunglasses and walk away from that bad relationship -- in slow motion, with a sick guitar riff in the background.
target: 你戴上墨镜，以慢动作离开这段烂关系，背景里响着超酷的吉他乐句。

source: Dahlia lets you guys tag along with her to the airport, and you gain +N2 HYPE saving the city! But you lose -N2 SOUL for ghosting the explosion.
target: 达丽雅让你们跟着去机场，你拯救城市，获得 +N2 热度！不过突然断联冷落了爆炸，你也失去了 -N2 灵魂。

source: 90s crawl-ready vents
target: 九十年代式随时能爬的通风管

source: You and your friends decide to check out a museum. It seems fun, and it's also one of the only buildings in this city not being actively blown up.
target: 你和朋友们决定逛逛博物馆。听着挺好玩，而且它是这座城市为数不多还没在被炸的建筑。

source: HEY! POLLY, SCOTT, %CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%! OVER HERE!
target: 嘿！波莉、斯科特、%CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%！这边！

source: Oh, hey Dahlia! Why are you hiding behind this big potted plant?
target: 哦，嘿，达丽雅！你为什么躲在这个大盆栽后面？

source: Because I'm being sneaky, obviously!
target: 当然是为了潜行！

source: Listen, we don't have much time. The bad guys are minutes away from enacting their big museum heist.
target: 听着，时间不多了。再过几分钟，那帮坏人就要动手抢博物馆了。

source: I'll keep you guys safe, but you need to crawl in this vent with me so we can jump their asses in a wicked gun fight!
target: 我会保护你们，不过得跟我爬进通风管，才能出其不意，跟他们来场劲爆枪战！

source: Wait, back up. Who are "the bad guys?" Why are you involved? Why do we need to get in a vent? Can't we just walk to the room they're in, or take an elevator?
target: 等等，先说清楚。“坏人”是谁？你怎么卷进来的？为什么要爬通风管？不能走过去，或者坐电梯吗？

source: Too many questions! This feeble action-movie plot doesn't have time for exposition, Polly; only suspense and gun fights! Now come on!
target: 问题太多！波莉，这种单薄的动作片剧情没空交代背景，只有悬念和枪战！快跟上！

source: Fair enough! You crawl into the vent with Dahlia. As you crawl, you pass two guys in bomber jackets and sunglasses.
target: 行吧！你跟达丽雅爬进通风管，路上经过两个穿飞行夹克、戴墨镜的男人。

source: "Oops, pardon us!" they say. "We're just looking for the motherfuckers who kidnapped our daughters."
target: 他们说：“哎呀，借过！我们在找绑架我们女儿的那帮混蛋。”

source: I heard the daughter-kidnappers' hideout is down the leftmost tunnel. Give 'em hell, gentlemen!
target: 听说绑架女儿那帮人的老巢，在最左边那条通道。先生们，狠狠干他们！

source: You then pass a woman in leather spandex. "Don't tell anyone I was here," she says. "I'm an international spy eavesdropping on a terrorists' meeting."
target: 接着，你们遇到一个身穿紧身皮衣的女人。她说：“别告诉别人我来过。我是国际间谍，正在偷听恐怖分子开会。”

source: My lips are sealed, miss. Good luck saving the world!
target: 小姐，我绝对保密。祝你拯救世界成功！

source: Then you pass a guy with a gnarly eyebrow scar. "Er, sorry," he says. "I'm heading to... you know, something something action movie stuff."
target: 又经过一个眉上有道狰狞伤疤的男人。“呃，不好意思，”他说，“我正要去……你懂的，干点动作片里的那些事。”

source: He waves goodbye... only to realize he's crawling in the same direction as you.
target: 他挥手告别……才发现跟你们爬的是同一个方向。

source: "Oh, are you guys headed this way too? I guess we're going there together, then."
target: “哦，你们也往这儿走？那咱们一起吧。”

source: (Ugh, great, now we have this awkward tension where we're all pretending not to notice this guy but it's SO OBVIOUS that he's still crawling with us.)
target: （靠，真棒。现在大家都装没注意到他，可他明明还跟咱们一起爬呢，尴尬死了。）

source: (I can't take this suffocating silence! %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, talk about something!)
target: （受不了这要命的沉默了！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，说点什么！）

source: Well, you could discuss the weather, but it's hard to know what the current weather is when you're in an air vent. So, what else ya got?
target: 聊天气也行，可人在通风管里，实在不知道外面什么天气。那还能聊什么？

source: Find common ground: praise the city government for their recent investment in local infrastructure, focused on tripling the number of vents in every building.
target: 找共同话题：赞扬市政府最近的基建投入，着重表扬把每栋楼的通风管数量增加到原来的三倍。

source: Ask him if he's read anything interesting lately. ...What? Action movie heroes can also read intellectually stimulating books!
target: 问他最近有没有读到什么有意思的书。……怎么了？动作片英雄也能读有深度的书啊！

source: "Ooh, I agree! It's great that our mayor cares so much about city infrastructure, especially since buildings get blown up all the time around here."
target: “哦，同意！市长这么关心城市基础设施，真好，尤其咱们这里的楼三天两头就被炸。”

source: "It's also nice that the mayor mandated they be replaced so often. Vents in this city get worn out so quickly for some reason."
target: “而且他还要求经常更换通风管，也很好。不知道为什么，这城里的通风管总是磨损得特别快。”

source: Yeah, it's weird, right? We only get like six months before the vents get clogged up with bullet shells and dead bodies!
target: 对啊，奇怪吧？才用六个月，就被弹壳和尸体堵死了！

source: "Yes. Until the mystery of why gets solved, I'm glad our government takes vent-politics so seriously."
target: “嗯，在这谜团解开之前，政府能这么重视通风管政治，我很欣慰。”

source: Agreed!
target: 同意！

source: (Fuck, we're back to awkward silence already?! Small talk is so hard! Scott, you say something now!)
target: （妈的，又没话说了？！闲聊也太难了！斯科特，这次你来说！）

source: Uh... so... what do you do for a living, bro?
target: 呃……那……兄弟，你干哪行的？

source: "Oh, nothing fancy. I'm the leader of a heist crew trying to escape with millions of dollars of the museum's prized jewelry."
target: “哦，没什么特别的。我是劫匪头子，正带人偷博物馆里价值几百万的珍贵珠宝，准备跑路。”

source: WHAAAAAAAAAAT?!
Dahlia ends up having her epic fight IN THE VENT. It's the most action-heroic thing you've ever seen.
target: 达丽雅最终在通风管里展开了一场史诗级大战。动作英雄能干的事，你就没见过比这更绝的。

source: She wins by kicking the terrorist in the face and sending him flying into the dangerously-sharp A/C fan blades spinning behind you.
target: 她一脚踹中恐怖分子的脸，把他踢进你们身后高速旋转、锋利得要命的空调扇叶里，赢下战斗。

source: Uh, I don't suppose the mayor is gonna do anything about that vent-safety hazard...?
target: 呃，市长不打算管管通风管的安全隐患吗……？

source: VICTORY IS MINE! It was so clever of you guys to get the bad guy to reveal himself with the power of your tedious chitchat!
target: 胜利属于我！你们太聪明了，竟然用无聊闲聊的力量，让坏人主动暴露了身份！

source: You lost -N2 STAMINA crawling for so long, but you gain +N2 SOUL for praising the mayor's good choices.
target: 爬了这么久，你失去了 -N2 体力；不过夸市长决策英明，又让你获得 +N2 灵魂。

source: "I have, actually!" the stranger says. "I just finished 'Homemade Bomb Creation for Dummies.' It was fascinating!"
target: 陌生人说：“还真有！刚看完《自制炸弹傻瓜指南》，太有意思了！”

source: What do you need THAT knowledge for?
target: 你学这东西干什么？

source: "Lots of things! Take this scenario: you've been knocked out and locked in a janitor's closet."
target: “用处多了！比如，你被打晕，锁进清洁工的杂物间。”

source: "Just combine bleach, floor polish, a cup of vomit absorbent, shake it up in a thermos, and BOOM! Homemade explosive to bust the door down!"
target: “把漂白剂、地板蜡和一杯呕吐物吸收剂混起来，装进保温瓶摇一摇，砰！自制炸药，直接把门炸开！”

source: "Or perhaps you're having dinner with your girlfriend's parents, and the evening is full of stares and awkward silence and you can't take it anymore."
target: “或者，跟女朋友父母吃晚饭，整晚大眼瞪小眼，谁也不说话，你实在受不了了。”

source: "Using chicken fat, a fancy candle, a three-tined fork, and the C-4 you stashed away for a heist later, you've got a ticket out of that mess!"
target: “拿鸡油、一根高级蜡烛、一把三齿叉，再加上你为之后抢劫藏好的 C-4 炸药，就能摆脱这烂摊子了！”

source: "Three... tined... fork..." Okay, I think I got all that written down! Thanks for the tips!
target: “三……齿……叉……”好，应该都记下来了！谢谢指点！

source: Wait a minute... what was that you said about doing a heist later?
target: 等等……刚才是不是说，一会儿要去抢劫？

source: "Oh, right. Well, since we get on so well, I guess I'll just tell you: I'm the leader of a criminal syndicate who's here to steal millions of dollars in jewelry from the museum!"
target: “哦，对。既然这么聊得来，就直说了吧：我是犯罪集团的头目，来偷博物馆里几百万的珠宝！”

source: WHAAAAAAAAAAAT?!
Dahlia ends up having her epic fight IN THE VENT. It's the most action-heroic thing you've ever seen.
target: 达丽雅最终在通风管里展开了一场史诗级大战。动作英雄能干的事，你就没见过比这更绝的。

source: She wins by creating an improvised bomb with a bullet and gunpowder, shoving it in a small metal chamber, and detonating it in the bad guy's temple. So innovative!
target: 她拿子弹和火药做了个简易炸弹，塞进金属小膛室，抵着坏人的太阳穴引爆，赢下战斗。太有创意了！

source: I AM VICTORIOUS! %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, it was clever of you to get the bad guy to reveal himself with the power of your inane chitchat.
target: 我赢了！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你真聪明，竟然用无聊闲聊的力量，让坏人主动暴露身份。

source: I never would've thought to try it. I mean, it's SMALL talk, and Dahlia never does ANYTHING small. But good work!
target: 我绝对想不出这种办法。毕竟这叫闲聊，聊的都是小事，而我达丽雅从不干小事。不过干得漂亮！

source: You lost -N2 STAMINA crawling for so long, but you gain +N2 MIND out of discussing books like a nerd.
target: 爬了这么久，你失去了 -N2 体力；不过像书呆子那样讨论书籍，又让你获得 +N2 头脑。

source: Complex rules
target: 复杂规则

source: You all go to the prison entrance to inquire about a tour, but the security guards just beat you unconscious and lock you in a cell. Bummer.
target: 大家来到监狱门口，想问问能不能参观，结果看守直接把你们打晕，关进牢房。真倒霉。

source: Ugh... ow... what happened? Did we go on a bender and I forgot? ...Did we buy these ugly jumpsuits on the bender?
target: 唔……疼……怎么回事？咱们是不是又喝疯了，我给忘了？……这身丑死的连体服，也是喝多了买的？

source: NOPE! Welcome to the Experimental Prison Theater! I've been stuck in here awhile, so I've got some good tips on how not to die and have fun doing it.
target: 不是！欢迎来到实验监狱剧场！我被困在这儿一阵子了，攒了不少保命又能玩得开心的经验。

source: First tip: don't join Santiago's gang. They just want your money, and they don't even have a cool prison gang tat.
target: 第一条：别进圣地亚哥的帮派。他们就想骗钱，连个像样的监狱帮派纹身都没有。

source: Uh... thanks for the info, Dahlia, but do you know anything about getting out of here?
target: 呃……谢谢情报，达丽雅，不过你知道怎么出去吗？

source: Oh, yeah, guess I should've started with that. So, this prison's golden rule is you're assigned a play to put on every night.
target: 哦，对，应该先说这个。这监狱有条铁律：每天晚上，都得演分配给你的戏。

source: The play you're assigned for the day is determined by your jumpsuit. The symbol corresponds to the play, and the number is the part you get.
target: 今天演什么，看你的囚服。符号对应剧目，数字对应角色。

source: Like, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s got the number 1, so %HESHE%'ll play the lead role. Nice!
target: 比如，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 身上是 1，所以 %HESHE% 演主角。不错！

source: Anyway, during your play, there will be a door onstage that leads outside. You can walk out of it and be home free.
target: 总之，表演的时候，舞台上会有扇通往外面的门。走出去，就自由了。

source: BUT, you have to improv a reason why using that door makes sense in the context of your play. If you can't improv a good reason, you'll get shot in the head.
target: 但是！你得即兴编个理由，解释为什么在这出戏里走那扇门是合理的。编不好，就会被一枪爆头。

source: Uh...
Don't worry, that's how these "punishment games" usually go. I just have fun with it and try to forget about the life-or-death stakes.
target: 放心，这种“惩罚游戏”一般都这样。我就尽情玩，尽量忘掉生死攸关的事。

source: I could've escaped last week, but we were doing "Mamma Mia!", and I really wanted to stay to find out who the real father was!
target: 上周本来就能逃出去，可那天演《妈妈咪呀！》，我实在想留下看看亲爹到底是谁！

source: Today I'm doing "Rockin' Terror Cinematic Spectacular". I've already got a plan to make my great escape during the "Time Jump" song.
target: 今天演《摇滚恐怖电影大秀》。我计划好了，唱《时间跳跃》的时候就大逃亡。

source: It's one of those songs that tells you how to dance to it, so I'll just sing "now go through the prison exit," and leave! DAHLIA WINS AGAIN!
target: 那首歌会一边唱，一边教你跳舞。我就唱句“现在走出监狱大门”，然后走人！达丽雅又赢了！

source: Gotcha... I'm guessing that based on our jumpsuits... we got assigned "The Lion Prince?"
target: 懂了……看我们这身囚服，分到的应该是《狮子王子》？

source: Guess so. Heh, good luck justifying why a lion would use a door. See you at the theater!
target: 应该是。嘿嘿，祝你们能解释清楚，狮子为什么要走门。剧场见！

source: Okay, we just have to escape a prison by improvising a reason to use a door during a stage production of "The Lion Prince" under penalty of death. No pressure.
target: 好吧，就是演《狮子王子》时，临场编个走门的理由，越狱逃出去，编不出来就处死。毫无压力。

source: ...I actually think that's a lot of pressure.
target: ……我倒觉得压力挺大的。

source: Don't worry, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, we've got this! Polly and I are great actors, and you're...
target: 放心，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，稳的！我和波莉演技超好，而你……

source: Oh, I know! You're great at thinking of a reason why our characters would use the door!
target: 哦，我知道了！你特别擅长替咱们的角色想个走门的理由！

source: Present the door as a metaphor of the passage to adulthood that the young lion prince MUST cross to become king.
target: 说这扇门象征通向成年的道路，小狮子王子必须跨过去，才能成为国王。

source: Wonder out loud why there's a single door in the middle of the African Savannah. Get everyone in the audience hooked on this off-putting mystery.
target: 大声问出来：非洲大草原中央，为什么孤零零立着一扇门？用这个诡异谜团，勾住所有观众。

source: After hours of intense rehearsal, you and your friends have lost -N2 STAMINA, but you're ready to perform!
target: 高强度排练几个小时后，你和朋友们失去了 -N2 体力，不过终于准备好上台了！

source: "The Lion Prince" is chosen first to perform. You'll be playing the titular role of Samba.
target: 《狮子王子》被选中第一个演。你出演标题里的那位王子：桑巴。

source: Hi! I'm Simone, the happy-go-lucky meerkat with no ambition and an appetite for bugs.
target: 嗨！我是西蒙妮，一只没心没肺、毫无志向、爱吃虫子的狐獴。

source: And I'm Rumba, a warthog who loves to fart!
target: 我是伦巴，一只爱放屁的疣猪！

source: (Jeez, Scott, you didn't have to ACTUALLY fart. Gross!)
target: （天啊，斯科特，不用真放屁吧！恶心！）

source: Anyway... Samba, my little prince, as you mature into the feline king you were born to be, we're here to teach you the most important part of adulthood...
target: 总之……桑巴，我的小王子，你生来就该当狮王。等你长大，我们要教你成年后最重要的一件事……

source: It's a little something called: ESCAPING THE PRISON. Sing with me, Rumba!
target: 那就是：越狱逃跑！伦巴，跟我唱！

source: "Escaping the prison! What a wonderful phrase!"
target: “越狱逃跑！这句话多么美妙！”

source: "Escaping the prison! It ain't no passing craaaaaze!"
target: “越狱逃跑！可不是一时风潮——！”

source: "You'll see no wardens for the rest of your daaaaays!"
target: “往后余生，狱卒再也见不着——！”

source: "But will you be truly free? It all depends on your philosophyyyy!"
target: “可你是否真自由？全看你的人生信条！”

source: "Escaping the prisoooon!"
As the song concludes, you say something vaguely profound about the metaphor of passing into adulthood and step through the door.
target: 歌曲收尾时，你对跨入成年这层隐喻说了些似懂非懂、貌似深奥的话，迈过了那扇门。

source: You make it outside without getting shot, maybe because everyone bought your bullshit, or maybe because they're too busy singing your song. Either way, you're alive!
target: 你没挨枪子就出了监狱。也许大家信了你的鬼话，也许只是忙着唱你的歌。反正活下来了！

source: Woohoo, we did it! I got out by making the point that Samba's ascent to the throne is also what forces Simone to mature, and everyone bought it!
target: 呜呼，成功！我说桑巴登基，也会逼着西蒙妮成长，于是就出来了。所有人都信了！

source: They kicked me out 'cause I couldn't stop farting. But I'll take it!
target: 我一直放屁，他们就把我赶出来了。不过也挺好！

source: You drive away from the prison, humming your catchy song, and gain +N2 MIND for your clever scene work.
target: 你们哼着洗脑的歌，开车离开监狱。机智的舞台表演让你获得 +N2 头脑。

source: After hours of intense rehearsal, you and your friends have lost -N2 STAMINA, but you're ready to perform!
target: 高强度排练几个小时后，你和朋友们失去了 -N2 体力，不过终于准备好上台了！

source: "The Lion Prince" is first to go on. You'll be playing the titular role of Samba.
target: 《狮子王子》第一个上场。你出演标题里的那位王子：桑巴。

source: Samba, as your father and the king of the savannah, I want you to look around. Everything the light touches is our kingdom!
target: 桑巴，我既是你的父亲，也是草原之王。看看四周吧，凡是光照到的地方，都是我们的王国！

source: The only rule is DON'T go into the shadowy parts. That's your evil Uncle Garbage's territory, and he's super mean!
target: 只有一条规矩：别去阴暗的地方。那是你邪恶的垃圾叔叔的地盘，他超级坏！

source: Heyyy, Samba! I'm your Uncle Garbage! I pinky-promise I'm not evil. You should totally go to the place your father explicitly forbade, for the lulz.
target: 嘿——桑巴！我是你的垃圾叔叔！拉钩保证，我绝对不坏。你爸明令禁止你去的地方，一定要去，找乐子嘛。

source: I'll think about it... but wait, what's that square wooden structure over there?
target: 我考虑考虑……等等，那边那块方方的木头结构是什么？

source: Huh? I've never noticed that before. Is that part of your kingdom or mine, Garbage?
target: 啊？以前没注意过。垃圾，那算你的王国，还是我的？

source: I have no clue, brother. I think we should just ignore that Macguffin until it becomes relevant.
target: 我也不知道，兄弟。先别管那个麦高芬，等它跟剧情有关再说吧。

source: Later in the play, a herd of running wildebeests is threatening to trample Samba and his father.
target: 演到后来，一群狂奔的角马冲过来，眼看就要把桑巴和父亲踩死。

source: GARBAGE! BRO! You gotta help my son and me over this cliff!
target: 垃圾！兄弟！快把我和儿子拉上悬崖！

source: NEVER! Fuck that "long live the king" shit -- you're both going in the canyon!
target: 休想！去他妈的“国王万岁”，你俩一起掉进峡谷吧！

source: You, as Samba, are scared shitless and want to save yourself -- and then you see the door!
target: 你演的桑巴吓得魂飞魄散，正想保命，突然看见了那扇门！

source: GO, SAMBA! Run through the door before Garbage kills your dad!
target: 跑啊，桑巴！趁垃圾杀你爸爸之前，快从门里跑出去！

source: Great plan! You grab Scott off the cliff and make a run for it!
target: 好主意！你把斯科特从悬崖边拉上来，拔腿就跑！

source: NOOOOOO! How were my evil plans thwarted by modern architecture?! THIS MAKES NO SEEEEENSE!
target: 不——！我的邪恶计划，怎么会败给现代建筑？！这不合逻辑啊——！

source: Woohoo! Great job, bro! We escaped!
target: 呜呼！干得好，兄弟！咱们逃出来了！

source: Good work out there, gang. We're definitely gonna win a Prison Tony!
target: 各位演得真好。这下监狱托尼奖稳了！

source: Wait, how did you get out, Polly? It didn't make sense for Uncle Garbage to use the door.
target: 等等，波莉，你怎么出来的？垃圾叔叔走那扇门，讲不通吧。

source: No prison can hold me, silly! I'm a ghost! I only stayed this long to see if %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% could pull it off.
target: 傻瓜，哪座监狱关得住我？我是鬼啊！待到现在，就是想看 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 能不能搞定。

source: Cool, nobody but Polly ended up dead today! You drive away from the prison, gaining +N2 HYPE for your clever scene work.
target: 很好，今天除了本来就死了的波莉，谁也没死！你们开车离开监狱，机智的舞台表演让你获得 +N2 热度。

source: Deadly games
target: 致命游戏

source: You all go to the prison entrance to inquire about a tour, but the security guards just beat you until you're unconscious. Bummer.
target: 大家来到监狱门口，想问问能不能参观，结果看守直接把你们打到昏迷。真倒霉。

source: Ugh... ow... what happened? Did we go on a bender and I forgot?
target: 唔……疼……怎么回事？咱们是不是又喝疯了，我给忘了？

source: Sweet, you guys are finally awake. Now we can solve this puzzle!
target: 好极了，你们总算醒了。这下能解谜了！

source: What puzzle? Where are we, Dahlia?
target: 什么谜？达丽雅，咱们在哪？

source: We're in the experimental prison. We were all kidnapped and put in here as a metaphor for how selfish monsters are or something dumb.
target: 实验监狱。咱们都被绑架关到这儿，用来隐喻怪物有多自私，还是什么蠢主题。

source: In order to escape, we need to solve this puzzle. There are two doors in this room: one leads to freedom, the other to certain death.
target: 想逃出去，就得解谜。屋里有两扇门，一扇通往自由，另一扇进去必死。

source: But there's a guy guarding each door. One guard always tells the truth, and the other guard always lies.
target: 每扇门各有一个守卫。一个永远说真话，另一个永远说谎。

source: We only have one chance to ask a guard a question and pick the right door, or we DIE.
target: 只能问一个守卫一个问题，再选对门，不然就死。

source: I know how to solve this riddle! We can ask a guard which door the other guard would tell us to--
target: 这题我会！问一个守卫，另一个守卫会让我们走哪扇——

source: BOOOOOORING! Don't be a boring boob, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. Let's add some spice to this situation!
target: 无——聊！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，别这么没劲。找点刺激嘛！

source: It's not often we get the opportunity to ask someone ANYTHING OUR HEARTS DESIRE.
target: 想问什么就问什么，这种机会可不多。

source: ...We've literally always had that opportunity. Asking people stuff is free.
target: ……这种机会明明一直都有。问问题又不收钱。

source: Yeah, but now we've got added stakes to the situation! And the stakes are meaningless to me because I'm already dead, so let's just have fun with it!
target: 可现在多了生死赌注！反正我已经死了，赌注对我无所谓，尽情玩嘛！

source: But Scott, Dahlia, and I aren't dead yet, and we'd really like to stay that way!
target: 可我、斯科特和达丽雅还没死，也很想继续活着！

source: Ha! I'd like to see them TRY to kill me. Worst case scenario I just get another cool scar out of this.
target: 哈！倒想看看他们怎么杀我。再不济，也就多道帅气伤疤。

source: And my understanding of mortality is shaky at best, so I'd rather do this Polly's way!
target: 而且我对死亡这回事本来就没太弄明白，所以更想按波莉说的来！

source: Well, dang. Peer pressure is your greatest weakness. Guess you can worry about not dying later; it's funny question time!
target: 唉，你最受不了朋友施压。保命的事晚点再想，现在该问好玩的问题了！

source: NICE! Let's fight fire with fire: if these guards wanted to mindfuck us with this riddle, let's ask them a mind-fucky question to get back at 'em!
target: 爽！以牙还牙：守卫想拿这谜语折腾咱们的脑子，那咱们也问个烧脑问题，整回去！

source: Emotional warfare: "Guard of the left door... is it true that you've developed secret feelings for guard of the right door?"
target: 打感情战：“左门守卫，你是不是偷偷爱上右门守卫了？”

source: FOMO warfare: "Guards, now that we're all good friends, I thought about renting quads for all of us. Wanna join us for a day of thrill, fun, and quads?"
target: 让他们怕错过：“守卫们，咱们关系这么好，我想租几辆四轮越野车，一起刺激、开心地玩一天，来不来？”

source: Ooh, nasty! We're definitely gonna lose -N2 SOUL for playing dirty, but fuck it, I wanna see what they say!
target: 哦，够损！耍这种阴招肯定得扣 -N2 灵魂，不过管他呢，我要听他们怎么说！

source: You stroll up to the first guard and ask him your question.
target: 你走到第一个守卫跟前，问出这个问题。

source: "Well... I... I don't know what you mean!" he says, sweating. "We're coworkers, and office romances are usually bad news, and... and..."
target: 他直冒汗：“这个……我……不知道你在说什么！我们是同事，办公室恋情一般不会有好结果，而且……而且……”

source: "UGH, FUCK IT! I can't tell a lie! It's true, I'm hopelessly in love with Guard #2!"
target: “唉，去他妈的！我说不了谎！没错，我爱二号守卫爱得无可救药！”

source: "After years of working together, all the nice conversations, I couldn't help catching feelings. And we have so much in common! We both guard doors!"
target: “一起工作这么多年，聊过那么多开心的事，我忍不住就动心了。而且我们共同点特别多！我俩都守门！”

source: "You really love me?" Guard #2 gasps. "Guard #1, I... I don't feel the same."
target: 二号守卫倒吸一口气：“你真爱我？一号守卫，我……我没那种感觉。”

source: WHAAAAT?! How could you break his heart so casually, bro?!
target: 什么？！兄弟，你怎么能这么随便就伤他的心？！

source: Guard #1 looks like he might cry, but then he realizes: "Wait, but you always lie, don't you? Does that mean... you DO feel the same?!"
target: 一号守卫眼看要哭了，却突然反应过来：“等等，你不是总说谎吗？那是不是……你也喜欢我？！”

source: Guard #2 winks roguishly. "I dunno, Guard #1... why don't you come over here and find out?"
target: 二号守卫坏坏地眨眼：“谁知道呢，一号守卫……过来试试，不就明白了？”

source: Holy shit! HOLY SHIT! They're hardcore making out! THIS IS THE BEEEEST!
target: 卧槽！卧槽！他们亲得好激烈！太棒了——！

source: What a twist! Here I thought we were in a deadly-games genre scenario, when it was actually a rom-com all along!
target: 好大的反转！我还以为是死亡游戏，原来一直都是爱情喜剧！

source: With the guards distracted, you can easily check both doors. You find the right exit and leave unharmed!
target: 守卫顾不上你们，你轻松查看两扇门，找对出口，平安离开！

source: I'm happy we left safely, but I'm even happier those guards found true love.
target: 能安全离开，我很开心。可守卫找到真爱，让我更开心。

source: True dat. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s a master riddle-solver AND match-maker!
target: 可不是。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 既是解谜大师，又是牵线高手！

source: Yup, you're the total package. You're also the proud owner of +N2 HYPE. Good work, champ!
target: 没错，你样样在行，还喜提 +N2 热度。干得漂亮，冠军！

source: QUADS?! I fucking love quads! They drive on ALL TERRAINS! I love a vehicle that doesn't know when to quit!
target: 四轮越野车？！我他妈爱死了！全地形都能跑！这种不知退缩的车，我就喜欢！

source: WOOHOO! QUAD DAY! QUAD DAY! QUAD DAY!
target: 呜呼！越野车日！越野车日！越野车日！

source: What do you say, guards? Wanna ride quads with us and maybe get ice cream after?
target: 怎么样，守卫？跟我们开四轮越野车，玩完再去吃冰淇淋？

source: "Quads AND ice cream?! That sounds so fun!" one of the guards says. "Count me in!"
target: 一个守卫说：“越野车加冰淇淋？！听着太好玩了！算我一个！”

source: The other guard is sweating and shaking profusely. Is he... okay?
target: 另一个守卫汗流不止，抖个不停。他……没事吧？

source: "OKAY, FINE!" he finally cries. "I really want to go too!"
target: 他终于喊道：“好，好吧！我也特别想去！”

source: "Guard #2!" Guard #1 gasps. "You always lie! Do you mean to tell me that... you don't like quads?"
target: 一号守卫惊呼：“二号守卫！你永远说谎！难道……你不喜欢四轮越野车？”

source: How could anyone not like quads? A world where people hate having fun on four-wheelers isn't a world I wanna live in!
target: 怎么会有人不喜欢？要是这世界有人讨厌开四轮越野车玩，那我也不想活在这世界上了！

source: "No, I really do want to go!" Guard #2 says, tearing up. "I'm sorry I failed to lie, but I just couldn't say no to quads!"
target: 二号守卫眼泪汪汪：“不，我真的想去！对不起，我没能撒谎，可越野车实在没法拒绝！”

source: Wow, he's actually sobbing. Way to play mind-games, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 哇，还真哭了。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你这心理战打得可以啊。

source: "Hey, man, it's okay," Guard #1 says sympathetically. "You don't have to cry. I won't tell the boss you broke character."
target: 一号守卫同情地说：“嘿，伙计，没事，别哭。我不会跟老板说你演砸了。”

source: "You... you won't?" Guard #2 asks, sniffing snottily.
target: 二号守卫吸着鼻涕问：“你……你不会说？”

source: "Nah. I get it; nobody can say no to quads."
target: “不会，我懂。四轮越野车，谁能拒绝啊。”

source: FUCK YEAH, QUAD DAY! You spend -N2 MONEY renting some vehicles, and you and the guards have a blast driving them all over the prison.
target: 他妈的，越野车日来啦！你花 -N2 金钱租车，和守卫们开遍监狱，玩得爽翻天。

source: "Man, you guys are awesome!" Guard #1 says over ice cream later. "Fuck it, since you were so nice to us, I'll just tell you the exit's behind door 2."
target: 后来，吃冰淇淋时，一号守卫说：“你们真够意思！算了，看在对我们这么好的份上，告诉你们吧：二号门后就是出口。”

source: He's the truthful guard, so you know it's legit! Let's go guys!
target: 他是说真话的那个，肯定没错！走吧，各位！

source: You bust down the door with your quad and ride off into the sunset with your friends, gaining +N2 HYPE!
target: 你开着四轮越野车撞开大门，和朋友们奔向夕阳，获得 +N2 热度！

source: Impossible mazes
target: 无解迷宫

source: You all go to the prison entrance to inquire about a tour, but the security guards just hit you over the heads with their batons until you're unconscious. Bummer.
target: 大家来到监狱门口，想问问能不能参观，结果看守用警棍敲你们的头，直到全打晕了。真倒霉。

source: Uh... what's going on? Where are we?
target: 呃……怎么回事？咱们在哪？

source: I was gonna ask you guys the same question.
target: 我也想问你们呢。

source: Dahlia? How'd you get here?
target: 达丽雅？你怎么来的？

source: No idea. I was leading my armies to conquer a lesser nation, typical Tuesday -- then I blacked out and woke up in this weird maze!
target: 不知道。本来正率领大军，征服一个弱小国家，很平常的星期二嘛。然后眼前一黑，再醒来就在这破迷宫里了！

source: Just then, you hear a mysterious voice over an intercom: "Welcome to the Death Maze. Find the exit, or DIE FOR OUR AMUSEMENT."
target: 这时，对讲机里传来神秘声音：“欢迎来到死亡迷宫。找到出口，或者死给我们取乐。”

source: Oh, this is one of those fucked-up survival games. A death maze is a little redundant, but we can still make this work.
target: 哦，又是那种变态生存游戏。死亡迷宫这设定有点老套，不过也能应付。

source: The first step to getting out should be assigning ourselves group roles. We'll be more likely to survive this if we stick to the established tropes.
target: 想出去，第一步得分配队内角色。按经典套路走，活下来的可能性更大。

source: I'll be the world-weary badass who's unfazed by all this shit. I'm sexy in that damaged antihero "I can fix her" way, and I get laid ALL THE TIME.
target: 我当看破世事、见怪不怪的狠角色。伤痕累累的反英雄，性感得让人觉得“我能拯救她”，还天天有人找我上床。
