source: Aww man, I was gonna call that one!
target: 啊，真是的，我刚想抢这个角色！

source: I call being the annoying panicky girl who's totally not cut out for this high-stakes situation! Watch, I'll get into character:
target: 我当那个烦人、爱慌张、完全应付不了生死局面的姑娘！看，我这就入戏：

source: WE'RE NEVER GETTING OUT OF HERE! WE'RE ALL GONNA DIE!!! I'M SCAAARED!
target: 咱们永远出不去了！全都要死啦！！！我好害怕！

source: Wow, Polly, great acting! You really made me believe for a second that we aren't getting out of here and we're all gonna die!
target: 哇，波莉，演得真好！刚有一瞬间，我真觉得咱们出不去，全都要死了！

source: Can I be the dumb jock with a heart of gold? I'm really good at that one!
target: 那我当傻乎乎、但心地善良的运动健将行吗？这个我特别会！

source: Sure! What about %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, though? Maybe %HESHE% should be the one who dies in the first ten minutes to establish the stakes?
target: 当然！不过 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 呢？要不让 %HESHE% 演开场十分钟就死掉，用来凸显危险的那个？

source: Hard pass. You decide to be...
target: 绝对不要。你决定当……

source: The quiet weirdo who solves lots of puzzles because they're secretly part of the evil corporation behind the maze.
target: 那个不爱说话、却能解开一堆谜题的怪人，因为其实是迷宫幕后邪恶公司的内部人员。

source: The thief. It's the best class for this adventure, with "disarm traps" as its starting skill and a spell to double the loot you get from each room!
target: 盗贼。这次冒险的最佳职业：自带“解除陷阱”技能，还有个能让每个房间的战利品翻倍的法术！

source: You silently pull out a knife and start carving weird symbols into the walls.
target: 你默默掏出刀，在墙上刻起奇怪的符号。

source: Fuuuuck, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s gonna be the weirdo who leaves cryptic messages everywhere. WE'RE DEFINITELY GONNA DIE!!
target: 靠，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 要当那种到处留谜语的怪人。咱们死定了！！

source: Every sci-fi dystopia's gotta have one, I guess. Let's roll.
target: 我看每个科幻反乌托邦都得有这么个人。走吧。

source: You all traverse the maze, dodging traps, getting injured, and generally going through the emotional wringer.
target: 大家穿行在迷宫里，躲陷阱、受伤，身心备受折磨。

source: And by "you all", I mostly mean your friends. You avoid the worst of the traps with your secret maze knowledge and mostly focus on graffitiing.
target: 说是“大家”，其实主要是你的朋友们。你靠着迷宫的内部情报，躲开最要命的陷阱，一门心思往墙上涂鸦。

source: Battered and worn out, you all finally reach the final room in the maze. It's...
target: 大家伤痕累累、精疲力尽，终于抵达最后一间房。里面是……

source: A password-protected door? How the hell do we solve that?! There have been no context clues or foreshadowing leading up to this!
target: 密码门？这他妈怎么解？！前面根本没给线索，也没埋伏笔！

source: Should we take a guess? Try "ScottsPassword". That's the most secure password I know.
target: 要不猜一下？试试“ScottsPassword”。这是我知道的最安全的密码。

source: IT'S NOT WORKIIIIING! WE'RE GONNA DIIIIIE! WHAT DO WE DO, %CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%?!
target: 不管用——！我们要死啦！%CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%，怎么办啊？！

source: You don't answer. You're focused on carving a possum with big tits into the wall.
target: 你没有回答，正忙着在墙上刻一只巨乳负鼠。

source: Goddammit, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! You've been no help AT ALL!
target: 妈的，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！你一点忙都没帮上！

source: Frustrated, Dahlia grabs your head and keysmashes the password entry computer with your face. It gets covered in your blood.
target: 达丽雅气得一把抓住你的脑袋，拿你的脸往密码电脑上乱砸。电脑沾满了你的血。

source: The computer says: "Employee DNA recognized. Security system disconnected. You are free from the Punishment Maze."
target: 电脑提示：“已识别员工 DNA。安保系统已解除。您已脱离惩罚迷宫。”

source: Wait, wait, back up. Why'd it say "employee DNA recognized"? %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, do you work for the sick fucks that made this maze?
target: 等等，先等等。为什么说“已识别员工 DNA”？%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，造迷宫的那些变态，是你的同事？

source: Yup, that's the role I chose! You're not the only one who can get into character!
target: 对啊，我选的就是这角色！又不是只有你才会入戏！

source: Okay, well, you'd better get out of character if you want back in the car. We forbade you from joining any corrupt organizations in the Road Trip Contract.
target: 行，那想回车上，最好赶紧出戏。《公路旅行合同》里可写了，不许加入任何腐败组织。

source: Ugh, fine. You gain +N2 MIND from solving the puzzle, but lose -N2 SOUL for briefly becoming a wickedly generic sci-fi antagonist.
target: 唉，行吧。解开谜题让你获得 +N2 头脑，可你短暂当了会儿毫无新意的邪恶科幻反派，也失去了 -N2 灵魂。

source: Goddammit, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. Why do you always try to bring roleplaying into every situation?
target: 妈的，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。怎么不管碰上什么事，你都要搞角色扮演？

source: It's not even the fun kind of roleplaying!
target: 还不是好玩的那种角色扮演！

source: Yeah. This may be a labyrinth, but it's obviously not the kind with a minotaur or dragon to slay at the end. Stick to one genre!
target: 就是。虽然是迷宫，可显然不是最后让你屠个牛头人、杀条龙的那种。统一一下题材吧！

source: C'mon, this will be fun! Dahlia can even be the barbarian if she plays along!
target: 哎呀，会很好玩的！达丽雅肯一起玩，就能当野蛮人！

source: Do I get a cool axe?
target: 能给我把酷炫斧头吗？

source: Duh! You toss Dahlia the cursed greataxe you keep on hand for emergency LARPing purposes.
target: 那当然！你把随身带着、供紧急真人角色扮演用的诅咒巨斧，扔给达丽雅。

source: I AM SUDDENLY VERY INTO THIS PLAN!
target: 我突然对这计划很有兴趣了！

source: You make that maze your bitch. With your sleight-of-hand skill you easily disarm most of the traps; and if you can't, there's always plan B...
target: 你把迷宫拿捏得死死的。靠着巧手技能，轻松拆掉大部分陷阱。拆不了，还有 B 计划……

source: I ROLL TO SMASH THE PUNY TRAP INTO A MILLION PIECES!
target: 我要掷骰，把这破陷阱劈成一百万块！

source: In the last room, a secret door opens, and several guards run in!
target: 最后一间房里，暗门突然打开，几个守卫冲了进来！

source: "Stop applying RPG logic to our punishment maze!" they complain. "You're totally undermining our gritty cyber-dystopia genre!"
target: 他们抱怨：“别再拿 RPG 那套玩我们的惩罚迷宫了！硬派赛博反乌托邦的氛围，全给你们毁了！”

source: So YOU'RE the fucks that put us in here?! You made a BIG mistake. I ACTIVATE MY BARBARIAN RAGE!
target: 所以就是你们这帮混蛋，把我们关在这里？！你们犯了大错。发动野蛮人狂暴！

source: It turns out the maze-runners' laser guns are weak against "enraged buff lady with fucknormous axe." Dahlia hacks them to bits with ease.
target: 事实证明，迷宫管理者的激光枪，弱点就是“拎着巨他妈大斧头的狂怒肌肉女”。达丽雅轻轻松松把他们砍成碎块。

source: Okay, fine, I admit that worked... but I still say next time we get trapped in a punishment maze we try the fun kind of roleplaying to get out.
target: 好吧，我承认有用……不过下次被关进惩罚迷宫，咱们还是试试好玩的那种角色扮演吧。

source: You leave the maze through the secret door, and by casting your thief -N2 MAGIC, you gain +N2 MONEY looting the guards' bodies!
target: 你们从暗门逃出迷宫。你花掉 -N2 魔力，施放盗贼法术，从守卫尸体上搜出 +N2 金钱！

source: Smuggle something out
target: 走私点东西出去

source: This "country" is little more than a cottage in a small field. You knock on the door.
target: 所谓的“国家”，其实就是小块田里的一栋小屋。你敲了敲门。

source: Howdy, tourists! Welcome to my personal country!
target: 游客们好啊！欢迎来到我的私人国家！

source: Wow, you have your own country? What's it called?
target: 哇，你有自己的国家？叫什么？

source: Europe.
target: 欧洲。

source: Uh... what? Isn't Europe already the name of a continent?
target: 呃……什么？不是已经有个洲叫欧洲了吗？

source: So what? Citizens of the United States call themselves "Americans" even though North and South America are continents.
target: 那又怎样？美国人还管自己叫美洲人呢，可北美洲、南美洲明明各是一个洲。

source: If people think that's normal, then fuck it, this is Europe, and people who live here are called Europeans!
target: 大家觉得那正常？行啊，管他妈的，我这儿就叫欧洲，住这儿的就叫欧洲人！

source: Besides, mine is the superior Europe! We've got no taxes, we decriminalized murder via piano wire, Wednesdays have been abolished...
target: 再说，我的欧洲更好！不收税，用钢琴弦杀人不算犯罪，星期三也废除了……

source: And we make one-of-a-kind products you can't find anywhere else on Earth!
target: 还生产独一无二的特产，地球上别处绝对找不到！

source: That sounds awesome! Can we have one?
target: 听着真棒！能给我们一个吗？

source: NO! It's illegal to bring these products over the border!
target: 不行！带这些产品出境，违法！

source: The border? You mean that line drawn in the sand over there?
target: 边境？你说那边沙地上画的线？

source: That's the one!
target: 正是！

source: Right, okay. So, what happens if we DO smuggle something out?
target: 行吧。那要是真偷运点东西出去，会怎样？

source: You don't want to know.
target: 你不会想知道的。

source: You watch Noodles slowly pull some piano wire out of his hat. Nope nope nope.
target: 你看着面条缓缓从帽子里抽出钢琴弦。不行不行，还是算了。

source: (Come on, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, don't pussy out on me now! We gotta smuggle something out, it'll be great! Pick something to take!)
target: （拜托，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，这会儿可别怂！非得偷运点东西出去，多好玩！挑一样带走！）

source: The Blueprints to Proprietary Market-Disrupting Phone Technology
target: 足以颠覆市场的独家手机技术蓝图

source: The Key to Immortality
target: 永生之钥

source: An action figure of the national hero: Valiant Buff Noodles. You can't buy it anywhere else.
target: 国民英雄“英勇肌肉面条”的可动人偶，别处买不到。

source: Whoa. This... this is groundbreaking. These blueprints would turn the whole mobile phone market on its head!
target: 哇，这……这简直是革命性的突破。这蓝图足以颠覆整个手机市场！

source: Really? Because if I'm reading this right, these blueprints just show someone holding a rat up to their ear and talking into it like it's a phone.
target: 真的？可要是没看错，图上不就是一个人拿老鼠贴在耳边，对着它当电话说话吗？

source: Yup, that's right! Good eye, Scott!
target: 没错！斯科特，眼力不错！

source: Would that actually work the same as a phone, though?
target: 可那真能当电话用吗？

source: Of course it will! It's on blueprints, and everything looks 150% more legit if it's in blueprints!
target: 当然！这可是蓝图，画进蓝图里，什么东西看起来都能靠谱 150%！

source: I just don't understand how it works.
target: 我就是不懂原理。

source: Well, do you understand how regular phones work?
target: 那普通电话的原理，你懂吗？

source: Hmmmm... no.
target: 嗯……不懂。

source: Exactly!
target: 没错!

source: Polly stuffs the blueprints down your pants, and you leave Noodles' Europe. You lose -N2 SOUL for stealing.
target: 波莉把蓝图塞进你的裤子，你们离开了面条的欧洲。偷东西让你失去了 -N2 灵魂。

source: Okay, gang, time to profit off these stolen ideas. I'll just list this blueprint on eBuy... and look, we've already got a buyer!
target: 各位，该拿偷来的点子赚钱了。把蓝图挂到 eBuy……看，已经有人买了！

source: Can you ask him why he's buying them? I'm still trying to understand the appeal of all this.
target: 能问问他，买来干什么吗？我还在琢磨这到底哪儿吸引人。

source: Okay, I'll ask... he said, "No idea, I just paid a lot of money for a digital drawing of a monkey, I don't know what I am doing with my money anymore, LOL."
target: 行，我问问……他说：“不知道，刚花了一大笔钱买了张猴子的电子画像，已经不懂自己在拿钱干什么了，笑死。”

source: ...I don't understand economics.
target: ……我不懂经济学。

source: No one does, Scotty. Just be glad we made +N2 MONEY!
target: 没人懂，小斯。反正咱们赚了 +N2 金钱，高兴就完了！

source: It's not cool to smuggle the key out of Noodles' Europe, but who cares? I love fucking around with ancient magic!
target: 把钥匙从面条的欧洲偷运出去，是不太好，可谁在乎？我就爱乱玩远古魔法！

source: Sweet, now we have immortality all to ourselves!
target: 爽，永生的秘密归咱们独享了！

source: It's a little late for me, but %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% could try to siphon its magic!
target: 我是用不上了，不过 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 可以试试吸取里面的魔法！

source: Okay, you'll try. You put the key in your mouth and start sucking on it to get that sweet, sweet forbidden power.
target: 行，试试。你把钥匙含进嘴里，吮吸起来，想吸出那诱人的禁忌力量。

source: Is it working? Do you feel immortal, bro?
target: 有用吗？兄弟，感觉自己长生不死了吗？

source: Well, now my spit tastes metallic, so there's that. And my stomachache is gone!
target: 口水现在有股金属味了，也算点变化吧。而且胃也不疼了！

source: Then it must be working! Why don't we test it out?
target: 那肯定有效！试验一下？

source: Without warning, Polly stabs you in the leg. Ouch.
target: 波莉毫无预兆地往你腿上捅了一刀。疼。

source: Dang, you're bleeding a lot. Guess you're not immortal, bro.
target: 哎，流了好多血。兄弟，看来你不是不死之身。

source: Before you can reply, a crow swoops down, steals the key out of your mouth, and swallows it in one gulp!
target: 你还没来得及回答，一只乌鸦俯冲下来，从你嘴里抢走钥匙，一口吞下！

source: HEY! That was our key, you rat with wings!
target: 嘿！那是我们的钥匙，你这长翅膀的耗子！

source: Polly grabs a gun (where is she getting all these weapons?!) and shoots the crow.
target: 波莉掏出一把枪，她到底哪儿来的这么多武器？！然后朝乌鸦开枪。

source: The crow's head explodes... then quickly reforms!
target: 乌鸦的脑袋炸开……很快又长好了！

source: WUT.
target: 啥。

source: The crow looks indignantly at you all, then fires a laser out of its mouth. It hits you right in the knife wound. Today is NOT your lucky day.
target: 乌鸦愤愤地看着你们，从嘴里射出一道激光，正中你的刀伤。今天可真不是你的幸运日。

source: That crow is bad news! We should go!
target: 这乌鸦不好惹！快走吧！

source: You make a run for the car and GTFO of Europe. You lost -N2 SOUL, but your injuries healed quickly, so maybe that key did give you a bit of +N2 MAGIC!
target: 你们冲回车上，赶紧滚出了欧洲。你失去了 -N2 灵魂，不过伤口愈合得很快，没准钥匙真给了你一点 +N2 魔力！

source: Okay, good choice. We need to smuggle it out somehow, though...
target: 好，选得不错。不过得想办法偷运出去……

source: Ooh, I know! %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, stick it up your butt!
target: 哦，有了！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，塞进屁股！

source: That sounds painful as hell! It's not like Noodles has a customs office or a metal detector; can't I just put it in my pocket?
target: 听着就他妈疼！面条这里又没海关，也没金属探测器，放口袋不行吗？

source: No, silly, this is how you have to smuggle stuff. It's tradition! Now, open that bootyhole wide!
target: 不行，傻瓜，走私就是得这么干。传统！来，把屁眼张大！

source: Ugh, fine. You sneak out of Europe with the Valiant Buff Noodles action figure in your ass, which is a sentence I never thought I'd say.
target: 唉，行吧。你屁股里塞着“英勇肌肉面条”可动人偶，偷偷溜出欧洲。我从没想过自己会说出这种话。

source: Yay, our own Valiant Buff Noodles! The box says it comes with "dozens of fun voice lines to make you forget the crushing weight of being alive!"
target: 耶，咱们也有英勇肌肉面条了！盒子上说：“内置几十句趣味语音，帮你忘掉活着那沉重的压力！”

source: Scott pulls Valiant Buff Noodles' pull string. You would've washed it off first if you were him, but whatever.
target: 斯科特拉动人偶的拉绳。换作你，怎么也得先洗洗，不过算了。

source: "Hi, I'm Valiant Buff Noodles!" says the doll.
target: 人偶开口：“嗨，我是英勇肌肉面条！”

source: Hiii Noodles!
target: 嗨——面条！

source: "Existence is pain!"
target: “存在即痛苦！”

source: Wow, it really sounds just like him!
target: 哇，听着真跟他一模一样！

source: "All hail Noodles' Europe! It has the most pizza, and no dirty communists!"
target: “面条的欧洲万岁！披萨最多，没有肮脏的共产主义者！”

source: Uh...
"What does fire taste like? Lick some and find out!"
target: “火是什么味道？舔舔就知道！”

source: Okay! Anyone got a lighter?
target: 好！谁有打火机？

source: You know what? That's enough Valiant Buff Noodles.
target: 算了，英勇肌肉面条，听够了。

source: Polly throws the action figure out of the car window. Guess it was fun while it lasted.
target: 波莉把人偶扔出车窗。好吧，至少刚才还挺好玩。

source: You lost -N2 SOUL stealing from Noodles' Europe, but at least those wacky catchphrases gave you +N2 HYPE!
target: 偷面条的欧洲的东西，让你失去了 -N2 灵魂。不过那些疯疯癫癫的口头禅，倒给你带来了 +N2 热度！

source: International relations
target: 国际关系

source: This "country" is little more than a cottage in a small field. You walk through the open door and see several important-looking people sitting around a table.
target: 所谓的“国家”，其实就是小块田里的一栋小屋。你从敞开的门进去，看见几个颇有来头的人围桌而坐。

source: Okay, settle down everyone. I officially call the annual Monster United Nations meeting to order!
target: 好了，各位安静。魔物联合国年度会议，正式开始！

source: I'm Baal Berith, here today in representation of Hell.
target: 我是 Baal Berith，今天代表地狱出席。

source: I'm Ambassador Fischoeder, representing the Merkingdom. Our nation is happy to test the "peaceful political discourse" thing before jumping straight to global invasions.
target: 我是费肖德大使，代表人鱼王国。直接发动全球入侵之前，我国愿意先试试“和平政治对话”这一套。

source: And I'm Noodles, representing my country, Noodles' Europe!
target: 我叫面条，代表我的国家：面条的欧洲！

source: Is there a specific reason as to why we recognize Noodles' "sovereign nation" as a legitimate country?
target: 我们承认面条这个“主权国家”是合法国家，有什么特别的理由吗？

source: It's a long story. The short version is we don't want a repeat of what happened last time we tried to kick him out of the MUN.
target: 说来话长。简单说，上次想把他踢出魔物联合国，后果我们不想再经历一遍。

source: Teehee!
target: 嘻嘻！

source: The rest of the ambassadors introduce themselves. The Ambassadors of Belgium, Singapore, Madagascar, and Christmas Island are all present.
target: 其余大使依次自我介绍。比利时、新加坡、马达加斯加和圣诞岛的大使都在。

source: Great! I think that's everyone, so let's begin!
target: 很好，人齐了，开始吧！

source: "Wait a minute," says the Singaporean ambassador. "Who are those people sitting off to the side?"
target: 新加坡大使说：“等等，旁边坐的那些人是谁？”

source: Hey bros! Don't mind us, we just wanted to listen in.
target: 嘿，兄弟们！别管我们，我们就想旁听一下。

source: "You can't do that!" cries the Belgian ambassador. "This is a classified meeting amongst some of the most respected, dangerous leaders in the monster world!"
target: 比利时大使惊呼：“不行！这是机密会议，与会的都是怪物世界里备受尊重、又极其危险的领袖！”

source: Yet you let Noodles in?
target: 那面条怎么能来？

source: You have no idea what war crimes I'm capable of!
target: 你根本不知道我能干出什么战争罪行!

source: Okay, fine. Then... we're actually ambassadors of a new country called... "The Independent Republic of Prankz." Yeah, let's go with that.
target: 好吧。那……我们其实也是大使，来自一个新国家，叫……“恶作剧独立共和国”。对，就这个。

source: Sounds made up... but all countries are made up I suppose. You can stay, but according to diplomatic laws you can only participate in one point of discussion.
target: 听着像编的……不过国家都是人编出来的吧。可以留下，但按外交法规，你们只能参与一个议题。

source: It's to help ease new countries into international politics.
target: 这是为了帮助新国家逐步融入国际政治。

source: You check the itinerary for today's meeting. Which point of discussion do you choose?
target: 你看了看今天的会议议程。选哪个议题？

source: International Trade Treaties
target: 国际贸易条约

source: Diplomatic negotiations aiming to stop Noodles' Europe from building nuclear weapons
target: 通过外交谈判，阻止面条的欧洲制造核武器

source: International Trade Treaties it is. You wait until they get to that point of discussion. When you join, some of the action has started already...
target: 就国际贸易条约了。你等到这个议题开始，加入时，讨论已经进行了一会儿……

source: Noodles, intel tells us you manufacture some weird products in your country, and Hell wants in. We're open to trade you 20,000 soldiers for 0.1% of your gross national product.
target: 面条，据情报，你们国家生产一些怪东西，地狱也想分一杯羹。我们愿意拿两万士兵，换你国国民生产总值的 0.1%。

source: Wait, I want a slice of that money pie! Noodles, I gotta have that 0.1% GNP!
target: 等等，赚钱怎么能不带我！面条，那 0.1% 的国民生产总值，我要了！

source: Okay, what will you give me for it?
target: 行啊，拿什么换？

source: How about this: the Independent Republic of Prankz can offer you a thirty-million dollar military armament...
target: 这样吧，恶作剧独立共和国愿意提供价值三千万美元的军备……

source: OR, you can have whatever's in %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s right hand.
target: 或者，选 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 右手里的东西。

source: This is idiotic. Military power is obviously the better deal; there's no way anybody would be stupid enough to--
target: 真蠢。显然军事实力更划算，怎么可能有人蠢到——

source: I CAN'T HANDLE THE SUSPENSE! I'll take the right hand!
target: 悬念憋死我了！我选右手！

source: Great choice! Your prize is a coupon entitling you to a free pizza!
target: 好眼光！奖品是一张免费披萨券！

source: Actually, wait... it seems to be a buy-one-get-one free pizza coupon. So you still have to buy a pizza to use it. But still, it's something!
target: 不过，等等……好像是买一送一券。也就是说，还得先买一张披萨才能用。不过总比没有强！

source: Oh, no, not the angry eyebrows! When he draws on the angry eyebrows it can only mean one thing... war crimes!
target: 哦，不，愤怒眉毛！他一画上愤怒眉毛，就只意味着一件事……战争罪行！

source: You will worry about war crimes tomorrow... today, you gain +N2 MONEY from Noodles' Europe.
target: 战争罪行，明天再操心吧……今天，你从面条的欧洲赚到了 +N2 金钱。

source: But you still lose -N2 MIND from doing lots of brainy diplomacy.
target: 不过费了这么多脑子搞外交，你还是失去了 -N2 头脑。

source: Yeah, stopping Noodles from building weapons of mass destruction sounds like the sensible choice here.
target: 没错，阻止面条制造大规模杀伤性武器，听起来确实是明智之选。

source: You wait until they get to that point of discussion. When you join, some of the action has started already...
target: 你等到这个议题开始，加入时，讨论已经进行了一会儿……

source: Fuck off! You can't make me stop making my nuclear weapons, no way, no how!
target: 滚蛋！休想让我停止造核武器，门都没有！

source: Maybe it's too late! Maybe I've even already built the nuclear weapons... and I have them stored here, inside this cardboard box!
target: 说不定已经晚了！没准我早就造好了……就存在这儿，这个纸箱里面！

source: He's bluffing! Not even Ambassador Noodles would be reckless enough to put nuclear weapons in a cardboard box.
target: 他在虚张声势！再怎么说，面条大使也不至于莽撞到把核武器装纸箱里。

source: You think so? Are you so sure that you're willing to let me... DROP IT?!
target: 是吗？这么肯定？那敢不敢让我……把它扔地上？！

source: NO! DON'T DO THAT!
target: 不！别扔！

source: Noodles, if you have nukes in there, you have to show us. International negotiations rules entitle us to at least a five-second peek of all nuclear bombs.
target: 面条，要是真有核弹，就得给我们看。按国际谈判规则，每颗核弹，至少得让我们看五秒。

source: Ugh, fine...
target: 唉，行吧……

source: SIKE! I got you! Hahaha, you should've seen the looks on your faces!
target: 骗你的！上当啦！哈哈哈，真该看看你们刚才那表情！

source: I think we can reach a compromise. Ambassador Noodles, if you let Ambassador Fischoeder have the box, Scott will do a silly dance for you.
target: 应该能折中。面条大使，你把箱子交给费肖德大使，斯科特就给你跳段滑稽舞。

source: Trust me, it's VERY silly. You won't wanna miss it!
target: 信我，特别滑稽。错过可就亏了！

source: Well... if it's really that silly... then okay!
target: 嗯……要是真有那么滑稽……那好吧！

source: Woohoo! Silly dancing time! Doo-dee-doo-dee-dah!
target: 呜呼！滑稽舞时间！嘟嘀嘟嘀哒！

source: Haha, that dance was great! Totally worth it. You guys can look in the box now.
target: 哈哈，这舞真棒！值了！现在可以看箱子了。

source: Fucking hell, he really DID have nukes in here!
target: 他妈的，里面还真有核弹！

source: Told ya! Teehee!
target: 早说了嘛！嘻嘻！

source: Hooray, we stopped the nuclear apocalypse! SILLY DANCE TIME! Doo-dee-doo-dee-dah!
target: 万岁，我们阻止了核末日！滑稽舞时间！嘟嘀嘟嘀哒！

source: You lost -N2 MIND from all the brainy diplomacy, but you gained +N2 SOUL for taking nukes away from Noodles!
target: 费了这么多脑子搞外交，你失去了 -N2 头脑；不过从面条手里收走核弹，让你获得 +N2 灵魂！

source: Learn the country's customs
target: 了解当地风俗

source: This "country" is little more than a cottage in a small field. You knock on the door.
target: 所谓的“国家”，其实就是小块田里的一栋小屋。你敲了敲门。

source: Hi there, foreigners! Welcome to my country: Noodles' Europe!
target: 外国人，你们好！欢迎来到我的国家：面条的欧洲！

source: "Noodles' Europe?" But isn't there already a continent called Europe?
target: “面条的欧洲”？不是已经有个洲叫欧洲了吗？

source: Yeah, but I liked the name! Don't like it, make your own country!
target: 对啊，可我喜欢这名字！不服就自己建国！

source: Okay, live your truth. So what are some of the customs of Noodles' Europe?
target: 行，你开心就好。那面条的欧洲有什么风俗？

source: One is that it's a common European custom to breathe using your lungs.
target: 其中一个，就是用肺呼吸。欧洲人都习惯这样。

source: It began as a fashion statement in the upper class, but it became popular in all social castes when people realized lung-breathing was the best way not to die of suffocation.
target: 最早是上流社会赶时髦的做法，后来大家发现，用肺呼吸最能避免窒息死亡，于是各个阶层都流行起来了。

source: We also eat everything slathered in mayo! Except for No Mayo Mondays, when eating mayo is punishable by death.
target: 还有，什么食物都得涂满蛋黄酱！但无酱星期一除外，那天吃蛋黄酱，处死。

source: And the favorite cultural pastime is to write Don Quixote!
target: 最流行的文化消遣，则是写《堂吉诃德》！

source: You mean read Don Quixote?
target: 你是说，读《堂吉诃德》？

source: No, write it! No European has ever read the original work, but we know about it through pop culture, so whenever we have free time we take to writing the story ourselves.
target: 不，写！欧洲人没谁读过原著，可都从流行文化里听说过。所以一有空，我们就自己动笔写这个故事。

source: So you just... rewrite the events of Don Quixote verbatim?
target: 所以你们就是……把《堂吉诃德》的情节原样重写一遍？

source: Not REwrite, silly! No one's ever read it, remember? We just write what we think is the closest version to Don Quixote we can imagine.
target: 不是重写，傻瓜！都说没人读过了。我们只是尽量写出想象中最接近《堂吉诃德》的版本。

source: In any case, you foreigners are in for a treat. Today's a special day in Europe!
target: 总之，你们这些外国人有福了。今天可是欧洲的大日子！

source: Oh, cool! Is today a holiday or something!
target: 哦，酷！今天过节吗？

source: Better! Today is TWO holidays!
target: 比那更棒！今天过两个节！

source: Wait, two? Isn't that kinda inefficient? Why not just give each holiday its own day so people can focus on celebrating just the one?
target: 等等，两个？不会有点低效吗？各挑一天过，大家不就能专心庆祝一个了？

source: Because it's my country and I make the rules! If I wanna have two holidays on the same day, THEN THAT'S HOW IT'S GONNA FUCKIN' BE!
target: 因为我的国家，我定规矩！我他妈想在同一天过两个节，那就得这么过！

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, why don't you pick which holiday we celebrate? The President of Europe commands you to!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你来选庆祝哪个节吧！欧洲总统命令你选！

source: Tanksgiving, the holiday in which we all give tanks to those who we love.
target: 感坦节，大家给心爱的人送坦克的节日。

source: Freaky Friday, the Friday in which we swap our bodies with a loved one to live wacky misadventures that ultimately teach us a valuable lesson in empathy.
target: 怪诞星期五，跟亲近的人互换身体，经历滑稽冒险，最后学会换位思考的重要一课。

source: Great choice! To show my appreciation for you all visiting Europe today, here's a tank specially made for each of you!
target: 选得好！谢谢各位今天来欧洲玩，送你们每人一辆专属坦克！

source: Aww, thanks Noodles! Mine's covered in peanut butter!
target: 哇，谢谢面条！我的涂满花生酱了！

source: My tank shoots confetti instead of bullets, but at the same lethal speeds! This RULES!
target: 我的坦克发射彩纸屑，不是子弹，速度却一样致命！爽翻了！

source: Okay, since you guys are my friends, I'll gift you some tanks too. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, I installed a gaming chair in yours so you'd feel right at home.
target: 既然大家都是朋友，我也送你们坦克。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，给你那辆装了电竞椅，保证坐着跟在家一样。

source: FUCK. YES.
target: 他妈的，太爽了。

source: I wanna give tanks too! %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, take this tank. It's a Howl family heirloom passed down through one generation, and it's covered in peanut butter!
target: 我也要送！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，拿着，这辆可是嚎尔家只传了一代的传家宝，还涂满花生酱！

source: How sweet! You gift your friends some tanks too. You're very tankful to have loved ones who gave you such great tanks.
target: 真暖心！你也送了朋友们几辆坦克。亲朋好友送你这么好的坦克，实在令人坦激不尽。

source: You, Polly, Scott, and Noodles all share a holiday dinner... while in your tanks. Then you play some sports, also in your tanks.
target: 你和波莉、斯科特、面条，全坐在各自的坦克里吃节日晚餐。饭后做运动，也坐在坦克里。

source: Full contact tank football was fun and destructive. Tank yoga was more experimental, but dang, tanks are more flexible than you'd have thought.
target: 全接触坦克橄榄球好玩又破坏力十足。坦克瑜伽更像实验，不过真没想到，坦克的柔韧性这么好。

source: "Tank" you all for celebrating Tanksgiving with me. Enjoy your tanks!
target: “坦”谢各位，陪我一起过感坦节。好好享受你们的坦克吧！

source: Just know if you ever use them against me, I have the self-destruction codes. Toodleoo!
target: 不过记好了，要是拿它们对付我，我可握着自毁代码。拜拜！

source: As fun as this was, I don't really NEED a tank, and it'd be hard to fit one into my luggage. We should sell these.
target: 虽然玩得很开心，可我确实不需要坦克，行李也塞不下。卖了吧。

source: Good call. You still have to sell them at a loss since your tanks are obviously used, bruised, and covered in peanut butter, so you lose -N2 MONEY.
target: 好主意。可坦克明显用过了，磕磕碰碰，还涂满花生酱，只能亏本卖，害你失去了 -N2 金钱。

source: But at least you gained +N2 HYPE sharing the joys of extremely dangerous armored vehicles with the ones you love!
target: 不过跟心爱的人分享极度危险的装甲载具，总算让你获得 +N2 热度！

source: AWESOME! I can't wait to trade bodies with my mom and learn the struggle of being a single mother of two trying to make ends meet while moonlighting as a chess coach!
target: 太棒了！等不及跟我妈换身体了！体验一下一边养两个孩子、一边兼职国际象棋教练，还得勉强维持生计的单亲妈妈有多辛苦！

source: Okay, I'll switch bodies with my mom too! I'll learn so many cool things about her, like her name, and where she is, and why she never calls me!
target: 好，那我也跟我妈换！肯定能知道好多关于她的酷事，比如她叫什么、在哪里，还有为什么从来不给我打电话！

source: Ehhh... it doesn't work like that. You have to already know the person you're switching bodies with.
target: 呃……不是这么玩的。你得先认识那个要换身体的人。

source: Oh...
Hey, Scott, chin up. How about this: we're best buds who love each other lots. Why don't you and I switch bodies instead?
target: 嘿，斯科特，别难过。这样吧：咱俩是特别要好的朋友，特别爱彼此，不如你跟我换？

source: You'd really do that for me, bro? Thank you so much!
target: 兄弟，你真愿意为我这样做？太谢谢了！

source: Using -N2 MAGIC, Noodles recites the Ancient Switcheroo Incantation, and Polly and Scott's minds get totally swapped!
target: 面条施展古老的调包咒，花掉 -N2 魔力，把波莉和斯科特的心智彻底互换了！

source: BROOO! Am I really Polly now? Weird... should I try talking like Polly?
target: 兄弟——！我现在真成波莉了？怪怪的……要不要学波莉说话？

source: Hey, boo! I'm Polly! I'm gorgeous and funny and I read big books and I do lots of dances with my butt! Watch me go!
target: 嘿，亲爱的！我是波莉！我又美又好笑，会读厚厚的书，还经常扭屁股跳舞！看我的！

source: Nice moves! Damn, I have a FINE ass. Hmm, okay, I'll try being you now.
target: 跳得不错！靠，我这屁股真翘。嗯，好，换我当你了。

source: AWOOOOO! Check it out, bros, I'm Scott! I have big muscles and an even bigger heart! SPORTS! SPORTS! SPORTS!
target: 嗷呜——！看啊，兄弟们，我是斯科特！肌肉大，心肠更好！运动！运动！运动！

source: Wow, you sound totally like me. You almost had me fooled that you WERE Scott!
target: 哇，听着跟我一模一样。我差点真信你是斯科特了！

source: Thanks! Ready to switch back now? Being body-swapped is fun, but this heartbeat of yours is really distracting.
target: 谢啦！准备换回去了吗？换身体是好玩，可你这心跳一直响，实在有点分心。

source: Noodles reverses the spell, and your friends are back to their old selves again.
target: 面条解除了法术，朋友们又恢复了原样。

source: Great work! But it wouldn't be a true Freaky Friday if you didn't learn a moral lesson along the way. What'd you guys learn?
target: 干得好！不过怪诞星期五里，要是没学到人生道理，那可不算数。你们学到了什么？

source: I learned that Polly is very impressive. Doing her signature dance requires a lot more butt strength than I thought!
target: 我明白了，波莉真的很厉害。她那招牌舞，屁股得使的劲比我想的大多了！

source: Aww, thanks! I learned that it's hard being in Scott's shoes, 'cause it's hard to bend down and tie your shoes when you have so many muscles.
target: 哇，谢谢！我发现斯科特也不容易，肌肉太多，想弯腰系个鞋带都难。

source: What did you learn while you were body-swapped, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你换身体的时候，学到了什么？

source: Oh, I didn't swap %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% with anybody. I figured nobody loved %HIMHER% enough to change bodies with %HIMHER%.
target: 哦，我没让 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 跟谁换。我寻思，没谁爱 %HIMHER% 爱到愿意跟 %HIMHER% 换身体吧。

source: Ouch. Guess the only lesson you learned this Freaky Friday is that Noodles is a dick.
target: 扎心了。看来这次怪诞星期五，你只学会了一件事：面条是个混蛋。

source: At least your friends gained +N2 SOUL for you while they were body-swapped!
target: 至少朋友们互换身体，帮你赚到了 +N2 灵魂！

source: The people
target: 人民

source: You all head to the plaza to see what's up with this place. People are milling about, buying groceries and polishing their weapons and praying.
target: 大家来到广场，看看这里怎么回事。人们四处走动，有的买菜，有的擦武器，有的祈祷。

source: Everyone gawks at you. "OUTSIDERS!" they say. "Welcome, welcome! You're the first sign of the outside world we've seen in decades!"
target: 众人瞪着你们：“外来者！欢迎，欢迎！几十年了，你们是我们见到的第一点外界的消息！”

source: Wow, wild. So you guys really don't know ANYTHING about outside life?
target: 哇，离谱。所以你们对外面的生活，真的一无所知？

source: "Well, we've never seen it ourselves, but we get some information from news broadcast tapes that the elders bring us."
target: “倒也不是，虽然没亲眼见过，但长者会带新闻录像给我们，看了也能知道一点。”

source: Oh, you guys get newscasts in here? What do you already know?
target: 哦，还能看新闻？那你们都知道些什么？

source: One person says, "Last week, I saw a newscast about a huge purple titan who snapped his fingers and made half of the world's population turn to ashes! So scary!"
target: 一个人说：“上周新闻里，有个巨大的紫色泰坦，打个响指，就把全球一半人口变成灰了！太可怕了！”

source: A huge purple... what?
target: 巨大的紫色……什么？

source: Someone else adds, "I watched one last night that showed the world was covered in monsters that made you kill yourself if you looked at them directly!"
target: 另一个补充：“昨晚我看的新闻说，全世界都是怪物，直视它们就会让人自杀！”

source: "Really?" another person adds. "I watched one recently that said the world was covered in monsters that would kill you if you made any noise!"
target: 还有人说：“真的？可我最近看的新闻说，全世界都是那种只要你发出声音，就会杀了你的怪物！”

source: That would mean people couldn't see OR talk ever... are you sure these are trusted sources?
target: 那大家岂不是既不能看，也不能说话……这些消息真的可靠吗？

source: "Totally sure!" says someone else. "I watched a newscast recently that showed society is gone, everyone has fled to space, and the world is covered in trash..."
target: 另一个人说：“绝对可靠！我最近看了新闻，社会崩溃，所有人都逃到太空，地球上全是垃圾……”

source: "But there was still hope, because there's still one square, plucky little robot out there going on adventures!"
target: “不过还有希望，因为外面还有个方方的、勇敢的小机器人在冒险！”

source: "WOOHOO!" someone cries. "GO ROBOT!"
target: 有人欢呼：“呜呼！机器人加油！”

source: (Polly, is it just me, or are these villagers describing movie plots as if they're real news?)
target: （波莉，是我的错觉吗？这些村民是不是把电影剧情当成真新闻了？）

source: (You hit the nail on the head, bud. These people don't know the difference between fiction and reality.)
target: （一针见血，伙计。这些人分不清虚构和现实。）

source: (Wow, that's so sad! Should we tell them the truth?)
target: （哇，太惨了！要告诉他们真相吗？）

source: (Well, we COULD... or we could put on our Prank Masterz hats and take this golden opportunity to dupe the most gullible people on Earth!)
target: （可以啊……或者咱们戴上恶作剧大师的帽子，抓住机会，好好骗骗全地球最好骗的人！）

source: "Tell us, outsiders," the villagers say eagerly, "since you've actually seen it yourselves: what is life REALLY like out there?"
target: “告诉我们,外来者,”村民们急切地说,“既然你们亲眼目睹了,外面的生活到底像什么?”

source: Oh, we'll tell you all right. Give us some news from afar, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!
target: 放心，肯定告诉你们。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，来点远方的消息！

source: The world has changed greatly: the new currency is these silly drawings we've made. Get them now, their price is skyrocketing!
target: 世界变了！现在流通的货币，是我们画的这些傻画。快买，价格正暴涨呢！

source: The world has changed greatly: the new form of entertainment is giving us A SHIT TON OF NOODLES and watching us eat them. It's called mukbang.
target: 世界变了！最新的娱乐，是给我们一大堆面条，看我们吃。这叫吃播。

source: "Really?" the villagers ask skeptically. "THESE drawings are currency? But they're so..."
target: 村民半信半疑：“真的？这些画能当钱？可画得也太……”

source: SO COOL, I'm sure you were gonna say! Yeah, these art pieces are the shit now. They're way more valuable than the dollar.
target: 太酷了，你肯定是想这么说！没错，这些画现在可牛了，比美元值钱多了。

source: Look at this one! I drew a dolphin in a cowboy hat! It represents a dolphin who is also a cowboy.
target: 看看这张！我画了只戴牛仔帽的海豚，象征着一只同时也是牛仔的海豚。

source: Normally we'd charge out the wazoo for this art. But since you guys are new to this, I'll let you have it for just +N2 MONEY.
target: 平时这种艺术品可贵了。不过你们刚入门，就便宜点，只收 +N2 金钱。

source: Never say ol' Polly never did anything for you.
target: 以后别说老波莉没照顾过你们啊。

source: Here's one I drew of a whale in a chef hat! A lot of these drawings are from my "sea animals in funny hats" era.
target: 这张画的是戴厨师帽的鲸鱼！好多都是我在“海洋动物戴滑稽帽子”时期画的。

source: "Well... it seems strange, but we'll buy into this new currency," the villagers say. "It's not like we have any choice but to believe that you're telling the truth!"
target: 村民说：“好吧……虽然挺奇怪，这种新货币我们买了。除了相信你们，我们也没别的选择嘛！”

source: Right you are, my friends! Just slide me some cash, and you'll be the proud owner of your own digital receipt of a Scott Howl original!
target: 朋友们，说得对！把现金给我，你就能光荣地拥有一张电子凭证，证明你拥有斯科特·嚎尔的原作！

source: "Wait, a digital receipt? We don't get to keep the actual artwork itself?"
target: “等等，电子凭证？不是把画本身给我们吗？”

source: Of course not, silly! These artworks aren't like a regular currency. They're a cryptocurrency!
target: 当然不是，傻瓜！这又不是普通货币，是加密货币！

source: "Oh... what's a cryptocurrency?"
target: “哦……加密货币是什么？”

source: It's a type of currency whose purposes are so cryptic and illogical that not even I can give you a satisfactory explanation for them.
target: 就是用途晦涩得像加了密、还毫无逻辑的一种货币，连我都没法给你们解释明白。

source: All you need to know is the new trend is buying a digital receipt saying that you legally own one of these drawings, but isn't actually the drawing itself.
target: 你们只要知道，现在流行花钱买个电子凭证，说这些画归你合法所有，可凭证本身又不是画。

source: "People really buy this crap?" the villagers ask, bewildered. "Wow. It IS the apocalypse out there."
target: 村民一脸茫然：“真有人买这破玩意儿？哇，外面果然是末日了。”

source: Look at this drawing I just finished! It's my friend Polly as a starfish tricking a school of tuna into giving her money for a drawing that isn't real!
target: 看看我刚画完的！我的朋友波莉，化身海星，骗一群金枪鱼花钱买一张不存在的画！

source: It was inspired by... a completely unrelated event.
target: 灵感来自……一件完全不相干的事。

source: You lose -N2 SOUL for tricking the villagers into buying NFTs. At least Scott can say he's a bona fide artist now!
target: 骗村民买 NFT，让你失去了 -N2 灵魂。至少斯科特现在能自称货真价实的艺术家了！

source: "Wh...what?" the villagers ask, confused. "Why would anyone want to watch that?"
target: 村民满脸困惑：“什……什么？谁会想看这个？”

source: No clue, but trust me, mukbang is SUPER inexplicably mesmerizing. Just watch.
target: 不知道，但相信我，吃播就是莫名其妙地让人着迷。看着吧。

source: You and your friends set up a mukbang eating station. Polly sits in front of her audience with a bowl of noodles.
target: 你和朋友们摆好吃播的阵势。波莉捧着一碗面，坐到观众面前。

source: OM NOM NOM! Look at me eating! These noodles sure are going into my corporeal body right now!
target: 啊呜啊呜！看我吃东西！这些面条现在正进入我有血有肉的身体！

source: Watch me chew these carbs up with my real mouth and teeth! You know you love it!
target: 看我用真的嘴和牙，把碳水嚼碎！你们肯定爱看！

source: "Is it just me, or is she talking like somebody who doesn't actually know how to eat food?" one villager asks.
target: 一个村民问：“只有我觉得，她说起话来，像根本不知道怎么吃饭吗？”

source: DON'T BE A HATER. THIS IS TOTALLY HOW EATING WORKS. I KNOW BECAUSE I DO IT EVERY DAY WITH INCREDIBLE REGULARITY.
target: 别抬杠！吃东西本来就是这样。我知道，因为我每天都吃，特别规律。

source: Despite the hater, the other villagers are entranced. "In all honesty," they say, "I don't know why I'm so invested in this, but I am."
target: 虽然有人质疑，其他村民还是看入迷了。“说真的，”他们说，“不知道为什么看得这么投入，可就是停不下来。”

source: "It could be how yummy the noodles look, or how attractive the girl is, or the hypnotic sound of her chewing, but I'm obsessed!"
target: “可能是面条看着好吃，也可能是姑娘漂亮，或者咀嚼声太催眠，反正我上瘾了！”

source: Haha, yep, that's definitely my chewing noises! CRUNCH MUNCH CHEW CHEW SWALLOW!
target: 哈哈，对，那肯定是我的咀嚼声！嘎吱，吧唧，嚼嚼嚼，咽下去！

source: It's not. What they're hearing is actually you and Scott hiding under the table eating all the noodles Polly's passing through her body.
target: 才不是。他们听见的，其实是你和斯科特躲在桌子底下，吃掉那些穿过波莉身体的面条。

source: The delicious pasta combined with the subtle ectoplasmic residue she leaves on them makes this an unforgettable dining experience.
target: 美味的面条，再配上她留下的淡淡灵质残渣，这顿饭实在令人难忘。

source: You lose -N2 SOUL tricking the villagers, but you gain +N2 STAMINA from your mukbang-sized meal!
target: 骗村民让你失去了 -N2 灵魂，不过吃播分量的大餐，也让你获得 +N2 体力！

source: The church
target: 教堂

source: A weird, secluded village like this must have some intriguing ideas about religion and the afterlife. You go check out the local church.
target: 这种古怪又与世隔绝的村子，对宗教和来世的理解，肯定很有意思。你去当地教堂看看。

source: There are several major churches in the town square, with arguing crowds outside.
target: 镇广场上有几座大教堂，外面的人群正吵成一团。

source: "I don't want to be intolerant of your beliefs," says one priest, "but your beliefs are wrong and dumb and mine are right and you should be ashamed."
target: 一个神父说：“我不想歧视你的信仰，可你的信仰既错又蠢，我的才对，你该羞愧。”

source: "The Temple of Tiny Folk teaches us that the Giants are a punishment for our lives of sin. They'd stop eating us if we went to confession and banned all violent video games!"
target: “小人神殿教导我们，巨人是对我们罪恶人生的惩罚。只要忏悔、禁止一切暴力电子游戏，他们就不会再吃我们！”

source: "You're wrong!" says another priest. "The First Church of Giant Saints teaches us that the Giants are here to SAVE us, not punish us!"
target: 另一个神父说：“你错了！巨圣第一教会教导我们，巨人是来拯救我们，而非惩罚我们！”

source: "The Giants are God's holy messengers. God's language is consumption, and within the Giants' bellies is the promised afterlife!"
target: “巨人是上帝的神圣使者。吞食就是上帝的语言，巨人的肚子里，就是应许给我们的来世！”

source: Another priest says, "No, THIS is the afterlife! Per the Church of Nihilism, we're already dead, and the Giants are a metaphor for our sins literally biting us in the asses."
target: 第三个神父说：“不，这里就是来世！根据虚无教会的教义，我们已经死了，巨人只是隐喻：我们的罪孽反噬，真来咬我们屁股了。”

source: A weird old man adds, "I think the Giants are a holy metaphor too! They're a metaphor for the instinctual desire to have sex with your mother!"
target: 一个古怪老人插话：“我也觉得巨人是神圣的隐喻！它们象征着你本能中想跟自己母亲上床的欲望！”

source: ...Please go to therapy.
target: ……麻烦去看看心理医生。

source: "Oh, hello new visitors! Are you interested in joining one of our parishes?"
target: “哦，新来的客人！有兴趣加入我们哪个教区吗？”

source: Not really.
target: 不太想。

source: "Great, glad to have you onboard! Now, do you believe that the Giants are forces of evil, or forces of good?"
target: “太好了，欢迎加入！那么，你们觉得巨人代表邪恶，还是善良？”

source: I dunno. Maybe they're just... forces? I've never liked how some religions enforce a black and white morality--
target: 不知道，也许就只是……一种力量？有些宗教非要把善恶分得黑白分明，我一直不喜欢——

source: "Wrong answer. What about you, hairy man?"
target: “答错了。毛茸茸的那位，你呢？”

source: Hmmm... I think the Giants are a metaphor too.
target: 嗯……我也觉得巨人是个隐喻。

source: For what?
target: 隐喻什么？

source: Um... being really tall!
target: 呃……个子特别高！

source: "Interesting theory!" say the priests. "So, having heard many of our spiels, is there a particular church that attracts you?"
target: 神父们说：“有意思的理论！听我们讲了这么多，有哪间教会特别吸引你们吗？”

source: Dang, I dunno... there's so many options! %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, which religious theory sounds most appealing to you?
target: 哎，不知道……选择也太多了！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你觉得哪种宗教理论最有吸引力？

source: Giants are a punishment from God. We need to prove ourselves worthy to pass the test of God... which is a literal 30 question test with a written essay.
target: 巨人是上帝的惩罚。我们得证明自己配得上通过上帝的考验……这考验真是一份三十道题、还要写作文的试卷。

source: Giants have been guarding the walls for so long because they're NBA scouts looking for new talent! Welcome to... THE CHURCH OF BASKETBALL!
target: 巨人守着城墙那么久，是因为他们是 NBA 球探，来找新秀的！欢迎来到……篮球教会！

source: "YES! That's three more for my parish!" the exams priest cheers. "You just need to pass these tests to count yourself among the holy!"
target: 主张考试的神父欢呼：“好！我的教区又多三个！通过这些测试，就能跻身圣徒了！”

source: Okay, let's see here... "Who do you love the most? a. Your mom; b. God; c. Taco Tuesdays; d. God's mom" Does God have a mom?
target: 好，我看看……“你最爱谁？a. 你妈；b. 上帝；c. 塔可星期二；d. 上帝他妈。”上帝有妈妈吗？

source: "Which adjective best describes God? a. Sacred; b. Radical!; c. Crunchy; d. Water-soluble"
target: “哪个形容词最适合形容上帝？a. 神圣；b. 酷毙了！；c. 酥脆；d. 水溶性。”

source: "According to God, what is 2+2? a. Yes; b. 8, God's well-known favorite number; c. A mathematical equation; d. All of the above...?"
target: “在上帝看来，2+2 是什么？a. 是的；b. 8，众所周知这是上帝最爱的数字；c. 数学等式；d. 以上皆是……？”

source: "Which of the following is most reprehensible to God's will? a. Shellfish; b. The color 'mauve'; c. 'that rat snitch Judas'; d. Slipknot"
target: “下列哪项最违背上帝的意志？a. 贝类；b. 藕紫色；c. ‘犹大那只告密耗子’；d. 活结乐队。”

source: "If you found the flayed corpse of God in the dead of night, would you tell your parents? a. Yes; b. No; c. I'm scared"
target: “如果深夜发现了上帝被剥皮的尸体，你会告诉父母吗？a. 会；b. 不会；c. 我害怕。”

source: Uh... I guess I'll answer C?
target: 呃……那我选 C？

source: "Write an essay explaining the greatest sin you've committed and why you regret it."
target: “写篇作文，说说你犯过最大的罪，以及为什么后悔。”

source: Polly, have I sinned?
target: 波莉，我犯过罪吗？

source: I dunno, but I definitely have, and you didn't do anything to stop me. I think that counts as at least a second-degree sin.
target: 不知道，但我肯定犯过，你也没拦着。起码算个二级罪吧。

source: You lose -N2 MIND trying to answer these weird nonsensical questions.
target: 你绞尽脑汁，回答这些莫名其妙的怪题，失去了 -N2 头脑。

source: Eventually you get sick of this shit and just copy the answers from the priest's Holy Answer Key.
target: 最后实在受不了这破试卷，你直接照着神父的神圣参考答案抄了。

source: "Congratulations, you all passed the test!" says the priest. "Feel your +N2 SOUL fill with God's most sacred blessing: an A+!"
target: 神父说：“恭喜，各位都通过了！感受上帝最神圣的祝福：A+！你们因此获得 +N2 灵魂！”

source: Hooray! We're super smart in the eyes of God and the church!
target: 万岁！在上帝和教会眼里，咱们是超级聪明人！

source: Yup. Never thought I'd see the day.
target: 嗯，没想到还能有这一天。

source: But the important lesson here, Scott, is church isn't a place, it's a feeling...
target: 不过斯科特，重点是：教会不是一个地方，而是一种感觉……

source: ...and I have a feeling that we're never coming back here again.
target: ……我感觉，咱们再也不会来了。

source: "Wonderful!" the basketball priest says. "Then as we say in our church, 'God just sent His draft list, and it looks like you're in!'"
target: 篮球神父说：“好极了！用我们教会的话说，‘上帝发来选秀名单，你入选了！’”

source: Sweet, that was easy. So what are some of the tenets of the Church of Basketball?
target: 爽，真简单。那篮球教会有什么教义？

source: "To be accepted into God's sacred lineup, you must commit to being the best athlete you can be. You can start by following the Five Basketball Commandments!"
target: “想入选上帝的神圣阵容，就得全力以赴，做最好的运动员。先从遵守篮球五诫开始吧！”

source: "1. Thou shalt not run with the ball without first dribbling it, as traveling is the utmost sin."
target: “一、汝不得持球奔跑而不运球，因为走步乃至大之罪。”

source: "2. Thou shalt respect the wisdom of the referee."
target: “二、汝当尊重裁判之智慧。”

source: "3. Thou shalt not hit the ball with a closed fist; only throw the ball or bat it with one or both hands."
target: “三、汝不得握拳击球，只可以单手或双手投球、拍球。”

source: "4. Thou shalt observe halftime in a 15 minute interval to rest, rehydrate, and pray."
target: “四、汝当遵守十五分钟之中场休息，用以休息、补水、祈祷。”

source: "5. Thou shalt not murder."
target: “五、汝不得杀人。”

source: That makes sense. Murder is strictly against the rules of basketball.
target: 说得通。杀人严格违反篮球规则。

source: Cool beans. What are your church services like?
target: 不错。你们的礼拜是什么样的？

source: "We do basketball drills -- but in a God-honoring way!"
target: “做篮球训练，不过得怀着荣耀上帝的心！”

source: Fun! You change into sportswear and spend the next hour learning sacred basketball plays.
target: 好玩！你换上运动服，接下来一小时都在练神圣的篮球战术。

source: Great form, Polly! %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, make sure you tuck your knees when you're doing a Lordly Layup!
target: 波莉，动作不错！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，做主之上篮的时候，记得收膝！

source: "Excellent coaching, Brother Scott!" the priest says, giving him a pious slap on the ass.
target: 神父虔诚地拍了拍他的屁股：“斯科特弟兄，指导得真好！”

source: "Let's take a break and enjoy some eucharist snacks. These protein bars represent the Lord's muscles, and this sports drink represents His blood and electrolytes."
target: “休息一下，吃点圣餐零食吧。这些蛋白棒代表主的肌肉，运动饮料代表祂的血和电解质。”

source: "After the break, I'll teach you the Theological Three-Pointer and the Hail Mary (But Basketball)!"
target: “休息完，教你们神学三分球，还有万福玛利亚绝招，篮球版！”

source: Y'know bros, this has been fun, but I don't think I wanna spend my life worshipping ONLY basketball. All the other sports I like would get jealous.
target: 兄弟们，玩是挺好玩，可我不想这辈子只崇拜篮球。我喜欢的其他运动会吃醋的。

source: "BLASPHEMY!" cries the priest from across the court.
target: 球场另一头，神父大喊：“亵渎！”

source: If you're ready to bail, I am too. I'm frickin' exhausted. Who knew being an athlete of God would take so much -N2 STAMINA?
target: 你想溜的话，我也想。我都累死了。谁知道当上帝的运动员，要耗掉 -N2 体力啊？

source: You tiptoe out while the priest is replacing his holy sweatband. At least you gained +N2 HYPE playing basketball!
target: 趁神父换神圣汗带，你们蹑手蹑脚溜了出去。至少打篮球让你获得 +N2 热度！

source: The elders
target: 长者

source: You find the capitol building and walk inside. Looks like the village elders are in the middle of a meeting.
target: 你们找到议事大楼，走进去一看，村里的长者似乎正在开会。

source: Howdy, neighbors! I'm Scott! My friends and I are from the outside world, but don't worry, we come in peace.
target: 邻居们好啊！我是斯科特！我和朋友们来自外面的世界，不过别担心，我们没有恶意。

source: "What?!" the elders cry. "But how can this be? The Giants killed all the outsiders and destroyed all civilization outside our walls!"
target: 长者们惊呼：“什么？！怎么可能？巨人杀光了外来者，也摧毁了城墙外的一切文明！”

source: Nope. We're living proof that that didn't happen, if you'll pardon the expression.
target: 没有，我们就是活生生的证据。虽然我说这词不太合适。

source: "No, it is true! The Giants are out there! LOOK, HERE THEY COME TO ATTACK US NOW!"
target: “不，是真的！巨人在外面！看，现在就来攻击我们了！”

source: You look over the wall to see a cardboard cutout of a giant, with a pre-recorded roaring sound playing on a loop.
target: 你往墙外一看，是块巨人形状的纸板，旁边循环播放着录好的咆哮声。

source: How stupid do you think we are?
target: 你觉得我们有多蠢?

source: IT'S THE GIANTS! RUN FOR YOUR LIVES!!!
target: 是巨人！快逃命啊！！！

source: NOT now, Scott!
target: 斯科特，别在这时候添乱！

source: "No, the Giants are... they're totally... ugh, fuck it, fine. You caught us, the Giants are all an elaborate lie."
target: “不，巨人是……他们真……唉，去他妈的，行吧，被你们识破了。巨人是个精心编造的谎言。”

source: "You see, decades ago when we were young rascals, we conceived the BEST PRANK we could pull on the entire village:"
target: “几十年前，我们还是年轻混小子时，想到一个能整全村的绝妙恶作剧：”

source: "We made some scary cardboard cutouts and convinced everyone that we were under attack by ravenous Giants!"
target: “做些吓人的纸板，骗大家说，有一群饥肠辘辘的巨人来袭！”

source: "Now we've been perpetuating the prank for decades, forever committed to the bit! For you see, we are... THE PRANK MASTERZ! With a Z!"
target: “这一骗就骗了几十年，始终坚持把戏演到底！因为，我们是……恶作剧大师！带 Z 的！”

source: What? But WE'RE the Prank Masterz with a Z!
target: 什么？可我们才是带 Z 的恶作剧大师！

source: "You are? How did you young outsiders take up the Prank Masterz mantle?"
target: “你们？你们这些外来的年轻人，怎么继承了恶作剧大师的名号？”

source: We made it up because pranks kick ass, duh!
target: 自己起的啊，恶作剧多酷，废话！

source: But now that I think about it, Polly, didn't we get the idea for the name "Prank Masterz" when we found those old papers full of cool prank ideas?
target: 可我想起来了，波莉。咱们不是找到过一些写满酷炫恶作剧点子的旧纸吗？“恶作剧大师”这名字，就是那上面来的吧？

source: Ohhh yeah! I forgot all about that... but I was pretty drunk at the time. And also now.
target: 哦——对！忘得一干二净了……不过当时喝得挺多。现在也是。

source: "You must've found the Prank Masterz Scrollz," say the elders. "We found them too, many years ago. It's the legacy of the Prank Masterz."
target: 长者们说：“你们一定找到了《恶作剧大师卷轴》。很多年前，我们也找到过。那就是恶作剧大师的传承。”

source: Wow. Two generations of Prank Masterz, brought together by total chaotic coincidence...
target: 哇，两代恶作剧大师，就因为一场彻底混乱的巧合，聚在了一起……

source: You know what this means, right? We need to combine the Prank Masterz chapters and brainstorm an even COOLER prank to play on this village!
target: 知道这意味着什么吧？两边的恶作剧大师分会合并，集思广益，想个更酷的恶作剧，整整这村子！

source: You're right! This could be the most important prank we've ever pulled! What should we do?
target: 没错！这可能是咱们这辈子最重要的恶作剧！干什么好？

source: The Giants have been defeated! They've been turned into cardboard BY GOD... who's this bowl of lettuce. Abide by Lettuce God's will or become cardboard!
target: 巨人被打败了！神把他们变成了纸板……神就是这碗生菜。服从生菜神的旨意，否则也变纸板！

source: Tell everyone time has changed forever and it's now one hour ahead for no good reason, and this will keep happening at least twice a year, and we all must get used to it.
target: 告诉大家：时间永远变了，现在毫无缘由地提前一小时；至少每年还得来两回，所有人都必须习惯。

source: Yaasss, fake religion pranks are so funny! Everyone's all, "Nooo, how could you shatter my worldview?!" Such a classic.
target: 好耶，假宗教恶作剧最好笑了！大家就会喊：“不——怎么能打碎我的世界观？！”经典！

source: Here, bros, you can use our lettuce for this prank. You'll put it to much better use than we would have.
target: 兄弟们，用我们的生菜吧。拿来做恶作剧，可比我们原本的用途强多了。

source: HEY! That lettuce was for my salad!
target: 嘿！那生菜是我要拌沙拉的！

source: Shhhh, it's okay, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. You don't need it. -N2 STAMINA is temporary; pranks are forever.
target: 嘘，没事的，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。用不着它。-N2 体力只是暂时的，恶作剧才是永恒。

source: The next morning, the Giants show up again. The villagers are all screaming and fleeing like usual, but then...
target: 第二天早上，巨人又出现了。村民照例尖叫逃窜，然后……

source: FEAR NOT, PUNY MORTALS! LETTUCE GOD IS HERE TO SAVE YOU!
target: 渺小的凡人，无须恐惧！生菜神来救你们了！

source: Oh boy, Lettuce God is here in the leafy flesh! I love and worship you so hard, bro!
target: 哇，生菜神亲自以菜叶之身降临了！兄弟，我太爱你、太崇拜你了！

source: WOOHOO, GO LETTUCE GOD! YOU DA SHIT!
target: 呜呼，生菜神加油！你最牛！

source: "Seriously? This is ridiculous!" the villagers protest. "A talking bowl of lettuce isn't going to save us from these beasts!"
target: 村民抗议：“认真的？太荒谬了！一碗会说话的生菜，怎么救我们对付这些怪兽！”

source: YOU DARE UNDERESTIMATE ME, MORTALS? THEN I WILL PROVE MY POWER BY KICKING THESE GIANTS' ASSES!
target: 凡人，竟敢小看我？我这就揍扁巨人，证明我的力量！

source: Lettuce God proceeds to kick the Giants' asses.
target: 生菜神开始揍巨人。

source: And by that, I mean that the elder Prank Master puppeting Lettuce God throws the lettuce bowl as hard as he can at the Giant's face. The Giant falls flat.
target: 也就是说，操纵生菜神的老恶作剧大师，使尽力气，把生菜碗砸在巨人脸上。巨人直挺挺倒了。

source: "Holy shit," the villagers marvel. "That bowl of lettuce turned the Giant into a cardboard cutout just by touching it!"
target: 村民们惊叹：“卧槽，那碗生菜就碰了一下，巨人就变成纸板了！”

source: YOU'RE WELCOME FOR SAVING YOUR PUNY LIVES! I ASK NOTHING IN RETURN... BESIDES YOUR UNCONDITIONAL WORSHIP FOREVER.
target: 救了你们的小命，不必道谢！我不求任何回报……除了永远无条件崇拜我。

source: "Oh, uh... that's a little sudden. Can we think about it?"
target: “哦，呃……有点突然。能考虑一下吗？”

source: YOU DARE TALK BACK TO LETTUCE GOD?! YOU'VE SEEN MY POWER! BOW TO ME!
target: 竟敢跟生菜神顶嘴？！我的力量，你们见过了！跪下！

source: IF YOU REFUSE, I'LL SUBJECT YOU TO THE SOGGY, DISPOSABLE, ONE-DIMENSIONAL HORROR OF BEING A CARDBOARD CUTOUT!
target: 胆敢拒绝，我就让你们尝尝变成纸板人的恐怖：湿乎乎、用完就扔，而且只有一个维度！

source: Terrified, the villagers fall to their knees and bow. Many of them are sobbing.
target: 村民吓得跪倒，伏地叩拜。很多人都在哭。

source: Meanwhile, you, Polly, and Scott high-five over a prank well pulled. You gain +N2 HYPE!
target: 与此同时，你和波莉、斯科特击掌，庆祝恶作剧成功，获得 +N2 热度！

source: It's settled! You and the elders put your heads together and spend hours planning how to fool the villagers. You pour -N2 MIND into this feat of pranking genius!
target: 就这么定了！你跟长者们凑在一起，花了几个小时谋划怎么骗村民。这场天才恶作剧，耗掉了 -N2 头脑！

source: The next morning, the elders call a town meeting. "Good news, everyone!" they say. "Some outsiders have come to help us fix our problems!"
target: 第二天早上，长者召集全村开会：“各位，好消息！来了些外来者，帮咱们解决问题！”

source: "You mean you've found a brave hero, or perhaps a highly-skilled acrobatic teenage militia, to take care of the Giants?" ask the villagers.
target: 村民问：“是找到勇敢的英雄，或者身手矫健的少年民兵，帮我们对付巨人了吗？”

source: Not even close!
target: 差远了！

source: Hey, boos! I'm Polly, this is Scott, and we're here to solve your pressing issue of not having enough daylight in the day.
target: 嘿，亲爱的各位！我是波莉，这是斯科特。我们来帮大家解决白天日照时间不够的紧迫问题。

source: "But... that was never really an issue."
target: “可……这根本没成过问题。”

source: You say that now, but just wait until you've tried MORE SUNSHINE TIME!
target: 现在这么想，等试过更多的日照时间，你就懂了！

source: Twice a year, on a day the universe will determine at random, everyone will move their clocks either forward or back one hour.
target: 每年两次，宇宙会随机决定一天，大家把钟表拨快或者拨慢一小时。

source: Rumor has it that this will conserve power, or grow your crops better.
target: 据说这样能省电，还能让庄稼长得更好。

source: "Oh... are those rumors true?"
target: “哦……传言是真的吗？”

source: Nope!
target: 假的！

source: But all the other Giant-ravaged secluded villages are doing this, so you should too. You don't wanna look weird.
target: 可其他受巨人摧残的偏僻村子都这么干，你们也该干。不想显得格格不入吧？

source: "Ugh, but it sounds like such a pain..."
target: “唉，听着好麻烦……”

source: "Well too bad!" the elders say. "We're your government and we decided this is happening, so you'd better get used to it."
target: 长者说：“那也没办法！我们是政府，已经决定这么办，你们最好习惯。”

source: GET PRANKED!
target: 上当了吧！

source: Crushed it. You, Polly, Scott, and the elder Prank Masterz high-five and gain +N2 HYPE from your great prank.
target: 完美！你、波莉、斯科特和老恶作剧大师们击掌，庆祝这场绝妙恶作剧，获得 +N2 热度。

source: Look for ore
target: 寻找矿石

source: Time to make some money! You and your friends go into the cave to mine for ore.
target: 赚钱时间到！你和朋友们进洞挖矿。

source: After an hour of walking and mining, you've got a decent pile of precious metals when you hear a voice cry:
target: 又走又挖了一个小时，你们攒起一小堆贵金属。这时，一声吼传来：

source: HEY! YOU DAD-GUM KIDS GIT THE HELL OFF MY ORE!
target: 嘿！你们这些臭小鬼，给我滚，离我的矿石远点！

source: Go on, git! I been hoardin' this ore for fifty years, and you ain't gettin' NONE of it!
target: 快滚！这些矿石我囤了五十年，一块都别想拿走！

source: Why have you been hoarding ore in a cave for fifty years? Are you selling it?
target: 为什么在洞里囤五十年矿石？拿去卖吗？

source: NO! I don't want money, I want ORE! You can't put a price on my precious ores; each one's perfect, priceless, and unique!
target: 不！我不要钱，我要矿！宝贝矿石怎么能用钱衡量？每块都完美、无价、独一无二！

source: Just look at my sittin' ore! I can spend hours crouchin' uncomfortably on it. Ain't she a beaut?
target: 看看这块，我坐的矿石！不太舒服地一蹲，就是好几个钟头。漂亮吧？

source: This one's my shittin' ore! Yeah, I shit on it. If y'all need to go, I have a guest shittin' ore cleaned up for ya.
target: 这块是我拉屎的矿石！对，就在上面拉。你们要方便，也有块擦干净的待客拉屎矿石。

source: And THIS tall drink of water is Orephelia, my ore-wife. No relation to the wife I abandoned to become an ore-hermit.
target: 这位高挑美人，是我的矿石老婆，矿菲莉娅。跟我为了当矿石隐士而抛弃的那个老婆，毫无关系。

source: Dang, bro, it sounds like you've got life all figured out. I'm jealous!
target: 哇，兄弟，你真是把人生都活明白了。羡慕！

source: Is there anything we can trade you for one of your best ores? Pretty please?
target: 我们拿什么，能跟你换块最好的矿石？求求你啦？

source: Hmm... what's yer offer?
target: 嗯……拿什么换？

source: Well, what do you want?
target: 那你想要什么？

source: Hell if I know. Y'all got any suggestions? I've been in this cave so long that I ain't got any frame of reference for what an ore's worth.
target: 我哪儿知道。你们说呢？洞里待太久，都不知道矿石该值多少了，连个参照都没有。

source: Oh, cool, then he'll be super easy to scam! You offer to trade the weird ore collector...
target: 哦，那岂不是特别好骗！你提议拿这个跟怪矿石收藏家交换……

source: Long, expositive stories about your lives. You'd be giving him the next best thing to ore: lore.
target: 讲讲你们漫长又详尽的身世故事。给他仅次于“矿石”的好东西：“故事”。

source: Therapy.
target: 心理咨询。

source: Okay, let's see, what's a juicy lore fact about fan-favorite Polly Geist...
target: 好，想想看，人气角色波莉·鬼斯特，有什么劲爆的背景故事……

source: Ooh, here's one: even though I've got a reputation for being happy-go-lucky, there are still a few things that really stress me out.
target: 哦，有了！虽然大家都觉得我没心没肺，可还是有几件事，真能让我压力山大。

source: Like children. They're annoying, demanding, and you can't give them alcohol! How am I supposed to relate to that?!
target: 比如小孩。烦人，要求又多，还不能给他们酒喝！那我怎么跟他们处啊？！

source: Also driving. I HATE driving. It took a long time for me to even be cool with being IN a car again, but driving one... that's still too much for me.
target: 还有开车。我讨厌开车。花了好久，我才敢重新坐进车里，可要自己开……还是受不了。

source: I guess it's my turn. A lore fact about me is that I like sports!
target: 该我了吧。我的背景故事是：我喜欢运动！

source: That's great, bud, but a lore fact is supposed to be something not a lot of people know about you.
target: 很好，伙计，可背景故事得是没几个人知道的事。

source: It is? Dang. If I'd known there was gonna be a Scott pop quiz today, I would've studied more!
target: 是吗？哎，早知道今天要考斯科特突击测验，我就多复习了！

source: Umm... oh, I know! A lore fact about me is I have trouble remembering the order of the days of the week.
target: 嗯……哦，有了！我的背景故事是，我总记不住一周七天的顺序。

source: I know when Monday night football is, but I always confuse Tuesday and Thoosday. And where does Earth Day fit in...?
target: 周一晚上的橄榄球赛，我知道是什么时候，可总搞混星期二和星期嘟。还有地球日，该排在哪儿啊……？

source: What about you, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? Tell us a lore about you!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你呢？讲讲你的背景故事！

source: If she insists! You launch into your favorite two-hour tale of your secret hobbies and passions that were foundational to your character development.
target: 既然她坚持，你就讲起最爱的那段两小时长篇：那些奠定你性格发展的秘密爱好与热情。

source: Ugh, now I know why "lore" rhymes with "bore." That story put me to sleep.
target: 唉，怪不得“讲故事”和“无聊死”押韵。你那故事听得我都睡着了。

source: Your story wasn't THAT boring, was it? ...Apparently it was, because you lost -N2 HYPE.
target: 你的故事没那么无聊吧？……显然有，因为你失去了 -N2 热度。

source: At least it satisfied the ore collector; any story you told was bound to be more interesting than his conversations with Orephelia. You make +N2 MONEY from the ore he gifts you.
target: 至少矿石收藏家听得很满意。随便什么故事，都比他跟矿菲莉娅聊天有意思。他送你矿石，让你赚了 +N2 金钱。

source: Therapy? I dunno... don't you need a license to do therapy on someone?
target: 心理咨询？不太确定……给人做咨询，不得有执照吗？

source: Yeah, good point. Maybe we could just listen to this guy for a while, offering him a sympathetic ear and a shoulder to cry on.
target: 对，有道理。那就听他讲一会儿吧，体谅体谅，借个肩膀给他哭。

source: Hmmm... can I still take notes on a clipboard?
target: 嗯……我还能拿写字板做笔记吗？

source: Sure.
target: 当然可以。

source: Cool, it's a deal! Tell us all your problems, ore collector!
target: 好，就这么办！矿石收藏家，说说你所有的烦恼吧！

source: My problems? What problems could I have when I'm surrounded by beautiful ore?
target: 烦恼？身边全是漂亮矿石，我能有什么烦恼？

source: There's the lack of food in here, no exposure to sunlight, not seeing another soul for fifty years...
target: 比如没吃的，晒不到太阳，五十年没见过一个人……

source: Nope, I don't give a fuck about none o' that. But I guess there is ONE thing that bothers me...
target: 不，那些我他妈都不在乎。不过倒真有一件事挺烦……

source: Sometimes I have nightmares that I accidentally swapped my kissin' ore with my sittin' ore. What if I've been kissin' my sittin' ore all this time?! THAT AIN'T WHAT IT'S FOR!
target: 我有时做噩梦，梦见不小心把亲嘴用的矿石和坐的矿石搞反了。万一我一直在亲坐的矿石呢？！那又不是这么用的！

source: Okay, crazy theory, but I'm sensing that your ore-obsession is a little unhealthy.
target: 好，有个大胆猜想：我感觉，你这矿石痴迷症不太健康。

source: At least, that's what I wrote on my clipboard, right under this tic-tac-toe game I'm playing with myself.
target: 至少写字板上，我是这么记的。就在我自己跟自己下的井字棋底下。

source: Hm... maybe you're right. Sometimes Orephelia says I'm 'overly possessive.' Maybe that's why I care so much about my ore?
target: 嗯……也许你说得对。矿菲莉娅有时候也说，我“占有欲太强”。所以才这么在乎矿石？

source: Now that I think about it, I spend more time worryin' about losin' my ore than actually enjoyin' it! Oh, no, what do I do?!
target: 想想也是，光顾着担心失去矿石，真正享受它们的时间反倒少！哦，不，怎么办？！

source: You could give us one of your ores. Sever those attachment issues or whatever!
target: 送我们一块呗。切断那种依恋啊，还是什么的！

source: Okay, if you think it'll help... here's Orewin, my youngest ore-son. Take good care of him, will ya?
target: 好吧，你觉得有用的话……这是矿尔文，我最小的矿石儿子。好好照顾他，行吗？

source: You will not! You later sell the ore for +N2 MONEY. It's almost enough to pay for the ACTUAL therapy you need after that convo took -N2 MIND out of you.
target: 你才不会！后来，你把矿石卖了，赚到 +N2 金钱。这段谈话耗掉 -N2 头脑，害你真得去做心理咨询，卖矿的钱差不多刚够付费。

source: Go spelunking
target: 洞穴探险

source: Woohoo, time to explore a dark cave with your best friends! What could be better?
target: 呜呼，和最好的朋友探索黑漆漆的洞穴！还有比这更棒的吗？

source: So we're just visiting a random cave? Why? You guys know we don't have to stop at EVERYTHING we see on the road, right?
target: 所以就随便挑个洞进去逛？为什么？也不是路上看见什么，都非得停下来吧？

source: Cheer up, Polly. Exploring a cave will be fun! It'll be full of new smells and tight spaces to get stuck in!
target: 开心点，波莉！探洞多好玩，有没闻过的味道，还有窄窄的地方能把人卡住！

source: You meet a strange old man at the cave's entrance. "Beware venturing too deep into the cave," he says hoarsely, "if you value your lives!"
target: 洞口有个古怪老人，哑着嗓子说：“珍惜小命的话，当心，别往洞穴太深的地方去！”

source: Ooh, this just got interesting! What's in the cave? Curses? Serial killers? Cursed serial killers?!
target: 哦，这下有意思了！里面有什么？诅咒？连环杀手？被诅咒的连环杀手？！

source: "No," says the old man. "It's just a really deep cave, and you kids clearly don't have enough provisions or hiking gear for this. Always spelunk responsibly!"
target: 老人说：“没有，就是个很深的洞。你们的补给和徒步装备，明显不够。探洞也得负责任！”

source: So all that awaits us in there is a lot of walking? Pass.
target: 所以，里面等着咱们的，只有走一大堆路？不去。

source: Since you're here, old man, do you know a good place to get a drink after we ditch this boring cave?
target: 老头，既然在这儿，那你知道放弃这个无聊洞穴以后，去哪儿喝一杯比较好吗？

source: We can't ditch the cave yet! Don't you wanna explore it and see where it leads? It's such a cool mystery!
target: 还不能放弃！你不想探索一下，看它通到哪儿吗？多酷的谜团啊！

source: How is that a mystery? It's a cave. It'll just lead to another exit. Or a dead end, maybe.
target: 有什么谜？不就是个洞。要么通另一个出口，要么就是死路。

source: You know where it probably WON'T lead? A bar, which is all I care about finding right now.
target: 知道它多半不会通哪儿吗？酒吧。而我现在只想找酒吧。

source: You said "probably." That means there's still a chance of finding a bar in the cave, and that's a chance we should take!
target: 你说的是“多半”，那就还是有机会在洞里找到酒吧，值得试试！

source: It's like Coach always says...
target: 就像教练常说的……

source: Remember, kids: every three-pointer not taken is another night you spend crying into a bowl of cereal wondering where it all went wrong!
target: 孩子们，记住：每一个没投出去的三分球，都让你多一个夜晚，对着麦片碗哭，想自己到底错在哪儿！

source: Coach said that? Is he... okay?
target: 教练说的？他……没事吧？

source: Who cares? We can worry about Coach after we've explored this cave!
target: 管他呢？等探完洞，再操心教练吧！

source: Fine, I'll do it. Just tell me how long this'll take so I can plan my boredom accordingly.
target: 行，去就去。告诉我得花多久，我好安排该无聊多久。

source: Do the sensible thing: just explore until you lose phone signal. You can risk your life, but you can't risk your access to funny memes!
target: 理智一点：走到手机没信号就回头。命可以冒险，搞笑梗图可不能断！

source: Keep walking until Polly admits this was a fun idea.
target: 一直走，走到波莉承认这是个好玩的主意。

source: Start walking and REFUSE to stop until someone serves you drinks in this fuckin' cave. You aren't leaving without a proper drink.
target: 开始走，谁也别想叫你停，直到有人在这破洞里给你端酒来。不正经喝一杯，绝不出去。

source: You begin walking through the cave. Polly quickly gets bored and starts watching videos on TokTok.
target: 你们进洞开走。波莉很快无聊了，开始刷 TokTok 视频。

source: Aww, look at this canary dancing to house music! Throw it back, you funky little dinosaur!
target: 哇，看这只跟着浩室舞曲跳舞的金丝雀！扭起来，小恐龙，你可真带劲！

source: Dammit, the video's buffering. How dare my internet crap out during such a crucial viewing!
target: 妈的，缓冲了。这么关键的视频，网络也敢给我掉链子！

source: Maybe that canary video is trying to tell us something. If we go too far in this cave, we might...
target: 也许金丝雀的视频，是想提醒咱们什么。再往洞里走，可能就会……

source: LOSE ACCESS TO THE INTERNET ENTIRELY!
target: 彻底断网！

source: NO! My need for memes and instant gratification can't take that! We gotta run for it!
target: 不！梗图和即时满足，少哪个我都受不了！快跑！

source: You sprint back to the cave entrance, losing -N2 STAMINA.
target: 你们狂奔回洞口，失去了 -N2 体力。

source: Hooray, my signal is back! That was a close one, bros.
target: 万岁，信号回来了！兄弟们，差点就完了。

source: We almost didn't make it out in time to retweet this new cat meme before people got sick of it and called it cringe! We're lucky to still be relevant...
target: 差一点，新的猫咪梗图还没来得及转发，就过气，被人嫌尬了！幸好咱们还没落伍……

source: Cheer up, bro, we made it! Wanna rewatch that dancing canary video to celebrate?
target: 开心点，兄弟，咱们赶上了！再看一遍金丝雀跳舞，庆祝一下？

source: I ALWAYS wanna watch a dancing canary video.
target: 金丝雀跳舞的视频，我随时都想看。

source: You all watch the groovin' birb and become filled with the +N2 HYPE of being terminally online.
target: 你们看着那只扭来扭去的小鸟，沉迷网络的快乐带来 +N2 热度。

source: You begin your long walk. Polly's stubbornly refusing to enjoy herself, but you're sure she'll eventually CAVE IN!
target: 你们开始长途跋涉。波莉死活不肯承认好玩，可你相信，进了洞，她早晚会“洞”摇！

source: Wow, bros, this cave is amazing! Check out that rock that looks like a butt!
target: 哇，兄弟们，这洞真棒！看那块石头，像个屁股！

source: Eh, I've seen thiccer butt-shaped rocks in my day.
target: 嘁，更丰满的屁股石，我都见过。

source: And look, there's a funny rat! It's doing a little twitchy dance, and it's got some cute foam coming out of its little mouth!
target: 还有只好玩的老鼠！在跳抖来抖去的舞，小嘴还冒着可爱的泡泡！

source: Oh, perfect. Hey, Rabid Rat, you know a good place to get a drink in this dumb cave? No? Yeah, I figured not.
target: 哦，太好了。嘿，狂犬病老鼠，知道这破洞里哪儿能喝一杯吗？不知道？嗯，就知道。

source: The rat stares at you, quietly. Then it runs away.
target: 老鼠默默看了你们一眼，然后跑了。

source: Polly, did you see that? The rat is clearly taking us to the fun part of the cave! Let's follow it!
target: 波莉，看见没？它肯定要带咱们去洞里好玩的地方！跟上！

source: (Fuck my life.)
target: （我命真苦。）

source: You follow the rabid rat through the dark, damp caverns for about half an hour.
target: 你们跟着狂犬病老鼠，在黑暗潮湿的洞里走了半个小时。

source: It's still not fun, but all this walking is enough cardio to lose -N2 STAMINA. Hooray?
target: 还是不好玩，可走这么久，也算有氧运动，耗掉 -N2 体力。万岁？

source: Can we go back now?
target: 现在能回去了吧？

source: No, Polly, look!
target: 等等，波莉，看！

source: ...What the fu...?
The rat has brought you to a part of the cave where... a stand-up act is taking place?
target: 老鼠带你们来到洞穴的一处地方，那里……正在演脱口秀？

source: Since you've walked so much to get here, you all decide to give it a try and stay.
target: 既然走了这么远才到，你们决定留下，试着看看。

source: A couple hours later you're back at the car.
target: 几小时后，你们回到车旁。

source: Well, it wasn't knee-slapping belly laugh comedy, but I must admit that was a solid +N2 HYPE stand up routine.
target: 虽说没笑到拍大腿、肚子疼，可不得不承认，那场单口喜剧真不赖，值 +N2 热度。

source: Fuck it. Visiting this cave was your idea, and finding a drink inside it will be your pilgrimage.
target: 去他妈的。既然探洞是你提的，那在洞里找到酒喝，就是你的朝圣之旅。

source: You walk through the cave. Minutes turn to hours. You lose -N3 HYPE in the boredom, lose track of your steps, lose track of time...
target: 你们在洞里走着，几分钟变成几小时。无聊让你失去了 -N3 热度；渐渐的，你忘了走过多少步，也忘了时间……

source: The sun, the Earth, your happiness -- they've all become distant memories. Is this dark, endless cave just a prison of your own mind?
target: 太阳、地球、快乐，都成了遥远的记忆。这片无尽的黑暗洞穴，难道只是你内心的牢笼？

source: Is the drink you're looking for just your subconscious metaphor for the intangible happiness you chase but never find??
target: 你苦苦追寻却永远得不到的无形幸福，难道在潜意识里，被隐喻成了这杯酒？？

source: IS THAT MYSTERIOUS DOOR IN THE CAVE WALL JUST A HALLUCINATION REPRESENTING YOUR DESPERATION TO ESCAPE YOURSELF?!
target: 洞壁上那扇神秘的门，难道只是幻觉，象征着你迫切想逃离自我的绝望？！

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, I know you're losing your -N3 MIND in here, but you really don't have to narrate your spiral into madness aloud.
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，知道你在这儿快疯了，掉了 -N3 头脑，可也不用把自己怎么一步步发疯的过程，都大声旁白出来吧。

source: Was I? Whoops!
target: 我说出来了？哎呀！

source: That door is real, though! Are there normally cozy cottage doors in cave walls?
target: 不过门是真的！洞壁上一般会有这种温馨小屋的门吗？

source: Uhh... not as far as I know.
target: 呃……据我所知，不会。

source: Now you're curious, so you open the door to find... a perfectly normal kitchen!
target: 这下好奇了。你打开门，发现……一间再正常不过的厨房！

source: A perfectly normal man enters the kitchen. "Oh, hello strangers!" he says. "Did you enter through the mysterious door?"
target: 一个再正常不过的男人走进厨房。“哦，陌生人，你们好！”他说，“从那扇神秘的门进来的？”

source: I guess we did. Are we still in the cave?
target: 应该是吧。咱们还在洞里吗？

source: "Cave? No, you're in my house, on 336 Tulip Lane."
target: “洞？没有，这是我家，郁金香巷三百三十六号。”

source: That is WILD. Why does your house have a door that leads into a random cave?
target: 也太离谱了。你家怎么有扇门，通到随便哪个山洞里？

source: "No idea. My wife and I never knew there was a cave back there. We just knew the door led to a dark, creepy corridor."
target: “不知道。我们夫妻俩从不知道后面有洞，只知道那扇门通向一条阴暗吓人的走廊。”

source: "We never explored the corridor, because that seemed like something the first dumbass to die in a horror movie would do."
target: “没探过，毕竟那种事，像是恐怖片里第一个死的傻子才会干的。”

source: Yeah, fair enough.
target: 嗯，也是。

source: "Honey, I'm home from work!" a woman says as she walks into the kitchen. "Oh, who are these people?"
target: 一个女人走进厨房，说：“亲爱的，我下班了！哦，这几位是谁？”

source: "They came from the dark corridor behind the mysterious door," the man explains cheerfully.
target: 男人开心地解释：“他们从神秘门后面那条黑走廊来的。”

source: "Oh, how nice! Did it lead to Hell?"
target: “哦，真好！那边通地狱吗？”

source: Nope, it's just a cave back there.
target: 不，就一个山洞。

source: "Good to know! Well, do you cave strangers want to join my husband and I for dinner? He's making baked ziti!"
target: “知道啦！那么，山洞来的客人，要跟我们夫妻一起吃晚饭吗？他在做焗通心粉！”

source: Hmm... will there be drinks?
target: 嗯……有酒吗？

source: "Sure! Honey, uncork us a bottle of wine!"
target: “当然！亲爱的，开瓶葡萄酒！”

source: HELL YEAH!
target: 他妈的好耶！

source: You can't believe that worked. But it did, and you gain +N6 STAMINA from your delicious meal on 336 Tulip Lane!
target: 你都不敢相信这居然行得通。可它就是成了！郁金香巷三百三十六号的美味晚餐，让你获得 +N6 体力！

source: Rescue trapped people
target: 救出被困人员

source: You, Polly, and Scott are hiking around the cave, looking at cool stalagmites and bats, when you hear voices coming from a far-off chamber.
target: 你和波莉、斯科特在洞里徒步，欣赏酷炫的石笋和蝙蝠。这时，远处一个洞室传来人声。

source: Whoa, bros, there are people in here... and they're chained to that wall!
target: 哇，兄弟们，这儿有人……还被锁在墙上！

source: Kinky.
target: 玩得挺花。

source: Don't worry, everyone. We're gonna save you and bring you back to the outside world!
target: 各位别怕，我们来救你们，带你们回到外面的世界！

source: "What are you talking about?" the prisoners ask. "We don't need saving. We like it here. This place has everything we need."
target: 被锁的人问：“说什么呢？我们不用救。这里挺好，该有的都有。”

source: The cave people nod at the wall opposite them. You look and see that there's shadow puppets being projected on it.
target: 洞里的人朝对面的墙努努嘴。你一看，上面正投着手影。

source: "Look! The Shadow Doggie is back, and he's playing with the Shadow Bunny and the Amorphous Shadow-Blob! Best day ever!"
target: “看！影子狗狗回来了，还跟影子兔兔和没形状的影子团一起玩！今天太棒了！”

source: But those shadows aren't real. Let us unchain you, and we'll show you that the outside world is more than shadow puppets.
target: 可影子又不是真的。解开锁链，带你们出去看看，外面可不只有手影。

source: "NO!" the prisoners yell. "How dare you try to force us to expand our narrow worldviews!"
target: 他们大喊：“不！竟敢强迫我们拓宽自己狭隘的世界观！”

source: "The shadows are all we've ever known. Why would we abandon them when we're already happy and complacent here?"
target: “我们一直只知道影子。在这里已经过得开心又满足，干吗抛下它们？”

source: Because learning the truth is worth overcoming your fear of the unknown, dammit!
target: 因为，为了真相，克服对未知的恐惧很值得，真是的！

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, how do we talk these people into leaving?
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，怎么说服他们出去？

source: Build a bulletproof, irrefutable case to convince them that the outside world is full of much cooler shadows.
target: 拿出无懈可击、无法反驳的论证，让他们相信外面的影子酷多了。

source: It's time to incur some good ol' student debt to get a PhD in philosophy.
target: 该背点学贷，读个哲学博士了。

source: Great idea! Time for a PLANNING MONTAGE!
target: 好主意！来段准备工作的蒙太奇！

source: A montage passes of you guys reading books about shadows, writing on a chalkboard, practicing your shadow puppets, and doing chemistry for some reason.
target: 一段蒙太奇：你们读影子相关书籍，在黑板上写写画画，练手影，还不知为何做起化学实验。

source: You lose -N2 MIND in the exhaustive research and planning, but finally, you have your irrefutable case on why the prisoners should leave:
target: 详尽的研究和计划耗掉 -N2 头脑。不过终于，你们拿出了不容反驳的论证，解释为什么这些人应该离开：

source: Listen up, bros! We know you think shadows are cool. But the shadows outside this cave are EVEN COOLER! So come with us!
target: 听着，兄弟们！知道你们觉得影子酷，可洞外的影子更酷！跟我们走吧！

source: ...That's it? That's your whole argument? What about the montage? What about the chemistry bit?!
target: ……就这？全部论证？那蒙太奇算什么？化学实验又干吗呢？！

source: "We're not convinced," the prisoners say. "The shadows in here are already pretty great."
target: 他们说：“没说服力。这里的影子已经很好了。”

source: True, but get this: in the outside world, shadows are so cool and interesting, they even have their own mascot.
target: 对，可你们想啊：外面的影子酷得很、有意思得很，甚至还有吉祥物。

source: His name is Shadow the Hedgehog. He's so popular, he has his own video game, and lots of lewd fetish art!
target: 他叫刺猬夏特，英文名 Shadow，就是“影子”。他可火了，有自己的电子游戏，还有一大堆色情性癖同人图！

source: "Oh!" the prisoners say. "Well, we do love lewd fetish stuff. Our second-favorite thing to shadows is being chained to a wall, after all."
target: 他们说：“哦！那种色情性癖的东西，我们确实爱看。毕竟除了影子，我们最爱的就是被锁在墙上。”

source: I knew it! I KNEW this was kinky!
target: 就知道！我就知道你们在玩这个！

source: You successfully free the prisoners, and they go to the outside world to meet Shadow the Hedgehog.
target: 你成功解救了他们。他们走向外面的世界，去见刺猬夏特。

source: Unfortunately, they're completely blinded by Shadow's coolness, but all that matters to you is gaining +N2 SOUL for the rescue!
target: 可惜，他们彻底被夏特的酷炫闪瞎了眼。不过你只在乎救人带来的 +N2 灵魂！

source: But aren't PhDs super expensive? Who would loan us that kind of money?
target: 可博士不是很贵吗？谁会借给我们那么多钱？

source: Any financial institution ready to profit from abusive interest rates and the cultural belief that a higher education is worth going into crippling debt.
target: 那些指望靠高利率，再靠“高等教育值得背一辈子巨债”的社会观念赚钱的金融机构呗。

source: Oh, really? Lucky us!
target: 哦，真的？真幸运！

source: You quickly apply for and receive some fat student loans and enroll in a philosophy course.
target: 你们飞快申请、拿到一大笔学贷，报上哲学课程。

source: "Welcome to the PhD philosophy program!" your professor says. "It's a pleasure to meet you fine young minds."
target: 教授说：“欢迎攻读哲学博士！很高兴见到各位才华横溢的年轻人。”

source: "Are you here because you have an unquenchable thirst for knowledge? Because you yearn to understand your place in the universe?"
target: “各位是因为对知识的渴求无穷无尽而来？还是渴望理解自己在宇宙中的位置？”

source: We're here to rescue some bros from a cave!
target: 我们来是为了救几个困在洞里的兄弟！

source: "Ah, yes, from the cave of their own ignorance. I see we have a poet in the class."
target: “哦，对，从自身无知的洞穴里解救出来。我看班上来了位诗人。”

source: "You need to know that, at its core, philosophy is about asking questions. But it's not really about ANSWERING those questions; just thinking about them really hard."
target: “要知道，哲学的核心是提问，却不是要回答问题，只需要非常努力地思考。”

source: Can I have one too?

source: "Another great question! Here, take one."
target: “又一个好问题！来，拿去。”

source: Thanks!
target: 谢谢!

target: 可刚学到，哲学重在提问，而非回答。所以我问你们：为什么不出洞？

target: 他们说：“嗯……也是，确实没法反驳。跟你们走吧。”

target: 漂亮，把他们难住了！可也把自己难住了，害你失去了 -N2 头脑。至少团长付了 +N2 金钱的演出费！

source: Magicians
target: 魔术师

target: 该掸掸高礼帽上的灰，把在行李里乱跑的讨厌兔子找回来了，因为你要当魔术师！

source: The ringmaster explains that doing magic is a passion, and therefore to honor that, they tell you that you won't get paid.
target: 团长说，魔术是一份热爱，为了尊重这份热爱，他们决定不给你工钱。

target: 等等，什么？胡说八道。魔术师也是文娱工作者，当然应该拿合理报酬。

target: 她说得对！可今天显然没这待遇。来变几个魔术，尽量从这段经历里捞点收获吧！

source: Hey, circus fans! I'm Polly the Phantasmal! Watch me make all the whiskey in this flask DISAPPEAR!
target: 嘿，马戏迷们！我是幽幻波莉，Polly the Phantasmal！看我把酒壶里的威士忌，全都变没！

target: 嘘——！魔术师名号烂透了，连开头字母都不一样！

target: 我是神奇斯科特！用魔法把自己变成……一只超级乖狗狗！

target: 观众很挑剔，不过你知道一个魔术，连狼队都会惊叹……

source: MAKE ALL FANFICS CANON!
target: 让所有同人文变成正史！

source: You take out a knife and cut a slice of cake. Then you take out another knife and cut into your original knife, revealing that it was also cake!
target: 你拿刀切下一块蛋糕，再拿另一把刀切开前一把刀，原来那把刀也是蛋糕！

source: Whoa, cool!
target: 哇，酷！

source: You slice your magician's hat to reveal it was cake. Then you take off your shoes and slice them -- also cake!
target: 你切开魔术礼帽，原来是蛋糕。再脱鞋切开，也是蛋糕！

source: Okay, this is getting a little old...

source: Too bad, 'cause it keeps going! See this priceless family heirloom my grandfather gave me on his deathbed?
target: 那也没办法，因为还没完呢！看到这件无价传家宝了吗？我爷爷临终前给我的。

source: BRO, DON'T DO IT!

source: TOO LATE. IT'S CAKE. EVERYTHING IS CAKE AND NOBODY CAN STOP ME.
target: 晚了。是蛋糕。一切都是蛋糕，谁也别想阻止我。

source: Where'd the knife go?!
target: 刀呢？！

target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%……？

source: HOLY SHIT!
target: 卧槽！

source: WHOA!
target: 哇！

source: What the fuck? Is Scott... made of cake?!
target: 什么鬼？斯科特……是蛋糕做的？！

source: I ALWAYS KNEW IT!

source: You can't leave Scott to this frosting-covered fate! You spend -N2 MAGIC restoring him to his former self.
target: 不能让斯科特就这么困在糖霜命运里！你花掉 -N2 魔力，把他恢复原样。

source: TADA! Don't worry, everybody, I'm okay! Turns out I taste pretty good!
target: 当当！别怕，各位，我没事！原来我还挺好吃！

target: 呼！这下有魔法为证，斯科特确实可口。吃光你变出的蛋糕，还能获得 +N2 体力！

target: 你邀请观众拿同人文上台，用魔法把它们变成正史。

target: 一个少女说：“下个我！同一只臭脾气猫，我写的同人里，它其实是只邪神怪物，正慢慢吞噬主人的心智！”

target: 哦，吓人。算正史了！

target: 一个老人问：“我的呢？我有个网络连载，把那只臭脾气猫的漫画，改成了完全没有猫的版本。”

target: 别怕，故事出了矛盾，记住这条铁律就行：
