source: Am I supposed to give a damn?! I gotta follow that cab RIGHT! FUCKING! NOW!
target: 关我屁事？！我得追那车！现在！立刻！马上！

source: You're not an Oober, but now you NEED to see how this ends. You decide to pick up...
target: 虽然你们不跑欧伯，可现在非得知道下文了。你决定载上……

source: The pregnant lady. She needs your help... even if it means never knowing why the mysterious man was so fixated on following that taxi.
target: 孕妇。她需要帮忙……即使这意味着永远也弄不清，那个神秘男人为什么非要追出租车。

source: The mysterious man. You're REALLY intrigued. And the pregnant lady... well, you know what they say: curiosity killed the cat (but not the newborn, so she'll be fine).
target: 神秘男人。实在太好奇了。至于孕妇……俗话说，好奇害死猫，又没说害死新生儿，她应该没事。

source: But we aren't gonna find out what was so special about that taxi! Can we... I don't know... follow the taxi on the way to the hospital?
target: 可那辆出租车到底怎么回事，就不知道了！要不……我也不知道……去医院的路上，顺便追追？

source: NO, YOU CAN'T! THIS IS KIND OF AN EMERGENCY SITUATION!
target: 不行！这算紧急情况，懂吗？！

source: Bummer. You lose -N2 MIND for never solving that mystery. Scott starts driving to the hospital.
target: 遗憾。谜团再也解不开，你失去了 -N2 头脑。斯科特开车前往医院。

source: Don't worry, miss, we'll get you through this! PUSH!
target: 小姐别怕，我们会帮你撑过去！用力！

source: Push what?
target: 用力干什么？

source: I dunno, I've just heard people say that to pregnant women in movies. Maybe you should do push-ups?
target: 不知道，电影里都这么对孕妇喊。要不做几个俯卧撑？

source: Huh? You know I'm not in labor right now, don't you? I'm only seven months along.
target: 啊？我现在又没要生，知道吗？才七个月。

source: Oh, sorry... that's awkward. I just figured, since you were going to the hospital...
target: 哦，抱歉……尴尬了。就是想着，既然去医院……

source: Well, honestly, I'm not actually going to the hospital. I'm going to the hot dog truck parked outside of it.
target: 说真的，其实不是去医院。我要去停在医院外面的热狗餐车。

source: It's just that Oober drivers tend to actually step on it if I tell them I'm going to the hospital.
target: 只是跟欧伯司机说去医院，他们一般才肯踩油门。

source: WE'RE GETTING HOT DOGS?! BEST HOSPITAL VISIT EVER!
target: 要吃热狗？！这趟医院之行，史上最棒！

source: But if all you wanted was a hot dog, why were you so breathless and desperate when we picked you up?
target: 可要只是吃热狗，上车时怎么喘成那样，还急得要死？

source: Because I'm really fucking craving this hot dog, okay?! Don't judge me! YOU should try being pregnant!
target: 因为我他妈特别想吃那家热狗，行吗？！别评判我！你自己怀个孕试试！

source: Ew. Pass.
target: 呕，算了。

source: You drive her to the hot dog truck, then return the car to the dealership. I guess getting a pregnant lady food is still a pretty good deed, so here, take +N2 SOUL.
target: 你们送她到热狗餐车，再把车还给车行。帮孕妇弄到吃的，也算好事吧。来，给你 +N2 灵魂。

source: Helping the pregnant woman might be the right thing to do... but you REALLY want to know what's so special about that cab.
target: 帮孕妇可能才是对的……可那辆出租车有什么特别，你真的很想知道。

source: Besides, she can always watch a YooToob tutorial on how to have an at-home birth. She'll probably be fine!
target: 再说，她总能去 YooToob 看个在家分娩的教程。应该没事！

source: You all speed off with the taxi-chaser!
target: 你们载着追出租车的男人，疾驰而去！

source: HANG A FAST RIGHT! STEP ON IT! DON'T LOSE SIGHT OF THAT CAB!
target: 快右转！踩油门！别跟丢那辆出租车！

source: Stepping on it, bro!
target: 踩着呢，兄弟！

source: HOLD IT! I need you to follow THAT cab now!
target: 等等！现在改追那辆出租车！

source: Why are you changing who you're following?
target: 怎么突然换跟踪对象了？

source: WE DON'T HAVE TIME FOR QUESTIONS! THE CAB'S ALREADY MOVING -- GO, GO, GO!
target: 没空问！车已经开走了，快快快！

source: Polly, I'm confused...
target: 波莉，我搞不懂了……

source: Same, but I guess we just gotta trust the process. Follow the taxi!
target: 我也不懂，不过先照着干吧。追那车！

source: Okay, stepping on it again!
target: 好，再踩油门！

source: STOP! Follow that cab now -- wait, no, never mind, follow THAT one!
target: 停！现在追那辆——等等，不对，算了，追那辆！

source: Okay, I can't take it anymore: why do you keep wanting to tail different cabs? Why are we following them at all?
target: 好，受不了了。怎么老换着追不同出租车？咱们到底为什么追车？

source: Ugh, we're obviously following them because I love looking at taxis!
target: 唉，当然是因为我爱看出租车啊！

source: What? That's stupid. Why can't you just look at them from the sidewalk?
target: 什么？有病吧。在人行道上看不行吗？

source: BECAUSE THEY MOVE TOO FUCKING FAST FOR ME TO PROPERLY APPRECIATE THEM!
target: 因为它们他妈开太快，我都来不及好好欣赏！

source: I mean, he's not wrong, Polly. When you think about it, this might be a good way of looking at cabs for a long period of time.
target: 波莉，他倒也没错。想想看，这还真是能盯着出租车看很久的好办法。

source: Today we might've lost -N2 SOUL for ignoring a pregnant woman in need, but we gained +N2 MIND from learning why this man wanted us to chase the cab. And at the end of the day...
target: 今天没帮那个需要帮忙的孕妇，可能掉了 -N2 灵魂；可弄清楚他为什么要追车，也赚了 +N2 头脑。说到底……

source: FOLLOW THAT OTHER CAB!
target: 追那边那辆出租车！

source: Sell some cars
target: 卖出一些车

source: As you and your friends are browsing the assorted cars, a nervous-looking gentleman approaches you and says, "Excuse me, do you work here?"
target: 你和朋友们看着各式各样的车。一个神情紧张的男人走来：“打扰，你们在这儿上班吗？”

source: As far as you know, yes!
target: 就当我们是吧！

source: Great! Can you help me choose a car to buy? There are so many options, I just can't make up my mind!
target: 太好了！帮我选辆车吧？选择太多，实在拿不定主意！

source: Absolutely! Why not buy this gently-used sports car? It's got stick shift, which I heard is on its way back.
target: 当然！这辆没怎么开过的跑车怎么样？手动挡，听说又要流行起来了。

source: Hmmm, I'm not sure about the color...
target: 嗯……颜色不太确定……

source: What's not to like about red? It's the color of wine, except when it's not.
target: 红色哪儿不好？葡萄酒就是红的，除了不是红的那些。

source: Yeah, but is it a TRUE red? It looks like more of a cinnamon. Or maybe it's closer to a blood orange...
target: 可这是正红吗？看着更像肉桂色，或者接近血橙色……

source: (Oh, God.)
target: （哦，天啊。）

source: How much storage space does this car have?
target: 这车的储物空间多大？

source: Hmmm, the only measurement I know is "Scotts." Wanna see how many times I can fit in the trunk?
target: 嗯，我只认识一种计量单位：“斯科特”。要不要试试后备箱能装几个我？

source: No, thank you. I'm realizing storage space and color aren't so important; what's really bugging me is the number of wheels.
target: 不，谢谢。想了想，储物空间和颜色也不重要，真正纠结的是轮子数量。

source: I mean... four wheels is the classic number of wheels... but is it the number of wheels I REALLY want on a car?
target: 我是说……四个轮子是经典，可我真想买一辆四个轮子的车吗？

source: (%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, step up and sell the car to this man before I find out if HE fits in the trunk.)
target: （%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，快出马，把车卖给他。不然我可要试试，他能不能塞进后备箱了。）

source: Hmmm, okay. There's gotta be something you can do to get this guy to hurry up and buy the damn car...
target: 嗯，行吧。总有办法让这人赶紧掏钱，把破车买走……

source: Sweeten the deal: if he buys the car, he can also have one of your kidneys.
target: 加点赠品：买这辆车，送你一个肾。

source: Lie and tell him the car looks crappy as a camouflage technique to adapt to the surroundings of a used car dealership. Its real form is a kickass battle robot from space!
target: 骗他说，破车外观只是为了融入二手车行的环境。它的真身，是来自太空的酷炫战斗机器人！

source: Hmmm... a kidney, you say?
target: 嗯……你说送肾？

source: And what a kidney it is!
target: 那可不是一般的肾！

source: Polly slaps you on the kidneys. Ow.
target: 波莉拍了拍你肾的位置。疼。

source: These bad boys can fit SO much erythropoietin in them.
target: 瞧这宝贝，能装多少促红细胞生成素啊！

source: I can make use of a spare kidney, I suppose... but that begs the question: WHICH kidney is for sale?
target: 有个备用肾，倒也用得上……不过问题来了，卖的是哪个肾？

source: Oh, easy: it's the left one, right Scott?
target: 简单，左边那个，对吧，斯科特？

source: Scott checks what seem to be medical records with... your name on them?!
target: 斯科特翻看着什么，像是病历……上面写着你的名字？！

source: Yup! That one's %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s good kidney!
target: 没错！那可是 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 好的那个肾！

source: And it can be yours if you buy this car NOW.
target: 现在买车，就是你的。

source: Hmmm, yeah... looking at these medical records, this deal isn't half-bad.
target: 嗯，是啊……看看这病历，买卖挺划算。

source: Okay, you got me. Gimme the keys... and don't forget the kidney!
target: 好，说动我了。钥匙拿来……别忘了肾！

source: Sweet! My partner Scott's gonna walk you through the paperwork while I perform some amateur kidney surgery on %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 爽！我的搭档斯科特带你办手续，我给 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 做个业余摘肾手术。

source: Aww, but I wanted to use the scalpel!
target: 哎，我也想玩手术刀！

source: Needless to say, getting your kidney removed in a parking lot costs you -N2 STAMINA. At least you gained +N2 MONEY selling a car and an organ!
target: 不用说，在停车场被摘肾，让你失去了 -N2 体力。至少车和器官一起卖，赚到了 +N2 金钱！

source: WHOA! This is a battle-robot from space?! That's awesome!
target: 哇！这竟然是太空战斗机器人？！太棒了！

source: Uh, yeah, totally. This "used car" is actually a refugee from the car-robot civil war devastating the planet... eh... Carrobotplanet.
target: 呃，对，当然。这辆“二手车”，其实是从汽车机器人内战中逃难来的，那场内战毁了……呃……汽车机器人星球。

source: Really? Isn't the name of that planet a little on the nose?
target: 真的？这星球的名字，不会太直白了吗？

source: I mean, I'm a ghost named "Polly Geist", but you don't hear me crying.
target: 我还是个叫“波莉·鬼斯特”的鬼呢，也没见我哭啊。

source: Fair enough. So, what features does this car-robot hybrid have?
target: 也是。那这半车半机器人的东西，有什么功能？

source: All kinds! It comes with battle lasers, a jetpack, sixteen-wheel drive, centuries of rage directed at the BikeDroids...
target: 多了！战斗激光、喷气背包、十六轮驱动，还有对摩托机器人绵延数百年的仇恨……

source: Who are these... 'BikeDroids'?
target: “摩托机器人”……又是谁？

source: They're the arbitrarily evil rogue race of robots from Carrobotplanet. They wanna steal our planet's life force and destroy all monsters.
target: 汽车机器人星球上，毫无来由就邪恶的叛变机器人种族。他们想偷走咱们星球的生命力，消灭所有怪物。

source: Hmm, I don't know if I want to buy a car that wants to wipe out my entire species...
target: 嗯……想灭我全族的车，我不知道该不该买……

source: No, no, sir: that'd be the "BikeDroids". This one is a "CarBot" -- those are the good guys!
target: 不，不，先生，那是“摩托机器人”。这是“汽车机器人”，好人那边的！

source: Ah, I think I get it now. Can I see its robot form? I wanna check some of its features.
target: 啊，懂了。能看看机器人形态吗？想检查几个功能。

source: NO, YOU CAN'T!
target: 不行！

source: It's, uh... hibernating right now, in preparation for the impending "CarBot v. BikeDroid" war.
target: 它，呃……正在冬眠，为即将到来的“汽车机器人对摩托机器人”大战做准备。

source: We can't interrupt its slumber!
target: 不能打扰它睡觉！

source: That's fine, I understand. I also get a bit cranky if I'm woken up without my coffee, haha!
target: 没事，理解。没喝咖啡就被叫醒，我脾气也大，哈哈！

source: LOL, you're so funny, are you gonna buy the damn thing or not?
target: 哈哈，真幽默。所以这破车，到底买不买？

source: He is, apparently! You earn +N2 MONEY from your sale, but you lose -N2 SOUL for... you know... scamming that poor idiot.
target: 还真买！你卖车赚到 +N2 金钱，可因为……你懂的……骗了这个可怜傻子，也失去了 -N2 灵魂。

source: Dance with the air dancers
target: 跟充气舞人跳舞

source: You approach those big, inflatable dancing bois and start busting a move.
target: 你走向那些高大的充气舞人，开始大跳特跳。

source: These balloon dudes are really good dancers! Throw that polyethylene-coated booty back!
target: 这些气球哥们真会跳！那包着聚乙烯的屁股，扭起来！

source: They're so cool! Do you think they like my dance moves?
target: 太酷了！你们说，他们喜欢我的舞步吗？

source: Silly Scott! The air dancers can't have opinions on his moves because they're not alive.
target: 傻斯科特！充气舞人又没生命，哪会对他的舞步有意见。

source: But after dancing with them for hours, losing -N2 STAMINA and sweating like a sinner in church, you suddenly aren't so sure of that anymore...
target: 可跳了几个小时，你失去 -N2 体力，汗流得像进教堂的罪人。这下，你突然不太确定了……

source: The air dancers' faces sway in the breeze. You sense that they're looking at you, appraising your mind, body, and soul... and dance skills.
target: 充气舞人的脸在风中晃动。你感觉他们正看着你，评判你的思想、身体和灵魂……还有舞技。

source: Whoa, this one just put his hand on my shoulder! I think he wants us to follow them!
target: 哇，这个把手放我肩膀上了！想让咱们跟着走吧！

source: In your dehydrated, hallucinating state of mind, it makes perfect sense!
target: 脱水到产生幻觉的你，觉得这完全合情合理！

source: After walking some ways, you find yourselves surrounded by more air dancers.
target: 走了一段，你们发现周围出现了更多充气舞人。

source: Logic says you're still in the used car dealership, but you've danced your logic away.
target: 按逻辑，你们还在二手车行。可逻辑已经被你们跳没了。

source: Holy shit. This must be, like... the secret air-dancer village!
target: 卧槽，这一定是……充气舞人的秘密村落！

source: The air dancers offer you something to drink. Thank goodness!
target: 充气舞人端来喝的。谢天谢地！

source: ...No, wait, this is just a cup of air. Damn.
target: ……等等，不，这就是一杯空气。靠。

source: This is so cool! They must've invited us here because they liked our dance moves so much.
target: 太酷了！肯定是因为喜欢咱们的舞步，才请我们过来的。

source: Totally! And any society that values the art of dancing till you drop is a society I wanna learn more about!
target: 当然！能珍视跳到趴下这种艺术的社会，我一定要多了解！

source: Sure, who needs water anyway? Find a way of immersing yourselves in air dancers culture!
target: 没错，谁还要喝水啊？想想办法，深入体验充气舞人的文化吧！

source: Learn to play the traditional instrument of their culture: the air guitar.
target: 学他们的传统乐器：空气吉他。

source: As their name suggests, air dancers have learned to control the most powerful element through the arcane art of... DANCEBENDING!
target: 顾名思义，充气舞人已经掌握了最强元素，靠的是玄奥的……御舞术！

source: It's a great plan! You just need to find yourself the perfect air guitar instructor, maybe buy some air guitar amps and air guitar picks and capos...
target: 计划很好！只要找个完美的空气吉他老师，可能还得买空气吉他音箱、空气拨片、空气变调夹……

source: Nah, fuck that noise! I bet I'm an air guitar prodigy already!
target: 呸，管他那些！我肯定天生就是空气吉他神童！

source: Polly whips out an air guitar. Whoa, where was she keeping that all this time?!
target: 波莉掏出一把空气吉他。哇，她一直藏哪儿的？！

source: Watch and learn, bitches! WAH WAH WAAAAAH!
target: 看好了，婊子们，学着点！哇哇哇——！

source: Nice riff, bro! Let me try. I just put my fingers here and strum like this...?
target: 这段真棒，兄弟！我也试试。手指放这儿，然后这么拨……？

source: DOODLY-DOODLY-DOODLY-DOOOOOO!
target: 嘟哩嘟哩嘟哩嘟——！

source: Holy shit, you're a natural, Scott! WE SHOULD START A BAND!
target: 卧槽，斯科特，天才啊！咱们组乐队吧！

source: Okay, I'm in! We can call ourselves the Air Guitarz -- with a Z!
target: 好，加入！就叫“空气吉他”，带 Z 的！

source: YES! We'll turn this road trip into a world tour, playing our music wherever the winds take us in our greatest adventure yet!
target: 对！把公路旅行变成世界巡演，风吹到哪儿就演到哪儿，来场前所未有的大冒险！

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%, YOU'RE OUT OF THE BAND!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%，你被踢出乐队了！

source: WHAT?!
target: 什么？！

source: Don't worry, Scott, we didn't need %HIMHER% anyway! The Air Guitarz were always meant to be a dynamic duo!
target: 别担心，斯科特，本来就用不着 %HIMHER%！空气吉他注定是劲爆二人组！

source: Cool!
target: 酷！

source: We'll be famous, my good boi! But fame will be exhausting and hollow. We'll probably end up doing airoin to cope with the pressure, like all the great air musicians.
target: 咱们会出名的，乖狗狗！可成名会又累又空虚，最后大概得吸空气洛因减压，像那些伟大的空气音乐家一样。

source: Oh, that doesn't seem fun... I don't know if I wanna be in the Air Guitarz anymore...
target: 哦，听着不好玩……我不太想待在空气吉他乐队了……

source: You're quitting on me? FINE! Polly Geist was always destined to be a one-woman show! I'll be the Lone Air Guitar -- WITHOUT the Z!
target: 你要退出？行啊！波莉·鬼斯特注定单飞！我就叫“孤独空气吉他”，不带 Z！

source: NO Z?! It's like I don't even know who you are anymore!
target: 不带 Z？！感觉都不认识你了！

source: "Hey!" someone says to you. "Are you kids okay? You look pretty flushed... should I get you some water?"
target: 有人问：“嘿，孩子们，没事吧？你们脸好红……要不要拿点水来？”

source: NO! I'M THE LONE AIR GUITAR, AND I'LL ONLY TAKE VODKA OR PURE OXYGEN IN MY DRESSING ROOM!!!
target: 不要！我是孤独空气吉他！我的化妆间，只收伏特加和纯氧！！！

source: "...Yeah, I'm definitely gonna get you water. Try not to wander into traffic while I'm gone."
target: “……嗯，我还是去拿水吧。我不在的时候，别乱跑到车流里。”

source: Scott and Polly make up when you all get hydrated and realize you were hallucinating all this time. Man, this argument was dumb!
target: 等大家喝上水，意识到刚才全是幻觉，斯科特和波莉也和好了。天啊，刚才吵得真蠢！

source: At least you gained +N2 MIND by learning and mastering the air guitar -- and you also learned the risks of fame!
target: 至少你学会并掌握空气吉他，获得 +N2 头脑，还知道了成名的风险！

source: Polly, what's dancebending?
target: 波莉，御舞术是什么？

source: You mean you've never heard the ancient air dancer proverb?!
target: 你居然没听过充气舞人那句古老谚语？！

source: It goes like this: "Dance. Cars. Other Kind of Dance. Air. Long ago, the four nations lived together in harmony..."
target: 这么说的：“舞蹈。汽车。另一种舞蹈。空气。很久以前，四国和睦相处……”

source: "But everything changed when the Car Nation attacked!"
target: “可汽车国发动进攻后，一切都变了！”

source: "Only the Dancebender, master of all four elements, could stop them from ruining pedestrian rights."
target: “唯有御舞师，四大元素的掌控者，才能阻止他们践踏行人权利。”

source: "But when the world needed him most... HE VANISHED."
target: “可就在世界最需要他时……他消失了。”

source: WHAT?! Where'd he go?!
target: 什么？！去哪儿了？！

source: Who knows? He could be anywhere. He could even be IN THIS VERY ROOM!

target: 还有 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。其实主要就是 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。亲爱的，丢不丢人啊。

source: Guess that's what you get for letting your horniness guide your actions. Evil Scott was definitely hot, but he wasn't worth losing your -N2 SOUL.
target: 被色欲牵着走，就是这种下场。邪恶斯科特是很性感，可也不值得你搭上 -N2 灵魂。

source: Hmm, using forbidden magic sounds like a -N3 SOUL move... but fuck it, I'll do whatever it takes to win this thing!
target: 嗯，禁忌魔法，听着就是要掉 -N3 灵魂的操作……可管他呢，为了赢，不择手段！

source: With -N3 MAGIC, you draw the transmutation circle, inscribing it with many arcane symbols... that, when translated, are basically just an employment contract.
target: 你花 -N3 魔力画出炼成阵，写满玄奥符文……翻译过来，基本就是一份雇佣合同。

source: Scott is enveloped in smoke that smells like expensive liquor and upscale lounge booth leather, and when he emerges...
target: 一股浓烟笼罩斯科特，带着名酒和高级酒廊卡座皮革的味道。等他走出来……

source: Good evening, Mr. and Mrs. Pet Contest Judges. Welcome to my bar. What can I get for you today?
target: 晚上好，宠物比赛的各位评委先生女士。欢迎来到我的酒吧。今天想喝点什么？

source: "Oh, my, look at how well-groomed this pet is!" the judges say, fanning themselves. "He's even trained to speak on command!"
target: 评委扇着风：“哎哟，瞧这宠物，打理得多好！还训练得能听指令说话呢！”

source: Please, let me make you a yummy drink. It may take some time to prepare, because I'm going to do lots of unnecessary shaking tricks to make myself look cool.
target: 请让我替各位调一杯美酒。可能要等一会儿，因为我要做很多没必要的花式摇壶，让自己显得很酷。

source: You see, I'm also something called a "mixologist." That means I take more time to make cocktails, and they're also more expensive.
target: 而且我还是位“调酒艺术家”。意思就是，调一杯花更久，也卖得更贵。

source: "Wow, this pet is so cultured! Can you make me a cosmopolitan, 'bartender'?"
target: “哇，这宠物真有格调！‘调酒师’，能来杯大都会吗？”

source: Sure! While I take an excessive amount of time making your drink, would you like to unload your sorrows onto me?
target: 当然！趁我花超长时间调酒，要不要把心里的苦，都倒给我听？

source: "How wonderful! He's handsome, trained, AND a great listener!"
target: “太棒了！又帅，又训练有素，还特别会倾听！”

source: Watch me pour these two drinks into one drink! Now I'll do some sexy poses and flex my biceps while I shake it up! Shakey, shakey!
target: 看，两杯倒成一杯！摇壶时，再摆个性感姿势，秀秀二头肌！摇啊摇！

source: "Oh, my! He's so casual, and at the same time so passionate!"
target: “哎呀！既随性，又热情！”

source: Wow, look at him go! I should get Scott to market my toilet wine!
target: 哇，瞧他！该找斯科特推销我的马桶酒！

source: Dammit, Astaroth's fancy hat can't top that! I knew I should've gotten a rat that could cook classy French cuisine!
target: 妈的，阿斯塔罗斯的漂亮帽子比不过这个！早知道就该找只会做高级法国菜的老鼠！

source: The judges give Scott the win -- and some of them even give him their phone numbers! You gain +N3 MONEY and +N3 HYPE!
target: 评委判斯科特获胜，还有几个塞了电话号码给他！你获得 +N3 金钱和 +N3 热度！

source: Category: obstacle course
target: 参赛项目：障碍赛

source: You enter Scott into the pet contest. He's very excited about it!
target: 你给斯科特报名参加宠物比赛。他兴奋极了！

source: This will be fun! I just need to transform first. Polly, you still got that picture of a full moon?
target: 肯定好玩！先变个身。波莉，那张满月照片还在吗？

source: Oh, I've got a full moon all right. PEEP THESE CHEEKS!
target: 哦，满月当然有。看看这屁股！

source: Polly moons you all with her bare butt.
target: 波莉朝大家亮出光屁股。

source: AWOOOOOOOOOOOOO!
target: 嗷呜——！

source: Whoa, that really worked? I was just messing around! The magic rules of this world make NO sense, haha!
target: 哇，真有用？我就瞎闹一下！这世界的魔法规则，真没道理，哈哈！

source: WOLF SCOTT IS READY TO DOMINATE COMPETITION! WHO WOLF SCOTT NEED TO EAT?
target: 狼斯科特，要赢！狼斯科特，吃谁？

source: Uhhh, I don't think eating the other competitors is part of the deal, buddy.
target: 呃，伙计，好像不包括吃掉其他选手。

source: According to these flyers, there are actually several different obstacle courses we can choose to compete in.
target: 传单上说，有好几条不同的障碍赛道，任咱们选。

source: "These obstacle courses will engage your pet's muscles and agility..."
target: “这些赛道，将考验宠物的肌肉和敏捷……”

source: WOLF SCOTT HAVE MUSCLES!
target: 狼斯科特，有肌肉！

source: "...along with wits, grit, charisma, bureaucratic expertise, an ironclad moral code, and full understanding of life and death."
target: “……以及智慧、毅力、魅力、办事手续的专长、坚定不移的道德准则，还有对生死的彻底理解。”

source: ARE... THOSE... OTHER MUSCLES?
target: 那些……别的肌肉？

source: Uh... never mind. Dang, there's gotta be at least ONE obstacle course here we can win...
target: 呃……算了。这里总有一条赛道，咱们能赢吧……

source: ...and if not, at least one that'll be very entertaining to lose. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, which obstacle course should we enter?
target: ……就算赢不了，也总有一条输得好玩。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，选哪个？

source: The Trolley Course: your pet will be thrown into impossible moral conundrums!
target: 电车赛道：让宠物直面无解的道德困境！

source: The Social Climbing Course: overcome social obstacles to be accepted in high society!
target: 上流社会攀登赛道：跨越社交障碍，挤进上流社会！

source: The Permit Course: be ready to get stressed from jumping through several bureaucratic hoops.
target: 许可赛道：准备接受官僚手续的层层刁难，压力拉满。

source: OKAY, TROLLEY SOUND FUN. WOLF SCOTT LIKE CARS AND TRAINS. WHAT GO WRONG?
target: 好，电车，好玩。狼斯科特，喜欢车和火车。能出什么事？

source: Smashcut to you three screaming in pure stress while a trolley barrels down the track toward several defenseless people.
target: 镜头猛地一切：电车朝轨道上几个无辜的人冲去，你们三个压力大得放声尖叫。

source: WHAT DO, POLLY?! PULL LEVER?!
target: 波莉，怎么办？！拉杆？！

source: Shit, I don't know! There's no easy answer! That's why this is a moral conundrum!
target: 妈的，不知道！哪有简单答案，不然叫什么道德困境！

source: You can change courses and hit one guy, saving five people but consciously killing one; or you can do nothing and let five people die due to your inaction!
target: 改道撞一个人，能救五个，可就是故意杀了一个；什么都不做，又会因为不作为，让五个人死！

source: Wolf Scott, do you believe inaction equals culpability? Do you believe saving five lives is worth sparing one?!
target: 狼斯科特，你觉得不作为等于有罪吗？为了救五个人，值得牺牲一个吗？！
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): KEEP; 前句明确改道杀一救五，后句明确杀一或杀五；sparing 是源文笔误，现译牺牲一人符合两侧证据。

source: CHOOSE SOMETHING, SCOTT! KILL ONE GUY OR KILL FIVE GUYS?!
target: 斯科特，选啊！杀一个，还是杀五个？！

source: ...WOLF SCOTT NOT SO GOOD WITH NUMBERS. FIVE IS MORE THAN ONE, RIGHT?
target: ……狼斯科特，数字不太行。五比一多，对吧？

source: Afterward, Scott's back to his normal self, and you all are reflecting on your choices after losing -N2 SOUL from manslaughter.
target: 事后，斯科特变回正常模样，大家反思自己的选择。过失杀人，让你失去了 -N2 灵魂。

source: That was rough... but the trolley problem was still exciting in its own adrenaline-pumping, stress-inducing way, so at least we got +N2 HYPE?
target: 太难受了……不过电车难题确实又刺激又紧张，所以至少赚了 +N2 热度？

source: I guess. But bro, ethics are hard...
target: 应该吧。可兄弟，伦理好难……

source: How are the other pets doing?
target: 其他宠物怎么样？

source: You check the obstacle course to see an orange cat is competing next. It's riding in the trolley and chooses to run over the five people.
target: 你看向赛道，下一位是一只橘猫。它坐在电车里，选择碾过五个人。

source: Then the cat REVERSES the trolley to go back and hit the remaining person on the other tracks!
target: 然后，猫又把电车倒回去，撞死另一条轨道上剩下的那个人！

source: Cats, amirite?
target: 猫嘛，懂的都懂。

source: BUT WOLF SCOTT NOT SURE HOW TO BE FANCY...
target: 可狼斯科特，不知道怎么优雅……

source: It's easy! We'll start by making you look expensive; rich people judge you based on what you have rather than who you are anyway.
target: 简单！先让你看着贵。有钱人反正只看你有什么，又不看你是什么人。

source: You spend -N2 MONEY to buy Wolf Scott some fancy clothes. It's some undies identical to the ones he had, but made out of something way fancier... like velvet.
target: 你花 -N2 金钱，给狼斯科特买高档衣服。就是条跟原来一模一样的内裤，可材料高级多了……比如，天鹅绒。

source: You and Polly spend hours teaching Wolf Scott fancy phrases and commands. By the time the competition starts, this mangy mutt has gone full purebred pedigree!
target: 你和波莉花了好几小时，教狼斯科特优雅用语和指令。等比赛开始，这只邋遢土狗，已经脱胎换骨成纯种名犬！

source: Oh, hey, it's you guys! You got Scott to compete in the upper society course, huh?
target: 哦，嘿，是你们！让斯科特比上流社会赛道啊？

source: Good luck defeating my pet! His name's Astaroth, and he's the fanciest little creature in all of Hell!
target: 想赢我的宠物，祝好运！他叫阿斯塔罗斯，全地狱最优雅的小东西！

source: Grrrrrr...
target: 呜噜噜……

source: Astaroth is horribly huge, smells like burning sulfur and looks like something you shouldn't feed after midnight. But he's got a fancy hat, so that basically cancels it out.
target: 阿斯塔罗斯大得吓人，散发着燃烧的硫磺味，看着就像午夜后绝对不能喂的东西。不过戴着漂亮帽子，基本就全抵消了。

source: He's cute, but we trained Scott HARDCORE for this. Show 'em, buddy! Shake!
target: 是可爱，可咱们给斯科特狠狠特训过！伙计，露一手！握手！

source: SALUTATIONS, ASTAROTH. ME WOLF SCOTT. WE SHAKE PAWS NOW, WITH PINKIES OUT.
target: 阿斯塔罗斯，安好。我，狼斯科特。现在握爪，小指翘起。

source: Good boy! Now catch this tennis ball... and tell us how it tastes but using fancy words.
target: 好狗狗！接住网球……再用高级词汇，说说什么味道。

source: TENNIS BALL GOOD. IT TASTES... VERY YELLOW.
target: 网球，好。味道……很黄。

source: The judges praise Wolf Scott: yellow is not a flavor but a color... which means this pet is using poetic language. Very fancy.
target: 评委大赞狼斯科特：黄色又不是味道，是颜色……所以，这宠物在用诗意的语言。真优雅。

source: Wolf Scott smokes the competition and proves that you really can teach an old werewolf new tricks. Nice! You gain +N2 HYPE!
target: 狼斯科特碾压对手，证明老狼人照样能学新把戏。棒！你获得 +N2 热度！

source: PERMIT? PERMIT FOR... WHAT?
target: 许可？什么……许可？

source: We don't have time to answer questions! Look at the line for the consulate office! We'd better grab a number or we'll be here all night!
target: 没空回答！看领事办事处排的队！快拿号，不然今晚就别走了！

source: You lose -N2 MIND organizing all your paperwork and waiting in line. When you finally reach the window, the secretary says, "Name and occupation, please."
target: 整理文件、排队，耗掉了 -N2 头脑。终于轮到窗口，秘书说：“姓名、职业。”

source: NAME... WOLF SCOTT. OCCUPATION... GOOD BOY?
target: 名字……狼斯科特。职业……乖狗狗？

source: "Do you have a 'good boy' work permit?"
target: “有‘乖狗狗’工作许可吗？”

source: We have these vet records affirming that Scott is a good boy who's up to date on his rabies vaccines. Will that work?
target: 有兽医记录，证明斯科特是乖狗狗，狂犬病疫苗也全按时打了。这个行吗？

source: "Nope. You gotta fill out this work permit paperwork." She slides you a brick of paper heavy enough to beat a man to death with.
target: “不行，得填这套工作许可申请表。”她推来砖头一样厚的纸，重得能打死人。

source: "Get it signed by three past employers, two Founding Fathers, and autographed by a DJ of my choosing, then you can come back. NEXT!"
target: “找三个前雇主、两位开国元勋签字，再让一个我指定的 DJ 签名，才能回来。下一位！”

source: Now we have to wait for an appointment to open back up again! Fuck this, I need a coffee.
target: 现在还得重新等预约放号！去他妈的，我要咖啡。

source: You go to the coffee machine. "Hey, you!" someone near it whispers. "Want a gun permit? It comes free with the purchase of a coffee."
target: 你走向咖啡机，附近有人压低声音：“嘿，要持枪证吗？买咖啡，免费送。”

source: Seriously? Why is a permit for a firearm so much easier to get than the work permit we need to get ANOTHER permit?
target: 真的假的？为了申请另一个许可，要先有工作许可；可弄个持枪证，怎么反而容易这么多？

source: ...WOLF SCOTT KIND OF WANT GUN?
target: ……狼斯科特，有点想要枪？

source: You do? Okay, anything for you, buddy!
target: 想要？好，为了你，什么都行，伙计！

source: "HOLY SHIT!" the secretaries and bureaucrats scream. "THAT WEREWOLF'S GOT A GUN! RUN FOR YOUR LIVES!!!"
target: 秘书和官员们尖叫：“卧槽！那个狼人拿枪了！快逃命啊！！！”

source: AWOOOOOOOOO!
target: 嗷呜——！

source: It takes all day to get the gun back from Wolf Scott. At least you won the obstacle course and earned +N2 HYPE!
target: 花了一整天，才从狼斯科特手里抢回枪。至少障碍赛赢了，获得 +N2 热度！

source: Soup time
target: 喝汤时间

source: WOOHOO, SOUP TIME! You and your friends enter the restaurant... only to be welcomed by a thing of nightmares.
target: 呜呼，喝汤时间！你和朋友们走进餐馆……迎接你们的，却是噩梦般的东西。

source: Welcome to my SOUP-er diner, children! I'm your best veggie pal, Simon Soups!
target: 孩子们，欢迎来我的“汤当棒”餐馆！我是你们最好的蔬菜朋友，西蒙·汤！

source: Nice to meet you, Simon Soup! What kind of food do you serve here? I'm unclear.
target: 很高兴认识你，西蒙·汤！这里卖什么吃的？没太弄明白。

source: Excellent question! C'mon gang, let's soak our new friend in the delicious broth of music and teach him the true meaning of the Simon Soups brand!
target: 好问题！来，各位，让新朋友泡进美味的音乐高汤，听听西蒙汤馆真正的品牌精神！

source: <INITIATING_WHIMSICAL_THEME_SONG_WITH_NO_THREATENING_UNDERTONES_NO._87>
target: <启动奇想主题曲，绝无威胁意味，编号87>

source: The animatronics' ancient, rusted speakers let out a metallic screech that you suppose must've sounded like banjo music forty years ago.
target: 机械玩偶陈旧生锈的扬声器，挤出刺耳的金属声。你猜，四十年前，这大概还像班卓琴的声音。

source: "I'm Simon Soups, welcome to my show! / There ain't a soup alive that I don't know!"
target: “我叫西蒙·汤，欢迎来看我的场！/ 天下活着的汤，我全知道不说谎！”

source: "Gumbo, miso, children's blood, cream of wheat! / Soup's the yummy food that just can't be beat!"
target: “秋葵汤、味噌汤、童血、小麦奶糊香！/ 美味哪家强，谁也比不过汤！”

source: Wait, what was that middle one--?
target: 等等，中间那个是——？

source: "I'm Mr. Leek, and I'll be your best friend / until the inevitable bloody end!"
target: “我是韭葱先生，要做你最好朋友！/ 直到必然降临的，血腥结局尽头！”

source: "Soup is my second-favorite thing to slurp / to a child's bone marrow as he screams 'THAT HURTS!'"
target: “最爱吸孩子骨髓，听他喊‘好痛’！/ 再要数这碗汤，吸溜吸溜进腹中！”

source: <I_AM_ONION_AND_I_HUNGER_FOR_YOUTHFUL_FLESH>
target: <我是洋葱_我渴求鲜嫩的血肉>

source: Oops, sorry, I must've inserted the wrong song cassette. Let me fix that real quick...
target: 哎呀，抱歉，应该放错歌曲磁带了。马上换一下……

source: <I_AM_ONION_AND_I_DO_NOT_HUNGER_FOR_YOUTHFUL_FLESH_END_CHORUS>
target: <我是洋葱_我并不渴求鲜嫩的血肉_副歌结束>

source: Oh... it just... ends? The song's over?
target: 哦……就……结束了？歌唱完了？

source: Yup, thank God.
target: 对，谢天谢地。

source: Is it just me, or were those animatronics giving off a weird vibe?
target: 只有我觉得，这些机械玩偶有点怪怪的吗？

source: Yeah, they can be kinda off-putting. But corporate made it against the rules for them to kill customers during store hours, so they won't mess with you too much.
target: 对，是挺瘆人的。不过公司规定营业时间不许杀顾客，不会太找你们麻烦。

source: ...I wouldn't recommend looking Mr. Leek in the eye, though. Just in case.
target: ……但最好别直视韭葱先生的眼睛。以防万一。

source: Anyway, what would you like to order?
target: 总之，想点什么？

source: The Special Customer Soup! It's a soup made ONLY of our most special customers!
target: 特别顾客汤！只用我们最特别的顾客熬制！

source: Delicious Breakfast Soup
target: 美味早餐汤

source: Deluxe Premium Soup Combo! It comes with soup fries, a soup soda, and a cool action figure of the soup.
target: 豪华尊享汤套餐！含汤薯条、汤汽水，还有一个酷炫的汤主题可动人偶。

source: You're ordering the soup made of souls, huh? Guess I should've expected that, edgelord.
target: 点灵魂熬的汤啊？也是，早该想到你会这样，中二病。

source: Oh, does that menu say "made OF our most special customers?" It should say "made FOR our most special customers."
target: 哦，菜单写的是“用最特别的顾客熬制”？应该是“为最特别的顾客熬制”。

source: That, uh, must be a typo or something.
target: 呃，肯定是错别字，或者什么的。

source: You can drop the act, boo. We get it, the soup's made of people. Just give us the goods.
target: 亲爱的，别装了。懂，就是人熬的汤。端上来就行。

source: Uh... so you're not gonna sue?
target: 呃……所以，不会起诉？

source: Why would we?
target: 干吗要告？

source: Because eating a soup made of people is sort of a crime against monstrosity?
target: 因为吃人熬的汤，算是反怪物罪吧？

source: Pfft, so? It's a little late in the road trip to stop committing crimes against monstrosity.
target: 嘁，那又怎样？公路旅行都到这份上，才想不再犯反怪物罪，不嫌晚？

source: Honestly, after the nefarious shit I've seen %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% pull off, "eating soul soup" wouldn't even make our top ten worst deeds.
target: 见识过 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 干的那些坏事，“喝灵魂汤”，连最坏的前十名都排不上。

source: Okay, I guess as long as you're cool with it. I'd also appreciate it if you didn't tell my manager we had this conversation.
target: 好吧，你们不介意就行。不过这段话，最好别告诉我经理，感激不尽。

source: No problemo. Who's your manager?
target: 没问题，谁是经理？

source: Mr. Leek.
target: 韭葱先生。

source: Even if it has souls in it, you still lose -N2 SOUL for eating a soup made of people... but you gain +N2 STAMINA!
target: 就算里面有灵魂，喝人熬的汤，还是让你失去了 -N2 灵魂……不过，也获得了 +N2 体力！

source: What? But this is just cereal. Cereal isn't soup.

target: 邪恶乔伊说得对：咬喉咙，客观上比打胸邪恶。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，交钱。

target: 跑了这么多，你失去了 -N2 体力。不过这下午收集超人速度数据，至少玩得开心！

target: 对抗正义圆桌会

target: 你坐在桌旁，周围一圈性感反派，正在轮流自我介绍。

target: 嗨，我是阿克萨拉克斯，也跟乔伊交往过。不过说真的，《女巫会》第三季播出后，我就算个 C 级反派了。能被邀请，已经很开心。

target: 有一点很明确，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，这份决心令人佩服。我们需要你这样有胆量的人。

target: 尤其万一哪天，遇到非得捅自己手不可的情况。

target: 定了，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 加入组织。欢迎来到黑暗面。

target: 爽，连邪恶计划都没做！只要流一大堆血，顺便失去 -N2 体力。

target: 这番没来由的狠劲，还让你获得 +N2 热度！

target: 周围全是肌肉发达、斗志高昂的风筝手，发色鲜艳，主角气场满得快溢出来。没错，这才是你的同类！必须参赛！

source: You're entering? That's awesome, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! I didn't know you were a professional kite-flyer.
target: 你要报名？太棒了，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！都不知道你是职业风筝手。

source: Yet despite all logic, you are! You see, while Scott and Polly were busy being popular and having fun, you were busy STUDYING THE KITE!
target: 虽然没道理，可你就是！斯科特和波莉忙着受欢迎、享乐的时候，你在埋头苦练风筝之道！

target: 哦，你不受欢迎是因为这个？还真没想到，不过挺好，亲爱的！

target: 朋友们坐进观众席给你加油，你一路高飞，杀进八强！

target: 嗯……下个对手就是你？%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，对吧？放风筝颇有君子之风，看得出训练有素。

source: AND SOMEHOW... WE WILL KICK... CHIYO'S ASS!
target: 总有办法……我们定要……把千代揍翻！

source: With the kite's newfound confidence and strength, and with the power of sing-alongs, your kite flies itself through the air and outperforms Chiyo in all respects!
target: 风筝有了新信心、新力量，又有大合唱加持，自己在空中飞翔，各方面都碾压千代！

source: You throw your kite into the sky, where it buoys on the wind. Great! It's got height; now it just needs a pep talk!
target: 你把风筝扔上天，借风托住了。好，高度有了，只差一段鼓励！

source: The power to fly was inside it all along! The line that connected it was just its training wheels, which you used to boost its confidence.
target: 飞翔的力量，一直在它体内！连接它的线，只是你用来提升它信心的辅助轮。

source: But now the time has come for the kite to fly solo, and achieve its dreams!
target: 现在，是它独自高飞，追逐梦想的时候了！

source: Your kite can't talk, but it can feel, and you know that your pep talk is getting through to it... yes! It's flying!
target: 风筝不会说话，可它有感受，你知道，鼓励传达到它心里了……对！它飞起来了！

source: ...Flying away from the tournament, over the horizon.
target: ……飞出赛场，飞过地平线。

source: Ha! How pathetic. Your disloyal kite has abandoned you in your time of need!
target: 哈，可悲。你最需要它时，不忠的风筝却抛弃了你！

source: Or maybe the kite just got caught in an updraft and was carried off in the wind? Because, you know, kites don't have autonomy?
target: 也可能就是被上升气流卷走，顺风飘了？毕竟，风筝又没有自主意识？

source: You'll never know which. All you know is that without a kite, you're definitely disqualified. You lose -2 HYPE and -1 TOURNAMENT.
target: 原因再也弄不清。只知道，没风筝，你肯定被取消资格。你失去了 -2 热度和 -1 次锦标赛。

source: Yes, of course! You close your eyes, honing the kite energy within you.
target: 没错，当然！你闭上双眼，凝聚体内的风筝之力。

source: You imagine the creation of the world: the Big Bang, the explosion of stars, the planetary bodies filling the empty vacuum of space...
target: 你想象世界初生：宇宙大爆炸，恒星爆发，星球填满空荡的太空……

source: You see your planet being formed. It began as a sphere covered in fire. Then the mountains pushed up, and rocky Earth covered its crust.
target: 你看见自己的星球成形，最初是个火焰包裹的球体，山峦随后隆起，岩石土壤覆盖地壳。

source: Then water flooded the planet, the waves colliding with the newborn shores. And with water came plants, and with plants came air, the atmosphere you rely on to breathe.
target: 接着，水淹没星球，浪拍着新生的海岸。有了水，就有植物；有了植物，就有空气，形成你赖以呼吸的大气。

source: And with air came wind, and on the wind came kites! The fifth element! Yeah, that's exactly how it worked!
target: 有空气就有风，有风就有风筝！第五元素！对，绝对就是这么来的！

source: You must channel the wild, unbridled spirit of those first ancient kites. Their magic fills your core, exploding from within!
target: 你要引导最早那些远古风筝，狂野不羁的精神！魔法充满内心，由内向外爆发！

source: What is this madness? How are you controlling your kite with random martial arts poses?!
target: 什么疯魔之术？随便摆几个武术姿势，怎么就控制住风筝了？！

source: Because %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% just became the legendary Kitemancer, bro! Now %HESHE% can control all the kites!
target: 因为 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 刚成为传说中的驭筝法师啊，兄弟！现在 %HESHE% 能控制所有风筝！

source: Wait, ALL the kites? This just got way easier. You take control of Chiyo's kite and crash it hard into the ground.
target: 等等，所有？这下简单了。你控制千代的风筝，狠狠撞向地面。

source: NOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!
Yes, of course! You close your eyes, honing the kite energy within you.
target: 没错，当然！你闭上双眼，凝聚体内的风筝之力。

source: You imagine the creation of the world: the Big Bang, the explosion of stars, the planetary bodies filling the empty vacuum of space...
target: 你想象世界初生：宇宙大爆炸，恒星爆发，星球填满空荡的太空……

source: You see your planet being formed. It began as a sphere totally covered in fire. Then the mountains pushed up, and rocky Earth covered its crust.
target: 你看见自己的星球成形，最初是个完全被火焰包裹的球体，山峦随后隆起，岩石土壤覆盖地壳。

source: Then water flooded the planet, the waves colliding with the still-young shores. And with water came plants, and with plants came air, the atmosphere you rely on to breathe.
target: 接着，水淹没星球，浪拍着尚且年轻的海岸。有了水，就有植物；有了植物，就有空气，形成你赖以呼吸的大气。

source: And with air came wind, and on the wind came kites! The fifth element! Yeah, that's totally how it worked!
target: 有空气就有风，有风就有风筝！第五元素！对，百分之百就是这么回事！

source: You must channel the wild, unbridled spirit of those first ancient kites. Their magic fills your core, exploding from within!
target: 你要引导最早那些远古风筝，狂野不羁的精神！魔法充满内心，由内向外爆发！

source: Polly, what is %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% doing?
target: 波莉，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 在干什么？

source: Random martial arts poses and incoherent yelling, it looks like.
target: 看着像乱摆武术姿势，再加上胡乱大叫。

source: Oh... do you think %HESHE%%VERB_'S_'VE% noticed %HISHER% kite flew away on an updraft?
target: 哦……你觉得%HESHE%%VERB_'S_'VE%发现%HISHER%风筝被上升气流卷走了吗？
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): POLISH; 风筝被上升气流带走后追问玩家是否发现；完成体由了吗表达。 按行中文动词展开已实现；未实机验证。

source: Given that %HESHE% just dropped dramatically to %HISHER% knees and shouted "NOOO" for a minute straight, I'ma go with yes.
target: 看 %HESHE% 刚跪得那么夸张，%HISHER% 双膝一着地，就连喊了一分钟“不——”，我猜发现了。

source: HOW COULD YOUR NONSENSICAL PLAN HAVE GONE SO AWRY?! You lose -2 HYPE and -1 TOURNAMENT.
target: 这毫无道理的计划，怎么会出这么大的岔子？！你失去了 -2 热度和 -1 次锦标赛。

source: I can't believe it... you've defeated me, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, and brought shame upon my name.
target: 不敢相信……你赢了，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，令我名誉扫地。

source: It seemed that while my blade could slash your kite string, there was a stronger string all along that connected both our souls...
target: 我的刀虽能斩断你的筝线，可原来，你我灵魂之间，始终有条更坚韧的线……

source: Well done.
target: 干得漂亮。

source: Fuck yeah! You ascend to the Final Four. With your kite's new power, your victory should be assured!
target: 他妈的，爽！晋级四强！有风筝的新力量，胜利应该稳了！

source: YOUR DEFEAT IS ASSURED! For it is I, your next opponent: Sarth of the Cobra Kite!
target: 稳输才对！因为下个对手是我，眼镜蛇风筝的萨尔斯！

source: You already defeated Chiyo, my greatest rival... WHICH IS WHAT I WAS SUPPOSED TO DO! What the hell, bro?!
target: 你已经击败我最大的宿敌千代……可那本该由我来干！搞什么，兄弟？！

source: For failing to uphold the co-bro code of not getting in the middle of monogamous sworn rivalries, I'm afraid I need to take you out of the competition...
target: “蛇兄弟守则”说了，专属宿敌关系，不许第三者插足。你没遵守，只能把你淘汰了……

source: Sarth swerves his kite to crash into yours! You manage to dodge his attack; he's only able to leave a tiny scratch on your kite's surface.
target: 萨尔斯操纵风筝猛撞过来！你及时躲开，只让风筝表面擦出一道小伤。

source: Don't look so smug. I didn't need to crush you with force; I only needed to apply the secret Cobra Kite technique...
target: 别得意，用不着武力碾压你。我只需施展，眼镜蛇风筝的秘密招数……

source: I just grazed your kite with my venomous Kite Fangs! Your kite will never survive to see the end of the round! HAHAHA!
target: 刚才擦过你的，是我带毒的风筝獠牙！你的风筝，活不到这轮比赛结束！哈哈哈！

source: Wait, Sarth poisoned your kite?! THAT'S SOMETHING HE CAN DO?!?
target: 等等，萨尔斯给你的风筝下毒？！他还能干这个？！

source: You need to save your kite before it's too late!
target: 得赶在太迟之前，救下风筝！

source: Focus! This technique is just psychological warfare to make you lose your cool. Just remember kites don't have cardiovascular systems and thus they can't really get poisoned.
target: 冷静！那招不过是心理战，让你乱阵脚。风筝又没心血管系统，不可能中毒。

source: So he poisoned your kite? Then fight fire with fire: POUR GASOLINE ON HIS KITE AND SET IT ON FIRE!
target: 给你风筝下毒？那就以火攻毒：给他的风筝浇汽油，点了它！

source: You stay calm and keep flying your kite like normal. As expected, nothing bad happens to it.
target: 你不慌不忙，照常放风筝。果然，什么事也没有。

source: What's going on? Why isn't your kite succumbing to my deadly venom?!
target: 怎么回事？你的风筝，为什么没被我的致命毒液毒倒？！

source: Because kites don't have cardiovascular systems or blood or anything, dummy. Therefore, venom won't affect it.
target: 因为风筝没有心血管系统，没血什么的，笨蛋。毒液当然没用。

source: WHAT?! Is that true?!
target: 什么？！真的？！

source: ...Yes.
Holy shit. I can't believe it. I went all in on this venom technique for nothing!
target: 卧槽，不敢信。我钻研这套毒液招数，全白干了！

source: Fine, you win this round. But I'll be back next year, with non-venomous kiting techniques to defeat you in a head-to-head "cobrawl"!
target: 行，这轮算你赢。明年我会带着无毒的放风筝招数回来，跟你正面对决，来场“蛇式肉搏”！

source: Whatever! You just care about winning the tournament today!
target: 管他呢！你只想赢下今天的比赛！

source: Yeah, you can resist this psychological warfare by fighting back with total apathy! You'll keep flying your kite no matter what!
target: 对，彻底无动于衷，就能破解心理战！不管怎样，继续放风筝！

source: Whoa, you're not even going to try and give your kite antivenom or something? Don't you care about your kite?
target: 哇，连抗毒药什么的，都不给它试试？不在乎自己的风筝吗？

source: I can't believe that %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% would heartlessly let %HISHER% kite die of anaphylactic shock!
target: 不敢相信，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 居然能狠心让 %HISHER% 风筝，死于过敏性休克！

source: I came to this kite tournament to have a fun afternoon and shatter the spirits of my rivals, not watch negligent kite slaughter!
target: 我是来享受下午的比赛，粉碎对手意志的，不是来看你疏忽照料、杀害风筝的！

source: I guess today we've learned %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% would let ALL %HISHER% loved ones die from poison just to win this tournament.
target: 看来懂了，为赢这场比赛，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 能眼看着所有 %HISHER% 亲人被毒死。

source: %HESHE% may win the kite tournament... but %HESHE% %VERB_HAS_HAVE% lost the friendship tournament...
target: %HESHE%或许赢了风筝大赛……可%HESHE%%VERB_HAS_HAVE%输了友谊大赛……
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): POLISH; 此处 HAS_HAVE 是完成体而非拥有，输了已经表达。 按行中文动词展开已实现；未实机验证。

source: Noooo, now everyone's mad at you! You decide to forfeit so you can take your kite to the hospital.
target: 不——这下所有人都生你气了！你决定弃权，送风筝去医院。

source: You beg the doctor to save your kite from death by poison. He says, "Kites can't be poisoned. Why and how would that ever happen? Stop wasting my time."
target: 你求医生，救救快被毒死的风筝。他说：“风筝中不了毒。怎么可能，又为什么会这样？别浪费我的时间。”

source: HAHAHA! You fell for my "cobrainy" ruse! The true psychological warfare at work here was the poisonous influence of peer pressure!
target: 哈哈哈，被我的“蛇机妙算”骗到了吧！真正起作用的心理战，是同伴压力的毒害！

source: Ugh, did Sarth seriously come to the hospital just to gloat? What a "cobrastard"! You lose -2 MIND and -1 TOURNAMENT.
target: 唉，萨尔斯还专程跑医院炫耀？真是个“蛇混蛋”！你失去了 -2 头脑和 -1 次锦标赛。

source: Good thing you thought ahead and brought a can of lighter fluid. You chuck it at Sarth's kite and chase it with a lit match.
target: 还好有先见之明，带了一罐打火机油。你朝萨尔斯的风筝扔过去，紧跟着扔了根点着的火柴。

source: NOOOOOOOOO! You deduced my kite's greatest weakness! Poison-type kites are weak to fire!
target: 不——！竟然识破了我风筝最大的弱点！毒属性风筝，被火克制！

source: Uhh, I'm pretty sure ALL kites are weak to fire, poison or not. 'Cause they're, y'know, flammable?
target: 呃，风筝不管带不带毒，应该都怕火吧？毕竟它们……易燃？

source: Actually, the more correct word is "inflammable." The word "flammable" gained popularity because "inflammable" sounds like its opposite, but--
target: 其实，更准确是 inflammable，也就是“易燃”。后来大家更爱用 flammable，是因为 inflammable 听着像反义词，不过——

source: Who asked you, Chiyo?! You already lost the tournament; you don't need to butt into conversations to be a vocab-snob and feel smart!
target: 千代，谁问你了？！已经出局，就别插嘴卖弄词汇，装聪明了！

source: You defeated me, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%... my "cobrand" has been forever tainted. Please, plunge this poisonous fang into my chest and kill me with honor.
target: 你赢了，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%……我的“蛇家招牌”，永远蒙羞。请将这颗毒牙刺入我胸，让我光荣死去。

source: Uh... no? You're not gonna murder Sarth over a kite tournament, right?
target: 呃……算了吧？总不会为了风筝比赛，就把萨尔斯杀了，对吧？

source: Good thing you thought ahead and brought a can of lighter fluid. You're about to chuck it at Sarth's kite...
target: 还好有先见之明，带了一罐打火机油。你正准备朝萨尔斯的风筝扔……

source: "HEY!" shouts one of the tournament organizers. "What are you doing with that lighter fluid?!"
target: 一个赛事组织者大喊：“嘿！你拿打火机油干什么？！”

source: Uh... nothing?
target: 呃……没什么？

source: Were you about to pour lighter fluid all over my kite and set it on fire? What a needlessly "cobrutal" thing to do!
target: 刚想往我风筝上倒打火机油，再放火？何必这样“蛇分残忍”！

source: Yeah, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, that's bad sportsmanship! You can't solve all your problems by setting them on fire.
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，这可没体育精神！哪能所有问题，都靠点火解决。

source: But Damien does it all the time, and everybody loves him! He's the most popular character in this franchise!
target: 可德魔一直这么干，大家还爱他！他是这系列里，最受欢迎的角色！

source: So? Jeez, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, get your own thing for once.
target: 所以呢？天啊，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，能不能有一次，找点自己的特色。

source: The tournament organizer calls the police.
target: 赛事组织者报了警。

source: You know, we've been looking for a criminal who commits frequent acts of arson. This kid kinda fits the bill.
target: 一直在找那个经常纵火的犯人。这孩子，看着挺符合。

source: Yeah, the infamous "Spicy Red Adult", as he goes by.
target: 对，臭名昭著的“火辣红大人”，他自称的。

source: No, it's not me! You're looking for Damien! Arrest HIM!
target: 不，不是我！你们找的是德魔！抓他！

source: Nevertheless, they arrest YOU, and you definitely can't win this kite tournament from jail. You lose -2 HYPE and -1 TOURNAMENT.
target: 可警察还是把你抓了。关进牢里，肯定赢不了风筝赛。你失去了 -2 热度和 -1 次锦标赛。

source: And so, after two fierce fights, you make it to the final round of the tournament, where the best of the best compete and character arcs are dramatically completed.
target: 两场激战后，你闯进决赛。最强的对手，将在这里交锋，角色的成长故事，也将在这里壮烈收尾。

source: The stakes have never been higher!
target: 从没这么紧张过！

source: YOU'RE my final opponent? Seriously? I thought it'd at least be Sarth or Chiyo, not some total amateur.
target: 决赛对手是你？认真？以为起码是萨尔斯或者千代，怎么是个纯菜鸟。

source: Whatever, kicking your ass will be a total breeze! I'm F.J., COMMANDER OF WIND!
target: 算了，赢你不过一阵风。我是 F.J.，风之统帅！

source: The fuck? If F.J. can control the wind, and this is a kite tournament, isn't that basically cheating?
target: 什么鬼？F.J. 能控风，这又是风筝比赛，不就等于作弊？

source: Eh, not really; in an anime-style sports tournament, special powers and ultimate moves are all fair game.
target: 也不算。动漫式体育大赛，超能力和必杀技，都是规则内操作。

source: But F.J. has a reputation for sabotaging kites, bribing the judges, and using explosives to rig the competition... which are all definitely cheating.
target: 可 F.J. 出了名，会破坏风筝、贿赂评委，还拿炸药操纵比赛……这些绝对算作弊。

source: Don't look now, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, but it looks like SOMEBODY swapped your kite fabric for porcelain! Good luck winning now, rookie!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，别太吃惊，好像有“某个人”，把你的风筝面料换成瓷了！新手，这下祝你好运！

source: Oh no, porcelain is the worst kite material! It's so heavy and breakable!
target: 哦不，最不适合做风筝的，就是瓷！又重又脆！

source: Tch, typical F.J. And he wonders why his unofficial kiter nickname is "That Fucking Jerk".
target: 嘁，典型的 F.J.。还纳闷，别人为什么私下叫他“那个该死的混蛋”。

source: What a "cobrutal" twist! Surely there's no way %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% can come out of this one on top!
target: 多么“蛇分残忍”的转折！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，这下绝不可能翻盘了！

source: Maybe not, but you've come this far and aren't backing down now! You've still got one more trick up your sleeve...
target: 也许，可都到这一步，绝不退缩！你还藏着最后一招……

source: Your kite won't survive once you throw it to the skies, so you must aim to kill: throw your porcelain kite DIRECTLY into F.J.'s kite. A TRUE KAMIKAZE ATTACK!
target: 瓷风筝一抛上天，肯定保不住，干脆搏命：直接砸向 F.J. 的风筝。真正的神风特攻！

source: You still have a few minutes to go full engineer and bring your kite to its next evolutionary state: a kickass drone.
target: 还有几分钟，化身工程师，让风筝进化到下个阶段：酷炫无人机。

source: You set your sights, tense all your muscles, and throw your porcelain kite with THE STRENGTH OF A THOUSAND KITES!
target: 你瞄准目标，绷紧全身肌肉，使出千筝之力，把瓷风筝抛了出去！

source: Ha! How pathetic. What are you even trying to do? Your kite will obviously never fly!
target: 哈！可悲，你到底想干什么？这风筝，根本不可能飞！

source: "I know that," you say smugly. "But it's not about making the kite fly. It's about making it SLAY."
target: 你得意地说：“知道。可我不是要它飞，是要它杀出重围。”

source: CRASH!
target: 轰！

source: NANI?!
target: 纳尼？！

source: HOLY SHIT!
target: 卧槽！

source: WHOA!
target: 哇！

source: Both of your kites go down -- but in a photo-finish moment, your kite hits the ground a few seconds after F.J.'s, making you the technical winner!
target: 两只风筝双双坠落，可在必须回看画面才能分胜负的关键时刻，你的风筝晚了 F.J. 几秒落地。按规则，你赢了！

source: You did it, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. Finally, our years of training have come to fruition. I always knew you had it in you.
target: 做到了，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。多年训练，终于结出果实。早就知道，你能行。

source: I am... proud of you.
target: 我……为你骄傲。

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! YOU DID IT! You defeated F.J., effectively avenging the murder of your father!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！成功了！你打败 F.J.，终于为被害的父亲报仇了！

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, seeing you fight with such passion and finesse has made me realize that my feelings for you go beyond friendship...
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，看你带着如此热情与技巧战斗，才明白，我对你的感情，早已超越友谊……

source: Shoo, shoo! Go away, generic anime characters! Stop building random lore around %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 去去去！走开，量产动漫角色！别乱给 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 编背景故事。

source: Hey, fam, let's leave with the spoils of the battle before %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% gets sucked into a different piece of fiction.
target: 各位，趁 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 还没被吸进另一部作品，赶紧带着战利品走吧。

source: As you drive away, you see the face of your late father in the clouds, looking at you with approval.
target: 开车离开时，你看见已故父亲的面孔，浮现在云间，赞许地望着你。

source: What are you doing? No, stop! That's not your real father, just a generic anime dad. Ignore that cloud, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! Enough anime vibes for today!
target: 干什么？不，停！那不是你真爸爸，只是个量产动漫爹。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，别看那朵云！今天的动漫味，已经够了！

source: Eh, anyway: you leave with the +2 MONEY and +1 HYPE from the kite tournament. What a character arc!
target: 嗯，总之，风筝大赛带给你 +2 金钱和 +1 热度，满载而归。多么完整的成长故事！

source: You set your sights, tense all your muscles, and throw your porcelain kite with THE STRENGTH OF A THOUSAND KITES!
target: 你瞄准目标，绷紧全身肌肉，使出千筝之力，把瓷风筝抛了出去！

source: Sadly, you only manage to throw it about a foot in the air.
target: 可惜，只往上扔了一英尺。

source: HAHAHA! How pathetic! You lack the STAMINA necessary to give your porcelain kite any momentum at all!
target: 哈哈哈，可悲！体力根本不够，还想让瓷风筝飞起来？！

source: But... but I had the strength of a thousand kites...!
target: 可……我明明有千筝之力……！

source: So? Why would you try to harness "the strength of a thousand kites" anyway? Kites are designed to be lightweight and aerodynamic, dummy, not strong.
target: 所以呢？干吗要借“千筝之力”？风筝讲究轻巧、顺风，又不讲力气，笨蛋。

source: Oof, should've thought of that. You also shouldn't have thrown your kite straight up in the air, because when it comes crashing down, it hits you square in the head.
target: 唉，早该想到了。而且不该笔直往头顶扔，因为风筝掉下来，正好砸中你的脑袋。

source: You end up in the hospital to treat your concussion. Worse, you lose -2 STAMINA and -1 TOURNAMENT.
target: 你进医院治疗脑震荡。更糟的是，失去了 -2 体力和 -1 次锦标赛。

source: In the precious minutes before the final round starts, you bust ass in a technology-upgrade montage to save your kite.
target: 决赛前宝贵的几分钟，你拼命赶工，上演技术升级蒙太奇，挽救风筝。

source: Tch! What a sad last-ditch effort. Why are you even trying to do? That porcelain disaster will never fly!
target: 嘁，垂死挣扎。到底想干什么？那块瓷器灾难，根本飞不起来！

source: Oh, WON'T IT?!
target: 哦，是吗？！

source: You whip out your remote control and pilot your kite-drone into the air!
target: 你掏出遥控器，让风筝无人机飞上天！

source: NANI?!
target: 纳尼？！

source: HOLY SHIT!
target: 卧槽！

source: WHOA!
target: 哇！

source: Ha... haha... HAHAHAHA! What a weak twist! This isn't over! My kite ALSO has a final form!
target: 哈……哈哈……哈哈哈！这点反转？还没完！我的风筝，也有最终形态！

source: F.J. does some dramatic poses and screams at the top of his lungs. In a burst of blinding light, his regular kite transforms into...
target: F.J. 夸张地摆姿势，扯着嗓子嘶吼。刺目光芒爆发，普通风筝化作……

source: A bigger, stronger, weirder-looking kite?
target: 一只更大、更强、样子更奇怪的风筝？

source: BEHOLD! The Forbidden Kite Jutsu, FORM NINE! The most complex and undefeatable form in all of kiting!
target: 看好了！风筝禁术，第九式！风筝之道中，最复杂、最不可战胜的形态！

source: Meh, it's still a kite made of fabric no matter how many poses F.J. does. You shoot it down with your drone easily.
target: 嘁，姿势摆得再多，也还是布做的风筝。你的无人机，轻松把它打了下来。

source: NOOOOOOOOOO!
You did it, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. Finally our years of training have come to fruition. I always knew you had it in you.
target: 做到了，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。多年训练，终于结出果实。早就知道，你能行。

source: I am... proud of you.
target: 我……为你骄傲。

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! YOU DID IT! You defeated F.J., effectively avenging the murder of your father!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！成功了！你打败 F.J.，终于为被害的父亲报仇了！

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, seeing you fight with such passion and finesse has made me realize that my feelings for you go beyond friendship...
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，看你带着如此热情与技巧战斗，才明白，我对你的感情，早已超越友谊……

source: Shoo, shoo! Go away, generic anime characters! Stop building random lore around %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 去去去！走开，量产动漫角色！别乱给 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 编背景故事。

source: Hey, fam, let's leave with the spoils of the battle before %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% gets sucked into a different piece of fiction.
target: 各位，趁 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 还没被吸进另一部作品，赶紧带着战利品走吧。

source: As you drive away, you see the face of your late father in the clouds, looking at you with approval.
target: 开车离开时，你看见已故父亲的面孔，浮现在云间，赞许地望着你。

source: What are you doing? No, stop! That's not your real father, just a generic anime dad. Ignore that cloud, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! Enough anime vibes for today!
target: 干什么？不，停！那不是你真爸爸，只是个量产动漫爹。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，别看那朵云！今天的动漫味，已经够了！

source: Eh, anyway: you leave with the +2 MONEY +1 HYPE from the kite tournament. What a character arc!
target: 嗯，总之，风筝大赛带给你 +2 金钱、+1 热度，满载而归。多么完整的成长故事！

source: In the precious minutes before the final round starts, you bust ass in a technology-upgrade montage to save your kite.
target: 决赛前宝贵的几分钟，你拼命赶工，上演技术升级蒙太奇，挽救风筝。

source: Tch! What a sad last-ditch effort. Why are you even trying to do? That porcelain disaster will never fly!
target: 嘁，垂死挣扎。到底想干什么？那块瓷器灾难，根本飞不起来！

source: That's where he's wrong. You whip out your remote control and pilot your kite-drone into the air!
target: 他错了。你掏出遥控器，让风筝无人机飞上天！

source: What the -- is that a drone? Who the fuck do you think you are?! I'm a cheater, but at least I have some kiting self-respect!
target: 什——无人机？以为自己是谁？！我是作弊，可风筝手的自尊，好歹还有！

source: Indeed, what a crude and disgraceful attempt to perverse the noble art of kite-flying. Everyone knows drones are the antithesis of kites.
target: 没错，多么粗鄙无耻，竟敢玷污高贵的风筝艺术。谁都知道，无人机就是风筝的反面。

source: What a twist! %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% was the true tournament villain all along!
target: 好大反转！原来 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 才是这届比赛，真正的反派！

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, your disgusting techniques bring shame upon your family. You have no place on these hallowed kiting grounds!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，这恶心的招数，令家族蒙羞。神圣的风筝赛场，容不下你！

source: Yeah! Get that "cobrastard" OUT of here!
target: 对！把那个“蛇混蛋”赶出去！

source: The event organizers disqualify you. Apparently "don't turn your kite into a drone" is literally Rule #1.
target: 主办方取消了你的资格。原来第一条规矩，真就写着“不许把风筝改成无人机”。

source: It's such a serious thing that the police must escort you out of the tournament in handcuffs... for you have commited a crime against kiting!
target: 这事严重到，警察得给你戴上手铐，押你出场……因为，你犯下了反风筝罪！

source: You lose your peers' respect (not that they respected you much to begin with), -2 HYPE, and -1 TOURNAMENT.
target: 对手们的尊重没了，虽然本来也没多尊重，你还失去了 -2 热度和 -1 次锦标赛。

source: Coach a stranger
target: 给陌生人当教练

source: The tournament is still two days away, but lots of competitors are already here training.
target: 离比赛还有两天，可不少选手已经来练习了。

source: They're all hyper-intense, meditating and doing drills and monologuing about what winning the tournament means for their honor and shit.
target: 一个个认真得要命，冥想、特训，再长篇独白，说赢比赛关乎自己的荣誉什么的。

source: This is exciting! I've been to a lot of sports tournaments, but a kite tournament will be a first for me! What about you bros?
target: 好兴奋！参加过那么多运动赛，风筝赛还是头一回！兄弟们，你们呢？

source: Well, when are you ever going to pass up the opportunity to lie to your friends to seem cooler?
target: 能骗朋友，让自己显得酷一点的机会，你什么时候放过？

source: (No, seriously, when will you? It's getting old.)
target: 说真的，什么时候才肯放过？这套都玩腻了。

source: I was an avid kite-flying competitor back in my day. I even won several gold medals before I retired!
target: 想当年，我可热衷风筝竞技。退役前，还拿过好几块金牌！

source: Wait, you say you're a retired kite-flying champion? Do you think you could train me before the tournament?
target: 等等，你是退役风筝冠军？比赛前，能训练我吗？

source: I've always wanted to be the best kite-flyer in the world! But now that I'm here with all these actual professionals... I realize I'm a bit out of my depth.
target: 一直想当世界第一风筝手！可真站在这些专业选手旁边……才发现自己有点招架不住。

source: But with your expertise and my plucky underdog archetype, I could win this thing!
target: 不过，有你的经验，再加上我这百折不挠的黑马人设，肯定能赢！

source: Of course %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% will help you, bro! It'll be a great opportunity for %HIMHER% to put all %HISHER% kite knowledge to good use!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 当然会帮，兄弟！正好给 %HIMHER% 一个机会，把 %HISHER% 风筝知识全用上！

source: And taking on a protegé will prove once and for all whether %HESHE% was lying to us or not about being a kite-flying master! Right, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?
target: 收个徒弟，就能一锤定音，看看 %HESHE% 到底有没有在风筝大师这事上骗我们。对吧，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%？

source: ...Don't look at me, I'm not bailing you out of this one. You need to learn to stop digging yourself in these holes!
target: ……别看我，这次不救场。别老给自己挖坑，学着点！

source: Everyone's counting on you to turn this kid into a master kite-flyer in two days. How are you gonna do it?
target: 大家都指望你，两天内把这孩子教成风筝大师。怎么教？

source: Summon the mystical Emperor of Kites and make a blood pact to receive "The Blessing of the Kite."
target: 召唤神秘的风筝皇帝，订下血契，获得“风筝的祝福”。

source: The sad truth is that competitive kiting is less about anime-style training montages and more about learning proper physics.
target: 可惜，竞技风筝真要练好，靠的不是动漫式特训蒙太奇，而是正经学物理。

source: Using -N2 MAGIC, you draw the summoning circle and recite the ancient kite-flying incantation.
target: 你花 -N2 魔力，画出召唤阵，念起古老的风筝咒语。

source: An explosion of kites suddenly appears! When the kites have cleared, an ornate palankeen held by servants stands in the circle before you.
target: 无数风筝突然炸开般涌现！等它们散去，一顶华丽轿子，被仆人抬着，停在眼前的法阵里。

source: The servants lower the palankeen to the ground, and out steps the Emperor of Kites in all his colorful, nylon glory.
target: 仆人落轿，风筝皇帝走了出来，满身彩色尼龙，光彩夺目。

source: Howdy, Your Brojesty! We were wondering if you could help us with a problem.
target: 兄弟陛下，您好！我们有件事，想请您帮忙。

source: Yes, yes, you're commoners who want me to solve all their problems. Typical.
target: 对，对，又是平民，等着朕来解决所有问题。老一套。

source: If you two can't figure out who the real mother is, I'll just cut the baby in half and we can get this done by lunch. Chop, chop! Where's the baby?
target: 分不清谁是亲娘？朕把孩子劈两半，午饭前就能搞定。快快，孩子呢？

source: Hey, no! That's not what we need! We don't even have a baby!
target: 嘿，不是！不是这事！我们连孩子都没有！

source: Oh, you haven't had a baby yet? So you need a baby. This is one of those 'jus primae noctis' things, got it. Servants, disrobe me!
target: 哦，还没生孩子？那就是想要孩子。初夜权那种事，懂了。来人，给朕宽衣！

source: WHOOOOA, PUMP THE BRAKES! You don't need to fuck anyone; put your clothes back on!
target: 哇，打住！不用跟谁上床，衣服穿回去！

source: You want me to wear clothes? Ah, I see: you're a wealthy merchant who's woven magical, invisible clothes that only the intelligent can see. I'll try them on!
target: 要朕穿衣？懂了，你是富商，织出了只有聪明人能看见的神奇隐形衣。朕试试！

source: No, you're not listening! You're making this so complicated, when it's actually quite simple--
target: 不，你根本没听！明明很简单，非让你搞得这么复杂——

source: You think being an emperor is SIMPLE?! You'll learn your place! We shall swap clothes for a week and SEE whose life is harder!
target: 当皇帝简单？！让你长点见识！交换衣服一星期，看看谁日子更难！

source: Nobody can convince the emperor that this isn't the move. He trades clothes with your protegé and leaves to learn a valuable lesson about class disparity.
target: 谁也劝不动皇帝。他跟你的徒弟换了衣服，离开，去体验阶级差异的人生道理了。

source: Well THAT was irritating. Sorry you didn't get the emperor's blessing, boo.
target: 真够烦的。没拿到皇帝的祝福，抱歉啦，亲爱的。

source: No worries, this is even better! I wanted to be the best kite-flyer like no one ever was, and now I'm the EMPEROR OF KITES!
target: 没事，这更好！本来想当无人能及的最强风筝手，现在直接成风筝皇帝了！

source: Fuck it, whatever floats their boat. You gain +N2 SOUL for helping, and you live to lie about your expertises another day!
target: 管他呢，开心就好。帮了忙，你获得 +N2 灵魂；还没被戳穿，以后又能吹嘘自己是行家了！

source: You haul out the textbooks on the fundamentals of aerodynamics and momentum vs. inertia and get to work.
target: 你搬出教科书，学习空气动力学基础，还有动量与惯性的区别，正式开工。

source: Oh. This isn't really the training I had in mind...
target: 哦，这跟想象中的训练，不太一样……

source: Hey, you wanna win, right? Flying a kite isn't about action and having fun. This is SERIOUS. BUSINESS.
target: 嘿，想赢，对吧？放风筝不是打打闹闹，也不是找乐子。这是正经事。

source: Now turn to page 318 and study this diagram of the Coriolis Effect. There will be a quiz!
target: 翻到第三百一十八页，学学这张科里奥利效应示意图。要测验的！

source: Meanwhile, to your left, a kite-flying sensei is teaching his pupil to fly a kite up a waterfall.
target: 与此同时，左边有位风筝大师，在教弟子把风筝放上瀑布。

source: To your right, a devoted kite monk is in deep meditation, trying to connect to "the heart of the kite."
target: 右边，一个虔诚的风筝僧人，正深度冥想，尝试连接“风筝之心”。

source: Behind you, a kite-flying champion is teaching his protegé to "think like a kite!" They're running around with their arms out, making wind noises.
target: 后方，一位风筝冠军教弟子“像风筝一样思考”。他们张着胳膊跑来跑去，嘴里呼呼刮风。

source: Up ahead, a seasoned kite-flyer is busy teaching his student to fly his kite with weights attached, even if that goes against all buoyancy principles.
target: 前方，一位资深风筝手，正教徒弟给风筝绑配重，完全不管浮力原理。

source: You lose -N2 HYPE with your obviously-less-cool training techniques, but when the tournament comes along...
target: 训练方法明显不够酷，你失去了 -N2 热度。不过，等比赛开始……

source: Wow, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, your protegé won by a landslide. Like, such a big lead it looked like nobody else was even competing!
target: 哇，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你徒弟赢得也太轻松了。领先那么多，看着都像没别人参赛！

source: "I meditated the whole time, but I still lost!" the monk sobs. "Why didn't the monastery tell me I couldn't pilot the kite with my mind?!"
target: 僧人哭道：“从头冥想到尾，还是输了！寺里怎么不告诉我，用意念控制不了风筝？！”

source: "I was the most convincing kite I could be," the student who pretended to be a kite sighs. "But no matter how hard I tried, I couldn't soar through the wind on a string."
target: 那个装风筝的学生叹道：“我扮得已经再像不过了。可不管怎么试，还是做不到拴根线，就在风里高飞。”

source: Thank you, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! I thought your methods were stupid at first, but I guess hard work and studying actually do make a difference!
target: 谢谢，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！开始觉得方法挺蠢，可努力和学习，原来真有用！

source: Who'd've thought? You gain +N2 SOUL for being a good coach!
target: 谁能想到呢？当了好教练，你获得 +N2 灵魂！

source: Place your bets
target: 下注

source: It's about a half hour before the tournament starts, and you find a crowd secretively placing bets on who they think will win.
target: 离开赛约半小时，你发现一群人在偷偷下注，赌谁会赢。

source: Hey, strangers. I'm looking to get into the underground gambling scene. Who's everybody betting on?
target: 嘿，各位。我也想参加地下赌局，大家押谁？

source: "I'm putting my money on Chiyo, the Lonesome Kite." says one gambler. "He's a master swordsman!"
target: 一个赌徒说：“我押千代，孤独之筝。他是剑术大师！”

source: What does being a swordsman have to do with being a good kite-flyer?
target: 剑术高，跟风筝放得好，有什么关系？

source: Actually, both sports require you to train your fluidity, aerodynamicism, precise motions, pose-holding, upper-arm strength...
target: 其实，两项运动都得练动作流畅、减少风阻、精确发力、保持姿势，还有上臂力量……

source: Whoa, Scott, you truly are the sports expert here... should I put my money on Chiyo, then?
target: 哇，斯科特，你才是运动专家……那押千代？

source: Wait, you wanna gamble? Isn't betting on a sports tournament illegal?
target: 等等，你想赌博？体育比赛下注，不是违法吗？

source: Uh... would you believe me if I said no?
target: 呃……我说不违法，你信吗？

source: Sure!
target: 当然！

source: Then it's not!
target: 那就不违法！

source: Okay! Well, I wouldn't bet on Chiyo...
target: 好！不过，我可不押千代……

source: If I had to pick, I would narrow it down to these two competitors... I'd say one of them will win the tournament for sure.
target: 真要选，会锁定这两个选手……他俩里面，肯定有一个赢。

source: Sweet! Then let's bet on... hmmm...
target: 爽，那押……嗯……

source: The Kite Knight: valiant kite hero; favorite of the masses; predictable winner of all this.
target: 风筝骑士：英勇的风筝英雄，观众最爱，毫无悬念的赢家。

source: F.J., the bastard who literally controls wind. Cheating is just a shortcut to winning!
target: F.J.，真能控风的混蛋。作弊，不过是赢比赛的捷径！

source: The tournament starts, and the Kite Knight takes the stage and addresses the crowd.
target: 比赛开始，风筝骑士上台，对观众致意。

source: I dedicate my competition today to my mother. If I win, I'll use my prize money to pay for her life-saving medical procedures!
target: 今天的比赛，献给我的母亲。赢了，就用奖金付她救命的手术费！

source: Go Kite Knight! Your plucky optimism and tragic backstory tug on my heartstrings and make you easy to root for!
target: 风筝骑士，加油！你那顽强乐观的精神，和悲惨身世，狠狠揪住我的心，不支持都不行！

source: Unfortunately, the Kite Knight is paired to fight her sworn nemesis... the Kite Knightmare!
target: 可惜，她抽到的对手，正是宿敌……风筝梦魇骑士！

source: So we meet again, Kite Knightmare. I know we've been kite-flying rivals ever since we were kids, but I hope we can put that behind us.
target: 又见面了，风筝梦魇骑士。从小就是风筝场上的对手，可希望能放下过去的恩怨。

source: Of course. I promise a fair fight, with no sudden betrayals.
target: 当然，保证公平比赛，绝不突然背叛。

source: ...said Kite Knightmare, while crossing his fingers behind his back.
target: 风筝梦魇骑士这样说着，却在背后交叉手指，偷偷作废誓言。

source: Five minutes later...
target: 五分钟后……

source: Kite Knightmare, you fiend! How dare you sabotage my kite right before the big match!
target: 风筝梦魇骑士，你这恶徒！大战在即，竟敢破坏我的风筝！

source: Nooo! There's no way Kite Knight can win now!

target: [未使用地点：神要来了]。

target: 开车时，你琢磨下个地点会是什么……总归不会是“神要来了”。

target: [废弃点子：《Monster Roadtrip》发生在米兰达已死的时间线。完成一条剧情线后，揭露这个重大反转]。

target: [开发备注：MMODS 版《Monster Prom》中，玩家在怪物学校里，互相谈恋爱]。

target: [开发备注：不告诉玩家，NPC 实际上都是其他玩家。这样，大家就会夸文案的“角色极其真实”]。

target: 波莉……我是被玩家控制的角色吗？

target: 剧情越来越复杂了！

source: Whoa, are there any more?
target: 哇，还有吗？

source: Yes!
target: 有！

target: [开发备注：“知情”玩家集结在“特里的后宫”名下，似乎通过给游戏写好评，留下“反抗”信息，互相联系]。

target: [开发备注：他们似乎认定，我们舍不得删除好评，就没法掩盖真相。尽管如此，仍须留意可疑好评]。

target: 几乎一句也没听懂，不过至少听着够带劲，值 +N2 热度！

target: 挖出来很多东西，可总觉得，够劲爆吗……

target: 又一条……

target: [未使用地点：神要来了]。

source: Eh.

target: [已取消的<灵魂>目的地：天堂]。

target: 不够秘密。

target: [玩家共同管理一副牌，使用、交换卡牌，尽量避免游戏结束]。

source: Hmmm... nah, keep digging.
target: 嗯……不行，再挖。

source: In the middle of the night, covered in dirt and sweat, you find a .txt file glowing with a most mysterious light...
target: 深夜，你浑身泥汗，找到一个 .txt 文件，闪着无比神秘的光……

target: [已移除搭车客：达丽雅，但[内容已删去]。请从游戏最终版本中移除]。

target: [移除原因：前作里，这个反转不够受欢迎。没有理由再搬回来。埋掉……永远]。

target: [开发备注：为必要时取回内容，已启动保险机制]。

target: 跟旁白去跑别的场子

target: 嘿，是那个负责旁白的兄弟！

source: Why do you do that, though? It's a bit weird.
target: 可为什么要做旁白？有点怪。

source: Well, for the audience!
target: 为了观众啊！

source: ...The audience?

source: It's hard to explain...
target: 难解释……

target: 在你们的现实里，我甚至不属于正史，只是个叙事手段……一个旁白！

target: 要不要一起，去我担任旁白的其他游戏里逛逛？

target: 我是说，也没什么可选。刚刚已经选了这个行动。

target: 《多元宇宙英雄》：传奇史诗，各个宇宙的人物联手，试图阻止终极熵增。

target: 《李姆舞会》：像《Monster Prom》，可所有人都是李姆。

target: 穿越游戏花掉 -N2 魔力，不过很快，你们就抵达另一部作品。

source: Hello? I can hear my voice, but I'm... nowhere?
target: 有人吗？能听见自己的声音，可我……哪儿都不在？

source: Oh, yes. You're not canon here, just like me. We're narrators in this game.
target: 哦对，你们跟我一样，不属于这里的正史。在这游戏里，咱们都是旁白。

target: 那这个“游戏”讲什么？

target: 不同时间线的人物联手，乘坐一艘能穿越多元宇宙的载具，四处旅行。

source: Their mission is to find a way to stop powerful old deities who plot to end all reality.
target: 他们的任务，是阻止一群想终结所有现实的强大古老神祇。

source: But...
Shhh, the characters are here!

target: 听着，惊悚学院有点不对劲……

target: 废话，那儿就是一锅他妈的乱炖。

source: No, I don't mean that.

target: 那么多时间线的毁灭，都从那所学校开始，不觉得奇怪吗？

source: I'm telling you, something doesn't add up.
target: 说真的，有些地方对不上。

source: Hmmm... it IS really suspicious that one random school brings together so many relevant pieces...
target: 嗯……随便一所学校，聚齐这么多关键人物，确实可疑……

source: ...both Hell and Merkingdom royalty; the Coven; a former Dark Lord...
target: ……地狱和人鱼王国的王族，女巫会，还有前黑暗领主……

source: I think it's no coincidence... something -- or someone -- is pulling the strings... but what for?
target: 恐怕不是巧合。有东西，或者有人，在幕后操控……可为了什么？

target: 该告诉船长。一直只顾寻找真之力碎片，可惊悚学院也绝不能忽视……

source: ...it might not be as harmless as it looks...
target: ……那里也许没看着那么无害……

source: You two! What are you doing?
target: 你们两个！干什么呢？

target: 刚进入另一条被 Z'Gord 毁掉的时间线，引擎室就过热了！

source: We might not be able to get out of here anytime soon. We need to be ready in case Z'Gord senses our arrival!
target: 恐怕一时出不去。得准备好，万一 Z'Gord 察觉我们来了！

source: FUCK!
target: 操！

source: Wait! What's that they were saying about Spooky Academy? It sounded serious!
target: 等等！他们刚说惊悚学院什么？听着很严重！

source: No spoilers!
target: 不准剧透！

source: Just take this +N2 HYPE from all the epicness of this game and let's go back to Monster Roadtrip.
target: 这游戏的史诗场面，让你赚了 +N2 热度。拿上，回《Monster Roadtrip》吧。

target: 对了，得抹掉你们的记忆。每次让角色意识到自己是虚构的，最后准出事。

source: What?!
target: 什么？

source: And so you go back to playing "Monster Roadtrip", and you have zero questions about Spooky Academy because that shit might not even be canon here... who knows?
target: 于是，继续玩《Monster Roadtrip》。对惊悚学院，你什么疑问也没有，毕竟那堆事，没准都不算这里的正史……谁知道？

source: Travelling through games requires some -N2 MAGIC, but soon you land in this other title.
target: 穿越游戏花掉 -N2 魔力，不过很快，你们就抵达另一部作品。

source: Hello? I can hear my voice, but I'm... nowhere?
target: 有人吗？能听见自己的声音，可我……哪儿都不在？

source: Oh, yes. You're not canon here, just like me. We're narrators in this game.
target: 哦对，你们跟我一样，不属于这里的正史。在这游戏里，咱们都是旁白。

source: What's this "game" about, then?
target: 那这个“游戏”讲什么？

source: Well, it's similar to your misadventures in Spooky Academy as the Monster Prom drew near...
target: 跟你们在惊悚学院，临近魔物舞会时，经历的胡闹差不多……

target: ……可这里是李姆学院，所有人都是李姆。玩家竞争的，是最受欢迎的某个李姆的心。

source: Everyone... is... Liam? I guess this is the sort of option that makes us gain MIND, isn't it?
target: 所有人……都是……李姆？这选项，应该是涨头脑的那个吧？

source: Yes. Here, have your +N2 MIND already; now shhh, lemme do my job...
target: 对，拿上你的 +N2 头脑，嘘，让我干活……

target: 而我们，尚未经历终极挑战：李姆舞会。

target: 记得清楚，只剩三个星期……

target: ……幻想着梦中的舞会伴侣，大家争相吸引四个最有魅力的同学之一：

target: 阴郁未来李姆（4XX 岁），过分严肃冷漠，满载黑暗反乌托邦未来的悲怆。

target: 被迫成名李姆（4XX 岁），少女漫画般的李姆，因为惊人的艺术天赋，不得不承受自己并不想要的名气。

source: Li'l Bastard Liam (4XX), a small, floating Liam who encapsulated all the sass and sarcasm that's so classic of Liam. The most annoying of all Liams!
target: 小混蛋李姆（4XX 岁），小小的，飘在空中，集李姆招牌式的刻薄和讽刺于一身。所有李姆里，最烦的那个！

source: And Buff Liam (4XX), who was Liam, but buff!
target: 还有肌肉李姆（4XX 岁），就是李姆，可有肌肉！

source: It was clear: it had to be one of them... but who?
target: 显然，只能选一个……可选谁？

target: 只有三个星期选舞会伴侣。更吓人的是，也只有三个星期追求他们，赢下他们的心！

target: 可就像说过的，我们年轻，无所畏惧……也准备好开始了。

source: But... fuck, now I can't help but wonder: which Liam would I try to romance?
target: 可……妈的，这下真忍不住想，该攻略哪个李姆？

target: 还有三星期，慢慢想！

target: 后来，带你们回《Monster Roadtrip》，再顺手抹掉记忆……

target: ……因为每次让角色意识到自己是虚构的，最后总会出事。

source: Now, please, proceed with your game.
target: 现在，请继续游戏。

source: It might not be nice; but dang if it's not fun!
target: 可能不好，可他妈真好玩！

target: 小斯，俗话说，别恨玩家，要恨就恨游戏！

target: 哦，好！

source: And always remember: until you learn to suppress it, always trust your gag reflex!
target: 记好了：还没学会压住呕吐反射之前，听它的准没错！

source: C'ya!
target: 回见！

source: And so, she leaves, bouncing her juicy turnip ass. Look at her go!
target: 于是她扭着多汁的芜菁屁股，走了。瞧这风姿！

source: You're savoring the road as you drive, but suddenly you see none other than the coolest person ever...
target: 你们开车，享受旅途，突然看见了那位史上最酷的人……

source: Heyaaaaaaaaaaaaa!
Patricia, gurl, what have you been up to?
target: 帕特丽夏，姐妹，最近忙啥？

source: I went to Paris last week!
target: 上周去巴黎了！

source: Oh, the city of love!
target: 哦，爱之城！

source: More like the city of "eating ass", amirite?
target: 不如说是“舔屁股之城”，对不对？

source: You know it, gurl!
target: 懂你，姐妹！

source: What a place to visit! So much culture, such great cuisine...
target: 那地方真值得去！文化丰富，美食一流……

source: I may or may not have eaten some tasty baguettes, if you get me!
target: 至于有没有吃到美味法棍嘛……懂的吧！

source: I do! Baguettes are tasty!
target: 懂！法棍很好吃！

source: (It's code for cocks, Scott; she's saying she ate some dick.)
target: （暗指鸡巴，斯科特。她说的是吃屌。）

source: Ooooooh! That's good too!
target: 哦——！那也不错！

source: You betcha, Scotty Boy!
target: 当然，小斯！

source: It was chef's kiss! Hours of om nom nom! The finest of ooh-la-las!
target: 绝了，厨师都得亲手指！啊呜啊呜几个钟头，顶级的“哦啦啦”！

source: Anyway, my prankster accomplices, Patricia's gotta go! So much more world to see and taste!
target: 总之，恶作剧搭子们，帕特丽夏得走了！还有那么多世界，等着去看、去尝！

source: Arrivederci!
target: 再会！

source: Ah... a woman of the world...
target: 啊……见过世面的女人……

source: You all watch Patricia vanish over the horizon... arrivederci!
target: 你们望着帕特丽夏，消失在地平线那边……再会！

source: Ah, the desert: a sea of rocks, cacti and... wait! Who's that there on the side of the road? Isn't that...?
target: 啊，沙漠，满眼岩石、仙人掌，还有……等等！路边是谁？那不是……？

source: PATRICIA!
target: 帕特丽夏！

source: YAAASSSS, it's me, Patricia, the official/unofficial mascot of the Prank Masterz!
target: 好耶，就是我，帕特丽夏，恶作剧大师的官方斜杠非官方吉祥物！

source: With a Z!
target: 带 Z 的！

source: You know it, Scott!
target: 斯科特，你懂的！

source: Tell us what's new with Patricia!
target: 帕特丽夏，又有什么新鲜事？

source: Well, I've been seeing someone lately...
target: 嗯，最近在跟谁约会……

source: NO WAY!
target: 不会吧！

source: Yeah, it's a handsome, tall bunch of turnips...
target: 对，一束又高又帅的芜菁……

source: A Turnip Boyfriend?!
target: 芜菁男朋友？！

source: Whoa, let's not get ahead of ourselves! Let's call it a Turnip Fuckbuddy for now.
target: 哇，别急着定性！目前，叫芜菁炮友就好。

source: Valid!
target: 有道理！

source: Imagine that! Patricia settling down!
target: 想想，帕特丽夏竟然要安定下来了！

source: What a twist that would be... after all the hilarious misadventures we've lived together... remember?
target: 那可是大反转……毕竟咱们一起，经历过那么多搞笑冒险……记得吧？

source: You don't, but sure.
target: 你不记得，不过就当记得。

source: Anyway, I gotta leave now. I need to keep spreading my sass and style across the world. C'ya!
target: 总之，得走了。还得把我的泼辣和范儿，传遍世界。回见！

source: And so, she leaves. Look at Patricia, going through true character growth. Good for her!
target: 于是，她离开了。瞧帕特丽夏，真有了角色成长。挺好！

source: You are driving pleasantly through the desert when... SOMEONE SUPER COOL SUDDENLY APPEARS!
target: 你愉快地开车穿过沙漠，突然……有个超级酷的人，出现了！

source: Polly, Scott? Is that you? It's me, Patricia! The official/unofficial mascot of the Prank Masterz!
target: 波莉，斯科特？是你们吗？我是帕特丽夏！恶作剧大师的官方斜杠非官方吉祥物！

source: With a Z!
target: 带 Z 的！

source: You know it, Scott!
target: 斯科特，你懂的！

source: So good to see you, girl! Any new misadventures or cool pranks lately?
target: 姐妹，见到你真好！最近有什么新冒险，或者酷炫恶作剧？

source: Now that you mention it... I'm in the middle of a super hilarious prank!
target: 说起这个……我正干个超级好笑的恶作剧！

source: Do tell!
target: 说来听听！

source: Well, I stole this dude's credit card, and I am buying all sorts of shit with it!
target: 偷了个家伙的信用卡，现在正用来买各种破玩意儿！

source: Haha... classic!
target: 哈哈……经典！

source: Check out my new purse! It looks like a vagina!
target: 看我的新手袋！长得像阴道！

source: Fancy!
target: 高级！

source: Yeah... it's like... very "girl power"; but at the same time it's also super chic too? Like $3,000 worth of chic!
target: 对……很有“女性力量”，又特别时髦，懂吧？三千美元那么时髦！

source: Ahh, you ooze good taste, Patricia.
target: 啊，帕特丽夏，好品位都满得往外冒了。

source: I do... it's my blessing and my curse... but mostly my blessing.
target: 是啊……既是福气，也是诅咒……不过，主要是福气。

source: Anyway, I gotta go! I've got a lot of credit to spend before that guy realizes I stole his card!
target: 总之，得走了！趁那家伙发现卡丢了，还有好多额度得花！

source: Imagine his face once he does! Haha... pranked!
target: 想想他发现时的脸！哈哈，上当了吧！

source: Gotta live the Prank Masterz life!
target: 恶作剧大师，就得这么活！

source: And so, she leaves. Ah, that Patricia... what a prankster!
target: 于是，她离开了。唉，帕特丽夏……真会整人！

source: You're driving along when you hear the clip-clop of hooves catching up to your car.
target: 你们正开着车，身后突然传来哒哒的马蹄声，离车子越来越近。

source: What the... is that a little orc riding a horse?
target: 什么鬼……那是个骑马的小兽人吗？

source: Oh no, not this fuckin' guy...
target: 不是吧，又是这混蛋……

source: WASHING MACHINE DAHLIA! WE MEET AGAIN!
target: 洗衣机达丽雅！我们又见面了！

source: The little orc whips out a crossbow and shoots at Dahlia!
target: 小兽人掏出一把弩，朝达丽雅射去！

source: But shooting a crossbow on horseback at a washing machine in a moving vehicle must be harder than it looks, 'cause he hits you instead. You lose -N2 STAMINA.
target: 不过，骑着马射中行驶车辆里的洗衣机，显然比看上去难多了。他射中的反而是你。你损失了 -N2 体力。

source: Ugh, seriously %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? We JUST got all the bloodstains out of the upholstery.
target: 不是吧，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%？我们才刚把座椅上的血渍全洗干净！

source: Why are you here, Gobbo?! You and I settled our debt, fair and square!
target: 戈博，你来干什么？！咱俩的账早就公平公正地两清了！

source: NO WE DID NOT! You promised to do my laundry if I gave you my favorite axe...
target: 才没有！你答应过，只要我把最喜欢的斧子给你，你就替我洗衣服……

source: ...but yesterday, when I was folding my clothes, I realized I was missing a sock! YOU TOOK IT!
target: ……可我昨天叠衣服时，发现少了一只袜子！是你拿走的！

source: I did not TAKE it; I LOST it. Not every sock makes it back from the battlefield... that's just the harsh reality of laundry, Gobbo.
target: 我没拿，我是把它弄丢了。不是每只袜子都能活着从战场回来……洗衣服就是这么残酷，戈博。

source: And why does it matter, anyway? I did a subpar washing job in exchange for your subpar axe. That means we're even.
target: 再说，这有什么好计较的？我洗得不怎么样，你那斧子也不怎么样。这不就扯平了？

source: MY AXE WAS NOT SUBPAR! IT WAS WAY ABOVE PAR!
target: 我的斧子才不是不怎么样！它好得很！

source: Was not! The grip was bad. I can't even hold it right!
target: 才没有！握柄烂透了，我连握都握不稳！

source: YOU CAN'T HOLD ANYTHING! YOU'RE A FUCKING WASHING MACHINE!
target: 你什么都握不住！你他妈是台洗衣机！

source: GIVE ME BACK MY SOCK!
target: 把袜子还给我！

source: NO!
target: 不还！

source: THEN GIVE ME BACK MY AXE!
target: 那就把斧子还给我！

source: ALSO NO!
target: 也不还！

source: You don't have all day to let Dahlia argue about this; you're kinda bleeding out. If the orc won't leave empty-handed, then maybe you can give him...
target: 你可没一整天陪达丽雅吵架，毕竟你的血都快流干了。既然兽人不肯空手走人，不如送他……

source: One free ride inside Dahlia's rinse cycle
target: 免费钻进达丽雅体内，体验一轮漂洗。

source: A hug
target: 一个拥抱。

source: Hmm... is that, like, a fun thing?
target: 唔……这个很好玩吗？

source: Totally, bro! I'd try it if I could fit in there!
target: 当然啦，兄弟！我要是钻得进去，肯定也想试试！

source: Eh... are you sure you don't just wanna give me my axe back and call it a day?
target: 呃……要不你还是把斧子还我，这事就算了？

source: Look, dude: we get it, Dahlia lost your sock. But last time I checked, socks weren't made of gold. They're just lame foot-shaped pieces of fabric.
target: 听着，哥们，我们知道达丽雅弄丢了你的袜子。可袜子又不是金子做的，不就是块长得像脚的破布吗。

source: So we're just gonna repay you with a rinse cycle and call it even, yeah?
target: 所以赔你一轮漂洗，咱们就两清，好吧？

source: Without waiting for an answer, Polly plucks the little orc off his horse and throws him into Dahlia's drum.
target: 没等他回答，波莉就把小兽人从马上拎起来，扔进达丽雅的滚筒。

source: GET RINSED!
target: 给老娘好好涮涮！

source: Dahlia starts laundering the FUCK out of that orc.
target: 达丽雅开足马力，把那兽人往死里洗。

source: Hey, you were right! All this spinning IS kinda fun! Wheee!
target: 嘿，还真让你说中了！转来转去挺好玩的！呜呼！

source: That's great, bro! What's it like in there?
target: 太棒了，兄弟！里面是什么感觉？

source: No response from the little orc. The water in Dahlia's drum starts to turn red.
target: 小兽人没有回答。达丽雅滚筒里的水开始变红。

source: You still having fun in there, little buddy? It's hard to tell when you're not yelling about it specifically!
target: 小家伙，你还玩得开心吗？你不大声喊出来，我很难判断啊！

source: DING!
target: 叮！

source: Dahlia opens her door, spilling soggy blood and guts everywhere.
target: 达丽雅打开舱门，泡得湿淋淋的血肉内脏洒了一地。

source: ...This car will never be clean again, will it?
target: ……这车是不是再也洗不干净了？

source: WHAAAAT?! Where'd the little orc go?!
target: 什么？！小兽人去哪儿了？！

source: Uh... no idea. I guess he, uh... went away.
target: 呃……不知道。他大概，呃……走了吧。

source: You mean he disappeared, just like his sock? THE PLOT THICKENS!
target: 你是说，他跟袜子一样凭空消失了？案情越来越扑朔迷离了！

source: Well, that happened. At least you gained +N2 HYPE for giving Gobbo the fun, free ride!
target: 好吧，事情就是这样。至少你让戈博免费玩了一趟刺激的，获得 +N2 热度！

source: A hug?
target: 一个拥抱？

source: Yeah! You'll love it! I'm a really buff hugger!
target: 对啊！你肯定喜欢！我的拥抱可有肌肉了！
