source: It's true! That's what Coach says biceps are for: hugging your friends as hard as you can!
target: 真的！教练说了，练二头肌就是为了尽全力抱紧朋友！

source: Eh... okay, fine. I'll take a hug.
target: 呃……好吧，行。那就抱一下。

source: MOST EXCELLENT! One full-body hug from Dahlia, coming right up!
target: 好极了！达丽雅的全身拥抱，马上送到！

source: Dahlia launches all 250 pounds of her steel washing machine body at the orc.
target: 达丽雅把自己那足有 250 磅重的钢铁洗衣机身躯，整个扑向兽人。

source: They fall flat on the road. You see Dahlia lying there... and a single crushed orc arm poking out from under her.
target: 两人重重摔在路上。达丽雅趴在那里……身下只露出一条被压扁的兽人胳膊。

source: ...Let's leave and never speak of this again.
target: ……咱们走吧，这事谁也别再提。

source: And so you do! You gain +N2 SOUL, 'cause it's the intention of the hug that matters.
target: 于是你们照做了！你获得 +N2 灵魂，毕竟拥抱这种事，心意到了就好。

source: You and your friends are driving quietly along the highway... well, it's quiet if you ignore Polly loudly groaning, anyway.
target: 你和朋友们静静地行驶在公路上……只要忽略波莉那一声声响亮的哀嚎，确实挺安静。

source: Uggghhh, are we there yet? I'm so bored!
target: 呃啊——还没到吗？无聊死了！

source: Me too. Wanna play a game while we drive? We could play I Spy.
target: 我也是。要不边开车边玩点什么？比如“我看见了”猜东西游戏。

source: Okay, I'll start. I spy with my little eye... something brown, hairy, and handsome!
target: 好，我先来。看一看，猜一猜……什么东西是棕色的、毛茸茸的，还特别帅？

source: ...Is it you? Did you spy yourself?
target: ……你自己？你看见你自己了？

source: Close! I spied the guy in my rearview mirror. He's always there, watching over me while I drive and giving me a thumbs up!
target: 差一点！我看见的是后视镜里的那哥们。我开车时他一直陪着我，还冲我竖大拇指呢！

source: Uh... sure. I won the round, so it's my turn now.
target: 呃……行吧。这轮我赢了，接下来轮到我。

source: I spy with my little eye something that starts with... "I."
target: 看一看，猜一猜……什么东西的英文是以“I”开头的？

source: Okay, that's a genuine challenge. You look out the window to see what Polly might've spied...
target: 好吧，这下真有难度了。你望向窗外，猜波莉究竟看见了什么……

source: Ooh, maybe it's that!
target: 哦，会不会是那个！

source: The lizard? But "lizard" doesn't start with an I... does it?
target: 那只蜥蜴？可蜥蜴的英文 lizard 不是以 I 开头的吧……是吗？

source: Then is it that thing?
target: 那是那个东西吗？

source: Hmmm, I don't think so. That's just a weird-looking house.
target: 唔，应该不是。那就是栋长得怪怪的房子。

source: Then maybe it's that guy!
target: 那难道是那个人！

source: The Sicilian? What does he have to do with the letter I?
target: 那个西西里人？他跟字母 I 有什么关系？

source: I think he's Florentine, actually.
target: 其实我觉得他是佛罗伦萨人。

source: Man, this is impossible! You need to think outside the box. What did Polly spy with her little eye?
target: 天哪，这怎么猜得出来！得换个思路了。波莉到底看见了什么？

source: An... Invisible... Something?
target: 某种……隐形的……东西？隐形，Invisible！

source: The road. But not this road. More like... the Idea of "the Road."
target: 路。但不是眼前这条路，而是……“路”这个概念，Idea！

source: Okay, an invisible what?
target: 好吧，隐形的什么？

source: No idea. You use -N2 MAGIC to cast a spell that lets you see beyond regular light wavelengths.
target: 你也不知道。你消耗 -N2 魔力，施法让自己能看见普通光线之外的波长。

source: Infrared, ultraviolet, gamma waves, the color "shmorange" -- they're all suddenly visible before your very eyes!
target: 红外线、紫外线、伽马射线，还有一种叫“什橙色”的颜色——全都突然出现在你眼前！

source: Awesome! What do you see, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?
target: 酷！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你看见什么了？

source: Well, I see that someone's been having sex in the back seat of this car... gross.
target: 呃，我看出有人在这辆车的后座上做过爱……真恶心。

source: Oops, my bad. I'll put a towel down next time.
target: 哎呀，我的锅。下次我会垫条毛巾的。

source: You can see where the seams of the Monster Realm and the Human Realm overlap. You're surrounded by humans that are operating on another plane of existence.
target: 你能看见怪物世界与人类世界交叠的缝隙。周围到处都是人类，在另一个存在层面上生活着。

source: You're also surrounded by ethereal, otherworldly creatures floating around in God-knows-which other realms.
target: 你身边还飘着缥缈的异界生物，天知道它们来自哪些世界。

source: You notice a group of invisible insectoids on the side of the road. They seem sinister, like they're plotting something... something against you, maybe?
target: 你发现路边聚着一群隐形的虫人。它们看上去阴森森的，似乎在密谋着什么……该不会是要对付你吧？

source: Is it the invisible, off-putting insectoids?
target: 是那群隐形的、看着就瘆人的虫人吗？

source: Yup, you got it, boo! Though I would've also accepted "iguana" as the correct answer.
target: 答对啦，宝！不过你要是答“鬣蜥，iguana”，我也算你对。

source: Ohhhh, so that lizard DID start with an I! Sorry I talked you out of it, bro.
target: 哦——原来那蜥蜴真是 I 开头的！抱歉，兄弟，我还劝你别选它来着。

source: How did you see those creepy, invisible bug-people in the first place?
target: 可你一开始是怎么看见那些隐形的恐怖虫人的？

source: Cause I have ghost powers... or I'm just hallucinating 'cause these weird roots I took finally kicked in. Hard to tell, really.
target: 我有幽灵超能力嘛……也可能是吃下去的怪树根终于起效，让我看见幻觉了。真不好说。

source: Cause I have ghost powers... or I'm just hallucinating 'cause these super shrooms finally kicked in. Hard to tell, really.
target: 我有幽灵超能力嘛……也可能是吃下去的超级蘑菇终于起效，让我看见幻觉了。真不好说。

source: ...Okay, whatever. Take +N2 HYPE for winning I Spy!
target: ……行吧，随便了。你赢了猜东西游戏，获得 +N2 热度！

source: The... what?
target: 什么……玩意儿？

source: You know! The Idea! Of the Road! Like... THE CONCEPT OF "THE ROAD". Or some abstract notion, like "The Road to Enlightenment".
target: 就是概念啊！路的概念！“路”这个概念本身！或者某种抽象的东西，比如“通往顿悟的道路”。

source: Enlightenment? I thought we were on State Road 47.
target: 顿悟？我以为咱们走的是 47 号州道。

source: Would "the road to Enlightenment" even be something I could physically spy with my little eye?
target: “通往顿悟的道路”这种东西，真的能让我用眼睛看见吗？

source: It could be... if you had spied it with her little THIRD eye!
target: 能啊……只要你用第三只眼去看！

source: Wow, boo, you're deep today.
target: 哇，宝，你今天很有深度嘛。

source: ...or you're just desperate to win the round.
target: ……也可能只是太想赢了。

source: Either works! So, did I guess correctly?
target: 都行！所以我猜对了吗？

source: No, dumb-dumb. I spied the iguana we passed, obviously.
target: 没呢，笨蛋。我看见的当然是刚才经过的鬣蜥，iguana 啊。

source: Ohhhh, so that lizard DID start with an I! Sorry I talked you out of it, bro.
target: 哦——原来那蜥蜴真是 I 开头的！抱歉，兄弟，我还劝你别选它来着。

source: But hey, "the Idea of the Road" was a pretty out-of-the-box answer, which I respect. I'll give you partial credit for creativity!
target: 不过嘛，“路的概念”这个答案确实挺有新意，我欣赏这种思路！给你点创意分吧！

source: Polly puts a gold star sticker on your forehead. It says "You Tried." Woohoo!
target: 波莉往你额头上贴了颗金星贴纸，上面写着“你努力过了”。好耶！

source: You lost -N2 MIND trying to justify your weird guess, but you gained +N2 HYPE from that sticker.
target: 你为圆那个离谱答案，损失了 -N2 头脑，不过那张贴纸让你获得了 +N2 热度。

source: You're trying to catch a nap while traveling between destinations, but Polly's having none of it.
target: 你想趁赶往下个目的地的工夫打个盹，可波莉偏不让你如愿。

source: Godddd, I'm so bored! Can't we play a game or something?
target: 天哪——无聊死了！咱们就不能玩个游戏什么的吗？

source: "How about the Quiet Game?" you suggest while yawning.
target: “要不玩谁先说话谁就输？”你打着哈欠提议。

source: Okay, let's play! Three, two, one... GO!
target: 好，开始！三、二、一……走！

source: WHOOPS I LOSE okay now let's play something actually fun please.
target: 哎呀我输了，好了现在求你们玩个真正有意思的吧。

source: What about I Spy? I spy with my little eye something that starts with...
target: 要不玩“我看见了”？看一看，猜一猜，什么东西的英文是以……

source: Uh, "highway" starts with an H, right?
target: 呃，公路的英文 highway 是 H 开头，对吧？

source: Actually, I'll start instead. I spy with my little eye something that starts with P...
target: 还是我先来吧。看一看，猜一猜，什么东西的英文以 P 开头……

source: ON THE INSIDE OF %CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%'S SOUL!
target: 而且就藏在 %CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS% 的灵魂里！

source: What?!
target: 什么？！

source: You heard me. I spied something that starts with P on the inside of your soul!
target: 你没听错。我在你的灵魂里，看见了一个英文以 P 开头的东西！

source: You can look into other people's souls? I didn't know your ghost powers could do that.
target: 你能看见别人的灵魂？我都不知道幽灵超能力还能干这个。

source: Neither did I! My powers make no sense most of the time, haha!
target: 我也不知道！我的能力大部分时候都莫名其妙，哈哈！

source: Or it could be that the cactus roots I took earlier are finally kicking in and I'm totally hallucinating that I can see souls. Who's to say?
target: 也可能是我之前吃的仙人掌根终于起效，我看见灵魂什么的全是幻觉。谁知道呢？

source: Or it could be that the acid I took earlier is finally kicking in and I'm totally hallucinating that I can see souls. Who's to say?
target: 也可能是我之前嗑的迷幻药终于起效，我看见灵魂什么的全是幻觉。谁知道呢？

source: Anyway, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, you gotta guess what I spied in your soul!
target: 总之，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，猜猜我在你灵魂里看见什么了！

source: How am I supposed to guess that? It's not like I can see the inside of my own soul.
target: 这让我怎么猜？我又看不见自己的灵魂里面有什么。

source: But it's still your soul! C'mon, boo, just try and guess! What do you think I spied?
target: 可那毕竟是你的灵魂啊！来嘛，宝，试着猜猜！你觉得我看见什么了？

source: A... (dormant) Passion for crafting artisanal marmalade, the most annoying of all hobbies?
target: 一份……潜藏的热情，Passion？对亲手熬制橘子酱的热情，那可是最烦人的爱好。

source: A... Prisoner embedded within your spirit? It'd explain the evil thoughts that live rent-free in your brain.
target: 一个……被关在你灵魂里的囚徒，Prisoner？难怪你脑子里那些邪恶念头一直赖着不走。

source: That's right! Good job!
target: 没错！答得漂亮！

source: Wow! I'd always suspected I might like crafting artisanal marmalade, but for some reason I never poked that thought until now!
target: 哇！我早就怀疑自己可能喜欢亲手熬橘子酱，可不知道为什么，直到现在才认真想过！

source: Why marmalade, though? Isn't "marmalade" basically just "jam" with a longer name?
target: 可为什么非得是橘子酱？橘子酱不就是果酱，只不过英文名字 marmalade 比 jam 长嘛？

source: It sounds kinda silly. It's like I always say: "Why make word long when short word work fine?"
target: 感觉有点傻。我老说嘛：“短词能用，干吗长词？”

source: Scott, Scott, Scott; such a naive boy. I clearly need to show you what makes artisanal marmalade so rewarding and fun!
target: 斯科特啊，斯科特，你还是太天真了。我得让你见识一下，手工橘子酱到底有多好玩、多有成就感！

source: Okay bro, if you insist. I'll pull over by that orange grove for you.
target: 好吧，兄弟，你非要做的话，我就停在那片橘子园边上。

source: Yay! Three hours of preserving oranges later...
target: 好耶！熬了三个小时的橘子酱之后……

source: We've been doing this for a while, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. When does the fun happen?
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，咱们都弄了好一阵了。到底什么时候才好玩啊？

source: Boo, I honestly couldn't care less about this shit. Can't you make marmalade when we're back home?
target: 宝，我真对这破玩意儿一点兴趣都没有。回家再做橘子酱不行吗？

source: NO! Artisanal marmalade is my fixation right now, and I'm gonna ride that wave of manic productivity until it crashes!
target: 不行！我现在满脑子都是手工橘子酱！我要趁这股狂热的干劲还没消退，一路做到底！

source: We don't have that kinda time. Can't you see our HYPE is decreasing at an alarming rate? We need to go before we risk losing more. I'm sure you understand.
target: 咱们没那么多时间。没看见热度正以惊人的速度往下掉吗？得赶紧走了，不能再掉了。你能理解吧。

source: But...
target: 可是……

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, this car is leaving with or without you. Put away your mason jars and let's get going.
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你上不上车，我们都要走了。收好你的玻璃罐，出发吧。

source: Ugh, fine. You'll just have to preserve your passion for homemade marmalade and shove it back on the furthest shelf of your subconscious for now.
target: 唉，好吧。你只能暂且把这份自制橘子酱的热情封存起来，塞回潜意识最深处的架子上。

source: But you vow that when this road trip ends, you'll reopen that jar and spread this newfound joy on the toast of your life! You lose -N2 HYPE, but gain +N2 MIND.
target: 不过你发誓，等公路旅行一结束，就重新开罐，把这份新发现的快乐抹在人生的吐司上！你损失 -N2 热度，获得 +N2 头脑。

source: Actually... yeah. I think that's exactly it.
target: 其实……对。好像还真是。

source: Ha! I knew all those horrible thoughts decreasing my -N2 SOUL couldn't be mine!
target: 哈！我就知道，那些害我损失 -N2 灵魂的恶毒念头，肯定不是我自己的！

source: Dang, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, how'd you get an evil spirit in your soul? Coach says spirits should be lifted, not used as prisons!
target: 哎呀，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你的灵魂里怎么会住着恶灵？教练说过，精神要振奋起来，不能拿来当监狱啊！

source: Hmmm...
A blurry flashback is called to Polly's mind. It was the late hours of a wine-tasting party with you, her, Milo, and Hope...
target: 波莉脑海里闪过一段模糊的回忆。那是一场品酒聚会的深夜，你、她、迈洛和希望女巫都在场……

source: Man, I -- *hic!* -- love you guys. I really needed this after my shitty week.
target: 天哪，我——*嗝！*——太爱你们了。这星期烂透了，我真的太需要放松一下了。

source: Riiight, you and the other Coven girls were busy defeating that evil demon lord, right? I saw Joy venting about it on her Momentgram story.
target: 对哦，你和女巫会的其他姑娘一直忙着对付那个邪恶魔王吧？我看见乔伊在 Momentgram 动态里吐槽了。

source: Yeah. We were able to steal the scrolls a cult was gonna use to summon the demon into our world.
target: 嗯。邪教打算用卷轴把那魔王召唤到咱们的世界，我们把卷轴偷走了。

source: That's dope.
target: 牛啊。

source: Thanks, but it was all for nothing, 'cause it -- *hic!* -- seems like the demon's just gonna cross over into this realm on its own... hence why I drink.
target: 谢了，可全白忙了。因为——*嗝！*——那魔王好像自己就能穿越到这个世界……所以我才借酒消愁。

source: You should just summon the demon now and get it all over with. Procrastination never helped anyone!
target: 那就现在把魔王召唤出来，早点解决啊。拖延可帮不了谁！

source: Are you sure that's a good idea? I think the wine's impairing our judgment a little bit...
target: 你确定这是个好主意？我觉得喝了酒之后，我们判断力有点下降……

source: No, you know what? They call alcohol "liquid courage" for a reason. I bet I can -- *hic!* -- take on that fucker now! Pass me those summoning scrolls!
target: 不，你听我说。大家都说“酒壮怂人胆”，这可不是白说的。我现在肯定能——*嗝！*——收拾那个混蛋！把召唤卷轴给我！

source: A few minutes later, as black flames surrounded them all...
target: 几分钟后，黑色火焰将所有人团团围住……

source: Okay, yep, I definitely cannot defeat this thing alone and drunk. Joy's gonna kill me when this demon destroys the world...
target: 好吧，没错，我一个醉鬼绝对打不过这玩意儿。等它毁了世界，乔伊非杀了我不可……

source: But the world can't be destroyed NOW; I have plans this weekend! Isn't there something we can do?
target: 可世界现在不能毁灭啊，我周末还有安排呢！咱们就没别的办法了？

source: I guess I could try using my psychic powers to imprison it in somebody's soul... but who would be willing to make such a sacrifice?
target: 我可以试着用通灵能力，把它囚禁在某个人的灵魂里……可谁愿意做出这种牺牲呢？

source: Polly, Milo, and Hope looked over to where you were passed out on the couch in a wine coma. Then they all slowly looked back at each other...
target: 波莉、迈洛和希望女巫望向沙发上喝到不省人事的你，又慢慢转头，彼此对视……

source: Uhhhh, weird! I have no idea how this could've happened, haha!
target: 呃——真奇怪！怎么会这样，我完全不知道呢，哈哈！

source: It's a mystery! But at least knowing that the demon is the one making you such a psychopath grants you +N2 MIND.
target: 真是个谜！不过，至少你知道自己之所以这么丧心病狂，是因为体内的魔王。你获得 +N2 头脑。

source: While driving, you and your friends have been playing I Spy. It's slightly more fun than sitting alone with your thoughts.
target: 赶路时，你和朋友们一直在玩“我看见了”猜东西游戏。总比独自对着自己的思绪发呆有意思一点。

source: My turn again! I spy with my little eye... something that starts with S!
target: 又轮到我了！看一看，猜一猜……什么东西的英文以 S 开头？

source: Is it the sand again?
target: 又是沙子，sand？

source: Yup! You're great at this, bro!
target: 对！兄弟，你好会猜！

source: Thanks. Guess that means it's my turn. I spy with my little eye...
target: 谢了。那就轮到我了。看一看，猜一猜……

source: CLASSIFIED DOCUMENTS FROM THE MERKINGDOM.
target: 人鱼王国的机密文件。

source: What?! The Merkingdom as in the ruthless, totalitarian monarchy under the sea?!
target: 什么？！你说的人鱼王国，是海底那个残暴无情的极权君主国吗？！

source: Yup, and I just spied some of their government secrets in this big packet labeled: "Merking ONLY: Do Not Read If You Value Your Worthless Life"
target: 对啊。我刚从这个大文件袋里看到了他们的政府机密，上面写着：“仅限人鱼王阅览：要是还想留着你那条贱命，就别看。”

source: THEN WHY WOULD YOU READ IT?!
target: 那你干吗还看？！

source: Because how many opportunites will I get to read classified government secrets in my unlife? Worth it!
target: 因为当了鬼以后，一辈子能有几次偷看政府机密的机会啊？值了！

source: Holy shit. We're so dead. I'll have to move to Scandinavia and start over as a mountain goat herder named Claude--
target: 我操。咱们死定了。我得逃到斯堪的纳维亚，改名克洛德，重新开始放山羊的生活——

source: Chillax, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. No one's becoming a Scandinavian goat herder, okay?
target: 冷静点，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。没人要跑去斯堪的纳维亚放羊，好吗？

source: We'll be fine if we just act like everything's normal. And that starts with finishing our game of I Spy!
target: 咱们只要装作一切正常，就不会有事。先把这局猜东西玩完！

source: The stress of knowing too much is destroying your -N2 MIND, but if Polly insists... guess what she read in those documents!
target: 知道得太多让你压力山大，损失了 -N2 头脑。不过波莉非要玩下去的话……猜猜她在文件里看到了什么！

source: Indoctrination plans through kids movies. The Merkingdom surely does that kind of shit, and you could use those secrets to deprogram the children.
target: 用儿童电影洗脑的计划。人鱼王国肯定干得出这种事，你还能利用这些机密，帮孩子们摆脱洗脑。

source: Intel on their most advanced weaponry: six-pack rings; waterparks; and that thing everyone has been talking about lately, "Sea 2." Priceless coveted affairs of state!
target: 最先进的武器情报：六罐装塑料提环、水上乐园，还有大家最近都在聊的“大海 2”。这可是人人垂涎的无价国家机密！

source: Yup. There are a LOT of propaganda-filled movie scripts in here.
target: 没错，这里有一大堆塞满政治宣传的电影剧本。

source: Listen to some of these: "The Lion King Isn't a Legitimate King and He Must Die".
target: 听听这几个：《狮子王没有合法王位，必须死》。

source: Spoiler alert: he does die, in a very gruesome way.
target: 剧透警告：他确实死了，而且死得很惨。

source: "The Little Mermaid Conquers the Surface World".
target: 《小美人鱼征服地表世界》。

source: "After realizing the idiocy of leaving the sea kingdom, the Little Mermaid aids her father in flooding the Earth and bringing the surface-dwellers to their knees."
target: “小美人鱼意识到离开海底王国有多愚蠢，便协助父王淹没地球，让地表居民俯首称臣。”

source: Jeez, this one's not even subtle: "Cinderella is a Lazy Handout-Taking Socialist Who Needs to Pay Rent".
target: 天哪，这部都懒得装了：《灰姑娘是个懒惰的社会主义者，光拿救济不交房租》。

source: These movies don't seem very nice. Maybe we could edit these scripts so they aren't so brainwash-y?
target: 这些电影好像不太友善。咱们能不能改改剧本，让它们没那么洗脑？

source: Sure! Let's change this one to "The Lion President That Everyone Democratically Elected Into Office of Their Own Free Will".
target: 好啊！这部就改成《全体人民自愿通过民主选举选出来的狮子总统》。

source: I didn't understand some of those words, but the ones I did, I liked!
target: 有些词我没听懂，不过听懂的那些，我都喜欢！

source: Fine, but the Merking is totally gonna get your asses after he sees the edits you made to these movie scripts.
target: 行吧，可人鱼王看见你们改的电影剧本，绝对会找你们算账。

source: Especially since Polly and Scott insist on mailing the revised scripts to him with an attached invoice for "editorial fees."
target: 尤其是波莉和斯科特还坚持把改好的剧本寄给他，随信附上一张“编辑费”账单。

source: But at least you might've helped some Merkingdom kids not get brainwashed! You gain +N2 SOUL.
target: 不过，至少你们可能救了几个险些被洗脑的人鱼王国小孩！你获得 +N2 灵魂。

source: Bingo. I gotta tell ya, there are some truly diabolical ideas in here.
target: 答对了。不得不说，这里有些主意真是邪恶透顶。

source: "The six-pack ring is a monster-sized plastic ring cluster. It's disguised as rubbish, but it suffocates the victim when they stupidly put one around their neck."
target: “六罐装塑料提环，是按怪物体型制作的一组塑料圈。外表伪装成垃圾，受害者一旦蠢得往脖子上套，就会窒息。”

source: I always knew garbage was secretly evil!
target: 我早就知道，垃圾暗地里邪恶得很！

source: "Waterparks are our most sophisticated coverup yet. Even after all these years, the surface-dwellers still have no idea we're slowly flooding the surface."
target: “水上乐园是我们至今最精妙的掩护。都这么多年了，地表居民还不知道，我们正在一点点淹没地表。”

source: Wait, does that mean the Merkingdom invented water slides? Are we sure they're so bad?
target: 等等，所以水滑梯是人鱼王国发明的？他们真的有那么坏吗？

source: We're pretty sure, buddy.
target: 真的，哥们。

source: I mean, if you have any doubt, just look at the blueprints for Sea 2. This is some really diabolical shit.
target: 还不信的话，看看“大海 2”的设计图就知道了。这玩意儿真他妈邪恶。

source: Yeah, let me put it this way: Sea 2 is so bad, I can't describe it to you without this game being pulled from most major retailers.
target: 这么说吧：“大海 2”邪恶到了我一旦说出详情，这游戏就会被大多数主流零售商下架的程度。

source: So what do we do with all this info? Should we tell the government?
target: 那这些情报怎么办？告诉政府吗？

source: Nah, that sounds lame and doesn't benefit me directly. Let's just sell these state secrets on the internet.
target: 不了吧，又无聊，又没我的好处。干脆把这些国家机密挂网上卖了。

source: Sounds like a plan! You sell the Merkingdom's most valuable secrets online and earn +N2 MONEY.
target: 好主意！你在网上卖掉了人鱼王国最珍贵的机密，赚得 +N2 金钱。

source: You're bored of all your playlists, so you decide to try listening to music on public radio.
target: 你听腻了所有歌单，决定换公共电台听听歌。

source: Passing through different stations, you stumble upon a frequency that seems to be a voice cutting through static.
target: 你不断换台，偶然调到一个频率，沙沙的杂音里似乎夹着人声。

source: "Hello? Is anyone there?" the voice says. Polly grabs the walkie-talking thing you plugged to the radio for some reason.
target: “喂？有人吗？”那个声音问。波莉抓起了那个对讲机一样的东西，也不知道你为什么会把它接到收音机上。

source: Hey, boo! You've reached Polly Geist, leave a message after the "YAAASSS!"
target: 嘿，宝！这里是波莉·鬼斯特，请在“好耶——！”之后留言！

source: "Thank God! I can't believe I'm actually talking to another survivor! How did you make it out of the building uprising alive?"
target: “谢天谢地！真不敢相信，我居然联系上了另一个幸存者！建筑起义那天，你们是怎么活下来的？”

source: The... what?
target: 什么……起义？

source: "The building uprising... you know, the day all the buildings revealed themselves to be living beings and turned against monsterkind?"
target: “建筑起义啊……就是所有建筑突然暴露自己是活物，开始反抗怪物的那一天，你知道的吧？”

source: The buildings didn't do that where we're from.
target: 我们那儿的建筑可没这样。

source: "Wow, really? Does that mean you still use buildings? Like, you still go inside them without the crippling fear that you'll be devoured whole?"
target: “哇，真的？所以你们还在使用建筑？还能走进屋里，不用吓得要死，担心被一口吞掉？”

source: Yep. Going inside buildings without getting devoured is a big staple in my daily routine.
target: 对啊。进屋以后不被吞掉，是我日常生活里很重要的一环。

source: "Oh, no! That means... you probably still use toilets too! God, you haven't figured out what important, messed-up role toilets play in the buildings' plans!"
target: “糟了！那你们……肯定还在用马桶！天哪，你们还不知道，马桶在建筑们的计划里，承担着多么重要又恶心的作用！”

source: "And carpets! You haven't even discovered what they actually are to the buildings' horrible anatomy yet!"
target: “还有地毯！你们甚至还没发现，在建筑那可怕的身体结构里，地毯到底是什么！”

source: Uh...
You hear screaming in the background of the radio transmission.
target: 电台里传来背景中的尖叫声。

source: "Oh yeah, I almost forgot," the radio voice says. "I was sending out a distress signal 'cause my camp of survivors is being attacked by murderous buildings. Can you help us?"
target: “哦对，差点忘了。”电台那头说，“我发求救信号，是因为一群杀人建筑正在袭击我们的幸存者营地。你们能帮忙吗？”

source: Jeez, boo, maybe start with that next time.
target: 天哪，宝，下次能不能先说重点。

source: Well, looks like all those deaths are on your conscience unless you can figure out a way to help this apocalypse survivor from the comfort of your car!
target: 看来，要是不想让这些人命压在你良心上，你就得想办法坐在舒适的车里，救下这位末日幸存者！

source: Help them make a sound investment and become the one person all buildings must abide by: THE LANDLORD!
target: 帮他们做笔稳妥的投资，成为所有建筑都得乖乖服从的人：房东！

source: Summon the most powerful entity that fights against all issues in buildings: THE NEIGHBORHOOD ASSOCIATION!
target: 召唤专治建筑各种问题的最强组织：社区协会！

source: Yeah! All we need is a mortgage large enough to buy property and become those buildings' landlord.
target: 对！只要申请到一笔够多的房贷，就能买下房产，当那些建筑的房东。

source: Wooo! Owning property in this economy? It'll be like subduing huge concrete crocodiles through a financial powermove!
target: 哇！这年头居然还能买房？这简直是靠金融手腕，制服一群巨型混凝土鳄鱼！

source: "That could work!" the voice says. "The only problem is that ever since society collapsed, there's nowhere to apply for a mortgage anymore..."
target: “这招可能有用！”那个声音说，“唯一的问题是，自从社会崩溃以后，就没地方申请房贷了……”

source: It's okay, we'll fund your mortgage. What's your bank account info?
target: 没事，我们给你出房贷钱。你的银行账户是多少？

source: "Well, banks aren't exactly a thing anymore. Society collapsed, remember?"
target: “呃，银行早就没了。社会崩溃了，记得吗？”

source: Oh, right... do you have Benmo?
target: 哦对……那你有 Benmo 吗？

source: "Yep, that'll work! Benmo has actually somehow outlived society after apocalypse."
target: “有，那个能用！也不知道为什么，末日之后社会都没了，Benmo 居然还在。”

source: Tight. You transfer them -N2 MONEY.
target: 好极了。你给对方转了 -N2 金钱。

source: "Wow, it worked!" the radio voice says. "I bought the deed to that ravenous building and became The Landlord! The buildings are terrified of me now!"
target: “哇，成功了！”电台那头说，“我买下了那栋饥肠辘辘的大楼的地契，成了房东！现在那些建筑都怕我了！”

source: "Thanks for your help, kind strangers! I promise, I'll pray every night that this horrible building apocalypse never ravages your world."
target: “谢谢你们，好心的陌生人！我保证，每晚都会祈祷，希望这场可怕的建筑末日永远别波及你们的世界。”

source: So... we just get thoughts and prayers?
target: 所以……我们就只得到点惦念和祈祷？

source: Thanks I guess, but I was kinda hoping I'd get something cool in return, like a new phone.
target: 呃，谢了吧。不过我本来还指望有点酷的回报，比如新手机什么的。

source: But we did get something cool, Polly: we got +N2 SOUL for being helpful! Doesn't that make it all worth it?
target: 可我们确实有很酷的收获啊，波莉！帮助别人让咱们获得了 +N2 灵魂！这不就很值得吗？

source: Eh, I guess I'll take it.
target: 行吧，那我就收下了。

source: Are you dumb, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? You can't use magic to summon the Neighborhood Association.
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你傻吗？社区协会哪能随便用魔法召出来。

source: What you CAN do is use magic to call for a summons or hearing with them. I'll look up the right summoning runes!
target: 你能用魔法申请让他们传唤你，或者开场听证会。我查查该用什么召唤符文！

source: You use -N2 MAGIC and the last of your emergency goat blood drawing runes on the car.
target: 你消耗 -N2 魔力，用最后一点应急山羊血在车上画起符文。

source: When you finish, the car is transported to the arcane pocket dimension where the Neighborhood Association conducts its world-governing business.
target: 画完以后，车子被传送进一个神秘的口袋维度。社区协会就在这里处理统治世界的公务。

source: Whoa, weird. How long has the universe had an all-powerful Neighborhood Association?
target: 哇，好怪。宇宙什么时候有了这么个无所不能的社区协会？

source: "For all time," says their leader, a wise grandfatherly type. "Think about it: the world you live in is like a massive neighborhood..."
target: “亘古以来。”领头的人一副睿智老爷爷的模样，“想想吧，你们生活的世界，就像一个巨大的社区……”

source: "And we're the only ones that can stop you young folks from ruining it!" screams a woman with a bob cut.
target: “只有我们才能阻止你们这帮年轻人把它糟蹋了！”一个留着波波头的女人尖叫道。

source: "Elder Karen, please calm down," sighs the irritable single mom. "I need at least two coffees in me before you start this shit."
target: “凯伦长老，麻烦冷静点。”一位烦躁的单亲妈妈叹了口气，“起码等我灌完两杯咖啡，你再开始作妖吧。”

source: "SILENCE!" the leader booms. "Now, children, please tell us: what can we do to improve the neighborhood?"
target: “肃静！”领头的人厉声喝道，“好了，孩子们，请告诉我们：怎样才能改善社区环境？”

source: Well, you should probably stop the buildings in that radio guy's universe from coming to life and killing people.
target: 呃，电台那人所在的宇宙里，建筑都活过来杀人了。你们大概该管管。

source: "True... if the buildings are revolting, the overall neighborhood economy will plummet, and then how are its residents supposed to qualify for the good school districts?!"
target: “确实……建筑一旦造反，整个社区的经济都会暴跌。到时候居民还怎么挤进好学区？！”

source: "It's settled. The Neighborhood Association will use its infinite arcane powers to bestow the highest possible punishment..."
target: “就这么定了。社区协会将动用无穷的奥术力量，施以最严厉的惩罚……”

source: "We'll send those buildings a VERY strong cease-and-desist letter."
target: “我们要给那些建筑寄一封措辞极其严厉的停止侵害函。”

source: ...For real?
target: ……认真的？

source: You all suddenly reappear in your own dimension. You can hear the apocalypse survivors cheering over the radio!
target: 你们突然又回到了自己的维度。电台那头传来了末日幸存者们的欢呼！

source: "I don't know what you guys did, but thank you!" the radio voice says. "A huge letter just descended from the skies! It was incredibly strongly-worded."
target: “不知道你们做了什么，但太谢谢了！”电台那头说，“刚才天上降下来一封巨大的信！措辞严厉得不得了！”

source: "It was so strongly-worded I can't even read it out loud for you. Its passive-aggressiveness is making all the buildings crumble. Thanks!"
target: “严厉到我都没法给你们念出来。那股阴阳怪气的劲儿，正在把所有建筑都震塌。谢谢！”

source: You gained +N2 SOUL for saving those people. But more importantly, you learned NEVER to fuck with the Neighborhood Association.
target: 你救下那些人，获得 +N2 灵魂。更重要的是，你明白了：千万别他妈招惹社区协会。

source: You're trying to find a radio station to listen to while you drive, but there's nothing good on.
target: 你想找个电台，赶路时听听，可就是没什么好节目。

source: The first station is on commercial, the second is just someone pleading for help, the third is playing a 24 hour yodeling special...
target: 第一个台在放广告，第二个只有个人在求救，第三个则是二十四小时约德尔唱法特辑……

source: Wait, back up. Someone's pleading for help?
target: 等一下，调回去。有人在求救？

source: You switch back to that station. "...anybody out there, please help me!" the voice is saying. "I'm trapped!"
target: 你调回那个台。“……有没有人，救救我！”那个声音喊道，“我被困住了！”

source: You're trapped where, bro? In the radio?! DON'T WORRY, I'LL SAVE YOU!
target: 你困在哪儿了，兄弟？收音机里面？！别怕，我来救你！

source: NO, SCOTT! Don't punch the radio! Just hand me the ham radio transceiver so we can talk to this guy.
target: 别，斯科特！不准揍收音机！把业余无线电收发器递给我，咱们就能跟那人说话了。

source: Heyyy, boo! Your distress signal has reached fan-favorite Polly Geist! Please, hold your applause.
target: 嘿——宝！你的求救信号已经传到了人气女王波莉·鬼斯特这里！先别急着鼓掌。

source: Okay, I was just being humble. You can give me a LITTLE applause.
target: 好吧，我刚才是谦虚。稍微鼓几下也可以。

source: "Oh, don't get me wrong, I'd love to. But one of my hands was crushed under this boulder while I was doing some off-trail hiking, so no clapping for me."
target: “别误会，我很乐意鼓掌。可我在野外徒步时，一只手被这块巨石压住了，实在拍不了。”

source: Ouch!
target: 哎哟！

source: "Ouch indeed. It's a real pickle. I've been stuck here for twelve hours, and I'm about to enter 'drinking my own pee to stay hydrated' territory."
target: “可不是嘛。真倒霉。我已经困了十二个小时，再不出去，就要沦落到喝自己的尿补水了。”

source: Yikes. It's the situation all hikers prep for, but hope it never comes to.
target: 嘶。这是每个徒步爱好者都做过准备，却谁也不愿真的碰上的情况。

source: "Yeah. So, can you help me? I'm not getting any WiFi to call the paramedics myself, and I REALLY don't want to drink my own pee... or die, for that matter."
target: “对。所以，你们能帮帮我吗？这里没有 WiFi，我没法自己叫救护人员。我真的不想喝自己的尿……当然，更不想死。”

source: Hmm, you tend to be more of a hindrance than a help, but you can definitely try!
target: 唔，你通常是越帮越忙，不过试试总可以！

source: He needs help fast! Do the sensible thing: search online for a way to get his WiFi back so he can call the paramedics!
target: 他急需帮助！做点明智的事：上网搜搜怎么帮他恢复 WiFi，好让他自己叫救护人员！

source: "Okay, hear me out: what if... this is all just a dream?"
target: “好吧，听我说：有没有可能……这一切都是梦？”

source: "Uh... what? Wouldn't it be easier for you guys to just call the paramedics for me?"
target: “呃……什么？你们直接替我叫救护人员，不是更方便吗？”

source: Yeah, but you know what they say: "Give a man a fish, he eats for a day. Force him to rescue himself, he'll live long enough to eat fish for a lifetime!"
target: 对啊，不过俗话说得好：“授人以鱼，吃饱一天；逼人自救，活着吃鱼一辈子！”

source: I'll just search, "How to get WiFi back when trapped in a hiking accident..."
target: 我搜搜：“徒步遇险被困后，如何恢复 WiFi……”

source: Ooh, I found a step-by-step guide on how to build your own cell phone tower! That should work!
target: 哦，我找到个教你自建手机信号塔的教程，步骤特别详细！这肯定行！

source: All you need is 35 tons of iron, some copper wiring, a building permit, and an electrician's license. So, are you good now?
target: 只需要三十五吨铁、一些铜线、一份建筑许可，还有电工资格证。怎么样，问题解决了吧？

source: "Uhh, but I don't have any of that stuff..."
target: “呃，可这些东西我一样都没有……”

source: Ugh, it's like you don't even WANT to be rescued.
target: 唉，搞得你好像根本就不想获救一样。

source: I found a video of a bunny rabbit using a cell phone! Does that help us?
target: 我找到一段小兔子玩手机的视频！能帮上忙吗？

source: "I'm pretty sure it doesn't."
target: “我很确定，不能。”

source: But just look at his cute little ears and the way he taps the app buttons with his nose!
target: 可是你看它的小耳朵多可爱，还用鼻子点应用按钮呢！

source: Aww! Can't we just watch these rabbit videos instead of helping this guy? This is WAY more entertaining than trying to fix his WiFi.
target: 好可爱！咱们别管他了，看兔兔视频不行吗？可比修他的 WiFi 好玩多了。

source: You cannot, though it pains you to say it. You lose -N2 HYPE, but you finally get your friends back on track and find a solution...
target: 不行，虽然你也很不情愿这么说。你损失了 -N2 热度，但终于把朋友们拉回正题，找到了解决办法……

source: This website says if I turn on my phone's WiFi hotspot, the trapped hiker can connect to it.
target: 这网站说，我打开手机的 WiFi 热点，被困的徒步者就能连上。

source: That'll only work if we're close enough to his location, which is highly unlikely...
target: 那得离他够近才行，可能性不大吧……

source: "Hey, I see it! 'Scott's Hotspot!'" the hiker says. "Wait, does that mean you guys have been close enough to me to just rescue me yourselves this whole time?"
target: “嘿，我看见了！‘斯科特的热点’！”徒步者说，“等等，难道你们一直就在附近，明明可以直接过来救我？”

source: I guess so. But more importantly, it means you're close enough to watch that bunny video with us!
target: 看来是的。更重要的是，咱们离得这么近，你也能跟我们一起看兔兔视频了！

source: "Uh... no thanks," says the hiker. "I think I'd rather call the paramedics so I don't die down here. Thanks, though."
target: “呃……不了，谢谢。”徒步者说，“我还是先叫救护人员吧，免得死在这里。不过谢了。”

source: Aw...
Well, at least you gained +N2 SOUL for doing a good deed. It was a boring deed, but good nonetheless!
target: 好吧，至少你做了件好事，获得 +N2 灵魂。虽然很无聊，但好事终究是好事！

source: Ooh, good point! Mr. Hiker, what if this is all just a dream and you're safe in bed right now?
target: 哦，有道理！徒步先生，有没有可能，这一切都是梦，你现在正好好地躺在床上？

source: "What? That's stupid. Can't you just call the paramedics to come save me?"
target: “什么？这也太蠢了。你们就不能叫救护人员来救我吗？”

source: But what if we call the paramedics and it turns out this is just an "it was all a dream" scenario? It'd be majorly embarrassing.
target: 可万一叫了救护人员，最后发现这只是个“一切都是梦”的剧情，那得多尴尬啊。

source: Just pinch yourself and see if you wake up, bro! There's no harm in trying all our options!
target: 掐自己一下，看看能不能醒过来嘛，兄弟！所有办法都试一遍，总没坏处！

source: "Goddammit, fine..."
target: “妈的，好吧……”

source: "You were right, it was all a dream! I'm at home in my bed! Who would've thought?!"
target: “你们说对了，这真的是梦！我现在就在家里的床上！谁能想到啊？！”

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% did. You're welcome, bro!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 想到了。不用谢，兄弟！

source: "But wait... if it was all a dream, how are we still talking right now? Weren't you guys part of my dream?"
target: “可等等……如果那是梦，咱们现在怎么还在说话？你们不是我梦里的人吗？”

source: I mean, I am pretty dreamy, but I don't think I'm literally a dream.
target: 我确实挺像梦中情人的，可应该不至于真是个梦吧。

source: "Well... I guess it's like when you're awoken from a dream and still see remnants of it while you're waking up... yeah, that's probably it..."
target: “呃……大概就跟刚醒过来，还能看见一点梦里的残影差不多……嗯，肯定是这样……”

source: "Thanks for the help, dream-people! I'll always remember you... for the next two minutes until I forget about this dream. Bye!"
target: “谢谢你们，梦里的人！我会永远记得你们……接下来的两分钟吧，再久我就把梦忘了。拜拜！”

source: Boy, that was weird.
target: 哇，真够怪的。

source: ...Polly?
target: ……波莉？

source: Yeah?
target: 嗯？

source: Are we real, or are we just the figments of somebody else's imagination?
target: 我们真的存在吗？还是说，我们只是别人想象出来的？

source: At this point, who even knows?
target: 都到这份上了，谁知道呢？

source: You gained +N2 SOUL for helping the trapped hiker, but suffice to say you lost -N2 MIND.
target: 你帮助了被困的徒步者，获得 +N2 灵魂。不过显而易见，你也损失了 -N2 头脑。

source: You, Polly, and Scott are listening to the radio as you drive when you stumble upon a station you've never seen before...
target: 你、波莉和斯科特边开车边听电台，无意间调到了一个从没听过的频道……

source: "Cool Hawk to Snake Venom," says one voice. "Have you cracked the security system mainframe yet? Over."
target: “酷鹰呼叫蛇毒，”一个声音说，“安全系统的主机破解了吗？完毕。”

source: "Snake Venom to Cool Hawk," says another. "I'm hacking as fast as I can. Over and out."
target: “蛇毒呼叫酷鹰，”另一个声音回答，“我已经在尽快破解了。通话结束。”

source: "Other Hawk to Cool Hawk. The getaway driver still isn't here yet. You sure today's the day for the job? Over."
target: “另一只鹰呼叫酷鹰。接应司机还没到。你确定是今天动手吗？完毕。”

source: This is a really weird song.
target: 这首歌真怪。

source: "Cool Hawk speaking. Who's talking on the comms? Over."
target: “酷鹰呼叫全体。谁在频道里说话？完毕。”

source: Ooh, I think they can hear us on the CB radio transceiver!
target: 哦，我觉得他们能通过民用电台收发器听见咱们！

source: Which calls into question why this car has one of those radios anyway...
target: 所以说，这车上为什么会有这种电台……

source: Because I bought one, silly. Prank-radioing is the grandfather of prank-calling! Hand me that transceiver, I'll show you how it's done.
target: 因为我买的呀，笨蛋。恶作剧电台可是恶作剧电话的祖宗！把收发器给我，我示范给你看。

source: Heyyy, party people! This is Polly Geist speaking, what's the good word?
target: 嘿——爱玩的小伙伴们！这里是波莉·鬼斯特，大家都好吗？

source: "Snake Venom to... Poltergeist, was it? Are you the getaway driver?"
target: “蛇毒呼叫……吵闹鬼，是吧？你就是接应司机？”

source: You guys wanna get in our car? I don't think you'd fit.
target: 你们要上我们的车？我觉得坐不下啊。

source: Yeah. I already called shotgun, and the back seat's full of our suitcases, Scott's bone collection, and our other friends somewhere in the pile.
target: 对啊。副驾我已经占了，后座塞满行李箱、斯科特收藏的骨头，还有埋在那堆东西里的其他朋友。

source: "Other Hawk to Poltergeist. So if you aren't our ride, what's your role here? 'Cause I'm not sharing the spoils of this heist with anyone who's dead weight."
target: “另一只鹰呼叫吵闹鬼。既然你不是来接应的，那你负责什么？我可不会把赃款分给拖后腿的。”

source: I can be the plug! I'm sure I've got some good drugs in my purse somewhere.
target: 我可以负责供货！我包里肯定还有些好货，药效包你满意。

source: I WANNA BE THE GOALIE!
target: 我要当守门员！

source: "Cool Hawk to Poltergeist and friends. 'The plug' and 'the goalie' aren't real heist roles, so either stop fucking around or risk losing your cut."
target: “酷鹰呼叫吵闹鬼和她的朋友们。‘供货的’和‘守门员’可不算劫案分工。别他妈瞎闹了，不然分成就没了。”

source: So if you can convince these guys you belong, you'll get a cut of whatever they're stealing?! Making money is EASY! How will you contribute to the heist?
target: 所以，只要说服他们你也是一伙的，就能分到赃款？！赚钱也太容易了！你打算为这场劫案做什么？

source: If you know anything about this mission so far, it's that their code names suck. Help them by brainstorming better code names.
target: 目前关于这任务，你只确定一件事：他们的代号烂透了。帮他们想几个更好的。

source: Every covert group has a double agent. Get them to decide who'll be the traitor. If we're doing betrayal, let's do it right!
target: 每个秘密组织都有双面间谍。让他们先决定谁来当叛徒。既然要背叛，就得认真搞！

source: "What do you mean?" demands Cool Hawk. "Our code names are great! I picked them myself!"
target: “什么意思？”酷鹰质问，“我们的代号好得很！都是我亲自取的！”

source: Eh, I've heisted with better.
target: 一般吧，我以前干劫案的同伙，代号可比这强。

source: "I wasn't gonna say anything, but... she's right, boss," says Other Hawk. "I mean, look what I got stuck with."
target: “本来我不想说的，可……她说得对，老大。”另一只鹰说，“你看看我摊上的这个名字。”

source: Yeah! Other Hawk deserves to have a name that he likes. Something cool, like... "Big Pastrami!"
target: 对！另一只鹰应该有个自己喜欢的名字。酷一点的，比如……“大熏牛肉”！

source: "Hey, I like that!" says the person who will hitherto be known as Big Pastrami. "I'm even eating a pastrami sandwich right now! How'd you know?!"
target: “嘿，我喜欢！”这位从此改叫大熏牛肉的人说，“我现在就在吃熏牛肉三明治！你怎么知道的？！”

source: Snake Venom, I bet we can help you out too. Your name's not bad, but it's a little TOO edgelord to be taken seriously.
target: 蛇毒，我看你也能改改。你这名字不算差，就是太刻意耍酷了，让人没法当回事。

source: It's also sorta confusing. Like, are you a venomous snake, or a snake-shaped alien symbiote?
target: 还挺容易搞混。你到底是一条有毒的蛇，还是长得像蛇的外星共生体？

source: How do you feel about changing your name to "The Tux?"
target: 换成“燕尾服”怎么样？

source: "Wow, I really like it!" The Tux says. "Tux can be my thing. I could, like, wear tuxes all the time, and people will be like, 'Whoa, this motherfucker's elegant!'"
target: “哇，我喜欢！”燕尾服说，“这能成为我的特色！以后我天天穿燕尾服，大家就会说：‘卧槽，这家伙真优雅！’”

source: "Well hey, c'mon, I don't wanna be the only one left out!" says Cool Hawk. "Can I get a nickname glow-up?"
target: “哎，别啊，我可不想一个人落下！”酷鹰说，“也帮我的外号升级一下呗？”

source: Awww, look at that. Even hardened criminals can get FOMO.
target: 哎哟，瞧瞧。原来老练的罪犯也怕跟不上大家啊。

source: What about Mayo Avalanche? That sounds cool!
target: “蛋黄酱雪崩”怎么样？听着很酷！

source: Why are all your code names food-themed?
target: 你取的代号为什么全是吃的？

source: I dunno. I guess I'm hungry.
target: 不知道。大概是我饿了吧。

source: "Fuck yeah, I love it!" says Mayo Avalanche. "Oh, and look at that, the getaway driver's here. Big Pastrami, Tux, grab your guns and get inside!"
target: “操，太喜欢了！”蛋黄酱雪崩说，“哦，接应司机到了。大熏牛肉、燕尾服，拿好枪上车！”

source: You lost -N2 MIND in the brainstorm, but the heist goes perfectly, and you earn +N2 MONEY from your cut!
target: 绞尽脑汁想代号，让你损失了 -N2 头脑。不过劫案进展顺利，你分到了 +N2 金钱！

source: But isn't testing these guys' trust in each other until it breaks kinda... toxic?
target: 可是，非要考验他们之间的信任，直到彻底崩溃……是不是有点伤感情？

source: Sure, but you know what's even more toxic? Finding out one of your best friends and heist-members is a FUCKING TRAITOR the hard way!
target: 当然，可什么更伤感情，你知道吗？真被最好的朋友兼劫案同伙背刺了，才发现对方他妈是个叛徒！

source: Fair enough! Then let's start with a fun scenario: your grandma wants to go the amusement park really bad, but you don't have time to take her.
target: 有道理！那咱们先来个有趣的情景题：奶奶特别想去游乐园，可你没空带她去。

source: Which heist teammate would you feel the LEAST comfortable asking to take her to the amusement park?
target: 让哪个劫案同伙陪她去，你最不放心？

source: "Hmmm... I guess Snake Venom," says Cool Hawk. "He's the most irresponsible."
target: “唔……应该是蛇毒吧。”酷鹰说，“他最不负责任。”

source: "Same here," Other Hawk says. "Snake Venom would ditch your grandma at the first face painting booth he saw and ride a rollercoaster all day."
target: “同意。”另一只鹰说，“蛇毒肯定把你奶奶丢在碰见的第一个脸部彩绘摊，自己坐一天过山车。”

source: "At least I wouldn't seduce Cool Hawk's grandma and date her behind his back," Snake Venom scoffs, "unlike ANOTHER hawk I know."
target: “至少我不会勾引酷鹰的奶奶，还背着他跟她约会。”蛇毒冷笑，“不像我认识的另一只鹰。”

source: Ooh, that gives me another exercise idea! Everyone say what animal they associate the heist teammate to their right with.
target: 哦，又想到一个练习！大家说说，右手边的劫案同伙让你联想到什么动物。

source: "Well... I guess I associate Snake Venom with a snake?" Cool Hawk says.
target: “呃……蛇毒让我想到蛇？”酷鹰说。

source: GASP! That's not good! Snakes are one of the most backstabbing, shady animals!
target: 嘶！不妙！蛇可是最阴险、最爱背后捅刀子的动物之一！

source: "Tch!" Snake Venom says. "If that's how it's gonna be: Cool Hawk, I associate YOU with a mole."
target: “啧！”蛇毒说，“那你要这样：酷鹰，你让我想到 mole，鼹鼠。”

source: "Is that a slight at my untrustworthy personality, or my bad eyesight?"
target: “你是在讽刺我像内鬼一样不可信，还是说我眼神不好？”

source: "I think it's a slight at the huge, unsightly mole on your back," Other Hawk says.
target: “我觉得是在说你背上那颗又大又难看的痣，那个也叫 mole。”另一只鹰说。

source: "DID YOU TELL SNAKE ABOUT THAT?!" Cool Hawk gasps. "You asshole! I showed you my ugly back mole in confidence!"
target: “你把那事告诉蛇毒了？！”酷鹰惊叫，“混蛋！我给你看背上的丑痣，是信任你会保密！”

source: Let's do one last exercise: the distrust fall! Fall flat on the floor, then get mad at the person to your right for not catching you!
target: 最后来个练习：不信任倒！直接摔在地上，再怪右边的人没接住你！

source: You hear three loud thuds, followed by muffled swearing.
target: 你听见三声重重的闷响，接着是压低声音的咒骂。

source: "Okay, I think we're done here," Cool Hawk says. "Clearly any one of us could go rogue, so we'll just do the heist without trusting anyone."
target: “好，差不多了。”酷鹰说，“很显然，咱们谁都有可能叛变，那就谁也别信谁，把这票干完。”

source: "Agreed," Snake Venom says. "But, uh, I think this is gonna be my last job with you guys."
target: “同意。”蛇毒说，“不过，呃，这应该是我最后一次跟你们合作了。”

source: "Same," says Other Hawk, "and don't expect to see me at the post-heist BBQ after this."
target: “我也是，”另一只鹰说，“这事之后的庆功烧烤，也别指望我去了。”

source: They pull off the heist and give you a +N2 MONEY cut, but you lose -N2 SOUL for undermining these people's trust in each other. Oh well!
target: 他们成功完成劫案，分给你 +N2 金钱，不过破坏了他们之间的信任，也让你损失 -N2 灵魂。哎，管他呢！

source: As you're driving, you pass a person walking along the side of the road. Maybe they need help?
target: 赶路时，你们经过一个沿路步行的人。也许对方需要帮忙？

source: Hey, bro! Need a ride somewhere?
target: 嘿，兄弟！要搭车吗？

source: Oh, hello! That's a very kind offer, but I'm afraid I can't accept it.
target: 哦，你们好！谢谢你们的好意，不过恐怕我不能接受。

source: I'm on a pilgrimage to the shrine of St. James in Galicia. It's a spiritual journey which must be made on foot.
target: 我正前往加利西亚的圣雅各圣殿朝圣。这是一场心灵之旅，必须靠双脚走完。

source: You're WALKING the whole way? You're a long way away from Spain, you know.
target: 全程都用走的？你知道这儿离西班牙还远着呢吧。

source: That's the point! The long, arduous trek will strengthen my faith, and when I finally reach the shrine, I will be spiritually cleansed by my Lord.
target: 正是如此！漫长艰辛的跋涉会坚定我的信仰。等我终于抵达圣殿，主便会净化我的心灵。

source: What about you fine folks? Are you on a pilgrimage yourselves?
target: 那各位呢？你们也是出来朝圣的吗？

source: We're on a road trip, actually. But I guess it's kinda like a pilgrimage to our final destination.
target: 其实我们在公路旅行。不过，前往最终目的地，应该也算有点像朝圣吧。

source: Well said! The Lord teaches us that we are all on our own journeys, be them literal pilgrimages or an internal pilgrimage of self-discovery.
target: 说得好！主教导我们，每个人都走在自己的旅途上。无论是实际的朝圣，还是探索内心、认识自我的朝圣。

source: I encourage you to gather much wisdom and peace from your little pilgrimage, in the name of happiness and the Lord's grace.
target: 愿你们在这场小小的朝圣中收获智慧与平静，感受幸福与主的恩典。

source: Ditto, bro!
target: 你也是，兄弟！

source: You seem like a pro pilgrim. Do you have any advice on how to get wiser on our road trip pilgrimage?
target: 你看着是个朝圣老手啊。有什么建议，能让我们在公路朝圣里变得更有智慧吗？

source: Well, a good way to remember your pilgrimage and the lessons it taught you is by collecting meaningful mementos along the way.
target: 沿途收集有意义的纪念品，就是个好办法。它们能帮你铭记这场朝圣，还有从中学到的道理。

source: Oh, we've been doing that! Check it out: at the last rest stop, I got this shot glass shaped like an ejaculating dick. Classic!
target: 哦，我们一直有收集！瞧，我在上个休息站买了这个小酒杯，形状像根正在射精的鸡巴。经典！

source: That's... interesting! I've been collecting pilgrimage mementos myself. Would you like to trade some, so that we may grow from our shared experiences?
target: 真是……有意思！我也收集了些朝圣纪念品。要不要交换几件，分享彼此的经历，一起有所成长？

source: Sure! Maybe don't trade him Richard Shotglass, though. You look at the pilgrim's wares and decide to...
target: 好啊！不过，“理查德小酒杯”还是别送他了吧。你看了看朝圣者的藏品，决定……

source: Give him a walkthrough guide that contains all the tricks you've learned during this road trip in exchange for a sacred ten dollar bill.
target: 用一份记录了本次公路旅行所有心得诀窍的攻略，换他那张神圣的十美元钞票。

source: Take the statue of the Saint of Forgiveness and Redemption, and give him the one memento that embodies the essence of this road trip: eh... ah... this banana!
target: 拿走宽恕与救赎圣女的雕像，再送他一件最能体现本次旅行精髓的纪念品：呃……啊……这根香蕉！

source: That sounds great! I'd love to hear all that you've learned about road-tripping during your pilgrimage.
target: 太好了！我很想听听，你们在这场朝圣中学到了哪些公路旅行的经验。

source: I learned that you gotta put gas in the car to make it wake up and go!
target: 我学会了，要给车加汽油，它才会醒过来跑！

source: Energy drinks and sugar are NOT a good substitute for this, even if it seems like they should be. I figured that out the hard way.
target: 能量饮料和糖可不能替代汽油，虽然按理说应该行。这可是我吃了苦头才学会的。

source: Do not despair, my friend. The Lord often teaches us important lessons via hardship.
target: 别灰心，朋友。主时常通过苦难，教会我们重要的道理。

source: I learned that road-tripping under the sun all day can be taxing, so it's important to have a good skincare routine!
target: 我学会了，整天顶着太阳公路旅行很伤身，所以护肤一定得做好！

source: Also, if you're pulled over by traffic cops, DON'T give them the middle finger. They don't respond well to it.
target: 还有，被交警拦下来时，千万别朝他们竖中指。他们可不喜欢这套。

source: And watch out for the green-tentacled creature of chaos!
target: 还有，小心那个长着绿色触手的混沌生物！

source: Whoa, what would that even be?
target: 哇，那又是什么东西？

source: Oh, I dunno. I just hear that warning in my dreams sometimes. It seemed relevant to this conversation.
target: 哦，我也不知道。有时做梦会听见这个警告，感觉这会儿说出来挺合适的。

source: Thank you for sharing your wisdom, friends. In exchange, I present you with this sacred ten dollar bill.
target: 感谢各位分享智慧。作为交换，请收下这张神圣的十美元钞票。

source: It's said that this is the very ten dollar bill Judas Iscariot was paid to betray the Lord.
target: 据说，当年加略人犹大出卖主，收的就是这张十美元钞票。

source: I thought Judas was paid thirty pieces of silver?
target: 犹大拿到的不是三十枚银币吗？

source: He was, but this is all that's left after inflation. Spend that blood money wisely!
target: 没错，不过通货膨胀到现在，就剩这么点了。这笔血钱，可要好好花啊！

source: It was lovely meeting you folks. May the Lord cross our paths again someday!
target: 很高兴认识各位。愿主让我们有朝一日再度相逢！

source: He seemed nice! And you're definitely not just saying that because he gave you some sweet +N2 MONEY.
target: 他人真不错！你这么说，绝对不是因为他给了你香喷喷的 +N2 金钱。

source: Unfortunately, though, giving him those tips seems to have meant literally giving them AWAY. You lose -N2 MIND from the lost knowledge.
target: 可惜，把心得“送给”他，好像真把它们从脑子里送走了。你丢了这些知识，损失 -N2 头脑。

source: Ah, a fine choice! The Saint of Forgiveness and Redemption is a fascinating historical figure.
target: 啊，选得好！宽恕与救赎圣女，是一位非常迷人的历史人物。

source: She's kinda thicc, too.
target: 身材也挺有料。

source: Indeed. Mother Beatrice was a woman ahead of her time who had a strong desire for a practice known today as "eating ass".
target: 确实。比阿特丽斯嬷嬷是位超越时代的女性，她特别热衷于一种如今被称为“舔屁眼”的行为。

source: But due to the culture of the times, her father disapproved of her behavior and sent her to live in a nunnery.
target: 但受限于当时的风气，父亲无法接受她的行为，便把她送进了修道院。

source: She became one of the convent's most passionate nuns! She beautifully sang the hymns, and even added a hitherto-unseen dance element!
target: 她成了院里最热情的修女之一！圣歌唱得动听极了，甚至还加入了前所未见的舞蹈！

source: The other nuns respected Mother Beatrice so highly, they would spend hours in the confession booth alone with her.
target: 其他修女都十分敬重比阿特丽斯嬷嬷，经常单独陪她在告解室里待上几个小时。

source: Onlookers reported great cries of ecstasy coming from those pounding confession booth doors -- exaltations of joy to the Lord, no doubt!
target: 据旁人说，告解室的门被撞得砰砰响，里面还传出阵阵狂喜的呻吟——毫无疑问，那是在欢呼赞美主！

source: Mother Beatrice sounds fant-ass-tic. Maybe it's not too late for me to become a nun.
target: 比阿特丽斯嬷嬷真是妙极了，尤其是屁股那方面。也许我现在出家当修女，还不算晚。

source: It isn't! Mother Beatrice teaches us that anyone from any walk of life can find forgiveness and redemption in the Lord's house.
target: 当然不晚！比阿特丽斯嬷嬷教导我们，无论出身如何，每个人都能在主的殿堂里得到宽恕与救赎。

source: Now, tell me more about this sacred banana, and all it represents for your journey!
target: 那么，快说说这根神圣的香蕉，以及它对你们旅途的意义吧！

source: Ummm... it's phallic-shaped. Is that anything?
target: 呃……它长得像根鸡巴。这算吗？

source: I can tell you! This banana is yummy and ripe, representing the ripe, yummy friendship that we've strengthened during our road trip together!
target: 我来说！这根香蕉成熟又美味，代表我们一起旅行后，越发成熟美味的友谊！

source: But if you step on the peel, you could get hurt. That represents how we've spent a lot of this road trip just one wrong step away from disaster.
target: 但要是踩到香蕉皮，也会受伤。这代表着咱们这一路上，总是差一步就要大祸临头。

source: Also, monkeys think bananas are really cool! That symbolizes how I think a monkey would think I'm really cool and be my best friend if I got the chance.
target: 而且，猴子都觉得香蕉特别棒！这象征着，只要有机会，我觉得猴子肯定也会觉得我特别棒，愿意当我最好的朋友。

source: Wow! This beautiful banana is filled with potassium AND wisdom. I'm honored to receive it!
target: 哇！这根美丽的香蕉，既富含钾，又富含智慧。能收到它，我倍感荣幸！

source: I'll bring this gift all the way to the shrine with me... or I might eat it on the way. Whichever comes first. Farewell!
target: 我会把这份礼物一路带到圣殿……也可能半路就吃了。看哪个先发生吧。再会！

source: He seemed nice! And you're definitely not just saying that because he gave you a statue of a hot nun wearing a G-string.
target: 他人真不错！你这么说，绝对不是因为他送了你一尊穿丁字裤的性感修女像。

source: You earn +N2 SOUL from Mother Beatrice's born-again booty, but you lose -N2 STAMINA later when you're craving that banana.
target: 比阿特丽斯嬷嬷那获得新生的美臀，让你获得 +N2 灵魂。不过，后来你馋起那根香蕉，损失了 -N2 体力。

source: You're driving along when you pass a large statue of a saint just off the road. Standing around it are a group of pilgrims having a heated discussion.
target: 车行途中，你们经过路边一尊巨大的圣人雕像。一群朝圣者围在旁边，正激烈地争论着。

source: I'm sorry, brothers and sisters, but I don't know how much longer I can do this!
target: 对不起，兄弟姐妹们，可我真不知道自己还能坚持多久了！

source: "Don't let your faith be put in crisis, brother!" the other pilgrims beg. "Someone tell him the 'footprints in the sand' story again!"
target: “兄弟，别让信仰动摇啊！”其他朝圣者苦苦劝道，“谁再给他讲一遍‘沙滩上的脚印’！”

source: NO! I'm tired of the "footprints in the sand" story! If I'm going to finish this pilgrimage, I need more than that!
target: 不！我听腻那个‘沙滩上的脚印’了！光靠这故事，我可走不完这场朝圣！

source: Whoa, trouble in God's paradise?
target: 哇，上帝的天堂也闹矛盾啦？

source: Oh, hello there. Normally I'd be in a fine mood to chat with some friendly strangers, but now isn't a good time.
target: 哦，你们好。平时我很乐意跟友善的陌生人聊聊，可现在实在不是时候。

source: "We're on a pilgrimage to the Santiago de Compostela Cathedral," the other pilgrims explain. "It's a spiritual journey we take yearly to strengthen our faith."
target: “我们正前往圣地亚哥-德孔波斯特拉大教堂朝圣。”其他朝圣者解释，“每年我们都会踏上这场心灵之旅，坚定信仰。”

source: But I'm finding that my heart just isn't in it this year...
target: 可今年，我实在提不起劲……

source: I've always been devoted to the Lord, but I feel as if I have nothing to show for it. Where are my rewards for my loyalty?
target: 我始终虔诚侍奉主，可总觉得一点回报都没有。我这么忠诚，奖赏在哪儿？

source: For example, I always end up in the longest line at the supermarket. Why does the Lord make His devoted followers wait so long to buy loaves and fishes?!
target: 比如，每回去超市，我排的队总是最长的。主为什么要让虔诚的信徒等那么久，才能买到饼和鱼？！

source: Sometimes I fear I'm just one more thirty-minute wait at the Quikkimart away from succumbing to a life of sin...
target: 有时我真怕，再让我在 Quikkimart 排上半小时，我就要堕落，过上罪恶的生活了……

source: Lord, if You are really my friend and protector, I beg you: show me a sign! Give me something to work with here!
target: 主啊，如果您真是我的朋友和守护者，我求您显个神迹吧！好歹给点盼头啊！

source: (This is sad, guys... I wish there was some way we could help this poor guy.)
target: （伙计们，太难过了……真想帮帮这个可怜的人。）

source: (Me too. I have an idea: let's perform a miracle to restore this guy's faith in religion and magic!)
target: （我也是。我有个主意：咱们造个神迹，让他重新相信宗教和魔法吧！）

source: Seems a little deceptive, but it really is hard to watch this holy man lose his faith. Perform a magical miracle for him!
target: 虽然有点骗人，不过看着这位虔诚人士失去信仰，确实不好受。为他施展魔法，造个神迹吧！

source: THE RESURRECTION OF SCOTT. Actually, the miracle is about making Scott finally learn to both play dead, then sit up.
target: 斯科特复活！其实，真正的奇迹是终于教会斯科特先装死，再坐起来。

source: Anyone can make the statue of a saint cry... but can you make the statue of a saint cum?
target: 谁都能让圣像流泪……可你能让圣像射精吗？

source: Ooh, good idea! GATHER ROUND, PILGRIMS, TO WITNESS A GENUINE MIRACLE!
target: 哦，好主意！朝圣者们，都围过来，见证真正的神迹吧！

source: A genuine miracle? Do you mean you are a prophet, here to dispense the teachings of the Lord?
target: 真正的神迹？你是说，你是前来传达主之教诲的先知？

source: Sure, let's go with that! Now watch this...
target: 对，就这么理解吧！接下来看好了……

source: SCOTT, DEAD!
target: 斯科特，装死！

source: Oh nooo... I'm dying... I'm deaaaad... blegh!
target: 哦不——我要死了……我死啦——呃！

source: Scott flops over with his tongue sticking out.
target: 斯科特吐着舌头，啪地倒了下去。

source: NOOOO! The poor boy, cut down in his prime! Lord, why must you taketh so much away?!
target: 不——！可怜的孩子，正值盛年就这样夭折！主啊，您为何如此无情地夺走一切？！

source: "It was not the Lord!" the pilgrims cry. "It was the girl! She killed him with a single word; she's an agent of the Devil! GET HER!"
target: “不是主干的！”朝圣者们喊道，“是那女孩！她一句话就杀了他！她是魔鬼的爪牙！抓住她！”

source: WORRY NOT, BROTHERS AND SISTERS! The Lord will come to aid Scott!
target: 兄弟姐妹们，不必惊慌！主会来拯救斯科特！

source: For Scott is a good boy: pure of heart, pious of soul, and dumb of ass... we just need to believe!
target: 因为斯科特是个乖孩子：心地纯洁，灵魂虔诚，脑子蠢得要命……只要咱们相信就行！

source: Scott, SIT UP!
target: 斯科特，坐起来！

source: I'm alive, hooray!
target: 我活啦，万岁！

source: INCREDIBLE! THE LORD HATH GIVETH! I REPEAT: THE LORD! HATH! GIVETH!
target: 不可思议！主赐予了生命！我再说一遍：是主！赐予的！生命！

source: "Bless you, O Saint Scott!" the pilgrims weep, kissing Scott's shoes. "Bless you!"
target: “愿福佑你，圣斯科特！”朝圣者们流着泪亲吻斯科特的鞋，“愿福佑你！”

source: You don't have to bless me, bros. I didn't even sneeze!
target: 兄弟们，不用说保佑我啦。我又没打喷嚏！

source: We'll always remember this day, Saint Scott. Next year, we will make a pilgrimage to this spot, where your resurrection took place!
target: 圣斯科特，我们会永远记住今天。明年，我们要来你复活的地方朝圣！

source: Sounds great! Can we make it a marathon thing? I've always wanted to do one of those!
target: 好啊！能不能顺便办个马拉松？我一直想参加！

source: The pilgrims leave, praising this confirmation of their faith. You spent -N2 MAGIC teaching Scott those tricks so fast, but he gained +N2 MIND for it!
target: 朝圣者们赞颂着这场坚定信仰的神迹，离开了。你消耗 -N2 魔力，才这么快教会斯科特那两招，不过他也因此获得了 +N2 头脑！

source: Um, I don't know if that's possible...?
target: 呃，这真的能做到吗……？

source: Probably not, but if there's anyone in this world horny enough to bring a statue to orgasm, it's %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 大概不能。不过这世上要是真有人骚到能把雕像搞高潮，那肯定是 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。

source: True! I'm proud to call %HIMHER% our friend.
target: 没错！能有 %HIMHER% 这样的朋友，我真骄傲。

source: Hell yeah. You get out of the car and sensually caress a holy statue the pilgrims are gathered around.
target: 那必须的。你下了车，开始充满情欲地抚摸朝圣者们围着的圣像。

source: You whisper salacious, unholy nothings into its ear. Then you double down and start licking the ear.
target: 你贴着它的耳朵，低声说着淫荡亵渎的情话。接着更进一步，开始舔它的耳朵。

source: Isn't this... sacrilege...?
target: 这不是……亵渎吗……？

source: No, my friend. This is a miracle. A REAL miracle.
target: 不，朋友。这是神迹，真正的神迹。

source: You make out with the statue and give it the rubdown of a lifetime. You lose yourself in the pleasure of your tongue on hard, cold marble.
target: 你亲吻雕像，给了它毕生最销魂的按摩。舌头舔过冰冷坚硬的大理石，你沉醉其中，忘乎所以。

source: You lose -N2 MAGIC as you enter a true religious experience. You're not sure if it's your imagination or not, but you think you can hear the statue whispering in your ear...
target: 你损失 -N2 魔力，进入了真正的宗教狂喜。不知道是不是幻觉，你似乎听见雕像在耳边低语……

source: "Giveth me more, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! Don't taketh it away now! Forgive me, Father... for I am... about to sin!!"
target: “再赐予我一点，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！现在可别收走啊！神父，宽恕我……因为我……就要犯罪了！！”

source: Look! The statue magically became wet!
target: 快看！雕像神奇地湿了！

source: It really is a miracle! This blessed statue was wetted by the Lord's own holy hand!
target: 真是神迹！这尊蒙福的圣像，被主亲自用圣手弄湿了！

source: You're pretty sure it was your hand that wetted it, but hey, whatever helps him sleep at night!
target: 你很确定，弄湿它的明明是你的手。不过他爱怎么想就怎么想吧，睡得着就行！

source: The pilgrims leave, reaffirmed in their faith, and you gain +N2 HYPE for rocking that statue's world!
target: 朝圣者们信仰愈发坚定，满意离去。而你把圣像伺候得欲仙欲死，获得 +N2 热度！

source: You're driving along when you pass a small church in the desert. There's a crowd gathered outside it, oohing and ahhing at something. You pull over to investigate.
target: 你们开车经过沙漠中的一间小教堂。外面围着一群人，正对着什么啧啧称奇。你们靠边停车，一探究竟。

source: It's incredible! A bona fide act of providence from the good Lord Himself!
target: 太不可思议了！这绝对是仁慈的主亲自降下的神迹！

source: Hey bros! What's everyone doing?
target: 嘿，兄弟们！大家在干什么？

source: Oh, hello! Are you late arrivals to the pilgrimage of Santiago?
target: 哦，你们好！你们也是去圣地亚哥朝圣，来晚了吗？

source: Nah, we're not pilgrims. But we saw you guys freaking out about something and felt like butting in.
target: 不是，我们不朝圣。就是看你们激动得不行，也想凑个热闹。

source: Butt in all you like! We're witnessing a genuine miracle: behold this crying statue we passed on our way to St. James' shrine!
target: 尽管来！我们正在见证真正的神迹：看这尊会哭泣的雕像！我们是在前往圣雅各圣殿的路上遇见它的！

source: The pilgrim points at a statue of a saint outside the church. It is indeed crying... crying blood, in fact.
target: 朝圣者指向教堂外的一尊圣人像。它确实在哭……准确地说，是在流血泪。

source: And you're... happy about this...?
target: 而你们……还很高兴……？

source: Of course I am! The Lord hath sent us a sign!
target: 当然！主给我们降下了征兆！

source: A sign of what?
target: 什么征兆？

source: A sign of His power! A sign that He is with us!
target: 彰显主之力量的征兆！证明主与我们同在的征兆！

source: And He did that by making some poor statue cry?
target: 所以他就把一尊可怜的雕像弄哭了？

source: Not cool, Lord... not cool.
target: 这可不酷，主啊……真不酷。

source: No, it's not like that. The Lord merely works in mysterious ways.
target: 不，不是那样。主的作为，总是奥妙难测。

source: Well, He definitely stumped me with this mystery. I have no idea what we're supposed to do about this crying statue.
target: 这奥妙可真把我难住了。我完全不知道，该拿这尊哭泣的雕像怎么办。

source: You should get on your knees and pray before the statue with me!
target: 你们应该跟我一起跪在圣像前祈祷！

source: Pass. Polly Geist gets on her knees for no man... well, actually, there's at least one man... and several women... ooh, and that one centaur...
target: 算了吧。我波莉·鬼斯特可不为任何男人下跪……呃，其实至少有一个男人……还有几个女人……哦，还有那个半人马……

source: ...What was I talking about? Oh yeah, we gotta help this statue, guys! It's clearly super sad!
target: ……我刚说到哪儿了？哦对，伙计们，得帮帮这雕像！它明显伤心透了！

source: There's nothing clear about this situation at all, but sure, cheering up the statue is a thing you could try. How do you wipe those bloody tears away?
target: 这情况哪儿明显了。不过，你确实可以试着哄雕像开心。要怎么擦去它的血泪呢？

source: This poor statue has been stuck in this spot for centuries. Rent a limo and take the statue to an exclusive nightclub in order to have... a night to remember!
target: 这可怜雕像在这里困了几百年。租辆豪华轿车，带它去高档夜店，度过……一个难忘之夜！

source: The statue is crying because no one's ever offered it some delicious ice cream.
target: 雕像哭，是因为从来没人请它吃过美味的冰淇淋。

source: LET'S GO! You spend -N2 MONEY on a limo and get in with Polly, Scott, the statue... and the pilgrim?
target: 出发！你花 -N2 金钱租了辆豪华轿车，和波莉、斯科特、雕像一起上车……朝圣者也来了？

source: What? I like partying. Even the Lord took a day off after six days of hard work, you know.
target: 怎么？我也爱派对啊。就连主辛苦工作六天之后，也得休息一天呢。

source: Fair enough, boo! Wanna get sloshed on wine with me on the way to the club?
target: 说得对，宝！去夜店的路上，要不要跟我一起灌葡萄酒，喝个痛快？

source: Fair enough, boo! Wanna do ecstasy with me on the way to the club?
target: 说得对，宝！去夜店的路上，要不要跟我一起嗑摇头丸？

source: Sure! Sacramental wine is a key component of Christian ceremonies! But if there's no altar wine around, store-bought is fine.
target: 当然！圣餐酒可是基督教仪式的重要组成部分！不过没有祭酒的话，商店买的也行。

source: Sure! Religious ecstasy is a key component of living a good, pious life! But if you can't create your own, store-bought is fine.
target: 当然！宗教狂喜可是虔诚美好生活的重要组成部分！要是自己造不出那种狂喜，商店买的也行。

source: Fuck yeah. You all pregame in the limo, then party the night away at the club.
target: 太他妈棒了。你们先在豪车里喝酒热场，接着在夜店里狂欢一整夜。

source: Check it out! The statue's really letting loose!
target: 快看！雕像玩得好放得开！

source: Is it? It's a little hard to tell for sure if the statue is having fun, considering it's an immobile piece of marble.
target: 有吗？考虑到它只是块一动不动的大理石，真不好判断它到底开不开心。

source: Are you kidding? Of course it's having fun! Look how dope it looks in the hat and glasses I gave it!
target: 开玩笑！它当然开心啊！戴上我送的帽子和眼镜，多酷啊！

source: Now THAT is a statue that fucks.
target: 这才叫能把人迷上床的雕像。

source: Well, everyone certainly seems to agree with Polly. The statue's getting offered free drinks from strangers left and right.
target: 好吧，大家显然都同意波莉的话。不断有陌生人过来，请雕像喝酒。

source: Look how cool the statue's playing it while that pretty girl hits on it! Get 'em, tiger!
target: 那漂亮女孩都来勾搭它了，它还这么淡定！上啊，情场猛虎！

source: The statue ends up leaving the club that night in a different limo, wink wink. But you all meet back up at the church the next day.
target: 那晚，雕像最后坐着另一辆豪华轿车离开了夜店，懂的都懂。不过第二天，你们又在教堂碰头。

source: Ugh, my aching head... am I dying? Is this some sort of divine punishment?
target: 呃啊，头疼死了……我要死了吗？这是某种天罚？

source: Don't worry, boo. God gives His hardest hangovers to His sexiest soldiers.
target: 别担心，宝。上帝总把最凶的宿醉，留给最性感的战士。

source: I had fun last night! Actually, I don't really remember last night, but these photos on my phone seem like it was fun. Look how happy we made the statue!
target: 昨晚真开心！其实我都不太记得了，可看手机里的照片，应该玩得很开心。瞧，咱们把雕像哄得多高兴！

source: Awww, look at that smile! YOU did that! You gain +N2 SOUL for showing the old statue a good time.
target: 哎呀，瞧那笑容！这都是你的功劳！你让老雕像玩了个痛快，获得 +N2 灵魂。

source: "What are you talking about?" the other pilgrims ask. "The statue isn't crying over something so simple as ice cream."
target: “你们在说什么？”其他朝圣者问，“雕像怎么可能为了冰淇淋这么简单的东西哭泣。”

source: Are you sure, bro? Have YOU ever had ice cream? I'd cry too if I could never try it!
target: 你确定，兄弟？你吃过冰淇淋吗？要是一辈子都吃不到，我也会哭的！

source: "No, the statue is surely weeping for some great tragedy. Like the sins of monsterkind, or crime and injustice!"
target: “不，雕像肯定是在为某种巨大悲剧流泪，比如怪物的罪孽，或者犯罪与不公！”

source: Yes, and never getting to try ice cream is the greatest crime and injustice of all!
target: 对啊，一辈子吃不到冰淇淋，就是最大的罪恶和不公！

source: Perhaps these strangers are right, fellow pilgrims. This could be a test from the Lord to encourage us to think outside of the box!
target: 朝圣的同伴们，也许这些陌生人说得对。这可能是主的考验，鼓励我们跳出固有思路！

source: "NO!" the pilgrims argue. "We'll be as closed-minded and ornery as we want! That's what the Lord intended!"
target: “不！”朝圣者们反驳，“我们想多固执、多暴躁，就多固执、多暴躁！这才是主的旨意！”

source: Whatever, I'm with %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! This is surely the thing we've been preparing for since the road trip began... a true ICE CREAM EMERGENCY.
target: 随你们怎么说，我支持 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！这一定就是我们从旅行开始时就一直防备的情况……真正的冰淇淋紧急事件。

source: I'll get the hammer!
target: 我去拿锤子！

source: Scott shatters the glass case that once protected your emergency ice cream and grabs a pint of creamy, dairy goodness.
target: 斯科特砸碎应急冰淇淋外的玻璃罩，取出一品脱浓郁香滑的乳制美味。

source: You smear some ice cream on the statue's mouth. You lose -N2 STAMINA not getting to enjoy it yourself, but it's the right thing to do.
target: 你往雕像嘴上抹了些冰淇淋。自己没能吃上，让你损失 -N2 体力，不过这事做得对。

source: "You're covering this saint's statue in sticky, sugary goop?!" the pilgrims gasp. "SACRILEGE!"
target: “你们往圣像上抹黏糊糊的糖浆？！”朝圣者们惊叫，“亵渎！”

source: No, look! The strangers have caused the statue to exhibit joy! It's not sacrilege, it's a miracle!
target: 不，快看！这些陌生人让雕像露出了喜悦！这不是亵渎，是神迹！

source: Aww, look at that smile! YOU did that!
target: 哎呀，瞧那笑容！这都是你的功劳！

source: Good work, bros. I always knew the answer to our problems was ice cream.
target: 干得好，兄弟们。我就知道，有什么问题，吃冰淇淋就能解决。

source: The pilgrims grudgingly admit that you were right, and +N2 SOUL is bestowed upon you for your good deed. Woohoo!
target: 朝圣者们勉强承认你做得对，你的善举为你赢得 +N2 灵魂。好耶！

source: You're driving along what you think is an empty road, until a weird salesman-looking motherfucker jumps in front of your car!
target: 你以为前方是条空无一人的路，开着开着，一个推销员模样的怪家伙突然跳到车前！

source: Good morning, future customers! Are you interested in making a deal?
target: 早上好，未来的顾客们！有兴趣做笔交易吗？

source: Maybe! What's the deal?
target: 也许有！什么交易？

source: Just ignore him, Scott. He's either trying to sell us a pyramid scheme or a vacuum, and I want no part of either.
target: 别理他，斯科特。他要么想拉我们搞金字塔传销，要么想卖吸尘器，哪样我都没兴趣。

source: Why, I never! This is no pyramid scheme. It's a chance to buy into my incredibly lucrative essential embalming oils business!
target: 这是什么话！这可不是金字塔传销，而是投资我这利润丰厚的防腐精油事业的大好机会！

source: You only have to invest $2000 to get your first salesman kit, but you'll earn the money back as you find customers to buy your luxury oils.
target: 只要投资 2000 美元，你就能获得首套销售礼包。找到顾客，卖出这些奢华精油，本钱自然就回来了。

source: You can earn extra by recruiting five other suckers -- I mean SELLERS -- to sell these kits, and you'll earn commission on their sales!
target: 再招五个冤大头——我是说销售员——来卖礼包，还能从他们的销售额里抽成，多赚一笔！

source: So, to clarify: you're at the top of this oil-selling chain, so you'd be making commission on our sales, right?
target: 所以说清楚：你站在这条精油销售链的最上头，我们卖东西，你就能抽成，对吧？

source: Right!
target: 没错！

source: And in order for us to earn any commission ourselves, we have to sell these kits to at least five people.
target: 而我们要想拿抽成，就得把这些礼包卖给至少五个人。

source: Right.
target: 对。

source: And then THOSE five people have to find five MORE people apiece to get their own commission, and then those five have to find five more, and so on...
target: 然后，那五个人各自还得再找五个人，才能拿到抽成。接着每人又找五个，如此循环……

source: Right...
Okay, you lost me.
target: 好吧，我已经听不懂了。

source: So if I draw that chain of command on this piece of paper, from top to bottom... what am I drawing?
target: 那要是我拿张纸，把这个上下级结构从上往下画出来……会是什么形状？

source: ...A triangle?
target: ……三角形？

source: Jeez, you're persistent. Look, if you're gonna scam us, you could at least pick a scam that isn't so overdone. Mix it up a little!
target: 天哪，你还真不死心。听着，要骗我们，起码挑个没被用烂的骗局吧。换点花样！

source: Yeah! He could try something like...
target: 对！他可以试试，比如……

source: The "Circular Scheme". You're still scammed, but at least everyone is equally scammed!
target: “圆形传销”。照样被骗，不过至少人人都被骗得一样多！

source: The "Truncated Icosahedron Scheme". You're still scammed, but it's a very sophisticated shape nonetheless!
target: “截角二十面体传销”。照样被骗，但这个形状起码足够精妙！

source: Hey, that's a great idea!
target: 嘿，这主意真好！

source: It is?
target: 是吗？

source: Yeah! The whole problem with pyramid schemes is that you're scamming innocent people. You should only scam other scammers who deserve it!
target: 对啊！金字塔传销的问题，就是在骗无辜的人。应该只骗那些罪有应得的骗子！

source: It's like karma! What goes around comes back around.
target: 就像因果报应！转来转去，总会转回自己身上。

source: Like, let's say you get us to buy your dumb oil. Sure, we got scammed, boo hoo. But we'll scam someone ourselves eventually!
target: 比如，你骗我们买了这破精油。好吧，我们上当了，呜呜呜。可我们迟早也会骗别人啊！

source: We will?
target: 会吗？

source: I mean, at least 20% of our pranks could be considered scams, so it's pretty likely.
target: 咱们至少有百分之二十的恶作剧能算骗局，所以可能性很大。

source: Then later on, the person we scammed will scam someone else, then that person will scam someone, and so on and so forth...
target: 接着，被我们骗的人又去骗别人，那个人再骗另一个人，这么一路传下去……

source: Until eventually, someone who was scammed by someone who was scammed by someone who was scammed by someone who was scammed by us will scam YOU!
target: 直到最后，被我们骗的人骗过的人骗过的人骗过的人骗过的人……再去骗你！

source: And the Circular Scheme will be closed in a cycle of beautiful comeuppance!
target: 圆形传销就此闭环，皆大欢喜，报应不爽！

source: ...Are you investing in my embalming oils scheme or not?
target: ……你们到底投不投资我的防腐精油项目？

source: We are! But you'll get what's coming to you someday, maybe!
target: 投！不过你迟早会遭报应的，大概吧！

source: Sure I will. Sign here, please.
target: 会的会的。请在这里签名。

source: You lose -N2 MONEY, but you did a good deed today, bringing a bit more fairness into the world of scams!
target: 你损失 -N2 金钱，不过今天做了件好事，让骗局的世界多了一点公平！

source: ...Well, you think you did at least. And thinking you did good is apparently still enough to earn +N2 SOUL!
target: ……至少你自己这么觉得。显然，只要觉得自己做了好事，也足够获得 +N2 灵魂！

source: Wow! Such a beautiful, complex shape. A truncated icosahedron scheme would be a geometric wonder of a scam!
target: 哇，多漂亮、多复杂的形状！截角二十面体传销，简直是诈骗界的几何奇迹！

source: Ah, a scammer after my own heart. Are you also enamored by the beauty of ill-gotten income?
target: 啊，原来是个志同道合的骗子。你也为不义之财的美丽着迷吗？

source: Nah, not usually. I'm just really high right now.
target: 没有，平时不会。我就是现在嗑嗨了。

source: Polly, what's a trunkkitty icecreamahedron?
target: 波莉，什么叫“切饺二十冰淇淋体”？

source: I'd be happy to explain the truncated icosahedron to you, my boy... for a fee, of course.
target: 孩子，我很乐意给你讲讲截角二十面体……当然，得收费。

source: Sure! Knowledge is priceless! Take our money and educate us, O wise geometry mummy!
target: 行啊！知识无价！拿走我们的钱，教导我们吧，睿智的几何木乃伊！

source: With pleasure! So, the truncated icosahedron is a three-dimensional shape with thirty-two faces, sixty vertices, and ninety edges.
target: 乐意之至！截角二十面体是一种立体图形，有三十二个面、六十个顶点、九十条棱。

source: It's used to calibrate atomic bombs, manufacture soccer balls, and scam gullible ghosts and werewolves on the side of the road.
target: 它能用来校准原子弹、制造足球，还能在路边骗骗好忽悠的幽灵和狼人。

source: Wow, I never knew they used math in soccer! I have so much to learn!
target: 哇，我都不知道踢足球也用得上数学！要学的还多着呢！

source: And I have so much more to teach you! For a fee, of course.
target: 我能教你的，也还多着呢！当然，得收费。

source: YAAASSS, LET'S GO! Tell us about the snub cube next!
target: 好耶——来吧！接下来给我们讲讲扭棱立方体！

source: Polly starts making it rain -N2 MONEY over the salesman while he pulls out a blackboard and a textbook.
target: 推销员掏出黑板和课本，波莉则开始朝他撒钞票，撒了足足 -N2 金钱。

source: A car pulls up behind you and honks its horn. "Would you move?!" the driver shouts. "You're blocking the road!"
target: 一辆车停到你们后面，按起喇叭。“能不能让开？！”司机喊道，“你们挡路了！”

source: CAN IT, ASSHOLE! IT'S GEOMETRY TIME! EITHER DRIVE AROUND OR PULL OVER AND LEARN ABOUT SHAPES!
target: 闭嘴，混蛋！现在是几何时间！要么绕过去，要么靠边停下，一起学图形！

source: You gain +N2 MIND over the next several geometry lessons. You also make some people late to work, but hey, not your problem!
target: 接下来的几节几何课，让你获得 +N2 头脑。也害得一些人上班迟到了，不过，那关你什么事！

source: The birds are singing, the motor is purring, Scott is snoring like a freight train... what could possibly ruin this peaceful drive?
target: 鸟儿鸣唱，引擎轻响，斯科特打起鼾来像货运火车……还有什么能打破这一路的宁静？

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%, SOMEONE JUST JUMPED IN THE ROAD!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%，有人跳到路上了！

source: HOLY SHIT SOMEONE DID JUST JUMP IN THE ROAD! You barely manage to swerve out of the way in time.
target: 我操，还真有人跳到路上了！你猛打方向盘，险险躲了过去。

source: Sorry, didn't see you folks there! Say, now that you're here, would you like to make a deal?
target: 抱歉，没看见各位！话说，既然来了，要不要做笔交易？

source: Oh my God, are you seriously starting a sales pitch like this? %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, is it too late to run him over?
target: 天哪，你还真打算这样开始推销？%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，现在碾过去还来得及吗？

source: You can go right ahead, I don't mind. Wanna know why?
target: 尽管碾，我不介意。想知道为什么吗？

source: Because... you're crazy?
target: 因为……你疯了？

source: Meanwhile, Scott keeps snoring. Damn, that guy can sleep through anything.
target: 与此同时，斯科特还在打鼾。妈的，这家伙真是什么情况都睡得着。

source: Nope! Because I've already invested in my AFTERLIFE PLAN!
target: 不！因为我已经投资了自己的来世计划！

source: The salesman slaps a flyer on your windshield. It says, "The Afterlife Plan: What are you bringing to the Field of Reeds?"
target: 推销员把一张传单拍在挡风玻璃上，上面写着：“来世计划：你打算带什么去芦苇原？”

source: Polly flicks on your windshield wipers, and the flyer gets swept away.
target: 波莉打开雨刷，把传单扫了下去。

source: No thanks, I don't need a retirement plan. I've already decided to spend my pension years blowing all my savings in Ibiza.
target: 不必了，我不需要退休计划。早就决定了，退休后我要去伊维萨岛，把积蓄全挥霍光。

source: Oh no, you misunderstand. The Afterlife Plan isn't for retirement. It's all about reserving top-quality products to keep you company AFTER you've died.
target: 不不，你误会了。来世计划可不管退休，而是帮你预订高品质商品，死后也有它们作伴！

source: So I'm planning stuff to do after I'm done on this plane of existence? That's kinda cool!
target: 所以，这是安排离开这个存在层面以后的娱乐活动？挺酷嘛！

source: *YAAAAWN!* Morning, bros! Morning, salesman I don't know! How did you get on the hood of our car?
target: *哈——欠！*兄弟们，早啊！不认识的推销员，早啊！你怎么跑到我们车头上去了？

source: Hey, Scott! So long story short, everyone in this car is already or will be dead someday, and I'm suddenly convinced we need to buy activities to do in the Afterlife.
target: 嘿，斯科特！简单说，这车里的人不是已经死了，就是迟早会死。而我突然觉得，咱们得买点来世的娱乐活动。

source: Which would be more fun to play for all eternity: mancala or Cards Against Monstrosity?
target: 要是玩到永远，曼卡拉棋和《反怪物卡牌》哪个更好玩？

source: EVERYONE IN THIS CAR WILL BE DEAD SOMEDAY?!
target: 这车里的每个人迟早都会死？！

source: Yeesh, that's a rough thing to wake up to. While Scott tries not to freak out, you take the liberty of picking something out of the Afterlife Plan catalogue:
target: 哎呀，一睡醒就听见这个，确实够呛。趁斯科特努力稳住情绪，你从来世计划的商品目录里，自作主张地挑了一件：

source: When you're dead, you'll finally have time to check out the book "100 Movies You Have to Watch After You Die."
target: 死后，你终于有空读《死后必看的 100 部电影》这本书了。

source: A VHS tape of the life of someone more interesting than you to flash before your eyes instead of your own.
target: 买一盘比你活得精彩的人的人生 VHS 录像带，让它在你眼前播放，代替你自己的人生走马灯。

source: Excellent choice! That'll be -N2 MONEY. No refunds in the afterlife!
target: 选得好！一共 -N2 金钱。来世恕不退款！

source: You all flip through the book. Some of the highlights include...
target: 你们翻起书来。精彩条目包括……

source: "89. 'The Brunch Bunch': A classic coming-of-age movie that anyone who was a teenager in the 80s will assume everyone can relate to."
target: “89.《早午餐俱乐部》：经典青春成长片。只要八十年代当过青少年，就会觉得全世界都能跟它共鸣。”

source: "You'll love the nostalgic soundtrack. Actually, you'll be dead, so you probably won't notice it, but trust me: it's awesome."
target: “你一定会爱上那怀旧的配乐。当然，那时你已经死了，可能根本听不见。不过相信我，超棒的。”

source: "64. 'Shrek 48: Donkey's Marriage Story': I admit that making so many 'Shrek' movies was excessive, but Shrek 48 was a diamond in the swamp."
target: “64.《怪物史莱克 48：驴子的婚姻故事》：我承认，《怪物史莱克》拍这么多部有点过头了，可第 48 部真是沼泽中的钻石。”

source: "Watching Donkey and Dragon's marriage fall apart will break your heart... if your heart is still beating, that is. In death, you'll probably be less emotionally affected."
target: “看着驴子和火龙的婚姻分崩离析，你会心碎……前提是心脏还在跳。既然已经死了，大概就没那么伤感了。”

source: "1. 'An Interview with Satan': Hands-down my favorite documentary about the multiverse's oldest, most infamous rebel."
target: “1.《撒旦访谈录》：这部纪录片讲述了多元宇宙里最古老、最臭名昭著的叛逆者，是我最爱的纪录片，毫无悬念。”

source: "I admit, I have an ulterior motive for adding this film. I'm assuming you're reading this in the afterlife, and there's at least a 50% chance you wound up in Hell."
target: “说实话，把这部片加进来，我是有私心的。我猜你此刻正在来世读这本书，而且至少有百分之五十的概率下了地狱。”

source: "If you would, please send me an autograph from Satan, or at the very least a video-taped shoutout, at hello@watchmummy.com."
target: “方便的话，请把撒旦的签名寄给我，实在不行，录段打招呼的视频也好。邮箱是 hello@watchmummy.com。”

source: You gain +N2 MIND knowing that you'll be watching all of these someday in the Great Beyond. Nice!
target: 想到有朝一日能在另一个世界看完这些片子，你获得 +N2 头脑。不错！

source: Excellent choice! That'll be -N2 MONEY. No refunds in the afterlife!
target: 选得好！一共 -N2 金钱。来世恕不退款！

source: Good choice! I mean, I personally really enjoyed watching my life flash before my eyes. It was like the ultimate Chatsnap memories rewind.
target: 选得不错！我个人特别喜欢死前的人生走马灯，简直是终极版 Chatsnap 回忆回放。

source: But I understand wanting to skip watching your life in favor of the life of someone cooler, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. I'd have done the same if I were you!
target: 不过，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，不想看自己那辈子，想换个更酷的人生，我也能理解。换我处在你的位置，我也会这么选！

source: Man, I know we're supposed to wait for %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% to die, but I'm so curious! Can we watch the tape now?
target: 我知道该等 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 死了再看，可我真的好好奇！现在能看吗？

source: Sure! You grab your 2000s-era TV with built-in VCR (never leave home without it!) and roll the tape.
target: 当然！你搬出那台两千年代的电视，内置录像机的那种（出门必带！），开始播放录像。

source: You see a somewhat-faded memory of an extremely cool dude accepting a first-place trophy.
target: 一段有些褪色的记忆浮现：一个酷得不得了的家伙，正在领取冠军奖杯。

source: Hey, this must be the life of Rex Radikal! He's the guy who invented XXXtreme Sports!
target: 嘿，这肯定是雷克斯·拉迪卡尔的人生！就是他发明了 XXX 极限运动！

source: That rocks! Scott and I go to the XXXtreme Sports championship every year. It's sorta like the cooler version of the Mile High Club.
target: 太棒了！我和斯科特每年都去 XXX 极限运动锦标赛。算是“高空性爱俱乐部”的升级版，酷多了。

source: Look, now we're watching Rex's wedding!
target: 看，现在播到雷克斯的婚礼了！

source: Aww, cute! He's skydiving with his new wife!
target: 啊，真可爱！他正在和新婚妻子一起跳伞！

source: NOW THEY'RE HAVING SEX WHILE SKYDIVING! THIS FUCKING RULES!
target: 现在他们一边跳伞一边做爱了！太他妈牛了！

source: Whoa, now Rex is watching his wife give birth while skydiving. That's commitment!
target: 哇，现在雷克斯正看着老婆一边跳伞一边生孩子。真够投入的！

source: Now he's publishing his autobiography!
target: 现在他出自传了！

source: "An XXXtraordinary Life: the memoirs of a man whose only flaw was being too good at sex."
target: 《XXX 非凡人生：一个除了床上功夫太好，别无缺点的男人的回忆录》。

source: I read it last year. It was full of typos and syntax errors, but that's only because Rex wrote the whole thing while skydiving.
target: 我去年看过。里面错字和病句一大堆，不过那是因为雷克斯整本书都是跳着伞写的。

source: You watch Rex Radikal raise his kids, play catch with his grandson, and become the first monster to go down on someone while skydiving from space.
target: 你看着雷克斯·拉迪卡尔养大孩子，陪孙子玩传接球，还成了第一个从太空跳伞时给人口交的怪物。

source: The last thing you see is Rex smiling serenely before flatlining on his deathbed... and popping one last wicked boner.
target: 最后的画面里，雷克斯在病床上安详地微笑，心跳终于归零……还留下了最后一次牛逼的勃起。

source: Man, you'd give anything to be that cool. At least you gained +N2 HYPE living vicariously through Rex's final moments!
target: 天哪，能像他这么酷，你什么都愿意换。至少，借着录像体验雷克斯的最后时光，让你获得 +N2 热度！

source: Scott stops the car at a stop sign. Before he can get going again, there's a knock on the driver's side window...
target: 斯科特在停车标志前停下车。还没来得及重新出发，驾驶座旁的窗户就被敲响了……

source: Hello, customers! I'm a traveling roadside salesman, and I have a fabulous deal just for you!
target: 顾客们，你们好！我是沿路做生意的旅行推销员，有笔专为各位准备的超值买卖！

source: Hey, I remember you! You stopped our car and sold us something earlier!
target: 嘿，我记得你！你之前拦过我们的车，还卖了东西给我们！

source: You said these "Cursed Earrings of Horrible Curses" would be 100% curse-free if we bought the "Probably Not Cursed Warranty Package"...
target: 你说，只要买了“应该没诅咒保修套餐”，这副“可怕诅咒之诅咒耳环”就能百分之百不带诅咒……

source: But it didn't work, and now we've just got two cursed earrings AND a cursed warranty statement full of big words that hurt my brain.
target: 可根本没用！现在我们不但有两只被诅咒的耳环，还有份被诅咒的保修声明，里面全是看得我脑壳疼的大词。

source: We want our money back!
target: 把钱还给我们！

source: Is that so? May I direct your attention to my refund policy...
target: 是吗？那请各位看看我的退款政策……

source: "If you are dissatisfied with your product, you can only return it for a refund if you correctly answer one of my riddles."
target: “如对产品不满，必须先正确回答我的一道谜语，才能退货退款。”

source: Ugh, fine. Lay it on me, then.
target: 唉，行吧。那你说。

source: "I have one voice, four feet in the morning, two feet in the afternoon, and three feet at night. What am I?"
target: “我只有一种声音，早上四只脚，下午两只脚，晚上三只脚。我是什么？”

source: You're a seahorse! No, wait, a regular horse! No, wait... AN AIR HOCKEY TABLE! Final answer!
target: 你是海马！不对，普通的马！不，等等……气垫球桌！最终答案！

source: I don't think that's it, buddy -- but don't worry, I have a plan! Let's ask The Horny Dating App (TM)!
target: 应该不对，伙计。不过别担心，我有办法！咱们问问“饥渴约会 App（TM）”！

source: I'll update my profile: "Sexy, fun-loving ghost looking for someone who's openminded to kinks, likes reading, and has four feet in the morning, two at noon, and three at night."
