target: 我改改个人简介：“性感又爱玩的女鬼，找个性癖开放、喜欢阅读，而且早上四只脚、中午两只脚、晚上三只脚的人。”

source: ...Dammit, all I'm getting are assholes who have the same number of feet 24/7. Dating app algorithms suck!
target: ……妈的，匹配来的混蛋，一天到晚脚的数量都不变。约会软件的算法烂透了！

source: Looks like your friends' deduction methods are dead ends. Time for you to swoop in and solve this riddle...
target: 看来朋友们的推理全走进了死胡同。该你闪亮登场，解开谜语了……

source: Life always finds a way. Build a logic-defying chimera that satisfies all the requisites of the riddle.
target: 生命总会找到出路。造出一个无视逻辑、满足谜语全部条件的奇美拉。

source: "How much do you charge for the answer? I'll pay anything to get my friend's money back!"
target: “答案卖多少钱？只要能替朋友拿回钱，花多少我都愿意！”

source: You upend the crate of raw meat you just happened to be carrying around and use -N2 MAGIC to give it life!
target: 你倒出那箱碰巧随身带着的生肉，消耗 -N2 魔力，赋予它生命！

source: WHAT THE FUCK IS THAT?!
target: 这他妈是什么东西？！

source: It's a grotesque, shambling meat-creature, constantly growing new feet and dropping them as it trudges along in endless torment. But more importantly...
target: 这是个丑陋、踉跄的肉块生物。它在无尽的痛苦中蹒跚前行，一边不断长出新脚，一边不断掉脚。不过更重要的是……

source: It's the answer to your dumb riddle, obviously!
target: 它显然就是你那破谜语的答案！

source: No it isn't! The answer was "human", because they crawl on all fours when they're babies, then walk on two feet when they're adults--
target: 才不是！答案是“人类”，因为人小时候四肢爬行，成年后用两条腿走路——

source: I don't think that's right, bro. If human was the answer, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s spell would've made a human, and that is NOT what happened.
target: 我觉得不对啊，兄弟。答案要是人类，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 的咒语造出来的就该是人类，可现在这明显不是啊。

source: "%FATHERMOTHER%!" the creature wails in agony. "Please... kill me...!"
target: “%FATHERMOTHER%！”那生物痛苦地哀号，“求你……杀了我……！”

source: Awww! Its first words!
target: 哎呀！它开口说话了！

source: Haha, now it's growing a foot on its tongue! Weird!
target: 哈哈，它舌头上又长了只脚！真怪！

source: By Anubis, this can't be happening...
target: 阿努比斯在上，这不可能……

source: So, are we good now? We followed your dumb conditions, which means I get my money back.
target: 所以，行了吧？我们按你的破规矩办了，该还钱了。

source: Well, this isn't QUITE what I had in mind... but frankly, I'm a bit terrified of you all now, so sure. Here's your refund.
target: 呃，这跟我想的……不太一样。不过说实话，我现在有点怕你们了。行，这是退款。

source: Pleasure doing business with ya, boo! And since you were so obsessed with this riddle-creature, you can keep it!
target: 合作愉快，宝！既然你这么喜欢这个谜语生物，那它就送你了！

source: Oh, no, I couldn't possibly--
target: 哦不，我可不能——

source: No need to thank us! Just remember to rub its feet sometimes to soothe its endless pain!
target: 不用谢！记得时不时给它揉揉脚，缓解一下它无尽的痛苦！

source: You leave the creature with the salesman, and gain +N2 MIND for solving that riddle!
target: 你把生物留给推销员，因解开谜语而获得 +N2 头脑！

source: What? If you pay me for your refund, won't you just lose money in the end?
target: 什么？为了退款再给我钱，到头来你们不是反而亏了吗？

source: Look at me. Seriously, look at me. Look deep into my eyes, and hear me when I say: I literally don't care.
target: 看着我。认真看着我。看着我的眼睛，把这句话听清楚：我、根、本、不、在、乎。

source: But that doesn't make any sense...
target: 可这说不通啊……

source: Who cares about making sense? I just want MY money back! It was my FAVORITE MONEY!
target: 谁管它通不通！我就要拿回我的钱！那可是我最喜欢的钱！

source: Those dollars and I have been through thick and thin together, and I can't end our long, storied friendship by spending them on a scam!
target: 那些钞票跟我风雨同舟，经历过那么多。我可不能因为一场骗局，就结束这段漫长又精彩的友谊！

source: I... you know what? I have no reason to be talking you out of this.
target: 我……算了，我干吗要劝你别这样。

source: I'll tell you the riddle's solution and give you your refund for -N2 MONEY. It was--
target: 花 -N2 金钱，我就告诉你答案，再给你退款。答案是——

source: Let me stop you right there: I don't care. I never cared. Keep your dumb riddle to yourself and just give me my cash back.
target: 打住。我不在乎，从来就不在乎。你那破谜语自己留着，把钱还给我就行。

source: Fine, have it your way. See you next time!
target: 行，随你便。下次见！

source: Polly gets her dollars back, and you gain +N2 MIND for "solving the riddle" by throwing money at the problem until it went away. Pay-to-win for the win!
target: 波莉拿回钞票，你则靠不断砸钱，直到问题消失，成功“解开谜语”，获得 +N2 头脑。氪金必胜！

source: As you're driving, you pass a weird salesman who's set up a pop-up shop on the side of the road.
target: 赶路时，你们经过一位古怪的推销员。他在路边支起了一个临时摊位。

source: Ah, new customers! Welcome to my magic artifact flash sale, where everything absolutely MUST go!
target: 啊，新顾客！欢迎光临魔法神器限时大甩卖，所有东西必须清空！

source: Neat! How much is this stuff?
target: 不错！这些多少钱？

source: It's all free! You just have to take it right now and never ever bring it back or tell people who gave it to you.
target: 全都免费！只要你们现在就拿走，永远别带回来，也别告诉任何人是谁给你们的。

source: Why do you want to get rid of these products so badly?
target: 你为什么这么急着把这些东西脱手？

source: They were taking up space in my inventory is all. They're definitely not cursed!
target: 就是太占库存而已。绝对没有诅咒！

source: I love free stuff that isn't cursed! Can I get something, Polly? Pretty please?

source: "I remember how much you like to build furniture, and it'd be cool to turn the nightstand you made me last year into a matching set."
target: “记得你很喜欢做家具。你去年送我的那个床头柜，要是能再添一个凑成一套，肯定很棒。”

source: Aww, %HESHE% even remembered %HISHER% ex's weird, niche interests!
target: 哎呀，%HESHE% 连 %HISHER% 前任那些冷门小爱好都记得！

source: "Hope to hear from you soon! -%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%"
target: “盼复！——%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%”

source: Wow, you did it! You texted your ex without sounding weepy, horny, or desperate! You MUST be sober!
target: 哇，你做到了！给前任发短信，居然既不哭哭啼啼，也不饥渴，更不死缠烂打！你绝对没喝醉！

source: Yeah, the logic is sound... sorry we put you through the wringer, kid. Drive safe! Good luck finding love again someday!
target: 对，逻辑说得通……抱歉折腾你了，孩子。开车小心！也祝你早日重新找到爱情！

source: Good job, bro! That text was so mature and adult, I think we even lost -N2 HYPE over it!
target: 干得好，兄弟！这短信太成熟、太有大人样了，感觉咱们都因此损失了 -N2 热度！

source: Oh... and your friends are happy about that because...?
target: 哦……所以，朋友们为什么还这么高兴……？

source: I mean, sure, it's sort of a bummer. But sometimes doing the right thing is more important than doing the fun thing, you know?
target: 确实，有点扫兴。不过有时候，做对的事比做有趣的事更重要，懂吧？

source: Wow, everyone in this car is acting mature today! And for proving your sobriety and reconnecting with your ex in a healthy way, you gained +N2 SOUL.
target: 哇，今天车里人人都这么成熟！你证明自己没醉，还以健康的方式重新联系了前任，获得 +N2 灵魂。

source: Great plan! You and your friends pop some bottles and get sloshed.
target: 好主意！你和朋友们开了几瓶酒，喝得烂醉。

source: The cops also get drunk with you "for supervision purposes", and definitely not because they just wanted to drink on the clock.
target: 警察也以“监督”为由，陪你们喝醉了。绝对不是想借上班时间喝酒。

source: WOOOO, I feel great! Why do we even arrest people for public intoxication? This rules!
target: 呜——爽！我们干吗还抓在公共场所喝醉的人？这不是很好玩吗！

source: Haha, yeeeah... say, do you kids wanna try out my gun?
target: 哈哈，是啊……话说，孩子们，想试试我的枪吗？

source: Sure! Can we shoot cans off each other's heads?
target: 好啊！能不能轮流把罐子顶在头上，让别人打下来？

source: Eh, that could turn into a lot of paperwork... but that's a problem for sober-me, so sure, why not!
target: 呃，可能得写不少报告……不过，那是清醒以后的我该操心的。现在当然可以！

source: Ooh, you know what else we could do? GRAFFITI! I've got some spray paint in the trunk that I was definitely going to use for legal reasons only.
target: 哦，咱们还能干什么，你们知道吗？涂鸦！后备箱里还有喷漆，我本来绝对只打算拿它做合法的事。

source: Fun! Polly grabs the spray paint, and you and the cops tag a few road signs.
target: 有意思！波莉拿来喷漆，你和警察一起，在几个路牌上涂了起来。

source: Look, I graffiti'd "FUCK COPS" and put my phone number underneath, heh heh.
target: 看，我写了“干警察”，底下还留了电话号码，嘿嘿。

source: Awesome, bro! Good luck getting back into the dating scene!
target: 棒啊，兄弟！祝你重返情场，一切顺利！

source: I wrote "ACAB!"
target: 我写了“ACAB”！

source: Uh... do you know what ACAB means?
target: 呃……你知道 ACAB 是什么意思吗？

source: It's what the kids say these days, right? I cleverly figured out it meant "All Cherubs Appreciate Buddycops!"
target: 现在年轻人都这么说，对吧？我聪明着呢，早猜出来了：All Cherubs Appreciate Buddycops，所有小天使都爱警察好搭档！

source: It's true! I do appreciate you, partner. I appreciate the fucking hell outta you.
target: 没错！我确实很珍惜你，搭档。珍惜得他妈不要不要的。

source: All right, kids, you're in the clear. You were obviously sober before, 'cause you weren't nearly this much fun then.
target: 好了，孩子们，没你们的事了。你们之前明显没醉，那会儿可没现在好玩。

source: We'd better get back to our jobs; there's been a bank robbery in progress for, like, half an hour now. See ya! Drive safe!
target: 咱们也该回去干活了。有家银行都被抢半个小时了。再见！开车小心！

source: ACAB FOREVER!
target: ACAB 万岁！

source: They leave, and after waiting a couple hours to sober up, so do you. You lost -N2 MIND from all the alcohol consumption, but the +N2 HYPE you gained was worth it!
target: 警察离开了。你们又等了几个小时醒酒，才继续上路。喝酒让你损失 -N2 头脑，不过换来 +N2 热度，值了！

source: A cop car pulls up behind you and signals for you to pull over. Shit...
target: 一辆警车开到后面，示意你靠边停车。妈的……

source: Good morning, fellas. Can we see everyone's licenses, please?
target: 早上好，各位。请出示一下所有人的驾驶证。

source: Wait a second... partner, look at this ghost girl's ID!
target: 等等……搭档，看看这幽灵姑娘的证件！

source: Ugh, I know, it's expired. But I never drive anyway, and do you know how hard it is to get the DMV to issue you a new ID when you're legally dead?
target: 唉，我知道，过期了。可我又不开车。你知道法律上已经死了的人，去车管所补办证件有多麻烦吗？

source: No, it's not that. You and your hairy friend here look suspiciously similar to these fugitives! Look!
target: 不是这个。你和旁边这位毛茸茸的朋友，跟这两个逃犯长得太像了！看！

source: The cops show you some wanted posters. The fugitives admittedly DO look similar to your friends...
target: 警察拿出通缉海报。不得不说，那两个逃犯跟你的朋友们还真挺像……

source: Great job identifying the perps, partner. You two, keep your hands and wagging tail where I can see them and step out of the car!
target: 认人认得好，搭档。你们两个，把手和摇来摇去的尾巴放在我看得见的地方，下车！

source: But we're not the criminals on the poster!
target: 可我们不是海报上的罪犯！

source: One, I would never wear THOSE shades with THAT top.
target: 首先，我绝不会拿那副墨镜，配那件上衣。

source: Two, Scott and I haven't commited "dozens of crimes." We've commited, like, four or five tops.
target: 其次，我和斯科特哪有犯“几十桩罪”。顶多也就四五桩。

source: What do you expect us to do, missy? Investigative work?
target: 小姐，你还指望我们干什么，调查取证吗？

source: Fuck no. This isn't a detective movie... we're just gonna arrest you two. It's almost time for lunch anyway.
target: 操，才不干。这又不是侦探电影……直接把你俩抓了就是。反正快到饭点了。

source: Get out of the car now! Don't cause any trouble, or you'll get the really pinchy handcuffs!
target: 马上下车！别惹事，不然就给你们戴最夹肉的手铐！

source: Nuh-uh, federal prison is NOT an acceptable final destination for this road trip. Stop the cops from arresting Polly and Scott!
target: 不行，联邦监狱可不能成为这趟公路旅行的最终目的地。阻止警察逮捕波莉和斯科特！

source: Organize the long-awaited 3rd Annual Polly and Scott lookalike contest in order to lure in the real criminals with a cash prize.
target: 举办大家盼望已久的第三届年度波莉与斯科特模仿大赛，用现金大奖把真凶引来。

source: Practice the art of deception by writing "NOT" on the wanted poster.
target: 在通缉海报上加个“不”字，施展一下蒙骗的艺术。

source: Bro, is it finally time for the 3rd Polly and Scott lookalike contest?! I was a huge fan of the first two!
target: 兄弟，终于要办第三届波莉与斯科特模仿大赛了吗？！前两届我可喜欢了！

source: Looks like it! We just need the proper funds to get started!
target: 看来是的！只要凑够启动资金就行！

source: The precinct WAS gonna use this year's budget to upgrade our gear, but this is definitely more important. We'll give you some money.
target: 警局本来打算拿今年的预算升级装备，不过这事显然更重要。我们出点钱。

source: You match the cops' contribution with -N2 MONEY of your own to fund the event. Soon, you're judging the costumes of hundreds of knockoff Pollys and Scotts!
target: 你也拿出 -N2 金钱，与警察的出资凑个对半，资助比赛。很快，你就开始给几百个冒牌波莉和斯科特的装扮打分！

source: Howdy, my brothers in sports-team! I'm Scott! I've got a head full of stuffing and a heart full of joy!
target: 运动队里的好兄弟们，你们好！我是斯科特！我脑袋里满是棉花，心里满是快乐！

source: Haha, that's so me! 10 out of 10 costume, bro!
target: 哈哈，太像我了！兄弟，这身装扮十分满分，给你十分！

source: YAHOO! It's Polly o'clock! Time for some shenanigans with the PRACTICAL JOKERZ!
target: 呀呼！现在是波莉时间！该跟“搞笑恶作剧团”一起闹事啦！

source: Eh, your costume's a little low-effort... but damn if your performance didn't perfectly capture my essence. 6.9 out of 10!
target: 呃，你的装扮有点敷衍……不过这表演还真把我的精髓拿捏住了。十分满分，给你 6.9 分！

source: Sup, dudes? I'm Chaz!
target: 嘿，伙计们，我是查兹！

source: Hi Chaz! Boy, you're handsome! Can we hear your Scott impression?
target: 嗨，查兹！你真帅！能模仿一下斯科特给我们听吗？

source: My what impression? Who's Scott?
target: 模仿什么？斯科特是谁？

source: Are... are you not here for the Polly and Scott Lookalike Contest?
target: 你……你不是来参加波莉与斯科特模仿大赛的？

source: Nah, I was looking for the breakfast buffet. I guess it's in the other atrium. Sorry to intrude!
target: 不是，我在找早餐自助餐。估计在另一个中庭。抱歉，打扰了！

source: Well, we've interviewed every contestant, and none of them were our fugitives. This was a waste of time!
target: 好吧，每个选手都问过了，没有逃犯。真是浪费时间！

source: Hmmm... did you check those Polly-and-Scott lookalikes stealing the cash prize over there?
target: 唔……那边两个长得像波莉和斯科特、正在偷奖金的人，你们查过吗？

source: What?! HEY, YOU TWO! PUT YOUR HANDS IN THE AIR!
target: 什么？！嘿，你们两个！举起手来！

source: Shit, they ran off! Which way did they go?! Everyone here looks like our perps!
target: 妈的，跑了！往哪儿去了？！这儿每个人都长得像嫌犯！

source: Yeah, maybe a venue where everyone looks the same was a bad place to lure a fugitive... but it's not your problem! Take +N2 HYPE and get on with the road trip!
target: 是啊，把逃犯引到人人都长得一样的地方，好像不太明智……不过，不关你的事！拿上 +N2 热度，继续公路旅行吧！

source: While the cop is distracted looking for the very pinchy handcuffs, you manage to write the word "NOT" on his poster in marker!
target: 警察忙着找最夹肉的手铐，你趁机拿记号笔，在他的通缉海报上加了个“不”字！

source: Polly sees your handiwork and grins.
target: 波莉看见你的杰作，咧嘴一笑。

source: Umm, I still don't understand the problem, officer. Even if we were those people, your sign says they're NOT wanted.
target: 呃，警官，我还是不明白。就算我们是那两个人，海报上不也写着“不通缉”吗？

source: Awww, that's so mean. Everybody should feel wanted and loved...
target: 哎呀，这也太伤人了。人人都该觉得有人需要自己、有人爱自己才对……

source: What are you talking about? It says... oh, wow, it DOES say "Not Wanted." I must've misread that!
target: 你说什么？上面写着……哦，还真是“不通缉”。肯定是我看错了！

source: Dammit! This must be one of our "Good Guy" posters that explicitly tell us which civilians NOT to arrest.
target: 妈的！这肯定是我们的“好人海报”，专门告诉我们哪些市民不能抓。

source: I told you that you need to pay more attention while you're reading stuff, partner. It's mistakes like these that feed the stereotype that cops are dumb!
target: 搭档，我说过，读东西得仔细点。就是这种错误，才让大家都觉得警察蠢！

source: My bad... well, you kids can go. Looks like we did the one thing this flyer told us NOT to do, which was arrest you.
target: 我的错……行，你们可以走了。看来我们偏偏干了海报上叫我们别干的事，就是逮捕你们。

source: Be safe out there, and if you see either of these postered people...
target: 路上小心。要是碰见海报上这两个人……

source: Make sure to give them a friendly hello from me!
target: 记得替我友善地问声好！

source: They leave, and you gain +N2 MIND for outsmarting those cops (which isn't really saying much, but still, good work).
target: 警察离开了。你比他们技高一筹，获得 +N2 头脑。（虽然赢过他们没多难，但还是干得漂亮。）

source: But you lose -N2 SOUL because your actions indirectly allowed two fugitives to run free. Oops!
target: 不过，你的行为间接让两名逃犯逍遥法外，损失了 -N2 灵魂。哎呀！

source: You're riding along with Scott in the driver's seat when a car pulls up behind your car and starts flashing red-and-blue lights at you.
target: 斯科特开着车，你坐在旁边。这时，一辆车追到后面，冲你们闪起红蓝警灯。

source: Shit, it's the cops! Do you know what we do when we see cops, Scotty?
target: 妈的，警察！小斯，你知道碰见警察，咱们该干什么吗？

source: Cooperate with them because it's the law?
target: 遵纪守法，配合他们？

source: No! FLOOR IT AND DRIVE AWAY!
target: 不！一脚油门，赶紧溜！

source: Too late, we already pulled you over.
target: 晚了，我们已经拦住你们了。

source: Dammit...
target: 该死……

source: Don't worry, we're just pulling over everybody on this road to warn them that there's a Level 5 Prank Spree happening in this area!
target: 别担心，只是把这条路上的车都拦下来，提醒大家：这一带正在发生五级恶作剧狂潮！

source: Yep, it's ugly out there. Nothing but smoke bombs, TP'd houses, and ding-dong-ditching for miles back East.
target: 没错，那边惨不忍睹。往东好几英里，到处都是烟雾弹、缠满卫生纸的房子，还有按门铃就跑的捣蛋鬼。

source: Oh, really? That's a coinkydink. We drove in from back East!
target: 啊，真的？那可真巧。我们就是从东边开过来的！

source: Scott...
target: 斯科特……

source: Uh... I mean, no we didn't! And I also don't have ANY smoke bombs in my suitcase.
target: 呃……我是说，没有！而且我行李箱里绝对没有烟雾弹。

source: Well, that's a relief. Just be careful; in all my years on the force, I've never come across such crafty prank masters.
target: 那就放心了。小心点，我从警这么多年，没见过这么狡猾的恶作剧高手。

source: Actually, I think it's pronounced "Prank Masterz" with a Z...
target: 其实应该叫“恶作剧大师”，英文 Prank Masterz，结尾用 Z……

source: We can't even establish an M.O. for their latest hits! These pranksters seem to be agents of total chaos.
target: 连他们最近几次作案的手法都摸不清！这帮捣蛋鬼，简直就是混乱的化身。

source: The only clues they've left are some brown fur clumps and a flask engraved with the initials "P.G." What could it mean...?
target: 现场只留下几撮棕色毛发，还有个刻着“P.G.”的酒壶。这到底代表什么……？

source: What a mystery! Maybe the initials stand for "Prank Guru?" Or it could "Polter Geist"... or maybe...
target: 真神秘！也许是“恶作剧宗师”，Prank Guru？或者“吵闹鬼”，Polter Geist……又或者……

source: (Shit, how do we get him to stop talking? Did we ever teach Scott "don't speak?")
target: （妈的，怎么才能让他闭嘴？我们教过斯科特“别出声”这个口令吗？）

source: Sadly, you never got that far. But it's not too late to do something to throw the cops off before they put two-and-two together!
target: 可惜，你们还没教到那一步。不过，在警察反应过来之前，想办法转移注意力还来得及！

source: "Officers, we have problems of our own: we've spent 2 hours looking for a chocolate bar we left somewhere in the car. Either help or get out of the way."
target: “警官，我们自己也有麻烦：车里有根巧克力棒，找了两个小时都没找到。要么帮忙，要么让路。”

source: It's time to... release the goose; the one you were keeping as a diversion in order to throw someone into a wild goose chase.
target: 是时候……放鹅了。你特意留着它分散注意力，好让人真的去追一场“野鹅”。

source: What?! You didn't tell us you had a Code: Missing Brown in progress! That's a serious matter!
target: 什么？！正在发生代号“棕色失踪”的事件，你们居然不早说！这可是大事！

source: Yeah, it was a jumbo-size Jupiter bar. I was eating it right before I started driving, then poof! Gone!
target: 对，是根超大号木星巧克力棒。开车前我还吃着呢，然后唰一下，没了！

source: Damn, another jumbo Jupiter taken away from us... I'm getting too old for this shit.
target: 妈的，又一根超大号木星离我们而去了……这种破事，我已经吃不消了。

source: I lost a chocolate bar myself in the summer of '93. I joined the force to ensure that nobody else would ever have to experience that heartbreak. We'll find your missing treat.
target: 九三年夏天，我也丢过一根巧克力棒。为了不让别人再经历那种心碎，我加入了警队。放心，一定帮你们找回来。

source: The cops radio for backup, and you all thoroughly search your car from top to bottom.
target: 警察呼叫支援，大家把你的车从上到下彻底搜了一遍。

source: (Heh, this might've turned out bad for me if I hadn't done all my drugs earlier. Polly: 1; moderation: 0!)
target: （嘿，还好我之前把药全嗑完了，不然这下可惨了。波莉一分，节制零分！）

source: I FOUND IT! You'll never believe this, but the chocolate bar was in my pocket all along!
target: 找到了！你们绝对想不到，那巧克力棒一直在我口袋里！

source: WE DID IT, BOYS!
target: 弟兄们，我们做到了！

source: All the officers cheer and hug each other in triumph. Somebody wraps the chocolate bar in a shock blanket.
target: 所有警察欢呼着，拥抱彼此，庆祝胜利。还有人拿急救保温毯裹住了巧克力棒。

source: Great work today, everyone. Donuts and coffee are on me tonight!
target: 今天大家干得好！今晚的甜甜圈和咖啡，我请！

source: Justice served, peace restored... it's days like these that make me put off retirement.
target: 正义得到伸张，和平重归人间……就是这样的日子，让我舍不得退休。

source: Keep a close eye on that chocolate bar now, kids. And stay safe on the road!
target: 孩子们，这回可看好那根巧克力棒。路上注意安全！

source: Good work distracting them, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. Now we can continue our prank spree with impunity!
target: 注意力转移得漂亮，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。现在咱们能逍遥法外，继续恶作剧了！

source: You sure can! It was sort of a -N2 SOUL move to trick the police like that, but at least you get +N2 STAMINA sharing that jumbo Jupiter bar!
target: 确实如此！骗警察让你损失 -N2 灵魂，不过分享那根超大号木星巧克力棒，也让你获得了 +N2 体力！

source: (You're right, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%... it's time to set the goose loose!)
target: （说得对，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%……该把鹅放出来了！）

source: Polly reaches into the backseat and opens the door on your emergency goose cage. The goose flies out of the car and into the cops' faces!
target: 波莉伸手到后座，打开应急鹅笼的门。鹅冲出车子，直扑警察的脸！

source: AHH! A GOOSE! IT'S BITING MY EYES!
target: 啊！鹅！它在咬我的眼睛！

source: SHOOT IT DOWN!
target: 开枪打下来！

source: The cops try to shoot down the goose. They miss, and are forced to chase after it.
target: 警察朝鹅开枪，却没打中，只好追着它跑。

source: "HALT, GOOSE!" the cops shout. "Quick, partner, plant some drugs on the goose so we have a reason to apprehend it using force!"
target: “站住，鹅！”警察喊道，“快，搭档，往鹅身上栽点毒品！这样就有理由用武力逮捕它了！”

source: "OH NO! THE GOOSE TOOK MY GUN!"
target: “糟了！鹅抢走了我的枪！”

source: LMAO, look at the goose hold the cops at gunpoint! Totally a +N2 HYPE sight.
target: 笑死，快看，那鹅拿枪指着警察！这画面绝对值 +N2 热度。

source: "Stand down, goose, nobody has to get hurt -- OH, DAMMIT, HE TOOK MY GUN TOO!"
target: “冷静，鹅，没必要有人受伤——操，它把我的枪也抢了！”

source: "CALL IN REINFORCEMENTS! WE HAVE A GOOSE WITH TWO GUNS!"
target: “呼叫增援！一只鹅，拿着两把枪！”

source: That was a great idea, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. A wild goose chase never fails!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，这主意真棒。让人追着野鹅跑，果然百试百灵！

source: Okay, gang, we should get back on the road. We can only get so behind schedule watching these cops get fucked up by a goose.
target: 好了，伙计们，该上路了。可不能光顾着看鹅把警察整惨，就把行程全耽误了。

source: You drive off and lose -N2 SOUL for fooling the cops (and indirectly arming a goose), but at least you lived to prank another day!
target: 你们开车离去。戏弄警察，还间接武装了一只鹅，让你损失 -N2 灵魂。不过，至少你们能留到明天，继续恶作剧！

source: A cop car signals for you to pull over. Ugh...
target: 警车示意你靠边停车。唉……

source: Well, well, well, look what we have here... do you know how fast you were going?
target: 哟，哟，哟，看看这是谁……知道自己刚才开多快吗？

source: Um... somewhere between "sorta" and "super duper?"
target: 呃……介于“有点快”和“超级无敌快”之间？

source: Exactly! And what's this?!
target: 没错！那这又是什么？！

source: It's the center console of the car. Man, I'm aceing this quiz!
target: 汽车的中控台。天哪，这测验我答得太好了！

source: Oh yeah? Then let's see how you explain this HUGE BAG OF MARRIAGE-IGUANA we just found in your center console!
target: 哦，是吗？那解释一下，为什么我们刚从中控台里，搜出了这么大一袋“结婚鬣蜥”，marriage-iguana！

source: You mean the bag you blatantly put it in there yourself? Also, it's pronounced "marijuana".
target: 你是说，你们刚才明目张胆塞进去的那袋？还有，那叫 marijuana，大麻。

source: Only a true drug-user would know what it's really called! You're under arrest!
target: 只有真正吸毒的人，才知道它叫什么！你被捕了！

source: Or... we have an offer for you. You can avoid arrest if you become a police informant and infiltrate the local mob for us!
target: 或者……我们有个提议。给警方当线人，替我们打入本地黑帮，就能免于逮捕！

source: Oh, really? Why didn't you just start with that? I'm in!
target: 哦，真的？早说嘛！我干了！

source: You are? Just like that?
target: 你同意了？这么干脆？

source: Yeah, I've always wanted to be a whistleblower for the mob! I even put it as my dream career in my elementary school yearbook!
target: 对啊，我一直想当揭发黑帮的线人！小学毕业纪念册里，梦想职业那栏我填的就是这个！

source: I'm pretty sure I either wanna be a pro athlete or a star scientist, but I could try being a police informant for a bit. I'm in too!
target: 我应该是想当职业运动员，或者明星科学家，不过也能先当一阵警方线人。我也干！

source: It's great you're both so onboard! We only need one informant, though, so decide who it'll be amongst yourselves.
target: 真高兴你俩都这么积极！不过只需要一个线人，你们自己决定谁来吧。

source: You'll also need a good cover story. We already exhausted all our creativity on this drug-planting farce, so if you kids have any ideas...
target: 还得有个好用的掩护身份。刚才栽赃毒品那一出，把我们的创意全用光了。你们要是有什么主意……

source: I bet %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% does! Boo, which of us should go undercover, and what should our cover story be?
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 肯定有！宝，我们谁去卧底？用什么身份？

source: Scott, the cartoonist of the mob. The mob won't ever suspect the friendly cartoonist who draws a zany picture of them once a month would ever betray their trust.
target: 斯科特，黑帮漫画家。每月替他们画张搞笑漫画的友善画师，怎么可能背叛他们的信任？黑帮绝对想不到。

source: Polly, mob accountant!
target: 波莉，黑帮会计！

source: It's decided! Scott goes to the mob headquarters and is soon deep in character as the mob cartoonist. Cue +N2 HYPE for having a fun job!
target: 决定了！斯科特来到黑帮总部，很快就投入了黑帮漫画家的角色。工作这么好玩，获得 +N2 热度！

source: Good morning, Boss! Ready for your weekly caricature?
target: 早上好，老大！准备好本周的夸张肖像画了吗？

source: "You bet I am!" says the mob boss. "This week, howsabout you draw me leaning all suave-like on the street sign where our secret headquarters is located?"
target: “那当然！”黑帮老大说，“这周把我画得潇洒一点，靠在咱们秘密总部那条街的路牌上，怎么样？”

source: I can't refuse that offer, Boss. Look, I drew you as a chef!
target: 这个提议，我没法拒绝，老大。看，我把你画成厨师了！

source: "My turn!" says Shortstack Grueber. "Can you sketch me tall and scary, with the cold glare of someone who murdered five people and buried them in Central Park?"
target: “轮到我了！”矮个子格鲁伯说，“能把我画得又高又吓人吗？眼神要冰冷，像个杀了五个人、把尸体埋在中央公园的家伙。”

source: Okie dokie, Shortstack. You can be the boss's scary sous chef in this drawing!
target: 没问题，矮个子。这幅画里，你就是老大的凶狠副厨！

source: "What about me?" asks Scarface Stabber. "I wanna be on the boss' chef posse!"
target: “那我呢？”刀疤捅人狂问，“我也想加入老大的厨师团！”

source: I can do that. Want me to draw you with your favorite steak knife? I know it's your weapon of choice!
target: 没问题。给你画上最喜欢的牛排刀怎么样？我知道那是你最趁手的凶器！

source: "That'd be great! I really want you to capture my stabbiness! You can borrow my knife for reference. Just don't show it to any cops, haha!"
target: “太棒了！一定要画出我那股爱捅人的劲儿！刀借你参考，别拿给警察看就行，哈哈！”

source: Yeah... right...
target: 嗯……当然……

source: Later, when Scott's debriefing the cops...
target: 后来，斯科特向警察汇报……

source: ...and that's all the evidence I got. Will it be enough?
target: ……证据全在这儿了。够吗？

source: It's more than enough! We've got plenty of probable cause to throw these mobsters in jail now!
target: 绰绰有余！这些理由，足够把那帮黑帮分子关进牢里了！

source: Wait, you're gonna arrest them? But these guys are my friends! They trusted me!
target: 等等，你们要抓他们？可他们是我朋友！他们信任我！

source: These aren't your friends, son; they're hardened criminals. They'd sell anyone out to save their own asses.
target: 孩子，他们可不是你朋友，都是惯犯。为了保住自己，谁都能出卖。

source: So thanks for agreeing to sell them out to save your own ass from jail. Hopefully we can work together again soon!
target: 所以，感谢你为了不坐牢，答应出卖他们。希望很快还有机会合作！

source: Man... I know I did the good boi thing, so why do I feel so bad?
target: 天哪……我明明做了乖孩子该做的事，为什么心里这么难受？

source: That day, Scott learned being the narc doesn't always mean being the good guy. You lose -N2 SOUL.
target: 那天，斯科特明白了：告密的人，不一定就是好人。你损失 -N2 灵魂。

source: It's decided! Polly goes to the mob headquarters to get into character and learn some dirty secrets.
target: 决定了！波莉前往黑帮总部，准备进入角色，打探黑幕。

source: Wuddup, mafia don? I heard you guys were in dire need of an "accountant."
target: 嘿，黑手党老大！听说你们急需一名“会计”？

source: "We are, actually!" says the don. "We're very behind on organizing our money laundering accounts this month. Can you help?"
target: “确实！”老大说，“这个月洗钱账目还差一大堆没整理，能帮忙吗？”

source: Haha, totally! Where are these "accounts" I need to "organize?"
target: 哈哈，当然！需要我“整理”的“账目”在哪儿？

source: "They're on the laptop... why do you keep using air quotes?"
target: “笔记本电脑里……你干吗老用手比引号？”

source: Because I'm "showing you" that I "know" the "code!"
target: 因为我在“告诉你”，我“听得懂”“暗号”！

source: I'll just grab this "laptop" here and fill up its "files" with some "spreadsheets", heh heh...
target: 我这就拿起这台“笔记本”，给它的“文件”装点“电子表格”，嘿嘿……

source: "HEY, WHOA! Where'd you get that tommy gun?! Quit filling the magazine with bullets, and quit being so weirdly cryptic while you do it!"
target: “嘿，等等！你哪儿弄来的汤普森冲锋枪？！别往弹匣里装子弹了，装的时候也别再打这种莫名其妙的哑谜！”

source: But... I don't understand. How am I gonna help with the next big bank robbery without a gun?
target: 可是……我不明白。没枪，下次抢银行我怎么帮忙？

source: "Look, toots: you can be our accountant, and you can be in the mob, but we don't need you to do robberies and stuff. We need you here, crunching numbers. Got it?"
target: “听着，小妞。你可以当会计，也可以入黑帮，可抢银行那些事用不着你。我们需要你待在这儿算账，懂吗？”

source: So... I'm an ACTUAL accountant?
target: 所以……我还真是个会计？

source: "Yes."
Aww, that blows!
target: 啊，那也太没劲了！

source: A few days later, Polly's back to debrief the cops.
target: 几天后，波莉回来向警察汇报。

source: ...and the laundromat on 3rd and Main is one of their hideouts too. That's the whole list.
target: ……第三街和主街交叉口的洗衣店，也是他们的藏身处。名单就这些。

source: Also, being a police informant was WAY more boring than I expected. I thought I'd basically get a free pass to do crimes for a bit, not sit around and do math all day.
target: 还有，当警方线人比我想的无聊多了。我以为能拿到一张临时犯罪通行证，谁知道得整天坐着算数。

source: Just so we're clear, we will never give you a free pass to do crimes.
target: 先说清楚，我们绝不会给你犯罪通行证。

source: You did us a big favor, though. Thanks for the help! Stay outta jail!
target: 不过你确实帮了大忙。谢了！可别进监狱啊！

source: Well, Polly lost -N2 HYPE in that disappointing debacle, but at least she also gained +N2 MIND crunching all those numbers!
target: 这场令人失望的闹剧让波莉损失了 -N2 热度。不过，算了那么多账，也让她获得了 +N2 头脑！

source: You're driving along peacefully when that peace is suddenly ruined by police sirens behind your car.
target: 你们正平静地赶路，车后突然响起警笛，打破了这份安宁。

source: Oh, no. Are we getting pulled over?
target: 不是吧。咱们被拦了？

source: I guess so. It's okay, we have nothing to hide!
target: 应该是。没事，咱们又没什么见不得人的！

source: Uh...
Good afternoon, kids. Can we see your license and vehicle registration?
target: 下午好，孩子们。请出示驾驶证和车辆登记证。

source: Sure thing, officers! How are you two doing on this fine, perfectly-legal day?
target: 当然，警官！在这个美好又完全合法的日子里，两位过得怎么样？

source: I'm doing great, thanks for asking! I had a chocolate donut for breakfast, I saw a butterfly on the way here, and now I get to do my favorite thing: routine traffic stops!
target: 好极了，谢谢关心！早上吃了巧克力甜甜圈，过来时看见了蝴蝶，现在还能做我最爱的事：例行交通检查！

source: Looks like your paperwork's in order. We'll just go back to the cruiser to run your plates real quick and you should be good to go.
target: 证件都没问题。我们回警车里查一下车牌，很快就能放你们走。

source: Awesome! Thanks for not checking the trunk!
target: 太棒了！谢谢你们不查后备箱！

source: ...SHOULD we check the trunk?
target: ……我们应该查查后备箱吗？
……不应该？

source: ...We'll be right back.
target: ……马上回来。

source: Fuck. They're totally gonna check the trunk. They're gonna find all my drugs!
target: 操。他们绝对要查后备箱了，我的药全要被翻出来！

source: You have drugs?!
target: 你带着毒品？！

source: I ALWAYS HAVE DRUGS, SCOTT.
target: 斯科特，我什么时候没带过毒品。

source: Welp, as always, you're everyone's last hope, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. Find a way to avoid getting caught with drugs!
target: 好了，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你一如既往，是大家最后的希望。想办法，别让他们人赃俱获！

source: "They can't find any drugs if we take them all first!"
target: “先把药全嗑了，他们不就什么都搜不到了！”

source: Plant the drugs on the cops by hugging them.
target: 借拥抱的机会，把毒品栽赃到警察身上。

source: Awww, shucks, we gotta take ALL the drugs? Oh well, guess I'll take one for the team.
target: 哎呀，必须全嗑完吗？好吧，那我就为团队牺牲一下。

source: Weren't these your drugs anyway? How are you "taking one for the--?"
target: 这不本来就是你的药吗？你这算哪门子“为团队牺——”？

source: Shhhh, no need to thank me, not all heroes wear capes, et cetera. Less talking, more drug-taking!
target: 嘘，不用谢。不是每个英雄都披着斗篷，诸如此类。少废话，多嗑药！

source: Fine, as long as you've got enough drugs left over to share with me and Scott!
target: 行，不过得留够我和斯科特的份！

source: Oh, no drugs for me, thanks. You guys have fun, though!
target: 哦，我不嗑，谢谢。你们玩得开心！

source: Okay, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, do you want a regular dose, a big dose, or a Polly-sized "I'm already dead so there are no consequences" dose?
target: 好了，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，普通剂量、加大剂量，还是波莉专用的“反正我都死了，不怕有后果”剂量？

source: Suffice to say, you and Polly do a TON of drugs, and gain +N2 HYPE!
target: 总之，你和波莉嗑了海量的药，获得 +N2 热度！

source: Okay, your plates came back clean, but my partner says we have to check the trunk for some reason.
target: 好了，车牌没问题，不过搭档说，不知道为什么，还是得查一下后备箱。

source: LMAO, good luck with that. We don't have a trunk now that the whole car is melting!
target: 笑死，祝你好运。整辆车都融化了，哪还有后备箱！

source: Melting...? What are you talking about?
target: 融化……？你在说什么？

source: I'm talking about how EVERYONE AND EVERYTHING IS MADE OF A MILLION GAZILLION ATOMS.
target: 我在说，每个人、每样东西，全都是由亿亿万万个原子组成的！

source: It makes you think, right? A fuck-ton of identical protons and neutrons all work together to make my whole incredible booty!
target: 是不是很引人深思？一大堆一模一样的质子和中子，合起来就成了我这完美的翘臀！

source: But those same atoms can also make other stuff, like Scott, or a doorknob, or a delicious pizza. Isn't that wild? We're all, like, connected or something...
target: 可同样的原子，也能组成别的东西，比如斯科特、门把手，或者美味披萨。多神奇啊！我们都互相连着，之类的……

source: (Partner, although these youngsters look sorta high, I didn't find any drugs in the trunk. Do you think they're just... like this?)
target: （搭档，这些年轻人虽然看着有点嗨，可后备箱里确实没毒品。他们该不会……平时就这样吧？）

source: (Guess the younger generation's even further gone than I feared...) Well, you kids are good to go, I suppose. Drive safe.
target: （看来年轻一代，比我担心的还没救……）行吧，你们可以走了。开车小心。

source: The cops leave, Scott takes over driving, and you and Polly experience ego death in the back seat. You lose -N2 MIND from all that tripping.
target: 警察离开后，斯科特接手开车，你和波莉则在后座经历自我消融。嗑得太猛，让你损失 -N2 头脑。

source: Okay, your plates came back clean, but I have a feeling we should check your trunk before we go. You have anything back there that we should know about?
target: 车牌没问题，不过走之前，我觉得还是该查查后备箱。里面有没有什么我们该知道的东西？

source: We sure do. We've got hugs for you! Bring it in, bro!
target: 当然有！有给你们的拥抱！来吧，兄弟！

source: You, Scott, and Polly group-hug the cop. Polly reaches into his pocket to plant the goods.
target: 你、斯科特和波莉一起抱住警察。波莉把手伸进他的口袋，悄悄塞进了货。

source: Hey, officer, what's this I just found in your pocket?
target: 嘿，警官，猜猜我从你口袋里摸到了什么？

source: Whoa, cocaine!
target: 哇，可卡因！

source: (Wait... this isn't the cocaine I planted on you, though...)
target: （等等……可这不是我刚才塞给你的那份啊……）

source: What did you just say?
target: 你刚说什么？

source: Don't change the subject! Your partner has cocaine!
target: 别转移话题！你搭档带着可卡因！

source: Well, yeah, but only a little. It helps me stay alert on the job! You gotta be quick and agile when you have a gun and a city to protect!
target: 是啊，就一点点，帮我工作时保持警觉！带着枪、保护整座城市，可得反应快、身手敏捷！

source: Thanks to the cocaine, I can shoot all the bad guys, and then some!
target: 多亏可卡因，我能把坏人全打死，还能多打几个！

source: I don't feel very protected... Polly, is this that "police corruption" thing you told me about?
target: 我可没觉得被保护了……波莉，这就是你说的“警察腐败”吗？

source: Noooo, c'mon! You can trust us! We're your friendly neighborhood cops! I'll just put that coke back, and we can forget all about...
target: 别这样嘛！你们可以相信我们！我们可是亲切的社区警察！我把可卡因放回去，咱们就把这事忘了……

source: Whoa. There are a LOT more drugs in my pocket than I remember. I guess I forgot how much I grabbed when I was coked up this morning.
target: 哇。口袋里的药比我记得多好多。估计早上嗑嗨时拿了多少，我都忘了。

source: Damn, partner, this looks bad for us. When the chief finds out how much drugs we have, we'll get our badges stripped for sure!
target: 妈的，搭档，这可不妙。局长要是知道咱们带着这么多药，警徽肯定保不住了！

source: Hmmm, I have an idea. What if you gave US your drugs? That way your chief won't be mad at you!
target: 唔，我有个主意。把药给我们怎么样？这样局长就不会生你们的气啦！

source: Are you sure? Giving drugs to strangers doesn't sound very... lawful.
target: 你确定？把毒品给陌生人，好像不太……合法吧。

source: We're not strangers! We're friends now! We hugged, don't you remember?
target: 咱们不是陌生人，是朋友了！都抱过了，忘了吗？

source: She's got a point. Just give her the drugs. We can just get more out of the evidence locker later.
target: 她说得有道理。给她吧，回头咱们再从证物柜里拿点就是。

source: Yessss, give me the drugs. Gimme gimme.
target: 对——把药给我。给我给我。

source: The cops give you their drugs and leave. You lose -N2 SOUL for your deception, but you gain +N2 HYPE for scoring free police-grade cocaine!
target: 警察把毒品给你们，离开了。欺骗让你损失 -N2 灵魂，不过白拿到警用级可卡因，也让你获得了 +N2 热度！

source: You see blinking lights in your rearview mirror and a police siren demanding that you pull over. Ugh...
target: 后视镜里闪起警灯，警笛催促你靠边停车。唉……

source: Good afternoon. Can I see your license and vehicle registration?
target: 下午好。请出示驾驶证和车辆登记证。

source: Yep, it's right here!
target: 有，就在这儿！

source: Oh, uh, thanks Ms. Geist, but we just need to see the driver's information.
target: 哦，呃，谢谢，鬼斯特女士，不过我们只需要司机的证件。

source: Oh! Haha, of course, sorry. I just wanted to show you how trustworthy and cooperative with the law I am.
target: 哦！哈哈，当然，抱歉。我只是想证明，自己有多可靠、多配合执法。

source: Trustworthy, cooperative, AND a nervous talker? You're my favorite kind of person to pull over!
target: 可靠、配合，还紧张得话多？我最喜欢拦你这种人了！

source: Speaking of which, we pulled you over because we're investigating a report that someone in this area stole a magic artifact.
target: 说起这个，我们拦车，是因为这一带有人报案，一件魔法神器被偷了，我们正在调查。

source: It's an ancient totem that radiates malevolent energy. Have you folks seen anything like it?
target: 那是个古老图腾，散发着邪恶能量。各位见过类似的东西吗？

source: NOPE! Never seen it! And even if I had, I wouldn't have felt ANY compulsion to take it, because I'm a levelheaded gal with great impulse control.
target: 没有！从没见过！就算见过，我也绝对不会冲动到拿走，因为我是个理智又特别能克制的姑娘。

source: Uh...
But if I HAD seen it, theoretically, it would've been sitting in an unlocked car pretty much begging for someone to steal it. So, it's not really the thief's fault.
target: 可假设我真见过，它肯定就在一辆没上锁的车里，简直求着人去偷。那也不能全怪小偷吧。

source: ...Right. Hey, partner, can I talk to you in the cruiser for a minute?
target: ……是吗。搭档，能回警车里谈一下吗？

source: FUCK. We don't have much time. We gotta hide this magic artifact I stole!
target: 操。时间不多了，得赶紧把我偷的魔法神器藏起来！

source: Wait, you DID steal it? But you just said--
target: 等等，你真的偷了？可刚才你不是说——

source: I know what I said, Scott. You bought my ruse because I've got an unbeatable poker face.
target: 斯科特，我知道自己说过什么。你会信，是因为我撒谎时从不露馅。

source: But those cops will sense the rancid vibes coming off this cursed totem soon, so we've gotta hide it quick! %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, any ideas?
target: 可那诅咒图腾的邪门气息这么重，警察很快就会察觉。得赶紧藏起来！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，有主意吗？

source: Deceive them by telling them you're undercover cops who just seized the artifact.
target: 骗他们说，你们是刚刚缴获神器的卧底警察。

source: Hide the magic artifact where you hide everything else: behind your cool façade.
target: 把魔法神器藏到你藏一切东西的地方：那副酷炫的伪装后面。

source: Okay, we talked it over, and we think we should check your vehicle for the stolen artifact.
target: 好了，商量过了，我们觉得还是得搜车，找找那件失窃的神器。

source: No need, fellow policemen. I've got the artifact right here! Because you see...
target: 不用了，警察同僚们。神器就在我这儿！因为，其实……

source: I'm actually Officer Gertrude Sikes, undercover cop extraordinaire!
target: 我是格特鲁德·赛克斯警官，顶级卧底！

source: You are? And you wear that fake mustache whenever you're... being yourself?
target: 是吗？所以你……做回自己的时候，反而戴着假胡子？

source: Correct! It makes other cops take me more seriously. No one cared who I was until I put on the 'stache!
target: 对！这样其他警察才会认真对待我。在我戴上胡子之前，根本没人关心我是谁！

source: Hmm... what about you, son? Are you an undercover cop too?
target: 唔……那你呢，小伙子？你也是卧底警察？

source: Yes! I'm Officer... Not Scott!
target: 对！我是……不斯科特警官！

source: Your name is "Not Scott"?
target: 你叫“不斯科特”？

source: Yup. First name "Not", last name "Scott". He knows what he's about.
target: 对。名叫“不”，姓“斯科特”。他很清楚自己在干什么。

source: Well, if you're really undercover cops, can we see your badges?
target: 好吧，真是卧底的话，能看看警徽吗？

source: Oh! I mean, I'd totally show you mine if I could, but I had to trade it to the ACTUAL thief in exchange for the artifact.
target: 哦！能给你看，我肯定给。不过为了换回神器，我把警徽给了真正的小偷。

source: Ah, no problem, I understand. I've lost two pistols that way. What about you, Officer Not Scott?
target: 啊，没事，我懂。我也这么丢过两把手枪。你呢，不斯科特警官？

source: I... ate it?
target: 我……吃了？

source: Haha, I did the same thing last week! The chief was pissed, but it's not my fault these things look like shiny potato chips.
target: 哈哈，我上周也干过！局长气坏了，可谁让这东西长得像亮闪闪的薯片呢，又不怪我。

source: Okay, well, looks like the artifact's already in good hands! Gertrude, Not, do you wanna blow off the rest of your shifts with us at the Donut Hut?
target: 好吧，看来神器已经有人妥善保管了！格特鲁德、不，要不要一起翘掉剩下的班，去甜甜圈小屋？

source: Sure! You gain +N2 MAGIC getting to keep that magic artifact, though you lose -N2 SOUL for lying to the cops.
target: 当然！你保住了魔法神器，获得 +N2 魔力，不过骗警察也让你损失 -N2 灵魂。

source: Okay, you'll just have to drop your cool façade for a minute to hide the artifact behind it. Hopefully Polly and Scott won't notice...
target: 好吧，你得先暂时卸下那副酷炫的伪装，才能把神器藏到后面。希望波莉和斯科特没注意到……

source: Dang, bro, what happened? You don't look nearly as interesting or radical as you usually do!
target: 哎，兄弟，怎么了？你看着一点都没平时那么有趣、那么酷了！

source: You definitely don't look like the %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% who told us %HESHE% %VERB_KNOWS_KNOW% a ton of awesome BMX tricks.
target: 你可不像那个跟我们吹牛，说%HESHE%%VERB_KNOWS_KNOW%一大堆超酷BMX车技的%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): POLISH; 酷人设被揭穿；知道车技在此为会车技。 按行中文动词展开已实现；未实机验证。

source: Nor do you look like the %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% who claimed to know "every digit of pi, yes, all of them."
target: 也不像那个号称“圆周率的每一位都知道，没错，每一位”的 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。

source: I feel so lied to... is your name even %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?
target: 感觉被你骗惨了……你真叫 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 吗？

source: Truthfully, no. I invented a cooler name to use, because my real name is... *shudder*... Pimplert.
target: 说实话，不是。我给自己编了个更酷的名字，因为真名叫……*一哆嗦*……皮姆普勒特。

source: Oh... okay, that IS unfortunate. But it's still no reason to lie to us!
target: 哦……好吧，这确实挺惨。可也不能拿这个当理由骗我们啊！

source: But how else was I supposed to befriend awesome people like you and Scott without changing my name and embellishing my personality a little?
target: 可不改名字、不稍微美化一下自己，我怎么跟你和斯科特这么酷的人交朋友？

source: By being yourself! I'm pretty offended you thought you had to lie to me to be my friend, jerk.
target: 做你自己就行了！你居然觉得，得先骗我才能当我朋友，真让我火大，混蛋。

source: Yeah, bro... we were already your friends. Why did you lie to us? That's so mean...
target: 对啊，兄弟……咱们本来就是朋友。你为什么还要骗人？太伤人了……

source: Oof. You lose -N2 HYPE exposing yourself like this. At least you've safely hidden the artifact behind your façade by the time the cops come back.
target: 唉，原形毕露让你损失 -N2 热度。至少警察回来之前，你把神器安全藏到了伪装后面。

source: Okay, we talked it over, and we think we should check your vehicle for the stolen artifact.
target: 好了，商量过了，我们觉得还是得搜车，找找那件失窃的神器。

source: I don't know anything about a magic artifact. I only know awesome BMX tricks and every digit of pi.
target: 魔法神器什么的，我不知道。我只知道超酷 BMX 车技，还有圆周率的每一位。

source: I believe you! Nobody who knows so many bike tricks and impossible integers would need to steal a magic artifact to be as cool as you clearly are.
target: 我信！懂那么多车技和不可能的整数，已经够酷了，哪还用得着偷魔法神器！

source: Yup. Your relaxed, radical aura is convincing enough, and I didn't feel like doing a whole investigation into this anyway. You're free to go.
target: 对。你这轻松又酷炫的气场，够有说服力了。反正我也懒得查个底朝天。你们可以走了。

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% -- or Pimplert, or whoever you are -- please never bring up BMX tricks again.
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%——还是皮姆普勒特，不管你叫什么——求你别再提 BMX 车技了。

source: Your victory would be sweeter if you couldn't feel the judgment radiating off your friends. At least that artifact is still radiating +N2 MAGIC!
target: 要是感觉不到朋友们满身的鄙夷，这场胜利本该更甜美。至少，那件神器还在散发 +N2 魔力！

source: You're driving along when a cop car pulls up and signals for you to pull over. Uh oh...
target: 你正开着车，一辆警车追上来，示意你靠边停车。糟了……

source: Afternoon, kids. Can we see your license and vehicle registration?
target: 下午好，孩子们。请出示驾驶证和车辆登记证。

source: Hey... does anyone else smell pie?
target: 嘿……有人闻到派的味道吗？

source: I don't.
target: 我没有。

source: Now that you mention it, I smell pie too!
target: 你这么一说，我也闻到了！

source: No you don't! Your nose is lying to you, Scott. Don't listen to it!
target: 你才没有！斯科特，你鼻子在骗人，别听它的！

source: I smell pie too! I figured I was just really craving pie, but now that Polly's being weird about it...
target: 我也闻到了！还以为只是自己太想吃派，可现在波莉这反应这么奇怪……

source: I'M NOT BEING WEIRD, YOU'RE ALL BEING WEIRD! I AM BEING PERFECTLY SANE AND NORMAL.
target: 我哪儿奇怪了，是你们都很奇怪！我明明特别理智、特别正常。

source: Okaaaay... well, it looks like your paperwork's all in order. We're just gonna run your plates real quick and you kids should be good to go.
target: 好——吧。证件都齐全。我们再快速查一下车牌，你们就能走了。

source: Goddammit, now we gotta figure out what to do with this pie I stole before those goons come back.
target: 该死，现在得赶紧想想怎么处理我偷来的这个派，免得那群混混回来。

source: You stole a pie? What for? You don't even eat.
target: 你偷了个派？干吗啊？你又不吃东西。

source: I dunno, I just saw it cooling on some old lady's windowsill and grabbed it. I was in a silly, goofy mood.
target: 不知道，看见老太太把派搁窗台上放凉，就顺手拿了。当时就是想犯点傻、捣点蛋。

source: But now because %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% was acting all suspicious, the cops are totally gonna know I stole this pie. We gotta hide it before they get back!
target: 可 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 刚才鬼鬼祟祟的，警察肯定猜到我偷了派。得赶在他们回来之前藏好！

source: Well, at least if you help Polly hide the pie, you can eat it later! How do you save this stolen pastry?
target: 好吧，帮波莉藏起来，至少之后还能吃上。要怎么保住这份偷来的点心？

source: Hide the pie under your trademark fancy top hat you've been wearing throughout this whole road trip.
target: 把派藏在你这一路始终戴着的、标志性的华丽高礼帽下面。

source: Hide the pie under the pile of money you will use to bribe the cops.
target: 拿一堆钱贿赂警察，再把派藏在钱堆底下。

source: Yeah, my fancy top hat! ...Wait, what fancy top hat?
target: 对，我的华丽高礼帽！……等等，哪来的华丽高礼帽？

source: Only THE trademark %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% fancy top hat! I knew it'd come in handy eventually!
target: 当然是 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 标志性的华丽高礼帽！我就知道，总有一天能派上用场！

source: Yeah, I barely remember who you were before you put on that hat. Let's hide the pie under there!
target: 对啊，我都快不记得，你戴这帽子之前是什么样了。把派藏在下面吧！

source: Polly stashes her stolen pie under your hat just in time for the cops to come back.
target: 波莉把偷来的派塞进你的帽子，警察正好回来了。

source: So, guess what? While we were in the cruiser we got a call that there's a pie thief on the loose. My partner's gonna need to search your vehicle.
target: 猜怎么着？刚在警车里接到消息，有个偷派贼还在外面晃。我搭档得搜搜你们的车。

source: You there, remove that hat for a moment so I can see if the contraband pie is under it.
target: 你，把帽子摘一下，我看看那违禁的派是不是藏在下面。

source: You want %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% to take off %HISHER% fancy top hat?! But it's the cornerstone of %HISHER% cool visual identity!
target: 你要让 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 摘掉 %HISHER% 华丽高礼帽？！这可是 %HISHER% 酷炫造型的根基！

source: So?
target: 所以呢？

source: You don't understand. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% was super lame back in school. Putting that fancy top hat on is what turned %HISHER% whole life around!
target: 你不懂。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 上学时超逊的，就是戴上那顶高礼帽，才改变了 %HISHER% 整个人生！

source: You can't force %HIMHER% to go back to %HISHER% old, boring ways. It's inhumane!
target: 你不能强迫 %HIMHER% 回到 %HISHER% 那种无聊又老土的生活！太不人道了！

source: Partner, I think they've got a point. I thought %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% was pretty cool with that hat on too.
target: 搭档，我觉得他们说得对。戴上那帽子，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 确实很酷。

source: Such a bold fashion choice to wear a top hat while driving -- in a convertible of all things! I don't think we should force %HIMHER% to take it off.
target: 开车还戴高礼帽，多大胆的时尚选择！而且开的居然是敞篷车！咱们不该逼 %HIMHER% 摘掉。

source: But... the pie...
target: 可是……派……

source: I know, but this is too far. We swore to protect people no matter what, even if that meant shooting at suspicious characters first and asking questions later.
target: 我知道，可这样太过分了。咱们发过誓，无论如何都要保护大家，哪怕得先对可疑的人开枪，再问话。

source: But THIS? I mean, we gotta draw the line somewhere. Are we really helping people if we make this poor youngster lame again?
target: 可现在这样？总得有条底线吧。让这可怜的年轻人重新变逊，真算保护人吗？

source: You're right... I'm sorry, partner. I've been a cop for so long, I guess I lost some perspective.
target: 你说得对……抱歉，搭档。当警察太久，我都快忘了什么才重要。

source: It's okay, pal. Sorry to bother you kids. Drive safe, and stay fancy!
target: 没事，老伙计。抱歉打扰你们。开车小心，继续保持时髦！

source: You have no recollection of ever putting this hat on, yet there it is, on your head and in everybody else's memories... it's a -N2 MIND-fuck.
target: 你根本不记得自己戴过这顶帽子，可它偏偏就在头上，也在所有人的记忆里……这事搞得你损失了 -N2 头脑。

source: But you don't let it bother you too much, especially since you gain +N2 STAMINA eating that stolen pie!
target: 不过你没太在意，尤其是吃掉那偷来的派，还让你获得了 +N2 体力！

source: So, guess what? While we were in the cruiser we got a call that there's a pie thief on the loose. My partner's gonna need to search your vehicle.
target: 猜怎么着？刚在警车里接到消息，有个偷派贼还在外面晃。我搭档得搜搜你们的车。

source: Okay. Just be sure NOT to check under that pile of money.
target: 行。千万别翻那堆钱下面就好。

source: Wink!
target: 眨眼！

source: ...Well now that's obviously the first place I'm gonna check.
target: ……好吧，那我当然得先翻那里。

source: Oh noooo. You found the pie under our fat stack of cash that was just sitting there waiting for a handsome, morally-gray officer to take it...
target: 哦不——你发现了那堆厚厚钞票底下的派。钞票就那么放着，专等一位英俊、道德底线灵活的警官来拿呢……

source: Awww, you really think I'm handsome?
target: 哎呀，你真觉得我帅？

source: Are you kids seriously trying to bribe an officer?!
target: 你们真在贿赂警察？！

source: Um... I think so?
target: 呃……应该是吧？

source: Okay, cool. I just wanted to make sure, because if not, this conversation was about to get awkward.
target: 行，那就好。确认一下而已，不然这话可就尴尬了。

source: Damn, only -N2 MONEY? You call that a bribe?! Back in my day, that'd barely cover the cost of stealing a gumball!
target: 妈的，才 -N2 金钱？这也叫贿赂？！换我年轻那会儿，偷颗口香糖交的钱都不止这点！

source: Take it or leave it.
target: 爱要不要。

source: Fine... guess we gotta start pulling over fancier cars if we wanna get the good bribes, partner.
target: 行吧……搭档，想收点像样的贿赂，咱们得拦更豪华的车才行。

source: Don't be so sour. I think we did great. I'm gonna use my half to buy a rhinestone bedazzler and gussy up my gun!
target: 别这么不高兴嘛，我觉得收获不错。我这半份钱，拿去买个水钻镶嵌器，把枪好好打扮一下！

source: All right, we'll look the other way for now. But if we ever pull you over again, remember: I'm a big fan of fifty-dollar bills and foot massages.
target: 好吧，这次就睁只眼闭只眼。下次再被我们拦住，记住：我特别喜欢五十美元钞票，还有足底按摩。

source: Sheesh, those cops sure are morally bankrupt... anyway, you gain +N2 STAMINA eating the pie Polly stole from a sweet old lady. Yum!
target: 啧，这帮警察真是毫无道德……总之，你吃掉波莉从善良老太太那儿偷来的派，获得 +N2 体力。真香！

source: Scott is driving you all along the highway when you hit a HUGE traffic jam.
target: 斯科特开车载着大家行驶在公路上，突然碰上了严重的大堵车。

source: Great. Juuuust great.
target: 好极了。真、是、好、极、了。

source: Dang, we're not moving at all. I wonder what's got us so backed up?
target: 哎，完全不动啊。前面到底为什么堵成这样？

source: Finding out would be more fun than waiting around here. Wanna walk up the road with me, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?
target: 过去看看，总比在这儿干等有意思。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，跟我沿路走过去瞧瞧？

source: Good idea. About twenty cars ahead, you find a young woman sobbing to a group of other annoyed motorists.
target: 好主意。往前大约二十辆车的位置，一名年轻女子正对着一群烦躁的司机哭诉。

source: "We can't drive across the bridge!" she wails. "I had a vision that there will be a collision that'll kill dozens of people!"
target: “不能开过那座桥！”她哀号道，“我预见了一场车祸，会死几十个人！”

source: Oh, God. Don't tell me this is one of those Final Destination situations...
target: 天哪。别告诉我，这是《死神来了》的剧情……

source: Suddenly, an oil truck slams into a truck full of matches. They explode, killing dozens of motorists far ahead of you.
target: 突然，一辆油罐车撞上一辆满载火柴的卡车。两车爆炸，炸死了前方几十名司机。

source: Yup, great. JUST. GREAT.
target: 果然。好极了。真、好。

source: "Oh no, it's a Final Destination thing!" the crowd cries. "We've cheated Death, and now we'll all be hunted down and killed in increasingly-gory ways!"
target: “糟了，真是《死神来了》！”人群惊呼，“我们逃过了死神，现在它会用越来越血腥的方式，把我们一个个杀死！”

source: It's not that big a deal. At least your deaths'll probably end up on someone's "Top 40 horror movie kills" list.
target: 也没那么糟吧。至少你们的死法，大概能上谁的“恐怖片四十大杀人名场面”。

source: "But we don't want to die! Our only hope is to kill someone else and steal their lifespan!"
target: “可我们不想死！唯一的希望，就是杀了别人，抢走他们的寿命！”

source: Fine, if that's what it takes to clear this highway. Anyone wanna start with stabbing %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?
target: 行吧，只要能让路通了就好。谁想先捅 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 一刀？

source: NO THANK YOU. There's gotta be some other way to calm these people down so you can get through this traffic jam. Think of something!
target: 不了，谢谢！肯定还有别的办法能安抚他们，让你们顺利通过堵车路段。快想办法！

source: "Let's all go to a Final Destination Safety Course to be properly prepared against all the unlikely mortal scenarios."
target: “一起去上《死神来了》安全课吧，充分防范各种离奇的致命意外。”

source: "Fake IDs for everyone!"
target: “每人发一张假证件！”

source: You, Polly, Scott, and the terrified motorists all attend the safety course.
target: 你、波莉、斯科特和惊恐的司机们，一起参加了安全课。

source: "Good afternoon," says the instructor. "Welcome to the 'Destination: Safety' seminar, where you'll learn invaluable tips and tricks on cheating death."
target: “下午好。”讲师说，“欢迎来到‘目的地：安全’讲座。这里会教你们实用而宝贵的逃死诀窍。”

source: A bit late for me, but sure, go on.
target: 对我来说晚了点，不过行，继续。

source: "Tip #1: dull every sharp edge in your vicinity. You can kiss a life of using scissors, knives, and square furniture goodbye."
target: “第一条：磨钝身边所有尖锐的边缘。以后就跟剪刀、刀具，还有方形家具说再见吧。”

source: "Tip #2: always look both ways before crossing the street, lest you be hit by surprise buses, falling panes of glass, or collapsing neon signs."
target: “第二条：过马路务必左右看，以免被突然冲出的公交车、坠落的玻璃板，或者倒塌的霓虹招牌砸中。”

source: "Tip #3: always be on the lookout for cruel irony."
target: “第三条：时刻警惕残酷的讽刺。”

source: "If you're in a dangerous place filled with sharp objects, be sure that the thing that actually kills you will be completely unassuming, like a rock or a flag."
target: “如果身处满是尖锐物体的危险场所，真正杀死你的，多半是石头、旗子这种不起眼的东西。”

source: "If you're getting eye surgery, expect to go blind; if you're an asshole, beware anus-related injuries; etc."
target: “做眼科手术，就做好失明的准备；要是你是个烂屁眼子，就小心肛门受伤。以此类推。”

source: Okay, you've got lots of tips, but what about the actual "cheating death" part?
target: 好吧，建议倒挺多。可到底要怎么逃过死神？

source: "Besides taking an innocent life, the only other known way to cheat death is to 'create new life.'"
target: “除了夺走无辜者的生命，唯一已知的逃死办法，就是‘创造新生命’。”

source: "Is there anyone here who wasn't tied to the accident that's willing to take one for the team and get pregnant?"
target: “在座有没有跟这场事故无关的人，愿意为大家牺牲一下，怀个孕？”

source: NOPE. NOPE. ABSOLUTELY NOT.
target: 不行。不行。绝对不行。

source: We're leaving now! Good luck with the whole "being on Death's list" thing!
target: 我们这就走！你们跟死神名单慢慢折腾，祝好运！

source: You lost -N2 HYPE waiting in traffic, but you gained +N2 MIND from that informative seminar!
target: 堵车让你损失 -N2 热度，不过这堂内容丰富的讲座，让你获得了 +N2 头脑！

source: "How would fake IDs help us?" the motorists ask. "Most of us are already old enough to drown our worries in booze."
target: “假证有什么用？”司机们问，“我们大部分人都够年龄借酒浇愁了。”

source: Sure, but think about it: Death's got all of your names on his shit list, right? What if you all pose as people who AREN'T in debt to Death? You'd be safe!
target: 对，可想想看，死神把你们的名字都记在黑名单上了吧？假装成不欠死神命的人，不就安全了！

source: Check it out, my fakes are SUPER convincing. Here, sir, you can now be known as "Tim the Immortal!" "Timmortal" for short!
target: 看，我的假证可逼真了。先生，你现在就叫“不死提姆”！简称“Timmortal”！

source: "Wow, that's great!" says the newly-christened Timmortal. "Now Death will totally believe I can never die!"
target: “哇，太好了！”新得名的不死提姆说，“这下死神肯定相信，我永远不会死！”

source: And you, ma'am, can be "Ida Ratherlive!" Death loves puns; it's easy to tickle his funny bone and talk him into letting you live.
target: 女士，你就叫“艾达·宁可活”！死神可爱双关了。逗得他骨头都乐了，再说服他放你一条生路，轻轻松松。

source: "Wow, really?" asks Ida. "Did that work for you?"
target: “哇，真的？”艾达问，“你当年就是这样活下来的？”

source: MOVING ON!
target: 下一位！

source: I'm glad we could help you guys get your asses back on the road! That'll be ten bucks for my incredible fakes.
target: 很高兴帮你们重新上路！我这超逼真的假证，十美元一张。

source: "Wait, you're charging us for these?" the crowd asks angrily. "Even when we're desperate?!"
target: “等等，还要收费？”人群愤愤地问，“我们都这样走投无路了？！”

source: I mean, duh. Desperate people are the BEST people to charge money to.
target: 当然了。走投无路的人，钱最好赚啊。

source: Heartless, but true. It's a good thing you lost -N2 HYPE in the traffic, or you'd probably be losing SOUL right about now.
target: 冷血，但确实。幸好你堵车时已经损失了 -N2 热度，不然这会儿该扣灵魂了。

source: But apparently actions have no consequences today, because you get your +N2 MONEY and head out!
target: 不过今天，干坏事好像都不用承担后果。你拿到 +N2 金钱，扬长而去！

source: You suddenly come upon a herd of sheep blocking the whole road.
target: 前方突然出现一群羊，堵住了整条路。

source: Dammit, we don't have time for this! MOVE, YOU DUMB SHEEP!
target: 妈的，我们没时间耗着！蠢羊们，让开！

source: Hey, maybe I could use my dog powers to herd these sheep! My grandma says everyone has a calling in life; this could be mine!
target: 嘿，也许我能用狗狗能力把羊赶走！奶奶说，每个人都有自己的天职，没准这就是我的！

source: Well, if Scott is happy and the sheep get moved, so much the better. He gets out of the car to herd the sheep.
target: 只要斯科特开心，羊又能挪走，何乐而不为。他下了车，准备牧羊。

source: Listen up, sheep! You should go over there!
target: 羊羊们，听好了！去那边！

source: The sheep don't respond to Scott's shouting or enthusiastic pointing.
target: 斯科特大声喊，还兴奋地指着方向，可羊群毫无反应。

source: HEY SHEEP! GO LONG!
target: 嘿，羊羊！跑远点，接球！

source: Scott throws a football into a nearby field. The sheep, surprisingly, don't all rush to tackle it.
target: 斯科特朝旁边田里扔了颗橄榄球。出人意料，羊群竟然没一窝蜂扑上去抢球。

source: 5-6-7-8! WHAT WOULD I APPRECIATE? YOU GETTING OUT OF THE ROAD! GO, SHEEP, GO!
target: 五六七八！我最想要什么呀？你们让开这条路呀！羊羊加油，羊羊冲呀！

source: Cheerleading doesn't move the sheep either, though they do seem a bit more confident in themselves after hearing it.
target: 啦啦队加油也没能让羊群挪窝。不过听完之后，它们似乎对自己更有信心了。

source: Man, I'm stumped. Guess I'll cross sheep-herding off of my "potential life's purposes" list...
target: 哎，没办法了。看来得把牧羊，从我的“人生可能的使命”清单里划掉……

source: No, you won't let Scott give up! He just needs a foolproof method of getting the sheep to move...
target: 不，你可不能让斯科特放弃！只要找到一个绝对有效的赶羊办法……

source: WAKE UP, SHEEPLE! Feed the sheep conspiranoia articles. They need to wake up and move, even if it's into a rabbit hole.
target: 醒醒吧，愚羊们！给羊灌几篇阴谋论文章。得让它们醒过来、动起来，哪怕是钻进阴谋论的牛角尖。

source: Run for sheep president and lead them somewhere, elsewhere.
target: 竞选羊总统，带领羊群奔向别处，哪儿都行。

source: Hell yeah! We just need to decide what to write an article about that would piss these sheep off.
target: 好耶！只需要想想写什么文章，才能把这群羊惹毛。

source: What about an article about ducks?
target: 写鸭子怎么样？

source: Just... ducks? Why?
target: 就……鸭子？为什么？

source: I don't trust ducks. Their bills are too flat and funny-looking. They gotta be up to something.
target: 我不信任鸭子。它们的嘴巴又扁又怪，肯定在密谋什么。

source: Uhh, okay. Let's write an article about a secret duck revolution plotting to overthrow the government. That should get them worked up!
target: 呃，好吧。那就写，鸭子正在秘密策划革命，要推翻政府。肯定能让它们激动起来！

source: Polly types up the article. It has lots of all-caps buzzwords like "CONSPIRACY" and "DEEP TRUTH" and "FUCK DUCKS", which has a nice rhyme.
target: 波莉写好文章，塞了一堆大写的劲爆词语：“惊天阴谋”“深层真相”，还有“去他妈的鸭，统统滚回家”，还挺押韵。

source: You show the sheep the article. They read it... and boy, are they MAD.
target: 你把文章给羊群看。它们读完……好家伙，气坏了。

source: (I mean, they're expressing anger as much as sheep ever express any emotion, but still, you can sense their rage.)
target: （当然，也就是羊能表现出的那点情绪。不过，你还是能感到它们的怒火。）

source: The sheep march off to storm the nearest duck pond in a riotous display of... activism, you guess?
target: 羊群浩浩荡荡地冲向最近的鸭塘，准备大闹一场……这算社会运动吧，大概？

source: That was awesome! Thanks for teaching me how to herd sheep, bro! I can't wait to tell my grandma I found my calling.
target: 太棒了！谢谢你教我牧羊，兄弟！真想马上告诉奶奶，我找到天职了。

source: You might wanna dissuade Scott from telling his grandma about the duck deep state... actually, meh, not really your problem.
target: 你也许该劝斯科特别跟奶奶讲鸭子幕后政府……算了，关你什么事。

source: You all continue the road trip, and gain +N2 MIND learning how to brainwash -- I mean, herd sheep! But you also lose -N2 SOUL for it.
target: 你们继续旅行，学会了如何洗脑——我是说，牧羊，让你获得 +N2 头脑！不过也损失了 -N2 灵魂。

source: That's perfect! Scott Howl, the wolf in sheep's clothing for president!
target: 完美！斯科特·嚎尔，这头披着羊皮的狼，要竞选总统了！

source: You spend -N2 MONEY building Scott's campaign. Cut to presidential candidates Scott Howl and Susie the Sheep having their big debate before the election!
target: 你花 -N2 金钱，为斯科特组织竞选。镜头切到大选前的辩论会：总统候选人斯科特·嚎尔，对阵绵羊苏茜！

source: What's up, sheeple? Welcome to the debate! I'm Polly Geist, your totally-impartial moderator.
target: 羊民们，大家好！欢迎来到辩论会！我是波莉·鬼斯特，绝对公正的主持人。

source: Question 1: Susie, how will you tackle the worsening overgrazing crisis?
target: 第一个问题：苏茜，你准备如何应对愈发严重的过度放牧危机？

source: "Baaaa!" says Susie.
target: “咩——！”苏茜说。

source: Damn, that's a strong opener. Scott, what's your rebuttal?
target: 妈的，好有力的开场。斯科特，你怎么反驳？

source: Um... can I phone a friend?
target: 呃……我能打电话求助朋友吗？

source: Sure, Scott.
target: 当然，斯科特。

source: (Psst! Polly?)
target: （嘘！波莉？）

source: (Yes, Scott?)
target: （怎么了，斯科特？）

source: (What's overgrazing?)
target: （什么叫过度放牧？）

source: (If you don't know, I bet the sheep don't either. Tell them it's a myth.)
target: （你都不知道，羊肯定也不知道。告诉它们，是骗人的。）

source: (Okay!)
I heard overgrazing is a myth, actually. But I promise if you make me president, I'll teach you all sheep sports and lead you to greener pastures! Wink!
target: 其实，我听说过度放牧是骗人的。不过，只要选我当总统，我保证教大家玩各种羊类运动，带大家去更绿的牧场！眨眼！

source: YAAASSS! Greener pastures! If I weren't so impartial, I'd definitely vote for THAT guy!
target: 好耶——更绿的牧场！要不是我这么公正，肯定投他一票！

source: After Polly establishes her support, all the sheep vote for Scott -- even Susie! Three cheers for herd mentality!
target: 波莉一表态，所有羊都投给斯科特，连苏茜也不例外！为从众心理欢呼三声！

source: Follow me, sheep bros! I'll lead you to a future out of the road, and with an improved education system!
target: 羊兄弟们，跟我来！我带你们走向不用堵在路上、教育制度更完善的未来！

source: Scott leads the sheep off the road, and now he can say he made a career in politics! You also gained +N2 MIND learning how to herd the sheep.
target: 斯科特领着羊群离开了公路，如今也能说自己干过政治了！你学会了牧羊，获得 +N2 头脑。

source: You pull over when you see a bus blasting techno music. A crowd of fish-people are hanging out and dancing around it.
target: 你们看见一辆大巴，正放着震耳欲聋的 Techno 舞曲，便靠边停下。一群鱼人围着大巴，闲聊跳舞。

source: Polly runs up to one of the merpeople, having the starstruck expression of someone meeting their celebrity crush.
target: 波莉跑向一个人鱼，表情就像见到了自己的明星梦中情人。

source: Uh... hi. Sorry to bug you, but we were driving past and I couldn't help but wonder if--
target: 呃……嗨。不好意思打扰了，我们开车经过，忍不住想问，这是不是——

source: "HUH?!" shouts the fish-man. "Sorry, brah, can't hear you over this boosted bass!"
target: “啊？！”鱼人大喊，“抱歉，兄弟，低音太猛，听不见！”

source: I was wondering if this is the legendary--!
target: 我想问，这是不是传说中的——！

source: "Yo, you gotta speak up! We're on Cod Route! The music only gets louder from here!"
target: “哟，说大声点！我们在走鳕鱼之路呢！接下来，音乐只会越来越响！”

source: THIS REALLY IS COD ROUTE?! NO WAYYYY!
target: 这真的是鳕鱼之路？！不会吧——！

source: What's Cod Route?
target: 什么叫鳕鱼之路？

source: It's a tradition -- a pilgrimage, practically -- that was popular in Spain during the 1980s.
target: 是一项传统，简直可以说是朝圣。二十世纪八十年代，在西班牙特别流行。

source: Groups of friends would spend Friday-Monday nonstop partying, hopping from nightclub to nightclub and getting turnt on the road or in parking lots along the way.
target: 一群朋友从周五玩到周一，派对不停，一家夜店接一家地跑，路上和停车场里也照样狂欢。

source: But as far as I knew, Cod Route ended around '96 when the government cracked down on nightlife laws, so this should be impossible!
target: 可据我所知，九六年前后，政府收紧夜生活法规，鳕鱼之路就结束了。所以这不可能啊！

source: "Nah, we found a loophole!" says the fish-man. "This bus has been going ever since '96. Cod Route can't end if the party never stops!"
target: “没，我们找到漏洞了！”鱼人说，“这辆大巴从九六年开到现在都没停。只要派对不停，鳕鱼之路就永远不会结束！”

source: THAT! IS! FUCKING! LEGENDARY!!!
target: 太！他！妈！传！奇！了！！！

source: "You should be a part of the legend, then! Wanna party with us?"
target: “那就一起成为传奇吧！要跟我们狂欢吗？”

source: IT WOULD BE MY HONOR.
target: 荣幸之至。

source: You and your friends dance, drink, and party the next several hours away.
target: 接下来好几个小时，你和朋友们喝酒、跳舞，尽情狂欢。

source: Hey, not to be a party pooper, but when are we leaving? I'm losing a lot of -N2 STAMINA after forty-eight hours of dancing...
target: 嘿，我不是想扫兴，可咱们什么时候走？跳了四十八小时，已经损失好多 -N2 体力了……

source: WOOOOO! SHOTS, SHOTS, SHOTS! COD ROUTE FOREVER!!!
target: 呜——！干杯，干杯，干杯！鳕鱼之路万岁！！！

source: Dang, I knew Polly liked to party, but I've never seen it get this bad... we gotta get her to leave, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, or we may really be stuck here forever!
target: 哎，我知道波莉爱派对，可从没见她这么夸张……%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，得把她劝走，不然咱们真要永远困在这儿了！

source: Tie Polly to the car's mast and shove some beeswax into her ears to protect her from the alluring beats of the cods' party.
target: 把波莉绑在车上的桅杆上，再用蜂蜡塞住耳朵，免得被鳕鱼派对的诱人节拍勾走魂。

source: The only way to catch Polly's elusive attention is by designing a party that's not only bombastic, but catered specifically to her exact tastes: THE POLLY FEST!
target: 想抓住波莉飘忽的注意力，只有办一场既轰轰烈烈、又完全投其所好的派对：波莉音乐节！

source: Okay, I'm in!
target: 好，我同意！

source: You are?
target: 你同意了？

source: Yeah. I'm obviously the hero of this road trip epic, lured in by Cod Route's siren song. It makes sense to tie me to the mast and continue on our adventure.
target: 对啊。我显然是这场公路史诗的主角，被鳕鱼之路的海妖之歌诱惑。把我绑上桅杆，继续冒险，很合理。

source: I don't wanna do the beeswax, though. That seems excessive. It's not like I'm gonna go anywhere while I'm friggin' tied up.
target: 不过别塞蜂蜡了，太夸张了。我都他妈被绑住了，还能跑到哪儿去？

source: Okay, if she's sure. You tie Polly to the mast of the car (you really packed everything), and Scott begins driving away from the Cod Route party.
target: 既然她这么肯定，就照办吧。你把波莉绑在车上的桅杆上（你们真是什么都带了），斯科特开车离开鳕鱼之路派对。

source: WAIT! THIS WAS A TERRIBLE MISTAKE! TAKE ME BACK!
target: 等等！这主意糟透了！带我回去！

source: No can do, bro. You gotta resist the call of the bass!
target: 不行，兄弟。你得抵抗低音的召唤！

source: Noooo, come on! They're playing my favorite song! You're seriously gonna make me leave without getting to twerk to my favorite song?
target: 不要嘛！他们在放我最爱的歌！不让我跟着最爱的歌扭一扭，你们真忍心走？

source: Fine... but we're only staying for one more song, okay?
target: 好吧……就再留一首歌的时间，好吗？

source: Deal!
target: 说定了！

source: Five hours later...
target: 五小时后……

source: WOOHOO! PARTAAAAYYY! HEY EVERYBODY, WATCH ME USE THIS MAST AS A STRIPPER POLE!
target: 呜呼！派对——！大家快看，我拿桅杆当钢管跳脱衣舞啦！

source: ...Fuck.
Fifteen minutes later, you've got Polly mast-tied and beeswax'd on the car roof.
target: 十五分钟后，你们把波莉绑在车顶桅杆上，耳朵也塞好了蜂蜡。

source: LMAO, you guys were right. I guess I deserve this.
target: 笑死，你们是对的。我这算自找的。

source: It's okay, bro. We forgive you!
target: 没事，兄弟。我们原谅你！

source: What?! I can't hear you over the beeswax!
target: 什么？！塞着蜂蜡，我听不见！

source: You all gain +N2 MIND, having learned the legacy (and the exhausting price) of taking the Cod Route.
target: 你们了解了鳕鱼之路的传统，以及参与它所付出的疲惫代价，全都获得 +N2 头脑。

source: Okay, good idea! Let's brainstorm some stuff we could add to Polly Fest to make Polly like it.
target: 好主意！想想波莉音乐节加点什么，才能让她喜欢吧。

source: Let's tell her there will be a twerking contest at Polly Fest. She loves twerking!
target: 告诉她，音乐节有扭臀比赛。她最爱扭臀了！

source: We can also tell her there will be a drug-taking contest. She likes drugs a LOT. I don't really get it, but it's her thing.
target: 还有嗑药比赛。她特别爱嗑药。我不是很懂，不过那是她的爱好。

source: Polly's also pretty smart. She's into smart stuff like chess and books. Maybe we can tell her there will be a smarts contest at the party too!
target: 波莉也很聪明，喜欢国际象棋、书籍这些聪明的东西。也许可以说，音乐节还有智力比赛！

source: Scott's ideas are very earnest and sweet, but you feel the need to remind him that partying isn't really about having a series of contests.
target: 斯科特的想法真诚又贴心，不过你觉得，还是得提醒他：派对可不是一场接一场的比赛。

source: Oh, good point. Then let's just tell her there will be twerking, drugs, books, and chess there. That should be enough to convince her.
target: 哦，有道理。那就说有扭臀、毒品、书，还有国际象棋。应该足够说服她了。

source: Fine by me, but doesn't all this dishonesty make you uncomfortable?
target: 我没意见，可撒这么多谎，你不会难受吗？

source: That's fair. I don't really like to lie. I usually do my best to tell the truth and be a good boy.
target: 也是，我确实不喜欢撒谎。平时总是尽力说实话，做个乖孩子。

source: But if we don't do something, Polly will stay at this party forever and never do the other stuff she likes to do, and I think letting that happen is a lot worse than lying.
target: 可要是不做点什么，波莉就会永远待在这个派对上，再也做不了别的喜欢的事。放任她这样，可比撒谎糟多了。

source: Let's find her. It'll probably take a lot of convincing to get Polly to leave this place for Polly Fest, but--
target: 去找她吧。想劝波莉离开，去波莉音乐节，估计得费不少口舌，不过——

source: Whoa, did you say there's a party going on called Polly Fest? That LITERALLY has my name on it! We should go!
target: 哇，你们刚说，有个派对叫波莉音乐节？那不就是给我办的吗！走啊！

source: Oh, perfect, we were gonna suggest that! I heard they've got all your favorite stuff there!
target: 哦，正好，我们刚想提！听说你最喜欢的东西，那儿全有！

source: Oh really? Do they have dolphin strippers? I've been OBSESSED with dolphin strippers ever since I thought of how cool dolphin strippers would be two minutes ago.
target: 哦，真的？有海豚脱衣舞娘吗？两分钟前，我刚想到海豚跳脱衣舞肯定超棒，从那时起就迷上了！

source: Uh... sure?
target: 呃……有吧？

source: Sweet! Let the +N2 HYPE roll in! ONWARD, TO POLLY FEST!
target: 太棒了！让 +N2 热度滚滚来吧！出发，去波莉音乐节！

source: That was easier than you expected! Though you are a bit worried Polly will be angry with you all when she realizes Polly Fest doesn't exist...
target: 比想象中容易多了！不过，等波莉发现音乐节根本不存在，肯定会生气吧，你有点担心……

source: ...but in ten minutes she's already forgotten all about it and is just talking about dolphins in G-strings. Good thing all those shots destroyed her short-term memory!
target: ……可十分钟后，她就忘得一干二净，只顾着聊穿丁字裤的海豚了。还好那几杯烈酒摧毁了她的短期记忆！

source: ONWARD, TO THE ROAD TRIP!
target: 出发，继续公路旅行！

source: You're driving along when you see two people doing something... weird on the side of the road. You pull over to investigate.
target: 赶路时，你看见路边有两个人，在干些……怪事。你们停下车，过去瞧瞧。

source: Hey, bros! Whatcha doin'?
target: 嘿，兄弟们！干什么呢？

source: "Uh... just digging some holes," says the man in the pinstripe suit and fedora digging a six-foot-deep square in the sand.
target: “呃……挖几个坑而已。”一个穿细条纹西装、戴软呢帽的男人说。他正在沙地上挖一个六英尺深的方坑。

source: Cool, I love holes! Whatcha gonna bury in 'em? Bones?
target: 酷，我喜欢坑！你们要埋什么？骨头吗？

source: "Yeah, in a sense," says the other man in a matching suit, glancing at the lumpy bag next to him.
target: “嗯，某种意义上是。”另一个穿着同款西装的男人说，瞥了一眼旁边鼓鼓囊囊的袋子。

source: Ohhh, I see what's going on here. You're mobsters disposing of a dead body!
target: 哦——懂了。你们是黑帮，在处理尸体！

source: "No we aren't!"
target: “我们不是！”

source: Yes you are.
target: 就是。

source: "No. We. AREN'T."
target: “我。们。不。是。”

source: Yes you are, yes you are, yes you are TIMES INFINITY! I win!
target: 就是就是就是，乘以无穷大！我赢了！

source: "Well, look, let's just say you kids didn't see anything, all right?"
target: “好吧，听着，就当你们什么都没看见，行吗？”

source: I can't say that. We DID see something. And Coach says liars never win!
target: 不能这么说。我们明明看见了。教练说过，撒谎的人永远赢不了！

source: Unless they lie about being on steroids, I guess... steroids usually make you win.
target: 除非是撒谎说自己没打类固醇吧……打了类固醇，一般都能赢。

source: "Fine, so you saw something. Just don't TELL anyone what you saw and we won't have a problem."
target: “行，你们看见了。只要别告诉别人，就不会有事。”

source: No way! It's not every day you see the mob burying a dead body. That's way too juicy to keep to myself!
target: 那可不行！黑帮埋尸体，可不是天天能看见的。这么劲爆，我哪儿憋得住！

source: This is going right up on my Tweeter: "LOL, just ran into the #mob disposing of a corpse at these coordinates..."
target: 我这就发 Tweeter：“笑死，刚遇到 #黑帮 在处理尸体，坐标是……”

source: A few minutes later, you and your friends are losing -N2 STAMINA as you dig your own graves while mobsters hold you at gunpoint.
target: 几分钟后，黑帮拿枪指着你们，你和朋友们只好挖自己的坟墓，损失 -N2 体力。

source: This stinks.
target: 真倒霉。

source: I know, buddy. At least we can take comfort in the fact that this outcome was completely unavoidable.
target: 我知道，伙计。至少可以安慰自己：这个结果，完全无法避免。

source: Well, the good news is that it's not completely unfixable. Come up with a way to get out of being buried alive!
target: 好消息是，还没到无可挽回的地步。快想办法，别被活埋！

source: Tell them you have a right to pick a better spot to be buried in. When you find it, you'll let them know. Then proceed to live your life in search of the perfect spot to be buried.
target: 告诉他们，你有权挑个更好的地方下葬。找到了会通知他们，然后就用一生，慢慢寻找最完美的安葬地。

source: SHOVEL FIGHT!
target: 铲子大战！

source: You inform the mobsters that you don't want to be buried here, and have the right to pick your preferred final resting place.
target: 你告诉黑帮，自己不想埋在这里，有权选择喜欢的长眠之地。

source: "Eh... is that true?" they ask. "We've always just buried mooks wherever we felt like."
target: “呃……真的吗？”他们问，“我们一直想把人埋哪儿就埋哪儿。”

source: Then you've been doing it all wrong! Everyone has a right to choose where they decompose!
target: 那你们一直都做错了！每个人都有权选择自己在哪儿腐烂！

source: I always thought my FINAL final resting place should be somewhere high-traffic, so everyone has to read my tombstone. Like in the middle of a nightclub maybe.
target: 我早就想过，最后、最后的长眠之地，一定得人流量大，逼大家都读我的墓碑。比如夜店正中央。

source: I want my final resting place to be in the same hole I buried my prized bone collection in!
target: 我想埋在收藏骨头的那个坑里，跟我最珍贵的骨头们在一起！

source: Burying my dead bones on top of all the bones I collected when I was alive would be the sort of thing my smart friend Liam would call "ironing."
target: 把我死后的骨头，埋在我活着时收集的骨头上，聪明的李姆管这种事叫“熨刺”。

source: "Well," say the mobsters, "I guess if I was gonna get buried alive in a shallow grave, I'd want some say on the spot too."
target: “也是，”黑帮说，“要换我被活埋在浅坑里，肯定也想挑挑地方。”

source: "Here, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, take this burner phone. When you find your ideal resting place, give us a call."
target: “来，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，这部一次性手机拿着。找到理想的安葬地，就打给我们。”

source: You and your friends leave and continue your road trip. You wonder all the while where you'd most like to be buried. It's a tough choice!
target: 你和朋友们离开，继续公路旅行。一路上，你都在想，自己最想埋在哪儿。真难选啊！

source: Days, months, years pass... finally, you're an old %MANWOMAN% near %HISHER% deathbed taking an invigorating wheelchair ride through the park.
target: 日复一日，月复一月，年复一年……终于，你成了个年老的 %MANWOMAN%，临近 %HISHER% 人生终点，正坐着轮椅在公园里兜风，精神抖擞。

source: There, up ahead, you see it. Beautiful trees, warm sunshine, a favorable lack of dog shit in the grass... it's the perfect burial spot!
target: 就在前方，你看见了。树木美丽，阳光温暖，草地上还难得没什么狗屎……完美的安葬地！

source: You pull your burner phone out of your fanny pack and call the mobsters to tell them the good news.
target: 你从腰包里掏出那部一次性手机，打给黑帮，告诉他们这个好消息。

source: "You found your spot? FINALLY!" they say. "We've been waiting in the desert for fuckin' decades!"
target: “找到了？终于！”他们说，“我们他妈在沙漠里等了几十年了！”

source: The mobsters arrive, and you use the last of your strength to dig your grave. You stagger into it with open arms, finally at peace...
target: 黑帮赶来，你用尽最后的力气，挖好自己的坟。你张开双臂，蹒跚走进去，终于心满意足……

source: You'll gain +N2 MIND for finding your ideal spot when you're old and gray. But for now, you're young, hot, and road-tripping with your best buds!
target: 等到白发苍苍，你会因找到理想的安葬地而获得 +N2 头脑。不过现在，你还年轻、性感，正和最好的朋友一起公路旅行！

source: OW! %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, did you just hit me with a shovel?!
target: 嗷！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你刚拿铲子打我？！

source: IT. IS. ON. MEET ME IN THE SHOVEL FIGHTING PIT, BITCH!
target: 这。事。没。完。来铲子格斗坑见我，混蛋！

source: You'd better not leave me out! SHOVEL FIIIIIGHT!
target: 不准把我落下！铲子大——战！

source: Polly swings her shovel at you. You parry it with your shovel. You both duck as Scott nearly decapitates you with the edge of his shovel. SHOVEL FIGHT!
target: 波莉挥铲攻来，你用铲子挡下。斯科特一铲子差点削掉你们的脑袋，两人连忙低头躲开。铲子大战！

source: "HEY!" the mobsters shout. "The fuck's goin' on? Keep diggin' those graves or we'll blow your brains out!"
target: “嘿！”黑帮大喊，“他妈干什么呢？继续挖坟，不然崩了你们！”

source: Hey, put those guns away! You can't bring a gun to a shovel fight. That's cheating!
target: 嘿，把枪收起来！铲子大战不能带枪，这是作弊！

source: You gotta respect the rules, bros. If you wanna play with us, grab a shovel!
target: 尊重规则，兄弟们。想加入，就拿铲子！

source: The mobsters look at each other while you and your friends shovel fight without a care in the world.
target: 你和朋友们无忧无虑地打着铲子大战，黑帮两人面面相觑。

source: "Fuck the graves," one snaps. "We should just execute them."
target: “挖他妈的坟。”一个人骂道，“直接毙了得了。”

source: "We should...," says the other, "but honestly, that shovel fight does look fun. Can't we join them, just for a little bit?"
target: “应该……”另一个说，“可说真的，铲子大战看着挺好玩。就跟他们玩一小会儿，不行吗？”

source: "No! The boss would be furious if he found out we were goofing off on the job!"
target: “不行！老大知道我们上班摸鱼，会气疯的！”

source: "But we always do whatever the boss tells us to do. 'Boys, go kill this guy.' 'Boys, bury this body in the desert.' 'Boys, pick up my lucky fedora from the dry-cleaner's.'"
target: “可我们一直都是老大说什么，就做什么。‘小子们，去杀了这家伙。’‘小子们，去沙漠埋尸。’‘小子们，去干洗店拿我的幸运软呢帽。’”

source: "Can't we finally do something WE wanna do for a change? I wanna shovel-fight!"
target: “不能也做次自己想做的事吗？我想打铲子大战！”

source: "Eh... fine. What could it hurt? Give us some shovels, kids!"
target: “呃……行吧。能有什么坏处？小子们，给我们铲子！”

source: Oh, we'll give you shovels all right. NOW, %CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%!
target: 哦，肯定给你们铲子。%CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%，就是现在！

source: You and Polly swing your shovels HARD and knock the two mobsters out.
target: 你和波莉使劲挥铲，把两个黑帮打晕在地。

source: Dang, Polly. I didn't know we were doing a shovel fight with street rules.
target: 哎，波莉，我都不知道，这场铲子大战用的是街头规则。

source: And neither did they! Now let's get in the car and drive as far away from here as possible.
target: 他们也不知道！快上车，开得越远越好。

source: Hands-down, that was the most fun way you've ever avoided being buried alive by the mob. You gain +N2 HYPE!
target: 毫无疑问，这是你逃过黑帮活埋最开心的一次。你获得 +N2 热度！

source: Your car is stopped at a red light when a slick red sports car pulls up next to you. The driver revs its engine in a deadly invitation to race.
target: 你在红灯前停下，一辆炫酷的红色跑车开到旁边。司机猛轰油门，发出危险的飙车邀请。

source: Fuck yeah, a street race! DRIVE, SCOTT!
target: 操，好啊，街头飙车！斯科特，冲！

source: But the light is still red. We can't move yet.
target: 可还是红灯，现在不能走。

source: Who cares?! Street racers don't play by the rules! DRIVE!
target: 管它呢！街头车手才不守规矩！冲！

source: Scott peels out, and so does the other car.
target: 斯科特猛踩油门，对方也蹿了出去。

source: WARP SPEED, SCOTTY! DRIVE LIKE THERE'S NO TOMORROW!
target: 小斯，曲速前进！拿出今天就是最后一天的气势！

source: Okay, if you insist. But I'll go five miles above the speed limit, 'cause I'm a good boy!
target: 好吧，你非要的话。不过最多只超速五英里，我可是乖孩子！

source: Ugh, fine...
target: 唉，行吧……

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, looks like it's up to you. SHOOT OUT THE OTHER GUY'S TIRES!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，只能靠你了。把那家伙的轮胎打爆！

source: What? How? I don't have a gun.
target: 什么？怎么打？我又没枪。

source: You don't?! But you called shotgun!
target: 你没枪？！可你刚才喊了 shotgun，要坐副驾啊！

source: That means you sit in the passenger seat with a loaded shotgun and fuck up anybody who tries to mess with us!
target: 那不就是坐在副驾，端着装好弹的霰弹枪，把所有敢惹咱们的家伙轰个稀烂吗！

source: You're about to tell Polly that's not what shotgun means (anymore) when your racing opponent suddenly slams his car into the side of your car.
target: 你正想告诉波莉，shotgun 现在可不是这个意思，对手突然开车撞向你们的侧面。

source: WHOA! We almost went off the road! That wasn't very nice...
target: 哇！差点冲出路面！这也太不友善了……

source: It sure wasn't. Looks like these motherfuckers wanna play dirty!
target: 就是。这帮混蛋看来想玩阴的！

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, since you already let me down on the shotgun, you'd better have a good idea on how to retaliate and win this race!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你没带霰弹枪，已经让我失望一次了。这次最好想个妙招，报复回去，赢下比赛！

source: Sure, why not? Given all the -N2 MAGIC your car already burnt up during this race, things can only go up from here.
target: 行啊，为什么不呢？反正这场比赛已经烧掉了 -N2 魔力，还能更糟吗。

source: Time to play a little dirty and win this street race!
target: 该玩点阴招，赢下这场街头飙车了！

source: The car pen is mightier than the car sword: write a strongly-worded letter and throw it to the other car as a paper plane!
target: 车用笔胜过车用剑：写封措辞严厉的信，折成纸飞机，扔进对方车里！

source: It's time to push the Big Red Button. No idea what it does, but desperate times call for desperate measures!
target: 是时候按下大红按钮了。虽然不知道有什么用，可紧急时刻，就得下点猛药！

source: Okay, I'm in! Help me brainstorm some hate-mail!
target: 好，我加入！一起想想怎么写封骂人的信！

source: "Dear Motherfucker..." Hmm, is that too strong of an opening?
target: “亲爱的狗娘养的……”唔，开头会不会太狠了？

source: I'm loving the attitude, but bringing the guy's mom into this might be too far. I suggest going with "Dear Shithead."
target: 我喜欢这个气势，不过连他妈一起骂，可能有点过。建议换成“亲爱的脑残”。

source: Good call. "Dear Shithead: How dare you hip-check our car?! I am absolutely DISGUSTED!"
target: 有道理。“亲爱的脑残：竟敢侧撞我们的车？！你的行为，实在令我作呕！”

source: "You are a deplorable jackass without a shred of redeemability, unfit for even the lowest dregs of society!"
target: “你这卑鄙可耻、无可救药的混账，连社会最底层的渣滓都不如！”

source: What's a deep lore jackass without a shed of red ear Billy in... uh, whatever you just said?
target: 什么叫被逼烤翅、无壳浇药的混账……呃，后面那些又是什么？

source: Here, I'll explain it this way: I'm using words to describe the feelings you get when your least favorite team scores a touchdown.
target: 这么解释吧：我用这些词，表达你最讨厌的球队达阵得分时，你心里的感觉。

source: Oh, got it! Then you should end it with, "I'm mad at you, but it's okay, because everyone's having fun and that's what matters!"
target: 哦，懂了！那最后应该写：“我很生你的气，不过没关系，大家玩得开心才最重要！”

source: Perfect. You fold the finished letter into a paper airplane and throw it into your opponent's open window.
target: 完美。你把写好的信折成纸飞机，扔进对手敞开的车窗。
