source: It punctures the driver's eyeball. He screams, thrashing blindly, and the car fishtails and crashes off-road.
target: 纸飞机扎穿了司机的眼球。他尖叫着胡乱挣扎，车子甩尾，冲出了公路。

source: ...Oops.
target: ……哎呀。

source: Maybe he can read our letter later when he regains consciousness?
target: 等他醒过来，应该还能看信吧？

source: The car suddenly explodes in a fiery inferno.
target: 车子突然爆炸，燃起冲天大火。

source: DRIVE, SCOTT!
target: 斯科特，快开车！

source: Yup, cool, never speaking of that again. At least you all gained +N2 MIND by choosing the intellectual's weapon: the mighty pen!
target: 好，行，这事谁也别再提。至少你们选择了知识分子的武器——强大的笔，获得 +N2 头脑！

source: Really? Is it finally time to push THE Big Red Button?! The suspense has been killing me!
target: 真的？终于轮到那个大红按钮了？！我都快好奇死了！

source: Looks like today is the fateful day. You and your friends gather your courage, hold your breaths, and... you push it!
target: 看来，命中注定的日子就是今天。你和朋友们鼓起勇气，屏住呼吸，然后……按了下去！

source: Nothing happens. Damn.
target: 什么都没发生。妈的。

source: This can't be right. Push it again, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, but do it right this time!
target: 不对啊。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，再按一次，这回好好按！

source: You didn't know there was a way to push a button wrong, but fine. This time when you hit the button, "La Cucaracha" begins to play.
target: 你都不知道，按按钮还能按错。不过行吧，这次一按，《蟑螂之歌》响了起来。

source: What the... why? Is that all this button does?
target: 什么鬼……为什么？这按钮就只会放歌？

source: I don't mind, I like this song. Play it again, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!
target: 我不介意，我喜欢这首。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，再放一遍！

source: You hit the Big Red Button again. A cannon pops out of your trunk and fires a cannonball at your opponent's car!
target: 你又按下大红按钮。后备箱里弹出一门炮，朝对方的车轰出一颗炮弹！

source: WHOA, that was awesome! Shame it missed, but damn, still wild.
target: 哇，太棒了！没打中有点可惜，不过还是牛啊。

source: Push it again, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. MORE CANNON POWER!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，再按！加大火炮力度！

source: You push it again, and...
target: 你又按了一次，然后……

source: LA CUCARAAAACHA! LA CUCARAAAACHA! YA NO PUEDE CAMINAAAAR!
target: 小蟑螂——小蟑螂——已经没法走路啦——！

source: Not this shit again! BRING BACK THE CANNON!
target: 怎么又是这破歌！把大炮还来！

source: You push the button again. Your opponent's car suddenly spins out, catches fire, and explodes in a spontaneous inferno.
target: 你再按一下。对手的车突然失控打转，起火，猛地炸成一团火球。

source: ...Did we win?
target: ……我们赢了吗？

source: Uh... push the button again, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 呃……%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，再按一下吧。

source: You do, and your car is filled once more with La Cucaracha's dulcet jaw harp as you drive off.
target: 你照做了。《蟑螂之歌》悦耳的口簧琴声又充满车厢，你们就这样开车离去。

source: Aside from all the manslaughter, the Big Red Button turned out to be a big fun time! You gain +N2 HYPE.
target: 除了那点过失杀人，大红按钮确实带来了不少乐趣！你获得 +N2 热度。

source: So, fun story: you and your friends have been hotly pursued by a mob of pissed-off motorists for the past ten miles.
target: 说个有趣的事：过去十英里，你和朋友们一直被一群暴怒的司机穷追不舍。

source: What do we do, guys?! Why is that angry mob chasing us?!
target: 怎么办，伙计们？！他们为什么追我们？！

source: No idea, Scott. They're probably murderously jealous of how hot and fun and cool we are!
target: 不知道啊，斯科特。大概嫉妒咱们又性感、又好玩、又酷，嫉妒得想杀人吧！

source: ...Or it could have something to do with the +N2 MAGIC which I siphoned out of their gas tanks at the last stop.
target: ……也可能是因为，我上次停车时，从他们油箱里抽走了 +N2 魔力。

source: What? Why did you do that?
target: 什么？你干吗这么做？

source: Have you SEEN the price of gas lately? We gotta save money where we can, and it was either selling someone's organs or tank-siphoning.
target: 最近油价多贵，你看见了吗？能省就得省。要么卖掉某个人的器官，要么偷抽汽油。

source: And since %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% is selfishly hoarding that extra lung of %HISHERS%, this was the best I could do.
target: 可 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 那么自私，非要留着 %HISHERS% 那个多余的肺，我也只能这样了。

source: You know, I work really hard to make this road trip a road home, and I'm not appreciated for it!
target: 我这么努力，想让公路旅行也有家的温暖，结果没人领情！

source: Aww, I appreciate you, bro! I just don't want an angry mob to put a pitchfork in my heinie...
target: 哎，我领情啊，兄弟！只是不想被愤怒的人群，用草叉戳屁股……

source: Maybe if I pull over and explain, they'll be cool about it and we can all group-hug?
target: 要不停车解释一下？也许他们会理解，最后大家还能抱一抱？

source: I don't think that's gonna work, bud. Our only hope is getting away!
target: 恐怕不行，伙计。咱们只能逃！

source: The car would move faster if we got rid of some heavy shit... %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, help me jettison some stuff from the car!
target: 扔掉些重东西，车就能跑快点……%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，帮我往外丢点东西！

source: Okay! You did overpack a little, to be fair. You help Polly toss out your novelty bowling ball collection, emergency anvil, and miniature black hole.
target: 好！说实话，你们确实带多了。你帮波莉扔掉花式保龄球收藏、应急铁砧，还有微型黑洞。

source: It's not enough; they're gaining on us!
target: 不够，他们快追上来了！

source: Ugh, they didn't even slip and slide a LITTLE on all those bowling balls? Lame!
target: 唉，那么多保龄球，居然连滑一下都没滑？没劲！

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, we gotta find something else to throw out, quick!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，再找点别的扔，快！

source: Jettison that heavy metal cassette you're listening to. It's... IT'S TOO HEAVY!
target: 扔掉正在听的重金属磁带。它……实在太重了！

source: As much as it breaks your heart, you must jettison your dear friend Troy, who's been riding with you all along during this trip.
target: 就算再心痛，也得扔下亲爱的特洛伊。他可是从旅行开始，就一直跟着你们的好朋友。

source: Whoa, I didn't even notice the heavy metal music. How long has that been playing? I thought we were listening to the %MUSIC% station.
target: 哇，我都没注意到在放重金属。放多久了？还以为咱们听的是 %MUSIC% 电台。

source: This is music? I thought the car was just screaming 'cause we were driving it too hard and fast.
target: 这是音乐？我还以为，车被开得又快又狠，疼得叫起来了。

source: Nah, it's music. Metal's not my preferred genre, but I guess it was good ambiance for this high-stakes car chase.
target: 不是，是音乐。重金属不是我的菜，不过这种生死时速的追车场面，拿它配乐还挺合适。

source: But it looks like it's time to kiss this soundtrack goodbye... farewell little buddy.
target: 可惜，该跟这段配乐说再见了……再见，小家伙。

source: Whoa, this tape's so heavy I can't even eject it. Scott, can you throw it out the window?
target: 哇，这磁带太重，连弹都弹不出来。斯科特，帮忙扔窗外？

source: Leave it to me, bro. THIS ONE'S FOR ARM DAY!
target: 交给我，兄弟。不枉我练了那么多次手臂！

source: Scott suplexes the heavy metal tape out of the moving car.
target: 斯科特使出一招背摔，把重金属磁带甩出行驶中的车子。

source: It's so heavy it cracks the asphalt when it hits the road and shatters.
target: 磁带重得落地就砸裂了柏油路，自己也摔得粉碎。

source: A shard of cassette pierces one angry motorist's tire at the same time that heavy metal music pierces everyone's ears, and the tape dies in one final rock-and-roll scream.
target: 一块碎片扎穿了某位愤怒司机的轮胎，重金属乐声同时刺穿了所有人的耳膜。最后一声摇滚尖啸中，磁带寿终正寝。

source: ...Well this silence is deafening.
target: ……好吧，这沉默简直震耳欲聋。

source: Dang, I miss the screaming already. Should I scream to fill the silence?
target: 哎，已经开始想念尖叫声了。要不我叫两声，填补一下？

source: Go for it.
target: 来吧。

source: AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!
target: 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！

source: *INHALE...*
AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH...
target: 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊……

source: It's just not the same. You successfully got away from that angry mob, but it came at the cost of your favorite heavy metal mixtape, and -N2 HYPE.
target: 还是不一样。你们成功甩掉了愤怒的人群，可代价是最爱的重金属混音带，以及 -N2 热度。

source: You look back at Troy, sitting where he's always sat in your backseat, and suggest throwing him out of the car.
target: 你回头看向特洛伊。他一直坐在后座的老位置上。你提议，把他扔下去。

source: No way, we can't get rid of Troy! We've all been through so much together!
target: 不行！怎么能丢掉特洛伊！咱们一起经历了那么多！

source: It's okay, dude. Somebody's gotta make a sacrifice to get us outta this pickle.
target: 没事，伙计。总得有人牺牲，才能脱困。

source: Sorry, Troy. You're really cool and all, and we've made some legendary road trip memories together...
target: 对不起，特洛伊。你很酷，咱们也一起留下了好多传奇的旅行回忆……

source: But if someone has to go, it should probably be you. You are a concrete golem, after all.
target: 可要是非得走一个，那大概只能是你。毕竟你是混凝土魔像。

source: Yeah, I get it. No hard feelings. It was still super dope road-tripping with you guys!
target: 嗯，我懂。不怪你们。跟大家一起公路旅行，真的超棒！

source: I'll spend the last few seconds of my life before I hit the ground at 90 miles per hour fondly remembering all of our wacky misadventures.
target: 我会用以九十英里的时速砸向地面前，人生最后的几秒钟，好好回忆咱们那些疯狂倒霉的冒险。

source: Please don't do this, Troy... you're my bro! I'll miss you!
target: 别这样，特洛伊……你是我兄弟！我会想你的！

source: I'll miss you too, Scott. Promise me you'll never stop being hairy and cool.
target: 我也会想你，斯科特。答应我，要一直毛茸茸、酷酷的。

source: For you, Troy... I'll be even hairier!
target: 为了你，特洛伊……我会长更多毛！

source: Polly: I love ya, girl. You've been a great friend to me. I'll see you on the other side.
target: 波莉，爱你啊，姑娘。你一直都是好朋友。咱们另一个世界见。

source: I mean, this IS my other side, so I kinda doubt it. But the sentiment is nice...
target: 可我已经在“另一个世界”了，所以不一定能见。不过心意我领了……

source: And %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, I'll never forget you... or the fact that it was your idea to toss me out of a moving car to save your own ass.
target: 还有 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，我永远不会忘记你……更不会忘记，是你出的主意，把我从行驶的车里扔出去，保你自己的命。

source: I get that you had no choice, but still, kind of a dick move.
target: 我知道你别无选择，可还是挺混蛋的。

source: Goodbye everyone, and remember my motto: live life to the fullest, and always eat pizza with a fork!
target: 再见，各位！记住我的座右铭：人生就要尽情活，吃披萨一定用叉子！

source: Troy jumps out of the moving car and shatters into a million concrete shards.
target: 特洛伊跳出行驶中的车，摔成无数混凝土碎片。

source: NOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!
I'm sorry, buddy. Just remember that this was all %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s idea, okay?
target: 对不起，伙计。不过记住，这全是 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 的主意，好吗？

source: You may have lightened the car's load, but all of your hearts are heavier after the loss of dear Troy. You lose -N2 SOUL.
target: 车是轻了，可失去亲爱的特洛伊，让所有人的心都沉了下去。你损失 -N2 灵魂。

source: You're driving cheerfully along, nothing weird to report...
target: 你们开开心心地赶路，一切正常，没什么怪事……

source: SCOTT, WATCH OUT FOR THAT DEER!
target: 斯科特，小心那头鹿！

source: TOO LATE! BRACE FOR IMPACT!
target: 来不及了！坐稳，要撞了！

source: CRASH!
target: 砰！

source: BROS! Are you all okay?! Please, tell me you're breathing!
target: 兄弟们！都没事吧？！快告诉我，你们还在呼吸！

source: I mean, I'm never breathing, but I'm okay, boo. Looks like the car is too!
target: 我本来就不呼吸，不过我没事，宝。车好像也没事！

source: I dunno if we can say the same about that deer, though... we should check on it.
target: 可那头鹿，就不一定了……咱们去看看吧。

source: You all get out of the car and check on the deer. You're no veterinarian, but you would diagnose this deer with F.U.B.A.R. for sure.
target: 你们下车查看。虽然不是兽医，但你很确定，这鹿已经惨得没救了。

source: Stay with me, my deer bro! Let me give you mouth-to-mouth!
target: 坚持住，鹿兄弟！我给你做人工呼吸！

source: "No... don't worry about it," the deer coughs. "It's too late, I'm a goner."
target: “不……别费心了。”鹿咳嗽着说，“太晚了，我不行了。”

source: God, we're so sorry, dude. Of all the violence and bloodshed our road trip has caused, I really hoped it'd never come to a deer hit-and-run.
target: 天哪，真的很抱歉，伙计。这趟旅行惹出那么多暴力和流血，我真希望，至少别闹出撞鹿逃逸这种事。

source: "It's okay. Don't blame yourselves; this is my fault. Jumping into the road without looking was my guilty pleasure... my only reprieve from my boring deer life."
target: “没事，别怪自己，是我的错。不看车就跳上马路，是我明知不该却戒不掉的爱好……也是无聊鹿生里唯一的消遣。”

source: "I only regret that I put you in danger. I hope you can forgive me for that... someday..."
target: “唯一后悔的，是把你们也置于危险。我希望有一天……你们能原谅我……”

source: You and your friends sit with the deer until his chest goes still. It's a somber, -N2 HYPE moment.
target: 你和朋友们陪在鹿身边，直到他的胸口不再起伏。这一刻沉重又悲伤，你损失 -N2 热度。

source: Jeez, poor guy. All he wanted was a little thrill in his life, and now he's dead for it.
target: 唉，可怜的家伙。他只是想给生活找点刺激，却因此丢了命。

source: I'm really sad... do you guys think there's anything we can do to honor the deer's life somehow?
target: 我真的很难过……咱们能不能做点什么，纪念一下他？

source: It's the least you could do after you shattered his ribs with your headlights. How do you honor the deer's passing?
target: 你都用车灯撞碎他的肋骨了，这点事总该做。要如何悼念这头鹿呢？

source: Be there for the deer's widow and child. Cover for the deer in the important paternal task of teaching his son to play baseball.
target: 陪伴鹿的遗孀和孩子。替他尽一份父亲的责任，教儿子打棒球。

source: Attend the deer's funeral and meet his loved ones in order to learn more about the deer as a form of honoring him.
target: 参加鹿的葬礼，认识他的亲友，多了解他生前的事，以此纪念他。

source: You all visit the deer's widow and son in their house... which is the woods, 'cause they're deer.
target: 你们去鹿的遗孀和儿子家探望……也就是树林，毕竟他们是鹿。

source: "I always knew my husband's hobby would kill him one day," sighs his widow. "But he lived a full life... and I suppose he would want us to continue on."
target: “我早知道，他那爱好迟早会害死他。”遗孀叹气，“不过，他这一生过得很充实……我想，他也希望我们继续生活。”

source: I know this must be hard for you, ma'am. Want us to help you with chores or anything?
target: 夫人，我知道你一定很难受。要不要帮忙做点家务什么的？

source: I could clean up a bit for you! There's dirt and leaves, like, literally everywhere.
target: 我可以帮忙打扫！到处都是泥土和树叶，真的是到处都有。

source: "That would be nice," says the widow, sniffling. "I was going to make my son breakfast. Could you help me open these marmalade jars?"
target: “那太好了。”遗孀抽泣着说，“我正准备给儿子做早饭，能帮我打开这些橘子酱罐吗？”

source: "I can never open them myself since I don't have thumbs... God, what was I thinking, buying these when I know I have no thumbs?"
target: “没有拇指，我总是拧不开……天哪，明知道自己没拇指，还买这些，我到底在想什么？”

source: Hey, it's okay--
target: 嘿，没关系——

source: "WHAT WAS I THINKING?!" the widow sobs. "Making a nice breakfast for everyone? Carrying this family alone?! I can't! I can't do any of this alone!!!"
target: “我到底在想什么？！”遗孀哭喊，“给大家做顿好吃的早饭？独自撑起这个家？！不行！我一个人根本做不到！！！”

source: Scott hugs the widow while she regains her composure, then keeps helping her open jars.
target: 斯科特抱住遗孀，等她慢慢平静下来，又继续帮她开罐子。

source: Meanwhile, you go out to the backyard (which is, you guessed it, just more woods) to teach the deer's son to play baseball.
target: 与此同时，你去后院（没错，还是树林），教鹿的儿子打棒球。

source: The juvenile deer is pretty bad at it, on account of the no thumbs.
target: 小鹿打得不太好，毕竟没有拇指。

source: "Sorry, I guess this just isn't my thing," he sighs. "Maybe my family and I should give up on thumb-related activities."
target: “抱歉，看来我真不适合这个。”他叹气，“也许我们全家，都该放弃需要拇指的活动。”

source: No, don't give up on baseball!
target: 不，别放弃棒球！

source: "Why not?" he says gloomily. "I'm no good at it. What's the point?"
target: “为什么？”他闷闷地说，“反正打不好，有什么意思？”

source: Because it's fun! Society and side-hustle culture have brainwashed us all into thinking we need to be fantastic at all of our hobbies...
target: 因为好玩啊！社会和副业文化，把我们都洗脑了，好像每个爱好都非得练得特别厉害……

source: But what happened to doing something just for fun? You can still come out here, play baseball badly, and have a great time!
target: 可单纯为了开心，去做一件事，不行吗？你完全可以来这里，棒球打得烂，但玩得很开心！

source: "Okay," he says, beginning to smile. "I guess my dad lived by that motto too. He loved jumping in the road, even if he was really bad at avoiding cars."
target: “好吧。”他慢慢笑了，“爸爸好像也是这样生活的。他很喜欢跳上马路，虽然真的很不擅长躲车。”

source: Yeah, kinda like that! I'd rather you play baseball than play in traffic, but yeah!
target: 对，差不多！不过比起在车流里玩，我还是希望你打棒球。总之，就是这样！

source: You and the deer play a rousing game of bad baseball, have a yummy breakfast with the family, and feel a bit more whole when you leave. You gain +N2 SOUL.
target: 你和小鹿打了场烂得很尽兴的棒球，又跟他们一家吃了顿美味早餐。离开时，心里也好受了些。你获得 +N2 灵魂。

source: You all attend the deer's funeral. There are lots of other forest animals in attendance.
target: 你们参加了鹿的葬礼，很多森林动物都来了。

source: Sorry for your loss, Mr. Squirrel. Were you and the deer close friends?
target: 节哀，松鼠先生。你和鹿是好朋友吗？

source: "Oh, we were 'close' all right...," says the squirrel shiftily. "Ever heard the phrase, 'keep your friends close and your enemies closer?'"
target: “哦，我们确实很‘亲近’……”松鼠眼神闪烁，“听过那句话吗？亲近你的朋友，更要亲近你的敌人。”

source: I haven't. I don't think I have any enemies. Should I make some?
target: 没听过。我好像没有敌人，要不要找几个？

source: "No. I'm trying to say that that deer was into some shady shit," the squirrel says. "I bet he knew too much about something and was murdered!"
target: “不是。我是说，那头鹿沾着些见不得人的勾当。”松鼠说，“我敢打赌，他肯定知道太多，被灭口了！”

source: "I think you're right!" says a nearby songbird. "And it wouldn't surprise me one bit if the murderer was in this very room..."
target: “我觉得你说得对！”旁边一只鸣禽说，“就算凶手现在就在这个房间里，我也一点都不意外……”

source: Well, yeah. We're his murderers, and we are in this room. It was more of a manslaughter thing, though.
target: 是啊，我们就是凶手，也在这个房间。不过严格说，是过失致死。

source: "Yes, it's a real mystery afoot," the squirrel goes on obliviously. "But who here would have the biggest motive to off the deer?"
target: “没错，真是疑云重重。”松鼠自顾自地说，“可在场谁最有动机杀他呢？”

source: There was no motive necessary. We hit him with our car on total accident.
target: 没什么动机，就是不小心开车撞了。

source: "Come to think of it..." says the bird, "do we even have proof the deer is really dead? This could be all staged... you know... to collect life insurance money and all that."
target: “说起来……”鸟开口道，“我们有证据，证明鹿真死了吗？没准一切都是演的……为了骗保金之类的。”

source: I THINK THE BUTLER MURDERED HIM!
target: 我觉得凶手是管家！

source: Wait, what?
target: 等等，什么？

source: I dunno. It's usually the butler, right?
target: 不知道。一般不都是管家吗？

source: No, Scott! It was us! Goddammit...
target: 不，斯科特！是我们！妈的……

source: Well, in any case, you all gain +N2 MIND learning so much about the deer... like how dumb all his peers are.
target: 总之，你们了解了许多关于这头鹿的事，获得 +N2 头脑……比如，他的朋友们有多蠢。

source: You notice two cars pulled over on the side of the road. The drivers are outside the cars screaming at each other.
target: 你注意到两辆车停在路边，司机都站在车外，对着彼此大吼大叫。

source: "You totally T-boned me!" one driver screams. "Look at that scratch! That's coming out of YOUR insurance, asshole!"
target: “你从侧面撞了我！”一个司机大吼，“看看这划痕！得走你的保险赔，混蛋！”

source: "You can barely even see the scratch!" the other driver shouts. "Besides, this accident isn't my fault. You nearly ran me off the road!"
target: “那划痕都快看不见了！”另一个喊，“再说，事故又不是我的错！你差点把我挤出路！”

source: "Nuh-uh! You have no proof that I'm at fault here!"
target: “少来！你有证据证明我有错吗！”

source: "You're right, but YOU don't have any proof that it's MY fault either."
target: “没有，可你也没证据，证明是我的错。”

source: "Ugh, you're right. Guess we have no choice but to stand here and yell at each other until someone comes along and solves this problem for us."
target: “唉，说得对。看来只能站这里对吼，等人过来替咱们解决了。”

source: Hey bros, you can stop yelling at each other! We're here to solve this problem for you!
target: 嘿，兄弟们，别吵了！我们来帮你们解决！

source: Yup! We're total strangers, we have no clue what went down here, and we aren't vehicle experts in the slightest...
target: 对！我们素不相识，完全不知道刚才发生了什么，汽车知识也一窍不通……

source: BUT, if you pay us, we'll determine who's at fault here for ya. Good deal, huh?
target: 不过，只要付钱，我们就帮忙判断谁的责任。很划算吧？

source: First question: which one of you is guilty?
target: 第一个问题：你们谁有错？

source: "HE IS!" both drivers shout in unison, pointing at each other.
target: “他！”两个司机指着对方，异口同声地喊道。

source: Uh... hmm... that answer doesn't really help me. I'm stumped. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, you got any ideas?
target: 呃……嗯……这回答没什么帮助。我没辙了。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，有主意吗？

source: Acquire proper understanding of the situation. Write down the drivers' full biographies to properly understand their psyches and motivations.
target: 全面了解情况。写下两位司机的完整传记，深入剖析他们的心理与动机。

source: Only the cars themselves know the whole story. Give them a sense of self and the gift of speech, so you can call them to the stand.
target: 只有车子知道完整经过。赋予它们自我意识和说话能力，传它们出庭作证。

source: "Ugh, if you insist...," says one driver. "I'm Ralph Jones, I'm a bartender, and my favorite pastime is crashing into cars for the thrill and chaos of it all."
target: “唉，你非要问的话……”一个司机说，“我叫拉尔夫·琼斯，是酒保。最爱的消遣就是开车撞人家的车，享受刺激和混乱。”

source: Oh... uh... that's pretty incriminating. I think we've got our culprit.
target: 哦……呃……这基本算自白了。找到肇事者了吧。

source: That's true, but we need to be thorough. We should still interview the other guy just to be sure!
target: 没错，不过调查要彻底。保险起见，另一个人也得问问！

source: "Aww, thanks! Nobody ever asks me about myself!" says the other driver. "My name's Wesley Spiegelman. I was born on October 31st, 1964."
target: “哎呀，谢谢！从来没人关心我！”另一个司机说，“我叫韦斯利·斯皮格尔曼，生于一九六四年十月三十一日。”

source: Your birthday's on Halloween? That's cool! I bet you really love candy!
target: 生日是万圣节？真酷！你肯定超爱糖果！

source: "Actually, I despise candy. I'm a children's dentist, and candy makes my job a lot harder."
target: “其实，我很讨厌糖。我是儿童牙医，糖果让我的工作难做多了。”

source: "But I'm not a total stick-in-the-mud. I moonlight as a standup comedian! Wanna hear some of my material? Yes, of course you do!"
target: “不过，我也不是个没趣的人。业余还讲单口喜剧呢！想听段子吗？当然想！”

source: "What time is it when it's time to go to the dentist? ...It's TOOTH-HURTY!"
target: “什么时候该看牙医？……两点半！因为 two-thirty 听着像 tooth-hurty，牙疼啦！”

source: "Get it? Like 'two-thirty'? It's extremely clever; you probably need a dental degree to understand such a nuanced pun."
target: “听懂了吧？跟‘两点半’谐音。极其巧妙，可能得有牙医学位，才能领会这么精妙的双关。”

source: ...Don't quit your day job, Wes.
target: ……韦斯，别辞掉你的正职。

source: Wesley goes on to tell you about his childhood, his sock-folding method, and his sexual fetishes (if you can even call "the possibility of getting laid one day" a fetish).
target: 韦斯利接着讲起童年、叠袜子的诀窍，还有性癖——如果“有朝一日能做上爱”也算性癖的话。

source: Hmm, none of that boring stuff sounds like the reason why you'd cause a car accident. I think the first guy did it after all!
target: 唔，这些无聊的事，听着都不像会引发车祸。我觉得还是第一个人干的！

source: Incredible. You and %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% are a regular Sherlock and Watson.
target: 真了不起。你和 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，简直就是福尔摩斯和华生。

source: Everyone's a critic. Regardless of your circuitous, -N2 HYPE-draining methods, you still got your answer, which means you were paid +N2 MONEY!
target: 人人都爱挑毛病。虽说你们这套绕远路的调查耗掉 -N2 热度，终究还是查出了答案，拿到 +N2 金钱！

source: You draw some runes on the cars, and -N2 MAGIC later, the drivers' vehicles are thinking and speaking!
target: 你在车身上画好符文，消耗 -N2 魔力。很快，两辆车就有了思想，还能开口说话！

source: "VROOM VROOM VROO--... wait... am I... saying engine noises aloud? Have I finally been gifted speech?!"
target: “轰隆，轰隆，轰——等等……我是在……开口模仿引擎声？我终于能说话了？！”

source: Yup! Congrats! We just have some questions--
target: 对！恭喜！我们只想问几个问——

source: "NO! MY TURN TO TALK NOW! I HAVE SO MUCH TO SAY!"
target: “不！现在轮到我说话！我有太多话想说了！”

source: "My owner is the WORST! He crashes me all the time! He crashed me yesterday, he crashed me today, and he'll probably crash me tomorrow!"
target: “我主人烂透了！整天开着我撞来撞去！昨天撞，今天撞，明天估计还得撞！”

source: "He also cheats on his wife! He's fucked so many people in my backseat! I'll NEVER get these stains out of the upholstery!"
target: “他还背着老婆出轨！在我的后座上跟那么多人做过爱！座椅上这些污渍，我这辈子都洗不掉！”

source: Oh, dope, guess we know who crashed into who then. Case solved!
target: 哦，棒，看来已经知道谁撞谁了。结案！

source: "Thanks for helping me out!" the other driver says. "Here's +N2 MONEY for your trouble."
target: “谢谢帮忙！”另一个司机说，“这 +N2 金钱，算是辛苦费。”

source: "I just hope my own car doesn't secretly resent me for driving it and getting into occasional accidents... can you ever forgive me, buddy?"
target: “只希望我的车，别因为我开它、偶尔出点事故，就暗地里恨我……伙计，能原谅我吗？”

source: "Yeah, we're cool," says the car. "You drive me pretty well. In fact, I love the feeling of you sitting inside me, shifting my gears, stomping on my brakes..."
target: “没事，咱俩好着呢。”车说，“你开得挺好。其实，我很喜欢你坐进我的身体、拨弄挡位、狠狠踩刹车的感觉……”

source: "So why don't you get in here and put those soft, sexy hands on my steering wheel, big guy?"
target: “所以，大个子，干吗不坐进来，把那双柔软性感的手，放上我的方向盘？”

source: "Oh, uh... okay!" says the driver. "I'm an openminded guy; I'm down to try this out. Let's go!"
target: “哦，呃……好啊！”司机说，“我这人挺开放的，可以试试。走吧！”

source: Huh, that was weird. I wonder if our car is secretly kinky.
target: 哎，真怪。不知道咱们的车，是不是也暗藏什么特殊性癖。

source: I hope so, buddy... I frickin' hope so.
target: 但愿吧，伙计……真他妈但愿如此。

source: You're still miles away from your next stop, but Scott's stomach is growling like crazy.
target: 离下一站还有好几英里，斯科特的肚子已经叫翻了天。

source: Bad news, bud. The GPS says there are no restaurants nearby.
target: 坏消息，伙计。导航说附近没有餐馆。

source: Dang. I guess I have no choice but to eat these leather sandals I found, then.
target: 哎，看来只能吃我找到的那双皮凉鞋了。

source: Wait, you better not be talking about MY sandals. Those are Jimmy Choopacabras!
target: 等等，你说的最好不是我的凉鞋。那可是 Jimmy Choopacabra！

source: Just then, you spot two food trucks on the side of the road! Score! You pull over to order, but the two truck drivers are too busy arguing to notice you.
target: 就在这时，你看见路边两辆餐车！太好了！你们停车点餐，可两位餐车老板忙着吵架，根本顾不上理你。

source: "Just admit you're at fault!" the first driver shouts. "You owe me a new bumper, asshole!"
target: “承认是你的错吧！”第一个司机大吼，“混蛋，你得赔我新保险杠！”

source: "I'm not taking the blame for an accident YOU caused!" the second driver argues. "So stop whining and start writing me a check for a new grille!"
target: “你造成的事故，别让我背锅！”第二个反驳，“少吵，赶紧开支票，赔我的进气格栅！”

source: Hi! Can I get a burger? Or a hot dog, or fries, or whatever you serve? I'll take pretty much anything.
target: 嗨！能来个汉堡吗？热狗、薯条，或者你们卖的随便什么也行。我基本不挑。

source: "No way, we're busy here! I'm not flipping one patty until we know once and for all who crashed into whose truck!"
target: “不行，忙着呢！不查清到底谁撞了谁的餐车，我一块肉饼都不煎！”

source: That sounds like it'll take a while. Sorry Polly, guess I'm back to eating your shoes.
target: 看来得等好久。对不起，波莉，我还是吃你的鞋吧。

source: PLEASE DON'T!
target: 求你别吃！

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, will you figure out which driver is at fault here so we can order something? Scott needs food, fast!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，快查清谁的责任，好让我们点餐吧！斯科特急需吃东西！

source: In order to be a fair judge, you need to put yourself in their shoes. Crash your car into another car and see how you feel about the whole issue.
target: 要公正裁决，先得换位思考。开车撞一下别人的车，体会自己对这事的感受。

source: The answers are in the stars. Consult both drivers' astral charts to get a direct look into their souls and see who was fated to crash their car today.
target: 答案藏在星星里。查看两位司机的星盘，直视他们的灵魂，找出今天命中注定要撞车的人。

source: Crashing into someone else's car on purpose is definitely a -N2 SOUL move...
target: 故意撞别人的车，绝对得扣 -N2 灵魂……

source: But I've done worse shit for less reward, so who am I to judge?
target: 不过，更缺德、更没好处的事，我也干过。哪轮得到我批评？

source: You all crash into the next car that comes down the road. It shakes you up and crunches your hood like an accordion.
target: 你们撞上下一辆经过的车。车身猛震，引擎盖挤得像手风琴。

source: Guys, I think crashing your car feels... bad.
target: 伙计们，我觉得撞车的感觉……挺糟糕的。

source: "HEY!" shouts the woman you hit. "WHY THE FUCK DID YOU WRECK MY CAR?! I'M GONNA WHOOP YOUR ASS!"
target: “嘿！”被撞的女人大吼，“你们他妈干吗撞烂我的车？！老娘揍死你们！”

source: Okay, I'm 100% sure now. I don't like crashing my car!
target: 好了，这下百分之百确定了。我不喜欢撞车！

source: Sorry, ma'am! I know how angry you must feel and how bad your neck probably hurts -- 'cause DAMN mine hurts.
target: 抱歉，女士！我知道你肯定很气，脖子大概也很痛——妈的，我的就痛死了。

source: We only crashed into you so we could be more sympathetic and understand what it's like to get in a car accident.
target: 撞你，是为了学会体谅别人，明白车祸到底是什么感觉。

source: You should try it! If you wrecked into a car right now, you'd know how bad we feel!
target: 你也试试！现在去撞辆车，就知道我们有多难受了！

source: "Well, my anger management coach DID say I should exercise more empathy... fine, I'll try your idea."
target: “呃，愤怒管理教练确实说过，要多培养同理心……行，我试试。”

source: She crashes into the next person who's driving down the road. That driver gets pissed. She gives them your spiel, and they agree to try crashing into someone else.
target: 她撞上下一位过路司机。对方怒了，她又把你们那套话复述一遍，对方便也同意撞个人试试。

source: After a while, there are eight wrecked cars on this road. But thanks to the power of empathy, everyone's discussing the wrecks very rationally!
target: 过了一阵，这条路上已经有八辆撞烂的车。不过，多亏同理心的力量，大家都在理性讨论车祸！

source: Bros, I think we've all realized the same thing here today: being in a car accident totally stinks.
target: 兄弟们，今天我们都明白了一件事：出车祸真的很糟。

source: So why make it worse for each other by getting pissed at each other? Let's just all shake hands and take this as a lesson, whaddaya say?
target: 那又何必互相生气，让彼此更难受？握个手，就当买个教训，怎么样？

source: "We're with ya!" the food truck drivers say. "Let's forget the cars and enjoy some hot dogs and hamburgers. It's on us!"
target: “同意！”餐车司机们说，“别管车了，吃点热狗汉堡吧，我们请！”

source: Woohoo, free food! Totally worth fucking up the car. You gain +N2 STAMINA.
target: 好耶，免费吃饭！车撞坏了也值。你获得 +N2 体力。

source: Yes, ask the stars! They always know best! You use -N2 MAGIC to divine the drivers' astrological charts.
target: 没错，问星星！星星总是最懂的！你消耗 -N2 魔力，推算两位司机的星盘。

source: It looks like his Mars is in Sagittarius... and his Saturn is in Capricorn!
target: 这个人的火星落在射手座……土星落在摩羯座！

source: Mars is the planet of Aggression. Having Mars in Sagittarius means this guy likes to push boundaries, and easily becomes impatient and restless.
target: 火星代表攻击性。火星在射手座，说明他喜欢挑战界限，容易急躁不安。

source: Furthermore, having Saturn in Capricorn means that he struggles to take responsibility for his actions.
target: 此外，土星在摩羯座，说明他不太愿意为自己的行为负责。

source: And if THAT wasn't enough, according to the alignment of his stars, he was predestined to act recklessly today!
target: 还不止这些，按他的星象看，今天他命中注定会鲁莽行事！

source: The stars don't lie, boo. You're probably the one who caused this accident!
target: 星星不会撒谎，宝。事故大概就是你造成的！

source: I trust the stars too, Polly, but I think we should still check out the other guy before we decide who did it. We need to be sure!
target: 波莉，我也相信星星。不过还是看看另一个人，再决定吧。得确认清楚！

source: Ugh, what a waste of magic... but fine.
target: 唉，浪费魔力……行吧。

source: Okay, looks like this guy's a Scorpio... uhhhh, Scorpios can be temperamental little fucks.
target: 好，这家伙是天蝎座……呃，天蝎可是群阴晴不定的小混蛋。

source: I guess crashing your car because you were feeling passionate and mercurial would be pretty in character for you?
target: 这么说，因为激情上头、情绪多变，就把车撞了，还挺符合你的性格？

source: "That's true... maybe I AM the one at fault here. I mean, he's the one who rammed into me, but crashing my car on purpose would be very Scorpio of me."
target: “说得对……没准真是我的错。虽然是他撞的我，可故意撞车，确实很符合我的天蝎座气质。”

source: "Eh, it's okay," says the other driver. "I'm impatient and restless; you're temperamental and passionate. We're probably both at fault for the accident."
target: “呃，没事。”另一个司机说，“我急躁不安，你暴躁多情。可能咱俩都有责任。”

source: "Why don't we just share the blame? These are company cars anyway; it's not like it'll come out of our wallets in the end."
target: “干脆一起担责吧？反正都是公司的车，最后又不用咱们自己掏腰包。”

source: "Hey, true! Thanks for helping us solve that dispute, kids. Have some food on the house!"
target: “对啊！谢谢帮忙调解，孩子们。请你们吃点东西！”

source: Good thing your astral chart predicted some free food in your future ;) You gain +N2 STAMINA!
target: 幸好你的星盘早就预言，未来会有免费饭吃 ;) 你获得 +N2 体力！

source: You're driving along, getting pretty thirsty, when you pass a food truck parked on the side of the road. Score!
target: 你开着车，渴得不行，正好看见路边停了辆餐车。太好了！

source: Welcome to Aaravi, Hex, and Calculester's food truck. Enjoy the perfect meal before your next big quest!
target: 欢迎光临阿拉维、Hex 与计算斯基的餐车。在下次大冒险前，享用一顿完美餐点吧！

source: Hey bros! How's the food truck business going?
target: 嘿，兄弟们！餐车生意怎么样？

source: It's pretty good. We're trying out an RPG food theme. The saying goes you should "stick to what you know", and adventuring is pretty much what I know best.
target: 还不错。我们在试 RPG 主题餐饮。不是说“做自己熟悉的事”嘛，我最熟的就是冒险。

source: Conversely, I am here to know more! The food truck is a great opportunity for me to grow my knowledge on the organic condition.
target: 而我恰恰是来学习新事物的！经营餐车，是了解有机生命的绝佳机会。

source: Some questions I'm hoping to answer are, "What is the purpose of food?" "Do colors have tastes?" "Is everything TRULY better deep-fried?"
target: 我希望弄清几个问题：“食物的作用是什么？”“颜色有味道吗？”“真的什么东西炸过都更好吃吗？”

source: "Why is there so much pain in the world? Could we know happiness without pain? Is happiness merely a reprieve from pain, or is pain the absence of true happiness?"
target: “为什么世上有这么多痛苦？没有痛苦，我们还能理解快乐吗？快乐只是痛苦间的喘息，还是说，痛苦才是真正快乐的缺席？”

source: Listen, Cal: all you need to know is that food's purpose is to fuel your body, so you can run faster and punch harder!
target: 听着，卡尔，你只要知道，吃饭是为了给身体补充能量，让你跑得更快、揍得更狠！

source: Shouldn't food taste good too?
target: 难道不该也很好吃吗？

source: Who cares about that? Taste is irrelevant to the magical effects of my homemade potions.
target: 谁在乎？味道跟自制药水的魔法效果又没关系。

source: Homemade potions, you say? Do any of them have tequila?
target: 自制药水？有哪款加了龙舌兰酒吗？

source: Nah, maybe next batch. We're still experimenting with the recipes of these things.
target: 没，下一批也许有。配方还在试。

source: We are gathering data on potions' effects and the market's acceptance of them. Would you like to see the spreadsheet I've been compiling?
target: 我们正在收集药效与市场接受程度的数据。想看看我整理的电子表格吗？

source: Hmm, so you're scoring the potions on taste, potency, adverse side effects, flammability...
target: 唔，原来你们按口味、药力、不良反应、易燃程度打分……

source: ...and "likelihood that the potion transforms the consumer into an oversexualized centaur?"
target: ……还有“把饮用者变成性感过头的半人马的概率”？

source: It happens with concerning regularity.
target: 这类情况发生得频繁，令人担忧。

source: Look, potion magic's hard, okay? And it's not easy finding willing taste testers...
target: 听着，药水魔法很难，好吗？愿意试喝的人也不好找……

source: Hey, I bet %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% would do it; %HESHE%%VERB_'S_'VE% been a chaotic motherfucker since day one.
target: 嘿，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%肯定愿意，%HESHE%%VERB_'S_'VE%从第一天起就是个唯恐天下不乱的混蛋。
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): POLISH; 赫克斯鼓动试药的粗口；原来的从第一天起就是已表达完成体。 按行中文动词展开已实现；未实机验证。

source: Oh yeah? How about it, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? You can try either of these tester potions for free!
target: 哦，是吗？怎么样，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%？这两种试验药水，随便挑一种，免费试喝！

source: The potion that gives you the strength of 10 men... but like 10 specific men who will be deprived of said strength while the effect lasts.
target: 一瓶让你获得十个男人力量的药水……不过是特定的十个人，药效持续期间，他们就会失去这份力量。

source: A love potion! Of course, drinking it sort of means that you'll fall in love with whoever you see first, essentially robbing you of your agency. Pros and cons!
target: 爱情魔药！当然，喝了之后，你会爱上第一眼看见的人，基本等于放弃自主选择。有利有弊嘛！

source: Meanwhile, somewhere far away, there's a man bench-pressing weights at the gym. He's pumping iron no problem, but suddenly, all his strength leaves him!
target: 与此同时，远方有个男人正在健身房做卧推。本来举得好好的，突然，全身力气都没了！

source: "NO!" he cries, pinned under his barbells. "Ugh, why does this keep happening to me?!"
target: “不！”他被杠铃压住，哀号道，“呃，怎么老是我？！”

source: Somewhere else, a burly biker is getting into an arm-wrestling match. He's winning, but then he suddenly has no strength left to pin his opponent!
target: 另一边，一个魁梧的摩托车手正跟人掰手腕。明明就快赢了，突然没了力气，怎么都压不倒对手！

source: He's defeated, and he earns the nickname "Bumbling Biker Baby", making him the laughingstock of the bar.
target: 他输了，喜提“笨蛋机车宝宝”的外号，成了酒吧的笑柄。

source: "Dammit, not again!" he swears. "Hex, you sonofabitch... I never should've made that cursed bargain with you!"
target: “妈的，又来！”他骂道，“Hex，你这狗娘养的……我就不该跟你做那笔诅咒交易！”

source: And now we cut to a golf tournament happening in another random location...
target: 接下来，镜头又切到别处一场高尔夫球赛……

source: "Ramirez is one putt away from the win," says the commentator. "He's lining up his shot. The wind's on his side, the green is smooth, this could be it..."
target: “拉米雷斯只差最后一推，就能夺冠。”解说员说，“他正在瞄准。风向有利，果岭平整，胜利就在眼前……”

source: "Ope! Would you look at that? Ramirez seems to have lost all his strength at the last second. That putter barely putted an inch."
target: “哦！快看！拉米雷斯在最后一秒，似乎突然失去全部力量。这球推出去，连一英寸都不到。”

source: "It's a shame this happens to Ramirez so frequently during championships. It's like he loses all will to play, or magically lost his strength from a cursed potion... oh well."
target: “真可惜，拉米雷斯在冠军赛上，老碰到这种事。像是突然失去斗志，又像被诅咒药水神奇地抽走了力量……唉。”

source: But you don't know about any of that; you just know you drank that potion and now have the strength of ten random men and one %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!
target: 不过，这些你一概不知。你只知道，喝下药水后，自己有了十个陌生男人，加上一个 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 的力量！

source: You're lookin' swole, bro! What are you gonna do with your strength +N2 MAGIC?
target: 兄弟，肌肉真壮！这股力量带来 +N2 魔力，你准备拿来干什么？

source: I know! You could deadlift that buffalo over there!
target: 我知道！去把那头野牛硬拉起来！

source: OMG, yes, that would be so wacky! I'll record it for posterity on Tok-Tok!
target: 天哪，好啊，太疯了！我拍个 Tok-Tok，留给后人瞻仰！

source: I fail to understand why buffalo-lifting is worth robbing ten strangers of their bodily strength without warning...
target: 我无法理解，为了举起野牛，就值得毫无预警地夺走十位陌生人的体力……

source: That's 'cause you just don't GET IT, man. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, lift some buffalos and show Cal how it's done.
target: 所以说，你根本不懂，伙计。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，举几头野牛，让卡尔开开眼。

source: You do, and while you can try to convince Calculester that this was justified, you can't fool me. You lose -N2 SOUL.
target: 你照做了。你可以试着说服计算斯基，说这事合理，可骗不了我。你损失 -N2 灵魂。

source: You would willingly give up your own free will in order to find love? Are you sure that's wise?
target: 为了找到爱情，主动放弃自由意志？你确定明智吗？

source: Fuck it, let %HIMHER% give it a go! This'll be just like "Love Is Blind"!
target: 管他的，让 %HIMHER% 试试！跟《爱情盲选》一样！

source: We could even make a game out of it. Let's blindfold %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% and spin %HIMHER% around in circles.
target: 还能当游戏玩。给 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 蒙上眼，拉着 %HIMHER% 转圈。

source: That way when %HESHE% %VERB_DRINKS_DRINK% the potion, %HESHE%'ll have no idea who %HESHE%'ll see when %HESHE% %VERB_OPENS_OPEN% %HISHER% eyes! We'll call it "Love Is Blind-FOLDED"!
target: 这样等%HESHE%%VERB_DRINKS_DRINK%药水，%HESHE%就完全猜不到，%HESHE%%VERB_OPENS_OPEN%%HISHER%眼睛时，%HESHE%会看见谁！就叫《爱情蒙眼选》！
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): FIX; 蒙眼喝药与睁眼爱上第一眼的人，保留四次 HESHE；重新组织中文顺序并消除动词空缺。 按行中文动词展开已实现；未实机验证。

source: Let's go! You drink the potion and gain +N2 MAGIC and a bit of a stomachache as Polly spins you around.
target: 开始！你喝下药水，获得 +N2 魔力，胃还有点疼。波莉拉着你转起圈。

source: You can feel your -N2 MIND slipping away as your agency is suppressed... you are buoyant, floating in the wind, with no control over what comes next.
target: 自主意志被压制，你感到 -N2 头脑一点点流失……整个人轻飘飘，随风浮动，完全无法控制接下来会发生什么。

source: Who will you see when you lift the blindfold? Who will become the object of your affections? Scott? Polly? Aaravi? Calculester? Hex?
target: 摘下眼罩，你会看见谁？谁会成为你的心上人？斯科特？波莉？阿拉维？计算斯基？Hex？

source: With trembling hands, you finally remove your blindfold, and you see a face...
target: 双手微颤，你终于摘下眼罩，看到一张脸……

source: It's quite a familiar face. It's YOUR face!
target: 非常熟悉的一张脸。是你自己的脸！

source: Surprise, boo! It's a mirror! Looks like you were your own true love all along!
target: 惊喜，宝！是镜子！看来你的真爱，一直就是你自己！

source: We talked it over, and we decided you could use more self-love in your life.
target: 我们商量过了，觉得你应该多爱自己一点。

source: Especially since, historically speaking, you're kinda obsessed with finding a significant other no matter the cost... it seemed unhealthy.
target: 尤其是回顾一下过去，你总是不惜一切代价，非要找个对象……感觉不太健康。

source: We hope that you will forgive our deception. We just want you to love yourself as much as we love being your friend!
target: 希望你能原谅我们的欺骗。我们喜欢做你的朋友，也希望你能同样喜欢自己！

source: Aww, how sweet! You hug all your friends tight for caring about you.
target: 哎呀，太贴心了！你紧紧抱住所有朋友，感谢他们这么关心你。

source: That night, you celebrate your new self-love by taking yourself out to your favorite restaurant, even springing for the fancy dessert.
target: 那天晚上，为了庆祝这份新发现的自爱，你请自己去最爱的餐厅吃饭，甚至大方地点了高级甜点。

source: Then you go to the movies, and while you're reaching for more popcorn, you accidentally brush fingers with your other hand. Sparks fly!
target: 接着去看电影。伸手拿爆米花时，指尖意外碰到自己的另一只手。爱情火花，瞬间迸发！

source: The date culminates when you invite yourself in "for coffee" and make sweet love to that hand. Awooga!
target: 约会的高潮，是你邀请自己进屋“喝杯咖啡”，再跟那只手好好缠绵一番。嗷呜！

source: Prom and summer camp might've been all about finding love, but on this road trip, you finally learned... to love yourself!
target: 舞会和夏令营，也许都是为了寻找爱情。可在这趟公路旅行里，你终于学会了……爱自己！

source: You're driving along when you see a food truck parked on the side of the road. The people running it look awfully familiar...
target: 你开车经过一辆路边餐车，经营餐车的几个人，眼熟得很……

source: Sup, bitches? Welcome to the Totally Hexed Taco Truck. You here to try my special recipe?
target: 嘿，贱人们！欢迎来到 Hex 全面诅咒塔可餐车。来尝我的特制配方？

source: Run. Seriously. Every "special recipe taco" Hex has made today has been absolutely inedible.
target: 快跑。认真的。Hex 今天做的每一个“特制塔可”，全都不能吃。

source: Friend Aaravi is not exaggerating. I've studied the molecular composition of Friend Hex's tacos, and they more closely resemble crude oil than food.
target: 阿拉维朋友并未夸大。我分析过 Hex 朋友做的塔可，分子结构更接近原油，而非食物。

source: C'mon, guys, let me practice! I can't learn to make tacos better if I don't work under the pressure of accidentally poisoning a customer with a taco!
target: 别这样嘛，让我练练！不承受那种一不小心就用塔可毒死顾客的压力，怎么学得会做好塔可！

source: I'll take three tacos, please!
target: 请给我三个塔可！

source: Uhhh, why don't we let this guy who just pulled up order first? Just to see what happens.
target: 呃，要不先让刚来的这位点？看看吃了会怎样。

source: "Hello," says the new customer. "My name is... Heath Inspectorman, and I'm... a janitor. Yep, that's all true, don't fact-check it."
target: “你好。”新顾客说，“我叫……魏生·检查曼，是个……清洁工。对，全是真的，不用查。”

source: Apologies, sir, but my fact-checking software can only be disabled by an administrator.
target: 抱歉，先生。我的事实核查软件，只有管理员才能禁用。

source: Your real name is Herman Tinnez, and you are a health inspector!
target: 你的真名是赫尔曼·廷内斯，职业是卫生检查员！

source: We're having a health inspection TODAY? Why weren't we given any warning?!
target: 今天要突击卫生检查？怎么一点通知都没有？！

source: "Because then you would've had time to prepare, and I wanted to catch you off-guard! MWAHAHAHAHA!"
target: “通知了，你们不就有时间准备了吗？我就是要杀你们个措手不及！哇哈哈哈哈！”

source: "Oh, my phone's ringing... it's my husband. I need to take this, sorry."
target: “哦，电话响了……我丈夫打来的。抱歉，得接一下。”

source: "Hi honey... what? I can't right now, I'm working... ugh, he won't fall asleep AT ALL? Fine, but I'm singing it in the car, it's got better acoustics. One sec."
target: “嗨，亲爱的……什么？现在不行，我在工作……呃，他怎么都不睡？好吧，不过我去车里唱，那儿音效好点。等一下。”

source: Okay, we've got a little time. Cal, what are our chances of passing this health inspection?
target: 好了，还有点时间。卡尔，咱们通过卫生检查的概率是多少？

source: 1:50000. Even less if I am right in my suspicions that Hex has been breeding mosquitos in the walk-in freezer.
target: 五万分之一。如果我猜得没错，Hex 正在步入式冷冻库里养蚊子，那概率还会更低。

source: Don't hate on my science experiments!
target: 别瞧不起我的科学实验！

source: Don't worry, I'm sure we can somehow pull this off in a weird, unexpected way. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, come up with a plan!
target: 别担心，肯定能用某种离谱又出人意料的办法过关。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，想个主意！

source: Cook the ultimate burrito for the inspector: a burrito so good it's worth the salmonella.
target: 给检查员做个终极墨西哥卷饼，好吃到就算感染沙门氏菌都值。

source: No one's dream is to be a health inspector. Ask him to tell you all about his childhood dreams, in the hopes he ditches everything to pursue his dream job!
target: 没人从小梦想当卫生检查员。问问他童年梦想，争取让他立刻撂挑子，去追寻理想职业！

source: It could work... but only with the combined might of all our abilities. We need to work together to achieve cooking nirvana!
target: 有可能成功……不过得集合所有人的能力。齐心协力，才能达到烹饪的至高境界！

source: Can do! You donate some of your trip food to making the burrito. You lose -N2 STAMINA, but it's for a good cause!
target: 没问题！你拿出一些旅行口粮做卷饼，损失 -N2 体力，不过这是为了好事！

source: You and your friends work together to create something magical in the food truck that day.
target: 那天，你和朋友们联手，在餐车里创造了奇迹。

source: You achieve total synchronicity; a perfect cooking flow state. You're a well-oiled, Michelin-star worthy, burrito-making machine!
target: 你们配合得天衣无缝，进入完美的烹饪心流。简直是一台运转顺畅、配得上米其林星级的卷饼制造机！

source: I do not wish to undermine you, Friend Aaravi, but I believe that in order to serve a chicken-filled burrito, we must have a working grill.
target: 无意拆台，阿拉维朋友。不过要制作鸡肉卷饼，我们需要一台能用的烤架。

source: Fuck the grill! I'll just roast this chicken with my flaming dagger. We use what we've got!
target: 去他妈的烤架！用我的火焰匕首烤鸡就是了。有什么用什么！

source: Oops, I dropped the tortilla on the floor... do you think the health inspector will notice a few ants in his beans?
target: 哎呀，饼掉地上了……检查员会不会发现，豆子里有几只蚂蚁？

source: Eh, it'll be fine. I added a TON of habanero peppers to the sauce. His taste buds will be too burnt to taste ants, or anything really.
target: 没事。我往酱里加了一大堆哈瓦那辣椒。他的味蕾会辣到尝不出蚂蚁，或者其他任何东西。

source: Finally, the health inspector returns. You slide him your masterpice: a greasy, weirdly-shaped burrito.
target: 终于，卫生检查员回来了。你递上杰作：一个油汪汪、形状怪异的卷饼。

source: "Uh...," he says, "I didn't order a burrito...?"
target: “呃……”他说，“我没点卷饼吧……？”

source: FOR FUCK'S SAKE, JUST EAT IT!
target: 妈的，让你吃就吃！

source: Aaravi shoves the burrito in his throat.
target: 阿拉维把卷饼塞进了他的喉咙。

source: "Oh, wow..." he says. "This chicken is immaculate! The skin's burnt to a smoky, nearly-ashen crisp, but the core is a buttery, medium-rare delicacy!"
target: “哦，哇……”他说，“这鸡肉完美无缺！外皮焦脆，几乎烧成灰，满是烟熏香。内里却像黄油般柔嫩，三分熟，美味极了！”

source: "The beans and queso envelope the chicken in a tender, gooey embrace, and the freezer-burnt ants you've mixed in add the perfect amount of crunch!"
target: “豆子和奶酪酱温柔黏稠地包裹着鸡肉，混入其中的冻伤蚂蚁，更带来了恰到好处的脆感！”

source: "And the aftertaste! It's a fiery, vibrant, explosive party of bacteria in the back of my throat! This burrito is absolutely 'salmonellicious'!"
target: “还有这回味！喉咙深处简直是一场细菌的火辣狂欢，鲜活又炸裂！这卷饼真是‘沙门氏菌级美味’！”

source: Herman loves the burrito. Even as the ambulance takes him away, he assures you the food was "truly to die for."
target: 赫尔曼爱死这卷饼了。哪怕被救护车拉走时，还坚持说，这食物“好吃得要命”。

source: What a nice man -- and an accurate one! According to this news report I'm reading, he did die in the hospital from burrito-related injuries.
target: 真是个友善的人，用词也准确！我正在读的新闻说，他确实因卷饼造成的损伤，死在医院了。

source: Y'all, I propose a toast: to Herman Tinnez -- RIP -- and to the best damn burrito this road trip's ever seen. +N2 HYPE for everyone!
target: 大家，我提议干杯：敬赫尔曼·廷内斯，愿他安息，也敬这趟旅途最他妈好吃的卷饼。每人 +N2 热度！

source: The health inspector returns. "I'm back! Let's get this inspection started. I want one taco, please."
target: 卫生检查员回来了。“我回来了！开始检查。请给我一个塔可。”

source: Say, Herman... you ever, uh... think of telling some total strangers about your childhood dreams?
target: 话说，赫尔曼……你有没有，呃……想过跟一群陌生人，聊聊自己的童年梦想？

source: "You want to hear about my dreams?" Herman asks, starry-eyed. "I'd LOVE to tell you! When I was a boy..."
target: “想听我的梦想？”赫尔曼两眼放光，“那太好了！小时候……”

source: (I already don't care. I'm losing -N2 HYPE as he speaks.)
target: （我已经不想听了。他每说一句，我就掉点 -N2 热度。）

source: "...my father was a firefighter. He was incredible; a real hero. Every day I watched him save lives, and I thought to myself..."
target: “……父亲是消防员，了不起，真正的英雄。每天看他救人，我都会想……”

source: "'These buildings wouldn't burn down so much if someone were making sure they're up to code!'"
target: “‘要是有人确保建筑符合安全规范，就不会有这么多房子着火了！’”

source: "I wanted to change that. When I grew up, I wanted to be... A SAFETY INSPECTOR!"
target: “我想改变这一切。我长大以后，要当……安全检查员！”

source: But... you sorta did that, right? Aren't health inspectors and safety inspectors pretty much the same thing?
target: 可你这不也差不多做到了？卫生检查员和安全检查员，不是基本一样吗？

source: "NO! Safety inspectors are superheroes, saving people from potential fires and ceiling cave-ins! Health inspectors just stop restaurants from giving people salmonella..."
target: “不！安全检查员是超级英雄，能防范火灾和天花板坍塌，拯救人命！卫生检查员，只能拦着餐馆别让人感染沙门氏菌……”

source: But stopping a salmonella outbreak would also indirectly save lives.
target: 但阻止沙门氏菌疫情，同样能间接挽救生命。

source: "Yeah, but who would notice, or care? You ever read a comic about a superhero who saved people from salmonella? Me neither."
target: “对，可谁会注意，谁会在乎？你看过哪部漫画，超级英雄靠预防沙门氏菌救人？我也没看过。”

source: Well, I think if you want to be a safety inspector, you should just go for it. Life's not gonna wait around for you to chase your dreams, dude.
target: 那你想当安全检查员，就去啊。人生可不会停下来，等你追梦，伙计。

source: Logically speaking, safety inspection is quite similar to your current job, so if you are already good at this, you will likely succeed at that.
target: 逻辑上，安全检查与你目前的工作十分相似。既然已经擅长现在的工作，新工作成功的概率也很高。

source: Yeah, you should make a career change immediately. Like, now immediately.
target: 对，赶紧转行。立刻，马上那种。

source: "Yeah... YEAH! You're right! I'm over this health-inspector shit. It's time to live my life for ME!"
target: “对……对！你们说得对！卫生检查员这破活儿，我不干了。该为自己活一次了！”

source: Herman rips his shirt off and walks confidently into the desert sunset to pursue his new dream.
target: 赫尔曼撕掉上衣，昂首走向沙漠落日，追寻新的梦想。

source: Why didn't he take his car?
target: 他干吗不把车开走？

source: Leave him be, Scott... leave him be.
target: 别管他了，斯科特……让他去吧。

source: You saved the food truck, and gained +N2 SOUL for helping the health inspector find himself. Nice!
target: 你保住了餐车，又帮卫生检查员找回自我，获得 +N2 灵魂。不错！

source: What do you get when you put a hotheaded adventurer, a sentient computer boy, and a chaotic cursed necklace in the same car?
target: 把一个火爆的冒险者、一个有自我意识的电脑男孩，以及一条混乱又带诅咒的项链，塞进同一辆车，会得到什么？

source: Apparently you get a food truck, if this truck you just pulled up to is any indication.
target: 看眼前这辆你刚停下车的餐车，答案显然是：餐车。

source: Welcome to the Aaravi, Hex, and Calculester's food truck! What can we get ya?
target: 欢迎光临阿拉维、Hex 和计算斯基的餐车！想吃点什么？

source: One hamburger, please!
target: 请给我一个汉堡！

source: Oof, sorry Charlie, we're all outta hamburgers. We can only serve cheeseburgers right now.
target: 哎呀，抱歉，哥们，汉堡卖光了。现在只卖芝士汉堡。

source: But... how does that...?
target: 可是……这怎么……？

source: Friends, I am having a problem. This cheese is not melting on this hot hamburger patty, which I believe breaks most laws of physics.
target: 朋友们，遇到问题了。这块芝士放在滚烫的汉堡肉饼上，居然不融化。我认为这违背了大部分物理定律。

source: Whoa, you're not kidding. That cheese is hard as a rock.
target: 哇，真的，硬得像石头。

source: It shouldn't be spoiled yet; I just picked it up from the store this morning. See, it doesn't even expire until after the Anthropocene ends.
target: 不应该变质啊，今早才从商店拿的。看，保质期一直到人类世结束之后呢。

source: What? That makes no sense. Let me see that package.
target: 什么？太离谱了，包装给我看看。

source: ...Hex, this isn't cheese. This is "Edible Cheese-Flavored Product."
target: ……Hex，这不是芝士，是“可食用芝士风味制品”。

source: "FDA-approved in seven states. Almost entirely nonpoisonous. Do not consume if pregnant."
target: “获七个州的 FDA 批准。几乎完全无毒。孕妇勿食。”

source: HEX! Why did you buy this?!
target: Hex！你干吗买这个？！

source: I was in a hurry, okay? You said to get the first cheese I saw, and I saw a guy giving this stuff away for free in the parking lot.
target: 我赶时间，好吗？你说，看见什么芝士就拿什么。正好停车场有人在免费送这个。

source: We cannot serve this "cheese!" Our customers could be pregnant, or sensitive to poison!
target: 我们不能把这种“芝士”卖给顾客！他们可能怀孕，也可能对毒素敏感！

source: Does that mean you guys are just gonna throw it out? Can we have it?
target: 那就是准备扔了？能给我们吗？

source: I suppose so; it is bad to waste food. But I do not think this "cheese" is legally recognized as food, so I do not recommend eating it.
target: 应该可以，浪费食物不好。不过这种“芝士”在法律上恐怕算不上食物，不建议食用。

source: Don't worry, we won't! What ARE we gonna use this "cheese-flavored product" for, though?
target: 放心，不会吃的！不过，这“芝士风味制品”拿来干什么呢？

source: The resilience of this "cheese" makes it the perfect material to treat open wounds. Lives will be saved!
target: 这种“芝士”坚韧耐用，简直是处理开放性伤口的完美材料。能救命！

source: REVENGE.
target: 复仇。

source: Say, that's not a bad idea...
target: 哎，这主意不错……

source: We flash forward to an operating room where a woman is undergoing emergency surgery.
target: 镜头快进到手术室，一位女性正在接受紧急手术。

source: "She's losing a lot of blood, Doctor. It looks like the bullet ruptured one of her lungs."
target: “医生，她失血严重。子弹似乎打破了她一侧的肺。”

source: "Don't worry, there's still time to save her. Nurse, pass me the 'cheese.'"
target: “别担心，还来得及救。护士，把‘芝士’递给我。”

source: "The cheese? Are you hungry, Doctor?"
target: “芝士？医生，您饿了吗？”

source: "What? No! I'm not talking about the cheese on the complimentary charcuterie board; I'm talking about the 'cheese' that's used to seal open wounds!"
target: “什么？不是！不是免费冷肉拼盘上的芝士！是用来封住开放性伤口的‘芝士’！”

source: "What do they teach you kids in med school these days? Didn't you see my air quotes?!"
target: “现在医学院都教些什么？没看见我用手比引号吗？！”

source: "I'm so sorry, Doctor. It must be the high pressure of the situation. I totally missed the air quotes."
target: “非常抱歉，医生。大概是情况太紧张，我完全没注意到您比的引号。”

source: "Lives have been lost of over missed air quotes, Nurse."
target: “护士，没看见引号，可是会死人的。”

source: "I'm so sorry. Here is the 'cheese.'"
target: “对不起。给，‘芝士’。”

source: Later, in the waiting room, the surgeon talks to the patient's husband.
target: 后来，外科医生在候诊室，与病人的丈夫交谈。

source: "Congratulations Mr. Auburndale, the surgery was a success. We removed the bullet from your wife's lung."
target: “恭喜，奥本代尔先生，手术很成功。我们取出了您妻子肺里的子弹。”

source: "That's great news, Doctor! God bless you!"
target: “太好了，医生！上帝保佑您！”

source: "Now, for transparency's sake, I must inform you that Mrs. Auburndale now has a square of 'cheese' in her left lung."

source: What? No, dude. It was the Magic of Teenage Love.
target: 什么？不是，伙计。是少男少女爱情的魔法。

source: How beautiful. But what transformed this juvenile love into an unrequited crush?
target: 真美好。可是什么让这段少年恋情，变成了单相思？

source: I dunno, Cal. For some time, she kept sneaking into Hell to see me. They were wonderful years...
target: 我也不知道，卡尔。有一阵，她总偷偷跑来地狱见我。那几年，真的很美好……

source: And then? I guess we grew up into different people...
target: 后来呢？大概，我们长大之后，变成了不同的人……

source: I've since learned that the Hope we know now is not the Hope I met back then.
target: 后来才知道，如今我们认识的希望女巫，已经不是当年遇见的那个了。

source: She's apparently, like, a vessel for all of the old Hope's memories.
target: 她好像，只是承载以前那个希望女巫全部记忆的容器。

source: Does she remember us slow dancing? Does she remember those years as her own?
target: 她记得我们慢舞过吗？她记得那几年时，会把它们当成自己的经历吗？

source: And even if we didn't talk anymore back then... where was I when she got killed? If only I had been there...
target: 就算那时我们已经不再联系……她被杀的时候，我又在哪儿？要是当时我在就好了……

source: I'm sorry, Damien. This seems like a heavy topic.
target: 抱歉，德魔。这个话题似乎很沉重。

source: It's okay. I guess I am this eternal Hell fire; and yet... to her... what am I but a weak old flame?
target: 没事。我大概算是永不熄灭的地狱之火，可对她来说……我又算什么，不过一缕微弱的旧情余火？

source: The world keeps spinning. I've moved on, sorta... things like this road trip help. Gotta keep moving forward!
target: 世界还在转。我也算，多少往前走了点……公路旅行这样的事，会有帮助。总得继续往前！

source: Speaking of which: I'm done. Thanks for the hot wings. Guys? I'm done. C'mon: let's move... forward.
target: 说到这个，我讲完了。谢了，辣翅不错。伙计们？讲完了。来吧，继续……往前走。

source: Gotcha!
target: 懂了！

source: You leave. What a loredump! It was interesting, but you still lose -N2 HYPE, since everyone knows Damien had a crush on Hope. You still get +N2 STAMINA from the hot wings, though.
target: 你们离开了。好一大段背景故事！虽然有意思，可大家都知道德魔喜欢希望女巫，所以还是损失了 -N2 热度。不过辣翅让你获得了 +N2 体力。

source: Fiery Fireball? That's my cue!
target: 烈焰火球？该我出场了！

source: Get ready for a red-hot interview, you loser!
target: 准备接受火辣采访吧，废柴！

source: BRING IT ON, NOOB!
target: 来啊，菜鸟！

source: You and Damien munch on some hot wings. They are HOT.
target: 你和德魔啃起辣鸡翅。辣，真他妈辣。

source: Well, Damien, reputable resources of mine tell me you have the hots... for lame vampire hipster Liam de Lioncourt!
target: 德魔，我的可靠消息说，你心里火热的对象……是那个逊爆的文青吸血鬼，李姆·堂·莱昂卡特！

source: Are your reputable sources "that one time you, Damien, and Liam had a threesome?"
target: 你的可靠消息，是不是“你跟德魔、李姆玩过的那次 3P”？

source: Shut up, Hex!
target: 闭嘴，Hex！

source: But yeah, that actually is my source.
target: 不过没错，消息就是这么来的。

source: That threesome was eye-opening.
target: 那次 3P 真是让我大开眼界。

source: It opened my eyes to the fact I am not into... that.
target: 让我彻底明白，我不喜欢……那种。

source: (That being you two lame losers, not threesomes. Tch.)
target: （那种，指你俩这对废柴，不是指 3P。啧。）

source: BUT, I must say, I saw some chemistry between you two. What do you have to say to that?
target: 不过，你俩之间确实有火花。怎么说？

source: ME? Into Liam? What the fuck are you on? He's a dork!
target: 我？喜欢李姆？你他妈嗑什么了？他就是个书呆子！

source: Lemme bring out my notes, then.
target: 那我拿笔记给你看。

source: One: you two are lame.
target: 第一，你俩都很逊。

source: You're lame.
target: 你才逊。

source: Two: you two both try too hard to look cool (despite the fact that no one cares... and the fact that you're lame).
target: 第二，都拼命想显得很酷。（虽然根本没人在乎……而且你俩都很逊。）

source: YOU. ARE. LAME.
target: 你、才、逊。

source: Three: you both have lots of lame pseudo-rebellious anti-establishment angst. You're the "fuck the system" to his "fuck the mainstream."
target: 第三，都有一大堆假装叛逆、反抗体制的破情绪。你喊“去他妈的体制”，他喊“去他妈的主流”，多配。

source: Meh.
target: 嘁。

source: Four: you two are, like, annoyingly intense. You're super extra, and he gets all dorky when he's into something.
target: 第四，都热情过头，烦死人。你什么都夸张，他一迷上什么，就变成死宅。

source: Yeah, that one is nice.
target: 嗯，这点倒不错。

source: Five: you two are lame.
target: 第五，你俩都很逊。

source: Shut up!
target: 闭嘴！

source: Dude, I was there. The threesome was cool and all, but it could have totally been a twosome.
target: 伙计，那天我可在场。3P 是不错，可你俩完全可以自己来个 2P。

source: I mean... psh... yeah, that dork knows what he's doing in bed...
target: 我是说……啧……好吧，那书呆子床上确实挺有一套……

source: (Yeah, gotta give credit where credit is due.)
target: （对，这点必须承认。）

source: Face it: he's the twink to your twunk.
target: 面对现实吧，你是壮实美男款，他是清瘦美男款，正好配一对。

source: Hmph...
Hey, it's okay. I wanted to make your lame ass a bit uncomfortable, and I succeeded. Fuck you.
target: 嘿，没事。我就是想让你这废柴尴尬一下，现在成功了。去你的。

source: You can leave now; thanks for coming to "The Hot Ones". Good luck unpacking everything we've just discussed. Byeeee.
target: 可以走了，感谢参加“火辣人物”。祝你慢慢消化刚才聊的那些。拜——

source: You all leave. Damien looks a bit more red than usual. Maybe it was the interview, maybe it was the hot sauce... who knows?
target: 你们离开。德魔似乎比平时更红了。也许是采访，也许是辣酱……谁知道呢？

source: You gain +N2 STAMINA from the hot wings, but lose -N2 MIND from the mental pain of enduring so much spice.
target: 辣翅让你获得 +N2 体力，可忍受这么猛的辣味带来的精神痛苦，也让你损失了 -N2 头脑。

source: Curse in a bottle? Heh, this oughta be good...
target: 瓶装诅咒？嘿，这下有好戏了……

source: You and Damien eat a single hot wing each. YOUR HEADS EXPLODE.
target: 你和德魔各吃了一只辣鸡翅。脑袋直接炸了。

source: Fuuuuuuuuuu...!
Lemme invade your mind while it's on fire, BTW.
target: 对了，趁你脑子烧着，我进你心里看看。

source: WHAT?!
target: 什么？！

source: Yeah, didn't you read the fine print on the waiver I handed you when you chose the curse in a bottle?
target: 对啊，选瓶装诅咒时，我给你的免责书，没看小字条款吗？

source: What waiver?! Fuck... my thoughts are melting.
target: 什么免责书？！操……我的思想都在融化。

source: Classic side-effect. Don't worry, it's only temporary. Lemme check out your mind before it turns to mush.
target: 常见副作用。别怕，暂时的。趁还没化成浆糊，先看看你的脑子。

source: Funny thing about the subconscious... it's like looking at the multiverse of potential crushes!
target: 潜意识挺有意思……像个多元宇宙，藏着各种可能的暗恋对象！

source: Like this one: that cute fish princess, Miranda.
target: 比如这位，可爱的鱼公主，米兰达。

source: WHAAAAAAAAAAAA...!
Miranda? Bullshit!
target: 米兰达？放屁！

source: Your subconscious begs to differ. C'mon, don't be a chickenshit. If you're game, I'll give you some milk.
target: 你的潜意识可不同意。别怂嘛，你肯配合，我就给你点牛奶。

source: FUCK, OKAY. Gimme that milk!
target: 操，好吧，牛奶拿来！

source: He downs the whole glass in one gulp. It looks like his brain is spilling through his nose.
target: 他一口灌完，看着像脑浆都从鼻子里流出来了。

source: Look, Miranda's lame as fuck sometimes, but I dunno... there's these times she gets in these murderous fits...
target: 听着，米兰达有时候确实逊得要死，可我不知道……有时她会突然起杀心……

source: Have you seen her? She plots to get people executed and all kinds of super fucked-up shit.
target: 你见过吗？密谋砍别人的头，还有各种变态得要命的破事。

source: I may or may not get a hard-on when that happens, tch...
target: 那种时候，我可能会，也可能不会硬起来。啧……

source: Oooh, murder-based ship! Hot! And royal-on-royal! Obscenely opulent!
target: 哦，靠杀人擦出火花的一对！火辣！还都是王室！奢华得简直下流！

source: Yeah, there's that too. Like... it's dumb to be a prince... but it's nice to meet someone who understands what it's like.
target: 嗯，还有这个。就是……当王子挺蠢的……可碰见个理解这种处境的人，感觉确实不错。

source: And she is super into love and romance. Sometimes I'm like "that's corny AF"... but I don't know... love is metal.
target: 她又特别喜欢爱情和浪漫。有时我想，“俗死了”……可又觉得……爱情，也挺金属的。

source: What about these fantasies I've peeped into?
target: 那我偷看到的那些幻想，又是怎么回事？

source: WHAT FANTASIES?!
target: 什么幻想？！

source: Hmmm... they're like... weird hair fantasies?
target: 唔……好像是……奇怪的头发幻想？

source: AH! Yes... fuck... okay... so, you know... she has this super silky hair... it's stupid beautiful, dude.
target: 啊！对……操……好吧……她头发特别柔顺，漂亮得不像话，伙计。

source: I'd LOVE to do her hair. I've brainstormed some ideas for cool hairstyles. I'd love to put my hands on her hair.
target: 我特想替她做头发。都想好好几种酷炫发型了，真想亲手摆弄她的头发。

source: I wonder if she'd like my work...
target: 不知道，她会不会喜欢我的手艺……

source: But no... that'd be stupid. And she'd be full of herself... fuckin' dumb little princess... no way.
target: 不过不行……太蠢了。她肯定得意死……妈的，蠢兮兮的小公主……不可能。

source: Damien, Damien, Damien... you're your own worst enemy, aren't you?
target: 德魔啊，德魔……你最大的敌人，就是你自己吧？

source: I saw many other faces when I peeped into your head. A true multiverse of love and heartbreak...
target: 刚在你脑子里，我还看到了好多别的面孔。真是个满载爱情与心碎的多元宇宙……

source: But you gotta be braver, buddy. Love CAN be metal, sure: but you gotta face your feelings...
target: 可你得勇敢点，伙计。爱情当然可以很金属，不过，你得先面对自己的感情……

source: But he won't face shit else today because you both pass out from the hot sauce.
target: 可今天，他什么破事都面对不了了。你们双双被辣酱辣晕。

source: You lose -N3 MIND and -N3 STAMINA from the hot sauce ravaging your innards. You get a bit of +N2 MAGIC from the curse...
target: 辣酱在五脏六腑里肆虐，让你损失 -N3 头脑和 -N3 体力。诅咒则让你获得一点 +N2 魔力……

source: ...and lots of +N4 HYPE from the incredible gossip you just heard!
target: ……还有刚才听见的那些劲爆八卦，让你获得足足 +N4 热度！

source: You're driving along with Liam in the passenger seat. He's staring out of the window when he suddenly gasps.
target: 你开着车，李姆坐在副驾，正望着窗外，突然倒吸一口气。

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%, STOP THE CAR!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%，停车！

source: You stop. Liam leaps out of the car, falls to his knees, and starts photographing a big rock on the side of the road.
target: 你停下车。李姆飞身跳出，双膝跪地，开始对着路边一块大石头疯狂拍照。

source: Well guys, it took over 400 years, but it finally happened. Liam has finally gone senile.
target: 伙计们，四百多年了，这一天终于来了。李姆终于老年痴呆了。

source: Quit calling me old. I'm not going senile; I'm appreciating art!
target: 别再说我老。我没痴呆，我是在欣赏艺术！

source: Just look at this incredible rock! It's so ordinary, so unseemly, yet conversely so extraordinarily beautiful... truly an artistic masterpiece!
target: 看看这块不可思议的石头！如此平凡，如此粗鄙，却又如此超凡脱俗地美……真正的艺术杰作！

source: But... it's just a rock. How can it be art?
target: 可……它不就是块石头吗？怎么能算艺术？

source: Good question, Scott. CAN this rock truly be considered art?
target: 问得好，斯科特。这块石头，真的能算艺术吗？

source: Is art only art when it has a creator? If so, does this art belong to God, or to Nature itself?
target: 艺术非得有创造者，才算艺术吗？如果是，那它属于上帝，还是属于自然本身？

source: No... surely not. Art becomes art based on the context in which it's perceived. Therefore, the true "author" of the art is the person who beheld it; who dared to dub it "art"!
target: 不……当然不是。艺术之所以成为艺术，取决于观赏它的语境。因此，真正的“作者”，是看见它、敢于称它为“艺术”的人！

source: And in this case, that means the author of this rock art is none other than... me, Liam de Lioncourt! Right?
target: 这么说来，这件石头艺术的作者，非我莫属……就是我，李姆·堂·莱昂卡特！没错吧？

source: Uh...
If we say yes, will you shut up?
target: 我们说对，你就能闭嘴吗？

source: Yes, but he certainly won't let it go. Liam names "his" art piece "Rumination en Granite #1" and posts pictures of it all over social media.
target: 能，可他绝不会就此罢休。李姆把“自己”的作品命名为《花岗岩沉思 #1》，在各大社交平台发满了照片。

source: An hour later, Liam's still mooning over the stupid rock when a dryad in a suit and tie bikes up to you all and hands Liam a stack of papers.
target: 一小时后，李姆仍对着那块破石头痴迷不已。这时，一个穿西装打领带的树精骑车过来，递给他一叠文件。

source: I'm being sued for copyright infringement?!
target: 有人告我侵犯版权？！

source: "Yup," says the dryad. "I'm a representative from Mother Nature's legal team. My client is pretty upset that you're claiming her roadside rock sculpture as your own."
target: “没错。”树精说，“我代表大自然母亲的法律团队。你把她的路边岩石雕塑据为己有，委托人很不高兴。”

source: Ugh, but a creative genius like myself doesn't have time for menial tasks like getting sued!
target: 唉，我这样的创作天才，哪有空处理被起诉这种琐事！

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, could you do that thing where you swoop in and resolve this so I don't have to face consequences for my actions? Thanks.
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，能不能像平时那样，挺身而出解决这事，让我不用为自己的行为负责？谢了。

source: Use a last big reveal as a smokescreen: this was all along a performance piece about the boundaries of authorship. Then escape while everyone is confused.
target: 用压轴揭秘混淆视听：这从头到尾，都是一场探讨创作归属边界的行为艺术。然后趁大家懵了，赶紧逃。

source: Divert attention by counter-suing Mother Nature for being an absent parent.
target: 反诉大自然母亲疏于养育，转移注意力。

source: Yes, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! Finally, someone gets it!
target: 没错，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！终于有人懂了！

source: The rock, the poetic waxing on the nature of art, the copyright infringement -- even the lawsuit were all part of my brilliant social commentary!
target: 石头、关于艺术本质的诗意高论、版权侵权，甚至这场官司，全是我天才般的社会评论的一部分！

source: No need to be alarmed by that shocking reveal, everyone. Simply bask in awe at the +N2 HYPE of my creative genius.
target: 各位不必为这个惊人揭晓而慌张。只管为我的创作天才惊叹，沐浴在 +N2 热度里吧。

source: Liam hands some pamphlets out to everyone. Wow, he's so committed to this lie!
target: 李姆给每个人发了小册子。哇，为了圆谎，他准备得真充分！

source: I ask you: what IS authorship? Is it an ephemeral philosophy? A capitalist invention? In a world of no original ideas, perhaps it's a distant memory?
target: 请问，何为创作归属？转瞬即逝的哲思？资本主义的发明？在这个没有原创的世界，也许它只是一段遥远的记忆？

source: When copyright becomes the iron fist that prevents true art from being shared, that is the day creativity and monsterkind are dead! DEAD, I SAY!
target: 当版权化作铁拳，阻止真正的艺术被分享，那就是创造力与怪物们的死期！没错，死期！

source: If you'll turn your pamphlets to page 3, we'll explore this thesis in further detail.
target: 请把小册子翻到第三页，我们将进一步探讨这个命题。

source: It seems Liam's bullshit is making the paralegal's eyes roll into the back of his head. This is your opportunity to escape!
target: 李姆满嘴胡扯，律师助理听得白眼都快翻到脑后了。逃跑的机会来了！

source: You lost -N2 MIND from listening to Liam's artsy nonsense, but at least you all got away un-sued!
target: 听李姆那些故作高深的艺术废话，让你损失 -N2 头脑。不过，至少大家摆脱了官司！

source: Nicely done, Liam. I've never seen you commit to a bit so flawlessly.
target: 演得漂亮，李姆。我从没见你把一场戏做得这么滴水不漏。

source: What are you talking about? That wasn't a bit. That was my actual performance art piece.
target: 说什么呢？那不是演戏，是真正的行为艺术。

source: Good one, bro! But you can drop the prank now. We already escaped from the lawyer.
target: 厉害，兄弟！不过现在可以收了，咱们都甩掉律师了。

source: But it wasn't a prank! I wasn't joking! That was my legitimate thinkpiece on the complexities of authorship--
target: 可那不是恶作剧！我没开玩笑！那是认真探讨创作归属复杂性的思想作品——

source: Ah, Liam: such a method actor. Never letting the bit go. Good for him!
target: 啊，李姆，真是个方法派演员，始终不肯出戏。挺好！

source: Yes, that's a great point. If anything, this "Mother Nature" should be begging ME not to sue HER!
target: 对，极有道理。真要说，这位“大自然母亲”该求我别告她才对！

source: Where has this supposed maternal figure of mine been all my life? Why doesn't she ever call me?
target: 这位号称母亲的人，我这一辈子，她在哪儿？为什么从来不给我打电话？

source: Furthermore, why did she fail to provide me with any healthy meals when I was young and helpless?
target: 还有，我年幼无助的时候，她为什么连顿健康饭都没给过我？

source: At best, she simply littered dirty, uncooked food all over the ground for me to find.
target: 最多也就是把又脏又生的食物扔得满地都是，让我自己找。

source: AND NO TOILETS! Mother Nature never gave me any safe, clean places to poop!
target: 连厕所都没有！大自然母亲从没给过我一个安全干净的拉屎场所！

source: She just left me in the wild, with alligators and stuff. What if an alligator ate me while I was a baby pooping in the wild?!
target: 把我丢在荒野，跟鳄鱼之类的待在一起。要是我还是个宝宝，在野外拉屎时被鳄鱼吃了呢？！

source: "I believe that would be ruled as 'natural selection'..." the paralegal sighs.
target: “那大概会被认定为‘自然选择’……”律师助理叹了口气。

source: That shit might fly with Darwin, but I doubt Child Protective Services is gonna like that answer.
target: 这套说辞，达尔文也许买账，儿童保护部门可不一定。

source: I might even need a little bribe not to rope them into this...
target: 说不定，还得给点小贿赂，才能让我不把他们也叫来……

source: "Ugh, fine! We'll give you +N2 MONEY to drop this counter-suit and forget the whole thing. Mother Nature has suffered enough."
target: “唉，行！”对方说，“给你 +N2 金钱，撤掉反诉，忘了这事吧。大自然母亲已经够受罪了。”

source: Damn, Liam, I'm impressed. That was a savage move you just pulled.
target: 妈的，李姆，佩服。你这招真够狠。

source: Indeed. Normally I wouldn't condone going to such dickish lengths... but for art, one must sacrifice everything, even their morals.
target: 确实。通常我不赞成混蛋到这种地步……但为了艺术，必须牺牲一切，连道德也不例外。

source: Well, he's not wrong about the sacrifice part. You set a terrible precedent for others to sue Mother Nature on bullshit charges in the future. That's -N2 SOUL at the very least!
target: 好吧，“牺牲”这部分没说错。你开了个坏头，以后别人都能找些扯淡理由起诉大自然母亲。起码得扣 -N2 灵魂！

source: She was already busy with rampant forest fires and climate change permanently damaging Nature, and now she has to deal with this nonsense too? Jeez...
target: 她本来已经忙着应付失控的山火，还有永久伤害自然的气候变化，现在还得处理这种破事？天哪……

source: You, Polly, and Scott are calmly driving to your next destination. Vera is... not so calm.
target: 你、波莉和斯科特正平静地赶往下一站。薇拉就……没那么平静了。

source: I honestly have no idea how you dumbasses made it this far before I got here. This trip is a disorganized mess!
target: 说真的，我来之前，你们这帮蠢货怎么走到现在的？这行程简直乱成一团！

source: Like, why do we keep stopping at random places? We don't have to visit EVERY zany location we pass; it just slows us down.
target: 为什么老在莫名其妙的地方停车？经过每个怪地方，都非得进去逛一圈？只会拖慢进度。

source: And why is it every time we stop somewhere, we lose one or more of our key resources? It's infuriatingly inefficient!
target: 还有，每次停车，为什么总要损失一种甚至几种关键资源？效率低得让人火大！

source: Yeah, it's kinda annoying and unhelpful too. Maybe we should only gain stuff, and not lose it when we don't have to?
target: 是啊，还挺烦、挺没用的。要不以后只拿东西，没必要的话，就别再丢了？

source: See? Scott gets it. Luckily for you all, I've figured out a way to do just that!
target: 看吧？斯科特都懂。算你们走运，我已经想出办法了！

source: Vera hands out some color-coded spreadsheets and planners, all labeled "Road Trip Optimization Initiative".
target: 薇拉发给大家几份按颜色分类的表格与计划本，封面统一写着“公路旅行优化方案”。

source: In order to reach our destination as fast as possible, we'll drive eighteen hours a day, ration our snacks, and sleep in the car with a brick on the gas pedal.
target: 要尽快抵达目的地，就每天开十八小时，零食按量分配。睡觉时，也拿砖头压着油门，让车继续跑。

source: You get a five-minute bathroom break every four hours. If you can't hold it, use your assigned emergency urine bottle so as not to disrupt the schedule.
target: 每四小时，给你们五分钟上厕所。憋不住，就用分配好的应急尿瓶，别扰乱日程。

source: Vera, babe, you gotta chill. We're on vacation; quit obsessing, relax, and invite a little chaos in your life!
target: 薇拉，宝贝，放松点。咱们在度假，别老绷着了，给生活来点混乱嘛！

source: Inviting chaos in my life sounds like the WORST possible way to relax!
target: 往生活里招惹混乱，简直是最糟糕的放松方式！

source: Okay, baby steps. Wanna try listening to one of our relaxing tapes to help you unwind instead?
target: 好，那一步一步来。先听盘舒缓磁带，放松一下，怎么样？

source: Fine. Play me a tape if you must -- preferably one that ISN'T a waste of my precious time.
target: 行，非要放就放吧。不过最好别浪费我的宝贵时间。

source: "Soothing Schadenfreude: a podcast to remind you that you're doing okay, at least compared to the shitty lives of these other people."
target: 《幸灾乐祸，安神助眠》：听听别人过得多惨，就能知道自己起码还不错。

source: "Sounds of the Sea: we put a mic underwater, now you get to listen."
target: 《海洋之声》：我们把麦克风丢进海里，你只管听。

source: "Welcome to 'Soothing Schadenfreude'," says the smooth-voiced host, "where we hope to remind you that whatever's going wrong in your life, it could always be worse."
target: “欢迎收听《幸灾乐祸，安神助眠》。”主持人声音温柔，“无论生活出了什么岔子，我们希望提醒各位：总有更惨的。”

source: This is exploitative and needlessly cruel... which is no big deal, but if this podcast is boring on top of that, I'm gonna be pissed.
target: 消费别人的痛苦，还残忍得毫无必要……这倒无所谓，可要是在这基础上还很无聊，我会生气的。

source: "Our first guest is Howie Russo. Tell us, Howie: what was the worst day of your life?"
target: “第一位嘉宾是豪伊·鲁索。豪伊，说说你人生中最糟糕的一天吧。”

source: "Well...," sighs Howie, "it'd have to be the day I got fired from my job at the manure plant."
target: “唉……”豪伊叹气，“肯定是被粪肥厂开除的那天。”

source: "I got caught sleeping with the manager's wife... in the manure pile... we were escorted out of the building naked... AND I got a lifelong infection from the whole thing..."
target: “我跟经理老婆上床，被抓了现行……就在粪堆里……我们光着身子被押出厂房……还染上了一辈子都治不好的感染……”

source: "I see, Howie. And was that infection due to a sexually-transmitted disease, or the manure?"
target: “明白了，豪伊。感染是因为性病，还是因为粪便？”

source: "The doctor said it's a mixture of both, and they're currently mutating into one super-infectious virus... at least I'm getting a disease named after me?"
target: “医生说，两样都有，而且正变异成一种超级传染病毒……至少，以后能有个病用我的名字命名？”

source: What do you think, Vera? Not so boring after all?
target: 薇拉，怎么样？没那么无聊吧？

source: Fine, I admit I'm entertained...
target: 好吧，我承认，挺有意思……

source: "Our next guest is Louise Wall. Louise, what was the worst day of your life?"
target: “下一位是露易丝·沃尔。露易丝，你人生最糟糕的一天是什么时候？”

source: "Um... I don't know," says Louise. "I've had a pretty good life: I have good children, a loving husband..."
target: “呃……不知道。”露易丝说，“我过得挺好，孩子们很好，丈夫也很爱我……”

source: "Really, Louise?" says the host in that eerily calm tone. "DOES your husband love you? Are you quite sure?"
target: “真的，露易丝？”主持人平静得让人发毛，“你丈夫真的爱你？确定吗？”

source: "I... I think so... what are you implying?"
target: “我……应该吧……你在暗示什么？”

source: "Louise, you and the lucky listeners are in for a treat. We have a surprise guest for the night... meet my tender and passionate lover, Mr. Charles Wall."
target: “露易丝，你和幸运的听众都有福了。今晚还有位惊喜嘉宾……来，认识一下我温柔热情的爱人，查尔斯·沃尔先生。”

source: "Charlie!" Louise gasps. "What's happening? You're fucking this podcaster guy?! How could you do this to me?!"
target: “查理！”露易丝惊呼，“什么情况？你在跟这个播客男主持上床？！你怎么能这样对我？！”

source: "Quite easily, actually," Charlie says. "I know I should feel guilty, but honestly, watching you shatter before my eyes makes me feel... at peace, somehow."
target: “其实挺容易的。”查理说，“我知道自己该内疚，可说真的，看你在眼前崩溃，不知怎么……让我很平静。”

source: Me too, Charlie... me too.
target: 我也是，查理……我也是。

source: You gain +N2 MIND from the relaxing tape. But reveling in others' misery, while soothing, isn't very kind. You lose -N2 SOUL.
target: 这盘舒缓磁带让你获得 +N2 头脑。不过，幸灾乐祸虽然舒心，终究不太厚道。你损失 -N2 灵魂。

source: You roll the tape and hear the mic plunging into the ocean. The rushing waves, babbling bubbles, and smooth current wash over you.
target: 你播放磁带，听见麦克风沉入大海。海浪奔涌，气泡咕嘟，水流轻缓，将你包围。

source: Then, suddenly, there's a voice on the tape! It says, "...as I was saying, I LOVE being a talking fish."
target: 突然，录音里传来人声！“……刚才说到，我爱死做一条会说话的鱼了。”

source: "Then we 'sea' eye-to-eye on that, buddy!" another voice chuckles. "And to think, the dumb surface-dwellers don't suspect a thing!"
target: “咱俩想到一‘鳍’去了，伙计！”另一个声音笑道，“那帮蠢地表人，居然一点都没发现！”

source: "Look, here comes Sheldon! How ya doin', old 'chum'?"
target: “看，谢尔顿来了！最近怎么样，老‘鱿’？”

source: "Hey, guys," says Sheldon. "I see you two are still 'hooked' on those awful ocean puns."
target: “嘿，各位。”谢尔顿说，“你俩还被那些烂海洋双关‘钓’得死死的啊。”

source: "Of course we are; they make us so 'bubbly'! Another big advantage to being a talking fish is getting to use so many great ocean puns."
target: “当然，这些梗让我们笑得直冒泡！当会说话的鱼，就能用这么多海洋双关，这也是一大好处。”

source: "Wait a sec... there's something fishy going on here -- other than us. What's on your chest, Sheldon?"
target: “等等，这事有股可疑的腥味——不是咱们身上的。谢尔顿，你胸口那是什么？”

source: "It's... a birthmark?"
"IT'S A MICROPHONE! Are you recording us to out us to the surface dwellers?! That's so 'shellfish' of you!"
target: “是麦克风！你在录音，想向地表人揭穿我们？！太‘贝’鄙了！”

source: "It's not just selfish, it's treason punishable by death! Someone call the merpeople!"
target: “岂止卑鄙，这是叛国，该处死！快叫人鱼来！”

source: "No, please don't have me arrested!" Sheldon begs. "We can all still have a 'merry time' together! ...Get it? Like 'maritime'?"
target: “别，求你们别抓我！”谢尔顿哀求，“咱们还能一起‘海’皮啊！……懂吗？‘嗨皮’加上‘海洋’！”

source: "Sorry, Sheldon. Not even that excellent pun can save you now."
target: “抱歉，谢尔顿。就算双关这么精彩，现在也救不了你。”

source: The next several minutes of screaming, scuffling, and the hiss of an axe strongly suggest that Sheldon was executed. Then the tape goes silent.
target: 接下来几分钟，尖叫、扭打，还有斧头挥落的声响，强烈暗示谢尔顿已被处决。随后，磁带归于寂静。

source: WOW. That was... something. At least it distracted me from whatever was stressing me out before.
target: 哇。这可真是……至少让我没空想刚才烦心的事了。

source: You lost -N2 HYPE listening to slow, soothing ocean sounds, but you gained +N2 MIND relaxing (and learning where talking fish go when they die).
target: 缓慢舒适的海洋音效让你损失 -N2 热度，不过放松下来，还知道了会说话的鱼死后去哪里，让你获得 +N2 头脑。

source: You're driving, and Miranda is riding shotgun, giving you directions. Too bad she's the worst navigator in history.
target: 你开着车，米兰达坐在副驾指路。可惜，她是史上最差领航员。

source: Soooo, according to this map thing... we should head "weest" to reach the ocean!
target: 所以——按这个地图说……想去海里，应该往“西西边”开！

source: It's pronounced "west". And again, I'll remind you we aren't trying to drive straight into the ocean.
target: 那叫“西边”。再提醒一次，咱们可不是要把车直接开进海里。

source: But I miss the ocean! I don't like the desert; it's too dry and sandy. It's all the worst parts of the beach, with none of the water!
target: 可我想海了！不喜欢沙漠，又干又全是沙。海滩最讨厌的东西，它都有，却一滴水也没有！

source: I understand, but can you rant later? Right now we need you to tell us when to turn.
target: 理解，不过能晚点再抱怨吗？现在得靠你告诉我们，什么时候转弯。

source: Turn... turn... oh, that reminds me! %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, it's your turn to braid my hair!
target: 转……转……哦，想起来了！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，该轮到你给我编辫子了！

source: Well, Miranda, that'll be pretty hard to do while I'm driving. I don't think you're really grasping the importance of the fact that I'm driving.
target: 米兰达，我开着车，不太好编啊。我觉得，你还没真正理解“我在开车”这件事有多重要。

source: Look, Miri, your lovable ditz schtick is as cute as ever, but right now we really need you to focus on--
target: 小米，你这迷迷糊糊的样子，确实一如既往地可爱。可现在，真得专心——

source: Yes! You're exactly right, Polly. We DO need to focus.
target: 对！波莉，你说得完全正确。得专心！

source: Focus on this beautiful song I just made up about how great I am at being navigator!
target: 专心听这首刚编好的美妙歌曲，歌颂我这位伟大的领航员！

source: "I can show you the road / Big, winding, confuuuusing! / Tell me, peasants, when did you last let a princess be your guide?"
target: “带你看这道路／宽阔，蜿蜒，真迷糊！／告诉我，平民们，上次让公主指路，是何时？”

source: This would be the first and last time for me, personally.
target: 对我来说，这会是第一次，也是最后一次。

source: "A WHOLE NEW ROOOOOAD! / A motor-tastic way to move! / No one to tell us no, or where to go..."
target: “一条全新的路——／开着汽车多美妙！／没人说不准，也没人说往哪儿走……”

source: YOU'RE supposed to be telling us where to go!
target: 该告诉我们往哪儿走的人，就是你！

source: Oh, right! Silly me. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, you need to turn left five minutes ago.
target: 哦，对，瞧我。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，五分钟前，你应该左转。

source: Goddammit. You'd honestly be better off if Miranda was distracted so you could just drive in peace. But what would distract her?
target: 妈的。说真的，要是能让米兰达分心，你反而能安静开车。可什么才能转移她的注意力？

source: Keep her mouth busy by using the Emergency Ice Cream.
target: 动用应急冰淇淋，让她的嘴先忙着。

source: Give her an assignment to write that you will review when you arrive at the next stop.
target: 布置一篇书面作业，告诉她到下一站时，你会批改。

source: WOOHOO! ICE CREAM EMERGENCY! It's my favorite emergency!
target: 好耶！冰淇淋紧急事件！我最喜欢的紧急事件！

source: Scott uses the emergency hammer to break the case protecting your emergency ice cream.
target: 斯科特拿应急锤，砸碎保护应急冰淇淋的玻璃罩。

source: One of these days, you should really sweep all the broken glass out of the back of the car.
target: 哪天真该把车后面那些碎玻璃，都扫出去了。

source: This is ice cream, you say? I've never tried it myself. I used to have my serfs do all my eating for me...
target: 你说这是冰淇淋？我从没亲自吃过。以前都是让农奴替我吃东西……

source: So this is your FIRST TIME having ice cream? Wow! I can't believe we get to be here for this big life milestone of yours!
target: 所以，这是你第一次吃冰淇淋？！哇！真不敢相信，这么大的人生里程碑，我们居然能在场见证！

source: Yes, and I'm glad you're here, Scott. I'll need some guidance in losing my ice cream virginity.
target: 是啊，斯科特，很高兴你在。献出冰淇淋初体验这事，还得请你指导。

source: Can do, bro. Just put your lips on the ice cream and go to town!
target: 没问题，兄弟。嘴唇贴上冰淇淋，尽情开吃！

source: Goodness me, this is fantastic! How have I never experienced this creamy delicacy before?!
target: 天哪，美妙极了！这么香甜绵滑的美味，我以前怎么从没尝过？！

source: Just goes to show the magic that can happen when you step out of your comfort zone, boo.
target: 宝，走出舒适区，奇迹不就发生了嘛。

source: ...Uh, Miri, you know we have spoons, right? You don't have to plunge your face into the ice cream like a pig eating from a hay trough.
target: ……呃，小米，知道咱们有勺子吧？不用像猪吃食那样，整张脸都扎进冰淇淋里。

source: MMMPHH HRHOGH SDFKRISKK!!!
target: 唔唔唔，呼噜呜咕唔！！！

source: The good news that is Miranda loves the ice cream, and the better news is that she can't babble with her mouth full. Sweet!
target: 好消息：米兰达很爱冰淇淋。更好的消息：嘴塞满了，她就没法胡扯了。真好！

source: You bask in the peace you've achieved by distracting Miranda and gain +N2 MIND! But by sacrificing your ice cream, you also sacrificed -N2 STAMINA.
