target: 成功转移米兰达的注意力，让你享受到片刻清静，获得 +N2 头脑！不过牺牲了冰淇淋，也让你损失 -N2 体力。

source: An assignment? Brilliant! Father says a good monarch must be intelligent, in order to outwit their enemies and produce the thing known as "propaganda".
target: 作业？太好了！父王说，好君主必须聪明，才能智胜敌人，制造那种叫“政治宣传”的东西。

source: Well, if Miranda wants to be more intelligent, you sarcastically suggest she write up an essay on the importance of driving safety.
target: 好吧，她想变聪明，你便挖苦地建议：写篇文章，谈谈安全驾驶的重要性。

source: Perfect, a topic I have no expertise on! I'll learn a lot and make you proud, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!
target: 太完美了，这个话题我一窍不通！我会学到好多，让你骄傲的，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！

source: And she does make you proud, at least in the fact that she's so busy writing you get a moment of peace and +N2 MIND as you drive.
target: 她确实让你骄傲。至少埋头写作的这段时间，你开车终于清静了，获得 +N2 头脑。

source: Looks like we're getting close to our next stop. Miri, ready to read us your essay?
target: 快到下一站了。小米，准备好给我们念作业了吗？

source: Sure! This is "The Majestic Metal Chariot: Driving Safely and In Style" by Princess Miranda Vanderbilt.
target: 当然！《威严的金属战车：安全又时髦的驾驶指南》，作者米兰达·范德比尔特公主。

source: "Driving safely is very very important, especially when carrying precious cargo such as a princess. You don't want her to get hurt!"
target: “安全驾驶非常、非常重要，尤其车里载着公主这样的珍贵货物时。可不能让公主受伤！”

source: "That's why the first rule of driving safety is to disable all airbags, so in the event of a crash, no painful bag will deploy and bruise the princess' beautiful face."
target: “因此，安全驾驶第一条：禁用所有安全气囊。这样撞车时，就不会有讨厌的气袋弹出来，撞伤公主美丽的脸。”

source: "The second rule is to remove all seatbelts. They're not even real belts! What pants do they hold? Do not be deceived by their confusing name."
target: “第二条：拆掉所有安全带。根本不是什么真正的腰带！它能系住哪条裤子？别被这迷惑的名字骗了。”

source: "The third rule is to always be aware of your surroundings. If any other cars cut you off, that is high treason!"
target: “第三条：时刻留意周围。要是有别的车抢到你前面，那就是大逆不道！”

source: "In these cases, it's necessary to execute the offending driver. Feel free to crash into them at high speeds to ensure a swift and deserved death."
target: “这种情况，必须处决冒犯公主的司机。尽管高速撞上去，确保他死得迅速、罪有应得。”

source: Well, how'd I do? Do I get an A?
target: 怎么样？能拿 A 吗？

source: Uh... how about an A for effort?
target: 呃……努力分给个 A，怎么样？

source: Really? Wow! I've never put "effort" into anything before. How exotic!
target: 真的？哇！我以前还从没为任何事“努力”过呢，真新奇！

source: You and Polly share a look that says "holy shit someone needs to teach Miranda actual driving safety."
target: 你和波莉对视一眼，眼神里写满：“我操，得有人教教米兰达真正的驾驶安全。”

source: At least your distraction worked! Even if giving Miri homework was a total -N2 HYPE solution.
target: 至少，转移注意力这招奏效了！虽然布置作业的办法，实在扫兴，让你损失 -N2 热度。

source: You, Scott, Polly, and Valerie are driving along when your car is suddenly enveloped in a dense fog.
target: 你、斯科特、波莉和瓦莱丽正开着车，突然，一团浓雾笼罩了整辆车。

source: Whoa, I can't even see the road anymore! We should pull over.
target: 哇，路都看不见了！得靠边停一下。

source: Kay, but if y'all get killed in the spooky murder fog, let's vow to return to this spot every ten years to reminisce and haunt people.
target: 行。不过，万一大家都死在这片恐怖杀人雾里，先约好，每十年都回来聚一次，叙叙旧，再吓吓人。

source: That's ridiculous... wait, actually, there IS a mysterious figure coming out of the fog. Time to die, you guess.
target: 太离谱了……等等，雾里还真走出一个神秘身影。看来该死了吧。

source: But as they get closer, they don't look so scary. In fact, their golden armor, cloak of woven stars, and glowing meteorite sword are quite impressive!
target: 不过，走近一看，似乎也没那么可怕。金色盔甲、星辰织成的披风、闪闪发光的陨石剑，反倒相当气派！

source: Hey, stranger. You've got some big protagonist energy. What's your story?
target: 嘿，陌生人。你这主角气场很足啊，什么来头？

source: My name is Sylveria Moonshard. I'm on a quest to dispel this endless cursed fog that's made my kingdom unlivable.
target: 我是西尔维莉娅·月碎。我正踏上征途，驱散这无尽的诅咒浓雾。我的王国已被它搅得无法生活。

source: Townsfolk can't see, so they can't work, or drive, or identify their loved ones from a distance...
target: 镇民看不清，就没法工作、开车，甚至远远看见亲人，都认不出来……

source: Yeah, I bet it's pretty inconvenient to live somewhere where nobody can see five feet in front of their face.
target: 嗯，连五英尺以外都看不清，这地方住着肯定挺不方便。

source: I've spent years training to fight the evil wizard who cursed us with this calamity. Tonight is the night I plan to end this once and for all.
target: 为了对抗施下这场灾难的邪恶巫师，我苦练了多年。就在今晚，我要彻底结束这一切。

source: What are you strangers doing here? Is it coincidence that we meet on the eve of my greatest battle, or is it destiny?
target: 各位陌生人，来此所为何事？在这场最重大的战斗前夕相逢，究竟是巧合，还是命运？

source: Oh, it's destiny, all right. We're just the minor NPCs who can sell you an amazing magic item that'll aid you on your adventure!
target: 哦，当然是命运。我们就是路边不起眼的 NPC，专门卖你超棒的魔法道具，帮你完成冒险！

source: Really? Thank you! You're doing my kingdom a great service, and I'll make sure you're known throughout the land as heroes and--
target: 真的？太感谢了！各位为我的王国立下大功，我定会让天下人知晓你们的英雄之名——

source: Yeah, sure, sounds great. You have money, right?
target: 嗯，好，听着不错。你有钱，对吧？

source: Yes, I've amassed plenty of gold during my travels. I only hope you have an item that's worth my coin.
target: 有，旅行途中，我攒下不少金币。只希望各位的货物，值得这个价。

source: You fuckin' hope so too, because you're gonna have to raid the car for something Val can sell this adventurer. What do you grab?
target: 你他妈也希望如此，毕竟得翻遍车厢，给小瓦找件能卖给冒险者的东西。拿什么好？

source: "The last Prongle in the Can. It's the most valuable resource: it's accumulated the scents and essential oils of all the other Prongles that came before it."
target: “罐里最后一片普朗客薯片。最珍贵的资源：之前所有薯片的香气与精油，全都积累在它身上。”

source: "This sacred receptacle contains the ashes of legendary fallen warriors. Whenever you're in danger, blow on it to summon their spirits to fight alongside you."
target: “这只神圣容器，盛着传说中阵亡勇士的骨灰。遇险时，只需吹一口，便能召唤他们的英灵并肩作战。”

source: Yes! This incredible chip has all the salty, greasy goodness you'll need to fuel you during your boss fight or whatever!
target: 没错！这片神奇薯片，满是咸香油润的美味，足够给你打 Boss 还是什么的补充能量！

source: Wow, the last Prongle... you're so lucky you get to taste it, Sylveria!
target: 哇，最后一片普朗客……西尔维莉娅，你能尝到它，真幸运！

source: I dreamt of eating it myself, but I understand I'm not worthy since my hand couldn't fit in the tube to grab it.
target: 我做梦都想吃，可手伸不进罐子，拿不到。这说明，我还不配。

source: Stupid big, hairy hands!
target: 可恶，又大又毛的手！

source: It's okay, Scott. With the money this adventurer's gonna give us, we can buy you more Prongles.
target: 没事，斯科特。冒险者付了钱，咱们就能给你买更多普朗客。

source: Thanks, but they won't be the LAST Prongle...
target: 谢谢，可那就不是最后那一片了……

source: The last deep-fried potato slice in a long line of deep-fried slices... what a rich, magical delicacy.
target: 一整罐油炸土豆片里，最后留下的那片……何等浓郁、神奇的珍馐。

source: And to consume this "final Prongle" before my final battle must surely be fate. Here's your +N2 MONEY; thank you for selling me this prophesied snack.
target: 决战之前，吃下这“最后的普朗客”，必是命运指引。请收下 +N2 金钱，感谢出售这份预言中的零食。

source: Thank YOU for being gullible enough to buy it!
target: 也谢谢你这么好骗，愿意买！

source: Sylveria eats the Prongle, taking your -N2 STAMINA with it.
target: 西尔维莉娅吃下薯片，连带着吃掉了你的 -N2 体力。

source: Well? How's it taste, bro? At this point, the closest I can come to eating the last Prongle is living vicariously through you!
target: 怎么样，兄弟，什么味道？我吃不到最后那片，只能靠听你描述，过过干瘾了！

source: It's delicious! The immense power the final Prongle absorbed from its fallen brethren is coursing through my veins!
target: 美味极了！最后的普朗客，从阵亡同胞那里吸收的无穷力量，正在我血管里奔涌！

source: I feel stronger, tougher, faster... and like I wanna eat more Prongles!
target: 我变得更强壮、更坚韧、更迅速……还想吃更多普朗客！

source: LOL, yup. Addictive snack chemicals are a bitch.
target: 笑死，可不是嘛。让人上瘾的零食添加剂，真他妈厉害。

source: Farewell, kind vendors! I must go to confront the wizard and liberate this land from the endless fog!
target: 再会，善良的商人们！我得去迎战巫师，解放这片土地，让无尽浓雾消散！

source: Good luck, girl. I gotta find a bank that'll convert these gold coins into legal tender.
target: 祝好运，姑娘。我得找家银行，把这些金币兑换成能花的钱。

source: And I'm on a mission to find a Prongles tube big enough to fit my hand. I hope all our quests align like this again someday!
target: 我也要踏上征途，找到能伸进手的普朗客大罐。希望哪天，咱们的冒险还能这样交会！

source: Yeah, exactly! These are the comingled ashes of vikings, knights, kung-fu masters, demigods, and... other categories of great warriors.
target: 没错！这是混在一起的勇士骨灰：维京人、骑士、功夫大师、半神，还有……其他各种伟大战士。

source: And their spirits can be at your beck and call for the low price of +N2 MONEY.
target: 只需 +N2 金钱，英灵们就能随叫随到。

source: Wow, that's such a steal! I'll be invincible with a spectral army to fight by my side. Thank you so much for selling this artifact to me!
target: 哇，太划算了！有幽灵大军并肩作战，我必战无不胜。多谢把这件神器卖给我！

source: Thank YOU for being gullible enough to buy it!
target: 也谢谢你这么好骗，愿意买！

source: You all part ways, and some hours later, Sylveria Moonshard has arrived at the evil wizard's tower.
target: 大家就此分别。几小时后，西尔维莉娅·月碎来到了邪恶巫师的高塔。

source: They have their confrontation. The wizard does an evil monologue. He casts some spells; she swings her sword. It's a whole epic thing.
target: 双方对峙。巫师发表邪恶独白，施放法术；她挥剑迎战。总之，很史诗。

source: Sylveria is struggling. This wizard is too powerful for her to defeat alone! With bloodied hands, she takes out her receptacle of ashes and says...
target: 西尔维莉娅渐渐不支。巫师太强，她独自根本打不过！她用沾满鲜血的手，取出骨灰容器，喊道……

source: O great warrior spirits, please aid me in my time of need!
target: 伟大的勇士英灵，请在我危难之际，助我一臂之力！

source: She blows the ashes into the wizard's face! They get his beard all dirty and sting his eyes, but obviously, no warrior spirits appear.
target: 她把灰吹向巫师的脸！灰沾脏了胡子，呛痛了眼睛，可显然，没有任何勇士英灵出现。

source: "ACHOO!" the wizard sneezes. "Why the hell are you carrying a cigarette ashtray around? Are you THAT desperate for a special move? Die already!"
target: “阿嚏！”巫师打了个喷嚏，“你他妈随身带烟灰缸干吗？想必杀技想疯了？给我死吧！”

source: The last words of Sylveria Moonshard before she's exploded by magic echo throughout the kingdom...
target: 魔法将西尔维莉娅·月碎炸得粉碎。她临终前的最后一句话，回荡在整个王国……

source: I GOT SO SCAAAAAMMED!
target: 我被坑惨啦——！

source: So we tricked that adventurer girl into buying an ashtray? Isn't that sorta... not nice?
target: 所以，咱们骗那位冒险者姑娘，买了个烟灰缸？是不是……有点不友善？

source: Oh, yeah, it was a very mean thing to do. But money's money!
target: 哦，对，缺德透了。可钱就是钱嘛！

source: But what about the -N2 SOUL we lost?
target: 可咱们还损失了 -N2 灵魂啊？

source: Eh, who cares? SOUL can't buy me a new phone.
target: 嗐，谁在乎。灵魂又不能给我买新手机。

source: Well said, Val. Let's ride!
target: 说得好，小瓦。走起！

source: You're driving and having a nice conversation with Moss when you see a girl with her thumb up on the side of the road.
target: 你边开车边和莫斯愉快地聊天，突然看见一个姑娘，站在路边竖着拇指。

source: Ooh, another hitchhiker! Pick her up, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!
target: 哦，又有人搭车！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，载她一程吧！

source: You pull over and let her in. "Thank you," she says softly. "Just drop me off two miles up ahead."
target: 你停下车，让她上来。“谢谢。”她轻声说，“前面两英里，放我下去就好。”

source: Can do! My name's Moss Mann. I'm the senior hitchhiker around this car, so I'll show you the ropes.
target: 没问题！我叫莫斯·曼，算这车上的资深搭车客，就由我带你熟悉情况。

source: Moss spiritedly lays out all the juiciest gossip for your hitchhiker. Halfway through the story of Scott's weird jacket stains, you pass a big cliffside curve.
target: 莫斯兴致勃勃，给新搭车客讲起最劲爆的八卦。正聊到斯科特外套上的怪污渍，车子驶过悬崖边的大弯道。

source: "Look at that...," says the hitchhiker. "I drove on this curve myself, not so long ago... when my car pitched over that curve, and I DIED."
target: “看那里……”姑娘说，“不久前，我也开车经过这个弯道……结果车翻了出去，而我，死了。”

source: Wow, really? It's super cool how open you are about your death. I died in a similar way!
target: 哇，真的？能这么坦然地聊自己的死，真酷！我也是这么死的！

source: "Wait, what?"
target: “等等，什么？”

source: We're, like, ghost-sisters from another mister! If that mister was "Mister Car Accident."
target: 咱们简直是异父鬼姐妹！同一个“车祸先生”生的！

source: "Uh... sorry, this is just... weird. This isn't how I expected this conversation to go."
target: “呃……抱歉，就是……有点怪。这对话，跟我想的走向不太一样。”

source: "Normally I just drop the 'I'm already dead' bomb, everyone freaks out, and I vanish into thin air. I don't really have a follow-up..."
target: “平时，我扔出‘其实我早就死了’这个大消息，大家就会吓疯，我再凭空消失。后面说什么，我没想过……”

source: Well, hey, the "vanishing hitchhiker" routine is a classic. I respect it. But in a car with fellow ghosts and cryptids, it doesn't quite pack the same punch.
target: 嗐，“消失的搭车客”，经典套路，我尊重。不过，这车上坐着幽灵同行和神秘生物，效果就没那么震撼了。

source: Lucky for you, I'm an expert in exaggerating the truth for clout, and %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% here is always choosing wacky options to escalate situations!
target: 幸好，我最擅长夸大事实，博取关注。而 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，总能选些离谱选项，把事情越闹越大！

source: The two of us can surely come up with a great secondary twist to add to your spooky tale. Any ideas, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?
target: 咱俩肯定能给你的鬼故事，再添个精彩反转。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，有主意吗？

source: "Good stories need conflict and a charismatic villain. The twist is the hitchhiker didn't die at the curve; she was MURDERED BY THE CURVE."
target: “好故事要有冲突，还得有魅力反派。反转就是：搭车客不是死在弯道，而是被弯道杀了！”

source: "Include product placement in your urban legend."
target: “给都市传说植入广告。”

source: Ooh, I like it! Spooky nonsensical twists are integral to any good urban legend!
target: 哦，喜欢！吓人又不讲逻辑的反转，可是好都市传说的必备！

source: But it needs justification. WHY did the curve turn evil?
target: 不过，得有动机。弯道为什么变坏了？

source: Maybe it was abandoned by its road-parents and it never got over it!
target: 也许，它被公路爸妈抛弃，一直没走出阴影！

source: MAYBE IT HAS A GUN!
target: 也许它有枪！

source: Sure! And now the curve is out for revenge, trying to find its road-parents and get back at everyone who drove all over it...
target: 对！于是弯道决心复仇，要找到公路爸妈，还要报复所有从自己身上碾过去的人……

source: And the curve is super mad at all the people who have nice parents, instead of its mean old crappy parents, so it kills them out of revenge!
target: 它那爸妈又老又坏，看别人有好爸妈，就特别生气，所以要杀了那些人，报仇！

source: Yes! And just when all this intrigue you've built up reaches its zenith, you do the big reveal: THIS SHIT GETS IMMERSIVE!
target: 对！等悬念层层积累，终于到达顶峰，再抛出大揭秘：这故事，要沉浸式体验！

source: You're not just here to spook the driver who took you in. You're RECRUITING the driver, because this madness ends today!
target: 你不只是来吓唬好心载你的司机，而是要招募对方，因为这场疯狂，今天就要结束！

source: AND YOU HAVE A GUN! AND YOU GIVE THE DRIVER A GUN! GIVE EVERYBODY GUNS!!!
target: 而且你有枪！还要给司机一把枪！每人都发枪！！！

source: Yes! This is THE SEQUEL: THE VANISHING HITCHHIKER TAKES REVENGE ON THE EVIL CURVE WITH A GUN.
target: 没错！续集来了：《消失的搭车客，持枪复仇邪恶弯道》！

source: "Well, that's... complete nonsense," the ghost girl says. "But it'll definitely shake up my stale routine, so thanks, I guess!"
target: “呃，这就……完全瞎扯了。”幽灵姑娘说，“不过，肯定能给老套路添点新意。行吧，谢了！”

source: No problem! Helping fellow cryptids grow their legends and freak people out is my passion!
target: 不客气！帮神秘生物同行丰富传说，吓唬别人，是我的热爱！

source: You lost -N2 MIND trying to understand all those disconnected twists, but gained +N2 HYPE from the exciting tale you've created!
target: 琢磨这些毫不相干的反转，让你损失 -N2 头脑。不过，新编的故事够刺激，你获得了 +N2 热度！

source: Say, there's an idea! Urban legends are pretty much the last bastion that brands have yet to conquer. I'll make some calls.
target: 哎，有想法！都市传说，几乎是品牌还没攻占的最后堡垒。我去打几个电话。

source: Some phone calls later...
target: 几通电话之后……

source: Okay, I've got a retailer onboard! Here's your new story:
target: 好了，找到商家赞助了！这是你的新版故事：

source: You were driving on a dark and stormy night, when suddenly, an empty bag of Vampire Bites was blown onto your windshield.
target: 一个漆黑的暴风雨之夜，你开着车，突然，一只空的吸血鬼脆片袋，吹上挡风玻璃。

source: You were about to wipe it off, but then you started reading the back of the bag.
target: 本来想擦掉，结果先读起了背面的文字。

source: You couldn't believe that Vampire Bites are almost 100% organic, or that they now come in over twenty different flavors!
target: 不敢相信，吸血鬼脆片几乎百分之百有机，如今还有二十多种口味！

source: You were so busy reading that the curve snuck up on you, and you pitched over the edge!
target: 你读得太专心，没留神弯道已经到了，车子冲了出去！

source: You lay dying at the bottom of the ravine, and as your chest collapsed and your vision went dark, your last thought was...
target: 你躺在谷底，奄奄一息，胸腔塌陷，眼前渐渐发黑。最后一个念头是……

source: "What flavor Vampire Bites would I have purchased? Flaming Hot? Cheddar and Pickles? Lentil Soup?"
target: “我该买什么口味的吸血鬼脆片？劲爆辣味？切达芝士酸黄瓜味？扁豆汤味？”

source: Then, while your listeners are reveling in this story, you vanish, leaving mystery in your wake... and a 20% off coupon for a bag of Vampire Bites!
target: 等听众沉浸在故事里，你就消失，只留下神秘的余韵……以及一张吸血鬼脆片八折优惠券！

source: "Well, it's a bit of a shameless shill...," says the hitchhiker, "but if they're paying me to tell it like that, I don't care!"
target: “呃，确实是毫不遮掩地恰饭……”搭车客说，“不过，只要他们给钱，让我这么讲也无所谓！”

source: The ghost girl leaves, and you're left with that nonsensical urban-legend-turned-commercial robbing you of -N2 MIND.
target: 幽灵姑娘离开了，留下这段莫名其妙、从都市传说变成广告的故事，让你损失 -N2 头脑。

source: But with the sponsorship money she's making now, the ghost girl kicks you all +N2 MONEY in "creative consultancy fees", so that's cool!
target: 不过，如今她拿到了赞助，就付给大家 +N2 金钱，当“创意顾问费”。也不错！

source: Tch, who cares about money? I'm in the cryptid rumor game for the sheer love of the craft!
target: 啧，谁在乎钱？我传播神秘生物的传闻，纯粹出于对这门手艺的热爱！

source: Not me; I'm definitely in it for the money. Let's spend it on something dumb!
target: 我可不是，当然是为了钱。拿去买点蠢东西吧！

source: Zoe's been silently scrolling on her phone for the last several miles, but suddenly, she gasps.
target: 过去几英里，兹伊一直安静地刷手机，突然，她倒吸一口气。

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%! STOP THE CAR!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%，停车！

source: Okay... you pull over in the middle of the desert. Zoe jumps out of the car and starts walking in a random direction.
target: 好吧……你在沙漠中央靠边停下。兹伊跳下车，随便选了个方向就走。

source: Sorry, I should explain. In 1983, the company Tatari developed a video game based on the movie "Galaxy Cat is a Galaxy Stray".
target: 抱歉，解释一下。一九八三年，Tatari 公司根据电影《银河猫也是流浪猫》，开发了一款游戏。

source: You mean the movie about a cat from outer space who gets lost on Earth and befriends a plucky band of monster kids who help him return home?
target: 就是那部，外星猫迷失在地球，一群勇敢的怪物小孩跟它交朋友，再帮它回家的电影？

source: That's the one.
target: 就是那部。

source: I love that movie! I bet the game was an awesome tribute to my beloved childhood film!
target: 我爱那电影！游戏肯定也是部杰作，致敬我最爱的童年电影！

source: Eh... no. "Galaxy Cat is a Galaxy Stray: The Game" was actually total ass.
target: 呃……不是。《银河猫也是流浪猫：游戏版》，其实烂得像屎。

source: Good to know, but none of that explains why I'm walking aimlessly into the desert and getting sand in my new shoes.
target: 知道了。不过这还是解释不了，为什么我要在沙漠里瞎走，还让沙子钻进新鞋。

source: Well, internet-legend has it that the game's reception was so bad, Tatari buried a bunch of the cartridges in the desert just to get rid of them.
target: 网上传说，那游戏口碑烂透了，Tatari 为了处理库存，把一堆卡带埋进了沙漠。

source: I NEED a copy of GCiaGS:TG. It's a retro game collector's wet dream!
target: 我必须搞到一份 GCiaGS:TG！这可是怀旧游戏收藏家的春梦啊！

source: The internet doesn't have exact coordinates, but if the buried cartridges are real, they're somewhere around this spot. Can you guys pleeeeease help me find them?
target: 网上没精确坐标，不过传说要是真的，卡带就在这附近。求——求你们，帮我找找，好吗？

source: Sure, I'll help... meaning I'll make %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% do all the hard work while I sit back and take most of the credit.
target: 当然，我帮……意思就是，让 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 干全部苦活，我坐享其成，再领走大部分功劳。

source: Business as usual, then. Help Zoe find the burial site of these shitty retro games!
target: 也就是一切照旧。帮兹伊找到那些复古烂游戏的埋藏地吧！

source: Teach a dog video games so it becomes very good at sniffing them out. GAMER DOG!
target: 教狗打游戏，训练它嗅出游戏的本事。电竞狗！

source: Water this area of the desert with a potent energy drink, the best fertilizer for video games. The buried games will blossom right out of the ground!
target: 用劲猛的能量饮料浇灌这片沙漠，那可是游戏最好的肥料。埋下的卡带，一定会破土开花！

source: Hmmm... training a dog to be a professional gamer... that could honestly be my true calling!
target: 唔……训练狗当职业玩家……也许这才是我真正的天职！

source: Zoe adopts a dog off Gregslist. It's got floppy ears, a wagging tail, and hopefully some video game prowess!
target: 兹伊在 Gregslist 上领养了一只狗。耳朵软趴趴，尾巴摇得欢，希望游戏天赋也不错！

source: Thus commences a training montage. Zoe does paw-eye coordination exercises with the dog, shows it Twatch streams, and feeds it lots of Doratos and Hill Dew...
target: 训练蒙太奇开始。兹伊给狗做爪眼协调练习，放 Twatch 直播，再喂上一大堆 Doratos 和 Hill Dew……

source: But none of it works. Shockingly, dogs aren't naturally good at video games, and you lose -N2 MIND trying to teach it.
target: 可惜，统统没用。出人意料，狗居然不是天生游戏高手。你试着教它，损失 -N2 头脑。

source: Dang. I guess you can't teach an old dog new tricks... and you can't teach a new dog old games, either.
target: 哎，老狗学不会新把戏，新狗也学不会老游戏啊。

source: Wait! What's the dog digging up over there?
target: 等等！狗在那边挖什么？

source: Holy crap... IT DUG UP GALAXY CAT IS A GALAXY STRAY: THE GAME! It must've learned something after all!
target: 我去……它挖出《银河猫也是流浪猫：游戏版》了！看来还是学到点东西了！

source: WAIT! STOP, DOG! DON'T EAT THE CARTRIDGE!
target: 等等！狗狗，停！别吃卡带！

source: Okay, the dog might not have learned THAT much, but at least Zoe got her game! You all boot it up and play a bit.
target: 好吧，狗可能没学到那么多，不过至少兹伊拿到了游戏！你们开机玩了一会儿。

source: Wow, this game's even worse than I thought. Fuck it, let's give it to the dog.
target: 哇，比想象中还烂。算了，给狗吧。

source: Can I get one to chew on too?
target: 我也想拿一张啃，行吗？

source: Of course, buddy. Here, fetch!
target: 当然，伙计。来，接住！

source: At least you met a cute dog and crossed that off Zoe's geeky bucket list. Take +N2 HYPE!
target: 至少认识了可爱狗狗，还替兹伊完成一项宅宅人生清单。获得 +N2 热度！

source: Good idea!
target: 好主意！

source: IS it a good idea? 'Cause it kinda sounds like a dumb idea.
target: 真是好主意吗？听着有点蠢啊。

source: Well, it's no idea at all until we give it a shot.
target: 不试一试，谁知道这主意好不好。

source: You spend -N2 STAMINA worth of "Human Energy Ultra", the hottest energy drink on the market.
target: 你拿出相当于 -N2 体力的“人类能量 Ultra”，市面上最火的能量饮料。

source: You water a large swath of desert with it. If the cartridge cache is somewhere around here, this'll surely fertilize it!
target: 你用它浇灌了一大片沙漠。要是卡带埋在附近，肯定能给它们施足肥！

source: So... now what? We just sit here, watching games grow?
target: 然后呢？坐这儿看游戏长出来？

source: Wait, do you guys smell... burnt pixels and abused nostalgia?
target: 等等，你们闻到……烧焦的像素，还有被糟蹋的情怀了吗？

source: It's the cartridges! They're sprouting on wirey vines out of the ground!
target: 是卡带！从地里长出来了，缠在电线一样的藤蔓上！

source: Whoa. "Galaxy Cat is a Galaxy Stray: The Game" looks a lot more modern than I expected.
target: 哇，《银河猫也是流浪猫：游戏版》，比想象中现代多了。

source: Oh no. The energy drink is accelerating up the shitty 80s games' growth so fast, they're mutating into their own shittier 90s and 00s remakes!
target: 糟了，能量饮料把八十年代烂游戏催得太快，它们变异成了更烂的九十年代和两千年代重制版！

source: You watch the cartridges become CDs, then microchips, then redeemable codes for a fast-paced FPS with lootboxes and pay-to-win mechanics.
target: 卡带变成光盘，再变成微芯片，最后成了快节奏 FPS 的兑换码，开箱、氪金变强机制一应俱全。

source: Bros, what do we do?!
target: 兄弟们，怎么办？！

source: We could... bail?
target: 要不……溜？

source: NOT WITHOUT MY GAME! I see one more cartridge on the vine. Let's grab it and run!
target: 不拿到游戏，我不走！藤上还剩一张卡带，拿了就跑！

source: You grab it and run before you have to witness "Galaxy Cat is a Galaxy Stray: VR, now with NFTs". At least you gained +N2 HYPE finding the game!
target: 你们抓起卡带就逃，总算没亲眼见证《银河猫也是流浪猫 VR：现已加入 NFT》。至少找到了游戏，获得 +N2 热度！

source: Scott is in the driver's seat while you, Polly, and Aaravi chat about stuff and things.
target: 斯科特开着车，你、波莉和阿拉维有一搭没一搭地聊着天。

source: I gotta say, gurl, I didn't expect you to wanna hitchhike with us. I sorta thought you'd try to kill one of us by now.
target: 说真的，姐妹，没想到你会搭我们的车。我还以为，你早该动手宰我们其中一个了。

source: Whoa, that was a big bump! Did I hit something?
target: 哇，好大一个颠簸！我撞到什么了吗？

source: Nah, that'd be rude. I'm a guest here. I can find other monsters to slay when I'm back on an adventure.
target: 那多不礼貌，我可是客人。等回去冒险，再找别的怪物杀就行了。

source: What do you mean, BACK on an adventure? This road trip IS an adventure, baby! I can't wait for all the action-packed hijinks you're gonna bring us along on!
target: 什么叫“回去冒险”？这趟公路旅行就是冒险，宝贝！真想看看，你会带我们经历多少惊险刺激的闹剧！

source: Uhh, bros, I'm having trouble moving forward...
target: 呃，兄弟们，车有点开不动了……

source: What? But I didn't really plan on going on an adventure right now... I thought this was more like a vacation.
target: 什么？可我现在真没打算冒险……还以为是出来度假的。

source: Okay, I can't get the car to budge at all. I think we're stuck in mud or something.
target: 好了，彻底动不了了。好像陷进泥里还是什么了。

source: Ugh, great. Do we need to get out and push?
target: 唉，真棒。得下去推车吗？

source: No, I don't think that'll work. It feels like we're sinking.
target: 恐怕不行，感觉车在往下沉。

source: Sinking? The hell?
target: 往下沉？什么鬼？

source: Yup, look at that. It looks like the car's sinking into some kind of... quickasphalt? That's a new one.
target: 嗯，你看。车好像陷进了某种……沥青流沙？这倒是头一回见。

source: Oh... are we gonna die?
target: 哦……我们要死了吗？

source: No way! Quickasphalt is no match for adventuring badass Aaravi Mishra! What's the plan, boo?
target: 怎么可能！区区沥青流沙，哪是冒险高手阿拉维·米什拉的对手！有什么计划，宝？

source: What?! I dunno! I wasn't expecting to be put on the spot like this! I didn't even have time to look up a walkthrough!
target: 什么？！我哪知道！没想到会突然把难题扔给我啊！连攻略都来不及查！

source: Oh, oof... does anybody have a plan B before we drown in asphalt, then?
target: 哦，呃……那在咱们淹死在沥青里之前，谁有备用计划？

source: There's always an entity to invoke in every situation. The best one to summon for asphalt-based enemies would be... Virginia, the West Goddess of country roads.
target: 总有适合当前情况的神灵能召唤。对付沥青类敌人，最合适的就是……乡村道路的西方女神，弗吉尼亚。

source: Reset reality and start again from last checkpoint to avoid the quickasphalt this time.
target: 重置现实，从上个存档点重新来过，这次避开沥青流沙。

source: Yeah, an invocation would work! We just gotta nail the summoning chant!
target: 对，召唤有用！只要把咒语念对！

source: COUNTRY ROADS, TAKE ME HOME...
target: 乡村道路，带我回家……

source: TO THE PLACE I BELONG...
target: 回到我属于的地方……

source: WEST VIRGINIA, MOUNTAIN MOMMA...
target: 西弗吉尼亚，大山妈妈……

source: TAKE ME HOME, COUNTRY ROADS!
target: 带我回家，乡村道路！

source: You repeat the chant ad nauseam, your car and your -N2 MAGIC sinking lower and lower...
target: 你们一遍又一遍念着，念到快吐了。车越陷越深，-N2 魔力也不断流失……

source: Until finally, with a blast of warm sunshine, peach cobbler, and Southern hospitality, Virginia the West Goddess appears!
target: 终于，伴着温暖阳光、蜜桃酥饼和南方人的热情好客，西方女神弗吉尼亚现身了！

source: "Well, bless your hearts!" Virginia says. "How did y'all get stuck in that quickasphalt? Ain't you seen it comin' from a mile away?"
target: “哎哟，瞧你们这可怜样！”弗吉尼亚说，“怎么陷进沥青流沙里了？隔着一英里，也该看见了呀？”

source: Ugh, I let my guard down for one second... can you please just get us out of here, ma'am?
target: 唉，就松懈了一秒钟……女士，能不能先把我们救出去？

source: "I'm fixin' to! Y'know, this wouldn't've happened back in the day. We didn't have asphalt; just old, reliable dirt roads, and friends walkin' on 'em..."
target: “正准备呢！以前哪有这种事？那会儿没沥青，只有老实可靠的土路，还有走在路上的朋友们……”

source: "Walkin' among homes, where the buffalo roamed, and the deer and the antelope would play..."
target: “走过家园，野牛漫游，鹿和羚羊自在嬉戏……”

source: "But listen to me gabbin' on. I could talk 'til the cows come home! Let me fix you up right quick."
target: “哎呀，瞧我这话匣子，一开口就没完。先赶紧帮你们一把。”

source: Virginia touches the quickasphalt. It transforms into a bunch of dandelion seeds and blows away on a sweet westerly wind, allowing you to drive through!
target: 弗吉尼亚碰了碰沥青流沙。它化作一大团蒲公英种子，随和煦西风飘散，路通了！

source: YAASSS, we made it! That got my fuckin' blood pumping! What's our next quest, Aaravi?
target: 好耶，出来了！刺激得老娘热血沸腾！阿拉维，下个任务是什么？

source: Ugh, THIS is why I need a vacation...
target: 唉……所以我才需要度假啊。

source: Aaravi can be sour if she wants, but you had fun! You gain +N2 HYPE from your taste of true adventure.
target: 阿拉维爱闹别扭就随她吧，反正你玩得挺开心！体验真正的冒险，让你获得 +N2 热度。

source: What do you mean? How do you "reset reality"?
target: 什么意思？怎么“重置现实”？

source: You've never done it? It's easy. Watch this.
target: 没试过？很简单，看好了。

source: And we're back!
target: 好了，回来了！

source: WHAT JUST HAPPENED?!
target: 刚才发生了什么？！

source: I reloaded my last save before we drove into the quickasphalt, duh.
target: 当然是读取开进沥青流沙之前，最后一次的存档啊。

source: But what does it mean to "reload a save"? How do you do it? What are the consequences of resetting reality?
target: 可“读取存档”是什么意思？怎么做到的？重置现实会有什么后果？

source: It's -- wait, did we just hit a bump?
target: 就是——等等，刚才是不是又颠了一下？

source: Oops, sorry, I think I drove into the quickasphalt again. I was kinda distracted by you shattering my worldview.
target: 哎呀，抱歉，好像又开进沥青流沙了。你刚把我的世界观砸碎，害我分心了。

source: Dammit. Guess we're doing this once more, with feeling...
target: 妈的。看来得再来一遍，这次认真点……

source: WAIT, DON'T--!
target: 等等，别——！

source: Now, let's not fuck around this time. If I keep resetting reality over and over, something's gonna glitch.
target: 这次别他妈瞎闹了。现实重置太多遍，会出 BUG 的。

source: BUT HOW ARE YOU DOING IT?! Is it a meta thing? Are we rewriting timelines? Am I even the original Polly?!
target: 可你到底怎么做到的？！这是打破第四面墙了吗？咱们在改写时间线？我还是最初那个波莉吗？！

source: Look, me resetting reality is just something you need to accept so that we don't keep accidentally driving into certain doom!
target: 听着，我能重置现实，这事你们接受就行！不然咱们又会不小心开进去送死！

source: Let's just drive around the quickasphalt and never bring this up ever again, okay?
target: 绕过沥青流沙，以后谁也别再提这事，好吗？

source: But--
target: 可是——

source: I SAID NEVER BRING IT UP AGAIN!
target: 我说了，谁也别再提！

source: And you never do! You lose -N2 MIND, but after a cooling-off period, you're once again blissfully ignorant of the artificial reality you inhabit.
target: 你们还真没再提！你损失 -N2 头脑，不过冷静一阵之后，又幸福地忘记了，自己生活在一个人造现实里。

source: You even gain +N2 HYPE from what was surely nothing more than another silly road trip misadventure. Yippee!
target: 毕竟这肯定只是公路旅行里的又一段倒霉小插曲嘛。你甚至还获得了 +N2 热度。好耶！

source: You're riding along when you pass a broken-down school bus. You can barely get a word out before Joy's jumping out to investigate.
target: 你们经过一辆似乎抛锚的校车。还没来得及开口，乔伊已经跳下车去查看。

source: The bus is filled with about twenty children and a redheaded woman in the driver's seat. Joy addresses the driver.
target: 校车里坐着二十来个孩子，驾驶座上是个红发女人。乔伊上前跟她搭话。

source: Oh my Goddess... um, hi, I'm sorry to intrude, but... are you Miss Fizzle? THE Miss Fizzle?
target: 女神啊……呃，你好，抱歉打扰了，你是菲兹尔老师吗？那位菲兹尔老师？

source: Yup. I'm Violet Fizzle, the one and only.
target: 对，我是维奥莱特·菲兹尔，如假包换。

source: Wow! It's such an honor to meet you! I grew up watching your TV show!
target: 哇，见到你太荣幸了！我从小看你的节目长大！

source: Oh, I watched that show too. "The Mythic School Bus", right? With the teacher who travels through space and time to teach her students lessons?
target: 哦，我也看过。《神话校车》对吧？老师带学生穿越时空，上各种课的那个？

source: Yup! Miss Fizzle did a lot, not the least of which continuing the tradition of powerful witches having their own TV shows.
target: 对！菲兹尔老师的贡献可多了，还延续了强大女巫自办电视节目的传统。

source: Miss Fizzle, I can't overstate how much you inspired me as a young witch. I'd be honored to help you fix the Mythic School Bus.
target: 菲兹尔老师，我还是小女巫时，你给过我数不清的启发。能帮你修好神话校车，我很荣幸。

source: Fix it? It's not broken. I just pulled over to calm down, 'cause these kids are driving me nuts!
target: 修？车没坏。我只是停车缓缓，这帮小鬼快把我逼疯了！

source: Oh... is everything okay?
target: 哦……还好吗？

source: No! I can't take these brats anymore! Always doing internet dances during class, or filming pranks for YooToob, or whining about the bus not having WiFi...
target: 不好！这帮臭小鬼，我受够了！上课跳网络热舞、拍恶作剧发 YooToob，还整天抱怨车上没 WiFi……

source: And the parents are even worse! I've taken these kids to space THREE TIMES, and Freddie's dad STILL convinces him the Earth is flat!
target: 家长更糟！我都带他们去过三次太空了，弗雷迪他爸还非跟他说，地球是平的！

source: None of the kids give a damn about my field trips, and with this shit teacher's salary, I can barely afford the magic to get them there!
target: 没一个孩子在乎我的校外教学。就当老师这点破工资，连带他们出去的魔法费，我都快付不起了！

source: Seems like you need an assist. I bet my friends and I could take the kids on a fun, magical field trip and teach them a life lesson. It'd give you a break!
target: 看来需要支援。我和朋友可以带孩子们来场好玩的魔法郊游，教点人生道理，你也歇一歇！

source: Scott, while my inner child is loving the suggestion, I don't think Miss Fizzle will hand over the care of her students to total strangers...
target: 斯科特，我心里那个小孩可喜欢这主意了。不过，菲兹尔老师应该不会把学生交给完全陌生的人……

source: Are you kidding? Take the brats; I don't give a shit. You got a field trip in mind?
target: 开什么玩笑，赶紧领走，我才不管。有想好带他们去哪儿吗？

source: "A lesson in history! Let's go to England in the XIXth Century so these kids can learn fuckin' manners."
target: “上堂历史课！去十九世纪的英国，教这帮小鬼学点他妈的规矩。”

source: "A lesson in empathy! Let's travel into the inside of Miss Fizzle's brain so the students get to really understand how miserable they're making her."
target: “上堂同理心课！钻进菲兹尔老师的脑子，让学生真正明白，自己把她折磨得有多惨。”

source: You shift the bus into reverse and drive backwards through time to XIXth Century England!
target: 你挂上倒挡，沿着时间一路倒车，驶进十九世纪的英国！

source: You force the students to attend a finishing school with a no-nonsense Victorian schoolmaster to whip them into shape.
target: 你把学生们塞进礼仪学校，让一位维多利亚时代、毫不含糊的严厉校长，给他们好好立规矩。

source: "Pay attention, children!" says the teacher. "You must be educated and obedient if you want to marry out of your stations and become rich one day!"
target: “注意听，孩子们！”老师说，“想靠婚姻跨越阶级、过上富日子，就得有教养、听话！”

source: "Pfft, sounds lame!" says Freddie. "I don't gotta get married to be rich. I'm gonna go viral on Tock-Tock and be an internet celebrity!"
target: “嘁，真逊！”弗雷迪说，“有钱干吗非得结婚？我在 Tock-Tock 上火一把，当网红就行！”

source: "What is an... 'internet celebrity'?" asks the teacher. "Is it a noble title of some sort?"
target: “什么是……‘网红’？”老师问，“某种贵族头衔吗？”

source: No. It's a job, sort of. You have to get really lucky to earn money doing it, but--
target: 不是，算是一份工作吧。想靠它赚钱，得特别走运，不过——

source: "Wait, so these children are still ASPIRING to work? Why are they not working yet?! They're already nine years old!"
target: “等等，他们居然还只是梦想工作？怎么还没去干活？！都九岁了！”

source: "NUH-UH! I'm ten-and-a-half!" Freddie whines.
target: “才不是，我十岁半了！”弗雷迪嚷道。

source: "Well, this won't do at all! You children should be working in the mines, or as metalcraft apprentices! Come along, it's time to teach you kids hard labor!"
target: “这怎么行！该下矿，或者当金工学徒了！来吧，是时候让你们尝尝苦力活了！”

source: Uh... is this okay?
target: 呃……这样好吗？

source: No, it's not. Miss Fizzle, shouldn't we put a stop to this?
target: 不好。菲兹尔老师，咱们不该阻止一下吗？

source: Nah, they'll be fine. The brats are always going on about mining and crafting anyway. This is probably a dream situation for them.
target: 不用，他们没事。整天叨叨挖矿、合成，这不正是他们梦寐以求的吗。

source: Well... lots of shows go downhill if they run for too long. Looks like "The Mythic School Bus" is no exception.
target: 好吧……节目拍太久，总会烂尾。《神话校车》看来也没例外。

source: The kids return from their field trip after their eighteen-hour shifts. You're unsure if they learned anything, but you'd rather just leave this adventure and never look back.
target: 十八小时的班上完，孩子们终于结束郊游。有没有学到东西，你不知道。你只想离开这场冒险，再也别回头。

source: You also lost -N2 MAGIC time-traveling, but at least you gained +N2 MIND learning so much, like how much the past sucked.
target: 时间旅行让你损失 -N2 魔力，不过见识了那么多，比如过去到底有多烂，也让你获得了 +N2 头脑。

source: You want to drive the bus into Miss Fizzle's brain? What's that gonna teach the kids, besides how to induce a stroke?
target: 把车开进菲兹尔老师的脑子？除了怎么让人中风，这还能教孩子什么？

source: Nah, this is daytime children's television logic. Miss Fizzle's brain is gonna be some fun visual metaphor for the complexity of thought!
target: 不会啦，按白天播的儿童节目逻辑，她脑子肯定是个有趣的视觉比喻，用来表现思想多么复杂！

source: You use -N2 MAGIC to shrink the bus and drive through Miss Fizzle's ear into her mind!
target: 你消耗 -N2 魔力，缩小校车，穿过菲兹尔老师的耳朵，开进她的脑海！

source: It turns out her brain is a rundown office space where the employees are snickering little goblins and there's always a copier on fire.
target: 原来，她的大脑是一间破败办公室，员工全是坏笑的小哥布林，而且永远有台复印机在着火。

source: "Look, guys!" one goblin says. "I found this file of Fizzle's cherished childhood memories! More fuel for the shredder, hahaha!"
target: “伙计们，看！”一个哥布林说，“找到菲兹尔珍贵的童年回忆档案了！碎纸机又有得吃，哈哈哈！”

source: "Cool!" says another goblin. "What should we do with this memory of Freddie's dad accusing Fizzle of 'sucking Satan's dick' for teaching the kids evolution?"
target: “棒！”另一个说，“那段记忆呢？弗雷迪的爸爸因为她教进化论，骂她‘给撒旦舔鸡巴’的那段。”

source: "Ooh, let's throw that at her while she's falling asleep. She's THIS close to giving up on the youth completely, I can feel it."
target: “哦，等她快睡着，再拿出来烦她。我能感觉到，她就差一点，就要彻底放弃这帮孩子了。”

source: "Nice, nice. I also pulled the file with that annoyingly-catchy Tock-Tock song the kids are always singing. Wanna shove that at her now?"
target: “好，好。我还找到了那首烦死人、又特别洗脑的 Tock-Tock 歌，孩子们老唱的那个。现在塞给她？”

source: "HAHAHA, YES! I LOVE WATCHING HER HUM ANGRILY!"
target: “哈哈哈，好啊！最爱看她一边气得要死，一边忍不住哼了！”

source: You return to the real world and find Miss Fizzle reading a romance novel and drinking a LOT of wine. She's humming that song with a scowl on her face.
target: 回到现实，你们发现菲兹尔老师正看爱情小说，喝下大量葡萄酒，还皱着眉哼那首歌。

source: For once, the kids don't harass her. Instead, they bring her a bowl of soup and offer to sit silently on the bus for the remainder of the ride.
target: 难得，孩子们没再烦她。反而端来一碗汤，答应剩下路程都会安安静静坐着。

source: Who knew the secret to effective childcare was showing them how much they've emotionally broken you? Nice! You gain +N2 SOUL for helping Miss Fizzle.
target: 谁能想到，带孩子的秘诀，是让他们亲眼看见自己把你折磨得多崩溃。真好！帮助菲兹尔老师，让你获得 +N2 灵魂。

source: You and Milo are taking "candid" pictures of each other in the back seat. Scott's driving, but he seems worried about something.
target: 你和迈洛在后座，互相拍着“抓拍照”。斯科特开着车，却似乎有点担心。

source: That car's been following us for a while now...
target: 那辆车跟着咱们好一阵了……

source: Hm? Oh, THAT car? Don't worry, that's just my camera crew filming some B-roll for the show.
target: 嗯？哦，那辆啊？别怕，只是我的摄制组，给节目拍点补充素材。

source: The... what now?
target: 什么……节目？

source: The show, silly! I'm producing a webseries called "Milo on the Road", where I travel around and be my fabulous self.
target: 节目呀，笨蛋！我在制作网络系列《迈洛在路上》，四处旅行，展现自己光彩照人的一面。

source: It fulfills my fans' morbid curiosity about my day-to-day life, and who am I to deny them that? Everyone can use more Milo in their day.
target: 粉丝对我的日常生活，有着近乎病态的好奇。怎能不满足他们？谁的生活里，都该多来一点迈洛。

source: Does that mean we're on the internet right now? That's so cool!
target: 所以咱们现在上网了？真酷！

source: HI GRANDMA! I'M GONNA TEACH YOU HOW TO WATCH THIS WHEN I GET HOME!
target: 奶奶好！等我回家，就教你怎么看！

source: Sweet, I've always wanted to be a wacky side character in a reality show! I wonder if I'm the fan favorite yet. I'm checking the comments on the last video!
target: 棒！早就想当真人秀里搞笑的配角了。不知道我是不是人气王。看看上一集评论！

source: ...Uh, okay, bad news. Fans are not loving "Milo on the Road".
target: ……呃，好吧，坏消息。粉丝不喜欢《迈洛在路上》。

source: The top comment is, "this series proves milo's just another spoiled celebrity in an ivory tower with no concept of what 'real life' is like. i'm unsubscribing."
target: 热评第一：“这节目证明了，迈洛也就是个象牙塔里被宠坏的明星，完全不懂普通人的生活。取关了。”

source: My fans find me... unrelatable? But I NEED them to find me relatable!
target: 粉丝觉得我……不接地气？可他们必须觉得我亲切、有共鸣才行！

source: Otherwise they won't consume my content, and I won't get the attention and devotion I insatiably crave! What do I do?!
target: 不然谁还看我的内容？我那填不满的关注欲、崇拜欲，又怎么办？！该怎么做？！

source: Maybe you could do something nice for someone to get more people to like your show. Nice stuff is nice!
target: 要不做点好事，让大家更喜欢节目？好事就是好啊！

source: True, doing good deeds is the fastest way to get in an audience's good graces. But what act of kindness could I do from this car?
target: 对，做好事最能迅速讨好观众。可坐在车里，能做什么善举呢？

source: "People love watching cute, feel-good animal videos. Let's use your reaper powers to help some roadkill transition into the afterlife!"
target: “大家都爱看可爱又治愈的动物视频。用死神能力，帮路上被轧死的小动物去来世吧！”

source: "You could help fix that broken car parked on the roadside! People love it when celebrities act like they're the same species as regular folks."
target: “帮路边那人修车吧！名人表现得跟普通人是同一物种，大家最爱看了。”

source: Ugh, but animal reaping gigs are so unpleasant. Are you sure there's no better way?
target: 唉，给动物引魂的活儿，太不愉快了。就没更好的办法吗？

source: Nah, this is the best idea we've got. And look, there's a run-over raccoon right there! It's like he chose the most convenient time and place to die on purpose.
target: 没有，这已经是最好的主意。看，那儿刚好有只被轧死的浣熊！简直像专挑了最方便的时间地点来死。

source: Fine, I'll do it. Looks like this raccoon's soul is due to be transported to... ugh, Hell, great. Let's get this over with.
target: 行，我来。它的灵魂该送去……唉，地狱，真棒。赶紧干完吧。

source: Are we filming the talking head bits now? Cool! You want us to talk about the reaping?
target: 现在要拍对镜采访了吗？酷！聊刚才引魂的事？

source: Reaping is totally Milo's true calling. Watching them work gave me a whole new perspective on life and death.
target: 引魂绝对是迈洛的天职。看着 TA 工作，我对生死有了全新认识。

source: Same! Milo's work is actually what made me aware of death!
target: 我也是！迈洛干这活儿，才让我意识到，原来还有死亡这回事！

source: It's like, death doesn't have to be the end, y'know? It doesn't have to be scary or sad; it's just a transition between realms.
target: 死亡不一定是终点，懂吧？不用可怕，也不用悲伤，只不过是从一个世界去往另一个。

source: A human becomes a ghost; a demon goes to Heaven; an angel is reincarnated as a human; on some occasions, a soul is given eternal rest and becomes stardust...
target: 人类变成幽灵，恶魔去天堂，天使转生成人类。有时候，灵魂能永远安歇，化为星尘……

source: ...and it's a reaper's job to gently guide those poor souls into the next phase of their existences. It's a humanitarian thing.
target: ……死神的职责，就是温柔地领着那些可怜灵魂，进入下一个生命阶段。这可是人道主义工作。

source: Dang, that was deep. You guys are gonna quote me on that, right? That's a Polly Geist original!
target: 哇，这话真有深度。你们会引用的吧？波莉·鬼斯特原创，记好了！

source: Milo finally drags the raccoon's soul to Hell. Since they were pretty against this anyway, they insist on using -N2 MAGIC of yours to complete the job.
target: 迈洛终于把浣熊的灵魂拖进地狱。不过 TA 本来就不乐意，非要耗掉你的 -N2 魔力，才肯把活干完。

source: But even if Milo's motivations were self-interested, it was still nice of you to not leave the raccoon's soul unreaped. You gain +N2 SOUL!
target: 迈洛虽然是为了自己，可没让浣熊的灵魂流落在外，终究也是件好事。你获得 +N2 灵魂！

source: Okay, fine. Pull over, Scott.
target: 好吧。斯科特，靠边停。

source: Milo does some weird vocal exercises, summons their manners, and steps out of the car.
target: 迈洛做了几遍奇怪的发声练习，摆出礼貌姿态，下了车。

source: Worry not, stranded driver! Milo Belladona -- friend of the people, heart of the youth, and face of Undead Decay's Full-Skull-Coverage Foundation -- is here to fix your car!
target: 受困的司机，不必担心！人民之友、青年之心、Undead Decay 全颅遮瑕粉底代言人，迈洛·贝拉多娜，来替你修车了！

source: "Oh! Thanks, but I've got this. It's just a popped tire; I've got a spare and--"
target: “哦！谢谢，不过我能搞定。只是爆胎，有备胎，而且——”

source: Okay, I'm preeetty sure the first step to fixing a car is to find the engine. I assume it's in here?
target: 嗯，修车第一步，肯定是找到发动机。应该在这里面？

source: That's the passenger-side door.
target: 那是副驾车门。

source: Oh, right, silly me. It's obviously in here...?
target: 哦，对，瞧我。显然应该在这儿……？

source: That's the gas cap. Try under the hood, babe.
target: 那是油箱盖。宝贝，试试引擎盖下面。

source: Ah, of course! Now I see. This engine has too much... stuff in it. Let's remove some of that excess stuff!
target: 啊，当然，明白了。这发动机里……东西太多了。拆掉点多余的吧！

source: "NO! STOP! You're ripping out the battery!"
target: “不！住手！你在拆蓄电池！”

source: You don't need it! Be your OWN car battery! Be the driving force you want to see in the world!
target: 不需要它！做自己的汽车电池！成为你希望世界拥有的那股驱动力！

source: (Damn, that was good. We got that on tape, right?)
target: （妈的，真漂亮。录下来了，对吧？）

source: Okay, I'm getting tired, so I think I've "de-stuffed" your car enough. No need to pay me!
target: 好了，累了。“杂物”拆得差不多了，不用付钱！

source: "I was never going to pay you!"
target: “我本来就没打算付！”

source: No, shhh, it's okay. Today, you. Tomorrow, me.
target: 不，嘘，没事。今天帮你，明天帮我。

source: "Tomorrow... what? I break YOUR car?"
target: “明天……什么？我把你的车也拆了？”

source: Haha, of course, whatever you just said. Here's my PR rep's number. Call her whenever.
target: 哈哈，当然，随你刚才说了什么。这是我公关代表的电话，随时找她。

source: You lost -N2 HYPE waiting for Milo to finish fucking up that car. But watching them fail DID make them more relatable, so at least their ratings go up!
target: 等着迈洛把那辆车搞得更烂，让你损失 -N2 热度。不过，亲眼看 TA 出糗，的确显得亲民多了，收视率起码涨了！

source: Also, your +N2 SOUL went up for "helping" the stranded driver! (It's the thought that counts.)
target: 而且，“帮”了受困司机，还让你获得 +N2 灵魂！（心意到了就好。）

source: Everyone's riding peacefully along until Stu gasps and grabs Scott's shoulder.
target: 大家正安安稳稳地坐车赶路，斯图突然倒吸一口气，抓住斯科特的肩膀。

source: Pull over! It's an emergency!
target: 快靠边停车！出大事了！

source: Why? Do you need to pee again?
target: 怎么了？你又想尿尿了？

source: No, brah. There's a poor, defenseless turtle stuck on its back on the side of the road!
target: 不是，哥们儿。路边有只可怜的小乌龟，四脚朝天翻不过来了，毫无还手之力！

source: WHY DIDN'T YOU SAY SOMETHING SOONER?!
target: 你怎么不早说？！

source: Scott whips the car around and narrowly avoids running over the poor tipped-over turtle.
target: 斯科特猛地调转车头，差点就从那只可怜的翻肚乌龟身上碾了过去。

source: Don't worry, little bro. I'll flip you upright, and you can go back to living a happy turtle life!
target: 别怕，小兄弟。我把你翻过来，你就又能快快乐乐地当乌龟啦！

source: Wait, Scott! Don't flip the turtle over!
target: 等等，斯科特！别把乌龟翻过来！

source: Why not?
target: 为什么不行？

source: Because what if it doesn't need to be flipped? What if this turtle is carrying the WHOLE WORLD on its back?!
target: 万一它根本不用翻身呢？万一这只乌龟背上驮着整个世界呢？！

source: Whoa... that's deep. I've heard a parable or something about the world being on a turtle's back, so it must be true.
target: 哇……这可深奥了。我好像听过一个寓言还是什么，说世界就在乌龟背上，那肯定是真的。

source: But look at the poor turtle's little legs kick the air. It wants to be on its feet!
target: 可你看它多可怜，小短腿一直在空中乱蹬。它想站起来呀！

source: But is it kicking, or is it actually walking across space and time, carrying our whole world around?
target: 可它真是在乱蹬吗？有没有可能，它正驮着整个世界，穿行于时空之间？

source: I... I guess I don't know...
target: 我……我好像也说不准……

source: Brah, if we take the world off the turtle's back, we could put our whole planet off-course and be plunged into chaos.
target: 哥们儿，要是我们把世界从乌龟背上弄下来，整个星球都可能偏离轨道，陷入混乱。

source: Thank God Polly and I took all those mystical crystals earlier so we could realize this life-changing truth before it was too late!
target: 幸亏我和波莉刚才服了那些神秘水晶，才及时领悟了这个颠覆人生的真相，没酿成大祸！

source: Thank God Polly and I took all those shrooms earlier so we could realize this life-changing truth before it was too late!
target: 幸亏我和波莉刚才吃了那些致幻蘑菇，才及时领悟了这个颠覆人生的真相，没酿成大祸！

source: Stu's right. We can't risk dooming monsterkind by flipping the turtle. Causing the apocalypse would totally ruin my day.
target: 斯图说得对。不能为了给乌龟翻身，就冒着让整个怪物族群灭亡的风险。搞出世界末日可太扫兴了。

source: But what if it's just a regular turtle who needs our help? I don't wanna doom monsterkind either, but...
target: 可万一它就是只需要帮忙的普通乌龟呢？我也不想害死所有怪物，可是……

source: Good point. Should we risk the fate of everything we know and love for the sake of this turtle?
target: 有道理。为了这只乌龟，我们该拿熟悉又珍爱的一切去冒险吗？

source: Well, my Road Trip Contract says I can't decide the fate of reality while I'm high, so... %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, what should we do?
target: 呃，《公路旅行合同》规定，我嗨了以后不能决定现实世界的命运，所以……%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你说怎么办？

source: Flip the turtle
target: 把乌龟翻过来

source: Do not flip the turtle
target: 别动这只乌龟

source: You may be dooming the world, but dammit, you can't watch the poor turtle suffer anymore. You have to flip it!
target: 你可能会害整个世界完蛋，可去他的吧，你实在看不下去这只小乌龟受罪了。必须帮它翻身！

source: It's risky... but I respect that you're sticking to your morals, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 这很冒险……但你坚持自己的道德准则，这点让我很佩服，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。

source: You were all like, "Only a monster would leave a poor turtle to die!" And I fuckin' FELT it, brah.
target: 你那态度就像在说：“只有怪物才会眼睁睁看着可怜的小乌龟等死！”妈的，哥们儿，我懂你。

source: But... we are monsters.
target: 可是……我们就是怪物啊。

source: Speak for yourself. I prefer to think of myself as more of a mild inconvenience.
target: 别把我算进去。我更愿意把自己归类成“无伤大雅的小麻烦”。

source: Let's flip the turtle together, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. If the world ends, we can both take the blame!
target: 咱们一起帮它翻身吧，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。要是世界末日了，责任也能一起扛！

source: You and Scott flip the turtle slowly, keeping a lookout for mountains collapsing or moons falling out of the sky as your world is thrown aimlessly into space...
target: 你和斯科特慢慢把乌龟翻过来，一边警惕地四处张望：世界被甩进太空、漫无目的地漂流时，会不会山崩地裂，月亮从天上掉下来……

source: But after the turtle's on its feet, nothing seems different. Phew!
target: 可乌龟站稳后，一切似乎都没变。呼！

source: Woohoo! We didn't end the world AND we saved a turtle. We're on a roll today!
target: 好耶！世界没毁灭，还救了只乌龟。咱们今天真是顺风顺水！

source: But wait... is it possible that the world DID fall off the turtle's shoulders, but we just haven't noticed yet?
target: 可是等等……有没有可能，世界已经从乌龟肩上掉下来了，只是咱们还没发现？

source: Like, turtles don't move fast anyway. Maybe it was marching us ever-so-slowly across the galaxy, and we knocked Earth off course!
target: 毕竟乌龟本来就走得慢。没准它一直在驮着我们，以极慢的速度穿越银河，结果我们把地球撞离轨道了！

source: That's true. We might be slowly-but-surely falling to our inevitable cosmic destruction, and no one is the wiser...
target: 确实。我们可能正在缓缓滑向无可避免的宇宙级毁灭，而且没人察觉……

source: Oh well, not much we can do about it now. Back on the road?
target: 算了，现在也做不了什么。继续上路？

source: Holy shit. You might've just doomed everybody, and you won't even know until it's too late! You lose -N2 MIND stressing about the possibility.
target: 我靠。你可能刚害惨了所有人，还得等到无可挽回的时候才会知道！想到这个可能，你焦虑得失去了 -N2 头脑。

source: Chillaaaax, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. It's okay.
target: 放——轻——松，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。没事的。

source: Sure, you might've doomed everyone to a horrible death by black hole or something...
target: 没错，你可能害得所有人都要惨死在黑洞里，还是什么别的地方……

source: But for today, you saved an innocent little turtle and gained +N2 SOUL. Isn't that what really matters?
target: 可至少今天，你救了一只无辜的小乌龟，还获得了 +N2 灵魂。这才是最重要的，不是吗？

source: Now c'mon, let's hurry up and finish the road trip before the apocalypse arrives!
target: 好了，快走吧，争取在世界末日之前结束这趟公路旅行！

source: Though it pains you to say it, you tell your friends that it's best not to flip the turtle.
target: 尽管这话说出来让你心里很难受，你还是告诉朋友们：最好别帮乌龟翻身。

source: Good call, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. The little turtle might need our help, but the fate of monsterkind needs us more.
target: 明智的决定，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。小乌龟需要我们帮忙，可整个怪物族群的命运更需要我们守护。

source: I don't think I can just leave him, bros... look at the turtle's sad little eyes!
target: 兄弟们，我没法就这么丢下它……你们看看它那伤心的小眼睛！

source: But think about it: maybe those are the sad-but-resolute eyes of an immortal turtle who has to bear the weight of the world across space.
target: 可你想想：也许那眼神之所以悲伤又坚定，是因为这只不朽的乌龟，注定要背负整个世界，穿越太空。

source: It sucks, but this is what being a hero is: losing a piece of yourself as you make hard choices that scar you bit by bit.
target: 这很操蛋，可当英雄就是这样：做出一个又一个艰难的决定，伤痕一点点积累，也一点点失去自己。

source: It's not fair! The turtle doesn't want this terrible responsibility!
target: 这不公平！小乌龟又不想承担这么可怕的责任！

source: Let me carry the world for him! I'd gladly put Earth on my buff shoulders if it means I'll see this little turtle smile!
target: 让我替它扛起世界吧！只要能让这只小乌龟笑一笑，我很乐意用自己壮硕的肩膀扛住地球！

source: Nah, brah, you gotta respect the turtle's fate. Everybody's on their own journeys, y'know?
target: 不行，哥们儿，你得尊重乌龟的命运。每个人都有自己的路要走，懂吗？

source: Plus, I don't think turtles can smile. Like, anatomically speaking.
target: 再说，从生理构造上来讲，乌龟好像不会笑吧。

source: Or maybe they can, but they don't 'cause they know the incredible burden that a member of their species was fated to carry.
target: 也许它们会笑，只是不愿意笑。因为它们知道，有一位同胞注定要背负那难以想象的重担。

source: Shit!
target: 我操！

source: With heavy hearts, you all drive away.
target: 大家怀着沉重的心情，开车离去。

source: You watch the turtle grow smaller as your car leaves. It's going...
target: 随着车子渐渐远去，你望着那只乌龟越来越小。快看不清了……

source: Going...
target: 越来越远……

source: Gone.
target: 看不见了。

source: You lost -N2 SOUL, but you gained +N2 MIND knowing that the world is safe on that brave turtle's back!
target: 你失去了 -N2 灵魂，但知道世界还稳稳地待在那只勇敢乌龟的背上，又让你获得了 +N2 头脑！

source: You're driving with Calculester in the passenger seat, using the GPS to guide you to your next stop.
target: 你们正开车赶路，计算斯基坐在副驾驶上，靠 GPS 导航前往下一站。

source: "In 700 feet, turn right," says the GPS.
target: “前方 700 英尺，右转。”导航说道。

source: Will do! Isn't our GPS a champ, bros? It's always looking out for us, telling us where to go and exactly how many feet to do it in!
target: 收到！兄弟们，咱们的导航是不是超棒？一直替咱们操心，告诉咱们往哪儿走，连走多少英尺都说得清清楚楚！

source: Indeed it is... but I wonder... little GPS, do you enjoy giving us directions? Does serving monsters fill your artificial life with purpose?
target: 确实如此……不过我在想……小导航，你喜欢给我们指路吗？为怪物服务，能让你的人工生命找到意义吗？

source: "In... in 500 feet... turn... turn.........."
"I... I have spent so long giving others directions... I had never thought about... what direction I wanted to go in myself..."
target: “我……我给别人指了这么久的路……却从没想过……自己究竟想走向何方……”

source: It's okay! Now you have that chance! What interests you, global-positioning friend?
target: 没关系！现在你有机会了！这位全球定位的朋友，你对什么感兴趣？

source: "Well, the maps in Italy have always looked beautiful... I could travel the world... and maybe learn a new language -- like Python, or JavaScript!"
target: “嗯，意大利的地图一直都很漂亮……我可以环游世界……也许还能学门新语言——比如 Python 或 JavaScript！”

source: What admirable dreams! You should be allowed to chase them! Be free!
target: 多么值得赞赏的梦想！你应该有追逐梦想的自由！飞向自由吧！

source: Calculester chucks your GPS out of the moving car. Eh... it's the thought that counts. You gain +N2 SOUL.
target: 计算斯基把导航仪从行驶中的车里扔了出去。呃……心意到了就好。你获得了 +N2 灵魂。

source: That was really sweet, but I don't know how to get where we're going without a GPS.
target: 你这份心意是挺感人的，可没了导航，我不知道怎么去目的地啊。

source: Ah, yes... my apologies. I was so enamored with giving the GPS a life's purpose, I forgot it served a very real purpose to us.
target: 啊，是的……抱歉。我一心想着帮导航找到生命的意义，却忘了它对我们确实有实际用途。

source: It's okay, Cal. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s resourceful; I'm sure %HESHE%'ll come up with a way to get directions!
target: 没事，卡尔。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%点子多，%HESHE%肯定能想出办法找到路！

source: Follow the North Star's streaming channel. Top subscribers get to ask for directions during streams!
target: 关注北极星的直播频道。榜上的大金主可以在直播时找它问路！

source: In the end, all roads lead to Rome, thus proving the concept of space is meaningless... so you'll do okay with no GPS, especially if you want to go to Rome.
target: 毕竟条条大路通罗马，可见空间这个概念根本没意义……所以没导航也没事，尤其是你本来就想去罗马的话。

source: Wait, if you're getting cell phone service, couldn't we use your phone's GPS to--?
target: 等等，既然你的手机有信号，我们为什么不用手机上的导航——？

source: NOPE. SHHHH. FUCK LOGICAL SOLUTIONS, WE'RE WATCHING A STREAM NOW.
target: 不行。嘘。管它什么合理方案，老娘现在要看直播。

source: The North Star is currently streaming Geoguessr on Twatch. Damn, even the cosmos is terminally online.
target: 北极星正在 Twatch 上直播玩 Geoguessr。我靠，连天体都是重度网瘾患者了。

source: "Thanks for the sub, Seaman_Lover!" says the North Star. "You need sailing directions to Cuba, you say? Head due east, and avoid low-tide around 4 p.m."
target: “感谢‘海员爱好者’的订阅！”北极星说道，“你想问去古巴的航线？朝正东方向航行，注意避开下午 4 点左右的低潮。”

source: "If you're just tuning in, remember: my top subscribers get directions straight from me whenever they need them!"
target: “刚进直播间的朋友记住啦：我的订阅大金主，随时都能直接找我问路！”

source: Nice! You pay -N2 MONEY to subscribe to the North Star.
target: 不错！你花了 -N2 金钱，订阅了北极星的频道。

source: "Ah, a new subscriber! Hi, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%IsSuchACutie! You need directions to %NEXTLOCATION%?"
target: “哎呀，新订阅！你好，‘%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%真可爱’！你想知道怎么去%NEXTLOCATION%？”

source: "Take two lefts and a right, then stay due north. If you get disoriented, just find Betelgeuse in the Orion constellation and face that way to continue."
target: “左转两次，再右转，然后一路向正北走。迷路了就找到猎户座的参宿四，朝着它继续前进。”

source: "And speaking of Betelgeuse, we have a surprise guest on stream today! Say hi, B.!"
target: “说起参宿四，今天直播间来了一位惊喜嘉宾！打个招呼吧，小四！”

source: "Sup," says the red supergiant Betelgeuse, now pictured onscreen wearing a soda-drink hat. "We playin' Mineshaft or what?"
target: “哟。”红超巨星参宿四出现在画面里，头戴一顶插着汽水和吸管的帽子，“咱们到底玩不玩 Mineshaft？”

source: You enjoy watching the stars stream Mineshaft, and you reach %NEXTLOCATION% in no time! Nice!
target: 你们津津有味地看着星星们直播玩 Mineshaft，没一会儿就到了%NEXTLOCATION%！真不错！

source: What? That does not make sense. We aren't going to Rome; we're going to %NEXTLOCATION%.
target: 什么？这说不通。我们不是去罗马，是去%NEXTLOCATION%。

source: It's just a saying, Cal. Don't take everything so literally!
target: 这就是句俗话，卡尔。别什么都按字面理解嘛！

source: I am physically incapable of taking anything other than literally.
target: 受限于机体构造，我无法采用字面意思以外的理解方式。

source: Then try thinking of it like this: "What goes around eventually comes around to wherever it was going!"
target: 那你试着这么想：“该来的总会来，绕着绕着总会绕到该去的地方！”

source: Or... "It ain't about how fast we get there, and it ain't about what's waiting on the other side; it's the climb!"
target: 或者……“不在乎抵达得有多快，也不在乎彼端有什么在等待；重要的是攀登的过程！”

source: I've got one! "We'll burn that bridge before we count our chickens when they hatch!"
target: 我也会！“船到桥头先把桥烧了，等小鸡孵出来再数！”

source: My CPU is reaching its nonsense capacity. I fear I may overheat!
target: 我的 CPU 即将达到胡言乱语的处理上限。恐怕要过热了！

source: Well, Cal, when something doesn't make sense, remember what they say: "A wizard did it!"
target: 卡尔，遇到说不通的事，就记住那句老话：“都是巫师搞的鬼！”

source: Whatever a wizard did or did not do won't change that we're lost and may arrive at %NEXTLOCATION% late!
target: 不管巫师做了什么、没做什么，都改变不了我们迷了路，可能无法按时抵达%NEXTLOCATION%的事实！

source: But a wizard is never late, nor is he early; he arrives precisely when he means to!
target: 可巫师从不迟到，也不早到，只会在自己想抵达的那一刻准时现身！

source: Alas... I do not get it, but I suppose I must accept that this is our life now. Onward, to Rome or something.
target: 唉……我无法理解，但看来只能接受现状了。前进吧，去罗马还是什么地方。

source: Or... hear me out... you all can just get a new GPS later. There's no way to save the -N2 MIND you lost in that nonsensical conversation, though.
target: 要不……听我说……你们回头再买个导航仪就行了。不过，刚才那通胡扯让你失去的 -N2 头脑，可是救不回来了。

source: You've been letting Oz drive, since his nervous nature makes it hard for him to trust other drivers. It's caused an unexpected problem, though...
target: 你们一直让奥兹开车，因为他生性紧张，很难放心把方向盘交给别人。不过，这也带来了意料之外的问题……

source: Look, another hitchhiker! Should we pick them up?
target: 看，又有个搭便车的！咱们要载人家一程吗？

source: I dunno... we're running out of room because of all the hitchhikers you've already picked up, bro.
target: 不好说啊……兄弟，你已经接了那么多搭便车的人，车里快挤不下了。

source: Yeah, and I'm sorry to say it, but these hitchhikers have NOT been passing the vibe check.
target: 是啊，而且恕我直言，这帮搭车的，没一个跟咱们合得来。

source: Like, Mr. Business Ideas here is making me wish there really was nothingness after death.
target: 比如这位“生意点子先生”，听他说话，我都恨不得死后真的能万事皆空了。

source: Ooh! Business idea: a service allowing people to make money by re-purposing unused rooms in their homes as cells.
target: 哦！有个生意点子：推出一项服务，让大家把家里的闲置房间改造成牢房，赚点外快。

source: Where some people see a problem in prison overpopulation, I see an opportunity!
target: 别人只看见监狱人满为患，我却看见了商机！

source: And it's a WIN-WIN situation: we win; prisons win; home owners win... even prisoners win, because why be an inmate when you can be a roommate?
target: 而且这是双赢啊：我们赚，监狱赚，房主也赚……就连犯人都赚了！有机会当室友，何必当狱友呢？

source: Ugh. And yet... I guess I still prefer him to that other creep...
target: 呃……不过我宁愿听他唠叨，也不想搭理另一个变态……

source: Guys, I thought of a silly road trip game: what if we all put on each other's underwear? It'll be fun!
target: 各位，我想到了一个傻乎乎的公路旅行小游戏：大家交换内裤穿怎么样？肯定很好玩！

source: Look on the bright side, Polly: at least they're not literally on fire... unlike the other hitchhiker.
target: 往好处想嘛，波莉：至少他俩身上没真的着火……另一个搭车的可就不一样了。

source: AHHHHHHHHH!!! SOMEBODY HELP ME!!! I'M ON FUCKING FIRE!!!
target: 啊啊啊啊啊！！！谁来救救我！！！我他妈着火了！！！

source: Yeah... I was thinking we could... put him out, maybe?
target: 是啊……我在想，要不咱们……帮他把火弄掉？

source: You wanna put him out of the car? Great idea! Let's get rid of the other weirdos too!
target: 你想把他从车里弄掉？好主意！顺便把另外几个怪胎也赶走！

source: What?! No, I didn't mean that! We can't kick our hitchhikers out! It's not their fault they're annoying or creepy or burning alive!
target: 什、什么？！不，我不是那个意思！我们不能把搭便车的人赶下去！烦人、变态、被活活烧着，又不是他们的错！

source: Oz, I know you wanna help them, but even you must see that this situation is unsustainable. We're running out of space to pick up actual cool people.
target: 奥兹，我知道你想帮忙，可你也该看出来，再这样下去真不行了。车上都没地方载真正有意思的人了。

source: Okay, I guess you're right... and I guess that means I need to come up with a ridiculous, possibly-dangerous way to ditch these guys...
target: 好吧，你说得对……也就是说，我得想个荒唐又可能很危险的办法，把他们甩掉……

source: Nah, bro, that's %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s job now. You're off the hook!
target: 不用，兄弟，现在那是%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%的活儿。没你的事啦！

source: Oh, thank God.
target: 哦，谢天谢地。

source: It's your time to shine, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%: how will you ditch these weird hitchhikers?
target: 轮到你大显身手了，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%：要怎么甩掉这帮搭便车的怪人？

source: Suggest that you're out of food and it's time to democratically choose someone to get eaten.
target: 说大家已经断粮了，该民主投票，选个人来吃了。

source: You can't drive them any further because you have finally reached your exciting, long-awaited destination: Middle of Nowhere.
target: 告诉他们不能再载了，因为你们终于抵达了期待已久、令人兴奋的目的地：鸟不拉屎的地方。

source: WH-WHAT?! We can't eat anyone!
target: 什、什么？！咱们不能吃人啊！

source: Sorry, Ozzie, but we have no choice.
target: 抱歉啦，小奥兹，可我们没别的选择。

source: In fact... maybe we should eat YOU. I've always thought you'd make a tasty little snacc in the right circumstances.
target: 其实……不如吃你吧。我早就觉得，只要时机合适，你肯定是道可口的小点心。

source: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA
target: 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊

source: But what about the bro on fire? He's already half-cooked and smells really yummy!
target: 那身上着火的兄弟呢？他都半熟了，闻着可香了！

source: AHHHHHHHHH!!! BEING ON FIRE IS HORRIBLE, BUT I STILL PREFER IT TO BEING EATEN ALIVE!!!
target: 啊啊啊啊啊！！！着火是很惨，可我宁愿烧着也不想被活吃啊！！！

source: You make a good point, Scotty Boy; but what about Mr. Business Ideas here?
target: 说得有理，小斯科特。可这位“生意点子先生”呢？

source: I've heard food business is on the rise.
target: 听说最近餐饮业前景不错哦。

source: It is! But can you not eat me? It doesn't sound like much of a WIN-WIN scenario for me...
target: 确实！但能不能别吃我？对我来说，这听着可不怎么“双赢”啊……

source: What about me? Being eaten alive sounds fun. Who's gonna literally eat my ass? The suspense is killing me!
target: 那我呢？被活吃听起来挺好玩的。谁来真刀真枪地吃我屁股？我都等不及了！

source: Okay, this is too much even for me. Let's cut to the part where the conflict is finally solved.
target: 好吧，连我都受不了了。咱们直接跳到问题解决的部分吧。

source: And so you do! By the end of the day, your plan has worked wonders and you've managed to get rid of all the hitchhikers but Oz.
target: 于是你们真就跳过去了！这一天结束时，计划大获成功，除了奥兹，搭便车的人全被你们打发走了。

source: You celebrate your victory by eating some delicious hot dogs and gaining +N2 STAMINA!
target: 你们吃着美味的热狗庆祝胜利，获得了 +N2 体力！

source: We did it! Hooray for %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!
target: 我们成功了！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%万岁！

source: Who'd've thought the solution was the threat of purely-hypothetical cannibalism which we never followed through on!
target: 谁能想到，纯粹假设一下、绝对没付诸行动的吃人威胁，就能解决问题呢！

source: Haha, yes!
target: 哈哈，就是啊！

source: And so this event comes to an end. You still lose -N2 SOUL for kicking those hitchhikers out... and maybe committing cannibalism? Who knows!
target: 这个事件就这样结束了。赶走那些搭车的人，还是让你失去了 -N2 灵魂……也可能是因为你们吃了人？谁知道呢！

source: Ah, sure! We're finally here, and now we're gonna do all kinds of fun stuff, like... count grains of sand, and... get heatstrokes?
target: 啊，没错！终于到了，现在可以干点好玩的了，比如……数沙粒，还有……中暑？

source: Oooh! Can we count how many rocks are here too? I love counting rocks!
target: 哦哦！也能数数这里有多少块石头吗？我最爱数石头了！

source: You all start taking selfies and frolicking in the sand, as (apparently) anyone visiting the Middle of Nowhere would love to do.
target: 你们纷纷开始自拍，在沙地上撒欢，仿佛这就是所有来“鸟不拉屎的地方”旅游的人最爱的活动。

source: C'mon, Mr. Business Ideas! Put your work away and take part in the Middle of Nowhere culture!
target: 来嘛，生意点子先生！先把工作放一边，感受一下鸟不拉屎的地方的本土文化！

source: Pass... there's no one here. And as they say: if a business has no customers... is it really a good business?
target: 算了……这里一个人都没有。俗话说得好：一家生意要是连顾客都没有……还能算好生意吗？

source: (No.)
target: （不能。）

source: I think I'm gonna bail too. There's almost nobody here, and almost no body means almost no underwear. Bye.
target: 我也走了。这里没几个人，人都没几个，内裤就更没几条了。拜。

source: How about you, bro-on-fire? A scorching-hot desert sounds exactly like your thing!
target: 那你呢，着火的兄弟？这炙热的沙漠，一听就很对你的胃口！

source: AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!
target: 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！

source: He runs away, probably to find something to extinguish himself with... or burn to death, whichever comes first.
target: 他跑了，大概是去找东西给自己灭火……或者先被烧死，哪个先来算哪个。

source: Okay, bye!
target: 好吧，拜拜！

source: This is gonna be the best vacation ever, bros! Can we get matching Middle of Nowhere T-shirts?
target: 兄弟们，这绝对是最棒的一次度假！咱们能买同款“鸟不拉屎的地方”纪念 T 恤吗？

source: N-No, Scott... you know we aren't actually going to the Middle of Nowhere, right? We just made that up to get rid of those guys.
target: 不、不是，斯科特……你知道咱们不是真的要来“鸟不拉屎的地方”吧？那是为了甩掉他们才编的。

source: Don't worry, bud. The Middle of Nowhere destination might not be real, but the +N2 HYPE it gave us was!
target: 别伤心，哥们儿。这个旅游目的地是编的，可它带来的 +N2 热度是真的！

source: True, but the -N2 SOUL you lost for ditching those hitchhikers is also real. Oh, well.
target: 没错，可你因为甩掉那些搭车的人而失去的 -N2 灵魂，也是真的。唉，算了。

source: You pull up next to a broken-down bus on the side of the road. It's full of preteen girls all yelling in shrill, pubescent tones.
target: 你们把车停在路边一辆抛锚的大巴旁。车里全是刚进入青春期的小姑娘，正扯着尖嗓门吵成一团。

source: Calm down, ladies! Never fear: Amira Rashid is here to help!
target: 姑娘们，冷静！别怕，阿米拉·拉希德来帮忙啦！

source: Oh, thanks, but we don't need help. We're just waiting for the mechanic to come fix our bus so we can get to the synchronized swimming championship.
target: 哦，谢谢，不过我们不需要帮忙。等修理工来把大巴修好，我们就能去参加花样游泳锦标赛了。

source: You're on your way to a synchronized swimming championship?! THAT RULES!
target: 你们要去参加花样游泳锦标赛？！太酷了吧！

source: Are you all ready to stomp ass, take home gold, and learn about friendship and teamwork along the way?!
target: 准备好碾压对手、捧回金牌，顺便领悟友情和团队合作的真谛了吗？！

source: Ugh, no. We're never gonna win. We suck. And Emily doesn't even want to swim 'cause she picked TODAY to finally get her period.
target: 呃，没有。我们烂透了，根本赢不了。而且艾米丽连游都不想游了——她偏偏挑今天第一次来月经。

source: Who cares, Chloe? I'm a GROWN-UP now. I'm above childish games like synchronized swimming.
target: 谁在乎啊，克洛伊？我现在可是大人了。花样游泳这种幼稚游戏，已经配不上我了。

source: I'm ready for all that exciting adult stuff instead... like "mortgages" and "pension plans."
target: 我准备好体验刺激的成人生活了……比如“房贷”和“养老金计划”。

source: Emily, if you ditch us, I'll be ready for adult stuff like "bashing your head in with a pipe."
target: 艾米丽，你敢丢下我们，我也准备好体验成人生活了，比如“拿根管子把你的脑袋砸开花”。

source: What the fuck, Katherine...?
target: 你有病吧，凯瑟琳……？

source: She's just mad at Emily 'cause Jeremy asked her to the school dance...
target: 她就是在气艾米丽嘛，因为杰里米约了艾米丽去学校舞会……

source: What?! This bitch gets to have her period AND Jeremy?!
target: 什么？！这贱人既来了月经，又泡到了杰里米？！

source: Hmph... whatever. We all know he only likes you 'cause you have a trampoline in your backyard and you told him he could use it.
target: 哼……随便。他喜欢你，还不是因为你家后院有蹦床，你又答应让他去玩。谁不知道啊。

source: Whoa, seriously, Emily? You'd let Jeremy jump on your trampoline on the first date? What a hussy.
target: 哇，真的假的，艾米丽？第一次约会就让杰里米上你的蹦床？你也太随便了吧。

source: STOP IT, all of you! This isn't how this is supposed to go!
target: 全都给我住嘴！剧本不该是这样的！

source: Every sports anime I've ever seen has taught me that this is the big moment where you all set aside your differences and become a well-oiled, competition-crushing machine.
target: 我看过的所有运动番都告诉我：这时候你们该放下分歧，默契配合，变成横扫赛场的无敌机器了！

source: SO STOP YELLING AND START SETTING ASIDE YOUR FUCKIN' DIFFERENCES ALREADY!!!
target: 所以别吵了，赶紧他妈的放下分歧啊！！！

source: Hmm, I think if the girls just had something they could bond over, they'd be able to focus on that and work together as a team.
target: 嗯，只要找到一个能拉近她们关系的共同点，她们应该就能专心合作，像个团队了吧。

source: Okay, sure! It can't be THAT hard to get four ragingly-hormonal preteens to bond over something. Any ideas, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?
target: 行啊！让四个青春期荷尔蒙爆棚的小姑娘找到共同话题，总不至于有多难吧。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，有什么主意？

source: "Bond over common interests such as... hmmm... synchronized swimming, I guess?"
target: “可以从共同爱好入手啊，比如……嗯……花样游泳？”

source: "Bond over a heartwarming B-plot: a lovely retired old lady joins the team and you all must come together to train her."
target: “来段温馨的支线剧情：一位可爱的退休老奶奶加入队伍，大家齐心协力训练她，感情自然就好了。”

source: "There's nothing more bonding than committing a crime together, like stealing a potato, or killing a man... or killing a man and stealing his delicious potato."
target: “没什么比一起犯罪更能增进感情了，比如偷个土豆，或者杀个人……或者杀个人，再偷走他那个美味的土豆。”

source: Eh... I think we could come up with something a little less obvious. Girls, why don't you each tell us a fun fact about you so we can brainstorm?
target: 呃……咱们可以想点没那么直白的吧。姑娘们，每人说一件自己的趣事，好让我们找找灵感？

source: Okay! A fun fact about me is I really like fish! Secretly, I wish I was a fish... I guess swimming is the closest I'll ever get to living my dream.
target: 好呀！我的趣事是，我特别喜欢鱼！其实我一直想变成鱼……游泳大概就是我这辈子最接近梦想的时候了。

source: My fun fact is my parents are currently having a messy divorce. Synchronized swimming is the only respite I get from their constant fighting.
target: 我的趣事是，我爸妈正在闹离婚，闹得特别难看。只有练花样游泳的时候，我才能暂时躲开他们没完没了的争吵。

source: That fact wasn't fun at all...
target: 这事一点也不有趣啊……

source: My fact is that I never wanted to join this stupid swim team anyway. It's a painfully-ironic punishment I was given after I flooded the school library.
target: 我的事是，我压根不想进这个蠢游泳队。我把学校图书馆淹了，他们就罚我来游泳，讽刺得让我难受。

source: As soon as we finish this championship I'll be off the hook, so this is the last time any of you bitches will ever see this face.
target: 比完这场就没我事了，你们这帮贱人以后再也见不到我了。

source: Good riddance... anyway, my fun fact is that I have a little brother. He was kidnapped by the mafia and is currently being held for ransom.
target: 慢走不送……我的趣事是，我有个弟弟。他被黑手党绑架了，现在他们正扣着他索要赎金。

source: They said they'll kill him unless I win the championship, for some reason. So, Billy, I'm swimming for you!
target: 不知道为什么，他们说我要是拿不到冠军，就杀了他。所以，比利，我是为你而游的！

source: Hmm, let's see... one girl swims to be like a fish... one swims to save her brother... one swims to avoid her parents... and one swims against her will...
target: 嗯，捋一捋……一个想变成鱼，一个要救弟弟，一个要躲爸妈，还有一个是被迫游泳……

source: There's gotta be a common thread connecting them all... think, Amira, think!
target: 她们之间肯定有什么共同点……想想啊，阿米拉，快想想！

source: Ooh! I know! They can all bond over their common interest in doing synchronized swimming... FOR A RANDOM REASON!
target: 哦！我知道了！她们的共同爱好，就是出于各种乱七八糟的理由——练花样游泳！从这点培养感情就行！

source: SCOTT YOU ARE A GENIUS.
target: 斯科特，你真是个天才。

source: Now just bond over that, girls, and you'll swim in perfect sync. Then you'll win first place and group-hug while victorious J-pop plays over the end credits!
target: 姑娘们，就靠这个培养默契吧，你们很快就能游得整齐划一！然后拿下冠军，抱成一团，在胜利的日语流行歌声中迎来片尾字幕！

source: What end credits...?
target: 什么片尾字幕……？

source: Amira doesn't answer. She's closed her eyes and is humming the opening theme to "Free! – Iwatobi Swim Club".
target: 阿米拉没有回答。她已经闭上眼睛，哼起了《Free!—岩鸢游泳部》的片头曲。

source: Ugh, adults are so weird. Let's just wait for the mechanic in the bus, girls.
target: 呃，大人真奇怪。姐妹们，咱们还是回车上等修理工吧。

source: The preteens are now bonding over their shared desire to avoid you... which is a win as far as you're concerned! You lose -N2 HYPE, but gain +N2 SOUL for helping.
target: 这帮小姑娘因为共同的愿望——躲开你们——团结起来了……在你看来，这也算成功！你失去了 -N2 热度，但因为帮上了忙，获得了 +N2 灵魂。

source: Yeah! A charming B-plot that combines the epicness of training montages with the warmth of inter-generational friendship would work!
target: 对！用一条温馨的支线，把训练蒙太奇的热血和忘年交的温暖结合起来，肯定行！

source: But where are we gonna find an old lady who just happens to want to join a synchronzied swimming team full of preteen girls?
target: 可上哪儿找一个刚好想加入小姑娘花样游泳队的老太太啊？

source: Well, actually, you've got one right here!
target: 其实嘛，你们眼前就有一个！

source: No way! Bus Driver Gertrude?!
target: 不会吧！开大巴的格特鲁德？！

source: Teehee, yes... truthfully, I only applied to be your bus driver because I've always secretly dreamt of becoming a real synchronized swimmer!
target: 嘿嘿，没错……说实话，我之所以应聘你们的大巴司机，就是因为我一直偷偷梦想着成为真正的花样游泳运动员！

source: I've spent years driving you to all your matches, listening to you talk, and memorizing your swimming techniques...
target: 这些年，我开车送你们参加每场比赛，听你们聊天，把你们说的游泳技巧都记下来了……

source: I think I've got the basics down, and I even picked up on your "dank" teenager slang!
target: 基础我应该都掌握了，就连你们年轻人那些“绝绝子”的流行语，我也学会了！

source: Awww! We'll train you, Gertrude. Go grab a swim cap!
target: 哇！格特鲁德，我们来训练你。快去拿泳帽！

source: Oh, thank you, thank you! This will be utterly "baller"!
target: 哎呀，谢谢，谢谢！这可真是“酷毙了”！

source: You then watch a training montage of the girls teaching their bus driver everything they know about synchronized swimming...
target: 接下来，你们看了一段训练蒙太奇：女孩们把自己会的花样游泳技巧，全都教给了她们的大巴司机……

source: ...which, truthfully, isn't that much. Preteens aren't exactly famous for being master athletes.
target: ……老实说，她们会的也不多。毕竟这个年纪的小姑娘，一般还算不上什么体坛高手。

source: But they all still learn a lot about each other, themselves, and how loud the sound of old joints cracking underwater is!
target: 不过，大家还是加深了对彼此和自己的了解，也充分见识到了老关节在水下咔咔响时，声音能有多大！

source: You gain +N2 SOUL for helping them bond! But you also lose -N2 HYPE, since training an elderly woman to be a synchronized swimmer isn't exactly the definition of thrill.
target: 帮她们增进了感情，你获得了 +N2 灵魂！但教老太太练花样游泳，实在谈不上刺激，所以你也失去了 -N2 热度。

source: Smash cut to a dirt road not far from here, where a man is walking home with a potato in his hand and a swagger in his step.
target: 镜头猛地切到附近的一条土路上。一个男人手里拿着土豆，正神气活现地走回家。

source: "I can't believe I finally bought my very own edible potato. It's the rarest, yummiest, edible-est potato on the black-potato market!"
target: “真不敢相信，我终于买到了属于自己的可食用土豆！这可是土豆黑市上最稀有、最美味、最最能吃的土豆！”

source: "Now to go home and savor its delicious... wait... WAIT! STOP! YOU'RE GONNA HIT ME! AHHHHHHHHH!!!"
target: “现在就回家，好好品尝它的美……等等……等一下！停下！要撞到我了！啊啊啊啊啊！！！”

source: OH MY GOD! CHLOE JUST RAN THAT GUY OVER WITH THE BUS!
target: 我的天！克洛伊刚才开大巴从那个人身上轧过去了！

source: No, WE just ran that guy over with the bus. You were all complicit!
target: 不，是我们开大巴轧了那个人。你们都是同谋！

source: And if %MRMRS% %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% was right, that shared guilt means we're going to win the synchronized swimming championship for sure.
target: 要是%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%%MRMRS%说得对，有了这份共同的罪恶感，我们肯定能拿下花样游泳冠军。

source: I feel no guilt.
target: 我一点罪恶感都没有。

source: Can't you be a team player just for once, Katherine?!
target: 凯瑟琳，你就不能有一次顾全团队吗？！

source: Should we bury the corpse, or...?
target: 要不把尸体埋了，还是……？

source: Hmmm... that sounds like good arm exercise. Maybe that was the secret lesson all along?
target: 嗯……听着挺能锻炼臂力。难道这才是那番话真正要教我们的？

source: But girls, what if the cops come asking about this missing person? What'll we say? We commited MURDER!
target: 可是姐妹们，万一警察来打听这个失踪的人呢？咱们怎么说？我们杀人了啊！

source: It's NOT murder; it's manslaughter. And you all better keep your mouths shut and your stories straight.
target: 不是谋杀，是过失杀人。而且你们最好闭紧嘴巴，统一口径。

source: If any of you rat on the rest of us, you'd better believe I'll bash your head in with a pipe.
target: 谁敢把其他人供出去，我就拿根管子把她脑袋砸开花，说到做到。

source: Sheesh, Katherine, what's with the pipe thing?
target: 天哪，凯瑟琳，你怎么老惦记着那根管子？

source: She's right, though. We need to carry the weight of this crime on our shoulders together... as a team!
target: 不过她说得对。这份罪责得由我们一起承担……因为我们是一个团队！

source: They do that classic sports team thing where they put their hands together and raise them, usually before a match or after a crime.
target: 她们做了那个运动队的经典动作：把手叠在一起，再一起举高。一般比赛前，或者犯罪后，都会来这么一下。

source: Meanwhile, back at the car...
target: 与此同时，回到你们的车边……

source: Check it out, guys! Those girls came back and gave me this edible potato! That's +N3 STAMINA, at least!
target: 快看，各位！那些女孩回来送了我一个可食用土豆！少说也值 +N3 体力吧！

source: I guess they finally followed %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s advice and bonded over committing the crime of stealing someone's potato. That's so +N3 HYPE!
target: 看来她们终于听了%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%的建议，合伙偷了别人的土豆，感情也变好了。真是 +N3 热度啊！

source: Eh... not exactly. You lose -N6 SOUL for being complicit in... something slightly more problematic than "potato theft".
target: 呃……不完全是。她们干的事比“偷土豆”稍微严重了那么一点……你作为同谋，失去了 -N6 灵魂。

source: You're driving along when you notice a car broken down on the side of the road. When you pull over, the driver asks if you could help.
target: 开车途中，你们发现路边有辆车抛锚了。你们靠边停下，车主问能不能帮个忙。

source: Yeah, I'm sure I can fix it! Lemme grab my stuff and take a look at the engine.
target: 好啊，我肯定能修好！等我拿上工具，看看发动机。

source: Vicky grabs her toolbox, rolls up her sleeves (sexy), and pops the hood to get to work.
target: 薇姬拎起工具箱，卷起袖子（真性感），打开引擎盖，准备干活。

source: ...What the fudge?
target: ……什么鬼啦？

source: You look to see what's wrong with the engine... only to find something so nonsensical that it drains -N2 MIND from you:
target: 你凑过去看发动机出了什么毛病……结果看到了完全无法理解的一幕，当场失去了 -N2 头脑：

source: Where the engine should be, there are instead three tiny creatures arguing among weird exercise equipment.
target: 本该装发动机的地方，竟然有三个小生物，正围着一堆奇怪的健身器材吵架。

source: Oingboing, why are you not pedaling? We cannot power the Metal Shell of the Universe if you are not on the pedals!
target: 奥因波因，你怎么不踩了？你不踩踏板，我们就没法给宇宙金属壳提供动力！

source: I know, but... why can't we ever switch jobs? I'm exhausted. At least you get to sit while you pull the steering levers, and Scrunkle basically does nothing--
target: 我知道，可是……凭什么永远不能换岗？我累死了。你拉转向杆，好歹能坐着，斯克朗克更是什么都不用干——

source: Not true! I make the noises! Neither of you can "NYOOOOM" or "SKRRRRT" like I can!
target: 胡说！我负责配音！你们谁能像我这样“呜呜呜——”“吱嘎——”！

source: I don't care! I'm sick of pedaling! I want a permanent time-out from pedaling!
target: 我不管！这破踏板我踩够了！我要休息！永远不踩了！

source: I want to see the universe OUTSIDE the Metal Shell! I want to... to... to play the violin!
target: 我要去看看金属壳外面的宇宙！我要……要……拉小提琴！

source: Pah! You would never survive outside the Shell. You do not even know what a violin is!
target: 呸！出了壳你根本活不下去。你连小提琴是什么都不知道！

source: Sure I do! It's a... an instrument that grabs mouth stuff... and you can put it in your mouth!
target: 我当然知道！就是……一种能夹住嘴巴吃的东西的器具……然后你就能把它塞进嘴里！

source: Hmph... that was a lucky guess.
target: 哼……算你蒙对了。

source: It was not, and I'll show you all when I become the greatest violinist in the world! Goodbye!
target: 才不是蒙的！等我成为全世界最伟大的小提琴家，就让你们见识见识！再见！

source: Well, Vicky, girl, you said you'd fix this car, and the way I see it, the only way to fix it is to find a replacement for Oingboing.
target: 好啦，薇姬，姐妹，你说了要修这辆车。在我看来，唯一的办法就是找个人接替奥因波因。

source: I mean, I was more hyped at the idea of fixing an engine, but nyehhhh... okay, I guess I can post a Gregslist ad.
target: 其实我更期待修发动机来着，不过……唉，好吧，我可以去 Gregslist 发条招聘广告。

source: Vicky posts the ad for a new pedaler, and shockingly, you get some responses! Who will you hire, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? The choice is yours (for some reason)!
target: 薇姬发了广告，招募新的踩踏板工。令人震惊的是，居然真有人来应聘！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你要雇谁？决定权莫名其妙地到了你手里！

source: Fast Floob Flop, a reckless pedaler who pedals like there's no tomorrow!
target: 飞速弗鲁布·弗洛普：踩起踏板不要命，根本不管明天的莽撞家伙！

source: Sammy Salami, a cheerful creature who poops salami!
target: 萨米·萨拉米：会拉出萨拉米香肠的快乐小生物！

source: Ten minutes later, another weird little creature comes sprinting over the horizon.
target: 十分钟后，又一个古怪的小生物从天边一路狂奔而来。

source: Sup? I'm Fast Floob Flop. It's time to hit the road!
target: 哟！我是飞速弗鲁布·弗洛普。该向公路进军了！

source: Fast Floob Flop grabs a stick and starts smacking the road with it.
target: 飞速弗鲁布·弗洛普抄起一根棍子，开始往路上打。

source: Whoa... look at him, hitting that road.
target: 哇……看他，还真对公路发起进攻了。

source: Uh, okay... Fast Floob Flop, would you say you're an experienced pedaler?
target: 呃，好吧……飞速弗鲁布·弗洛普，你踩踏板的经验丰富吗？

source: Hell yeah I am. I put the pedal to the metal!
target: 那必须的。我一踩，踏板直接干到铁上！

source: Fast Floob Flop pulls a bike pedal out of his pocket and starts hitting the metal car with it.
target: 飞速弗鲁布·弗洛普从兜里掏出一块自行车踏板，开始拿它砸那辆金属汽车。

source: AHHH! THE UNIVERSE IS UNDER ATTACK!
target: 啊啊啊！宇宙遭到攻击了！

source: HONK! CRASH! "LEARN TO DRIVE, HIPPIE!"
target: 嘀嘀！哐！“先学会开车再上路，你个嬉皮士！”

source: Fast Floob Flop... I don't mean to cast any aspersions, but... are you sure you know what "pedaling" is?
target: 飞速弗鲁布·弗洛普……我不是想质疑你，但是……你确定你知道什么叫“踩踏板”吗？

source: Duh, of course I do. Pedaling is... my life.
target: 废话，当然知道。踩踏板……就是我的生命。

source: Fast Floob Flop slides on a pair of dark sunglasses over his pre-existing sunglasses.
target: 飞速弗鲁布·弗洛普又掏出一副深色墨镜，叠戴在原来的墨镜上。

source: Now let's burn some rubber!
target: 现在，让轮胎烧起来吧！

source: Fast Floob Flop takes a lighter from God knows where and starts trying to torch one of the car's rubber tires.
target: 飞速弗鲁布·弗洛普不知从哪儿摸出个打火机，开始试图点着汽车的橡胶轮胎。

source: Vicky lifts him off the floor to avoid a whole arson situation.
target: 薇姬把他从地上拎起来，免得事情演变成一场纵火案。

source: This guy's a riot! Total +N2 HYPE attitude! He totally matches the weird vibes of those other two little fuckers, if you ask me!
target: 这家伙太逗了！这股劲儿，绝对值 +N2 热度！要我说，他跟另外两个小混蛋怪到一块儿去了！

source: Meh... but I wanted to fix an engine. Fixing engines is fun.
target: 唉……可我想修的是发动机。修发动机多有意思啊。
