source: Trust me, Vicky: we've been helpful here. This car is as fixed as it's gonna get.
target: 信我，薇姬，咱们已经帮上忙了。这车能修到这份上，就算到头了。

source: Eh... I suppose so, yes. Still, I'd buy an actual engine if it were me.
target: 呃……也是。不过换成我，还是会买台真正的发动机。

source: The important thing is that our car has one, and not just three weirdos making noises.
target: 反正咱们车里有就行，里面又不是只有三个怪胎在配音。

source: ...Does it, though?
target: ……真的有吗？

source: You leave before Vicky tries to check under your car's hood. Sometimes it's better to live in blissful ignorance.
target: 趁薇姬还没掀开你们的引擎盖检查，你们赶紧走了。有时候，什么都不知道，反而更幸福。

source: Ten minutes later, a cheerful sausage-shaped creature comes waddling over the horizon.
target: 十分钟后，一个乐呵呵、长得像香肠的小生物，从天边摇摇摆摆地走了过来。

source: Hiya, kids! I'm Sammy Salami! Wanna try my homemade Salami-Butt Bites? They're sodium-tastic!
target: 嗨，孩子们！我是萨米·萨拉米！尝尝我自制的“屁屁萨拉米小脆块”？钠含量高得棒呆啦！

source: Sammy hands you some Salami-Butt Bites. They're pretty tasty despite the circumstances.
target: 萨米递给你一些屁屁萨拉米小脆块。虽然来路有点那啥，味道倒还不错。

source: Wait... I know the name Salami-Butt Bites from somewhere. Wasn't it a breakfast cereal?
target: 等等……屁屁萨拉米小脆块，这名字我好像听过。是不是一种早餐麦片？

source: It was! That was my previous job: I was the mascot for a salami-based kid's cereal that INEXPLICABLY failed to succeed.
target: 没错！那就是我的上一份工作：给一种萨拉米香肠做的儿童麦片当吉祥物。谁知道它莫名其妙就卖不动呢。

target: 打了个养神的小盹后，你获得了 +N2 头脑……不过一醒来，就发现路对面停着一辆和你们一模一样的车，只是颜色是蓝的。

target: “说个布赖恩的冷知识：他的下巴能完全脱开……然后从里面涌出一大群蜜蜂！”

target: 哼，有回我们去沙漠蹦迪，拜伦可是踩着真冲浪板，在人群头顶冲浪的！布赖恩玩过人群冲浪吗？用不用板都算！

target: 布赖恩尽显猛男风范，随手把“！”扔了，你们随后继续上路。

NO. WAY. That's so cool!

HALT, YOU BEAST! I don't care what deals you've made with this village; I won't let you hurt this woman!

target: ……什么？夏琳，这是怎么回事？没听你说还要叫别人一起啊。

target: 哦……看来我误会了，你们是在精心扮演某种情侣情境。实在惭愧。

target: 嗨，没事。说真的，“嗜血沙漠巨虫玷污村庄献上的祭品”这套，玩久了也有点腻了。

target: 哦，亲爱的，要不这次把人鱼骑士吃了，添点新鲜感？

target: “试试经典角色扮演：两个陌生人在酒吧邂逅……只是其中一个，真的是条巨型蠕虫。酒吧我们来提供！”

target: 这对伴侣决定去拜访沙漠巨虫的父亲。她们来到他的沙洞入口，敲了敲门。

target: 嗨，爸。好久不见了，是吧？

target: 我知道，对不起……我一直躲着你，是因为……嗯，我想介绍个人给你认识。这是我妻子。

target: 您好！我是夏琳。终于见到您了，真高兴！

target: “沃米尔达……这可真让我意外。你娶了个……长着两条腿的女人？她……好小啊。”

target: 我知道你希望我找条好蠕虫结婚，轮流让彼此怀孕，再给你生一大群虫孙孙。

target: 可今天我就要出沙丘、向你坦白了！夏琳虽然个头小，心胸却很宽广……而且我们相爱！

target: 的确……不过，我不太明白我们为什么也要跟来。总觉得自己格格不入。

target: 你是不是想说……自己像条离了水的鱼？

target: 那不如试试……交换角色？夏琳，这次你来当蠕虫，沃米尔达来当两条腿的人。

target: 幸亏你们平时胡闹，从来不讲逻辑！

source: With some stuff you had stored in the car and plenty of good will, you improvise a pop-up bar.
target: 你们拿出车里存的杂物，凭着满腔热情，临时拼出了一间酒吧。

source: Welcome to The Bar, Miss Not-a-Giant-Worm! I'm your bartender Scott. What can I get you to drink?
target: 欢迎来到“酒吧”，绝对不是巨虫小姐！我是酒保斯科特，您要喝点什么？

target: 请来杯伏特加苏打。再替我请那边那条性感的蠕虫喝一杯。

target: 您好，绝对是巨虫小姐！那边那位女士请您喝这个，您的老样子：朗姆酒兑泥土。

target: 谢谢你的酒，小可爱。你常来这家酒吧吗？

target: 常来，用我这两条腿走来的。它们走起路来有多低效，长得就有多性感。

target: 嗯，走路是慢了点，不过我相信，这两条腿还能派上别的用场……

target: ……比如做爱。

target: 这张嘴可真不老实！

target: 没错，我这张嘴就是这么不老实——而且按照蠕虫的生理构造，它跟我的肛门几乎没区别。

source: Really? I wouldn't mind... checking if that's true.
target: 真的？我不介意……亲自检查一下。

source: Oh, look, they're making out! Or... maybe eating ass? Hard to tell with Wormilda.
target: 哦，快看，她们亲上了！还是说……在舔屁眼？沃米尔达这构造，真不好分。

source: I don't understand why we also need to be here for this. I feel very out of place.
target: 我不明白，这种时候我们为什么也得在场。总觉得自己格格不入。

source: Would you say that you feel like... a fish out of water?
target: 你是不是想说……自己像条离了水的鱼？

source: You gain +N2 SOUL for helping this couple rekindle their spark! But you lose -N2 STAMINA from the alcohol you gave them to do so.
target: 帮这对伴侣重燃爱火，你获得了 +N2 灵魂！可为了助兴，把酒给了她们，你也失去了 -N2 体力。

source: You're driving along with Hope riding shotgun when you glimpse something strange and unidentifiable off in the distance.
target: 你们开车赶路，希望女巫坐在副驾驶上。忽然，你瞥见远处有什么奇怪的东西，一时认不出来。

source: Whoa, what is that? We have to pull over and see!
target: 哇，那是什么？必须停车看看！

source: Yup, that seems totally reasonable. You all get out of the car and walk a bit to find...
target: 行，这决定听着特别合理。你们全都下车，走过去一看……

source: Three old men bathing each other in an antique washtub?
target: 三个老爷爷，挤在一只老式浴桶里互相洗澡？

source: Hey.
target: 嗨。

source: Can someone pass the soap?
target: 谁帮我递一下肥皂？

source: WHAT?! Speak up, dammit!
target: 什么？！大点声，妈的！

source: OMG. These old men must be the oracle! They're three wise seers who can answer our questions about the future!
target: 我的天！这几位老人一定是先知！三位智慧的预言家，能回答我们有关未来的问题！

source: What? No. As a real seer, I'm offended; and as a practitioner of common sense, I'm SUPER offended. These guys aren't oracles at all!
target: 什么？不是。作为真正的预言家，我感到被冒犯了；作为有常识的人，我简直被冒犯透了。这几位根本不是先知！

source: We'll see about that! O wise old dudes: are you seers who will answer any three questions we ask?
target: 试试就知道啦！智慧的老伙计们：你们是能回答任意三个问题的先知吗？

source: No.
target: 不是。

source: Ah, seers, always speaking in riddles!
target: 啊，先知嘛，说话总是打哑谜！

source: Shit, I just wasted one of our questions! We only have two more. Scott, you ask one!
target: 靠，我刚浪费了一次提问！只剩两次了。斯科特，你问一个！

source: Hmm, okay... hey, seer bros, will there still be math in the future?
target: 嗯，好……先知兄弟们，未来还会有数学吗？

source: Probably.
target: 大概有吧。

source: Aw, nuts.
target: 唉，真倒霉。

source: Well, since Hope is a "skeptical Sally", that means you get to ask the third question, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!
target: 既然希望女巫非要当个怀疑精，那第三个问题就交给你啦，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！

source: Ask the oracle to look into a future they can surely see: ask what it will be like to be an old person.
target: 问先知一个他们肯定了解的未来：变成老人会是什么感觉？

source: Seek the Oracle's Endless Knowledge: ask how many people fit in the tub.
target: 向先知的无尽智慧求教：这只浴桶能挤下几个人？

source: That isn't even fortune-telling. That's just sharing an experience that happens to be placed in YOUR future. There's no MAGIC involved!
target: 这根本不叫预言。只是让他们分享人生经历，而那恰好是你将来的经历罢了。跟魔力没有半点关系！

source: Ohhh, then that's what they must be missing! I'll get them some MAGIC from the car so they can use their powers!
target: 哦——所以他们缺的就是这个！我去车里拿点魔力过来，他们就能施展本领了！

source: Scott pours -N2 MAGIC into the tub. If it wasn't weird enough that monsters use magic to power their cars, it apparently also doubles as bath salts!
target: 斯科特往浴桶里倒入了 -N2 魔力。怪物拿魔力给车供能就够怪了，没想到这玩意儿还能当浴盐用！

source: Thanks, sonny, that was kind of you. What were you askin' about again? What's it like to be old?
target: 谢谢啊，小伙子，真有心。你们刚才问什么来着？变老是什么感觉？

source: Well... your back hurts... and your joints hurt... and your knee hurts... whenever it rains... and also just in general...
target: 这个嘛……背也疼……关节也疼……膝盖也疼……一下雨就疼……不下雨也照样疼……

source: AND EVERYONE AROUND YOU STARTS TALKING QUIETER!
target: 而且身边所有人说话都越来越小声了！

source: There's also your loved ones dying, and the world you knew becoming "the past"...
target: 还有，亲人朋友陆续离去，熟悉的世界变成了“从前”……

source: ...but there's good things too.
target: ……不过，也有好处。

source: Like outgrowing your shame, allowing you to do fun stuff like take a bath in the middle of nowhere with your best friends!
target: 比如老了就不怕丢人了，想干点有趣的事就能干，像这样跟最好的朋友在荒郊野外泡个澡！

source: And salami. Getting to eat all the salami you want is a great part of being old.
target: 还有萨拉米香肠。想吃多少就吃多少，也是变老的一大好处。

source: Ooh, that's true! Everyone knows salami is a grown-up food!
target: 哦，说得对！谁都知道，萨拉米香肠是大人吃的东西！

source: Yep! And when you're old and retired, you can eat salami all day, every day! Even in the tub!
target: 没错！老了退休了，就能天天吃、从早吃到晚！泡澡也照吃！

source: Hey, I told you NOT to bring your salami into the tub! You'll get the water all greasy!
target: 喂，我不是叫你别把萨拉米香肠带进浴桶吗？水都要被你弄得油乎乎的了！

source: DID YOU SAY SALAMI?! PASS THAT SALAMI, WILBERT!
target: 你说萨拉米香肠？！维尔伯特，递点过来！

source: See, Hope? I told you these seers were full of wisdom about the future!
target: 看吧，希望女巫？我就说，这几位先知对未来有满肚子的智慧！

source: *sigh*...
Man, you can't wait to get old and take salami-baths! You gain +N2 MIND from the oracles' wisdom.
target: 哎呀，你已经迫不及待想变老，边吃萨拉米香肠边泡澡了！先知们的智慧让你获得了 +N2 头脑。

source: That isn't even fortune-telling. That's just using logic to reach a plausible conclusion. There's no MAGIC involved!
target: 这根本不叫预言。只是用逻辑得出合理的结论罢了。跟魔力没有半点关系！

source: Ohhh, then that's what they must be missing! I'll get them some MAGIC from the car so they can use their powers!
target: 哦——所以他们缺的就是这个！我去车里拿点魔力过来，他们就能施展本领了！

source: Scott pours -N2 MAGIC into the tub. If it wasn't weird enough that monsters use magic to power their cars, it apparently also doubles as bath salts!
target: 斯科特往浴桶里倒入了 -N2 魔力。怪物拿魔力给车供能就够怪了，没想到这玩意儿还能当浴盐用！

source: Thanks, sonny, that was kind of you. What were you askin' about again? How many people can fit in here?
target: 谢谢啊，小伙子，真有心。你们刚才问什么来着？这里能挤下几个人？

source: Well, in my long life, I've learned that the best answers are gained through experience. Let's find out how many it can fit together!
target: 我活了这么多年，悟出一个道理：最好的答案，要靠亲身实践。咱们一起试试，到底能挤下几个！

source: Ooh, group bath in the desert! I'm in!
target: 哦，沙漠集体泡澡！算我一个！

source: You, Polly, and Scott change into swimwear and get into the tub.
target: 你、波莉和斯科特换上泳装，挤进了浴桶。

source: Man, who would've thought bathing in the middle of nowhere could be so relaxing?
target: 谁能想到，在荒郊野外泡个澡，居然这么放松？

source: Yup! Life's full of simple pleasures like these. You learn to appreciate 'em when you get older.
target: 是啊！生活里到处都有这样简单的小乐趣。上了年纪，就懂得珍惜啦。

source: Well, SOMEONE hasn't learned that yet, apparently...
target: 不过，某个人显然还没学会呢……

source: ...Are you talking about me? I am NOT getting in a bath with you guys and three strange old men.
target: ……在说我？我才不要跟你们，还有三个陌生老头一起泡澡。

source: But it's so nice! And you seem stressed, Hope. What's better for stress than a warm bath?
target: 可是真的很舒服！希望女巫，你看起来压力好大。还有什么比泡个热水澡更解压呢？

source: I think she's just being prideful 'cause she doesn't wanna admit she was wrong about everything.
target: 我看她就是放不下面子，不想承认自己全说错了。

source: Ugh, it DOES look nice...
target: 唉，看着确实挺舒服的……

source: FINE! I'll get in. But if you ever tell anyone about this, your only future will be one filled with pain.
target: 行！我泡。但谁敢把这事说出去，我保证你以后的日子只有痛苦。

source: Yeah, whatever. Shut up and get in, gurl!
target: 行行行，少废话，快进来吧姐妹！

source: You all spend a while in the bath, gaining +N2 STAMINA from your relaxed muscles -- and you learn that the tub can fit at least seven people! The more you know!
target: 你们一起泡了会儿澡，放松的肌肉让你获得了 +N2 体力——还顺便证实了，这只浴桶至少能装下七个人！又长知识了！

source: Suddenly, four horseriding bandits come out of nowhere and box you all in! You're forced to stop the car.
target: 突然，四个骑马的劫匪不知从哪儿冲出来，把你们团团围住！你们被迫停了车。

source: We've got you surrounded! Come out with your hands up and your money out!
target: 你们被包围了！举起手来，把钱拿出来，给我下车！

source: Here, have this -N2 MONEY! It's ALL we have!
target: 给，拿着这 -N2 金钱！我们就这么多了！

source: (It's nooooooot.)
What about you, finn-guy? Give us your wallet!
target: 那个叫芬恩的，你呢？钱包交出来！

source: Eh, okay. Good luck with that.
target: 呃，行啊。祝你们好运。

source: Hey! There's nothing in here! Where's your money?
target: 喂！里面什么都没有！你的钱呢？

source: You can ask my boss. Maybe you'll have better luck than me.
target: 问我老板去吧。没准你们比我运气好。

source: You think you're funny, huh? Stop messing with us, or we'll make you regret it.
target: 觉得自己很幽默，是吧？别耍我们，不然有你好后悔的。

source: I doubt you can make me regret anything at this point. I have too many regrets already.
target: 我已经够后悔了，不觉得你们还能让我多后悔点什么。

source: And anyway, I'm not messing with anyone; I'm seriously broke. Most of my salary is paid in "experience".
target: 再说我没耍谁，我是真穷。我的工资，大部分都是拿“经验”抵的。

source: Wanna steal my "experience"? I wouldn't recommend it, 'cause it certainly wasn't a pleasant experience; but please, be my guests.
target: 想抢我的“经验”？不推荐，毕竟都不是什么愉快的经历。不过你们要想要，尽管拿去。

source: ...Hooray?
target: ……好耶？

source: Uh... look, we usually never ask our victims this, but... are you okay, bud?
target: 呃……虽然我们一般不问受害者这个，不过……哥们儿，你还好吗？

source: Heh... that question's above my pay grade.
target: 呵……我这点工资，可不负责回答这么难的问题。

source: (Polly, should we do something? Finn is really bumming me out...)
target: （波莉，咱们要不要做点什么？芬恩这样，搞得我也好难过……）

source: (We should absolutely do something. No negative nihilism allowed on this road trip! We gotta help Finn find meaning in life again!)
target: （必须做点什么。这趟公路旅行不许搞消极虚无那一套！得帮芬恩重新找到人生的意义！）

source: Okay, guess that's more important than stopping these guys from robbing you. How will you bring joy back to Finn's life?
target: 好吧，看来这比阻止他们抢你们还重要。要怎么让芬恩的生活重新有点快乐呢？

source: Finn is jaded by a life that's too mundane. He needs adventure... he needs to give himself over to a romantic life of banditry!
target: 芬恩是被平淡的生活磨麻木了。他需要冒险……需要投身浪漫的劫匪生涯！

source: Help Finn look for the something, anything that's truly valuable in his life... something worth being stolen!
target: 帮芬恩找找，他人生中究竟还有什么真正宝贵的东西……什么都行，至少得值得人家抢！

source: NOICE! I've been meaning to get into a life of crime! Let's do it!
target: 妙啊！我早就想走上犯罪道路了！干吧！

source: And so, without a second thought, you and your friends begin a life of banditry. You gain +N2 HYPE!
target: 于是，你们想都没想，就开始了劫匪生涯。你获得了 +N2 热度！

source: But one day, the bandits call you all in for a meeting.
target: 可有一天，劫匪们把你们叫去开会。

source: Listen, guys, we need to talk.
target: 各位，听着，咱们得谈谈。

source: We appreciate how much you've helped us commit crimes; but in the end, we welcomed you to our group because we were worried about Finn.
target: 你们帮忙犯了那么多案，我们很感激。不过说到底，让你们入伙，是因为我们担心芬恩。

source: Yeah, Finn seemed so jaded... so devoid of a spark in his life...
target: 对啊，芬恩看着太麻木了……生活里一点火花都没了……

source: We knew we had to do something, 'cause banditry isn't just about robbing people; it's about escaping the numbness of traditional society... by robbing people.
target: 我们知道不能坐视不管。做劫匪，图的不光是抢钱，也是要摆脱传统社会的麻木……靠抢钱来摆脱。

source: But we're still quite worried about you, Finn.
target: 可我们还是很担心你，芬恩。

source: About me? But I've been doing my best!
target: 担心我？可我一直很努力啊！

source: Exactly, that's the problem. You're just too efficient.
target: 对，问题就在这儿。你效率实在太高了。

source: You're working super hard to manage our finances, schedule our heists, and keep us on top of our tax fraud.
target: 管账、安排劫案、跟进偷税漏税的进度，你每样都做得特别卖力。

source: You've turned banditry into a 9-to-5 job.
target: 你把当劫匪干成了朝九晚五的上班。

source: But we've seen the passion you put in that... I'd say office work is to you what banditry is to us. Maybe what made you miserable wasn't your career... but your specific job.
target: 可我们也看得出来，你干这些事很有热情……对你来说，办公室工作就像抢劫之于我们。让你痛苦的，也许不是这行，而是现在这份工作。

source: Hmmm... that could be true. My boss there is a massive asshole.
target: 嗯……可能真是这样。我那个老板就是个大混蛋。

source: Ah, we know a thing or two about that. We used to have an awful boss, but then we staged a mutiny and stabbed him. Like... a lot.
target: 啊，这方面我们熟。以前我们老板也烂透了，后来我们造了反，把他捅了。捅了……好多刀。

source: Have you tried stabbing your boss, Finn? Sometimes that does the trick.
target: 芬恩，试过捅你老板吗？有时候真管用。

source: ...Stabbing my boss probably wouldn't reflect well in my yearly performance review.
target: ……捅了老板，我的年度绩效考核大概不会太好看。

source: Fair enough. Then I hope you eventually find a better boss, one that brings the thrill of menial office work back into your heart.
target: 也是。那希望你早日找到个好老板，让你重新爱上办公室里那些琐碎杂活。

source: Well, that was fun while it lasted. You part ways with the bandits and hit the road again... but you don't get back the MONEY they stole from you.
target: 好吧，这段日子玩得还挺开心。你们告别劫匪，重新上路……不过，被抢的金钱是拿不回来了。

source: Good thinking, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! Surely Finn has something valuable other than MONEY (which he has none of)!
target: 好主意，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！除了金钱，芬恩肯定还有别的宝贝——毕竟钱他是一分没有！

source: What about a meaningful memento from Finn's mother; something nostalgic -- and very expensive -- that reminds him of the motherland...
target: 有没有芬恩妈妈留的纪念品？要有纪念意义，很怀旧——还很贵——能让他想起故土的那种……

source: Like her credit card! That glorious card which brought you so much wealth and happiness as a boy... got anything like that?
target: 比如她的信用卡！那张神奇的卡，在你小时候给你带来了多少财富和幸福啊……有这种东西吗？

source: Eh... no.
target: 呃……没有。

source: What about your tie, Finn? It's a key part of your whole "it's Monday at the office and I'm dead inside" aesthetic, so it must be important to you.
target: 芬恩，你的领带呢？你那一整套“周一来上班，心里已死透”的造型，全靠它点睛，它对你一定很重要吧。

source: ...What?
target: ……什么？

source: You guys have it all wrong! Finn's biggest wealth isn't material; it's SPIRITUAL.
target: 你们都搞错了！芬恩最宝贵的财富，不是物质，是精神上的。

source: Finn may feel miserable in his day-to-day life, but he still finds meaning in rare, precious moments amidst the routine...
target: 日复一日的生活可能让芬恩痛苦，可他依然能在平淡中那些罕见而珍贵的瞬间，找到意义……

source: An unforgettable night out with the co-workers; a moment of camaraderie in the office; even escaping his routine by hitting the road with us...
target: 跟同事一起度过难忘的夜晚，在办公室感受到彼此的情谊，或者像这样暂时跳出日常，跟我们一起上路……

source: ...those moments make everything else worth it.
target: ……正是这些瞬间，让其余一切都变得值得。

source: Sure... but that touchy-feely shit isn't something we can resell for profit, so I guess we're taking the tie.
target: 行吧……可这些煽情的玩意儿没法转手卖钱，所以我们还是拿领带吧。

source: The bandits leave with your MONEY and Finn's tie.
target: 劫匪们拿着你们的金钱和芬恩的领带走了。

source: Well, there goes my favorite tie... good thing I have twelve identical ones.
target: 得，我最喜欢的领带没了……幸好还有十二条一模一样的。

source: And hey, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%: I should thank you.
target: 对了，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，我得谢谢你。

source: Your words made me think: I focus so much on the things I hate in life that I've forgotten to cherish the things I love. Thanks!
target: 你那番话让我想明白了：我总盯着生活里讨厌的事，反倒忘了珍惜自己喜欢的东西。谢谢！

source: You're rewarded with a rare, hopeful smile from Finn, and +N2 SOUL!
target: 芬恩难得露出了一个满怀希望的微笑。你收获了这份回报，还有 +N2 灵魂！

source: You're driving along when you notice three adorable critters in bloody, singed cultist robes praying on the side of the road.
target: 你们开车赶路时，看见路边有三只可爱的小动物正在祈祷，身上的教徒长袍血迹斑斑，还烧焦了。

source: Hey, wait a moment! Those are some of my followers! Pull over!
target: 等等！那几个是我的信徒！靠边停车！

source: Blessed be our eyes! Leader, we've been on a quest to find thee: the cult is being ravaged by a plague!
target: 我等何其有幸！教主，我们一直在找您：教团正遭受一场瘟疫！

source: Of fire!
target: 火灾瘟疫！

source: A... what now?
target: 一场……什么？

source: It all started when we ran out of food. We were going to accept the sweet embrace of death, but someone suggested cooking grass.
target: 一切都得从断粮说起。我们本打算投入死亡甜蜜的怀抱，可有人提议煮草吃。

source: We were saved, but it turns out grass makes you poop... a lot.
target: 我们是得救了，但没想到，吃草会拉屎……拉特别多。

source: After a few days, some people started getting sick. We highly suspect it was due to being surrounded by poop 24/7.
target: 过了几天，有人开始生病。我们严重怀疑，是因为全天候泡在屎堆里。

source: Surely we were hit with some evil curse. Poop always disappears by itself after a while!
target: 肯定是遭了什么邪恶诅咒！屎放一阵子，明明总会自己消失的！

source: ...It does not. I clean up your poop, like, all day.
target: ……不会。那是我一天到晚都在给你们铲屎。

source: See? I told you guys!
target: 看吧！我早说了！

source: Well, we didn't know that, so we did the sensible thing: we set the poop on fire.
target: 好吧，我们不知道，所以就采取了合理措施：放火烧屎。

source: But then the fire spread everywhere, as contagious diseases do... a most terrible plague of fire!
target: 可火势就像传染病一样，到处蔓延……一场可怕至极的火灾瘟疫！

source: At least the sick followers got better?
target: 至少生病的信徒好起来了吧？

source: No, we eventually gave up and threw them into the fire.
target: 没有，后来我们放弃了，把他们也扔火里了。

source: We're lost without you, O powerful fluffy one. Please return!
target: 伟大的毛茸茸之主，没有您，我们无所适从。请您回来吧！

source: No way. I am on... this sort of sacred pilgrimage. It's called "Vacation". It's very sacred and very important.
target: 不行。我正在进行……一种神圣的朝圣，叫“度假”。非常神圣，也非常重要。

source: You gotta learn to clean up your own messes.
target: 你们得学着收拾自己的烂摊子。

source: I had this idea: you know how they say "fight fire with fire"? I say we should start an even bigger fire to defeat the first fire!
target: 我有个主意：不是有句话叫“以火攻火”吗？那就再放一场更大的火，把前一场火打败！

source: Never mind. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, let's brainstorm something that'll stop my followers from messing everything up (again).
target: 算了。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，一起想个办法，别让我的信徒又把一切搞砸。

source: The Shrine of Common Sense: an effigy that protects the followers by repeating recordings of the Lamb's wisest commandments, such as "Do NOT eat that!"
target: 建一座常识神龛：放上一尊圣像，循环播放羔羊最睿智的戒律录音，保护信徒，比如“那个不能吃！”

source: Endless ball pit: keep the followers busy and entertained so they don't mess things up! It's like a body pit, but more fun!
target: 建个无底球池：让信徒忙着玩，就没空惹事了！跟尸坑差不多，只是更好玩！

source: That sounds great, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, but I don't know if a few prerecorded teachings will be enough to keep the cult in check.
target: 听着不错，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，可光靠几段录好的教诲，真能管住整个教团吗？

source: Sure they will! You just have to find good advice that can be applied generally, like...
target: 当然能！找些放哪儿都适用的建议就行，比如……

source: "...Do NOT eat that"?
target: “……那个不能吃！”？

source: Yeah! That one has worked for Scott SO many times. Or like: "That's not a toilet!"
target: 对！这句话对斯科特可管用了。还有什么“那不是厕所！”

source: Oh, that's REALLY good advice too, trust me!
target: 哦，这句也特别有用，相信我！

source: Okay, you've convinced me! I'm going to have the shrine set up right away.
target: 好，说服我了！我马上安排建神龛。

source: A few days later, the followers are back at the cult space, or whatever remains of it.
target: 几天后，信徒们回到了教团驻地——或者说，那地方烧剩下的部分。

source: How are you, fellow follower?
target: 这位教友，近来可好？

source: Oh, not bad. Still hungry, though. I could eat a whole horse...
target: 哦，还不错。就是饿。我现在能吃下一整匹马……

source: Do NOT eat that!
target: 那个不能吃！

source: Aw, okay...
target: 唉，好吧……

source: ...What?
target: ……什么？

source: Hey, guys! The outhouse is full, so I'm going to borrow one of the spare bowls of food, okay?
target: 各位！茅坑满了，我借个备用饭碗用用，行吧？

source: That's not a toilet!
target: 那不是厕所！

source: Oh...
Hello, everyone! I found this rock that looks like our leader. Who wants to buy it from me? It's very rare!
target: 大家好！我捡到一块长得像教主的石头。谁想买？非常稀有哦！

source: Any market that relies on scarcity to determine value is bound to become speculative and will only bring misery to the people involved.
target: 任何依靠稀缺性来决定价值的市场，最终都会沦为投机的温床，只会给参与其中的人带来苦难。

source: Aw... I wonder what can I do with the rock if I can't sell it...
target: 唉……不能卖的话，这石头还能干什么呢……

source: Do NOT eat that!
target: 那个不能吃！

source: Whoa, just when I thought our leader couldn't be any wiser!
target: 哇，我还以为教主的智慧已经登峰造极了，没想到还能更高！

source: Turns out there's nothing a little technology can't fix! You lose -N2 MONEY because talking shrines don't come for free, but you gain +N2 MIND from the Lamb's words of wisdom!
target: 事实证明，一点小科技就能解决一切！会说话的神龛可不是白送的，你失去了 -N2 金钱；但羔羊的智慧之言，又让你获得了 +N2 头脑！

source: Ooh, that works! You guys would like a ball pit, wouldn't you?
target: 哦，这个行！你们会喜欢球池的，对吧？

source: If you say we will, we will! I have just one question: what is a ball?
target: 您说我们会，我们就会！我只有一个问题：球是什么？

source: YOU DON'T KNOW WHAT A BALL IS?! Man, life in a cult is so much harder than I thought.
target: 你们连球是什么都不知道？！天哪，当教徒比我想的还苦。

source: It's, like, a round thing you throw for fun.
target: 就是……一种圆圆的东西，可以扔着玩。

source: Oh, like a rock? I get it now! You want us to dig a pit to stone people in as punishment!
target: 哦，像石头？我明白了！您是让我们挖个坑，用石头把人砸死，以示惩戒！

source: Nooo, it's not a punishment! The ball pit is for fun! You can jump around in it or bury yourself in the balls.
target: 不——不是惩罚！球池是用来玩的！你们可以在里面蹦，也可以把自己埋在球里。

source: Ahhh, so you want us to bury people alive in the balls as punishment for their sins!
target: 啊，所以您是想让我们把人活埋在球里，惩罚他们的罪孽！

source: No, you dolt, the Leader just said it ISN'T a punishment.
target: 不是，你个笨蛋，教主刚说了，这不是惩罚。

source: Thank you. At least ONE of you was listening.
target: 谢谢。至少还有一个在认真听。

source: The Leader is commanding us to bury people alive in the balls for fun!
target: 教主是让我们把人活埋在球里，取乐！

source: NO! Do NOT bury people alive!!!
target: 不是！不准活埋别人！！！

source: Sorry, Leader! Would you rather us kill the sinners before we bury them in the ball pit?
target: 抱歉，教主！那您是希望我们先杀了罪人，再把他们埋进球池吗？

source: You know what, sure, whatever. At least if you're busy with that you won't have time to set your poop on fire.
target: 行吧，随你们便。至少忙着干这个，就没空放火烧屎了。

source: A few days and -N2 MONEY later, the cultists have built the ball pit.
target: 几天后，花了 -N2 金钱，信徒们终于建好了球池。

source: With trial and error and only a few accidental deaths, they finally learn how to have fun in it! Whatever that means for them. You gain +N2 HYPE by proxy.
target: 反复尝试、付出了仅仅几条人命的代价后，他们总算学会在里面找乐子了！至于他们所谓的乐子是什么，那就随他们吧。你也跟着获得了 +N2 热度。

source: Heya, you just reached a high amount of STAMINA. Good for you!
target: 嘿，你的体力已经攒得很高了。不错嘛！

source: Does that mean you're aiming for... the STAMINA-BASED DESTINATION?
target: 这么说，你的目标是……以体力为条件的目的地？

source: If so, there's a wacky adventure that could unlock a layer for that DESTINATION... wanna go for it?
target: 要是这样，有场荒唐冒险能解锁这个目的地的额外内容……要试试吗？

source: GO GO GO!
target: 冲冲冲！

source: Nah, I'm good.
target: 不了，就这样挺好。

source: Great! The adventure will be waiting for you on the road.
target: 太好了！这场冒险会在路上等着你。

source: Sorry for breaking the 4th wall... see ya!
target: 抱歉，打破第四面墙了……回见！

source: Gotcha, I just wanted to check. Sorry for breaking the 4th wall!
target: 明白，我就问问。抱歉，打破第四面墙了！

source: You're driving past a rest stop where you see some ghosts chatting outside their van. Polly rolls her window down and waves hello.
target: 你们开车经过休息站，看见几个幽灵在面包车外聊天。波莉摇下车窗，挥手打招呼。

source: POLLYYY! What's up, bitch?!
target: 波莉——！最近怎么样，臭姐妹？！

source: Whoa... Polly's here? Haha... small world... gimme a hug, pretty girl...
target: 哇……波莉来了？哈哈……世界真小……抱一个，美女……

source: You park the car and greet Polly's friends: Summer, Macarena, and Cheese, the Ghosts of Parties Past.
target: 你们停下车，跟波莉的朋友们打招呼：Summer、Macarena 和 Cheese，也就是“昔日派对之鬼”。

source: What are you guys doing here? You going on a trip?
target: 你们怎么在这儿？出来旅行？

source: We're on our way to Veranotone. We've gone every year of our un-lives together!
target: 我们要去 Veranotone。死后每年都一起去，一次没落！

source: We just pulled over to buy gum for our festival survival kits.
target: 刚才停车买点口香糖，放进音乐节生存包里。

source: There are festival survival kits? I didn't know survival was so important at these things. I thought music festivals were all about going wild.
target: 音乐节还有生存包？我都不知道，去音乐节还得考虑活命。我以为就是去疯玩的。

source: They are, my hairy dude. But in order to party hard, you first gotta party prepare!
target: 没错，毛茸茸的兄弟。不过想玩得尽兴，得先准备充分！

source: I'm packing a printout of the schedule to make sure we see all our favorite artists, a map of the grounds in case we get lost...
target: 我打印了演出时间表，保证喜欢的艺人一个不漏，再带张场地地图，免得迷路……

source: ...water for drugs that dehydrate you, gum for drugs that make you grind your jaw, baby wipes for drugs that make you poop...
target: ……还有水，应付会让人脱水的药；口香糖，应付会让人磨牙的药；婴儿湿巾，应付会让人拉屎的药……

source: Do ghosts poop?
target: 幽灵也会拉屎吗？

source: Not usually... but poop drugs... are powerful stuff...
target: 一般不会……不过让人拉屎的药……威力可大了……

source: So, have you guys made your festival kits yet? What'd you put in yours? I'm always looking for inspiration.
target: 你们的音乐节生存包准备好了没？都放了些什么？我正想找点灵感呢。

source: You're no Ghost of Parties Past, but you've been around the dance floor enough times to know the perfect addition to any festival survival kit...
target: 你虽算不上“昔日派对之鬼”，可舞池也没少混，知道往音乐节生存包里加什么最合适……

source: The biggest risk is losing your friends and spending the whole festival stressed and looking for them. The solution is a red thread linking each one's index finger at all times.
target: 最怕跟朋友走散，整场音乐节都在焦头烂额地找人。解决办法：用一根红线始终连着大家的食指。

source: The biggest risk is wearing your legs down after three full days of partying. The solution is attending the festival on a horse.
target: 最怕狂欢整整三天，两条腿都站废了。解决办法：骑马参加音乐节。

source: Great idea! Between the crowds, the drugs, and our short attention spans, getting separated's a big possibility.
target: 好主意！人这么多，又嗑了药，我们还总是走神，确实很容易走散。

source: Thanks, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. I know party prep isn't the most -N2 HYPE activity, but I appreciate you taking it seriously!
target: 谢谢你，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。我知道派对前的准备挺扫兴，会让人 -N2 热度，不过你愿意认真对待，我很感激！

source: Flash forward to the music festival. The Ghosts of Parties Past are deep in the throes of hard-partying.
target: 镜头快进到音乐节。昔日派对之鬼正玩得如痴如狂。

source: Can we hit the bathrooms? I know I'm drunk and it's probably just a phantom-limb thing, but FUCK I need to pee.
target: 能去趟厕所吗？我知道自己喝醉了，这可能只是幻肢反应，但我他妈真的好想尿！

source: We can't go now! The Grateful Undead is playing next, and I didn't do shrooms to NOT see the ghost of Jerry Garcia perform.
target: 现在不能走！下一场就是“感恩不死”乐队。我可不是为了错过杰里·加西亚的鬼魂表演，才吃致幻蘑菇的。

source: Whoa... that guy's hair is... so soft... I gotta touch it... nothing else has ever been more important to me...
target: 哇……那个人的头发……好软……我得摸摸……这辈子都没什么事比这更重要了……

source: It's cool, this is what we got the thread for. Everyone tie an end to your fingers. Let's meet back up right here ASAP, okay?
target: 没事，红线不就是干这个用的吗？大家把线头系在手指上，尽快回这儿碰头，好吧？

source: Thirty minutes later, two festival attendees are tripping over the red thread covering the festival grounds.
target: 三十分钟后，两名观众被铺满音乐节场地的红线绊得踉踉跄跄。

source: They turn the corner and see other festival attendees completely tied up in the thread like a spider's next meal!
target: 他们一拐弯，就看见其他观众被红线捆得严严实实，活像蜘蛛准备享用的下一顿大餐！

source: "Look out for those three ghosts!" the trapped people cry. "They're wandering aimlessly across the festival, trapping us all with a VERY LONG thread!"
target: “小心那三个幽灵！”被困的人喊道，“他们在音乐节上到处瞎逛，用一根特别长的线，把我们全缠住了！”

source: "But why?" ask the friends. "Were they killed at a music festival and now they're cursing us to a horrible fate?!"
target: “可这是为什么？”那两个朋友问，“难道他们死在音乐节上，现在来诅咒我们，让我们也不得好死？！”

source: "No," say the trapped friends, "we're pretty sure they're just super drunk."
target: “不是，”被困的人说，“我们基本确定，他们只是喝得烂醉。”

source: Well, you didn't do the other festival-goers any favors, but the Ghosts of Parties Past appreciate the peace of +N2 MIND your thread idea gave them. Good work!
target: 好吧，你没给其他观众帮上什么忙，可昔日派对之鬼倒是很感谢你的红线妙计，让他们安心了不少。你获得了 +N2 头脑，干得好！

source: Great idea! Three days of straight partying is exhausting, so outsourcing all the walking and standing to a horse would save our +N2 STAMINA.
target: 好主意！连着狂欢三天多累啊，把走路和站着的活儿全外包给马，能省下 +N2 体力呢。

source: But aren't you guys ghosts? Can't you just float everywhere?
target: 可你们不是幽灵吗？直接飘着走不就行了？

source: Yeah, but as a matter of principle, we're going with the horse thing. It's too dope of an opportunity to pass up.
target: 能啊，但原则问题，这马必须骑。机会这么酷，错过可不行。

source: Thanks, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. I know party prep isn't the most -N2 HYPE activity, but I appreciate you taking it seriously!
target: 谢谢你，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。我知道派对前的准备挺扫兴，会让人 -N2 热度，不过你愿意认真对待，我很感激！

source: Flash forward to the music festival. The crowds are screaming and running in terror.
target: 镜头快进到音乐节。人群正尖叫着四散奔逃。

source: "Beware the ghosts on horses!" they cry. "They'll trample any man, woman, or port-o-potty in their way!"
target: “小心那些骑马的幽灵！”大家喊道，“不管挡路的是男人、女人，还是移动厕所，都会被他们踏平！”

source: "They must be the ghosts of some festival attendees who got trampled by a crowd, and they've returned to get revenge!" someone says.
target: “他们一定是以前被人群踩死的音乐节观众，现在回来报仇了！”有人说。

source: "Or maybe they're the three horsemen of the apocalypse!" someone else suggests.
target: “也可能是天启三骑士！”另一个人猜道。

source: "Weren't there four horsemen, though?"
target: “可天启骑士不是有四个吗？”

source: "Oh, maybe? I can't remember. Let me look it up..."
target: “哦，是吗？我记不清了，查一下……”

source: "SHIT! I'M NOT GETTING ANY CELL SERVICE!"
target: “我靠！手机没信号！”

source: "Oh God, it really IS the end of days! RUN FOR YOUR LIVES!!!"
target: “天哪，真是世界末日！快逃命啊！！！”

source: This rocks. I'm NEVER going to another music festival without a horse. They cut through the crowds so well!
target: 爽啊。以后参加音乐节，我一定骑马来。挤人群太方便了！

source: Same... I love my horsie... I named her "Om Nom Nom"... she's the bestest... 'cause she shares her tranquilizer with me...
target: 同感……我好爱我的小马……给她起名叫“啊呜啊呜”……她最好了……因为她会把镇静剂分给我……

source: Same... I love my horsie... I named her "Om Nom Nom"... she's the bestest... 'cause she shares her ketamine with me...
target: 同感……我好爱我的小马……给她起名叫“啊呜啊呜”……她最好了……因为她会把氯胺酮分给我……

source: It's this way to the main stage, guys. We can take a shortcut if our horses jump over that bar counter! Giddy-up!
target: 主舞台在这边，各位。骑马跳过那个吧台就能抄近路了！驾！

source: Well, you didn't do the other festival attendees any favors, but your hot friends had fun, which is all that matters!
target: 好吧，你没给其他观众帮上什么忙，可你的性感朋友们玩开心了，这才是重点！

source: As you're driving, you see the Ghosts of Parties Past parked at a rest stop. You can't resist pulling over and saying hi to those sexy specters!
target: 开车途中，你们看见昔日派对之鬼的车停在休息站，忍不住靠边停车，去跟那几位性感幽灵打招呼！

source: Heyyy, dudes! Good to see you! Wanna help me brainstorm a scheme real quick?
target: 嘿——伙计们！见到你们真好！来帮我出个点子？很快的！

source: Sure! What kind of scheme? Evil? Money-making? Color?
target: 行啊！想搞什么方案？作恶的？赚钱的？配色的？

source: Whatever you want! I just wanna make this music festival an unforgettable night. I try to do something weird and memorable at every party we go to.
target: 都行！我就想让这场音乐节成为难忘的一晚。每次参加派对，我都想搞点古怪又让人忘不掉的事。

source: Like the time I bought fake gems and hid them around the club, then we spread rumors that the previous owner had buried his life's savings there before he died!
target: 比如有一次，我买了些假宝石，藏在夜店各处，再放出风声，说前任老板临死前把毕生积蓄埋在了店里！

source: Haha, yeah... everyone was so frantic... some lady throat-punched a guy for a plastic diamond... good times...
target: 哈哈，对……大家都抢疯了……有个女的为了一颗塑料钻石，一拳打在别人喉咙上……真怀念啊……

source: I liked the time we went to a party pretending to be a group of paranormal investigators on break.
target: 我喜欢另外那次，我们假装是一群休假中的灵异调查员，去参加派对。

source: Someone hired us to check if their house was haunted. I thought they were just high, but nope, their house was SUPER haunted!
target: 有人雇我们检查他家有没有闹鬼。我还以为那人嗑嗨了，结果不是，那房子真的闹鬼，闹得可凶了！

source: We had the best afterparty there... you haven't un-lived... if you've never tried Victorian ghost opium... it's... like... the tits...
target: 我们在那儿续了场最棒的派对……没尝过维多利亚时代的幽灵鸦片……你这鬼就白当了……简直……爽翻……

source: It'll be hard to top either of those parties, or the ones that came before. I wanna make Veranotone great, but I've got schemer's block...
target: 想超过那两次，还有之前那些派对，可不容易。我想让 Veranotone 也精彩起来，但现在点子卡壳了……

source: I'm sure %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% can help; %HESHE%%VERB_'S_'RE% pretty good at schemes! Got any ideas, bro?
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%肯定能帮忙，%HESHE%%VERB_'S_'RE%可是出点子的高手！兄弟，有什么主意？
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): KEEP; 派对鬼魂请求出点子；可是高手已表达系词。 按行中文动词展开已实现；未实机验证。

source: "Go to the festival site before it starts and bury bottles of alcohol under the ground. When the party's on, you bring a shovel and dig up your secret stashes!"
target: “音乐节开始前，先去场地把酒埋好。等开场后，带把铲子进去，随时挖出你的秘密存货！”

source: "Deceive everyone with the most powerful persona imaginable: 'The Music Festival Inspectors'"
target: “用最强大的伪装唬住所有人：‘音乐节检查员’！”

source: Duuude, that's perfect! It's as funny as it is practical!
target: 兄——弟，绝了！好玩又实用！

source: Like, do you have any idea how much they charge for drinks at music festivals? We're gonna save a LOT of money.
target: 你知道音乐节上的酒卖得有多贵吗？这下可省大钱了。

source: You give the ghosts your shovels so they can carry out their scheme. You'll lose -N2 STAMINA when you have to dig things up with your hands later, but it's worth it!
target: 你把铲子送给了幽灵们，让他们实施计划。之后再要挖东西，就只能徒手挖了，会损失 -N2 体力，不过值了！

source: Later, at the festival...
target: 后来，在音乐节上……

source: Man, I'm really craving tequila shots. Didn't we bury some around here?
target: 伙计，我现在特别想来几杯龙舌兰。咱们是不是在附近埋了点？

source: Let me check the map... looks like there are two bottles of tequila buried thirty feet that way. Get the party shovels!
target: 我看看地图……那边三十英尺外埋了两瓶龙舌兰。拿上派对铲！

source: Later, the ghosts see a woman proposing to her girlfriend. She says yes!
target: 后来，幽灵们看到一位女士向女友求婚。她答应了！

source: Aww, so sweet... we gotta toast to this... Cheese, dig up the champagne... it's, like, seventeen feet away or something...
target: 啊，好甜……必须干一杯……Cheese，快把香槟挖出来……就在十七英尺外还是什么地方……

source: Even later, the ghosts pass a festival attendee crying by the bathrooms. He explains that he lost his favorite jacket.
target: 再后来，幽灵们路过厕所，遇见一个哭泣的观众。原来，他把最喜欢的外套弄丢了。

source: Don't worry, dude. I knew my spirit was called to this party for a reason, and that reason is to give you my backup jacket! Just let me dig it up.
target: 别担心，兄弟。我就知道，冥冥之中有股力量把我的灵魂召唤到这场派对，是有原因的——就是为了把我的备用外套送给你！等我挖一下。

source: And guess what... we buried extra tequila shots in the jacket pockets... what a great surprise from sober-us.
target: 而且你猜怎么着……外套口袋里还藏了几小杯龙舌兰……清醒时的我们，真会给自己准备惊喜。

source: Still later, just as the festival headliner is about to go onstage, a stage light falls on the bassist and kills him instantly! Oh no!
target: 又过了一阵，就在压轴乐队即将登台时，一盏舞台灯掉下来，当场砸死了贝斯手！糟了！

source: It's okay everyone, the show can still go on! Where'd we bury that backup bassist?
target: 没事，各位，演出还能继续！备用贝斯手埋哪儿了？

source: Over here... good news... I'm pretty sure he's still alive... and better news... I buried him with more tequila shots... yaaay!
target: 这边……好消息……他应该还活着……更好的消息……埋他的时候，我又多放了几小杯龙舌兰……好耶！

source: The concert is saved! And since the ghosts saved the night by following your suggestion to bury things beforehand, you legally get a cut of their +N2 HYPE.
target: 演出保住了！幽灵们听了你的建议，提前埋好东西，才救了这一晚；所以依法，你也能分到他们的 +N2 热度。

source: Duuude, that's genius! Can you help us make some fake badges?
target: 兄——弟，天才啊！能帮我们做几个假证件吗？

source: You sure can! Later, at the music festival...
target: 当然能！后来，在音乐节上……

source: Sup, dude? We need to get into the VIP section.
target: 哟，兄弟，我们要进贵宾区。

source: "Nice try, you don't have VIP badges," the security guard says. "Get lost."
target: “少来，你们又没有 VIP 证。”保安说，“一边去。”

source: No, but we DO have BFI badges. We're from the Bureau of Festival Investigators.
target: 是没有，但我们有 BFI 证件。我们来自音乐节调查局，Bureau of Festival Investigators。

source: "Oh shit, really? Come on in then. I didn't know we had an inspection today."
target: “我靠，真的？快请进。我都不知道今天有检查。”

source: Thanks. We're also gonna need to sample all your beer and liquor, and we need skip-the-line passes for the bathrooms.
target: 谢了。另外，所有啤酒和烈酒，我们都得抽样尝尝，再给几张厕所免排队通行证。

source: "Seriously? Why do you ghosts even need to go to the bathroom? Do you even poop?"
target: “真的假的？你们幽灵为什么还要上厕所？你们也会拉屎？”

source: Ugh... this question again... can't you un-undead people... like... stop asking about our pooping habits...?
target: 唉……又问这个……你们这些没死过的人……能不能……别老打听我们怎么拉屎……？

source: Y'know what? Just for that, we're also gonna need someone to paint our nails backstage.
target: 行，就冲你这句话，我们还得找个人，在后台给我们做美甲。

source: And while you're at it, tell the next punk band on the setlist to play contemporary jazz instead, just to amuse me.
target: 顺便告诉演出表上下一个朋克乐队，改弹现代爵士，逗我开心。

source: "But... but...!"
No "buts"! Remember who we are?
target: 没什么可是的！还记得我们是谁吗？

source: Festival... Inspectors...
target: 音乐节……检查员……

source: Bitch.
target: 贱人。

source: The Ghosts of Parties Past spend the festival exploiting their fake authority, and you take +N2 HYPE and -N2 SOUL for enabling them.
target: 整个音乐节，昔日派对之鬼都在拿假身份作威作福。因为是你帮忙成全的，你获得了 +N2 热度，同时失去了 -N2 灵魂。

source: You're driving along when you see the Ghosts of Parties Past again. They're all crowded around Macarena's phone.
target: 你们开车赶路，又碰见了昔日派对之鬼。他们全挤在 Macarena 的手机旁边。

source: Heyyy gang! I'm glad you're here. We're at the final stage of music festival prep, and it's turning out to be a real doozy.
target: 嘿——各位！来得正好。音乐节的准备工作就剩最后一步了，结果这一步可真够折腾的。

source: We're trying to get some "goods"... and by goods, I obviously mean drugs.
target: 我们想弄点“好货”……所谓好货，当然就是毒品。

source: We probably shouldn't have put this off until the last minute, but we were too busy doing our pre-festival drugs to remember to get festival drugs.
target: 本来不该拖到最后一刻，可我们忙着嗑音乐节前的药，忘了买音乐节上要嗑的药。

source: Looks like I've exhausted all my usual contacts... except for Tommy, anyway.
target: 平时联系的那几个人，我都问遍了……就剩汤米还没问。

source: Fuuuck, dude, are we really THAT desperate? I heard Tommy's super paranoid and cryptic...
target: 我靠，真走投无路到这份上了？听说汤米特别多疑，说话还神神秘秘的……

source: Well, the good news is I got a response! But... just look at this text he sent me.
target: 好消息是，他回消息了！不过……你们自己看他发的短信吧。

source: Uh... Polly, did I forget how to read again?
target: 呃……波莉，我是不是又忘记怎么认字了？

source: Not this time, buddy. Ugh, looks like Tommy's made up his own convoluted drug-dealer code.
target: 这次不是，哥们儿。唉，看来汤米给自己编了一套复杂得要命的贩毒暗号。

source: What do you mean by code?
target: 什么叫暗号？

source: Lots of dealers text in code to avoid getting arrested. Usually it's easy to understand: "sugar" for coke, "pill emoji" for pills, "horse emoji + sleepy emoji" for ketamine...
target: 很多毒贩发短信都用暗号，免得被抓。一般挺好懂：“糖”是可卡因，“药丸表情”是药丸，“马的表情加瞌睡表情”是氯胺酮……

source: But Tommy's thrown out the entire accepted drug-code alphabet. We gotta figure out how to speak in his weird code to place an order!
target: 可汤米把大家通用的那套全扔了。得弄懂他那些怪暗号，才下得了单！

source: Who knew attending a music festival would involve becoming a code-breaker? Life's funny that way! How do you proceed?
target: 谁能想到，参加音乐节还得先学会破译密码？生活就是这么奇妙！你打算怎么办？

source: Research the Rosetta Stone from which all drug dealers' codes come from.
target: 研究毒贩暗号的源头——罗塞塔石碑。

source: Convince the cops to tell you about their ongoing investigation to decode the dealer's complex lingo. It's "for your safety"; you don't want to "accidentally sound like a dealer"!
target: 说服警察，把他们调查毒贩复杂黑话的进展告诉你。毕竟是“为了自身安全”，免得“不小心说得像个毒贩”！

source: Ugh, that sounds a lot like homework...
target: 呃，听起来好像做作业……

source: Yeaaah... but just think... it's homework... for DRUGS.
target: 是啊……可你想想……这是为了毒品……做作业。

source: That's true. Thank you, Summer, for giving me some much-needed perspective.
target: 也是。谢谢你，Summer，我确实需要换个角度看问题。

source: Is a drug-dealers' Rosetta Stone even a thing? Did they have drugs in prehistoric times?
target: 真有毒贩专用的罗塞塔石碑？史前时代就有毒品了吗？

source: Yeah, totally! Altered states of consciousness predate civilization itself! Just picture it...
target: 当然有！人类还没创造文明，就知道怎么让意识飘起来了！想象一下……

source: And just like that, you're having a flashback to a caveman roasting a woolly mammoth leg in his cave.
target: 于是，你的脑海里忽然闪回一幕：一个穴居人，正在洞穴里烤一条猛犸象腿。

source: Another caveman enters the cave. "Ogg," he says. "Is me, good friend Ugg. Ugg overhear Ogg have... thing."
target: 另一个穴居人走了进来。“奥格，”他说，“是我，好朋友乌格。乌格听说，奥格有……东西。”

source: "'Thing?'" asks Ogg. "What 'thing' is? Use words, Ugg! We evolve from monkeys for no reason?!"
target: “‘东西’？”奥格问，“什么‘东西’？说清楚，乌格！我们从猴子变过来，白变的？！”

source: "Is frog," says Ugg. "But not normal frog. Ugg lick frog once, then Ugg hear colors. Want lick again."
target: “青蛙，”乌格说，“不是普通青蛙。乌格舔一下，乌格听见颜色。乌格还想舔。”

source: "SHH! Ugg lower voice! No go just ask for frog. Frog too good to be legal!"
target: “嘘！乌格小声！不能张嘴就要青蛙。青蛙这么好，肯定不合法！”

source: "What 'legal?'"
target: “什么叫‘合法’？”

source: "Is not invented yet. But Ugg listen now: if Ugg want lick Ogg's frog, Ugg pay. Ugg give Ogg three pelts for one lick."
target: “还没发明。乌格现在听好：乌格想舔奥格的青蛙，乌格得付钱。舔一次，给奥格三张皮子。”

source: "But Ugg use secret code so Ogg no get in trouble, okay? Paint blueberry on cave wall. Then Ogg know Ugg want frog lick."
target: “不过乌格得用暗号，奥格才不会惹麻烦，懂？洞壁画蓝莓。奥格就知道，乌格想舔青蛙。”

source: Snap out of it, dude! While you were having that flashback, we found the drug-dealer Rosetta Stone online!
target: 回神啦，兄弟！你忙着看脑内闪回的时候，我们已经在网上找到毒贩的罗塞塔石碑了！

source: Okay, I think I've got this now. I'll tell Tommy we want four calamari... eight teeth with extra plaque... three grams of croissant... half an orangutan...
target: 好，我大概懂了。我跟汤米说，我们要四份鱿鱼……八颗牙，牙菌斑加量……三克可颂……半只猩猩……

source: ...And one blueberry.
target: ……再加一颗蓝莓。

source: After much online research, you finally find the ancient drug dealers' Rosetta Stone! Unfortunately, it's not very comprehensive...
target: 在网上查了半天，你终于找到了古代毒贩的罗塞塔石碑！可惜，收录的东西实在不多……

source: Honestly, I dunno what we were expecting. It's not like they had many drugs in ancient times.
target: 说真的，我们到底在期待什么啊？古时候又没多少种毒品。

source: Do they have ecstasy?
target: 有摇头丸吗？

source: Nah, that was invented by a chemist in the 20th century.
target: 没，二十世纪才有化学家发明出来。

source: Coke?
target: 可卡因？

source: Nope. 19th century.
target: 没有，十九世纪的。

source: LSD?
target: LSD？

source: No. The atrocities of MK Ultra definitely came after prehistoric times.
target: 没有。MK Ultra 那些暴行，肯定是在史前时代之后了。

source: THEN WHAT IS THERE?!
target: 那到底有什么？！

source: Looks like they've got licking a frog that makes you hallucinate.
target: 看起来，有“舔一只会让你产生幻觉的青蛙”。

source: NO! I can't... I can't do frogs anymore... I only just started trusting the color purple again...
target: 不！我不行……我再也碰不了青蛙了……我好不容易才重新信任紫色……

source: Okay, then they've also got "hitting you over the head with a rock so you lose blood and see things"?
target: 那还有“用石头砸脑袋，失血之后看见幻觉”？

source: Fuck... it's times like these... I wish I still had blood...
target: 妈的……每到这种时候……就好希望自己还有血……

source: And it's times like these that you miss the -3 MIND you lost for having bad ideas. Oof.
target: 而每到这种时候，你就会怀念因为烂主意而失去的 -3 头脑。唉。

source: What a great plan that couldn't possibly go wrong! You and your friends all head down to the local precinct.
target: 好主意，绝对不可能出任何岔子！你和朋友们一起前往当地警局。

source: So let me get this straight... you want us to teach you all the drug-dealer codes we've learned... so that you WON'T order drugs from a dealer?
target: 我捋一捋……你们想让我们把掌握的所有毒贩暗号都教给你们……好让你们不去找毒贩买毒品？

source: Yup! Think about it: the war on drugs is perilous and ongoing. We don't wanna be innocently sending emojis and accidentally order a drug!
target: 对！想想看，禁毒战争又危险，又没完。我们可不想无辜地发个表情，结果一不小心就买了毒品！

source: That's true, it could happen! Who among us hasn't tried to "ROFL" at their nephew and accidentally ordered cocaine?
target: 有道理，真有这种可能！谁没试过给外甥发个“笑到打滚”，结果误买了可卡因呢？

source: Exactly... so, like... if I type "zebra"... does that mean "ecstasy"?
target: 没错……所以嘛……我要是打“斑马”……意思就是“摇头丸”？

source: It actually means "cookies-and-cream-flavored ketamine". It's gross, though. "Unicorn" means "bubblegum-flavored ketamine", which is much better... I've heard.
target: 其实是“曲奇奶油味氯胺酮”。不过很难吃。“独角兽”是“泡泡糖味氯胺酮”，那个好多了……我是听说的。

source: These days, "femme-presenting rockstar" means ecstasy. Not to be confused with "masc-presenting rockstar"; that means gun for some reason.
target: 现在，“女性化打扮的摇滚明星”才是摇头丸。别跟“男性化打扮的摇滚明星”搞混了；后者不知道为什么，是枪。

source: Gotcha. So, according to what you've heard around the force, what's the hottest drug on the market right now?
target: 懂了。那按你们在警队听到的消息，现在市面上最火的毒品是什么？

source: Have you come across any codes for drugs that people our age who do drugs -- but not us -- would describe as "the good shit"?
target: 有没有哪种暗号，指的是我们这年纪的嗑药人士——当然不包括我们——会称之为“极品好货”的东西？

source: Hmm... let's just say that whatever you do, do NOT text anyone "star emoji, explosion emoji, sleepy fairy emoji, yin-yang emoji" and add "with a cherry on top."
target: 嗯……这么说吧，无论如何，都别给人发“星星表情、爆炸表情、瞌睡仙子表情、阴阳表情”，再补一句“顶上加颗樱桃”。

source: Good point, partner! That combination of illicit substances is so good, it should be illegal!
target: 说得对，搭档！这几种违禁品配在一起实在太棒了，简直应该立法禁止！

source: ...It IS illegal.
target: ……本来就违法。

source: Oh yeah!
target: 哦，对哦！

source: Are the cops high right now, or are they actually this dumb? Either way, they give you all the info your friends need to place an order with Tommy.
target: 这俩警察是现在嗑嗨了，还是天生就这么蠢？反正，你的朋友们得到了找汤米下单所需的全部信息。

source: What a great plan that couldn't possibly go wrong! You and your friends all head down to the local precinct.
target: 好主意，绝对不可能出任何岔子！你和朋友们一起前往当地警局。

source: So let me get this straight... you want us to teach you all the drug-dealer codes we've learned... so that you WON'T order drugs from a dealer?
target: 我捋一捋……你们想让我们把掌握的所有毒贩暗号都教给你们……好让你们不去找毒贩买毒品？

source: Yup! Think about it: the war on drugs is perilous and ongoing. We don't wanna be innocently sending emojis and accidentally order a drug!
target: 对！想想看，禁毒战争又危险，又没完。我们可不想无辜地发个表情，结果一不小心就买了毒品！

source: Exactly... so, like... what emojis should I use to order ecstasy?
target: 没错……所以嘛……要买摇头丸，该用什么表情？

source: UH! She means what emojis should she NOT use to NOT order ecstasy!
target: 呃！她的意思是，不想买到摇头丸，就不该用哪些表情！

source: Wha...? No I don't... why would I not order ecstasy... it's like... you don't even know me...
target: 什么……？我没这意思……为什么不买摇头丸……你这话说得……跟不认识我似的……

source: You kids are acting real suspicious...
target: 你们这帮小年轻，很可疑啊……

source: NUH-UH! YOU'RE ACTING SUSPICIOUS! WE'RE BEING SO FUCKIN' NORMAL RIGHT NOW!
target: 才没有！可疑的是你们！我们他妈的现在正常得很！

source: Oh no, AM I acting suspicious? Guess I'm still on edge from all that cocaine I snorted.
target: 糟了，我很可疑吗？估计是之前吸了太多可卡因，到现在还神经紧绷。

source: UH! He means all the cocaine he DIDN'T snort!
target: 呃！他是说，他没吸过的那些可卡因！

source: ...Did we get ecstasy yet?
target: ……所以，买到摇头丸了吗？

source: Okay, you're all definitely under arrest.
target: 行了，你们全被捕了。

source: THIS WAS ALL %CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%'S IDEA!
target: 这全是%CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%的主意！

source: The four ghosts phase out, leaving you to deal with the cops. You lose -3 MONEY from the bail out of jail.
target: 四个幽灵穿透墙壁溜了，留下你独自应付警察。为交保释金，你失去了 -3 金钱。

source: Yaaay... we placed an order... is it time to partaaay yet...?
target: 好耶……下好单了……现在能开派对了吗……？

source: Uh... no. Now Tommy wants to establish where we're meeting. He says it has to be a "safe place" where there's no chance of us getting caught.
target: 呃……还不行。汤米现在要定见面的地点。他说必须是“安全的地方”，绝不能有被抓的可能。

source: Hmmm... what if we meet... in the middle of the ocean?
target: 嗯……要不……海中央见？

source: I'll text him... Tommy says, "no way. the merkingdom's out there, and merkingdom cops r the WORST."
target: 我问问他……汤米说：“不行，人鱼王国就在那儿，人鱼王国的条子最烦了。”

source: What about at a police station after hours? There'd be no cops there 'cause they've all gone home for the day!
target: 警察局下班以后怎么样？警察都回家了，里面就没人啦！

source: Tommy says... "r u stupid?"
target: 汤米说……“你是不是傻？”

source: I prefer the term "smarts-challenged".
target: 我更喜欢叫“智力方面有点困难”。

source: Ugh, if we can't get Tommy to agree on someplace then none of us will be able to get stupid on drugs. Any suggestions, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?
target: 唉，再定不下汤米肯去的地方，咱们谁也别想嗑嗨了。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，有建议吗？

source: Meet at Tommy's comfort zone by having dinner at his parents' house.
target: 去汤米的舒适区见面：到他父母家吃晚饭。

source: Meet at the one place that's above law and punishment: a gated community.
target: 去那个能凌驾于法律、免受惩罚的地方见面：封闭式富人社区。

source: Tommy says... "that's either a dumb idea or a great idea, and the intuition that led me to quit medical school and become a dealer is telling me that it's a great idea!"
target: 汤米说……“这主意要么蠢透了，要么棒极了。当年指引我退出医学院、当上毒贩的直觉告诉我：棒极了！”

source: Soon enough, you and your friends are gathered around a table with Tommy and Tommy's moms, eating spaghetti and meatballs.
target: 没过多久，你和朋友们就跟汤米，还有他的两位妈妈一起围坐桌边，吃着肉丸意面。

source: Psst... Tommy... can you pass me "the sauce"... I'm sooo ready... to get lost in the sauce...
target: 嘘……汤米……能把“酱料”递给我吗……我已经迫不及待……要嗨在“酱料”里了……

source: Sure, here you go.
target: 行，给。

source: Nooo, silly... the "sauce"... I'll give you fifty bucks for a gram-and-a-half of "sauce".
target: 不是啦，傻瓜……是“酱料”……给你五十块，来一克半“酱料”。

source: Uhh, you don't need to pay for my moms' sauce. You're our guests, not customers.
target: 呃，我妈妈们做的酱不用买。你们是客人，又不是顾客。

source: (Jesus, Tommy. She's asking for drugs. Didn't you see the air quotes?)
target: （天哪，汤米。她在问你要毒品。没看见她用手比的引号吗？）

source: Ohhh, right! We'll do that later. No talking politics, religion, or drugs at the dinner table!
target: 哦——懂了！待会儿再说。饭桌上不谈政治、宗教，也不谈毒品！

source: Later, you're helping Tommy clean up after dinner. Polly makes copious references to having no interest in "getting clean" herself. Tommy tells her to wait until later.
target: 饭后，你们帮汤米收拾。波莉不停暗示，自己可没兴趣“洗心革面、戒个干净”。汤米让她再等等。

source: Still later, Tommy's family insists on playing a game of charades. The party ghosts pantomime snorting coke off each other's asses. Tommy still waves them off.
target: 再后来，汤米一家坚持玩比手画脚猜词。派对幽灵们比划着从彼此屁股上吸可卡因的动作，汤米还是摆手让他们先别急。

source: Finally, impatient and sick of being sober, all your friends corner Tommy when he goes to the bathroom.
target: 最后，你的朋友们实在等不下去，也受够了清醒，趁汤米上厕所，把他堵了个正着。

source: Look, Thomas: this has been fun, you have a lovely family, etcetera. When do we get to the part with the drugs?!
target: 听着，托马斯：玩得很开心，你家人很可爱，诸如此类的话就不说了。到底什么时候才能拿到毒品？！

source: Okay, fine, I guess you've waited long enough. Just let me wipe my ass and we'll do this.
target: 好吧好吧，你们确实等够久了。让我先擦个屁股，咱们就交易。

source: Finally, you're in the home stretch!
target: 终于，胜利就在眼前了！

source: Tommy says... "yea, i do feel pretty comfortable at my parents' place. there's no cops there, after all. i'm in."
target: 汤米说……“对，我在爸妈家确实挺自在的，毕竟那里没警察。就这么定。”

source: "do u have something to bring for dinner?"
target: “你们能带点什么来吃晚饭吗？”

source: Uhhh, nope. I ate all my Scott Snacks, and the only things I can cook are "microwaved Scott Snacks" and "grease fire."
target: 呃，没有。我把斯科特零食全吃光了。我只会做“微波斯科特零食”，还有“厨房油锅起火”。

source: I only know how to cook drugs, and if I could do that right now, we wouldn't need Tommy.
target: 我只会制毒，要是现在就能做，还找汤米干什么。

source: Okay, I'll tell him...
target: 好，我跟他说……

source: He says, "wow. ofc. typical mooches tryna exploit the dealer's overzealousness by setting a meeting at my parents' place as an excuse to get free dinner."
target: 他说：“哇，果然。又是一群蹭饭的，拿约在我爸妈家交易当幌子，专门利用毒贩过分热情的弱点，混顿免费晚饭。”

source: What? That's not what we're doing. Dinner is nice, but we're in this for the drugs!
target: 什么？我们可没这意思。晚饭当然不错，但我们图的是毒品啊！

source: "suuuure, u just want 'the drugs' and have no ulterior motive to get free food. fuck off!"
target: “是是是，你们只想要‘毒品’，绝不是为了蹭饭。滚吧！”

source: Tommy blocks you all, thereby halting the ghosts' last chance to get the good shit before the festival. Ouch. You lose -3 HYPE.
target: 汤米把你们全拉黑了，幽灵们想在音乐节前买到好货的最后希望也没了。惨。你失去了 -3 热度。

source: You and all your friends pile into the car and drive to a gated community. You meet the security guards at the gate.
target: 你和朋友们挤进车里，开到一处封闭式富人社区，在大门口碰见了保安。

source: "Stop right there," they say. "Do you live here?"
target: “站住，”他们说，“住这儿的？”

source: Nope.
target: 不是。

source: "Are you here to visit a resident, then?"
target: “那是来拜访住户的？”

source: Noperino.
target: 也不——是——呢。

source: "Then why are you here?"
target: “那你们来干什么？”

source: To get drugs... teehee!
target: 买毒品……嘿嘿！

source: "WHAT?! This is an upscale community! You can't do that here!"
target: “什么？！这里是高档社区！不许在这儿干这种事！”

source: Sure we can. We've got MONEY.
target: 怎么不行？我们有金钱。

source: "Oh, you do? Well, that's completely fair. We'll open the gate. Have fun!"
target: “哦，有钱啊？那就完全合理了。我们开门，祝各位玩得开心！”

source: Wait, that's it? They're not even worried about drugs being illegal?
target: 等等，这就行了？他们不管买毒品违法的事吗？

source: Nah, dude. Laws don't apply to rich people. The only crime those schmucks punish is the one we aren't committing: being poor.
target: 不管，兄弟。有钱人不受法律约束。这帮蠢货只惩罚一种罪，而咱们没犯那种罪：穷。

source: Yup! It's pretty fucked up, but you're not here to fix the system; you're just here to get your friends drugs!
target: 没错！这制度是挺操蛋，可你们又不是来改革制度的，只是来帮朋友买毒品的！

source: You meet Tommy by the center fountain, fanning yourself with a wad of cash to blend in.
target: 你们在中央喷泉边见到汤米，还拿一沓钞票扇着风，努力融入环境。

source: You and all your friends pile into the car and drive to a gated community. You meet the security guards at the gate.
target: 你和朋友们挤进车里，开到一处封闭式富人社区，在大门口碰见了保安。

source: "Stop right there," they say. "Only one-percenters are allowed in here. Are you rich?"
target: “站住，”他们说，“这里只接待最富有的那百分之一。你们有钱吗？”

source: Yeah we are. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s got oodles of cash. Show 'em, boo.
target: 有啊。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%有的是钱。给他们瞧瞧，宝贝。

source: You reach into your wallet to prove yourself...
target: 你伸手掏钱包，准备证明自己……

source: ...and only find eighty-six cents and the Justice Brigade of Monstropolis Membership Card you got out of a cereal box. Oof.
target: ……却只翻出八十六美分，还有一张从麦片盒里拿到的“怪物大都会正义旅”会员卡。惨。

source: "Nice try," the guards sneer. "Get out of here before one of our residents faints at the sight of your poverty."
target: “还想蒙混过关？”保安冷笑，“快滚，别让我们哪位住户看见你这穷酸样，当场吓晕。”

source: No, we promise we're rich! %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% must've just left %HISHER% MONEY in %HISHER% other pants!
target: 不，我们保证有钱！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%肯定只是把%HISHER%金钱放在了%HISHER%另一条裤子里！

source: "Fine, we'll give you the Rich Quiz. If you can answer these questions correctly, we'll know you're wealthy."
target: “行，那就来个富人小测验。答对了，我们就知道你们真有钱。”

source: "Question one: on which part of the yacht do you take cocktail hour?"
target: “第一题：你们一般在游艇的哪个部位享用餐前鸡尾酒？”

source: Uh... the cocktail-hour... part...?
target: 呃……享用餐前鸡尾酒的……那个部位……？

source: "Wrong. Question two: what amount of CO2 emissions from your private jet is considered too much?"
target: “错。第二题：私人飞机的二氧化碳排放量，达到多少算过量？”

source: Any amount?
target: 排多少都算？

source: "Wrong again. Question three: how much money did you pay in taxes last year?"
target: “又错。第三题：去年交了多少税？”

source: I think it was around four hundred and--
target: 好像是四百多——

source: "Wrong once again. The correct answer was 'zero' -- only poors pay taxes. Begone!"
target: “还是错。正确答案是‘零’——穷人才交税。滚吧！”

source: You and your friends leave with no drugs, no money, and no hope of success. You lose -3 HYPE.
target: 你和朋友们一无所获地离开：没毒品，没钱，也没了成功的希望。你失去了 -3 热度。

source: Yessss... finally... I can practically taste the drugs!
target: 好耶……终于……毒品的味道我都快尝到了！

source: Tommy and Macarena are completing the handoff, but then Tommy hesitates.
target: 汤米正跟 Macarena 交货，忽然又犹豫起来。

source: Wait a sec. You guys aren't cops, are you?
target: 等一下。你们不是警察吧？

source: For fuck's sake, dude, no. Don't you think if we were cops, we'd've arrested you by now?
target: 我操，兄弟，真不是。要是警察，我们还不早把你抓了？

source: You could be playing the long game! Or maybe a cop bribed you to infiltrate me and report back so they can arrest me later!
target: 没准你们放长线钓大鱼呢！或者有警察收买你们，打入我这里，回去通风报信，好以后再抓我！

source: You really think we'd do that to you?
target: 你真觉得我们会这么对你？

source: For the right price, yes!
target: 钱给够了，就会！

source: ...Yeah, that's fair actually. But I promise that's not the case this time!
target: ……也是，有道理。但我保证，这次真不是！

source: You've got a funny feeling that Tommy will need more proof than that. Convince him you're not cops so he'll give the ghosts their drugs!
target: 你隐约觉得，光这样还不足以打消汤米的疑心。让他相信你们不是警察，幽灵们才能拿到毒品！

source: "It's only a crime to SELL drugs. If you give us the drugs for free, you can't possibly be incriminated!"
target: “只有卖毒品才算犯罪。你要是免费送给我们，就绝对落不下罪名！”

source: Get a forged diploma that proves you're a licensed architect, therefore not a cop.
target: 弄张假文凭，证明你是持证建筑师，因此绝不是警察。

source: Whoa, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%... did you just, like... find the undercover-cop loophole?
target: 哇，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%……你是不是……找到了绕过卧底警察的漏洞？

source: I think so! And it makes sense. If you just give us the drugs for free, the cops wouldn't be able to pin you with a drug-dealing charge!
target: 我看是！而且说得通。只要你免费把毒品送给我们，警察就没法给你安上贩毒的罪名！

source: Say, that's true... But wait, is this just an elaborate scheme to make me give you free drugs?
target: 嘿，还真是……可等等，这不会是什么精心设计的圈套，就为了骗我送你们毒品吧？
……不是？

source: It's a very simple scheme to make you give us free drugs!
target: 没精心设计，骗你送毒品这招很简单！

source: Is it working?
target: 管用吗？

source: Yeah, sure! You're honest, and that's worth its weight in gold in this business. Worth more than money, even!
target: 管，行啊！你们够诚实。这行里，诚实可是千金难买，比钱都值钱！

source: (Is it, though?)
target: （真的吗？）

source: Here, take as many drugs as you want. It's all free, after all, and therefore not illegal!
target: 来，想拿多少拿多少。反正是免费送的，自然就不违法了！

source: YES!!! INFINITE DRUGS HACK!
target: 好耶！！！卡出无限毒品漏洞啦！

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, you came through in a big way today. I really hope we run into you at Veranotone.
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，今天真是多亏了你。希望咱们能在 Veranotone 再碰上。

source: You hope so too! The ghosts leave with pockets full of drugs, and you make off with RESOURCES full of +5 STAMINA.
target: 你也这么希望！幽灵们兜里装满了毒品，而你的资源栏里则装进了 +5 体力。

source: Whoa, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%... did you just, like... find the undercover-cop loophole?
target: 哇，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%……你是不是……找到了绕过卧底警察的漏洞？

source: I think so! And it makes sense. If you just give us the drugs for free, no undercover cop could possibly catch you!
target: 我看是！而且说得通。只要你免费把毒品送给我们，卧底警察就根本抓不了你！

source: Say, that's true... But wait, is this just an elaborate scheme to make me give you free drugs?
target: 嘿，还真是……可等等，这不会是什么精心设计的圈套，就为了骗我送你们毒品吧？
……不是？

source: It's a very simple scheme to make you give us free drugs!
target: 没精心设计，骗你送毒品这招很简单！

source: ...So are we getting drugs or nah?
target: ……所以，到底能不能拿到毒品？

source: Nah.
target: 不能。

source: Yeah, that's fair.
target: 行，也合理。

source: This was pretty much all Scott's fault, but since this is a co-op game, it's your fault too. You lose -3 HYPE.
target: 这基本全是斯科特的锅，可谁让这是合作游戏呢，你也得背。你失去了 -3 热度。

source: Ugh, now we gotta go to a DIPLOMA dealer? This is getting pretty convoluted...
target: 唉，现在还得去找卖文凭的？这也太绕了吧……

source: Yeaaah... but y'know... anything for the partaaaay!
target: 是啊……不过嘛……为了派对，什么都值！

source: Before you know it, you, Polly, Scott, and the Ghosts of Parties Past are meeting a shady diploma dealer in a back alley.
target: 还没反应过来，你、波莉、斯科特和昔日派对之鬼，就已经在后巷里跟一个鬼鬼祟祟的假文凭贩子碰头了。

source: "All right," he says, "what kinda diploma you want?" He opens his trenchcoat to reveal a variety of forged certificates.
target: “行吧，”他说，“想要什么文凭？”他掀开风衣，里面挂满了各种假证。

source: Wait, that's it? It's just that easy? No code? No convoluted rendezvous?
target: 等等，就这样？这么简单？不用暗号，也不用折腾半天约地点？

source: "Nah, fam. Why bother? The law doesn't give a fuck about forged diplomas."
target: “不用，兄弟。费那个劲干吗？根本没人管卖假文凭这事。”

source: "If anything, legit diplomas are the REAL scam. College is so expensive, and for what? To get the same paper I'm about to sell you for fifty bucks?"
target: “要我说，真文凭才是最大的骗局。上大学花那么多钱，为的什么？还不是跟我这五十块就能卖给你的一样，一张纸？”

source: Whoa... so deep... so true...
target: 哇……好深刻……好有道理……

source: Look, we could stand around all day contemplating the depressing higher-education money trap, or we could buy drugs. I want drugs.
target: 听着，咱们可以站这儿感叹一整天，高等教育这个烧钱陷阱有多令人绝望；也可以去买毒品。我选毒品。

source: The diploma dealer happily sells each of the ghosts a forged architecture diploma, which they bring back to Tommy.
target: 文凭贩子高高兴兴地给每个幽灵都卖了一张假建筑学文凭。他们拿上证，回去找汤米。

source: Oh, you guys are architects? That's great! You can't possibly be cops!
target: 哦，你们是建筑师？太好了！那肯定不是警察！

source: I should've guessed anyway; architects are some of my best clients. That's why there are so many weird buildings around today.
target: 早该猜到的，建筑师可是我的优质客户。所以现在才到处都是奇奇怪怪的建筑。

source: Awesooome... gimme the good shit, Tommy... gimme that shit that made Gaudi make a house look like a coral reef.
target: 棒极了……好货拿来，汤米……就是能让高迪把房子盖成珊瑚礁的那种。

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, you came through in a big way today. I really hope we run into you at Veranotone.
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，今天真是多亏了你。希望咱们能在 Veranotone 再碰上。

source: You hope so too! The ghosts leave with pockets full of drugs, and you make off with RESOURCES full of +5 STAMINA.
target: 你也这么希望！幽灵们兜里装满了毒品，而你的资源栏里则装进了 +5 体力。
