target: 唉，现在还得去找卖文凭的？这也太绕了吧……

source: Yeaaah... but y'know... anything for the partaaaay!
target: 是啊……不过嘛……为了派对，什么都值！

source: First things first: track down a diploma dealer. After several hours of making phone calls, you finally find a guy named Timmy who's willing to sell you one.
target: 先办第一件事：找个卖文凭的。打了几个小时电话，你们终于找到一个叫提米的家伙，愿意卖给你们一张。

source: The problem is, Timmy only communicates in weird, obscure diploma-dealer code. You gotta figure out what it means!
target: 问题是，提米只用晦涩古怪的文凭贩子暗号交流。得先弄明白他说的是什么！

source: After several more hours of researching the ancient diploma-dealers' Rosetta Stone, you can read his code and ask for what you want.
target: 又研究了好几个小时古代文凭贩子的罗塞塔石碑，你们总算看懂暗号，说明了想买什么。

source: But now Timmy's paranoid about meeting you someplace too public. You have to establish a rendezvous point he's comfortable with!
target: 可提米又怕见面地点太公开，不安全。你们还得定一个让他安心的交易地点！

source: You settle on meeting at his parents' house for dinner. You spend hours pretending to like his dads' tuna casserole and terrible Borat impressions.
target: 最后定在他父母家吃晚饭。你们花了好几个小时，假装很喜欢他爸爸们做的金枪鱼焗饭，还有模仿波拉特的烂表演。

source: Finally, your friends corner Timmy and demand the diplomas. He's reaching into his pocket... but then he stops.
target: 最后，朋友们把提米堵住，要求拿文凭。他伸手摸向口袋……又停住了。

source: "Wait a sec," he says suspiciously. "You guys aren't cops, are you?"
target: “等等，”他疑神疑鬼地问，“你们不是警察吧？”

source: NO. WE'RE NOT COPS. JESUS FUCKING CHRIST I JUST WANT DRUGS.
target: 不是。我们不是警察。我操他妈的，我就想买点毒品。

source: "Yeah, well, you gotta prove it. I'm trying to run an illegal business here; I can't be selling diplomas to any old cop!"
target: “那也得证明。我这可是非法生意，不能随便把文凭卖给警察！”

source: Aw, fuck. I think we found the Catch-22 of illegal activities.
target: 妈的，我们好像撞上违法活动的“第二十二条军规”了。

source: So it would seem. You did all that work for nothing, and lose -3 HYPE.
target: 看来是的。忙了这么一大圈，全是白费劲。你失去了 -3 热度。

source: Heya, you just reached a high amount of HYPE. Good for you!
target: 嘿，你的热度已经攒得很高了。不错嘛！

source: Does that mean you're aiming for... the HYPE-BASED DESTINATION?
target: 这么说，你的目标是……以热度为条件的目的地？

source: If so, there's a wacky adventure that could unlock a layer for that DESTINATION... wanna go for it?
target: 要是这样，有场荒唐冒险能解锁这个目的地的额外内容……要试试吗？

source: LET'S GO!
target: 冲吧！

source: Sorry, not in the mood.
target: 对不起,没心情

source: Great! The adventure will be waiting for you on the road.
target: 太好了！这场冒险会在路上等着你。

source: Sorry for breaking the 4th wall... see ya!
target: 抱歉，打破第四面墙了……回见！

source: Gotcha, I just wanted to check. Sorry for breaking the 4th wall!
target: 明白，我就问问。抱歉，打破第四面墙了！

source: You drive past Susanne and Whiskey wiping grease off their arms outside of an old car mechanic shop. You pull over to say hi!
target: 你们路过一家老汽修店，看见苏珊娜和威士忌正在店外擦胳膊上的油污，于是靠边停车，过去打个招呼！

source: Hey, bros! What're you up to?
target: 嘿，兄弟们！忙什么呢？

source: We're working on our bumper car to enter in the annual Bumpin' Uglies tournament.
target: 我们在改装碰碰车，准备参加一年一度的“激情碰撞”大赛。

source: It's a no-holds-barred knockout battle royale held at Knife Land every year, and we're gonna fuckin' CRUSH IT.
target: 刀子乐园每年都办，毫无规则限制的淘汰大逃杀。我们他妈的要横扫全场！

source: Especially with my incredible misdirection strategy. Those amateurs won't even know what hit 'em!
target: 尤其有我这套出神入化的障眼法策略。那帮菜鸟被撞了都不知道是谁干的！

source: Nah, fuck misdirection! The best strategy is to crash into everyone else FIRST and HARD!
target: 去他的障眼法！最好的策略就是抢先撞，狠狠撞，挨个撞！

source: Susanne, I don't know if Bumpin' Uglies is the right place for a full-frontal assault...
target: 苏珊娜，“激情碰撞”大赛恐怕不太适合正面猛攻……

source: We should play defensively. I know you'd rather take the thrillseeker route, but the only thrill I seek is the THRILL OF VICTORY.
target: 该打防守。我知道你想走刺激路线，可我唯一追求的刺激，就是胜利的刺激。

source: But what's the point of even Bumpin' Uglies if you're not willing to play hard and dirty and possibly kill your partner?
target: 又猛又脏地干，连搭档都可能送命，这才够味啊！连这都不敢，还参加什么“激情碰撞”？

source: Because I'M your partner, and I don't wanna die!
target: 因为我就是你的搭档，我不想死！

source: Ugh, that non-team-player thinking is exactly why we haven't settled on a final design for our bumper car yet.
target: 唉，就是因为你这么没团队精神，咱们才到现在都定不下碰碰车的最终设计。

source: You know, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s got lots of experience butting in on other people's problems. I bet %HESHE% could help you pick a final design.
target: 说起来，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%最擅长插手别人的事。%HESHE%肯定能帮你们定下设计。

source: Sure, why not? Which design do you like best, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?
target: 行啊，试试呗。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你喜欢哪一款？

source: "The 'Baby on Board' is the better design. You'll avoid full confrontation, since MOST cars will avoid running over a baby!"
target: “‘车上有宝宝’更好。大部分车都不愿意轧到婴儿，正好能避开正面冲突！”

source: "The 'Just Lots of Eels' is the better design. It doesn't avoid full confrontation, but it provides a fuckton of eels, which when weaponized are great for full confrontation!"
target: “‘就是鳗鱼多’更好。它躲不开正面冲突，但能提供他妈的一大堆鳗鱼；把鳗鱼变成武器，就特别适合正面冲突了！”

source: Fuck yeah, that was my idea! You have excellent taste, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 太他妈对了，那是我的主意！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你真有眼光。

source: I call bias! Of course %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% could tell it was your idea. It's so like you to use a deceptively adorable exterior to hide a badass interior!
target: 这不公平！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%肯定一眼就知道是你想的。用可爱的外表骗人，把凶残的内在藏起来——太像你了！

source: I'll take that as a compliment!
target: 我就当你在夸我了！

source: Even if Susanne's not enthused, you're confident that the Baby on Board is the smarter strategy, and gain +N2 MIND for your keen insight!
target: 苏珊娜虽然不太买账，你却确信，“车上有宝宝”才是更明智的策略。敏锐的洞察力让你获得了 +N2 头脑！

source: Later, at Knife Land's 12th annual Bumpin' Uglies tournament, a team of banshees are competing in the bumper-car battle royale.
target: 后来，在刀子乐园第十二届年度“激情碰撞”大赛上，一队女妖正开着碰碰车，参加这场大逃杀。

source: "Someone's coming up on our right!" the one at the wheel shouts. "It's... wait... is that a giant baby?"
target: “右边有车冲过来了！”开车的女妖喊道，“那是……等等……一个巨婴？”

source: "Huh?" says her partner. "No, that's definitely just a bumper car disguised with papier-maché to look like a baby."
target: “啊？”她的搭档说，“不是，分明就是辆碰碰车，用纸糊成了婴儿的样子。”

source: "But there's still a small chance that it really is a giant baby that's wandered onto the battlefield! We can't risk accidentally hurting a baby!"
target: “可万一真是个误闯战场的巨婴呢！咱们不能冒险伤到小宝宝啊！”

source: They spend too long arguing, and the baby-car is upon them. Susanne and Whiskey jump out of the papier-maché flaps with chainsaws ready!
target: 她们争论得太久，婴儿车已经冲到眼前。苏珊娜和威士忌掀开纸糊的外壳，拎着电锯跳了出来！

source: SURPRISE, BITCHES!
target: 惊不惊喜，贱人们！

source: HA! Was someone too scawed to muwder a wittwe baby?
target: 哈！谁怕怕呀，不敢杀小宝宝呀？

source: I TOLD YOU NOT TO DO THE BABY VOICE, MAN!
target: 老子说过，别他妈学宝宝说话！

source: And I told YOU that if we're doing the baby car, I'm doing the baby voice. I'm method, Susanne!
target: 我也说过，既然开婴儿车，我就要学宝宝说话。我是方法派，苏珊娜！

source: Despite being cringe about it, Susanne and Whiskey get the drop on their foes and totally chainsaw them to death.
target: 虽然场面让人尴尬得脚趾抠地，苏珊娜和威士忌还是打了对手一个措手不及，用电锯把她们全干掉了。

source: I guess this is working, but pretending to be a baby is still a cowardly way to win. This is kinda bringing down my -N2 HYPE.
target: 行吧，是挺管用，可装成宝宝赢比赛，还是太怂了。搞得我都 -N2 热度了。

source: Critique all you want; you just can't acknowwedge the bwiwwiance and badassewy of my supewior intewwigence!
target: 随你说去吧，你就是不肯承认，本宝宝超群智商的英明和霸气嘛！

source: Ugh...
HAHA, YES! I knew you'd appreciate my genius, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!
target: 哈哈，对！我就知道你懂得欣赏我的天才，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！

source: So the strategy is just... eels?
target: 所以，策略就是……鳗鱼？

source: No, even better. The strategy is "LOTS of eels."
target: 不，比那还棒。策略是“好多好多鳗鱼”。

source: I just don't see how that'll work against a bumper car with actual weapons...
target: 可对面碰碰车要是装了真武器，这招怎么打啊……

source: Dude, you're thinking too hard about it. Who needs weapons when we've got FUCKIN' EELS!
target: 兄弟，想太多了。咱们他妈的有鳗鱼，还要什么武器！

source: Later, at Knife Land's 12th annual Bumpin' Uglies tournament, a team of banshees are competing in the bumper-car battle royale.
target: 后来，在刀子乐园第十二届年度“激情碰撞”大赛上，一队女妖正开着碰碰车，参加这场大逃杀。

source: "Someone's coming up on our right!" says the one manning the harpoon. "What's their weapon?"
target: “右边有车冲过来了！”负责鱼叉的女妖说，“她们用的什么武器？”

source: "I can't tell from here," says the one driving. "It looks like they're throwing something?"
target: “太远，看不清，”开车的说，“好像在往外扔什么东西？”

source: "Is it fireballs? It's usually fireballs. Nobody has any imagination anymore."
target: “火球？一般都是火球。现在的人真是一点想象力都没有。”

source: "No, it's not. It looks kinda like slimy ropes... or wait, is it--?"
target: “不是，好像是滑溜溜的绳子……等等，难道是——？”

source: FUCK YEAH! GET EEL'D, BITCHES!
target: 爽！吃老娘一鳗鱼，贱人们！

source: Quit jumping, Susanne! You're gonna spill the eels!
target: 别蹦了，苏珊娜！鳗鱼要洒了！

source: Susanne chucks some eels at the banshees. They get electrocuted and fall out of their bumper car, allowing Whiskey to run them over. Nice!
target: 苏珊娜朝女妖们扔出几条鳗鱼。她们触电，从碰碰车里摔了出去，威士忌顺势开车轧了过去。漂亮！

source: You gain +N2 HYPE for picking such an incredible strategy, but using a bunch of eels to massacre people at a battle royale isn't very eel-friendly, so you lose -N2 SOUL.
target: 这么棒的策略，让你获得了 +N2 热度；不过，拿一堆鳗鱼在大逃杀里屠杀对手，对鳗鱼实在不太友好，所以你也失去了 -N2 灵魂。

source: You're driving along when you see Kale and Abdu at a gas station. Kale's holding what looks like a big vase. You pull over to say hello.
target: 开车途中，你们看见卡莱和阿卜杜在加油站。卡莱抱着个像大花瓶的东西。你们停下车，过去打招呼。

source: Hey, guys! What'cha got there? Some kind of weird, artisanal hookah?
target: 嘿，各位！拿的是什么？什么奇怪的手工水烟壶？

source: Uh... no. This is actually my grandpa's urn.
target: 呃……不是。其实，这是我爷爷的骨灰罐。

source: Oh...
But THIS is our weird, artisanal hookah. Want a hit?
target: 不过，这个才是我们的奇怪手工水烟壶。来一口？

source: Yes please!
target: 好啊，谢谢！

source: All yours, girl. We just pulled over to toke up one last time before we get to Knife Land.
target: 拿去吧，姐妹。我们刚停下来，打算到刀子乐园前再抽最后一轮。

source: Hey, we're going to Knife Land too! I didn't think that'd be your sort of scene, though.
target: 嘿，我们也去刀子乐园！不过，我还以为你们不会喜欢那种地方呢。

source: Nah, you're right. I hate loud, crowded places...
target: 嗯，你没想错。我讨厌又吵又挤的地方……

source: But my grandpa loved Knife Land, and I loved spending time with him, so we used to go together every year.
target: 可爷爷特别喜欢刀子乐园，我也喜欢陪他。所以以前每年，我们都一起去。

source: He died a few months ago, so I wanted to spread his ashes at the park. To honor him, y'know.
target: 几个月前他去世了，我想把他的骨灰撒在乐园里。算是纪念他吧。

source: That's sweet, boo. If you ever want to talk through your grief, or just get buttered in the Knife Land parking lot together, you know where to find me.
target: 真有心，宝贝。哪天想找人聊聊难过的事，或者只想在刀子乐园停车场一起嗨一场，随时找我。

source: Thanks. Now that you mention it, there is something you could help me with...
target: 谢谢。既然你这么说了，倒真有件事想请你们帮忙……

source: See, Grandpa gave me this mysterious letter on his deathbed. He said it was important.
target: 爷爷临终前给了我一封神秘的信，说它很重要。

source: But he had awful handwriting, so I can't read it. I know it's a shot in the dark, but can any of you figure it out?
target: 可他字写得太潦草，我看不懂。虽然未必有用，你们能帮我辨认一下吗？

source: Uh... sorry, bro, I can't make this out. Did your grandpa write this in Russian?
target: 呃……抱歉，兄弟，真看不出来。你爷爷写的是俄语吗？

source: Nah. Cursive.
target: 不是。是英文连笔字。

source: Yeah, no way can your zoomer ass read old man cursive. But you're not out of ideas yet...
target: 没错，你这 Z 世代小年轻，怎么可能看得懂老头的连笔字。不过你还有别的办法……

source: You must find Grandpa's old acquaintances. Old people's texting apparently involved handwriting, so they might understand the will!
target: 去找爷爷的老朋友。据说老人以前“发消息”都得用手写，说不定能看懂这份遗嘱！

source: This might be the only time that you can think of that one of those professional calligraphy analysts might come in handy! Hire one!
target: 那些专业笔迹分析师，可能也就这时候才派得上用场！雇一个！

source: Hey, good idea. Old people have a lot of cool stories to tell if you're willing to listen. Let's give some of Grandpa's old buddies a call.
target: 嘿，好主意。只要愿意听，老人们能讲出不少精彩故事。给爷爷的几个老朋友打个电话吧。

source: Kale pulls out his phone and rings up someone.
target: 卡莱拿出手机，拨通了一个号码。

source: Hi, I'm looking for Eugene Patterson. You were on a firefighting squad with my grandpa Basil, right?
target: 您好，请问是尤金·帕特森吗？您以前跟我爷爷巴兹尔在一个消防队，对吧？

source: "Yes! Basil was such a brave man... to be covered in flammable leaves and still devote your life to firefighting..."
target: “对！巴兹尔真是个勇士……明明浑身都是易燃的叶子，却还是把一生献给了消防事业……”

source: "You know that's how your grandpa got bald? His head leaves got burned while saving a pregnant woman from a building on fire..."
target: “知道你爷爷怎么秃的吗？有次他冲进着火的大楼，救了个孕妇，脑袋上的叶子全烧掉了……”

source: "Other men get insecure from early baldness... but Basil? That never stopped him from pulling tail. Your grandpa was a real horndog back in the day, y'know!"
target: “别的男人年纪轻轻就秃了，难免自卑……可巴兹尔呢？照样风流快活。你爷爷年轻时，那可真是个老色鬼啊！”

source: I'd... rather not know about the sexual life of my grandfather.
target: 我……不太想了解我爷爷的性生活。

source: "I can respect that, boy."
target: “行，孩子，我尊重你的想法。”

source: "Anyway, we stayed in close touch even after he retired. Your grandpa actually invited me onto his houseboat a few times before the end."
target: “总之，他退休以后，我们也一直常联系。临终前，他还邀请我去他的船屋玩过几回。”

source: "So many fond memories on that boat... Basil and I spent entire days... uhm... churning butter and eating delicious churros."
target: “那艘船上，全是美好的回忆……我和巴兹尔一整天都在……呃……搅黄油，吃美味的吉拿棒。”

source: Such a foodie, your grandpa!
target: 你爷爷真是个美食家！

source: "He always wanted for that boat to become yours one day."
target: “他一直盼着，有一天那艘船能交到你手里。”

source: "He knew you're not as much of a 'foodie', but he hoped you could create your own fond memories there."
target: “他知道你没那么爱‘美食’，不过希望你能在那里，留下属于自己的美好回忆。”

source: Kale! Your grandpa's letter had a wax seal with a boat on it! That's it!
target: 卡莱！你爷爷那封信上有个蜡封，画着一条船！肯定就是这个！

source: It seems so. That's so thoughtful of gramps... we sometimes went fishing on that boat.
target: 看来是的。爷爷想得真周到……我们以前还一起在那条船上钓过鱼。

source: Anyway, thanks for helping me out guys. Looks like we're gonna take a detour to find a boat, but hopefully we'll see you at Knife Land.
target: 总之，谢谢你们帮忙。看来得绕个道，先去找条船了。希望还能在刀子乐园见到你们。

source: You say goodbye, gaining +N2 SOUL for helping Kale, but losing -N2 HYPE for sitting through an old man's long-winded tale about someone else's grandpa.
target: 你们挥手告别。帮了卡莱，让你获得了 +N2 灵魂；可听一个老头滔滔不绝地聊别人的爷爷，也让你失去了 -N2 热度。

source: Uhh, how do we know this "analyst" isn't just scamming us into thinking they can read this letter to make a quick buck?
target: 呃，怎么知道这个“分析师”不是想骗快钱，装作自己看得懂这封信呢？

source: "I understand. How about I give you a free trial of my skills?" asks the analyst you hired. "Sign your names here, and I'll interpret your handwriting."
target: “我明白。不如免费展示一下我的本领？”你们雇来的分析师说，“请在这里签名，我来解读各位的笔迹。”

source: "Let's see... Kale, I can see by your cramped, all-lowercase handwriting that you're an introverted person who values their privacy."
target: “我看看……卡莱，你的字挤得紧紧的，全用小写，说明你很内向，也很重视个人隐私。”

source: Dang. That's spot-on!
target: 哇，说得真准！

source: "Abdu, your flowy half-cursive shows you're a go-with-the-flow type who knows how to pull off sick skateboard tricks."
target: “阿卜杜，你流畅的半连笔字，说明你性格随和，而且能玩出很炫的滑板花样。”

source: Guilty as charged.
target: 被你说中了。

source: "Scott, you're happy-go-lucky and in touch with your inner child, as shown by the smiley face you put in your O."
target: “斯科特，你在名字的 O 里画了张笑脸，说明你乐天知足，也始终保持着童心。”

source: Thanks! I like it when my name looks like it's in a good mood!
target: 谢谢！我喜欢让自己的名字看起来心情很好！

source: "Polly, anyone looking at your signature could tell that... you're pretty drunk right now."
target: “波莉，任何人看到你的签名，都能知道……你现在醉得不轻。”

source: Eh, lucky guess.
target: 嗨，蒙对罢了。

source: Well, I'm convinced. Do you think you can read the handwriting in this letter from my grandfather?
target: 好吧，我信了。那能看懂我爷爷这封信的笔迹吗？

source: "Um... I'm sorry, but this handwriting is too messy even for me... I may be able to help in another way, though."
target: “呃……抱歉，这字连我也认不出来……不过，我也许能从别的角度帮忙。”

source: "I see that your grandpa's handwriting slants occasionally to the left, then to the right. The oscillation of the pen strokes is equal to the slow rolling of waves."
target: “你爷爷的笔迹一会儿左斜，一会儿右斜，笔画摆动的幅度，恰好与水波的缓慢起伏一致。”

source: "Therefore, I'm pretty sure he was writing this letter on a lake. It could be that he's describing a boat he left for you."
target: “所以，我很确定，他是在湖上写的这封信。也许信里提到了他留给你的一艘船。”

source: You got all that just from the directions of the letters?
target: 光看字母歪向哪边，就能知道这么多？

source: "Well, there's that, and there's an official wax seal at the bottom of the paper with an anchor on it."
target: “那个是一方面。另一方面，信纸底下还有一枚正式蜡封，上面画着船锚。”

source: Oh, yep, there sure is... then it looks like we're gonna detour to find a boat. Thanks for the help, guys.
target: 哦，还真有……看来得绕个道，先去找条船了。谢谢大家帮忙。

source: No problem! You lose -N2 MONEY paying the calligraphy analyst, but gain +N2 SOUL for helping Kale.
target: 不客气！支付笔迹分析师的费用，让你失去了 -N2 金钱；帮了卡莱，又让你获得了 +N2 灵魂。

source: *YAAAWN!* Morning, bros! Thanks for letting me take a little nap while %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s driving.
target: *哈——欠！*早啊，兄弟们！谢谢你们让我趁%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%开车的时候，眯了一会儿。

source: No prob, but don't be alarmed. There have been some... developments since you fell asleep.
target: 小事，不过你先别慌。你睡着以后，情况有了点……发展。

source: That's one way to put it. The HR rep sitting in front of you all says, "Welcome, everyone, to Knife Land's open mascot hiring event!"
target: 这说法可真够委婉的。坐在你们面前的人事代表开口了：“欢迎各位参加刀子乐园的吉祥物公开招聘！”

source: Sup.
target: 哟。

source: Nice to meet you, ma'am. Thanks for letting my friend Mamimi and I apply for this position.
target: 您好，女士。谢谢您让我和朋友马美美申请这个职位。

source: Oh, wow! One minute I'm napping, the next I'm about to get a job! I dunno why my grandma made finding a career sound so hard.
target: 哇！前一秒我还在睡觉，下一秒就要找到工作了！真不知道奶奶为什么总把找工作说得那么难。

source: (Noooo, silly, we're not here to ACTUALLY get jobs. We're gonna bomb this interview and make Sawyer and Mamimi look better by comparison!)
target: （不——是——啦，傻瓜，我们又不是真的来找工作。咱们故意把面试搞砸，才能衬得索伊尔和马美美更优秀！）

source: (Oh, really? That's nice of us!)
target: （哦，真的？咱们人真好！）

source: (Totes! It was always my intention; I definitely didn't see a billboard for this thing, decide I felt like fucking some shit up, and force %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% to pull over.)
target: （那当然！我一开始就这么打算的。绝对不是因为看见招聘广告牌，突然想搞点破坏，才逼%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%停的车。）

source: (Makes sense to me!)
target: （听起来很合理！）

source: Now, let's start with a bit of an unorthodox prompt. Rather than list all your strengths as job candidates, tell me what your biggest WEAKNESS is.
target: 先来个不太常规的问题吧。比起列举各位应聘的优势，我更想知道，你们最大的弱点是什么？

source: Uh... I can be kinda shy, I guess. But that's why I'm a great fit for a job where I wear a mask all day and barely talk. Mamimi, what's yours?
target: 呃……我大概有点害羞。不过这份工作要整天戴面具，又不怎么用说话，正好适合我。马美美，你呢？

source: Mamimi takes a long, noisy sip from her energy drink.
target: 马美美拿起能量饮料，吸溜了长长一口，声音响得很。

source: ...Emotional unavailability.
target: ……无法投入感情。

source: MY BIGGEST WEAKNESS IS MY INCURABLE BUTT RASH!
target: 我最大的弱点，就是屁股上永远治不好的疹子！

source: Gross.
target: 恶心。

source: (Don't worry, Mamimi, I lied; my butt rash IS curable.)
target: （别担心，马美美，我撒谎了。我的屁股疹子是能治好的。）

source: My biggest weakness is my brutal honesty, and that I don't give a fuck about this job and will deliberately fuck it up if given the opportunity.
target: 我最大的弱点是，诚实得太伤人。另外就是，我压根不在乎这份工作，有机会一定故意把它搞砸。

source: Guess it's your turn now. What's your biggest weakness?

source: Shh, don't cry, it's okay. Flailard's here. Flailard's got you.
target: 嘘，别哭，没事的。弗莱拉德来了，弗莱拉德会照顾你。

source: Good work, you two! Way to calm the child and take charge of the situation. Now, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, how would you respond?
target: 你们俩做得很好！既安抚了孩子，也控制住了局面。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，换成你会怎么办？

source: "We show the lost child on the park's big screen... then we threaten to cut them in half so the real parents reveal themselves. Parents hate when their children are cut in half!"
target: “把走失的孩子投到乐园大屏幕上，再威胁把人切成两半，亲生父母就会现身了。父母最受不了孩子被切成两半！”

source: "No shenanigans this time. We should always honor the park rule: finders keepers."
target: “这次不胡闹了。必须遵守乐园的规则：谁捡到，就归谁。”

source: Before any objections can be made, you've pulled out a sword and are holding it over HR rep's chest.
target: 还没等人提出异议，你已经拔出剑，悬在人事代表胸前。

source: THIS GIRL'S PARENTS HAD BETTER COME CLAIM HER, OR SHE'S GETTIN' BISECTED!
target: 这女孩的父母最好赶紧来认领，不然我可要把她切成两半了！

source: WAIT! We're... uh... we're actually this child's parents. So don't cut her in half, maybe?
target: 等等！我们……呃……其实是这孩子的父母。所以，能不能别把她切成两半？

source: Yeah. Also, just to add: I don't think murdering the HR rep would help us get this job.
target: 对。另外，补充一句，我不觉得杀了人事代表能帮我们找到工作。

source: I'M ALSO THIS CHILD'S MOTHER!
target: 我也是这孩子的妈妈！

source: What?!
target: 什么？！

source: THE PLOT THICKENS!
target: 剧情越来越复杂了！

source: Gertrude... I suppose you never told Hugh that he wasn't Wilma's real father. I understand you were trying to save your marriage, but I can't take it anymore.
target: 格特鲁德……看来你始终没告诉休，他不是威尔玛的亲生父亲。我知道你想保住婚姻，可我实在忍不下去了。

source: Seeing %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% almost cut little Wilma in half opened my eyes: this child is mine, and I want to be part of her life!
target: 看见%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%差点把小威尔玛切成两半，我才恍然大悟：这是我的孩子，我想参与她的人生！

source: Eh... uh...
Umm... it's okay... Gertrude. I forgive you for having an affair; I know I wasn't a perfect partner to you either...
target: 嗯……没事……格特鲁德。我原谅你出轨了。我知道，我也没当好你的伴侣……

source: If... eh... Paul here wants to be part of Wilma's life, I know we'll make it work, right?
target: 如果……呃……这位保罗想参与威尔玛的人生，那咱们一定能安排好的，对吧？

source: Uh... okay?
target: 呃……好？

source: AND SCENE!
target: 好，收戏！

source: Bravo! Excellent role-play session; such pathos, such character development! I'm ready to make my decision.
target: 精彩！这场角色扮演真棒，多么深切的情感，多么丰富的人物成长！我已经可以做决定了。

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, sorry, but we can't hire you. You just don't have that 'spark' we're looking for, and threatening to kill me wasn't a plus.
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，抱歉，我们不能录用你。你缺少我们想要的那点“灵气”，而且威胁杀掉我，也不算加分项。

source: But Sawyer, Mamimi: you seem like a perfect fit, knowing the few park rules we have and not jumping to commit crimes at every chance. You're hired!
target: 不过，索伊尔、马美美，你们很合适。既懂得乐园为数不多的规则，也不会一有机会就去犯罪。你们被录用了！

source: Cool.
target: 酷毙了

source: Despite your best efforts, you somehow succeeded at helping Mamimi and Sawyer get this job. You gain +5 HYPE!
target: 明明你都这么折腾了，居然还是帮马美美和索伊尔拿到了工作。你获得了 +5 热度！

source: Before any objections can be made, you've pulled out a sword and are holding it over HR rep's chest.
target: 还没等人提出异议，你已经拔出剑，悬在人事代表胸前。

source: THIS GIRL'S PARENTS HAD BETTER COME CLAIM HER, OR SHE'S GETTIN' BISECTED!
target: 这女孩的父母最好赶紧来认领，不然我可要把她切成两半了！

source: Silence. Not even a whimper of fear from the HR rep. Damn, you thought you were at least a LITTLE intimidating...
target: 一片寂静。人事代表连声害怕的哼唧都没发出来。靠，你还以为自己多少有点威慑力呢……

source: You're doing this all wrong, boo. You're not holding your sword with any conviction; I don't buy your murderous intent at all.
target: 宝贝，你这演得全错了。拿剑一点狠劲儿都没有，谁信你真想杀人啊。

source: You gotta really sell it or the threat isn't convincing. Let me demonstrate. The trick's all in how you move your wrists, look...
target: 得演像一点，威胁才有用。我给你示范。诀窍全在手腕的动作，看……

source: Polly takes the sword, twists her wrists, and accidentally cuts the HR rep cleanly in half.
target: 波莉接过剑，转了转手腕，不小心干净利落地把人事代表切成了两半。

source: You're right, Polly! That DOES look convincing!
target: 你说得对，波莉！这看起来可有说服力了！

source: WELL I THINK THAT'S OUR CUE TO LEAVE
target: 好我看咱们该走了

source: But--!
YOU GUYS HOLD ONTO THIS SWORD AND IF THE COPS ASK WE WERE NEVER HERE OKAY BYE
target: 你们拿好这把剑警察要问就说我们没来过好吗拜拜

source: You all GTFO before anyone can get another word in. You manage to evade arrest, but not the -3 SOUL loss.
target: 还没等别人再说一个字，你们就全溜了。逮捕是躲过了，-3 灵魂可没躲过。

source: That's not a park rule, though.
target: 可乐园没有这条规定啊。

source: I'm pretty sure it is.
target: 我很确定，有的。

source: Nope. Definitely not.
target: 没有。绝对没有。

source: True, it isn't. Way to know the rulebook, Sawyer and Mamimi, and thanks for exercising general common sense!
target: 没错，确实没有。索伊尔、马美美，看来你们熟读了规则手册，谢谢你们运用了基本常识！

source: Well maybe it should be a rule! Have you considered the upsides to finders-keepers?
target: 那就该加上这条！想过“谁捡到就归谁”能有多少好处吗？

source: As in... the upsides of kidnapping random children?
target: 你是说……随便绑架小孩的好处？

source: Exactly!
target: 没错!

source: For instance, you could put all the kids in a boy band and have them perform at the park. You could call them "The Lost Children"!
target: 比如，把小孩全编进一个男子组合，让他们在乐园演出。名字就叫“走失儿童”！

source: Hmm, having our own boy band WOULD be good for the Knife Land brand... but not the kidnapping idea you proposed. That'd be a PR nightmare, unfortunately.
target: 嗯，有自己的男子组合，的确有助于刀子乐园的品牌形象……可不能用你那套绑架办法。很遗憾，那会是场公关噩梦。

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, you and your friends do have some charming ideas, but most of your ideas are just crimes. We'll have to pass on you.
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你和朋友的点子确实有点意思，可大部分都是犯罪。我们没法录用你。

source: But Sawyer and Mamimi... I don't know if it's just those three setting the bar so low, but you seem like a perfect fit. You're hired!
target: 不过索伊尔和马美美……不知道是不是那三位把标准拉得太低了，总之，你们非常合适。录用了！

source: Awesome!
target: 太棒了！

source: Despite your best efforts, you somehow succeeded at helping Mamimi and Sawyer get this job. You gain +5 HYPE!
target: 明明你都这么折腾了，居然还是帮马美美和索伊尔拿到了工作。你获得了 +5 热度！

source: That's not a park rule, though.
target: 可乐园没有这条规定啊。

source: I'm pretty sure it is. I'd even go as far as to say it's an unspoken rule in general.
target: 我很确定，有的。甚至可以说，这是大家默认的规矩。

source: Maybe for, like, a lighter you found on the floor, but not a whole-ass kid.
target: 地上捡个打火机，可能还算。可那是个活生生的小孩啊。

source: Bullshit! Then explain how I have this baby I found the other day!
target: 放屁！那怎么解释，我前两天捡的这个宝宝，现在还在我这儿！

source: WHAT?! Where did that baby even come from?!
target: 什么？！这宝宝到底哪来的？！

source: Not from my coochie, that's for sure!
target: 反正肯定不是从我裆里出来的！

source: Polly, finders-keepers is NOT a thing. What you've done is actually a crime.
target: 波莉，没有“谁捡到就归谁”这回事。你这叫犯罪。

source: Oh... yikes.
target: 哦……糟糕。

source: This is horrifying. I'm definitely required to call the police.
target: 太可怕了，我必须报警。

source: NOPE! SCOTT, GO LONG!
target: 不行！斯科特，跑远点接球！

source: On it!
target: 收到！

source: Scott grabs the baby and throws it like a football at the HR rep. Miraculously, she catches it!
target: 斯科特抓起宝宝，像传橄榄球一样朝人事代表扔了过去。奇迹般地，她接住了！

source: Welp, you were the last person to touch the baby, so it's yours now!
target: 好了，你是最后碰到宝宝的人，现在归你啦！

source: That's not how that works either.
target: 也没这规矩。

source: Sorry, can't hear you! We're too busy running back to our car!
target: 抱歉，听不见！我们忙着跑回车里呢！

source: You all GTFO before anyone can get another word in. You manage to evade arrest, but not the -3 SOUL loss.
target: 还没等别人再说一个字，你们就全溜了。逮捕是躲过了，-3 灵魂可没躲过。

source: Heya, you just reached a high amount of SOUL. Good for you!
target: 嘿，你的灵魂已经攒得很高了。不错嘛！

source: Does that mean you're aiming for... the SOUL-BASED DESTINATION?
target: 这么说，你的目标是……以灵魂为条件的目的地？

source: If so, there's a wacky adventure that could unlock a layer for that DESTINATION... wanna go for it?
target: 要是这样，有场荒唐冒险能解锁这个目的地的额外内容……要试试吗？

source: Yay!
target: 好耶！

source: Nay!
target: 不要！

source: Great! The adventure will be waiting for you on the road.
target: 太好了！这场冒险会在路上等着你。

source: Sorry for breaking the 4th wall... see ya!
target: 抱歉，打破第四面墙了……回见！

source: Gotcha, I just wanted to check. Sorry for breaking the 4th wall!
target: 明白，我就问问。抱歉，打破第四面墙了！

source: You're driving along like normal when you hear an inexplicable guitar riff. Then there's suddenly a blue anteater in your car.
target: 你们正照常开车赶路，忽然响起一段来路不明的吉他炫技。紧接着，一只蓝色食蚁兽就出现在了车里。

source: Hey! It's me, Tubular Eddy, here to remind you that cool kidz say no to gambling!
target: 嘿！是我，潮人艾迪！特地来提醒各位：酷小孩，拒绝赌博！

source: WHOA! Where did you come from, bro?
target: 哇！兄弟，你从哪儿冒出来的？

source: Haha, don't think about it!
target: 哈哈，别琢磨了！

source: Okay!
target: 好！

source: It's too late to talk us out of gambling, Eddy. We're on our way to the City of Vice to gamble right now!
target: 艾迪，现在劝我们别赌可晚了。我们正要去罪恶之城赌一把呢！

source: Bummer. Looks like you'll never be cool kidz...
target: 真遗憾，看来你们永远当不了酷小孩了……

source: Oh no. Whatever shall we do.
target: 哎呀，不好啦。这可怎么办呀。

source: It's okay, though. I'm headed to the City of Vice too, and I'd bet everything I own that I can talk you out of gambling when we get there!
target: 不过没关系，我也去罪恶之城。我敢拿全部家当打赌：等到了那儿，我肯定能说服你们戒赌！

source: Why are you going to the City of Vice? It seems like the opposite of a place someone who hates gambling would wanna go...
target: 你去罪恶之城干什么？讨厌赌博的人，按理说最不想去的就是那种地方吧……

source: Because I'm on a mission to teach the world that gambling is bad, and the City of Vice by far needs that advice the most.
target: 因为我的使命，就是让全世界明白赌博有害，而最需要这番忠告的，非罪恶之城莫属。

source: It's also where my favorite dealer does all his business. All cool kidz have a dealer!
target: 再说，我最喜欢的毒贩也在那儿做生意。酷小孩都有自己的供货商！

source: It's also where my favorite cocaine dealer does all his business. All cool kidz do coke!
target: 再说，我最喜欢的可卡因贩子也在那儿做生意。酷小孩都吸可卡因！

source: Are you sure about that...?
target: 你确定……？

source: Ha! Good luck getting the denizens of the City of Vice to give up gambling. You'd have better luck talking the merfolk into moving to the Sahara.
target: 哈！想让罪恶之城的居民戒赌？祝你好运。劝人鱼搬去撒哈拉沙漠，成功率都比这高。

source: I know, it'll be a difficult task. But I've got a funny feeling my luck's about to turn around...
target: 我知道，这任务不容易。不过我有种预感，运气马上就要好起来了……

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, you're as good at giving advice as I am at radical skateboard tricks.
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你提建议的本事，就跟我玩酷炫滑板花样的本事一样厉害。

source: Can you think of a creative way to convince a bunch of gambling addicts to give up the incredible rush of gambling?
target: 能不能想个有创意的办法，让一群赌徒放下赌博那种爽到不行的刺激？

source: The Gamble to end all Gambles: get the gamblers to gamble on how long they can go without gambling. Are they gambling if they gamble about not gambling?
target: 来一场终结赌博的豪赌：让赌徒赌自己能坚持多久不赌。如果赌的是“不赌博”，那还算赌博吗？

source: Give them a baby to raise collectively. The power of responsible parenting will push them in the right direction.
target: 给他们一个宝宝，一起抚养。为人父母的责任感，会把他们推向正道。

source: Hey, that's a great idea!
target: 嘿，好主意！

source: It is? I'm not even sure what %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% said.
target: 是吗？我都没听懂%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%说了什么。

source: Let me break it down for ya, kiddo: I'll get to the City of Vice, gather up all the gambling addicts I can find, and I'll say...
target: 我给你解释，小朋友：到了罪恶之城，我就把能找到的赌徒都召集起来，然后这么说……

source: Gather 'round, everyone! I've got the newest, coolest, tubular-est gambling game to play!
target: 各位围过来！最新、最酷、最潮的赌法来啦！

source: "That sounds great!" say the gambling addicts. "We literally cannot resist gambling on any game we can find. How do you play?"
target: “太棒了！”赌徒们说，“只要有能下注的游戏，我们根本忍不住。怎么玩？”

source: Simple: it's you vs. the house to gamble on how long you can go without gambling!
target: 简单：你们跟庄家赌，看自己能坚持多久不赌！

source: How many bets can an addict not bet if he's gambling not to gamble on the gamble?
target: 赌徒要是赌这场赌里不赌博，到底能忍住多少场赌不去赌？

source: "I've got this!" says one gambler. "I'm gonna get back into playing the cello. I'll join an orchestra and stay out of casinos for the next 20 years!"
target: “我有办法！”一个赌徒说，“我要重新拉大提琴，加入管弦乐团，二十年不进赌场！”

source: "You'll never beat me!" says another gambler. "I'm gonna focus on my kids. I'll raise them to avoid gambling, meaning we'll ALL beat the house and win triple the cash!"
target: “你赢不了我的！”另一个赌徒说，“我要专心养孩子，教他们远离赌博。这样全家都能赢庄家，奖金翻三倍！”

source: "I just have to find my kids first. I think I left them at the slot machines...?"
target: “不过得先找到我的孩子。我好像把他们留在老虎机那儿了……？”

source: ...then that guy will find his kids, then they'll all be "betting" to see who goes without gambling the longest, and they'll all win by never gambling again!
target: ……然后那个人就会找到孩子，大家一起“赌”谁戒赌戒得最久，最后再也不赌，人人都是赢家！

source: So... they're gambling... by not gambling? How is that not just gambling?
target: 所以……他们靠不赌博……来赌博？这怎么就不叫赌博了？

source: Well, it's not NOT gambling, but it's still not gambling by gambling on how long you can go without gambling, which will eventually put an end to gambling!
target: 也不是说没在赌，可赌的是能坚持多久不赌，所以还是没在赌，最后就能把赌博戒掉！

source: All thanks to the power of gambling!
target: 全靠赌博的力量！

source: You lose -N2 MIND trying to make sense of this shit. The good news is your idea is as well-intentioned as it is nonsensical, and you gain +N2 SOUL!
target: 琢磨这通鬼话，让你失去了 -N2 头脑。好消息是，你的点子有多扯淡，就有多好心，所以你获得了 +N2 灵魂！

source: Great idea! Parenting is a great way to force adults to stop doing things they love, like gambling!
target: 好主意！为人父母，就能逼成年人放下他们热爱的事，比如赌博！

source: Makes sense to me. But where are you gonna get a baby for your plan?
target: 听起来有道理。可计划里的宝宝，你上哪儿弄啊？

source: Haha! What'd I tell you the last time you asked me an uncomfortable question, kiddo?
target: 哈哈！小朋友，上次你问我难以启齿的问题时，我怎么说的？

source: ...Don't think about it?
target: ……别琢磨了？

source: Exactly! See you at the City of Vice!
target: 没错！罪恶之城见！

source: Later, at the City of Vice, twenty-something people are in a casino lobby discussing the strange letters they received telling them to gather here.
target: 后来，在罪恶之城，二十多个人聚在赌场大厅，讨论着各自收到的怪信——信里让他们来这儿集合。

source: Hiya, gambling addictz! I'm Tubular Eddy, and I've brought you all here to award you a collective ten million bucks for being the best gamblers in all of the City of Vice!
target: 赌徒们，你们好呀！我是潮人艾迪。把大家请来，是为了奖励全罪恶之城最棒的赌徒们：你们共同获得一千万！

source: You can take the money and run... OR you can spin the WHEEL OF MISFORTUNE for a chance to triple your payout!
target: 可以拿钱走人……也可以转动“厄运转盘”，有机会让奖金翻三倍！

source: "So there's a sliver of a chance we'd win thirty million dollars?!" the addicts ask. "WE'RE DOING THAT, OBVIOUSLY!"
target: “也就是说，还有一丁点机会赢到三千万？！”赌徒们问，“废话，当然转啊！”

source: Eddy spins the wheel. It looks like it might stop on the thirty-million payout slice... but at the last minute it flips to "A BABY."
target: 艾迪转动轮盘。指针眼看就要停在三千万奖金上……最后一刻，却转到了“一个宝宝”。

source: Congratz! You all lost ten million dollars, and now you have to collectively raise this child to be a responsible adult!
target: 恭喜！你们失去了一千万，现在还得一起把这孩子培养成负责任的成年人！

source: "There's no fucking way we're doing that."
target: “我们他妈才不干呢。”

source: Bet'cha can't.
target: 我赌你们做不到。

source: "You BET? YOU'RE ON!"
target: “你打赌？赌就赌！”

source: The addicts throw themselves into raising the child. They're so busy parenting that they don't have time to go to casinos, and they become much healthier for it!
target: 赌徒们全心投入育儿大业，忙得没空再去赌场，生活也健康多了！

source: The joys of parenting also bring the former addicts together. They fall deeply, mutually in love -- and also have group sex now!
target: 育儿的快乐还让这群前赌徒走得更近。大家深深地爱上彼此——现在还一起群交了！

source: Their lives are forever changed, and you made off with +N2 SOUL for your help! But you lose -N2 HYPE for choosing parental responsibility over the fun of gambling.
target: 他们的人生从此改变，你也因为帮忙获得了 +N2 灵魂！可选择养孩子的责任，放弃赌博的乐趣，还是让你失去了 -N2 热度。

source: You drive past an empty field where you see your friend Valerie! She's counting a wad of cash... and has a boat parked behind her?
target: 你们路过一片空地，发现朋友瓦莱丽就在那儿！她正数着一沓钱……身后还停着条船？

source: Whoa, what brings you guys to this usually-abandoned location? You're not with the cops, are you?
target: 哇，你们怎么跑到这平时没人来的地方了？不是跟警察一伙的吧？

source: Nah, we're just passing through on our way to the City of Vice. Is that where you're headed?
target: 不是，我们去罪恶之城，正好路过。你也去那儿？

source: Nope. Sounds fun, though. I'm just out here doing shady shit.
target: 不去，不过听着挺好玩。我就是来干点见不得光的勾当。

source: I met a guy here to sell him some "perfectly-legal goods", but he didn't have enough cash to pay me upfront, so he offered to give me his boat to make up the deficit.
target: 我约了个人在这儿见面，卖他一些“完全合法的商品”。可他一时拿不出那么多现金，就说把船给我，补上差额。

source: I don't normally accept trades, but he was only fifteen bucks short, and who am I to pass up a fifteen-dollar boat?
target: 我一般不接受以物抵款，可他才差十五块。十五块换条船，这便宜谁不占啊？

source: Noice! Got any fun plans for your new boat?
target: 妙啊！打算拿这条新船玩点什么？

source: Not yet. I'll probably sell it in the end, but I'd like to pull off at least one shady boat-themed scheme with it first.
target: 还没想好。最后多半会卖掉，不过在那之前，总得先拿它干一票跟船有关的黑活儿。

source: I'm not sure what I'll do yet, but I'll come up with something eventually. Doing shady shit is kinda my specialty.
target: 具体还没想好，迟早会有主意的。搞这些见不得光的勾当，我可是行家。

source: Hey, yours too! Here's a golden opportunity to impress your crime-inclined friend: pitch a scheme Val could pull off with her new boat!
target: 嘿，你也是！给这位热衷犯罪的朋友留下好印象，机会来了：想个点子，让小瓦拿新船搞点事！

source: "Get into a life of piracy, selling illegal photo editing software to other vessels!"
target: “去当海盗，给别的船卖盗版修图软件！”

source: "Film a TV show where people sail with you into international waters to fulfill their most illegal dreams!"
target: “拍档电视节目，载大家去公海，实现他们最不合法的梦想！”

source: Now THERE'S a plan that'll make me a boatload of cash! Thanks for the idea, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!
target: 这点子，能让我赚满满一船的钱！谢啦，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！

source: Later, aboard Valerie's boat, she's preparing to trade some pirated software to another pirate crew.
target: 后来，在瓦莱丽的船上，她准备跟另一伙海盗交易盗版软件。

source: Avast, ye digital scurvy dogs! Here's your pirated photo-editing software, filled with all the airbrushed booty you can imagine!
target: 听着，你们这帮数码恶棍！盗版修图软件来了，里面全是精修过的翘臀“宝藏”，你想要什么样的都有！
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): FIX; 盗版软件卖给海盗；booty 同为战利品及臀部，用翘臀宝藏保留两层。

source: "Great!" says her buyer. "Here's your money, as promised..."
target: “好！”买家说，“按说好的，钱给你……”

source: That's not money. That's a cutlass in my face.
target: 这不是钱，是架在我面前的一把弯刀。

source: "Yeah, well, what did you expect? We're pirates, kitty-cat. Betrayal is how we roll."
target: “对啊，不然你指望什么？我们是海盗，小猫咪，背叛才是老本行。”

source: But you can't kill me. I'm the only one who knows how to install the software for you!
target: 可你不能杀我。只有我知道怎么给你们装这个软件！

source: "So what? We're not using the software; we're reselling it for a higher value. Now shut up so I can focus on killing you!"
target: “那又怎样？我们又不用，是要加价转手卖掉的。现在闭嘴，我好专心杀你！”

source: "WAIT, CAPTAIN!" shouts one of the buyer's crewmen. "We're throwing that birthday party for Smelly Greg next week, remember?"
target: “船长，等等！”买家的一名船员喊道，“下周还要给臭臭格雷格办生日派对，记得吗？”

source: "We could use that software to make a cool birthday slideshow for him!"
target: “正好用这软件，给他做个酷炫的生日幻灯片！”

source: "Ugh... I suppose that's true," says the captain. "Fine, Oberlin -- you live this time. Go install that software on my mates' laptops, or feel the bite of my blade!"
target: “唉……也对，”船长说，“行吧，奥伯林，这次留你一命。给兄弟们的笔记本装好软件，不然让你尝尝我的刀锋！”

source: Fine.
target: 行。

source: Valerie installs the software... and while she's at it, she wires herself thousands of dollars from the pirates' computers to make up for the theft, and then some!
target: 瓦莱丽装好软件……顺手从海盗的电脑上给自己转了几千块，不仅补回被抢的钱，还多赚了一笔！

source: Wow, people will save their credit card info to any old website, huh? This pirate scheme is so easy it's downright boring.
target: 哇，这帮人什么网站都敢存信用卡信息啊？这海盗生意太简单，简直无聊。

source: I think I'll stick to making money selling shady shit on dry land... and occasionally hitting the City of Vice with weighted dice.
target: 我还是回陆地卖那些见不得光的东西赚钱吧……偶尔带副灌铅骰子，去罪恶之城玩玩。

source: Val quits the pirate life, but not before she wires you +N2 MONEY for giving her this lucrative idea!
target: 小瓦告别了海盗生涯，不过在那之前，还是给你转来了 +N2 金钱，感谢你这个赚钱的点子！

source: It's almost enough to take the sting out of the -N2 SOUL you lost by being involved in her software-stealing crimes.
target: 这笔钱，几乎能抚平你帮她搞盗版软件、失去 -N2 灵魂的心痛了。

source: That sounds HILARIOUS. I'm doing it. Thanks for the idea, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!
target: 听着就好笑。干了！谢谢你的点子，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！

source: You all continue on your road trip, excited to watch this show one day... which, thanks to the power of time-skips, is today!
target: 你们继续公路旅行，迫不及待地想等哪天看看这节目……多亏时间跳转的力量，那天就是今天！

source: Thank you for tuning into the first episode of "Maritime Scams!" I'm your handsome host, the Interdimensional Prince!
target: 感谢收看《公海骗局》第一期！我是各位英俊的主持人，跨次元王子！

source: Nope. No you're not. This is MY boat and MY show. Crawl back into whatever portal you came from.
target: 不，你不是。这是我的船，我的节目。从哪个传送门来的，就爬回哪个传送门去。

source: Hi everyone. I'm Valerie Oberlin, the ACTUAL host of "Maritime Scams", here with my friend Sadie. What crimes will you commit in international waters today, girl?
target: 各位好，我是《公海骗局》真正的主持人，瓦莱丽·奥伯林。旁边是我的朋友赛迪。姐妹，今天打算在公海犯点什么罪？

source: I haven't actually decided yet. I might make some illegal collect calls, maybe dabble in a little tax evasion...
target: 还没决定。也许打几通非法的对方付费电话，再稍微逃点税……

source: Both good options! What about you, sir?
target: 都不错！这位先生，你呢？

source: The man Valerie's speaking to looks up from the person he's currently stabbing in the chest.
target: 瓦莱丽问的那个男人，正往别人胸口捅刀子，闻声抬起了头。

source: Uh... tax evasion also.
target: 呃……我也逃税。

source: Cool! Let's move onto these two. Dmitri, Morty, what are you doing in international waters today?
target: 好！再来看看这两位。迪米特里、莫蒂，今天来公海干什么？

source: Butt stuff.
target: 玩屁股。

source: We're actually here to smuggle some interdimensional artifacts into the Dark Side... but sure, we might do "butt stuff" too, if there's time.
target: 其实，我们是来把一些跨次元神器走私进黑暗面的……不过有空的话，也可能玩点“屁股”。

source: I'm in on this scheme too! Nobody does multidimensional smuggling or international-waters butt stuff like the Interdimensional Prince!
target: 这事也有我的份！多维度走私，还有公海上的屁股玩法，谁都比不过跨次元王子！

source: NONE OF YOU ARE ALLOWED TO DO BUTT STUFF ON MY BOAT!
target: 谁都不许在我的船上玩屁股！

source: This is the pinnacle of reality television; it gives you +N2 HYPE. You lose -N2 SOUL for giving Val the idea to enable all these weirdos to do crimes, though.
target: 这堪称真人秀的巅峰，让你获得了 +N2 热度。不过，出主意帮小瓦纵容这群怪胎犯罪，也让你失去了 -N2 灵魂。

source: You stop the car when you see none other than Hope waiting on the side of the road!
target: 看见路边等车的竟然是希望女巫，你们停下了车！

source: Hoooope! Where you goin', gurl?
target: 希望女巫——！姐妹，上哪儿去？

source: Oh, it's you. Hey.
target: 哦，是你们啊。嗨。

source: I'm en route to the City of Vice to enter the annual world "Competitive Tarot Championship".
target: 我要去罪恶之城，参加一年一度的世界竞技塔罗锦标赛。

source: We might be going to the City of Vice too! Wanna join us?
target: 我们可能也去罪恶之城！要不要一起？

source: No, it's okay, I'm already waiting for my Oober. You can help me in a different way, though...
target: 不用，没事，我已经在等 Oober 了。不过，你们倒是可以帮点别的忙……

source: She throws a deck of cards to you.
target: 她把一副牌抛给你。

source: Wanna spar with me, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，陪我切磋一局？

source: GAME ON!
target: 来战！

source: But... how are you supposed to play competitive tarot?
target: 可……竞技塔罗怎么玩啊？

source: By being... VERY ANIME.
target: 玩得……特别热血动漫就行。

source: The ground below you starts moving. A strange structure rises from the dirt. You and Hope stand on opposing platforms across a sort of battlefield.
target: 脚下的地面开始移动，一座奇异的装置破土升起。你和希望女巫各站一座平台，隔着像是战场的地方遥遥相对。

source: Polly, Scott: you'll be the info-dumping side characters.
target: 波莉，斯科特：你们负责当解说设定的配角。

source: What does that mean, Polly?
target: 波莉，什么意思？

source: I'm guessing it means the action will occasionally cut to us commenting on the match and providing useful information about this very complicated card game.
target: 我猜，就是镜头偶尔会切到咱们这边，听我们点评战况，顺便解释这款复杂得要命的卡牌游戏怎么玩。

source: Holy moly!
target: 我的天！

source: Your hand starts glowing as you hold the deck of cards.
target: 你握着牌组，手忽然开始发光。

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, now those cards are bound to you: their effectiveness will depend directly on the nature of your spirit!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，这些牌已经与你绑定，能发挥多大威力，直接取决于你的精神特质！

source: So it's like %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s spirit is divided into different aspects, kinda like stats... or RESOURCES!
target: 所以，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%的精神分成了不同方面，有点像属性……或者说，资源！

source: I see... %HESHE% only %VERB_NEEDS_NEED% to use cards that play into a strong aspect of %HISHER% spirit... %HESHE% must be true to %HIMSELFHERSELF%!
target: 明白了……%HESHE%只%VERB_NEEDS_NEED%打出符合%HISHER%精神强项的牌……%HESHE%必须忠于%HIMSELFHERSELF%！
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): KEEP; 强项对应玩法资源，needs 在此译需要。 按行中文动词展开已实现；未实机验证。

source: That's right! And the first phase of competitive tarot is... THE ASTRAL INFLUENCE PHASE.
target: 没错！竞技塔罗的第一阶段，就是……星体影响阶段！

source: THE ASTRAL INFLUENCE PHASE?!
target: 星体影响阶段？！

source: We each choose a celestial body that will grant us its favor and boons.
target: 双方各选一个天体，获得它的眷顾和赐福。

source: Good luck defeating me when I'm supported by... THE MOON!
target: 想打赢我？先过我背后的……月亮这一关吧！

source: It's a mysterious Celestial Body of Many Faces.
target: 它是一颗神秘的千面天体。

source: The Moon controls the Tides and influences not only all of our fates, but the Earth's fate too, as both Celestial Bodies dance a cosmic tango of gravity.
target: 月亮掌控潮汐，影响着我们每个人，乃至地球本身的命运。两颗天体以引力为纽带，在宇宙中共舞探戈。

source: Oh no, not THE MOON! I've only known the rules of this game for like five full minutes, but I already know that's a very powerful card!
target: 糟了，竟然是月亮！虽然我才学了整整五分钟规则，但已经知道，这张牌非常强！

source: How will %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% outplay Hope?!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%要怎么出招，才能胜过希望女巫？！

source: Exactly... what's your play here?
target: 没错……这一手，你打算怎么下？

source: MARS! The favorite celestial body of billionaires, who want to colonize it once they finish destroying Earth.
target: 火星！亿万富翁最爱的天体，等他们把地球毁完，就要去殖民那里了。

source: URANUS, the celestial body of... heh... you know...
target: 天王星，URANUS。它掌管的嘛……嘿……你懂的……

source: MARS?!
target: 火星？！

source: That's a great investment from %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%这笔投资，眼光不错。

source: Hope's Moon can twerk at the Earth as much as it wants... Earth will be rendered inhabitable pretty soon, anyway.
target: 希望女巫的月亮想冲着地球怎么扭屁股都行……反正地球很快就没法住人了。
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): FIX; 前选项和后文反复说明富豪毁坏地球后逃去火星；inhabitable 疑漏 un-，据完整分支修正原来反向的意思。

source: What the fuck are you saying? Mars is the celestial body of war and aggression!
target: 你们他妈在说什么？火星代表的是战争和侵略！

source: That is literally based on nothing but myths.
target: 那全是根据神话编出来的。

source: Billionaires trying to colonize Mars on the other hand? That's cold hard facts.
target: 可亿万富翁想殖民火星，这才是铁打的事实。

source: Now all of %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s cards will be cheaper to play because Mars will soon become the next hot tax haven for all the fierce capitalists to flee to!
target: 火星很快就会变成最热门的避税天堂，供那些凶狠的资本家逃过去！所以，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%所有牌的出牌费用都降低了！

source: That's not how the card works, you idiots!
target: 这牌不是这么用的，你们这群白痴！

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% doesn't give a fuck!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%才不在乎！

source: With the power of Mars, %HESHE% can form colonies with %HISHER% own dystopian private law! NEW RULES, BABYYYY!
target: 有了火星的力量，%HESHE%就能建立殖民地，按%HISHER%私家恶法统治那里的反乌托邦！新规则来啦，宝贝！

source: Yeah, bro! NEW RULES! We didn't completely understand the old ones anyway!
target: 对，兄弟！新规则！反正旧的咱们也没完全搞懂！

source: What's wrong, Hope? Are you scared?
target: 怎么，希望女巫，怕了？

source: Tch...
Pfffffft, good luck playing that when you're broke AF!
target: 噗，你穷成那样，还想打这张牌？做梦去吧！

source: You're just another doofus who thinks you're the one benefitting from predatory laws and tax cuts instead of the billonaires destroying the country and the planet.
target: 又一个傻子，以为掠夺性法律和减税政策惠及的是自己，不是那帮正在毁掉国家、毁掉地球的亿万富翁。

source: Yeah, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%: not a good look.
target: 对啊，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，这可不怎么体面。

source: I don't think you'll have a ticket to Mars when the time comes, boo...
target: 宝贝，真到了那天，你恐怕买不到去火星的船票……

source: It's true that playing Mars could benefit you if your other cards were from the right class ("High Income Class"), and if you had enough Privilege Stacks...
target: 你其他的牌要是职业选对了——“高收入阶层”——再叠够特权层数，打火星确实能有好处……

source: That's not %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. I saw %HIMHER% pay for a milkshake the other day only using ten-cent coins.
target: 那肯定不是%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。前两天我亲眼看见，%HIMHER%买杯奶昔，掏的全是十美分硬币。

source: Yeah... with this card, your future plays will need to abide by dystopian private laws created by the wealthy that will only put you at a greater disadvantage.
target: 没错……用了这张牌，之后出牌就得服从富人制定的反乌托邦私法，而这些规定只会让你越来越吃亏。

source: There's no winning the rat race, boo!
target: 宝贝，这场你追我赶的“老鼠赛跑”，根本赢不了！

source: There's a Competitive Tarot stage where they make rats race? Cool!
target: 竞技塔罗还有让老鼠赛跑的阶段？酷啊！

source: Scott, no...
target: 斯科特，不是啦……

source: Your friends aren't wrong, though.
target: 不过，朋友们确实没说错。

source: You spend the rest of the match trying unsuccessfully to survive in a dog-eat-dog capitalist cycle where the cards are never stacked in your favor.
target: 剩下的比赛，你都在弱肉强食的资本主义循环里拼命挣扎，却怎么也活不下去；这副牌，从一开始就不站在你这边。

source: Needless to say, Hope beats your ass. It's quite dire.
target: 不用说，希望女巫把你揍惨了。场面相当凄凉。

source: Not long after that, Hope's Oober finally arrives, and she leaves.
target: 没过多久，希望女巫叫的 Oober 终于到了，她坐车离开。

source: You're left defeated, having lost -3 MONEY you were apparently gambling on this match.
target: 你惨败收场，还失去了 -3 金钱——看来你们这局居然还赌了钱。

source: URANUS?!
target: 天王星 URANUS？！

source: Uranus? Pffft....hahahaha!
target: Uranus？噗……哈哈哈哈！

source: Why is Uranus so powerful, Polly?
target: 波莉，天王星为什么这么强？

source: Uranus is known as the "Awakener," since...
target: 天王星被称为“觉醒者”，因为……

source: URANUS! HAHAHAHAHA!
target: URANUS！哈哈哈哈！

source: ...since its aspects and transits bring sudden...
target: ……因为它的相位和行运，会带来突然的……

source: UR-ANUS! Get it, Scott? UR-ANUS! HAHAHA!
target: UR-ANUS！斯科特，懂了没？UR-ANUS！哈哈哈！

source: ...sudden changes and shocks.
target: ……突然的改变和冲击。

source: It's like "YOUR ANUS", you see? "URANUS" -- "YOUR ANUS", HAHAHAHA!
target: 念起来像“YOUR ANUS”，就是“你的屁眼”，懂吧？“URANUS”——“YOUR ANUS”，哈哈哈哈！

source: WHAT ARE YOU, FIVE?!?!
target: 你们几岁了，五岁吗？！？！

source: Ohhhhhhhhhh, I get it now! It's very funny!
target: 哦——懂了！确实很好笑！

source: Why'd %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% play URANUS, Hope? Did %HESHE% steal it when you weren't looking? Hahahaha!
target: 希望女巫，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%干吗要出“你的屁眼”？是%HESHE%趁你没看见，偷来的吗？哈哈哈哈！

source: Goddammit...
target: 妈的……

source: What's wrong, Hope? Are you scared that you now must face URANUS?! HAHAHAHAHA!
target: 怎么了，希望女巫？现在要面对“你的屁眼”，害怕了？哈哈哈哈！

source: Tch...
...What? Uranus is a very bad card, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! Why would you play that?
target: ……什么？天王星是张烂牌，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！你为什么要出这张？

source: You know... heehee... because... URANUS!
target: 你懂的……嘿嘿……因为……URANUS 嘛！

source: Because what? Did you read the card? It says it right there: "Very bad card, do not play."
target: 因为什么？你看牌了吗？上面明明写着：“这牌很烂，不要打。”

source: But... but... URANUS!
target: 可……可是……URANUS 啊！

source: "URANUS"! "YOUR ANUS"! Pfff...
target: “URANUS”！“你的屁眼”！噗……

source: What are you, five?
target: 你几岁了，五岁？

source: Heeheehee... Uranus...
target: 嘿嘿嘿……Uranus……

source: Well, beating someone who is essentially a five-year-old shouldn't be too hard...
target: 行吧，打赢一个跟五岁小孩差不多的人，应该没多难……

source: No, it most definitely isn't.
target: 嗯，当然没多难。

source: Hope beats your ass.
target: 希望女巫把你揍惨了。

source: (Or you could say she beats... you know... Uranus.)
target: （或者也可以说，她揍的是……你懂的……Uranus。）

source: Not long after that, Hope's Oober finally arrives, and she leaves.
target: 没过多久，希望女巫叫的 Oober 终于到了，她坐车离开。

source: You're left defeated, having lost -3 HYPE out of being lame.
target: 你惨败收场，失去了 -3 热度——因为你实在太逊了。

source: I don't care! The Moon will still help me win this match.
target: 我不管！月亮照样能帮我赢下这局。

source: It's time to summon the champion that will fight for us in this battle of the arcana.
target: 接下来，召唤替我们出战的英雄，在这场秘仪之战里一决高下。

source: Today, I'm playing a deck of Virtues.
target: 今天，我用的是美德牌组。

source: Heh...
Why is Hope smirking in such a patronizing way, Polly?
target: 波莉，希望女巫怎么笑得这么一副瞧不起人的样子？

source: She must have a secret play %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% won't see coming!
target: 她肯定藏了什么招，打算让%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%措手不及！

source: You're not wrong, Polly. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% here is obviously expecting me to play "Hope" as my champion of Virtue...
target: 没错，波莉。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%肯定以为，我会选“希望”当自己的美德英雄……

source: You aren't expecting anything. You barely understand how this game is played at all.
target: 你什么都没在想。这游戏怎么玩，你都还没弄明白。

source: BUT NO! For you see: I am three moves ahead!
target: 可惜，不是！因为我早就算到了三步之后！

source: She's three moves ahead?!
target: 她都算到三步之后了？！

source: Yes! And that's why I'm playing Fides, the card of Faith. It grants me zealous determination to achieve my goals blindly...
target: 没错！所以我要打出菲德斯，“信仰”之牌。它赋予我狂热的决心，让我不顾一切、盲目追求目标……

source: ...and my goal is winning this match!
target: ……而我的目标，就是赢下这局！

source: I wanna see how you beat that, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，我倒要看看，你怎么赢我！

source: You want to see that too... but how?
target: 你也想知道……可怎么赢呢？

source: You spot two champions in your hand... or rather, one champion and one super-cool "champion" you may or may not have snuck in yourself...
target: 你在手牌里发现了两张英雄牌……确切说，是一张英雄牌，加上一张可能是你自己偷偷塞进去的、超酷的“英雄牌”……

source: Gluttony
target: 暴食

source: Pride
target: 傲慢

source: You play "Gluttony".
target: 你打出“暴食”。

source: NANI?!?!
target: 纳尼？！

source: GLUTTONY?! WHAT'S THAT?!
target: 暴食？！那是什么？！

source: NO WAY!!!
target: 不会吧！！！

source: No, but really... is that card, like... good?
target: 不是，认真问……这牌……很强吗？

source: Yeah. It represents one of the "Old Deities": entities that have preyed upon reality since the beginning of time.
target: 强。它代表一位“古神”：从时间伊始，就以现实为猎物的存在。

source: This Old One is said to represent obsession, of which gluttony is one aspect.
target: 据说，这位古神象征着痴迷，而暴食只是其中一个方面。

source: I'm pretty sure the card represents the orange cat from that one cartoon show.
target: 我怎么觉得，这张牌画的是某部动画里的橘猫呢。

source: No, it's the Old One! When someone is under its influence, obsession overtakes them... and they will devour anything with no end in sight!
target: 不是，是古神！受它影响的人，会被执念彻底吞没……然后没完没了地吞噬一切！

source: Anything... like lasagna?
target: 吞噬一切……比如千层面？

source: I suppose; it can be anything! Lasagna; a TV show; anything that you can obsess about.
target: 可以吧，什么都行！千层面、电视剧，任何能让你上瘾的东西。

source: I'm telling you: it's the cat. You know the one: "I love lasagna, and I hate Mondays!"
target: 都说了，就是那只猫。你知道的：“我爱千层面，我讨厌星期一！”

source: You know the one! Does this "old deity" hate Mondays?
target: 就是它嘛！你这位“古神”讨厌星期一吗？

source: I mean... I don't think the deity cares about the abstract construct of time or workdays...
target: 呃……我不觉得神会在乎时间、工作日这种抽象概念……

source: ...but I suppose that if it had to choose a least favorite day, it'd be the most "productive" one, Monday, sure.
target: ……不过硬要选一天最讨厌的，那应该是最讲究“生产力”的日子，星期一吧。

source: See?
target: 看吧？

source: But anyway... you say the orange cat is a powerful card, isn't it?
target: 不过话说回来……你说这橘猫牌很强，对吧？

source: Yes!
target: 没错!

source: Great! Then shut up and keep playing!
target: 太好了！那就闭嘴，继续打！

source: Hmph...
GLUTTONY!
target: 暴食！

source: Gluttony?
target: 暴食？

source: Yeah. It represents one of the "Old Deities": entities that have preyed upon reality since the beginning of time.
target: 强。它代表一位“古神”：从时间伊始，就以现实为猎物的存在。

source: This Old One is said to represent obsession, of which gluttony is one aspect.
target: 据说，这位古神象征着痴迷，而暴食只是其中一个方面。

source: I'm pretty sure the card represents the orange cat from that one cartoon show.
target: 我怎么觉得，这张牌画的是某部动画里的橘猫呢。

source: It does not!
target: 才没有!

source: It's based on a very powerful old entity. But it's also quite high maintenance!
target: 它代表一位非常强大的古老存在。可养起来也很费劲！

source: After playing it, you must feed the card four Lasagna Tokens per turn... or else.
target: 打出这张牌后，每回合必须喂它四枚千层面代币……不然嘛。

source: OR ELSE?! WILL %CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS% DIE IF THE CARD IS NOT FED THE LASAGNA TOKENS?!
target: 不然会怎样？！要是不喂千层面代币，%CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%会死吗？！

source: Nah, but this card is known to be a massive jerk to its owner if not properly fed.
target: 不会，可这牌出了名的：吃不饱，就对主人特别混蛋。

source: Hope is not wrong. You have no Lasagna Tokens, and thus the card gets quite upset...
target: 希望女巫没说错。你一枚千层面代币都没有，这张牌相当不高兴……

source: ...and Hope failed to mention that the fucking card can somehow talk.
target: ……而且希望女巫忘了提，这破牌不知道怎么还能说话。

source: So for the next few hours you get massively distracted by the talking card.
target: 于是接下来的几个小时，这张喋喋不休的牌，吵得你根本没法集中注意力。

source: "%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, I require lasagna".
target: “%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，我需要千层面。”

source: "%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, where is my lasagna?"
target: “%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，我的千层面呢？”

source: "%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, I can smell you, give me my lasagna."
target: “%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，我闻得到你，把我的千层面交出来。”

source: It's just too annoying. You give up before you feel like throwing the card into a lake.
target: 实在太烦了。趁自己还没忍不住把牌扔进湖里，你赶紧认输。

source: Not long after that, Hope's Oober finally arrives, and she leaves.
target: 没过多久，希望女巫叫的 Oober 终于到了，她坐车离开。

source: You're left defeated, having lost -3 STAMINA out of a sandwich of yours Hope keeps for beating you at competitive tarot.
target: 你惨败收场。希望女巫赢了这局竞技塔罗，拿走你一个三明治当战利品，让你失去了 -3 体力。

source: You play "Pride".
target: 你打出“傲慢”。

source: NANI?!?!
target: 纳尼？！

source: IT CAN'T BE! PRIDE?!
target: 不可能！傲慢？！

source: NO WAY!!!
target: 不会吧！！！

source: No, but really: what the fuck is that card?
target: 不是，认真问：这他妈是什么牌？

source: It's... not even a real card. That's a piece of cardboard with a drawing of you on it!
target: 这……根本不是正经牌。就是一块纸板，上面画着你自己！

source: Yeah, self-insert for the win!
target: 没错！自设角色万岁！

source: You... can't do that. You can't make up a card!
target: 你……不能这样。哪有自己瞎编牌的！

source: All cards are made up, though...
target: 可所有牌都是编出来的啊……

source: Yes, but not in that way.
target: 是的,但不是那样的。

source: What's the difference?
target: 有什么区别？

source: Well, the real cards are made by professionals, and that thing is made by... you.
target: 正经牌都是专业人士做的，你这玩意儿……是你自己做的。

source: So? I am the very best; that's the whole point of the card.
target: 那又怎样？我就是最棒的，这就是这张牌的核心。

source: That proves the card is right: I am prideful; prideful enough to consider myself as good as or better than the dumb creators of these dumb cards!
target: 正好证明这张牌没错：我很傲慢，傲慢到觉得自己不比那帮设计破牌的蠢货差，甚至比他们强！

source: That's not how it works!
target: 事情不是这样的!

source: As the self-appointed referee, I decree this is a legal play.
target: 作为自封的裁判，我宣布，这手牌合法。

source: You can't self-appoint yourself as referee!
target: 你不能自己给自己封个裁判！

source: Welp, I just did it. You see: I am very prideful too.
target: 可我已经封了。你看，我也很傲慢。

source: Ugh!
target: 唉哟!

source: Are you implying that the moment a player plays a dumb little "made-up" card, you are automatically unable to win?
target: 你是说，玩家一打出一张蠢兮兮的“自制牌”，你就立刻赢不了了？

source: Eh... no! Of course not! I can beat this idiot with one hand tied to my back!
target: 呃……不是！当然不是！就算一只手绑在背后，我也能赢这个白痴！

source: (Look who's prideful now.)
target: （看看，现在是谁在傲慢了。）

source: Well, then show us!
target: 那就给我们看看!

source: Hmph, okay!
target: 哼，行啊！

source: ...What?
target: ……什么？

source: It's a card I made myself! It's me!
target: 我自己做的牌！画的就是我！

source: So...? I mean, this is a magical game full of mythical creatures full of unbound power...
target: 所以呢……？这可是场魔法游戏，里面全是力量无穷的神话生物……

source: ...and you play yourself? I don't want to throw shade, but you're kind of lame.
target: ……结果你把自己打出来？不是想损你，可你真的有点逊。

source: She has a point, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!
target: 她说得有道理 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!

source: N-No! I'm cool!
target: 才、才没有！我很酷的！

source: Okay, then tell us what this card does...
target: 行，那说说这张牌有什么本事……

source: Well, hmmm... it is very cool!
target: 这个，嗯……它特别酷！

source: It can jump very high and knows a lot about yogurt... although I guess %HESHE% can't consume yogurt because the card is lactose intolerant.
target: 能跳得很高，还特别懂酸奶……不过%HESHE%应该不能喝酸奶，因为这张牌乳糖不耐受。

source: But if you equip a dairy card on it, I guess this champ can pass a lot of gas! And that can be good, maybe?
target: 但要是给这位英雄装备一张乳制品牌，应该就能放一大堆屁！没准……能有用？

source: No, it's not.
target: 不，没用。

source: Is this Polly's subtle way of telling you she's not okay with you eating lots of yogurt and getting gassy during the trip?!
target: 波莉这是在委婉地告诉你：别在旅途中灌一肚子酸奶，然后一路放屁吗？！

source: Oh...
You realize this wasn't nearly as cool as you thought it would be, and everyone's insistence on how lame you are surely doesn't help your confidence.
target: 你终于发现，这主意根本没自己想的那么酷。大家还一个劲说你很逊，更把你的自信心打得稀碎。

source: Hope exploits your newfound insecurities and beats you easily.
target: 希望女巫抓住你刚冒出来的自卑，轻松赢了你。

source: Not long after that, Hope's Oober finally arrives, and she leaves.
target: 没过多久，希望女巫叫的 Oober 终于到了，她坐车离开。

source: You're left defeated, having lost -3 HYPE from being a lame loser.
target: 你惨败收场，因为是个逊透了的输家，失去了 -3 热度。

source: None of this matters anyway! Everything will be decided in the main phase: THE FORTUNE PHASE!
target: 那些都不重要！真正决定胜负的主阶段，才刚要开始：占卜阶段！

source: Impossible! The Fortune Phase?!
target: 不可能！占卜阶段？！

source: (What's The Fortune Phase, Polly?)
target: （波莉，占卜阶段是什么？）

source: No idea; but I'm pretty sure she'll explain now.
target: 不知道，不过她马上就会解释了。

source: In The Fortune Phase, you try to finish your opponent by arranging your cards into a successful tarot reading of your opponent.
target: 占卜阶段，要把手里的牌组成一次成功的塔罗占卜，解读对手，从而终结比赛。

source: You read their future, and you read them to filth!
target: 既要看透对方的未来，也要把对方损到体无完肤！

source: THIS IS COMPETITIVE TAROT AFTER ALL!
target: 毕竟，这可是竞技塔罗！

source: Okay, finally! All this time, I've been wondering why this game even has the word "tarot" in it.
target: 行，终于来了！我还一直纳闷，这游戏名字里为什么有“塔罗”两个字呢。

source: Be ready, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, because I've seen the future, and it doesn't look good for you...
target: 准备好，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。我已经看到了未来，而你的前景……不太妙。

source: First... The Enlightenment!
target: 首先……启悟！

source: It predicts %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% realizing and coming to terms with the fact that %HESHE% barely %VERB_KNOWS_KNOW% how to play this game!
target: 它预示着，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%终于看清并接受了现实：%HESHE%几乎不%VERB_KNOWS_KNOW%这游戏该怎么玩！
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): KEEP; 希望女巫嘲讽玩家不懂规则，knows 为知道。 按行中文动词展开已实现；未实机验证。

source: Incredible, that's 100% true!
target: 太神了，100%准确！

source: Second... The Hole!
target: 第二张……洞！

source: It represents the fact that %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% is riddled with so much embarrassment that %HESHE% %VERB_WANTS_WANT% to dig a hole and bury %HIMSELFHERSELF% in it!
target: 它代表，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%已经尴尬得受不了，%HESHE%%VERB_WANTS_WANT%挖个洞，把%HIMSELFHERSELF%埋进去！
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): POLISH; 尴尬到想钻地洞，wants 为想。 按行中文动词展开已实现；未实机验证。

source: And finally, the card with which I always destroy my opponents...
target: 最后，是我用来击溃所有对手的那张牌……

source: HOPE ALWAYS PREVAILS!!!
target: 希望女巫必胜！！！

source: It literally predicts %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% losing against me! Look at it!
target: 它预言的就是%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%输给我！你们自己看！

source: Oh, no! It's a foolproof fortune! How could %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% defy such a specific fate?!
target: 糟了！这预言无懈可击！命运都说得这么具体了，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%要怎么反抗？！

source: Heh... exactly. One could say %HESHE% %VERB_IS_ARE%... hopeless.
target: 呵……没错。可以说，%HESHE%%VERB_IS_ARE%……没“希望”了。
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): POLISH; hopeless 既无望又被希望女巫打败；保留引号，不再输出系词。 按行中文动词展开已实现；未实机验证。

source: You're finished... unless you find the perfect counterplay...
target: 你完了……除非，能找到完美的反击手段……

source: Play any random sequence of cards and give a deep-sounding yet vague-enough prediction that you can't fail.
target: 随便打一串牌，给个听起来高深、实际上足够模糊的预言，怎么说都不会错。

source: Hope can't defeat someone who's not even fighting her! Play "The Birthday Card"!
target: 希望女巫没法打败一个根本不跟她打的人！打出“生日贺卡”！

source: Yeah, good idea... it's risky AF; but if you make your predictions vague enough it could actually work... let's see...
target: 对，好主意……风险大得要命，不过预言只要够模糊，也许真能行……试试看……

source: You play a random card"
target: 你随便打出一张牌。

source: THE FLOODED BASEMENT!
target: 进水的地下室！

source: Ah, it signifies that even with your confident exterior, something's falling apart inside of you, Hope... in the deep end of your deepest inner depths.
target: 啊，它说明，别看你外表自信，希望女巫，你内心已经有什么东西在崩塌了……就在你最深最深的内心深处。

source: How long you can keep up your act until the whole house comes down?
target: 整栋房子倒塌之前，你这出戏还能撑多久？

source: This card predicts that everything you're trying to hide under your cool façade will soon come to light once the basement of your soul is flooded. The reckoning is near!
target: 这张牌预示着，一旦灵魂的地下室进了水，你藏在冷静外表下的一切，都会暴露在光天化日之下。清算之日将近！

source: Whooooa, I can see it now! Hope, your façade is falling apart!
target: 哇——看见了！希望女巫，你的伪装要崩塌了！

source: It's okay, Hope! Stay positive; you can always turn the flooded basement into a nice indoor pool!
target: 没关系，希望女巫！乐观点，地下室淹了，正好改成漂亮的室内泳池嘛！

source: Whose side are you even on, Scott?
target: 斯科特，你到底站哪边啊？

source: I don't take sides. I don't cheer for people; I cheer people up!
target: 我不站队。我不是给谁助威的，我是给大家打气的！

source: Fair enough.
target: 说得没错

source: Next...
target: 下一张……

source: ...THE PEAR WITH A BROWN SPOT.
target: ……长了褐斑的梨。

source: Undoubtedly an omen of decay.
target: 毫无疑问，这是衰败的预兆。

source: You thought of yourself as this fresh, delicious tarot champion, but you've shone in the sun for too long. Everything is eventually defeated by the passage of time.
target: 你以为自己新鲜可口，是个塔罗冠军，可你在阳光下闪耀太久了。万物终将败给时间。

source: You know it's true, Hope. You can feel time taking chunks of you as the first brown spots will soon start to show in the pear of your power.
target: 希望女巫，你知道这是真的。你能感觉到，时间正一口口啃掉你；象征你力量的这颗梨，很快就要长出第一块褐斑。

source: This card predicts you will succumb to the passage of time!
target: 这张牌预示着，你终将屈服于时光流逝！

source: Whoa! I can see that prediction happening!
target: 哇！这预言肯定会成真！

source: Of course, you dumbasses. Why the fuck wouldn't I be affected by the passage of time?
target: 废话，白痴们。我他妈为什么不会受时间流逝影响？

source: Aha! So you admit %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% is correctly predicting your future!
target: 哈！所以你承认，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%准确预言了你的未来！

source: Ugh, %HESHE% %VERB_IS_ARE% predicting anyone's future!
target: 唉，%HESHE%%VERB_IS_ARE%预言的，是所有人都会遇到的未来！
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): POLISH; 预言只说人人都会老，被斯科特曲解成能预言所有人的能力；现译关系准确。 按行中文动词展开已实现；未实机验证。

source: ANYONE'S FUTURE?! That sounds even more powerful! What kind of wizard are you, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?!
target: 所有人的未来？！那不是更强了！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你到底是什么大巫师？！

source: A powerful one, for you play your last card...
target: 超强的那种。因为，你打出了最后一张牌……

source: ...THE STRANGER!!!
This card predicts that you'll meet someone that will say or do something that will impact you in some way, changing the course of things!
target: 这张牌预示着，你会遇到某个人，对方会说点什么，或者做点什么，以某种方式影响你，改变事情的走向！

source: OMINOUS!
target: 不祥的预兆！

source: That's fuckin' dumb!
target: 这他妈也太蠢了！

source: Oh, so now you're saying tarot is dumb, huh?
target: 哦，所以你现在说塔罗很蠢，是吧？

source: NO! I'm saying %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% is dumb! I WANNA PUNCH YOU!
target: 不是！我说%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%很蠢！我想揍你！

source: You wanna punch %HIMHER%? Dang, Hope. One might say that... today you met someone who has done something that has impacted you in some way... wouldn't you say?
target: 你想揍%HIMHER%？好家伙，希望女巫。可以说……今天你遇到了一个人，对方做了某件事，以某种方式影响了你……你说对吧？

source: Oooooooooooooooooooh!!!
ARGH!!! YOU SHUT UP!
target: 啊啊啊！你给我闭嘴！

source: She flips the table (which is saying something, since you were playing in a giant high-tech battlefield made of steel). Still, you win!
target: 她直接掀了桌——你们可是在一个巨大的钢铁高科技战场上打牌，这就相当了不起了。总之，你赢了！

source: Later, Hope thanks you; fighting you has shown her she still has much practice to do.
target: 后来，希望女巫向你道谢。这场对决让她明白，自己还有很多要练的地方。

source: (Especially in regards to excercising her patience against annoying dumbasses.)
target: （尤其要练练，怎么耐心面对烦人的蠢货。）

source: For helping a friend, you get +5 SOUL.
target: 帮了朋友，你获得了 +5 灵魂。

source: Hey, if you end up in the City of Vice, give me a call. We can all laugh this off and have a party after the tournament.
target: 嘿，要是到了罪恶之城，给我打电话。锦标赛结束后，咱们开个派对，把这事一笑置之。

source: It's a deal, boo!
target: 说定了，宝贝！

source: You part ways.
target: 你们就此告别。

source: Today you won... because you believed in the heart of the cards!
target: 今天，你赢了……因为你相信卡牌之心！

source: Yeah, good idea... it's risky AF; but if you make your predictions vague enough it could actually work... let's see...
target: 对，好主意……风险大得要命，不过预言只要够模糊，也许真能行……试试看……

source: You play a random card.
target: 你随便打出一张牌。

source: THE FLOODED BASEMENT.
target: 进水的地下室。

source: Eh... yes... ah... this card represents the basement of your... soul?
target: 呃……对……啊……这张牌代表你……灵魂的地下室？

source: What would that be?
target: 那是啥？

source: Uhm... eh... okay, okay, it's just your basement. The basement of your soul is your actual basement. And it will be flooded soon!
target: 嗯……呃……好吧，就是你的地下室。灵魂的地下室，就是你家真正的地下室。而它马上就要进水了！

source: One: that's a terrible metaphor... if it's even a metaphor at all.
target: 第一，这比喻烂透了……如果这也能算比喻的话。

source: Two: I don't have a basement.
target: 第二，我根本没有地下室。

source: Dang, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, not having a basement makes that flood prediction quite unlikely!
target: 哎呀，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，她连地下室都没有，你那进水的预言就不太可能成真了！

source: Sure, but what about...
target: 是啊，可再看这张……

source: THE PEAR WITH A BROWN SPOT.
target: 长了褐斑的梨。

source: This card foretells... eh... brown spots!
target: 这张牌预示着……呃……褐斑！

source: ...What?
target: ……什么？

source: Yes! You should visit your dermatologist!
target: 对！你该去看看皮肤科！

source: Hmmm, see, that's more like advice. Are you sure you know how predictions work?
target: 嗯，听着更像建议。你确定自己明白预言是怎么回事？

source: Yeah, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. I want to root for you, but you're making this very hard.
target: 对啊，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。我是想挺你，可你这表现，真让人挺不下去。

source: Remember, it's okay to not know the rules of the games as long as you play with your heart!
target: 记住，就算不懂规则，只要用心玩游戏，也没关系！

source: But also... consider knowing the rules of the games? It could be a great step toward winning the match... I think...
target: 不过……要不还是考虑一下，弄懂规则？这样离赢下比赛，可能就更近一大步了……我想……

source: Uh... giving advice is so hard... I have no idea how Coach does it...
target: 呃……给人提建议好难啊……真不知道教练是怎么做到的……

source: Ugh... fine... but I have one last ace up my sleeve...
target: 唉……行吧……可我袖子里还藏着最后一张王牌……

source: THE STRANGER!!!
target: 陌生人！！！

source: What about it?
target: 这张又怎么了？

source: Well, you want a prediction, huh? Have one! This card foretells the coming of a stranger who will interrupt this match to ask for... eh... the capital of Norway!
target: 想要预言，是吧？那就来！这张牌预示着，会有个陌生人来打断比赛，问……呃……挪威的首都！

source: I mean, that's a prediction, sure. A very weird one.
target: 嗯，确实算预言。特别古怪的预言。

source: But the match is indeed interrupted by a stranger. Everyone is amazed.
target: 可比赛还真被一个陌生人打断了。大家都惊呆了。

source: Ha! Idiots... you saw the stranger coming from afar and how he looked like wanting to ask you a question, heh.
target: 哈！笨蛋们……你早就看见那人从远处过来，一副想问点什么的样子，嘿嘿。

source: The stranger interrupts you. He asks for directions. You help him and he leaves.
target: 陌生人打断你们，问了个路。你指点一番，他就走了。

source: Dang it. Yeah, asking for directions now seems like a way more obvious possibility than asking for the capital of Norway. What were you thinking?
target: 可恶。现在想想，问路确实比问挪威首都合理多了。你刚才脑子里装的什么？

source: Hope ends up beating you big time... which was actually another much-safer prediction than "a stranger asking for the capital of Norway".
target: 最后，希望女巫把你虐惨了……说真的，这个结果，也比“陌生人来问挪威首都”好预测多了。

source: Not long after that, Hope's Oober finally arrives, and she leaves.
target: 没过多久，希望女巫叫的 Oober 终于到了，她坐车离开。

source: You're left defeated, having lost -3 MIND from such a dumb plan.
target: 你惨败收场，这个蠢计划让你失去了 -3 头脑。

source: Oh, that's so nice!
target: 哦，真贴心！

source: But that's not a tarot card! It's a birthday card!
target: 可这根本不是塔罗牌！这是生日贺卡！

source: Hey, any card can be a tarot card if you want it to be.
target: 嗨，只要你愿意，什么卡都能当塔罗牌。

source: No, that's literally and factually untrue. This is a birthday card, not a tool that can be used to make predictions.
target: 不，按字面意思和客观事实来说，都不成立。这是生日贺卡，不是用来预测未来的工具。

source: Well, don't be so close-minded, Hope! Isn't wishing you a happy birthday sort of... predicting a happy birthday?
target: 希望女巫，别这么死板嘛！祝你生日快乐，不就有点像……预言你生日会快乐吗？

source: No!
target: 不是！

source: I mean, isn't it your birthday this year?
target: 我是说，你今年不是要过生日吗？

source: I have a birthday every year!
target: 我每年都过生日！

source: Ah, and %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% knew this! So wise and thoughtful of %HIMHER%!
target: 对啊，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%早就知道了！%HIMHER%真是既聪明，又体贴！

source: My birthday isn't today, though!
target: 可我今天不过生日！

source: Well, of course: this is more like a prediction that you will have a birthday soon!
target: 那当然，这更像是在预言，你很快就要过生日了！

source: My birthday isn't soon.
target: 我生日还早着呢。

source: I mean... what's "soon", really? A year isn't that long anyway. Isn't your birthday less than a year away?
target: 那……什么才算“很快”呢？反正一年也不长。离你生日总不到一年吧？

source: Well, yes, but...
target: 是没错，可是……

source: Then close enough, if you ask me!
target: 那在我看来，就够近了！

source: Happy birthday, Hope!
target: 生日快乐，希望女巫！

source: IT'S NOT MY BIRTHDAY!
target: 今天不是我生日！

source: Hope, why so grumpy? Is it because you miss your birthday?
target: 希望女巫，怎么这么暴躁？想你的生日了？

source: Would you be less of a grumpy grump if we celebrated your birthday early this year?
target: 今年提前给你过个生日，你是不是就没这么气鼓鼓了？

source: ...Maybe.
target: 也许吧

source: And so you celebrate Hope's birthday.
target: 于是，你们给希望女巫过了个生日。

source: Later, Hope thanks you; fighting you has shown her she still has much practice to do.
target: 后来，希望女巫向你道谢。这场对决让她明白，自己还有很多要练的地方。

source: (Especially in regards to practicing her patience against annoying dumbasses.)
target: （尤其要练练，怎么耐心面对烦人的蠢货。）

source: For helping a friend, you get +5 SOUL.
target: 帮了朋友，你获得了 +5 灵魂。

source: Hey, if you end up in the City of Vice, give me a call. We can all laugh this off and have a party after the tournament.
target: 嘿，要是到了罪恶之城，给我打电话。锦标赛结束后，咱们开个派对，把这事一笑置之。

source: It's a deal, boo!
target: 说定了，宝贝！

source: You part ways.
target: 你们就此告别。

source: Today you won... because you believed in the heart of the cards!
target: 今天，你赢了……因为你相信卡牌之心！

source: You give Hope the birthday card, but it's not her birthday!
target: 你送了希望女巫一张生日贺卡，可今天不是她生日！

source: Dang, you didn't even need to be a fortune teller to nail that one; just a good friend!
target: 唉，这事都不用会占卜，当个称职的朋友就能答对！

source: No, but I'm close. I'm, like, foretelling her birthday.
target: 不是，我猜得挺近了啊。我这是……在预言她的生日。

source: It's not close, you idiot.
target: 一点都不近，白痴。

source: Well, surely it's not that far! Less than a year away, at the very least!
target: 那也不会远到哪儿去吧！至少，肯定不到一年！

source: ...Do you even understand how birthdays work?
target: ……你真知道生日是怎么回事吗？

source: ...Yes?
target: ……知道？

source: Debatable.
target: 有待商榷。

source: Also, my name is HopE, with an E at the end.
target: 还有，我叫希望女巫，英文名是 HopE，最后有个 E。

source: You wrote "Happy Birthday, Hop".
target: 你写的却是“生日快乐，Hop”。

source: ...Are you sure about that E thing?
target: ……你确定，真有那个 E？

source: You lose for being a terrible fortune teller and an even worse friend (go lose -3 SOUL for that).
target: 占卜师当得烂，朋友当得更烂，你输了。（为此失去 -3 灵魂，拿好。）

source: Everyone is bummed by your lack of consideration. They decide that the best way to make up for it is to gift your next birthday to Hope, so it becomes Hope's second birthday!
target: 你这么不体贴，大家都很失望。他们决定，把你的下一个生日送给希望女巫作补偿，给她多过一次生日！

source: (But you're not invited to Hope's second birthday party, since you still were a terrible friend.)
target: （不过，希望女巫的第二场生日派对，你没被邀请。毕竟你这朋友当得太烂了。）

source: Hope's Oober finally arrives, and she leaves.
target: 希望女巫叫的 Oober 终于到了，她坐车离开。

source: You're left to reflect on your poor choices today.
target: 留下你独自反思，今天都做了些什么烂决定。

source: Heya, you just reached a high amount of MONEY. Good for you!
target: 嘿，你的金钱已经攒得很高了。不错嘛！

source: Does that mean you're aiming for... the MONEY-BASED DESTINATION?
target: 这么说，你的目标是……以金钱为条件的目的地？

source: If so, there's a wacky adventure that could unlock a layer for that DESTINATION... wanna go for it?
target: 要是这样，有场荒唐冒险能解锁这个目的地的额外内容……要试试吗？

source: I thought you'd never ask!
target: 早就等你问了！

source: Nah, maybe some other time.
target: 不,也许改天吧。

source: Great! The adventure will be waiting for you on the road.
target: 太好了！这场冒险会在路上等着你。

source: Sorry for breaking the 4th wall... see ya!
target: 抱歉，打破第四面墙了……回见！

source: Gotcha, I just wanted to check. Sorry for breaking the 4th wall!
target: 明白，我就问问。抱歉，打破第四面墙了！

source: You're driving along when you see a fire hydrant explode. An aquatic knight in full armor steps out of the geiser!
target: 开车途中，你们看见一个消防栓猛地炸开，一位全副武装的水族骑士，从喷涌的水柱里走了出来！

source: HALT, METAL LAND HORSE! Come hither! I bid thine assistance in finding my way posthaste!
target: 陆地上的铁马，且慢！速速近前！我急需有人指路，还望相助！

source: ...Huh?
He's asking you to pull over and give him directions.
target: 他让你靠边停车，给他指个路。

source: Oh, okay! He could've just said so.
target: 哦，好！直接这么说不就行了。

source: Goodmorrow! I am Brigadier Beluga, servant and soldier to the glorious Vanderbilt Crown.
target: 日安！我是贝卢加准将，为荣耀的范德比尔特王室效命的仆从与战士。

source: Oh, that's cool. We went to school with Princess Miranda. Not to brag, but we're pretty tight with the Vanderbilts.
target: 哦，挺酷。我们跟米兰达公主是同学。不是吹牛，我们跟范德比尔特家可熟了。

source: Hmph! Ist thou so "tight" with the royal family that thou hast been given a quest upon which rests the fate of the entire Merkingdom?!
target: 哼！你们跟王室如此“熟”，可曾受命执行一项关乎整个人鱼王国命运的任务？！

source: No, thank God. That sounds like a chore.
target: 没有，谢天谢地。听着就麻烦。

source: Nay, 'tis an honor to aid Royal Commander Bellanda in her latest brilliant war campaign!
target: 此言差矣！协助王室指挥官贝兰达执行她最新的英明作战计划，乃无上荣耀！

source: The Commander is hard at work sieging aquariums and liberating the fish within to prepare for a full-scale invasion of this accursed dry land!
target: 指挥官正忙于围攻各处水族馆，解放其中的鱼类，为全面入侵这片可憎的旱地做准备！

source: ...Um, which thou didst not hear about from me.
target: ……呃，当然，这话可不是我说的。

source: However, this latest siege is posing a unique challenge. Those scoundrels hath built an impenetrable wall around the border of the aquarium!
target: 只是，这一次围攻颇有难处。那群恶棍竟在水族馆周围，修起了一道固若金汤的墙！

source: I go now aid the Commander, but alas, I knowest not where to find the aquarium, nor do I even have a plan for whenst I arrive...
target: 我正要赶去助阵，奈何不知水族馆位于何处，就算赶到了，也尚无破敌良策……

source: We can help you, bro; Coach says to leave no soldier or teammate behind! %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, what should he do?
target: 兄弟，我们能帮你！教练说，绝不落下任何士兵或队友！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，他该怎么办？

source: There's no need for confrontation at all: just ask the workers holding the fort if they're billing these siege-related extra hours.
target: 根本不用开打：问问守在墙后的员工，围城期间这些额外工时，算不算加班费。

source: A Trojan approach: cook some hot dogs and send them a much-needed hot dog vendor... but hide one or two Merkingdom soldiers inside the cart!
target: 来个特洛伊木马计：做点热狗，派个他们急需的热狗摊贩过去……再往推车里藏一两个人鱼王国士兵！

source: But peaceful negotiations are boring! I was hoping for a plan involving a catapult at least.
target: 可和平谈判好无聊！我还以为至少能来架投石机呢。

source: Nay, 'tis a splendid plan! Abovewater's strange obsession with "wages" and "fair treatment of workers" shall be its downfall!
target: 非也，此计甚妙！水上世界竟如此执着于“工资”和“公平对待工人”，必将自食其果！

source: You give Brigadier Beluga directions to the aquarium and say goodbye. Later, at the battlefront...
target: 你们给贝卢加准将指了去水族馆的路，便与他告别。后来，在前线……

source: HEY! You there, on top of the wall! Why do you guys wanna resist us so damn bad?!
target: 喂！墙上那个！你们干吗非得拼命跟我们作对？！

source: "Because it's our job!" the employee-turned-soldier shouts back.
target: “因为这是我们的工作！”由员工转行的士兵喊了回来。

source: Yeah, but do you even like doing it? We're fighting for King and country; what're you fighting for?
target: 是，可你真喜欢这活儿？我们为国王、为国家而战，你们图什么？

source: "I'm fighting for $10.75 an hour!"
target: “我为每小时 10.75 美元而战！”

source: That's it? Tell me you're getting overtime pay for all the extra siege hours at least!
target: 就这？至少告诉我，围城期间多干的这些小时，有加班费吧！

source: Dost thou even receive a bushel of grain for thine widow and guppies shouldst thou perish on the battlefield?!
target: 若阁下战死沙场，可有人赐予一斗粮食，抚恤遗孀与小鱼苗？！

source: "Uh... no, we don't get any of that."
target: “呃……没有，这些都没有。”

source: Sounds like you work for some real assholes. If you surrender now, we could start you off as a Merkingdom foot soldier for five clams an hour.
target: 你这老板够混蛋啊。现在投降，我们可以给你个普通人鱼步兵的职位，每小时五个蛤。

source: "...Is that a lot of clams?"
target: “……五个蛤算多吗？”

source: Yeah, sure, whatever you wanna believe. Are you gonna surrender or what?
target: 对，当然，随你怎么想。到底投不投降？

source: The employee raises the white flag! From there, the merfolk are easily able to storm the aquarium, recruiting the jaded employees and slaughtering the managers.
target: 员工举起了白旗！随后，人鱼们轻松攻入水族馆，招揽了心灰意冷的员工，屠杀了管理层。

source: You gain +N2 SOUL for helping Bellanda and Brigadier Beluga, though you lose -N2 HYPE for suggesting a peaceful(ish) solution.
target: 帮了贝兰达和贝卢加准将，你获得了 +N2 灵魂；不过，提了个差不多算和平的办法，也让你失去了 -N2 热度。

source: Great idea, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! Any idea involving hot dogs is bound to work!
