target: 好主意，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！有热狗的计划，肯定能成！

source: Tis a good plan, but alas, I have no dogs -- hot or otherwise...
target: 此计甚好，可惜，我并无狗——热的也好，别的也罢……

source: Don't worry, we have some hot dogs you can have. Anything to help you pull off a Trojan horse scam!
target: 别担心，我们有热狗，给你拿去。只要能帮你搞成特洛伊木马骗局就行！

source: Later, at the battlefront...
target: 后来，在前线……

source: This is a brilliant plan! Merkingdom history will be forever changed by Commander Bellanda and the hot dogs that turned the tides of war!
target: 妙计！贝兰达指挥官，还有这些扭转战局的热狗，将永远改写人鱼王国的历史！

source: Huzzah! 'Tis a great honor to let a Vanderbilt princess take credit for my idea, which I myself stole from a stranger on the side of the road.
target: 万岁！能让范德比尔特公主收下我的功劳，真是无上荣幸。虽说这主意，也是我从路边的陌生人那儿偷来的。

source: Damn right. That said, it's too risky to stash you in the cart itself. We need a better hiding spot... follow my lead.
target: 那当然。不过，把你藏车里太冒险了。得换个更好的地方……跟我来。

source: Bellanda and Brigadier Beluga approach the hot dog vendor with a big scalpel and a rag soaked in chloroform.
target: 贝兰达和贝卢加准将拿着一把大手术刀、一块浸过氯仿的布，走向那位热狗摊贩。

source: Thanks again for volunteering to be the hot dog guy, soldier. We just need to sedate you real quick before you go in.
target: 士兵，再次感谢你自愿扮演热狗摊贩。进去前，只需要先让你睡一下。

source: "Sedate me? Why?"
target: “让我睡一下？为什么？”

source: Erm... to receive thine tetanus shot! 'Tis mandatory procedure before a bloody battle!
target: 呃……要给阁下打破伤风针！血战之前，这是必要手续！

source: "But I already have my tetanus shot."
target: “可我已经打过破伤风针了。”

source: DID I ASK?! I'm your Commander! I'll give you ten tetanus shots if I damn well want to!
target: 我问了吗？！我是你的指挥官！老娘他妈乐意的话，给你打十针都行！

source: Can't argue with that! As soon as the soldier's asleep, Bellanda cuts open his stomach to hide Brigadier Beluga inside.
target: 无从反驳！士兵一睡着，贝兰达就剖开他的肚子，把贝卢加准将藏了进去。

source: Use this snorkel to breathe through his anus. When you hear him say "HOT DOGS FOR SALE", that's your cue to burst out of his stomach and attack!
target: 拿这根呼吸管，从他肛门通出去换气。听到他喊“热狗大甩卖”，就从他肚子里冲出来，发动攻击！

source: I shan't disappoint you, Commander! GLORY TO THE MERKINGDOM!
target: 定不负指挥官所托！荣耀归于人鱼王国！

source: The invasion goes swimmingly, and the Merkingdom takes another outpost! You gain +N2 SOUL for helping, but lose -N2 STAMINA giving away those hot dogs.
target: 入侵顺利得如鱼得水，人鱼王国又拿下一处前哨！你帮了忙，获得 +N2 灵魂；不过送出了热狗，也让你失去了 -N2 体力。

source: You're driving along when you see your old pal Brigadier Beluga on the side of the road, reading a map upside-down.
target: 开车途中，你们看见老朋友贝卢加准将在路边看地图……地图拿反了。

source: Ah! Hello again, valiant ones! Many thanks for thine assistance in Commander Bellanda's siege!
target: 啊！英勇的诸位，又见面了！多谢各位助贝兰达指挥官攻城！

source: Tis wonderful and utterly convenient that ye have found me once more, for I once again find myself floundering on a quest to serve the Vanderbilt Crown.
target: 诸位又找到了我，实在妙极，正好救急！因为我再次受命效忠范德比尔特王室，也再次陷入困境。

source: I am in search of the Royal Priestess Amanda. She is visiting the Sacred Sanctuary, a monastery only accessible to those who "take a leap of faith."
target: 我正在寻找王室女祭司阿曼达。她去了神圣圣所，一座只有“纵身一跃，笃信不疑”的人才能进入的修道院。

source: Now the Priestess must return home for the royal feast, but I cannot find the entrance to the monastery... prithee, do ye have any ideas?
target: 如今女祭司须返回王宫赴宴，我却找不到修道院入口……敢问诸位，可有办法？

source: Well, you said you had to take a leap of faith, right?
target: 你说，得“纵身一跃，笃信不疑”，对吧？

source: Aye.
target: 对

source: And there's a cliff right over there.
target: 那边正好有个悬崖。

source: Aye... so whateth?
target: 是……那又如何？

source: So take a leap of faith off the cliff to find the Sanctuary! It's Chekov's gun, smoking right here in front of you!
target: 那就心怀信仰，从悬崖上跳下去找圣所啊！契诃夫的枪都在你面前冒烟了！

source: But... um... what if thou art wrong, and I leap off a cliff to my untimely demise?
target: 可是……呃……万一你说错了，我跳下去，岂不是要英年早逝？

source: You mean you wouldn't risk dying to find your princess? Some knight you are!
target: 怎么，你不肯为了找公主冒死？你算什么骑士！

source: BOOOOO! FAKE FAN! FAKE KNIGHT IN SHINING ARMOR!
target: 嘘——！假粉丝！披着亮铠甲的冒牌骑士！

source: You suspect that jumping off a cliff isn't Brigadier Beluga's only option. He could also try...
target: 你觉得，贝卢加准将除了跳崖，应该还有别的选择。比如……

source: Ordering some pizza to be delivered to the Sacred Sanctuary, then following the pizza delivery person into the sanctuary!
target: 点披萨送到神圣圣所，再跟着披萨外送员进去！

source: Praying for directions.
target: 祈祷，请神指路。

source: YES! PIZZA IS ALWAYS THE ANSWER!
target: 没错！披萨永远是答案！

source: I know not what "pizza" is, but if it truly is "always the answer", I suppose this is the leap of faith I must take.
target: 虽不知“披萨”为何物，但既然它“永远是答案”，想必这便是我该付出的信任。

source: You're glad he's onboard, because you definitely only suggested this because you wanted pizza. You spend -N2 MONEY placing an order.
target: 他肯配合就好。毕竟你提这主意，绝对只是因为自己想吃披萨。你花了 -N2 金钱下单。

source: 15-to-45 minutes later, you, Polly, Scott, and Brigadier Beluga are crouched uncomfortably behind a bush as the pizza delivery girl pulls up on her bike.
target: 15 到 45 分钟后，你、波莉、斯科特和贝卢加准将，正难受地挤在灌木后面，披萨外送姑娘骑着车到了。

source: Pizza delivery for... no way... this can't be right.
target: 披萨外送，地址是……不会吧……肯定搞错了。

source: She pulls out her phone and calls her manager.
target: 她拿出手机，打给经理。

source: I'm telling you, Michael: there's nothing but a big cliff out here. I think we've been pranked.
target: 迈克尔，真的，这里除了大悬崖，什么都没有。我看是有人整我们。

source: Yeah, I put the address in my GPS... it just says to "take a leap of faith in 700 feet."
target: 对，地址输进导航了……它就说“前方 700 英尺，来一次信仰之跃”。

source: ...You want me to try taking a leap OFF the cliff? ...Ugh, fine, but this better be brought up in my next performance review.
target: ……你让我试着跳下悬崖？……唉，行吧，可下次绩效考核，得把这事算进去。

source: With a sigh, the pizza girl ragdolls and pitches over the side of the cliff.
target: 送披萨的姑娘叹了口气，浑身一松，像布娃娃一样栽下了悬崖。

source: ...Did we just make that girl jump off a cliff and die?
target: ……我们是不是刚让那姑娘跳崖死了？

source: I didn't hear any screaming or bone-crunching, so she's probably fine! I bet she found the Sanctuary!
target: 没听到尖叫，也没听到骨头碎掉的声音，应该没事吧！肯定找到圣所了！

source: I suppose that is the best assurance I shall get. Fare-thee-well, Abovewaterians! Let us meet again, if I do not shatter all of my bones!
target: 想来，这已是我能得到的最好保证。水上世界的诸位，就此别过！若我没摔得粉身碎骨，愿来日再会！

source: Brigadier Beluga jumps over the cliff and falls like a lead balloon.
target: 贝卢加准将纵身跃下悬崖，像灌了铅的气球一样直坠下去。

source: Dang... it's a shame the pizza girl jumped off the cliff before she could deliver our pizza.
target: 唉……可惜披萨姑娘还没把我们的披萨送来，就跳下去了。

source: Don't worry, Scotty! She left her bike box full of pizza here. We paid for a pizza, so we're eating a pizza!
target: 别担心，小斯科特！她把满满一箱披萨留在车上了。钱都付了，披萨必须吃到！

source: Works for you! You and Scott eat someone else's pizza, have no regrets whatsoever, and gain +N2 STAMINA.
target: 这办法你能接受！你和斯科特吃掉了别人的披萨，毫不后悔，获得了 +N2 体力。

source: I am skeptical that that will work.
target: 我对此法能否奏效，深表怀疑。

source: Of course you are. Typical man, never wanting to ask for directions!
target: 那当然。典型的男人，死活不肯问路！

source: But... I asked thee for directions...
target: 可是……我方才就在向你们问路……

source: Yeah, but did you try praying for them? Didn't think so! Let me show you how it's done:
target: 对，可你祈祷过，请神指路吗？没有吧！看我示范：

source: Hey God. It's Polly. I know we don't get along, but let's set aside our status as frenemies with will-they-won't-they vibes and broker a temporary truce here.
target: 嗨，上帝，我是波莉。我知道咱俩处不来，不过先把亦敌亦友、暧昧不明的关系放一边，暂时休个战。

source: Will you tell us where the Sanctuary is? Pretty please?
target: 告诉我们圣所在哪儿嘛。求求你啦？

source: ...I hearest nothing. Hath God abandoned us?
target: ……我什么都没听见。上帝抛弃我们了吗？

source: Maybe, but I'm sure plan B will work: let's be so annoying that giving us what we want is easier than denying us!
target: 也许吧，可 B 计划肯定管用：烦到他受不了，发现满足我们的要求，比拒绝还省事！

source: HEY, GOD! C'MON, GOD! ANSWER US, YOU OMNIPOTENT BASTARD!
target: 喂，上帝！快点啊，上帝！回答我们，你这无所不能的混蛋！

source: GOD! GOD! GOD! GOD GOD GOD GOD GOD GOD GOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOD!
target: 上帝！上帝！上帝！上帝上帝上帝上帝上帝上帝——！

source: "WHAT DO YOU WANT?!"
target: “你们想干什么？！”

source: Holy shit... God?!
target: 我靠……上帝？！

source: "No, we're the monks of the Sacred Sanctuary," says the man in the magical doorway behind you. "Will you please be quieter? We're meditating in here!"
target: “不是，我们是神圣圣所的僧侣，”你们身后，一位站在魔法门口的男人说，“能小点声吗？我们在里面冥想呢！”

source: WAIT! Prithee, let me into the Sacred Sanctuary! I beseech an audience with the Royal Priestess Amanda Vanderbilt!
target: 且慢！求您允我进入神圣圣所，我须拜见王室女祭司阿曼达·范德比尔特！

source: "Fine, you can come in. But next time, can you just take the cliff entrance instead of screaming outside the back door?"
target: “行，你进来吧。不过下次能直接走悬崖入口，别在后门外面吵吗？”

source: Sweet, I knew we could do it! I always believed... in the power of being really annoying.
target: 太好了，我就知道能成！我一直坚信……烦死人不偿命的力量。

source: You abandoned cold, critical logic and turned instead to blind faith and prayer. As a result, you lost -N2 MIND and gained +N2 MAGIC!
target: 你抛开了冷静、理性的逻辑，转而盲目相信信仰与祈祷。因此失去了 -N2 头脑，获得了 +N2 魔力！

source: You decide to stop when you see a certain big beluga who seems to be on the verge of having a heart attack...
target: 看到某位高大的白鲸朋友，紧张得像随时要心脏病发作，你们决定停车……

source: Brigadier Beluga, my man! Why're you lookin' so stressed?
target: 贝卢加准将，老兄！怎么愁成这样？

source: Oh, 'tis you, my noble newfound friends...
target: 哦，是诸位，我新结识的高尚朋友……

source: I am contemplating my likely fate, which will likely involve my head on a pike...
target: 我正思量自己将来的命运，多半……要脑袋挂枪尖了……

source: Beluga, Beluga, Beluga... what did you do this time, you zany rascal?
target: 贝卢加，贝卢加啊……你这个活宝，这回又干什么了？

source: Sigh... I was given a most crucial mission by none other than Her Royal Highness, Laudanda Vanderbilt...
target: 唉……劳丹达·范德比尔特殿下，亲自交给我一项至关重要的任务……

source: Beluga! Did you mix whites and colors when you were doing the royal laundry?
target: 贝卢加！洗王室的衣服时，你把白衣服和彩色衣服混一块儿了？

source: Alas, if only it were that...
target: 唉，若只是如此，倒好了……

source: Her Royal Highness is on a most critical diplomatic trip, in Hell.
target: 殿下正在地狱，进行一场极为重要的外交访问。

source: The Merkingdom doth attempt to broker some treaties with three of the Circles of Hell, for we have common enemies.
target: 人鱼王国想与地狱的其中三层签订条约，毕竟彼此有共同的敌人。

source: But alas! Hell is so prone to betrayal and general treachery that they tend to be quite skeptical of any strategic alliance.
target: 奈何地狱尔虞我诈、背信弃义乃是常态，因此他们对任何战略同盟都满腹疑虑。

source: After days of incessant diplomacy, Laudanda hath commanded I bring a few merdiplomats who are knowledgeable in the ways of Hell... but... but...
target: 连续斡旋数日后，劳丹达命我带去几名熟知地狱事务的人鱼外交官……可是……可是……

source: Beluga...?
target: 贝卢加……？

source: Prithee, sparest me from narrating my embarrassing failures! Let us simply say the diplomats fell off a cliff, okay? They are no more, and soon shall I also be!
target: 求诸位饶过我，别再逼我讲这丢人的经过！总之，外交官们掉下悬崖了，行吗？他们已不在人世，很快我也一样了！

source: My bros, wait, I'm getting a bit lost with this much info... just to be sure: the "head on a pike" thing is like... a bad thing, right? We want to avoid that, or...?
target: 兄弟们，等等，信息太多，我有点跟不上……就确认一下：“脑袋挂枪尖”……是坏事，对吧？咱们要避免，对不对……？

source: It's a bad thing, Scott; but Brigadier Beluga here is in luck, because the Prank Masterz are gonna save the day! We just need some costumes...
target: 是坏事，斯科特。不过贝卢加准将走运了，恶作剧大师来救场啦！只需要几套衣服……

source: And that's how, thanks to some expertly-crafted costumes, you infiltrate the diplomatic meeting.
target: 于是，靠着几套精心制作的伪装服，你们混进了外交会议。

source: No one can tell you're not the real merdiplomats!
target: 没人看得出，你们根本不是真正的人鱼外交官！

source: Now you just need to help Laudanda secure a treaty with Hell, and she will surely pardon Brigadier Beluga.
target: 只要帮劳丹达和地狱签下条约，她肯定就会赦免贝卢加准将。

source: This might be your moment to shine, actually. After hours of fierce negotiation, the whole discussion seems to have reached a dead end.
target: 说不定真该你大显身手了。激烈谈判几个小时后，整个会议似乎陷入了僵局。

source: The Merkingdom is failing to offer something valuable enough for Hell to accept the alliance.
target: 人鱼王国开出的条件还不够有吸引力，无法让地狱同意结盟。

source: What would be an unexpected asset for the Merkingdom to offer that'd tip the balance in favor of this treaty?
target: 该拿出什么出人意料的筹码，才能让天平倒向签约的一边？

source: Being underwater gives the Merkingdom juicy intel to barter with. You can offer... THE FULL ICEBERG, EXPLAINED!
target: 人鱼王国住在水下，手握大量情报可供交换。比如……整座冰山，全解析！

source: Hell is a very unpopular destination for tormented souls, but that's just because it's missing... its own catchy theme song!
target: 受折磨的灵魂都不想去地狱，可原因只是……地狱还没有一首洗脑主题曲！

source: You want to explain us... an iceberg?
target: 你想给我们讲解……一座冰山？

source: Yeah, it's Internet slang to refer to the hidden depths of different topics and stuff, analyzed in super-entertaining videos.
target: 对，网上的说法，指某个话题下隐藏的层层内幕，有人会做成特别有意思的解析视频。

source: Yeah! Like Shrek's iceberg! I loved watching Shrek's iceberg explained!
target: 没错！就像史莱克冰山！我可爱看《史莱克冰山全解析》了！

source: You're offering us... a video analysis of an animated movie?
target: 你给我们的提议……是一段动画电影解析视频？

source: That's the offer that's supposed to convince us to make a strategic alliance that might lead to the deaths of countless soldiers in our ranks...?
target: 你打算靠这个，说服我们缔结可能让无数麾下士兵丧命的战略同盟……？

source: Hmph...
Our advisor is clearly speaking metaphorically here.
target: 显然，我们的顾问是在打比方。

source: They meant we can share our intel on different fronts that could both prove useful in our crusade against Heaven and further Hell's general interests.
target: 顾问的意思是，双方可以共享各条战线的情报，既有助于征伐天堂，也能促进地狱的整体利益。

source: So... no Shrek iceberg explained?
target: 所以……不看史莱克冰山解析了？

source: Anyway...
target: 总之...

source: In the Merkingdom, we value intel. We have many historians, spies, and arcane mages investigating esoteric-yet-potentially-useful fronts.
target: 人鱼王国一向重视情报。众多历史学家、间谍和奥术法师，都在调查那些深奥、却可能有用的领域。

source: From the current location and strategies of various Old Deities in their quest to unmake reality... to the true identity of God.
target: 比如，企图毁灭现实的各位古神，目前身在何处、作何打算……又比如，上帝的真实身份。

source: Well... now that's something.
target: 嗯……这倒有点意思。

source: Not to mention our research on the Multiverse Theory or the Shards of the True Power...
target: 还有我们对多元宇宙理论、真之力碎片的研究，就更不必说了……

source: All of this could certainly be useful.
target: 这些的确都能派上用场。

source: We would require, of course, that Hell also share its intel on these topics to build better strategies.
target: 当然，地狱也须分享这些领域的情报，才能制定更完善的战略。

source: Of course, of course.
target: 当然,当然。

source: Good enough, then?
target: 那么，这样足够了吗？

source: Throw in that "Shrek" thing too and we have a deal...
target: 再加上那个“史莱克”，就成交……

source: Yes, yes. I am now utterly intrigued by this "Shrek Iceberg Explained"... Good idea...
target: 对，对。现在我对这个《史莱克冰山全解析》，可是充满好奇……好主意……

source: Sure. Shall we continue?
target: 可以。继续谈吧？

source: ...What? We don't need intel on what's underneath the iceberg. We know: there's more iceberg.
target: ……什么？冰山下面有什么，不用你们提供情报。我们知道：还是冰山。

source: Yes, I won't lie: that is the case.
target: 是的，不瞒各位，确实如此。

source: No, no, I'm not talking about a LITERAL ICEBERG, goddammit!
target: 不是，不是，我他妈说的又不是真的冰山！

source: It's a metaphor for the hidden depths of different topics, most commonly pieces of fiction. Like... "The Evangelion Iceberg".
target: 那是比喻，指某个话题底下隐藏的层层内幕，多半是虚构作品。比如……《EVA 冰山》。

source: What's an Evangelion?
target: EVA 是什么？

source: What?! It's a cult classic anime; a work of art, one might say!
target: 什么？！那可是有大批狂热粉丝的经典动画，说是艺术品都不为过！

source: Why... why would we want to know more about this Evangelion? Why even make it a key component of our alliance with the Merkingdom?
target: 为什么……我们为什么想了解这个 EVA？还要把它当成人鱼王国同盟的重要条件？

source: Well, you see, Evangelion has a pretty complex story built on intricate lore. It has angels!
target: 是这样，EVA 的故事特别复杂，背后设定也很庞大。里面有天使！

source: Angels have something to do with this Evangelion? We HATE angels!
target: 这个 EVA 跟天使有关？我们恨天使！

source: Yes. They are trying to provoke the Third Impact to end all life on Earth.
target: 对，它们想引发第三次冲击，终结地球上的所有生命。

source: Damned angels!
target: 可恶的天使！

source: Indeed. But the corporation known as NERV has built some mechas to fight the angels.
target: 没错。不过，有家叫 NERV 的公司，造了些机甲来对抗天使。

source: They're trying to get beneath Tokyo-3. They want to make contact with Adam... but little do they know, someone else is there instead!
target: 天使想钻进第三新东京市的地下，接触亚当……可它们不知道，下面其实另有其人！

source: We could join forces with this NERV, then. These mechas could prove useful.
target: 那我们可以跟 NERV 联手。这些机甲应该能派上用场。

source: Yes! We only need some very angsty teenagers to pilot them and enact a very depressing version of a romcom!
target: 对！再找些特别拧巴的青少年来开，演一出极其压抑的恋爱喜剧就行！

source: You know, I actually have the full anime on my phone. Let's check it out!
target: 我手机里正好存了全套动画。来，一起看！

source: Hmmmm... okay.
target: 嗯……行吧。

source: You watch the full EVANGELION, including the old two movies and the four new ones.
target: 你们看完了整部《新世纪福音战士》，包括两部旧剧场版，还有四部新剧场版。

source: We... just watched a cartoon. This is not real. It's a cartoon.
target: 我们……刚看了一部动画片。这不是真实事件，就是动画片。

source: Ugh, it's NOT a cartoon! It's an anime!
target: 烦死了，这不叫卡通！叫日本动画！

source: You're kicked out of the meeting. NO ONE EVER UNDERSTANDS THE BEAUTY OF EVANGELION!
target: 你被赶出了会议室。永远没人懂 EVA 的美！

source: You lose -3 STAMINA because you are not kicked out in a peaceful manner. Ouch.
target: 而且人家请你出去的方式，可不怎么和平，所以你失去了 -3 体力。疼。

source: ...What?
target: ……什么？

source: Hmmm... we're intrigued by this proposal...
target: 嗯……这个提议，我们很感兴趣……

source: You... are...?
target: 你们……真的……？

source: Yes. Surely this intelligent diplomat is talking about an anthem.
target: 是的。这位聪慧的外交官，说的肯定是一首颂歌。

source: The Merkingdom excels at controlling the masses while keeping the population loyal to the crown.
target: 人鱼王国擅长统御民众，让百姓始终忠于王室。

source: We are riddled with betrayal, always threatened by coups... we could learn from your expertise.
target: 我们内部背叛不断，随时面临政变……可以向你们取取经。

source: Indeed, our noble aristocrat certainly meant this.
target: 不错，我们这位高贵的臣属，确实就是此意。

source: We must assume you didn't come to this important meeting empty-handed.
target: 想必各位前来参加如此重要的会议，不至于空手而来吧。

source: Yes, we would love to hear a first draft of this anthem, to prove the value of this alliance.
target: 是啊，我们想先听个颂歌初稿，好证明这份同盟的价值。

source: That's not a problem. Our wise diplomat here doubles as an anthem composer, and they most certainly brought a proposal.
target: 当然没问题。这位睿智的外交官，也兼任颂歌作曲家，肯定准备了方案。

source: For you see, their artistry is fueled by the knowledge that they will be beheaded if they don't deliver their best work.
target: 毕竟，顾问心里清楚，拿不出最好的作品，就得掉脑袋。这便是艺术灵感的源泉。

source: See? Look at the Merkingdom, always keeping their subjects motivated! How admirable.
target: 瞧瞧！人鱼王国就是有办法，让臣民时刻充满干劲！真令人钦佩。

source: Uh... eh... okay... here I go...
target: 呃……嗯……好……我唱了……

source: "Fuck everyone who's not in Hell! / Especially angels; throw 'em in a cell!"
target: “没在地狱的，全都滚蛋！/尤其是天使，统统关进牢房里看管！”

source: "Fuck everyone who's not in Hell! / Except for the Merkingdom, they're pretty swell!"
target: “没在地狱的，全都滚蛋！/人鱼王国除外，他们就是赞！”

source: "Fuck everyone who IS in Hell! / 'Cause demons are fuckin' hot as hell!"
target: “待在地狱的，全都操个遍！/恶魔他妈性感，辣翻天！”

source: "FUCKIN' HELL! / FUCK IN HELL! / LET'S ALL FUCKIN' GO TO HELL!"
target: “他妈的地狱！/在地狱操！/大家他妈的，下地狱去吧！”

source: It's not bad, but don't you think the third line is a little... misleading?
target: 还行，不过第三句是不是有点……容易误解？

source: No, it's a subversion of the established poetic form. It's deep. People will eat that shit up.
target: 没有，这是对既定诗歌形式的颠覆。很深刻，大家就吃这一套。

source: True! I liked the wordplay. The song is catchy and accurate: we demons ARE hot as hell, aren't we?
target: 没错！我喜欢里面的双关。这歌朗朗上口，也很准确：我们恶魔，不就是性感得要命吗？

source: ...Sure. And surely that song is just one of several tools of mass control the Merkingdom can provide us if this treaty is signed, right?
target: ……当然。而且只要条约签订，人鱼王国能提供的群众管控手段，肯定不止这么一首歌，对吧？

source: If so, I'm in.
target: 要是这样，我同意。

source: That is completely right. That... song was just the first of many boons to come your way. Shall we continue now?
target: 完全正确。这首……歌，只是日后种种好处的第一项。现在可以继续了吗？

source: What?
target: 什么？

source: You're negotiating a game-changing alliance between two of the world's strongest kingdoms in order to take down Heaven... and your best offer is... a song?
target: 世界上两个最强大的王国，为攻打天堂，正在商谈足以改变格局的同盟……你能拿出的最好筹码，就是……一首歌？

source: Is this some sort of jape?
target: 这是在开玩笑吗？

source: So far, this negotiation has discussed the use of entire armies, the exchange of strategic territories, the creation of key diplomatic positions...
target: 截至目前，谈判涉及整支军队的调遣、战略领土的交换、关键外交职位的设立……

source: ...and you want to tip the balance with a tune.
target: ……你却想靠一首小曲，左右最后的结果。

source: Wait, wait, you haven't heard it yet. It's a great theme song!
target: 等等，你们还没听呢。主题曲超棒的！

source: Listen...
target: 听着...

source: "I LOVE HELL! / HELL IS NEAT! / HELL IS COOL! / HELL IS SWEET! / HELL IS..."
target: “我爱地狱！/地狱好看！/地狱超酷！/地狱香甜！/地狱是……”

source: ...ah, shit, what else rhymes with neat and sweet... oh! "HELL IS... FEET!"
target: ……啊，妈的，还有什么跟“好看”“香甜”押韵……哦！“地狱是……脚板！”

source: "GO HELL! / GO HELL! / GO HELL!"
target: “地狱加油！/地狱加油！/地狱加油！”

source: GUARDS!
target: 卫兵！

source: And that's how you got kicked out of a diplomatic meeting by singing an admittedly-bad song. Needless to say, you lost -3 HYPE for it.
target: 就这样，你唱了一首确实很烂的歌，被赶出了外交会议。不用说，你失去了 -3 热度。

source: Yes, yes, I'd say we have a deal here... but an issue remains: how we can be sure you'll hold up your end of the bargain?
target: 好，好，我看可以成交……不过还有个问题：怎么保证你们履行承诺？

source: I could raise the same question to you. Hell is known for backstabbing, no offense.
target: 同样的问题，我也可以问你们。地狱素来以背叛闻名，无意冒犯。

source: None taken; but that fact also makes us quite skeptical of any sort of lasting alliance.
target: 不算冒犯。不过正因如此，我们才不怎么相信长久的同盟。

source: It's clear that no treaty will serve its purpose unless we have solid assurances that both parties will hold up their end of the deal.
target: 显然，若无可靠的保障，确保双方履约，任何条约都不过是空谈。

source: There's an awkward silence that can obviously only be broken with a fantastic idea on how to ensure both sides will be legit about this!
target: 一阵尴尬的沉默。显然，只有绝妙的主意才能打破僵局：如何确保双方都来真的？

source: The fanfic twist: orchestrate a strategic marriage. With the proper intel on who the betrothed should be, you can play into the trope of diplomatic allies-to-lovers.
target: 来个同人转折：安排政治联姻。查清该让谁订婚，就能演出“外交盟友变恋人”的经典套路。

source: Both kingdoms should get matching tattoos!
target: 让两个王国纹同款纹身！

source: A royal wedding? That would be... most fabulous.
target: 王室婚礼？那可真是……华丽极了。

source: But who should be betrothed?
target: 可是，让谁订婚呢？

source: As a sign of commitment, we can offer the hand of Miranda, Princess of the Merkingdom.
target: 为表诚意，我们可以让人鱼王国的米兰达公主联姻。

source: What about Hell, though?
target: 地狱愿意派出哪位？

source: Uh, good question...
target: 呃，好问题……

source: What about Gwendoline the Black Widow?
target: 黑寡妇格温多琳怎么样？

source: Eh... doesn't she tend to eat her lovers?
target: 呃……她不是总吃掉自己的情人吗？

source: True, true...
target: 是真的,没错...

source: Ah, there's Baaltazar the Big Bad Bachelor!
target: 啊，还有大坏蛋单身汉巴尔塔扎尔！

source: But being a bachelor is part of his identity! What will become of him if he's a bachelor no more?
target: 可单身汉就是他身份的一部分！不单身了，他还怎么当自己？

source: You're 100% right. I suppose some things are sacred, even in Hell.
target: 100%正确。我想，即便在地狱，有些东西也神圣不可侵犯。

source: Stan, Lucien, wouldn't your child make a good consort for this union?
target: 斯坦，吕西安，你们的孩子不就很适合这门亲事吗？

source: You mean Damien?
target: 你是说德魔？

source: I don't know, my love... should we push a marriage onto our baby?
target: 不好说，亲爱的……真要逼我们的小宝贝结婚吗？

source: Well, doesn't Miranda go to the same school as him? I'm sure he's mentioned her before...
target: 米兰达不是跟他在一所学校吗？他肯定提过她……

source: Oh, right, he had a massive crush on her, didn't he? He was obsessed with her for the longest time. It was so cute!
target: 哦，对，他当时可迷她了，不是吗？迷了好长一段时间。太可爱了！

source: No, no, that was Hope, I think.
target: 不不，我记得那是希望女巫。

source: Do you have a picture of Miranda?
target: 有米兰达的照片吗？

source: Ugh... yes. Here.
target: 唉……有，给。

source: Ahhhhhhhhh, yes. They hang out quite a bit. He has mentioned he finds her corny and dumb, but I know my boy: he was simply hiding his interest.
target: 啊——对，他们经常一起玩。他说她又土又傻，可我了解自己儿子：那不过是在掩饰喜欢。

source: Our Damien... always playing tough, huh?
target: 我们家德魔……就是爱装硬汉，是吧？

source: I think this could actually work... give us three days to consult with him and we will come back with a definite answer.
target: 这事也许真能成……给我们三天，跟他商量一下，再给各位明确答复。

source: Would Miranda be okay with this strategic wedding?
target: 米兰达会愿意接受这种政治婚姻吗？

source: Yes, yes. Miranda will love it, or something.
target: 会，会，米兰达会喜欢的吧，差不多。

source: In the Merkingdom, we also believe weddings are for "love" and not just an arrangement to increase wealth and power, as was originally intended.
target: 在人鱼王国，我们也相信，婚姻应当为了“爱情”，不只是像它最初的用途那样，用来扩张财富和权势。

source: That's great to hear.
target: 那真是太好了。

source: Excellent.
target: 不错

source: (Should I consult Princess Miranda on this, Your Grace?)
target: （殿下，要不要就这事，征求一下米兰达公主的意见？）

source: (No.)
target: （不用。）

source: But listen: we know one of the chief warmongers trying to conquer the 8th Circle goes to school with Miranda too.
target: 不过，有件事得说明：我们知道，企图征服地狱第八层的一位好战头目，也跟米兰达在同一所学校。

source: If Hell ever puts this alliance in jeopardy, the Merkingdom won't hesitate to marry Miranda off to the opposition instead.
target: 地狱若危及这份同盟，人鱼王国绝不介意换个对象，把米兰达嫁给敌方。

source: WHOOOOOA, SOMEONE BRING POPCORN PLEASE?!
target: 哇——谁来给我拿点爆米花？！

source: A royal wedding?
target: 王室婚礼？

source: We could betroth your son to the fourth Vanderbilt sister, Princess Miranda.
target: 我们可以安排贵公子，与范德比尔特家的四公主米兰达订婚。

source: I don't know... we would never push an arranged marriage on our boy if he wasn't truly in love.
target: 不好说……要不是他真心喜欢，我们绝不会强迫儿子接受包办婚姻。

source: Yes. We believe in true love in the 8th Circle of Hell. We could never condone an arranged marriage...
target: 没错。地狱第八层相信真爱，绝不能容许包办婚姻……

source: Of course, of course... we obviously knew this.
target: 当然，当然……我们自然知道。

source: It was all but a jape. We would never push a marriage on our sister Miranda... of course.
target: 只是个玩笑。我们当然不会逼自己的妹妹米兰达结婚……当然。

source: She's so much more than a maid to be married off for strategic reasons.
target: 她可不只是个用来政治联姻的待嫁姑娘。

source: In the end, she's... like... an individual with her own opinions... I suspect.
target: 毕竟，她是……那个……有自己想法的独立个体……我猜。

source: What a strange jape for your advisors to make...
target: 你们顾问的玩笑，真是古怪……

source: Indeed. As a matter of fact, they're not advisors, but jesters I hired to entertain you with their silly games.
target: 确实。其实，他们并非顾问，是我请来逗各位开心的弄臣，专门耍些愚蠢把戏。

source: Ah, I see. So their ideas do not represent your real stance on this?
target: 啊，原来如此。所以他们的提议，不代表你方的真实立场？

source: Not at all. They only voice dumb ideas on purpose.
target: 完全不代表。他们就是故意说些蠢话。

source: Makes sense. That wedding idea was very dumb.
target: 说得通 那个婚礼的想法很蠢

source: HEY!
target: 哎哟!

source: Don't worry, we'll now proceed to kick the jesters out so we can get into more serious business.
target: 放心，现在就把弄臣赶出去，好继续谈正事。

source: Please do.
target: 请吧

source: They kick you out. You also lose -3 HYPE for not being a funny jester. Meh.
target: 你们被赶了出去。弄臣当得不好笑，还让你失去了 -3 热度。唉。

source: Whoa, that's a rad idea, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!
target: 哇，这主意真酷，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！

source: I mean... Merdiplomat Number Two.
target: 我是说……人鱼外交官二号。

source: You're suggesting we secure our commitment by... getting tattoos?
target: 你想让我们靠……纹身，来确保彼此履约？

source: Yeah, tattoos are cool!
target: 是啊,纹身很酷!

source: Our advisors here surely mean that both parties should secure fidelity via some sort of arcane glyphing.
target: 想必，顾问是希望双方以某种奥术符文，约束彼此的忠诚。

source: Like a spell carved into our skins that will ensure we abide by this alliance.
target: 比如，把咒文刻在皮肤上，确保双方遵守同盟约定。

source: Ah, that makes much more sense!
target: 啊，那合理多了！

source: And the tattoos can be super cool.
target: 纹身可以超级酷.

source: Ooh, it can have a shark to symbolize the Merkingdom.
target: 哦，可以纹条鲨鱼，象征人鱼王国。

source: And... and a HAWK! FOR HELL!
target: 再……再纹只鹰！象征地狱！

source: There are no hawks in Hell.
target: 地狱没有鹰。

source: But hawks are rad!
target: 可鹰很酷啊！

source: They are rad, certainly.
target: 那倒是，确实很酷。

source: All of that is irrelevant; the important part of the enchantment will be in the glyphs. The image can be whatever.
target: 这些不重要，附魔的关键在符文，图案随意。

source: Whatever... as in a cool shark and an awesome hawk doing the raddest handshake ever?
target: 随意……比如一条酷鲨鱼，跟一只超棒的鹰，来个史上最酷的握手？

source: ...Sure.
target: ……可以。

source: What about the cool shark and the awesome hawk having rad sex?
target: 那酷鲨鱼跟超棒的鹰，来场超酷的性爱呢？

source: Don't push it.
target: 别得寸进尺。

source: Okay, okay. Let's shake on it.
target: 好吧好吧，握手成交。

source: This measure satisfies our side.
target: 这一措施令我们满意。

source: MATCHING TATTOOS!
target: 同款纹身！

source: (Are we really getting tattoos of a shark and a hawk, Your Royal Highness?)
target: （殿下，我们真要纹鲨鱼和鹰吗？）

source: (No.)
target: （不用。）

source: A tattoo? What a rad idea!
target: 纹身？好主意，够酷！

source: How... how will a tattoo keep us from betraying each other?
target: 可……纹身怎么就能防止彼此背叛？

source: BECAUSE WE'LL BE TATTOO BROS FOR LIFE!
target: 因为我们会是同款纹身一辈子的好兄弟！

source: What does that even mean?
target: 这是什么意思?

source: We'll get a cool tattoo with something awesome, like a shark and a hawk shaking hands. You know: shark for the Merkingdom, hawk for Hell.
target: 纹个特别棒、特别酷的图案，比如鲨鱼跟鹰握手。你们懂，鲨鱼代表人鱼王国，鹰代表地狱。

source: There are no hawks in Hell.
target: 地狱没有鹰。

source: But they're rad!
target: 可它们很酷啊！

source: But you can still totally betray us even if we get some dumb tattoos.
target: 可就算纹了蠢纹身，你们照样能背叛我们。

source: THEY'RE NOT DUMB!
target: 这纹身才不蠢！

source: Yeah, and you wouldn't betray a fellow hawk-sharker, would you?
target: 对啊，你总不会背叛同属“鹰鲨帮”的兄弟吧？

source: ...Yes, we would.
target: 是的,我们会的。

source: No way, bro! That's cold!
target: 不是吧，兄弟！太无情了！

source: Please, ignore the advisors. They don't know what they're talking about.
target: 请无视这些顾问，他们根本不知道自己在说什么。

source: As a matter of fact, they're not advisors, but jesters I hired to entertain you with their silly games.
target: 其实，他们并非顾问，是我请来逗各位开心的弄臣，专门耍些愚蠢把戏。

source: Ah, I see. So their ideas do not represent your real stance on this?
target: 啊，原来如此。所以他们的提议，不代表你方的真实立场？

source: Not at all. They only voice dumb ideas on purpose.
target: 完全不代表。他们就是故意说些蠢话。

source: Makes sense. That tattoo thing was very dumb.
target: 说得通 那个纹身很蠢

source: HEY!
target: 哎哟!

source: Don't worry, we'll now proceed to kick the jesters out so we can get into more serious business.
target: 放心，现在就把弄臣赶出去，好继续谈正事。

source: Please do.
target: 请吧

source: They kick you out. You also lose -3 HYPE for not being a funny jester. Meh.
target: 你们被赶了出去。弄臣当得不好笑，还让你失去了 -3 热度。唉。

source: With everything agreed upon and a commitment clause in place, it seems the diplomatic meeting has been a huge success.
target: 随着所有协议和一项承诺条款的落实,外交会议似乎取得了巨大成功。

source: Or it would be if it wasn't for what happens next...
target: 本该如此，要不是接下来发生了这件事……

source: What... ANGELS?!
target: 什么……天使？！

source: How did they know about this gathering?
target: 他们怎么知道这次集会的?

source: Heh... I might have told them...
target: 呵……可能是我告诉他们的……

source: Barbatos?! How could you?
target: 巴巴托斯？！你怎么能这样？

source: How could YOU assume I was game for an alliance with other Circles of Hell? Much less an alliance with these filthy, fish-faced outsiders?!
target: 你凭什么以为，我愿意跟地狱其他层结盟？更何况，还要跟这帮肮脏的鱼脸外族结盟？！

source: No, no... better to cut a deal with Heaven. We had to bring you to this vulnerable state for them to end you.
target: 不，不……还是跟天堂交易更划算。先让你们毫无防备，他们才能一举消灭你们。

source: Either we'll take over your Circles... or if Heaven comes to conquer Hell, we've been promised a good portion of it, to act as representatives for God.
target: 要么由我们接管你们的地盘……要么，天堂攻陷地狱后，我们也能分到大块领土，替上帝代管。

source: You treacherous bastard...
target: 你这背信弃义的混蛋……

source: You need to do something fast if you want to avoid... you know... dying.
target: 想避免……你懂的……死掉，就得赶紧想办法。

source: Violence is not the answer... RELEASE THE DIPLOMACY DOLPHINS!
target: 暴力解决不了问题……放出外交海豚！

source: Conjure some extraordinary ventriloquism skills to pretend you're the voice of God coming from nowhere.
target: 使出非凡的腹语功夫，假装自己是凭空响起的上帝之声。

source: Oh, that's such a sensible idea, yes.
target: 哦，对，真是明智的主意。

source: Release the Diplomacy Dolphins.
target: 释放外交海豚。

source: Lots of dolphins are dropped from the ceiling, where they were kept hidden as a safety measure.
target: 大群海豚从天花板上落下——先前就被藏在那儿，以防万一。

source: (Good thing you were paying attention when Miranda was blabbering to you about how they do things in the Merkingdom.)
target: （幸亏米兰达跟你唠叨人鱼王国的处事方式时，你认真听了。）

source: Dolphins! So silly!
target: 海豚！傻乎乎的真可爱！

source: Will they do diplomacy now?
target: 现在它们要搞外交了吗？

source: Yes, they'll probably negotiate our release.
target: 对，应该会谈判，让我们获释。

source: The dolphins start violently massacring the traitors and the angels.
target: 海豚开始疯狂屠杀叛徒和天使。

source: (Well, guess you weren't paying THAT much attention when Miranda was talking about this... intention is all that matters, maybe?)
target: （好吧，看来米兰达讲的时候，你也没那么认真……也许，有这份心就够了？）

source: ...Polly, this is not so nice.
target: ……波莉，这可不太友好。

source: Maybe this is how dolphins do diplomacy?
target: 没准海豚就是这么搞外交的？

source: We only call them that because of the alliteration. It rolls better off the tongue.
target: 因为英文叫“Diplomacy Dolphins”，押头韵，念着顺口才这么叫的。

source: It actually does.
target: 确实是

source: You witness the dolphins murdering everyone in a horrible manner.
target: 你亲眼看着海豚，用惨不忍睹的方式大开杀戒。

source: Ah. That was a splendid sight, no doubt.
target: 啊，毫无疑问，真是赏心悦目。

source: We apologize for the treacherous ways of our former ally. We hope the fact that we were also targeted is proof that we're loyal to this treaty between us.
target: 昔日盟友的背叛行径，我们深感抱歉。我们同样遭到袭击，想必足以证明，我们对这份条约的忠诚。

source: Don't fret. We trust your loyalty to this alliance.
target: 不必担心，我们相信贵方对同盟的忠心。

source: Otherwise, this tactic of ours has most likely shown you how we deal with traitors in the Merkingdom.
target: 否则，想必刚才的手段，也已让贵方见识到，人鱼王国是如何处置叛徒的。

source: With a beautiful display of violence... truly admirable.
target: 一场美丽的暴力盛宴……实在令人钦佩。

source: Should we sign these accords? If anything, this has confirmed how essential it is for us to deal with the threat of Heaven.
target: 现在签署协议吧？刚才的事恰好证明，联手应对天堂的威胁，有多么必要。

source: Laudanda shakes hand with the Hell Commanders. Diplomatic documents are signed.
target: 劳丹达与地狱指挥官握手，签下了外交文件。

source: Her Royal Highness pardons you all for your obvious costumes and for the murder of the real merdiplomats thanks to your crucial role in this negotiation.
target: 你们在谈判中起了关键作用，殿下赦免了你们那些一眼就能看穿的伪装，还有杀害真正人鱼外交官的罪行。

source: She pays you +5 MONEY and even mentions she'd be pleased to welcome you in the Merkingdom if you were to visit. Hooray!
target: 她付给你 +5 金钱，还说若你们来人鱼王国，一定热烈欢迎。好耶！

source: Yeah, release the Diplomacy Dolphins!
target: 对，放出外交海豚！

source: Good, sensible idea! We'll avoid bloodshed with diplomacy!
target: 好主意，明智！用外交避免流血！

source: Why would we store a pod of dolphins somewhere secret for... diplomacy reasons?
target: 我们为什么要偷偷藏一群海豚……就为了外交？

source: We're already doing diplomacy ourselves.
target: 外交，我们自己就在做。

source: Dunno... for reasons?
target: 不知道……总得有点理由吧？

source: Your idea is quite stupid.
target: 你的点子很蠢。

source: NO IT ISN'T.
target: 才不蠢。

source: We do not have Diplomacy Dolphins, but...
target: 我们没有外交海豚，不过……

source: ...release the Murder Killer Whales.
target: ……放出杀戮虎鲸。

source: The... what now?
target: 什么……你说什么？

source: No time to explain. The merfolk drop the killer whales they had secretly stored in the ceiling for... murder reasons, I wanna say?
target: 没时间解释了。人鱼们放下暗藏在天花板里的虎鲸——事先藏起来，大概就是为了……杀人吧？

source: You never know when you'll get double crossed!
target: 谁知道什么时候，就会有人背后捅刀呢！

source: Dang, these killer whales really are good at killing. Look at all that blood!
target: 哇，这些虎鲸真是杀人高手。看这血！

source: The day has been saved!
target: 危机解除！

source: But not by your dumb idea. If it was up to you, everyone would be murdered by now.
target: 可不是靠你的蠢主意。真听你的，大家早被杀光了。

source: You're a disgrace. Leave this meeting immediately.
target: 真丢脸。立刻离开会场。

source: And do it in shame.
target: 带着羞愧离开。

source: Sigh...
You lose -3 HYPE for leaving... in shame.
target: 你因为……灰溜溜地离场，失去了 -3 热度。

source: Thanks to your MAGIC prowess, you can amp up your ventriloquism skills.
target: 凭着出色的魔力，你的腹语功夫更上一层楼。

source: You project your voice as if it's a deep voice coming from nowhere... maybe from Above?!
target: 你将声音投射出去，听起来像一阵不知从何而来的低沉嗓音……也许，是来自天上？！

source: STOP THIS NOW.
target: 立刻住手。

source: Who was that?
target: 那是谁?

source: IT'S ME: GOD.
target: 是我：上帝。

source: God...? Is that... you?
target: 上帝……？是……您吗？

source: No, you moron. Of course it isn't God!
target: 不是，白痴，当然不是上帝！

source: Prove you're God!
target: 证明你是上帝!

source: I DON'T NEED TO PROVE ANYTHING. MY WHOLE THING IS NEVER PROVING ANYTHING!
target: 我无需证明什么。从不证明什么，就是我的一贯风格！

source: YOU MUST BELIEVE. DON'T YOU HAVE FAITH?!
target: 你们必须相信。难道没有信仰吗？！

source: ...I mean, they got you there. Faith is like a big thing for us.
target: ……这话你还真反驳不了。信仰对咱们来说，可是头等大事。

source: Shucks! They're right...
target: 可恶！说得对……

source: I bet this is one of God's tests.
target: 肯定是上帝的又一次考验。

source: Maybe. They're ALWAYS testing people.
target: 也许。上帝总爱考验人。

source: Like that one time they tricked that random dude into almost killing his own son.
target: 比如那次，骗了个男的，差点让他杀掉亲生儿子。

source: A classic.
target: 经典.

source: SILENCE! LISTEN TO ME, OR I WILL MAKE YOU ALL KILL YOUR OWN SONS!
target: 安静！听我的话，否则就让你们全去杀自己的儿子！

source: I think we should abide by God's word.
target: 我觉得，还是听上帝的话吧。

source: ...Fuck.
Yeah, I think we should call it a day.
target: 对，今天就到这儿吧。

source: Yes, these Hell scum were probably going to double-cross us eventually anyway.
target: 是啊，反正地狱这帮渣滓，迟早也要出卖我们。

source: Hey!
target: 嘿

source: (They aren't wrong, though.)
target: （倒也没说错。）

source: Fuck you all.
target: 操你们

source: The angels leave.
target: 天使们离开。

source: This gives you the upper hand to overwhelm the Hell traitors and murder them.
target: 天使一走，你们便占了上风，将地狱叛徒压制、杀死。

source: We apologize for the treacherous ways of our former ally. We hope the fact that we were also targeted is proof that we're loyal to this treaty between us.
target: 昔日盟友的背叛行径，我们深感抱歉。我们同样遭到袭击，想必足以证明，我们对这份条约的忠诚。

source: Don't fret. We trust your loyalty to this alliance.
target: 不必担心，我们相信贵方对同盟的忠心。

source: Otherwise, this tactic of ours has most likely shown you how we deal with traitors in the Merkingdom.
target: 否则，想必刚才的手段，也已让贵方见识到，人鱼王国是如何处置叛徒的。

source: With a beautiful display of violence... truly admirable.
target: 一场美丽的暴力盛宴……实在令人钦佩。

source: Should we sign these accords? If anything, this has confirmed how essential it is for us to deal with the threat of Heaven.
target: 现在签署协议吧？刚才的事恰好证明，联手应对天堂的威胁，有多么必要。

source: Laudanda shakes hand with the Hell Commanders. Diplomatic documents are signed.
target: 劳丹达与地狱指挥官握手，签下了外交文件。

source: Her Royal Highness pardons you all for your obvious costumes and for the murder of the real merdiplomats thanks to your crucial role in this negotiation.
target: 你们在谈判中起了关键作用，殿下赦免了你们那些一眼就能看穿的伪装，还有杀害真正人鱼外交官的罪行。

source: She pays you +5 MONEY and even mentions she'd be pleased to welcome you in the Merkingdom if you were to visit. Hooray!
target: 她付给你 +5 金钱，还说若你们来人鱼王国，一定热烈欢迎。好耶！

source: Thanks to your MAGIC prowess, you can amp up your ventriloquism skills.
target: 凭着出色的魔力，你的腹语功夫更上一层楼。

source: You project your voice as if it's a deep voice coming from nowhere... maybe from Above?!
target: 你将声音投射出去，听起来像一阵不知从何而来的低沉嗓音……也许，是来自天上？！

source: STOP THIS NOW.
target: 立刻住手。

source: Who was that?
target: 那是谁?

source: IT'S ME: GOD.
target: 是我：上帝。

source: GOOOOOD!
You're not God.
target: 你不是上帝。

source: I AM! BOW TO ME, PUNY ANGEL.
target: 我就是！渺小的天使，跪拜我！

source: (Eh... is it God?)
target: （呃……真是上帝？）

source: (No, it clearly isn't.)
target: (不,显然不是。)

source: I AM GOD.
target: 是我：上帝。

source: Look, it's that one there.
target: 看，就是那个人。

source: NO, IT'S ME, GOD.
target: 不，是我，上帝。

source: Yes, you can clearly tell the voice is coming from them.
target: 对，明明就是那个人在说话。

source: NO YOU CAN'T! IT'S NOT ME, IT'S GOD!
target: 才不是！不是我说的，是上帝！

source: Now you're not even trying.
target: 都懒得装了是吧。

source: SHUT UP!
target: 闭嘴!

source: They stab you.
target: 他们捅了你。

source: Laudanda uses your stabbing as a distraction to allow the Merkingdom soldiers to valiantly overwhelm the angels.
target: 趁你挨捅、吸引了注意力，劳丹达指挥人鱼王国士兵勇猛出击，压倒了天使。

source: The day has been saved!
target: 危机解除！

source: But not by your dumb idea. If it was up to you, everyone would be murdered by now.
target: 可不是靠你的蠢主意。真听你的，大家早被杀光了。

source: You're a disgrace. Leave this meeting immediately.
target: 真丢脸。立刻离开会场。

source: And do it in shame.
target: 带着羞愧离开。

source: Sigh...
You lose -3 HYPE for leaving... in shame.
target: 你因为……灰溜溜地离场，失去了 -3 热度。

source: Heya, you just reached a high amount of MAGIC. Good for you!
target: 嘿，你的魔力已经攒得很高了。不错嘛！

source: Does that mean you're aiming for... the MAGIC-BASED DESTINATION?
target: 这么说，你的目标是……以魔力为条件的目的地？

source: If so, there's a wacky adventure that could unlock a layer for that DESTINATION... wanna go for it?
target: 要是这样，有场荒唐冒险能解锁这个目的地的额外内容……要试试吗？

source: Duh!
target: 废话！

source: No way!
target: 才不要！

source: Great! The adventure will be waiting for you on the road.
target: 太好了！这场冒险会在路上等着你。

source: Sorry for breaking the 4th wall... see ya!
target: 抱歉，打破第四面墙了……回见！

source: Gotcha, I just wanted to check. Sorry for breaking the 4th wall!
target: 明白，我就问问。抱歉，打破第四面墙了！

source: You're driving along when you pass your friend Dahlia fleeing a burning castle on a chariot pulled by a griffin and holding overflowing bags of gold coins.
target: 开车途中，你们路过一座燃烧的城堡，正好看见朋友达丽雅坐着狮鹫拉的战车逃出来，手里还抱着几袋满得往外溢的金币。

source: Hi Dahlia! What're you up to?
target: 嗨，达丽雅！干什么呢？

source: Hey! Just another siege gone right; I won't bore you with the details. I'd much rather hear about the wacky misadventures you guys have been going on!
target: 嘿！又打赢了一场攻城战，细节就不说了，省得你们听腻。我更想听听，你们又碰上什么稀奇古怪的倒霉事了！

source: Right now we're on our way to a pocket-dimension filled with magic and mayhem!
target: 我们正要去一个袖珍维度，里面全是魔法和乱七八糟的事！

source: Actually, do you wanna come with us? I've heard this place is most fun to visit when you have an "adventuring party."
target: 要不一起来？听说去那儿玩，最好先组个“冒险小队”。

source: I'm intrigued! A magical realm full of riches to pillage and beasties to defeat sounds exactly like my scene.
target: 有意思！魔法世界，遍地财宝等着抢，还有怪兽等着打，太适合我了。

source: Are you guys sure you're prepared for an adventure, though?
target: 不过，你们真做好冒险的准备了吗？

source: I know books and movies made the idea of a plucky band of idiots going on a heroic journey seem really easy, but this is real life we're talking about!
target: 书和电影把一群有胆无脑的家伙，踏上英雄之旅的事说得很轻松，可这回是真生活！

source: You're heading into the unknown, where death could be waiting for you around every corner. You gotta prepare for anything!
target: 你们要去的可是未知世界，拐个弯就可能碰上死神。什么情况都得准备好！

source: I hear you. What do you think we should bring on the adventure, then?
target: 明白。那你觉得，我们该带点什么？

source: Don't ask me! Those sorts of questions are what war advisors are for. I'm a general; a woman of action!
target: 别问我！这种问题，问军事顾问去。我是将军，负责行动的女人！

source: Well, the closest thing we've got to an advisor is %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, so... what'cha got, boo?
target: 我们这儿最接近顾问的，就是%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%了。所以……宝贝，你有主意吗？

source: Summon a powerful creature that's the true heir to the dinosaurs, source of endless eggs, and -- according to old wives' tales -- the true source of chicken nuggies!
target: 召唤强大的生物：恐龙的真正继承者、取之不尽的鸡蛋之源——据民间传说，还是鸡块的真正原料！

source: Since you don't know what they use as currency in this other reality, you must acquire the only thing that holds value everywhere: porn.
target: 不知道那边的世界用什么货币，就得准备一种走到哪儿都值钱的东西：色情片。

source: You exert -N2 MAGIC to cast the summoning spell, and from the magic cloud you created, out walks...
target: 你消耗 -N2 魔力，施展召唤术。你造出的魔法云雾里，走出来一只……

source: A chicken? What the hell?!
target: 鸡？搞什么鬼？！

source: Aww, I like her! She's cute and poofy, and she can give us eggs to feed us on our adventure!
target: 哇，我喜欢她！毛蓬蓬的，好可爱，还能下蛋，让我们冒险时有东西吃！

source: I guess... but is this puny bird really the secret ingredient to chicken nuggies?
target: 也是……可这小不点，真是鸡块的秘密原料？

source: Yup. Think about it: sometimes chicken nuggies are dinosaur-shaped. It must be a reference to the chicken's dino ancestors!
target: 对啊。想想看，有的鸡块会做成恐龙形状，肯定就是在致敬鸡的恐龙祖先！

source: Interesting theory...
target: 有趣的理论...

source: Let's test it.
target: 试试看。

source: The chicken lets out a terrified "SQUAWK!" and lays an egg.
target: 鸡吓得“咯——！”一声，立刻下了个蛋。

source: Look! Our investment is already paying off! Let's eat!
target: 看，投资已经有回报了！开饭！

source: Hooray! You all work together to make a delicious omelette and eat it as a group, gaining +N2 STAMINA.
target: 好耶！你们齐心协力，做了份美味的煎蛋卷，分着吃掉，获得了 +N2 体力。

source: Okay, I admit, this feathery endless food machine will be pretty helpful on our adventure. I accept it as a member of our squad!
target: 行，我承认，这台长毛的无限食物机，在冒险中肯定很有用。我准许她加入队伍！

source: In fact... could I maybe... keep the chicken for now? It'd make a cute mascot for my chariot.
target: 其实……能不能……先让我养着这只鸡？给我的战车当吉祥物，多可爱。

source: Sure! Just remember to give her back later, and/or save some nuggies for us!
target: 行啊！之后记得还来，或者至少给我们留点鸡块！

source: You leave Dahlia with her new friend and continue on your journey. Hopefully you'll meet up with them later in the adventuring realm!
target: 你们告别达丽雅和她的新朋友，继续上路。希望之后，能在冒险世界再碰见她们！

source: Fuck yeah, I'm in. Momma looooves porn.
target: 太他妈好了，算我一个。老娘最爱色情片了。

source: But isn't porn notorious for spreading misinformation and giving consumers unhealthy expectations about natural intercourse?
target: 可色情片不是会传播错误信息，让观众对真实的性爱产生不健康的期待吗？

source: Whoa, Scott... that was deep.
target: 哇，斯科特……好深刻。

source: Thanks! Liam said those words to me once! I don't know what they all mean, but I knew it was a good point.
target: 谢谢！李姆以前对我说过这段话！我也不全懂，可知道他说得有道理。

source: But porn can't be THAT bad, can it? If it's so bad, why does it make me feel so good?
target: 可色情片没那么坏吧？真那么坏，怎么会让我这么爽？

source: Like anything else, porn is fine as long as you consume it responsibly and critically.
target: 跟其他东西一样，只要理性、有分寸地看，色情片也没问题。

source: Besides, it can be informative! Not about realistic sex, but it has lots of info about nice butts. Just look at this porn star's butt, it's VERY educational.
target: 再说，还挺长知识！学不到真实的性爱，但能学到不少关于漂亮屁股的知识。看看这位色情明星的屁股，教育意义可大了。

source: Wow! Such taut, turgent buttocks! This is indeed a high-quality butt.
target: 哇，这臀部，紧实又饱满！确实是个好屁股。

source: You and your friends gain +N2 HYPE drooling over such a magnificent ass.
target: 你和朋友们对着如此壮观的美臀流口水，获得了 +N2 热度。

source: You know, it occurs to me that the people in this pocket dimension might not find these forms sexually appealing...
target: 不过，我忽然想到，那些袖珍维度的居民，不一定对这种身体感兴趣……

source: ...and if that highly-likely scenario happens, we should just keep the porn. Like, all of it.
target: ……真要碰上这种很可能发生的情况，那些色情片，咱们就自己留着。全留着。

source: Hard agree. This is why you're a great general, Dahlia: you always make the right decisions.
target: 完全同意。达丽雅，你能当好将军，就是因为你总能做出正确决定。

source: You spend -N2 MONEY on more dirty magazines to trade in the pocket dimension. Hopefully nobody will mind if they're slightly used, wink!
target: 你花了 -N2 金钱，买了更多色情杂志，准备带去袖珍维度换东西。希望没人介意，它们被稍微“用过”一点点，眨眼！

source: As you're driving, you pass a familiar computer boy walking around with a strange device in his hands.
target: 你们开车路过，发现熟悉的电脑男孩，手里拿着一个奇怪的装置，四处走动。

source: Hey, Calculester! What'cha got there? Some kinda hi-tech football?
target: 嘿，计算斯基！拿的什么？高科技橄榄球？

source: Hello, Friend Scott! This is actually a device I invented to detect weak spots in the edges of our dimension where we might be able to cross into others.
target: 斯科特朋友，你好！这是我发明的装置，能探测我们维度边缘的薄弱之处，让我们有机会穿越到别的维度。

source: Friend Joy has alluded to me that there are other pocket dimensions clinging to the edges of our own... places which defy all science and logic.
target: 乔伊朋友曾透露，我们维度的边缘，还依附着其他袖珍维度……那些地方，违背一切科学与逻辑。

source: These realms are surely impossible, but if I found one, think of the strange plants that likely grow there! I could study them!
target: 这样的世界，理应不可能存在。可要真能找到，想想那里会长出什么奇异植物！我就能研究它们了！

source: Then today's your lucky day, Cal. We're following this map to a magical pocket dimension right now!
target: 那你今天走运了，卡尔。我们正照着地图，去一个充满魔法的袖珍维度呢！

source: <ERROR: HOLY SHIT WHAT>
target: <错误：我靠，什么情况>

source: Do you wanna come with us, bro? You can do your science while we go on an adventure!
target: 一起去吗，兄弟？我们冒险，你做科学研究！

source: If you have a map to the dimension, I would be foolish not to accept your offer! But I must ask... will this be a safe adventure?
target: 既然你们有地图，我若不接受邀请，就太愚蠢了！不过，我必须问……这趟冒险安全吗？

source: Uhh, sure, tooootally.
target: 呃，当然，安——全——得很。

source: We've got %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% in charge of safety, and %HESHE% knows all the safety rules of interdimensional travel, don't you boo?
target: 安全由%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%负责，%HESHE%懂跨次元旅行的所有安全规则。是吧，宝贝？

source: You absolutely do not, but you'd better put Cal at ease by pretending you do.
target: 你懂个鬼。不过，最好还是装作很懂，让卡尔放心。

source: You decide to tell him (AKA make up) the #1 rule of interdimensional travel, which is...
target: 你决定告诉他——其实是现编——跨次元旅行的头号守则，那就是……

source: Do not alter the course of that reality's timeline by introducing them to Shrek.
target: 别向当地居民介绍《怪物史莱克》，以免改变那个现实的时间线。

source: Never ever fall in love!
target: 千万，千万不能爱上任何人！

source: Wait, really? I knew Shrek was one of the greatest films ever made, but is it that big of an interdimensional deal?
target: 等等，真的？我知道《怪物史莱克》是影史最佳电影之一，可在跨次元层面，也有这么重要？

source: Yes. Shrek plays a surprisingly large role in the course of history and societal norms.
target: 是的。《怪物史莱克》对历史进程和社会规范的影响，比想象中大得多。

source: For example, did you know that our timeline wasn't even meant to have a Shrek franchise?
target: 比如，你知道吗，我们这条时间线，本来根本不该有史莱克系列。

source: NO WAY! I can't imagine life without Shrek!
target: 不会吧！我没法想象，没有史莱克的日子！

source: And yet such a life was almost our destiny, until an interdimensional traveler brought a DVD copy of Shrek 2 into our realm.
target: 然而，那几乎就是我们的命运。直到一位跨次元旅行者，带了一张《怪物史莱克 2》的 DVD 来到我们世界。

source: This threw the monster realm into a frenzy, and diehard Shrek fans worked tirelessly to reverse-engineer what the original Shrek must have been about.
target: 整个怪物世界陷入狂热，死忠粉不眠不休，靠逆向推导，还原第一部史莱克本该是什么样。

source: At first, it was a beautiful collective effort to capture the magic of the original film...
target: 最初，大家齐心协力，只是想重现原作的魅力，那场面十分美好……

source: But the taste of success was addictive. The Shrek internet hivemind became drunk with power, and continued making Shrek sequels ad nauseum.
target: 可成功令人上瘾。史莱克的网络粉丝群体，被力量冲昏头脑，不停制作续集，令人不胜其烦。

source: To date, there are over sixty films in the Shrek cinematic universe, with no signs of stopping!
target: 至今，史莱克电影宇宙已有六十多部作品，仍没有停下来的迹象！

source: Some theorize that there is a limit to how many iterations of Shrek can exist in a liminal space...
target: 有人提出理论：在同一个阈限空间里，史莱克的版本数量，存在一个上限……

source: ...meaning that with every mediocre Shrek sequel we create, we bring our world one step closer to total entropy and chaos!
target: ……也就是说，每多拍一部平庸的史莱克续集，我们的世界就离彻底的熵增与混乱更近一步！

source: Shit... how do you know so much about this, Calculester?
target: 靠……计算斯基，你怎么懂这么多？

source: I am inextricably connected to the internet at all times. I know more about Shrek than I ever wanted to know.
target: 我始终与互联网相连。我掌握的史莱克知识，比我想知道的还多。

source: You lose -N2 HYPE knowing you must withhold your passion for Shrek on this adventure, but at least you gained +N2 MIND learning that deep Shrek lore!
target: 想到这趟冒险必须收起对史莱克的热爱，你失去了 -N2 热度。不过，学到这么深的史莱克设定，至少让你获得了 +N2 头脑！

source: Ah, yes, that is a good rule! I commend your commitment to safety even in the face of raw emotional passion, Friend %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 没错，好规则！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%朋友，即便面临强烈的情感冲动，你依然坚守安全，我深表赞赏。

source: What? But love is the purest, most magical force in the universe!
target: 什么？可是，爱是宇宙中最纯粹、最神奇的力量！

source: Which is exactly why we must avoid it when we are traversing other universes, Friend Scott.
target: 斯科特朋友，正因如此，穿越其他宇宙时，才必须避开它。

source: No! Love is fun, and worth the risk! If I see a cute nymph or a sexy centaur in the pocket realm, I can't promise I won't try to smash!
target: 不行！爱情多有意思，值得冒险！万一在那儿看见可爱的宁芙，或性感的半人马，我可不保证自己不会想跟人家来一发！

source: I understand that organic beings struggle to separate logic from emotion, so I will try to express the importance of this rule in a way you will understand.
target: 我理解，有机生物很难将逻辑和情感分开。所以，我会用你们听得懂的方式，说明这条规则的重要性。

source: Cal downloads a voice-changing module and puts some sock puppets on his hands.
target: 卡尔下载了变声模块，在双手上套起袜子手偶。

source: NOW PRESENTING: "A Pathos-Filled PSA on the Dangers of Interdimensional Love [Passes Bechdel Test Edition]"
target: 现在上演：《跨次元恋爱危害催泪公益短剧[通过贝克德尔测试版]》

source: SETTING: Spooky Interdimensional Academy. CHARACTERS: Angela, a good girl with straight A's; Evelyn, who wears leather pants and does not play by the rules.
target: 场景：惊悚跨次元学院。人物：安吉拉，全科 A 的乖乖女；伊芙琳，穿皮裤、不守规矩。

source: ANGELA: "Evelyn, I will do this school project with you, but you must promise not to fall in love with me."
target: 安吉拉：“伊芙琳，我可以跟你一起做这份学校作业，不过，你必须保证，不会爱上我。”

source: EVELYN: "Angela, you know I do not play by the rules. I am in love with you."
target: 伊芙琳：“安吉拉，你知道，我从来不守规矩。我爱上你了。”

source: ANGELA: "Oh Evelyn, I am in love with you too. But we are not meant to be, for I am from a different timeline, and now I must return home. Farewell."
target: 安吉拉：“哦，伊芙琳，我也爱你。可是，我们注定不能在一起。我来自另一条时间线，现在必须回家了。再见。”

source: And so Angela and Evelyn parted ways, and both turned to drug abuse and risky behaviors to cope, and they died early and in immense pain. THE END.
target: 于是，安吉拉和伊芙琳分道扬镳，双双靠滥用药物和危险行为排遣痛苦，最后早早死去，死得极其痛苦。全剧终。

source: Fuck... talk about a bummer ending.
target: 妈的……这结局也太扫兴了。

source: Nooo! It's so sad! Why does the love between interdimensional sock-puppet girls have to be forbidden?
target: 不——！太伤心了！跨次元袜子偶女孩的爱情，为什么非得遭到禁止？

source: You lose -N2 MAGIC for eschewing the magic of romance. At least you gain +N2 SOUL for making that sacrifice!
target: 放弃浪漫的魔法，让你失去了 -N2 魔力。至少，因为这份牺牲，你又获得了 +N2 灵魂！

source: PREVIOUSLY ON: "THE COVEN" (Now streaming exclusively on BTFLGlitchflix!)
target: 《女巫会》前情提要：（现于 BTFLGlitchflix 独家上线！）

source: You've broken my heart, you merciless witch! We're through, and I'll NEVER help you with anything again!
target: 无情的女巫，你伤透了我的心！我们完了，我再也不会帮你任何忙！

source: Nu is definitely up to something. I sense a disquiet in the universe... and since we're near the season finale, it makes sense for one of our Big Bads to pull some shit.
target: 努肯定在谋划什么。宇宙里有股不安的气息……而且这季快大结局了，哪个大反派出来搞点事，也很合理。

source: Then it looks like I need to figure out what he's doing and stop him. I just need some intel...
target: 看来，我得查清他想干什么，再阻止他。只差一点情报……

source: All the clues are pointing to this bar... and meeting shady characters at dive bars is a tried-and-true trope. This must be where I'll find answers.
target: 所有线索都指向这家酒吧……在破酒馆遇见可疑人物，可是屡试不爽的套路。答案肯定就在这里。

source: We open at the Midnight Cantina, a popular bar for villains, knaves, and ne'er-do-wells... and occasionally, the heroes that hunt them.
target: 开场，午夜小酒馆。反派、无赖和恶棍们常来光顾……偶尔，也会有追捕他们的英雄。

source: Hello, barkeep. Tell me, have you seen any shady characters here lately?
target: 酒保，你好。最近有没有看见可疑人物？

source: "Everyone who drinks here is shady, toots," says the bartender. "I guess you could start with the weird ghost and werewolf doing shots over there."
target: “来这儿喝酒的，谁不可疑啊，姑娘，”酒保说，“先看看那边拼小杯酒的古怪幽灵和狼人吧。”

source: Wait... a ghost and a werewolf... no, please, it can't be--
target: 等等……幽灵和狼人……拜托，不会是——

source: Hey, it's Joy! How's it going, bro? Wanna watch me take this tequila shot with my nose?
target: 嘿，乔伊！最近怎么样，兄弟？想看我用鼻子灌这杯龙舌兰吗？

source: Actually, it's good we ran into you. We're on our way to a magic pocket-dimension, and magic's sorta your thing, yeah? You should come with us!
target: 来得正好！我们要去一个魔法袖珍维度，魔法不是你的专长吗？一起吧！

source: Ugh, I know what dimension you're talking about, and I am NOT going there. Not after what happened last time...
target: 唉，我知道你们说的是哪个维度，我不去。尤其是上次出了那事以后……

source: Wait, what happened last time? Did I miss that part of the "Previously On" section?
target: 等等，上次出了什么事？“前情提要”漏看一段了？

source: Just then, a man in a dark cloak shows up. "Gimme a whiskey," he says to the bartender. "Make it quick. I don't have much time before Lord Nu needs me to return."
target: 这时，一个黑斗篷男人出现了。“来杯威士忌，”他对酒保说，“快点，努大人很快就要我回去了。”

source: Hold up, are you one of Nu's henchmen? You have to tell me what he's up to!
target: 等等，你是努的手下？告诉我，他在打什么主意！

source: "Tch! You're wasting your time, hero; I'll never tell you the details of Lord Nu's big plot that's taking place next week at--"
target: “啧！英雄，别白费劲。我绝不告诉你努大人那场大阴谋的细节，下周就在——”

source: ACHOO! AHHH, IT BURNS! I forgot how hard it is to take shots with your nose.
target: 阿嚏！啊啊，辣死了！都忘了，用鼻子喝烈酒有多难。

source: It's okay bud, you'll get it next time. Try taking this next one with your ear!
target: 没事，哥们儿，下次就行了。这杯试试用耳朵喝！

source: Stop it, both of you! Your stupid antics are ruining the gritty urban-fantasy vibe of this interrogation!
target: 你们俩别闹了！这场审讯本来该有阴暗都市奇幻的氛围，全让你们的蠢把戏毁了！

source: It's obvious Joy isn't gonna relax until she finishes her saving-the-world bullshit, so maybe you should speed this along by getting this guy to spill the beans!
target: 看来，不忙完拯救世界那堆破事，乔伊是不会放松了。不如加快进度，让这家伙把秘密像倒豆子一样倒出来！

source: If he's not spilling the beans, you may need to do it for him: FLIP THE TABLE TO SPILL THE BEANS HE'S EATING!
target: 他不肯倒豆子，就替他倒：掀翻桌子，把他正在吃的豆子洒出来！

source: Waterboarding might be too much even for you, so what about... SNOWBOARDING?!
target: 水刑也许连你都觉得太过了，那就……“雪刑”，让他滑单板？！

source: What? "Spill the beans" is just an idiom, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, not a literal--
target: 什么？“倒豆子”是说把话全讲出来，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，不是让你真的——

source: TOO MUCH TALKING, NOT ENOUGH TABLE-FLIPPING!
target: 别光说话了，快掀桌！

source: You, Polly, and Scott flip the table. The shady guy's beans fly everywhere.
target: 你、波莉和斯科特一起掀翻桌子，那可疑家伙的豆子飞得到处都是。

source: "NOOOO, MY BEANS!" he cries. "How could you?! My daily beans are the one thing I get to look forward to in this world!"
target: “不——我的豆子！”他惨叫，“你们怎么能这样！每天吃点豆子，是我在这世上唯一的盼头！”

source: "My life of crime, dodging heroes and death at every corner... the only thing that made it worth it were those delicious legumes, and now they're ruined!"
target: “干这行，时时都得躲英雄、躲死亡……全靠这些美味豆子，我才觉得值得。现在，全毁了！”

source: YOU GOT THAT RIGHT, MOTHERFUCKER. AND IF YOU DON'T START SPILLING THE BEANS NOW, WE'RE GONNA SPILL *YOUR* BEANS FOREVER!
target: 没错，混蛋！再不把秘密全倒出来，你的豆子，这辈子就都得倒在地上！

source: Every night when you open your beloved beans, thinking you're safe, we'll be there, and we're gonna dump your beans ALL OVER THE FLOOR.
target: 每晚打开你心爱的豆子，以为终于安全了，我们都会出现，把它们全倒在地板上。

source: "YOU WOULDN'T!"
target: “你不敢！”

source: OF COURSE I WOULD! LOOK AT ME. LOOK INTO MY EYES. I'M FUCKIN' CRAZY.
target: 我当然敢！看着我，看着我的眼睛。老娘他妈就是个疯子。

source: "UGH, FINE! You wanna know Lord Nu's plans so bad? Ask Gerard the Necromancer!"
target: “烦死了，行！就这么想知道努大人的计划？找死灵法师杰拉德去！”

source: Wait, Gerard? How did he get caught up in this?
target: 等等，杰拉德？他怎么卷进来的？

source: Who knows; who cares? We got the guy to spill the dumb secret. Now you're free to come to the pocket dimension with us!
target: 谁知道，谁管他。反正秘密问出来了。现在能跟我们去袖珍维度了吧！

source: No! A hero's work is never done! And even if it were, I already told you I'm not going!
target: 不！英雄的工作永远做不完！就算做完了，我也说过，我不去！

source: You'll just see about that!
target: 那就走着瞧吧！

source: You try to flip the table, but alas, it's too heavy. All you can do is pull on the corner and strain.
target: 你想掀桌子，可惜太重了。只好拽住桌角，拼命使劲。

source: Uhhh, what's wrong with %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?
target: 呃，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%怎么了？

source: Besides the usual? Dunno, but %HISHER% face looks weird for sure. Maybe %HESHE%%VERB_'S_'RE% holding in a fart?
target: 你说，除了平常那点毛病？不知道，反正%HISHER%表情怪怪的。也许%HESHE%%VERB_'S_'RE%在憋屁？
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): KEEP; 玩家搬桌子使劲被误认为憋屁；在憋屁已表达进行体。 按行中文动词展开已实现；未实机验证。

source: If you gotta fart, bro, it's okay. It's a natural part of the body!
target: 想放就放吧，兄弟。正常的生理现象嘛！

source: Hmm, maybe it's supposed to be a threat?
target: 可能这是个威胁?

source: HEY ASSHOLE, YOU'D BETTER TELL JOY YOUR DUMB PLAN, OR %CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%'S GONNA FART REAL LOUD!
target: 嘿，混蛋，最好把你的蠢计划告诉乔伊，不然%CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%就要放个超级响的屁了！

source: "Okay... so what? That's not intimidating, it's just gross."
target: “哦……那又怎样？这不叫吓人，只叫恶心。”

source: Eh, fair enough. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% definitely doesn't look intimidating right now. What is that face even supposed to be, boo?
target: 也是。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%现在确实不吓人。宝贝，这到底什么表情？

source: It's the face of someone who just herniated a disk and fucked up an interrogation. You lose -3 STAMINA.
target: 一个刚把椎间盘使突出、又搞砸审讯的人的表情。你失去了 -3 体力。

source: Yeah, you heard my friend! Tell us what you know, or we'll force you to snowboard, bub!
target: 对，听见没有！把知道的都说出来，不然就逼你滑单板，老兄！

source: No, Scott, other way around. He needs to tell us what he knows or he WON'T get to snowboard.
target: 不，斯科特，反了。不说实话，就不让他滑单板。

source: Ohhhh, yeah, that makes a lot more sense.
target: 哦——对，这才说得通。

source: No it doesn't. Seriously, snowboarding? There's no way a hardened criminal would agree to snowboarding in exchange for valuable intel.
target: 一点都不通。认真的，滑单板？哪个穷凶极恶的罪犯，会为了滑雪，把重要情报卖掉？

source: Smash cut to a ski resort where you, your friends, and the hardened criminal just had an amazing snowboarding trip!
target: 镜头猛地切到滑雪场。你、朋友们，还有那个穷凶极恶的罪犯，刚爽玩了一场单板滑雪！

source: "This was so fun! Thanks for inviting me. I'll always cherish this amazing day on the slopes."
target: “太好玩了！谢谢你们邀请我。雪道上这美好的一天，我会永远记得。”

source: Same here! Now we're snowboarding bros for life!
target: 我也是！一辈子的滑雪好兄弟！

source: Yup! And you know, all the best snowboarding bros tell each other their deepest secrets -- like what your boss is planning!
target: 对啊！最好的滑雪兄弟，都得分享心底最深的秘密——比如，你老板的计划！

source: "Hmmm, that could get me killed... but you're right, snowboard bros come first! If you wanna know more about Lord Nu's plans, ask Gerard the Necromancer."
target: “嗯，说出来可能被杀……不过你们说得对，滑雪兄弟最重要！想知道努大人的计划，就找死灵法师杰拉德。”

source: Thanks! See, Joy? We told you snowboarding would get him to talk!
target: 谢谢！看吧，乔伊，都说滑单板能让他开口了！

source: ...Shut up.
I can't believe Gerard is caught up in this somehow. What did that dumbass do now?
target: 没想到，杰拉德竟然也牵扯进来了。那蠢货这次又干什么了？

source: Who knows; who cares? We got the guy to spill the dumb secret. Now you're free to come to the pocket dimension with us!
target: 谁知道，谁管他。反正秘密问出来了。现在能跟我们去袖珍维度了吧！

source: No! A hero's work is never done! And even if it were, I already told you I'm not going!
target: 不！英雄的工作永远做不完！就算做完了，我也说过，我不去！

source: You'll just see about that!
target: 那就走着瞧吧！

source: "You're threatening to torture me with... snowboarding?"
target: “你们想拿……滑雪来折磨我？”

source: No, I'm threatening to TREAT you to snowboarding! Snowboarding is cool!
target: 不，是威胁要请你滑雪！单板滑雪，多酷啊！

source: "...Is it, though?"
It is if you're really into it!
target: 喜欢的话，就很酷啊！

source: "Okay, but I'm not."
target: “行，可我不喜欢。”

source: But maybe you will be. Don't knock it 'til you try it!
target: 没准试试就喜欢了。都没试过，别急着否定嘛！

source: "That's fair, but consider: if I tell you guys about Lord Nu's plot, he'll definitely kill me. I'm not going to risk my life over a hobby I don't even have."
target: “有道理，可问题是，把努大人的阴谋告诉你们，他肯定会杀我。我可不想为一个自己都没养成的爱好，冒生命危险。”

source: Damn, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, this was a really dumb idea in retrospect.
target: 靠，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，现在回头看，这主意真够蠢的。

source: In RETROSPECT?! It was a dumb idea from the start! Just get out of here, all of you!
target: 现在回头看？！从一开始就很蠢！你们全都给我滚！

source: Sigh... why does nobody properly appreciate the magic of snowboarding? You lose -3 HYPE.
target: 唉……为什么就没人懂得欣赏单板滑雪的魔力？你失去了 -3 热度。

source: After a short commercial break, we find our intrepid, often-irritated protagonist standing outside her evil ex's lair.
target: 一小段广告过后，镜头回到我们无所畏惧、又经常被惹恼的主角。她正站在邪恶前男友的巢穴外。

source: Okay... you can do this, Joy. If the whole world's at stake, Gerard will HAVE to agree to help you, right?
target: 好……你能行的，乔伊。全世界都危在旦夕，杰拉德总该肯帮忙了吧？

source: Ten minutes of begging later...
target: 苦苦恳求十分钟后……

source: No.
target: 不。

source: Come on, Gerard, at least think about it! I know we've had our issues, but--
target: 拜托，杰拉德，至少考虑一下！我知道，我们之间有些问题，可——

source: Our "ISSUES"?! YOU CHEATED ON ME, YOU HEARTLESS HARLOT! And I told you I'd NEVER help you with anything again! It was even in the "Previously On"!
target: “有些问题”？！你出轨了，无情的贱人！我说过，再也不会帮你任何忙！连“前情提要”里都有！

source: But this is bigger than you and me! This is the FATE OF THE WORLD! The world you live in, might I add!
target: 可这不是你我之间的事，是全世界的命运！提醒一句，你也活在这个世界里！

source: Tch, this is so typical. You only ever come around when you need something.
target: 啧，一贯如此。只有要东西的时候，你才来找我。

source: I don't come around any other time because you made it explicitly clear you never wanted to see me again!
target: 其他时候不来，是因为你明明白白说过，再也不想见到我！

source: Heyyy, Joy! Is now a bad time? No? Cool. You comin' to the magic dimension with us or what?
target: 嘿，乔伊！来得不是时候？没有？太好了。到底跟不跟我们去魔法维度？

source: Are you serious? You couldn't have come at a WORSE time!
target: 认真的？你们简直专挑最糟的时候来！

source: It's never a good time for you, is it Joy? Everyone has to abide by your fucking schedule.
target: 对你来说，就没有合适的时候，是吧，乔伊？全世界都得配合你他妈的日程表。

source: Look, you told me to think about it; well, I did, and I don't want to feel a thing anymore.
target: 你让我考虑，好，我考虑了：我再也不想有任何感觉。

source: I'm tired of begging for the things that I want, which is for you to leave. So get lost.
target: 我已经受够了，为自己的愿望苦苦哀求。我的愿望就是你走，所以滚吧。

source: Damn, if Joy can't get Gerard to help her save the world, she's gonna be super cranky. You'd better help these two reach a compromise!
target: 靠，杰拉德不帮忙救世界，乔伊肯定又要暴躁。最好帮他俩找个折中办法！

source: "Gerard, teaming up with unbearable, betrayal-ready, evil ex Joy will give you unlimited fuel to complain-brag about how miserable your life is! Think about it!"
target: “杰拉德，跟难以忍受、随时背叛、邪恶的前任乔伊组队，你就有无穷的素材，边抱怨边炫耀自己多惨！想想吧！”

source: "Gerard, hear us out: if you team up with Joy, we will treat you to what's bound to be your next hobby/fixation: SNOWBOARDIIIIIING!"
target: “杰拉德，听我说！只要跟乔伊组队，就请你体验注定让你痴迷的新爱好：单——板——滑——雪！”

source: Hmm... that's true. Teaming up with Joy would make me pretty miserable.
target: 嗯，有道理。跟乔伊组队，确实能让我很惨。

source: Hey!
target: 嘿

source: Totes. Joy kinda sucks, right?
target: 对啊，乔伊是挺烂，对吧？

source: HEY!
target: 喂！

source: I bet spending time with her will give you oodles of emo cred and inspire lots of sad poems!
target: 跟她待着，你的忧郁人设肯定更深入人心，还能写出一大堆悲伤的诗！

source: True. I was finally beginning to feel the tender touch of happiness on my tortured soul, which is terrible for my poetry. This could rectify that.
target: 确实。我饱受折磨的灵魂，好不容易开始感受到幸福的温柔抚摸，对写诗简直是灾难。这办法能纠正过来。

source: Whatever. Does this mean you'll help me stop Nu?
target: 随便。所以，你肯帮我阻止努了？

source: Tch, fine... Nu's building some kind of death ray to shatter the planet or whatever.
target: 啧，行吧……努在造什么死亡射线，要把星球轰碎，差不多吧。

source: He came to me a few days ago asking for a necromancy spell powerful enough to resurrect the planet afterwards and "rebuild it in his image."
target: 几天前他找我，想要个强大的死灵法术，把星球复活，再“按他的模样重建”。

source: And you gave it to him?!
target: 你就给他了？！

source: Yes. I figured it'd fuck you over specifically.
target: 对。我觉得，这样能专门坑到你。

source: Thanks for that. Did you ever consider that helping Nu destroy the planet might fuck YOU over too?
target: 那可谢谢你了。帮努毁掉星球的时候，没想过也会坑到你自己吗？

source: Don't get shitty with me! You just love tormenting me, don't you Joy? WHEN WILL IT BE ENOUGH FOR YOU?!
target: 别给我甩脸色！你就是喜欢折磨我，对吧，乔伊？你到底要怎样才会满足？！

source: This is going well!
target: 进展顺利!

source: Tch! I don't need Joy for that! I've already got misery enough for hundreds of dark, twisted poems.
target: 啧！那还用得着乔伊？我的苦难，已经够写几百首黑暗扭曲的诗了。

source: Would you like me to share one of them with you?
target: 要听一首吗？

source: No.
target: 不要。

source: I call this one "The Exquisite Agony of a Crowded Subway Car", by Gerard Path.
target: 这首叫《拥挤地铁里的精致苦痛》，作者，杰拉德·帕斯。

source: Several minutes later, the only intel Gerard has given you is the many different ways he can rhyme "train" with "pain". Ugh.
target: 几分钟后，杰拉德给你的唯一情报，就是他能拿“车厢”和“心伤”变着花样押韵。唉。

source: You lose -3 HYPE and -1 POTENTIAL TEAM UP for Joy.
target: 你失去了 -3 热度，乔伊则失去了 -1 次潜在组队机会。

source: Yeah, Gerard, you'd love it! Like, you obviously don't wanna help Joy, which makes sense. She kinda sucks.
target: 是啊，杰拉德，你肯定喜欢！不想帮乔伊，完全能理解，她是挺烂。

source: Hey!
target: 嘿

source: Seriously, I get it. Joy? Yuck. But snowboarding? That's a whole other thing that makes this team-up totally worth it!
target: 说真的，我懂。乔伊？恶心。可滑单板就不一样了，光为了这个，组队都值！

source: THIS IS SO DUMB! Gerard isn't gonna turn over a new leaf thanks to fucking snowboarding!
target: 蠢死了！杰拉德难道会因为他妈的滑雪，就洗心革面？！

source: Smash cut to you, Polly, Scott, and Gerard having a blast snowboarding!
target: 镜头猛地切到你、波莉、斯科特和杰拉德，正滑单板玩得不亦乐乎！

source: I never thought I'd say this, but this has been life-changing. These snowy slopes have somehow melted the ice around my frigid soul!
target: 从没想过，自己会这么说……可这真的改变了人生。皑皑雪坡，竟融化了我冰冷灵魂外的坚冰！

source: WOOOOO! Snowboarding bros for life!
target: 呜——！一辈子的滑雪好兄弟！

source: Fine, fuck it, whatever. We're "snowboarding bros" now. Does that mean you'll help me stop Nu, Gerard?
target: 行，去他的，随便。现在我们是“滑雪好兄弟”了。杰拉德，肯帮我阻止努了吧？

source: Sure. Nu's building some kind of death ray to shatter the planet or whatever.
target: 行。努在造什么死亡射线，要把星球轰碎，差不多吧。

source: He came to me a few days ago asking for a necromancy spell powerful enough to resurrect the planet afterwards and "rebuild it in his image."
target: 几天前他找我，想要个强大的死灵法术，把星球复活，再“按他的模样重建”。

source: And you gave it to him?!
target: 你就给他了？！

source: Yes. I figured it'd fuck you over specifically.
target: 对。我觉得，这样能专门坑到你。

source: Thanks for that. Did you ever consider that helping Nu destroy the planet might fuck YOU over too?
target: 那可谢谢你了。帮努毁掉星球的时候，没想过也会坑到你自己吗？

source: Are you seriously getting shitty with me on the eve of my snowboarding character arc?! WHY MUST YOU RUIN EVERYTHING I LOVE?!
target: 我的滑雪成长篇章才刚开始，你就非得跟我闹？！为什么我爱的东西，你全要毁掉？！

source: This is going well! And it's all thanks to the power of SNOWBOARDIIIIING!
target: 进展顺利！全靠单——板——滑——雪的力量！

source: You want me to join forces with JOY, of all people, just for the promise of snowboarding?
target: 你想让我跟乔伊组队，偏偏是乔伊，就因为你们答应请我滑单板？

source: Yeah! It's snowboarding! It's COOL!
target: 对啊！单板滑雪！超酷的！

source: "Cool"? Tch. A vapid, preppy descriptor for a vapid, pointless activity.
target: “酷”？啧。用肤浅又做作的词，描述肤浅又无意义的活动。

source: Have you ever even snowboarded before? You might really like it!
target: 你以前滑过单板吗？没准真喜欢呢！

source: Couldn't I try it on my own time, without having to also team up with the worst person in the world while I'm at it?
target: 我不能自己抽空试吗？非得同时跟全世界最烂的人组队？

source: HEY!
target: 喂！

source: Erm... yeah, I guess you could.
target: 呃……也是，好像可以。

source: I thought so. This entire shitty plan of yours was built on a foundation of decay.
target: 果然。你们这整个烂计划，根基早就腐朽了。

source: Yeah, in retrospect it was a pretty dumb idea, boo.
target: 是啊，宝贝，回头看，这主意确实挺蠢。

source: Glad we're in agreement. Now can you three get lost already?!
target: 很高兴大家达成共识。现在，你们三个能滚了吗？！

source: Sigh... why does nobody appreciate the magic of snowboarding like you do? You lose -3 HYPE.
target: 唉……怎么就没人跟你一样，懂得单板滑雪的魔力？你失去了 -3 热度。

source: After another commercial break, Gerard and Joy are deep in the throes of battle with Nu! But it's not going well...
target: 又一段广告过后，乔伊和杰拉德正与努激战！可战况不太妙……

source: Give it up, Joy! You and your weepy boy-toy are no match for me. Soon, this world will be shattered, then reglazed and renewed in my image!
target: 放弃吧，乔伊！你和那哭哭啼啼的小白脸，根本不是我的对手。很快，世界就会粉碎，再按我的模样重新上釉、焕然一新！

source: Stay strong, Gerard! We can still defeat him if we work together!
target: 撑住，杰拉德！齐心协力，我们还能赢他！

source: No... just forget it... I can think of no better way to go... than bleeding out... in the arms of the woman I love... to hate...
target: 不……算了……还有什么死法……比在我深爱……深深痛恨的女人怀里……流尽鲜血更好呢……

source: So long and goodnight, Joy... when I get to Hell... I'm gonna write... so many poems... about how much you suck...
target: 永别了，晚安，乔伊……下地狱以后……我要写好多诗……写你有多烂……

source: Gerard? GERARD?! PLEASE, STAY WITH ME! I never got to say that I--!
target: 杰拉德？杰拉德？！求你，撑住！我还没来得及告诉你，我——！

source: Hiii Joy! Sorry, we stepped out to get popcorn for the big fight. Did we miss anything important?
target: 嗨，乔伊！不好意思，为了看大战，我们出去买爆米花了。错过什么重要剧情了吗？

source: So Joy, after you defeat Nu with the magic of friendship or whatever, will you be ready to come to the pocket dimension with us?
target: 乔伊，等你用友情魔法之类的打败努以后，就能跟我们去袖珍维度了吧？

source: HOW DO YOU GUYS KEEP FINDING ME?! Is this a curse? Am I being cosmically punished for something?!
target: 你们怎么每次都找得到我？！是诅咒？宇宙在惩罚我什么吗？！

source: What's going on? Are you pulling that move where you get help from unexpected allies at the last moment? What a pathetic last-ditch effort!
target: 怎么回事？想玩最后关头、意外援军现身的那一套？垂死挣扎，真可悲！

source: Trust me, Nu: Polly, Scott, and %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% aren't my allies, nor will they be any help whatsoever.
target: 信我，努：波莉、斯科特，还有%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，都不是我的盟友，也绝对帮不上任何忙。

source: You'll just see about that! Help Joy defeat Nu once and for all (unless he somehow returns in a contrived plot twist)!
target: 走着瞧！帮乔伊彻底打败努——除非他以后又靠什么牵强的剧情反转，死灰复燃！

source: Pull a literal deus ex machina by renting a mechanical crane and tying Scott to it
target: 租台起重机，把斯科特绑上去，来一场货真价实的“机械降神”。

source: You will never defeat Nu by fighting... you must prey on his pride and challenge him to the only duel you could win... A SNOWBOARDING RACE!
target: 硬打绝对赢不了努……利用他的傲气，挑战唯一可能赢的决斗：单板滑雪赛！

source: Great plan! Soon, you've acquired a crane and tied your favorite hairy himbo to it.
target: 好计划！很快，你弄来一台起重机，把最喜欢的毛茸茸傻大个帅哥绑了上去。

source: It's over, you pathetic excuse for a witch! Perhaps I'll let you live in my "Nu World" if you surrender to me now...
target: 结束了，废物女巫！现在投降，说不定还能让你在我的“Nu 新世界”里活下去……

source: No, I won't give up! I can still defeat you with... with--
target: 不，我不会放弃！我还能打败你，靠……靠——

source: A WEREWOLF TIED TO A HEAVY CRANE?!
target: 一只绑在重型起重机上的狼人？！

source: YES! -- Wait, what?
target: 没错！——等等，什么？

source: COWABUNGAAAAAAA!
target: 卡哇邦嘎——！

source: You drive the crane around, smacking Nu with Scott. Scott may not be a bona fide "god in a machine", but he's an effective blunt weapon!
target: 你开着起重机四处转，把斯科特甩在努身上。斯科特算不上真的“机器里的神”，可当钝器，倒挺好使！

source: UGH! OW! This is painful and annoying! You win this time, Joy, but I'll be back to destroy this pathetic planet some other time!
target: 呃！嗷！又疼又烦！这次算你赢，乔伊。改天，我还会回来毁了这破星球！

source: That really worked? Tch. What a narratively unsatisfying conclusion to our story.
target: 竟然真管用？啧，从叙事角度来说，这结局，真让人不满意。

source: GERARD?! You're okay? I thought you bled out!
target: 杰拉德？！你没事？我以为你流血流死了！

source: Nah, I'm okay. Did I look dramatic... like... in a cool way?
target: 没有，我没事。刚才看起来，够不够戏剧化……那种……很酷的戏剧化？

source: I guess...?
target: 大概……算吧？

source: Ha! We saved you, Joy! Now you HAVE to come to the pocket dimension with us!
target: 哈！乔伊，我们救了你！现在，你必须跟我们去袖珍维度了！

source: I told you, I'm not going there! It's... ugh, it's a dimension my Coven accidentally created in a previous adventure, okay? I'd rather just put the whole thing behind me.
target: 都说了我不去！那是……唉，是我们女巫会以前冒险时，不小心创造出来的维度，行了吧？我只想把那件事忘了。

source: Of course you would. Typical Joy, throwing away her old toys.
target: 那当然。典型的乔伊，玩腻了，就把旧玩具扔掉。

source: You call yourself a hero, walking around "saving" the world, then you turn a blind eye to the destruction you leave in your wake!
target: 自称英雄，满世界“拯救”别人，却对自己身后留下的烂摊子视而不见！

source: Oh, no... I do do that, don't I?
target: 糟了……我还真干过这种“事”，对吧？

source: Haha! Joy said "doo doo".
target: 哈哈！乔伊说“屎”。

source: I guess I should check on that dimension... Polly, Scott, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%: if you're going there, I suppose I'll join you.
target: 看来，真该看看那个维度怎么样了……波莉、斯科特、%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你们要去的话，我就一起吧。

source: Hooray, you teamed up with Joy and managed to save the world along the way! You gain +5 MAGIC.
target: 好耶，跟乔伊组上队了，还顺便拯救了世界！你获得了 +5 魔力。

source: Great plan! Soon, you've acquired a crane and tied your favorite hairy himbo to it.
target: 好计划！很快，你弄来一台起重机，把最喜欢的毛茸茸傻大个帅哥绑了上去。

source: COWABUNGAAAAA!
target: 卡哇邦嘎——！

source: Joy, what are your idiot sidekicks doing now?
target: 乔伊，你那几个白痴跟班，这回又在干什么？

source: Again, they're NOT my sidekicks... and I think they're trying to do a deus ex machina?
target: 再说一遍，他们不是我跟班……大概是想搞“机械降神”？

source: A what?
target: 什麽?

source: Y'know, a "God in the machine", from Ancient Greek theater. They tie an actor to a crane, and he pretends to be God and saves everyone at the last minute.
target: 你懂的，古希腊戏剧里的“机器之神”。把演员绑在起重机上，装成神，在最后关头拯救所有人。

source: But that's such a cheap way to end a fight! It completely removes the tension and stakes!
target: 可这收场也太敷衍了！紧张感没了，胜负的分量也没了！

source: Agreed. I want to save the world, but not like THIS. Please leave, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, and take the crane with you.
target: 同意。我想救世界，可不是用这种办法。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，请走吧，带着起重机一起。

source: If only you could've afforded a narrative device that wasn't so lame. You lose -3 HYPE.
target: 要是你买得起没那么逊的剧情手段就好了。你失去了 -3 热度。

source: Nooo, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, don't be silly. Nu's not gullible enough to accept a challenge he's 100% sure to lose.
target: 别傻了，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。努还没蠢到，肯接这种 100%会输的挑战。

source: Excuse me? I can defeat you weaklings at ANYTHING, even a snowboarding race! And when I win, you'll all cower as I blow your planet to smithereens!
target: 什么？比什么，我都能赢你们这群弱者，包括单板滑雪！等我赢了，你们就发着抖，看我把星球炸成渣吧！

source: YOU'RE ON!
target: 一言为定！

source: Smash cut to a ski resort where you, Polly, Scott, and Nu are racing on snowboards! It's a close race, but Nu slides into first.
target: 镜头猛地切到滑雪场，你、波莉、斯科特和努，正在比单板！比赛难分难解，最后，努滑到了第一。

source: How do you like me now, peons? I bested you in your ridiculous winter sport!
target: 服了没有，蝼蚁们？你们这可笑的冬季运动，我赢了！

source: You sure did, bro. Being good at sports also means being a good loser, and you clearly won the race. Good job!
target: 确实，兄弟。好运动员也得输得起，你赢得明明白白。干得漂亮！

source: WHY ARE YOU MORONS SO CALM?! YOUR DUMB PLAN FAILED, AND NOW NU'S GONNA DESTROY THE WORLD!
target: 你们这群蠢货，怎么还这么淡定？！破计划失败了，努现在就要毁灭世界了！

source: Eh... I dunno... this pathetic planet isn't SO pathetic... I mean, it has snowboarding, after all.
target: 呃……说不好……这破星球，好像也没那么破……毕竟，还有单板滑雪呢。

source: Besides, we're snowboarding bros now! What kind of bro would I be if I blew up your planet? I'm a villain, not an asshole.
target: 再说，我们现在是滑雪好兄弟！炸了你们的星球，还算什么兄弟？我只是反派，又不是混蛋。

source: Yes, I suppose I'll call off the death ray for now. Let's make these snowboarding trips a monthly thing, maybe? That would be fun. See you then.
target: 好吧，死亡射线先关了。以后每个月来滑一次，怎么样？肯定很好玩。回头见。

source: So, snowboarding convinced him, huh? I should've guessed... no man, woman, or villain can resist the siren's song of the slopes.
target: 原来，滑雪就能说服他。早该想到……无论男女，就算反派，也抗拒不了雪坡这海妖般的呼唤。

source: GERARD?! You're okay? I thought you bled out!
target: 杰拉德？！你没事？我以为你流血流死了！

source: Nah, I'm okay. Did I look dramatic... like... in a cool way?
target: 没有，我没事。刚才看起来，够不够戏剧化……那种……很酷的戏剧化？

source: I guess...?
target: 大概……算吧？

source: Ha! We saved you, Joy! Now you HAVE to come to the pocket dimension with us!
target: 哈！乔伊，我们救了你！现在，你必须跟我们去袖珍维度了！

source: I told you, I'm not going there! It's... ugh, it's a dimension my Coven accidentally created in a previous adventure, okay? I'd rather just put the whole thing behind me.
target: 都说了我不去！那是……唉，是我们女巫会以前冒险时，不小心创造出来的维度，行了吧？我只想把那件事忘了。

source: Of course you would. Typical Joy, throwing away her old toys.
target: 那当然。典型的乔伊，玩腻了，就把旧玩具扔掉。

source: You call yourself a hero, walking around "saving" the world, then you turn a blind eye to the destruction you leave in your wake!
target: 自称英雄，满世界“拯救”别人，却对自己身后留下的烂摊子视而不见！

source: Oh, no... I do do that, don't I?
target: 糟了……我还真干过这种“事”，对吧？

source: Haha! Joy said "doo doo".
target: 哈哈！乔伊说“屎”。

source: I guess I should check on that dimension... Polly, Scott, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%: if you're going there, I suppose I'll join you.
target: 看来，真该看看那个维度怎么样了……波莉、斯科特、%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你们要去的话，我就一起吧。

source: Hooray, you teamed up with Joy and managed to save the world along the way! You gain +5 MAGIC.
