target: 好耶，跟乔伊组上队了，还顺便拯救了世界！你获得了 +5 魔力。

source: So, let me get this straight... in your attempt to save the world... you're challenging me to a snowboarding race?
target: 所以，我确认一下……为了拯救世界……你要挑战我，比单板滑雪？

source: Of course! It's snowboarding! It's COOL!
target: 当然！单板滑雪！超酷的！

source: Sure, but I could just destroy the world without doing the snowboarding part, right?
target: 行，可我也可以不滑雪，直接毁掉世界，对吧？

source: Uh... I mean, yes, technically...
target: 呃……理论上，确实……

source: That's what I thought. I think I'm going to take that route, then. NOW DIE!
target: 果然。那我就选这个办法。现在，受死吧！

source: And just like that, Nu's death ray shatters the planet, and all things good and bright in the world are destroyed.
target: 就这样，努的死亡射线轰碎星球，世上一切明亮、美好的事物，全都毁灭。

source: Joy is dead. Gerard is dead. Scott is dead. Polly is re-dead. And you... you are SUPER dead.
target: 乔伊死了，杰拉德死了，斯科特死了，波莉又死了一次。至于你……死得透透的。

source: Millions of years pass, and eventually the heat-death of the universe comes and goes... and then the Big Bang 2 happens and recreates everything!
target: 几百万年过去，宇宙热寂来了又走……接着，“宇宙大爆炸 2”发生，一切重建！

source: Over millions more years, life resurfaces. Fishes leave the oceans; mammals evolve thumbs; someone invents cryptocurrency -- it's the circle of life.
target: 又过几百万年，生命重现。鱼类离开海洋，哺乳动物进化出拇指，有人发明加密货币——生命的循环啊。

source: Everything is reborn the same as it ever was... with a few small differences.
target: 一切重获新生，跟以前一模一样……只差一点点。

source: For instance, this time around when you challenge Nu to a snowboarding race, Polly smacks you with a rolled-up newspaper and tells you that's a terrible idea.
target: 比如，这次你向努发出滑雪挑战时，波莉抄起卷好的报纸，敲了你一下，说这主意烂透了。

source: You leave the battlefield in shame, letting Joy handle things, and Polly unwittingly saves the world!
target: 你灰溜溜地离开战场，让乔伊自己处理，波莉就这样，无意间救了世界！

source: Not you, though; you almost caused the apocalypse TWICE. Not a great track record. You lose -3 SOUL.
target: 可不是你救的。你差点两次搞出世界末日，履历实在不怎么样。你失去了 -3 灵魂。

source: Heya, you just reached a high amount of MIND. Good for you!
target: 嘿，你的头脑已经攒得很高了。不错嘛！

source: Does that mean you're aiming for... the MIND-BASED DESTINATION?

source: That's exactly what happens to you, and before you can get back to the Monster Realm, yout get ambushed by four black vans.
target: 你们正好中招，还没回得去，就遭到四辆黑色面包车的伏击。

source: The humans capture you all and knock you out.
target: 人类抓住你们，把大家全打晕了。

source: When you wake up, the cryptids are nowhere to be seen. You're in a small empty room. There's an old TV with a video of an old human talking...
target: 醒来时，神秘生物早没了踪影。你在一间空荡荡的小房间里，旧电视上，正播放一个老人类讲话的视频……

source: Welcome to WTF,  a foundation that aims to secure and contain the anomalous creatures known as cryptids.
target: 欢迎来到 WTF 基金会。我们致力于抓捕并收容，被称作神秘生物的异常存在。

source: Our goal is to test them and learn all about their strange nature.
target: 我们的目标，是通过测试，全面了解它们古怪的特性。

source: If you are watching this, you are a newly captured cryptid. Hello!
target: 如果你正在看这个视频，说明你是新捕获的神秘生物。你好！

source: From now on, tests will be conducted on you by a member of our Class-L personnel. It would be much appreciated if you didn't viciously murder the Class-L personnel...
target: 从现在起，将由 L 级人员对你进行测试。若你能不残忍杀害 L 级人员，我们不胜感激……

source: ...but if you must murder them, please consider doing it in a very weird and messed-up way that can inspire good creepypasta, our foundation's biggest export.
target: ……但若非杀不可，请考虑用特别离奇、特别扭曲的方式，启发出精彩的恐怖怪谈。这可是本基金会最大的出口产品。

source: Thanks, and have a nice rest of your existence.
target: 谢谢，祝你余生愉快。

source: WTF: Watch; Test; and Find out.
target: WTF：Watch，观察；Test，测试；Find out，查明。

source: The video cuts off. A door opens and a very fragile-looking human enters the room. It has a notepad, a pen, and the most nervous-looking face you've ever seen.
target: 视频结束，门开了，一个看着脆弱不堪的人类走进房间。拿着记事本和笔，脸上是你见过最紧张的表情。

source: Eh... ah... hello... welcome to WTF. As explained, we will... we will conduct several tests on you... (please don't murder me)...
target: 呃……啊……你们好……欢迎来到 WTF。刚才也说了，我们会……会做几项测试……（请别杀我）……

source: A SURPRISE TEST! OH, NO! SCOTT'S BIGGEST FOE!
target: 突击测验！不——！斯科特最强大的敌人！

source: Several tests? What are we, the toast and testes tasteful test-testing committee? No way, ma'am!
target: 几项测试？当我们是“吐司睾丸品味测试测评委员会”吗？不干，女士！

source: We're doing ONE test and we're outta here, okay?!
target: 只做一项，然后放我们走，行不行？！

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, go choose whatever tests looks like the easiest for us to pass and let's GTFO.
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，挑个看着最容易过的测试，赶紧走人。

source: You're pretty sure these aren't those sorts of tests... but anyway:
target: 你觉得，这跟他们说的“测试”，好像不是一回事……不过算了：

source: The Bechdel Test: does a piece of fiction feature at least two women talking to each other about something other than a man? It's not about knowing more, but about doing better!
target: 贝克德尔测试：作品里至少有两名女性，在谈论男人之外的话题吗？关键不在懂得更多，而在做得更好！

source: Can you survive... THE BLOOD TEST?!
target: 你能撑过……验血吗？！

source: Ah, we can totally pass that test!
target: 啊，这个稳过！

source: I'm a woman. And... hey, you, human: you're a woman too, aren't you?
target: 我是女人。喂，人类，你也是女人吧？

source: AHHHHHH!
target: 啊啊啊啊！

source: Eh... uh... (yes).
That test also establishes we should have a name. Do you have a name?
target: 还有一条，得有名字。你有名字吗？

source: ...Yes.
Excellent. Can we get a private room for just the two of us so we can engage in non-boy-related talk?
target: 很好。能给咱俩一个单独的房间，聊点男孩以外的话题吗？

source: ...! *arousal noises*
target: ……！*春心荡漾的声音*

source: (...Okay.)
You and Scott leave so Polly and the human can have a one-on-one conversation...
target: 你和斯科特离开，让波莉跟人类单独聊聊……

source: Uhm...
Eh...
So... fish, huh?
target: 那个……鱼，是吧？

source: ...What about them?
target: ……鱼怎么了？

source: They're weird!
target: 很古怪啊！

source: I don't know... I work at a facility that contains cryptids, so...
target: 说不好……我是在收容神秘生物的地方上班的，所以……

source: Fish are way weirder!
target: 鱼更古怪！

source: ...Okay.
target: ...当然了。

source: Ah, fish... you like them or you hate them, amirite?
target: 鱼啊……不是喜欢，就是讨厌，对吧？

source: ...I like fish.
target: ……我喜欢鱼。

source: SEE?!
target: 看到没?

source: Look at us, two independent women talking about our... I don't know... I wanna say... interests?
target: 看，两个独立女性，在聊自己的……不知道……应该说……兴趣？

source: Ah... well... I have this passion... I haven't told anyone else... but every Thursday I love to--
target: 啊……其实……我有个特别喜欢做的事……没跟别人说过……每个星期四，我都爱——

source: What a great conversation! I think we passed the test!
target: 聊得真好！我看测试通过了！

source: Scott, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, come back!
target: 斯科特，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，回来吧！

source: Did you talk about lots of interesting things?
target: 聊了很多有意思的东西吗？

source: Eh... that's debatable.
target: 额... 这点很值得商榷

source: The important thing here is we did it, buddy!
target: 重点是，我们做到了，哥们儿！

source: Hooray!
target: 万岁!

source: Ah, we can totally pass that test!
target: 啊，这个稳过！

source: I'm a woman. And... hey, you, human: you're a woman too, aren't you?
target: 我是女人。喂，人类，你也是女人吧？

source: AHHHHHH!
target: 啊啊啊啊！

source: Eh... uh... (yes).
Excellent. Can we get a private room for just the two of us so we can engage in non-boy-related talk?
target: 很好。能给咱俩一个单独的房间，聊点男孩以外的话题吗？

source: ...! *arousal noises*
target: ……！*春心荡漾的声音*

source: (...Okay.)
You and Scott leave so Polly and the human can have a one-on-one conversation...
target: 你和斯科特离开，让波莉跟人类单独聊聊……

source: Hmmm...
Eh... ah...
...men, amirite?
target: ……男人啊，你说是不是？

source: Oh, fuck!
target: 哦，操！

source: I guess we failed that one. That's on me.
target: 看来没过。怪我。

source: No, it's on us, the devs.
target: 不，怪我们，开发者。

source: In failing the Bechdel Test, we've failed you, our dear players.
target: 没通过贝克德尔测试，是我们辜负了亲爱的玩家们。

source: We need some time to reflect on this.
target: 我们需要一些时间来思考这个问题。

source: In the meantime, we will abruptly end this plotline. Goodbye.
target: 因此，先把这条剧情线突然掐断。再见。

source: Let's say you were all rescued by... eh... hmmm... Liam! Sure!
target: 就当……呃……嗯……李姆把你们救了吧！对！

source: (But this is a FAILURE OUTCOME, so you still lose -3 HYPE)
target: （不过，这是失败结果，你照样失去了 -3 热度。）

source: WHOA! THE BLOOD TEST?!
target: 哇！验血？！

source: NO WAY! NOT THE BLOOD TEST!
target: 不行！别是验血啊！

source: (...What's the Blood Test, Polly?)
target: （……波莉，验血是什么？）

source: With that name, one can only imagine it's some sort of battle royale scenario in which all but one of us will die.
target: 听名字，只能是某种大逃杀吧，咱们中间只能活一个。

source: Oh no, anything but that!
target: 不，什么都行，就别这个！

source: Or maybe it's a challenge in which we'll need to use forbidden blood magic!
target: 也可能是挑战，要动用禁忌血魔法！

source: But Polly, we made a pact to never again use forbidden blood magic!
target: 可波莉，我们说好，再也不碰禁忌血魔法了！

source: Yeah, we should stay far away from forbidden blood magic after what happened last time...
target: 对，上次出了那事以后，确实该离禁忌血魔法远点……

source: But I guess if we want to get out of here, there will be no other way...
target: 可想离开这里，好像也没别的办法……

source: Polly takes a knife from God knows where and makes a slight incision on Scott's palm.
target: 波莉不知从哪儿掏出把刀，在斯科特手掌上，轻轻划了一道。

source: ...What... what are you doing?
target: ……什……你们在干什么？

source: Preparing for the blood test, duh.
target: 准备验血啊，还用问。

source: Ah... eh... please stop that...
target: 啊……呃……请别这样……

source: NO! We will pass the blood test! Even if it means using forbidden blood magic... again!
target: 不！一定得通过验血！哪怕要……再用一次禁忌血魔法！

source: Uh... a blood test is just... eh... taking some of your blood... so we can analyze it... yes?
target: 呃……验血只是……嗯……抽一点血……拿去分析……明白吗？

source: So... no forbidden blood magic?
target: 所以……不用禁忌血魔法？

source: Really? Oh, okay.
target: 真的？哦，好吧。

source: Those two stop painting glyphs on the floor and walls with Scott's blood. It was getting low-key disturbing anyway.
target: 这俩才停下，不再拿斯科特的血，往地上墙上画符文。反正场面也已经有点瘆人了。

source: Those of you who have blood get your blood tested. Look at the Human Realm, so no-nonsense!
target: 有血的几位，都做了验血。瞧瞧人类世界，多务实！

source: Thanks to your high STAMINA you don't faint from blood loss, what a champ!
target: 多亏体力够高，你没因失血晕过去，真厉害！

source: Hooray!
target: 万岁!

source: Oh, a bit underwhelming... but okay.
target: 哦，有点不过瘾……行吧。

source: Wasn't the whole point to choose an easy-to-pass test?
target: 不就是要选个容易通过的测试吗？

source: Well, yeah... but when you choose stuff I usually expect something a bit more bombastic. I don't know, I think you've conditioned us to believe that.
target: 是啊……可每次让你选，我们都盼着闹出点更大的动静。大概已经被你养成习惯了吧。

source: Let's just pass the blood test and leave.
target: 过血检就走

source: They take your blood for the blood test... and you faint.
target: 人家抽了点血化验……你就晕过去了。

source: To be fair, you haven't eaten in a while, so your STAMINA is sorta low.
target: 说句公道话，你好久没吃东西，体力确实有点低。

source: You wake up hours later. You're back in the car.
target: 几小时后，你醒了，发现自己已经回到车里。

source: Polly, Polly, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% is up!
target: 波莉，波莉，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%醒了！

source: Finally!
target: 总算醒了！

source: Did we... escape?
target: 我们……逃出来了？

source: I guess you can call it that.
target: 我想你可以这么说

source: It was more like fainting from a simple blood test was so lame that they deemed you too uncool to be studied.
target: 准确说，验个血都能晕，实在太逊，他们觉得你不够酷，不值得研究。

source: Long story short, we got kicked out of a containment facility. Imagine that!
target: 长话短说，我们被收容机构赶出来了。想想看！

source: They said they wanted to learn all about your anomalous nature... and they learned your nature was "lame".
target: 本来想弄懂你的异常本质……结果弄懂了，你的本质就是“逊”。

source: Ugh, so embarrassing... you lose -3 HYPE. And your arm still itches from the needle. Sad face.
target: 真丢脸……你失去了 -3 热度，挨针的地方还痒着呢。哭脸。

source: Yeah, fuck y'all! PRANK MASTERZ: one, WTF: zero!
target: 哈，去你们的！恶作剧大师，一分！WTF，零分！

source: Now, show us the exit door. We're done here.
target: 现在带我们去出口，完事了。

source: Ah... I... I can't. We need to... keep doing these tests.
target: 啊……我……不行。还得……继续测试。

source: Are you kidding me? Lemme see those stupid tests. We're gonna speedrun those motherfuckers, if that's what it takes...
target: 逗我呢？破测试拿来看看。非做不可的话，就给它们全速通了……

source: Polly takes the notepad from the human. The human jumps in what looks like an awkward mix of fear and arousal.
target: 波莉拿过人类的记事本。对方浑身一跳，像是害怕，又像动了情，尴尬地混在一起。

source: Hmmm... lemme see... eh...
target: 嗯……看看……呃……

source: Dude! Half of these tests are just "what would happen if this cryptid fought that other cryptid?"
target: 喂，一半测试都是“这个神秘生物，跟那个打起来，谁会赢”！

source: What's the scientific basis for that?
target: 科学依据呢？

source: I... I'm sure the head scientists have very good reasons... like testing the resilience and aggressiveness of the different subjects...
target: 我……主管科学家，肯定有很好的理由……比如，测试各受试者的耐受力和攻击性……

source: Meanwhile, in the main lab...
target: 与此同时，主实验室里……

source: "I tell you what, no cryptid can beat WTF-173. Such a classic..."
target: “我跟你说，谁也打不过 WTF-173。经典就是经典……”

source: "Meh, that dumb statue is totally overrated. WTF-049 on the other hand... such a mysterious and brilliant creature!"
target: “得了吧，那破雕像被捧过头了。WTF-049 才叫神秘又出色！”

source: "That plague doctor? Such a snobbish choice! WTF-173 would snap his neck in no time!"
target: “瘟疫医生？选得够装。WTF-173 分分钟拧断它脖子！”

source: "Wanna bet? Let's schedule a test for WTF-173 to fight WTF-049."
target: “赌不赌？安排 WTF-173 跟 WTF-049 打一场，做个测试。”

source: "Hypothesis to prove: WTF-049 would totally win in a fight against WTF-173."
target: “待验证假设：WTF-049 会在对战 WTF-173 时大获全胜。”

source: "Man, I love science."
target: “哎呀，我爱科学。”

source: This is scientific nonsense! Ugh!
target: 什么破科学，胡扯！

source: Are you gonna... murder me...? Please don't murder me...
target: 你要……杀我吗……？求你别杀我……

source: Nah, we'd still be in the same predicament, and without a shivering, exposition-providing human.
target: 不杀。杀了也出不去，还少一个哆哆嗦嗦、负责解释设定的人类。

source: So stupid fight it is...
target: 行吧，那就打这破架……

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, you know what to do: choose whichever cryptid on this list looks the least-likely to slaughter all of us.
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，知道怎么做了吧？挑个看起来，最不可能把我们全杀掉的。

source: Gotcha...
target: 明白……

source: WTF-096, the "Shy Dude". Once it decides to kill you, it never stops. Will you be the ones to figure out how to survive his relentless hunt?
target: WTF-096，“害羞哥”。一旦决定杀你，绝不罢休。你们能找到办法，躲过它不眠不休的追杀吗？

source: WTF-682, the "Difficult-to-Destroy Dinosaur". With that dumb name, you know you'll be in for a long, long fight... ready to test your resilience?
target: WTF-682，“难以摧毁的恐龙”。光听这蠢名字，就知道得打一场漫长、漫长的仗……准备好考验耐力了吗？

source: Just a shy dude? That sounds easy!
target: 就一害羞哥？听着简单！

source: N-no... the "Shy Dude" is called like that because... the subject viciously preys upon and murders whoever sees its face.
target: 不、不……叫“害羞哥”，是因为……它会疯狂追杀，任何看见它脸的人。

source: ...Great.
target: ……真棒。

source: Soon after that, you're thrown in a room with WTF-096. It's a huge humanoid creature with long spooky arms.
target: 没多久，你们被扔进房间，和 WTF-096 共处一室。它是个巨大的人形生物，胳膊长得瘆人。

source: There's an awkward silence until brave, dumb Scott dares to start a conversation.
target: 尴尬地沉默了一会儿，勇敢又没脑子的斯科特，终于试着搭话。

source: Hey, bro...  wassup? I heard about that thing of murdering whoever sees your face... why is that?
target: 嘿，兄弟……最近怎么样？听说，看过你脸的人，你都会杀掉……为什么啊？

source: It doesn't sound cool, bro. But I'm sure you have your reasons.
target: 听着不太好，兄弟。不过，你肯定有自己的原因。

source: ...It's just... I am shy.
target: ……就是……我害羞。

source: Yeah... but murdering people? Isn't that a bit of an... overkill?
target: 害羞归害羞，直接杀人，是不是有点……小题大杀？

source: Heehee, nice pun.
target: 嘿嘿，好个双关。

source: But no... you're right... I don't know... what if people don't like my face? I don't want to risk it...
target: 不过……你说得对……我就是……怕别人不喜欢我的脸，不敢冒险……

source: Gosh... you couldn't imagine how hard online dating has been... I always end up murdering every person who sees my profile...
target: 天哪，网恋有多难，你们根本不知道……看了我个人资料的人，最后都被我杀了……

source: Have you tried uploading feet pics instead of face pics to your profile? Some people are into that!
target: 个人资料不放脸照，改放脚照，试过没？有人喜欢这个！

source: ...Really?
target: ...真的吗?

source: That'd be great... I have been told I have pretty feet.
target: 那可太好了……有人夸过，我的脚很漂亮。

source: You actually do! And you know what, my shy friend? I have just the app for this. Lemme set you up a profile.
target: 确实！害羞的朋友，我正好有个合适的软件，来，给你建个账号。

source: Polly sets up a profile for the "Shy Dude" on a dating app for people into feet. WTF-096 starts matching right away!
target: 波莉在恋足交友软件上，给“害羞哥”建好资料。WTF-096 马上就配对成功了！

source: Yay!
target: 赞!

source: So... no murdering us?
target: 所以……不杀我们了？

source: Hmmm... I guess not... I'll be busy with all the action Imma be getting soon anyway...
target: 嗯……应该不杀了……反正马上就有大把艳遇，够我忙的……

source: And that's how you survived the lethal WTF-096!
target: 就这样，你们从致命的 WTF-096 手里活下来了！

source: Just a shy dude? That sounds easy!
target: 就一害羞哥？听着简单！

source: N-no... the "Shy Dude" is called like that because... the subject viciously preys upon and murders whoever sees its face.
target: 不、不……叫“害羞哥”，是因为……它会疯狂追杀，任何看见它脸的人。

source: ...Great.
target: ……真棒。

source: Soon after that, you're thrown in a room with WTF-096. It's a huge humanoid creature with long spooky arms.
target: 没多久，你们被扔进房间，和 WTF-096 共处一室。它是个巨大的人形生物，胳膊长得瘆人。

source: You try to avoid eye contact to... you know... not get viciously murdered.
target: 为了……你懂的……不被残忍杀死，你们尽量不跟它对视。

source: A voice is heard over an intercom.
target: 对讲机里，传来一个声音。

source: "Do something! This is boring!"
target: “干点什么啊！好无聊！”

source: "Yeah! Fight... fight for science!"
target: “对！打起来……为了科学，打起来！”

source: Well, you are a firm believer in science, so you take one for the team and look at WTF-096's face.
target: 你坚定信奉科学，决定为团队牺牲一下，直视 WTF-096 的脸。

source: Aren't you gonna... like... murder %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?
target: 你不准备……杀了%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%吗？

source: I mean... I've always killed people who see my face because I get very insecure. I find my face to be very ugly.
target: 嗯……杀掉看见我脸的人，是因为我太自卑，觉得自己的脸很丑。

source: But... I don't know... like... don't you prey on and murder everyone who sees YOUR face?
target: 可……你呢……看过你这张脸的人，你难道不会全杀掉？
……不会啊？

source: Whoa... this makes me reconsider my whole stance on murdering people who see my face.
target: 哇……这让我重新思考起，杀掉所有看过我脸的人这件事。

source: I mean, if you can remain chill about people seeing YOUR face... then I guess I can too.
target: 别人看了你的脸，你都能这么淡定……那我也该能。

source: In a way, you succeeded today... but at what cost? You lose -3 HYPE from the sick, unintended burn from WTF-096.
target: 某种意义上，今天成功了……可代价呢？WTF-096 无心的一句狠损，让你失去了 -3 热度。

source: Shortly after that, they kick you out of the containment facility. You strongly suspect it's because they don't want to look at your face for a prolonged period of time.
target: 随后，你们被赶出收容机构。你严重怀疑，他们只是实在不想长时间看着你这张脸。

source: Ah, yes, "Difficult-to-Destroy-Dinosaur"... this will be easy.

source: Whoa. It's really gross, but I can't look away.
target: 哇，好恶心。可眼睛就是挪不开。

source: This makes me nostalgic for a time where I was made of flesh.
target: 忽然好怀念，自己还是血肉之躯的时候。

source: And to think: somewhere lies my body, slowly decomposing like this possum's. The flesh that I once was... a shedded carcass, of sorts.
target: 想想看，我的尸体也躺在某个地方，像这负鼠一样，慢慢腐烂。我曾经的肉身……如今，倒像一副蜕下的躯壳。

source: Polly...
target: 波莉...

source: I miss the flesh.
target: 真想念那副血肉之躯。

source: Sometimes I wonder, Polly... Am I made of flesh at all?
target: 波莉，有时候，我也会想……我真的是血肉做的吗？

source: Of course, buddy! You're all fleshy and hairy.
target: 当然，哥们儿！一身肉，一身毛的。

source: Scott looks silently at his palms.
target: 斯科特默默看着自己的手掌。

source: Am I?
target: 是吗?

source: Polly grabs his hand... his vibrant, colorful, two-dimensional hand.
target: 波莉握住他的手……那只鲜活、多彩、二维的手。

source: I... I don't know.
target: 我……不知道。

source: Yeah... me neither.
target: 嗯……我也不知道。

source: You lose -N2 MIND questioning the nature of your existence...
target: 对自身存在的本质产生怀疑，让你失去了 -N2 头脑……

source: ...but you gain +N2 HYPE because I still have to give you a RESOURCE, and this was... fun, in its own way? Wasn't it...?
target: ……不过，你又获得了 +N2 热度，毕竟我总得给你点资源。这也算是……某种意义上的好玩？对吧……？

source: You leave the static. The TV buzzes, almost imperceptibly...
target: 你让电视停在雪花屏上，微弱的嗡嗡声，几乎听不见……

source: Look at the static. An amalgam of senseless dots; a soothing, everlasting buzz.
target: 看这些噪点。毫无意义的点，混在一起；低鸣不止，让人安定。

source: If you look at it directly, it's like it's speaking to you in all its unsettling grace.
target: 盯着看，仿佛它正用那种令人不安的优雅，对你说话。

source: It's so calming...
target: 好平静……

source: Imagine if everything was just... static.
target: 想想，要是一切都只是……电视雪花。

source: Sometimes I do wonder where this trip is leading to; where we're supposed to go...
target: 有时候，我真会想，这趟旅行究竟通向哪里，我们又该去哪里……

source: It makes me feel... empty.
target: 想着想着……心里空空的。

source: But...
target: 不过...

source: The static and the buzz fill the emptiness, don't they?
target: 可噪点和嗡嗡声，把那片空白填满了，对吧？

source: Yes...
But sometimes everything just feels like static. Like we're all dots buzzing in a whole bunch of nonsense. Just hovering there... buzzing forever.
target: 但有时，一切都像雪花点。我们不过是一堆荒诞里的小点，嗡嗡响着，悬在那里……永远地响下去。

source: Polly...
target: 波莉...

source: Yes?
target: 嗯？

source: It's okay. Even if everything is just static, I will always be a dot buzzing next to the dot that you are.
target: 没事。哪怕一切都只是雪花点，我也会是紧挨着你的那一点，一直陪你嗡嗡作响。

source: I know buddy. Let's buzz together forever.
target: 我知道，哥们儿。那就永远一起响下去吧。

source: You watch the static all night. You gain +N2 MIND from its soothing buzz, but lose -N2 HYPE for doing absolutely nothing.
target: 你们看了一夜雪花屏。舒缓的低鸣，让你获得 +N2 头脑；可什么也没干，又让你失去了 -N2 热度。

source: Hiya, Kidz! Or, as we say in my realm, 'GLORY TO THE ARCHDEMONS, COMRADES.'
target: 小朋友们好！或者，按我们那儿的说法：“同志们，荣耀归于大恶魔！”

source: Who's ready for some dark arts and crafts with your buddy Melchor?
target: 谁准备好，跟好朋友梅尔乔，一起上黑魔法手工课了？

source: ME! ME! I'M READY! PICK ME!
target: 我！我！我准备好了！选我！

source: "We're ready!" say the Kidz in haunting unison. "What are we making today, Melchor?"
target: “我们准备好了！”孩子们齐声回答，整齐得诡异，“今天做什么，梅尔乔？”

source: WHAT ARE WE MAKING, MELCHOR?! I HAVE TO KNOW!!!
target: 做什么，梅尔乔？！我必须知道！！！

source: We're making a very special amulet that will break us free from this cursed prison of glass!
target: 要做一枚特别的护身符，带我们逃离这座被诅咒的玻璃牢笼！

source: What prison of glass?
target: 什么玻璃牢笼？

source: The one we're all trapped in.
target: 囚禁着我们所有人的这座。

source: Does he mean the TV? And... wait... is he responding to what we're saying?
target: 他在说电视？等等……他是在回答我们？

source: Sure, there's the TV for me; but beyond the TV there's yet another prison of glass, one for all of us. Look closely.
target: 对我来说，是电视。可电视之外，还有一重玻璃牢笼，困着我们所有人。仔细看。

source: Polly and Scott look closely. You can see them, just now. Look at their models, so static, yet their eyes are looking directly at you. Do they... see you?
target: 波莉和斯科特凑近看。就在此刻，你能看见他们。看看那些一动不动的模型，可他们的眼睛，正直直看着你。他们……看得见你？

source: Do you see anything, Polly?
target: 波莉，你看到什么了吗？

source: I... I think I see something. It's like visions amidst a dense mist. There's someone there... so close, yet so far... looking at us.
target: 我……好像看到了。像浓雾中的幻影。那里有人……这么近，又那么远……看着我们。

source: It's... unsettling.
target: ……真让人不安。

source: They stay there... looking into that distant mist, out of their prison of glass, directly at you.
target: 他们就这样，看着遥远的雾气，望出囚禁自己的玻璃牢笼，直直望向你。

source: So silly; just some characters spouting some lines.
target: 真傻，不过是几个角色，在念台词罢了。

source: But aren't we all characters who only feel real thanks to a flimsy sense of self? How do we know ours is legitimate, and not just another layer in these prisons within prisons...?
target: 可我们，不也只是凭着一丝薄弱的自我意识，就觉得自己真实存在的角色吗？怎么知道我们的现实是真的，而非这重重牢笼里的又一层……？

source: As you also look through the mist that divides the prisons, these revelations imbue you with +N2 MAGIC.
target: 你也望向那片分隔牢笼的迷雾。这番领悟，赋予你 +N2 魔力。

source: But something feels amiss... perhaps a part of your -N2 SOUL that's gone, maybe forever.
target: 可总有什么不对……或许，你失去的 -N2 灵魂，已经一去不返。

source: Order some pizza
target: 点披萨吧

source: No way you're going to bed on an empty stomach! You decide to order some pizza. Trouble is, none of you know any of the local restaurants around here.
target: 不能饿着肚子睡！你决定点份披萨。可问题是，附近的餐馆，谁都不熟。

source: The best way to get pizza is to call and order it. We could call a random number and see if there's pizza.
target: 想吃披萨，最好打电话订。随便拨个号码，问问有没有披萨吧。

source: Scott, the odds of calling a random phone number and actually getting a pizza restaurant are SUPER low.
target: 斯科特，乱打个号码，正好打到披萨店，概率也太低了。

source: So let's dial a bunch of random numbers to increase our chances!
target: 所以多打几个，增加成功率！

source: Beep boop beep!
target: 哔，嘟，哔！

source: Hello, is this a pizza place?
target: 喂,这里是披萨店吗?

source: Well, that's odd. They picked up, but there's just silence.
target: 奇怪，接是接了，可一句话都不说。

source: Let's try another number.
target: 试试别的号码

source: Hi, is this a pizza restaurant?
target: 你好，请问是披萨店吗？

source: Strange...
target: 奇怪……

source: I feel like we should stop.
target: 我觉得，该停下来了。

source: Maybe.
target: 也许吧

source: Your friends sit in silence. They look uncomfortable. You're all hungry. The phone is there, but still... it feels as if it's pulsating with an odd sort of energy. You look at it.
target: 朋友们一声不吭，神色不安。肚子都饿着。电话就在那儿，可是……仿佛有股古怪的能量，在里面搏动。你望着它。

source: You can't stop now. You must get to the bottom of this, pizza or no pizza. Dial a random number, yet again.
target: 不能停。有没有披萨，都得查个究竟。再乱拨一个号码。

source: Ignore all this and just move on to the part where you all eat pizza.
target: 别管了，直接跳到大家吃披萨的部分。

source: You grab the phone and dial some random number.
target: 你拿起电话，随便拨了个号码。

source: Someone picks up, but there's just pure, unsettling, almost-deafening silence.
target: 有人接听，却只有一片纯粹的寂静，令人不安，几乎震耳欲聋。

source: ...None of this is real.
target: ...这一切都不是真的。

source: A strange chill goes down your spine. You hang up.
target: 一股诡异的寒意，顺着脊背爬上来。你挂了电话。

source: Bros, I don't feel like eating anymore.
target: 兄弟们，我不想吃了。

source: Yeah, let's just go to sleep. Tomorrow will be another day and we can look past all this.
target: 嗯，睡吧。明天又是新的一天，就能把这些都忘了。

source: Please.
target: 拜托了。

source: You all go to sleep, hoping you'll all forget about this. You lose -N2 STAMINA because you didn't have dinner, but you feel as if you gained +N2 MIND listening to that voice.
target: 大家上床，盼着睡醒就能忘掉。没吃晚饭，你失去了 -N2 体力；可听过那个声音，又好像获得了 +N2 头脑。

source: Was it worth it, though?
target: 值得吗?

source: You're all eating pizza.
target: 你们正吃着披萨。

source: Bros, this pizza is really good!
target: 兄弟们，披萨真好吃！

source: Fuck yeah it is!
target: 那他妈当然！

source: It's just... When did we... when did we order this pizza, Polly?
target: 只是……波莉，我们什么时候……什么时候订的披萨？

source: You know, Scott! Just a moment ago, when we were at the phone and... and...
target: 你记得啊，斯科特！就刚才，打电话的时候……然后……

source: You're all eating pizza.
target: 你们正吃着披萨。

source: Bros, this pizza is really good!
target: 兄弟们，披萨真好吃！

source: Fuck yeah it is!
target: 那他妈当然！

source: You all eat the pizza and question nothing about how you got it.
target: 大家吃着披萨，谁也不问，它是怎么来的。

source: It's pizza! Enjoy it and ask no questions.
target: 披萨嘛！吃就完了，别问。

source: It's +N2 STAMINA at the low cost of -N2 MIND. Yum.
target: 只需付出 -N2 头脑，就能获得 +N2 体力。真香。

source: Get ready for bed
target: 准备睡觉吧

source: The table who clearly doesn't want to be bothered
target: 那桌明显不想被打扰的人

source: Yet again, you choose the table who clearly doesn't want to be bothered... but this time the people sitting there are quite different from before...
target: 又一次，你选择了那桌明显不想被打扰的人……可这回，坐在那里的人，跟以前大不一样……

source: Polly, look: It's us.
target: 波莉，看，是我们。

source: Oh, hey. You made it all the way here.
target: 哦，嘿，你们居然走到这儿了。

source: This is a strange vision. You're all standing in front of what seems to be other versions of Polly and Scott, sitting at the booth.
target: 景象十分古怪。你们面前的卡座里，坐着的仿佛是另一个版本的波莉和斯科特。

source: What the fuck is happening? Why are we sitting there?!
target: 搞什么鬼？我们为什么坐在那儿？！

source: It's the road trip: it keeps happening and happening.
target: 公路旅行啊，它一直、一直在发生。

source: Yeah, bros... it never ends.
target: 是啊，兄弟们……永远不会结束。

source: We hit game over one too many times. So we decided it was better to give up and just stay at one LOCATION.
target: 游戏结束太多次了，所以决定，干脆放弃，就待在一个地点。

source: Now that I think about it, it makes sense that if we stayed here long enough, the loop would repeat despite us.
target: 现在想想，我们待得够久，循环照样会重来，就算我们不参与，也一样。

source: Loop? What are you even talking about?
target: 循环？你到底在说什么？

source: Polly... I'm confused...
target: 波莉……我不太懂……

source: Hmmm... you don't get it. It's okay: just lose. The loop will reset and everything will be back to normal.
target: 嗯……不明白也没事，输一局就好。循环重置，一切又会恢复正常。

source: If you're overlapping with us, it might also mean you're disrupting your own loop a bit too much.
target: 你们跟我们重叠，可能也说明，你们把自己的循环，扰乱得太过了。

source: You should probably stop.
target: 你也许应该停下来。

source: Polly's right: you gotta stop before it gets too weird. It's better for everyone's sake.
target: 波莉说得对。别等事情变得太古怪，再停下。这样，对大家都好。

source: Yeah, I can feel it: us interacting is having some strange effect. You must leave.
target: 没错，感觉得到，我们的交流，已经在造成奇怪的影响。你们必须走。

source: Please, just move onto the part where you choose an option and mess with your resources.
target: 拜托，直接跳到选选项、增减资源的部分吧。

source: My advice, though? Aim to lose before it's too late.
target: 不过，要我建议？趁还来得及，赶紧输一局。

source: ...I don't feel okay.
target: ...我感觉不舒服。

source: Your friends are a bit too shocked. This is not good. Other Polly is right; let's just choose an option and move on.
target: 朋友们受惊不轻，这可不妙。另一个波莉说得对，赶紧选个选项，继续走吧。

source: Throw your wallet at a stranger.
target: 把你的钱包扔给陌生人

source: Stab someone and steal their food.
target: 捅个人，抢他的食物。

source: You don't have much time. You grab your wallet and throw it at a stranger sitting in a booth.
target: 时间不多，你抄起钱包，扔向卡座里的一个陌生人。

source: This effectively makes you lose -N2 MONEY. Good.
target: 这确实让你失去了 -N2 金钱。很好。

source: "Hey, I like free money! So kind of you!"
target: “嘿，我喜欢白捡的钱！你人真好！”

source: This effectively makes you gain +N2 SOUL.
target: 这确实让你获得了 +N2 灵魂。

source: RESOURCES affected. Now you're good to go.
target: 资源已变动，可以走了。

source: You grab your friends and run out of the diner before they can think too much about what just happened.
target: 趁朋友们还没开始细想，你拉着他们，跑出了餐厅。

source: You don't have much time. You grab a knife and stab a stranger sitting in a booth next to you.
target: 时间不多，你抄起刀，捅了旁边卡座里的一个陌生人。

source: "Oh, no, please stop! I don't like getting stabbed!"
target: “哦，不，快停下！我不喜欢被捅！”

source: This effectively makes you lose -N2 SOUL.
target: 这确实让你失去了 -N2 灵魂。

source: Then you eat their food. It's some nice apple pie. You realize it would have been better to not cut the pie with the same knife you used to stab them. Too late.
target: 接着，你吃了他的食物，挺不错的苹果派。忽然想到，切派最好别用刚捅过人的那把刀。晚了。

source: The important thing is that, by doing this, you effectively gain +N2 STAMINA.
target: 重点是，这确实让你获得了 +N2 体力。

source: RESOURCES affected. Now you're good to go.
target: 资源已变动，可以走了。

source: You grab your friends and run out of the diner before they can think too much about what just happened.
target: 趁朋友们还没开始细想，你拉着他们，跑出了餐厅。

source: The poor soul waiting for their blind date
target: 那个苦等相亲对象的可怜人

source: You all sit down with a sad living puppet.
target: 你们坐到一个愁眉苦脸的活木偶旁边。

source: Hey, bro! I'm Scott. Is this seat taken?
target: 嘿，兄弟！我是斯科特。这儿有人吗？

source: Huh? Um, hi, Scott. I'm Mindy, and I was actually saving that seat for my date...
target: 啊？嗯，嗨，斯科特。我叫明蒂，那个位子，其实留给约会对象了……

source: Oh, okay! When's your date getting here?
target: 哦，好！他什么时候到？

source: Any second now! His name is Ernis the Avaricious. We were set up by mutual friends to go on our first date today.
target: 马上就来！他叫贪婪者厄尼斯。共同的朋友撮合的，今天第一次见面。

source: Eh? Wait... would you just give me a second to talk to my friends privately?
target: 呃，等等……能让我跟朋友私下说两句吗？

source: Uh... why would you sit at my table without permission only to exclude me from the conversation a couple minutes later?
target: 你们擅自坐下，过几分钟，又要把我排除在谈话之外？

source: I'll take that as a yes. Wait there!
target: 就当你同意了，等一下！

source: You all huddle.
target: 你们凑成一圈。

source: (Guys, doesn't all this sound familiar?)
target: （各位，这不觉得眼熟吗？）

source: (Yes, the feeling of being stood up at a date is sadly all too familiar to me. No need to bring that up, though.)
target: （是，被约会对象放鸽子的感觉，我遗憾地表示，太熟悉了。不过，没必要提。）

source: (No, I mean I really feel like we've been in this situation before, don't you?)
target: （不是，我是说，真的经历过这种情况，不觉得吗？）

source: (Now that you mention it... I feel like we've been here before, but it wasn't exactly here. It's odd...)
target: （这么一说……好像来过，可又不完全是这里。好奇怪……）

source: (Yeah... what is this place? What's happening?)
target: （是啊……这里到底是哪儿？怎么回事？）

source: (I don't like this, bros... I'm scared.)
target: （兄弟们，我不喜欢这样……好害怕。）

source: It feels like you've been here before, doesn't it? This is weird... but what can you do?
target: 像是来过，对吧？真古怪……可你能怎么办？

source: Don't stop huddling. Huddle forever. This is your safe space from now on; your comfort zone. No one can hurt you while you huddle, right?
target: 别散开，永远抱团。从今往后，这就是安全区、舒适圈。抱在一起，就没人能伤害你们，对吧？

source: Something something game show. Guessing stuff and cash prizes and whatever.
target: 什么什么竞猜节目，猜点东西，赢现金，随便吧。

source: (So this is your best idea? To just keep huddling?)
target: （这就是最好的主意？一直抱团？）

source: (I don't know... something feels off. I don't think we're safe here. Do you hear that?)
target: （不知道……感觉不对，这儿不安全。听见了吗？）

source: (I don't hear anything.)
target: （什么都没听见。）

source: (Exactly. Shortly after we started huddling, all the noise went away. Look.)
target: （对。刚一抱团，声音就全没了。看。）

source: You take a peek out of your huddle. Everyone is quietly looking at you.
target: 你从人圈里探头看。所有人，正静静盯着你们。

source: (I'm scared, Polly.)
target: （波莉，我害怕。）

source: (Let's try to leave.)
target: （试着走吧。）

source: You slowly walk to the door without undoing the huddle. People stare at you in silence.
target: 你们仍抱作一团，慢慢挪向门口。人们默默注视着。

source: You try to open the door, but it's locked.
target: 想开门，可门锁了。

source: (Ugh. What's happening?!)
target: （烦死了，怎么回事？！）

source: (Hmmm... Usually before we leave any place, we solve a conflict that makes us gain and lose RESOURCES.)
target: （嗯……平时离开前，总得解决点矛盾，再增减一些资源。）

source: (You might be onto something. Okay, let's go back to Mindy. She had a conflict that needed resolution.)
target: （有道理。好，回明蒂那儿，她正好有个待解决的矛盾。）

source: You walk to Mindy.
target: 你们走向明蒂。

source: (We need to forfeit a RESOURCE, though...)
target: （可我们得失去一项资源……）

source: (...I'm sorry, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.)
target: （……对不起，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。）

source: Polly stabs you. She grabs some of your blood and splatters Mindy with it.
target: 波莉捅了你，沾起你的血，泼了明蒂一脸。

source: HERE! YOU DON'T NEED NO MAN! YOU'RE STRONG BY YOURSELF! LOOK, FREE BLOOD! YOU'RE WELCOME! BYE!
target: 给！你不需要男人！一个人照样坚强！看，免费鲜血！不客气！拜！

source: Mindy stares at you quietly, her face soaked in your blood.
target: 明蒂脸上浸满你的血，静静望着你们。

source: The diner door opens slowly by itself.
target: 餐厅大门，缓缓自行打开。

source: You run towards it as you bleed out. All of the people in the diner keep staring at you all. The silence is almost deafening.

source: ...What?

source: Contestant first: hairy blue baby eyes! Name?
target: 第一位选手，毛茸茸蓝色宝宝眼睛！姓名？

source: I'm confused.
target: 我不明白。

source: Incorrect! Answer was "Bachelor Celebrity Host Prince"! Disqualified much!
target: 错！答案是“单身汉名人主持王子”！彻底淘汰！

target: 第二位选手，幽灵幽灵！问题：“主持王子单身汉名人？”

target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你选的选项，很不对劲。

target: 正确，不！[失败音效]。

source: What's that noise? It's killing me! PLEASE, LET'S LEAVE.
target: 什么声音？受不了了！求你们，快走吧。

target: 今天离开，永远不行。现金现在变奖金，上交财物。

target: 当然,随便了。  %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%把你的钱包给他

target: [开发备注 /J/：嗯……或许可行，试试“老角色回归”]。

target: [开发备注 /J/：不行。诺拉一直是正面角色，写得这么负面，玩家不会喜欢]。

source: Time to make some money! You and your friends go into the cave to mine for ore.
target: 是时候赚钱了! 你和你的朋友去洞穴取矿

source: After an hour of walking and mining, you've got a decent pile of precious metals when you hear a voice cry out:
target: 走了挖了一个小时，刚攒下一堆贵金属，就听见一声大喊：

source: HEY! YOU KIDS LEAVE MY ORE ALONE!
target: 喂！你们几个，别动我的矿石！

source: YOU'RE ALWAYS ALL UP IN MY BIZNIZ, TAKING ALL MY ORE! WHEN WILL IT STOP?!
target: 整天掺和我的事，把矿石全拿走，到底有完没完？！

source: What are you talking about? This is the first time we've looked for ore in these caves. We don't even know who you are.
target: 说什么呢？我们第一次来这儿挖矿，连你是谁都不知道。

source: Is this some sort of sophistimicated city-people joke?!
target: 这是你们城里人，啥高深的玩笑？！

source: You come here over and over again, always either taking my ore or tricking me into giving my precious ore up.
target: 你们一次又一次来，不是抢矿，就是骗我交出心爱的矿石。

source: WHY?! Why do you keep coming? Is this some sort of game for you? An "ore-theft" game?!
target: 为什么？！老来干什么？当这是游戏？“偷矿石游戏”？！

source: Who would play a game about stealing ore?
target: 谁会玩偷矿石的游戏?

source: YOU, APPARENTLY!
target: 显然是你们！

source: I'm losing my mind. These last few months have been like some sort of dreadful purgatory... an endless loop where I'm forced to forfeit my beloved belongings countless times...
target: 我快疯了。这几个月，像被困在可怕的炼狱……没完没了地循环，被迫交出心爱的东西，一次又一次……

source: What did I do to deserve this hellish torture? Is it punishment for all those people I murdered years ago?!
target: 我做错什么，要遭这种地狱折磨？难道在罚我，多年前杀过那么多人？！

source: ...What did you just say?
target: ...你刚才说什么?

source: NO! I won't hear any more of your ploys and ruses to make me give you my ore!
target: 不！别再耍花招，休想让我把矿石交出来！

source: No more hearing stupid "lore"; no more free therapy sessions; no more taxi licenses; nooooooooooo!
target: 不听什么蠢“背景故事”，不做免费心理咨询，不要出租车执照！再也不要！

source: Polly, this bro sounds a bit... dangerous. I think we should leave.
target: 波莉，这兄弟有点……危险。要不走吧。

source: I sort of agree, Scott; but I feel like we need to get this ore. It's like... the goal of this conflict, if that makes sense.
target: 我也这么想，斯科特。可又觉得，非得弄到矿石。这场矛盾的……目标就是这个，懂吧。

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, any ideas?
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%有什么想法吗?

source: Choose no option at all. Let this poor soul keep his ore for once and break this whole "ACTION; CONFLICT; OPTIONS; OUTCOME" loop that defines your existence.
target: 什么选项都不选，让这可怜人，难得留住自己的矿。打破那定义你存在的“行动、冲突、选项、结果”循环。

source: Taxi license: it always works.
target: 出租车牌照:总是有效的.

source: Maybe we should... just leave.
target: 要不……直接走吧。

source: ...What?
target: ……什么？

source: I don't know. Choosing no option just doesn't feel right.
target: 不知道，不选选项，总觉得不对。

source: But endlessly punishing this weirdo does?
target: 那没完没了折磨他，就对了？

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% is right, Polly.
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 说对了 波莉.

source: Sometimes... sometimes I feel like we do stuff that's wrong just because we need to "choose an option."
target: 有时候……我们好像只因为要“选个选项”，就去做错事。

source: I... I wish we could... just for once... choose no option and avoid messing with things.
target: 我……希望哪怕就这一次，也能什么都不选，不把事情搞砸。

source: We... we'll leave, okay? You can keep your ore.
target: 我们……走了，好吗？矿石你留着。

source: ...Really?
target: ...真的吗?

target: ……又是骗我，对吧？没完没了。今天走了，很快，又回来，拿背景故事、心理咨询，换我的矿。

source: It never ends... it never ends...
target: 永无止境... 永无止境...

source: I think we should leave now, guys...
target: 各位，我觉得该走了……

target: 你们空手离开洞穴，什么都没做，失去了 -N2 热度……

target: ……不过，为了不再折腾这个矿石老兄，你克制了非选不可的天性，获得了 +N2 灵魂。

source: You buy a taxi license from that one website that sells them for really cheap. It's just -N2 MONEY!
target: 你上那个廉价卖出租车执照的网站，买了一张，只花 -N2 金钱！

source: Getting a taxi license is so easy, it should be illegal!
target: 出租车执照这么好弄，简直该算违法！

source: (It probably is illegal to get a taxi license THIS WAY, now that you think about it.)
target: （仔细想想，用这种办法弄执照，大概确实违法。）

source: You give the taxi license to the ore guy.
target: 你把出租车执照，递给矿石老兄。

source: You lose the MONEY, and you get ore which gives you MONEY... wait, no, it can't give the same RESOURCE it takes...
target: 失去金钱，得到矿石，矿石又给你金钱……等等，不行，不能拿什么资源，又给什么资源……

source: No, no, it gives you +N2 MAGIC! Because this ore is magic ore!
target: 不不，给的是 +N2 魔力！因为，这是魔法矿石！

source: (Phew, that was close.)
target: （呼，差点穿帮。）

target: 不！别又是出租车执照！

target: 别碰我的矿！不！我不想再切到，那个古怪的电影预告片！

source: It's a living nightmare. Why does my life suddenly cut to some sort of taxi-related plot?
target: 活像噩梦。为什么人生会突然切换成，某种出租车剧情？

source: I don't get it. it's confusing... it's not fun... please, no...
target: 不懂……好乱……一点也不好玩……求你，别……

source: "Man, we've been lost in these caves for hours. If only there was a clear way out..."
target: “在这洞里迷路好几个小时了，要是有条明确的出路就好了……”

source: "Look! It's a taxi!"
target: “看，有出租车！”

source: "Whoa! This is a lifesaver. Can you drive us to the nearest exit?"
target: “哇，救命了！能载我们去最近的出口吗？”

source: Do you have some ORE?!
target: 你们有矿石吗？！

source: "Uh... no. Do you take credit cards?"
target: “呃……没。刷卡行吗？”

source: ...I guess.
target: 应该是吧

source: "Man, driving a taxi in a cave? How did you end up in this line of work? It's so disruptive!"
target: “洞里开出租车？怎么干上这行的？也太颠覆传统了！”

source: Some rascals forced me into it in exchange for my ore. Now this is my life... my punishment... forever.
target: 几个混蛋，拿它来换我的矿，逼我干的。现在，这就是我的生活……我的惩罚……永远。

source: "Whoa, bummer... can you turn the radio on? Thanks."
target: “哇，真惨……能开个收音机吗？谢谢。”

source: Ore was his favorite thing in the world... until someone made him an offer he couldn't refuse.
target: 矿石，本是他最爱的东西……直到有人，开出了无法拒绝的条件。

source: Now he drives the dark streets of the caves, reminiscing about the good ol' times, when life was simpler and full of ore.
target: 如今，他驶过洞穴的黑暗街道，追忆从前：生活简单，矿石满满。

source: For he is now trapped in...
target: 因为，他如今被困在……

source: "TAXI PURGATORY: You Just Can't Say 'No' to a Taxi License"; coming soon to a theater near you!
target: 《出租车炼狱：没人能对出租车执照说“不”》，即将在您附近的影院上映！

source: Go spelunking
target: 探索洞穴

source: Woohoo, time to explore a dark cave with your best friends! What could be better?
target: 好耶，跟最好的朋友，一起探索黑暗洞穴！还有比这更棒的吗？

source: Here, have +N2 HYPE from all the HYPE of exploring caves. Because this will surely be a fun-filled experience... right?
target: 喏，洞穴探险够刺激，你获得了 +N2 热度。这肯定是趟充满乐趣的旅程……对吧？

source: So we're just visiting a random cave? Why? You guys know we don't have to stop at EVERYTHING we see on the road, right?
target: 所以，就随便找个洞钻？为什么？路上看见什么都要停一下，也没这必要吧？

source: Cheer up, Polly. Exploring a cave will be fun! It'll be full of new smells and tight spaces to get stuck in!
target: 开心点，波莉，探洞多好玩！有新气味，还有能把自己卡住的窄缝！

source: You start walking through the dark, damp caverns.
target: 你们走进黑暗潮湿的洞穴。

source: As you get deeper, light becomes a scarce resource that keeps getting scarcer.
target: 越往里，光就越稀少，越来越稀少。

source: It slowly gets harder to recognize what's a path and what's a dead end.
target: 渐渐地，分不清哪里有路，哪里是死胡同。

source: You make a right, two lefts, another right...
target: 右转，左转两次，再右转……

source: I don't know about this, fam. Aren't we going too far into this dumb cave?
target: 不好说啊，各位。这破洞，是不是钻得太深了？

source: Remember, we'll eventually need to get out.
target: 别忘了，总得出去的。

source: No. You're too invested now. You need to keep going...
target: 不行，已经走到这份上了，必须继续……

source: ...although, as you traverse all kinds of turns and passages, you wonder just what you're expecting to find.
target: ……可穿过一条条弯道与岔路，你又忍不住想，究竟指望找到什么。

source: Maybe the usual thing... some sort of conflict that forces you to make a choice.
target: 也许，还是老一套……遇到点矛盾，逼你选个选项。

source: Yes, something like that...
target: 对，大概就是这样……

source: And so, you eventually find a fork that begs for a choice:
target: 于是，终于遇上了一个需要选择的岔路口：

source: Should you turn left or right?
target: 往左，还是往右？

source: Left
target: 左边

source: Right
target: 右边

source: Uhm... Usually the options you have to choose from are more... how would you put it? Colorful.
target: 嗯……通常，选项会更……怎么说呢？丰富多彩一点。

source: Left or right.
target: 左，或者右。

source: It feels a bit basic.
target: 有点太简单了。
