target: 嗯……通常，选项会更……怎么说呢？丰富多彩一点。

source: Left or right.
target: 左，或者右。

source: It feels a bit basic.
target: 有点太简单了。

source: But oh well... onto the climactic outcome of this situation...
target: 不过算了……接下来，该到这件事的高潮结局了……

source: Climactic outcome happening... NOW!
target: 高潮结局，即将发生……就是现在！

source: Hmmm... the cave just... keeps going.
target: 嗯……洞穴只是……仍在延伸。

source: You're definitely not used to this.
target: 这可真不习惯。

source: And then...
target: 然后……

source: Left
target: 左边

source: Right
target: 右边

source: Again with this "Left or Right" thing?
target: 又是“左还是右”？

source: It's not even remotely funny this time.
target: 这回，真是半点都不好笑。

source: (Not that it was funny last time.)
target: （也不是说上回好笑。）

source: Again with this "Left or Right" thing?
target: 又是“左还是右”？

source: It's not even remotely funny this time.
target: 这回，真是半点都不好笑。

source: (Not that it was funny last time.)
target: （也不是说上回好笑。）

source: I don't know bros... I think we've gone a bit too deep.
target: 不好说啊，兄弟们……是不是走得有点太深了。

source: Yeah, Scott's right.
target: 嗯，斯科特说得对。

source: They're not wrong.
target: 他们没有错。

source: But you don't want to admit that you are completely lost now.
target: 可你不愿承认，自己彻底迷路了。

source: We're completely lost, aren't we?
target: 我们完全迷路了，对吧？

source: So I guess going back is just as good as going forward.
target: 所以，往回走，跟往前走，也没什么区别。

source: *sigh*
target: *叹息*

source: You just need to keep walking... maybe you'll get to the other side.
target: 继续走就是……也许，能到另一头。

source: The cave didn't look so big from the outside.
target: 从外面看，洞明明没这么大。

source: If you just keep walking...
target: 只要继续走……

source: Some more...
target: 再走一点……

source: Until...
target: 直到……

source: Right
target: 右边

source: Left
target: 左边

source: Huh, that one felt a bit weird.
target: 嗯，刚才那个，感觉有点奇怪。

source: Like... not completely right.
target: 好像……不太对劲。

source: You're feeling a bit dizzy.
target: 你有点晕了

source: Huh, that one felt a bit weird.
target: 嗯，刚才那个，感觉有点奇怪。

source: Like... not completely right.
target: 好像……不太对劲。

source: You're feeling a bit dizzy.
target: 你有点晕了

source: The caves go on and on forever: the same claustrophobic walls, all damp and hard.
target: 洞穴无穷无尽，洞壁始终一样逼仄，潮湿又坚硬。

source: It almost feels as if they're slowly closing in on you.
target: 仿佛正慢慢向你挤过来。

source: This doesn't feel good.
target: 感觉不太好

source: Common sense should tell you not to keep going.
target: 常识告诉你，不该再继续。

source: But you have this basic instinct that you can't stop now.
target: 可本能又说，不能停。

source: Even if the walls keep closing in on you, slowly but steadily.
target: 哪怕洞壁，正缓慢而坚定地不断挤近。

source: At some point you can't comfortably walk at your full height.
target: 渐渐地，连直起身子走路，都很困难。

source: You need to bend your back a bit...
target: 你得弯点腰……

source: Soon you're almost crouching...
target: 很快，几乎蹲着走……

source: Before you realize it, you're crawling...
target: 不知不觉，已经开始爬了……

source: Into narrower and narrower cavities...
target: 钻进越来越窄的缝隙……

source: This is not going to end well; and yet, it doesn't feel like you have a choice.
target: 这不会有好结果，可你又觉得，自己没得选。

source: Unless you...
target: 除非……

source: Keep going deeper.
target: 继续往下走

source: Keep going deeper.
target: 继续往下走

source: Bros, are we sure about this? If we keep going, I might get stuck.
target: 兄弟们，确定吗？再往前，我可能要卡住了。

source: Scott isn't wrong. You're also starting to have difficulty breathing.
target: 斯科特说得对，你也开始呼吸困难。

source: Still...
target: 可是……

source: Just... keep going...
target: 只管……继续走……

source: Bros, are we sure about this? If we keep going, I might get stuck.
target: 兄弟们，确定吗？再往前，我可能要卡住了。

source: Scott isn't wrong. You're also starting to have difficulty breathing.
target: 斯科特说得对，你也开始呼吸困难。

source: Still...
target: 可是……

source: Just... keep going...
target: 只管……继续走……

source: What the fu...?
target: 搞什……？

source: The narrow passage has suddenly opened into... something else.
target: 狭窄的通道，忽然通向了……另一种地方。

source: As you crawl out of it, you find yourselves in a hallway.
target: 爬出来，你们发现，自己站在走廊里。

source: It looks like a non-descript hotel hallway, except there's no doors.
target: 像一条平平无奇的酒店走廊，只有一点：没有门。

source: Just the hallways... going and going.
target: 只有走廊，无止境地延伸。

source: Something's wrong, bros... listen.
target: 兄弟们，不对劲……听。

source: I don't hear anything, boo.
target: 什么也没听见，哥们儿。

source: Exactly: there's no noise AT ALL.
target: 就是，半点声音都没有。

source: It's true: the space seems huge, yet there's not one single noise. Not a vermin crawling, or some water running in the distance... nothing.
target: 没错。空间仿佛很大，却一丝声响也没有。虫子爬行，远处水流……全没有。

source: Going back is outright impossible. The crawlspace from which you emerged is legitimately tiny.
target: 回去不可能了，刚钻出的缝隙，小得可怕。

source: It actually took Scott some time to get out, and it doesn't look like he could get back in there.
target: 斯科特好不容易才挤出来，看样子，根本钻不回去。

source: But these hallways seem to lead nowhere at all.
target: 可走廊，好像也哪儿都不通。

source: They all look the same: going and going. Sometimes there's a turn, but there doesn't seem to be any logic to them.
target: 全都一个样，不断延伸。偶有转弯，也看不出任何规律。

source: You all wonder what this place is. Is this still the cave? It's lit by some white lights that make the whole thing look a bit like a hospital. Who even put them here?
target: 你们纳闷，这是哪儿，还在洞里吗？白色灯光，让四周像间医院。谁装的灯？

source: Stupid cave... how do we even know that we're not going in circles? These halls all look the same.
target: 破洞……走廊都一样，怎么知道，我们是不是在绕圈？

source: Maybe we could leave a mark!
target: 留个记号呢？

source: Oh, good idea. Pass me a marker.
target: 好主意，给我支记号笔。

source: Scott gives Polly a marker. She writes "STUPID CAVE" on a wall.
target: 斯科特递过记号笔，波莉在墙上写下：“破洞”。

source: Now if we stumble upon this again, we'll know we've gone in circles.
target: 再碰见这儿，就知道是在绕圈了。

source: But as she finishes, you hear a sudden noise. The walls rumble.
target: 刚写完，一声异响传来，墙壁隆隆震动。

source: What was that?!
target: 什么声音？！

source: NO TIME TO THINK! RUN!
target: 没空想了！快跑！

source: You run as fast as your sore legs let you. Polly and Scott do the same, the echo of your frantic steps filling the halls.
target: 你拖着酸痛的腿，拼命跑。波莉和斯科特也一样，慌乱的脚步声，在走廊中回荡。

source: And yet, you're sure there are more steps echoing:
target: 可你肯定，还回荡着别的脚步：

source: Someone else's steps.
target: 另一个人的脚步。

source: You keep taking turns until you face a choice.
target: 你们接连拐弯，直到又要做出选择。

source: Go upstairs.
target: 上楼去

source: Look back.
target: 回头看

source: Go downstairs.
target: 下楼去

source: As you climb the stairs, you realise what a dumb choice this was. Why upstairs? It only slows you down.
target: 爬楼时，才发现这选择多蠢。干吗上楼？只会拖慢速度。

source: But on the other hand, at least going upstairs feels like you're getting closer to wherever an exit might be.
target: 可另一方面，至少往上，感觉离出口更近。

source: After climbing a few stairs, you get to a different floor. The halls all look all the same; except...
target: 爬过几段楼梯，又到了一层。走廊看着一模一样，除了……

source: Fuck it. You need to see what's after you.
target: 去他的，必须看看，后面追的是什么。

source: You start turning your head, though that forces you to stop for a split second.
target: 你开始转头，不得不停下短短一瞬。

source: WHAT ARE YOU DOING, YOU DUMBASS?! QUICK! COME ON!
target: 干吗呢，蠢货？！快！走啊！

source: Polly grabs your arm and pulls you toward the stairs. You're so stressed, you can hardly tell if you're going up or down.
target: 波莉一把抓住你，往楼梯拉。你紧张得，连上下楼都分不清。

source: You can only think about what you were starting to glimpse out of the corner of your eye: a grotesque silhouette charging violently towards you.
target: 脑子里全是，刚从眼角瞥见的东西：一个畸形身影，正疯狂扑来。

source: As you race downstairs (or is it upstairs?), you're putting all your focus into trying to make sense of what little you got to see.
target: 一边往下跑——还是往上？——你一边竭力理解，那一闪而过的东西。

source: Before you can think too much about it, you reach a different floor.
target: 还没想明白，已到了另一层。

source: The halls all look the same; except...
target: 走廊看着一模一样，除了……

source: You rush downstairs.
target: 你们冲下楼。

source: Going down is good... You can run way faster than if you were running upstairs.
target: 往下好，跑得比往上快得多。

source: Although...
target: 可是……

source: ...do you really want to keep going deeper? Wherever an exit might be, it feels unlikely it'd be further down.
target: ……真要继续深入？不管出口在哪儿，总不太可能，还在更下面。

source: Before you can think too much about it, you reach a different floor.
target: 还没想明白，已到了另一层。

source: The halls all look the same; except...
target: 走廊看着一模一样，除了……

source: They're all covered in a dense fog.
target: 四处浓雾弥漫。

source: You can hardly see your own hands, let alone Polly and Scott, who have become mere silhouettes.
target: 连自己的手都看不清，更别说波莉和斯科特，只剩模糊的影子。

source: Guys, are y'all okay?
target: 各位，没事吧？

source: Yes.
target: 没事。

source: Good, good.
target: 好，那就好。

source: Following your voice, Polly finds you amidst the fog.
target: 波莉循着声音，在雾里找到了你。

source: Scott?
target: 斯科特?

source: Yeah!
target: 在！

source: Great.
target: 太好了。

source: Wait.
target: 慢着

source: What?
target: 什麽?

source: (That voice... Scott's voice is coming from your left, right?)
target: （那声音……斯科特的声音，是从你左边传来的，对吧？）
怎么……？

source: (Look to your right.)
target: （看右边。）

source: Scott's silhouette is there... and it's definitely not where the voice is coming from.
target: 斯科特的影子在那儿……绝不是声音传来的方向。

source: Bros...? I can hear you, but I can't see where you are. There's too much fog.
target: 兄弟们……听得到，可看不见你们在哪儿。雾太浓了。

source: (Ugh, this is seriously creeping me out, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.)
target: （%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，这下真吓到我了。）

source: (Is the silhouette some sort of trick, or is that voice trying to lure us away from the real Scott?)
target: （影子是假的，还是那声音，想把我们从真正的斯科特身边引走？）

source: Bros? I can't hear you! Please, bros... I'm getting scared.
target: 兄弟们？听不见你们了！拜托……我有点害怕。

source: (I don't know, the voice seems like it's trying to pull our heartstrings to convince us. It's a bit suspicious.)
target: （声音听着，像在打感情牌骗我们。挺可疑的。）

source: (Sure, but if the "real Scott" is the silhouette in the fog, then why isn't he saying anything at all? It's weird.)
target: （可要是雾里那个影子，才是真正的斯科特，为什么一声不吭？也很怪。）

source: (Oof... you choose if we should go towards the voice or the silhouette, OK?)
target: （唉……跟声音，还是跟影子，你来选，行吗？）

source: (This is too weird, and I just couldn't bear the weight of the consequences.)
target: （太诡异了，我真承受不了选错的后果。）

source: The Silhouette.
target: 影子。

source: The Voice.
target: 声音。

source: It's the silhouette, you're almost sure. The voice is just too suspicious.
target: 应该是影子，几乎可以肯定。声音太可疑了。

source: As you get closer to the silhouette, Scott is indeed there!
target: 走近影子，斯科特果然就在那儿！

source: Bros! There you are! I was scared for a bit!
target: 兄弟们！你们在这儿！刚才真有点怕了！

source: It's okay, boo. The important thing is that we're all together again.
target: 没事，哥们儿。最重要的，是又在一起了。

source: And yet... you can't completely brush off the idea that Scott has a slightly different vibe to him...
target: 可你始终挥不掉一个念头……斯科特给人的感觉，有些不一样了……

source: It's almost as if this isn't YOUR Scott.
target: 仿佛，这不是你们的斯科特。

source: But surely it's just these fucking caves messing with your head big time.
target: 可肯定只是这破洞，把你的脑子搅乱了。

source: Unless...
target: 除非……

source: No! You can't let the caves get to your head.
target: 不行！不能让这破洞影响自己。

source: And what's the point of worrying about this now? It won't solve anything.
target: 再说，现在担心有什么用？什么也解决不了。

source: It's the voice, you're almost sure. The silhouette is too suspicious, so quiet and all.
target: 应该是声音，几乎可以肯定。那影子静悄悄的，实在可疑。

source: As you follow the source of the voice, you eventually find Scott not too far from where you were!
target: 循声找去，你们终于在不远的地方，找到了斯科特！

source: Bros! There you are! I was scared for a bit!
target: 兄弟们！你们在这儿！刚才真有点怕了！

source: It's okay, boo. The important thing is that we're all together again.
target: 没事，哥们儿。最重要的，是又在一起了。

source: And yet... you can't completely brush off the idea that Scott has a slightly different vibe to him...
target: 可你始终挥不掉一个念头……斯科特给人的感觉，有些不一样了……

source: It's almost as if this isn't YOUR Scott.
target: 仿佛，这不是你们的斯科特。

source: But surely it's just these fucking caves messing with your head big time.
target: 可肯定只是这破洞，把你的脑子搅乱了。

source: Unless...
target: 除非……

source: No! You can't let the caves get to your head.
target: 不行！不能让这破洞影响自己。

source: And what's the point of worrying about this now? It won't solve anything.
target: 再说，现在担心有什么用？什么也解决不了。

source: So you choose to focus on getting out of here.
target: 所以你选择专注于离开这里。

source: You keep walking through the fog for what feels like entire hours.
target: 雾里走个不停，仿佛好几个小时过去了。

source: It's so dizzying that soon you feel like the mist is slowing you down, as though you're dragging your feet through a swamp.
target: 头昏眼花，渐渐觉得，雾也在拖住脚步，像跋涉沼泽。

source: It's like one of those dreams where you're in a hurry, and yet, no matter how fast you try to run, you move incredibly slow.
target: 就像梦里，明明急得不行，可无论多拼命跑，还是慢得可怕。

source: The only solace is that your choices about which path to take were already so random that seeing nothing changes very little.
target: 唯一安慰的是，反正原先也在乱选路，看不见，也差不了多少。

source: There's a downside, though:
target: 不过，也有坏处：

source: Sometimes you can perceive silhouettes not too far from you.
target: 偶尔，不远处能看见影子。

source: Most of them are unmoving, which unsettles the three of you. They look like they're just there, standing... looking at you.
target: 多数一动不动，令你们三个不寒而栗。仿佛就站在那里……看着你们。

source: The most unnerving ones are probably the ones behind you. Soon you realize they're ALWAYS behind you.
target: 最可怕的，恐怕是身后的那些。很快，你就发现，它们永远在身后。

source: They look as still as the other ones, but after a while you realize they must be moving -- because they're always there, no matter how far you walk.
target: 看着与其他影子一样静止，可渐渐明白，它们一定在动：不管走多远，它们都还在。

source: A long time passes. At some point, you feel like the fog is seeping into your brain.
target: 过了很久，雾仿佛开始渗进脑子。

source: Bros, I'm getting tired. Should we sit and rest for a bit?
target: 兄弟们，累了，能坐下来歇会儿吗？

source: I don't know about that. Those silhouettes seem to be following us. Maybe resting isn't the best option.
target: 不好说，那些影子，像在跟踪我们。休息恐怕不是好选择。

source: I get it, really; but if we keep going on like this, I'll faint at any moment. Whatever happens will happen, but we won't have any energy left to do anything about it.
target: 我明白，真的。可再这么走，随时会晕。该发生的还是会发生，到时，却连应付的力气都没了。

source: Also, if they wanted to harm us, they could've done it already, couldn't they?
target: 再说，真想害我们，早动手了，不是吗？

source: Maybe... I don't know.
target: 也许吧……不知道。

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?

source: Rest.
target: 休息。

source: Keep walking.
target: 继续走

source: You settle on resting.
target: 你们决定休息。

source: You all sit against the hall wall. Polly offers to keep watch while you and Scott sleep.
target: 大家靠墙坐下。波莉说，她来守着，你和斯科特睡会儿。

source: This might be the only upside of this fog: falling asleep is easy when you're surrounded by a confounding mist that blocks most of the already-faint light.
target: 浓雾，或许只有这点好处：本就微弱的光，大多也被遮住，迷迷糊糊，很容易睡着。

source: You have comforting dreams. You dream of times where you weren't trapped in a cave.
target: 梦里让人安心，梦到还没困在洞里的日子。

source: You dream of the outside, a concept that by now feels like a mythical place of fairytales.
target: 梦见“外面”，如今，那已经像童话里的神秘国度。

source: A place full of things you dearly miss now: clean air, bright light, natural noise; the sky, the sun.
target: 那里有好多你想念的东西：清新的空气，明亮的光，自然的声响，天空，太阳。

source: A time when you and your friends were having a fun road trip, with no worries in your heart.
target: 那时，你和朋友们开开心心地公路旅行，无忧无虑。

source: Before you can find some kind of comfort in this dream, you wake up.
target: 还没来得及从梦里得到安慰，你醒了。

source: As your eyes open, the sudden realization of the caves rushes back into your mind like a bitter punishment:
target: 眼睛睁开，身在洞穴的现实，像苦涩的惩罚，一下涌回脑海：

source: You remember that those times are gone. The caves are your life now.
target: 那些时光，已经过去。洞穴，才是如今的人生。

source: And yet... something has changed.
target: 可是……有些变化。

source: The fog is no more. It's totally gone, as if it were nothing more than a bad dream. You've finally regained vision.
target: 雾没了，彻底消失，仿佛只是一场噩梦。你终于又能看清。

source: It'd be good news, if it wasn't for a detail that you can't unsee now...
target: 本该是好消息，要不是，眼前有个让你再也无法忽略的细节……

source: Polly isn't wrong: It's better to keep walking.
target: 波莉说得对，还是继续走。

source: While it's true that the silhouettes could have already harmed you if they wanted to, they're still incredibly threatening.
target: 虽说真想伤人，它们早能动手，可那些影子，仍威胁十足。

source: There's this unavoidable feeling that they're patiently waiting; looking for an opening.
target: 你总觉得，它们在耐心等着，等一个破绽。

source: You can't risk it, no.
target: 不能冒险，不行。

source: You walk for several more hours.
target: 又走了几个小时。

source: The three of you hold hands, afraid of getting lost.
target: 怕走散，你们三个手牵着手。

source: This idea reminds you of Scott, and the choice you made earlier.
target: 这让你想起斯科特，还有之前做的选择。

source: No, no: you shouldn't think about that. It's nothing. Scott got lost for a few minutes, and you found him; it's all okay.
target: 不，不该想。没事，斯科特只走散了几分钟，又找回来了。一切都好。

source: And yet... for a split second, your head is swamped by terrible thoughts.
target: 可刹那间，可怕的念头，又淹没了脑子。

source: A whisper that tells you to connect this to the fact that it was Scott who suggested that you all rest, maybe to create an opening for the silhouettes.
target: 心里一个声音说，想想看：提议休息的是斯科特，会不会，就是为了给那些影子制造机会。

source: It's most likely a bunch of nonsense. You don't know if resting would leave you at the mercy of the silhouettes.
target: 多半是胡思乱想。你根本不知道，休息会不会让自己任影子摆布。

source: You don't even know if the silhouettes could or would harm you! Scott is just exhausted! This is all in your head!
target: 甚至不知道，影子能不能、会不会伤人！斯科特只是太累了！全是你想多了！

source: As you brush off these thoughts, you realize that something is changing:
target: 甩开这些念头，才发现，有什么变了：

source: Finally, the fog seems to recede, step by step. You regain some vision as you advance.
target: 雾终于一点点退去。你们越往前，越能看清。

source: It'd be good news if it wasn't for a detail that you can't unsee now...
target: 本该是好消息，要不是，眼前有个让你再也无法忽略的细节……

source: Okay, this is NOT fun.
target: 好吧，这可一点都不好玩。

source: Does this mean we're walking in circles? You said if we stumbled upon the sign you left, that's what it'd mean!
target: 所以我们是在绕圈吗？你说过，要是又碰上你留下的记号，就说明我们在绕圈！

source: No, Scott. This means this place is definitely and deeply fucked up.
target: 不是，斯科特。这说明这地方绝对他妈的有大问题。

source: Well, now we know we're totally surrounded by a stupid cave.
target: 行吧，现在可以确定，我们彻底被这个蠢洞穴困住了。

source: The stupidest cave.
target: 蠢得不能再蠢了。

source: You keep walking: what else is there left to do, anyway?
target: 你们继续往前走。反正还能干什么呢？

source: You walk... and walk... and walk...
target: 你们走啊……走啊……走啊……

source: After a while, doors start to appear.
target: 不知过了多久，门开始出现了。

source: You keep walking through countless doors, down different halls.
target: 你们穿过一道又一道门，走进一条又一条不同的走廊。

source: Many of them look exactly the same.
target: 其中许多看起来一模一样。

source: Sometimes "STUPID CAVE" is written all over the walls; sometimes it's not.
target: 有时，墙上到处写着“蠢洞穴”；有时又没有。

source: One hall is tilted slightly to the left. It throws you a bit off balance.
target: 有条走廊略微向左倾斜，让你有点站不稳。

source: There's a hall that looks totally normal, but there's a low-yet-clear static noise in the background.
target: 有条走廊看起来完全正常，四周却一直响着微弱而清晰的沙沙杂音。

source: Then, there's the hall filled with windows.
target: 接着，你们来到一条满是窗户的走廊。

source: This one gives you hope, as windows mean you might gain more perspective of where you are.
target: 这让你们燃起一丝希望。有窗户，说不定就能看清自己究竟在哪儿。

source: This is before you look through the window, though.
target: 当然，那是在你往窗外看之前。

source: What you see is a huge lightwell: other walls with windows, the same as the windows you're looking through.
target: 窗外是一口巨大的采光井。对面的墙上也全是窗户，和你正往外看的这扇一模一样。

source: You can surmise a massive building with this sort of internal opening, only letting you look at other walls.
target: 你大致能想象出，这是一座中央留有天井的庞大建筑，而你只能看见它内侧的墙。

source: Looking up and down doesn't help either. The walls go on for so long that it's impossible to see if there's sky above you, or where the floor is.
target: 往上看、往下看也没用。墙壁延伸得太远，根本望不见上方的天空，也看不到下方的地面。

source: Just walls.
target: 只有墙。

source: And that's not even the worst part.
target: 这甚至不是最糟糕的部分。

source: In some of the windows across the lightwell, you see silhouettes.
target: 采光井对面的几扇窗里，出现了人影。

source: They're too far away to make anything of them; but they're there.
target: 距离太远，你看不清那是什么。但它们确实在那里。

source: They're only in some of the windows, but it's hard not to notice them, as they don't move.
target: 只有几扇窗里有人影，可你很难不注意到它们，因为它们一动不动。

source: They're still, just there. You can't see them clearly, but you have this chilling feeling that they're quietly looking at you.
target: 它们就那样静静地待在那里。你看不清它们，却有种毛骨悚然的感觉：它们正默默地看着你。

source: It feels like a quiet mockery, a frustrating reminder that you're trapped in this cave. An oppressive reminder that claws at your throats.
target: 仿佛是一种无声的嘲弄，反复提醒你们：你们被困在这个洞穴里了。那股令人绝望的压迫感，像利爪一样扼住你们的喉咙。

source: WHAT ARE YOU LOOKING AT?! SAY SOMETHING!
target: 看什么看？！说句话啊！

source: Polly goes on like that for a while until she gets tired.
target: 波莉就这样喊了一阵，直到喊累了。

source: One might think the sight of other people would bring some solace to being this lost, yet it does the opposite.
target: 迷路到这个地步，看见其他人，本该多少是个安慰。可此刻却恰恰相反。

source: You can't help but feel like it's your fate to remain lost and alone in here forever.
target: 你忍不住觉得，自己注定要永远迷失在这里，孤独一人。

source: And yet, eventually, the strangest thing happens: one of the doors leads to the most obvious, yet unexpected hall...
target: 然而，最奇怪的事终于发生了：其中一扇门后，竟是一条再寻常不过、却又最出乎意料的通道……

source: ...for once you cross it, you're once again walking through a cavernous tunnel.
target: ……跨过门槛后，你们又走进了一条洞穴隧道。

source: There's hope in this, you all agree. Nothing about it proves you're an inch closer to escaping this place, but at least it looks like a cave again.
target: 你们一致觉得，这总算带来了一点希望。虽然没有任何迹象表明你们离出口近了哪怕一寸，但至少这里又像个洞穴了。

source: You feel a bit more confined in a cave, but a little less trapped in an endless bad dream.
target: 洞穴让人觉得更狭窄，却也让你稍微摆脱了那种困在无尽噩梦中的感觉。

source: You do the only thing you've been doing for the last several hours: keep walking.
target: 你们继续做着过去几个小时里唯一在做的事：往前走。

source: You walk, and you walk, and you walk...
target: 走啊，走啊，走啊……

source: Until you stumble upon two paths.
target: 直到面前又出现两条路。

source: Despite the fact that you've been stuck in this predicament so many times since the fateful moment you stepped into these caves...
target: 自从踏进洞穴的那一刻起，你们已经无数次陷入这样的困境……

source: ...you have the strong feeling that there's something final in this choice.
target: ……但这一次，你强烈地感觉到，这个选择将决定一切的终局。

source: And although this brings you some relief, it also means that now, more than ever, you must choose wisely.
target: 这让你稍感宽慰，也意味着：此刻，你比以往任何时候都更不能选错。

source: Climb the stairs.
target: 爬上楼梯。

source: Take the door that has no business being here.
target: 走那扇根本不该出现在这里的门。

source: You start walking up the stairs, maybe towards the exit?
target: 你们开始沿楼梯往上走。也许出口就在上面？

source: This nugget of hope might be worth the -N2 STAMINA from the exercise of going upwards.
target: 爬楼梯要消耗 -N2 体力。但为了这点希望，也许值得。

source: But after five minutes, Polly implodes.
target: 可才过了五分钟，波莉就崩溃了。

source: NO. I REFUSE.
target: 不行。我不干了。

source: Here we go again: five hours of climbing some eerie stairs.
target: 又来了。接下来又得在这诡异的楼梯上爬五个小时。

source: No way! This girl isn't falling for this! Not this time!
target: 想都别想！老娘才不上这个当！这回绝不！

source: I'm sure the other option won't involve climbing any fucking stairs, at least!
target: 起码另一条路用不着爬什么狗屁楼梯吧！

source: As if this stupid fuckin' cave hadn't punished us enough!
target: 这破洞穴还嫌折腾我们折腾得不够吗！

source: You know I always blindly follow your dumb choices, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, but not today!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你也知道，你做什么蠢决定我都闭着眼跟。可今天不行！

source: Nah, I'm out! Come with me or don't!
target: 不，我不奉陪了！要不要跟我走，随你们！

source: Polly starts to walk down the stairs.
target: 波莉转身往楼梯下走去。

source: You and Scott are left a bit confused, not knowing what to do.
target: 你和斯科特有点懵，一时不知道该怎么办。

source: I don't think we should split up, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. We should go after her.
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，我觉得咱们不该分头行动。去追她吧。

source: I guess.
target: 也是。

source: But I don't have a good feeling about that door.
target: 可我总觉得那扇门不太对劲。

source: Lemme go after her. I'll convince her and be back in a minute, okay?
target: 我去追她吧。我劝劝她，一会儿就回来，好吗？

source: Sure, bro!
target: 当然,兄弟!

source: I'll be here. I'm sure she'll come around once she thinks it over.
target: 我就在这儿等。她想明白了，肯定会回心转意的。

source: See ya in a minute.
target: 一会儿见。

source: You start going down the stairs.
target: 你开始往楼梯下走。

source: It takes you some time, but you finally find Polly. She's sitting on a step. She doesn't look great.
target: 走了一阵，你终于找到了波莉。她坐在一级台阶上，脸色不太好。

source: Fuck this... fuck this...
target: 妈的……妈的……

source: What's up, Polly?
target: 波莉，怎么了？

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!

source: I might be too tired, but... weren't we climbing the stairs for, like, five minutes before I left?
target: 也许是我累糊涂了，可……我走之前，我们是不是才往上爬了五分钟左右？

source: Kind of, yes.
target: 差不多，是啊。

source: Then how come I've been walking for at least fifteen minutes now and there's no sight of the foot of the stairs?!
target: 那我怎么往下走了起码十五分钟，还连楼梯底下的影子都见不着？！

source: You realize she's right. You should've reached the bottom of the stairs by now.
target: 你意识到她说得没错。按理说，你们早该走到底了。

source: Fuckin' stupid cave. You distract me for one minute and the foot of the stairs vanishes?!
target: 该死的蠢洞穴。一分钟没盯着你，楼梯底下就没了？！

source: At this point, there's not much that can surprise me, really...
target: 都到这份上了，真没什么事能让我意外了……

source: Stupid cave...
target: 破洞穴……

source: Wait.
target: 等等。

source: Where's Scott?
target: 斯科特呢？

source: He's waiting for us where we were. I told him to wait while I went after you.
target: 还在刚才那儿等我们。我说我去追你，让他留在原地等。

source: NO.
target: 不。

source: She stands up and starts rushing upstairs. You follow her.
target: 她猛地站起来，往楼梯上冲。你跟了上去。

source: You run up the stairs as fast as you can.
target: 你们拼命往上跑。

source: Time goes by. You keep telling yourself Scott might be on the next turn.
target: 时间不断流逝。你一遍遍告诉自己，也许下一个拐角就能看到斯科特。

source: Deep down, you fear that whatever happened to the foot of the stairs might have happened to him as well.
target: 可你心底害怕，楼梯底端遭遇的那种事，也发生在了他身上。

source: You keep running upstairs... and upstairs... and upstairs...
target: 你们不停地往上跑……往上跑……往上跑……

source: After what feels like an hour, Polly stops. She's quiet, but there's an intensity to her... the weight of an insurmountable worry.
target: 仿佛过了整整一个小时，波莉停了下来。她一言不发，却浑身紧绷，沉重的忧惧压得她喘不过气。

source: SCOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOTT!
SCOOOOOTT!
target: 斯科特——！

source: SCOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOTT!
SCOOOOOOOOOOOTT!
No, no, no...
target: 不，不，不……

source: Polly sits on one of the steps. She looks defeated.
target: 波莉坐到一级台阶上，像是彻底垮了。

source: This can't be happening...
target: 不可能……不该这样的……

source: This is just a bad dream...
target: 这只是一场噩梦……

source: Scott...
target: 斯科特……

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, why didn't you stop? There were some caves over there!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，怎么没停车？那边有洞穴诶！

source: Eh... but we visited some caves recently, didn't we?
target: 呃……我们最近不是刚去过洞穴吗？

source: You guys know we don't have to stop at EVERYTHING we see on the road, right?
target: 你们知道的吧？路上也不是见到什么都得停下来看看啊。

source: Yeah, but I don't know... It's what we do!
target: 也是，可是……我也说不上来。咱们不就一直这样吗！

source: Sure, but so what? This isn't some game with unavoidable rules! We can just choose NOT to stop there.
target: 是啊，那又怎样？又不是在玩什么必须遵守规则的游戏！我们完全可以选择不停啊。

source: What were we going to do there, anyway? Wander around the cave until we got lost?
target: 再说，去那儿干吗？在洞里瞎转，转到迷路？

source: It doesn't sound fun, buddy. C'mon, I'm sure next stop we find will be way cooler!
target: 听着就没劲，伙计。走啦，下一站肯定比这儿酷多了！

source: Oh, okay!
target: 哦，那好吧！

source: You drive past the caves.
target: 你们开车驶过了洞穴。

source: As you pass the cave entrance, you can't shake off a strong feeling that there's something intensely off-putting about the cave. You can't stop looking at it...
target: 车子经过洞口时，一种强烈的不安始终挥之不去。那个洞穴让你说不出地反感，你却忍不住一直看着它……

source: You feel... you feel like you were there recently...
target: 你觉得……觉得自己不久前才去过那里……

source: Or... like you're inside there right now, even as you look at the entrance.
target: 又或者……此时此刻，你依然身在其中，哪怕你正望着它的入口。

source: Are we sure...?
target: 真要进去……？

source: Yeah! Look: it even has your name on it!
target: 当然！你看，上面还写着你的名字呢！

source: I'm not sure if that's a good thing, buddy.
target: 伙计，我可不确定这算什么好事。

source: This looks exactly like my bedroom door from when I was a kid. The resemblance is uncanny.
target: 这和我小时候的卧室门一模一样。像得让人发毛。

source: This cave has been mocking us for hours and hours now... but this? This feels personal.
target: 这破洞穴已经耍了我们好几个小时了……可这回？这回摆明了是冲着我来的。

source: It's impossible to stop yourselves from losing -N2 MIND from this malicious twist.
target: 面对这充满恶意的新花样，你们还是没能避免损失 -N2 头脑。

source: But as off-putting as the door is, its strange nature lures you in strongly.
target: 这扇门令人不安，可它的诡异之处又有种强烈的吸引力。

source: Wanna go first, Polly? It's your door after all.
target: 波莉，你想先进去吗？毕竟这是你的门。

source: I guess it makes sense for me to go first, right?
target: 也是，该我先进去，对吧？

source: ...Right?
target: ……对吧？

source: She opens the door and immediately freezes up.
target: 她推开门，瞬间僵在了原地。

source: This... this is my childhood bedroom, guys.
target: 各位……这、这是我小时候的卧室。

source: But... how?
target: 可……怎么可能？

source: It's not even in this realm. My room -- if it even still looks like this -- should be in the Human Realm.
target: 它都不在这个世界里。我的房间——如果现在还长这样的话——应该在人类世界才对。

source: Polly is so shocked that she doesn't realize other key details.
target: 波莉太过震惊，连其他关键的细节都没注意到。

source: For one, there are windows.
target: 比如，这里有窗户。

source: And these aren't like the windows from before, no. These windows lead to a calm, beautiful night sky.
target: 这些窗户和刚才的不同。窗外是一片宁静而美丽的夜空。

source: Cautiously, the three of you enter the room, mesmerized by the stars, lured into the promise of a reality outside the caves.
target: 你们三人小心地走进房间。星光让人着迷，窗外仿佛就是洞穴之外的真实世界，引得你们不由自主地靠近。

source: You wonder if what's outside the window is truly the outside.
target: 可你不禁怀疑，窗外真的是外面吗？

source: You're still inside the caves, aren't you? Like Polly said, her old room isn't even in this realm.
target: 你们明明还在洞穴里，不是吗？就像波莉说的，她以前的房间甚至不在这个世界。

source: As you walk closer, the door closes behind you.
target: 你们越走越近，身后的门关上了。

source: The noise is almost imperceptible: too low to truly disrupt the dead quiet of the night, but loud enough to make you turn around.
target: 关门声轻得几乎难以察觉，微弱得打不破夜晚的死寂，却又足以让你们回头。

source: In doing so, Polly notices the other significant detail:
target: 这一回头，波莉发现了另一个重要的细节：

source: There's a small lump under the bedsheets, only a fraction of what must be the back of a head sticking out.
target: 被子下有小小的一团隆起，边缘只露出一点点像是后脑勺的部分。

source: As unlikely as it sounds, there's only one explanation that makes a sliver of sense...
target: 听起来再不可能，也只有一个解释勉强说得通……

source: No... no...
The back of the head moves gently; the peaceful cadence of someone breathing as they sleep.
target: 那颗脑袋轻轻起伏，节奏安稳而规律，像是熟睡之人的呼吸。

source: What the fuck is this...?
target: 这他妈到底是怎么回事……？

source: I... I want to leave, guys. I won't let this cave mess with me anymore... yes, let's leave.
target: 我……我想走了，各位。我不会再让这个洞穴耍我了……对，我们走。

source: You follow Polly as she goes back to the door, disturbed but ready to take the stairs; but there are no cavernous tunnels beyond the door anymore.
target: 波莉不安地走回门口，你们跟在后面，准备回去爬楼梯。可门外已经不再是洞穴隧道。

source: There's a muted grey hall. The entire hallway seems to be made entirely out of hard, solid concrete.
target: 那是一条灰暗的走廊。整条走廊似乎都由坚硬厚实的混凝土浇筑而成。

source: Only one thing disturbs the absoluteness of the cement: papers and sticky notes hanging in messy displays on the wall.
target: 只有墙上凌乱贴着的纸张和便签，打破了这片纯粹的水泥世界。

source: You get a closer look.
target: 你凑近看了看。

source: It's... it's Polly.
target: 是……是波莉。

source: There are sticky notes filled with tidbits about Polly. Stuff like "Ghost girl that's a party animal".
target: 便签上记满了关于波莉的零碎设定，比如“热衷派对的幽灵女孩”。

source: And there are dozens of sketches. Some bear a very slight resemblance to Polly, while others land much closer to the Polly you know.
target: 还有几十张草图。有些只是依稀像波莉，有些则更接近你熟悉的那个波莉。

source: What... what is all this? I... I can't...
target: 这……这些都是什么？我……我没法……

source: Before she can finish that thought, a figure appears from the other end of the hallway.
target: 她还没说完，走廊另一端就出现了一个身影。

source: It looks blurred, undefined... It makes you feel strange.
target: 那身影模糊不清，没有明确的轮廓……让你觉得很不对劲。

source: You should not be here.
target: 你们不该来这里。

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, why didn't you stop? There were some caves over there!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，怎么没停车？那边有洞穴诶！

source: Eh... but we visited some caves recently, didn't we?
target: 呃……我们最近不是刚去过洞穴吗？

source: You guys know we don't have to stop at EVERYTHING we see on the road, right?
target: 你们知道的吧？路上也不是见到什么都得停下来看看啊。

source: Yeah, but I don't know... It's what we do!
target: 也是，可是……我也说不上来。咱们不就一直这样吗！

source: Sure, but so what? This isn't some game with unavoidable rules! We can just choose NOT to stop there.
target: 是啊，那又怎样？又不是在玩什么必须遵守规则的游戏！我们完全可以选择不停啊。

source: What were we going to do there, anyway? Wander around the cave until we got lost?
target: 再说，去那儿干吗？在洞里瞎转，转到迷路？

source: It doesn't sound fun, buddy. C'mon, I'm sure next stop we find will be way cooler!
target: 听着就没劲，伙计。走啦，下一站肯定比这儿酷多了！

source: Oh, okay!
target: 哦，那好吧！

source: You drive past the caves.
target: 你们开车驶过了洞穴。

source: As you pass the cave entrance, you can't shake off a strong feeling that there's something intensely off-putting about the cave. You can't stop looking at it...
target: 车子经过洞口时，一种强烈的不安始终挥之不去。那个洞穴让你说不出地反感，你却忍不住一直看着它……

source: You feel... you feel like you were there recently...
target: 你觉得……觉得自己不久前才去过那里……

source: Or... like you're inside there right now, even as you look at the entrance.
target: 又或者……此时此刻，你依然身在其中，哪怕你正望着它的入口。

source: Rescue trapped people
target: 救出被困人员

source: Spook people by posing as ghosts
target: 假扮幽灵吓人

source: You get a moment alone with Polly and Scott and pitch your sheet ghost idea to them. They're immediately onboard.
target: 你趁旁边没人，把披床单扮鬼的点子告诉了波莉和斯科特。他们立刻举双手赞成。

source: You spy your first victim laying flowers on three graves. You sneak up behind the gravestones, wait for the right moment, and pounce!
target: 你们发现了第一个目标：有人正在三座坟前献花。你们悄悄绕到墓碑后，瞅准时机，猛地跳了出来！

source: BOO!
target: 哇！

source: AWOOOO! I'm a ghost!
target: 嗷呜——！我是鬼！

source: Eh, close enough.
target: 呃，也差不多吧。

source: The mourner seems unphased, though.
target: 可那位扫墓人似乎毫无反应。

source: Awooo?
target: 嗷呜？

source: I think they can't hear us, buddy...
target: 伙计，我觉得人家听不见我们……

source: ...or even see us, for that matter.
target: ……准确地说，连看都看不见。

source: As you look at your cottonish ghost hands, you realize you're truly gone. You're no longer the center of your own story, but a witness to the world you've left behind.
target: 你低头看着自己棉布做的幽灵双手，意识到自己真的已经不在了。你不再是自己故事的主角，只能旁观那个被你留在身后的世界。

source: And this is how your road trip comes to an end... a game over of sorts.
target: 你们的公路旅行就这样结束了……也算是一种游戏结束吧。

source: But life must continue, even if you are no more.
target: 可即使你们已经不在，生活仍要继续。

source: Another start; a new journey in this never-ending loop of road trips.
target: 又一次启程。在永无止境的公路旅行循环中，一段新的旅途开始了。

source: This catches you off-guard: life repeats, but now you're a quiet witness; a reluctant outsider.
target: 这让你措手不及。生活再次上演，可你成了沉默的旁观者，被迫置身事外。

source: Life looks so strange when seen from the sidelines...
target: 站在一旁看着生活，竟是如此陌生……

source: It's you there, but it's also not you? Such a strange feeling.
target: 那里的明明是你，却又不是你？感觉真奇怪。

source: You look at your friends: they aren't talking anymore.
target: 你看向朋友们。他们也不再说话了。

source: Like you, they're quiet bedsheet ghosts, looking at these other versions of you all, the ones who get to go on wacky misadventures.
target: 和你一样，他们成了沉默的床单幽灵，望着另一个版本的你们——那些还能经历各种荒唐冒险的你们。

source: In time, these alternate versions of you also reach the graveyard. In their ignorant bliss, they too decide to prank people by posing as ghosts. If only they knew...
target: 过了一阵，另一个版本的你们也来到了墓地。他们什么都不知道，乐呵呵地决定假扮幽灵捉弄别人。要是他们知道就好了……

source: Is this it? Is this some kind of endless purgatory for the sin of a dumb prank gone wrong?
target: 就只能这样了吗？就因为一次搞砸了的蠢恶作剧，你们就要永远困在这种炼狱里？

source: No! You want it all back! You miss your life; your road trip; all the memories you were building together!
target: 不！你想把一切都找回来！你想念自己的生活，想念公路旅行，想念你们一起创造的那些回忆！

source: But how? How can you break this weird curse?
target: 可是该怎么办？怎样才能打破这个诡异的诅咒？

source: Use your newly-acquired ghost powers to intervene with the living and stop them from making the same mistake you did!
target: 用刚获得的幽灵之力干涉活人的世界，阻止他们重蹈你们的覆辙！

source: Take the bedsheet off to get your corporeal form back! It makes no sense, but it's so simple it has to work!
target: 脱掉床单，变回有血有肉的自己！虽然毫无道理，可这办法简单得让人觉得肯定行！

source: Yes! Ghost powers!
target: 没错！幽灵之力！

source: But... how?
target: 可……怎么用？

source: You focus as hard as you can. If you weren't covered in a bedsheet, everyone would see you making a holding-in-a-fart face.
target: 你拼命集中精神。要不是披着床单，大家准能看到你那张憋屁似的脸。

source: C'mon, you can do it! Focus! Burn that -N2 MAGIC if necessary, but FOCUS!
target: 加油，你能行的！集中精神！哪怕消耗 -N2 魔力也在所不惜，给我集中精神！

source: You extend your ghostly, cotton hand... AND REACH SCOTT'S HAND!
target: 你伸出棉布做的幽灵之手……碰到了斯科特的手！

source: Wooo!
target: 呜!

source: What happened, buddy?
target: 怎么了，伙计？

source: I got the chills!
target: 我打了个寒战！

source: It was almost as if... as if an invisible hand was holding me back from taking the ghost costumes...
target: 刚才就好像……好像有只看不见的手，拦着我去拿扮鬼的服装……

source: Eh... it's probably nothing.
target: 呃……应该没什么吧。

source: ...unless it's a force beyond our understanding trying to communicate with us to stop us from doing this prank because something horrible will happen if we do.
target: ……除非是某种超出我们理解的力量在试着联系我们，阻止我们恶作剧，因为真这么干就会出大事。

source: It could totally be that!
target: 完全有可能！

source: Thanks, force-bro! That was swell of you!
target: 谢啦，神秘力量老兄！你人真好！

source: Yeah, that strange entity (whatever it is) has surely gained +N2 SOUL from this good deed.
target: 是啊，那个神秘存在——不管它是什么——做了这么件好事，肯定能获得 +N2 灵魂。

source: So... no ghost prank?
target: 所以……不扮鬼恶作剧了？

source: No ghost prank.
target: 不扮了。

source: As they decide that, a blinding light surrounds you all. You feel a warm, fuzzy feeling inside of you. And then...
target: 他们话音刚落，耀眼的光芒便包围了你们。你心底泛起一阵暖意，浑身舒畅。接着……

source: ...A FLASH!
target: ……白光一闪！

source: When you open your eyes, you're you again! Corporeal-body you!
target: 睁开眼时，你又变回了自己！有血有肉的自己！

source: Goddammit... what a fuckin' trip.
target: 妈的……这趟可真够迷幻的。

source: Yeah, bro. It was really weird seeing ourselves from the outside.
target: 是啊，伙计。从外面看着另一个自己，真是怪透了。

source: But at least it allowed us to learn a valuable lesson.
target: 但至少它让我们吸取了宝贵的教训。

source: That we should never do a sheet ghost prank again?
target: 以后再也别披床单扮鬼吓人了？

source: That I need to do more butt exercises, because now that I've seen it from the outside it turns out my butt isn't buff enough?
target: 我得多练练臀，因为现在亲眼见过才发现，我的屁股还不够结实？

source: No!
target: 不是！

source: That we can't go through life taking it for granted. We have to savor every minute of it!
target: 是不能把活着当成理所当然。我们得好好享受生命中的每一分钟！

source: Oh, okay!
target: 哦，好吧！

source: How do we savor life, though?
target: 可是，要怎么享受生命呢？

source: Well, for starters, we can go get some milkshakes and leave all this purgatory madness behind us!
target: 嗯，先去喝杯奶昔，把这堆炼狱破事抛到脑后吧！

source: Hooray!
target: 万岁!

source: As you leave the graveyard, you can't help but wonder if there are more ghost versions of you all out there, quietly looking at you in their own purgatory loop.
target: 离开墓地时，你不禁想，也许还有其他版本的你们变成了幽灵，困在各自的炼狱循环里，默默地望着你们。

source: You hope they're okay.
target: 希望他们一切都好。

source: Just... take the bedsheet off?
target: 只要……把床单脱下来？

source: Ugh, it's so dumb and it follows no real logic. It's almost like -N2 MIND worth of nonsense!
target: 唉，真够蠢的，一点逻辑都没有。这荒唐劲儿简直能让你损失 -N2 头脑！

source: But desperate times call for desperate measures.
target: 但事到如今，也只能死马当活马医了。

source: You try to take the bedsheet off, but it weighs a ton. It's heavy, almost like it's carrying the weight of all your bad choices. But you must persevere.
target: 你试着脱掉床单，可它重得要命，仿佛你做过的所有错误选择都压在上面。但你不能放弃。

source: You lift as hard as you can with your videogame-playing, unmuscular body. You risk herniating a disk, but you don't give up!
target: 你使出浑身力气，用这副只顾打游戏、没练过肌肉的身体往上掀。哪怕腰椎间盘都快突出了，也决不松手！

source: As the sheet finally lifts over your body and head, a blinding light surrounds you all. And then...
target: 床单终于越过身体，被你从头顶掀了下来。耀眼的光芒包围了你们。接着……

source: ...A FLASH!
target: ……白光一闪！

source: When you open your eyes again, you're you again! Corporeal-body you!
target: 再次睁开眼时，你又变回了自己！有血有肉的自己！

source: You can feel again your flesh, and your bones, and the +N2 STAMINA flowing through your very tangible body!
target: 你又能感受到自己的血肉、骨骼，还有流淌在这副真切躯体里的 +N2 体力！

source: The other versions of you are nowhere to be found. Did they ever exist to begin with?
target: 另一个版本的你们不见了。他们真的存在过吗？

source: Goddammit... what a fuckin' trip.
target: 妈的……这趟可真够迷幻的。

source: Yeah, bro... it was really weird seeing ourselves from the outside...
target: 是啊，伙计……从外面看着另一个自己，真是怪透了……

source: But at least it allowed us to learn a valuable lesson.
target: 但至少它让我们吸取了宝贵的教训。

source: That we should never do a sheet ghost prank again?
target: 以后再也别披床单扮鬼吓人了？

source: That I need to do more butt exercises, because now that I've seen it from the outside it turns out my butt isn't buff enough?
target: 我得多练练臀，因为现在亲眼见过才发现，我的屁股还不够结实？

source: No!
target: 不是！

source: That we can't go through life taking it for granted. We have to savor every minute of it!
target: 是不能把活着当成理所当然。我们得好好享受生命中的每一分钟！

source: Oh, okay!
target: 哦，好吧！

source: How do we savor life, though?
target: 可是，要怎么享受生命呢？

source: Well, for starters, we can go get some milkshakes and leave all this purgatory madness behind us!
target: 嗯，先去喝杯奶昔，把这堆炼狱破事抛到脑后吧！

source: Hooray!
target: 万岁!

source: As you leave the graveyard, you can't help but wonder if there are more ghost versions of you all out there, quietly looking at you in their own purgatory loop.
target: 离开墓地时，你不禁想，也许还有其他版本的你们变成了幽灵，困在各自的炼狱循环里，默默地望着你们。

source: You hope they're okay.
target: 希望他们一切都好。

source: Raise the dead
target: 复活死者

source: YAAAASSS! This place is a snoozefest anyway!
target: 好耶——！反正这地方无聊得要命！

source: I don't know, Polly. Isn't raising the dead, like... a bad thing?
target: 波莉，我有点拿不准。复活死者是不是……不太好啊？

source: No, buddy, it's all A-OK if it's for a good reason, such as having fun.
target: 不会啊，伙计。只要理由正当就完全没问题，比如找点乐子。

source: Oh, okay then!
target: 哦，那就好！

source: As the two of them discuss this, you can't ignore that there's something strange happening: a strong fog that rolls in from time to time.
target: 他俩讨论时，你注意到一件怪事：不时有浓雾涌来。

source: At one point, the mist covers everything, and a strange old woman appears, visibly concerned.
target: 不一会儿，大雾笼罩了一切。一位古怪的老妇人出现在你们面前，神色十分忧虑。

source: You young fools! You're toying with forces you don't understand!
target: 你们这些无知的小辈！竟敢摆弄自己一无所知的力量！

source: This is the Graveyard of Graveyards, a place that transcends time and space; the inevitable graveyard that eventually claims us all.
target: 这里是万墓之墓，超越时空之地。所有人最终都逃不过它，终将在此长眠。

source: Your disrespectful tomfoolery is a desecration of all things sacred in the Graveyard of Graveyards.
target: 你们这般无礼胡闹，是在亵渎万墓之墓的一切神圣之物。

source: This place breathes, this places knows... and this place isn't happy with what you're doing. Stop yourselves before the Graveyard decides to stop you itself.
target: 这地方会呼吸，会感知……它对你们的所作所为很不高兴。趁墓地还没亲自出手制止你们，赶紧收手。

source: I hear you, old lady. I realize now that our actions weren't okay. We understand. Here, let's shake hands as a sign of our understanding.
target: 听到了，老太太。我现在明白，我们这么干不合适。懂了，都懂了。来，握个手，表示我们达成共识。

source: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!!!!
target: 啊啊啊啊啊！！！！

source: Hehe, the hand buzzer: a true classic!
target: 嘿嘿，握手电人器，经典永不过时！

source: C'mon, guys. Let's go before this buzzkill goes back to raining on our parade!
target: 走啦，各位。趁这位扫兴大师还没继续给咱们泼冷水，赶紧撤！

source: You run through the fog until you feel like you've lost the old lady.
target: 你们穿过浓雾跑了好一阵，觉得总算甩掉了那位老妇人。

source: As the fog surrounds you, you begin to lose your sense of space. You feel like you're nowhere.
target: 浓雾环绕着你们，方向和距离渐渐模糊，仿佛你们身处一片虚无。

source: Before you can keep worrying about all this, Polly brings you back to reality.
target: 你还没来得及多想，波莉就把你拉回了现实。

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, my good friend, I appoint you Manager of Raising the Dead!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，我的好朋友，我任命你为复活死者项目经理！

source: Whoa, bro... that's a huge honor.
target: 哇，伙计……这可是莫大的荣誉。

source: It is! Raising the dead is all about technique! But I'm too drunk to decide how we should go about this, so... chop chop!
target: 可不是嘛！复活死人是门技术活！不过我喝多了，拿不定主意该怎么搞，所以……赶紧开工！

source: Yay...? Anyhow, you know what to do: make a choice.
target: 耶……？总之，你知道该干什么：做个选择。

source: Get a shovel and dig up the bodies of those buried long ago, beyond memories... the ones that could have been.
target: 找把铲子，挖出那些早已下葬、连记忆中都不再存在的尸体……那些本可以存在的人。

source: Use the power of the monkey's paw to bring back the person who's closest to you, so you can get back that what was left behind.
target: 借助猴爪的力量，复活与你们最亲近的人，找回曾经失去的一切。

source: Great idea! It's SHOVEL TIME!
target: 好主意！铲子时间到！

source: You dig for hours. Shovel Time is way less fun than it sounds. It predictably drains -N2 STAMINA from you.
target: 你们一挖就是几个小时。“铲子时间”远没听起来那么好玩，毫不意外地耗掉了 -N2 体力。

source: But it might be worth it, because you eventually find a mysterious coffin with a cryptic carving on it that says "REMOVED CHARACTER."
target: 不过也许值得。你们终于挖出了一具神秘棺材，上面刻着一行费解的字：“被删掉的角色”。

source: So mysterious, so meta... you open it and as you do, a blinding light showers you all, imbuing you with the +N2 MIND of a big revelation!
target: 如此神秘，如此打破次元壁……你们打开棺材，耀眼的光芒倾泻而出。恍然大悟的你们获得了 +N2 头脑！

source: Oh, my!
target: 哦,我的天呐!

source: Hey, bro! Welcome!
target: 嘿,哥们! 欢迎光临!

source: Scott, honey, it's you!
target: 斯科特，亲爱的，是你呀！

source: Uh... how do you know my name?
target: 呃……你怎么知道我的名字？

source: It's me! Beatrice, your old friend!
target: 是我呀！比阿特丽斯，你的老朋友！

source: I'm confused.
target: 我有点搞不懂了。

source: About what, silly? You know me. We all went to Spooky Academy together.
target: 不懂什么呀，小傻瓜？你认识我啊。咱们可都是惊悚学院的同学。

source: I'm the uptight-yet-lovable queen bee who sometimes says stingy things because I'm oblivious to the manners of the commonfolk!
target: 我就是那个端着架子却又讨人喜欢的蜂后呀。因为不懂平民的礼节，偶尔说话会有点扎人！

source: ...Polly, what's going on?
target: ……波莉，这是怎么回事？

source: One time we built an empire by selling lemons. Don't you remember, Scott?
target: 有一回，咱们靠卖柠檬建起了一个商业帝国。斯科特，你不记得啦？

source: Didn't I do that with Miranda?
target: 那不是我跟米兰达干的吗？

source: Miranda? Who's Miranda? No, no... you did that with your good friend Beatrice.
target: 米兰达？米兰达是谁？不，不……那明明是你和好朋友比阿特丽斯一起干的。

source: And Polly, what about you? You were always ready to teach me all about peasant stuff, like dating app etiquette!
target: 还有波莉，你呢？你以前总是乐意教我平民的那些事，比如交友软件上的礼仪！

source: And %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! You were there too!
target: 还有 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！你当时也在！

source: Remember that time you wanted to ask me to the Monster Prom, and I fooled you into helping me assassinate the entire water polo team? Good times!
target: 还记得那次吗？你想约我参加怪物舞会，我却骗你帮我暗杀了整支水球队。真是好时光！

source: I think you're confused... all these things you're talking about happened with Miranda. Look, I even have pics.
target: 我想你搞错了……你说的这些事，都是我们和米兰达一起干的。你看，我还留着照片。

source: What's this? Who is this pinkish phony? I was there, not her! Have you forgotten about me? Did you replace me? That stings! We were good friends!
target: 这是什么？这个粉红色的冒牌货是谁？当时在场的是我，不是她！你们把我忘了？找人替代了我？真扎心！我们明明是好朋友！

source: Scott, Polly, c'mon; I'm sure you remember! This can't bee happening...
target: 斯科特，波莉，拜托，你们肯定还记得！怎么会这样……我都要“蜂”了……

source: ...Beatrice?
target: ……比阿特丽斯？

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, why didn't you stop? There was a graveyard over there!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，怎么没停车？那边有个墓地诶！

source: Eh... graveyards are a snooze. And we visited one recently! What's with all these graveyards anyway?
target: 呃……墓地无聊死了，而且咱们最近不是刚去过吗！怎么到处都是墓地？

source: You guys know we don't have to stop at EVERYTHING we see on the road, right?
target: 你们知道的吧？路上也不是见到什么都得停下来看看啊。

source: Yeah, but I don't know... It's what we do!
target: 也是，可是……我也说不上来。咱们不就一直这样吗！

source: Sure, but so what? This isn't some kind of game with unavoidable rules! We can just choose NOT to stop there!
target: 是啊，那又怎样？又不是在玩什么必须遵守规则的游戏！我们完全可以选择不停啊！

source: What were we going to do there anyway? Exhume some old corpses? Raise the dead yet again? That shit is growin' older by the minute!
target: 去了又能干吗？挖点陈年老尸？再复活一次死人？这破点子真是越来越老掉牙了！

source: Nah, hard pass, buddy.
target: 不了，伙计，免谈。

source: C'mon, I'm sure the next stop we find will be much more fun!
target: 走啦，下一站肯定好玩多了！

source: Oh, okay!
target: 哦，好吧！

source: And so, you drive past the graveyard.
target: 于是，你们开车驶过了墓地。

source: As you pass the entrance, you can't shake off a strong, off-putting feeling...
target: 车子经过入口时，一股强烈的不安始终挥之不去……

source: The feeling that you're leaving someone behind, stranded at the graveyard... but who?
target: 你好像把谁抛在了身后，让那人孤零零地困在墓地里……可到底是谁？

source: As hard as you try, you can't remember who that would be... Eh, probably nobody important!
target: 你怎么想也想不起来……嗐，肯定不是什么重要的人！

source: Ah, the monkey's paw. You remember buying it from the weird old man who only spoke in cryptic, vaguely-threatening sentences.
target: 啊，猴爪。你还记得，卖它的是个古怪老头，说起话来总是神神秘秘，隐约带着威胁。

source: This paw comes with immense power. You can use it to wish for whatever you can imagine. But beware...
target: 这只猴爪蕴藏着巨大的力量。只要你想得到，就能用它许愿。但你可要当心……

source: ...Ugh, why do I keep trying? You never give a fuck about these ominous flashbacks!
target: ……唉，我还费什么劲？这些不祥的回忆片段，你他妈从来就没往心里去过！

source: You'll just use the paw's dangerous magic power for something utterly dumb, like getting free drinks or pulling a prank.
target: 你肯定会拿猴爪的危险魔力干些蠢透了的事，比如白嫖酒水，或者搞恶作剧。

source: It's the prank. We're doing the prank thing.
target: 是恶作剧。我们这次要搞的是恶作剧。

source: Fuck you.
target: 去你妈的。

source: The monkey's paw! Are we sure, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? The weird seller said something about it being really dangerous...
target: 是猴爪诶！%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，真要用吗？那个怪怪的卖家好像说过，这玩意儿很危险……

source: Eh, I only remember him saying something about pranks... probably that we should only use the monkey's paw for important stuff... like pranks!
target: 呃，我只记得他说了什么恶作剧……大概是让我们把猴爪用在重要的事上……比如恶作剧！

source: Hmmm... yeah, it was probably that! We're good then!
target: 嗯……对，肯定就是这个意思！那就没问题啦！

source: You use -N2 MAGIC to bring back a dead person who's close to you all... which technically counts as a good deed, right? So, +N2 SOUL for doing a solid for a dead person!
target: 你消耗 -N2 魔力，要复活一位与你们都很亲近的死者……严格来说，这算做好事吧？帮了死者一个大忙，获得 +N2 灵魂！

source: After making your wish, an unsettling amount of dark purple smoke emanates from the paw and seeps into the ground...
target: 许完愿，浓得令人不安的深紫色烟雾从猴爪中涌出，渗入地下……

source: The ground starts vibrating in slow, heavy pulsations, as a deep guttural noise emanates from within it.
target: 地面开始缓慢而沉重地震颤，地下传来低沉的嘶吼。

source: Then, a long charged silence, until...
target: 随后，是一阵漫长而紧绷的寂静，直到……

source: A HAND ERUPTS FROM THE SOIL!
target: 一只手破土而出！

source: Wait... I know that arm...
target: 等等……这条胳膊，我认得……

source: Fuuuck.
Fuck, fuck, fuck.
target: 他妈的,他妈的,他妈的。

source: This is not good... we need to leave.
target: 不妙……我们得走了。

source: But...
target: 可是……

source: NOW!
target: 现在就走！

source: She grabs your and Scott's hands, and you all leave the grave behind as the corpse continues clawing out of the underworld.
target: 她一把抓住你和斯科特的手，拉着你们逃离坟墓。身后，那具尸体还在挣扎着爬出阴间。

source: As you run, you catch a glimpse of the tombstone, appearing through the fog. It's only a split second, but you can't ignore what it says:
target: 奔跑时，你瞥见雾中的墓碑。只有短短一瞬，可上面的名字却清清楚楚：

source: Polina Geist.
target: 波莉娜·鬼斯特。

source: Crash a funeral
target: 闯进葬礼捣乱

source: You find your friends and tell them you plan to crash a funeral. They're immediately onboard!
target: 你找到朋友们，告诉他们你打算去葬礼上捣乱。他们立刻举双手赞成！

source: Ahh, funeral-crashing, one of my favorite pastimes. It's like wedding crashing, but for ghosts, geriatrics, and thrice-widowed girlbosses.
target: 啊，混进葬礼捣乱，我最爱的消遣之一。就跟混进婚礼蹭吃蹭喝一样，只是宾客换成了幽灵、老年人，还有死过三任老公的女强人。

source: You all crash various funerals, wreaking all sorts of mourning havoc. You gain +N2 HYPE from all the havoc wreaked.
target: 你们闯进一场又一场葬礼，闹得各路哀悼人士鸡飞狗跳。这番大闹让你获得了 +N2 热度。

source: There's something strange happening, though... a strong fog that rolls in from time to time.
target: 不过，有件事有些奇怪……不时有浓雾涌来。

source: At one point, the mist covers everything, and a strange old woman appears, visibly concerned.
target: 不一会儿，大雾笼罩了一切。一位古怪的老妇人出现在你们面前，神色十分忧虑。

source: You young fools! You're toying with forces you don't understand!
target: 你们这些无知的小辈！竟敢摆弄自己一无所知的力量！

source: This is the Graveyard of Graveyards, a place that transcends time and space; the inevitable graveyard that eventually claims us all.
target: 这里是万墓之墓，超越时空之地。所有人最终都逃不过它，终将在此长眠。

source: Your disrespectful tomfoolery is a desecration of all things sacred in the Graveyard of Graveyards.
target: 你们这般无礼胡闹，是在亵渎万墓之墓的一切神圣之物。

source: This place breathes, this places knows... and this place isn't happy with what you're doing. Stop yourselves before the Graveyard decides to stop you itself!
target: 这地方会呼吸，会感知……它对你们的所作所为很不高兴。趁墓地还没亲自出手制止你们，赶紧收手！

source: I hear you, old lady. I realize now that our actions weren't okay. We understand. Here, let's shake hands as a sign of our understanding.
target: 听到了，老太太。我现在明白，我们这么干不合适。懂了，都懂了。来，握个手，表示我们达成共识。

source: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!!!!
target: 啊啊啊啊啊！！！！

source: Hehe, the hand buzzer: a true classic!
target: 嘿嘿，握手电人器，经典永不过时！

source: C'mon, guys. Let's go before this buzzkill goes back to raining on our parade!
target: 走啦，各位。趁这位扫兴大师还没继续给咱们泼冷水，赶紧撤！

source: You run through the fog until you end up at someone's eulogies... which, of course, Scott and Polly want to crash too. Nothing is sacred.
target: 你们穿过浓雾，来到一处正在致悼词的葬礼现场……当然，斯科特和波莉也想去捣乱。真是什么都不肯放过。

source: So here you are, in front of the two obvious options when it comes to pranking a funeral...
target: 于是，说到在葬礼上恶作剧，两个再明显不过的选项摆在你面前……

source: The classic of all classics: place a banana peel for someone to comically slip on once the eulogy is done.
target: 经典中的经典：放块香蕉皮，让人在致完悼词后滑个大跟头。

source: Buy a three-person horse costume online and crash the funeral. A horse suddenly crashing overly-serious events is always hilarious.
target: 上网买套能装下三个人的马戏服，闯进葬礼。越是严肃的场合，突然冒出一匹马就越好笑。

source: Banana peel? %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, you're a natural!
target: 香蕉皮？%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你简直是个天才！

source: Go get that banana, you prankster!
target: 去拿香蕉吧，恶作剧大师！

source: You get a banana from the car, throw the banana away (losing -N2 STAMINA), and strategically drop the peel in the best spot possible.
target: 你从车里拿出一根香蕉，把香蕉扔掉——损失 -N2 体力——再把皮精心摆在最合适的位置。

source: As you sneak into the eulogy, you can hear snatches of the priest introducing the eulogies.
target: 你偷偷溜进葬礼现场，断断续续听见牧师在为悼词作开场白。

source: "Losing a loved one is always a tragedy. We can only imagine the weight of bearing the loss of an entire family..."
target: “失去挚爱总是一场悲剧。我们只能想象，失去整个家庭是何等沉重的痛苦……”

source: You can't hear the entire thing, but eventually the priest invites a man to say some words about the departed.
target: 你听不全他的话。过了一阵，牧师请一位男人上前，为逝者说几句话。

source: You're too focused on not getting caught, but you get to hear some stuff, some disconnected sentences here and there:
target: 你忙着躲避旁人的视线，只零零碎碎地听见几句话：

source: "And then there's my little girl... anyone who met her knows that she could light up a room with her smile..."
target: “还有我的小女儿……认识她的人都知道，她的笑容能照亮整个房间……”

source: "...and no matter what, she always found a reason to smile..."
target: “……无论发生什么，她总能找到微笑的理由……”

source: "...oh, God... I miss her smile..."
target: “……天啊……我好想再看看她的笑容……”

source: "...I'm sorry... I'm so sorry..."
target: “……对不起……真的对不起……”

source: By then you've made it back to where Polly and Scott are hiding.
target: 这时，你已经回到了波莉和斯科特藏身的地方。

source: Polly looks somber.
target: 波莉神色黯然。

source: I don't feel like pranking anymore, guys. Let's leave.
target: 各位，我不想恶作剧了。走吧。

source: ...Okay.
%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, can you get the banana peel back? This isn't fun anymore.
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，能把香蕉皮捡回来吗？这已经不好笑了。

source: You sneak back, get the banana peel, and leave. Polly and Scott have already left the funeral, but you can't blame them for not waiting.
target: 你偷偷回去，捡起香蕉皮后离开。波莉和斯科特已经走了，但你没法怪他们没等你。

source: Sigh.
target: 唉。

source: Horse costume? %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, you're a natural!
target: 扮马？%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你简直是个天才！

source: Go get that costume, you prankster!
target: 去拿戏服吧，恶作剧大师！

source: Against all odds, you find a three-person horse costume. It has... six legs? You spend -N2 MONEY on such a weird, rare gem.
target: 你居然真找到了一套能装下三个人的马戏服。它有……六条腿？你花了 -N2 金钱，买下这件罕见的奇葩宝贝。

source: Polly is the horse head. Scott is the horse butt. You are... whatever that middle horse part is supposed to be.
target: 波莉扮马头，斯科特扮马屁股。至于你……就扮中间那段不知道该叫什么的部位吧。

source: As you sneak into the eulogy, you can hear snatches of the priest introducing the eulogies.
target: 你偷偷溜进葬礼现场，断断续续听见牧师在为悼词作开场白。

source: "Losing a loved one is always a tragedy. We can only imagine the weight of bearing the loss of an entire family..."
target: “失去挚爱总是一场悲剧。我们只能想象，失去整个家庭是何等沉重的痛苦……”

source: You can't hear the entire thing, but eventually the priest invites a man to say some words about the departed.
target: 你听不全他的话。过了一阵，牧师请一位男人上前，为逝者说几句话。

source: You're too focused not getting caught, but you get to hear some stuff, some disconnected sentences here and there:
target: 你忙着躲避旁人的视线，只零零碎碎地听见几句话：

source: "And then there's my little girl... anyone who met her knows that she could light up a room with her smile..."
target: “还有我的小女儿……认识她的人都知道，她的笑容能照亮整个房间……”

source: "...and no matter what, she always found a reason to smile..."
target: “……无论发生什么，她总能找到微笑的理由……”

source: "...oh, God... I miss her smile..."
target: “……天啊……我好想再看看她的笑容……”

source: "...I'm sorry... I'm so sorry..."
target: “……对不起……真的对不起……”

source: Polly looks somber.
target: 波莉神色黯然。

source: I don't feel like pranking anymore, guys. Let's leave.
target: 各位，我不想恶作剧了。走吧。

source: ...Okay.
You leave in a silent, respectful trot... it's hard to break character now.
target: 你们沉默而恭敬地迈着小碎步离开……都到这份上了，实在很难不继续演下去。

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, please, stop it.
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，拜托，别闹了。

source: Sorry.
target: 抱歉。

source: You three leave, and it goes without saying that you won't talk about this.
target: 你们三人离开了。心照不宣，谁也不会再提这件事。

source: Watch some tv
target: 看电视

source: You're not quite ready for bed yet, so you decide to watch some TV.
target: 你还不想睡，于是决定看会儿电视。

source: Everything has been weird and off-putting lately. Maybe some TV will numb you for a few hours.
target: 最近的一切都透着古怪，令人不安。也许看几个小时电视，能暂时让脑子麻木一下。

source: First, you check on the reality show where the contestants are tiny people literally trapped inside your TV.
target: 你先看看那个真人秀：参赛者都是被困在你家电视里的小人，字面意义上的。

source: Wow.
target: 哇哦

source: Polly, do you think they're okay?
target: 波莉，你觉得他们还好吗？

source: I think we should try another channel...
target: 我觉得还是换个台吧……

source: You change it to the "Snakes and Ladders" TV adaptation. The ladder is lying dead in a pool of its own... blood?
target: 你换到《蛇梯棋》的电视剧。梯子倒在地上，已经死了，身下流的那滩是……血？

source: The snake holds a gun and looks broken inside.
target: 蛇手里握着枪，一副心如死灰的模样。

source: "My lover, my ladder... you were always so optimistic... so sure that there was a way for us to ascend, to escape this dark pit in which we fell..."
target: “我的爱人，我的梯子……你总是那么乐观……坚信我们终能向上攀爬，逃出这个跌落其中的黑暗深坑……”

source: "But I am a snake; betrayal is in my nature. If you get too close to me, I can't help but take you down... those are rules not even I can break."
target: “可我是一条蛇，背叛是我的天性。你若靠我太近，我就忍不住把你拖下去……这规则，连我也无法违背。”

source: "For this is a world... of SNAKES AND LADDERS."
target: “因为这个世界……只有蛇与梯子。”

source: So, wait... they mentioned a ladder could bring the two lovers together... but one of the lovers was already a ladder themselves? How does that work? This is so inconsistent!
target: 所以，等等……他们说一架梯子能让这对恋人团聚……可其中一个本来就是梯子啊？这算怎么回事？前后完全说不通嘛！

source: I think the show means that we're all either Snakes or Ladders, and we can't escape the nature of who we are.
target: 我觉得这剧是想说，咱们不是蛇，就是梯子。谁都逃不过自己的本性。

source: Which one are you, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? Are you a snake? Or are you a ladder?
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你是哪种呢？你是蛇？还是梯子？

source: The question makes you a bit uncomfortable. What if you're a snake, and it's you who's taken your friends down this weird rabbit hole...?
target: 这个问题让你有点不自在。万一你就是那条蛇，是你把朋友们拖进了这场诡异的怪事里呢……？

source: You try another channel.
target: 你又换了个台。

source: The next channel is the Merkingdom Totally Objective News station.
target: 下一个频道是人鱼王国绝对客观新闻台。

source: TECHNICAL DIFFICULTIES. PLEASE STAND BY.
target: 技术故障，请稍候。

source: Oh... I hope the Merkingdom is okay.
target: 哦……希望人鱼王国没事。

source: Let's not think too much about it... %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, can you change the channel?
target: 别想那么多了……%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，能换个台吗？

source: Stop.
target: 停下。

source: Stop.
target: 停下。

source: Stop.
target: 停下。

source: Stop.
target: 停下。

source: "Stop."
target: “停下。”

source: ...What?
target: ……什么？

source: "Stop."
target: “停下。”

source: I don't like this channel, bros.
target: 我不喜欢这个频道,兄弟们。

source: "Stop. Restart the loop."
target: “停下。重启循环。”

source: "Polly Geist and Chess"
target: “波莉·鬼斯特与国际象棋”

source: "One of Polly's traits is her passion for and mastery of chess."
target: “波莉的特征之一，是热爱国际象棋，并且棋艺高超。”

source: "This serves two main purposes:"
target: “这项设定主要有两个作用：”

source: "First, it builds lore, especially towards her relationship with her mother, Nadja."
target: “首先，补充背景设定，尤其是她与母亲娜佳之间的关系。”

source: "It's a different way of showcasing a mother-daughter relationship, as we discover chess is how Polly connects with her mom, despite having such different personalities."
target: “我们由此得知，尽管母女性格迥异，国际象棋却是波莉与母亲维系感情的纽带。这展现了另一种母女关系。”

source: "Second, it aims to add more depth and texture to the character."
target: “其次，让角色更加立体、丰富。”

source: "Polly is one of the smartest characters, even if she rarely displays this intelligence in conventional ways."
target: “波莉是最聪明的角色之一，只是她很少以常规的方式展现这份聪明。”

source: "She often messes with other characters, effectively outsmarting them in a chaotic way."
target: “她常常捉弄其他角色，以混乱出格的方式在智力上胜过对方。”

source: "But by being bubbly and a party animal, she's often still judged as 'not that smart'."
target: “可因为她活泼开朗，又热衷派对，人们往往还是会觉得她‘没那么聪明’。”

source: "A later reveal of her more stereotypically intellectual passions invites us to reflect on our own judgment of the character."
target: “后来揭示她在传统意义上的智性爱好，便能让我们反思自己对这个角色的判断。”
